records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Egypt was unanimously selected to host the 18th Conference of the Parties (COP18) of the UN Convention to Combat Desertification in 2028.
records.description: Egypt was unanimously selected to host the 18th Conference of the Parties (COP18) of the UN Convention to Combat Desertification in 2028. The selection reflects coordination between the Egyptian Foreign Ministry and the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, the national focal point for the convention. Hosting COP18 will provide Egypt with an international platform to address desertification, land degradation and drought, which are increasingly important to water and food security, particularly in Africa.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Iraq’s Ministry of Construction, Housing and Municipalities and JICA signed an MoU to support strategic water projects in central and sou...
records.description: Iraq’s Ministry of Construction, Housing and Municipalities and JICA signed an MoU to support strategic water projects in central and southern provinces, focusing on improving drinking water infrastructure and ensuring sustainable water services. The agreement builds on previous Japanese cooperation in water-sector surveys and data collection to support better project planning and prioritisation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Construction, Housing and Municipalities

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources organised a two-day symposium in Salalah on water resources sustainability and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources organised a two-day symposium in Salalah on water resources sustainability and climate change, in partnership with Dhofar Municipality, Nama Dhofar Services, UNESCO and other national institutions. The event focused on strengthening water-resource management, climate adaptation, modern technologies, and policies and partnerships to enhance water sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The State of Palestine, led by the Minister of Agriculture, participated in COP17 of the UN Convention to Combat Desertification in Mongo...
records.description: The State of Palestine, led by the Minister of Agriculture, participated in COP17 of the UN Convention to Combat Desertification in Mongolia, highlighting the growing impacts of drought, land degradation and water scarcity on food security and rural livelihoods. Palestine called for stronger drought-risk management through early warning systems, climate-smart agriculture, improved water-use efficiency, drought-tolerant crops, soil restoration and support for farmers and pastoral communities. The delegation also stressed the need for fair and sustainable international financing and partnerships to strengthen resilience and protect agricultural land and natural resources. Palestine further noted that Israeli occupation-related restrictions on access to land and water, damage to agricultural infrastructure and depletion of natural resources exacerbate the impacts of climate-related drought on Palestinian communities.

records.title: Saudi Arabia and Pakistan agreed to strengthen cooperation on food security and agricultural trade, with a target of increasing Pakistan’...
records.description: Saudi Arabia and Pakistan agreed to strengthen cooperation on food security and agricultural trade, with a target of increasing Pakistan’s agricultural and food exports to Saudi Arabia to $3 billion. Priority areas include rice, red meat, fruits and fruit concentrates, green fodder, and water-efficient agricultural technologies. The two sides also agreed to facilitate private-sector partnerships, expand trade and investment in livestock, agri-food processing and rice value chains, and advance water-efficient irrigation initiatives, supporting Saudi Arabia’s food security priorities and Pakistan’s agricultural export growth.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Relizane recorded a significant increase in cereal production, reaching approximately 1.05 million quintals, supported mainly by favorabl...
records.description: Relizane recorded a significant increase in cereal production, reaching approximately 1.05 million quintals, supported mainly by favorable rainfall and improved crop yields. The harvest was collected from around 88,000 hectares, while six new grain storage centres increased local storage capacity from 900,000 to 1.2 million quintals, improving post-harvest management and bringing storage facilities closer to farms. Extensive agricultural equipment was also mobilized to support harvesting, collection, and storage operations.

records.title: Farmers in Rajeb, Ajloun Governorate, are gradually expanding the cultivation of tropical and non-traditional crops such as avocado, mang...
records.description: Farmers in Rajeb, Ajloun Governorate, are gradually expanding the cultivation of tropical and non-traditional crops such as avocado, mango, dragon fruit, custard apple, and Monstera deliciosa after promising results showed their suitability to local conditions. The Agriculture Directorate is monitoring farms and providing technical support on irrigation, fertilisation, pest control, post-harvest handling, and marketing. The initiative aims to diversify agricultural production, provide farmers with higher-value crops and new markets, and improve farm incomes.

records.title: Oman will host the International United Nations Symposium on Water Resources Sustainability in Salalah under the theme “Water and Climate...
records.description: Oman will host the International United Nations Symposium on Water Resources Sustainability in Salalah under the theme “Water and Climate Change,” bringing together experts to discuss sustainable water management and climate resilience. Key topics include drought, floods and salinity risks, desalination and treated-water reuse, improving agricultural water-use efficiency, protecting groundwater, rehabilitating traditional aflaj irrigation systems, and applying AI, remote sensing and hydrological modelling. The symposium aims to share expertise and promote innovative approaches to strengthening water security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a memorandum of understanding with Al-Khatib Company to provide farmers with agricultural machinery an...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a memorandum of understanding with Al-Khatib Company to provide farmers with agricultural machinery and equipment through flexible instalment plans, in coordination with the Agricultural Cooperative Bank. The initiative aims to improve farmers’ access to production equipment, increase agricultural productivity and operational efficiency, reduce costs, and strengthen the competitiveness of agricultural products, supporting sustainable agricultural and economic development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a memorandum of understanding with Saudi and Syrian private-sector groups to study and develop Syria’s...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a memorandum of understanding with Saudi and Syrian private-sector groups to study and develop Syria’s poultry industry and related value chains. The agreement covers the rehabilitation and expansion of poultry farms, hatcheries and slaughterhouses, development of integrated egg and broiler production complexes, food processing, cold storage, marketing and export. It also addresses biosecurity, veterinary health and modern technologies, with the aim of increasing production, improving efficiency and quality, strengthening competitiveness, and opening regional and international markets for Syrian poultry products.

records.title: Egypt is facing increased pressure on its wheat supply chain as escalating Russia-Ukraine attacks on Black Sea ports, vessels, and grain...
records.description: Egypt is facing increased pressure on its wheat supply chain as escalating Russia-Ukraine attacks on Black Sea ports, vessels, and grain infrastructure disrupt shipments and raise global wheat prices. With more than 82% of Egypt’s wheat imports in the first half of 2026 reportedly coming from Russia and Ukraine, the disruptions expose Egypt to significant risks to wheat availability, shipping, and food security.
records.institution: The General Authority for Supply Commodities (GASC)

records.title: Egypt’s agricultural exports have reached approximately 6.8 million tonnes, supported by government measures to improve the competitivene...
records.description: Egypt’s agricultural exports have reached approximately 6.8 million tonnes, supported by government measures to improve the competitiveness, safety, and quality of Egyptian agricultural products and expand access to international markets. The sector is strengthening export quality control through a digital coding and traceability system for farms, while coordination among agricultural quarantine authorities, accredited laboratories, foreign agricultural relations bodies, and the Agricultural Export Council is helping streamline trade procedures and maintain international standards. Citrus accounted for the largest share of exports, followed by fresh potatoes, sweet potatoes, grapes, onions, and beans.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Oman’s Industrial Strategy 2040 is allocating RO 935 million to polymer and packaging projects as part of efforts to strengthen local man...
records.description: Oman’s Industrial Strategy 2040 is allocating RO 935 million to polymer and packaging projects as part of efforts to strengthen local manufacturing, reduce import dependence, and develop circular economy opportunities. The SOHAR Port and Freezone is advancing a polyethylene foam packaging plant with United Packaging Industries, while smart manufacturing and workforce programmes aim to improve efficiency, reduce waste, and create higher-quality employment. The strategy also targets stronger non-oil exports and greater private-sector and foreign investment in manufacturing.

records.title: Saudi Arabia will host the Innovation Driven Water Sustainability Conference (IDWS 2026) in Jeddah, bringing together global water-sector...
records.description: Saudi Arabia will host the Innovation Driven Water Sustainability Conference (IDWS 2026) in Jeddah, bringing together global water-sector leaders, investors, researchers, and innovators to advance sustainable water solutions. The conference will focus on desalination, water reuse, circular systems, AI and digital technologies, agricultural water use, infrastructure, and water quality, with a new focus on water conservation and efficiency. It will also connect innovation with financing and implementation through the Global Prize for Innovation in Water, technical workshops, a water hackathon, and an innovation showcase, supporting Saudi Arabia’s efforts to improve water security, efficiency, and resource sustainability.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al-Mithnab Red Sukkari date variety is leading sales at the local dates season market in Al-Mithnab, capturing the largest market sha...
records.description: The Al-Mithnab Red Sukkari date variety is leading sales at the local dates season market in Al-Mithnab, capturing the largest market share among more than 65 varieties and driving agricultural trade. The season is organised in cooperation with the National Center for Palms and Dates, the Qassim Chamber of Commerce, and local entities. Large shipments are being distributed across Saudi Arabia at moderate prices, alongside popular varieties including Sukkari, Barhi, Sagai, and Medjool.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a memorandum of understanding with Khair Al-Jiyad Cheese Factory to study establishing an integrated p...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a memorandum of understanding with Khair Al-Jiyad Cheese Factory to study establishing an integrated project for feed production and dairy processing. The proposed project would cultivate up to 5,000 hectares of fodder crops using modern center-pivot and linear irrigation systems, linked to feed mills, storage and logistics facilities, dairy farms, and cheese and dairy-processing plants. The project aims to improve resource and water-use efficiency, secure feed supplies for livestock, strengthen local agricultural and dairy value chains, and support sustainable agricultural and food production.

records.title: The Public Authority for Small and Micro Enterprise Development is supporting the development of Yemen’s dairy value chain as part of eff...
records.description: The Public Authority for Small and Micro Enterprise Development is supporting the development of Yemen’s dairy value chain as part of efforts to strengthen local production, create jobs, increase household incomes, reduce dairy imports, and improve food security. Interventions include supporting livestock-owning families, expanding milk production, training local associations in modern dairy processing, providing equipment, and linking producers with processing and marketing opportunities. In Hodeidah, these efforts have significantly increased milk production and enabled thousands of families to sell milk directly to factories, while further initiatives target food-processing training, women and students, research, and the establishment of milk and dairy production centres.
records.institution: Public Authority for Small and Micro Enterprise Development

records.title: The General Authority for Zakat launched an economic empowerment project to support 75 families in beekeeping, honey production, and mark...
records.description: The General Authority for Zakat launched an economic empowerment project to support 75 families in beekeeping, honey production, and marketing in Wasab Al-Safil District, providing 1,875 beehives along with production, processing, packaging, training, and marketing support. Implemented in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries and local agricultural organisations, the project aims to create sustainable income opportunities for poor and vulnerable families, increase honey production, improve product quality, and strengthen access to markets. The initiative also includes forming productive beekeeper groups and providing extension services to improve the sustainability and efficiency of the projects.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Egypt is advancing a $278 million project to produce second-generation bioethanol from sugarcane bagasse, converting a byproduct of sugar...
records.description: Egypt is advancing a $278 million project to produce second-generation bioethanol from sugarcane bagasse, converting a byproduct of sugar processing into a higher-value product while reducing agricultural and industrial waste, environmental impacts, and carbon emissions. The project involves technical testing and feasibility studies, with the Sugar and Integrated Industries Company providing the land and raw materials and preparing supporting infrastructure, while private-sector partners are working on the investment structure, financing, and a long-term offtake arrangement for the ethanol, with production targeted for export to European markets. The initiative supports resource efficiency, waste valorisation, industrial development, and the transition toward lower-carbon production by creating economic value from agricultural residues.
records.institution: The Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and FAO signed a cooperation agreement under the Building Resilience to Cope with Climate Change in Jordan th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and FAO signed a cooperation agreement under the Building Resilience to Cope with Climate Change in Jordan through Improving Water Use Efficiency in the Agriculture Sector (BRCCJ) project to strengthen farmers’ capacity to adapt to climate change through climate-smart farmer field schools and promote water-saving agricultural technologies. The Green Climate Fund-supported project will establish 44 farmer field schools and 44 field days in Madaba, Karak, Tafileh, and Maan, benefiting around 880 farmers, while preparing the groundwork for additional field schools. The initiative builds on previous training of agricultural extension officers and aims to improve water-use efficiency, strengthen food and water security, and build a more climate-resilient agricultural sector in areas affected by water scarcity and climate change.

records.title: Tunisian exporters are diversifying their markets toward Asia and Eastern Europe as Morocco, the main destination for Tunisian Deglet Nou...
records.description: Tunisian exporters are diversifying their markets toward Asia and Eastern Europe as Morocco, the main destination for Tunisian Deglet Nour dates, continues to restrict imports through quotas and authorization requirements amid rising domestic production. Exporters are seeking to expand sales in markets such as Malaysia and Indonesia, where Tunisian Deglet Nour dates already have a strong reputation, while also targeting other Asian countries and Eastern Europe through new distribution capacity in Poland. The shift is also driven by expectations of an earlier date harvest following a hotter-than-usual summer and aims to reduce dependence on the Moroccan market and increase export volumes.

records.title: Emirati agricultural company Al Dahra Holding, through Al Dahra Agriculture Trading, has begun implementing a five-year agreement to supp...
records.description: Emirati agricultural company Al Dahra Holding, through Al Dahra Agriculture Trading, has begun implementing a five-year agreement to supply Egypt with wheat under an arrangement valued at up to $500 million and supported by the Abu Dhabi Exports Office. The agreement aims to strengthen Egypt’s wheat supply-chain buffer and improve resilience against unexpected disruptions in global grain markets. The initiative builds on Al Dahra’s longstanding presence in Egypt and its broader cooperation to strengthen agricultural supply chains and food security.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development signed and supported several financing agreements and development projects in Jordan aimed at strength...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development signed and supported several financing agreements and development projects in Jordan aimed at strengthening economic resilience, infrastructure, industrial competitiveness, and human capital. Key initiatives include approximately AED 1.1 billion (USD 300 million) in budget support, a USD 70 million project to connect industrial cities to the natural gas network, and a USD 40 million programme to develop and equip five government technical schools offering specialisations including agriculture, engineering, construction, tourism, and other fields. The projects are aligned with Jordan’s Economic Modernisation Vision and seek to strengthen fiscal stability, reduce industrial production costs, improve energy infrastructure, develop workforce skills, support employment, and promote sustainable economic growth.

records.title: UAE company begins wheat supplies to Egypt in $500m deal
records.description: Emirati agricultural company Al Dahra Holding, through Al Dahra Agriculture Trading, has begun implementing a five-year agreement to supply Egypt with wheat under an arrangement valued at up to $500 million and supported by the Abu Dhabi Exports Office. The agreement aims to strengthen Egypt’s wheat supply-chain buffer and improve resilience against unexpected disruptions in global grain markets. The initiative builds on Al Dahra’s longstanding presence in Egypt and its broader cooperation to strengthen agricultural supply chains and food security.

records.title: Tissemsilt recorded cereal production of approximately 516,400 quintals, more than double the previous season, from an area exceeding 45,...
records.description: Tissemsilt recorded cereal production of approximately 516,400 quintals, more than double the previous season, from an area exceeding 45,000 hectares. Durum wheat accounted for the largest share of production, followed by barley, soft wheat, and oats. The significant increase was attributed mainly to higher rainfall, while the harvest campaign benefited from the mobilisation of agricultural resources and coordination among farmers and relevant sector organisations. The wilaya also strengthened its grain storage capacity through the commissioning of six new storage centres, each with a capacity of 50,000 quintals, improving post-harvest preservation, storage conditions, and farmers’ access to storage facilities.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The ministry delivered 826 solar-powered streetlights to South Sinai as part of the Green Sharm project, supporting the expansion of rene...
records.description: The ministry delivered 826 solar-powered streetlights to South Sinai as part of the Green Sharm project, supporting the expansion of renewable energy and the transition toward greener and more sustainable cities. The initiative aims to reduce conventional energy consumption and associated emissions while improving lighting services in key areas, remote locations, and Bedouin communities. It also forms part of broader efforts to integrate environmental considerations into local development, including renewable energy, sustainable transport, waste management, water conservation, biodiversity protection, and improved public services. The project reflects Egypt’s use of international partnerships and grants to implement practical low-emission solutions and develop models that could be replicated in other governorates.
records.institution: The Ministry of Local Development and Environment

records.title: The Agricultural Extension and Training Directorate, in cooperation with ACSAD, launched an advanced training programme on irrigation wat...
records.description: The Agricultural Extension and Training Directorate, in cooperation with ACSAD, launched an advanced training programme on irrigation water management using modern technologies. The training focuses on practical crop modelling through AquaCrop, analysis of satellite data using Google Earth Engine, and remote sensing applications to strengthen the capacity of agricultural staff to manage water scarcity and salinity more efficiently. The initiative aims to improve irrigation and crop water-use efficiency, support sustainable management of water and agricultural resources, and strengthen Arab cooperation and knowledge transfer in response to Iraq’s water-related challenges.

records.title: The ministry signed a technical, scientific, and technological cooperation agreement with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones a...
records.description: The ministry signed a technical, scientific, and technological cooperation agreement with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), along with three memoranda of understanding focused on strengthening Iraq’s agricultural sector and addressing desertification. The agreements cover the development of the seed sector, the adoption of salt-tolerant crop varieties, and the introduction of crops better suited to Iraq’s environmental and climatic conditions, with the aim of increasing agricultural productivity, improving crop efficiency, and promoting more sustainable farming systems.

records.title: Estidamah, in cooperation with the Qassim Region branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, conducted two specialised...
records.description: Estidamah, in cooperation with the Qassim Region branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, conducted two specialised workshops to promote modern and sustainable agricultural practices. The first workshop focused on the production, harvesting, and baling of seasonal fodder, with emphasis on improving fodder quality and production efficiency, while the second addressed greenhouse management, crop growth, productivity, and the efficient use of resources in protected agriculture systems. The activities aim to strengthen farmers’ technical knowledge, transfer agricultural expertise, and encourage the adoption of improved practices to enhance production efficiency and resource management.
records.institution: National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The ministry reviewed preparations for the Sudan–Turkey Trade and Industrial Cooperation Forum, which aims to strengthen economic and tra...
records.description: The ministry reviewed preparations for the Sudan–Turkey Trade and Industrial Cooperation Forum, which aims to strengthen economic and trade cooperation by connecting businesses and investors from both countries, promoting investment opportunities, and encouraging private-sector partnerships. Turkey is identified as a strategic partner in Sudan’s reconstruction, particularly in agriculture, energy, mining, and infrastructure, with the forum expected to support investment, expand trade relations, and contribute to Sudan’s economic recovery and reconstruction efforts.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Trade

records.title: Extreme heat, high humidity, and repeated power outages are severely affecting broiler poultry farms in Nabeul Governorate, where electri...
records.description: Extreme heat, high humidity, and repeated power outages are severely affecting broiler poultry farms in Nabeul Governorate, where electricity is essential for ventilation, cooling, and temperature control. Frequent outages lasting several hours are forcing farmers to rely heavily on generators, increasing operating costs and creating additional risks of equipment failure. The combination of extreme temperatures and humidity, which can reach very high levels inside poultry houses, is causing breathing difficulties, animal deaths, and significant declines in production. The sector had already experienced substantial losses during an earlier heatwave, highlighting the need for a strategy to protect poultry production from extreme weather and electricity disruptions.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, in partnership with the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), launc...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, in partnership with the Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA), launched the Climate-Smart Agriculture for Enhancing Productivity in Tunisia (ClimAT) project to promote modern resource management and improve water governance. The project will establish pilot farms equipped with smart irrigation systems, support climate-smart wheat and olive production, strengthen agricultural research and development, modernize infrastructure, and provide training to agricultural stakeholders.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Sonatrach and Eni agreed to expand cooperation on decarbonising Algeria’s oil and gas sector and reducing greenhouse gas emissions.
records.description: Sonatrach and Eni agreed to expand cooperation on decarbonising Algeria’s oil and gas sector and reducing greenhouse gas emissions. The cooperation will focus on reducing gas flaring, recovering and using gas, improving methane monitoring and reduction, enhancing energy efficiency, expanding renewable energy opportunities, exploring carbon capture and storage, and developing forestry projects for natural CO₂ removal. Joint technical assessments, training, field visits, and leak detection and repair activities have already helped identify and reduce emissions across jointly operated upstream assets.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), launched an advance...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), launched an advanced training programme on irrigation water management using modern technologies, including AquaCrop crop simulation, Google Earth Engine, and remote sensing. The programme aims to strengthen agricultural staff capacity to improve irrigation efficiency and address water scarcity and salinity challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is investigating the deaths of small fish observed along parts of the Lebanese coast.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is investigating the deaths of small fish observed along parts of the Lebanese coast. Preliminary findings point to high seawater temperatures and reduced dissolved oxygen in semi-enclosed coastal areas, potentially worsened by pollution, as well as illegal fishing practices. The ministry is coordinating with security authorities and the National Center for Marine Sciences to investigate suspected violations and conduct laboratory tests on fish samples to determine the exact causes.

records.title: The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Development signed a €35 million financial cooperation agreement with Germany, including funding to...
records.description: The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Development signed a €35 million financial cooperation agreement with Germany, including funding to strengthen technical and vocational training and support coastal biodiversity conservation and the blue economy. The coastal component will focus on protecting ecosystems, sustainable natural-resource management, marine research, reducing marine waste and overfishing, and addressing the impacts of climate change and coastal erosion.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Development

records.title: Salalah Free Zone signed an agreement with DuroMENA LLC to develop a US$105 million integrated fertilizer and chemical production complex...
records.description: Salalah Free Zone signed an agreement with DuroMENA LLC to develop a US$105 million integrated fertilizer and chemical production complex in Dhofar, with annual production capacity of up to 100,000 tonnes each of sulfate of potash (SOP) and granular calcium carbonate, alongside specialized chemical products. The project will support high-value crop production by supplying chloride-free fertilizer, while strengthening Oman’s non-oil industrial base, creating employment, expanding exports, and supporting regional fertilizer supply chains across the GCC, India, Southeast Asia, and East Africa. The investment also aligns with Oman Vision 2040 by promoting economic diversification, developing value-added manufacturing, and leveraging Salalah’s strategic port and logistics infrastructure.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

records.title: The EU-funded Agricultural Assistance Programme completed six projects in Tulkarm Governorate, covering livestock, solar-powered groundwa...
records.description: The EU-funded Agricultural Assistance Programme completed six projects in Tulkarm Governorate, covering livestock, solar-powered groundwater wells, and irrigation water infrastructure. The projects support farmers affected by occupation-related attacks and settler violence, aiming to strengthen their resilience, sustain agricultural production, improve resource-use efficiency, and enhance food and water security through longer-term productive investments.

records.title: The Nablus Directorate of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), organized a...
records.description: The Nablus Directorate of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), organized a workshop to introduce farmers and agricultural entrepreneurs to available financing opportunities for developing their projects, improving production, and strengthening their ability to continue operating. The initiative aims to improve access to agricultural finance, support farmers’ resilience, strengthen food security, and contribute to the local agricultural economy.

records.title: Estidamah has developed two new wheat varieties that showed higher yields and improved irrigation water-use efficiency in initial field t...
records.description: Estidamah has developed two new wheat varieties that showed higher yields and improved irrigation water-use efficiency in initial field trials. The varieties produced up to 9.8 and 8.6 tons per hectare, while reducing irrigation water use by 15% and 24.2%, respectively, compared with a widely cultivated commercial variety. The research aims to improve wheat production efficiency, reduce crop losses, and strengthen Saudi Arabia’s food security, with further trials underway to confirm performance under different conditions.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Syrian Grain Establishment announced that Syria has achieved wheat self-sufficiency for the 2026 harvest after state procurement agen...
records.description: The Syrian Grain Establishment announced that Syria has achieved wheat self-sufficiency for the 2026 harvest after state procurement agencies collected approximately 2.72 million tonnes of domestic wheat, exceeding the country’s estimated annual requirement of around 2.55 million tonnes for subsidized flour and bread programmes. The strong recovery was supported by favorable weather conditions, expanded cultivated areas, and agricultural incentives, representing a significant improvement from the previous season when wheat production fell below one million tonnes due to severe drought and economic disruption. The achievement strengthens national food security, reduces dependence on wheat imports, and improves the country’s ability to meet domestic food needs through local production.

records.title: ADAFSA will participate in the Abu Dhabi International Hunting and Equestrian Exhibition to showcase its efforts to protect animal health...
records.description: ADAFSA will participate in the Abu Dhabi International Hunting and Equestrian Exhibition to showcase its efforts to protect animal health, strengthen biosecurity, and ensure sustainable livestock resources. The authority will highlight veterinary, research, regulatory, vaccination, animal identification, feed testing, and livestock breeding services, while raising awareness of zoonotic diseases and the One Health approach. The initiative also promotes veterinary careers among young people and supports food security and livestock sustainability.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Egypt concluded its wheat procurement season with government purchases of around 5 million tonnes, the highest level recorded under the s...
records.description: Egypt concluded its wheat procurement season with government purchases of around 5 million tonnes, the highest level recorded under the state procurement system. Domestic wheat production is expected to exceed 10 million tonnes, supported by a significant expansion in cultivated area, higher-yielding and climate-resilient varieties, improved collection systems, and policies encouraging farmers to sell to the government. Wheat imports are projected to decline to 12.5 million tonnes, while the increased local supply will help strengthen strategic reserves, support the subsidised bread system, and reduce exposure to global price fluctuations and supply disruptions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade

records.title: The Iraqi government approved 350 billion Iraqi dinars (approximately US$267 million) in outstanding 2025 payments owed to farmers nation...
records.description: The Iraqi government approved 350 billion Iraqi dinars (approximately US$267 million) in outstanding 2025 payments owed to farmers nationwide, including 58.6 billion dinars (around US$45 million) allocated to farmers in the Kurdistan Region. The measure aims to settle overdue agricultural dues and provide financial support to farmers, helping strengthen the agricultural sector and its production capacity.

records.title: FAO launched training workshops in Madaba to strengthen farmers’ and local stakeholders’ knowledge on the safe and sustainable use of tre...
records.description: FAO launched training workshops in Madaba to strengthen farmers’ and local stakeholders’ knowledge on the safe and sustainable use of treated wastewater in agriculture. Implemented under the BRCCJ project with support from the Green Climate Fund, the initiative promotes water-use efficiency, climate-smart agricultural practices, and adaptation to water scarcity and climate change. Similar capacity-building activities will be extended to other targeted governorates to strengthen local resilience and sustainable agricultural development.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The National Development Agency (NDA) held economic and investment meetings in Cyprus with the Cyprus Chamber of Commerce and Industry an...
records.description: The National Development Agency (NDA) held economic and investment meetings in Cyprus with the Cyprus Chamber of Commerce and Industry and several Cypriot companies to explore investment opportunities in renewable and alternative energy, particularly solar power and energy-storage systems. The initiative seeks to address electricity supply challenges, diversify Libya’s energy sources, attract investment and technology, and develop more sustainable and reliable electricity solutions to support future development projects.

records.title: Saudi Arabia has updated its executive regulations for the sustainable management of the marine and coastal environment, introducing stri...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has updated its executive regulations for the sustainable management of the marine and coastal environment, introducing stricter controls, prohibitions, and penalties for environmental violations. Fines for failing to contain marine or coastal leaks can reach SAR 5 million, with violators also required to repair damage and pay compensation. The regulations prohibit harmful fishing practices, dumping of untreated wastewater and hazardous materials, damage to sensitive habitats, and other activities that threaten marine ecosystems, while requiring environmental permits for several marine and coastal activities. The measures aim to strengthen environmental compliance and protect marine biodiversity and coastal resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al-Mithnab Dates Season opened with the arrival of the first quantities of Al-Mithnab Al-Hamra dates at the governorate’s central mar...
records.description: The Al-Mithnab Dates Season opened with the arrival of the first quantities of Al-Mithnab Al-Hamra dates at the governorate’s central market, attracting strong interest from traders, consumers, and visitors. The season is supported by the National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD) and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, highlighting the importance of the local date variety to Al-Mithnab’s agricultural identity and economy. Farmers reported high-quality, fully ripened produce and strong demand from the start of the auction.
records.institution: The National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD)

records.title: he Directorate of Agriculture in Deir ez-Zor distributed 25,000 doses of enterotoxemia vaccine to agricultural extension units in Al-Sour...
records.description: he Directorate of Agriculture in Deir ez-Zor distributed 25,000 doses of enterotoxemia vaccine to agricultural extension units in Al-Sour area as part of the Ministry of Agriculture’s free veterinary vaccination programme to protect newborn sheep, prevent disease outbreaks, and reduce livestock losses. Enterotoxemia is a serious bacterial disease affecting sheep and goats, particularly following sudden changes in feed or excessive consumption of energy-rich feed and grains.
records.institution: Directorate of Agriculture in Deir ez-Zor

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) launched the first phase of the Women Farmer Field Schools (FFS) programme under...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) launched the first phase of the Women Farmer Field Schools (FFS) programme under the “Empowering Women Farmers” initiative to strengthen women’s role in sustainable agriculture, food security, and agricultural entrepreneurship. The programme will provide practical, field-based training on sustainable palm management, pest control, irrigation and fertilisation, greenhouse and open-field production, beekeeping, honey production, record-keeping, and farm profitability. Implemented jointly with Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) and FAO, the initiative also aims to expand market opportunities for women farmers and promote knowledge transfer within families and communities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture launched the 17th Agricultural Week at the Baghdad International Fair, bringing together local, Arab, and int...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture launched the 17th Agricultural Week at the Baghdad International Fair, bringing together local, Arab, and international companies to showcase modern machinery, technologies, and inputs for crop and livestock production. The event aims to support the development of the agricultural sector, promote investment and cooperation, improve production efficiency, introduce advanced agricultural technologies, and contribute to sustainable development and national food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with UNDP, the Council for Development and Reconstruction, and the World Bank, launched a US$...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with UNDP, the Council for Development and Reconstruction, and the World Bank, launched a US$18.5 million agricultural grant programme under the GATE project to support farmers, women farmers, cooperatives, and farmers’ associations. Grants will finance climate-smart investments including irrigation and water management, renewable energy, protected agriculture, machinery, post-harvest management, food safety, packaging, marketing, and rehabilitation of damaged agricultural facilities. The initiative aims to restore production affected by the recent war, strengthen farmers’ resilience and livelihoods, improve productivity and competitiveness, and support food security and sustainable agrifood sector recovery.

records.title: The Man-Made River Authority (MMR) temporarily halted water flow along a central pipeline route serving Libya’s Western Mountain region t...
records.description: The Man-Made River Authority (MMR) temporarily halted water flow along a central pipeline route serving Libya’s Western Mountain region to address increasing attacks, damage to mechanical equipment, and illegal connections affecting the regular supply of water. Following an appeal from the MMR, the Office of the Attorney General instructed the Law Enforcement Department to cooperate with the Authority in removing encroachments and restoring the system. Technical teams, supported by law enforcement and the MMR Protection Battalion, are working to remove illegal connections and safeguard the high-pressure pipeline infrastructure, with water flow to be restored once the necessary measures are completed.
records.institution: The Man-Made River Authority (MMR) / Office of the Attorney General

records.title: Credit Oman reported approved credit ceilings of approximately OMR226.6 million and insured sales of OMR191.4 million during the first ha...
records.description: Credit Oman reported approved credit ceilings of approximately OMR226.6 million and insured sales of OMR191.4 million during the first half of the year, with manufacturing accounting for the largest share of both. The agriculture, forestry and fishing sector ranked third, receiving around OMR3.1 million in approved credit ceilings and generating OMR6.2 million in insured sales. The institution continues to provide credit insurance and protection against non-payment and buyer default, supporting Omani exporters and businesses in maintaining operations, entering new markets, and expanding sales.

records.title: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication increased potato seed distribution through its branches and distribution centres follow...
records.description: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication increased potato seed distribution through its branches and distribution centres following a decision to provide potato seeds under a credit-based sales system, with more than 800 tonnes distributed amid strong demand from farmers. The initiative aims to ease farmers’ financial burden and facilitate access to essential agricultural inputs by allowing them to obtain potato seed without immediate full payment, thereby supporting potato production.
records.institution: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication

records.title: The Capital Secretariat of Sana’a, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, launched the first ph...
records.description: The Capital Secretariat of Sana’a, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, launched the first phase of a green belt project by planting 10,000 Sidr trees on the outskirts of Sana’a. The initiative aims to expand green spaces, improve environmental and aesthetic conditions, contribute to a better urban climate, and promote community participation in tree planting.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, together with the local authority in Al-Hodeidah Governorate, launched a proj...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, together with the local authority in Al-Hodeidah Governorate, launched a project to distribute 22 locally manufactured seed sieves and 20 mechanical seeders to multipurpose agricultural cooperative associations across the governorate. The initiative, implemented through Sohool Al-Yemen Company for Agricultural and Fisheries Development and Investment in cooperation with local manufacturers and the General Corporation for Grain Development and Production, aims to improve seed quality, increase farming efficiency, reduce seed losses and production costs, and strengthen agricultural services for farmers.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Veterinary Department, rejected and ordered the return of a 29-ton shipment of frozen buffalo me...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Veterinary Department, rejected and ordered the return of a 29-ton shipment of frozen buffalo meat of Indian origin after determining that it had exceeded half of its permitted shelf-life period, in violation of Iraqi standard specifications. The decision was taken by veterinary authorities at the Trebil border quarantine facility in accordance with national customs law and food safety requirements, highlighting the ministry’s enforcement of import controls to ensure compliance with approved standards and protect food safety.

records.title: Saudi Arabia has achieved self-sufficiency in fresh potato production, with domestic output reaching approximately 623,770 tonnes from 17...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has achieved self-sufficiency in fresh potato production, with domestic output reaching approximately 623,770 tonnes from 17,064 hectares, supporting the expansion of potato processing and frozen potato exports to neighbouring markets. The sector benefits from two annual growing seasons, government support, advanced irrigation technologies, and the Saudi Potato Development Programme established through cooperation with the Netherlands. To conserve water resources, MEWA regulates fresh potato trade through seasonal import and export restrictions, permits, farm registration requirements, and restrictions on exports from areas with vulnerable groundwater reserves.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al-Badayea Dates Market in Qassim Region is experiencing strong commercial activity, supported by high consumer demand, diverse date...
records.description: The Al-Badayea Dates Market in Qassim Region is experiencing strong commercial activity, supported by high consumer demand, diverse date supplies, and active participation from local farmers, marketers, and young entrepreneurs. Operating under the seasonal market framework overseen by the National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD), the market aims to improve marketing efficiency, enhance services, and expand market opportunities for premium local dates, particularly the Sukkari variety. The market also creates seasonal employment and supports youth-led businesses involved in marketing, packaging, and value-added date products, contributing to the local economy while preserving Qassim’s agricultural heritage.
records.institution: The National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD)

records.title: The Directorate General for Studies and Tax Legislation (DGELF) issued four general guidelines establishing flat-rate minimum net income...
records.description: The Directorate General for Studies and Tax Legislation (DGELF) issued four general guidelines establishing flat-rate minimum net income scales for farmers whose agricultural income cannot be determined through regular accounting or supporting records. The scales cover cereals, olive trees, citrus fruits, and vineyards, with assessed income varying according to crop, region, cultivated area, and, for olive production, irrigation method. The framework was developed in consultation with the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries and the Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) and is intended to establish the minimum taxable income for farmers using the flat-rate method. Tax authorities may increase the assessed income where evidence indicates that actual earnings are higher.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of Iraq is developing Al-Shuhaimiya forests in Wasit Governorate under a seed multiplication programme to exp...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Iraq is developing Al-Shuhaimiya forests in Wasit Governorate under a seed multiplication programme to expand the production of seedlings with medicinal, pharmaceutical, and economic value. The initiative includes cultivating specialised fields of coriander, anise, and rosemary, as well as producing seedlings such as rosemary, Christ’s thorn, and lemon eucalyptus in nurseries. The programme aims to diversify plant production, promote medicinal and aromatic plant cultivation, support green investment and sustainable agricultural development, and improve the use and conservation of natural resources.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: be’ah is developing carbon-credit opportunities from greenhouse-gas reductions across its waste-management operations, with landfill gas...
records.description: be’ah is developing carbon-credit opportunities from greenhouse-gas reductions across its waste-management operations, with landfill gas recovery as a key focus. Its Carbon Management Framework covers emissions measurement, reduction projects, carbon-credit registration and verification, and the eventual sale and financial integration of credits. Two landfill gas recovery projects at Al Multaqa and Barka have been registered under the Verra Verified Carbon Standard, while efforts are underway to use recovered methane for electricity generation. The initiative aims to reduce landfill emissions, support renewable energy generation, promote resource recovery, and create potential climate-finance revenues.

records.title: Oman plans to develop a wheat grain storage facility in Ibra, North Al Sharqiyah Governorate, to expand national grain-handling capacity...
records.description: Oman plans to develop a wheat grain storage facility in Ibra, North Al Sharqiyah Governorate, to expand national grain-handling capacity and improve the storage and distribution of wheat. The project forms part of broader efforts to strengthen food supply systems, reduce risks associated with dependence on imported food, and improve grain logistics and infrastructure. The investment also complements Oman’s wider development of milling, port, agricultural, and transport infrastructure, while potentially supporting the country’s role in regional grain trade and distribution.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Jordanian-Palestinian Agricultural Products Marketing Company signed agreements to export and market 1,700 tonnes of Palestinian agri...
records.description: The Jordanian-Palestinian Agricultural Products Marketing Company signed agreements to export and market 1,700 tonnes of Palestinian agricultural products, including avocados, lemons, dates, and other produce, to markets in Jordan and the UAE. The agreements aim to open new marketing channels, increase demand for Palestinian products, improve market access and returns for farmers, and strengthen partnerships that support the resilience and continued production of Palestinian farmers. The initiative also seeks to expand export volumes, diversify targeted agricultural products, and increase the contribution of agriculture to the Palestinian economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture (Palestine), through the Tulkarm Directorate of Agriculture, provided 400 metres of 6-inch metal water pipes...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture (Palestine), through the Tulkarm Directorate of Agriculture, provided 400 metres of 6-inch metal water pipes and four valves to rehabilitate a groundwater well serving farmers in Shuweika. The support, worth around €12,000, was funded by GIZ and the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) under a rural livelihoods project. The intervention aims to restore damaged water infrastructure, improve access to irrigation water, strengthen agricultural production, and enhance the resilience and livelihoods of farmers affected by land destruction and attacks in the area.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Qassim Region has recorded date production of around 584,128 tons, supported by approximately 10.87 million palm trees across more than 1...
records.description: Qassim Region has recorded date production of around 584,128 tons, supported by approximately 10.87 million palm trees across more than 13,400 agricultural holdings, highlighting the region’s leading role in Saudi Arabia’s date production and marketing. The National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD), in cooperation with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, is supporting seasonal date markets across the region to regulate sales and purchases, strengthen farmers’ and producers’ market access, expand marketing opportunities, and stimulate economic activity in the palm and date sector.
records.institution: The National Center for Palms and Dates (NCPD) / Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture – Qassim Branch

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the Ministry of Culture completed the second phase of a greening initiative in His...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the Ministry of Culture completed the second phase of a greening initiative in Historic Jeddah, with volunteers planting around 3,000 seedlings to expand green spaces, improve the urban landscape, and promote environmental sustainability at cultural and heritage sites. The initiative supports the targets of the Saudi Green Initiative while encouraging community participation and raising awareness of vegetation conservation and sustainable environmental practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is advancing clean energy infrastructure while integrating environmental protection, res...
records.description: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is advancing clean energy infrastructure while integrating environmental protection, resource efficiency, waste management and biodiversity conservation across its projects. Key initiatives include the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, which is planned to exceed 8,000 MW by 2030, and the Hatta pumped-storage hydroelectric power plant, supporting Dubai’s clean energy and energy-storage goals. DEWA also conducts environmental assessments and monitoring, promotes circular economy practices, and supports biodiversity through mangrove planting and beach-cleaning campaigns. These efforts contribute to reducing emissions, conserving natural resources, strengthening climate resilience, and supporting Dubai’s transition toward a low-carbon and sustainable economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) concluded the “Livestock and Processing Industries” track of the third edition of...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) concluded the “Livestock and Processing Industries” track of the third edition of the Mustadeem programme, in collaboration with the Sharjah Department of Agriculture and Livestock. The four-day programme, held at the Mleiha Dairy Farm and Factory and a wheat farm in Sharjah, provided students from Grades 6 to 8 with hands-on training in livestock production, veterinary care, biosecurity, food quality, dairy processing, and supply chains.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held an interactive farmer workshop in Dibba, Fujairah, to discuss farmers’ production, marketing,...
records.description: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held an interactive farmer workshop in Dibba, Fujairah, to discuss farmers’ production, marketing, irrigation, and agricultural service needs ahead of the new growing season. The workshop introduced NAC initiatives aimed at improving resource-use efficiency, strengthening agricultural value chains, and supporting sustainable local production, including the Integrated Agricultural Centres project, the Al Hamraniyah Centre in Ras Al Khaimah, and the UAE Good Agricultural Practices (UAE G.A.P.) programme. The UAE G.A.P. framework supports improved product quality, food safety, traceability, production efficiency, market access, and stronger links between farmers and supply chains. The initiative also supports the UAE’s Plant the Emirates programme and broader national food-security objectives by encouraging modern technologies, sustainable agricultural practices, and greater farmer participation in agricultural development.

records.title: The Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park (SRTI Park) is strengthening Sharjah’s innovation ecosystem by connecting researcher...
records.description: The Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park (SRTI Park) is strengthening Sharjah’s innovation ecosystem by connecting researchers, startups, industry, investors, and government entities to develop, test, and commercialise practical solutions in food security, agriculture, water management, clean energy, and the circular economy. Its initiatives include precision agriculture, AI-enabled farming, smart water management and reuse, renewable energy, hydrogen, energy storage, emissions reduction, and resource recovery technologies. The ecosystem aims to accelerate technology transfer and move innovations from research and pilot stages into scalable commercial applications, while Sharjah Next – Sustainability will provide a platform for collaboration, investment, pilot projects, and deployment of sustainable technologies.
records.institution: Sharjah Research, Technology and Innovation Park (SRTI Park)

records.title: Egypt procured 4.72 million tonnes of wheat from the domestic harvest, an increase from the previous season, as part of efforts to reduce...
records.description: Egypt procured 4.72 million tonnes of wheat from the domestic harvest, an increase from the previous season, as part of efforts to reduce dependence on imports and strengthen national food security. The government is supporting domestic wheat production through higher procurement prices, improved seeds, expanded cultivation on reclaimed land, and modern farming practices such as laser land levelling. When durum wheat purchased by pasta factories and wheat retained for seed is included, total procurement reportedly exceeded the 5 million-tonne target, supporting Egypt’s longer-term goal of achieving greater wheat self-sufficiency for the subsidized bread programme.
records.institution: The Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade

records.title: Egypt's Qena, Kafr El-Sheikh develop local climate action plans through 2035
records.description: The ministry is developing local climate action plans for Qena and Kafr El-Sheikh Governorates through 2035, in cooperation with GIZ, the National Solid Waste Management Programme, and the EU Green Initiative. The plans will integrate climate adaptation and emissions reduction into local development and investment planning, with measures covering climate-smart agriculture, energy and water efficiency, circular economy, solid waste management, governance, and monitoring. They will also identify priority projects and potential sources of international climate finance to support implementation and strengthen local capacity to address climate risks.
records.institution: The Ministry of Local Development and Environment
