records.title: FAO, in partnership with Water, Energy and Environment Specialists (WEE Pros) and with support from the Green Climate Fund (GCF), launche...
records.description: FAO, in partnership with Water, Energy and Environment Specialists (WEE Pros) and with support from the Green Climate Fund (GCF), launched training workshops in Tafilah under the BRCCJ project to strengthen the capacity of local administrations, civil society organisations, and private-sector representatives to address climate change and improve water-use efficiency in agriculture. The workshops focus on climate-change policies, adaptation and mitigation, climate-smart agriculture, sustainable water-resource management, and integrating climate considerations into local planning, supporting Jordan’s transition toward a more resilient and sustainable agricultural sector.

records.title: Kuwait Customs seized 2,236 items of subsidized and rationed food supplies from six containers at Shuwaikh Port that were being prepared...
records.description: Kuwait Customs seized 2,236 items of subsidized and rationed food supplies from six containers at Shuwaikh Port that were being prepared for export to Sri Lanka. The shipment included subsidized milk, flour, oil, ghee, lentils, pasta, rice, sugar, and tomato paste. The seizure is part of efforts to protect Kuwait’s food security, safeguard strategic stocks of essential commodities, ensure subsidized products reach their intended beneficiaries, and prevent their illegal export.

records.title: OCP has resumed shipments of 54,000 tonnes of Triple Super Phosphate (TSP) fertilizer to the United States, reopening a supply route that...
records.description: OCP has resumed shipments of 54,000 tonnes of Triple Super Phosphate (TSP) fertilizer to the United States, reopening a supply route that had been largely inactive for more than five years. The shipment is expected to increase phosphate fertilizer availability ahead of the US fall application season, while temporary relief from US countervailing duties allows OCP to re-enter the market and provides farmers with a more diversified supply source. The move comes amid concerns about fertilizer supply disruptions and limited domestic production in the US.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture (Palestine), in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), signed 18...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture (Palestine), in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), signed 18 agreements supporting agricultural investment projects under the Multi-Donor Agricultural Business Program (MAP II). The projects, valued at approximately 5.9 million shekels, aim to promote market-oriented investment and innovation, increase agricultural production, support individual and cooperative enterprises, create employment opportunities, and strengthen farmers’ resilience and access to markets. The initiative is funded by multiple international partners and includes monitoring and supervision by the Ministry and FAO to ensure effective implementation and sustainable impacts on the Palestinian agri-food sector.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Unaizah International Dates Season highlights Qassim’s leading role in date production, with around 2,850 farms and more than 1.5 mil...
records.description: The Unaizah International Dates Season highlights Qassim’s leading role in date production, with around 2,850 farms and more than 1.5 million palm trees producing approximately 90,000 tonnes of dates annually. Featuring more than 20 varieties, including the highly sought-after Sukkari, the season serves as a major platform connecting producers, traders, and consumers. Ongoing development aims to strengthen the event as an important economic, agricultural, and cultural platform, reinforce Qassim’s position as a leading global date-producing hub, and support the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.

records.title: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication introduced a credit-based sales system for potato seeds for the 2026 autumn growing sea...
records.description: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication introduced a credit-based sales system for potato seeds for the 2026 autumn growing season, attracting strong demand from farmers. The initiative aims to reduce farmers’ upfront financial burdens, facilitate access to certified planting material, lower production costs, and encourage expanded potato cultivation. Available seed includes Elite-stage varieties such as Afamia, Lana, Sidra, Qalamoun, Furat, Tadmor, Athar, and Aya, as well as net-house-produced seed of Afamia, Lana, Tadmor, and Qalamoun varieties.
records.institution: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication

records.title: The ministry is studying the possible resumption of chicken meat imports, potentially with higher customs duties to protect local poultry...
records.description: The ministry is studying the possible resumption of chicken meat imports, potentially with higher customs duties to protect local poultry producers while preventing market shortages. It is also planning to increase interest-free loans for farmers, develop crop-linked financing mechanisms, amend 16 agricultural laws and regulations covering inputs, land, forestry, and agricultural ownership, and strengthen partnerships with the private sector and Arab and international development funds. The ministry is also restructuring agricultural institutions and separating regulatory and supervisory functions from production activities to improve sector governance, investment, production, and food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform

records.title: The ministry set maximum selling prices for selected poultry products, including live and ready-to-cook chicken, while requiring market s...
records.description: The ministry set maximum selling prices for selected poultry products, including live and ready-to-cook chicken, while requiring market stakeholders to maintain regular supplies, comply with traceability requirements, and ensure adequate availability of cut-up chicken. The measure aims to regulate poultry prices and support market supply, although enforcement may remain challenging.
records.institution: The Ministry of Trade and Export Development

records.title: Tunisia’s food trade balance remained in surplus, supported mainly by strong growth in olive oil exports, which increased significantly i...
records.description: Tunisia’s food trade balance remained in surplus, supported mainly by strong growth in olive oil exports, which increased significantly in both value and volume and accounted for the majority of food export revenues. Date exports also recorded growth, while fishery product exports declined. On the import side, cereals remained the largest component of the food import bill, with higher purchases of soft wheat, maize, and barley, while sugar and vegetable oil imports also increased sharply. Overall, the food surplus helped offset part of Tunisia’s wider trade deficit and reflects the continued importance of agricultural exports, particularly olive oil, to the national economy

records.title: Egypt exported around 160,000 tonnes of food through 3,800 consignments while importing approximately 176,000 tonnes during the reporting...
records.description: Egypt exported around 160,000 tonnes of food through 3,800 consignments while importing approximately 176,000 tonnes during the reporting period. Vegetable and fruit exports included sweet potatoes, onions, potatoes, strawberries, citrus fruits, and mangoes, with Saudi Arabia the largest export destination. Imports were led by wheat, oils, and soybeans, with Russia the main supplier. The figures demonstrate Egypt’s extensive food-trade network, with exports reaching 181 countries and imports sourced from 84 countries, highlighting the importance of international trade in maintaining food supplies and supporting national food security.

records.title: The ministry introduced exceptional measures to simplify registration in the national Farmers’ Registry, particularly for farmers in vill...
records.description: The ministry introduced exceptional measures to simplify registration in the national Farmers’ Registry, particularly for farmers in villages where land surveying has not been completed. The measures allow alternative documentation certified by local authorities, reduce administrative and financial burdens, and facilitate access to agricultural services and support programmes while maintaining verification requirements. The initiative aims to expand the registry, establish a reliable national agricultural database, improve governance and digitalization, and enable more accurate targeting of agricultural policies and programmes.

records.title: Saudi Arabia produced around 623,770 tonnes of potatoes from 17,064 hectares, supporting a high level of domestic self-sufficiency and a...
records.description: Saudi Arabia produced around 623,770 tonnes of potatoes from 17,064 hectares, supporting a high level of domestic self-sufficiency and a growing processing and export sector. Potato production is concentrated in several central and northern regions and increasingly uses water-efficient irrigation technologies, including drip irrigation. MEWA regulates potato imports and exports through seasonal restrictions, permits, farm registration, and water-resource assessments, with export limitations applied in areas where groundwater conservation is a concern. The sector continues to balance domestic food supply, processing and export opportunities with the need to protect scarce water resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The agricultural sector in Madinah Region recorded the highest growth among economic sectors at 44%, supported by major development proje...
records.description: The agricultural sector in Madinah Region recorded the highest growth among economic sectors at 44%, supported by major development projects and an increase in agricultural commercial registrations. The region is a major date-producing and processing hub, with around 344,000 tonnes of dates produced annually from more than 8 million palm trees, alongside significant exports to international markets. Its date-processing and packaging industry includes 39 factories, contributing to value addition, investment, employment, food processing, and the expansion of Saudi agricultural exports.
records.institution: Madinah Chamber of Commerce and Industry

records.title: The Jazan branch of Estidamah, in collaboration with Thamarah Association for Agricultural Marketing and Food Processing, organized a spe...
records.description: The Jazan branch of Estidamah, in collaboration with Thamarah Association for Agricultural Marketing and Food Processing, organized a specialized workshop on banana farming to promote modern cultivation practices, improve crop quality and productivity, and enhance efficient resource use. The training covered land preparation, planting distances, irrigation management, crop production practices, and post-harvest handling to reduce losses and increase market value. The initiative supports farmers and promotes more sustainable and efficient agricultural production in Jazan.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: A training workshop in Daraa focused on improving post-harvest handling of chickpeas, including better harvesting, drying, and storage pr...
records.description: A training workshop in Daraa focused on improving post-harvest handling of chickpeas, including better harvesting, drying, and storage practices to reduce losses, maintain product quality, increase economic value, and improve market opportunities. The initiative, supported by the Arab Gulf Programme for Development (AGFUND), also included the provision of agricultural and hand tools to farmers to strengthen their capacity and improve the efficiency of agricultural operations.

records.title: The Central Bank of Tunisia revised the financing scales for cereal and selected seasonal crops, establishing updated bank credit ceiling...
records.description: The Central Bank of Tunisia revised the financing scales for cereal and selected seasonal crops, establishing updated bank credit ceilings based on crop type, production zone, and whether land is irrigated or rainfed. The revised framework covers durum and soft wheat, legumes, barley, and forage crops, with financing levels adjusted according to farm size, expected production costs, and previous yields. The measure aims to improve access to agricultural finance and ensure that bank lending better reflects regional and production conditions.

records.title: A training course for leaders of Agricultural Cooperative Union branches in seven governorates concluded in Sana’a, focusing on strengthe...
records.description: A training course for leaders of Agricultural Cooperative Union branches in seven governorates concluded in Sana’a, focusing on strengthening cooperative work, field-based agricultural development, value-chain approaches, and the implementation of agricultural policies. The training aims to improve the capacity of cooperative associations to support production, promote self-sufficiency, reduce dependence on imports, and strengthen local economic development. The initiative also highlighted ongoing efforts related to plowing and seed projects and expanding domestic crop production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is preparing to activate GMO testing for animal feed through the Molecular Biotechnology Laboratory within th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is preparing to activate GMO testing for animal feed through the Molecular Biotechnology Laboratory within the Feed Quality Control Department. The initiative includes assessing laboratory readiness, establishing testing protocols, providing the necessary scientific and technical requirements, and developing the capacities of specialized technical staff. Introducing GMO testing will strengthen the diagnostic and monitoring capabilities of the feed-control system, improve the safety and quality of animal feed, and support the protection and sustainability of Iraq’s livestock sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with FAO and with funding from the Government of Canada, organized an agricultural extension...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with FAO and with funding from the Government of Canada, organized an agricultural extension lecture at the Abdeh Agricultural Centre in Akkar on integrated soil fertility and fertilization management. The session focused on soil testing, optimizing fertilizer types, quantities and application timing, and reducing the environmental and economic impacts of excessive or inappropriate fertilizer use, including soil salinity, water pollution, and inefficient use of agricultural inputs. The activity aims to strengthen farmers’ technical capacities, improve crop quality and productivity, promote sustainable resource management, and support rural resilience and food security in Lebanon.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with UNDP and with support from the Palestinian International Cooperation Agency (PICA) and f...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with UNDP and with support from the Palestinian International Cooperation Agency (PICA) and funding from India, Brazil, and South Africa through the IBSA Fund, organized a training course on effective knowledge transfer and agricultural extension communication for 20 ministry staff. The training aims to strengthen the technical and extension capacities of ministry personnel, improve their ability to translate scientific information into practical guidance for farmers and livestock keepers, and promote modern agricultural practices. The initiative is part of the ministry’s food security efforts and focuses on areas including reducing livestock mortality, strengthening cooperatives and field schools, empowering women farmers, and improving agricultural marketing skills.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries announced the prices of certified and controlled cereal seeds for the upcoming...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries announced the prices of certified and controlled cereal seeds for the upcoming 2026–2027 agricultural season, setting prices for durum wheat, soft wheat, barley, and triticale seeds and applying an additional surcharge to certified varieties subject to plant variety rights. The ministry is also ensuring the availability of sufficient quantities of certified and ordinary seeds through designated sales points as part of preparations for the next cereal sowing campaign and to support farmers’ access to quality planting material.

records.title: Tunisian dam water reserves have improved significantly, reaching nearly 60% of capacity, providing some relief for irrigated agriculture...
records.description: Tunisian dam water reserves have improved significantly, reaching nearly 60% of capacity, providing some relief for irrigated agriculture; however, the recovery remains uneven across regions and agriculture continues to face substantial water pressure due to heat waves, evaporation, and overexploitation of groundwater. The situation highlights the need to strengthen water management through improved irrigation efficiency, desalination, wastewater reuse, and better control of agricultural water withdrawals, while ensuring that water savings do not lead to expanded cultivation or intensified water use.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in a workshop in Erbil on the project to improve farm management and pilot aggregation models in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in a workshop in Erbil on the project to improve farm management and pilot aggregation models in Iraq, implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) with World Bank support. The project targets Babil, Najaf, Dhi Qar, and Sulaymaniyah and focuses on improving farm management and sustainable agricultural and livestock production, including addressing livestock feed challenges, developing and managing climate-smart fodder crops, producing and using silage for animal feed, and strengthening beneficiary selection and field verification.

records.title: FAO launched training workshops in Tafileh Governorate under the Building Resilience to Cope with Climate Change in Jordan through Improv...
records.description: FAO launched training workshops in Tafileh Governorate under the Building Resilience to Cope with Climate Change in Jordan through Improving Water Use Efficiency in the Agriculture Sector (BRCCJ) project, implemented with support from the Green Climate Fund (GCF) and in partnership with Advance Consulting and Jordanian government institutions. The eight-day programme is training 30 members from five cooperatives on climate-smart agriculture, adaptation measures, water-use efficiency, and sustainable management of agricultural and natural resources. The initiative aims to strengthen the capacity of cooperatives and civil society organisations to promote climate-smart practices, improve water-use efficiency, support food security and livelihoods, and enhance the resilience of communities and the agricultural sector to water scarcity and climate change.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Environment Protection Fund approved a package of environmental and development projects focused on protecting natural resources, str...
records.description: The Environment Protection Fund approved a package of environmental and development projects focused on protecting natural resources, strengthening food security, supporting rural communities, and promoting sustainable development. The projects include water-harvesting wells and home gardens, renewable-energy-based drying of vegetables and fruits, rehabilitation of nature reserves and wetlands, development of the Mujib Agricultural Project as a model for modern agriculture, establishment of an applied agricultural academy for innovative and environmentally friendly farming, expansion of green spaces, and recycling plastic into public-use products. The initiatives also aim to empower youth and women, create livelihood opportunities, strengthen local community participation, and advance the green and circular economies.

records.title: The Public Authority for Food and Nutrition conducted inspection campaigns in Al-Jahra Governorate and recorded 40 food safety violations...
records.description: The Public Authority for Food and Nutrition conducted inspection campaigns in Al-Jahra Governorate and recorded 40 food safety violations, including the display and sale of food products unfit for human consumption, leading to legal action and the closure of five food establishments. The inspections targeted warehouses, factories, and other food establishments to ensure compliance with approved food safety regulations and health requirements, reinforcing efforts to protect consumer health and improve food safety standards.
records.institution: Public Authority for Food and Nutrition

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The fourth edition of the Shaqra Al-Asyah Dates Festival opened in Ain Ibn Fahid, bringing together farmers, producers, shoppers, and vis...
records.description: The fourth edition of the Shaqra Al-Asyah Dates Festival opened in Ain Ibn Fahid, bringing together farmers, producers, shoppers, and visitors to promote locally produced dates and support agricultural and economic activity. The weeklong festival provides farmers with opportunities to market their products, showcase the quality and diversity of local dates, and increase commercial activity during the harvest season.

records.title: The Saudi Water Authority will host the 21st IDRA World Congress on Desalination and Water Reuse (IDRA 2026) in Riyadh, bringing together...
records.description: The Saudi Water Authority will host the 21st IDRA World Congress on Desalination and Water Reuse (IDRA 2026) in Riyadh, bringing together water-sector leaders and experts from around 100 countries to address global water security. The congress will focus on water reuse, desalination, water efficiency, climate adaptation, energy efficiency, digital transformation, financing, and regulatory frameworks, while promoting international cooperation and innovation to address water scarcity and growing demand. The event also includes the Water Regulation Forum, technical sessions, scientific presentations, workshops, and a dedicated exhibition.

records.title: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held a farmer workshop in Dibba, Fujairah, to discuss farmers’ production, marketing, and agricultu...
records.description: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held a farmer workshop in Dibba, Fujairah, to discuss farmers’ production, marketing, and agricultural service needs and introduce initiatives aimed at strengthening local agricultural production and sustainability. The workshop highlighted the Integrated Agricultural Centres project, which provides farmers with technical support, production inputs, packaging, marketing, and distribution services, as well as the UAE Good Agricultural Practices (UAE G.A.P.) programme, which promotes quality, food safety, traceability, resource efficiency, and access to new markets. The initiative supports the UAE’s food security objectives and the “Plant the Emirates” programme by encouraging modern technologies, sustainable farming practices, and stronger agricultural value chains.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture introduced a proactive framework for forest fire prevention and sustainable forest management, focusing on ve...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture introduced a proactive framework for forest fire prevention and sustainable forest management, focusing on vegetation maintenance, cleaning, thinning, and removal of flammable biomass in forests and woodlands, particularly in high-risk areas. The measures also give municipalities and environmental associations a stronger role in preventive maintenance and introduce regulated grazing as a tool to reduce flammable vegetation, subject to permits specifying locations, periods, and livestock numbers while protecting trees and natural regeneration. The framework also strengthens monitoring and enforcement against unauthorized cutting, grazing, and vegetation clearing.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture introduced an exceptional and temporary mechanism for the sanitary emergency cutting of completely dead fores...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture introduced an exceptional and temporary mechanism for the sanitary emergency cutting of completely dead forest trees affected by pests or diseases, aiming to prevent infestations from spreading to healthy trees and protect Lebanon’s forest resources. The measure is based on technical inspections and applies only to trees confirmed to be completely dead and posing a risk to forest health; living or partially dead trees are excluded. The mechanism requires strict supervision, documentation, and controls over the resulting wood, including on-site chipping or approved treatment before transport, with permits required for any movement and a ban on selling or storing untreated wood.

records.title: The Culinary Arts Commission has documented 35 products from Madinah among 180 Saudi products featured in the “Ark of Taste” global initi...
records.description: The Culinary Arts Commission has documented 35 products from Madinah among 180 Saudi products featured in the “Ark of Taste” global initiative, which seeks to protect heritage food products, support local producers, and preserve agricultural biodiversity and culinary traditions. The listed products include traditional wheat, dates, mint, honey, chickpeas, bread, cabbage, and jujube, reflecting Madinah’s rich agricultural and culinary heritage. The initiative aims to enhance the cultural and economic value of traditional foods, raise awareness of their preservation, support local producers, and ensure that traditional knowledge and production practices are passed on to future generations.

records.title: The Ministry has approved updated executive regulations for monitoring and enforcing water-efficiency and conservation standards, empower...
records.description: The Ministry has approved updated executive regulations for monitoring and enforcing water-efficiency and conservation standards, empowering the National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center to investigate violations across the urban, agricultural, and industrial sectors. The rules introduce escalating fines for using inefficient sanitary fixtures, tampering with water-saving components, wasting drinking water due to defective or poorly maintained tanks, and using drinking water for purposes where alternative sources such as treated wastewater or licensed wells are available. Penalties range from SR500 to SR200,000, strengthening enforcement of water conservation and supporting the sustainable management of Saudi Arabia’s scarce water resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation launched the distribution of 100 agricultural tractors to farmers at Al-Rahad Agricultural Sch...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation launched the distribution of 100 agricultural tractors to farmers at Al-Rahad Agricultural Scheme, supplied by Giad Company through the Agricultural Bank of Sudan, as part of efforts to improve agricultural productivity and address machinery and irrigation-related constraints. The ministry also reviewed challenges including electricity supply, bird pests, canal clearance, and silt accumulation, while emphasizing an approach that links agricultural finance with insurance, extension services, and value-chain financing. The ministry further highlighted the agricultural sector’s role in supporting reconstruction efforts in Kordofan and Darfur.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation / Agricultural Bank of Sudan

records.title: The UAE is expanding its network of Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreements (CEPAs) to diversify export markets, reduce trade barri...
records.description: The UAE is expanding its network of Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreements (CEPAs) to diversify export markets, reduce trade barriers, strengthen private-sector competitiveness, and expand investment and trade links across Asia, Africa, and Europe. Since the programme was launched in 2021, the UAE has signed 38 CEPAs, with an increasing number entering into force and improving market access for UAE businesses. The agreements are supporting opportunities in sectors including agriculture, logistics, renewable energy, manufacturing, and investment, while strengthening the UAE’s role as a global trade and logistics hub connecting Asian, African, and European markets.
records.institution: UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism

records.title: Moroccan watermelon producers are facing significant price pressure at the end of the season, with some farms reporting prices as low as...
records.description: Moroccan watermelon producers are facing significant price pressure at the end of the season, with some farms reporting prices as low as 0.50 DH/kg, although this is not a national average and varies by region, quality, timing, and market conditions. European trade data shows that Moroccan watermelon exports to the EU increased by 14% in the first half of 2026 to nearly 149,000 tonnes, while their total declared value fell by around 10%, causing the average declared value to decline by 21.1% to €0.98/kg. The situation highlights growing market saturation and weaker returns despite higher export volumes, particularly for late-season producers competing with other Mediterranean suppliers

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning are supporting the development of t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning are supporting the development of the Al Najd Agricultural City in Dhofar, a large-scale self-sustaining agricultural development designed to strengthen food security, agricultural innovation, and economic diversification in line with Oman Vision 2040. The masterplan integrates large agricultural areas with urban facilities and incorporates technologies such as agrivoltaics, aquaponics, greenhouse production, advanced irrigation, and water-reuse and management systems. The project will focus on water-efficient and locally suitable crops, agro-processing and export opportunities, and sustainable energy and water use, with the long-term goal of creating Oman’s first zero-waste agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Saudi Arabia increased the disposal rate of ozone-depleting substances to 69% during the first half of 2026, with more than 8,000 metric...
records.description: Saudi Arabia increased the disposal rate of ozone-depleting substances to 69% during the first half of 2026, with more than 8,000 metric tons of ozone-depleting substances and HFCs cleared as part of the gradual phase-out programme. The initiative strengthens regulatory oversight of the import and circulation of controlled substances through environmental clearance procedures, supported by electronic integration with the Zakat, Tax and Customs Authority. Since 2023, more than 3,200 clearance permits have been issued under the Montreal Protocol framework.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of Iraq, in cooperation with the World Food Programme (WFP), is developing and rehabilitating the Al-Azziya P...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Iraq, in cooperation with the World Food Programme (WFP), is developing and rehabilitating the Al-Azziya Pasture Station in Najaf to restore natural rangelands, combat desertification, and strengthen the resilience of ecosystems to climate change. The work includes drainage infrastructure, solar energy systems, land preparation, maintenance of facilities, and windbreaks to improve the station’s productive environment and support sustainable management of natural resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture of Iraq / World Food Programme (WFP)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) imposed a nationwide seasonal ban on the fishing, possession, transpor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) imposed a nationwide seasonal ban on the fishing, possession, transportation, sale, purchase, storage and trade of kingfish (kanad) along Oman’s coasts from 15 August to 15 October 2026. The measure, issued under the Marine Fisheries Law and Ministerial Decision No. 70/2026, aims to protect kingfish stocks during a critical stage of their life cycle and support the long-term sustainability of Oman’s fisheries and marine biodiversity. Fishermen and businesses holding existing stocks are required to register them with the relevant authorities, while violations are subject to legal penalties.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is monitoring the potential environmental and food-safety impacts of a grounde...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is monitoring the potential environmental and food-safety impacts of a grounded vessel incident off Al Qibliya Island in the Al Hallaniyat Islands, Dhofar. As a precautionary measure, the Food Safety and Quality Centre is conducting inspections, investigations, and sampling of fishery products circulating in markets to verify their safety and compliance with health standards. The ministry has also instructed fishermen and seafarers to report oil slicks, unusual odours, or visible changes in seawater and marine life and to avoid fishing in affected areas.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Jericho and Jordan Valley Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with FAO, concluded a specialized training programme on farm man...
records.description: The Jericho and Jordan Valley Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with FAO, concluded a specialized training programme on farm management and dairy product safety in Deir al-Fouqa, benefiting 30 participants. The programme covered good farm management practices, dairy safety requirements, and practical training for women farmers on cream cheese production, aiming to improve food safety, product quality, resource utilization, and the economic value of local dairy products.

records.title: Saudi Arabia’s consumer inflation remained relatively low in July, with prices increasing by 1.8% year-on-year, despite a sharp rise in r...
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s consumer inflation remained relatively low in July, with prices increasing by 1.8% year-on-year, despite a sharp rise in regulated gas prices and higher rents. However, wholesale prices increased by 5%, driven largely by supply-chain constraints affecting transportation and logistics, higher agricultural produce prices, and a significant increase in basic chemical prices. While consumer prices have so far remained largely insulated, continued supply-chain pressures could gradually feed into retail prices, although a major increase in inflation is not expected.

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification signed SAR40 million in contracts with Morooj National...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification signed SAR40 million in contracts with Morooj National Foundation for sustainable forest management projects, marking the first national initiative of its kind to strengthen forest sustainability and preserve their environmental, economic, and social value while increasing the contribution of the non-profit sector to national environmental goals. The initiative uses GIS and remote sensing to assess forest conditions, including topography, degradation, and climate factors, and covers six areas: improving forest health, preventing and restoring fire-affected forests, rehabilitating degraded forests, engaging stakeholders and encouraging investment, strengthening forest monitoring, and assessing risks and developing mitigation measures.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC), a consortium involving ACWA Power, Air Products, and NEOM, has completed construction of the $8.5...
records.description: The NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC), a consortium involving ACWA Power, Air Products, and NEOM, has completed construction of the $8.5 billion green hydrogen project at Oxagon and entered the commissioning stage. The facility is expected to become the world’s largest green hydrogen plant, producing up to 600 tonnes of carbon-free hydrogen daily and converting it into green ammonia for international export. Powered by large-scale solar and wind generation, the project is designed to support Saudi Arabia’s energy diversification, renewable energy development, and transition toward lower-carbon industrial production.
records.institution: NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC) / ACWA Power / NEOM

records.title: The General Organization for Seed Multiplication announced the sale of potato seed produced under the 2026 national autumn-season potato...
records.description: The General Organization for Seed Multiplication announced the sale of potato seed produced under the 2026 national autumn-season potato programme, with payment to be made at a later stage. The measure supports the availability of certified planting material and facilitates farmers’ access to potato seed for the upcoming autumn production season.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Directorate, is carrying out secondary acclimatization of tissue-cultured date palm...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Directorate, is carrying out secondary acclimatization of tissue-cultured date palm offshoots to prepare them for distribution to farmers. The process gradually exposes the plants to field conditions, including heat, light, wind, lower humidity, and controlled water and salinity stress, helping them adapt to Iraq’s environment and improving their survival after planting. The initiative aims to produce high-quality, locally adapted planting material, increase the success of date palm cultivation, and support the development of Iraq’s date palm sector.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Moroccan avocado producers are closely monitoring the 2026–2027 harvest after significant fruit drop linked to high temperatures and heat...
records.description: Moroccan avocado producers are closely monitoring the 2026–2027 harvest after significant fruit drop linked to high temperatures and heat stress, particularly during late spring and early summer. While an initial industry estimate suggested production could reach around 130,000 tonnes under favorable conditions, producers in the Gharb region consider the final harvest volume and potential losses uncertain until later in the season. High temperatures, dry air, intense radiation, and limited water availability can affect young fruit development and increase fruit drop, highlighting the vulnerability of avocado production to heat stress. The situation follows a weaker previous season and underscores the importance of monitoring weather conditions and water availability for the upcoming harvest.

records.title: The Casablanca-Settat Regional Directorate of Agriculture plans to develop a regional agricultural mapping and geographic information sys...
records.description: The Casablanca-Settat Regional Directorate of Agriculture plans to develop a regional agricultural mapping and geographic information system to assess the agricultural potential of land and support better decisions between agricultural preservation and urban development. The system will classify land according to its agricultural suitability using soil, climate, irrigation, and production data, while satellite imagery will help assess urbanization and land-use changes. Covering a region with more than 1.26 million hectares of usable agricultural land, the initiative is intended to help authorities identify high-value agricultural areas, guide land-use and urban planning, and better account for the importance of agricultural land to cereal, fodder, vegetable, dairy, and livestock production. The map will serve as a technical decision-support tool rather than automatically providing legal protection against development.
records.institution: The Casablanca-Settat Regional Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Arab American University signed a cooperation memorandum to strengthen collaboration in agricultural...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Arab American University signed a cooperation memorandum to strengthen collaboration in agricultural education, scientific research, training, and knowledge exchange, with the aim of aligning academic programmes and research with the needs of the agricultural sector. The partnership will focus on areas including food and water security, smart agriculture and irrigation, drought and soil management, and agri-food industries, while providing students with practical training opportunities and supporting capacity development among ministry staff. The ministry will also facilitate cooperation through its facilities, particularly the National Agricultural Research Centre, to translate research and education into practical applications that support farmers and sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture received 400,000 doses of SAT1 foot-and-mouth disease vaccine, funded by the Palestinian government, to expan...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture received 400,000 doses of SAT1 foot-and-mouth disease vaccine, funded by the Palestinian government, to expand the national livestock vaccination and identification campaign and protect sheep and cattle from animal diseases. The vaccines will be distributed across the governorates according to needs and priorities, building on ongoing veterinary interventions in high-priority areas. The campaign aims to improve livestock health, reduce potential economic losses, support farmers, and strengthen animal production and national food security. The ministry is also preparing additional vaccination activities, including a campaign using brucellosis vaccines provided through FAO with Italian government funding.

records.title: The Algerian Interprofessional Cereals Office (OAIC) is keeping cereal collection centres open to receive remaining harvests from the cur...
records.description: The Algerian Interprofessional Cereals Office (OAIC) is keeping cereal collection centres open to receive remaining harvests from the current agricultural campaign, while preparations are underway for the next plowing-sowing season. Farmers receiving state support are required to deliver their full production to the OAIC. Farmers planning to grow cereals and pulses are encouraged to apply early for seeds and agricultural inputs, while applications for the “Rafik” credit through the Bank of Agriculture and Rural Development (BADR) are also being processed. The OAIC is preparing contracted seed production through cleaning, screening and treatment to ensure adequate seed supplies for the next agricultural season across Algeria.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Animal Resources Directorate, has begun early preparations for the upcoming fish breeding and pr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Animal Resources Directorate, has begun early preparations for the upcoming fish breeding and propagation season by maintaining and rehabilitating the water system serving the fish propagation laboratory at the Al-Suwaira fish hatchery. The work aims to improve water supply efficiency and ensure that the hatchery meets the technical requirements for hatching and fish propagation during the coming production season. The early preparations are intended to strengthen the readiness of government hatcheries, build on positive results from the previous season, and support the development of fisheries and increased domestic fish production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Tikrit Research Department of the Agricultural Research Directorate, is continuing the cleaning,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Tikrit Research Department of the Agricultural Research Directorate, is continuing the cleaning, treatment, packaging, and storage of high-grade wheat seeds produced at its research stations. The work covers the wheat varieties Dahab, Mawadda, Qimma, and Buhuth 22, following approved technical and scientific standards. The programme aims to preserve the genetic purity and quality characteristics of wheat varieties, ensure seed quality and proper storage, and prepare high-quality seed for replanting and further multiplication in the next agricultural season.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Seed Testing and Certification Directorate is strengthening technical oversight of seed cleaning and preparation facilities operated...
records.description: The Seed Testing and Certification Directorate is strengthening technical oversight of seed cleaning and preparation facilities operated by seed-producing companies ahead of the upcoming agricultural season. The programme covers monitoring seed reception, cleaning, testing, certification, and the performance of cleaning lines to ensure compliance with approved technical standards. It also focuses on preserving the genetic purity, quality, and production characteristics of seed varieties, ensuring that farmers receive certified, high-quality planting material. The measures aim to improve agricultural inputs, raise productivity, support Iraqi farmers, and strengthen food security and sustainable agricultural production.

records.title: The Russian Ministry of Agriculture raised its forecast for total grain exports for the new agricultural season to approximately 54 milli...
records.description: The Russian Ministry of Agriculture raised its forecast for total grain exports for the new agricultural season to approximately 54 million tonnes, up from an earlier estimate of 45 million tonnes. Milling wheat is expected to account for more than 47 million tonnes, supported by continued global demand for Russian grain. The ministry also aims to increase food exports to around 60 million tonnes annually, strengthening Russia’s position in international markets and supporting food supplies to importing countries, particularly in the Middle East.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture of the Russian Federation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized an agricultural extension seminar in Kahaleh, with logistical support from the “Hal Ardna Lana” Ass...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized an agricultural extension seminar in Kahaleh, with logistical support from the “Hal Ardna Lana” Association and coordination with the municipality, focusing on proper pruning of fruit trees and the safe use of agricultural pesticides. The session provided farmers with practical guidance on pruning techniques, timing, appropriate tools, and plant health, while also highlighting the risks of improper pesticide use and the importance of following recommended doses, safety intervals, and protective measures to safeguard farmers, consumers, and the environment. The ministry also distributed pruning equipment to registered farmers to support safer and more efficient orchard management and promote sustainable agricultural practices.

records.title: The desert locust situation in Morocco improved significantly in July 2026.
records.description: The desert locust situation in Morocco improved significantly in July 2026. According to FAO’s Desert Locust Bulletin No. 574, locust populations declined, and no locusts were observed after mid-July. Moroccan control teams treated 2,375 hectares during July, compared with 87,363 hectares in June, representing an approximately 97% reduction in the area treated. The treated area reflects the extent of control operations and does not represent agricultural damage or crop losses; the bulletin reported no figures on crop damage.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: A consortium comprising EDF power solutions, Al Khadra Partners, and OQ Alternative Energy (OQAE) has reached financial close for the 120...
records.description: A consortium comprising EDF power solutions, Al Khadra Partners, and OQ Alternative Energy (OQAE) has reached financial close for the 120 MW Jaalan Bani Bu Ali Wind Independent Power Project in Oman. The project will establish a major onshore wind farm with 16 turbines, providing renewable electricity for more than 13,500 households and reducing carbon emissions. It is expected to support local employment, skills development, and Omani businesses while strengthening energy security and diversifying the national energy mix. The project aligns with Oman Vision 2040 and the country’s renewable energy and Net Zero 2050 objectives.
records.institution: OQ Alternative Energy (OQAE) / Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Food Security Exhibition opened in Salalah with the participation of around 100 institutions, companies, and projects working across...
records.description: The Food Security Exhibition opened in Salalah with the participation of around 100 institutions, companies, and projects working across agriculture, livestock, fisheries, food industries, modern agricultural technologies, logistics, financing, and investment. The five-day exhibition showcases food security-related products, projects, and innovations while providing a platform to strengthen cooperation, promote investment opportunities, and connect public and private sector stakeholders across Oman’s food and agriculture sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture distributed 12 plastic water tanks to farming households in the Al-Masoudiya area through the Burqa Village C...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture distributed 12 plastic water tanks to farming households in the Al-Masoudiya area through the Burqa Village Council under its rapid response programme. The intervention aims to provide farmers with essential water supplies, reduce the challenges they face, and strengthen their ability to continue cultivating and investing in their agricultural land. The support is part of the Ministry’s efforts to target agricultural assistance to areas most in need, strengthen farmers’ resilience, and sustain agricultural production.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Palestinian Hydrologists Group, established a 50-kilowatt solar energy unit in Firas...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Palestinian Hydrologists Group, established a 50-kilowatt solar energy unit in Firasin Village Council, funded through a Dutch-supported project. The initiative aims to reduce the cost of agricultural water pumping, improve farmers’ access to irrigation water, and provide a sustainable energy source for agricultural production. The project forms part of the Ministry’s efforts to improve agricultural infrastructure, promote renewable energy, reduce production costs, improve resource-use efficiency, and strengthen farmers’ resilience and ability to continue investing in their land.

records.title: Saudi Arabia’s Port of Jeddah is experiencing congestion as shipping companies reroute cargo away from traditional Gulf routes amid the o...
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s Port of Jeddah is experiencing congestion as shipping companies reroute cargo away from traditional Gulf routes amid the ongoing United States–Iran conflict. Increased volumes through Jeddah have contributed to vessel waiting times of five to ten days, while several carriers have suspended or reduced direct services and introduced additional surcharges. Shipping companies are also redirecting cargo through alternative gateways, including King Abdullah Port, while land-bridge and multimodal routes are being adjusted. These disruptions are affecting exporters and logistics providers, increasing freight costs and complicating procurement, inventory management, delivery schedules, and regional supply-chain planning.

records.title: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab has begun rehabilitating and clearing agricultural irrigation canals...
records.description: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab has begun rehabilitating and clearing agricultural irrigation canals and drainage channels near Joreen in Al-Ghab Plain, aiming to restore the efficiency of the irrigation network and improve water delivery to agricultural land. The works include removing sediment and obstructions to improve water flow and irrigation efficiency, enabling irrigation of more than 50 hectares of agricultural land. The initiative is part of broader efforts to rehabilitate agricultural water infrastructure, ensure reliable irrigation services, support continued agricultural production, and improve conditions for farmers in the area.
records.institution: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of Syria expanded its regional and international agricultural cooperation while strengthening field engagemen...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Syria expanded its regional and international agricultural cooperation while strengthening field engagement across the governorates. The ministry advanced partnerships with regional and international institutions and private companies covering agricultural research, irrigation, livestock, olive production, modern technologies, investment, renewable energy, and agricultural infrastructure, alongside signing cooperation agreements and memoranda of understanding to support training, technology transfer, and agricultural investment. Field visits focused on farmers’ needs, production inputs, irrigation networks, agricultural extension, marketing, export opportunities, and rehabilitation of agricultural facilities. The ministry also promoted rural household empowerment, modern irrigation, precision and regenerative agriculture, and livestock development, while participating in agricultural, food, and rural-product exhibitions and conferences aimed at strengthening value chains, food safety, food security, and sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: Tunisia is expected to maintain moderate economic growth, supported partly by improved performance in agriculture and the agri-food indus...
records.description: Tunisia is expected to maintain moderate economic growth, supported partly by improved performance in agriculture and the agri-food industry, alongside recovery in tourism and other sectors. To strengthen food security and supply, the authorities have introduced measures to expand storage capacity and support access to seeds and fertilizers, while also pursuing reforms to the distribution system. The Arab Monetary Fund expects Tunisia’s gradual economic recovery to continue, although growth remains constrained by structural challenges and price pressures. Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East are noted as a potential source of supply-chain and transport-cost disruptions, but they are not expected to significantly affect Tunisian inflation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture / Arab Monetary Fund (AMF)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture launched a digital agricultural extension portal to strengthen direct communication between farmers, extensio...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture launched a digital agricultural extension portal to strengthen direct communication between farmers, extension officers, and agricultural experts. The platform provides farmers with access to reliable technical advice, agricultural recommendations, and extension services, helping improve production efficiency, support informed decision-making, and accelerate access to services across Iraq’s governorates. The initiative forms part of the Ministry’s broader digital transformation efforts and aims to build a modern, technology-enabled agricultural extension system that supports sustainable agricultural development and food security.

records.title: The Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in cooperation with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development (ESDC), dis...
records.description: The Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in cooperation with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development (ESDC), distributed 2,275 almond saplings to 10 small farmers across several communities in Jenin Governorate. The intervention is part of a project aimed at improving livelihoods, strengthening small farmers’ resilience, and promoting sustainable agriculture under changing circumstances. The initiative supports the productive use and preservation of agricultural land, provides new income and production opportunities for farming families, and strengthens farmers’ ability to maintain and invest in their land, particularly in areas vulnerable to land confiscation or seizure.

records.title: The Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Directorate of Agriculture, in coordination with the Palestinian Hydrologists Group, distributed pre...
records.description: The Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Directorate of Agriculture, in coordination with the Palestinian Hydrologists Group, distributed pressure-controlled irrigation sub-networks, main transmission lines, and related equipment to 23 farmers in several areas of Tubas Governorate. The intervention is part of the Water, Land, and Agricultural Roads Investment Program, funded by the Dutch government and managed by the Welfare Association in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture. The project aims to improve irrigation efficiency, reduce water losses, increase water and land productivity, and strengthen agricultural infrastructure, helping farmers make better use of limited water resources and sustain investment in their agricultural land.

records.title: The Ministry of Public Health (MoPH) intensified national food safety monitoring, increasing inspections of imported food shipments and l...
records.description: The Ministry of Public Health (MoPH) intensified national food safety monitoring, increasing inspections of imported food shipments and local food establishments while using laboratory testing, sampling, and digital services to verify compliance with food safety standards and regulations. During the second quarter, the Food Safety Department inspected 29,147 imported food shipments, conducted 5,748 inspection visits to local food establishments, collected thousands of food samples, and carried out 136,280 laboratory tests. The department also expanded digital food safety services through the Watheq system, supporting stronger oversight, compliance, and food safety practices across Qatar’s food supply chain.

records.title: Saudi Arabia, through the Weqaa Center and King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief), provided logistical support to the...
records.description: Saudi Arabia, through the Weqaa Center and King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief), provided logistical support to the FAO Commission for Controlling the Desert Locust in the Central Region to strengthen regional efforts to control desert locusts and protect agricultural resources and food security. The support included 40 modern devices and equipment, 8,250 safety items, and 100 tonnes of pest-control materials, enhancing emergency response capacity and the safety of control teams across member countries. The initiative strengthens regional preparedness and promotes coordinated, preventive action against cross-border agricultural pests.
records.institution: National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center)

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: The Syrian Grain Establishment reported receiving more than 2.7 million tonnes of wheat from farmers during the current harvest season, e...
records.description: The Syrian Grain Establishment reported receiving more than 2.7 million tonnes of wheat from farmers during the current harvest season, exceeding Syria’s estimated annual domestic requirement of 2.55 million tonnes and marking a significant improvement in domestic wheat production and food security. Wheat procurement remains ongoing across the country, while authorities are implementing expanded storage measures to manage the large harvest and preserve grain quality. The development indicates increased domestic production capacity and reduced reliance on wheat imports.

records.title: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture and Saudi Arabia’s United Feed Company signed a memorandum of understanding to study the establishment...
records.description: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture and Saudi Arabia’s United Feed Company signed a memorandum of understanding to study the establishment of feed-production farms and processing facilities in eastern Syria, supporting livestock development and agricultural investment. The proposed project could cover up to 30,000 hectares, using sustainable centre-pivot and linear irrigation systems, and would integrate feed-crop farms with feed-processing, manufacturing, and logistics facilities. The initiative aims to strengthen local feed supplies, support livestock producers, introduce modern technologies, create employment, train farmers, and potentially generate surplus for export.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture continued its comprehensive field campaign to contain and control a scale insect infestation affecting fig or...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture continued its comprehensive field campaign to contain and control a scale insect infestation affecting fig orchards in Tal Afar District, Nineveh Governorate. Technical teams from the Plant Protection Department are conducting field inspections, diagnosing affected orchards, applying necessary control measures, and continuing monitoring and assessment in damaged areas to prevent the pest from spreading further. The campaign aims to protect fig orchards and plant resources, support affected farmers, and ensure a rapid and coordinated response to agricultural pest outbreaks.

records.title: The Doukkala Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVAD) reported a significant recovery in sugar beet production during the 20...
records.description: The Doukkala Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVAD) reported a significant recovery in sugar beet production during the 2025–2026 agricultural campaign, with regional output reaching around 544,000 tonnes, a 31% increase compared with the previous season. The improvement was supported by expanded cultivation, higher yields, increased rainfall, strengthened technical and phytosanitary monitoring, and improved coordination among agricultural stakeholders. Economic measures, including raising the purchase price of sugar beet to 630 dirhams per tonne and providing fertilizer support, were also introduced to improve farmers’ incomes and the attractiveness of the crop, which remains an important source of employment and economic activity in the Doukkala region.
records.institution: Doukkala Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVAD)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is supporting the “Rural Dhofar 2026” exhibition, which brings together rural...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is supporting the “Rural Dhofar 2026” exhibition, which brings together rural women entrepreneurs and productive families to promote and market Omani agricultural, fishery, food, honey, dates, and natural products. The exhibition aims to expand direct marketing opportunities, increase household incomes, support small and medium-sized enterprises, and strengthen the role of rural women in food security and sustainable economic development. It also includes specialised workshops on sustainable production, product quality and value addition, financing opportunities, and women’s contribution to food security, supporting the development of rural communities and the diversification and sustainability of Oman’s economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources will implement a seasonal ban on catching, possessing, transporting, selling,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources will implement a seasonal ban on catching, possessing, transporting, selling, trading, storing, freezing, and exporting kingfish along Oman’s coasts to protect fish stocks and ensure the long-term sustainability of the fishery. The measure forms part of a broader fisheries management approach that includes regulating fishing seasons, protecting stocks during breeding periods, strengthening compliance, and raising fishermen’s awareness. Kingfish is an economically and nutritionally important resource in Oman, with production concentrated mainly in Al Wusta and South A’Sharqiyah Governorates, making sustainable management essential for maintaining fishermen’s livelihoods, fish supplies, and the wider fisheries economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), organised an advanced training course o...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), organised an advanced training course on analysing and interpreting laboratory test results for animal feed samples to strengthen the technical and supervisory capacities of agricultural staff. The training focuses on assessing feed composition and quality, detecting mycotoxins and additives, interpreting laboratory results, and supporting evidence-based regulatory decisions. Implemented under the Ministry’s food security initiative and the “My Initiative” project, with support from PICA and funding through the IBSA Fund, the activity also contributes to improving feed quality, livestock health and productivity, strengthening monitoring systems, supporting farmers and livestock breeders, and enhancing food security and resilience.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Buraidah International Dates Carnival highlights Qassim Region’s leading role in Saudi Arabia’s palm and dates sector, with around 11...
records.description: The Buraidah International Dates Carnival highlights Qassim Region’s leading role in Saudi Arabia’s palm and dates sector, with around 11 million palm trees producing more than 580,000 tonnes of dates annually, equivalent to approximately half of the Kingdom’s total production. The sector benefits from government support, suitable agricultural conditions, and farmers’ adoption of modern cultivation and palm-care practices. The carnival markets a large share of Sukkari date production and serves as a major platform connecting producers, traders, and consumers, contributing to food security and the local agricultural economy. The sector’s future development is expected to focus on modern agricultural technologies, mechanisation, and water-efficient irrigation systems to improve productivity while conserving water resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is supporting the development of Jazan as Saudi Arabia’s leading hub for tropical frui...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is supporting the development of Jazan as Saudi Arabia’s leading hub for tropical fruit production, with the region producing significant quantities of mangoes, papayas, bananas, guavas, and custard apples. Jazan accounts for nearly 60% of national mango production, supported by its favourable agricultural conditions, modern farming practices, and government and farmer efforts to improve productivity and product quality. The region is also developing the “Tropical Fruits and Greenhouses” project, with investments exceeding SAR 600 million, aimed at expanding production capacity, introducing modern agricultural technologies, increasing value addition, and creating investment opportunities while contributing to food security and rural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture supports the development of the dates sector through seasonal events such as the Al-Kh...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture supports the development of the dates sector through seasonal events such as the Al-Khabra and Riyadh Al-Khabra Dates Festival, which stimulates date trading, strengthens logistics and supply chains, and creates seasonal employment opportunities. The festival also promotes local agricultural products, tourism, and economic activity in Qassim Region, while supporting the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 through agricultural development, income diversification, increased local content, and improved competitiveness and sustainability of the dates sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a memorandum of understanding with a Brazilian livestock company to explore investment cooperation in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a memorandum of understanding with a Brazilian livestock company to explore investment cooperation in rebuilding, rehabilitating, developing, and operating public livestock facilities and dairy farms, while supporting livestock development and rural communities. The cooperation aims to restore and expand production capacity for milk and meat, develop local and export-oriented livestock value chains, improve feed production, introduce modern breeding, nutrition, veterinary, and management technologies, and promote sustainable use of water and energy. The initiative also includes agricultural extension, training, contract farming, support for small livestock producers, and potential concessional financing, with the broader objective of creating employment, strengthening rural economies, and improving the efficiency and sustainability of Syria’s livestock sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Aleppo Pistachio Office, organised a training course in Hama on integrated management of pistach...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Aleppo Pistachio Office, organised a training course in Hama on integrated management of pistachio trees to strengthen the technical capacities of agricultural staff and extension workers. The training focused on modern scientific techniques and good agricultural practices for managing pistachio orchards, with the aim of improving productivity and product quality, strengthening agricultural extension services, and transferring updated knowledge to farmers. The initiative supports the sustainable development and protection of pistachio production, an important strategic crop in Syria, particularly in Hama Governorate.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Maritime Fisheries has finalized an amended version of Tunisia’s draft Water Code, incor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Maritime Fisheries has finalized an amended version of Tunisia’s draft Water Code, incorporating observations from relevant ministries and institutions, and is preparing to submit it to the Council of Ministers before forwarding it to the Assembly of the Representatives of the People for consideration and adoption. The revised text includes draft implementing regulations and an explanatory note, with the proposed reforms aimed at strengthening Tunisia’s water governance framework and addressing the country’s water resource challenges. The draft has been under review for several years, and its advancement to the next legislative stage represents a step toward updating the national framework for water resources management.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Maritime Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture continued its intensive field campaign to control and contain a scale insect infestation affecting fig orchar...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture continued its intensive field campaign to control and contain a scale insect infestation affecting fig orchards in the Tal Afar district of Nineveh Governorate. Specialized technical teams carried out pest-control operations for the second consecutive day to protect the orchards and limit the spread of the infestation. The campaign was launched under the urgent directives of the Minister of Agriculture, Abdulrahim Jassim Al-Shammari, with field technical supervision to ensure rapid containment of the pest and protect agricultural production in the governorate

records.title: The Jordan Chamber of Industry highlighted the strategic role of Jordan’s food industry in strengthening national food security, with loc...
records.description: The Jordan Chamber of Industry highlighted the strategic role of Jordan’s food industry in strengthening national food security, with locally manufactured food products covering more than 62% of domestic market needs. The sector has approximately 2,600 industrial establishments, employs more than 66,000 workers, and generates around JOD 4.5 billion in annual production. The industry has achieved high self-sufficiency in products including dairy, poultry, eggs, legumes, and canned foods, while food exports nearly doubled from JOD 458 million in 2021 to approximately JOD 926 million in 2025, reaching markets in 114 countries. The sector is identified as a priority under Jordan’s Economic Modernization Vision, which aims to increase local production, strengthen agricultural-industrial linkages, diversify export markets, and improve food supply-chain resilience.

records.title: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), in cooperation with the Office of the Governor of Dhofar and the Ministry of Agricultur...
records.description: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), in cooperation with the Office of the Governor of Dhofar and the Ministry of Agricultural Wealth, Fisheries and Water Resources, is organising the Food Security Forum and Exhibition 2026 in Salalah to strengthen food security, attract investment, and promote sustainable growth in Oman’s agricultural and food sectors. The event will bring together public and private sector stakeholders, investors, entrepreneurs, and specialists, with discussions focusing on food security, agricultural investment, modern technologies, sustainable food supply chains, financing, logistics, and economic diversification under Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)
