records.description: The Social Development Bank (SDB) supported the participation of 15 cottage-industry families in the Farmers’ Market Festival in Rafha Governorate, helping them access direct sales opportunities and expand the marketing of their products. The festival, organised by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Northern Borders Region branch, showcases locally produced dates, fruits, vegetables, honey, and other rural and food products, alongside awareness activities promoting sustainable agricultural practices and local production. The initiative supports farmers and productive families, strengthens market access and livelihoods, and contributes to agricultural development, food security, and Saudi Vision 2030 objectives related to microenterprises and the cottage industry.

records.title: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held an interactive workshop with farmers in Ras Al Khaimah to strengthen engagement, identify farm...
records.description: The National Agriculture Centre (NAC) held an interactive workshop with farmers in Ras Al Khaimah to strengthen engagement, identify farmers’ needs, and promote initiatives supporting climate-smart farming and sustainable resource management. The session highlighted the Integrated Agricultural Centres Project, which provides agricultural extension, production inputs, packaging, marketing, and distribution support to improve value chains and the competitiveness of UAE-grown products. Farmers were also introduced to the UAE Good Agricultural Practices (UAEG.A.P.) programme, implemented with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), which supports food safety, traceability, responsible use of water and agricultural inputs, and access to retail and export markets.

records.title: The Algerian Chamber of Fisheries and Aquaculture (CAPA) launched a national campaign to clean 45 fishing and aquaculture ports and shelt...
records.description: The Algerian Chamber of Fisheries and Aquaculture (CAPA) launched a national campaign to clean 45 fishing and aquaculture ports and shelters across Algeria’s coastal provinces. Conducted in coordination with fisheries and aquaculture authorities, port management bodies, industry professionals, and civil society organizations, the campaign includes cleaning quays and basins, removing waste and solid residues, and raising awareness among port users about reducing marine pollution and protecting coastal ecosystems.
records.institution: Algerian Chamber of Fisheries and Aquaculture (CAPA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture – Lebanon issued a clarification on the new fisheries and aquaculture law following consultations with fisher...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture – Lebanon issued a clarification on the new fisheries and aquaculture law following consultations with fishermen, cooperatives, and unions. The ministry explained that industrial fishing is restricted to Lebanon’s exclusive economic zone and that the law expands Lebanese fishermen’s fishing rights within territorial waters from six to twelve nautical miles. It also clarified that the law does not establish that 30% of territorial waters are marine reserves and provides a legal framework for aquaculture, with implementing regulations being prepared to prioritise fishermen’s cooperatives and protect their economic interests.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its National Agricultural Extension Programme, organised a workshop in Jezzine on contract farming t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its National Agricultural Extension Programme, organised a workshop in Jezzine on contract farming to strengthen farmers’ production, marketing, and business-management skills. The workshop introduced contract farming as a tool for reducing market risks, securing more stable markets, improving productivity and farmer incomes, and establishing clearer relationships between producers and private companies. Participants received practical guidance on contracts, including production requirements, prices, quality standards, delivery arrangements, rights and obligations, and dispute-resolution mechanisms.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture – Northern Borders Region Branch launched the Farmers’ Market Festival to support loca...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture – Northern Borders Region Branch launched the Farmers’ Market Festival to support local farmers and productive families by promoting the direct marketing and sale of locally produced agricultural and rural products. The festival showcases dates, vegetables, fruits, honey, and other food products, while also providing awareness activities on sustainable agricultural practices and encouraging consumption of national products. records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) hosted a workshop in Riyadh on smart irrigation and...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) hosted a workshop in Riyadh on smart irrigation and water-use efficiency, bringing together specialists to explore innovative approaches to addressing water scarcity and improving agricultural productivity. Discussions focused on crop water requirements, advanced greenhouse technologies, and the use of data and artificial intelligence to develop smart irrigation systems. The workshop highlighted the importance of research, innovation, and collaboration in conserving water resources and advancing sustainable agriculture in Saudi Arabia, supporting preparations for the Year of Water 2027.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) provided the Ministry of Animal Resources and Fisheries in Sennar State...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) provided the Ministry of Animal Resources and Fisheries in Sennar State with a solar-powered integrated cold chain system to safely store and distribute veterinary vaccines for livestock in remote and vulnerable areas. The unit, supported through a Norwegian-funded livestock project, addresses challenges caused by unreliable electricity and seasonal isolation, particularly during the rainy season. The initiative also supports livestock disease surveillance and sample collection, while similar cold storage units are being deployed in other localities to expand veterinary services and strengthen livestock health systems.
records.institution: The Ministry of Animal Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The General Directorate of Forests – Ministry of Agriculture signed a partnership agreement with the Food and Agriculture Organization of...
records.description: The General Directorate of Forests – Ministry of Agriculture signed a partnership agreement with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) to implement a $2.48 million project to restore degraded Aleppo pine ecosystems in Kasserine Governorate. Funded by the Global Environment Facility (GEF), the project aims to strengthen forest resilience to climate change, drought, rising temperatures, wildfires, and soil degradation. The initiative will promote sustainable, adaptive, and participatory forest management; restore degraded land; improve the livelihoods of forest-dependent communities; strengthen knowledge and technical capacities; and establish monitoring and evaluation mechanisms.
records.institution: The General Directorate of Forests – Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD) and the Department of Municipalities and Transport (DMT) are strengthening cooperation under the...
records.description: The Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD) and the Department of Municipalities and Transport (DMT) are strengthening cooperation under the Abu Dhabi Waste Management Strategy through coordinated land, coastal, and marine clean-up operations combined with systematic waste data collection and analysis. The initiative involves partners including Tadweer Group, the Abu Dhabi Marine Sports Club, and diving associations, with waste being classified, weighed, and documented through the Sahim – Citizen Science programme. The resulting data helps identify waste patterns, improve monitoring, target awareness campaigns, optimise resource allocation, and support evidence-based waste management policies. The programme also promotes community participation and responsible waste practices, contributing to Abu Dhabi’s environmental protection, sustainability, and more efficient waste management.

records.title: The Ministry of the Interior, Local Authorities and Transport of Algeria reported that governors across the country implemented field and...
records.description: The Ministry of the Interior, Local Authorities and Transport of Algeria reported that governors across the country implemented field and organizational measures to facilitate the smooth progress of the agricultural harvest campaign. Measures included regular evaluation meetings, intensified field visits, stronger coordination and monitoring mechanisms, rapid responses to farmers’ concerns, and the immediate removal of operational obstacles. The authorities also coordinated the transfer of combine harvesters and agricultural equipment from provinces where harvesting had been completed to areas where operations were still underway, while mobilizing excess storage capacity in neighboring provinces to ease collection pressures.
records.institution: The Ministry of the Interior, Local Authorities and Transport

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the opening of the annual Baitir Eggplant Market Festival in Baitir, Bethlehem Governorate, h...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the opening of the annual Baitir Eggplant Market Festival in Baitir, Bethlehem Governorate, highlighting the importance of supporting Palestinian farmers, protecting agricultural land, strengthening agricultural associations, and developing food processing to increase the value and marketability of local products. The festival provides a platform for marketing locally produced agricultural, handicraft, and processed food products while promoting Baitir’s agricultural heritage, local economy, and cultural identity. The ministry reaffirmed its commitment to sustainable agricultural development, farmer empowerment, and partnerships among government institutions, civil society, and the private sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and Deir Dibwan Munici...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and Deir Dibwan Municipality, held an awareness meeting to introduce farmers and young people to a grant supporting wheat and barley cultivation, funded by the Dutch government. The programme provides financial support per dunum cultivated with wheat or barley, with a maximum grant per beneficiary, and aims to cultivate at least 250 dunums in Deir Dibwan. The initiative seeks to protect agricultural land, increase cultivated areas, strengthen farmers’ resilience, support young people, create sustainable income opportunities, and contribute to food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Directorate of Agriculture, participated in a field session for olive farmers in Burqin on...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Directorate of Agriculture, participated in a field session for olive farmers in Burqin on supplementary irrigation as a climate-smart agricultural practice. The activity, implemented with Oxfam and the Palestinian Economic and Social Development Center (ESDC), aimed to help farmers reduce the impacts of climate change and water scarcity, improve olive productivity and fruit and olive oil quality, and strengthen marketing and competitiveness. The session also covered best practices during the olive harvest and ways to improve the performance of olive presses and increase the added value of Palestinian olive oil.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Energy highlighted the contribution of the Al Henakiyah (1) Solar PV Plant to expanding renewable energy generation under...
records.description: The Ministry of Energy highlighted the contribution of the Al Henakiyah (1) Solar PV Plant to expanding renewable energy generation under the National Renewable Energy Programme. With a generation capacity of 1,100 MW, the project supplies electricity to approximately 190,000 homes annually and supports the Kingdom’s transition towards a more diversified and sustainable energy system. The project contributes to the deployment of renewable energy, energy storage, emissions reduction, and the Liquid Fuel Displacement Program, while advancing Saudi Vision 2030 and the national target of increasing renewable energy and storage to around 50% of the electricity generation mix by 2030.

records.title: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab, in cooperation with Gopa-Derd, concluded a training programme for su...
records.description: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab, in cooperation with Gopa-Derd, concluded a training programme for summer vegetable farmers in Qalaat Al-Madiq as part of a project providing agricultural production inputs and technical support. The training focused on proper crop management, efficient use of agricultural inputs, improving farming practices, and enhancing resource-use efficiency and product quality, with the broader aim of strengthening farmers’ technical capacities, promoting more efficient and sustainable agricultural practices, and supporting agricultural production in the Al-Ghab area.

records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) concluded the Marine Environment Track of its “Mustadeem” programme, an initiative designed to build youth awareness and skills in marine conservation, biodiversity protection, sustainable fisheries, food security, and water-quality management. records.title: Egypt, Jordan, and Iraq reaffirmed their commitment to advancing regional cooperation through the Egypt–Jordan–Iraq Trilateral Cooperatio...
records.description: Egypt, Jordan, and Iraq reaffirmed their commitment to advancing regional cooperation through the Egypt–Jordan–Iraq Trilateral Cooperation Mechanism, with a focus on implementing joint projects in infrastructure, trade, industry, energy, electricity interconnection, agriculture, and transport. The ministers emphasized strengthening economic integration, enhancing regional development, and accelerating the implementation of recommendations from the mechanism’s technical committees. Discussions also addressed regional political developments, including the situation in Palestine, while reaffirming the importance of regional stability, security, and continued cooperation among the three countries.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture launched a specialized training programme in the Kurdistan Region, in cooperation with the International Trad...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture launched a specialized training programme in the Kurdistan Region, in cooperation with the International Trade Centre (ITC) and with support from the European Union, to strengthen agricultural value chains and market systems. The programme aims to build the capacities of agricultural staff in value chain analysis, market systems approaches, commercial partnerships, and market requirements. It supports improving the efficiency and competitiveness of Iraq’s agrifood sector, enhancing the marketing of agricultural products, increasing value addition, and strengthening farmers’ access to domestic and international markets through international cooperation and knowledge transfer.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture announced that Jordan maintains strategic food reserves sufficient to cover domestic demand for more than six...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture announced that Jordan maintains strategic food reserves sufficient to cover domestic demand for more than six months, supported by strong domestic agricultural production, import management, and coordination with the private sector and the Higher Council for Food Security. The ministry reported increased cereal production, adequate supplies of meat, poultry, eggs, and essential food commodities, and continued support for farmers through compensation for flood-related losses, concessional financing for water-saving and renewable energy technologies, and funding to purchase locally produced grain. These measures aim to strengthen food security, reduce reliance on imports, and enhance the resilience and sustainability of Jordan’s agricultural sector.

records.description: Qatar is expected to experience strong growth in solar power as the country accelerates investments in renewable energy to diversify its energy mix, strengthen energy security, and reduce greenhouse gas emissions. records.description: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD) launched a Capacity-Building Program for Sudan’s Agricultural Sector to strengthen the human, institutional, and organizational capacities of the country’s agriculture sector. The programme will provide technical support for agricultural policy development, institutional strengthening, natural resource management, production systems, and agricultural value chains. records.title: The Directorate of Agriculture in Idlib supervised a locust control campaign in the Ariha countryside following the detection of locust s...
records.description: The Directorate of Agriculture in Idlib supervised a locust control campaign in the Ariha countryside following the detection of locust swarms affecting agricultural fields, particularly sorghum crops. The campaign supplied farmers with appropriate insecticides and provided field supervision for spraying operations covering approximately 60 hectares of agricultural land. Implemented in coordination with local agricultural offices, the campaign also included precautionary measures with beekeepers to protect honeybee populations during pesticide application. The intervention aims to protect crops, limit the spread of agricultural pests, and safeguard agricultural production.

records.title: The WWF North Africa has launched a marine waste recycling initiative in Tunisia’s Gulf of Gabès to remove abandoned fishing gear, reduce...
records.description: The WWF North Africa has launched a marine waste recycling initiative in Tunisia’s Gulf of Gabès to remove abandoned fishing gear, reduce marine pollution, and support the circular economy. Through an integrated waste management system, recovered materials are sorted for reuse by artisan cooperatives or recycled by licensed companies, while non-recyclable waste is safely disposed of through approved facilities. The initiative also strengthens the capacities of fishermen’s groups and local organizations, promotes sustainable livelihoods, restores coastal ecosystems, and supports blue carbon mechanisms by protecting Posidonia oceanica seagrass meadows to enhance climate resilience.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development (ESDC), Agricultural Relief,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development (ESDC), Agricultural Relief, and other partners, distributed 4,000 irrigated almond and apricot saplings to 25 farmers in the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Governorate. The project is funded by the Dutch Representative Office as part of broader efforts to improve livelihoods and promote sustainable economic growth in the West Bank and Gaza Strip.

records.title: The Tadweer Group has launched the second edition of the "Our Sustainable Farms" initiative to promote sustainable agriculture through re...
records.description: The Tadweer Group has launched the second edition of the "Our Sustainable Farms" initiative to promote sustainable agriculture through responsible waste management, environmental awareness, and community engagement across Abu Dhabi. Implemented in collaboration with government and agricultural partners, the initiative includes field visits, workshops, multilingual educational materials, and a podcast series to encourage proper waste segregation, soil and water conservation, livestock care, climate resilience, and the responsible use of approved waste management services. The programme aims to improve resource efficiency, reduce the environmental impact of agricultural waste, support food security, and strengthen the sustainable management of natural resources.

records.title: A specialized training workshop was conducted to strengthen the capacity of production group facilitators in organizing and managing agri...
records.description: A specialized training workshop was conducted to strengthen the capacity of production group facilitators in organizing and managing agricultural production groups and delivering community agricultural extension services. The programme trained community facilitators in farmer organization, meeting facilitation, action planning, and field monitoring to improve agricultural value chains, increase crop productivity, promote sustainable agricultural development, and enhance rural livelihoods. The initiative is implemented through agricultural cooperatives under the supervision of national agricultural institutions to strengthen community participation and encourage the adoption of good agricultural practices.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Agricultural Research Directorate, developed two new short-duration rice varieties (MRRS1 and MR...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Agricultural Research Directorate, developed two new short-duration rice varieties (MRRS1 and MRRS2) designed to reduce irrigation requirements and improve resilience to water scarcity and climate change. Following successful research trials, the new varieties entered seed multiplication under the high-grade seed production programme. Their shorter growing season enables later planting, saves more than 45 days of irrigation water, improves water-use efficiency, supports the expansion of rice cultivation into new areas, and contributes to sustainable agricultural production and national food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the General Company for Agricultural Supplies, supplied farmers in Diyala Governorate with center-pi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the General Company for Agricultural Supplies, supplied farmers in Diyala Governorate with center-pivot irrigation systems under a deferred payment scheme to facilitate access to modern irrigation technologies. The initiative aims to reduce financial barriers for farmers, improve irrigation efficiency, modernize agricultural production, and enhance the sustainability of the agricultural sector.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Agricultural Credit Corporation (ACC) signed a cooperation agre...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Agricultural Credit Corporation (ACC) signed a cooperation agreement to strengthen sustainable agricultural financing in Jordan through the development of innovative blended finance mechanisms. The initiative aims to improve access to finance for smallholder farmers, women, youth, and agricultural SMEs, enhance the resilience of the agrifood sector to economic and climate-related challenges, and support agricultural development, food security, and rural livelihoods through closer collaboration between national and international institutions.

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) reported that Jordan is expected to achieve a significantly above-avera...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) reported that Jordan is expected to achieve a significantly above-average cereal harvest due to favourable and well-distributed rainfall that improved soil moisture and crop development across major grain-producing areas. Despite the stronger domestic production and increased local grain procurement, the country will continue to rely heavily on cereal imports to maintain strategic wheat and barley reserves. The report also notes ongoing humanitarian pressures affecting refugees due to funding shortfalls, while emphasizing that improved local production strengthens national food security and grain reserves.
records.institution: Jordan Silos and Supply General Company (JSSC)

records.title: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation, in partnership with the Aqaba Special Economic Zone Authority (ASEZA) and with technical support fr...
records.description: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation, in partnership with the Aqaba Special Economic Zone Authority (ASEZA) and with technical support from the U.S. Government, launched a single-window digital platform for the National Water Carrier Project to streamline licensing and permit procedures through a unified online system. The platform enhances coordination among government institutions, accelerates project implementation, improves transparency and administrative efficiency, and supports Jordan’s water security by facilitating the delivery of one of the country’s key strategic water infrastructure projects through digital integration and governance reforms.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The General Directorate of Meteorology (DGM) issued an orange heatwave alert for several provinces in Morocco, warning of extremely high...
records.description: The General Directorate of Meteorology (DGM) issued an orange heatwave alert for several provinces in Morocco, warning of extremely high temperatures that could affect agricultural production. The heatwave is expected to increase crop water requirements, intensify heat stress on crops, and raise water losses through evaporation, while also posing risks to livestock health. Farmers are advised to optimize irrigation schedules, monitor irrigation systems, ensure adequate water and shade for livestock, and minimize animal handling during peak heat periods to reduce the impacts on agricultural productivity.

records.title: Oman submits third National Determined Contribution report to UNFCCC
records.description: The Environment Authority of Oman submitted the country's third Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC) report to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC), outlining climate mitigation and adaptation targets through 2035. The report commits to reducing greenhouse gas emissions, expanding renewable energy, improving energy efficiency, promoting green hydrogen and circular economy initiatives, and strengthening resilience to climate risks such as drought, rising temperatures, floods, sea-level rise, and tropical cyclones. It also prioritizes adaptation measures for key sectors including agriculture, water resources, fisheries, public health, tourism, and infrastructure, supporting Oman Vision 2040 and the national net-zero emissions target by 2050.

records.title: The Nama Water Services, in partnership with Hema Energy, launched a pilot project to cultivate Camelina using recycled water to promote...
records.description: The Nama Water Services, in partnership with Hema Energy, launched a pilot project to cultivate Camelina using recycled water to promote sustainable agriculture, biofuel production, and the circular use of treated wastewater. Supported by Sultan Qaboos University, the Environment Authority, and the Oman Net Zero Centre, the initiative will assess Camelina’s carbon sequestration potential and commercial viability while contributing to water security, reducing carbon emissions, and advancing Oman’s green economy and clean energy transition.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development distributed almond saplings to farmers in the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development distributed almond saplings to farmers in the Farasin area under a project to improve livelihoods and strengthen the resilience of small farmers. The initiative aims to encourage the cultivation and protection of agricultural land, expand almond production, improve farmers' incomes, enhance food security, and support sustainable agricultural development while helping farmers maintain agricultural activities in threatened areas.

records.title: Saudi Arabia and Kuwait have strengthened bilateral trade and transport cooperation through a digital customs linkage and ongoing railway...
records.description: Saudi Arabia and Kuwait have strengthened bilateral trade and transport cooperation through a digital customs linkage and ongoing railway collaboration to improve cross-border logistics and regional connectivity. The new customs system enables the secure, real-time exchange of customs data before shipments reach border crossings, accelerating clearance procedures, reducing administrative barriers, improving risk management, and facilitating trade flows. The two countries are also advancing railway cooperation and sharing technical expertise to enhance transport infrastructure and support long-term economic integration across the Gulf region.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al-Khabra Festival in Saudi Arabia serves as a platform to strengthen the palm and date value chain by promoting local dates and agri...
records.description: The Al-Khabra Festival in Saudi Arabia serves as a platform to strengthen the palm and date value chain by promoting local dates and agricultural products, supporting farmers, cottage industries, and entrepreneurs, and creating new marketing and investment opportunities. The festival provides direct market access for producers, enhances the competitiveness of high-quality dates, and showcases heritage products, handicrafts, and cultural activities, contributing to local economic development and the promotion of the region's agricultural heritage.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al-Kharj Farmers and Seasonal Products Festival continues to promote the marketing of local agricultural products by providing farmer...
records.description: The Al-Kharj Farmers and Seasonal Products Festival continues to promote the marketing of local agricultural products by providing farmers with a platform to sell dates, fruits, vegetables, and cottage industry products directly to consumers. The festival has generated strong sales and visitor turnout, supporting the palm and date value chain, encouraging local investment, and strengthening the agricultural economy through expanded market opportunities for producers.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, with support from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), launched a national liv...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, with support from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), launched a national livestock vaccination campaign by receiving 1.5 million doses of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccine for cattle, alongside additional vaccines for sheep. The initiative aims to strengthen disease prevention and control, protect livestock from regional disease outbreaks, enhance veterinary surveillance and early detection, ensure safe vaccine distribution and quality control, and improve livestock health and food security through a comprehensive national immunization programme.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture attributed Tunisia’s dairy sector crisis to climate change, recurring drought, water scarcity, rising global...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture attributed Tunisia’s dairy sector crisis to climate change, recurring drought, water scarcity, rising global feed prices, and structural challenges such as small herd sizes and fragmented production. In response, the ministry has implemented measures including increasing guaranteed farm-gate milk prices, raising collection incentives, capping livestock feed prices in coordination with the Ministry of Commerce, developing a national forage production plan, and preparing a livestock recovery programme to rebuild animal resources and improve the sector’s resilience and sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agricultur, the Ministry of Commerce

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), in partnership with the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) and the Mini...
records.description: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), in partnership with the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) and the Ministry of Water Resources, with funding from Global Affairs Canada (GAC), launched the MURUNA project to strengthen Iraq’s resilience to water scarcity and climate change. The initiative will improve water governance, enhance community-level water management, rehabilitate water infrastructure, and promote climate-smart agriculture to help vulnerable farming communities adapt to drought, desertification, rising temperatures, and declining river flows, while supporting long-term food security and sustainable agricultural development.
records.institution: The International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) and the Ministry of Water Resources

records.title: The National Union of Agricultural Engineers (UNA) will organize a national symposium on mountain agriculture and the rural economy to de...
records.description: The National Union of Agricultural Engineers (UNA) will organize a national symposium on mountain agriculture and the rural economy to develop a national vision for sustainable development in Algeria’s mountain areas. The event will bring together government institutions, research organizations, universities, businesses, and experts to promote sustainable agriculture, rural economic development, forest protection, wildfire prevention, renewable energy, innovation, investment, and scientific research. It will also feature technical workshops, exhibitions, awareness campaigns, reforestation activities, and support initiatives for communities affected by forest fires, with the aim of strengthening food security and sustainable rural development.
records.institution: Representatives from government sectors, national institutions

records.title: The Government of Iraq and the Government of Türkiye are implementing a bilateral water cooperation agreement that has significantly incr...
records.description: The Government of Iraq and the Government of Türkiye are implementing a bilateral water cooperation agreement that has significantly increased upstream water flows in the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, while introducing an oil-for-water financing mechanism to support water infrastructure projects through joint Iraqi–Turkish implementation. The agreement establishes a framework for coordinated seasonal water releases based on Iraq’s needs, aiming to improve long-term water security. The initiative comes as Iraq continues to face water scarcity driven by upstream dam development, climate change, declining rainfall, and resource management challenges, although recent abundant rainfall has temporarily improved reservoir levels.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) celebrated the graduation of the first 200 participants under its Clima...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) celebrated the graduation of the first 200 participants under its Climate Wise Women programme as part of the Building Resilience to Cope with Climate Change in Jordan through Improving Water Use Efficiency in the Agriculture Sector (BRCCJ) project. Implemented with national and international partners and funded by the Green Climate Fund (GCF), the initiative equips rural women with skills in climate adaptation, water-use efficiency, and climate-smart agriculture to strengthen community resilience, promote sustainable agricultural practices, and improve food security in areas affected by water scarcity, rising temperatures, and drought.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation, Ministry of Agriculture, Ministry of Environment

records.title: Morocco Foodex reported continued growth in Morocco’s agri-food exports, with export value and volumes increasing significantly, reinforc...
records.description: Morocco Foodex reported continued growth in Morocco’s agri-food exports, with export value and volumes increasing significantly, reinforcing the sector’s role as one of the country’s leading sources of foreign exchange. Despite weather-related declines in citrus and some horticultural exports, the institution highlighted ongoing efforts to strengthen the competitiveness of Moroccan agricultural, agri-food, and fisheries products through technical quality control, market intelligence, export promotion, and support for exporters. The strategy also focuses on diversifying export markets, supporting new exporters and startups, and maintaining a balance between domestic supply and export growth under the Generation Green 2020–2030 strategy.

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources reported strong growth in North Al Batinah’s agricultural, livestoc...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources reported strong growth in North Al Batinah’s agricultural, livestock, fisheries, and food sectors, driven by strategic investments, improved infrastructure, food safety systems, and agricultural support programmes. The governorate expanded cultivated areas, increased crop and livestock production, strengthened pest and animal disease control, promoted sustainable water management, and advanced food security through new investment opportunities, food processing projects, logistics infrastructure, and integrated agricultural cities. Partnerships with the Development Bank, Oman Sugar Refinery Company, and Oman Agriculture Development Company further supported value chain development, export growth, and sustainable agricultural production in line with Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Palestinian Hydrologists Group and with funding from the German Federal Ministry for...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Palestinian Hydrologists Group and with funding from the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) through the German Agency for International Cooperation (GIZ), launched a project to strengthen the resilience of small farmers by distributing pressurized irrigation equipment in Tulkarm Governorate. The initiative promotes modern irrigation technologies to improve water-use efficiency, conserve water resources, increase agricultural productivity, enhance climate resilience, and support sustainable agricultural production and food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and supported by the IBSA Fund (Governme...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and supported by the IBSA Fund (Governments of India, Brazil, and South Africa), signed an agreement to establish and equip an alternative animal feed production unit in Bardala. The project will convert agricultural waste into livestock feed, benefiting local livestock breeders by reducing production costs, improving resource efficiency, strengthening the sustainability of the livestock sector, and enhancing farmers' resilience through training and modern feed production technologies

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Palestinian Center for Economic and So...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development (ESDC), distributed almond saplings to small farmers to expand fruit tree cultivation, improve land productivity, and strengthen sustainable livelihoods. The initiative supports the resilience of small farmers by promoting sustainable agricultural production, encouraging investment in agricultural land, enhancing food security, and improving farmers' ability to cope with ongoing challenges.

records.description: The National Center for Palms and Dates launched the Buraidah International Dates Carnival, one of the world's largest dates markets, bringing together farmers, traders, and importers to promote Saudi Arabia's dates sector. The carnival serves as a major platform for marketing dates, supporting investment, creating employment, and showcasing value-added products while highlighting Qassim's leading role in date production and its contribution to the national economy. The event also features cultural and tourism activities that promote the region's agricultural heritage and strengthen the competitiveness of the Kingdom's date industry.
records.institution: The National Center for Palms and Dates

records.description: The Rahat Seasonal Date Market is strengthening agricultural supply chains and improving the marketing of locally produced dates by connecting farmers directly with traders and consumers. Supported by a strong production base of approximately 300,000 palm trees, the market promotes efficient harvesting, grading, packaging, and sales, enhancing the value chain for the date sector. The initiative supports farmers' incomes, improves marketing efficiency, and contributes to the sustainable development and competitiveness of Saudi Arabia's palm and date industry.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Heritage Authority launched the inaugural Al Wathba Dates Festival to support date palm cultivation, promote high-quality l...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Heritage Authority launched the inaugural Al Wathba Dates Festival to support date palm cultivation, promote high-quality local date production, and strengthen the competitiveness of the UAE's date sector. The festival features competitions that encourage best agricultural practices, recognize outstanding date growers, and preserve the cultural heritage associated with date palms while creating marketing opportunities for farmers and supporting the sustainability of the sector.

records.title: The Public Establishment for Industrial Estates (Madayn) reported continued investment growth in Ibri Industrial City, with projects span...
records.description: The Public Establishment for Industrial Estates (Madayn) reported continued investment growth in Ibri Industrial City, with projects spanning the food, manufacturing, oil and gas, and light industry sectors. To strengthen agrifood value chains and support economic diversification, Madayn launched new investment opportunities in food manufacturing and organic fertilizer production in partnership with the Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources through the Tharawat and Tatweer platforms. The industrial city is also expanding its infrastructure under Oman’s development plan to attract value-added investments, create jobs, and support the objectives of Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Public Establishment for Industrial Estates (Madayn)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, supported by data from the National Cereals Board, reported that the national grain harvest and collection c...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, supported by data from the National Cereals Board, reported that the national grain harvest and collection campaign is nearly complete, with cereal production exceeding initial estimates and surpassing 20 million quintals. Improved durum and soft wheat harvests are expected to reduce cereal import requirements, strengthen domestic food security, improve the agricultural trade balance, and reflect the sector’s recovery following several drought-affected seasons.

records.domain: Fisheries and aquaculture measures and regulations
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced the opening of the squid fishing season in Yemen’s Red Sea territor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced the opening of the squid fishing season in Yemen’s Red Sea territorial waters under regulated conditions based on scientific assessments and technical recommendations. The measures include restrictions on fishing in estuaries and shallow areas, field monitoring of juvenile squid, enforcement against illegal fishing, and the implementation of an emergency squid stock management plan in coordination with relevant authorities. The initiative aims to conserve squid stocks, ensure the sustainable management of marine fisheries, protect aquatic resources, and support continued fish production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture highlighted tree planting as a natural measure to reduce summer temperatures, noting t...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture highlighted tree planting as a natural measure to reduce summer temperatures, noting that trees lower heat through shading, reduced heat absorption, and transpiration, while each tree can absorb an average of 150 kilograms of carbon dioxide annually. The ministry stated that expanding green spaces improves air quality, reduces noise, supports rainwater management, and provides habitats for wildlife and pollinators. It recommended planting native tree species adapted to local climatic conditions and advised irrigation during early morning or evening using drip irrigation systems, together with organic mulch to conserve soil moisture and regulate soil temperature.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), in collaboration with the Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) and the Embass...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), in collaboration with the Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) and the Embassy of the Netherlands, launched the Mapping Irrigation Potential and Needs (IRMA) initiative in Jordan under the Regional Water Scarcity Initiative (WSI) Programme. The initiative introduces an artificial intelligence-based framework to map irrigated areas and assess irrigation potential using biophysical suitability, development needs, and irrigation benefits. The workshop brought together national water and agriculture institutions and development partners to present the IRMA methodology, digital platform, and international applications, while reviewing Jordan’s irrigation priorities and the current status of the irrigation sector. The programme is supported by the governments of Sweden and the Netherlands and implemented with technical contributions from UNICEF, ESCWA, ICARDA, IWMI, and ICBA.

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: The Jordanian state grain buyer issued an international tender to purchase up to 120,000 metric tons of milling wheat from optional origi...
records.description: The Jordanian state grain buyer issued an international tender to purchase up to 120,000 metric tons of milling wheat from optional origins after no purchase was made in the previous tender for the same volume. The tender requests deliveries in 60,000-ton consignments across four shipment windows between September and October. Jordan also issued a separate international tender for 120,000 tons of animal feed barley. The country previously purchased 60,000 tons of milling wheat through an international tender as part of its grain procurement programme and continues to use international tenders to maintain national grain stocks and secure supplies from multiple origins.

records.title: The General Authority for Fisheries and Aquatic Resources continued fish production activities at the Al-Sin Estuary Research Center, tra...
records.description: The General Authority for Fisheries and Aquatic Resources continued fish production activities at the Al-Sin Estuary Research Center, transferring five-day-old grass carp and silver carp larvae from hatchery incubation tanks to primary nursery ponds. The transfer was carried out under approved technical procedures, including continuous oxygen supply throughout transport to maintain larval survival and growth conditions. The activity forms part of the authority’s fish production programme to produce high-quality fingerlings and support aquaculture development and fish production.
records.institution: The General Authority for Fisheries and Aquatic Resources

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: The Cereals Office instructed cereal collectors to implement preventive measures to protect grain stocks from forecasted heavy rainfall a...
records.description: The Cereals Office instructed cereal collectors to implement preventive measures to protect grain stocks from forecasted heavy rainfall and storm conditions affecting northern and central regions. Collectors were directed to secure cereals stored at collection centres and in transit by using protective tarpaulins and to remain on high alert for rapid intervention if needed. The measures were issued following weather forecasts from the National Institute of Meteorology (INM) warning of adverse weather conditions that could threaten the cereal harvest.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture announced a pilot vaccination programme against bovine tuberculosis using the Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG)...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture announced a pilot vaccination programme against bovine tuberculosis using the Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) vaccine following a review of a national study on its effectiveness and risks. The pilot will evaluate the vaccine’s performance under Tunisian farming conditions before any wider rollout. Existing disease control measures, including epidemiological surveillance, biosecurity, animal movement controls, herd testing, and culling of infected animals, will remain in place. The announcement follows recent detections of bovine tuberculosis in cattle and forms part of the national livestock recovery strategy, which includes rebuilding livestock herds, improving forage production, digitising livestock monitoring systems, and strengthening veterinary services.

records.title: The Directorate of Agricultural Services (DSA) in Mila organized a technical training day for potato producers in coordination with a pri...
records.description: The Directorate of Agricultural Services (DSA) in Mila organized a technical training day for potato producers in coordination with a private seed company. The event presented new potato varieties, their production potential, cultivation requirements, disease management practices, and technical recommendations on irrigation, fertilization, and variety selection adapted to local conditions.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, announced the successful cultivation of local and international olive v...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, announced the successful cultivation of local and international olive varieties at the Najaf Specialized Nursery in Najaf Governorate. The trial demonstrated the successful flowering and fruiting of olive trees under dry climatic conditions and poor soils. The nursery is producing subsidized olive seedlings of several local and international varieties, including Picual, Arbequina, Frantoio, Qaisi, Bashiqi, and improved Nabali, for distribution to farmers.

records.title: Mauritania, Saudi Arabia Sign Long-term Lease To Boost Agriculture in Brakna
records.description: The Ministry of Public Domain, State Property, and Land Reform signed a long-term lease agreement with the Saudi investment company E-Rif for the development and operation of 53,957 hectares of agricultural land in Brakna Wilaya. The project will involve significant private investment and the application of modern agricultural technologies to expand agricultural production, improve productivity, and strengthen Mauritania’s agricultural capacity and food security through foreign investment and large-scale land development.

records.description: The Nablus Directorate of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Palestinian Standards Institution and Jabal Al-Zaytoun Al-Akhdar Company, organized a workshop on quality management targeting 20 olive mill owners in the governorate. The workshop addressed the application of quality standards and procedures to improve olive oil production in line with approved specifications. The activity included presentations on quality management standards for olive mills, compliance with Palestinian specifications, and practices to enhance the quality of olive oil production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is finalizing preparations with the World Bank to launch the STAR project, a US$175 million initiative that w...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is finalizing preparations with the World Bank to launch the STAR project, a US$175 million initiative that will be implemented over six years to strengthen Syria’s agricultural sector. The project will support crop production, improve agricultural value chains, and develop the livestock sector while promoting sustainable agricultural practices. It also aims to strengthen agricultural cooperatives, increase private sector participation, digitize agricultural services and ministry operations, improve institutional performance, and enhance food security and rural livelihoods through modernized agricultural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with ACSAD, launched a training course for agricultural technicians to strengthen capacities...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with ACSAD, launched a training course for agricultural technicians to strengthen capacities in strategic planning, agricultural investment plan development, and economic feasibility studies. The programme aims to improve institutional planning, resource allocation, project prioritization, and the preparation of investment projects that enhance agricultural sector performance, support food security, promote sustainable development, and strengthen the resilience of rural communities to climate change.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Damascus and Rural Damascus Chamber of Agriculture and Amal Relief and Development O...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Damascus and Rural Damascus Chamber of Agriculture and Amal Relief and Development Organization, launched the Rural Women's Food and Handicrafts Exhibition to support rural women entrepreneurs by promoting and marketing locally produced food and handicrafts directly to consumers. The initiative aims to improve rural household incomes, strengthen the competitiveness of rural products through better quality and packaging, expand market access, support rural food processing units, and reduce marketing intermediaries by facilitating direct sales between producers and consumers.

records.title: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar Governorate conducted a field training workshop for farmers on the safe use of agricultural pesticides.
records.description: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar Governorate conducted a field training workshop for farmers on the safe use of agricultural pesticides. The programme provided guidance on pesticide handling, personal protective equipment, integrated pest management, crop rotation, pest identification, correct application rates, pre-harvest safety intervals, first aid for pesticide poisoning, and the proper disposal of pesticide containers. Officials also warned against the use of banned or smuggled pesticides and highlighted unsafe practices observed among farmers, while distributing awareness materials at the end of the workshop.
records.institution: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar Governorate
