records.title: Trinasolar signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Al-Raebi for Trading and Solar Energy Systems Company to explore a potential 1...
records.description: Trinasolar signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Al-Raebi for Trading and Solar Energy Systems Company to explore a potential 1.5 GW solar project pipeline in Yemen during 2026–2029. The agreement provides a framework for evaluating large-scale solar energy opportunities, technical requirements, and future cooperation models, including the potential use of advanced photovoltaic technologies for utility-scale and commercial projects. The partnership focuses on renewable energy development and expanding access to clean energy solutions in Yemen and the wider Middle East.
records.institution: Al-Raebi for Trading and Solar Energy Systems Company

records.title: The Presidency of Egypt and the Government of Tanzania agreed to strengthen bilateral cooperation through plans to launch a large-scale a...
records.description: The Presidency of Egypt and the Government of Tanzania agreed to strengthen bilateral cooperation through plans to launch a large-scale agricultural land reclamation project in Tanzania to produce strategic crops and enhance food security, alongside expanding collaboration in maritime transport, port development, logistics, energy, irrigation, and infrastructure. The two countries also discussed establishing a direct maritime shipping route, developing regional transport corridors, increasing trade and investment, and expanding technical cooperation and capacity-building programmes.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture completed the 2026 implementation of the National Soybean Programme for the multiplication and maintenance of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture completed the 2026 implementation of the National Soybean Programme for the multiplication and maintenance of high-grade soybean seeds following the completion of planting across central, northern, southern, and western governorates. The programme used artificial intelligence and smart agriculture technologies, including satellite data, soil analysis, spectral analysis, and thermal mapping, to monitor crop growth and support technical decision-making. This marks the third consecutive year that the programme has applied AI and satellite monitoring technologies.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, announced the successful production of Super S potato seed, the highest...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, announced the successful production of Super S potato seed, the highest internationally recognized seed potato classification, following official certification by the Department of Seed Testing and Certification. The achievement was developed through the National Potato Development Programme, including tissue culture and field production facilities in Nineveh and Anbar, producing genetically pure and virus-free seed potatoes and establishing domestic production of high-grade seed potatoes in Iraq.

records.domain: Fisheries and aquaculture measures and regulations
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Department of Animal Resources, completed its 2026 fish breeding and stocking programme with a 1...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Department of Animal Resources, completed its 2026 fish breeding and stocking programme with a 100% implementation rate, releasing more than 155 million fish into lakes and water bodies across Iraq, compared with 96 million in the previous season. The programme included newly hatched fish, fingerlings, and juvenile fish of common, grass, and silver carp, as well as native Iraqi species including qattan, shabout, and bani, through the department’s hatcheries.

records.title: The Moroccan government has resumed onion exports to African markets while maintaining restrictions on tomato and potato exports, despite...
records.description: The Moroccan government has resumed onion exports to African markets while maintaining restrictions on tomato and potato exports, despite providing no official explanation for the selective controls. Exporters are also facing logistical challenges as freight traffic has shifted from the traditional Mali transit corridor to the Rosso border crossing between Mauritania and Senegal due to ongoing insecurity in Mali. Congestion, limited ferry capacity, and transport delays are increasing costs and affecting the quality of perishable products, highlighting the importance of regional security and infrastructure improvements for maintaining agricultural trade with sub-Saharan Africa.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the North Hebron Directorate of Agriculture and in partnership with the United Nations Development P...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the North Hebron Directorate of Agriculture and in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), implemented olive field school activities in Sa'ir for 15 women farmers under the "My Initiative" project. The programme included assessing participants' needs to support the implementation of small income-generating projects and provided participatory agricultural extension on olive cultivation and good agricultural practices to improve production quality and efficiency.

records.title: Researchers at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) developed a new genome engineering method that enables the prec...
records.description: Researchers at King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) developed a new genome engineering method that enables the precise insertion of large genetic sequences into specific locations within plant genomes without creating DNA breaks. The method was successfully demonstrated in tobacco and rice and expands the capabilities of plant biotechnology for developing crops with complex genetic traits, including improved tolerance to heat, drought, and disease, as well as supporting plant-based biomanufacturing.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) signed seven contracts worth SAR1 billion to expand logistics centres at Jeddah Islamic Port and the A...
records.description: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) signed seven contracts worth SAR1 billion to expand logistics centres at Jeddah Islamic Port and the Al Khumra logistics zone. The projects will develop nearly 384,000 square metres of logistics infrastructure for storage, consolidation, and re-export, supported by digital technologies and enhanced transport connectivity. The expansion includes new container yards in partnership with Maersk and is expected to improve supply chain efficiency, increase trade capacity, create more than 5,000 jobs, and strengthen Saudi Arabia’s position as a regional and global logistics hub under Saudi Vision 2030 and the National Transport and Logistics Strategy.

records.title: The General Directorate of Veterinary Services raised epidemiological surveillance to the highest level in response to increasing regiona...
records.description: The General Directorate of Veterinary Services raised epidemiological surveillance to the highest level in response to increasing regional animal health alerts. Veterinary authorities strengthened active disease surveillance, field inspections, biosecurity measures, emergency preparedness, and vaccine stock management, including maintaining cold-chain systems during power outages. The measures also include adapting vaccination campaigns to high temperatures, revaccinating livestock after the heatwave, and expanding collaboration with private veterinarians through training to enhance preparedness for transboundary animal diseases.
records.institution: The General Directorate of Veterinary Services

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture urged heightened vigilance and preventive measures to reduce the risk of forest fires during an exceptional h...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture urged heightened vigilance and preventive measures to reduce the risk of forest fires during an exceptional heatwave and increased fire activity. The Ministry announced that the General Directorate of Forests and its regional services are monitoring the situation and remain fully mobilized to protect forest resources. It also called on residents and visitors to avoid activities that could trigger fires, promptly report incidents, and support coordinated emergency response efforts involving local authorities, disaster management committees, and civil society.

records.title: The Bonyan Development Foundation, in cooperation with the local authority in Ibb Governorate, the Ministries of Agriculture, Fisheries a...
records.description: The Bonyan Development Foundation, in cooperation with the local authority in Ibb Governorate, the Ministries of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and Social Affairs and Labor, concluded a 10-day training course for members of agricultural associations. The programme strengthened the technical and administrative capacities of association representatives through training on development mechanisms, agricultural policies, institutional management, productive groups, and resource optimization. It was implemented by the Bonyan Training and Qualification Academy with support from the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit and involved participants from several districts in Ibb Governorate.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Agricultural Research Directorate, continued manual rice transplanting activities at the Mishkha...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Agricultural Research Directorate, continued manual rice transplanting activities at the Mishkhab Research Station under the national breeding and seed multiplication programme to develop and preserve high-quality national rice varieties. The work covers several local rice cultivars using approved cultivation techniques to maintain genetic purity, improve seed quality, and strengthen breeding programmes. The initiative supports agricultural research, enhances domestic rice production, and contributes to improving food security through the development of resilient and productive local crop varieties.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Plant Protection Directorate, continued field surveillance and control campaigns against the red...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Plant Protection Directorate, continued field surveillance and control campaigns against the red palm weevil in Wasit and Diyala governorates as part of the national programme to limit the spread of the pest. The campaigns included field inspections and treatment of infected palm groves using approved technical methods to protect date palm production. The Ministry reaffirmed its commitment to implementing preventive measures, while urging farmers to report infestations early and follow technical guidance to improve the effectiveness of pest control efforts and safeguard palm orchards.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) launched the second phase of a capacity-building programme on climate-s...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) launched the second phase of a capacity-building programme on climate-smart agriculture in Jordan under the BRCCJ project to strengthen the resilience of local communities to climate change. The programme provides civil society and community organizations with practical training on climate-smart agricultural practices, sustainable water management, and the planning of local resilience initiatives. Implemented in partnership with national stakeholders and funded by the Green Climate Fund, the initiative aims to improve water-use efficiency, support sustainable agriculture, strengthen food security, and enhance climate adaptation across multiple governorates.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture stated that stable and declining meat prices in the local market are the result of measures to strengthen foo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture stated that stable and declining meat prices in the local market are the result of measures to strengthen food supply chains, diversify import sources, and increase market competition while maintaining strict veterinary and health standards. The Ministry reported that local production supplies a significant share of national red meat demand, with the remainder secured through imports from multiple approved origins to build a strategic reserve and reduce dependence on a single source. Ongoing market monitoring, partnerships with the private sector, and enhanced supply chain management have improved the availability of meat, stabilized prices, protected consumers, and reinforced Jordan’s national food security.

records.title: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) reported that Libya's cereal production is expected to remain below average...
records.description: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) reported that Libya's cereal production is expected to remain below average due to unfavorable weather conditions, including delayed planting caused by dry conditions and below-average rainfall in key cereal-producing areas. As a result, cereal import requirements are projected to increase, reflecting the country's dependence on imported wheat to meet domestic demand. The report also highlights rising food inflation driven by currency depreciation and notes that funding shortages are limiting humanitarian assistance for vulnerable populations affected by ongoing political and economic instability.
records.institution: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources announced the implementation of 493 food security projects under Oman’s 10th F...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources announced the implementation of 493 food security projects under Oman’s 10th Five-Year Plan (2021–2025), with investments aimed at strengthening domestic agricultural and fisheries production, reducing reliance on food imports, and enhancing long-term food security. The projects span the agriculture, fisheries, and related sectors, with the majority focused on agricultural development, supporting economic diversification, increasing local production capacity, and improving the resilience of the national agrifood system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is exploring the expanded use of drone technology to strengthen agricultural p...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is exploring the expanded use of drone technology to strengthen agricultural productivity, environmental monitoring, and biosecurity in Oman. The initiative focuses on integrating unmanned aerial systems into crop monitoring, pest and disease surveillance, precision agriculture, and the protection of agricultural resources, while also enhancing food security through the adoption of advanced technologies. The discussions emphasize collaboration among government institutions, technology providers, and research partners to develop innovative drone applications that improve decision-making, increase production efficiency, and support the sustainable development of the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture signed an agreement worth 126,000 shekels to procure equipment required to complete the operation of the Yatt...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture signed an agreement worth 126,000 shekels to procure equipment required to complete the operation of the Yatta municipal slaughterhouse under a broader EU-funded agricultural development project. The overall project includes establishing the slaughterhouse and rehabilitating the Al-Samu breeding station and laboratory to improve livestock breeds. The initiative aims to strengthen food safety, improve livestock sector infrastructure, and support sustainable livestock development.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The National Center for Palms and Dates highlighted Al-Kharj Governorate's role as one of Saudi Arabia's leading date-producing regions,...
records.description: The National Center for Palms and Dates highlighted Al-Kharj Governorate's role as one of Saudi Arabia's leading date-producing regions, supported by extensive palm cultivation, diverse date varieties, and an integrated production, processing, and marketing system that strengthens food security and agricultural development. The governorate produces approximately 90,400 tons of dates annually, generating significant economic value and seasonal employment. Annual promotional events, including the Al-Kharj Dates and Saudi Coffee Festival, further support marketing, boost local economic activity, and create additional job opportunities.
records.institution: The National Center for Palms and Dates

records.title: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab has launched the rehabilitation of more than 3 kilometers of the irri...
records.description: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab has launched the rehabilitation of more than 3 kilometers of the irrigation canal between Al-Jabin and Sheikh Hadid in northern Hama Governorate. The project aims to improve the efficiency of irrigation networks, strengthen water resource management, and support agricultural production by enhancing water delivery to farmland.
records.institution: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The General Organization for Seed Multiplication is continuing quality control and laboratory testing of seed samples collected from cont...
records.description: The General Organization for Seed Multiplication is continuing quality control and laboratory testing of seed samples collected from contracted fields as part of the seed procurement season. More than 1,000 samples have been examined to verify compliance with approved technical standards before final acceptance. The initiative aims to ensure the supply of certified, high-quality seeds to farmers, improve crop performance, and enhance agricultural productivity in future planting seasons.
records.institution: The General Organization for Seed Multiplication

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in coordination with the General Authority for Water Resources and Water Faci...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in coordination with the General Authority for Water Resources and Water Facilities and local authorities, assessed water infrastructure needs in Bayt Hadyan, Bani Al-Harith district, to support agriculture and improve groundwater recharge. The planned interventions include developing dams and water barriers to maximize rainwater harvesting, strengthen irrigation for vineyards, and expand cultivated farmland through community-led initiatives supported by technical assistance and hydrological studies. The initiative aims to enhance sustainable water resource management, reduce pressure on groundwater resources, and strengthen agricultural self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with Order of Malta Lebanon, launched an initiative to support livestock breeders and farming...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with Order of Malta Lebanon, launched an initiative to support livestock breeders and farming families in Jezzine through the distribution of animal feed and agricultural inputs under the AHEAD programme. The intervention aims to strengthen farmers’ resilience, sustain livestock production, protect rural livelihoods, and enhance food security amid ongoing economic challenges and the impacts of recent conflict. The initiative forms part of a broader agricultural recovery strategy that includes rehabilitation of irrigation infrastructure, water sources, production facilities, and extension services, alongside the promotion of modern technologies and efficient resource use. The programme also contributes to maintaining milk and meat production, supporting rural development, and building a more resilient and sustainable agricultural sector through partnerships with international organizations and donors.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests and Bank Al-Maghrib signed a partnership agreeme...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests and Bank Al-Maghrib signed a partnership agreement to strengthen cooperation in the exchange of statistical data, economic information, and forecasting related to the agriculture, fisheries, water, and forestry sectors. The agreement establishes a framework for sharing studies and expertise, conducting joint research to support evidence-based policymaking, and implementing training and capacity-building activities for staff from both institutions. The partnership aims to improve data-driven decision-making and enhance the development of public policies affecting the agricultural sector.
records.institution: Bank Al-Maghrib and the Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Khayrat AlUla seasonal initiative at AlManshiyah Farmers Market promotes the marketing of locally produced summer fruits by providing...
records.description: The Khayrat AlUla seasonal initiative at AlManshiyah Farmers Market promotes the marketing of locally produced summer fruits by providing farmers with direct access to consumers, increasing market opportunities and farm incomes while supporting sustainable agriculture. The initiative also encourages value addition through the production of processed foods such as juices, jams, dried fruits, and sweets, creating opportunities for cottage industries and small businesses. By strengthening production, processing, and marketing linkages, the programme enhances agricultural value chains, supports entrepreneurship, and contributes to local economic development and the sustainable growth of AlUla’s agricultural sector.

records.title: The Central Bank of Iraq (CBI) launched a lending initiative worth IQD 1.2 trillion to support investment in the education and veterinary...
records.description: The Central Bank of Iraq (CBI) launched a lending initiative worth IQD 1.2 trillion to support investment in the education and veterinary sectors while strengthening liquidity in the banking system. The financing scheme provides loans for private educational institutions and vocational training facilities, as well as veterinary pharmaceutical and vaccine manufacturers, veterinary hospitals, clinics, laboratories, and producers of veterinary supplies, subject to approvals from the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Agriculture, and other relevant authorities. The initiative aims to expand access to financing, strengthen veterinary health infrastructure, support animal health services and domestic production of veterinary products, and contribute to broader economic and agricultural development.

records.domain: Fisheries and aquaculture measures and regulations
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture announced the enactment of a new Fisheries and Aquaculture Law establishing a modern legal framework for the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture announced the enactment of a new Fisheries and Aquaculture Law establishing a modern legal framework for the sustainable management of marine fisheries and aquaculture. The law promotes a sustainable blue economy by strengthening governance, regulating fisheries and aquaculture, protecting marine biodiversity, combating illegal fishing, and expanding aquaculture investment to increase domestic fish production and improve food security. It gives priority to small-scale artisanal fishers and their cooperatives in aquaculture investments, safeguards their livelihoods, and aligns Lebanon's fisheries management with international standards, including FAO guidelines and GFCM practices. The legislation also positions the Ministry of Agriculture as the lead authority for managing the sector and aims to stimulate investment, create employment, reduce dependence on fish imports, and support sustainable coastal development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty, together with the Ministry of Youth Empowerment, Employment, Sports, and Civil Service,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty, together with the Ministry of Youth Empowerment, Employment, Sports, and Civil Service, the Ministry of the Interior, Decentralization and Local Development, and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), signed three framework cooperation agreements to strengthen agricultural development, youth empowerment, and local development in Mauritania. The agreements establish a coordinated institutional framework for implementing development programs by integrating donor-funded initiatives into national systems, improving technical oversight, strengthening monitoring and accountability, and enhancing collaboration among government institutions. The partnership also aims to integrate rural youth into agricultural value chains, support participatory local development, strengthen the role of municipalities, and improve the implementation of agricultural and food sovereignty policies. The agreements support the expansion of the Mauritania–IFAD programme, increasing institutional capacity, improving governance, and enhancing the effectiveness of agricultural and rural development investments.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through its Tabuk branch, launched mobile honey sorting and packaging units to provid...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through its Tabuk branch, launched mobile honey sorting and packaging units to provide on-site services for beekeepers across villages and natural pasture areas. The units offer honey analysis, sorting, packaging, and technical guidance using modern technologies to improve product quality and marketing. The initiative aims to strengthen the regional apiculture sector, increase the commercial value of locally produced honey, enhance service efficiency, and support sustainable agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries issued preventive guidance to farmers and livestock producers to mitigate the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries issued preventive guidance to farmers and livestock producers to mitigate the impacts of an ongoing heat wave and extreme temperatures on agricultural production. The recommendations include optimizing irrigation, avoiding field operations during peak heat, protecting young crops, monitoring for heat stress and pest outbreaks, ensuring adequate water, shade, and ventilation for livestock, reducing animal transport during hot periods, and increasing vigilance against crop and forest fires. The Ministry also advised measures to protect agricultural workers from heat exposure and urged stakeholders to follow meteorological updates and implement preventive actions to minimize damage to crops, livestock, and natural resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The General Tihama Development Authority reported significant progress in agricultural and livestock development through programs aimed a...
records.description: The General Tihama Development Authority reported significant progress in agricultural and livestock development through programs aimed at increasing production, strengthening food security, and supporting self-sufficiency. Key achievements included expanding agricultural and livestock exports, rehabilitating irrigation infrastructure and floodwater harvesting systems, implementing large-scale livestock vaccination campaigns, establishing agricultural field schools, supporting beekeeping, promoting digital transformation, deploying solar energy systems, strengthening pesticide control, and improving agricultural facilities. The authority also emphasized continued investment in irrigation, farmer support, environmental protection, and institutional modernization to enhance agricultural productivity and resilience across the Tihama Plain.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, returned a shipment of chilled fish to its country of origin after veteri...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, returned a shipment of chilled fish to its country of origin after veterinary quarantine inspections at the Al-Walid border crossing found that it did not comply with required storage conditions, import regulations, and official approval procedures. The measure was taken to safeguard public health, prevent the entry of non-compliant food products, and ensure adherence to national veterinary and food safety standards. The return process was implemented in coordination with the Border Ports Authority, the General Authority of Customs, the Al-Walid Border Crossing Directorate, and other relevant authorities, reflecting Iraq’s continued efforts to strengthen border biosecurity, enforce import controls, and maintain the safety and quality of imported food products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued more than 3,100 certificates of origin to wheat and barley farmers to facilitate the delivery of l...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued more than 3,100 certificates of origin to wheat and barley farmers to facilitate the delivery of locally produced grain to storage silos and collection centers managed in coordination with the Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply. The government has expanded grain collection and transportation capacity, including the establishment of new collection centers, to streamline procurement and reduce logistical bottlenecks. As part of its continued support for strategic crops, the government is purchasing locally produced wheat and barley at subsidized prices significantly above international market levels, while allocating increased funding for grain procurement. These measures aim to encourage the expansion of wheat and barley cultivation, strengthen domestic grain production, improve marketing channels for farmers, and enhance Jordan’s national food security through greater reliance on local production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture continued implementing the second phase of the European Union-funded Agricultural Assistance Programme by dis...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture continued implementing the second phase of the European Union-funded Agricultural Assistance Programme by disbursing funds for agricultural projects in Hebron and Bethlehem as part of a wider initiative across the West Bank. The programme supports investments in livestock production, protected agriculture, rainwater harvesting, agricultural mechanization, land rehabilitation, and greenhouse development to improve production efficiency, strengthen water and food security, and promote sustainable agricultural production. The initiative aims to help affected farmers maintain and expand their agricultural activities, improve farm productivity, and enhance the resilience of rural livelihoods through continued financial support.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through its Qassim branch, planted 183,000 trees during the first half of 2026 as par...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through its Qassim branch, planted 183,000 trees during the first half of 2026 as part of efforts to expand vegetation cover, conserve natural resources, and advance environmental sustainability. The afforestation initiative was supported by strong community participation involving volunteers, public and private sector partners, and regional nurseries. It also included environmental awareness campaigns targeting schools and technical colleges to promote sustainability and support the environmental objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Lebanese Reforestation Initiative (LRI), the University of Balamand, and touch, laun...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Lebanese Reforestation Initiative (LRI), the University of Balamand, and touch, launched a national campaign to strengthen forest health management and protect Lebanon’s forests from diseases, pests, wildfires, climate-related risks, and human pressures. The campaign promotes a science-based approach through continuous forest monitoring, the use of technologies such as drones for early detection, strengthened enforcement of forest protection laws, legislative reforms, and enhanced collaboration with municipalities, security agencies, universities, and civil society. It also includes awareness and educational activities to promote sustainable forest management, biodiversity conservation, and the protection of water and soil resources, while improving the resilience of forest ecosystems and ensuring the long-term sustainability of Lebanon’s natural heritage.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests launched a mid-term review of the Generation Gre...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests launched a mid-term review of the Generation Green 2020–2030 strategy to assess progress, accelerate implementation, and develop a long-term vision for a more resilient, competitive, and sustainable agricultural sector. Conducted in consultation with agricultural chambers, professional organizations, and other stakeholders, the review will evaluate achievements and identify measures to strengthen plant and livestock production, improve irrigation water security, expand agricultural mechanization, modernize distribution and marketing systems, and increase financing and investment. The ministry noted that despite challenges such as prolonged drought, global market disruptions, and the effects of recent crises, the strategy has contributed to improved agricultural value chains, greater water-use efficiency, enhanced farmer livelihoods, strengthened social protection, and emergency interventions to mitigate drought impacts, including livestock restocking.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in North Al Sharqiyah, under the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in North Al Sharqiyah, under the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, organized a stakeholder forum to promote the use of water desalination units as part of efforts to strengthen sustainable food and water security. The event brought together private sector representatives, farmers, investors, and technicians to discuss desalination solutions and foster collaboration. A partnership agreement was signed with Nada Al Rabee Company to provide technical support and install water desalination units for farms affected by soil and water salinity, helping improve agricultural resilience and water resource management.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is supporting the expansion of modern agricultural projects that enhance food...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is supporting the expansion of modern agricultural projects that enhance food security, improve resource-use efficiency, and promote high-value crop production in Oman. A papaya cultivation project in North Al Batinah demonstrates the successful adoption of climate-suitable crop varieties, drip irrigation, modern fertilization practices, and technical extension services to increase productivity and optimize water use. The project also plans to expand cultivation and invest in agro-processing to produce value-added products such as juices and dried fruits, contributing to agricultural diversification, increased farmer incomes, and the competitiveness of Omani agricultural products.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Salfit Directorate of Agriculture and with funding from the United Nations Development Programme...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Salfit Directorate of Agriculture and with funding from the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), provided a package of agricultural inputs and equipment to olive farmers participating in field schools in Iskaka and Farkha to promote sustainable olive cultivation and improve farm productivity. The assistance included organic compost, olive fruit fly traps, supplemental irrigation barrels, harvesting materials, pruning and harvesting tools, weed control equipment, and organic fertilizers to enhance crop management, reduce pest damage, and lower production costs. As part of the ministry’s field school program, the initiative combines practical training with the provision of agricultural inputs to improve farmers’ technical knowledge, strengthen agricultural resilience, and support sustainable agricultural development and livelihoods.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) implemented a project to strengthen the wheat production chain in eastern A...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) implemented a project to strengthen the wheat production chain in eastern Aleppo, Syria, by rehabilitating key agricultural infrastructure and providing equipment to improve food security and farmer livelihoods. The project included the delivery of a mobile seed-cleaning station, rehabilitation of a seed multiplication warehouse to increase certified seed production and reduce post-harvest losses, renovation of agricultural extension centers, provision of agricultural tractors and machinery, and restoration of irrigation pumping stations powered by solar energy. These interventions aim to improve access to quality seeds, mechanized farming services, irrigation, and technical support, thereby enhancing agricultural productivity, strengthening the resilience of farming communities, and supporting sustainable food production in conflict-affected areas.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries announced that Tunisia achieved record exports of packaged olive oil during th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries announced that Tunisia achieved record exports of packaged olive oil during the current export season, with shipments reaching more than 60 international markets. The ministry aims to further expand packaged olive oil exports despite expectations of lower production in the next season, reflecting a strategy to increase the value and competitiveness of Tunisian olive oil in global markets. The strong export performance was attributed to effective collaboration between the public and private sectors, as well as the active participation of producers and industry stakeholders in improving production quality and export capacity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), in partnership with the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), the Ministr...
records.description: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), in partnership with the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), the Ministry of Water Resources, and with financial support from Global Affairs Canada (GAC), launched the MURUNA project to strengthen climate resilience and improve food and water security in Iraq. The project promotes inclusive water governance, improved community-based water management, and climate-smart agriculture through better water planning, rehabilitation of water infrastructure, support for water user associations, and the introduction of innovative agricultural technologies and practices. Targeting communities affected by water scarcity, drought, desertification, rising temperatures, and declining river flows, the initiative aims to enhance agricultural productivity, strengthen the resilience of vulnerable farmers, improve sustainable resource management, and support long-term food security, with particular emphasis on community participation and women's inclusion.
records.institution: The International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), the Ministry of Water Resources

records.title: The Sana'a Chamber of Commerce and Industry, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, Sana'a Univ...
records.description: The Sana'a Chamber of Commerce and Industry, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, Sana'a University, and the Central Veterinary Laboratory, reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening the poultry sector by complying with government health and veterinary regulations. Following scientific assessments addressing concerns over Newcastle disease, stakeholders pledged to implement regular vaccination and immunization programs, strengthen quality control of poultry production inputs such as feed and chicks, and cooperate fully with veterinary inspection teams to ensure supply chain safety and compliance with national standards. The initiative aims to restore market confidence, reduce losses for poultry farmers, safeguard domestic poultry production, and support national food security by maintaining a reliable and affordable source of animal protein.
records.institution: The Sana'a Chamber of Commerce and Industry

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation and the Central Administration for Agricultural Quarantine reported a significant increa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation and the Central Administration for Agricultural Quarantine reported a significant increase in Egypt's agricultural exports, exceeding 5.8 million tonnes, led by citrus fruits, potatoes, sweet potatoes, grapes, beans, onions, strawberries, garlic, tomatoes, guava, and pomegranates. The growth is attributed to strengthened quality control, traceability, phytosanitary compliance, and monitoring systems that meet international food safety standards, alongside efforts to expand access to new export markets. The government continues to collaborate with producers and exporters to enhance the competitiveness of Egyptian agricultural products and reinforce the country's position as a leading global agricultural exporter.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation and the Central Administration for Agricultural Quarantine

records.title: The General Company for Grain Processing, in coordination with the Ministry of Trade, is launching a unified electronic platform to manag...
records.description: The General Company for Grain Processing, in coordination with the Ministry of Trade, is launching a unified electronic platform to manage and streamline bran sales auctions for registered bidders across Baghdad and other governorates. The digital system is designed to standardize bidding conditions—requiring official documentation, specialized payment cards, and verified financial balances—while utilizing automated text notifications to ensure equitable access and prevent fraudulent side agreements. In addition to establishing greater transactional integrity and anti-corruption measures, the state enterprise is actively reviewing bidder feedback regarding variations in bran quality and impurity levels between public and private mills to implement standardized quality-control remedies.
records.institution: The General Company for Grain Processing

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is exploring the implementation of a smart national livestock tracking sy...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is exploring the implementation of a smart national livestock tracking system to strengthen veterinary health security, improve livestock disease surveillance, and enhance epidemic control. The proposed project would establish a centralized database linking veterinary clinics and livestock farms nationwide, while using RFID technology to identify animals, monitor their health status, manage electronic vaccination schedules, and support evidence-based decision-making. The initiative aims to improve the efficiency of veterinary services and strengthen livestock management through modern digital technologies.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is continuing its nationwide cattle vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease to protect livestock,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is continuing its nationwide cattle vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease to protect livestock, prevent the spread of animal diseases, enhance food security, and support the livestock production sector. Veterinary teams, working with regional agricultural offices and veterinarians, are implementing a comprehensive vaccination plan covering farms across all governorates, resulting in the vaccination of more than 24,000 cattle. The ministry continues to encourage livestock breeders to participate in the campaign to safeguard herd health and ensure the sustainability of Lebanon’s livestock sector.

records.title: The Razat Sultaniya Farm of the Royal Court Affairs in Oman has successfully established local pineapple production after extensive resea...
records.description: The Razat Sultaniya Farm of the Royal Court Affairs in Oman has successfully established local pineapple production after extensive research to assess the crop's suitability under local conditions. The initiative advanced from small-scale cultivation to commercial production under shaded areas and greenhouses in Dhofar, where favorable climatic conditions support growth. The farm evaluated multiple pineapple varieties before selecting the globally preferred MD-2 variety for its high yield, fruit quality, and market value. The project also demonstrated the crop's relatively low water requirements and adopted tissue culture technology to produce disease-free planting material, supporting the potential expansion of pineapple cultivation and agricultural diversification in Oman.
records.institution: The Razat Sultaniya Farm of the Royal Court Affairs

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Mithlon Agriculture and Veterinary Department and in partnership with GIZ (German Hydrologists G...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Mithlon Agriculture and Veterinary Department and in partnership with GIZ (German Hydrologists Group), distributed irrigation network equipment to small-scale vegetable farmers to improve irrigation efficiency, conserve water resources, and enhance agricultural productivity. The initiative supports farmers by upgrading irrigation infrastructure, strengthening resilience, promoting sustainable agriculture, and improving livelihoods through more efficient water use and continued agricultural production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, with funding from the European Union, allocated 25 agricultural development projects to support affected far...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, with funding from the European Union, allocated 25 agricultural development projects to support affected farmers in Nablus, Tulkarm, Tubas, and Qalqilya as part of a broader agricultural assistance program. The initiative provides financial support for agricultural projects to strengthen farmers' resilience, sustain agricultural production, protect agricultural lands, and improve productivity in areas affected by ongoing challenges. Implemented in partnership with local authorities and international donors, the program aims to enhance sustainable agricultural development, encourage agricultural investment, and support farming families through targeted resilience-building interventions.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change outlined Qatar’s comprehensive strategy to combat desertification and drought through the...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change outlined Qatar’s comprehensive strategy to combat desertification and drought through the National Strategy to Combat Desertification 2025–2030, aligned with Qatar National Vision 2030. The strategy focuses on sustainable land management, ecosystem restoration, afforestation, rehabilitation of degraded land, protection of biodiversity, expansion of nature reserves, and the use of advanced technologies such as geographic information systems, remote sensing, drones, and artificial intelligence for environmental monitoring. Complemented by legislative reforms, research, community engagement, and international cooperation, including the Middle East Green Initiative, the ministry is implementing programs to increase vegetation cover, improve water efficiency, restore natural habitats, and strengthen climate resilience while supporting sustainable agriculture and long-term environmental sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is conducting inspection and awareness campaigns in livestock markets across the Makka...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is conducting inspection and awareness campaigns in livestock markets across the Makkah Region to strengthen compliance with animal health and veterinary regulations, protect consumers, preserve livestock, and support national food security. As part of a nationwide program, the initiative combines field inspections with awareness activities targeting livestock owners, vendors, and market workers to promote proper livestock transport, handling, display, and veterinary practices while reducing regulatory violations and improving market operations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Production and Economic Resources and stakeholders from the agricultural sector highlighted the severe impact of the ongo...
records.description: The Ministry of Production and Economic Resources and stakeholders from the agricultural sector highlighted the severe impact of the ongoing civil war on Sudan's mango industry, with disrupted supply chains, damaged infrastructure, and rising transportation and logistics costs causing significant post-harvest losses and limiting market access. Despite strong domestic production and continued demand from export markets, inadequate processing facilities, weak cold-chain infrastructure, and unreliable transport networks have reduced the sector's competitiveness. Experts emphasized the need to invest in resilient agricultural infrastructure, sorting and packaging facilities, cold-chain systems, food processing, and efficient supply chains to restore the mango industry, improve food security, and support rural economic recovery.
records.institution: The Ministry of Production and Economic Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Environment of Egypt reviewed proposed projects under the Sustainable Blue Economy in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden (HESBE...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment of Egypt reviewed proposed projects under the Sustainable Blue Economy in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden (HESBERSGA) initiative aimed at protecting marine ecosystems while supporting sustainable economic development. The projects include upgrading environmental infrastructure in Red Sea marine protected areas through eco-friendly mooring systems, monitoring equipment, and capacity-building programmes; implementing a green ports programme to improve environmental management, reduce pollution, and lower carbon emissions; and developing marine spatial planning to better manage coastal economic activities. The initiative also promotes regional cooperation through PERSGA on marine pollution control, emergency response, scientific research, environmental monitoring, and protection of marine resources, while supporting sustainable tourism and fisheries management.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment of Egypt

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through technical committees from its Seed Testing and Certification Department, is supervising seed purific...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through technical committees from its Seed Testing and Certification Department, is supervising seed purification operations at the Al-Suwaira processing plant in Wasit Governorate, which is operated by the Iraqi Seed Production Company. This quality control initiative is designed to oversee the mechanical operation of purification lines and enforce strict adherence to approved technical specifications and purity regulations. By ensuring the systematic production of high-purity, certified crop seeds, the program aims to supply efficient planting materials that meet the requirements of the national agricultural plan, bolster farmers' confidence in domestic agricultural products, and ultimately strengthen food security and sustainable agricultural development in Iraq.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), in partnership with the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) and funded b...
records.description: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP), in partnership with the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) and funded by Global Affairs Canada (GAC), has officially launched the MURUNA project to enhance climate resilience, agricultural productivity, and food security across Iraq. Implemented in direct coordination with the Ministry of Water Resources, the comprehensive program targets structural vulnerabilities confronting rural communities, where escalating desertification, acute droughts, and severely reduced inflows from the Tigris and Euphrates rivers leave an estimated 2.5 million people in need of humanitarian assistance. The strategic framework will deploy resources across three interconnected pillars: implementing inclusive national-level water governance and macro-planning, upgrading community-level water management infrastructure, and scaling the adoption of climate-smart agricultural technologies. Furthermore, the initiative will build institutional capacity within local water user associations to design equitable allocation schedules, with explicit mandates to support and economically empower rural women.
records.institution: The International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock launched development and rehabilitation works at the Sidi Al-Masri Nature Reserve in cooperatio...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock launched development and rehabilitation works at the Sidi Al-Masri Nature Reserve in cooperation with the Tripoli Public Services Company and with support from the Agricultural Police. The project includes clearing weeds and waste to reduce fire risks, opening access roads, constructing service facilities, and strengthening protection of the reserve through continued security measures. The initiative aims to preserve the reserve’s natural environment, improve its management, and support the conservation of biodiversity and natural resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock

records.title: The Bank Al-Morocco (Bank Al-Maghrib) and the Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests have...
records.description: The Bank Al-Morocco (Bank Al-Maghrib) and the Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests have signed a partnership agreement to strengthen institutional cooperation through the exchange of statistical data, economic forecasting, and technical expertise. The collaborative framework establishes a formal mechanism for sharing research, sector-specific studies, and data resources necessary to monitor economic trends and improve policy analysis across Morocco’s agricultural, maritime, and forestry sectors. In addition to co-authoring research on shared economic interests to support evidence-based public policymaking, the agreement prioritizes staff capacity-building and specialized training programs to enhance technical skills and deepen coordination between the central bank and the ministry.
records.institution: The Bank Al-Morocco (Bank Al-Maghrib) and the Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: According to agricultural trial data released by Razat Royal Farm, operating under the Royal Court Affairs, Oman has successfully cultiva...
records.description: According to agricultural trial data released by Razat Royal Farm, operating under the Royal Court Affairs, Oman has successfully cultivated local pineapple crops in the Dhofar Governorate following nearly fifteen years of agronomic research and field trials. Supervised by the farm’s agricultural engineering specialists, the cultivation methodology transitioned from initial container trials to shaded field planting and controlled greenhouse production, revealing that the crop adapts optimally to Dhofar's mild temperatures and high humidity during the annual Khareef (monsoon) season from July through December. The research evaluated the Queen, Mauritius, and MD-2 pineapple cultivars, identifying the MD-2 variety as the most commercially viable due to its high sweetness profile, low irrigation requirements relative to other tropical species, and large fruit weight ranging from two to over four kilograms. To facilitate future commercial scaling and crop diversification under the Sultanate's agricultural development goals, the farm integrated advanced tissue-culture techniques to systematically mass-produce uniform, disease-free seedlings.

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Dhahirah Governorate, under the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and W...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Dhahirah Governorate, under the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, is advancing agricultural, livestock, and food security investments to position the governorate as a key production hub in Oman. The region is developing a portfolio of projects covering crop production, greenhouses, livestock farming, food processing, storage, logistics, and agricultural services, supported by government services, private sector partnerships, and modern technologies. These initiatives aim to increase local production, strengthen value chains, enhance self-sufficiency, attract investment, and contribute to Oman Vision 2040 food security objectives.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Dhahirah Governorate

records.title: During a comprehensive development field tour in Jenin Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture coordinated several agricultural, infrast...
records.description: During a comprehensive development field tour in Jenin Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture coordinated several agricultural, infrastructural, and food-processing projects aimed at strengthening local farmers' economic resilience, optimizing resource management, and protecting agricultural lands. The regional interventions included signing bilateral agreements with the Jenin Municipality to establish two agricultural parks spanning 30 dunams, inaugurating a 1,000-cubic-meter groundwater collection reservoir in Kafr Ra'i to support long-term water security, and inspecting a four-kilometer agricultural road reclamation project in Ya'bad completed in partnership with the Land Research Center. To evaluate localized value-chain integration and industrial food production, administrative visits were conducted across regional agrifood facilities—including the "Spring Cucumber" pickle factory, the Canaan Fairtrade Company, the Al-Hafeed Dairy Factory, and an olive oil tin manufacturing plant—while agricultural officials documented the grievances of local farmers regarding regional security challenges and land seizures to plan targeted support interventions.

records.title: According to production data released by the Directorate of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform in Al-Hasakah, the northeastern Syrian govern...
records.description: According to production data released by the Directorate of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform in Al-Hasakah, the northeastern Syrian governorate has concluded its winter harvesting cycle for the 2025–2026 agricultural season, recording some of its highest crop yields in recent years. Spanning a cultivation footprint of approximately 373,500 hectares of wheat, 289,000 hectares of barley, and 24,000 hectares of lentils, the bumper harvest was driven by abundant, regular seasonal rainfall that significantly enhanced soil moisture, optimized grain quality, and minimized reliance on deep-well irrigation, thereby drastically reducing fuel and machinery maintenance costs for local smallholders. The subnational authority has processed over 863,000 tons of wheat through designated collection centers as of July 12, with aggregate seasonal deliveries projected to exceed one million tons via an electronic registration platform operating through the end of August. Following the completion of the harvest, officials have suspended the routine issuance of certificates of origin to finalize the marketing phase, cementing the governorate's strategic role as a primary national grain-producing breadbasket.
records.institution: The Directorate of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform

records.title: The local Directorate of Agricultural Services has reported that the Wilaya of Mila achieved a garlic yield of 1,619,325 quintals for the...
records.description: The local Directorate of Agricultural Services has reported that the Wilaya of Mila achieved a garlic yield of 1,619,325 quintals for the 2025–2026 agricultural season, exceeding initial institutional forecasts of 1.55 million quintals. This production volume was harvested across an estimated 2,887 hectares, with cultivation heavily clustered within the Teleghema irrigation perimeter in the southern region of the wilaya, encompassing the municipalities of Oued Atmania, Oued Seggan, Teleghema, and Mechira. Local agricultural officials attributed the surplus performance to favorable seasonal climatic conditions and advanced technical mastery of crop management protocols by domestic smallholders. To stabilize market dynamics and prevent supply gluts, a dedicated portion of the harvested yield will be systematically transferred to cold storage facilities under the national garlic regulation program.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has initiated a national enforcement campaign to remove illegal longline networks, fixed fishing nets, and tr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has initiated a national enforcement campaign to remove illegal longline networks, fixed fishing nets, and traps as part of its strategic plan to protect fish stocks and promote sustainable marine resource management. Undertaken in close coordination with the Lebanese Army and state security forces, the administrative intervention aims to combat destructive harvesting practices, protect vulnerable marine habitats, and allow depleted fish stocks to regenerate. Minister of Agriculture Dr. Nizar Hani commended the constructive cooperation shown by local fishermen and fishermen's unions, emphasizing that institutional partnerships and rigorous regulatory oversight are vital to securing the long-term economic livelihoods of coastal communities and stabilizing domestic food security. Moving forward, the ministry intends to expand its monitoring programs and advance responsible fishing protocols to safeguard marine biodiversity as a strategic national asset.

records.title: The Sebha Chamber of Commerce has signed a strategic cooperation agreement with the Regional Consular Department of the Agadez Chamber of...
records.description: The Sebha Chamber of Commerce has signed a strategic cooperation agreement with the Regional Consular Department of the Agadez Chamber of Commerce and Industry in Niger to establish an economic and trade corridor linking southern Libya's Fezzan region to sub-Saharan African markets. This bilateral partnership is engineered to facilitate the trans-Saharan movement of goods and services, reduce logistical transport costs, and optimize regional supply chains while expanding joint investment opportunities in agriculture, industry, energy, tourism, and logistics. Additionally, the agreement aims to build a shared economic information system for business networks and serves as a foundational step ahead of the Fezzan Economic Forum, which seeks to assemble private-sector actors and financial institutions to convert these institutional frameworks into tangible, sustainable development projects.

records.title: According to data released by the Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources, Al Dhahirah Governorate has compiled an integra...
records.description: According to data released by the Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources, Al Dhahirah Governorate has compiled an integrated portfolio of 67 active food security investment projects across three wilayats, spanning approximately 9,607 acres with an aggregate capital value of OMR 84 million. Operating under the strategic framework of Oman Vision 2040 and coordinated with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the subnational development plan includes a newly finalized poultry production agreement with A'Namaa valued at OMR 28.85 million. The localized investments are structurally distributed to optimize regional comparative advantages, with Ibri leading in diverse greenhouse, fodder, and livestock processing facilities, Dhank functioning as a primary vegetable and table egg production basket, and Yanqul executing horticultural and fish market management projects. To transition from basic harvesting to integrated value chains, the governorate has collaborated with Madayn (Ibri Industrial City) and the Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning to introduce dozens of new high-tech agronomic, tissue culture, and organic fertilizer opportunities via the Tatweer platform, aiming to lock in localized value addition and expand regional agrifood export capacity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Hebron Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, with institutional support from the Diakonia Foundation, distributed 14,274 summer veg...
records.description: The Hebron Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, with institutional support from the Diakonia Foundation, distributed 14,274 summer vegetable seedlings to 61 farmers in the town of Tafouh to enhance domestic food production and build local agricultural capacity. Integrated within the broader development programs of the Ministry of Agriculture, this localized intervention focuses on expanding home-based agriculture and backyard gardening to optimize smallholder land-use efficiency and improve household economic security. The project underscores the importance of multi-institutional partnerships between regional agricultural authorities, local bodies, and non-governmental organizations to deliver critical production inputs, scale sustainable agrifood production, and reinforce the long-term economic resilience of rural farming communities.
records.institution: The Hebron Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Nablus Directorate of Agriculture, representing the Ministry of Agriculture, partnered with the ARIJ Foundation to distribute 110 spe...
records.description: The Nablus Directorate of Agriculture, representing the Ministry of Agriculture, partnered with the ARIJ Foundation to distribute 110 specialized agricultural kits to 110 livestock smallholders across the central Jordan Valley, specifically targeting the areas of Aqrabaniya and Faroush Beit Dajan. Funded by the Mennonite Central Committee under the framework of the "Ta'ma" project, this localized intervention delivers critical inputs to improve the day-to-day working conditions and operational efficiency of regional animal herders. The strategic distribution operates as part of an institutional framework designed to mitigate production challenges, preserve pastoral livelihoods, and enhance the long-term sustainability of subnational livestock value chains within vulnerable rural agricultural communities.

records.title: The North Hebron Agriculture Directorate delivered critical agricultural inputs to field schools in the towns of Sa'ir and Beit Ula to en...
records.description: The North Hebron Agriculture Directorate delivered critical agricultural inputs to field schools in the towns of Sa'ir and Beit Ula to enhance olive grove productivity and expand the technical capacities of rural smallholders. Implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), the localized intervention distributed 150 plastic barrels and 1,000 sacks of composted organic fertilizer to 27 beneficiaries, including 14 female and 13 male farmers. The input distribution followed a specialized training curriculum managed by the directorate's Olive, Rural Development, and Extension units, which focused on instructing farmers in supplemental irrigation, organic fertilization, and sustainable soil management. This collaborative development project aims to optimize subnational olive value chains, economically empower rural women, and strengthen the long-term resilience and productivity of the regional agrarian sector.

records.title: Egypt's agricultural exports have surpassed 5.8 million tons for the current year, driven by rising global demand and enhanced market com...
records.description: Egypt's agricultural exports have surpassed 5.8 million tons for the current year, driven by rising global demand and enhanced market competitiveness, according to a report from the Central Administration for Agricultural Quarantine (a subsidiary of the Agricultural Services Sector under the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation). Citrus fruits commanded the largest share of export shipments at over 2.2 million tons, followed by fresh potatoes at 908,000 tons and sweet potatoes at 218,000 tons, alongside notable volumes of grapes, onions, beans, strawberries, and garlic. The sustained expansion reflects increased international trust in the state's phytosanitary monitoring and traceability systems, supporting a broader institutional strategy to penetrate new global markets across multiple continents with strict quarantine requirements and build on the positive export trajectories established over previous years.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The National Seed Bank, affiliated with the National Agricultural Research Centre (NARC), serves as a strategic sovereign facility in Jor...
records.description: The National Seed Bank, affiliated with the National Agricultural Research Centre (NARC), serves as a strategic sovereign facility in Jordan holding more than 5,000 genetic accessions across field crops, vegetables, medicinal plants, and wild relatives to preserve genetic diversity and secure long-term food security. Operating as the scientific arm of the Ministry of Agriculture, the institution utilizes advanced drying, processing, and cryogenic storage facilities—including specialized cold rooms set to 4 degrees Celsius for short-term and minus 18 degrees Celsius for long-term preservation—to expand seed viability up to 100 years. The center also encompasses the National Herbarium with over 4,400 documented wild specimens, functioning as a vital specialized research infrastructure that supplies genetic material to universities and scientific organizations to develop climate-resilient, highly productive plant varieties in alignment with international plant genetic resource treaties.

records.title: The Buraimi Governorate has launched its first integrated agricultural investment project in the Al Zaroub area of Mahdah, representing a...
records.description: The Buraimi Governorate has launched its first integrated agricultural investment project in the Al Zaroub area of Mahdah, representing a strategic infrastructure development designed to enhance national food security and mobilize private capital into the agrifood sector. Valued at an initial investment exceeding OMR 171,000 (approximately $444,770), the 30-acre facility specializes in the commercial cultivation, processing, and marketing of high-value horticultural commodities, specifically figs, lemons, and mangoes. Current land allocation includes dedicated acreage for lemon trees, fig orchards, and mango groves, with structural land preparation actively underway to expand production capacity by establishing a new seven-acre fig orchard. This localized initiative functions as a subnational model for sustainable resource management and commercial crop diversification to maximize the economic productivity of agricultural lands.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources announced plans to construct 33 new dams across Oman under the Eleventh Five-Y...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources announced plans to construct 33 new dams across Oman under the Eleventh Five-Year Development Plan to enhance water security, reduce flood risks, and improve climate resilience. The projects include flood protection dams, groundwater recharge facilities, surface storage dams, and community-based water projects aimed at strengthening water resource management, supporting agriculture, and protecting communities and infrastructure. The initiative builds on Oman’s existing dam network and incorporates advanced hydrological models, climate data, early warning systems, and monitoring technologies to improve preparedness for extreme weather events and ensure sustainable water use.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has officially launched the 2026–2027 Khairat AlUla agricultural season to strengthen the competitiv...
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has officially launched the 2026–2027 Khairat AlUla agricultural season to strengthen the competitiveness and production efficiency of the region’s agricultural sector across more than 20,500 hectares of cultivated land. To modernize the local agrifood value chain and boost export readiness, the commission has surveyed over 4.2 million palm trees and integrated more than 1.5 million palms into a smart QR code traceability system. These data-driven interventions support the institution's strategic goals to increase gross agricultural output and maximize export revenues, backed by advisory, technical, and veterinary extension services deployed to over 7,100 farmers. Furthermore, the commission is executing circular economy initiatives to recycle agricultural waste into organic compost, alongside deploying designs for modern, water-efficient irrigation networks across 4,000 hectares to achieve targeted reductions in water consumption.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of Tunisia has unveiled a five-year livestock sector recovery strategy covering the 2026 to 2030 period, desi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Tunisia has unveiled a five-year livestock sector recovery strategy covering the 2026 to 2030 period, designed to restore domestic cattle and small ruminant populations following severe losses caused by prolonged drought. Funded through a combination of the national budget, the Agricultural Sector Competitiveness Development Fund, and external financial partners, the comprehensive program aims to relieve inflationary pressure on domestic meat prices and enhance subnational food security. The roadmap outlines targeted structural interventions, including rebuilding depleted national herds, expanding resilient forage and fodder resources, deploying digital livestock monitoring systems for optimized tracking, and strengthening public veterinary and animal health services.
