records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Tunisia has unveiled a five-year livestock sector recovery strategy covering the 2026 to 2030 period, designed to restore domestic cattle and small ruminant populations following severe losses caused by prolonged drought. Funded through a combination of the national budget, the Agricultural Sector Competitiveness Development Fund, and external financial partners, the comprehensive program aims to relieve inflationary pressure on domestic meat prices and enhance subnational food security. The roadmap outlines targeted structural interventions, including rebuilding depleted national herds, expanding resilient forage and fodder resources, deploying digital livestock monitoring systems for optimized tracking, and strengthening public veterinary and animal health services.

records.title: The summer bell pepper harvesting season in Morocco has commenced with growers and exporters anticipating a significant increase in produ...
records.description: The summer bell pepper harvesting season in Morocco has commenced with growers and exporters anticipating a significant increase in production volume across the region, driven primarily by domestic tomato growers strategically transitioning their acreage to bell and Kapia peppers due to structural difficulties within the tomato industry. Backed by corporate and grower-level collaborations with Universal Peppers, this crop diversification strategy is being met with strong, diversified international market demand capable of absorbing the expanded supply without distribution bottlenecks. According to market data from the Association of Fruit and Vegetable Exporters (APEFEL), which tracked robust export benchmarks between 80,000 and 90,000 metric tons of peppers during previous growing cycles, early seed procurement and favorable microclimate conditions in the Agadir cultivation hub have mitigated historical supply constraints, though agribusiness operators maintain strict vigilance regarding plant health protocols as harvesting intensifies.
records.institution: The Association of Fruit and Vegetable Exporters (APEFEL)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Farmers' Market Festival in Turaif Governorate has commenced operations, under the organizational oversight of the regional branch of...
records.description: The Farmers' Market Festival in Turaif Governorate has commenced operations, under the organizational oversight of the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture alongside the Social Development Bank, to create vital localized sales channels for smallholders and cottage-industry producers. The institutional initiative features dedicated market stalls designed to showcase regional dates, fresh fruits, vegetables, honey, and traditional handicrafts, effectively converting local agronomic production into high-value micro-economic outputs. Furthermore, the event integrates community-level awareness modules focusing on standardized food security frameworks and sustainable agricultural practices, operating as a strategic subnational mechanism to incentivize the consumption of domestic products and advance the socio-economic empowerment of rural communities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: The Tunisian Cereals Office has reported that cumulative national grain collections reached approximately 9.1 million quintals as of July...
records.description: The Tunisian Cereals Office has reported that cumulative national grain collections reached approximately 9.1 million quintals as of July 7, 2026. This domestic harvest yield is composed of 8.6 million quintals of consumer grains (95% of the total volume) and 493,000 quintals of raw, selected seeds (5%) sourced from specialized seed production entities. Subnational collection data highlights the northern and northwestern governorates as primary production hubs, led by Béja (21.9%), Kef (13.8%), Bizerte (13.4%), and Siliana (13.3%). To secure subsequent cropping cycles, regional technical committees are actively isolating specific barley volumes to establish a strategic national seed reserve. Furthermore, institutional field control teams are conducting systematic audits across collection centers and calibration laboratories to monitor grain evacuation logistics—which reached 3.4 million quintals transferred or sold to commercial mills by early July—while oversight mechanisms ensure the standard flow of financial disbursements to domestic farmers.

records.title: The Dubai World Trade Centre is scheduled to host Growtech Middle East 2026 (GrowtechME) from October 26 to 28, 2026, in Halls 7 and 8, s...
records.description: The Dubai World Trade Centre is scheduled to host Growtech Middle East 2026 (GrowtechME) from October 26 to 28, 2026, in Halls 7 and 8, serving as a primary regional venue for agricultural innovation, technology, and sustainable farming. Rebranded from its previous iteration as Agra Middle East (AgraME) to reflect an intensifying institutional focus on food security, the exhibition leverages a 17-year sector legacy across the agriculture, aquaculture, and animal health verticals. Designed as a commercial B2B matchmaking and knowledge-sharing hub to connect public and private stakeholders across the agrifood value chain, the upcoming event is projected to feature more than 150 international exhibitors and attract over 9,000 professional attendees.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The National Center of Meteorology (NCM) reported a high probability that moderate El Niño conditions will persist through the coming mon...
records.description: The National Center of Meteorology (NCM) reported a high probability that moderate El Niño conditions will persist through the coming months, with temperatures and rainfall across the UAE expected to range from near normal to above seasonal averages, particularly toward the latter part of the forecast period. Based on monitoring of sea surface temperatures in the tropical Pacific, the outlook indicates that El Niño is likely to influence the UAE’s climate, with potential implications for weather conditions that are relevant to water resources, agriculture, and climate monitoring.

records.title: The Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, in coordination with the regional Agriculture Office and the Agri...
records.description: The Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, in coordination with the regional Agriculture Office and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, has concluded two specialized animal health training courses for 36 trainees in the Al-Makhadir and Dhi As-Sufal districts of Ibb Governorate. Executed in partnership with the Bonyan Development Foundation and the Bonyan Academy for Training and Qualification, the 19-day curriculum provided intensive theoretical and field-based training in diagnosing and treating viral, bacterial, and parasitic livestock diseases. This community-level veterinary intervention, supported by local authorities and the Dhi As-Sufal Agricultural Cooperative Society, aims to establish a rural veterinary nucleus to minimize livestock losses, improve animal health management, and advance national food security and self-sufficiency goals. At the culmination of the program, graduates were equipped with integrated veterinary kits to provide sustainable veterinary extension services directly to smallholder breeders across local villages.
records.institution: The Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit

records.title: According to an official announcement by the Ministry of Agriculture reported by the Jordan News Agency, Petra, the government has launch...
records.description: According to an official announcement by the Ministry of Agriculture reported by the Jordan News Agency, Petra, the government has launched the Green Jobs Project, a four-year sustainable development initiative designed to plant 300,000 forest seedlings and create 4,300 direct employment opportunities. Developed in coordination with the German Development Bank (KfW), the project incorporates targeted social inclusion mandates, allocating 30% of the newly created jobs to women and 6% to persons with disabilities. The initial phase will deploy afforestation operations across Irbid's Koura and Bani Kinanah districts—specifically focusing on Rahmeh and Yarmouk—alongside the Deir Alla and Iqaba nurseries before expanding to additional subnational zones. By broadening forest coverage, the program functions as a strategic environmental mechanism to enhance regional water security, mitigate soil erosion, increase carbon sequestration, and combat desertification, while simultaneously delivering specialized vocational training to upgrade national forest management expertise and empower rural economies.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Alternative Energy Projects Company (AEP), a Kuwait-based renewable energy developer, has announced plans to raise capital to expand...
records.description: The Alternative Energy Projects Company (AEP), a Kuwait-based renewable energy developer, has announced plans to raise capital to expand its solar energy operations across Kuwait and the wider MENA region, appointing Kamco Invest and Burgan Bank to lead the transaction. Under the agreement, Kamco Invest will establish a special purpose vehicle for clients to participate in the capital increase, acquiring an equity stake and board representation to support the execution of the firm's growth strategy. The proceeds will be utilized to accelerate the development, financing, and operation of a high-quality pipeline of solar and hybrid off-grid projects under long-term contracts spanning 15 to 25 years. This capital injection will enhance AEP's regional footprint, which already includes secured projects in Kuwait and Oman, while positioning it to pursue additional utility-scale, commercial, and industrial opportunities across Saudi Arabia, Jordan, and the broader region in alignment with national sustainability objectives.

records.title: The National Advisory Committee for Organic Production has approved the draft implementing decrees for Law No.
records.description: The National Advisory Committee for Organic Production has approved the draft implementing decrees for Law No. 158 concerning the regulation of organic production in Lebanon, solidifying the legal and administrative framework required to align domestic organic practices with international regulatory standards. Moving forward, the regulatory package will be submitted to the State Council for comprehensive judicial review to establish standardized governance, verify certification protocols, and build market and consumer trust in domestic organic supply chains. In tandem with these legislative advancements, the committee finalized plans to organize the first National Conference on Organic Agriculture at the Engineers Syndicate headquarters in Beirut, an institutional platform designed to bring together producers, academic bodies, and international donors. Championed by the Ministry of Agriculture, this strategic environmental framework aims to scale the economic competitiveness of high-added-value agrarian exports while safeguarding biodiversity and natural resources.
records.institution: The National Advisory Committee for Organic Production

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Oil and Gas of Libya held a strategic bilateral meeting with the European Union delegation to enhance technical cooperati...
records.description: The Ministry of Oil and Gas of Libya held a strategic bilateral meeting with the European Union delegation to enhance technical cooperation and review the "ANQA" Clean Energy and Industry Project (2027–2030). The joint initiative establishes a collaborative framework engineered to decarbonize the domestic hydrocarbons sector and accelerate the transition toward clean energy. During the proceedings, technical teams from the ministry's planning and renewable energy offices—alongside experts from the Petroleum Research Center—emphasized the mandatory integration of national institutions within the Methane Emission Reduction and Gas Flaring Mitigation Committee. This atmospheric emission abatement program serves as a structural pillar of Libya's long-term sustainability strategy, designed to optimize industrial resource efficiency, curb greenhouse gas intensity, and elevate the state's alignment with international environmental compliance frameworks.
records.institution: The Ministry of Oil and Gas

records.title: The Agriculture and Veterinary Department in Methlon/Jenin Agriculture, in cooperation with the Agricultural Development Association (Agr...
records.description: The Agriculture and Veterinary Department in Methlon/Jenin Agriculture, in cooperation with the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief), organized a specialized training course as part of a multi-partner initiative executed alongside Oxfam and funded by the Belgian Development Agency. The programmatic framework focuses on expanding the technical capabilities of field staff and smallholders within the fresh vegetable value chain, with explicit structural mandates to empower women and youth as active economic agents. Operational modules delivered specialized instruction on the safe application of chemical inputs and the integration of biological pest management methodologies. Orchestrated as part of a broader development strategy by the Ministry of Agriculture, this capacity-building intervention aims to optimize crop safety metrics, mitigate localized environmental footprints, and advance subnational food security by scaling production efficiency across smallholder farming communities.

records.title: The Bethlehem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), conducted a sp...
records.description: The Bethlehem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), conducted a specialized livestock training activity under the Field Schools program at the Za'tara site. Funded with the support of the IBSA Fund, this structural intervention benefited ten subnational livestock breeders as part of the broader "My Initiative" project overseen by the Ministry of Agriculture. The participatory extension curriculum focused on building localized capacity in herd management, optimal animal nutrition, veterinary healthcare, and biosecurity protocols to scale productivity and lower operational vulnerabilities. By integrating practical applications with scientific field training, the collaborative program aims to enhance the socioeconomic resilience of rural communities, optimize smallholder livestock value chains, and secure sustainable livestock production across the region.

records.title: Under the supervision and participation of the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Directorate of Agriculture, the Agricultural Development...
records.description: Under the supervision and participation of the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Directorate of Agriculture, the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief) has completed the distribution of specialized irrigation networks to 18 farmers across Atouf, Tammoun, Tayasir, and Aqaba to rehabilitate existing vineyards. Funded by the Dutch Representative Office as part of a broader livelihood and food security initiative, this project targets increased water use efficiency, upgraded crop productivity, and enhanced farm incomes within localized agrarian communities. The Ministry of Agriculture prioritized this intervention to alleviate operational cost burdens and supply critical production inputs to smallholders facing escalating structural challenges, reflecting a long-term developmental partnership designed to boost agricultural sustainability and reinforce the continuity of domestic farming operations on the ground.

records.title: As part of a strategic initiative reported by the Saudi Press Agency (SPA), the Jazan Region has launched a major tropical fruits and gre...
records.description: As part of a strategic initiative reported by the Saudi Press Agency (SPA), the Jazan Region has launched a major tropical fruits and greenhouses project with capital investments exceeding SAR 600 million to establish the province as a modern agricultural hub. Spanning 1 million square meters, the project allocates half of its footprint to high-tech greenhouse infrastructure and the remaining half to commercial tropical fruit cultivation. The infrastructure integrates smart farming systems—including closed-loop irrigation networks for water recycling and automated greenhouse climate controls—engineered to reduce water consumption by up to 75%. Facilitated through a strategic Saudi-Dutch bilateral partnership for technology transfer, this agrifood investment aims to localize advanced agronomic expertise, expand local content, enhance national food security, and open new channels for high-value manufacturing and exports in line with long-term economic sustainability goals.

records.title: Organized by the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the Khairat Najran festival has commenced operati...
records.description: Organized by the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the Khairat Najran festival has commenced operations, featuring extensive participation from localized organic farms to showcase domestic agricultural yields and promote standardized organic farming practices. The institutional exhibition provides dedicated commercial booths for local agrarian producers, allowing consumers to interface with chemical-free agricultural commodities cultivated using advanced agronomic technologies without synthetic fertilizers or pesticides. Participating farmers highlighted the regional festival as a vital B2B and B2C marketing platform that drives rewarding economic returns, stimulates the subnational agrarian economy, and capitalizes on growing consumer demand for high-quality, verified organic produce, thereby incentivizing smallholders to expand production capacity and optimize structural efficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Local authorities alongside the Jabal Al-Sharq Agricultural Association have launched a specialized breeding center for native Fayoumi ch...
records.description: Local authorities alongside the Jabal Al-Sharq Agricultural Association have launched a specialized breeding center for native Fayoumi chickens in Dhamar Governorate to bolster domestic poultry production, advance food self-sufficiency, and drive rural economic empowerment. Implemented with institutional support from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the Agricultural Cooperative Union, the Higher Agricultural and Fisheries Committee, and the Bonyan Development Foundation, the project establishes an integrated production framework where core breeding and hatching occur at the center, while second-generation chicks are distributed to rural households via productive livestock loan programs. To ensure long-term operational viability and mitigate overhead costs for smallholders, the initiative incorporates circular economy principles by providing localized technical training, veterinary vaccination protocols, and cost-effective, locally sourced feed alternatives.

records.title: According to an official statement from the Prime Minister's office, the Algerian government has initiated reviews on a new legal framewo...
records.description: According to an official statement from the Prime Minister's office, the Algerian government has initiated reviews on a new legal framework to establish a national port authority tasked with the public management, development, and conservation of the country's maritime port domain. Concurrently, the executive council examined a draft executive decree creating the National Council for Agricultural Mechanization to coordinate a unified sovereign governance strategy aimed at modernizing domestic farms, improving crop yields, and consolidating national food sovereignty. To address the growing economic demand for skilled labor, the government also evaluated the "Sanaa" program, an operational technical training and mentoring initiative for youth that features extended evening and weekend hours to promote widespread professional skill acquisition and entrepreneurship.
records.institution: The National Council for Agricultural Mechanization

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: KAR Electrical Power Plant Production Trading FZE (KEPPT) has formally appointed J.P.
records.description: KAR Electrical Power Plant Production Trading FZE (KEPPT) has formally appointed J.P. Morgan to coordinate development financing for a landmark $1.6 billion urea plant in Basra, collaborating alongside several leading international export credit agencies. Designed to optimize regional agricultural supply chains, the mega-project is engineered to achieve an annual production capacity of 1.15 million tonnes of urea using proprietary technology detailed in a front-end engineering design (FEED) study by KBR Inc. Scheduled to begin construction in 2027 with operations slated for 2030, this second-of-its-kind domestic facility will monetize local gas feedstock, insulation-protecting the Iraqi agricultural sector from external input shocks, lowering price volatility in the domestic fertilizer market, and expanding subnational employment. The industrial development stands as a cornerstone of the private operator's long-term infrastructure pipeline across the agri-industrial and energy sectors.
records.institution: KAR Electrical Power Plant Production Trading FZE (KEPPT)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The National Office of Electricity and Drinking Water (ONEE) of Morocco has launched an international tender for the construction of a 36...
records.description: The National Office of Electricity and Drinking Water (ONEE) of Morocco has launched an international tender for the construction of a 362 MW pumped-storage hydroelectric plant (PSHP) in El Menzel, located in the Fes-Meknes region. Financed by the Islamic Development Bank, the project will be executed under a comprehensive 48-month turnkey contract covering engineering, equipment procurement, construction, and commissioning. This infrastructure asset is designed to absorb and store surplus variable renewable energy, releasing it during peak grid demand to optimize the flexibility, stability, and security of the national electricity grid. The strategic development builds on Morocco's expanding energy storage portfolio, complementing the operational plants at Afourer and Abdelmoumen, alongside the upcoming Ifahsa facility.
records.institution: The National Office of Electricity and Drinking Water (ONEE)

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has announced the completion of 11 development projects valued at ove...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has announced the completion of 11 development projects valued at over SAR 70 million, designed to modernize Saudi Arabia's beekeeping and honey production sector. The initiative includes four honey production infrastructure assets worth nearly SAR 17 million and seven regional stations for queen bee breeding and bee package production worth more than SAR 53.3 million. These specialized breeding installations have reached advanced completion rates across multiple areas, including Tabuk, Hail, Madinah, Jazan, and Aseer (Namas). Alongside physical infrastructure, the program has deployed mobile diagnostic veterinary clinics, three specialized mobile laboratories, and field clinics at strategic quarantine sites to mitigate bee diseases and pests. This comprehensive agrifood intervention aims to enhance subnational biodiversity, optimize domestic bee colony strains, and scale production capacities to advance national food security and rural self-sufficiency goals.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: According to a legislative initiative put forward by 25 members of Tunisia’s Assembly of People’s Representatives, a new 23-article bill...
records.description: According to a legislative initiative put forward by 25 members of Tunisia’s Assembly of People’s Representatives, a new 23-article bill has been proposed to impose a comprehensive nationwide ban on single-use plastic bags within a 12-month transition period. Currently under review by the Industry, Commerce, Natural Resources, Energy and Environment Committee, the bill targets the nation's severe plastic pollution—where 4.2 billion bags are consumed annually and plastic constitutes over 80% of marine litter in the Mediterranean basin—by superseding a largely ineffective 2020 government decree. The new framework permits only two eco-friendly packaging alternatives: reusable bags with a minimum thickness of 50 microns designed for at least 20 use cycles, and biodegradable bags capable of 90% decomposition within 6 to 12 months without leaving toxic microplastics. To enforce compliance, the legislation enshrines Extended Producer Responsibility, leverages criminal liability and hefty fines of up to 50,000 dinars (US$16,000) for violations, and simultaneously offers subsidized loans and tax incentives to support domestic factory owners in modernizing their industrial production lines.
records.institution: The Industry, Commerce, Natural Resources, Energy and Environment Committee

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), in partnership with national institutions, is intensifying its operati...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), in partnership with national institutions, is intensifying its operational interventions in Tunisia to promote sustainable land management and elevate the climate resilience of local agricultural systems. According to an official statement from the UN institution, this collaborative initiative leverages localized agronomic expertise to optimize land-resource efficiency and deploy sustainable farming practices tailored to mitigate escalating environmental risks. By raising institutional and public awareness regarding the critical importance of soil and land preservation, the program aims to establish soil conservation as a primary structural pillar for long-term national food security and sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The Maghreb and North African Farmers' Union (UMNAGRI), with the backing of Spanish cooperation, has officially launched the FATIMA proje...
records.description: The Maghreb and North African Farmers' Union (UMNAGRI), with the backing of Spanish cooperation, has officially launched the FATIMA project at the headquarters of the Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP). This multilateral initiative establishes a knowledge-transfer network connecting academic and professional organizations across Tunisia, Palestine, and Spain. Over its duration, the project is designed to accelerate agricultural innovation, mitigate climate change risks, and promote the empowerment of rural youth and women by expanding the operational capacities of female agricultural cooperatives. By fostering applied scientific research and sustainable natural resource management, the partnership aims to reinforce agrarian resilience and secure inclusive socioeconomic development across the regional rural economy.
records.institution: The Maghreb and North African Farmers' Union (UMNAGRI)

records.title: Expo City Dubai, in partnership with the UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism, launched the first Expo Green Licences for six sustainabili...
records.description: Expo City Dubai, in partnership with the UAE Ministry of Economy and Tourism, launched the first Expo Green Licences for six sustainability-focused businesses as part of the UAE’s first Green Innovation District. The initiative provides financial and business incentives to organizations with verified environmental, social, and governance (ESG) credentials to promote sustainable innovation, circular economy solutions, climate technologies, and clean energy. The programme aims to support green business growth, strengthen the UAE’s sustainability ecosystem, and contribute to the country's economic diversification and net-zero ambitions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism

records.title: A multi-ministerial workshop held in Sana’a, bringing together the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, the Ministry of Economy and Ind...
records.description: A multi-ministerial workshop held in Sana’a, bringing together the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, the Ministry of Economy and Industry, and the General Land Transport Authority in cooperation with the Agricultural Cooperative Union and the Bonyan Foundation, outlined a unified strategy to develop the domestic pomegranate value chain ahead of the seasonal harvest. To reduce post-harvest losses and protect agrarian incomes, the collaborative framework prioritizes shifting from arbitrary basket-based pricing to standardized, kilogram-based market transactions. Key operational directives focus on expanding localized cold-storage networks, optimizing packaging systems, and establishing a joint logistics operations room with the land transport sector to guarantee stable truck fleets and fixed transport rates. By coordinating subnational marketing extensions, launching product promotional festivals, and mitigating seasonal oversupply, the joint initiative aims to break export monopolies, expand access to international agrifood corridors, and conserve regional water resources by shifting acreage away from water-intensive cash crops.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, the Ministry of Economy and Industry

records.title: During a technical conference in Algiers, academic experts and industry professionals emphasized that the generalization of precision agr...
records.description: During a technical conference in Algiers, academic experts and industry professionals emphasized that the generalization of precision agriculture—utilizing digital technologies such as drones, GPS geolocation, remote sensing, and artificial intelligence—is an essential lever to maximize crop yields, optimize resource input efficiency, and minimize operational waste. Organized by the National Higher School of Agronomy (ENSA), the forum highlighted how targeted data analysis from these advanced tools allows for the precise application of water, fertilizer, and phytosanitary products tailored to specific crop needs, directly bolstering national food security and creating high-tech employment opportunities. To accelerate this modernization, speakers called for a robust, forward-looking national manufacturing industry, enhanced technical training, and improved machinery leasing and maintenance structures, as demonstrated by the public subsidiary Agrodrive, which is aggressively expanding its fleet of combine harvesters and plowing equipment available to local farmers.
records.institution: The National Higher School of Agronomy (ENSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Housing, Utilities and Urban Communities announced a major expansion of Egypt’s wastewater treatment infrastructure, incr...
records.description: The Ministry of Housing, Utilities and Urban Communities announced a major expansion of Egypt’s wastewater treatment infrastructure, increasing the number and capacity of treatment plants to strengthen water security and improve sanitation services. The expansion includes new tertiary treatment facilities and major projects such as the Abu Rawash and Zagazig wastewater treatment plants, which support the reuse of treated wastewater for agricultural and industrial purposes. The investments are part of the government’s strategy to maximize the efficient use of limited water resources, enhance environmental sustainability, and increase the availability of non-conventional water sources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Housing, Utilities and Urban Communities

records.title: A specialized study published by the Geographical Society reveals that nearly 50 percent of Kuwait’s land has the biophysical potential t...
records.description: A specialized study published by the Geographical Society reveals that nearly 50 percent of Kuwait’s land has the biophysical potential to support agricultural expansion if supported by reliable and sustainable water resources, framing innovative water management as a core pillar to reduce import dependence and achieve long-term food self-sufficiency. Faced with climate-induced pressures such as rising evaporation rates and unpredictable rainfall, the research outlines a strategic shift toward capturing seasonal runoff through rainwater harvesting systems, maximizing the utilization of treated wastewater for irrigation, and transitioning to drought-tolerant crops like barley, sorghum, and quinoa. By adopting high-tech water recycling models similar to international best practices, the study concludes that integrated resource planning can successfully transform severe desert water scarcity into a resilient national asset capable of withstand supply chain and environmental shocks.

records.title: According to data and industry testimony published by Hespress, Morocco is maintaining its strategic freeze on tomato and diverse horticu...
records.description: According to data and industry testimony published by Hespress, Morocco is maintaining its strategic freeze on tomato and diverse horticultural exports—including watermelon, courgettes, peppers, and onions—to African markets to prioritize domestic food affordability and price stability over exporter profits. This prolonged regulatory restriction has triggered an unprecedented trade collapse that the Association of Fruit and Vegetable Exporters warns could permanently damage Morocco’s reputation as a reliable supplier and erode long-term market share as international competitors fill the void. While agricultural analysts note that the absence of formal binding contracts with African partners allows Morocco to abruptly suspend shipments without the legal or contractual repercussions faced in European markets, industry leaders warn that destination countries are aggressively accelerating their own domestic production and self-sufficiency initiatives to eliminate reliance on Moroccan agrifood supplies.

records.title: According to Joint Decision No.
records.description: According to Joint Decision No. 1096.26 published in Morocco's Official Gazette, the Moroccan government has enacted regulatory updates governing the purchase, production, packaging, distribution, and pricing of soft wheat used in subsidized flour production. Under the revised framework, the National Office of Cereals and Legumes (ONICL) will procure soft wheat through public tenders open to legally registered grain traders and agricultural cooperatives, setting a fixed selling price for industrial mills at MAD 258.80 per quintal. The structural policy maintains strict extraction rates (81% for national flour and 74% for special flour) and imposes rigorous supply-chain tracking mandates—including explicit packaging guidelines, visible green branding stripes, unique serial numbers, and mill stamps—to reinforce market oversight. While production costs are established at MAD 325.375 per quintal for national subsidized flour, the policy enforces a maximum retail price cap of MAD 200 per quintal to shield consumer purchasing power and maintain domestic food security.
records.institution: The National Office of Cereals and Legumes (ONICL)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed 23 investm...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed 23 investment agreements across eight West Bank governorates under the new phase of the MAP II program. The initiative represents a total investment volume exceeding 8.1 million shekels, with the program contributing a 51% financial share funded by the governments of Denmark, Switzerland, Spain, the European Union, and Italy. Designed to promote market-oriented innovations and build a sustainable food system, the diverse portfolio spans crop production (including avocado, dragon fruit, and stone fruit orchards), livestock facilities (poultry, sheep, and fish farms), and advanced food processing units (olive oil mills, dairy processing, and cold storage). This strategic multilateral partnership optimizes regional agrifood value chains, upgrades the market competitiveness of localized commodities, and directly strengthens subnational agricultural economic resilience.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia has inaugurated its first seasonal initiative at Al-Hazem Rural Farm i...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia has inaugurated its first seasonal initiative at Al-Hazem Rural Farm in the Al-Mandaq Governorate of the Al-Baha Region. Featuring 22 specialized exhibition pavilions, the public-private event brings together seasonal fruit cultivators, local beekeepers, cottage industry entrepreneurs, and traditional artisans. The agricultural governance framework is structured to empower subnational smallholders and honey producers by optimizing regional market access, enhancing direct-to-consumer commercial pipelines, and stimulating rural tourism and micro-economic growth. By highlighting Al-Baha's distinct agrifood and apiculture offerings, the state-led initiative advances the socio-economic diversification and rural development mandates outlined in Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Saudi government has officially granted ACWA Power Company (ACWA) an exclusive mandate to export green hydrogen and its synthesized d...
records.description: The Saudi government has officially granted ACWA Power Company (ACWA) an exclusive mandate to export green hydrogen and its synthesized derivatives—including green ammonia, green methanol, and low-carbon green fuels—produced within the Kingdom to international markets. Under this sovereign authorization, the utility enterprise will develop integrated infrastructure projects to generate, transmit, and export renewable-generated electricity directly to European and Arab trade markets to support regional energy security. This exclusive export framework leverages the company's extensive asset pipeline to advance Saudi Arabia's strategic Vision 2030 energy transition targets, establishing a large-scale logistics and operational foundation to connect the Kingdom's abundant renewable resources with expanding global demand for clean energy molecules.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries of Tunisia, operating in coordination with the Ministry of State Domains and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries of Tunisia, operating in coordination with the Ministry of State Domains and Land Affairs and the Ministry of Employment and Vocational Training, has compiled an initial regulatory list designating 38 state-owned agricultural farms across ten governorates and 24 delegations for priority lease allocation to community-based agricultural enterprises. Spanning approximately 17,014 hectares, this structural land-tenure reform is managed by a specialized joint inter-ministerial commission tasked with expanding the program through a secondary phase, which includes the strategic evaluation of recovered and currently vacant public plots within the El Amra delegation of the Sfax governorate. By granting collective local structures prioritized access to state assets under formal administrative decrees, the public policy is engineered to drive regional economic development, optimize subnational land utilization, and reinforce national food security architecture through localized cooperative farming models.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The National Agency for Energy Conservation (ANME) of Tunisia has outlined a strategic decarbonization roadmap targeting an 80% share of...
records.description: The National Agency for Energy Conservation (ANME) of Tunisia has outlined a strategic decarbonization roadmap targeting an 80% share of renewable energy (RE) in national electricity production by 2050, supported by interim milestones of 35% by 2030 and 50% by 2035. Currently reliant on natural gas for approximately 97–98% of its electricity, Tunisia plans to scale its installed RE capacity to roughly 4,800 megawatts by 2035 through upcoming wind projects (900 MW) and solar initiatives (600 MW) centered in the Sidi Bouzid, Gafsa, and Gabès governorates. To achieve a 62% reduction in carbon emissions by 2035, the national strategy prioritizes sector-specific energy efficiency—targeting the building sector (36% of consumption) and the transport sector (34% of consumption)—the latter of which remains the primary emitter of greenhouse gases and a key focus for electrification and electric vehicle adoption. Since its inception, the agency has facilitated cumulative energy savings equivalent to 14 million tons of oil equivalent, representing an economic impact of 14 billion dinars, and is now shifting toward a diversified energy mix incorporating solar, wind, biogas, and waste-to-energy technologies to enhance national energy security.
records.institution: The National Agency for Energy Conservation (ANME)

records.title: According to a report by the state-run Syrian News Agency, a strategic trade agreement has been established to launch a direct overland t...
records.description: According to a report by the state-run Syrian News Agency, a strategic trade agreement has been established to launch a direct overland transit corridor for fruit and vegetable exports routing from Syria through Iraq into the United Arab Emirates. Bypassing regional intermediaries to optimize delivery timelines and increase financial returns for local farmers, the framework includes a memorandum of understanding with the UAE-based Mair Group to construct four specialized agricultural processing and sorting centers across Syria's coastal, central, southern, and eastern regions. The initiative also features the development of an integrated digital platform and digital financing services to streamline agrifood value chains, aligning with a broader logistics corridor designed to connect Syrian ports with Iraq’s port of Umm Qasr and the UAE’s Khalifa Port.

records.title: The Tadweer Group has awarded a strategic contract to the Spanish environmental services corporation Urbaser to construct and operate Abu...
records.description: The Tadweer Group has awarded a strategic contract to the Spanish environmental services corporation Urbaser to construct and operate Abu Dhabi’s first greenfield Material Recovery Facility. Operating through a joint venture structured with a 60% stake held by Urbaser and 40% by Tadweer Group, the state-of-the-art 400,000-tonne facility is designed to process 200,000 tonnes of municipal solid waste and 200,000 tonnes of commercial and industrial waste annually. The infrastructure asset will integrate automated sorting, optical technologies, and artificial intelligence to optimize material separation accuracy, feeding recovered materials directly into Abu Dhabi's upcoming Waste-to-Energy (WtE) pipeline. This landmark circular economy project marks the international operator's expansion into the UAE waste treatment sector and serves as a primary operational lever to achieve the emirate's sovereign mandate of diverting 80% of municipal waste away from landfills.

records.title: The Agricultural Cooperation and Food Security Committee of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) has convened an extraordinary ministerial...
records.description: The Agricultural Cooperation and Food Security Committee of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) has convened an extraordinary ministerial meeting to accelerate the integration of a unified Gulf food security system and enhance the subregional capacity to absorb international economic shocks. Chaired under the current presidency of the Kingdom of Bahrain, the high-level virtual summit brought together ministers and senior officials to advance the technical blueprint for a joint GCC strategic storage network encompassing staple foods, essential medicines, and critical commodity reserves. To insulate member states from high import dependency, the institutional framework prioritizes the immediate diversification of foreign agricultural supply lines, the harmonization of cross-border customs logistics to safeguard the continuous movement of agrifood goods, and the expansion of domestic production using advanced agritech applications. This coordinated public planning initiative serves as an essential national security pillar designed to solidify regional emergency preparedness and maintain supply chain resilience across all member states.
records.institution: The Agricultural Cooperation and Food Security Committee

records.title: The Department of Agricultural Extension and Training has initiated strategic bilateral talks with the International Trade Centre (ITC) t...
records.description: The Department of Agricultural Extension and Training has initiated strategic bilateral talks with the International Trade Centre (ITC) to coordinate the formal institutional transfer of the "Safi" digital platform under the framework of the GOBS program. The technical consultations focus on activating the automated system to deploy standardized, scientifically grounded training modules that equip youth demographics with specialized agrifood entrepreneurship and small-scale project management capabilities. To broaden the program's socioeconomic footprint and drive long-term structural diversification, the ITC delegation outlined upcoming platform modernizations designed to introduce technical skills instruction spanning sectors beyond traditional agriculture. This cooperative public framework aims to strengthen rural human capital, accelerate localized economic development, and advance national food security architecture through digital innovation.
records.institution: The Department of Agricultural Extension and Training

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Horticulture Department of the Ministry of Agriculture of Iraq has completed the technical purification and structural packaging stag...
records.description: The Horticulture Department of the Ministry of Agriculture of Iraq has completed the technical purification and structural packaging stages for domestic hybrid vegetable seeds at its central production facility. Under the administrative supervision of the Director General, Dr. Hatem Karim Abbas, and following executive directives from the Minister of Agriculture, Mr. Abdul Rahim Al-Shammari, the processing facility took delivery of high-grade parent stock from the Abu Ghraib Research Station. The operations focus specifically on the localized "Rafidain" eggplant variant and the "Aseel" tomato hybrid, managed as core components of the state-backed National Program for the Propagation of Local Vegetable Crop Strains and Hybrids. Following successful evaluation protocols confirming high genetic purity and safety compliance, the seeds are slated for immediate subnational distribution to local farmers at state-subsidized rates. By scaling climate-resilient, high-yielding domestic crop genetics that offer a distinct cost advantage over international imports, the institutional initiative is engineered to enhance farm-level profitability, accelerate import substitution, and insulate national food security from global supply chain volatility.
records.institution: The Horticulture Department of the Ministry of Agriculture

records.domain: Sanitary, phytosanitary and technical standards improvements
records.title: The Ministry of Trade of Iraq, through its Private Sector Development Department and in coordination with the Trade Attaché in Rome, has...
records.description: The Ministry of Trade of Iraq, through its Private Sector Development Department and in coordination with the Trade Attaché in Rome, has convened a strategic multilateral seminar in operational cooperation with the Investment and Technology Promotion Office of the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) in Italy to align the domestic date industry with European Union market entry regulations. The technical framework brought together key institutional stakeholders, including the Iraqi Dates Council, the Iraqi Company for Manufacturing and Marketing of Dates, and the Federation of Iraqi Chambers of Commerce, to audit mandatory EU phytosanitary protocols, food safety certifications, and commercial packaging specifications. To optimize export potential and minimize port-of-entry rejections, industry experts outlined actionable workflows to transition local processors toward high-value organic date variants and derivative commodities like date sugar. This public intervention is engineered to modernize upstream agro-industrial value chains, enhance private sector global competitiveness, and diversify the national export portfolio away from hydrocarbon dependency.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of Jordan, in strategic cooperation with the National Land Coalition (NLC), has launched the country’s first...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Jordan, in strategic cooperation with the National Land Coalition (NLC), has launched the country’s first national program to measure indicators tracking rangeland health, pastoralist mobility, and livestock breeder livelihoods. With this initiative, Jordan becomes the first Arab nation to adopt the global methodology of the international "Mobility Matters" campaign, an effort designed to build a comprehensive, evidence-based national database to resolve sector-specific challenges. By quantifying variables linked to ecological health, resource access, and traditional pastoral movement patterns, the state-backed data collection effort is engineered to generate data-driven insights that will optimize rangeland management policies, preserve regional biodiversity, and strengthen the resilience of rural herding communities against climate-induced resource scarcity.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Water Diplomacy Centre at the Jordan University of Science and Technology, in conjunction with the second edition of the Water–Peace...
records.description: The Water Diplomacy Centre at the Jordan University of Science and Technology, in conjunction with the second edition of the Water–Peace Dialogue Series, has convened a regional meeting with a delegation from the Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) to advance the Climate Adaptation Readiness Programme for the Levant and Iraq. The cross-border institutional framework brings together representatives from Jordan, Iraq, Lebanon, Syria, and Turkey to scale climate finance readiness, upgrade transboundary water governance, and prepare joint investment pathways capable of mitigating severe regional water scarcity. Executed under the umbrella of the Blue Peace Middle East Initiative, the program is engineered to deploy collaborative agrifood and ecological solutions that protect shared ecosystems from climate change, improve food and energy security, and establish structural mechanisms for regional resource cooperation.

records.title: The Chamber of Commerce and the Ministry of Agriculture of Lebanon are actively supporting domestic agrifood trade interests through spec...
records.description: The Chamber of Commerce and the Ministry of Agriculture of Lebanon are actively supporting domestic agrifood trade interests through specialized regulatory webinars and commercial market research following the lifting of a five-year sovereign import ban by Saudi Arabia. Executed in coordination with prominent export firms such as Nasr Rahme, the public-private framework aims to navigate a highly altered regional trade landscape marked by stringent Saudi phytosanitary certifications, advanced administrative permitting structures, and entrenched market competition from alternative suppliers like Egypt and Jordan. Due to persistent border bottlenecks and the lack of automated transit scanners along land routes traversing Syria, the strategic recovery initiative is prioritizing high-value horticultural commodities like grapes and avocados over historical volume staples like potatoes.
records.institution: The Chamber of Commerce and the Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: A regional workshop hosted in Nouakchott brought together member states of the Desert Locust Control Organization for the Western Region...
records.description: A regional workshop hosted in Nouakchott brought together member states of the Desert Locust Control Organization for the Western Region (CLCPRO), in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty of Mauritania and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), to develop a coordinated action plan against a significant climate-driven resurgence of desert locusts. Driven by accelerating climate change anomalies that have redrawn traditional pest distribution maps, the emergency response builds on previous synchronized interventions by Algeria, Mauritania, Morocco, and Tunisia that successfully treated over 400,000 hectares—including 70,000 hectares managed directly by Mauritania's National Center for Desert Locust Control. By integrating global meteorological data, regional rainfall forecasting, and strategic ground-to-aerial survey modeling, the multilateral coalition aims to deploy a highly proactive, resource-aligned operational strategy designed to insulate primary crop yields, protect agrarian environments, and safeguard macro-level food security architecture across the Sahel and Western regions.
records.institution: The Desert Locust Control Organization for the Western Region (CLCPRO)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nat...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and private sector partners, concluded a project to strengthen sustainable beekeeping and enhance the capacity of small and medium-sized enterprises in the sector. The initiative introduced national quality standards for Omani honey, launched a digital platform and a honey guide, and promoted capacity building, innovation, and digital transformation to improve product quality, competitiveness, investment opportunities, and exports. FAO recognized the project as a model for supporting food security, economic diversification, sustainable agriculture, and resilient rural livelihoods through effective partnerships between the government, private sector, and international organizations
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Hebron Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), organized a spe...
records.description: The Hebron Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), organized a specialized training workshop entitled "Identifying Marketing Opportunities" under the framework of the Improvement of Extension for Value-Added Agriculture (EVAP 3) project. Held in the town of Beit Kahil, the initiative targeted 17 beneficiaries, specifically livestock breeders and rural women specialized in the food processing sector. The training curriculum focused on value-added agriculture techniques, market analysis, classification methods, and modern commercial marketing strategies designed to optimize product competitiveness, expand local market access, and enhance smallholder income streams.
records.institution: The Hebron Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: According to data released by Mwani Qatar, Qatari ports experienced a significant increase in trade volume and operational efficiency, ma...
records.description: According to data released by Mwani Qatar, Qatari ports experienced a significant increase in trade volume and operational efficiency, marked by a 13% month-on-month rise in container handling to over 78,000 TEUs and a 21% jump in vessel arrivals to 121 ships. The maritime infrastructure also successfully absorbed a 40% surge in bulk cargo, exceeding 67,000 tonnes, driven by increased imports of essential food commodities to support national food security objectives and industrial raw materials for local construction activity. This expansion in shipping traffic was accommodated without a proportional rise in congestion or cargo delays, underscoring enhanced capacity for temperature-controlled refrigerated containers and reinforcing the nation's broader economic diversification and international trade connectivity goals.

records.title: The Middle East Green Initiative (MGI) and the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) have signed a strategic memora...
records.description: The Middle East Green Initiative (MGI) and the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) have signed a strategic memorandum of understanding (MoU) in Riyadh to strengthen regional cooperation on land rehabilitation and vegetation cover development. Under the executive framework, the partnership establishes a mechanism for intensive information sharing, technical capacity building, and knowledge transfer across member states to systematically combat land degradation and accelerate desertification control projects. The agreement aligns with the G20 Global Land Initiative and supports the environmental sustainability mandates of Saudi Vision 2030 by mobilizing technical and financial resources to restore degraded ecosystems, protect vital natural resources, and scale up subnational and regional conservation programs.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in the Qassim Region has driven a significant expansion in agricultural diversi...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in the Qassim Region has driven a significant expansion in agricultural diversification by providing targeted agricultural guidance, technical lectures, and field extension tours to optimize local farming efficiency. This institutional support has enabled the region to establish a robust fig cultivation sector alongside its traditional palm, peach, grape, and melon crops, directly contributing to the national food security system in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. Utilizing favorable local environmental conditions, the region now features nearly 30 specialized farms cultivating over 100,000 fig trees across roughly 30 distinct local and international varieties. By enhancing downstream agricultural practices and proving the economic viability of high-yield fruit crops, this public-private framework successfully transforms regional natural resources into sustainable, value-added domestic agrifood assets.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of Syria has signed a memorandum of understanding with the UAE's Mir Group and the Agricultural Technology an...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Syria has signed a memorandum of understanding with the UAE's Mir Group and the Agricultural Technology and Services Solutions Company to launch and manage the joint Emirati-Syrian Company for Agricultural Development, Food Security, Value Chains, and Exports. The strategic investment partnership establishes a comprehensive public-private framework covering contractual farming operations, localized agricultural finance systems, technical extension services, and advanced cold-chain logistics networks, including central sorting and refrigeration infrastructure. Backed by an integrated digital platform designed to optimize downstream processing and minimize intermediary market friction, the project aims to revitalize the state's underutilized productive assets and expand agrifood shipping networks to Gulf markets via newly streamlined overland transit routes crossing Iraqi territory. This initiative is engineered to maximize domestic primary production efficiency, establish stable income streams for regional smallholders, and fortify macro-level regional food security and trade connectivity.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries of Tunisia, operating in coordination with the Ministries of State Domains and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries of Tunisia, operating in coordination with the Ministries of State Domains and Land Affairs and Employment and Vocational Training, has finalized an initial regulatory list designating 38 state-owned agricultural holdings for allocation to community companies under a sharecropping lease framework. Formalized in response to legislative oversight regarding an inter-ministerial joint decree, the localized land-reform program encompasses approximately 17,014 hectares distributed across ten governorates and 24 delegations. Managed by a specialized inter-ministerial commission established to evaluate vacant public plots—such as those under review within the El Amra delegation in the Sfax Governorate—this structural initiative seeks to position community-based enterprises as drivers of regional economic development. By granting these collective structures priority land access alongside dedicated state financing mechanisms, the public policy is engineered to cultivate rural entrepreneurship, optimize state land utilization, and reinforce national agrifood production capacity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The General Women’s Union (GWU), the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), and the Ministry of Education of the United Ara...
records.description: The General Women’s Union (GWU), the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), and the Ministry of Education of the United Arab Emirates have collaborated to execute the "Future Women Farmers" training program. Launched as a core component of the "We Grow for Sustainability" initiative and aligned with the United Nations’ declaration of the International Year of the Woman Farmer, the four-month educational curriculum engaged 190 female students from schools across the nation. The program provided an integrated scientific and practical pathway covering sustainable agronomy, soil fertility preservation, and biodiversity protection. By combining hands-on agricultural applications with advanced agritech solutions—such as vertical farming, hydroponics, and smart irrigation systems—the inter-institutional framework is engineered to optimize water efficiency, support the "Plant the Emirates" national program, and cultivate a new generation of technical female talent capable of advancing the mandates of the UAE’s National Food Security Strategy 2051.
records.institution: The General Women’s Union (GWU), the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), and the Ministry of Education

records.title: The Future of Egypt Authority for Sustainable Development (widely known as Mostaqbal Misr) has been directed to collaborate with the mini...
records.description: The Future of Egypt Authority for Sustainable Development (widely known as Mostaqbal Misr) has been directed to collaborate with the ministries of agriculture and supply on a national program designed to lower household living costs by expanding permanent retail markets and reinforcing supply chains to stabilize basic commodity prices. This directive positions the state entity at the center of an integrated development model that connects land reclamation, modern irrigation infrastructure—including treated wastewater and groundwater systems—and agricultural production with downstream logistics, agro-industry, and retail networks like the "Kheirha" and "Carry On" brands. Originally emerging as the agricultural foundation of the New Delta initiative, the authority has expanded its scope to target the reclamation of millions of acres, utilizing advanced center-pivot irrigation and new supply canals to boost crop yields, enhance food security, and insulate domestic consumers from market fluctuations.
records.institution: The Future of Egypt Authority for Sustainable Development

records.title: The Vocational Training Corporation (VTC), in strategic cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture of Jordan, has officially launched t...
records.description: The Vocational Training Corporation (VTC), in strategic cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture of Jordan, has officially launched the third phase of the "ARDI" (My Land) project to scale technical on-farm and off-farm employment skills across the country. The comprehensive human-capital development initiative is structured to train 3,100 young men and women across various governorates through 64 specialized courses, utilizing a combination of modern agritech training modules and Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) frameworks. To lower barriers to workforce entry and stimulate private entrepreneurship, the state-backed program provides participants with practical field training, transportation allowances, and accredited professional practice licenses for the agricultural and food processing sectors. Following previous campaign phases that engaged over 4,200 beneficiaries, this institutional intervention is engineered to correct domestic labor market skills gaps, boost rural employment productivity, and strengthen macro-level national food security architecture.

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Dakhiliyah Governorate has scaled its food security investment portfolio...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Dakhiliyah Governorate has scaled its food security investment portfolio, securing contracts worth approximately OMR 158 million through May 2026 and exceeding its annual target with a 113% completion rate. Spurred by state-led investment platforms like "Tatweer" and the "Propose Your Project" window, the regional development strategy has unlocked over 185.7 million square meters of newly zoned agricultural, livestock, and aquaculture lands across the Wilayats of Nizwa, Adam, Izki, Al Hamra, and Al Jabal Al Akhdar. Key capital deployments include an OMR 4 million tissue culture biotechnology facility in Nizwa for date palm and seedling optimization, an OMR 3 million downstream processing plant via the Nizwa Food Industries Factory, and the OMR 1.7 million Al Bashair Veterinary Hospital in Adam, functioning as a landmark public-private partnership. By systematically integrating primary production with specialized food processing, modernized fish market infrastructure, and advanced micro-climate farming for high-value crops like saffron and olives, the institutional framework aims to build an integrated agrifood value chain that accelerates import substitution and supports the economic diversification mandates of Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources

records.title: The OQ Group, in strategic public-private partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Agricultura...
records.description: The OQ Group, in strategic public-private partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund, has concluded the primary phase of the "OQ Green Initiative," yielding significant agricultural, economic, and environmental results across Oman. Managed operationally through specialized state bodies like the Department of Agricultural Research in the North Al Batinah Governorate, the unified framework successfully cultivated and distributed more than 274,000 high-productivity economic seedlings—including mango, Omani lemon, fig, grape, and pomegranate varieties—to commercial operations, smallholders, and public institutions. The long-term macroeconomic forecast models an output exceeding 10,000 tonnes of domestic fruit yields with an estimated market valuation of OMR 4.3 million, directly advancing national import substitution, reinforcing the expansion of plant genetic banks, and introducing a carbon sequestration asset capable of absorbing 8,000 tonnes of $CO_2$ annually. Furthermore, the program maximized in-country value (ICV) by directing over OMR 346,000 across 60 operational contracts to local small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), successfully aligning private corporate capital with the sustainable land-management, decarbonization, and economic diversification mandates of Oman Vision 2040 and the Net Zero 2050 target.

records.title: The Bethlehem Directorate of Agriculture, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture and in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Or...
records.description: The Bethlehem Directorate of Agriculture, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture and in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has conducted a series of specialized training sessions on modern sheep farm management and high-quality dairy production in the towns of Al-Minya and Beit Fajjar. Funded by the European Union, the capacity-building initiative targeted dozens of local livestock breeders, agricultural engineers, and rural female farmers to upgrade technical skills in livestock care and safe dairy processing. By focusing on hygienic handling methods and standardized production practices at local community venues, such as the Al-Minya Pioneering Association for Women and Child Development and the Beit Fajjar Agricultural Association, the program is engineered to raise value-chain efficiency, empower rural women within the agrifood sector, and promote long-term sustainable agricultural development.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in the Tabuk Region, in strategic corporate partnership with Red Sea Global,...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in the Tabuk Region, in strategic corporate partnership with Red Sea Global, has successfully concluded the fifth annual Mango Festival held at Al-Duqm Park in the Umluj Governorate. The four-day regional agrifood exhibition attracted over 18,000 visitors and featured dedicated pavilions for 20 local primary producers, serving as a structured commercial platform to enhance market access for regional fruit yields. By facilitating direct business-to-business (B2B) meetings, commercial understandings, and forward-purchasing arrangements between smallholders and private sector investors, the public-private initiative is engineered to diversify local agrarian marketing channels, stabilize rural producer incomes, and elevate the market profile of Umluj mangoes within the national supply chain.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of Tunisia, in coordination with the National Observatory on Agriculture (ONAGRI), has reported an exceptiona...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Tunisia, in coordination with the National Observatory on Agriculture (ONAGRI), has reported an exceptional recovery in its domestic cereal harvest for the 2026 season, with total yields projected to exceed 20 million quintals—a 15% to 20% increase over the previous year. Driven by favorable rainfall patterns distributed across 834,000 hectares in the northern basins and 157,000 hectares in the central region, harvesting operations have achieved a 60% completion rate, with 8.4 million quintals already secured at state collection centers led by the Béja and Le Kef governorates. To optimize crop resilience and grain quality, the state-backed initiative achieved a landmark strategic objective by doubling the distribution of high-grade certified seeds to 524,000 quintals, successfully introducing advanced climate-adapted varieties such as "INRAT 100," "Qods," and "Mactaris." This substantial domestic production surge insulates the national economy from a rising Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Cereal Price Index—which saw global wheat prices climb 7.8% year-on-year due to adverse winter growing conditions in the United States and high global fertilizer costs—thereby reinforcing macro-level national food security and decreasing import dependency.

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) of the United Arab Emirates, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organ...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) of the United Arab Emirates, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has organized a strategic workshop titled “Legislations of the Future” to build an agile, future-ready regulatory framework for the agrifood and food safety sectors. The institutional initiative focused on overcoming regulatory barriers to accelerate the adoption of advanced technologies, establishing flexible "regulatory sandboxes" to attract global agritech startups, and managing critical water scarcity. To drive these structural reforms, the UAE has locked in concrete success metrics, targeting a 50% reduction in licensing times for new agritech ventures, a 30% reduction in irrigation water consumption per tonne of crop, and a 15% reduction in overall food waste.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Agricultural Research Department of the Ministry of Agriculture of Iraq has completed the execution of foundational rice seed contrac...
records.description: The Agricultural Research Department of the Ministry of Agriculture of Iraq has completed the execution of foundational rice seed contracts for the 2026 agricultural season, finalizing the agreements directly at the Al-Mishkhab Research Station in Najaf to optimize administrative workflows for local seed multipliers. Under this state-backed genetic purity framework, high-grade foundation seeds of strategic, climate-adapted varieties—including Anbar 33, Jasmine, Euphrates, Baraka, Tigris, and Ghari—were systematically allocated to certified growers. The targeted cultivation footprint spans over 900 dunams across the major agricultural governorates of Najaf, Diwaniyah, Wasit, and Diyala, mandating the deployment of water-efficient dryland farming techniques and mechanical transplanting technologies. By modernizing upstream crop genetics and enforcing strict production standards, this public intervention is engineered to accelerate import substitution, preserve critical water resources amidst regional climate pressures, and fortify national food security architecture.
records.institution: The Agricultural Research Department of the Ministry of Agriculture
