records.title: The Invest Oman agency, driving national food security priorities under the Oman Vision 2040 development framework, has structured a majo...
records.description: The Invest Oman agency, driving national food security priorities under the Oman Vision 2040 development framework, has structured a major public-private investment opportunity to construct the Al Salil Smart Agricultural Cluster in Quriyat, a specialized agrotech development requiring a capital expenditure of RO17 million. Spanning over 2.09 million square meters, the mega-cluster is engineered to consolidate multi-tiered farming operations combining open-field plots, shade-net facilities, climate-controlled smart greenhouses, and yield-intensive vertical farming systems to generate an estimated 62 million kilograms of annual crop output, targeting high-value commodities such as strawberries, cherry tomatoes, and water-efficient leafy greens. Utilizing optimized irrigation networks drawing from the Wadi Dayqah Dam and regional groundwater reserves, the phased infrastructure project is strategically positioned near the Muscat consumer market to scale up national fruit and vegetable self-sufficiency, generate rural technical employment, and significantly lower the country's international food import bill.

records.title: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman, in institutional coord...
records.description: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman, in institutional coordination with architectural firm Foster + Partners and consulting firm Dar Al-Handasah, have launched the master plan for Al Najd Agricultural City in Dhofar, a 54 million-square-foot, zero-waste agricultural and urban settlement engineered to house 13,000 residents and generate 6,500 jobs in alignment with Oman Vision 2040. The self-sustaining development incorporates rectangular farm clusters ranging from 10 to 200 hectares dedicated to regionally optimized crops like date palms and greenhouse tomatoes, supported by an advanced, multi-source water strategy utilizing groundwater, mountain runoff dams, and desalinated seawater. Managed alongside broader national food security initiatives—including a separate agricultural city near Saham designed by the Surbana Jurong Group—the project is structured to scale agro-processing industries, produce organic fertilizers, and accelerate high-value food export pipelines.
records.institution: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The World Economic Forum (WEF) has published its 2026 Energy Transition Index (ETI), ranking Tunisia 62nd globally out of 120 countries a...
records.description: The World Economic Forum (WEF) has published its 2026 Energy Transition Index (ETI), ranking Tunisia 62nd globally out of 120 countries and 2nd across the African continent with an overall score of 56 points. The metric reveals a structural performance gap within the nation's energy architecture, scoring 62.4 points for current energy system stability—supported by near-universal electrification and a structured national grid—compared to 46.3 points for its long-term transition readiness due to constrained capital financing, infrastructure modernization bottlenecks, and delayed large-scale utility deployments. On the continental scale, Tunisia trails only Namibia (61st globally) while leading regional peers like Gabon, South Africa, and Morocco within an expanding sub-Saharan and North African clean-energy landscape. Driven by aggressive government initiatives and commercial electric vehicle infrastructure rollouts, the report highlights that the global energy transition market is projected to scale from $2.71 trillion in 2026 to $7.72 trillion by 2035, emphasizing the macroeconomic necessity for developing economies to align policy, regulatory, and human capital frameworks to capture international green investment flows.

records.title: The Ministry of Transport and the Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform of Syria, in coordination with the UAE's state-backed AD Po...
records.description: The Ministry of Transport and the Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform of Syria, in coordination with the UAE's state-backed AD Ports Group and agri-food conglomerate Silal Group, have advanced talks to establish a multimodal regional trade and logistics corridor. The infrastructure project is engineered to connect Syrian ports with Iraq’s port of Umm Qasr via a weekly shipping service running from Khalifa Port in the UAE, effectively linking the Gulf with Turkish and European commercial corridors while integrating dry ports across Damascus, Aleppo, Homs, and a strategic hub at the Al-Tanf border crossing. Simultaneously, the public-private partnership incorporates two major agricultural investment agreements with Silal Group establishing contract farming structures, direct procurement mechanisms, and sorting facilities to export at least 16,000 tons of local potatoes and seasonal crops to the UAE market.

records.title: The Cabinet of Jordan, in institutional coordination with the French Development Agency (AFD) and the German Development Bank (KfW), has...
records.description: The Cabinet of Jordan, in institutional coordination with the French Development Agency (AFD) and the German Development Bank (KfW), has finalized a €123 million integrated municipal infrastructure package to expand the Madaba wastewater treatment plant and scale up regional sewage networks. Funded via a €25 million European Union grant channelled through the AFD, alongside €97 million in joint credit facilities from the AFD and KfW, the three-year environmental engineering initiative will construct a new treatment facility boosting the governorate's capacity to 16,000 cubic meters per day to serve approximately 200,000 residents. Managed locally by the Madaba Water Administration, the structural climate-adaptation framework incorporates the installation of dedicated transmission pipelines to route reclaimed, treated wastewater exclusively toward restricted agricultural sectors, optimizing non-conventional water utilities while alleviating compounding resource pressures on natural fresh irrigation supplies.

records.title: The Jerash Agriculture Directorate, in institutional coordination with the Royal Society for the Conservation of Nature (RSCN) and enviro...
records.description: The Jerash Agriculture Directorate, in institutional coordination with the Royal Society for the Conservation of Nature (RSCN) and environmental stakeholders, is advocating for a comprehensive, sustainable development framework to rehabilitate and integrate the governorate's 64 natural water springs—such as Ain Al-Deek and Ain Al-Qairawan—into localized eco-tourism and hiking trail programs. While these vital water sources underpin regional food security and agricultural resilience by irrigating hundreds of cultivated dunums—supported by state-backed infrastructure projects that have lined over 3,000 meters of irrigation channels and constructed 1,000 rainwater harvesting wells—most sites currently lack the necessary service infrastructure, signage, and basic facilities to safely accommodate visitors. By deploying low-impact, environmentally friendly infrastructure and specialized maintenance frameworks, the strategic initiative aims to create jobs and stimulate rural economies through green tourism without compromising water quality, volumetric flow, or the primary irrigation utilities required by local smallholders.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Jordan Electric Power Company (JEPCO) has released comprehensive infrastructure data indicating that total connected renewable energy...
records.description: The Jordan Electric Power Company (JEPCO) has released comprehensive infrastructure data indicating that total connected renewable energy systems surpassed 40,329 installations, driving aggregate clean-energy generating capacity to over 716 megawatts. Highlighting a multi-decade structural transformation within the utility matrix—expanding from a baseline of just 0.003 megawatts—the network successfully integrated 2,202 new systems adding significant capacity, with monthly installation rates peaking in January before tapering off to seasonal lows. Operating in compliance with national electricity sector regulations, the utility continues to systematically approve and connect localized solar and wind assets to expand clean energy distribution, strengthen grid stability, and optimize the overarching renewable energy mix within the national electricity grid.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia, operating under its "Sweet in Season" campaign to promote localized c...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture of Saudi Arabia, operating under its "Sweet in Season" campaign to promote localized crop diversification and improve agricultural marketing efficiency, has announced that domestic pomegranate production has reached over 39,700 tons annually. Cultivated across a national footprint of more than 1.3 million productive trees, the crop is concentrated in high-yield agricultural regions including Asir, Makkah, Tabuk, Qassim, and Al-Baha. By utilizing state-backed agricultural guidance, tailored financing facilities, and modern agrotech systems, local smallholders harvest diverse commercial varieties—such as Taif, Hijazi, Wonderful, and Eversweet—designed to thrive in the regional climate. This coordinated public-private supply chain optimization ensures that fresh local produce effectively reaches commercial agrifood processing and retail markets, maximizing smallholder financial returns while advancing the Kingdom's non-oil economic goals and domestic food security objectives.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform of Syria has inaugurated the Agritex International Exhibition for Agricultural and Veteri...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform of Syria has inaugurated the Agritex International Exhibition for Agricultural and Veterinary Supplies, convening 84 specialized agribusinesses and 158 commercial brands from domestic, Arab, and international markets. Formally opened by the Minister of Agriculture, the international summit is engineered to foster public-private partnerships (PPPs) and streamline cross-border trade diplomacy to mitigate mounting regional water and food security deficits. With veterinary health and pharmaceutical enterprises comprising approximately 60% of total exhibitors, the event's strategic focus centers on upgrading livestock biosecurity, enhancing quarantine protocols, and standardizing regional regulatory frameworks to combat transboundary animal diseases. To complement these private-sector investments, the ministry is advancing structural legislative reforms aimed at simplifying commercial licensing, accelerating agrotech localization, and modernizing veterinary oversight to achieve high-yield livestock self-sufficiency and sustainable primary sector growth.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of Syria participated in the Arab consultative workshop on the governance of plant health, phytosanitary (SPS...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Syria participated in the Arab consultative workshop on the governance of plant health, phytosanitary (SPS), and food safety systems held in Muscat, Oman, presenting a strategic working paper on building risk-based and evidence-based agricultural governance. The institutional paper highlighted the necessity of deploying early warning systems, advancing digital transformation, and utilizing electronic health certificates for regional data exchange to enhance collective Arab food security. Furthermore, the framework reviewed national initiatives aimed at revitalizing the domestic seed sector through joint partnerships with international organizations, emphasizing that crisis-recovering states require flexible, adaptive regulatory pathways to successfully align with international food safety standards.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI), in institutional cooperation with the Municipal Council of Khorfakkan, Khorfakkan Ci...
records.description: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI), in institutional cooperation with the Municipal Council of Khorfakkan, Khorfakkan City Municipality, and Expo Khorfakkan, has initiated the fifth edition of the Khorfakkan Mango Festival under the theme "Mango: Our Fruit, Our Wealth." Designed as a direct agrifood marketing platform and a local agricultural enterprise incubator, the three-day event integrates local farmers, productive families, and UAE agribusinesses to showcase premium domestic mangoes, citrus fruits, and seasonal crops. To incentivize high-quality production and agricultural transparency, the festival hosts five specialized categories—including crop beauty and innovation competitions—enforcing strict compliance measures such as mandatory land ownership verification and field inspection audits by a formal judging committee. By blending traditional heritage activities with scientific workshops on modern cultivation, pest control, and sustainable tree management, the state-backed initiative enhances smallholder commercial viability, drives technical optimization, and safeguards regional food security goals.
records.institution: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.title: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation, operating under the framework of Egypt’s Water Resources Strategy 2050 and the Second-Gen...
records.description: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation, operating under the framework of Egypt’s Water Resources Strategy 2050 and the Second-Generation Water System (Water 2.0) approach, has initiated high-level bilateral consultations with Coca-Cola International to develop a public-private partnership focused on non-conventional water resource expansion. Led by Water Resources Minister Hani Sewilam, the proposed infrastructure project aims to deploy localized, renewable-energy-powered desalination and treatment systems to convert moderately saline agricultural drainage water into a sustainable irrigation utility, eliminating the need for additional freshwater withdrawals from the Nile River. Formulated under Coca-Cola’s global Replenish 2.0 water stewardship program, the strategic blueprint builds upon extensive multi-year technical feasibility assessments conducted in cooperation with UNDP, the AWARe initiative, the International Development Research Centre (IDRC), and the Center for Applied Research on the Environment and Sustainability at the American University in Cairo (CARES). By scaling up circular water reuse models, the state-backed climate adaptation framework lowers agricultural water stress overheads, secures regional food supply chains, and shields vulnerable agrarian communities from compounding environmental resource pressures.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation

records.title: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA), operating in institutional coordination with the Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation, h...
records.description: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA), operating in institutional coordination with the Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation, has secured an allocation of JD 169,342 from the Jordan–Japan Counterpart Fund to finance a localized water infrastructure deployment in Wadi Araba, within the Aqaba Governorate. Established originally in 1997 to drive rural socioeconomic and agricultural development, the bilateral funding framework will be utilized to construct small-scale rainwater harvesting systems designed to capture and store seasonal runoff. By optimizing decentralized surface-water collection methods in an increasingly water-scarce geographic pocket, the structural climate-adaptation intervention directly expands the volume of non-conventional water utilities available for local farmers and livestock breeders, stabilizing rural livelihoods and mitigating climate-induced production volatility.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock of Libya, in institutional coordination with the Renewable Energy Holding Company and national...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock of Libya, in institutional coordination with the Renewable Energy Holding Company and national commercial banking institutions, has finalized an expanded meeting in Tripoli to establish mechanisms for deploying decentralized solar energy systems to local farmers. Chaired by the Minister of Agriculture and Livestock, Abdul Latif Muhammad Al-Tahir, the multilateral planning session focused on structuring Sharia-compliant Islamic Murabaha financing models to bypass capital investment barriers for smallholders. Led by the company’s Directors of Projects and Investment, the clean energy initiative is engineered to reduce agricultural overheads, lower crop production costs, and shield local agrifood supply chains from conventional fuel price volatility. The session concluded with an agreement to finalize an integrated technical and financial roadmap, establishing a unified public-private framework to ensure high-standard, sustainable solar irrigation and power projects across the nation's agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock

records.title: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry, and Investment Promotion of Oman, operating through its export promotion framework alongside Algerian...
records.description: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry, and Investment Promotion of Oman, operating through its export promotion framework alongside Algerian trade authorities, has finalized several strategic agreements and memoranda of understanding (MoUs) at the 57th Algiers International Fair. The bilateral frameworks establish direct trade channels and corporate partnerships across high-priority industrial sectors, including logistics, food processing, fisheries, downstream manufacturing, building materials, chemical fertilizers, and pharmaceuticals. Aligned with the non-oil export maximization and market diversification objectives of Oman Vision 2040, the state-backed trade offensive leverages direct business-to-business (B2B) networks to accelerate the penetration of national products across Algerian and broader continental African economic corridors. This report focuses on international trade diplomacy, bilateral investment mobilization, and macro-level export diversification frameworks; it is not related to the current Middle East conflict.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry, and Investment Promotion

records.title: The South Hebron Directorate of Agriculture, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture and in direct partnership with the Ma'an Develop...
records.description: The South Hebron Directorate of Agriculture, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture and in direct partnership with the Ma'an Development Center and Oxfam, has distributed 130 tons of barley fodder to 463 sheep farmers across the western communities of Dura, including Al-Burj, Beit Marsam, Al-Bireh, and surrounding villages. Executed as part of the Emergency Humanitarian Assistance Project with structural financial support from Italian Cooperation, the emergency logistics deployment provides vital nutritional inputs to safeguard livestock herds and insulate smallholders from compounding operational overheads. By stabilizing feed availability for vulnerable livestock breeders amidst severe regional economic disruptions, the inter-institutional intervention mitigates flock mortality risks, sustains domestic meat and dairy production capabilities, and directly reinforces baseline household food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, operating in alignment with the food security and agricultural localization targets o...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, operating in alignment with the food security and agricultural localization targets of Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 transformation agenda, has announced that domestic grape production has scaled to exceed 128,000 tons for the summer harvest season. Cultivated across more than 6.3 million productive grapevines, the geographic distribution of the crop spans premium agricultural basins including Tabuk, Qassim, Hail, Al-Jouf, Madinah, Aseer, and the Taif Governorate. By integrating modern agrotech systems and Good Agricultural Practices (GAP), local smallholders systematically harvest diverse commercial varieties—such as Taifi, Helwani, Banati, Crimson Seedless, and Thompson Seedless—which effectively extends the seasonal harvest window from July through August. This state-supported output fulfills local fresh consumption demand, minimizes import reliance overheads, and anchors regional downstream fruit processing industries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI) has released trade metrics indicating that Tunisian olive oil exports surged to 327,400...
records.description: The National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI) has released trade metrics indicating that Tunisian olive oil exports surged to 327,400 tonnes during the first seven months of the 2025–2026 commercial campaign, yielding an export revenue increase of 44.9% to reach 4,058.5 million dinars. While extra virgin olive oil commands a dominant 83.3% share of total outward shipments, the trade profile continues to face structural processing limitations, with bulk sales accounting for 87.1% of total volumes compared to a stagnant 12.9% allocation for higher-value packaged alternatives. Supported by localized organic segments yielding 44,500 tonnes in premium cross-border revenues, the macro-level distribution strategy remains heavily anchored within Western trade channels, with the European Union absorbing 57.8% of global shipments—led specifically by Spanish and Italian industrial refineries—followed by North American and Asian markets.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The University of Carthage, in collaboration with the National Engineering School of Monastir (LESTE) and under the framework of the Euro...
records.description: The University of Carthage, in collaboration with the National Engineering School of Monastir (LESTE) and under the framework of the European Union's Horizon Europe OpenMod4Africa-Tunisia (OM4A-Tunisia) initiative, has finalized an energy modeling framework indicating that the Tunisian national power grid can integrate up to 35% renewable energy capacity by 2030 without requiring immediate, large-scale structural reinforcement. Based on advanced simulations analyzing long-term energy trajectories through 2050, researchers determined that while the current grid infrastructure can manage the intermittency of localized solar photovoltaic and wind power in the short term, capital-intensive infrastructure investments will become critical starting in 2035 to accommodate deeper decarbonization. By utilizing open-source modeling tools and factoring in cross-border transmission assets like the ELMED electricity interconnection between Tunisia and Italy, the state-backed scientific initiative provides public decision-makers with data-driven pathways to reduce the nation's high reliance on natural gas imports, optimize regional power grid interconnections, and establish a permanent clean-energy planning network across 25 African nations.

records.title: The International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), operating in strategic collaboration with the Ministry of Climate Change and E...
records.description: The International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), operating in strategic collaboration with the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, the National Agriculture Centre, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), and the Gates Foundation, has celebrated the graduation of the fourth cohort of the Arab Women Leaders in Agriculture Fellowship Program (AWLA). The leadership and research capacity-building initiative adds 21 new fellows from across the Arab region, bringing the cumulative total to 79 graduates specializing in agricultural innovation, resource management, and food security. Executed against global frameworks recognizing women's contributions to sustainable food systems, the state-backed platform empowers female researchers and agriculturalists to deploy science-based, climate-smart crop solutions to combat compounding regional challenges including water scarcity, land degradation, and severe climate-induced pressures in arid environments.
records.institution: The International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA)

records.title: The governments of Jordan and Japan have authorized the allocation of JD169,342 from the Jordan–Japan Counterpart Fund to finance the con...
records.description: The governments of Jordan and Japan have authorized the allocation of JD169,342 from the Jordan–Japan Counterpart Fund to finance the construction of localized water harvesting infrastructure in Wadi Araba, within the Aqaba Governorate, to support the Jordan Valley Authority. Orchestrated through a bilateral economic framework managed by Jordan's Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation, the development project aims to mitigate climate-induced water scarcity for regional agricultural smallholders and livestock herders. By deploying efficient rainwater catchment systems designed to maximize surface runoff storage, the intervention boosts immediate water security, stabilizes rural livelihoods, and reinforces climate-adaptive farming methods. This strategic deployment continues a long-term economic development partnership established in 1997 to expand domestic agrifood infrastructure and secure sustainable water resources across the Kingdom's arid zones.
records.institution: The Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation

records.title: The Oman Flour Mills (OFM), in direct institutional partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR),...
records.description: The Oman Flour Mills (OFM), in direct institutional partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR), has officially initiated its sixth consecutive national wheat procurement and purchase program for the 2026 harvest season. Designed as a key agricultural localization and smallholder empowerment initiative under the overarching framework of the Oman Vision 2040 development strategy, the program provides Omani farmers across multiple governorates with an organized, guaranteed marketing channel and standardized technical benchmarks for grain supply. By receiving, processing, and converting diverse domestic wheat varieties into added-value national food products, the enterprise has successfully accelerated local wheat output nearly 20-fold since 2021, thereby expanding strategic domestic grain reserves from an eight-month to a ten-month supply, reducing import dependency risks, and safeguarding localized rural livelihoods.

records.title: The Oman Flour Mills Company, in direct integration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has commenced its an...
records.description: The Oman Flour Mills Company, in direct integration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has commenced its annual Omani Wheat Receiving and Purchasing Program for the domestic harvest. Serving as a strategic national mechanism to enhance food security and secure local food supply chains, the initiative provides smallholders and commercial growers with a stable, organized marketing channel and fair-market pricing to incentivize the expansion of wheat cultivation. The agricultural cycle has drawn active participation across multiple governorates, demonstrating stable farmer engagement, high diversification of indigenous wheat varieties, and projected yield increases relative to previous seasons. By processing the raw grain into value-added national food products, the enterprise drives local economic retention, elevates supply-chain resilience, and reinforces standardized technical benchmarks for domestic harvesting and supply logistics.

records.title: The Yatta Agriculture and Veterinary Directorate, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture, has supervised and executed a targeted agr...
records.description: The Yatta Agriculture and Veterinary Directorate, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture, has supervised and executed a targeted agricultural input deployment to distribute 18,300 summer vegetable seedlings to 61 smallholder beneficiaries with home gardens across Al-Karmel, Al-Riha, As-Samu, and Yatta. Implemented under the framework of the "Nutrition and Care of Palestinian Children through Agriculture" project in partnership with Diakonia and Radio Hellen, the intervention allocates 300 assorted seedlings to each household. By providing vulnerable families with the necessary material inputs and direct technical guidance to optimize home-based crop cultivation, the structural program aims to scale up localized micro-agricultural production, reduce household food expenditure, and elevate baseline nutritional security for children and women in rural communities.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, through the Directorate General of Dams and Major Hydraulic Works, has confir...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, through the Directorate General of Dams and Major Hydraulic Works, has confirmed that the collective filling rate of Tunisian dams has rebounded to 60% of total capacity. This substantial increase in national water reserves contrasts sharply with prior multi-year drought trends, including the corresponding prior season's filling level of 41%, and provides sufficient capacity to secure domestic baseline demands during peak summer usage. While reservoirs across the Northern and Cap Bon regions captured the vast majority of seasonal precipitation inflows, localized supply deficits persist within Central region basins, such as the Nebhana dam infrastructure.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced that the province of Karbala achieved a historic milestone during the 2025-2026 agricultural se...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced that the province of Karbala achieved a historic milestone during the 2025-2026 agricultural season, recording its highest wheat harvest to date at 365,000 tons. This production, successfully delivered to the General Company for Grain Trade, marks a 60,000-ton increase over the previous season. The total yield comprises 285,000 tons grown within the state's official agricultural plan and an additional 80,000 tons cultivated outside of it, driven by a government directive to purchase all available crops to incentivize local producers. With this record-breaking volume, the province secures its local needs under the national food ration program while contributing surplus grain to support neighboring areas.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has commenced the drafting of a national Organic Agriculture Law aimed at establishing a modern regulatory fr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has commenced the drafting of a national Organic Agriculture Law aimed at establishing a modern regulatory framework that aligns with international and European Union standards. Chaired by the Agricultural Services Department, the ministerial committee is developing mechanisms to localize organic farming benchmarks, institute an accredited certification system, and protect soil and water resources from chemical pollution. This regulatory initiative is designed to bolster the national green economy, enhance the global competitiveness of Iraqi agricultural products, and expand export opportunities with developed nations to support long-term sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The Veterinary Department at the Ministry of Agriculture has expanded its advanced diagnostic and laboratory testing services to enhance...
records.description: The Veterinary Department at the Ministry of Agriculture has expanded its advanced diagnostic and laboratory testing services to enhance animal health and support livestock breeders. Managed by the Central Veterinary Laboratories and Research Department, technical teams utilize modern technologies to facilitate early disease detection and improve veterinary care efficiency. Recent diagnostics include 385 ELISA serological tests, 159 bacteriological examinations, 49 poultry disease assessments, and 145 public health and food safety evaluations. These targeted epidemiological and diagnostic efforts are designed to safeguard livestock production quality, minimize economic losses for breeders, and bolster national food security.
records.institution: The Veterinary Department at the Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Aqaba Special Economic Zone Authority (ASEZA), Aqaba Development Corporation (ADC), and Abu Dhabi Ports Group have launched Maqta Ayl...
records.description: The Aqaba Special Economic Zone Authority (ASEZA), Aqaba Development Corporation (ADC), and Abu Dhabi Ports Group have launched Maqta Ayla Digital Solutions to manage and operate Aqaba’s truck control and monitoring system. The joint initiative introduces an integrated digital platform that leverages artificial intelligence and advanced technologies to streamline cargo movements, reduce vehicle waiting times, and elevate logistics efficiency. Following the completion of its first phase, the automated system has successfully scaled daily processing capacities from 2,000 trucks to a standard flow of up to 4,000 trucks per day, with peak volumes exceeding 4,500 vehicles. Implemented in coordination with global operators like Noatum Ports, this strategic modernization of critical port infrastructure aims to upgrade regional digital supply chain networks and bolster Aqaba's position as a competitive trade hub along the Red Sea corridor.
records.institution: The Aqaba Special Economic Zone Authority (ASEZA), Aqaba Development Corporation (ADC)

records.title: The Marrakech-Safi Regional Multiservices Company (SRM), backed by financing from the state budget and the Ministry of the Interior, has...
records.description: The Marrakech-Safi Regional Multiservices Company (SRM), backed by financing from the state budget and the Ministry of the Interior, has entered the final testing phase of a massive 4.2 billion dirham hydraulic transfer project designed to secure the drinking water supply for Greater Marrakech. The strategic infrastructure involves pumping up to 3.2 cubic meters of water per second (nearly 100 million cubic meters annually) from a coastal desalination facility built by the OCP Group in Safi directly to inland reservoirs via a 185.3-kilometer network of steel pipelines. Engineered to mitigate severe regional water scarcity caused by prolonged drought cycles and rapid urban demand, the system utilizes three pumping stations to elevate the desalinated water before feeding it by gravity into the main distribution networks north and south of Marrakech, significantly minimizing ongoing operational energy footprints.

records.title: The National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA), in direct system integration with PortNet (the Moroccan Portal for Foreign Trade Procedures)...
records.description: The National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA), in direct system integration with PortNet (the Moroccan Portal for Foreign Trade Procedures), has launched a digital platform enabling the electronic submission of sanitary and phytosanitary (SPS) documentation for agrifood imports. Executed as a core milestone under Morocco’s 2025–2027 Foreign Trade Roadmap, the real-time interoperability between both organizations' information systems eliminates manual data redundancies and accelerates the validation of Single Goods Declarations (DUM). By digitalizing the complex regulatory compliance checks required for agricultural imports, the initiative aims to slash transit bottlenecks at maritime ports and airports, enhance national logistics competitiveness, and minimize the time perishable products spend in transit undergoing necessary health and safety controls.
records.institution: The National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA)

records.title: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), in collaboration with the Falcon Training Institute, implemented the "Model Farm Manage...
records.description: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), in collaboration with the Falcon Training Institute, implemented the "Model Farm Management" programme across the Governorates of South Al Batinah, South Al Sharqiyah, and Dhofar to enhance local agricultural production, optimize resource efficiency, and stimulate sustainable agribusiness investments. Designed to align with the socioeconomic development goals of Oman Vision 2040, the specialized training initiative equipped agricultural entrepreneurs and model farm owners with advanced skills in supply chain optimization, modern marketing strategies, value-added food processing, and efficient resource management. The theoretical coursework was directly augmented by on-site field visits to leading regional agricultural enterprises, including the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Company and Dhofar Foods and Investment Company, where participants analyzed practical field applications of water-efficient irrigation, smart farming technologies, and collective exporting frameworks. This initiative represents one of five macro-sector operational training tracks orchestrated by the chamber to expand private sector capability, reduce industrial waste, and accelerate economic diversification across the Sultanate's governorates.
records.institution: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)

records.title: The Yatta Agriculture Directorate, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture, has launched an urgent field immunization and animal iden...
records.description: The Yatta Agriculture Directorate, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture, has launched an urgent field immunization and animal identification campaign across the threatened pastoral communities of Jinba, Al-Markaz, and Al-Halawa in Masafer Yatta. On its initial deployment day, specialized veterinary teams systematically targeted , or inoculated, 4,300 sheep across 45 smallholder herds against the highly infectious foot-and-mouth disease (specifically the SAT-1 serotype variant). Concurrently, the mobile units are executing a comprehensive livestock tagging and registration protocol, inserting unique identification tags to formally document herd ownership, optimize animal disease traceability vectors, and prevent asset loss. This urgent veterinary response reduces livestock mortality overheads, preserves the localized production of essential meat and dairy products, and directly stabilizes rural livelihoods against escalating physical disruption and systemic resource displacement.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has revealed that watermelon has secured the top position in Saudi Arabia’s sum...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has revealed that watermelon has secured the top position in Saudi Arabia’s summer fruit sector, with total annual production surpassing 620,000 tons. Distributed across a highly diverse geographic matrix—including Riyadh, Makkah, the Eastern Region, Al-Jouf, Al-Baha, Madinah, Qassim, Tabuk, Hail, Aseer, and Jazan—the crop is highly valued both for fresh seasonal consumption and as a vital raw input for domestic food-processing industries. In alignment with Saudi Vision 2030 economic diversification and food security targets, public authorities are actively backing local growers by deploying targeted agricultural guidance, direct development financing, and modern water-efficient farming technologies while refining integrated marketing and supply-chain logistics to maximize local self-sufficiency during peak summer demand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Damascus and Rural Damascus Agriculture Directorate, working in active coordination with the Damascus Governorate and the Civil Defen...
records.description: The Damascus and Rural Damascus Agriculture Directorate, working in active coordination with the Damascus Governorate and the Civil Defense Directorate, is executing an integrated pest management and containment campaign targeting the red palm weevil (Rhynchophorus ferrugineus). To arrest the spread of this highly destructive wood-boring insect, phytosanitary teams have systematically identified, excavated, and removed approximately 60 heavily infested palm trees from municipal gardens, highway medians, and public infrastructure spaces. The extracted plant biomass was safely routed to containment landfills for controlled bio-secure incineration and deep burial. To safeguard the remaining urban canopy, field crews are pairing targeted chemical canopy sprayings with the deployment of specialized pheromone traps to disrupt the weevil's mating cycle and continuously track population vectors across the metropolitan territory.
records.institution: The Damascus and Rural Damascus Agriculture Directorate

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has reported a decline in Egypt’s wheat imports to 12.5 million tonnes in the current fi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has reported a decline in Egypt’s wheat imports to 12.5 million tonnes in the current fiscal year, down from 13.2 million tonnes the previous year. This 700,000-tonne reduction is attributed to a 6.5% increase in domestic wheat output, which exceeded 10 million tonnes, and a record government procurement approaching 5 million tonnes. The production growth was supported by expanding cultivated wheat areas to 3.76 million feddans and strengthening the contract farming system to link farmers directly with processors. Additionally, the institution highlighted large-scale land reclamation projects, such as the New Delta and Toshka developments, alongside major water treatment infrastructures like the Al-Hammam and Bahr Al-Baqar stations to sustain agricultural expansion and reduce import reliance.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

This growth is part of a broader expansion that pushed the country's total agricultural exports past five million tons, with beans ranking high on the export list followed by onions, grapes, and strawberries. Officials attribute this performance to a strict national coding and agricultural quarantine system, alongside the successful opening of 21 new global markets across Asia, Latin America, and the Caribbean during the first half of the year.

Field inspectors confirmed that the facility met all national sanitary specifications, maintaining functional infrastructure and absolute compliance with safety requirements to mitigate the transmission of zoonotic diseases. These rigorous tracking and safety enforcement protocols form part of a broader national framework dedicated to securing domestic meat supply chains and safeguarding consumer health.

records.description: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion has organized the Sultanate of Oman’s official participation in the 57th Algiers International Fair at the Pins Maritime Exhibition Palace. Aligned with the economic diversification and non-oil export expansion targets of Oman Vision 2040, a delegation of 20 Omani companies is representing a diverse array of industrial sectors. The targeted trade pavilion showcases Omani production capabilities across macro-industries—including agriculture, fertilizers, chemical and pharmaceutical products, plastics, logistics, and automotive manufacturing—alongside traditional heritage goods such as frankincense, perfumes, and Omani sweets. Managed by the ministry's Export Development and Promotion departments, this strategic deployment aims to open new export channels, leverage regional bilateral meetings, and establish long-term trade partnerships with importers and supply-chain distributors across African markets.

records.description: The growing AgriTech ecosystem in Algeria is driving digital transformation within the agricultural sector through innovative startup solutions focused on enhancing productivity and strengthening national food sovereignty. By utilizing an encouraging public support framework, local companies are deploying distinct yet complementary technologies. Notably, AgroTech Solutions has developed an integrated management platform (ERP) that fuses internet-of-things (IoT) sensors and data analytics to optimize crop management, streamline irrigation, and reduce post-harvest economic losses across domestic farms. Concurrently, GB Vertical—recipient of the ARLEM local youth entrepreneurship prize—is pioneering automated vertical farming systems where artificial intelligence regulates climate, lighting, and nutrients in a controlled environment. This soil-less technology reduces water consumption by up to 90% and accelerates crop cycles, creating a sustainable model to produce leafy greens and aromatic herbs in peri-urban areas, which frees up valuable open-field land and water resources for strategic crops like cereals and legumes. Both startups are positioned to mitigate local climate change challenges while planning medium-term commercial expansion into broader African markets facing rapid urbanization and water scarcity.

records.description: The Aqaba Special Economic Zone Authority (ASEZA), in a direct public-private partnership with the special-purpose venture Jordan Green Ammonia (JGA), has finalized a strategic land lease agreement to construct the Kingdom’s first commercial green fuel plant in southern Aqaba. The utility-scale complex is designed to achieve a maximum annual nameplate capacity of up to 120,000 tonnes of zero-emission green ammonia, targeting premium, regulated low-carbon export markets across Europe and Asia. To operate with total energy independence from the national power grid, the $1 billion infrastructure layout is powered entirely by a dedicated 550 MW solar photovoltaic plant integrated with advanced battery energy storage systems (BESS). Moving through the Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) and Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) phases toward a targeted financial close in late 2027, the state-backed initiative leverages Aqaba's deepwater port corridors and stable regulatory framework to generate clean-tech industrial employment and strengthen regional economic competitiveness.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Development, Water and Forests has documented a notable multi-sector structural recovery across the Moroccan agricultural economy for the current seasonal cycle, successfully rebounding from consecutive years of acute climate-induced water stress. Substantial autumn and winter rainfall volumes directly replenished national water reserves and accelerated production targets across three high-value, commercially dynamic export segments: soft fruits, citrus fruits, and olives. Driven by robust European market demand and competitive production timelines, the berry sector consolidated its lucrative standing in the Loukkos, Gharb, and Souss-Massa regions, while national citrus fruit yields are projected to expand by approximately 25% to reach nearly 1.9 million tons through optimized irrigation networks and modernized orchard configurations. Most notably, the olive sector experienced a record-breaking harvest expansion of over 100% relative to the prior season—yielding nearly 2 million tons due to the maturation of newly established intensive and super-intensive orchards—which is expected to ease domestic price pressures and significantly boost the country's macro-export capacity.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Damet Municipality, the Association for Forest Wealth and Development (AFDC), and the International College – Ali Ghandour Center for Leadership and Civic Engagement, has inaugurated the "Phoenix" project in Damet, Chouf District. Structured as a localized environmental governance framework, the initiative establishes an integrated civic and developmental platform dedicated to expanding environmental education, constructing safe nature-conservation laboratories, and scaling up sustainable agriculture practices among younger generations. To reinforce regional biodiversity awareness, the participating student delegation curated a living botanical mapping project composed of distinct regional plant varieties representing Lebanon's diverse biophysical terrain. Furthermore, institutional leaders utilized the forum to address compounding climate pressures and conflict-driven agricultural degradation across rural spaces, emphasizing that localized agro-ecological investments serve as a crucial mechanism for protecting forest resources and stabilizing long-term food security.

records.title: Silal Group, Delphy join forces to elevate local capabilities across UAE's food, agriculture sector
records.description: The Silal Group, in direct coordination with the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, has finalized a five-year strategic collaboration agreement with the Dutch agricultural consultancy Delphy to advance national training and capacity-building programs. Centered within Silal Group’s Innovation Oasis and Delphy Research Centres, the partnership integrates cutting-edge agricultural science with practical field applications to address localized food security challenges and scale up the domestic knowledge infrastructure. The technical curriculum focuses on optimizing high-efficiency open-field and protected-crop cultivation methodologies—such as advanced automated greenhouse and hydroponic systems—while simultaneously developing sustainable business models, feasibility frameworks, and commercialization pathways to enhance the profitability of local farming operations. Executed as a structural milestone for the agritech sector, this international knowledge-transfer initiative directly supports the UAE’s National Food Security Strategy 2051 by empowering local talent with specialized agronomic and commercial expertise.

records.description: The National Institute for Agricultural Research (INRA) and SONACOS have entered into a strategic partnership agreement to enhance national seed sovereignty and accelerate the production of locally adapted pre-basic seeds. Formalized at the Marchouch experimental station, the collaborative framework directly aligns with the guidelines of the "Generation Green 2020-2030" strategy, which targets raising the utilization rate of certified seeds to 40% and increasing the market share of nationally developed plant varieties to 50% by 2030. Operating under joint strategic and technical governance committees, the integrated approach structures coordinated seed-requirement planning, rigorous quality monitoring across critical crop segments—including cereals, pulses, forage crops, and oilseeds—and unified commercialization pathways. This programmatic alignment aims to bolster agricultural competitiveness and provide farmers with resilient, climate-adapted plant genetics optimized for local soil and weather conditions.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has launched an infrastructure project to supply the El Alem agricultural complex in the Sbeitla delegation with treated wastewater routed from the local municipal treatment plant. Backed by a capital investment of 870,000 dinars via the Regional Commission for Agricultural Development, the hydraulic engineering system integrates dedicated solar energy arrays to pump and distribute unconventional water resources across a 30-hectare fodder cultivation zone and 50 hectares of regional olive groves. This intervention delivers a climate-adaptive framework for the Kairouan governorate, which has faced severe groundwater depletion and protracted multi-year drought cycles, while simultaneously utilizing tertiary water treatment to sustain regional agrifood supply chains. Additionally, institutional monitoring confirmed that regional harvest operations have scaled to 40% completion at the complex and 79% across the broader governorate, accumulating roughly 550,000 quintals of grain at localized collection centers.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has blocked the entry of 1,750 head of live calves imported for slaughter through the Trebil border crossing. The emergency epidemiological directive was triggered by the Veterinary Department after confirming that the livestock, which originated in Colombia, was infected with foot-and-mouth disease. Officials emphasized that the interception was necessary to prevent the spread of lethal diseases and epidemics among local livestock populations, thereby safeguarding public health, protecting domestic food safety networks, and shielding the national economy from major agricultural losses.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of Lebanon, in operational coordination with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and backed by fu...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Lebanon, in operational coordination with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and backed by funding from the German Government through the KfW Development Bank, has initiated the first distribution phase of a 1.5 million vegetable seedling project under the "Together for Food Security" campaign. Cultivated at the state nursery in Abdeh, Akkar, the initial cohort of 500,000 diversified seedlings is being systematically allocated via the National Farmers Registry and localized municipal networks to smallholders situated in climate-compatible zones exceeding 500 meters above sea level. This emergency agronomic intervention is a core element of the state's broader Agricultural Response and Recovery Plan, which interfaces with a macro-level UNDP program dedicated to reviving the seed production value chain at the Lebanese Agricultural Research Institute (LARI). Backed by a 153.3 million euro German humanitarian and development aid package designed to insulate vulnerable farming families from current crises, the state-led infrastructure project aims to revitalize dormant arable land, expand domestic crop yields, and stabilize national food security architecture.

records.title: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) has project-based data indicating that the national cereal harvest is projected to...
records.description: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) has project-based data indicating that the national cereal harvest is projected to cover nearly 65% of Tunisia's total cereal requirements, signaling a notable recovery from consecutive years of depressed yields despite ongoing vulnerabilities to climate fluctuations and an acute structural dependence on international soft wheat imports. While optimal rainfall patterns and cool temperatures initially slowed grain ripening to push back the launch of the harvesting campaign, institutional assessments stress that the season's overall output potential was severely constrained by systemic input supply bottlenecks, leaving domestic farmers with only 60% of the required ammonium nitrate allocations alongside deep deficits in improved seeds and DAP fertilizers.
records.institution: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD), in a strategic bilateral partnership with the Government of Uzbekistan—represented by the Mini...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD), in a strategic bilateral partnership with the Government of Uzbekistan—represented by the Ministry of Ecology, Environmental Protection and Climate Change and the Ministry of Agriculture—has financed the Agricultural Systems Development Project in Karakalpakstan with a total investment of AED 18.7 million. Executed in direct technical collaboration with the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), the International Innovation Center for the Aral Sea Basin (IICAS), and the Karakalpakstan Agricultural Research Institute (KARI), the project deploys integrated agricultural infrastructure to mitigate the severe environmental impacts of drought and desertification caused by the Aral Sea crisis. The climate-adaptive infrastructure introduces over 20 varieties of drought- and salinity-tolerant crops, modernizes localized irrigation and drainage networks, and establishes co-managed agriculture-aquaculture frameworks to maximize resource efficiency.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD)

Supported by complementary frameworks like the National Biodiversity Strategy 2031 and the Blue Carbon Project, the nation has integrated advanced technological interventions including aerial agricultural mapping, dedicated saline agriculture research stations, and an extensive network of 109 dams that recently retained 72 million cubic metres of rainfall to supply critical irrigation. These structural measures are further reinforced by the newly launched National Agricultural Initiative for the Adoption of Climate-Smart Crops, transforming severe climate vulnerabilities into proactive, sustainable development pathways.

records.description: The Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company (EETC), in a high-level multilateral partnership with EIB Global (the development arm of the European Investment Bank) and the European Commission, has secured a €690 million financing package to modernize and scale up the national power grid. Structured as one of the inaugural flagship operations under the Trans-Mediterranean Renewable Energy and Clean-Tech Cooperation Initiative (T-MED), the capital deployment combines a €600 million loan with up to €90 million in direct European Union grants. The macro-scale infrastructure modernization framework is designed to integrate 22 gigawatts (GW) of new renewable energy generation capacity into the domestic grid architecture by 2030—effectively securing clean power access for approximately 10 million households while positioning the country as a competitive, cross-border Mediterranean energy transmission hub.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation, in tandem with the Sudanese Agricultural Bank, has launched an extensive multi-sectoral financing and stabilization initiative for the 2026 summer cropping season, mapping out an ambitious cultivation plan targeting over 31 million feddans across decentralized states like Sennar. Implemented to directly counter the severe infrastructural destruction and vegetation degradation left by conflict zones, the rehabilitation strategy introduces a mandatory technology-linked lending mechanism that bundles microfinance, capital allocations, and advanced extension programs with formal agricultural insurance through a dedicated Risk Mitigation Fund. To alleviate the heavy economic constraints bearing down on smallholders and organized cooperative associations, the coordinated banking framework leverages capital instruments and subsidized fuel proposals alongside targeted fertilizer and seed distributions, prioritizing high-efficiency organized farming structures to reinforce macro food security.

The multi-sectoral forum brought together government bodies, local civil defense units, disaster risk reduction teams, public health entities, and international environmental partners to formalize seasonal preparedness frameworks and mitigate systemic climate hazards. To confront overlapping risks from prolonged droughts, severe seasonal flooding, flash floods, and escalating temperatures, the assembly established structured guidelines to unify early-warning data-sharing networks. Ultimately, these integrated meteorological metrics are designed to guide state institutions in building operational resilience, protecting critical civic infrastructure, and safeguarding domestic smallholder food security against volatile shifts in weather patterns.

To manage the anticipated surge in Saharan crop yields, the province has built nine local grain storage hubs with a combined capacity of 450,000 quintals and is currently constructing a massive strategic silo capable of holding one million quintals. records.description: The National Agricultural Mutual Insurance Fund (CNMA) has approved its annual financial report, detailing improved performance and heightened risk coverage for the fiscal year. Driven by increasing demand from farmers facing climate, health, and economic volatility, the institution's dedicated agricultural insurance portfolio expanded by 10% to exceed 1.6 billion dinars, with livestock production insurance growing by 10% and crop insurance rising by 7%. Concurrently, the fund fulfilled its stabilization role by processing and settling claims totaling 8.1 billion dinars—a 17% increase in compensation payouts designed to secure domestic agricultural incomes. Across all operations, the entity recorded an overall turnover increase of 12% to reach 15.2 billion dinars, yielding a net profit of nearly 2 billion dinars on a financial activity volume of 27.5 billion dinars. This strong capital positioning underpins the organization's multi-year development strategy to secure agricultural investments, modernize regional farm operations, and diversify financial stability into agri-food processing, transportation, and emerging industrial segments to support national food sovereignty.

Notably, the crop achieved sustainable production relying entirely on natural rainwater without supplemental irrigation, marking a significant milestone for national seed development programs aimed at securing long-term food security.

Additionally, agricultural fertilizers and technical support were provided to 140 beneficiaries to optimize vegetable production and promote sustainable resource management. This cross-border and localized initiative aims to strengthen climate resilience, advance women's economic empowerment, and secure regional food systems.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman, operating through its Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in the Al Dhahirah Governorate, has issued an official regulatory alert prohibiting the use of untreated sewage water for the irrigation of agricultural land. The regional enforcement directive underscores that the deployment of non-potable wastewater in primary crop production explicitly violates the statutory provisions and executive regulations of the national Agriculture System Law. Designed to insulate local aquifers from environmental contamination, uphold strict public food safety standards, and protect consumers from soil-borne pathogenic risks, this public health intervention reinforces the state's legal framework governing sustainable resource management.

Designed to serve as a primary industrial hub for the country's edible oil, food, feed, poultry, and livestock sectors, the facility is slated to process approximately 300,000 tonnes of soybeans and 100,000 tonnes of sunflower seeds annually, yielding an estimated production value of $500 million. Under this operational framework, the international agribusiness firm will leverage its global supply chain and logistics expertise to optimize factory performance while implementing structured workforce development programs. Notably, the agreement mandates that local citizens represent at least 75% of both technical and managerial personnel, ensuring a direct transfer of operational know-how to build independent domestic capacity over time.

records.title: The Department of Animal Resources at the Ministry of Agriculture has launched a major restocking initiative to release one million commo...
records.description: The Department of Animal Resources at the Ministry of Agriculture has launched a major restocking initiative to release one million common carp fingerlings into natural water bodies. Executed in strategic partnership with the private sector specifically the Iraqi Fish Producers Association—the conservation and aquaculture project aims to significantly enhance inland fisheries and support regional food security. The first phase of the rollout commenced with the release of an initial 100,000 fingerlings in the wetlands of the Maysan Governorate. These juvenile fish were produced through specialized artificial breeding techniques at the Golden Fish Hatchery located in the Al-Madain District, southeast of Baghdad. The ministry intends to proceed with successive phased releases across strategic waterways until the total target of one million carp is achieved, replenishing aquatic ecosystems and sustaining livelihoods for local fishing communities.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has officially established the nationwide cereal reception pricing structure f...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has officially established the nationwide cereal reception pricing structure for the current harvest and storage campaign, embedding tiered financial incentives to accelerate crop collection. Under this framework, durum wheat is priced at 140 dinars per quintal (inclusive of a 40 dinar expedited delivery bonus), soft wheat is set at 110 dinars per quintal (inclusive of a 30 dinar expedited bonus), and barley and triticale are valued at 90 dinars per quintal (inclusive of a 25 dinar expedited bonus). To secure these maximum payout rates, agricultural producers must comply with staggered seasonal delivery deadlines, with barley and triticale allocations requiring mid-summer submission, while durum and soft wheat eligibility extends into late summer.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, has approved an emerg...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, has approved an emergency support project for Lebanon during the 181st session of the FAO Council in Rome to mitigate severe agricultural infrastructure damage and production losses. Backed by joint institutional assessments, data indicates that intense armed hostilities have damaged more than 22.5% of national farmland—amounting to roughly 51,956 hectares—while displacing 76.8% of agricultural communities and threatening to push approximately 1.24 million people into acute food insecurity. Designed to stabilize local food networks and maintain the continuity of rural livelihoods, the emergency recovery framework deploys specialized technical and financial aid portfolios to restore disrupted livestock breeding, secure the vulnerable beekeeping sector, and rehabilitate compromised agrifood supply lines.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has formally welcomed the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's decision to lift import restrictions and resume receiving...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has formally welcomed the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's decision to lift import restrictions and resume receiving Lebanese agricultural shipments, classifying the trade reopening as a pivotal development for national economic recovery and rural socioeconomic stability. Prior to market closures, the Gulf Cooperation Council operated as Lebanon's primary export destination by consuming 45% of its outbound agricultural volume—with Saudi Arabia alone routing approximately 60,000 tons of fruits and vegetables annually—before structural disruptions caused total regional export values to plunge from 242 million USD to just 14 million USD. By restoring direct access to this high-value commercial network, the regulatory milestone is projected to rapidly revitalize domestic packaging, transport, and cultivation supply lines while incentivizing the ministry to enforce stringent food safety oversight, product traceability, and international quality standards.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in a direct multi-lateral partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the Lebanese...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in a direct multi-lateral partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the Lebanese National Institute for Agricultural Scientific Research (LARI), has launched a major food security project to produce and distribute 1.5 million vegetable seedlings to vulnerable domestic farming networks. Funded by the German government through the German Development Bank (KfW) as part of a larger 153.3 million euro humanitarian and development aid package, the initiative utilizes state-run nurseries—such as the Al-Abdeh facility in Akkar—to distribute high-quality agricultural inputs to growers registered in the National Farmers' Registry. The climate-matched distribution strategy scales up local agrifood production capacities, rehabilitates vital wheat seed value chains, and expands cultivated land area across diverse governorates to insulate rural communities from compounding supply shocks.

records.title: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, acting via direct directives from the Crown Prince and coordinated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, has o...
records.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, acting via direct directives from the Crown Prince and coordinated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, has officially ordered the full resumption of Lebanese imports into its domestic markets, effectively dismantling a five-year economic blockade initially imposed in April 2021 due to regional Captagon narcotics smuggling networks. This major trade breakthrough was brokered following high-level diplomatic appeals from the state institutions of Lebanon, specifically the newly established presidency and prime ministerial cabinet. The diplomatic and trade normalization reflects growing regional institutional confidence in the Lebanese government's recent regulatory, customs, and security measures designed to rebuild credible state agencies, secure national border controls, and aggressively curb illicit transnational trafficking. The restoration of this strategic trade gateway is anticipated to inject up to $500 million annually into the Lebanese private sector, offering a substantial fiscal lifeline to domestic agricultural and manufacturing industries while systematically realigning Beirut's economic and political ties with the Arab Gulf states.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO), under the patronage of Jordan's Ministry of Social Development and in...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO), under the patronage of Jordan's Ministry of Social Development and in collaboration with the AlMustaqbal Club for Persons with Motor Disabilities, has launched the AGRI-FIT innovation project. This pioneering national initiative is designed to promote inclusive and accessible agricultural systems by deploying innovative, adapted soilless farming techniques and modified greenhouse infrastructure specifically engineered for persons with motor disabilities. Aligned with Jordan's Economic Modernisation Vision and international Sustainable Development Goals, the project aims to dismantle physical and structural barriers to entry within the agricultural economy, providing independent, sustainable income streams and advancing targeted economic empowerment and social inclusion. By utilizing customized vertical or soilless nurseries that eliminate conventional labor limitations, the multi-institutional partnership establishes a scalable model for inclusive rural development and equitable workforce integration across Jordan's agrifood sector.

records.title: The Bethlehem Directorate of Agriculture, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture and in direct partnership with the Food and Agricul...
records.description: The Bethlehem Directorate of Agriculture, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture and in direct partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has conducted a specialized technical training program for 22 female farmers from the village of Marah Rabah. Financed by the European Union under a broader national livestock sector development framework, the two-day capacity-building initiative delivers theoretical and practical instruction on advanced sheep farm management, sanitary raw milk processing, and safe dairy production according to approved public health benchmarks. By training rural women in optimized flock-care methodologies and standardizing sterilization protocols, the structural intervention lowers operational overhead costs, mitigates food safety hazards, and elevates the economic returns of localized smallholder enterprises.

records.title: The Directorate of Agriculture of the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Governorate, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture, has part...
records.description: The Directorate of Agriculture of the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Governorate, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture, has partnered with the Applied Research Institute – Jerusalem (ARIJ) to sign a strategic funding agreement under the "Strengthening Livelihoods, Infrastructure, and Food Systems (LIFT)" program, financed by the Swedish organization We Effect. The infrastructure rehabilitation project in the town of Aqaba involves reconstructing 4 kilometers of vital agricultural access roads alongside modernizing local water utility networks by equipping licensed wells with solar energy systems and high-efficiency pipelines. Designed as a long-term development framework spanning from late 2025 through 2029, the structural intervention lowers regional transport costs, reduces fossil fuel dependencies for irrigation pumps, and expands land cultivation capabilities to reinforce smallholder food security.
records.institution: The Directorate of Agriculture of the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Governorate

records.title: The US-Qatar Business Council in Doha, in partnership with the International Finance Corporation (IFC), has launched a strategic investme...
records.description: The US-Qatar Business Council in Doha, in partnership with the International Finance Corporation (IFC), has launched a strategic investment roadmap designed to accelerate development in Qatar's agriculture and agrifood sector. Developed over a year-long consultative period with public and private stakeholders, the framework provides actionable guidance for policymakers and investors to strengthen food security, optimize supply chain logistics, and build resilient food systems through both localized production and targeted emerging international market assets. The initiative introduces specialized evaluation tools to help investors identify high-value agricultural commodities across various geographies, positioning Qatar as a regional hub for agrifood innovation, economic diversification, and sustainable commercial returns.
records.institution: The US-Qatar Business Council in Doha, in partnership with the International Finance Corporation (IFC)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of the Syrian Arab Republic has issued an official regulatory directive to halt all poultry imports until fur...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of the Syrian Arab Republic has issued an official regulatory directive to halt all poultry imports until further notice. This protectionist policy measure is strategically designed to insulate the domestic livestock market from international trade competition, safeguard the broader poultry sector from commercial volatility, and provide critical market support to local breeders and small-scale livestock producers.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO), in coordination with Advanced Haloes for Project Management, the Green...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO), in coordination with Advanced Haloes for Project Management, the Green Climate Fund (GCF), the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), and the Jordanian Ministries of Water and Irrigation, Agriculture, and Environment, has launched a specialized two-month climate change adaptation training programme in Jordan. Operating under the $33.25 million Building Resilience to Cope with Climate Change in Jordan (BRCCJ) project, the initiative targets 200 women from local communities across the Madaba, Karak, Tafileh, and Ma’an governorates within the climate-vulnerable Dead Sea Basin. The curriculum—comprising 30 specialized sessions peer-supervised by established local female leaders—is structurally designed to build a localized network of women leaders specialized in climate change adaptation, enhance community-level water-use efficiency in the agricultural sector, and safeguard rural livelihoods against severe regional water stress.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation, Agriculture, and Environment
