records.title: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals has released an updated national roadmap for net-zero emissions alongside a new regulatory framework...
records.description: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals has released an updated national roadmap for net-zero emissions alongside a new regulatory framework for carbon markets, aiming for full carbon neutrality by 2050. Developed by the Oman Centre for Net-Zero, the strategy targets a 33% reduction in greenhouse gas emissions by 2035 by converting mitigation efforts into tradable carbon credits to attract international investment. While maintaining a steady daily production of one million barrels of oil and expanding gas exploration, the institution is prioritizing a shift toward green industries, with targets for renewable energy to reach 10% of the mix by the end of this year and up to 100% by 2050. Key developments include $44 billion in green hydrogen investments, the establishment of a commercial hydrogen corridor with the Netherlands, and a 92% Omanization rate within the energy sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals

records.title: Dava Agricultural has announced the launch of the Taif mega-project, an expansion of controlled-environment farming covering 350 hectares...
records.description: Dava Agricultural has announced the launch of the Taif mega-project, an expansion of controlled-environment farming covering 350 hectares of glass greenhouses. The initiative aims to scale daily fresh produce output to 1,000 tons by 2030, building on the company's current 13.8% share of national greenhouse production. By utilizing high-tech hydroponic systems and water-saving technologies, the project seeks to replace various imported crops with premium local varieties, including tomatoes, grapes, and blueberries, while diversifying into open-field cultivation and sustainable energy through an on-site solar park. This development serves as a strategic move to strengthen national self-sufficiency and establish the region as a competitive exporter of fresh produce, particularly during the winter months.

records.title: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has established a wholly owned subsidiary, DBOL International Food and Beverages Trading FZE, within the Jeb...
records.description: Dhampur Bio Organics Limited has established a wholly owned subsidiary, DBOL International Food and Beverages Trading FZE, within the Jebel Ali Free Zone Authority (JAFZA) in Dubai. This new entity is dedicated to the trading, distribution, and value-added packaging of sugar and other fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), leveraging the strategic logistics advantages of one of the world's largest free zones and its proximity to major shipping lanes. By moving packaging operations closer to end-markets, the institution aims to reduce logistics timelines for customers across the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia while benefiting from duty-free sourcing of materials and streamlined export documentation. This move represents a strategic international expansion intended to enhance supply chain efficiency and explore further opportunities in sugar-based products like confectionery and beverages.

records.title: DP World and Al Dahra Holding have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to develop comprehensive supply chain solutions for food and agri...
records.description: DP World and Al Dahra Holding have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to develop comprehensive supply chain solutions for food and agricultural commodities across the GCC and international markets. This strategic partnership aims to address regional reliance on food imports by combining global logistics infrastructure with large-scale agricultural sourcing and procurement. The collaboration will explore joint investments in port infrastructure, cold chain warehousing, and agri-food processing hubs, particularly in Abu Dhabi, while identifying new sourcing corridors across Africa, Europe, and the Americas. By integrating digital traceability systems and optimizing cross-border regulatory processes, the initiative seeks to enhance the resilience and efficiency of the regional food distribution network.
records.institution: DP World and Al Dahra Holding

records.title: The International Exhibition of Agriculture, Livestock and Agri-food Industries (SIPSA-FILAHA), organized by the think-tank FILAHA INNOV,...
records.description: The International Exhibition of Agriculture, Livestock and Agri-food Industries (SIPSA-FILAHA), organized by the think-tank FILAHA INNOV, is hosting an expansive economic event in Algiers featuring 850 exhibitors from 39 countries and representing 247 international brands. Under the theme of modernizing agriculture and strengthening food sovereignty, the exhibition focuses on regional production chains, livestock challenges, and the integration of sustainable technologies like marine resource development. The event includes specialized fairs such as Afrika Food Export and Djazaqua, alongside an innovation hub for startups and the Oleomed olive oil competition, all designed to enhance yields, reduce import dependency, and promote national agricultural products globally.
records.institution: The International Exhibition of Agriculture, Livestock and Agri-food Industries (SIPSA-FILAHA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has announced a strategic goal to exceed 20,000 tonnes of annual farmed fish...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has announced a strategic goal to exceed 20,000 tonnes of annual farmed fish production by 2027. During a visit from the General Fisheries Commission for the Mediterranean (GFCM), officials highlighted that current production is expected to reach up to 14,000 tonnes this year as part of a government action plan focused on food security and marine ecosystem preservation. Algeria’s commitment to international standards has placed it in a leading position within the Mediterranean basin, supported by over 35 resource assessment campaigns and the creation of five protected fishing zones since 2017.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation reported that Egypt’s agricultural export volumes have reached approximately 3.7 million...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation reported that Egypt’s agricultural export volumes have reached approximately 3.7 million tons since the start of 2026. Citrus remains the leading category at 1.7 million tons, followed by significant shipments of potatoes (748,000 tons), sweet potatoes (140,000 tons), and beans (91,000 tons), alongside notable volumes of onions, strawberries, and garlic. This growth has been sustained through a multi-pronged approach: strategic investments in cold-chain infrastructure, strict compliance with international phytosanitary standards, and the diversification of export channels into non-EU markets like Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Kenya, and South Africa. To mitigate climate-related challenges such as water scarcity and temperature fluctuations, the institution is leveraging technology-driven irrigation and drought-resistant crop varieties. Furthermore, the agricultural quarantine authority is expanding pre-shipment inspection agreements to ensure long-term stability in the global supply chain.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture recently conducted a specialized training course focused on organic farming as a strategic tool for combating...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture recently conducted a specialized training course focused on organic farming as a strategic tool for combating desertification and enhancing environmental sustainability. Organized by the Planning and Follow-up Department, the program aimed to improve scientific capabilities and environmental awareness by promoting agricultural methods that reduce land degradation and preserve soil fertility and biodiversity. The curriculum covered essential modules on sustainable natural resource management, the reduction of chemical fertilizers and pesticides, and the application of modern agricultural technologies to address climate change and ensure food security. By fostering a dialogue on current agricultural challenges, the institution sought to develop scientific solutions that align with national goals for sustainable development and safe, eco-friendly food production.

records.title: The Veterinary Department of the Ministry of Agriculture has received a donation of 1,000 gallons of Deltamethrin 5% solution from the Ho...
records.description: The Veterinary Department of the Ministry of Agriculture has received a donation of 1,000 gallons of Deltamethrin 5% solution from the Holy Abbasid Shrine to bolster national efforts against Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever. This chemical solution is specifically designed to target ticks, which serve as the primary vector for the disease among livestock. The shipment, received at central warehouses, is slated for distribution to veterinary hospitals and clinics across various provinces to support field teams during intensive spraying and dipping campaigns. This initiative highlights the ongoing coordination between government entities and religious institutions to enhance public health and protect animal security through integrated veterinary control procedures.
records.institution: The Veterinary Department of the Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has initiated a comprehensive rescue plan for the domestic dairy sector to address sustainability ch...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has initiated a comprehensive rescue plan for the domestic dairy sector to address sustainability challenges exacerbated by economic instability and regional security pressures. During a high-level meeting at the ministry headquarters, officials and stakeholders agreed on a temporary indicative price for fresh milk and established measures to prioritize local production over imported powdered milk and artificial substitutes. The plan includes stricter regulations for processing plants, a reduction in imported cheese varieties that can be produced locally, and a mandate for importers to disclose beneficiaries of powdered milk to prevent unfair competition. Additionally, the institution aims to launch a national awareness campaign to promote fresh Lebanese dairy products while monitoring intermediaries and collection centers to ensure transparency and quality.

records.title: The Moroccan raspberry sector is facing a challenging second half of the season as producers in the north grapple with severe weather los...
records.description: The Moroccan raspberry sector is facing a challenging second half of the season as producers in the north grapple with severe weather losses estimated at 30% to 40% of production potential. These difficulties are compounded by labor shortages during holiday periods and logistical bottlenecks at major transit points like the port of Algeciras, which have led some exporters to freeze their fruit rather than risk fresh-market delivery delays. High transport costs have further restricted market access to the Gulf region, forcing a heavy concentration of shipments toward Europe where price levels have remained stagnant despite the reduced supply. While fresh exports saw a slight decline by the end of the first quarter, the industry has shown a strategic pivot toward frozen products, which saw a 27% increase in volume compared to the previous season.

records.title: Nama Water Services is implementing a comprehensive water sustainability strategy centered on the Aquifer Storage and Recovery (ASR) proj...
records.description: Nama Water Services is implementing a comprehensive water sustainability strategy centered on the Aquifer Storage and Recovery (ASR) project, a strategic initiative designed to bolster national water security and support Oman Vision 2040. By utilizing advanced water injection technology, the institution stores excess desalinated water in underground aquifers during low-demand periods for recovery during emergencies or peak consumption, targeting a storage capacity of up to 30 million cubic meters. This project, currently being piloted in the Sharqiyah Sands basin, aims to reduce operational pressure on desalination plants, lower energy consumption, and ensure a resilient supply for the North and South Al Sharqiyah and Al Dakhiliyah Governorates. Developed in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and academic partners like Sultan Qaboos University, the initiative represents a shift toward proactive, technology-driven water management and resource efficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in the A’Dhahirah Governorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Agricultur...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in the A’Dhahirah Governorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has supported the expansion of the "Murtafaat Al Najeed" project, the first commercial chick-producing hatchery in the Wilayat of Ibri. The facility has reached an annual production capacity of approximately 700,000 chicks, utilizing modern incubation and hatching technologies to supply local farms across multiple governorates. By providing technical guidance, vaccination programs, and biosecurity oversight, the institution aims to increase national white meat self-sufficiency—which currently stands at 62%—and reduce reliance on imports. This initiative serves as a strategic model for localizing the poultry supply chain and enhancing national food security through integrated production cycles.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources

records.title: The National Center for Research and Development of Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) has successfully conducted a research trial in Al...
records.description: The National Center for Research and Development of Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) has successfully conducted a research trial in Al-Kharj Governorate to evaluate the adaptability of quinoa within arid environmental conditions. The study focused on assessing crop performance against high temperatures, soil salinity, and limited water availability to support crop diversification and national food security. Results identified high-yielding varieties suitable for local cultivation, with the "Golden Afternoon" and "Mint Vanilla" varieties producing approximately 4.3 and 4.0 tons per hectare, respectively. This initiative reflects the institution's commitment to developing modern agricultural technologies that improve production efficiency and ensure the sustainability of natural resources.
records.institution: The National Center for Research and Development of Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa) is spearheading a comprehensive transformat...
records.description: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa) is spearheading a comprehensive transformation of the agricultural sector through an integrated, surveillance-based biosecurity system. By implementing enhanced farm inspections, rigorous quarantine protocols, and advanced early-detection laboratories, the institution aims to mitigate the economic impact of transboundary pests and protect national food security. These efforts include the development of emergency response frameworks and a shift toward digital transformation in pest management. This proactive approach serves as a strategic investment in public health and economic stability, ensuring a resilient agricultural environment capable of addressing climate-related and biological risks.
records.institution: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa)

records.description: The National Council of Regions and Districts (CNRD) has commenced the review of five draft laws concerning concession agreements for solar electricity production in Sidi Bouzid, Gafsa, and Gabès. With a total planned capacity of 598 megawatts and an investment of 1.64 billion dinars, the initiative aims to sell the generated power to the national utility provider to reduce natural gas imports by an estimated 13.3% and save approximately 246 million dinars in foreign currency. While the project is viewed as a strategic move toward energy independence and sustainability, discussions continue regarding cost transparency, land management, and international arbitration terms.

records.description: The KEZAD Group, a division of AD Ports Group, has signed a long-term land lease agreement with the Abu Dhabi Refreshment Company to establish a 32,500-square-meter beverage production and distribution facility. With an investment of approximately AED 300 million, the state-of-the-art project is designed to expand the company's regional production capacity and optimize distribution through KEZAD's integrated industrial ecosystem and proximity to Khalifa Port. This initiative aligns with the Abu Dhabi Industrial Strategy, aiming to reinforce the emirate's status as a regional manufacturing hub for fast-moving consumer goods and strengthen downstream supply chains across the UAE. As a franchisee of PepsiCo, the Abu Dhabi Refreshment Company intends for this expansion to enhance its response to evolving consumer demand while supporting national goals for economic diversification and localized production.

records.title: The NRTC Holding Group and DAVA Agricultural have entered into a strategic Memorandum of Understanding to enhance regional agricultural c...
records.description: The NRTC Holding Group and DAVA Agricultural have entered into a strategic Memorandum of Understanding to enhance regional agricultural collaboration and food security across the GCC. This partnership focuses on fresh produce sourcing, supply chain optimization, and sustainable trade, leveraging an integrated supply network that handles approximately one million tonnes of produce annually and advanced hydroponic greenhouse technology that achieves significant water savings. The collaboration aligns with regional sustainability goals and seeks to address a market opportunity exceeding billions in value by expanding high-tech agricultural investments and cross-border distribution networks.
records.institution: The NRTC Holding Group and DAVA Agricultural

records.title: The National Agricultural Mutual Fund (CNMA) organized a national seminar in Algiers to address the security and risk management of grain...
records.description: The National Agricultural Mutual Fund (CNMA) organized a national seminar in Algiers to address the security and risk management of grain storage infrastructure. Participants, including insurers, academic experts, and logistics operators, emphasized the necessity of a comprehensive approach that integrates prevention, specialized insurance, and technical rehabilitation of older silos to stabilize the grain supply chain. As the leading insurer of silos in Algeria, the CNMA detailed its protocol of conducting expert field inspections before and during the insurance subscription process to mitigate vulnerabilities such as fires and structural failures. The seminar concluded with a call for stronger institutional synergies and the adoption of modern, performance-based standards to enhance the resilience of the nation’s strategic food storage sector.

records.title: Egypt targets 70% wheat self-sufficiency by 2030 as EU-backed project aims to curb crop losses
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has announced a strategic goal to increase Egypt's wheat self-sufficiency to 70% by 2030, supported by an expansion of cultivated areas to 3.7 million feddans. Central to this effort is the Good Agricultural Practices (KAFIEU) project, an EU-backed initiative implemented in coordination with the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS) and the Agricultural Research Centre. This program targets 400,000 smallholder farmers across the Nile Delta to introduce modern mechanization and certified seeds, aiming to drastically reduce harvest losses—which previously reached up to 30%—and boost yields to 24 ardebs per feddan. By upgrading seed processing facilities and providing machinery like maize shellers, the project seeks to lower operational costs and solidify cereal production as a vital component of national security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has initiated field monitoring for the 2025-2026 wheat harvest in Karbala, reporting a highly successful and smooth marketing operation. With over 387,000 dunams cultivated, local officials anticipate a total production of 400,000 tons, supported by 22 specialized warehouses and yields reaching up to 1.7 tons per dunam. The season has been characterized by a significant shift toward modern irrigation, with approximately 3,500 sprinklers currently in use by 1,500 farmers to optimize water consumption. Through close coordination between the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Trade, the initiative aims to bolster national food security by providing high-quality seeds and technical support to agricultural investment projects.

records.title: The Ministry of Livestock Development and Acting Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty, in coordination with the Ministry of Real...
records.description: The Ministry of Livestock Development and Acting Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty, in coordination with the Ministry of Real Estate, State Property, and Land Reform, has signed a long-term lease agreement with the China Science and Technology Corporation (CSTC) to develop 2,400 hectares of agricultural land in the Brakna region. This project expands upon the existing Agricultural Training and Technology Center in M'Bagne, established in 2016, which focuses on modern technology transfer and farmer capacity building. The initiative includes advanced production facilities, poultry farms with a capacity of 31,000 units, and a feed production plant, all aimed at enhancing national food sovereignty and creating local employment. Officials from both Mauritania and China emphasized that this partnership is a strategic response to global food supply challenges, designed to modernize agricultural value chains and leverage local resources for sustainable development.

records.description: The National Agency for the Development of Oasis Zones and the Argan Tree (ANDZOA), during the 8th International Argan Tree Congress, announced a strategic transition toward modern argan cultivation under the Generation Green 2020-2030 strategy. The initiative aims to transform the sector from traditional harvesting to a technologically advanced agroforestry system to enhance water resilience and ecological transition in Morocco. Supported by national research institutions, the project has developed heat-resistant genotypes and bioclimatic modeling, with the first argan oil production from these modern plantations expected this coming summer. This shift focuses on sustainable resource management and the socio-economic empowerment of women's cooperatives while maintaining the UNESCO-recognized Arganeraie Biosphere Reserve as a global model for conservation.

records.description: The National Agency for the Development of Oasis Zones and the Argan Tree (ANDZOA), in partnership with the National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) and other key stakeholders, concluded the 8th International Argan Tree Congress in Essaouira. The event brought together 500 delegates to discuss the transition from traditional forest management to modern arboriculture, emphasizing water resilience and ecological sustainability. Several strategic partnership agreements were signed to advance applied research, technical capacity, and innovative solutions for the argan ecosystem, including collaborations with the African Institute of Plant Nutrition (APNI) and private sector partners. Scientific recommendations from the congress highlighted the need for adopting modern cultivation practices, such as using cloned, high-productivity varieties, while honoring young researchers for their contributions to biodiversity and socio-economic studies.

records.title: The Qassim Region has solidified its role as a critical contributor to Saudi Arabia’s strategic food reserves, with wheat production serv...
records.description: The Qassim Region has solidified its role as a critical contributor to Saudi Arabia’s strategic food reserves, with wheat production serving as a primary pillar of the region's agricultural output. Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, the local sector has integrated advanced farming and storage technologies—including high-yield, drought-resistant seed varieties and modern irrigation systems—to enhance self-sufficiency while addressing challenges like water scarcity and climate change. The annual harvest, which typically occurs between April and June, is a coordinated effort between government agencies and local farmers to supply the flour and bread industries, thereby supporting rural development and national food security. Through the expansion of advanced silos and proactive water management, the region continues to model a resilient and sustainable agricultural future for the Kingdom.

records.title: The Africa AgriTrade Coalition was officially launched by Proparco (the private sector subsidiary of the French Development Agency, AFD)...
records.description: The Africa AgriTrade Coalition was officially launched by Proparco (the private sector subsidiary of the French Development Agency, AFD) at the Africa Forward Summit in Nairobi. Comprising 16 major financial institutions with a combined balance sheet of nearly €400 billion—including Ecobank, Equity Group, KCB Bank, and Coris Holding—the coalition aims to bridge a $50 billion financing gap that currently hinders African agricultural trade. The initiative will leverage Proparco’s expertise in risk sharing and guarantees to facilitate large-scale transactions across vital corridors, focusing on commodities such as cocoa, cashew nuts, cereals, and fertilizers. Starting in June 2026, the operational phase will prioritize transactions that align with the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) objectives to enhance food security, supply chain resilience, and regional employment.
records.institution: Ecobank, Equity Group, KCB Bank, and Coris Holding

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Interprofessional Groups and the State Lands Office (OTD), has launched a "From Producer to Consumer" sales initiative in Tunis. Held in a specialized large-scale facility, the event brings approximately twenty producers directly to the public to offer a wide range of agricultural goods—including fresh vegetables, fruits, poultry, fish, and dairy—at prices strictly aligned with wholesale market rates. This initiative coincides with national celebrations marking the anniversary of the agricultural evacuation, highlighting the historical recovery of land and the ongoing restructuring of the sector. By eliminating intermediaries, the program aims to guarantee product quality and accessibility while supporting the domestic economy and providing citizens with preferential pricing on local staples and processed goods.

records.title: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) has proposed the creation of a High Council for Food Sovereignty to coordinate and...
records.description: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) has proposed the creation of a High Council for Food Sovereignty to coordinate and anticipate major challenges in national food production. On the occasion of National Agriculture Day, the organization emphasized that agriculture and fishing must be treated as strategic levers for national stability and economic resilience rather than mere economic sectors. The proposal advocates for integrated governance to secure the national market, reduce vulnerability to international shocks, and modernize production systems through increased investment and improved working conditions for farmers. By establishing this council, the institution aims to align various stakeholders around a common vision that treats food security as a core component of national sovereignty and sustainable development.
records.institution: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) marked the International Day of Plant Health 2026 by reaffirming its commitm...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) marked the International Day of Plant Health 2026 by reaffirming its commitment to "Plant Biosecurity for Food Security." Central to this mission is an integrated system aimed at combating agricultural pests, specifically focusing on the protection of date palms through the "One Health" approach and advanced early warning systems. Between 2019 and 2025, the authority deployed over 124,000 pheromone traps across 21,000 farms, capturing more than 11 million red palm weevils and treating 300,000 infected trees. Additionally, ADAFSA has integrated circular economy principles by recycling over 2,500 tonnes of palm waste into organic fertilizers while providing extensive technical training to farm owners on Integrated Pest Management (IPM) and sustainable agricultural practices. These efforts align with the UAE’s broader vision to strengthen food security and build a resilient agricultural sector capable of addressing evolving biological and climatic challenges.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Administrative Undersecretary, has signed a strategic cooperation agreement with the Food and Ag...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Administrative Undersecretary, has signed a strategic cooperation agreement with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) to implement the "Smallholder Agriculture Revitalization" project. Funded by the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), this initiative targets 15,000 smallholder farmers across four climate-affected governorates in Iraq, providing them with technical support to modernize agricultural infrastructure and improve resilience against environmental changes. The partnership reflects a broader government effort to leverage international expertise to transform the agricultural sector into a more sustainable and economically viable industry.

records.title: Jordan Green Ammonia (JGA), a joint venture between Poland’s Hynfra and Jordan’s Fidelity Group, has signed a $1 billion investment agree...
records.description: Jordan Green Ammonia (JGA), a joint venture between Poland’s Hynfra and Jordan’s Fidelity Group, has signed a $1 billion investment agreement with the Government of Jordan to build the country's first green ammonia production facility. Located in the strategic port city of Aqaba, the plant will utilize 550 MW of solar power and 500 MWh of energy storage to produce 100,000 tonnes of green ammonia annually through water electrolysis. By securing this binding agreement, JGA has outpaced several global energy firms, becoming the first to move beyond preliminary studies into formal project establishment in Jordan. The project, which utilizes technology from Denmark’s Topsoe, aims to start commercial operations by late 2030, targeting international markets for fertilizers, shipping fuel, and power generation.

records.title: The Ministry of Trade and Tourism, in collaboration with the Mauritanian Agency for Food Safety, the National Authority for Radiation Pro...
records.description: The Ministry of Trade and Tourism, in collaboration with the Mauritanian Agency for Food Safety, the National Authority for Radiation Protection and Nuclear Safety and Security, and the European Union, inaugurated a four-day national workshop in Nouakchott focused on the legal and technical framework for food safety. Part of a broader initiative to strengthen health monitoring and food analysis across the Sahel, the workshop aims to modernize regulatory frameworks, enhance laboratory capacities, and develop traceability mechanisms to protect consumer health. Government officials emphasized that these reforms are central to building an integrated national system capable of preventing health risks while improving the international competitiveness of Mauritanian food products. Over the course of the event, experts and international partners will formulate practical recommendations to align national control systems with international standards and ensure the quality of local food industries.
records.institution: The Mauritanian Agency for Food Safety, the National Authority for Radiation Protection and Nuclear Safety and Security

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The National Agency for the Development of Oasis Zones and the Argan Tree (ANDZOA), during the 8th International Argan Tree Congress in E...
records.description: The National Agency for the Development of Oasis Zones and the Argan Tree (ANDZOA), during the 8th International Argan Tree Congress in Essaouira, announced a strategic shift toward modern argan cultivation as part of the Generation Green 2020-2030 strategy. Under the patronage of the King, the agency is transitioning from traditional harvesting to a technologically advanced agroforestry system designed to enhance water resilience and ecological transition. Supported by national research institutions, the initiative has developed heat-resistant genotypes and sustainable management practices, with the first production of argan oil from these modern plantations expected this coming summer.
records.institution: The National Agency for the Development of Oasis Zones and the Argan Tree (ANDZOA)

records.title: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA), speaking at the 8th International Argan Tree Congress, designated the argan tree as...
records.description: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA), speaking at the 8th International Argan Tree Congress, designated the argan tree as a strategic resource for Morocco’s food security, ecological sovereignty, and water resilience. A major scientific milestone was announced: the complete sequencing of the argan tree genome, identifying nearly 35,000 genes and establishing Morocco as a global leader in genomic research for arid-land species. This breakthrough supports a nationwide shift from traditional wild harvesting to a modern, structured argan farming model that utilizes high-performing, heat-resistant genotypes and sustainable irrigation techniques. By integrating scientific innovation with the economic empowerment of women and youth, the initiative aims to transform the UNESCO-recognized biosphere into a stable, technologically advanced value chain capable of adapting to severe climate change.
records.institution: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA)

records.title: The Dhofar Governorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR), has launched four new in...
records.description: The Dhofar Governorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR), has launched four new investment opportunities for water purification and bottling plants in the wilayats of Salalah, Taqah, Muqshin, and the Shalim and Hallaniyat Islands. This initiative is part of a broader strategy to expand the Sultanate’s water industry, which already produces 7.7 million liters of bottled water daily across 81 operational plants. To manage this growth, the MAFWR has introduced updated technical regulations and a streamlined application process via the Tatwir platform to ensure all new projects meet national health and safety standards. By encouraging private sector participation and ensuring a wide geographical distribution of facilities, the government aims to meet the rising demand for clean drinking water driven by population growth and regional development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Wali of Qurayat and local authorities in Oman are expanding the region's agricultural footprint during a highly successful mango seas...
records.description: The Wali of Qurayat and local authorities in Oman are expanding the region's agricultural footprint during a highly successful mango season characterized by strong consumer demand and public participation. Under the Eleventh Five-Year Plan, four new agricultural development sites have been proposed for approval by the Municipal Council of Muscat Governorate to stimulate economic activity and local investment. In addition to infrastructure expansion, preparations are underway for the Mango and Agricultural Products Exhibition, which aims to create marketing opportunities for local growers while celebrating the crop's deep cultural and historical ties to the community. These initiatives, supported by research into variety quality and heritage, position the mango season as a strategic platform for rural development and sustainable food production.

records.title: Dava Agricultural has announced a landmark expansion mega-project in Taif, Saudi Arabia, designed to transform 1,000 hectares of desert l...
records.description: Dava Agricultural has announced a landmark expansion mega-project in Taif, Saudi Arabia, designed to transform 1,000 hectares of desert land into a high-tech agricultural hub in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. The project features 350 hectares of climate-controlled glass greenhouses, a 65-hectare solar energy park, and a large-scale plantation program of one million trees, alongside integrated fish production and eco-tourism facilities. Currently contributing nearly 14% of the Kingdom's greenhouse production, the company aims to scale its daily output to 1,000 tons by 2030 through advanced hydroponics and water-saving technologies. By replacing fruit and vegetable imports with premium local produce and expanding exports to Europe, the initiative seeks to bolster national food security and create significant local employment.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) has implemented a comprehensive agricultural project in the eastern Aleppo...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) has implemented a comprehensive agricultural project in the eastern Aleppo countryside to support the Syrian wheat production chain and enhance local food security. The initiative directly benefited 2,750 families by rehabilitating critical irrigation and drainage networks, installing solar-powered water pumping units, and supporting the propagation of high-quality Syrian wheat seeds through the provision of sifting and sterilization equipment. Additionally, the project rehabilitated a central seed warehouse and three agricultural extension centers, providing farmers with technical training in modern irrigation and crop management to improve long-term productivity and resilience.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief)

records.title: The Najran Region has established itself as a premier agricultural hub in Saudi Arabia, leveraging its fertile soil, moderate climate, an...
records.description: The Najran Region has established itself as a premier agricultural hub in Saudi Arabia, leveraging its fertile soil, moderate climate, and abundant water resources to bolster national food security. Local farmers have transitioned toward high-tech, sustainable practices—including vertical farming and greenhouses—to produce organic, pesticide-free crops such as citrus fruits, grapes, wheat, and the region's signature Al-Bayadh dates. By adopting these water-efficient and innovative methods, Najran’s agricultural sector continues to supply fresh produce to local markets while reducing environmental impact. These advancements are further reinforced by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, which provides specialized workshops and training to enhance the professional skills of farmers and stimulate regional economic growth.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) has expressed significant optimism for the upcoming harvest, forecasting one of th...
records.description: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) has expressed significant optimism for the upcoming harvest, forecasting one of the best cereal seasons in recent years due to abundant rainfall across approximately 991,000 hectares of planted land. With the Ministry of Agriculture estimating a harvest of nearly 20 million quintals, the country anticipates achieving self-sufficiency in durum wheat, which would significantly reduce its reliance on imports and ease the burden on public finances. Despite challenges such as rising production costs for pesticides and the need for improved rural infrastructure, the Cereals Office and the National Agricultural Bank are mobilizing to ensure efficient storage and timely payments to farmers.
records.institution: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP)

records.title: Al Ain Farms Group and NRTC Group, both subsidiaries of Ghitha, have launched a joint venture called Al Ain Taaza to establish a domestic...
records.description: Al Ain Farms Group and NRTC Group, both subsidiaries of Ghitha, have launched a joint venture called Al Ain Taaza to establish a domestic ultra-fresh juice operation in the UAE. Targeting a 30% share of the country's AED 500 million fresh juice market within five years, the partnership leverages NRTC’s end-to-end cold-chain logistics and sourcing expertise alongside Al Ain Farms’ massive distribution network of 23,000 daily sales points. The venture aims to disrupt the market by delivering juice from harvest to shelf within 48 hours—significantly faster than the 4–6 week lead times of international brands—while reducing costs by an estimated 15–20% through vertical integration. Set to launch in Q3 2026 with 15 flavors, the initiative is designed to bolster national food security by reducing reliance on imported finished goods and insulating the local market from global supply chain volatility.
records.institution: Al Ain Farms Group and NRTC Group

records.title: The National Food Safety Authority released its weekly report detailing Egypt's robust food trade, noting that approximately 230,000 tons...
records.description: The National Food Safety Authority released its weekly report detailing Egypt's robust food trade, noting that approximately 230,000 tons of food across 3,812 consignments were exported by 1,480 companies. Fruit exports were led by citrus and strawberries, while vegetable exports were dominated by potatoes and sweet potatoes, with Italy and Saudi Arabia emerging as the top importing destinations. On the import side, 340,000 tons of essential commodities such as wheat and soybeans were received, primarily sourced from Russia and Ukraine, through major ports like Alexandria and Damietta. To facilitate this trade, the authority issued 1,250 export health certificates and 94 import licenses, ensuring adherence to global safety standards and enhancing international confidence in Egyptian agricultural products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources and in cooperation with the Diyala Agriculture Directorate, has r...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources and in cooperation with the Diyala Agriculture Directorate, has released approximately ten million newly hatched common and grass carp into Lake Hamrin. This initiative leverages the abundant water supply recorded this year to revive the lake's ecosystem, increase fish production, and achieve ecological balance. By replenishing the fish stock, the project seeks to support the local fishing community and stimulate economic activity within the fisheries sector, ultimately contributing to national food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has successfully developed the "Wissam" eggplant hybrid specifically de...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has successfully developed the "Wissam" eggplant hybrid specifically designed for greenhouse cultivation at the Al-Burjasiya Palm Station in Basra. Produced as part of the National Program for Propagating Local Vegetable Crop Strains and Hybrids, this variety is engineered to withstand extreme temperatures, desert soils, and irrigation with saline well water. By creating local hybrids that outperform imported varieties in harsh environments, the ministry aims to bolster domestic agricultural production and address Iraq's specific climatic challenges.

records.title: The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ), in coordination with the Libyan Ministry of Local Government, has laun...
records.description: The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ), in coordination with the Libyan Ministry of Local Government, has launched a new phase of Municipal Waste Management Planning workshops for 15 municipalities at the Municipal Development and Decentralisation Support Centre (MDDSC). Part of the Support to Municipalities in Libya Programme (SML III)—funded by the European Union and the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ)—the initiative focuses on strengthening technical capacities and developing strategic waste management plans based on local data. By training specialized experts to support the preparation and implementation of integrated plans, the project aims to improve waste collection services, public health, and environmental conditions across Libya.
records.institution: The Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman, represented by its Minister during a session with the Shura Council,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman, represented by its Minister during a session with the Shura Council, reviewed the robust performance of the food and water sectors under the Tenth Five-Year Development Plan and outlined strategies for the upcoming Eleventh Plan. Significant achievements include a growth in production to 5.6 million tonnes, a 7.9% increase in the sectors' contribution to GDP, and reaching a food self-sufficiency rate of 67.3%, with fish and dates exceeding 100%. The report highlighted extensive infrastructure development, including 85 groundwater recharge dams and a water monitoring network of over 3,400 stations, alongside OMR 1.87 billion in new investment contracts. With food industry exports reaching OMR 753 million and the creation of over 51,000 jobs for Omani workers, the Ministry is now prioritizing digital governance, technological transformation, and expanded private sector partnerships to further enhance national food security and sustainable resource management.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the European Union, launched a specialized training program in Ramallah focused on the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the European Union, launched a specialized training program in Ramallah focused on the Value Chain Analysis for Development (VCA4D) methodology. Inaugurated by the Undersecretary of the Ministry, the program trains national experts to use data-driven diagnostics across functional, economic, social, and environmental dimensions to prioritize agricultural development projects. The initiative specifically addresses the political and economic challenges faced by the Palestinian agricultural sector, aiming to develop robust planning tools that support farmer resilience and sustainable investment despite direct and indirect losses caused by regional instability.

records.title: The technical committee at the Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Qalqilya Directorate of Agriculture, has overseen the han...
records.description: The technical committee at the Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Qalqilya Directorate of Agriculture, has overseen the handover of pilot projects focused on developing the animal feed industry in the village of Hajja. Part of the "SANET" project—funded by the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation and implemented by CIHEAM Bari in partnership with the Palestinian Employment Fund—this initiative provided a local farmer with four 10-ton grain storage tanks. By increasing storage capacity to 40 tons and introducing modern preservation technologies, the project aims to reduce grain losses and improve feed management efficiency. These efforts align with the Ministry's goal of empowering farmers through technology to enhance livestock production and food security.
records.institution: The technical committee at the Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has completed five development projects in the honey sector valued at...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has completed five development projects in the honey sector valued at over SAR 38.2 million across Saudi Arabia. These initiatives, aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, aim to achieve honey self-sufficiency and bolster food security by supporting smallholder producers and modernizing value chains. The program focuses on empowering beekeepers through technical training, the introduction of modern breeding and pollination technologies, and the expansion of marketing opportunities. By reducing reliance on traditional methods and imports, these projects are designed to improve biodiversity, enhance crop pollination, and create sustainable local jobs within the apiculture industry.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) is implementing a strategy to diversify water sources by licensing saline wells and simplifying drillin...
records.description: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) is implementing a strategy to diversify water sources by licensing saline wells and simplifying drilling procedures for private-sector agricultural use. In cooperation with the German agency BGR, the authority conducted groundwater studies to ensure sustainable extraction, resulting in the issuance of approximately 400 well licenses to expand cultivated areas and improve irrigation efficiency. These reforms aim to curb illegal water extraction, utilize previously unsuitable lands, and adopt "water footprint" concepts to maximize crop value and farmer income. Additionally, the National Water Carrier project is expected to provide 300 million cubic meters of water, with significant volumes designated for agricultural reuse to reduce pressure on groundwater basins and enhance national food security.

records.title: The Bethlehem Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), conducted intensive extens...
records.description: The Bethlehem Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), conducted intensive extension workshops for sheep farmers in the communities of Tuqu', Za'tara, and Al-Ubaidiya. As part of the "My Initiative" project—supported by the IBSA Fund (India, Brazil, and South Africa)—the training provided 40 farmers with technical expertise on biosecurity measures, balanced feeding systems, and the productive characteristics of local sheep breeds. By focusing on increasing production efficiency and reducing operational costs, the initiative aims to empower marginalized rural communities and promote sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The Dura Agriculture Directorate conducted the fourth session of its "Field Schools" training series, targeting sheep farmers in the Al-S...
records.description: The Dura Agriculture Directorate conducted the fourth session of its "Field Schools" training series, targeting sheep farmers in the Al-Sarra area south of Hebron. This session, part of the "My Initiative" project—a partnership between the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) with support from the IBSA Fund—focused on managing diseases that cause abortions in sheep and the critical role of balanced nutrition in improving productivity. Experts emphasized adherence to national vaccination programs for diseases like brucellosis and foot-and-mouth disease to reduce mortality rates and transform traditional farming into sustainable agricultural investments.

records.title: The Qassim Region has solidified its reputation as Saudi Arabia’s "food basket" following an exceptional harvest of seasonal peaches, wit...
records.description: The Qassim Region has solidified its reputation as Saudi Arabia’s "food basket" following an exceptional harvest of seasonal peaches, with individual trees yielding between 30 and 50 kilograms. This success follows a pilot phase where 12 varieties were tested, resulting in the identification of a highly successful, water-efficient cultivar well-suited to the region's deciduous growth patterns. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has played a pivotal role in this expansion by providing technical support, promoting modern irrigation technologies, and conducting field visits to ensure agricultural sustainability. By focusing on water conservation and meticulous tree management—including specific pruning and fertilization—the initiative aims to bolster national food security while stimulating the local economy through seasonal employment in harvesting and marketing.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ghab Development and Management teams are rehabilitating and cleaning over three kilometers of main irrigation canals in the village...
records.description: The Ghab Development and Management teams are rehabilitating and cleaning over three kilometers of main irrigation canals in the village of Dimo, located in the Masyaf region. This maintenance effort is designed to ensure the readiness of the irrigation networks and the continuous flow of water to agricultural lands for the current season. By improving water conveyance capacity and reducing waste, the project aims to provide a fair and consistent water supply to local farmers.

records.title: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG) and Borouge have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) for the supply of approximately 3,500 tonnes of Hig...
records.description: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG) and Borouge have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) for the supply of approximately 3,500 tonnes of High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) resin annually, representing a 600% increase in supply. Signed during the Make it in the Emirates forum, the agreement supports AAFG’s vertical integration strategy, particularly its in-house blow molding and cap production operations. This partnership aligns with the UAE’s Operation 300bn industrial strategy by prioritizing local manufacturing, enhancing supply chain resilience, and reducing reliance on imports to bolster national food security.
records.institution: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG) and Borouge

records.title: The Cevital Group is accelerating its $600 million agro-industrial sugar beet project in the Mansourah region of Ghardaïa, aimed at estab...
records.description: The Cevital Group is accelerating its $600 million agro-industrial sugar beet project in the Mansourah region of Ghardaïa, aimed at establishing an integrated sugar sector in southern Algeria. The project combines agricultural production across 1,200 hectares with an on-site industrial refinery scheduled for 2028, utilizing a model that minimizes logistical costs by processing crops where they are grown. Initial agronomic trials have yielded promising sugar extraction levels of 18% to 20%, supported by critical infrastructure developments including a 385-meter borehole to secure water for irrigation and industrial use in the Saharan environment. Expected to create up to 5,000 direct and indirect jobs, the complex will also produce animal feed from by-products like pulp and molasses to support regional livestock farming.

records.title: Egypt’s mango industry achieved a historic record in the 2025/2026 season, with production exceeding 1.4 million tons across 137,000 hect...
records.description: Egypt’s mango industry achieved a historic record in the 2025/2026 season, with production exceeding 1.4 million tons across 137,000 hectares and export volumes of processed IQF mangoes reaching 40,000 tons. Despite logistical challenges and rising shipping costs, exporters successfully expanded into the Gulf, Russia, Eastern Europe, and new markets in Africa and Asia by leveraging over 200 varieties and improved packaging standards. For the upcoming 2026/2027 season, the industry expects an early start due to higher temperatures and plans to shift focus toward high-value late-season varieties like Keitt and Kent to capture market gaps. To maintain global competitiveness, Egyptian companies are prioritizing consistent quality, enhanced cold-chain logistics, and professionalized export operations to meet international retail standards.

records.title: The Morocco Agribusiness Water Coalition (MAWC) was officially launched in Casablanca to address the critical challenge of water scarcity...
records.description: The Morocco Agribusiness Water Coalition (MAWC) was officially launched in Casablanca to address the critical challenge of water scarcity in the Kingdom's agricultural sector. Formed by leading private-sector players including Azura Group, Centrale Danone, Diana Holding, Driscoll's, Equatorial Coca-Cola Bottling Company, and GPC Papier et Carton, the coalition focuses on three priority areas: preserving water resources, enhancing ecosystem resilience, and implementing high-impact local solutions. By fostering innovation and sharing best practices, the members aim to build agricultural models capable of withstanding successive droughts and securing long-term water stability for strategic food sectors.

records.title: The Souss-Massa region in Morocco is launching a 10,000-hectare irrigated area in the province of Tiznit as part of a 15 billion dirham i...
records.description: The Souss-Massa region in Morocco is launching a 10,000-hectare irrigated area in the province of Tiznit as part of a 15 billion dirham investment in water security and agricultural development. The project includes the construction of the Tiznit-Taroudant desalination unit, scheduled for 2028, which will produce 350 million m³ of water annually to support both irrigation and regional water needs. By extending agricultural activity beyond traditional zones, the initiative aims to benefit 1,800 farmers and create 1,500 direct jobs while alleviating pressure on natural water resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has established reference prices for sacrificial sheep for Eid al-Adha 2026, r...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has established reference prices for sacrificial sheep for Eid al-Adha 2026, ranging from 23.8 to 27 dinars per live kilogram across three weight categories. These prices will be implemented at organized sales outlets overseen by the Interprofessional Group for Red Meat and Dairy (GIVLait) in La Manouba and Ben Arous starting May 18. The decision follows discussions regarding rising production costs, including expensive livestock feed and agricultural inputs, while authorities encourage citizens to use regulated points of sale to ensure price transparency and combat speculative practices by intermediaries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development in the governorate of Manouba has announced that the water quota for public irrigate...
records.description: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development in the governorate of Manouba has announced that the water quota for public irrigated perimeters will increase to 20 million m³ for the current agricultural season, up from 7.3 million m³ in 2025. Access to these supplies is contingent upon agricultural development groups adhering to specific financial criteria set by the Ministry of Agriculture, including a three-part payment structure and a seven-year debt repayment plan. To ensure efficient resource management, a comprehensive maintenance campaign for hydraulic structures—including pumping stations, collection basins, and canals—has been launched to optimize distribution and curb illegal pumping from the Medjerda wadi. This expansion and infrastructure overhaul are critical for supporting summer crops across the region's 12,739 hectares of irrigated land, which have been heavily impacted by water stress.
records.institution: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development

records.title: The National Agricultural Mutual Insurance Fund (CNMA) is developing a new parametric insurance system, the Agricultural Disaster and Cli...
records.description: The National Agricultural Mutual Insurance Fund (CNMA) is developing a new parametric insurance system, the Agricultural Disaster and Climate Insurance (DACA), to mitigate the impact of climate change on Algeria’s agricultural sector. Currently under study by the Ministries of Finance and Agriculture, this mechanism aims to replace the traditional post-disaster public intervention model with an index-based system that uses satellite data, drones, and artificial intelligence to trigger automatic compensation. By focusing on strategic crops like cereals, the program seeks to improve state budgetary visibility, streamline public spending through premium support, and provide faster relief for risks like drought, which are difficult to cover under traditional schemes.
records.institution: The National Agricultural Mutual Insurance Fund (CNMA)

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Forage Crop Seed Multiplication and Processing Program has officially launched its fodder barley harvest ca...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Forage Crop Seed Multiplication and Processing Program has officially launched its fodder barley harvest campaign at sites in the Maysan and Karbala governorates. Technical staff are currently collecting, bagging, and storing seeds according to approved technical standards to support the development of forage crops and enhance overall agricultural production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture's Forage Crop Seed Multiplication and Processing Program

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL) and the Ports and Maritime Transport Authority have signed a memorandum of understanding...
records.description: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL) and the Ports and Maritime Transport Authority have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to transition the Libyan port sector toward clean energy and environmental sustainability. This partnership aligns with Libya’s National Strategy for Renewable Energies and the international MARPOL Convention, focusing on reducing emissions and implementing joint energy efficiency projects. By integrating solar power and other renewable technologies, the initiative aims to transform domestic facilities into "green ports" that attract investment and improve air quality.
records.institution: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL) and the Ports and Maritime Transport Authority

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Morocco is projecting a major recovery for its 2025-2026 cereal campaign, with production expected to reach nearly 90 million quintals.
records.description: Morocco is projecting a major recovery for its 2025-2026 cereal campaign, with production expected to reach nearly 90 million quintals. This significant turnaround, announced at the International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM), follows a challenging 2024-2025 season where yields were halved to 44 million quintals due to persistent drought. The recovery is driven by a 95% year-on-year increase in rainfall, which has raised dam filling levels to approximately 46% and allowed for the cultivation of 3.9 million hectares of wheat and barley. While the Ministry of Agriculture anticipates a 15% increase in agricultural GDP as a result of these favorable conditions, officials maintain that long-term strategic investments in irrigation and climate adaptation remain essential to combat the structural challenges of climate change.

records.title: The Syngenta Innovation Center hosted the "Tomato Excellence Experience" in Aït Amira to align Moroccan tomato production with the evolvi...
records.description: The Syngenta Innovation Center hosted the "Tomato Excellence Experience" in Aït Amira to align Moroccan tomato production with the evolving demands of the European export market. The event combined technical workshops on genetic resistance—specifically against the ToBRFV virus—with sensory evaluations, such as baby plum tomato tastings, to emphasize the commercial importance of taste and quality. Syngenta showcased new varieties like Bonnelle, which provide enhanced resistance and post-harvest stability, while promoting an integrated strategy that connects seed genetics to consumer experience.

records.title: The Tatweer platform has launched 43 new investment opportunities in the North A’Sharqiyah Governorate, specifically affiliated with the...
records.description: The Tatweer platform has launched 43 new investment opportunities in the North A’Sharqiyah Governorate, specifically affiliated with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. These opportunities are designed to provide a gateway for investors and entrepreneurs to develop high-quality agricultural and water-related projects with strong economic feasibility. By opening these channels, the platform aims to stimulate local economic growth and encourage private sector participation in the governorate's development.

records.title: The Bethlehem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture recently concluded specialized field school activities for olive and grape farmers i...
records.description: The Bethlehem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture recently concluded specialized field school activities for olive and grape farmers in the towns of Husan and Battir. Implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) in partnership with the Arab Agricultural Engineers Association, the "Supporting Sustainable Tourism" project provided 45 farmers with hands-on training in integrated pest management and the installation of modern irrigation networks. These efforts are designed to transfer scientific expertise directly to the field, improving crop productivity and water efficiency while linking agricultural preservation to national heritage and economic sustainability.
records.institution: The Bethlehem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Jerusalem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Agricultural Relief Association, distributed 198 tons of ba...
records.description: The Jerusalem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Agricultural Relief Association, distributed 198 tons of barley to 165 livestock breeders across several rural communities. Funded by the Humanitarian Fund for the Occupied Palestinian Territory, this initiative is part of a broader project aimed at strengthening the resilience of farmers in the central and northern West Bank who have been impacted by local violence and economic hardship. The Ministry of Agriculture noted that providing animal feed alleviates financial burdens and helps preserve livestock, which is essential for maintaining rural stability and agricultural production in threatened areas.
records.institution: The Jerusalem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Palestinian Agricultural Lending Institution, Oxfam, and the...
records.description: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Palestinian Agricultural Lending Institution, Oxfam, and the Rural Women's Development Association, completed handover visits for vegetable production projects in Anabta, Deir al-Ghusun, and Allar. Part of the initiative "Increasing the Benefits of Women, Youth, and Small Farmers as Change Agents in the Fresh Vegetable Value Chain," the program provides financial incentives and technical support to entrepreneurial projects managed by youth and women. By focusing on the development of the fresh vegetable value chain and rewarding successful, sustainable agricultural practices, the project aims to improve economic opportunities and livelihoods in rural areas.
records.institution: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Al-Baha Region is leveraging its diverse terrain and fertile soil to strengthen its position as a vital agricultural hub within Saudi...
records.description: The Al-Baha Region is leveraging its diverse terrain and fertile soil to strengthen its position as a vital agricultural hub within Saudi Arabia. The region produces a wide variety of high-demand crops, including grapes, pomegranates, mangoes, and coffee, with its hundreds of thousands of pomegranate trees yielding thousands of tons annually. To support this production and enhance food security, the region has established 19 agricultural cities that focus on economic development, resource preservation, and the cultivation of promising seasonal fruits across both mountainous and coastal sectors.

records.title: The International Affairs Office at the UAE Presidential Court, in partnership with the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and supported by the...
records.description: The International Affairs Office at the UAE Presidential Court, in partnership with the Asian Development Bank (ADB) and supported by the Japan Fund for Prosperous and Resilient Asia and the Pacific (JFPR), has launched a $1.5 million technical cooperation agreement to scale agricultural innovations across eight countries in Asia and the Pacific. Operationalized through the Agricultural Innovation Mechanism for Scale (AIM for Scale)—an initiative backed by the UAE and the Gates Foundation—the partnership focuses on integrating AI-powered weather forecasting, digital advisory services, and livestock productivity tools into national programs. This collaboration, which also involves the Mohamed Bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI) and other global partners, aims to strengthen global food security by reaching farmers in Bangladesh, Indonesia, Nepal, the Philippines, Vietnam, Pakistan, Thailand, and the Maldives.
records.institution: The International Affairs Office at the UAE Presidential Court

records.title: The Joint Supreme Committee for Cooperation between Qatar and the United Arab Emirates concluded its seventh session in Abu Dhabi, markin...
records.description: The Joint Supreme Committee for Cooperation between Qatar and the United Arab Emirates concluded its seventh session in Abu Dhabi, marking a transition toward a more integrated phase of bilateral partnership. Co-chaired by the respective Ministers of Foreign Affairs, the session resulted in the signing of an Investment Promotion and Protection Agreement and several memoranda of understanding focused on agriculture, food security, and municipal cooperation. Key discussions centered on economic diversification through high-quality public-private partnerships, cooperation in future technologies like artificial intelligence and cybersecurity, and the enhancement of logistical connectivity between maritime and air transport hubs. The committee emphasized building resilient supply chains and food security systems to address global challenges, while also coordinating on health, education, and humanitarian efforts.
records.institution: The Joint Supreme Committee for Cooperation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Algeria has set a target to increase aquaculture production to 20,000 tonnes by 2026 to address a signific...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Algeria has set a target to increase aquaculture production to 20,000 tonnes by 2026 to address a significant national fish production shortfall. To support this growth, the government has increased stocking activities to 80 million fry and is expanding marine farm infrastructure while focusing on reducing high operational costs through local feed production. Strategic partnerships and the entry of private firms like AviFish are being bolstered by fiscal measures in the 2026 finance law, including customs duty exemptions and VAT reductions on feed materials. These efforts aim to decrease reliance on wild catch fisheries and imported inputs, ensuring the long-term viability of the domestic fish farming sector.

records.title: Iraq's Council of Ministers has approved a revised procurement strategy and pricing structure for the 2025–2026 agricultural season to st...
records.description: Iraq's Council of Ministers has approved a revised procurement strategy and pricing structure for the 2025–2026 agricultural season to stabilize the national wheat supply. The plan sets purchase prices at IQD 700,000 per tonne for planned crops and high-grade seeds, while providing a secondary rate for quantities produced outside the official plan. To ensure the financial stability of the sector, the Council of Ministers authorized the Trade Bank of Iraq (TBI) and the Ministry of Finance to settle outstanding payments to farmers and established specific production quotas for the Kurdistan Region.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) organized a national consultative workshop in Amman to initiate the est...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) organized a national consultative workshop in Amman to initiate the establishment of the Jordan Forum for Agricultural Extension and Advisory Services (JFAAS). Held in the presence of the Ministry of Agriculture, the workshop aimed to create a coordinated platform linking public institutions, research bodies, and the private sector to address challenges such as water scarcity and climate variability. By aligning with regional and global advisory networks, the forum will focus on digital transformation and data-driven services to support smallholders, women, and youth in improving productivity.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Forestry Directorate, has reported a positive recovery of Jordan’s forests and rangelands follow...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Forestry Directorate, has reported a positive recovery of Jordan’s forests and rangelands following a productive 2025–2026 rainy season, which has helped revive vegetation cover and biodiversity after years of severe drought. While wildflowers like the black iris have reappeared, officials caution that sustained rainfall in future seasons is necessary for a full ecosystem recovery, especially for drought-impacted conifer trees. To combat persistent threats like forest fires and illegal logging, the Ministry of Agriculture has partnered with the technology firm Growtech to implement an AI-powered remote sensing and satellite monitoring system for early fire detection and environmental protection.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP) has issued a tender for techno-economic consultancy services to develop a large-s...
records.description: The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP) has issued a tender for techno-economic consultancy services to develop a large-scale Independent Power Project (IPP) fueled by green hydrogen. This pioneering initiative explores the feasibility of a generation facility with a capacity of 800 to 1,000 megawatts capable of operating on up to 100% hydrogen, marking a shift from Oman's traditional focus on hydrogen exports toward domestic power application. By evaluating hydrogen as a long-duration energy storage medium and a clean fuel for dispatchable power, Nama PWP aims to balance the intermittency of increasing solar and wind capacity while reducing reliance on natural gas in alignment with Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP)

records.title: Baladna and Al Dahra Holding have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) during the Make it in the Emirates 2026 forum to establish a...
records.description: Baladna and Al Dahra Holding have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) during the Make it in the Emirates 2026 forum to establish a strategic partnership focused on global farming and animal feed supply. Under this agreement, Al Dahra will serve as a strategic supplier of grains and feed commodities, supporting Baladna’s international dairy expansion and ensuring high-quality feed security for its operations in several markets, including Syria. The collaboration aims to develop integrated farming platforms and scalable agricultural systems to enhance productivity and long-term food security.

records.title: Fruit cultivation in the Najran Region has become a primary driver of agricultural diversity and food security, leveraging the area's fer...
records.description: Fruit cultivation in the Najran Region has become a primary driver of agricultural diversity and food security, leveraging the area's fertile soil and moderate climate to establish red guava as a high-value investment crop. According to the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the region now hosts approximately 7,000 productive red guava trees, marking a qualitative transformation in local output supported by technical guidance for farmers. This expansion aligns with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 by promoting self-sufficiency and creating new employment opportunities within the agricultural and processing sectors.
