By focusing on high-quality nutritional crops with strong economic viability, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture aims to solidify Najran's position as a strategic agricultural hub.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Halal Products Development Company (HPDC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and the multi-protein producer MBRF have...
records.description: The Halal Products Development Company (HPDC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and the multi-protein producer MBRF have completed the financial closing of the SAR 8 billion (US$2.07 billion) Sadia Halal transaction. This strategic deal integrates production plants, logistics hubs, and distribution networks across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, and Oman to create a large-scale regional halal food platform. Under the agreement, HPDC has increased its stake to 20%, with the potential to reach 40%, as the company prepares for an initial public offering on the Tadawul stock exchange. The partnership aims to strengthen regional food supply chains and enhance Saudi Arabia's role in the global halal market through expanded industrial capabilities.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has completed the rehabilitation of the central fish, vegetable, and fruit...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has completed the rehabilitation of the central fish, vegetable, and fruit market in Al-Mukalla, Hadhramaut, as part of a sustainable agriculture and fisheries empowerment project. The renovation included upgrading 22 fish outlets and 17 vegetable and fruit stalls, along with modernizing water, sewage, and electrical systems to provide advanced infrastructure for local producers. By developing value chains and improving market access, the initiative aims to enhance local resilience, support the livelihoods of fishermen and farmers, and ensure the delivery of high-quality products to consumers.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture led a high-level delegation to the 5th Istanbul International Water Forum to advocate...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture led a high-level delegation to the 5th Istanbul International Water Forum to advocate for a global shift in treating water as a strategic economic link between climate, food, health, and ecosystems. During the forum, officials emphasized the necessity of international cooperation, governance, and innovation to build global water resilience and address growing scarcity challenges. In partnership with the World Water Council, the delegation also reviewed preparatory progress for the upcoming World Water Forum, which the Kingdom is scheduled to host in Riyadh in 2027.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has reached a 50% completion milestone for the Rayyis Fish Auction an...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has reached a 50% completion milestone for the Rayyis Fish Auction and Boat Maintenance Center on the Red Sea coast. This strategic project is designed to boost the local economy by improving the marketing lifespan of seafood and providing an advanced auction hall and ice production facilities for approximately 150 boats monthly. Additionally, the initiative includes a technical maintenance center capable of servicing up to 25 boats per month using modern diagnostic technologies to reduce downtime for local fishermen. By focusing on professional packaging and the localization of technical skills, the program aims to enhance the competitiveness of Rayyis fish in both local and international markets.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Data presented to the National Council of Regions and Districts (CNRD) highlights a strategic push for renewable energy concession agreem...
records.description: Data presented to the National Council of Regions and Districts (CNRD) highlights a strategic push for renewable energy concession agreements in response to Tunisia's widening energy deficit. Official figures indicate that national primary energy resources fell to 3.4 million tonnes of oil equivalent (TOE) by 2025, while high consumption levels created a deficit representing 65% of national needs and a trade balance gap exceeding 11 billion dinars. To alleviate pressure on public finances and reduce dependence on costly natural gas, the Ministry of Economy and Planning and the Secretary of State for Energy Transition are prioritizing private investment in photovoltaic power plants. This transition to solar energy is framed as a strategic necessity to lower production costs, improve financial stability, and ensure long-term energy security.
records.institution: The National Council of Regions and Districts (CNRD)

records.title: The Ministry of Health in Tunisia, supported by findings from the World Health Organization and the Food and Agriculture Organization of...
records.description: The Ministry of Health in Tunisia, supported by findings from the World Health Organization and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations, has verified that approximately 3,500 cases of tuberculosis are recorded annually, with nearly 1,400 linked to the consumption of unpasteurized milk. While the disease is primarily transmitted through the air, bovine tuberculosis poses a significant risk to humans via contaminated raw dairy products, leading to symptoms such as persistent cough, fatigue, and weight loss. Health officials emphasize that pasteurization effectively eliminates the bacteria and underscore the importance of early detection and herd monitoring to control this public health risk.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Expo City Dubai Foundation has awarded funding to seven global projects under its Global Innovators Programme, specifically targeting...
records.description: The Expo City Dubai Foundation has awarded funding to seven global projects under its Global Innovators Programme, specifically targeting extreme heat challenges in the Global South. Selected from over 1,000 applications, these initiatives from Egypt, Morocco, Peru, India, and Nigeria will each receive up to $100,000 to implement sustainable solutions in sectors such as agriculture, construction, and waste management. Notable projects include Ecodome Maroc (Morocco), which uses traditional building methods for heat-resistant bricks, and Visenleer (Egypt), which produces cooling textiles from ocean waste. By providing technical support and access to global networks, the foundation aims to scale these climate-resilient innovations, which have already reached over six million people worldwide since the program's inception.

records.title: The General Authority for Supply Commodities, an affiliate of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade, is reportedly seeking up to $1.4...
records.description: The General Authority for Supply Commodities, an affiliate of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade, is reportedly seeking up to $1.4 billion in financing from a consortium of Gulf lenders and the Islamic Development Bank to secure essential food imports like wheat and corn. This funding effort, which includes potential loans from First Abu Dhabi Bank, Emirates NBD, and the Arab Banking Corporation, aims to bolster national reserves that currently cover six months of consumption. The move is necessitated by global agricultural prices reaching a two-year high due to fertilizer shortages and lower crop yields.
records.institution: The General Authority for Supply Commodities

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has announced a strategic goal to achieve wheat self-sufficiency for Egypt's national su...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has announced a strategic goal to achieve wheat self-sufficiency for Egypt's national subsidized bread program by 2028. While the government requires approximately 8.6 million metric tons of wheat annually to sustain the scheme, the current procurement strategy involves offering competitive prices to local farmers to stimulate production, with a target of purchasing 5 million tons of domestic wheat this season. Although current procurement levels are 17% higher than the previous year, they remain slightly below 2024 figures, reflecting the ongoing challenge of scaling local harvests to meet the revised 2028 timeline.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) signed an EGP 5 billion agreement with Alpha Smart to develop a 500,000-square-meter factory comple...
records.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) signed an EGP 5 billion agreement with Alpha Smart to develop a 500,000-square-meter factory complex in Sokhna, targeting sectors such as packaging, electronics, e-commerce logistics, and agro-processing. Designed to accelerate industrial growth, the project features a "plug-and-play" model with factory units ready for operation within 90 days, supported by an integrated logistics zone and a global distribution center. By leveraging its proximity to major trade routes, the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) aims to create 12,000 direct and indirect jobs while strengthening supply chain resilience and boosting Egypt's manufacturing exports.

records.title: The Council of Ministers, chaired by the Prime Minister, has approved a comprehensive support package for the agricultural sector to stim...
records.description: The Council of Ministers, chaired by the Prime Minister, has approved a comprehensive support package for the agricultural sector to stimulate local production and ensure food security for the 2025-2026 season. Under the guidance of the Ministry of Agriculture, the government established a dual-pricing structure for wheat, set at 700,000 dinars per ton for planned crops and 500,000 dinars for unplanned quantities, while also authorizing the purchase of 100,000 tons of high-grade seeds. To alleviate financial burdens on producers, the Council of Ministers directed the settlement of outstanding dues through the upcoming general budget and postponed the collection of land rents and irrigation fees.

records.title: The Livestock Breeders Association has predicted that prices for sacrificial animals this year will remain consistent with the previous h...
records.description: The Livestock Breeders Association has predicted that prices for sacrificial animals this year will remain consistent with the previous holiday season, ranging between 220 and 300 JOD for local and Romanian varieties. Despite a "good" supply of sheep and goats from various regional sources, the Ministry of Agriculture anticipates lower demand due to weakened consumer purchasing power. To stabilize the market and reduce local meat prices, the Ministry of Agriculture has authorized the importation of live animals and chilled meat from Syria and Egypt while continuing to monitor supply chain readiness.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized an educational seminar titled "Care of Pine Trees" in Btekhne as part of the National Agricultural...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized an educational seminar titled "Care of Pine Trees" in Btekhne as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program to address forest health and pest management. In cooperation with the Municipality of Btekhne and the Syndicate of Pine Tree Growers in Lebanon, experts discussed the impact of climate change on pest spread and demonstrated modern control methods, including pheromone traps and the use of drones for precise chemical application. The Ministry of Agriculture aims to support productive farmers and protect Lebanon's forest resources by promoting sustainable practices and proper disposal techniques for infested trees.

records.title: Morocco has achieved a significant breakthrough in the European frozen fruit market, with raspberry exports to the Netherlands reaching 1...
records.description: Morocco has achieved a significant breakthrough in the European frozen fruit market, with raspberry exports to the Netherlands reaching 1,000 tonnes in 2025, a 50% increase from the previous year. This performance, highlighted by EastFruit, positions Morocco among the top five suppliers to the Dutch logistics hub, capturing a 7.4% market share through increased investments in freezing and sorting infrastructure. By adhering to international quality standards like GlobalG.AP and BRC, the Moroccan soft fruit sector is successfully transitioning from fresh produce to high-value-added processed goods to build resilience against market fluctuations.

records.title: The cultivation of dragon fruit, or pitaya, is gaining traction in the El Jadida region as farmers seek alternative crops better suited t...
records.description: The cultivation of dragon fruit, or pitaya, is gaining traction in the El Jadida region as farmers seek alternative crops better suited to local water scarcity and soil salinity. In the municipality of Tnin Chtouka, an experimental nursery is evaluating the tropical species for its drought tolerance, low maintenance costs, and rapid production cycle, with plants reaching full potential within three growing seasons. According to the Ministry of Agriculture and regional observers, the crop's easy propagation and high international market value offer a strategic opportunity for medium-sized farms to diversify income and strengthen resilience against climate challenges.

records.title: The World Agriculture Forum (WAF) officially launched its Moroccan council in Meknes through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding...
records.description: The World Agriculture Forum (WAF) officially launched its Moroccan council in Meknes through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding aimed at fostering strategic cooperation on national and international agricultural challenges. This new branch serves as a structured platform to connect a diverse range of stakeholders—including public decision-makers, agribusiness operators, and researchers—to accelerate the transition toward more resilient and sustainable food systems. By aligning national priorities with global trends, WAF Morocco intends to reinforce the country’s strategic role in shaping agricultural development across Africa and the Mediterranean while contributing to global food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Japan Internat...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), launched a $3 million development project aimed at revitalizing 19 irrigated schemes in River Nile State. This two-year initiative focuses on the rehabilitation of irrigation systems, the provision of seeds for essential crops like sorghum and fava beans, and the enhancement of certified seed production to improve local productivity. By training technical personnel and coordinating with the Hudeiba Research Station, the project seeks to modernize water-use efficiency and support farmers' livelihoods to strengthen food security in the region.

records.title: The Tunisian Consumer Guidance Organization (OTOC) has reported a significant surge in sheep prices for Eid al-Adha, with costs ranging f...
records.description: The Tunisian Consumer Guidance Organization (OTOC) has reported a significant surge in sheep prices for Eid al-Adha, with costs ranging from 800 to over 1,500 dinars due to intermediaries indexing prices to the rising cost of red meat. The organization has criticized the Ministry of Agriculture for a structural crisis in the sector and is calling for urgent reforms, including a national livestock census, the regulation of female slaughtering to preserve herds, and the implementation of a price regulation system. To enhance transparency and combat rising feed costs, the Tunisian Consumer Guidance Organization (OTOC) proposes using AI-powered applications to track production capacity and clarify the true costs of red meat from producer to retailer.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Emirates Water and Electricity Company (EWEC) has signed a strategic Collaboration Framework Agreement with Masdar to accelerate the...
records.description: The Emirates Water and Electricity Company (EWEC) has signed a strategic Collaboration Framework Agreement with Masdar to accelerate the deployment of utility-scale renewable energy projects across the UAE. This roadmap aims to diversify the national energy mix and secure 60% of Abu Dhabi’s total energy demand from renewable and clean sources by 2035, specifically targeting over 30GW of solar PV capacity and 8GW of battery energy storage. By streamlining project development from early stages to financial close, the partnership seeks to enhance supply security, support local industrial growth, and foster Emirati talent in line with the UAE Net Zero by 2050 Strategic Initiative.
records.institution: The Emirates Water and Electricity Company (EWEC)

records.title: The Russia-UAE Business Council (RUBC) and the UAE Food Cluster signed a strategic cooperation agreement during the "Make it in the Emira...
records.description: The Russia-UAE Business Council (RUBC) and the UAE Food Cluster signed a strategic cooperation agreement during the "Make it in the Emirates" forum to enhance bilateral trade and industrial localization within the food sector. The partnership focuses on four priority areas: joint project development, mutual market access, the establishment of resilient logistics corridors, and the creation of agro-industrial localization programs. This agreement aligns with the UAE's National Programme to Strengthen Supply Chain Resilience and leverages the complementary nature of the two economies to secure supplies of food and industrial goods while exploring joint opportunities in third-country markets.

records.title: The Sharjah Agricultural and Livestock Production Establishment (EKTIFA), operating under the Sharjah Department of Agriculture and Lives...
records.description: The Sharjah Agricultural and Livestock Production Establishment (EKTIFA), operating under the Sharjah Department of Agriculture and Livestock, signed a memorandum of understanding with Al Dahra during the "Make it in the Emirates" 2026 forum to enhance the sustainability and efficiency of local food production. The agreement focuses on building robust agricultural value chains, developing specialized animal feed solutions, and establishing flexible supply arrangements to support major projects like Mleiha Farm. By leveraging the global expertise of Al Dahra, EKTIFA aims to integrate leading agricultural institutions to drive higher-quality output and ensure the responsible stewardship of natural resources in line with national food security goals.
records.institution: The Sharjah Agricultural and Livestock Production Establishment (EKTIFA)

records.title: The Silal Group launched an advanced AI-powered sustainability platform named "Zero," developed by Olive Gaea, during the "Make it in the...
records.description: The Silal Group launched an advanced AI-powered sustainability platform named "Zero," developed by Olive Gaea, during the "Make it in the Emirates" 2026 forum. This platform utilizes machine learning and real-time intelligence to automate carbon tracking, ESG data collection, and sustainability reporting across all of the group's subsidiaries. By aligning with the UAE's Net Zero 2050 Strategy, the Silal Group aims to enhance investor transparency, bolster internal governance, and support the national food security agenda through data-driven environmental stewardship.

records.domain: Sanitary, phytosanitary and technical standards improvements
records.title: Egypt has successfully resumed poultry exports to Qatar for the first time in nearly 20 years, signaling a major recovery for a sector lo...
records.description: Egypt has successfully resumed poultry exports to Qatar for the first time in nearly 20 years, signaling a major recovery for a sector long restricted by avian influenza outbreaks. The initial shipment of 300 tonnes (distributed across ten containers) was made possible by the implementation of rigorous biosecurity protocols and modernized farm practices that align with international health standards. With domestic production now exceeding local demand, authorities are leveraging this surplus to stabilize farmgate prices and generate foreign exchange. Beyond Qatar, Egypt is currently in negotiations to enter the Kuwaiti market and plans to diversify its exports to include processed poultry meats and table eggs, all while maintaining a local reserve of 1,000 tonnes of frozen poultry to ensure domestic market stability.

records.title: Representatives from the Jordan Chamber of Commerce (JCC) and Egypt’s Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade held high-level discussion...
records.description: Representatives from the Jordan Chamber of Commerce (JCC) and Egypt’s Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade held high-level discussions in Cairo to enhance bilateral investment, trade, and private-sector partnerships. The meeting focused on deeper economic integration in logistics, agriculture, and services, highlighting Jordan’s role as a stable regional hub despite broader regional challenges. Trade figures reaching approximately JD812 million in the previous year underscored the potential for expanding Jordanian exports of fertilizers and chemicals alongside Egyptian exports of construction materials and food products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a technical seminar in Mukhtara, in coordination with the Union of Municipalities of Upper Chouf an...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a technical seminar in Mukhtara, in coordination with the Union of Municipalities of Upper Chouf and the Chouf Cedar Reserve, to educate farmers on the rational and safe use of agricultural pesticides. The session provided approximately 55 participants with essential guidance on pesticide toxicity, safety periods, proper storage, and the environmental impact of chemical use, while warning against the dangers of prohibited or smuggled substances. By focusing on scientific practices and the Mediterranean fruit fly control, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to balance crop protection with public health and environmental preservation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman organized the Veterinary Medicine Forum 2026 in Muscat to strengthen t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman organized the Veterinary Medicine Forum 2026 in Muscat to strengthen the role of veterinarians in safeguarding public health and food safety. The forum brought together specialists and representatives from the World Organization for Animal Health (WOAH) to discuss international health standards, disease prevention, and the enhancement of technical competencies within the livestock sector. By fostering partnerships between the public and private sectors, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources aims to support sustainable agricultural development and modernize veterinary services to mitigate global health risks.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Jericho and Jordan Valley Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations...
records.description: The Jericho and Jordan Valley Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), signed an investment support agreement valued at 126,488 NIS with the "Palestinian Chef's Kitchen and Products" facility to develop a food processing project. Implemented as part of the MAP II program with financial backing from the European Union and several European governments, the initiative focuses on empowering small and medium-sized enterprises by increasing production capacity, improving product quality, and enhancing market competitiveness. Through the Ministry of Agriculture, this intervention seeks to strengthen food value chains and promote innovation to support the economic resilience of local producers.
records.institution: The Jericho and Jordan Valley Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, supported by the National Security Forces, distributed 430 olive trees to ten farming families in villages n...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, supported by the National Security Forces, distributed 430 olive trees to ten farming families in villages northeast of Ramallah, including Turmus Ayya and Budrus, as part of an emergency response program. This initiative, facilitated by the Ramallah and Al-Bireh Directorate of Agriculture, focuses on rehabilitating damaged agricultural lands and strengthening the resilience of local producers following targeted attacks on their properties. By activating rapid response mechanisms through the Response Fund, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to protect natural resources and ensure the continuity of agricultural production in high-risk areas.

records.title: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has launched an awareness campaign designed to reposition the value of water...
records.description: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has launched an awareness campaign designed to reposition the value of water as a fundamental driver of urban, industrial, and agricultural progress. By linking conservation directly to economic expansion and food security, the National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) aims to shift community perception from simple daily usage to a broader strategic development scope. The initiative underscores that improving water-use efficiency is essential for supporting the national economy, ensuring sustainable development, and enhancing overall quality of life.
records.institution: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE)

records.title: Syria’s wheat production is projected to reach approximately 2.3 million tonnes this season, signaling a steady recovery for the national...
records.description: Syria’s wheat production is projected to reach approximately 2.3 million tonnes this season, signaling a steady recovery for the national agricultural sector driven by favorable rainfall and expanded farmer support. According to the Ministry of Agriculture, the implementation of 86 percent of the planned cultivation program resulted in 1.2 million hectares of planted land, split between irrigated and rain-fed systems. While some localized flooding occurred, the overall increase in output is attributed to improved crop performance and higher yields across key regions.

records.title: The expanded executive bureau of the Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Maritime Fisheries (UTAP) has issued an urgent appeal to address t...
records.description: The expanded executive bureau of the Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Maritime Fisheries (UTAP) has issued an urgent appeal to address the deteriorating working conditions and shattered financial stability within the primary and fisheries sectors. In response to soaring production costs and a critical shortage of nitrogen fertilizers, the union is demanding an immediate increase in farmgate prices for cereals and greater flexibility in the cereal grading scale to prevent penalizing farmers for climate-affected crop quality. Beyond economic reforms, the Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Maritime Fisheries (UTAP) is calling for an emergency harvest plan, intensified security measures to combat cattle rustling and summer fires, and a comprehensive social protection framework for fishermen.
records.institution: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Maritime Fisheries (UTAP)

records.title: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development in Medenine has estimated the volume of livestock available for sacrifice at 35,000...
records.description: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development in Medenine has estimated the volume of livestock available for sacrifice at 35,000 head, ensuring a stable supply that avoids the shortages seen in previous years. To manage the upcoming holiday period, the Regional Commission for Agricultural Development is conducting ongoing inspections of fattening units and tightening controls on unregulated slaughter, particularly to protect breeding females. While market prices have risen compared to the previous year—ranging typically between 800 and 1,200 dinars—officials clarified that they remain below the exorbitant levels reported on social media.
records.institution: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Tahya Misr Holding Company for Investment and Development, in coordination with the ministries of electricity and finance, has signed...
records.description: The Tahya Misr Holding Company for Investment and Development, in coordination with the ministries of electricity and finance, has signed a protocol to finance and execute a massive renewable energy expansion involving 4,750MW of wind power projects across the Suez Gulf, Ras Shukeir, Galala, and Zafarana. The agreement also incorporates 4,000MWh of battery energy storage systems (BESS) in South Cairo, Damanhour, and Wadi El Natrun to stabilize the national grid and support the government's target of a 45% renewable energy share by 2028. By pricing the produced energy in Egyptian pounds and utilizing private sector participation, the initiative aims to transition the country toward green energy while ensuring grid reliability during peak hours.
records.institution: The Tahya Misr Holding Company for Investment and Development

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has clarified that current egg supplies are sufficient to meet market demand, attributing recent price hikes...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has clarified that current egg supplies are sufficient to meet market demand, attributing recent price hikes to artificial inflation and speculative trading rather than a production shortage. To stabilize the market and counter rumors of scarcity, the Ministry of Agriculture has supported field initiatives that offer eggs at subsidized prices directly to the public. Monitoring teams are currently coordinating with relevant authorities to prevent monopolies and exploitation, ensuring that local production remains stable and secure. The Ministry of Agriculture urges citizens to avoid panic buying, reaffirming that the essential commodity is fully available and that market balance is being restored.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Research, has initiated a genetic improvement and propagation project...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Research, has initiated a genetic improvement and propagation project for local chicken breeds in Iraq to enhance production efficiency and self-sufficiency. Utilizing modern scientific selection programs at the Poultry Research Station, the project focuses on boosting productivity while preserving the genetic diversity of authentic local breeds. By introducing thousands of hatching eggs from local hybrids and improved brown strains, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to provide breeders with resilient poultry capable of thriving in harsh local climates, ultimately supporting national food security and economic stability.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has released over 9 million newly hatched carp into Lake Habbani...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has released over 9 million newly hatched carp into Lake Habbaniyah in the Anbar Governorate to bolster national fish stocks. Produced via artificial breeding programs at the Al-Suwaira hatchery, the initiative was supervised by technical teams to ensure optimal growth and ecological balance within the water body. By enhancing natural fish populations, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to strengthen food security, support local ecosystems, and provide a sustainable source of protein to meet the needs of the population.

records.title: The Hebron Governorate Agriculture Directorate, through its Technical Department, has initiated the annual collection and planting of nat...
records.description: The Hebron Governorate Agriculture Directorate, through its Technical Department, has initiated the annual collection and planting of native forest seeds at the Wadi al-Qaf government nurseries. This specialized operation involves the selection, sorting, and technical preparation of local species adapted to the regional climate to ensure high germination rates and superior seedling quality. By monitoring the early-stage irrigation and care of these plants, the Ministry of Agriculture is securing the biological foundation needed to rehabilitate degraded lands and combat environmental encroachment. This program serves as a critical supply line for upcoming afforestation campaigns, aiming to expand green spaces and strengthen biodiversity across the Hebron Governorate in partnership with local stakeholders.

records.title: The North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Social Development, has dis...
records.description: The North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Social Development, has distributed 15,750 vegetable seedlings and a variety of agricultural seeds to 21 families in the town of Halhul. Part of a broader food security project funded by the Creek Foundation and implemented by the Land Research Center, the initiative provided each beneficiary with approximately 750 seedlings and seeds for essential crops like tomatoes, peppers, thyme, and okra. Designed to support home gardens of roughly 0.5 dunams, this program focuses on empowering rural women and enhancing family resilience. By providing the basic requirements for home farming, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to bolster the local economy, improve nutrition, and achieve sustainable agricultural development in rural areas of the southern West Bank.

records.title: The aquaculture sector in the Qassim Region is undergoing a transformative expansion, serving as a key pillar of Saudi Vision 2030 to enh...
records.description: The aquaculture sector in the Qassim Region is undergoing a transformative expansion, serving as a key pillar of Saudi Vision 2030 to enhance national food security. Despite the region's arid climate, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has successfully integrated high-tech solutions like Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) and Aquaponics to maximize water efficiency. Primarily focusing on Tilapia and Catfish, these projects provide a sustainable source of local protein while diversifying rural incomes. According to the Qassim branch of MEWA, the sector is now shifting toward strengthening private sector partnerships and developing robust supply chains to meet both domestic demand and future export targets, positioning the Kingdom as a rising leader in desert-based aquaculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has mobilized unprecedented resources for the 2026 harvest season to strengt...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has mobilized unprecedented resources for the 2026 harvest season to strengthen national production and achieve cereal self-sufficiency. In alignment with presidential directives, the initiative includes the creation of the agricultural mechanization company "Agrodrive" and the deployment of over 1,100 combine harvesters and 1,200 transport trucks across the country. To ensure efficient handling of the yields, 307 local storage centers have been provided, alongside the specialized training of more than 900 harvester drivers in coordination with the vocational training sector. Through these logistical and human resource enhancements, the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries aims to minimize harvest losses and optimize the strategic supply chain to bolster national food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has achieved substantial progress on critical infrastructure and development p...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has achieved substantial progress on critical infrastructure and development projects across the Musandam Governorate to enhance food security and economic growth. Significant milestones include the near-completion of fish markets in Khasab, Ghamdha, and Al-Jari, along with a strategic OMR 39.8 million expansion of the Dibba fishing port. The initiative also encompasses environmental and resource management efforts, such as marine habitat rehabilitation, national pest management programs, and the construction of dams and protection walls. By integrating advanced aquaculture technologies, promoting oyster and finfish farming, and expanding private sector participation in the fisheries sector, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is fostering a sustainable blue economy that creates jobs and bolsters the resilience of local artisanal fishing communities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation, through the Oman Animal and Plant Genetic Resources Center (Mawrid), is spearh...
records.description: The Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation, through the Oman Animal and Plant Genetic Resources Center (Mawrid), is spearheading an advanced national framework to collect, preserve, and study the Sultanate’s diverse biological resources. This initiative includes the documentation of thousands of terrestrial, marine, and microbial samples, ranging from purebred Arabian horse semen and endangered wild animal DNA to strategic crops like wheat and medicinal plants. To enhance research efficiency, the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation has introduced a mobile research laboratory and a digital data platform, both of which serve as the foundation for a future national gene bank. By collaborating with local universities and international partners, the ministry aims to leverage Oman’s unique biodiversity—including globally significant species like the Arabian leopard and frankincense tree—to drive innovation in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and the bioeconomy while ensuring long-term environmental sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, in collaboration with several government entities including the Ministry of Education...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, in collaboration with several government entities including the Ministry of Education, is set to launch Saudi Environment Week 2026 under the theme “Green Impact.” This nationwide initiative features programs across all 13 administrative regions, aiming to engage over nine million students and the general public in environmental conservation and the celebration of biodiversity. Aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, the week includes a national environmental exhibition showcasing technological innovations and successful protection strategies, alongside an interactive platform designed to foster partnerships between the public, private, and non-profit sectors. By raising community awareness and encouraging active participation in field activities, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture seeks to generate a lasting sustainable impact and secure natural resources for future generations.

records.description: The National Development Agency (NDA) has signed a contract in Benghazi for the "National Food Sovereignty Project – 1,000 Centre Pivot Irrigation Circuits" to promote sustainable food sufficiency. This strategic initiative, launched in collaboration with international partners such as Farm Tech, Valley, and New Holland, aims to establish modern irrigation systems across expansive agricultural areas to improve water efficiency and boost domestic production. By integrating advanced technologies and international expertise, the National Development Agency (NDA) seeks to enhance national food security and drive sustainable development through high-impact infrastructure projects.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) has announced a comprehensive development initiative in Sennar State designed to empower yout...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) has announced a comprehensive development initiative in Sennar State designed to empower youth associations through productive, income-generating projects. In coordination with local livestock authorities, the organization is establishing business incubators across the horticulture, livestock, and fisheries sectors to foster sustainable livelihoods. Key technical components of the rollout include the distribution of large-scale agricultural equipment and the allocation of 40 solar-powered irrigation pumps to farms across three localities. Additionally, 20 production-enhancing machines will be provided to various departmental units to increase overall output. To ensure long-term community resilience, the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) is also forming cooperative societies focused on poverty alleviation, all of which will operate under the technical and administrative supervision of relevant regional departments.

records.title: Human Appeal, in cooperation with the Idlib Directorate of Agriculture, has distributed fig saplings to residents in the southern Idlib c...
records.description: Human Appeal, in cooperation with the Idlib Directorate of Agriculture, has distributed fig saplings to residents in the southern Idlib countryside to restore vegetation cover lost to deforestation and fire. This initiative focuses on compensating farmers for previous crop losses while enhancing local livelihoods and increasing overall agricultural production. By providing these resources, Human Appeal and the Idlib Directorate of Agriculture aim to strengthen food security and empower the community to resume vital agricultural activities in the region.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has launched a national preventive strategy to protect forests and agricultura...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has launched a national preventive strategy to protect forests and agricultural crops from fires ahead of the 2026 summer season. This operational system, coordinated across the entire territory, includes the installation of firebreaks, the clearing of agricultural tracks for intervention access, and the rehabilitation of surveillance posts for early warning. In addition to logistical reinforcements such as vehicle maintenance and harvesting machinery inspections, the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries is implementing an awareness program for farmers and residents to prevent risky behavior. These measures are designed to preserve forest cover and secure national agricultural production against the increased threat of fire posed by rising temperatures.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, organized a specialized workshop focused on integrating electronic paym...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, organized a specialized workshop focused on integrating electronic payment systems to advance digital transformation and institutional performance. Held in collaboration with Switch, the session explored mechanisms for transitioning to modern electronic systems, such as Point of Sale (POS) services and financial transaction tracking, to simplify procedures and increase administrative transparency. By adopting these technological solutions, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to enhance the efficiency of financial transfers and modernize its administrative framework to keep pace with rapid digital developments.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment has announced plans to regulate the use of Bisphenol A (BPA) in food packaging and drinking water containers...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment has announced plans to regulate the use of Bisphenol A (BPA) in food packaging and drinking water containers to address potential health risks. Citing international studies that link the chemical to endocrine disruption and developmental issues in children, the Ministry of Environment is working to establish safe exposure limits and incorporate them into national standard specifications. While BPA is commonly used to enhance the durability and transparency of plastics, the initiative seeks to prevent chemical leaching into food and water, particularly when containers are heated or damaged. By developing these new regulatory frameworks, the Ministry of Environment aims to ensure that food-contact materials serve as protective barriers rather than sources of contamination for the public.

records.title: At the 18th International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM 2026), the National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) and the Internati...
records.description: At the 18th International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM 2026), the National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) and the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA) signed a strategic letter of understanding to launch Phase V of the Moroccan Collaborative Research Programme (MCGP-V). Spanning 2026–2030, this initiative aligns with Morocco’s Generation Green 2020–2030 strategy to address climate variability, water scarcity, and soil degradation. Building on decades of cooperation, the new phase focuses on accelerating genetic innovation for climate-resilient crops, scaling up conservation agriculture, and developing desert farming and agroforestry. By bridging the gap between scientific research and field implementation, INRA and ICARDA aim to enhance the productivity and sustainability of rainfed and mixed production systems while strengthening the technical capacity of researchers and farmers alike.

records.description: The World Bank has approved $500 million in financing for Morocco, marking the first tranche of a comprehensive program to bolster employment and accelerate the transition to green growth. While macroeconomic in nature, this funding is strategically aligned with the modernization of the Moroccan agricultural and agri-food sectors. By targeting professional integration for youth and women, the program aims to address the technical labor gap in precision agriculture and water management. Furthermore, by improving financing mechanisms for SMEs, the initiative seeks to upgrade agri-food value chains and enhance export competitiveness. A core pillar of the funding is the promotion of a green economy, which directly supports the integration of renewable energy—specifically solar power—to reduce irrigation costs and build climate resilience across the nation’s farms.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Nablus Governorate Directorate and in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Nablus Governorate Directorate and in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed an agreement to develop a packing house in Al-Nasariya. Part of the Multi-Donor Agricultural Business Program – Phase II (MAP II), the project is valued at approximately 470,907 NIS and focuses on improving post-harvest processes and product quality. This initiative aims to enhance the market competitiveness of local goods while supporting agricultural value chains and increasing the income of farming families. By investing in essential infrastructure for packaging and marketing, the Ministry of Agriculture continues to bolster the resilience of farmers and promote sustainable, market-oriented growth across the West Bank.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Northern Jordan Valley Department in Tubas, partnered with the United Nations Development Progra...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Northern Jordan Valley Department in Tubas, partnered with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to conduct a specialized three-day workshop on silage production and feed mix preparation. Targeting 40 sheep farmers in the Bardala area, the training was funded by the IBSA Fund (India, Brazil, and South Africa) as part of the "My Initiative" project to empower marginalized communities. The program provided farmers with practical skills in formulating locally sourced feed alternatives to reduce high operating costs and ensure the sustainability of livestock production under difficult economic conditions. By transforming these field challenges into opportunities for economic self-sufficiency, the Ministry of Agriculture and its international partners aim to strengthen the resilience of vulnerable breeders and protect their livelihoods in the Northern Jordan Valley.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Salfit Governorate Directorate and in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Salfit Governorate Directorate and in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed two agreements totaling 455,089 NIS to support agricultural investments in Salfit and Farkha. These projects, part of the Multi-Donor Agricultural Business Program – Phase II (MAP II), aim to strengthen agricultural value chains, enhance the quality of local products, and improve the incomes of farming families. To date, the Salfit Governorate has benefited from 21 projects under this initiative, which focuses on promoting market-oriented innovations and sustainable food systems. By directing these investments toward production and competitiveness, the Ministry of Agriculture and its international partners continue to bolster the resilience of local farmers and support the long-term development of the agri-food sector in the West Bank.

records.title: The National Center for Research and Development for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) represented the national delegation at the Shang...
records.description: The National Center for Research and Development for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) represented the national delegation at the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) in China to discuss the integration of modern technologies in addressing regional agricultural challenges. The center focused on enhancing natural resource efficiency, adopting innovative technological solutions, and developing sustainable practices to improve production efficiency and food security. By engaging with international scientific entities, the National Center for Research and Development for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) emphasized the value of global knowledge exchange and the adoption of successful international models in advanced agriculture. This participation highlights a strategic effort to foster international cooperation and utilize cutting-edge technology to support long-term agricultural development and sustainability.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially closed the coastal shrimp fishing season in the Red Sea within...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially closed the coastal shrimp fishing season in the Red Sea within territorial waters, effective as of end of April , 2026. This regulatory decision, based on recommendations from the Marine Science and Aquatic Life Research Authority and the Tihama Coast Association, aims to preserve fishery resources and allow for the natural reproduction of aquatic life. As part of the closure, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has mandated an inventory of all stored shrimp stocks and directed the Coast Guard and the General Authority for Fisheries to intensify maritime monitoring. Violators of this decision will face legal penalties under the Law Regulating the Fishing, Exploitation, and Protection of Aquatic Life, ensuring the long-term sustainability of the marine ecosystem.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has launched a strategic action plan for 2026 to accelerate the growth of ma...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has launched a strategic action plan for 2026 to accelerate the growth of marine aquaculture by localizing the production of critical inputs and feed. According to the Director General of Fisheries and Aquaculture, the program focuses on reducing import dependency through the relaunch of specialized units, such as the fish and shrimp feed factory in Ouargla (in collaboration with South Korea) and private sector initiatives like the AviFish unit in Bouira. With a national goal to double marine aquaculture production in 2026, the sector is also negotiating a fry production partnership with a Chinese investor and expanding operational capacity across its 28 active marine farms. To ensure sustainable growth, the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries is currently streamlining maritime concessions to favor active investors and developing new interest-free financing mechanisms to support fishermen and aquaculture entrepreneurs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has outlined a strategic shift toward a modern, science-based production sys...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has outlined a strategic shift toward a modern, science-based production system to reduce the high cost of local red and white meat. During the 60th anniversary of the National Institute of Agronomic Research of Algeria (INRAA), officials emphasized that bridging the price gap between local and imported products requires developing high-yield local breeds and optimizing livestock feed through innovative research. The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries, in coordination with the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research, is also launching a national soil analysis operation to rationalize fertilizer use and is prioritizing the completion of a strategic gene bank to preserve national genetic resources. To support these goals, new cooperation agreements were signed between INRAA, the National Chamber of Agriculture (CNA), and the Scientific and Technical Research Center for Physico-Chemical Analyses (CRAPC) to enhance value chains and provide technical guidance to farmers.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, has launched a field release program utilizing biological parasites...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, has launched a field release program utilizing biological parasites to combat the Red Palm Pest in palm orchards. This initiative focuses on the release of Trichogramma (egg parasites) and Bracon (larval parasites), which act as natural enemies to the pest by targeting its eggs and larvae. By deploying these biological agents, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to reduce pest populations and limit agricultural damage without the heavy use of chemical interventions. This move is a core component of the ministry’s integrated pest management strategy, designed to transition toward environmentally friendly biological alternatives that restore ecological balance and ensure the safety of local agricultural products.

records.title: The Ministry of Economy and Trade in Tripoli has approved four key decisions to extend the operating licenses and facilitate the relocati...
records.description: The Ministry of Economy and Trade in Tripoli has approved four key decisions to extend the operating licenses and facilitate the relocation of headquarters for foreign companies from India, Malta, Italy, and Egypt. This move is part of an accelerated push to enhance Libya’s investment climate, with the ministry issuing 42 decisions related to foreign and joint-venture support within just 22 working days. By simplifying registration through a unified digital window and reforming executive regulations, the Ministry of Economy and Trade aims to build international confidence, revitalize economic sectors, and align with global investment standards, such as those highlighted in the US State Department’s Investment Climate Report.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Trade

records.title: Green Muscat Sustainability Solutions, an Omani-British joint venture, has officially launched its PET waste recycling facility at Al Rus...
records.description: Green Muscat Sustainability Solutions, an Omani-British joint venture, has officially launched its PET waste recycling facility at Al Rusayl Industrial City, marking a significant milestone in Oman’s transition toward a circular economy. The facility currently processes approximately 15 tonnes of post-consumer beverage bottles daily, transforming them into high-quality secondary raw materials. By the end of 2027, the company aims to scale its capacity to 10,000 metric tonnes annually. Through a robust supply chain involving 43 local collectors and strategic partnerships with hotels—achieving a landfill diversion rate of over 80%—Green Muscat is ensuring that plastic waste is retained as a strategic economic asset. Furthermore, the venture is expanding its impact by preparing to convert secondary waste components, such as caps and labels, into specialized products for the Omani agricultural sector.

By prioritizing value chains, market access, and the empowerment of women and youth, the Ministry of Agriculture and its international partners aim to transform food systems and ensure economic stability for farming communities facing significant environmental and regional challenges.

By addressing the "marketing bottleneck"—a primary challenge for the sector—the festival integrates efforts to improve agricultural inputs and select commercially competitive varieties. records.title: Supply levels at Tunisia's wholesale markets, particularly the central Bir El Kassaa hub, have stabilized following a period of weather-r...
records.description: Supply levels at Tunisia's wholesale markets, particularly the central Bir El Kassaa hub, have stabilized following a period of weather-related disruptions. According to Sotumag (Tunisian Wholesale Markets Company), daily tomato deliveries have rebounded to 110–120 tons, a significant recovery from previous shortages. This increased supply is driving wholesale prices down, with tomatoes averaging 2.5 dinars and potatoes steady at 1 dinar. To combat retail price inflation and informal trading, the Ministry of Commerce, in coordination with the ministries of Agriculture and Interior, has deployed 25 monitoring teams to track distribution margins. Furthermore, the Ministry of Agriculture and Sotumag are accelerating the digitalization of the sector, launching a new traceability platform for fishery products and stricter documentation requirements for imports to ensure transparency and food safety.

records.title: The signing of the founding document for a permanent consultation mechanism in Tripoli marks a historic turning point for the North-Weste...
records.description: The signing of the founding document for a permanent consultation mechanism in Tripoli marks a historic turning point for the North-Western Sahara Aquifer System (NWSAS)—often referred to as the SASS (Système Aquifère du Sahara Septentrional). This tripartite agreement between Tunisia, Libya, and Algeria transitions the region from decades of informal data exchange toward a formal, coordinated governance framework. By adopting the "Tripoli Declaration," the three nations have committed to a "Nexus" approach—linking water, energy, and food security—to manage one of the planet's largest fossil water reserves. With the aquifer supporting over five million people and 300,000 hectares of irrigated land, this mechanism is designed to prevent overexploitation and salinization while securing a "water heritage" estimated to last for several centuries.

records.title: The Eighth International Date Palm Conference 2026 has opened at Emirates Palace in Abu Dhabi, serving as a premier global platform for a...
records.description: The Eighth International Date Palm Conference 2026 has opened at Emirates Palace in Abu Dhabi, serving as a premier global platform for advancing date palm cultivation and agricultural innovation. Organised by the Khalifa International Award for Date Palm and Agricultural Innovation in cooperation with UAE University, the event convenes international ministers, scientists, and experts to address critical themes including biotechnology, genetic engineering, and the circular economy. Key highlights of the conference include the launch of the UAE’s first AI-powered digital platform for documenting local date varieties and research into AI-driven early detection of the red palm weevil. By showcasing smart monitoring systems and innovative uses for palm waste, the conference reinforces the UAE's leadership in sustainable agriculture and its commitment to integrating cutting-edge technology into the heritage-rich date palm sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has officially expanded the approved use of recycled plastics in food-contact app...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has officially expanded the approved use of recycled plastics in food-contact applications, moving beyond rPET to include recycled polypropylene (rPP) and recycled polyethylene (rHDPE and rLDPE). This regulatory shift is a cornerstone of the UAE’s Green Agenda 2030 and Net Zero 2050 targets, designed to transform plastic waste into high-value circular raw materials. By allowing these polymers in packaging formats like yogurt pots, tubs, and flexible films for fresh produce, the UAE is fostering a domestic "closed-loop" system. This move not only supports the “UAE Operated” manufacturing initiative but also provides food and beverage companies with a legal framework to reduce their reliance on imported virgin polymers while meeting the 2026 bans on single-use plastics.

By ensuring the continued availability of staple goods and enhancing the nation's readiness for regional and global developments, the National Programme to Strengthen Supply Chain Resilience seeks to address severe risks currently facing global trade routes and critical commodity access.

records.title: The General Authority for Veterinary Services has issued an urgent warning regarding the illegal sale of an unregistered vaccine marketed...
records.description: The General Authority for Veterinary Services has issued an urgent warning regarding the illegal sale of an unregistered vaccine marketed as “AFTOVAXPUR SAT-1” (Batch H07289), which claims to target foot-and-mouth disease. The General Authority for Veterinary Services clarified that this product has not undergone mandatory laboratory verification or calibration at the Central Laboratory for Veterinary Biologicals Control, rendering it a substance of unknown origin and efficacy. Furthermore, the vaccine is being distributed outside the regulated cold chain system, posing a severe risk of contamination or total ineffectiveness that could inadvertently spread epidemics and devastate livestock. To protect animal wealth and prevent significant financial loss, the General Authority for Veterinary Services urges breeders to rely exclusively on official veterinary units and national immunization campaigns, while requesting that any sightings of the suspected product be reported immediately via the official hotline.
records.institution: The General Authority for Veterinary Services

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with Ain International Company, conducted a specialized workshop to launch the Animal Trans...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with Ain International Company, conducted a specialized workshop to launch the Animal Transportation and its Products project. This initiative centers on a comprehensive digital transformation of the livestock sector, aimed at enhancing food security and the marketability of local products. The project introduces an integrated digital system designed to regulate market prices and provide precise, secure tracking for the transportation of animals and their products. By implementing these technical and organizational mechanisms, the Ministry of Agriculture intends to ensure the safety and efficiency of logistics while stabilizing the domestic livestock market through real-time data and improved oversight.

records.title: According to the World Bank, fertilizer prices are projected to rise by 31%, with urea alone potentially jumping 60% due to energy market...
records.description: According to the World Bank, fertilizer prices are projected to rise by 31%, with urea alone potentially jumping 60% due to energy market disruptions and logistics challenges in the Strait of Hormuz. In Jordan, where nitrogen-based fertilizers now trade at JD450–JD750 per tonne, the Agricultural Credit Corporation (ACC) and the Ministry of Agriculture have responded by deploying JD10 million in lending programs and interest-free "Ardhi" financing for water-saving technologies. While the Kingdom maintains self-sufficiency in many vegetables and dairy products, it remains vulnerable in strategic grains. To mitigate these risks, sector leaders are calling for strategic reserves and a pivot toward leveraging Jordan’s own phosphate and potash resources to expand exports and offset rising domestic costs.

records.title: The Ministry of Industry and Trade has launched a safeguard investigation into rice imports following a formal complaint from local produ...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry and Trade has launched a safeguard investigation into rice imports following a formal complaint from local producers representing 78% of national output. The probe follows a dramatic 116% surge in imports, which escalated from approximately 55,000 tons in 2022 to nearly 119,000 tons by 2025—a volume that now exceeds domestic production by more than 800%. This influx, driven by high global supply and competitive pricing from exporters in Egypt and India, has left a significant portion of the 2025 local harvest unsold and caused financial losses for Moroccan farmers. As the Ministry of Industry and Trade begins its nine-month review, the investigation seeks to balance the need for market competition with the urgent recovery of the local rice sector, which is seeing renewed potential for the upcoming planting season due to improved rainfall levels.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Trade

records.title: The Ramallah and Al-Bireh Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United...
records.description: The Ramallah and Al-Bireh Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed two major agreements valued at approximately 882,000 NIS to catalyze agricultural investment. These agreements are part of the Multi-Donor Agricultural Business Programme (MAP II), funded by Denmark, Switzerland, Spain, the European Union, and Italy. The initiative focuses on high-impact, market-oriented projects, including the development of integrated greenhouse farms and solar energy units in Beit Liqya. Additionally, the establishment of a specialized date processing and packaging unit in Deir Ibzi' aims to strengthen agricultural value chains and increase the market value of local produce. By integrating smart irrigation and renewable energy, the Ministry of Agriculture and the FAO are prioritizing the resilience of farmers in marginalized areas, ensuring long-term food security and economic stability.
records.institution: The Ramallah and Al-Bireh Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Salfit Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, through its Rural Development Department, conducted two specialized training workshops...
records.description: The Salfit Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, through its Rural Development Department, conducted two specialized training workshops to empower rural women in agricultural production and food processing. Led by the Ministry of Agriculture, these sessions provided 30 participants with practical skills in mushroom cultivation and grape processing, including the production of raisins and molasses. By focusing on home-based income generation and value-added techniques, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to strengthen the role of women in the local economy, improve household incomes, and enhance food security across the governorate.
records.institution: The Salfit Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Rural Women's Development Association and the German Agency...
records.description: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Rural Women's Development Association and the German Agency for International Cooperation (GIZ), has successfully completed a series of strategic interventions to bolster rural livelihoods. Funded by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), the project focused on enhancing the resilience of women-led cooperatives and youth agricultural groups. Key actions included the installation of a modern greenhouse for the Al-Jaroushiya Youth Agricultural Group and the provision of professional packaging materials to four major cooperative societies. By improving production capacity and market visibility for approximately 100 beneficiaries, the Ministry of Agriculture is strengthening the economic stability of rural families and fostering a more competitive, crisis-responsive agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The National Committee for Import and Export has implemented a series of strategic import restrictions on specific fruits and vegetables...
records.description: The National Committee for Import and Export has implemented a series of strategic import restrictions on specific fruits and vegetables through 2026, carefully timed to align with the domestic agricultural calendar. By limiting the entry of foreign produce—including staples like potatoes and onions starting in May, and seasonal fruits such as apricots and cherries during peak summer months—the National Committee for Import and Export aims to protect local farmers from international competition during their primary harvest windows. These measures are designed to alleviate the pressure of rising input costs for fuel and fertilizers by prioritizing domestic sales and reducing reliance on imports. While the National Committee for Import and Export intends for these restrictions to stabilize the agricultural sector and improve returns for growers, the move also addresses the need to manage market availability and consumer pricing amidst ongoing economic challenges.
records.institution: The National Committee for Import and Export

records.title: Majra – National CSR Fund, in partnership with the National Agricultural Centre, has launched a dedicated agricultural category within th...
records.description: Majra – National CSR Fund, in partnership with the National Agricultural Centre, has launched a dedicated agricultural category within the “Sustainable Impact Challenge.” Introduced at the UAE Agricultural Exhibition and Conference 2026, this national initiative is designed to accelerate sustainable production models and empower local farmers by scaling applied agricultural projects. The challenge focuses on enhancing production efficiency, optimizing resource use, and improving the market competitiveness of UAE-grown products. By fostering cross-sector partnerships between the government, private sector, and academic institutions, the National Agricultural Centre and Majra aim to future-proof the nation’s food supply chains and recognize high-impact innovations during the upcoming Impact Summit in October.

records.domain: Fisheries and aquaculture measures and regulations
records.title: The General Directorate of Fisheries and Aquaculture has entered into a strategic partnership with the University of Science and Technolo...
records.description: The General Directorate of Fisheries and Aquaculture has entered into a strategic partnership with the University of Science and Technology Houari-Boumediene (USTHB) to align national production with international technical and normative standards. This agreement, signed in Algiers, aims to leverage academic expertise to boost the quality and competitiveness of a sector currently contributing less than 7% to national fish production. Under an emergency government plan, production is projected to double from 7,300 tonnes in 2025 to 14,000 tonnes in 2026, with an ultimate target of 20,000 tonnes by 2027. To support this growth, the General Directorate of Fisheries and Aquaculture is developing a new regulatory framework to authorize hatcheries based on traceability and quality, while USTHB will establish a pilot "smart" aquaculture farm to foster applied research and entrepreneurial innovation.
records.institution: The General Directorate of Fisheries and Aquaculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has mobilized extensive technical and material resources through AgroDrive,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has mobilized extensive technical and material resources through AgroDrive, a subsidiary of the public group Agrodive, to support the 2025-2026 harvest-threshing season. Launched in the southern wilayas under national directives to enhance cereal production, the campaign features the deployment of 332 combine harvesters and 765 transport trucks to collection centers. This operational surge is supported by the newly established National Council for Agricultural Mechanization, which ensures equipment maintenance and spare part availability to minimize yield losses. To further professionalize the sector, the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has introduced specialized training for machine operators and maintenance staff, focusing on optimizing harvest efficiency. With the recent acquisition of 331 combine harvesters and 1,800 tractors, the initiative marks a qualitative shift toward a modernized, high-yield agricultural fleet designed to strengthen national food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries
