records.title: The Ministry of Industry has held discussions regarding a landmark green ammonia project in Ras Banas, led by the Egypt Amun Green Ammoni...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry has held discussions regarding a landmark green ammonia project in Ras Banas, led by the Egypt Amun Green Ammonia (EAGA) consortium. With initial investments of $5 billion scaling to $10 billion, the facility is designed to produce up to 1 million tons of green ammonia annually by 2031, powered by a 2,000-megawatt hybrid solar and wind energy system independent of the national grid. The project includes the development of dedicated export infrastructure and a port to facilitate shipments to Central and Eastern European markets, with anticipated annual revenues of $490 million in its first phase. Beyond creating thousands of direct and indirect jobs, the initiative seeks to localize renewable energy component manufacturing and integrate with the agriculture and water sectors. This partnership reinforces the Ministry of Industry's objective to position Egypt as a global hub for green hydrogen and advanced energy technologies while diversifying the national energy mix through sustainable industrial growth.

records.title: The National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) reported a robust week for agricultural trade, with 1,512 companies exporting 237,000 tons of f...
records.description: The National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) reported a robust week for agricultural trade, with 1,512 companies exporting 237,000 tons of food across 192 countries. This export activity was led by fruit shipments totaling 81,000 tons—driven largely by 60,000 tons of citrus—and vegetable exports of 52,000 tons, where potatoes remained the primary commodity. Saudi Arabia emerged as the top destination for these products, with Safaga and Damietta ports handling the highest volume of outgoing consignments. On the import side, the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) overseen the arrival of 575,000 tons of essential commodities, including wheat and oils, primarily sourced from Russia and Ukraine. To facilitate this massive trade flow, the authority issued over 1,200 health certificates and utilized fast-track clearing systems to ensure supply chain efficiency and the safety of both imported and exported food products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Integrity Commission, conducted a specialized workshop focused on the intersection...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Integrity Commission, conducted a specialized workshop focused on the intersection of environmental integrity and human rights protection. Organized by the Education and Public Relations Department, the session emphasized that access to a clean and safe environment is an essential human right, requiring transparent management of natural and agricultural resources to prevent waste and violations. By integrating awareness lectures from the Integrity Commission, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to foster a culture of transparency and accountability in environmental governance. This initiative underscores a strategic commitment to protecting fundamental rights through the sustainable preservation of the nation’s ecological and agricultural assets.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has secured four major investment contracts worth over OMR 51 million to signi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has secured four major investment contracts worth over OMR 51 million to significantly expand the national aquaculture sector. These projects, distributed across South Al Sharqiyah, Al Wusta, and Muscat, aim to bolster food security and industrial capacity through high-volume shrimp and finfish production. In South Al Sharqiyah, the Local Fish Company and the Arab Company for Aquatic Development will invest a combined OMR 41.3 million to produce 11,000 tonnes of shrimp annually. Further expansion includes a OMR 6 million shrimp farm by the Arabian Sea Aquaculture Company in Al Wusta and a OMR 3.8 million European seabass facility managed by Marjan Global Fish Company in Muscat. Collectively, these agreements represent a strategic move by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources to utilize local expertise and coastal resources to achieve an annual production target exceeding 15,000 tonnes of high-value aquatic products.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Economic Development, Russia has become a key contributor to Oman’s food security through the supply of wheat and barley,...
records.description: The Ministry of Economic Development, Russia has become a key contributor to Oman’s food security through the supply of wheat and barley, while Oman exports chemical products, petroleum derivatives, and luxury perfumes to the Russian market. Joint investment projects are currently expanding across logistics, finance, information technology, and agriculture, supported by an integrated system of grants and tax incentives. Furthermore, the Ministry of Economic Development highlighted a deepening partnership in energy, including green hydrogen and renewables, as well as a growing tourism sector bolstered by a visa-waiver system and direct flights between Muscat and Sochi. To sustain this momentum, Russia has introduced business reforms, such as a "golden visa" system and specialized economic zones, to attract long-term investment from the Omani private sector into its competitive and growing economy.

records.title: The Salfit Agriculture Directorate, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture, conducted specialized field school activities in the vil...
records.description: The Salfit Agriculture Directorate, operating under the Ministry of Agriculture, conducted specialized field school activities in the village of Iskaka to empower rural women and enhance their technical knowledge in olive cultivation. In partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), the session provided 15 participants with critical guidelines for seasonal tree care, including pest monitoring, land clearing, and soil management. Beyond cultivation, the program addressed olive product processing techniques designed to increase product quality and market value. This ongoing initiative, which will continue through the end of the agricultural season, is a central component of a broader strategy by the Ministry of Agriculture to support farmer resilience and promote sustainable rural development across the governorate.

records.title: The Tulkarm Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with Islamic Relief – France, has successfully completed the installation and fina...
records.description: The Tulkarm Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with Islamic Relief – France, has successfully completed the installation and final handover of a 50-kilowatt-hour solar power station for a water well in the town of Far'un. This initiative, part of the "Improving Livelihoods and Mitigating the Impact of Climate Change" project, is designed to enhance the resilience of the local agricultural sector by leveraging renewable energy to lower water extraction costs. By reducing the financial burden of irrigation for farming families, the Tulkarm Directorate of Agriculture aims to stabilize water prices and boost agricultural productivity while promoting sustainable rural development. This project underscores a strategic commitment to empowering local farmers through alternative energy solutions and international cooperation to mitigate the long-term repercussions of climate change on food systems.

records.title: A groundbreaking study led by King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), in collaboration with international partners, h...
records.description: A groundbreaking study led by King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), in collaboration with international partners, has identified that mangrove forest ecosystems are a vital resource for discovering enzymes capable of breaking down plastic waste, specifically polyethylene terephthalate (PET). By analyzing the microbial diversity in mangrove soils under varying conditions like salinity and pollution, researchers from the King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) discovered that introducing agricultural residues can boost the presence of plastic-degrading enzymes. Utilizing a combination of metagenomics, 3D structural analysis, and artificial intelligence, the team uncovered a new group of enzymes that remain functional in high-salinity industrial environments where conventional enzymes typically fail. This research highlights the microscopic potential of Saudi Arabia’s Red Sea mangroves, positioning these dynamic ecosystems as natural laboratories for developing sustainable solutions to global plastic accumulation while emphasizing the need for further testing to realize their practical industrial potential.
records.institution: The King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB) has entered into a strategic agreement with the Environment Fund (EF) to provide credit facilities for beneficiari...
records.description: Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB) has entered into a strategic agreement with the Environment Fund (EF) to provide credit facilities for beneficiaries of the incentives and grants program, aimed at accelerating environmental transformation across the Kingdom. This partnership enables small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) as well as large corporations to access financing solutions—including term loans, project finance, and trade finance—for projects focused on waste management, environmental compliance, and wildlife conservation. By facilitating greater access to capital for green initiatives, the Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB) and the Environment Fund (EF) aim to foster a more attractive investment environment for the private sector while supporting the national goals of combating desertification and promoting vegetation development. This collaboration reinforces a broader commitment to economic diversification and sustainable development, ensuring that businesses can adopt environmentally responsible practices in alignment with national strategic visions.

records.title: The Turkish Cooperation and Coordination Agency (TİKA) has delivered a comprehensive package of modern fishing and agricultural equipment...
records.description: The Turkish Cooperation and Coordination Agency (TİKA) has delivered a comprehensive package of modern fishing and agricultural equipment to Sennar State, marking a significant expansion of its development projects in Sudan. The initiative, aimed at empowering small-scale producers and improving household incomes, provided the Ministry of Animal Resources and Fisheries with fully equipped boats, specialized nets, and essential safety gear. Simultaneously, TİKA extended its support to the Ministry of Production and Economic Resources by delivering improved seeds and tools for smallholder farmers. These interventions reflect a strategic commitment to strengthening Sudan’s productive sectors—specifically fisheries and agriculture—while reinforcing the historical and economic ties between the two nations through direct, community-level support.
records.institution: The Ministry of Animal Resources and Fisheries

records.title: MOCCAE, ICBA Launch ‘National Agricultural Initiative for Adoption of Climate-Smart Crops in UAE’
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), in partnership with the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA), has launched a national initiative to adopt climate-smart crops such as millet and sorghum to enhance water sustainability and food sovereignty. Designed to support the National Food Security Strategy 2051, the program focuses on crops that consume up to 50 percent less water and thrive in extreme heat, alongside water-efficient fodder like Blue Panicum for the livestock sector. The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) is implementing the initiative in two phases, beginning with 45 field trials and the training of farmers and extension officers, followed by commercial expansion through private sector partnerships. By integrating scientific research into practical field solutions and introducing prototype products like "Resilience," the initiative aims to build a resilient, innovation-based agricultural ecosystem that transforms environmental challenges into sustainable economic opportunities for the UAE.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA)

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) and the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC) have signed a Memorandum...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) and the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to strengthen national biosecurity and food safety through enhanced institutional integration. This agreement focuses on unifying diagnostic systems and laboratory testing capabilities for water, food, animal feed, and livestock, leveraging advanced infrastructure such as the Central Testing Laboratory. By standardizing procedures and fostering data exchange, the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) aims to accelerate response times to plant and animal health challenges while protecting vital supply chains. The partnership also emphasizes the development of qualified national talent and the implementation of inter-laboratory testing programs, creating a proactive and efficient regulatory framework that ensures the highest standards of quality assurance and environmental sustainability across the UAE’s ports of entry.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) and the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC)

records.title: The National Agricultural Centre (NAC) and NRTC Group (a subsidiary of Ghitha Holding) have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understandin...
records.description: The National Agricultural Centre (NAC) and NRTC Group (a subsidiary of Ghitha Holding) have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding to integrate UAE-grown produce into mainstream retail and distribution networks. Signed at the Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition 2026, the agreement focuses on creating dedicated retail spaces for local produce, streamlining logistics, and implementing training programs for quality grading and packaging. By leveraging the advanced infrastructure of the NRTC Group and its "Mazraati" initiative—supported by recent acquisitions like Ripe Organic and Mahsool—the partnership aims to improve farmer returns and enhance supply chain traceability. This collaboration, overseen by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, represents a critical step in future-proofing the national food system by empowering Emirati farmers and ensuring a consistent supply of sustainable local products to the market.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced significant success in its targeted campaigns to eradicate the red palm weevil in the Abu Ghrai...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced significant success in its targeted campaigns to eradicate the red palm weevil in the Abu Ghraib region. Led by the Plant Protection Department, the initiative utilized advanced scientific methods and field surgeries to treat infested trees, moving beyond traditional pesticide application toward a comprehensive recovery strategy. Under the oversight of the Red Palm Weevil Operations Room, technical teams successfully reversed tissue damage in infested palms, resulting in a documented decline in pest density and a marked recovery of the local palm population.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) has launched the second phase of consultative sessions for the "Buildin...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) has launched the second phase of consultative sessions for the "Building Resilience to Cope with Climate Change in Jordan (BRCCJ)" project, targeting the water-stressed Dead Sea Basin governorates of Madaba, Karak, Tafileh, and Maan. Funded by the Green Climate Fund and implemented in cooperation with the Ministry of Water and Irrigation, the Ministry of Agriculture, and the Ministry of Environment, the initiative aims to enhance water use efficiency and promote climate-smart agricultural practices. By partnering with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and Advance Consulting, the project facilitates a participatory approach where cooperative and charitable associations provide feedback to refine training programs and address field challenges in water management and marketing. Valued at $33.25 million and aligned with the Economic Modernization Vision, this program strengthens the capacity of local communities to adapt to climate-resilient sustainable development while ensuring that agricultural interventions respond directly to the actual needs of stakeholders on the ground.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation, the Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: An agreement has been signed to establish several food processing plants within the Al-Jouf Free Zone in Kufra, covering an area of appro...
records.description: An agreement has been signed to establish several food processing plants within the Al-Jouf Free Zone in Kufra, covering an area of approximately 20,000 square meters. This initiative, implemented by a private sector partner, is designed to strengthen the industrial and food sectors by maximizing the region's investment potential and developing essential industrial infrastructure. By focusing on the processing of food products to meet local market demands, the project aims to enhance national food security and revitalize economic activity through the creation of new employment opportunities. This development serves as a foundational step for future investment projects in the food industry, supporting a broader path of economic development and creating a more attractive environment for industrial growth in the region.

records.title: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) showcased its latest advancements in water scarcity management during a strategic pan...
records.description: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) showcased its latest advancements in water scarcity management during a strategic panel held at the International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM). Focused on the theme of agricultural resilience, the meeting highlighted the institute's tested innovations, including drought-resistant crop varieties, improved agricultural practices, and highly efficient irrigation systems. Aligned with the "Generation Green" strategy, the National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) emphasized the necessity of transitioning these solutions to large-scale dissemination to support farmers facing climate change. The discussions, which involved experts from the Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests, underscored the critical interconnection between water, energy, and food as a pillar of future public policy. This collaborative effort aimed to secure agricultural water resources and utilize renewable energy to strengthen the sector's long-term sustainability and global competitiveness.
records.institution: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA)

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through the Higher Agricultural Emergency Committee and in partnership with the Food and Agricul...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through the Higher Agricultural Emergency Committee and in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), convened a specialized workshop in Gaza City to advance a strategic shift toward "resilience and sovereignty agriculture." Held at the PalTrade headquarters, the session focused on practical solutions to resource scarcity, such as adopting biological pest management and utilizing organic fertilizers as alternatives to imported chemical inputs. By emphasizing the rehabilitation of damaged lands and the empowerment of small-scale farmers, the initiative seeks to reduce external dependency and maximize the use of local resources. The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture underscored that integrating governmental and international efforts is essential for building a self-sufficient system capable of securing food sovereignty and long-term sustainability despite ongoing environmental and economic challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has finalized its comprehensive operational plan for the 1447 AH Hajj season, designed...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has finalized its comprehensive operational plan for the 1447 AH Hajj season, designed to enhance the pilgrim experience through optimized service quality and infrastructure readiness. The plan focuses on the full preparation of slaughterhouses and public benefit markets, the implementation of advanced performance indicators (KPIs) to track operational efficiency, and the automation of livestock sales tracking. Key environmental initiatives include the establishment of new engineered landfill cells and the licensing of specialized operators for waste transport, alongside the activation of volunteer programs to support workforce capacity and shelter point management. Furthermore, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has strengthened regulatory enforcement and charitable partnerships to manage surplus meat distribution, ensuring an integrated and sustainable framework that aligns with national goals for safety, efficiency, and environmental protection during the pilgrimage.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Sudan participated in a high-level African Union retreat for ambassadors in Beijing focused on maximizing the impact of China’s 100% tari...
records.description: Sudan participated in a high-level African Union retreat for ambassadors in Beijing focused on maximizing the impact of China’s 100% tariff exemption initiative for African exports. Set to take effect on May 1, 2026, the initiative aims to expand market access and align with the priorities of the African Continental Free Trade Area and Agenda 2063 to drive industrialization and economic transformation. The delegation emphasized the strategic opportunity to boost national exports in the agriculture and mining sectors, ensuring these resources generate greater added value for the economy. The retreat concluded with a call to move from policy planning to practical implementation by strengthening financing mechanisms, information-sharing, and capacity-building to ensure African products remain competitive in Chinese markets.

records.title: The United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) hosted the Agricultural Sustainability and Food Security Forum as part of the Emirates Agricul...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) hosted the Agricultural Sustainability and Food Security Forum as part of the Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition 2026, serving as a high-level platform to align academic research with national food security priorities. Featuring specialized sessions on the circular bioeconomy, the impact of climate change on livestock, and the role of genomic technologies in agricultural output, the forum emphasized the university's role in developing homegrown innovations through its College of Agriculture and Veterinary Medicine. Supported by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, the event focused on empowering youth and integrating climate science with food safety policies to build a more resilient production system. By fostering partnerships between researchers and government entities, the United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) reaffirmed its commitment to the nation’s vision of a sustainable, knowledge-based agricultural future rooted in the late Sheikh Zayed’s legacy of viewing agriculture as a cornerstone of growth and dignity.

records.title: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation showcased a massive infrastructure overhaul aimed at transforming the Sinai Peninsula into...
records.description: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation showcased a massive infrastructure overhaul aimed at transforming the Sinai Peninsula into a hub for agricultural productivity. Minister Hani Sewilam highlighted the Bahr El-Baqar treatment plant—one of the world's largest—as a cornerstone of this strategy, processing 5.6 million cubic meters of water daily for reuse. Major progress was reported on water conveyance routes, which are now 88% complete and set to irrigate 270,000 feddans. Additionally, the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation has finalized 21 of 24 planned intake points along the Sheikh Jaber Canal to support thousands of feddans in Rabaa and Bir El-Abd. These agricultural efforts are complemented by 16 integrated development clusters and 561 flood protection projects designed to capture rainwater and recharge groundwater, ensuring the long-term resilience and settlement of Sinai’s local communities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation

records.title: The Misrata Free Zone (MFZ) has witnessed the launch of a new animal protein manufacturing project by the Chinese investment and trade co...
records.description: The Misrata Free Zone (MFZ) has witnessed the launch of a new animal protein manufacturing project by the Chinese investment and trade company, Reed Pelagics (Reed Huayin Trading and Investment Company). This initiative is designed to strengthen national food security and drive economic diversification by investing directly in food industries and local production. According to the Misrata Free Zone (MFZ), the project will enhance supply chain efficiency, reduce dependency on imported goods, and create significant added value within the industrial sector. By leveraging the advanced infrastructure and technological capabilities of the Misrata Free Zone (MFZ), the project integrates into a broader investment system that supports the oil, industrial, and logistics sectors within a stimulating and highly technical environment.

records.title: The National Office for Agricultural Advice (ONCA) and the General Directorate of Meteorology (DGM) have signed a strategic framework agr...
records.description: The National Office for Agricultural Advice (ONCA) and the General Directorate of Meteorology (DGM) have signed a strategic framework agreement at SIAM 2026 to integrate their resources into the State Climate Network (RCE). Under this partnership, ONCA will contribute approximately 100 automatic meteorological stations to the national network, allowing for the centralization and pooling of climatological data within the DGM. This collaboration ensures that data collection meets the international standards of the World Meteorological Organization (WMO), focusing on technical quality and data sovereignty. By leveraging these optimized agro-meteorological services, the National Office for Agricultural Advice (ONCA) aims to provide farmers with highly accurate, validated information to support sustainable modernization and informed public decision-making across Morocco's agricultural sector.
records.institution: The National Office for Agricultural Advice (ONCA) and the General Directorate of Meteorology (DGM)

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman concluded a highly successful participation in the International Seafood Exhibition 2026 in Barcelona, securing com...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman concluded a highly successful participation in the International Seafood Exhibition 2026 in Barcelona, securing commercial deals exceeding OMR 30 million. Led by the Public Establishment for Industrial Estates (Madayn), the Omani pavilion served as a strategic gateway to markets in Africa, Europe, and Asia. This participation, aligned with Oman Vision 2040, highlights the nation's push to become a global hub for marine industries. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources reported that Oman’s fish production surpassed 900,000 tonnes in 2025, with exports now reaching 84 countries. Beyond trade, the event was used by Madayn and the Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones to pitch high-value investment opportunities in aquaculture, fish processing, and specialized logistics, supported by preliminary feasibility studies and competitive industrial incentives.
records.institution: The Public Establishment for Industrial Estates (Madayn)

records.title: The General Authority for the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE), in partnership with the United Nations Industrial Development Organizati...
records.description: The General Authority for the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE), in partnership with the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO), has launched the National Clean Hydrogen Program–Egypt to accelerate the nation’s transition toward a competitive green hydrogen-based economy. Funded by the Global Environment Facility (GEF), the initiative focuses on enhancing investment readiness through feasibility studies, technical policy support, and the establishment of a Green Hydrogen Center of Excellence at the SZONE headquarters in Ain Sokhna. The program operates under an integrated institutional framework—including the Ministry of Environment, the Ministry of Electricity and Renewable Energy, and the Ministry of Industry—to ensure alignment with national priorities and global environmental standards. By strengthening institutional capacities and infrastructure, the initiative positions Egypt as a central hub within the Global Clean Hydrogen Program, fostering industrial development and sustainable energy innovation.
records.institution: The General Authority for the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE)

records.title: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) has expanded its industrial footprint with the inauguration of the Green Recycle plastic recycling...
records.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) has expanded its industrial footprint with the inauguration of the Green Recycle plastic recycling plant in the Sokhna Integrated Industrial Zone. This facility, representing a US$5 million investment across 30,000 square metres, is designed to process 8,000 tonnes of plastic waste annually into high-quality recycled raw materials. By transforming waste into economically valuable production inputs, the project supports Egypt’s transition toward a circular green economy, reduces reliance on imported virgin plastics, and strengthens local supply chains. Beyond its environmental impact in reducing pollution, the facility creates direct and indirect employment opportunities while contributing to the national trade balance through import replacement and potential foreign currency inflows from exports.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued a decisive mandate to safeguard Lebanon's agricultural biosecurity against the Xylella fastidiosa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued a decisive mandate to safeguard Lebanon's agricultural biosecurity against the Xylella fastidiosa bacteria. Minister Nizar Hani’s latest decree establishes rigorous new protocols for the importation of all plant propagation materials (excluding seeds), superseding previous regulations from 2015, 2019, and 2022. By aligning with the standards of the International Plant Protection Convention, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to shield vital domestic crops—such as olives, grapes, and stone fruits—from a devastating pathogen that has caused significant economic loss across the Mediterranean basin.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform have signed a joint declaration of intent at...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform have signed a joint declaration of intent at SIAM 2026 to accelerate the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) and digital tools into the agricultural sector. This partnership paves the way for the agricultural ministry to join the Al-Jazari Institutes, a national network of centers of excellence in AI, focusing on enhancing data utilization and developing intelligent solutions for climate resilience. Minister Ahmed El Bouari emphasized that digitalization is no longer optional but a vital lever for competitiveness and resource management. To support this transition, Minister Amal El Fallah Seghrouchni committed her department’s resources, including data centers and "data factories," to foster an AI-based agricultural economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform

records.title: Oman has recorded a massive 288 percent surge in aluminum scrap recycling volumes by the end of 2025, a milestone driven by the sultanate...
records.description: Oman has recorded a massive 288 percent surge in aluminum scrap recycling volumes by the end of 2025, a milestone driven by the sultanate’s Oman Vision 2040 and new aluminum-specific regulations introduced in March 2025. Highlighted at the third Aluminium Recycling Forum, this growth reflects a successful partnership between the Environment Authority and Sohar Aluminium to streamline scrap management and retain high-value materials within the local economy. By capturing scrap domestically rather than exporting it, Oman is significantly reducing the carbon footprint of its industrial sector—given that recycling aluminum requires 95 percent less energy than primary production—while positioning itself as a regional hub for the circular economy.
records.institution: The Environment Authority and Sohar Aluminium

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has officially launched the ‘Young Farmer Seal’ at the Emirates Agriculture Confe...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has officially launched the ‘Young Farmer Seal’ at the Emirates Agriculture Conference 2026. This initiative is designed to transition young Emirati farmers from traditional production to competitive "agri-entrepreneurship." By providing a certified stamp of quality, the program builds consumer trust and grants young producers direct access to major retail outlets and cooperative societies. Developed by the Emirates Youth Council for Agriculture, the initiative is open to Emiratis under 35 who own or manage farms, livestock, or beekeeping projects. To qualify, projects must undergo a technical evaluation to ensure they meet the UAE’s high standards for sustainability and innovation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment organized a strategic gathering where the National Agriculture Centre signed five major Me...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment organized a strategic gathering where the National Agriculture Centre signed five major Memoranda of Understanding to accelerate the digital and sustainable transformation of the UAE’s food sector. These agreements establish a robust framework for institutional cooperation in areas such as artificial intelligence, vertical farming, and livestock production, specifically involving partnerships with the Department of Agriculture and Livestock Sharjah, Elite Agro Holding, ADNOC, NRTC, and Al Baraka Dates Factory. By focusing on the deployment of smart technologies, the reuse of treated water, and the integration of local farm outputs into global marketing networks, the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment is working to enhance resource efficiency and strengthen national food security value chains. This collaborative effort aims to transition the agricultural sector into a future-ready industry that prioritizes sustainable production, national capacity building, and the competitiveness of local products in alignment with the country’s long-term economic vision.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.title: The Zayed for Good Foundation and Silal Group have formalized a strategic partnership through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed...
records.description: The Zayed for Good Foundation and Silal Group have formalized a strategic partnership through a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) signed at the UAE Agricultural Conference 2026. This collaboration represents a shift from traditional humanitarian aid toward a sustainable development model that prioritizes food security and community resilience. By leveraging Silal’s Innovation Oasis, the partnership aims to cultivate national talent, advance agricultural technology, and export Emirati expertise to international markets. The agreement focuses on practical learning for students and capacity-building for farmers, ensuring the adoption of modern, technology-driven practices that enhance productivity and resource efficiency.
records.institution: The Zayed for Good Foundation and Silal Group

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has presided over the signing of a second massive batch of contracts for the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has presided over the signing of a second massive batch of contracts for the "Baladna Algérie" project, totaling more than $635 million. This phase marks a decisive shift from planning to execution for the Adrar-based mega-project, which aims to become one of Africa’s largest powdered milk production hubs. The new agreements involve seven Algerian companies and several international partners to oversee the import of a 33,250-cow herd, civil engineering works, and the construction of essential infrastructure. Minister Yacine El-Mahdi Oualid highlighted the project as a global model for transforming desert land into high-yield agricultural units, while the Algerian Investment Promotion Agency (AAPI) emphasized the vast subcontracting opportunities now opening for local start-ups and operators.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: Badia Farms has committed a multi-million dollar investment to develop a 50,000sqm "Agricultural Oasis" in Hamala.
records.description: Badia Farms has committed a multi-million dollar investment to develop a 50,000sqm "Agricultural Oasis" in Hamala. The project is the result of a strategic partnership with Edamah (the real estate arm of Mumtalakat), with the land secured through the Government Land Investment Platform. This high-tech facility will utilize advanced hydroponic systems and controlled-environment greenhouses to enable year-round production of fruits and vegetables, effectively overcoming Bahrain's challenges with water scarcity and seasonal climate shifts. Designed as a model of sustainability, the farm will integrate solar energy, water recycling, and biodegradable waste management. Leaders from Mumtalakat and the Bahrain Economic Development Board have hailed the initiative as a transformative step that will drive foreign direct investment, create local jobs, and redefine sustainable agriculture in the Kingdom.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully released more than 11 million fish into Lake Ana in the Anbar Governorate.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully released more than 11 million fish into Lake Ana in the Anbar Governorate. This large-scale campaign, executed by the Department of Animal Resources in coordination with the Anbar Agriculture Directorate, included 10 million newly hatched common carp from the Al-Suwaira hatchery and over one million catfish from the Al-Radwaniyah Reserve. By replenishing these stocks, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to restore ecological balance, support the local fisheries sector, and provide a sustainable source of high-quality protein for Iraqi citizens.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture of Lebanon and the Italian Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty, and Forestry have established a strateg...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture of Lebanon and the Italian Ministry of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty, and Forestry have established a strategic partnership through a Memorandum of Understanding signed to bolster the resilience and modernization of the Lebanese agricultural sector. This agreement, formulated following a comprehensive technical and institutional process, focuses on critical areas such as enhancing product quality through geographical indication systems, updating phytosanitary standards to align with European requirements, and revitalizing rural areas through agricultural tourism. The cooperation also targets the recovery of lands affected by regional conflict, aiming to rebuild production infrastructure and improve food security via advanced knowledge transfer and sustainable development programs. By fostering joint expertise in fisheries, aquaculture, and agricultural management, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to enhance the global competitiveness of national products and ensure the long-term sustainability of marine and terrestrial resources.

records.title: The Directorate of Plant Protection, in coordination with technical teams from the Ministry of Agriculture, has launched a vital initiati...
records.description: The Directorate of Plant Protection, in coordination with technical teams from the Ministry of Agriculture, has launched a vital initiative to protect the regional olive sector through a specialized training workshop. Focused on "Combating the Olive Fruit Fly Using Environmentally Friendly Traps," the program provides 40 olive grove owners with the skills and tools needed to implement biological control methods. Supported by the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC), this campaign aims to safeguard approximately 650 dunams of groves by distributing over 5,000 sustainable traps. By prioritizing these modern, chemical-free techniques, the Directorate of Plant Protection is ensuring higher olive oil quality while strengthening the long-term resilience of local farmers against agricultural pests.

records.title: The Ramallah and Al-Bireh Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has successfully c...
records.description: The Ramallah and Al-Bireh Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has successfully concluded a strategic initiative titled "Green Jobs and Sustainable Income Opportunities for Young Palestinian Men and Women." Funded by the Danish government, the project is a key component of the Ministry of Agriculture's broader mandate to drive economic empowerment and resource sustainability. By targeting 176 young beneficiaries across the villages of Sinjil, Abu Falah, and Al-Mughayyir, the initiative facilitated the cultivation of 673 dunams of essential crops such as lentils, chickpeas, vetch, and alfalfa. This collaborative effort serves as a national model for integrating international support with local expertise to enhance food security and strengthen the resilience of citizens on their land.
records.institution: The Ramallah and Al-Bireh Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Jazan branch of the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in collaboration with the Minis...
records.description: The Jazan branch of the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, conducted a specialized workshop in Qilwah Governorate to empower local farmers. The initiative combined scientific presentations with hands-on field training, specifically focusing on the diagnosis and control of mango diseases, soil analysis, and advanced grafting techniques. By addressing real-world field challenges through open discussions, Estidamah aims to bridge the gap between applied research and daily farming practices, ensuring the localization of agricultural technologies and the sustainable improvement of crop quality throughout the Al-Baha Region.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), is concluding a specialized workshop toda...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), is concluding a specialized workshop today focused on "Supporting Improved Food Earnings for the Most Vulnerable Farmers." This preparatory session brings together stakeholders from the agricultural directorates of Deir ez-Zor, Raqqa, and Hasakah to finalize an emergency aid project targeting over 17,000 beneficiaries. The initiative is designed to provide immediate relief and long-term stability by distributing high-quality vegetable seeds and bio-fertilizers for the summer season, alongside significant support for the livestock sector.

records.title: The Nabeul region has officially inaugurated "The Bitter Orange Route" (Zahr Nabeul Tour), a themed experiential tourism initiative desig...
records.description: The Nabeul region has officially inaugurated "The Bitter Orange Route" (Zahr Nabeul Tour), a themed experiential tourism initiative designed to showcase the cultural and economic significance of the bitter orange blossom. Developed under the Market Access Project for Agri-food and Local Products (PAMPAT) and led by the Association for the Safeguarding of the City of Nabeul (ASVN), the route integrates the entire value chain—from farmers to perfumers and restaurateurs. Supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, APIA, and UNIDO, the project aims to diversify Tunisia's tourism offering beyond traditional crafts and pottery, offering visitors immersive experiences in gastronomy and cosmetics. By uniting local stakeholders, the initiative seeks to enhance the international visibility of Tunisian local products while fostering sustainable territorial development and preserving ancestral agricultural know-how.

records.title: Tunisia’s date sector has achieved a historic milestone for the 2025/2026 season, crossing the 400,000-tonne production mark for the firs...
records.description: Tunisia’s date sector has achieved a historic milestone for the 2025/2026 season, crossing the 400,000-tonne production mark for the first time in the country’s history. As of April 10, 2026, exports reached 108,000 tonnes, valued at approximately 705 million dinars. This growth is underpinned by a record harvest of 404,000 tonnes, with the premium Deglet Ennour variety accounting for 347,000 tonnes (86% of total output).This performance was discussed during a recent parliamentary hearing of the National Council of Regions and Districts, where representatives from the Ministry of Agriculture and Ministry of Trade evaluated the season's expansion into 94 international markets.

records.title: Silal has officially opened applications for its Farm Innovation Fund at the Emirates Agriculture Conference 2026, a strategic initiative...
records.description: Silal has officially opened applications for its Farm Innovation Fund at the Emirates Agriculture Conference 2026, a strategic initiative launched by Silal’s Innovation Oasis. The fund is designed to empower Emirati farmers by providing the financial and technical resources necessary to develop, test, and scale cutting-edge agricultural solutions. Annually, five selected farmers will each receive up to AED 200,000 in support, alongside specialized mentorship, with the long-term goal of supporting 25 projects over the next five years. By focusing on field-based innovation tailored to local environmental needs, Silal aims to enhance crop productivity, optimize water and energy efficiency, and transform grassroots ideas into commercially viable, sustainable ventures that strengthen the UAE's national food security.

records.title: The Grain Trading Company has finalized preparations for the new wheat procurement season, readying 78 silos and storage facilities—inclu...
records.description: The Grain Trading Company has finalized preparations for the new wheat procurement season, readying 78 silos and storage facilities—including new sites in Muthanna and Karbala—to handle a combined capacity of 340,000 tons. To safeguard the quality of the national food supply, which supports the Public Distribution System for 42 million people, the Grain Trading Company has implemented strict moisture and pest inspections while prohibiting the mixing of new harvests with old stock. Despite a record 6.3 million metric ton harvest last year, the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) predicts a decline to 4.5 million metric tons in 2025, potentially necessitating significant imports. Furthermore, while the country approaches self-sufficiency for basic staples, the Ministry of Agriculture faces ongoing regional tensions regarding procurement quotas in the Kurdistan Region, and local commercial bakeries continue to rely on approximately 1.5 million tons of imported flour annually from regional partners.

records.title: The Ministry of Industry and Trade has secured 60,000 tons of milling wheat through an international tender to bolster national reserves...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry and Trade has secured 60,000 tons of milling wheat through an international tender to bolster national reserves and maintain stable bread prices. Purchased at US$273.99 per ton on a cost and freight basis, the shipment is scheduled for arrival in late August 2026. This move follows a strategic decision by the Ministry of Industry and Trade to reduce domestic flour and wheat prices to approximately US$236 per ton and US$192 per ton, respectively, easing the financial pressure on bakeries. With current grain stocks capable of covering over nine months of local demand, the government continues to enforce export controls and regular cost reviews to shield consumers from global market volatility and rising transport expenses.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Trade

records.title: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation in Jordan and the Ministry of Energy in Syria have officially launched a first-of-its-kind joint ope...
records.description: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation in Jordan and the Ministry of Energy in Syria have officially launched a first-of-its-kind joint operational water platform in Amman. This digital initiative aims to unify databases for the Yarmouk Basin, enabling real-time hydrological monitoring and transparent data exchange to combat regional water scarcity. Supported technically by the United States, the platform integrates Jordan's national Water Management Information System (WMIS) with a dedicated Syrian portal, allowing for joint planning, secure information sharing, and institutionalized training programs. Officials from both nations, including Minister Raed Abu Al-Saud and Assistant Minister Osama Abu Zaid, emphasized that this strategic tool—the first globally for a shared water basin—will directly support water sustainability, modernize agricultural planning, and enhance the resilience of farmers in the border regions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation

records.title: The Libyan Export Development Authority (LEDA) has facilitated a major trade agreement with the Indonesian Exporters Association for the...
records.description: The Libyan Export Development Authority (LEDA) has facilitated a major trade agreement with the Indonesian Exporters Association for the export of 200,000 litres of Libyan olive oil. Signed during the 52nd Tripoli International Fair, this contract follows a successful fact-finding mission where Indonesian delegates evaluated the quality and market competitiveness of both olive oil and dates. The Libyan Export Development Authority (LEDA) views this partnership as a strategic entry point into high-growth East Asian markets, specifically targeting Indonesia and India as primary destinations for agricultural expansion. To sustain this momentum, the Libyan Export Development Authority (LEDA) has established a direct coordination mechanism between registered local exporters and international buyers to foster future trade deals in the premium food sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Economy and Trade has enacted a comprehensive three-month ban on the export and re-export of all types of fish, including...
records.description: The Ministry of Economy and Trade has enacted a comprehensive three-month ban on the export and re-export of all types of fish, including mollusks, crustaceans, and coral reefs, whether alive, dead, or as derivatives. This temporary restriction applies to all forms of transport, shipping, and transit trade to regulate the sector effectively. According to the Libyan Export Development Authority (LEDA), the measure is designed to stabilize the local market, ensure national self-sufficiency, and reorganize the fisheries export framework. To support the long-term sustainability of the industry, the Libyan Export Development Authority (LEDA) is simultaneously launching strategic development projects managed by specialized local teams.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Trade

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP) have formalized a strategic pa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP) have formalized a strategic partnership through the signing of a cooperation agreement at the International Agriculture Fair in Meknes. This agreement integrates the agricultural sector into the “DATA-TIKA” program, an initiative designed to ensure compliance with Law 09-08 regarding the processing and protection of personal data. To facilitate this transition, the National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP) has established a dedicated unit to provide tailored support to stakeholders ranging from small farmers to large cooperatives. By embedding data governance into the sector's digital transformation, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to build public trust, promote professional responsibility, and align Morocco's agricultural modernization with national ethical and legal standards.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and the National Commission for the Control of Personal Data Protection (CNDP)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen the commencement of the wheat harvest across the South A’Sharqiya...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen the commencement of the wheat harvest across the South A’Sharqiyah Governorate in Oman, specifically in the wilayats of Al Kamil wa Al Wafi, Sur, and Ja’alan Bani Bu Hassan. With 41 feddans under cultivation, production is projected to exceed 50 tonnes for the 2025–2026 season, supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources through the provision of modern harvesting machinery and technical guidance on seed quality. Simultaneously, the Grain Trading Company in Iraq has readied 78 silos with a 340,000-tonne capacity to handle the upcoming harvest, implementing rigorous moisture and pest inspections to ensure grain quality. While Iraqi officials prepare for a 10-day delay due to recent rains, internal discussions persist regarding procurement quotas, as regional authorities advocate for a larger purchase share of a harvest that could surpass 2 million tonnes.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Wa...
records.description: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has launched a high-value investment portfolio targeting nearly $250 million (OMR 96 million) across 11 food security projects. This initiative, unveiled through the Invest Oman platform in April 2026, aims to bolster national self-sufficiency and resource sustainability under Oman Vision 2040. In the Al Najd Agricultural Zone, the portfolio features five diverse crops including potato (OMR 5.5 million), onion (OMR 4.8 million), and garlic (OMR 2.3 million) cultivation and processing. The fisheries sector offers strategic opportunities ranging from whiteleg shrimp farming (OMR 25 million) to a major OMR 32 million giant tiger prawn project in Ras Madrakah. Additionally, a OMR 3.8 million sustainable fish feed alternative project in Samail Industrial City is being promoted to strengthen the integration of domestic food value chains.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Tulkarm Agriculture Directorate, has officially handed over a series of pioneering...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Tulkarm Agriculture Directorate, has officially handed over a series of pioneering plum production projects to local farmers as part of the "SANET" initiative. Implemented by the CIHEAM Bari Institute and the Palestinian Employment Fund, and funded by the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS), the project aims to modernize the fruit tree sector in rural and marginalized areas. The grants provided essential production tools, including advanced irrigation networks, high-quality plum saplings, and protective fencing, all of which underwent rigorous technical inspections to ensure compliance with international standards. According to national coordinator Engineer Awda Sabarneh, these interventions are vital for enhancing farmer resilience and achieving long-term economic sustainability through a successful model of international cooperation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its General Directorate of Extension and Rural Development, has launched a specialized training prog...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its General Directorate of Extension and Rural Development, has launched a specialized training program focused on the efficient management of ruminant farms to modernize the livestock sector. This initiative, part of a broader project funded by the European Union and implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), aims to refine the technical and administrative skills of extension agents and engineers across various governorates. By equipping rural development and livestock extension workers with the latest scientific methods and field practices, the Ministry of Agriculture seeks to improve production efficiency and product quality. This strategic investment in human capital is designed to strengthen food security and ensure the long-term sustainability of rural livelihoods by enabling staff to effectively transfer modern technologies directly to farmers and breeders.
records.institution: The General Directorate of Extension and Rural Development at the Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its General Directorate of Forests and Rangelands, has executed a targeted field campaign to combat...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its General Directorate of Forests and Rangelands, has executed a targeted field campaign to combat the pine processionary caterpillar in the Hebron and North Hebron governorates. Utilizing specialized insecticides, the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate treated both established forested areas and young saplings recently planted under the "Greening Palestine" initiative. This intervention is a critical component of the national strategy to protect conifer trees, which are highly susceptible to this Mediterranean pest. By limiting the spread of the caterpillar, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to safeguard forest growth, protect biodiversity, and ensure the long-term sustainability of the region's natural resources and forest cover.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its General Directorate of Forests and Rangelands

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has reached over 75% completion on a model livestock farm complex in Jubail, a key ini...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has reached over 75% completion on a model livestock farm complex in Jubail, a key initiative under the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef). Designed to align with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030, the facility features advanced infrastructure including specialized livestock barns, a veterinary clinic, sterilization units, and quarantine pens. By integrating modern technologies such as artificial insemination and breed improvement, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture aims to boost domestic meat production, enhance food self-sufficiency, and reduce dependence on imports. Beyond its technical capacity, the project supports the local economy by creating sustainable jobs, raising breeder incomes, and serving as a hub for research and development in sheep and goat farming.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has launched a rigorous initiative to reform the distribution of subsidized "S...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has launched a rigorous initiative to reform the distribution of subsidized "Sédari" wheat bran to combat monopolies and speculation, the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries emphasized the urgent need for a livestock traceability system to ensure feed reaches intended breeders based on updated field data. To enhance transparency, the ministry has ordered the Regional Agricultural Development Offices (CRDA) of Ben Arous and Ariana to submit detailed reports on quotas and beneficiaries for the 2024-2025 period. By reviewing allocation criteria and strengthening regional coordination, the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries aims to guarantee a fair supply chain and protect the national livestock sector from market manipulation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries
