records.title: Three ships carrying 70,000 tons of wheat arrived at the port of Tartous as part of a strategic effort by the General Establishment for G...
records.description: Three ships carrying 70,000 tons of wheat arrived at the port of Tartous as part of a strategic effort by the General Establishment for Grain and the Ministry of Economy and Industry to secure the local market's needs. These arrivals are part of a broader series of import contracts that have brought approximately 1.3 million tons of wheat into the country via 57 ships since the conclusion of major regional hostilities. By bolstering grain reserves and ensuring a consistent supply of flour for all governorates, the General Establishment for Grain aims to maintain national food security and stabilize the domestic market.

records.title: The AGRICULTURAL INVESTMENT PROMOTION AGENCY (APIA) has significantly bolstered the regional economy by approving 17 investment projects...
records.description: The AGRICULTURAL INVESTMENT PROMOTION AGENCY (APIA) has significantly bolstered the regional economy by approving 17 investment projects during the first quarter of 2026, totaling 2 million dinars and generating 22 new jobs. Within this framework, the commission recently greenlit funding for 10 specific agricultural initiatives valued at 830,000 dinars, complemented by 263,000 dinars in subsidies. These strategic allocations, which reached nearly 1 million dinars for the entire quarter, focus on the modernization of the sector through the acquisition of advanced agricultural equipment and the installation of solar power generation units to enhance energy sustainability.

records.title: The Algerian Investment Promotion Agency (AAPI) and Invest Oman Lounge have officially initiated a high-level strategic partnership via v...
records.description: The Algerian Investment Promotion Agency (AAPI) and Invest Oman Lounge have officially initiated a high-level strategic partnership via videoconference to accelerate bilateral investment and expertise sharing. This collaboration, co-chaired by the Directors General of both agencies, focuses on establishing a "technical backbone" for cross-border projects in high-priority sectors including agriculture, agri-food, pharmaceuticals, and manufacturing. By leveraging Oman’s successful one-stop-shop model and fully digitalized investment procedures, the two nations aim to streamline the realization of joint ventures. A joint technical team has been tasked with organizing exchange visits and workshops, culminating in a future Algerian-Omani Business Forum designed to connect official institutions, private sector actors, and employers' organizations from both countries.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Egyptian Space Agency has achieved a significant milestone in regional space cooperation with the successful launch of the ClimCam sp...
records.description: The Egyptian Space Agency has achieved a significant milestone in regional space cooperation with the successful launch of the ClimCam space camera to the International Space Station (ISS) as part of the Cygnus NG-24 mission. Developed in partnership with the Kenyan Space Agency and Uganda's space programme, the project utilizes an Earth observation system equipped with multispectral imaging and artificial intelligence to monitor extreme weather events, such as droughts and floods, in East Africa. Installed on the Bartolomeo platform operated by Airbus, ClimCam will provide critical data for climate monitoring and disaster response for one year. This mission, which emerged from a competition organized by the United Nations Office for Outer Space Affairs (UNOOSA), highlights the Egyptian Space Agency's commitment to advancing African space science and utilizing satellite technology to support sustainable development and agricultural productivity across the continent.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) has provided a $65 million construction bridging loan to Hassan Allam Utiliti...
records.description: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) has provided a $65 million construction bridging loan to Hassan Allam Utilities (HAU Energy) to develop a high-capacity renewable energy facility at the Benban Solar Park in Aswan. This project serves as a "technical backbone" for Egypt’s grid modernization, combining a 200 MW solar photovoltaic (PV) plant with a 120 MWh battery energy storage system (BESS). By integrating utility-scale storage, the facility addresses the intermittency of solar power, enhancing grid stability and offsetting 280,000 tonnes of $CO_2$ annually. Beyond infrastructure, the initiative includes a specialized technical cooperation package to establish nationally accredited green skills training programs, focusing on gender equality and equipping young jobseekers for leadership roles in Egypt's expanding low-carbon economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has officially launched the 2026 wheat procurement season, marking a significant push to...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has officially launched the 2026 wheat procurement season, marking a significant push toward national food self-sufficiency. Under the directive of the state leadership, the procurement price has been raised to EGP 2,500 per ardeb, with a guarantee that farmers will receive their financial dues within 48 hours. This season is characterized by a massive expansion in cultivation, with total planted areas reaching over 3.7 million feddans—a 600,000-feddan increase over the previous year. To manage this scale, the Ministry is deploying a "technical backbone" of improved seed varieties and mechanical harvesting support, aiming to collect 5 million tonnes of domestic wheat to bolster strategic reserves and narrow the import gap.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture has authorized a strategic opening of tomato imports as of late March 2026 to stabilize local markets f...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture has authorized a strategic opening of tomato imports as of late March 2026 to stabilize local markets following a significant price surge. Deputy Minister for Administrative Affairs, noted that while Iraq recently marketed over 500,000 tons of tomatoes from the Basra region (Safwan and Al-Zubair) between October 2025 and April 2026, a seasonal production gap in April necessitated external supply. Currently, tomato prices are holding between 1,750 and 2,250 IQD (wholesale) and 2,000 and 2,500 IQD (retail) per kilogram. This import window serves as a "technical fix" to bridge the gap until the next local harvest cycle begins at the end of April, which is expected to naturally drive down retail costs.

records.title: The Agricultural Credit Corporation (ACC) has rapidly scaled its financial support for the Jordanian agricultural sector in 2026, providi...
records.description: The Agricultural Credit Corporation (ACC) has rapidly scaled its financial support for the Jordanian agricultural sector in 2026, providing JD 10 million in loans to approximately 1,600 farmers in the first quarter alone. This is part of a broader annual target to extend JD 70 million in financing to over 10,000 beneficiaries. Under the modernization strategy, the ACC has introduced a new computerized system—currently in its pilot phase—to transition toward a full e-service model, ensuring faster delivery and higher accuracy. With a remarkable 96% repayment rate, the corporation is prioritizing the "technical backbone" of the industry by funding modern technologies, water-saving systems through the “Ardhi” programme, and rural agri-food industries at reduced interest rates.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has authorized a strategic OMR 50 million ($130 million) financial pac...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has authorized a strategic OMR 50 million ($130 million) financial package to safeguard the Sultanate’s food supply chain against regional instability. This emergency fund is specifically designed to buffer crop and livestock farmers against a 30% surge in the cost of seeds and equipment recorded over the last six weeks. By integrating this aid with the recently established food depots in Sohar, Oman is creating a resilient logistical corridor near the UAE border, effectively bypassing maritime conflict zones. This package serves as a critical "technical backbone" to the nation’s $13 billion 2020–2040 food security roadmap, ensuring that local production targets for meat and essential crops remain viable despite shifting global economic pressures.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Hebron Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Hebron Municipality's Sharek Community Center, has successfully conducted...
records.description: The Hebron Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Hebron Municipality's Sharek Community Center, has successfully conducted a specialized training workshop on "Tree Pruning and Grafting" for 35 rural Palestinian women. This initiative serves as a "technical backbone" for women’s economic empowerment, transitioning participants from traditional labor to skilled agricultural technicians. By mastering advanced pruning and grafting methods, these women are directly improving orchard productivity and field efficiency, which is vital for the resilience of local communities. This activity is a core component of the Ministry of Agriculture's broader strategy to foster a sustainable and inclusive agricultural sector through targeted capacity building and cooperative learning.

records.title: The Ramallah and Al-Bireh Directorate of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, has successfully completed the t...
records.description: The Ramallah and Al-Bireh Directorate of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, has successfully completed the technical handover of 11 new agricultural initiatives, bringing the total number of completed projects under the EU-funded assistance program to 36. Valued at approximately 475,000 shekels, these projects span several towns, including Deir Ibzi', Safa, Bil'in, Ras Karkar, and Sinjil. This initiative serves as a "technical backbone" for rural resilience by providing critical infrastructure such as water collection wells, sheep pens, and greenhouses, alongside the distribution of livestock, beehives, and essential farming tools. By combining asset provision with infrastructure development, the Ministry of Agriculture and the European Union are directly empowering local farmers to diversify their income, stabilize production, and ensure long-term sustainability across the governorate.
records.institution: The Ramallah and Al-Bireh Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Livestock Development has launched a consultative workshop in Nouakchott to develop a new strategy for the livestock sect...
records.description: The Ministry of Livestock Development has launched a consultative workshop in Nouakchott to develop a new strategy for the livestock sector in Mauritania's northern regions, emphasizing its role as a vital income source and a pillar of economic stability. The initiative aims to modernize the sector and achieve a sustainable structural transformation through coherent programming and effective budgetary implementation, addressing core challenges such as climate change, limited market access, and infrastructure gaps. Supported by the World Bank and the Sahel Pastoral System Support Project, the Ministry of Livestock Development seeks to integrate practical, innovative solutions from stakeholders and technicians to establish a more resilient and inclusive livestock framework by 2036.

records.title: Morocco’s grain and feed imports surged to 1.48 million mt in March 2026, marking a nine-month high as the country manages the tail end o...
records.description: Morocco’s grain and feed imports surged to 1.48 million mt in March 2026, marking a nine-month high as the country manages the tail end of a chronic production shortfall caused by successive years of drought. While the High Commission for Planning anticipates a robust recovery this year—projecting a harvest of 8 million to 9 million mt—the March data highlights an immediate and aggressive move by buyers to secure animal feed, with corn and soft wheat each nearing half a million tonnes. This strategic stockpiling serves as a "technical backbone" to the livestock sector, ensuring supply stability before a potential import ban from May to August, should the favorable April weather conditions confirm the expected domestic bumper crop.

records.title: The Dakhliyah Governorate has officially opened a tender for the construction and operation of a specialized fruit farm as part of the ma...
records.description: The Dakhliyah Governorate has officially opened a tender for the construction and operation of a specialized fruit farm as part of the massive Jabal Shams Grand Canyon View project in Al Hamra. This 9,830sqm agricultural investment is offered under a 25-year lease, serving as a "technical backbone" for the region's burgeoning agri-tourism sector by integrating fruit orchards and a dedicated coffee farm into a 148,000sqm mountain development. Situated at an altitude of 3,000 meters, the project combines modern agricultural production with adventure tourism—featuring a 97-meter glass walkway, ziplines, and a 500-seat theatre—to create a sustainable economic model. By providing 12 dedicated kiosks for selling fresh seasonal produce and traditional products, the initiative aims to strengthen the local supply chain and offer visitors an immersive cultural experience centered on Oman’s unique mountain agriculture.

records.title: The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine at Hama University inaugurated a specialized technical workshop focused on enhancing national capabili...
records.description: The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine at Hama University inaugurated a specialized technical workshop focused on enhancing national capabilities to combat foot-and-mouth disease and protecting regional livestock. Organized in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the ministry responsible for livestock affairs, the event aimed to raise technical preparedness by training veterinary personnel on the latest scientific methods for diagnosis, prevention, and rapid response. By fostering coordination between local and international bodies, the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine at Hama University seeks to modernize the veterinary system through continuous qualification programs, effectively limiting the spread of epidemic diseases and supporting the long-term stability of livestock production across various governorates.
records.institution: The Faculty of Veterinary Medicine at Hama University

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), is establishing a p...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), is establishing a pioneering research station in Idlib Governorate to serve as a "technical backbone" for agricultural resilience in northern Syria. This facility will focus on developing high-yielding, drought-tolerant varieties of wheat, barley, and sorghum, while simultaneously establishing a major nursery with a production capacity of one million seedlings annually, targeting olive, pistachio, and almond trees. Beyond plant production, the Ministry of Agriculture and ACSAD will implement advanced livestock programs, including genetic improvement for Awassi sheep and Shami goats, alongside a specialized center for embryo transfer in cattle. By integrating modern technologies like GIS and remote sensing into its training programs for farmers and engineers, the station aims to transform Idlib into a regional center for agricultural expertise, specifically addressing the challenges of land deterioration and climate change to secure long-term food stability.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Extension and Training, conducted a specialized central training cour...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Extension and Training, conducted a specialized central training course to enhance the technical proficiency of staff in managing tomato crops adapted to climate change. This initiative, part of a broader effort to disseminate modern agricultural technologies, focused on addressing salinity stress and its impact on production through scientific lectures and field applications at a demonstration plot. By training participants from various governorates in advanced cultivation methods and resource management, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to improve the professional performance of extension agents, ensuring the efficient implementation of programs that support national food security and climate resilience.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is accelerating the modernization of Baghdad's food safety infrastructure...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is accelerating the modernization of Baghdad's food safety infrastructure by preparing the Al-Fadhiliya government slaughterhouse for reopening. This initiative serves as a "technical backbone" to combat unregulated and unsanitary slaughtering practices, ensuring that meat production aligns with the latest health and technical standards under the Law Regulating the Slaughter of Animals No. 22 of 1972. Following an intensive field audit by a specialized technical committee, the facility is set to operate via a public-private partnership, a strategic move designed to encourage investment in modern slaughterhouse facilities. By addressing the current shortage of licensed sites, the Ministry of Agriculture is directly strengthening Iraq's public health system and enhancing national food security through regulated, civilized, and hygienic production cycles.

records.title: The General Directorate of Agricultural Wealth, Fisheries, and Water Resources in Al Dhahirah Governorate is overseeing a major expansion...
records.description: The General Directorate of Agricultural Wealth, Fisheries, and Water Resources in Al Dhahirah Governorate is overseeing a major expansion of the regional "technical backbone" for food security, with over 50 active investment projects valued at more than RO 50 million. Covering approximately 9,000 acres, these initiatives are strategically diversified across field crops like wheat, high-value fruits such as date palms and grapes, and advanced greenhouse cultivation for garlic and onions. The livestock sector is simultaneously being modernized through large-scale red meat and dairy production facilities utilizing calf fattening and efficient breeding methods. To further accelerate these goals, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources is leveraging the Tatweer platform to offer 30 additional investment opportunities in 2026, focusing on the utilization of dam sediments and the localization of the "second billion" to achieve national self-sufficiency and sustainable development.
records.institution: The General Directorate of Agricultural Wealth, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a major infrastructure project in Fins village, Wilayat of Quriya...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a major infrastructure project in Fins village, Wilayat of Quriyat, with the construction of a new Fish Landing Centre valued at RO 3 million. This "technical backbone" for the Muscat Governorate’s maritime sector is designed to modernize landing operations and improve the safety and efficiency of local artisanal fishing. Key components of the project include the installation of robust breakwaters, a dedicated boat slipway, and a 10,000-square-meter investment zone earmarked for fisheries-related industries. With a projected completion date of mid-2027, the facility will integrate essential utility networks and internal roads, creating a stabilized hub for local economic activity and reinforcing national food security through improved fisheries management.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has successfully completed the maintenance and restoration of 34 falaj systems...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has successfully completed the maintenance and restoration of 34 falaj systems and water springs across the Sultanate of Oman during the first quarter of 2026. This "technical backbone" of traditional Omani irrigation is being preserved through a nationwide effort by the Directorate General of Water Resources Management, with completed projects spanning from Musandam (4 projects) to Dhofar (4 projects), and significant concentrations in Al Buraimi, North A’Sharqiyah, and South A’Sharqiyah. Beyond the completed works, the Ministry has already initiated new maintenance phases for additional systems in governorates like A’Dakhiliyah and Muscat, ensuring that these heritage water networks continue to provide the consistent irrigation necessary for national food security and the sustainability of rural agricultural lands.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment,...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, recently conducted a specialized field day in the Jouf region centered on the optimization of seasonal fodder. This initiative, part of the broader fodder localization project, serves as a "technical backbone" for the Kingdom’s livestock sector by introducing advanced cultivation methods and precision harvesting and baling techniques. By integrating scientific presentations with practical field applications, Estidamah is focused on improving production efficiency and reducing resource loss, while simultaneously strengthening local supply chains. This regional engagement follows the center's recent participation in the Qatar International Agricultural Exhibition, reinforcing its commitment to knowledge transfer, resource efficiency, and the deployment of field-based research to bolster national food security
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Agriculture Sector Office in Dhamar Governorate has launched a summer agricultural program titled “The Green Army,” designed to integ...
records.description: The Agriculture Sector Office in Dhamar Governorate has launched a summer agricultural program titled “The Green Army,” designed to integrate environmental stewardship with youth education. By distributing diverse seedlings across various districts for planting in summer center yards, the Agriculture Sector Office aims to expand green spaces while fostering a generational connection to the land and raising awareness of the sector's role in the national economy. The initiative seeks to transform educational facilities into productive environmental models that reflect the region's agricultural identity, investing in the current season to enhance the aesthetic and ecological quality of community environments through active student participation.
records.institution: The Agriculture Sector Office in Dhamar Governorate

records.title: The Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply has implemented a strategic price reduction for flour and wheat for April 2026, a move designe...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply has implemented a strategic price reduction for flour and wheat for April 2026, a move designed to stabilize the "technical backbone" of Jordan's food security during a period of rising global production costs. By lowering the price of unified flour by JD 7.797 per tonne and wheat by JD 6.083 per tonne, the government is directly intervening to protect the fixed price of Arabic bread, an essential staple. This regular review of production costs ensures that bakeries remain operationally viable while shielding citizens from the financial burden of market volatility, maintaining a steady and affordable national supply chain in line with Cabinet policies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply

records.title: The Libyan Agricultural Investment Company (LAICo) has entered into a strategic Memorandum of Understanding with the Azerbaijani firm Sis...
records.description: The Libyan Agricultural Investment Company (LAICo) has entered into a strategic Memorandum of Understanding with the Azerbaijani firm Sisan Agricultural Production, Livestock Development, and Related Industries Company to facilitate foreign entry into the domestic market and diversify national income sources. This partnership establishes a framework for technical cooperation and preliminary arrangements for large-scale initiatives, specifically the Zliten Agricultural Project and the Tawergha Agricultural Project, which will undergo comprehensive technical studies and organizational planning. By leveraging Libya's fertile land, diverse geography, and proximity to maritime ports, the Libyan Agricultural Investment Company (LAICo) aims to implement advanced investment projects across the agricultural and livestock sectors, aligning with broader state directives to enhance food security and industrialize related agricultural industries through modernized legislative support for foreign investors.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Sultanate of Oman has become the 32nd country to join Japan’s Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM), signing a strategic cooperation memora...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman has become the 32nd country to join Japan’s Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM), signing a strategic cooperation memorandum as of April 2026. This partnership establishes a formal "technical backbone" for bilateral decarbonization, allowing Oman to adopt advanced Japanese low-carbon technologies and infrastructure while generating carbon credits. These credits, derived from greenhouse gas removals or reductions, will be shared between both nations to meet their respective Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) under the Paris Agreement. By leveraging Article 6.2 guidance to avoid double counting, the agreement transforms carbon reduction into a practical engine for sustainable development, combining technological diffusion with rigorous capacity-building support for Omani institutions.

records.title: The Qassim Region is undergoing a high-tech agricultural evolution, successfully scaling mulberry and berry cultivation from experimental...
records.description: The Qassim Region is undergoing a high-tech agricultural evolution, successfully scaling mulberry and berry cultivation from experimental greenhouses into a robust economic sector that rivals international imports. Under the strategic framework of Saudi Vision 2030, the region has leveraged its distinct soil conditions to become a national hub for black, white, red, and blue berry varieties. Modern farms, particularly in Unaizah, are now recording annual yields of approximately 40 tons, supported by a "technical backbone" of closed-loop greenhouses, solar energy, and precision climate-control systems. By utilizing advanced drip irrigation to navigate water scarcity and extreme heat, these projects have created a scalable model for technology-driven farming that reduces import reliance and strengthens the Kingdom’s food security and global competitiveness.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Sharjah Waste to Energy Facility has reached a massive operational milestone, processing 1,000,000 tonnes of waste since its 2022 ina...
records.description: The Sharjah Waste to Energy Facility has reached a massive operational milestone, processing 1,000,000 tonnes of waste since its 2022 inauguration. This facility, a joint venture between BEEAH and Tadweer Group, serves as the "technical backbone" of Sharjah’s circular economy, enabling a record 93% landfill diversion rate. By converting residual, hard-to-recycle waste into 30MW of low-carbon electricity, the plant currently powers 28,000 homes while offsetting 450,000 tonnes of $CO_2$ annually. As the project advances into Phase 2, these figures are set to double, raising output to 60MW and processing capacity to 600,000 tonnes per year, further solidifying the UAE’s path toward its Net Zero 2050 ambitions.
records.institution: The Sharjah Waste to Energy Facility

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has officially launched the "supplier credit" mechanism in Algiers, a strate...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has officially launched the "supplier credit" mechanism in Algiers, a strategic financial tool designed to provide low-income farmers with immediate access to plant protection products without upfront payment. Chaired by Minister Yacine El-Mahdi Oualid, the initiative is a critical component of the cereal sector development program for the 2025-2026 season, aiming to mitigate phytosanitary hazards that threaten up to 40% of annual crop yields. This "technical backbone" of the campaign is supported by the deployment of high-tech solutions, including the first-ever use of drones for crop monitoring and precision fertilization, alongside an additional 50% allocation of nitrogen fertilizers. By establishing post-sowing monitoring units and providing specialized training to over 3,800 farmers, the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries is fostering a scientific approach to yield optimization, while simultaneously accelerating the national mechanization program to prepare for a high-capacity harvest.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) is rapidly transforming into a global hub for phosphate-based industrialization, with the Polyserve...
records.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) is rapidly transforming into a global hub for phosphate-based industrialization, with the Polyserve Group announcing a $215 million phosphate chemicals project in the Sokhna Industrial Zone. Spanning 650,000 square metres, the facility will be developed under a new joint stock company, Nile Ferchem—a venture between Ferchem Masr (60%) and Polyserve (30%)—aimed at producing up to 3.5 million tonnes of phosphate fertilizers and phosphoric acid annually. This project, which integrates phosphate extraction and concentration in partnership with the Egyptian Company for Mineral Resources (ECMR), is part of a massive wave of recent investments in Sokhna, including Indorama’s $525 million partnership with Misr Phosphate and China’s CJN $1 billion integrated complex. Together, these initiatives establish a high-capacity "technical backbone" for Egypt’s fertilizer industry, leveraging the zone’s logistical advantages to create over 500 direct jobs and boost national export potential.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, has launched a strategic campaign to divide beehives at the Al-Mans...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, has launched a strategic campaign to divide beehives at the Al-Mansouriya Apiary as part of a modernized scientific partnership with national academic institutions. This initiative, supervised by the Plant Protection Department, is designed to provide agricultural colleges with advanced apiary models to serve as a "technical backbone" for practical research and specialized studies in honey production. By aligning with the Prime Minister's initiative to bridge the gap between state institutions and universities, the Ministry of Agriculture seeks to integrate academic outputs with field realities, ensuring that the next generation of specialists can contribute to sustainable agricultural development through high-efficiency beekeeping and scientific innovation.

records.title: AgriMaroc has announced a major update to its digital Phytosanitary Index, a sophisticated "technical backbone" designed to streamline de...
records.description: AgriMaroc has announced a major update to its digital Phytosanitary Index, a sophisticated "technical backbone" designed to streamline decision-making for farmers and agronomists across Morocco. Updated by ONSSA (the National Food Safety Office), this centralized index provides real-time access to authorized plant protection solutions, specifically tailored for the vegetable, fruit, and field crop sectors. By reflecting the latest registration changes, product withdrawals, and new chemical approvals, the tool enables technicians to develop more coherent protection strategies that align with both regulatory constraints and evolving pest pressures. This digital modernization by AgriMaroc aims to eliminate errors in technical selection, optimize treatment effectiveness, and professionalize farm-level plant health management to ensure safer and more efficient agricultural production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with CIHEAM Bari, has officially delivered six pioneering projects specializing in the produc...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with CIHEAM Bari, has officially delivered six pioneering projects specializing in the production of alternative animal feed in the Dura area, south of Hebron. Valued at 170,000 shekels, these grants are part of the SANET (Supporting the Agricultural and Food Cooperation Network in Palestine) project, funded by the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS) and implemented in cooperation with the Palestinian Employment Fund. The initiative serves as a "technical backbone" for the local livestock sector by providing advanced equipment for the onsite preparation of feed, directly reducing the operational costs for breeders and decreasing reliance on expensive imported supplies. By focusing on the development of value chains and improving the nutritional quality of local products, the Ministry of Agriculture and its international partners are enhancing the competitiveness of national livestock and strengthening the overall food security system in Palestine.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Saudi Arabia has emerged as a global frontrunner in the energy transition, recording a staggering 87% year-on-year increase in renewable...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has emerged as a global frontrunner in the energy transition, recording a staggering 87% year-on-year increase in renewable capacity to reach 12,332 MW in 2025. According to the IRENA ‘Renewable Capacity Statistics 2026’ report, this "technical backbone" of the Kingdom's Vision 2030 was almost exclusively driven by solar photovoltaic (PV) additions, which alone accounted for 97% of the growth. With the share of renewables in the national power mix nearly doubling from 6.9% to 12.6% in a single year, the Saudi Power Procurement Company (SPPC) is now accelerating into 2026 with plans to award an additional 14 GW of capacity across solar and wind projects, including the massive Round 7 tenders.

records.title: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has officially activated the appointment booking service through the “Mahsoli” platform to fac...
records.description: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has officially activated the appointment booking service through the “Mahsoli” platform to facilitate the reception of local wheat for the current agricultural season. Operating in coordination with the National Grains Supply Company (SABIL), the initiative streamlines the supply process at various regional branches for eligible farmers in Riyadh, the Eastern Province, and Qassim. To enhance operational efficiency, the General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has modernized its electronic services, allowing farmers to verify data and manage logistics digitally, while the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture provides the necessary licensing to ensure that the reception of domestic grain aligns with national food security and sustainability standards.

records.title: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has launched a strategic digital awareness campaign, positioning water as a...
records.description: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has launched a strategic digital awareness campaign, positioning water as a "fundamental pillar" for the Kingdom’s development and long-term quality of life. This initiative is a core component of MAEE’s broader mandate to unify water conservation efforts across the urban, agricultural, and industrial sectors. By providing practical, knowledge-based guidance, the campaign aims to shift societal behaviors toward conscious consumption and sustainability. These efforts are directly aligned with Saudi Vision 2030 and the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), emphasizing that the "technical backbone" of water sustainability relies as much on individual behavioral correction as it does on large-scale infrastructure and industrial efficiency.
records.institution: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The United Arab Emirates has bolstered its "technical backbone" for the energy transition, achieving a 15.4% year-on-year increase in ren...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates has bolstered its "technical backbone" for the energy transition, achieving a 15.4% year-on-year increase in renewable capacity to reach 7,907 MW in 2025. According to the IRENA ‘Renewable Capacity Statistics 2026’ report, this growth was anchored by the addition of over 1,000 MW of solar PV, which now represents the vast majority of the nation's clean energy portfolio. A strategic milestone in 2025 was the UAE's entry into long-duration energy storage with the commissioning of 250 MW of pumped hydro capacity, a critical move to ensure grid stability as intermittent solar penetration rises. These advancements directly support the UAE Energy Strategy 2050, which aims to triple the contribution of renewable energy over the next decade.

records.title: The 23rd edition of the Djazagro professional agri-food production fair will convene at the Palais des Expositions in Algiers, featuring...
records.description: The 23rd edition of the Djazagro professional agri-food production fair will convene at the Palais des Expositions in Algiers, featuring a significant mobilization of over 600 national and foreign exhibitors from 28 countries. This industrial event serves as a critical "technical backbone" for the region, showcasing advanced agri-food equipment, processing solutions, and packaging technologies from prominent international pavilions including Italy, Turkey, China, and Germany. With a strong turnout of more than 150 Algerian companies and over 26,000 professional visitors expected, the fair prioritizes innovation through the "Djaz'Innov" competition and a series of technical workshops focused on food security, green innovation, and export growth. By facilitating direct interactions between producers and industrialists, Djazagro aims to modernize conditioning and packaging standards, ultimately enhancing the competitiveness of local agricultural products in global markets.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has finalized a landmark cooperation agreement with Mauritania, granting Alg...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has finalized a landmark cooperation agreement with Mauritania, granting Algerian vessels direct access to Mauritanian fishing zones through the issuance of formal fishing and exploitation permits. Signed during the 20th session of the Algerian-Mauritanian Joint High Commission, the agreement establishes a "technical backbone" for regional maritime growth by implementing a comprehensive protocol focused on fisheries, the maritime economy, and aquaculture. Beyond resource extraction, the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries aims to strengthen scientific cooperation between the two nations, fostering joint research in aquaculture and sustainable maritime infrastructure to enhance food security and industrial integration across the Maghreb.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: Despite maintaining its status as the world’s leading orange exporter, Egypt’s citrus industry is currently navigating a complex "technic...
records.description: Despite maintaining its status as the world’s leading orange exporter, Egypt’s citrus industry is currently navigating a complex "technical backbone" of geopolitical and logistical hurdles. Disrupted Red Sea shipping routes have forced a shift to the Cape of Good Hope route, adding up to 20 days to transit times and inflating insurance premiums by approximately US$4,000 per container. To mitigate the risk of European market saturation and price-cutting, Egypt is strategically pivoting toward the food processing sector, with plans to open six new factories in 2026 to convert fresh surplus into juice concentrate, essential oils, and dried products. By prioritizing resilient Valencia oranges, advanced refrigerated containers, and streamlined port exemptions, Egyptian authorities and exporters are transforming logistical constraints into an opportunity to modernize the value chain and protect national agricultural revenue.

records.title: The Red Sea Ports Authority continues to serve as a critical "technical backbone" for regional food logistics, recently handling 21,000 t...
records.description: The Red Sea Ports Authority continues to serve as a critical "technical backbone" for regional food logistics, recently handling 21,000 tonnes of cargo, 622 trucks, and 10 vessels across its network. Export activity significantly outperformed imports, with outbound shipments reaching 92,000 tonnes in one reporting period, highlighting Egypt’s dominant role as a net exporter of agricultural produce to Middle Eastern and African markets. Nuweiba Port in South Sinai has emerged as a particularly vital hub, utilizing frequent shuttle voyages and roll-on, roll-off connections to facilitate the efficient movement of perishable goods like fresh fruits, vegetables, and chilled meats. By maintaining high-frequency vessel traffic and streamlined cargo flows, the Red Sea Ports Authority provides the essential infrastructure and operational transparency required for food logistics investors to manage time-sensitive supply chains effectively.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has announced a qualitative breakthrough in the cultivation of internat...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has announced a qualitative breakthrough in the cultivation of international olive varieties at the Najaf Specialized Nursery. Under the National Program for the Propagation of Fruit and Olive Varieties, the ministry has successfully established elite economic varieties—including Arbequina, Picual, Frontio, and Surani—which have demonstrated high efficiency and adaptability to Iraq’s specific climatic conditions since their planting in 2020. This "technical backbone" project aims to diversify Iraq’s agricultural output by supplying citizens with high-yield, subsidized seedlings to expand the national cultivated area. By successfully transitioning these varieties from experimental to flowering stages, the Ministry of Agriculture is securing a sustainable foundation for local olive oil and table olive production, strengthening national food security through modern horticulture.

records.title: The Mokhalad Group has significantly expanded its industrial footprint in Iraq’s agribusiness sector by signing a third agreement with th...
records.description: The Mokhalad Group has significantly expanded its industrial footprint in Iraq’s agribusiness sector by signing a third agreement with the Turkish manufacturer Imas to construct another state-of-the-art flour mill. This partnership establishes a robust "technical backbone" for Iraq’s food security, with three separate 500-ton-per-day (TPD) projects concentrated in regions like Tikrit. Once the second and third mills are commissioned by the end of 2026, the combined infrastructure will possess an annual wheat-processing capacity of 500,000 tonnes. By integrating the latest Turkish automation and engineering technologies, the Mokhalad Group is effectively localizing flour production, reducing dependency on imports, and stabilizing the supply of bakery and all-purpose flour for the domestic market amid global grain price volatility.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has officially launched the potato harvest season in Akkar, a region identified as a primary pillar of nation...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has officially launched the potato harvest season in Akkar, a region identified as a primary pillar of national food security, particularly as structural challenges and recent regional conflicts have impacted over 20% of the country's agricultural land. To stabilize the "technical backbone" of the sector, the Ministry of Agriculture is overseeing the production of approximately 70,000 tons of potatoes from 20,000 dunams, while simultaneously managing a massive network of 65,000 greenhouses and significant livestock assets. Key strategic interventions include the expansion of a "Farmers' Registry" that tracks over 80,000 producers for better traceability, the distribution of 1.5 million improved seedlings, and the promotion of contract farming to shorten value chains and connect farmers directly to markets. By prioritizing smart agriculture and modernizing distribution, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to ensure price stability for consumers and a fair income for producers, reinforcing Akkar's role as a resilient hub for Lebanon's continuous food supply.

records.title: Morocco has solidified its position as the primary supplier of cucumbers to Spain, capturing an overwhelming 71.71% of the Spanish import...
records.description: Morocco has solidified its position as the primary supplier of cucumbers to Spain, capturing an overwhelming 71.71% of the Spanish import market in 2025. According to data from Hortoinfo, Moroccan cucumber exports reached 18.24 million kilograms, generating approximately €21.1 million at an average price of €1.16 per kilogram. This "technical backbone" of trade is part of a broader decade-long surge, during which Spanish cucumber imports grew by 248%. Logistically, the integration is deepening as over 50% of these volumes transit through the province of Almería, serving as a redistribution hub for the wider European market. This growth highlights the increased competitiveness of Moroccan greenhouse crops and the strategic role the Kingdom plays in providing seasonal complementarity to the Iberian horticultural sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reached a 47% completion rate on the Wadi Adai Dam project, a strategic co...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reached a 47% completion rate on the Wadi Adai Dam project, a strategic cornerstone of Muscat’s flood protection system. During an inspection visit by the Wali of Mutrah, officials detailed the dam’s "technical backbone," which includes a significant storage capacity of 23 million cubic metres. This infrastructure is specifically engineered to mitigate flood risks for residential and commercial districts, protecting essential road networks and utility services from extreme weather events. Once fully operational, the Wadi Adai Dam will integrate into the broader Muscat governorate safety network, enhancing public safety and supporting long-term sustainable water resource management in the Sultanate.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reported a significant acceleration in the "technical backbone" of Oman's...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reported a significant acceleration in the "technical backbone" of Oman's wheat sector for the 2025/2026 harvest season. Under the Wheat Cultivation Expansion Project (2023–2027), the Sultanate is moving to reduce its 350,000-tonne annual requirement gap by incentivizing local production through a government purchase price of RO 500 per tonne. This strategic push is most evident in the Najd region of Dhofar, where cultivated land now exceeds 6,400 acres, and in Al Mudhaibi. While the sector saw a 9.1% growth in its GDP contribution by late 2025, the government maintains a dual model: boosting domestic yields via high-yield varieties and smart technologies while leveraging the silo capacities of Oman Flour Mills and Salalah Mills to manage a total import and re-export volume of roughly 900,000 tonnes.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Jerusalem Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Jerusalem Affairs,...
records.description: The Jerusalem Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Jerusalem Affairs, has completed the distribution of towed water tanks to livestock breeders as a key component of the "Sumud" project. Funded by the Bayt Mal Al-Quds Al-Sharif Agency and implemented by the Land Research Center, this initiative provides a critical "technical backbone" for water security in marginalized communities such as Al-Muntar, Abu Hindi, and Al-Jib. By delivering nine of the fifteen allocated tanks, along with veterinary kits and almond seedlings, the project strengthens the operational resilience of Jerusalemite families, ensuring the sustainability of livestock production and enhancing food security in areas facing significant environmental and logistical threats.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced a landmark achievement in Palestinian agribusiness with the official accreditation of agricultu...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced a landmark achievement in Palestinian agribusiness with the official accreditation of agricultural products for the Saudi Arabian market. This "technical backbone" of trade was established after the Ministry of Agriculture finalized all phytosanitary certifications and procedural requirements in compliance with Saudi quality standards. Minister Rizq Salimiya confirmed that the first shipment, consisting of lemons from the Qalqilya Governorate, is prepared for export via the Jordanian-Palestinian Company. By securing this high-value marketing channel, which benefits from short shipping durations to preserve fruit integrity, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to bolster the economic resilience of Palestinian farmers and provide a sustainable outlet for the nation's premium citrus and vegetable produce.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has significantly scaled its national response to the foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) type SAT1, reporting that...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has significantly scaled its national response to the foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) type SAT1, reporting that 13,067 dairy cows have been successfully vaccinated as of April 8, 2026. This "technical backbone" of the livestock defense strategy involves a massive mobilization across the Northern Governorates, with Nablus (1,417 head), Tulkarm (1,000 head), and Salfit (599 head) seeing rapid deployment. The campaign, which was initiated in Hebron, has now covered nearly 9,000 head in the southern districts alone, including Dura and Yatta. By combining intensive field vaccinations with strengthened epidemiological investigations and biosecurity awareness, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to complete the first phase of total herd immunization, ensuring the stability of national dairy production and the resilience of the rural economy.

records.title: The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Land Research Center, has distributed 3,000 fruit saplings to farmers i...
records.description: The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Land Research Center, has distributed 3,000 fruit saplings to farmers in Beit al-Roush al-Fouqa, marking the final phase of the Land, Water, and Agricultural Roads Investment Project. This initiative provides a critical "technical backbone" for the region's reclaimed lands by supplying high-quality varieties of olives, citrus, grapes, almonds, and figs, specifically selected to match the town's unique soil and environmental conditions. By integrating technical guidance with the provision of resilient saplings, the South Hebron Agriculture Directorate aims to maximize the productivity of newly rehabilitated areas, strengthening the economic resilience of rural families and ensuring the sustainable utilization of local water and land resources in the southern Hebron hills.

records.title: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FA...
records.description: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed strategic investment agreements totaling 852,944 NIS to modernize the regional food system. These agreements, part of the Multi-Donor Agricultural Action Programme (MAP II), establish a critical "technical backbone" for market-oriented growth by funding diverse projects including the establishment of a feed mill, a vineyard, and the technical development of vegetable and fruit farms. Supported by a cost-sharing model where the MAP II program contributes 379,833 NIS alongside 473,110 NIS from local beneficiaries, the initiative focuses on improving water well efficiency and increasing market access for farmers. Funded by a coalition including Denmark, Switzerland, Spain, the European Union, and Italy, the Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture aims to utilize these targeted interventions to enhance productivity and strengthen the economic resilience of agricultural families on their land.
records.institution: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: AlUla Governorate is undergoing a strategic agricultural transformation with the expansion of saffron cultivation trials, a high-value in...
records.description: AlUla Governorate is undergoing a strategic agricultural transformation with the expansion of saffron cultivation trials, a high-value initiative designed to leverage the region’s unique micro-climate and volcanic soil. Under the Kingdom’s saffron localization project, led by the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), AlUla has successfully produced premium-grade "Saudi Saffron" that meets rigorous ISO 3632 international standards. This "technical backbone" for luxury spice production is built on an integrated support system—managed by Estidamah—which provides local farmers with specialized training in soil preparation, specialized bulb (corm) management, and delicate harvesting techniques. By transitioning from traditional crops to this "red gold," AlUla is enhancing its agricultural sustainability and establishing a new, high-margin economic pillar in line with national diversification goals.

records.title: The Saudi Irrigation Organization has reported a massive influx of over 4.6 million cubic meters of floodwater into the Al-Baha region’s...
records.description: The Saudi Irrigation Organization has reported a massive influx of over 4.6 million cubic meters of floodwater into the Al-Baha region’s dam network following heavy rainfall between March 19 and April 6, 2026. This "technical backbone" of water infrastructure, comprising 50 dams across the Sarat and Tihama sectors, saw several facilities—including the Dharak, Al-Mazlimat, and Jarab dams—reach 100% capacity. Managed through controlled gate discharges and emergency protocols, the surge has significantly bolstered the region’s water security. Out of the 50 dams, 35 are strategically utilized for groundwater recharge, while 6 are dedicated to drinking water, providing a vital resource for Al-Baha’s agricultural sector, which remains heavily dependent on seasonal runoff for long-term sustainability.

records.title: Cabinet Secretariat Holds Workshop on Five-Year Strategic Plan (2026–2030)
records.description: The General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers has initiated a high-level workshop to develop the frameworks for the national five-year strategic plan (2026–2030), a key component of the “Government of Hope” reconstruction efforts. This strategic roadmap prioritizes the transition toward a more resilient state through comprehensive national development, digital transformation, and good governance. A central feature of the plan is the generation of real revenue through productive sectors—specifically agriculture, livestock, and mining—to create sustainable employment and support local communities. By emphasizing integrated strategies and cross-institutional coordination, the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers aims to reposition development projects nationwide, ensuring that reconstruction is paired with sustainable peace and improved executive performance across both service and productive industries.
records.institution: The General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers

records.description: The General Commission for Agricultural Scientific Research, in partnership with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), has launched a specialized workshop in Damascus focused on the "technical backbone" of regional climate adaptation: Rainwater Harvesting. Attended by Minister of Agriculture Dr. Amjad Badr, the event serves as a high-level scientific platform to address water scarcity and food security through the optimization of surface runoff. A key highlight of the initiative is ACSAD’s integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems and water accounting—previously tested in the West Maskana project—to advance the design and maintenance of harvesting infrastructure. The program includes technical sessions on drought mitigation and a practical field training phase at the Beit Tima Research Station, aiming to bridge the national water gap by expanding cultivated areas through modern hydrological engineering.

records.description: The Rural Women's Products Market, hosted at the Quneitra Agriculture Directorate, serves as a vital "technical backbone" for the local artisanal economy by providing a dedicated platform for small-scale rural producers. This initiative, managed by the Quneitra Agriculture Directorate, is specifically designed to empower rural women by transforming traditional household skills into sustainable income streams. By showcasing high-quality, handcrafted goods—ranging from traditional processed foods to artisanal crafts—the market bridges the gap between rural producers and urban consumers, fostering economic resilience and social stability within the Quneitra community.

records.title: UNS Vertical Farms, a subsidiary of the UAE-based Speedex Group, has launched a state-of-the-art 10,000-square-metre high-tech tomato fac...
records.description: UNS Vertical Farms, a subsidiary of the UAE-based Speedex Group, has launched a state-of-the-art 10,000-square-metre high-tech tomato facility in Al Ain, marking a significant milestone in the UAE's pursuit of food self-sufficiency. This "technical backbone" of modern desert farming leverages Controlled-Environment Agriculture (CEA), combining hydroponics with AI, IoT, and data-driven systems to produce 150,000 kilograms of premium, non-GMO tomatoes annually. By operating independently of the region's arid climate and extreme heat, the facility reduces water consumption by up to 90% compared to traditional methods. With a direct-to-consumer (D2C) model ensuring delivery within 24 to 48 hours of harvest, UNS Vertical Farms is actively advancing the UAE National Food Security Strategy 2051 and Net Zero 2050 goals through high-precision, pesticide-free local production.

records.title: The Directorate of Local Agricultural Services (DSA) has announced a record-breaking olive campaign, with production reaching 12,615,504...
records.description: The Directorate of Local Agricultural Services (DSA) has announced a record-breaking olive campaign, with production reaching 12,615,504 liters of oil—more than double the previous year's output. This "technical backbone" of the region's economy was supported by the processing of 776,339 quintals of olives harvested across 31,138 hectares, achieving an exceptional fruit yield of 25.1 qx/ha. Despite climatic challenges that affected oil content during the lipogenesis phase and rainy episodes that delayed harvesting, the Directorate of Local Agricultural Services (DSA) successfully bolstered industrial capacity through the commissioning of four new modern oil mills. This brings the total infrastructure to 337 units, including 126 modern continuous chain mills acquired through state-subsidized loans, ensuring that the wilaya can handle the massive increase in volume while modernizing processing efficiency.
records.institution: The Directorate of Local Agricultural Services (DSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has announced that the National Veal Project has surpassed EGP 10.408 billion in total d...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has announced that the National Veal Project has surpassed EGP 10.408 billion in total disbursed financing, establishing a massive "technical backbone" for Egypt’s animal protein supply. This strategic initiative has benefited 45,575 small-scale breeders and young graduates, supporting the rearing and fattening of over 517,580 head of livestock, including high-yield dairy heifers and meat-producing calves. Under the umbrella of the "Decent Life" presidential initiative, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation recently approved an additional EGP 57.32 million in funding to further stabilize domestic meat and milk prices. To ensure project sustainability, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation—in coordination with the Agricultural Bank of Egypt and the National Bank of Egypt—conducts regular field inspections and provides preferential insurance through the Livestock Insurance Fund, aiming to create rural employment and modernize the productivity of smallholder barns across the country.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) has overseen a robust period of agricultural trade, facilitating the export of 230,000 tons of...
records.description: The National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) has overseen a robust period of agricultural trade, facilitating the export of 230,000 tons of food products across 186 countries. This "technical backbone" of Egypt's trade sector was supported by 1,400 companies and involved 5,065 consignments handled through major logistics hubs like Damietta, Safaga, and Alexandria ports. Fruit exports led the performance with 70,000 tons, driven primarily by 45,000 tons of citrus and 20,000 tons of strawberries, while vegetable exports reached 55,000 tons, with potatoes as the primary commodity. To ensure international compliance and market confidence, the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) issued 1,375 health certificates and 3,218 export permits, reinforcing Egypt’s status as a top supplier to key markets including Saudi Arabia, Russia, and the Netherlands.

records.title: Imas, a Turkish manufacturer of grain and feed milling technologies, has reinforced its presence in the Iraqi milling sector by signing a...
records.description: Imas, a Turkish manufacturer of grain and feed milling technologies, has reinforced its presence in the Iraqi milling sector by signing a third agreement with the Mokhalad Group to construct a new flour mill. This project follows two previous agreements, bringing the total number of facilities developed for the group to three, each with a daily capacity of 500 tonnes (TPD). Combined, these projects represent an annual wheat processing capacity of approximately 500,000 tonnes, serving as a critical "technical backbone" for Iraq's domestic food supply. The initial plant in Tikrit utilizes two independent 250 TPD milling units and features full automation, centralized process management, and remote connectivity. With the new projects expected to be commissioned by the end of the year, Imas and the Mokhalad Group are significantly expanding the availability of bakery and all-purpose flour for the local market, driving industrial growth and reducing reliance on imported finished products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced the active implementation of its 2026 water harvesting plan, targeting the construction and mai...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced the active implementation of its 2026 water harvesting plan, targeting the construction and maintenance of 40 sites with a total capacity of 1.5 million cubic meters. Executed in collaboration with the Jordan Valley Authority, this initiative serves as a critical "technical backbone" for Jordan's water security, specifically focusing on the collection and storage of rainwater in the Badia and Southern Ghor regions. According to the Ministry of Agriculture, these facilities provide a sustainable water source for livestock breeders, reducing production costs while supporting supplemental irrigation in Wadi Araba without depleting traditional reserves. Beyond agricultural support, the plan prioritizes environmental resilience by facilitating groundwater recharge and mitigating flood risks during intense storms. With recent rainfall already filling many of these facilities, the Ministry of Agriculture is emphasizing the importance of specialized technical maintenance and community involvement to ensure these vital assets continue to strengthen the national water reserve and support national food security.

records.title: The Misrata Municipality, Misrata Free Zone (MFZ), and TotalEnergies have entered the critical pre-development phase for the 500 MW Sadad...
records.description: The Misrata Municipality, Misrata Free Zone (MFZ), and TotalEnergies have entered the critical pre-development phase for the 500 MW Sadada solar photovoltaic (PV) project, set to become Libya’s largest utility-scale renewable energy asset. Developed in partnership with the Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAOL) and GECOL, this "technical backbone" project is currently undergoing geotechnical investigations, soil testing, and spatial mapping to prepare for field mobilization. With a Final Investment Decision (FID) expected by the end of 2026, the Sadada plant is designed to serve as a strategic benchmark for Libya’s energy transition—moving the nation beyond its current minimal capacity of 9 MW—while pioneering a domestic solar supply chain and establishing new technical standards for future large-scale renewable developments in the region.
records.institution: The Misrata Municipality, Misrata Free Zone (MFZ)

records.title: The private sector solar provider Zadco has achieved a significant milestone by launching Libya’s first solar-powered single-pivot agricu...
records.description: The private sector solar provider Zadco has achieved a significant milestone by launching Libya’s first solar-powered single-pivot agricultural irrigation system in the southern region. This off-grid "technical backbone" utilizes high-tier components, including JA Solar panels and 75-horsepower submersible pumps, to power a pivot irrigation circle covering 50 hectares. The infrastructure features a sophisticated array of Italian Weg Gefrun inverters, Schneider Electric protection systems, and durable galvanized iron structures, all managed from an insulated, air-conditioned equipment room. By integrating renewable energy into large-scale irrigation, Zadco is demonstrating a sustainable model for Libyan agriculture that reduces reliance on traditional power grids while maximizing the productivity of arid lands.

records.title: The International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM) has significantly enhanced its role as a regional investment hub with the launch of...
records.description: The International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM) has significantly enhanced its role as a regional investment hub with the launch of the B2BConnect platform, a digital "technical backbone" designed to structure professional exchanges for the 2026 edition. This networking tool allows exhibitors, investors, and agricultural operators to create detailed profiles and schedule targeted meetings in advance, shifting the event's focus toward concrete commercial projects and expedited negotiations. By providing holders of Business and Business Plus badges with early access to potential partners, the International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM) aims to maximize the return on investment for participants in the plant and animal sectors. This proactive digital strategy aligns with the broader goal of intensifying agricultural trade and consolidating the show’s status as one of Africa’s premier platforms for agricultural innovation and export-oriented partnerships.
records.institution: The International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched an intensive national vaccination campaign in the Hebron Governorate as part of its strategic re...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched an intensive national vaccination campaign in the Hebron Governorate as part of its strategic response plan to control the SAT1 variant of foot-and-mouth disease. This "technical backbone" of the livestock sector’s defense saw the mobilization of field veterinary teams who successfully administered free vaccinations to 7,645 head of cattle on the first day alone. The campaign covered high-density dairy farming zones, including 2,775 head in Qalqas, 2,450 head in the Al-Burj and Wadi Al-Kilab areas, and significant clusters in Yatta and Bani Na'im. By prioritizing these regional hotspots, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to establish a sanitary barrier against regional disease transmission, urging livestock breeders to maintain strict biosecurity protocols and cooperate with veterinary staff to ensure the long-term sustainability of national milk and meat production.

records.title: The National Union of Algerian Farmers (UNPA), alongside the Chamber of Agriculture and the National Union of Agronomists (UNA), has welc...
records.description: The National Union of Algerian Farmers (UNPA), alongside the Chamber of Agriculture and the National Union of Agronomists (UNA), has welcomed new strategic directives aimed at modernizing the agricultural sector through the rapid expansion of mechanization for the upcoming harvest-threshing campaign. These measures include the creation of specialized cooperatives for renting agricultural equipment and the establishment of a National Council for Agricultural Mechanization to optimize yields and reduce losses associated with traditional harvesting techniques. By focusing on the local manufacturing of equipment in specialized industrial units and providing technical training for operators, the National Union of Algerian Farmers (UNPA) seeks to ensure a balanced distribution of resources across all regions, particularly within the strategic cereal sector. This integrated "technical backbone" of modernized machinery and proactive rental models is designed to expand cultivated areas and enhance national food security in response to favorable weather conditions and expected production abundance.
records.institution: The National Union of Algerian Farmers (UNPA)

records.description: The Egyptian government has launched the fourth phase of the National Initiative for Smart Green Projects (NISGP) to accelerate the transition to a green economy and strengthen climate action through a "technical backbone" of digital governance and localized innovation. This collaborative effort—supported by the Ministry of Local Development, the Ministry of Higher Education, the Ministry of Planning, and the National Council for Women—aims to foster sustainable solutions by linking academic research with private sector implementation. Building on the success of earlier phases that qualified nearly 4,859 projects and trained over 11,500 participants, the new phase prioritizes resource efficiency, clean energy, and waste management in alignment with Egypt Vision 2030. By utilizing a dedicated project evaluation platform and maintaining a specific category for female-led initiatives, the National Initiative for Smart Green Projects (NISGP) focuses on scaling high-quality, high-impact projects that create sustainable jobs and enhance the nation's environmental resilience.
