records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has unveiled a comprehensive five-pillar strategy to safeguard national food security an...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has unveiled a comprehensive five-pillar strategy to safeguard national food security and sovereignty amid regional supply chain disruptions. This "technical backbone" focuses on the reclamation of over 3.5 million feddans in the New Delta, Toshka, and Sinai, alongside the registration of 14 new seed varieties in 2026 to boost productivity. According to the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, the plan also targets a 70% self-sufficiency rate in red meat by 2029 through a 10 million-head high-productivity livestock program, complementing Egypt's existing full self-sufficiency in poultry, eggs, and rice. To enhance export competitiveness, which reached 9.5 million tons in 2025, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation is prioritizing digital development, including a nationwide electronic fertilizer payment system via the "Farmer’s Card" and AI-driven data platforms. With the food processing sector valued at $30 billion, these pillars aim to stabilize local markets against inflationary pressures while positioning Egypt as a high-productivity, sustainable agricultural hub.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has achieved a breakthrough in the local production of cherry tomato se...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has achieved a breakthrough in the local production of cherry tomato seeds as part of the National Program for the Propagation of Local Vegetable Crop Varieties and Hybrids. Conducted at the Abu Ghraib Research Station in Baghdad, this scientific initiative serves as a critical "technical backbone" for national food security by developing hybrids with superior flowering rates, taste, and climate adaptation. By producing high-quality seeds that rival imported varieties, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to provide farmers with subsidized, locally adapted inputs to reduce production costs and enhance self-sufficiency. The new variety has been submitted to the National Committee for the Accreditation, Registration, and Protection of Agricultural Varieties for official certification, marking a significant step toward domesticating the high-value vegetable seed supply chain.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced a strategic investment of JD 64.5 million to accelerate the adoption of modern agricultural tec...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced a strategic investment of JD 64.5 million to accelerate the adoption of modern agricultural technologies under the Economic Modernisation Vision (EMV). This "technical backbone" of the High-Value Industries programme targets Jordan’s severe water scarcity and limited arable land by prioritizing hydroponics, which can reduce water use by up to 80%, and precision farming that utilizes IoT sensors and artificial intelligence to optimize irrigation and fertilization. Supported by the Agricultural Credit Corporation and private sector contributions, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to transform the national food security system through vertical farming and smart greenhouse environments that allow for year-round, internationally compliant production. By integrating treated wastewater reuse and rainwater harvesting with automated scheduling, the Ministry of Agriculture seeks to lower operational costs and position the Kingdom as a regional hub for agri-tech innovation and high-value exports.

records.title: The Extralait cooperative has inaugurated a new industrial unit in the province of Kenitra, marking a 108 million dirham investment to mo...
records.description: The Extralait cooperative has inaugurated a new industrial unit in the province of Kenitra, marking a 108 million dirham investment to modernize Morocco’s dairy "technical backbone." This strategic expansion includes a new pasteurized milk production facility and the technological upgrading of yogurt and butter lines, creating 139 direct jobs in the region. By integrating nearly 12,000 livestock farmers and 57 collection centers, the Extralait cooperative model secures market access for small producers and enhances national added value through one of only four milk-drying towers in the country—a critical tool for regulating supply and mitigating market fluctuations. This project, supported by the national agri-food development program, combines industrial growth with technical field assistance, such as genetic improvement and modernized farming practices, to stabilize the livelihoods of rural producers and ensure long-term food security.

records.title: The Hebron Governorate Agriculture Directorate, as part of the General Directorate of Forests and Rangelands' strategic plan, is currentl...
records.description: The Hebron Governorate Agriculture Directorate, as part of the General Directorate of Forests and Rangelands' strategic plan, is currently preparing the Wadi al-Qaf nursery to serve as a high-capacity production hub for forest, rangeland, and shade tree seedlings. By focusing on native varieties, the Hebron Governorate Agriculture Directorate is establishing a "technical backbone" for national afforestation projects designed to enhance vegetation cover, preserve biodiversity, and combat desertification. The initiative involves developing specialized infrastructure to create optimal environments for producing high-quality seedlings capable of withstanding climate change and soil degradation. As one of the most significant facilities in the governorate, the Wadi al-Qaf nursery plays a vital role in the Ministry of Agriculture's broader strategy to protect forest lands from encroachment while supporting the resilience of local citizens through the sustainable management of natural resources for future generations.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in the State of Palestine issued a decision to control a new outbreak of a highly contagious poultry disease...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in the State of Palestine issued a decision to control a new outbreak of a highly contagious poultry disease (SAT1). The measures include banning the import of live poultry from other countries, allowing only frozen poultry from disease-free areas under veterinary supervision, prohibiting transport of animals between governorates without official permits, and closing all animal markets. The decision also enforces strict biosecurity measures on farms, including limiting movement of people and vehicles, intensifying cleaning and disinfection, ensuring full veterinary compliance, and requiring immediate reporting of any suspected cases. All authorities are mandated to implement these measures immediately, and any previous conflicting regulations are repealed.

records.title: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with Islamic Relief (France) and the Modern Irrigation Project Well Co...
records.description: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with Islamic Relief (France) and the Modern Irrigation Project Well Committee, has signed a strategic agreement to establish a 50 kW/h solar power station to modernize regional water infrastructure. This initiative, part of the "Improving Livelihoods and Mitigating the Impact of Climate Change" program, creates a renewable "technical backbone" designed to drastically reduce the electrical costs of extracting agricultural water. By transitioning the operation of the local well to solar energy, the Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture aims to lower water prices for farming families, thereby directly increasing their net income and enhancing their resilience against environmental shifts. With installation expected to be completed within two weeks, the project highlights the vital role of international partnerships in driving sustainable rural development and empowering the agricultural sector through the adoption of clean energy technologies.

records.title: ACWA Power has informed the Saudi bourse, Tadawul, that two of its major solar independent power producer (IPP) plants in Saudi Arabia—th...
records.description: ACWA Power has informed the Saudi bourse, Tadawul, that two of its major solar independent power producer (IPP) plants in Saudi Arabia—the 1,425MW Al Kahfah and the 2,000MW Ar Rass 2—are currently facing temporary dispatch limitations. These restrictions were issued by the grid operator due to technical concerns regarding reactive power fluctuations and their potential impact on grid stability. While ACWA Power and the project firms dispute these allegations and have issued "deemed energy" invoices to protect their contractual rights, the financial impact has already reached approximately SAR 95 million for Al Kahfah and SAR 73 million for Ar Rass 2 as of late March. To resolve the impasse, the ACWA Power project companies are conducting independent third-party technical assessments and coordinating with authorities to restore full operational capacity to these critical renewable energy assets.

records.title: The Sheikh Badr Agriculture Department has launched an intensive integrated pest management campaign to combat the pine nut bug, deployin...
records.description: The Sheikh Badr Agriculture Department has launched an intensive integrated pest management campaign to combat the pine nut bug, deploying specialized teams to spray infested trees across several district villages. This targeted intervention focuses on high-traffic areas, including schools, places of worship, forest edges, and public roads, coinciding with the biological stage where the insect's larvae are most vulnerable to control. To protect public health, the Sheikh Badr Agriculture Department has issued a high-priority warning to residents and schoolchildren to avoid contact with insect nests, which can cause severe skin allergies and respiratory issues. By maintaining a continuous "technical backbone" of chemical treatment and environmental monitoring, the Sheikh Badr Agriculture Department aims to strictly limit the spread of the pest and ensure the safety of both the local population and the surrounding forest ecosystems.

records.title: The Tunisian Embassy in Brussels, in partnership with the German-Luxembourg Economic Initiative (DLWI), has organized a high-level invest...
records.description: The Tunisian Embassy in Brussels, in partnership with the German-Luxembourg Economic Initiative (DLWI), has organized a high-level investment forum at the Luxembourg Chamber of Trades to position Tunisia as a "preferred investment destination" for European capital. The event served as a strategic platform to showcase the "technical backbone" of the Tunisian agri-food sector, specifically its world-class olive oil production, to an audience of German and Luxembourgish business leaders across the trade, industry, and finance sectors. By combining a review of Tunisia's cooperative strengths with a technical tasting session of diverse olive oil varieties, the Tunisian Embassy in Brussels highlighted the high quality and export potential of local products. This diplomatic and economic outreach aims to foster new partnerships in information technology and services, leveraging Tunisia's geographical and industrial advantages to attract sustainable investment into its diversifying agricultural economy.

records.title: The National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) has reported a significant surge in Egypt’s food trade, overseeing the arrival of 510,000 tonne...
records.description: The National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) has reported a significant surge in Egypt’s food trade, overseeing the arrival of 510,000 tonnes of food imports while facilitating the export of approximately 230,000 tonnes of domestic agri-food products. Through its General Directorate of Exports and Imports, the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) managed over 2,440 incoming consignments of strategic commodities like wheat and edible oils from 90 supplying countries, with Russia and France leading the list. On the export side, the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) supported 1,400 companies in reaching 186 international markets, with citrus and potatoes emerging as the top-performing categories. By issuing 1,375 health certificates and 3,218 export permits, the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) has reinforced the "technical backbone" of the Egyptian supply chain, utilizing expedited clearance systems at major hubs like Alexandria and Damietta Ports to maintain rigorous safety standards and enhance the global competitiveness of Egyptian products.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment has officially designated the newly released Third State of the Environment Report (2015–2022) as the primary...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment has officially designated the newly released Third State of the Environment Report (2015–2022) as the primary national reference for Jordan’s environmental reality. Utilizing a transparent, evidence-based methodology, the report serves as a "technical backbone" for monitoring the Kingdom’s natural resources and documenting integrated institutional responses to climate change. A significant portion of the report highlights critical pressures on the land and soil sector, specifically addressing land degradation and the decline in agricultural productivity caused by rapid urban expansion and shifting land use. To combat these challenges, the Ministry of Environment has implemented a series of legislative reforms, including mandatory environmental impact assessments for development projects and the promotion of sustainable urban planning. These efforts are further supported by large-scale ecological initiatives like the 10 Million Trees programme and the “Juthoor” initiative, which aim to expand green cover, combat desertification, and enhance the resilience of ecosystems against future environmental pressures.

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in North Al Sharqiyah has reported a significant expansion in the l...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in North Al Sharqiyah has reported a significant expansion in the livestock and poultry sectors, with seven new investment projects valued at approximately OMR 33 million. These initiatives, ranging from horse breeding to Dutch rabbit meat and ostrich farming, are supported by the "Tatweer" and "Suggest Your Project" platforms to modernize the regional "technical backbone." With a livestock population of 435,000 head, the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources oversaw the administration of over 818,000 vaccine doses and provided veterinary services through a network of 50 public and private clinics, marking a 24% growth in prevention programs. Furthermore, the governorate has achieved a remarkable 218% self-sufficiency rate in table eggs and produces over 3.6 million birds annually. By managing 1,622 farm complexes and approving 46 pastoral sites, the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is effectively balancing industrial growth with sustainable rangeland management to enhance the Sultanate’s overall food security.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially launched the 2026 Food Safety Week in the Wilayat of Sohar, aim...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially launched the 2026 Food Safety Week in the Wilayat of Sohar, aiming to strengthen the national "technical backbone" of food oversight under the theme "Food safety is the responsibility of all." Managed by the Food Safety and Quality Centre, the six-day event serves as a strategic platform for government departments and private sector establishments to exchange expertise through a specialized food safety forum and the "Food safety system in numbers" lecture series. Key initiatives include the launch of a dedicated food safety magazine, a public marathon, and an exhibition featuring innovative programs from leading production companies. By integrating specialized workshops, field visits to production facilities, and educational outreach for schools and universities, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is working to harmonize regulatory standards and raise public awareness to ensure a resilient and high-efficiency food power system across the Sultanate.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Directorate of Agriculture in Tulkarm, in partnership with the Rural Women’s Development Society (RWDS), has delivered specialized fo...
records.description: The Directorate of Agriculture in Tulkarm, in partnership with the Rural Women’s Development Society (RWDS), has delivered specialized food processing equipment to three key agricultural cooperatives: the Kafr al-Labad Women’s Cooperative Society, the Kafr Abboush Agricultural Cooperative Society, and the Bal’a Women’s Cooperative Society for Food Processing. This initiative, funded by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and implemented alongside the German Agency for International Cooperation (GIZ), serves as a critical "technical backbone" for women-led agribusinesses facing regional economic instability. By providing tailored machinery based on pre-identified operational needs, the Directorate of Agriculture in Tulkarm aims to transition these cooperatives toward crisis-responsive business models, significantly raising production efficiency and enhancing the sustainable livelihoods of rural families in the Tulkarm Governorate.
records.institution: The Directorate of Agriculture in Tulkarm

records.title: The Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has...
records.description: The Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed six strategic investment agreements valued at approximately 2.2 million shekels to modernize the regional agri-food system. Part of the Multi-Donor Agricultural Business Program (MAP2), these projects establish a high-tech "technical backbone" in Jenin, including suspended strawberry cultivation, climate-resilient greenhouses, and renewable solar energy installations. The initiative also introduces innovative Azolla alternative feed production to strengthen local value chains and reduce operational costs for the 58 current beneficiaries. Funded by a coalition including Denmark, Switzerland, Spain, the European Union, and Italy, the Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate is focusing on market-oriented innovations that secure the livelihoods of agricultural families and enhance food security in marginalized areas, ensuring that land investment translates directly into regional stability and economic survival.

records.title: The Jerusalem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Land Research Center and the Ministry of Jerusalem Affairs,...
records.description: The Jerusalem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, in partnership with the Land Research Center and the Ministry of Jerusalem Affairs, has initiated the distribution of towed water tanks to livestock breeders in Hizma, Mikhmas, Jaba', and the Jaba' Bedouin community. This intervention is a core component of the "Sumud" project, an economic empowerment initiative funded by the Bayt Mal Al-Quds Al-Sharif Agency/Morocco to develop the agricultural sector and enhance food security. By providing these mobile water resources, the Jerusalem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture is establishing a critical "technical backbone" for livestock production in marginalized areas, directly alleviating the logistical burdens faced by breeders. This project, which will eventually distribute 15 tanks across the governorate, reflects the ongoing commitment of the Kingdom of Morocco to support the resilience of Jerusalemite families, ensuring they have the basic infrastructure required to sustain their livelihoods and remain on their land.
records.institution: The Jerusalem Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nat...
records.description: The Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed a strategic agreement to implement a high-tech hanging strawberry farming system across four dunams of land. This project, part of the Multi-Donor Agricultural Business Program (MAP2), introduces modern vertical cultivation technologies to the northern Jordan Valley to optimize natural resource use and significantly increase product quality and farmer income. Funded by a global coalition including Denmark, Switzerland, Spain, the European Union, and Italy, the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate is utilizing this "technical backbone" to foster market-oriented investments and create new employment opportunities in the agri-food sector. By enabling the adoption of sustainable production models and improving marketing efficiency, the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate aims to bolster the resilience of local farmers and ensure the long-term development of a modern agricultural system in the West Bank.

records.description: The Saudi Reef program has identified the Jazan Region as a primary hub for the green economy, leveraging its vast natural assets to transform the traditional jasmine and aromatic plant sectors into high-efficiency processing industries. In the Ahad Al Masarihah Governorate, Saudi Reef projects already encompass 65,000 hectares with 26,000 trees producing 156,000 kilograms annually, supported by a massive nursery infrastructure of 132,000 hectares capable of yielding 317,000 kilograms per year. By developing specialized "jasmine cities," Saudi Reef is building a "technical backbone" for small farmers to move beyond cottage industry sales into industrial-scale production. This strategic modernization of Jazan's botanical heritage aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 goals for sustainability and regional economic diversification, positioning the area as a leading center for the high-value natural products market.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has formalized a strategic partnership between the harvesting equipment manu...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has formalized a strategic partnership between the harvesting equipment manufacturer SAMPO and Agrodrive, a subsidiary of the Agrodiv group, to accelerate the integration of locally manufactured machinery into the national agricultural fleet. This agreement facilitates the acquisition of high-tech harvesters and tractors to be deployed across six regional hubs, providing a vital "technical backbone" for the current harvest season, which is supported by record rainfall and the widespread distribution of seeds and fertilizers. During an inspection in Sidi Bel-Abbes, the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries also emphasized the modernization of the Algerian-Italian Center for Agricultural Innovation as a hub for technology transfer and research. By leveraging the production capacities of both the public company SAMPO and the private sector firm Famag-Sonalika, the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries aims to conduct the 2025-2026 campaign through a scientific and digital approach, significantly advancing the nation's goals for food security and industrial autonomy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Arab Potash Company (APC) is intensifying its operational and logistical efforts to safeguard global food security and stabilize the...
records.description: The Arab Potash Company (APC) is intensifying its operational and logistical efforts to safeguard global food security and stabilize the domestic market against rising "imported inflation" triggered by regional conflict. As the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) reports a significant climb in the Food Price Index due to surging energy and fertilizer costs, the Arab Potash Company (APC) has implemented a strategy of "strategic inventory positioning" and flexible shipping programs from the Port of Aqaba to ensure the continuity of essential mineral exports. By utilizing multiple logistics routes and maintaining overseas inventories, the Arab Potash Company (APC) aims to decouple critical agricultural supply chains from the volatility of the Strait of Hormuz, addressing urgent concerns from Bloomberg and the FAO regarding potential yield reductions and prolonged food inflation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Mount Lebanon Agricultural Department and the Keserwan Agricultural Center, has conducted a comp...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Mount Lebanon Agricultural Department and the Keserwan Agricultural Center, has conducted a comprehensive agricultural extension day in Baaqata Kanaan to advance sustainable farming and production safety. This initiative, held in coordination with the Baaqata Kanaan Municipality, served as a critical "technical backbone" for the region by registering local farmers and beekeepers in the official agricultural registry to regulate the sector and strengthen the national database. The program featured specialized training on the rational and safe use of pesticides to minimize environmental risks, alongside the distribution of mineral oil to promote integrated pest management. By enhancing the technical capabilities of the local workforce, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to bolster the resilience and sustainability of the Lebanese agricultural sector against modern environmental and economic challenges.

records.title: The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Hebron Community Center for Youth and Adult Education, has initiated th...
records.description: The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Hebron Community Center for Youth and Adult Education, has initiated the field distribution phase of the "Improved (Violet) Aloe Vera" project across targeted rural clusters in the governorate. This strategic intervention provides 20 beneficiaries from Dura, Al-Ramadin, and Al-Dhahiriya with a complete "technical backbone" for high-value cultivation, including specialized purple aloe seedlings and integrated irrigation networks. By establishing these model farms, the South Hebron Agriculture Directorate aims to diversify the local agricultural base with climate-adaptive varieties that offer superior economic feasibility compared to traditional crops. Director General Engineer Khalil Abu Aqifan emphasized that this high-quality intervention not only enhances the resilience of farmers on their land but also activates the role of youth in rural development, creating sustainable investment prospects in the face of current environmental and economic challenges.

records.description: The Secretary of State for Energy Transition has identified the fifth district, comprising the governorates of Medenine, Tataouine, Gabès, and Kébili, as a burgeoning national renewable energy hub due to its vast solar resources and potential for integrated agriculture and water management. Through the continued support of the state permitting system, the Secretary of State for Energy Transition has already facilitated the granting of 186 permits representing a total capacity of approximately 286 megawatts, demonstrating the robust capability of local investors to deliver high-performing projects. To further accelerate this strategy, the Secretary of State for Energy Transition is preparing to launch the sixth phase of this investment mechanism, which aims to provide real regional opportunities and strengthen the "technical backbone" of Tunisia's green energy infrastructure.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy and the Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company (Masdar) are spearheading a massive strategic expansion of the...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy and the Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company (Masdar) are spearheading a massive strategic expansion of the UAE’s clean energy footprint, domestic and international, through integrated technology and infrastructure projects. Domestically, the Abu Dhabi Department of Energy introduced the Solar Energy Self-Supply Policy to empower the agricultural sector, while Masdar partnered with Elite Agro to launch the region's first agricultural photovoltaic (AgriPV) project, contributing to a national renewable capacity that has already exceeded 7.7 GW. Internationally, Masdar has reached a global capacity of 65 GW, driven by large-scale solar and battery storage investments in Angola, Uzbekistan, and Germany, as well as a $2.2 billion joint venture with TotalEnergies covering nine countries. Supported by industrial collaborations between Global South Utilities and global manufacturers to localize battery production in Abu Dhabi, these initiatives reinforce the "technical backbone" of the UAE's energy transformation and its ambition to reach 100 GW of clean energy capacity by the end of the decade.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy and the Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company (Masdar)

records.title: The Algerian Embassy in the United Kingdom organized a high-level networking event on the sidelines of the International Food Exhibition...
records.description: The Algerian Embassy in the United Kingdom organized a high-level networking event on the sidelines of the International Food Exhibition to bridge national public and private economic operators with British agri-food professionals. Under the theme of building bilateral business links, the gathering highlighted that the agricultural sector now represents nearly 19% of Algeria's non-hydrocarbon GDP, reflecting a massive strategic push toward economic modernization through expanded irrigation, AgriTech development, and value chain digitization. The event culminated in a landmark memorandum of understanding signed between the Algerian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CACI) and the London Chamber of Commerce, establishing a formal framework for cooperation in sustainable production and smart logistics. This collaboration, supported by representatives from the UK Department for Business and Trade, aims to leverage British excellence in research and innovation to enhance the competitiveness of high-quality Algerian exports—such as dates and olive oil—within the British market.
records.institution: Algerian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CACI)

records.title: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is providing a $20 million (EGP 1.1 billion) loan to Futurefert to expand Egy...
records.description: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is providing a $20 million (EGP 1.1 billion) loan to Futurefert to expand Egypt’s high-value industrial fertilizer production within the Suez Canal Economic Zone. This investment, part of a $46 million total project, will fund the construction of a specialized "technical backbone" consisting of three interconnected plants: sulfuric acid, potassium sulfate, and single superphosphate facilities. Wholly owned by Sharkia Holding, Futurefert aims to produce 240,000 metric tonnes of granular NPK fertilizers annually, targeting export markets across Europe and Africa. Beyond creating 300 direct jobs, this EBRD-backed initiative strengthens Egypt’s role in the global supply chain at a critical time, as regional disruptions have removed over 20% of the global ammonia trade, making domestic production of nitrogen-based agricultural inputs essential for regional and international food security.
records.institution: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD)

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, is advancing a strategic shift toward national food sovereignty by scaling up the National Potato Development Program. This initiative focuses on the localized production of high-grade potato seeds (G0 and G1 classes), specifically designed to break the cycle of import dependency. By providing Iraqi farmers with high-quality, disease-free "starting material" at competitive prices, the Ministry of Agriculture is not only lowering the technical barriers to entry for large-scale cultivation but also insulating the domestic food supply from global market volatility and supply chain disruptions.

records.title: The EastFruit market analysis highlights a historic shift in the European fresh vegetable trade, with Morocco emerging as the primary sup...
records.description: The EastFruit market analysis highlights a historic shift in the European fresh vegetable trade, with Morocco emerging as the primary supplier of green beans to the Irish market in 2025. By exporting 817 tonnes—a nearly sevenfold increase since 2023—Moroccan producers have captured 36% of Irish imports, effectively displacing traditional long-haul competitors like Guatemala and Kenya. According to EastFruit, this structural reorganization is driven by Morocco's strategic geographical proximity, which facilitates shorter transit times, superior product freshness, and reduced logistical costs for European retailers. The transition toward direct shipments, bypassing traditional hubs in Spain and the Netherlands, further demonstrates the growing maturity of the Moroccan export sector. As European standards on pesticide residues tighten and logistical constraints hamper distant origins, EastFruit suggests that Morocco's reliable "technical backbone" of infrastructure and competitive pricing positions the Kingdom to further expand its footprint across Northern European markets.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), in collaboration with the Red Sea State government and the Arba’at Rural Development Ass...
records.description: The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), in collaboration with the Red Sea State government and the Arba’at Rural Development Association, has successfully implemented a Reconstruction and Community Resilience Support Program to revitalize the agricultural sector and improve local livelihoods. Following the collapse of a critical dam, the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) established five model farms for home-based agriculture, providing a "technical backbone" of solar power systems, well rehabilitation, and high-quality seeds and seedlings. These interventions have specifically empowered rural women and enhanced food security in the Al-Qanab and Al-Olib localities by fostering sustainable, local production. This successful partnership model between international organizations and local authorities has not only restored essential water provision but also strengthened community stability, providing a scalable roadmap for economic recovery and climate-resilient farming throughout the region.
records.institution: The Red Sea State government and the Arba’at Rural Development Association

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries, in coordination with the Ministry of Vocational Training and Education, has...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries, in coordination with the Ministry of Vocational Training and Education, has launched a joint action plan to professionalize agricultural mechanization through specialized training for trainers and technical workers. This initiative, which includes key stakeholders such as the National Chamber of Agriculture, the National Interprofessional Council of the Cereal Sector (CNIF-cereals), and the Algerian Interprofessional Cereals Office (OAIC), specifically addresses the critical shortage of skilled labor in the operation and maintenance of strategic machinery like combine harvesters. By integrating technology, innovation, and entrepreneurship into tailored programs at facilities like the National Higher School of Agronomy (ENSA) and companies like Agrodrive and PMAT, the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries aims to modernize the "technical backbone" of the cereal sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: Egypt has officially pledged to finance and mobilize funding for critical water-related infrastructure in the Nile Basin in Uganda, marki...
records.description: Egypt has officially pledged to finance and mobilize funding for critical water-related infrastructure in the Nile Basin in Uganda, marking a significant escalation in "win-win" technical cooperation. Following the high-level "2+2" ministerial talks in Cairo, the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs confirmed that the Nile Development Fund will be the primary vehicle for these investments. This commitment follows the March 30, 2026, Joint Steering Committee meeting and is built upon a 2025 memorandum of understanding focused on integrated water resources management. By prioritizing sustainable development and consensus-based governance within the Nile Basin Initiative (NBI), both nations are signaling a shift toward inclusive infrastructure projects that adhere to the principle of "not causing significant harm" while bolstering regional stability and food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has executed a major ecological intervention by releasing over 1...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has executed a major ecological intervention by releasing over 1.836 million newly hatched catfish into the Al-Fatha Marsh in Najaf Governorate. Produced at the Al-Radwaniyah Fish Reserve hatchery west of Baghdad, these fingerlings represent a strategic effort to reinforce the "technical backbone" of Mesopotamia's aquatic biodiversity. By targeting the Najaf Sea/Al-Fatha ecosystem, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to restore the natural equilibrium of local water bodies, ensuring the survival of indigenous species that hold significant environmental, nutritional, and cultural value for the region.

records.title: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry has issued a ministerial decision to provide financial support for additional import costs, a strat...
records.description: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry has issued a ministerial decision to provide financial support for additional import costs, a strategic measure designed to safeguard the uninterrupted supply of essential goods and stabilize local market prices. Under this framework, the government will cover extra expenses incurred by importing companies when exceptional circumstances—such as disruptions to sea, land, or air transport—force a reliance on alternative, more expensive shipping routes. This support is strictly focused on a "technical backbone" of basic commodities, including rice, flour, lentils, vegetable oils, sugar, frozen chicken, infant formula, and various canned products. By authorizing the extension of these subsidies as needed within approved budget limits, the Ministry of Commerce and Industry aims to protect national food security and mitigate the impact of global logistical volatility on Kuwaiti consumers.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry

records.title: The Moroccan Confederation of Agriculture and Rural Development (COMADER) organized a national conference focused on identifying strategi...
records.description: The Moroccan Confederation of Agriculture and Rural Development (COMADER) organized a national conference focused on identifying strategic levers to strengthen domestic cereal production and bolster national food sovereignty. Bringing together ministerial departments, public institutions, and agricultural professional organizations, the Moroccan Confederation of Agriculture and Rural Development (COMADER) addressed structural challenges such as climate change, market volatility, and rising production costs. The discussions emphasized the importance of royal directives to establish an integrated system of strategic reserves and resulted in a moderation agreement for the collection and marketing of soft wheat. By focusing on modernizing the "technical backbone" of the sector—including storage capacities, climate-smart productivity, and integrated logistics—the Moroccan Confederation of Agriculture and Rural Development (COMADER) aims to improve the economic viability of the value chain and ensure a sustainable balance between domestic production and international imports.
records.institution: The Moroccan Confederation of Agriculture and Rural Development (COMADER)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a period of significant strategic expansion, leading to a 146% se...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a period of significant strategic expansion, leading to a 146% self-sufficiency rate in fish and substantial gains across the dairy and poultry sectors. Managing a diverse landscape that includes 312,000 acres of cultivated land and 3.2 million acres of natural grazing land supporting 4 million head of livestock, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has achieved self-sufficiency rates of 99% for dates, 96% for fresh milk, and 95% for table eggs. This progress is anchored by a robust "technical backbone" consisting of 26 research centers, 35 food safety laboratories, and extensive water infrastructure including desalination plants, recharge dams, and treatment facilities producing millions of cubic meters of water. These coordinated efforts by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources have not only driven a 5.2% production growth rate but also significantly improved the nation's global environmental and fisheries management rankings.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reported a significant strengthening of Oman’s strategic water reserves fo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has reported a significant strengthening of Oman’s strategic water reserves following the Masarrat low-pressure system, which brought intense rainfall to several wilayats. Data shows that Ibra recorded the highest precipitation at 356mm, followed by Wadi Al Maawil (289mm) and Yanqul (276mm). This surge has directly impacted the nation's "technical backbone" of water infrastructure; of the Sultanate's 209 dams, 181 are now completely filled. With a total national storage capacity of 458.7 million m³, current reserves have reached 160 million m³, with Muscat Governorate holding the largest share at nearly 80 million m³. These figures, tracked by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, underscore the critical role of the dam network in flood protection, sustainable water management, and essential groundwater recharge across the Sultanate.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, through its Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, through its Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Dhofar, has officially launched the wheat harvest for the current agricultural season in Al Najd province. Spanning 6,408 acres across 51 farms, the harvest is projected to yield approximately 8,000 tons of wheat, representing a vital contribution to national food security. To support this "technical backbone" of domestic production, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources provides farmers with subsidized seeds and free harvesting machinery, while streamlining collection logistics in coordination with the Oman Flour Mills Company. This integrated support system ensures that high-quality Omani wheat efficiently reaches the market, strengthening the economic resilience of the agricultural community in the Dhofar Governorate.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Tulkarm Directorate of Agriculture, through its Rural Development Department and in coordination with the Women's Affairs Department,...
records.description: The Tulkarm Directorate of Agriculture, through its Rural Development Department and in coordination with the Women's Affairs Department, has conducted a specialized technical lecture on "Diseases and Pests Affecting Bees" to empower rural women and enhance their practical skills in apiculture. Attended by fifteen participants, the session provided a critical "technical backbone" for income-generating rural projects by addressing the most prominent apiary threats and effective prevention strategies. Led by the Tulkarm Directorate of Agriculture’s technical experts, the program emphasized the sound principles of beekeeping and the optimal timing for establishing new hives, ensuring the long-term success and economic viability of small-scale agricultural ventures. This initiative reflects the ongoing commitment of the Tulkarm Directorate of Agriculture to strengthen the active role of women in the agricultural sector and reinforce the foundations of sustainable regional development.

records.title: The Al-Baha Municipality, in coordination with the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, has launched a...
records.description: The Al-Baha Municipality, in coordination with the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, has launched a large-scale afforestation initiative involving over 11 public and private entities and 700 volunteers. This environmental sustainability project aims to plant more than 20,000 native seedlings across walkways, parks, public squares, and medians throughout the city and its surrounding governorates. To support this "technical backbone" of green expansion, the Al-Baha Municipality is implementing advanced irrigation methods designed to rationalize freshwater consumption, with a strategic target of using treated water for over 85% of tree irrigation. This multi-sectoral effort, which includes the participation of non-profit organizations and scouts, is a key component of the region's broader strategy to enhance quality of life and expand green spaces through modern resource management.

records.title: The Qardaha Forestry Division has launched its 2025/2026 environmental roadmap, focusing on the ecological restoration of Deir Hanna and...
records.description: The Qardaha Forestry Division has launched its 2025/2026 environmental roadmap, focusing on the ecological restoration of Deir Hanna and the western slopes of Jabal al-Arba'in. By planting a diverse "technical backbone" of indigenous forest species—including Aleppo pine, stone pine, laurel, and carob—the Qardaha Forestry Division is working to significantly expand regional vegetation cover and fortify natural forest resources. This targeted afforestation effort is designed to enhance local biodiversity and improve the environmental resilience of the mountainous terrain against soil erosion and climate-related degradation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has launched a specialized wheat field cleaning campaign at th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has launched a specialized wheat field cleaning campaign at the Qurna Research Station in Basra. This initiative is a critical phase of the high-grade seed propagation program, focusing on the manual and mechanical removal of impurities, off-types, and invasive weeds from elite wheat plots. Under the direction of Professor Muhammad Zain Al-Abidin, the campaign aims to safeguard the genetic purity of the crop, ensuring that the resulting seeds meet the rigorous "approved specifications" required for distribution to Iraqi farmers. By maintaining the integrity of these seed stocks, the Ministry of Agriculture is securing the technical foundation for higher yields and national food security.

records.title: The Irbid Chamber of Industry has reported a robust start to 2026, with industrial exports from Jordan’s northern governorate reaching $2...
records.description: The Irbid Chamber of Industry has reported a robust start to 2026, with industrial exports from Jordan’s northern governorate reaching $265.4 million in the first quarter—a 10.5% increase over the previous year. Despite the persistent "technical backbone" challenges of global supply chain disruptions and regional conflict, Chairman Hani Abu Hassan highlighted that March alone saw exports climb to $91.8 million. While the Leather and Garments sector remains the dominant export engine at $232 million, the Food and Agriculture sector demonstrated the highest agility with a 29% growth rate. These figures, supported by a 12% rise in certificates of origin, underscore the resilience of the Irbid industrial base and its expanding reach into high-growth markets like the Netherlands and the USA.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), is accelerating the implementation of a r...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), is accelerating the implementation of a regional food security and nutrition observatory for the Arab Mashreq sub-region. This strategic platform is designed to serve as a "technical backbone" for Jordan, Egypt, Iraq, Lebanon, Palestine, and Syria, providing accurate, up-to-date data and periodic analyses to support proactive policymaking. By enhancing early warning capabilities and risk analysis, the Ministry of Agriculture and the Higher Council for Food Security aim to build more resilient and sustainable food systems capable of navigating climate change and regional geopolitical fluctuations. The project, which also involves the Department of Statistics, is a pivotal step toward establishing Jordan as a regional hub for food security through a well-defined roadmap and intensified inter-sectoral cooperation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon has launched a strategic market intervention to cap potato prices at LBP 400,000 (US$4.47) per 10kg.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon has launched a strategic market intervention to cap potato prices at LBP 400,000 (US$4.47) per 10kg. To bridge the supply gap until the local Akkar harvest matures in early April, the Ministry of Agriculture is coordinating the import of limited quantities from Egypt. This short-term stabilization measure, developed in partnership with Bekaa farmers, aims to protect consumer purchasing power and prevent market distortion during the seasonal transition. By ensuring a steady flow of affordable produce, the Ministry of Agriculture is maintaining market balance and supporting national food security until full domestic availability is restored by mid-month.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon, in collaboration with the Bekaa Potato Farmers Syndicate, has published an official directory of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon, in collaboration with the Bekaa Potato Farmers Syndicate, has published an official directory of retail outlets and stores committed to the national price-capping initiative. Following the recent arrival of strategic imports, the Ministry of Agriculture is ensuring that these "reduced-price" potatoes reach all Lebanese regions, specifically targeting high-demand urban centers to alleviate the financial strain on households. By maintaining a continuous distribution loop and providing updated lists of participating vendors, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to reinforce market stability and protect consumer purchasing power during the critical transition period before the local Akkar harvest.

records.title: The Misrata Chamber of Commerce, Industry, and Agriculture has launched a specialized digital workshop titled "The Smart Export Gateway"...
records.description: The Misrata Chamber of Commerce, Industry, and Agriculture has launched a specialized digital workshop titled "The Smart Export Gateway" to equip local businesses with the modern mechanisms required to access international markets. By focusing on professional export strategies amidst rapidly increasing global competition, the Misrata Chamber of Commerce, Industry, and Agriculture aims to provide a practical framework for companies seeking to expand their reach beyond national borders. This initiative, which offers accredited certification, serves as a strategic platform for strengthening the "technical backbone" of the private sector and enhancing the global competitiveness of local products in the evolving international trade landscape.
records.institution: The Misrata Chamber of Commerce, Industry, and Agriculture

records.title: The UN World Food Programme (WFP) has released its Libya Market Price Monitoring report for February 2026, detailing a 5.0% increase in t...
records.description: The UN World Food Programme (WFP) has released its Libya Market Price Monitoring report for February 2026, detailing a 5.0% increase in the national Minimum Expenditure Basket (MEB) to LD 1,128.35. This inflationary spike is a direct consequence of the Central Bank of Libya’s 14.7% devaluation of the dinar on January 18, which triggered a rapid exchange-rate pass-through for essential imported commodities. While the West saw a marginal decrease of 1.3%, the East and South experienced sharp surges of 9.1% and 9.5% respectively, driven by supply chain vulnerabilities and higher transport costs. In response, the Libya Development & Reconstruction Fund in the East launched subsidized sale mechanisms for staples like rice and cooking oil, though the WFP remains cautious about the long-term effectiveness of these measures amid ongoing liquidity constraints.

records.title: The Food and Water Security Committee of the Shura Council convened its fifth meeting of the 2025–2026 sitting to discuss the strategic d...
records.description: The Food and Water Security Committee of the Shura Council convened its fifth meeting of the 2025–2026 sitting to discuss the strategic development of "Future Agricultural Cities" in Oman. In collaboration with Sultan Qaboos University (SQU), represented by the College of Agricultural and Marine Sciences, the committee explored a digital roadmap for integrating artificial intelligence, precision agriculture, and resource management into the national food security framework. This initiative, aligned with Oman Vision 2040, aims to bridge the gap between laboratory research and commercial application by establishing business incubators for agricultural startups and strengthening the "technical backbone" of the Sultanate's arid-land farming through enhanced water and energy efficiency.
records.institution: The Food and Water Security Committee of the Shura Council

records.title: The World Bank has approved two transformative projects for Tunisia totaling $332.5 million, marking the first phase of a ten-year Water...
records.description: The World Bank has approved two transformative projects for Tunisia totaling $332.5 million, marking the first phase of a ten-year Water Resilience and Security Program designed to combat extreme water scarcity and climate pressures. The first initiative focuses on modernizing irrigation infrastructure in northern governorates and promoting climate-smart agriculture to benefit thousands of farmers and generate over 10,000 total jobs. The second project aims to strengthen the National Water Distribution Company (Sonede) by doubling the capacity of the Zarat desalination plant to 100,000 $m^3$/day and deploying 100,000 smart meters to reduce water losses across several regions. Together, these World Bank operations are expected to improve service quality for 2.3 million people while rehabilitating the "technical backbone" of Tunisia's rural and urban water management systems.

records.description: At the opening of EGYPES 2026, the Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources announced that Egypt has secured $6.5 billion in investments and recorded 83 new oil and gas discoveries during the 2024–2025 fiscal year. A central pillar of this success is the strategic reduction of outstanding dues to international partners from $6.1 billion in mid-2024 to $1.3 billion as of March 2026, with a target for full settlement by June 30, 2026. To solidify its role as a regional energy hub, the Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources signed a landmark framework agreement with Cyprus to link offshore fields, specifically the Cronos field (estimated at 3.4 tcf), to Egypt’s liquefaction plants at Idku and Damietta, which boast a combined capacity of over 12 million tonnes per year.

records.title: The Damietta Port Authority has launched a pioneering non-direct transit service connecting Europe to the Gulf via a strategic Ro-Ro (Rol...
records.description: The Damietta Port Authority has launched a pioneering non-direct transit service connecting Europe to the Gulf via a strategic Ro-Ro (Roll-on/Roll-off) shipping link with the Port of Trieste, Italy. This integrated logistics model allows refrigerated and dry cargo arriving from Europe at Damietta Port to be transported overland to Safaga Port on the Red Sea, where it is then shipped to markets across the Arabian Gulf. By exempting these transit shipments from the Advance Cargo Information (ACI) pre-registration system and utilizing advanced digital customs integration, the Damietta Port Authority has significantly reduced handling times and operational costs, reinforcing Egypt's position as a premier "green corridor" and a vital hub for international transit trade.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq has officially authorized the importation of five key vegetable crops—cabbage, cauliflower, turnips,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq has officially authorized the importation of five key vegetable crops—cabbage, cauliflower, turnips, beets, and lettuce—to bridge the supply gap following the conclusion of the local harvest season. This decision, approved by the Ministerial Council for the Economy, was triggered by "agricultural calendar indicators" and real-time monitoring of wholesale markets in Baghdad and other provinces, which confirmed the depletion of domestic stocks. By opening these import channels, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to prevent supply shortages and maintain price stability for essential produce, ensuring that the local market remains well-stocked until the next domestic production cycle begins.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq, through its Department of Animal Resources, has launched a comprehensive modernization and sanitatio...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq, through its Department of Animal Resources, has launched a comprehensive modernization and sanitation program at the Al-Maymouna fish hatchery in Maysan Governorate. This initiative is a critical component of the national fish breeding season, focusing on the technical readiness of infrastructure to maximize fingerling production. By disinfecting breeding halls, maintaining high-capacity water pumps, and optimizing flow systems, the Ministry of Agriculture is creating a controlled environment designed to enhance the survival rates and genetic quality of local fish stocks. These efforts are part of a broader strategic plan to restock Iraqi water bodies and ensure long-term food security through a sustainable and plentiful domestic fish supply.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Topsoe has signed a Front-End Engineering and Design (FEED) agreement for Hynfra’s green ammonia project located in the Port of Aqaba, Jo...
records.description: Topsoe has signed a Front-End Engineering and Design (FEED) agreement for Hynfra’s green ammonia project located in the Port of Aqaba, Jordan. This strategic partnership utilizes Topsoe’s proprietary ModuLite™ ammonia synthesis technology to convert green hydrogen into ammonia, offering a scalable and rapidly deployable platform. Developed as a joint venture between Hynfra and Fidelity Group, the Jordan Green Ammonia project aims to position Jordan as a central hub for low-carbon fertilizers and industrial feedstock. By decoupling essential supply chains from volatile energy markets, Hynfra intends to export the green ammonia to international markets, providing a critical decarbonization pathway for heavy industries like steel, cement, and long-distance maritime transportation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty, in partnership with the German Agency for International Cooperation (GIZ), has official...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty, in partnership with the German Agency for International Cooperation (GIZ), has officially launched the electronic phytosanitary certification (ePhyto) service in Nouakchott. This digital transition aligns Mauritania with the requirements of the International Plant Protection Convention (IPPC), replacing traditional paper-based certificates with a secure, real-time electronic exchange system. By automating the certification process for agricultural imports and exports, the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty aims to eliminate the risks of forgery and administrative error, significantly reducing the "time-to-market" for Mauritanian produce and enhancing its competitiveness in the global trade arena.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman, in partnership with Nafath Energy Company and the Development Bank, h...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman, in partnership with Nafath Energy Company and the Development Bank, has launched the "Solar Energy — Sustainable Harvest" initiative. This program provides farmers and investors with interest-free or low-interest (3%) financing of up to RO 15,000 to integrate solar power into their operations, targeting a 30% reduction in electricity costs. Applications are processed through the Tharawat platform, with priority given to high-production farms utilizing greenhouses and modern irrigation. By enabling the transition to clean energy, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources aims to lower operating expenses, enhance the sustainability of natural resources, and align the agricultural sector with the Sultanate’s long-term vision for innovative, green development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has signed 25 new agreements totaling 1.236 million shekels to rehabilitate the productive capacities of farm...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has signed 25 new agreements totaling 1.236 million shekels to rehabilitate the productive capacities of farmers across the Nablus, Tubas, Tulkarm, and Qalqilya governorates. Funded by the European Union, this initiative specifically targets producers whose agricultural losses have been documented in official records, providing grants ranging from 14,000 to 114,000 shekels. The diversified support packages include the installation of solar-powered water wells, the construction of greenhouses, the distribution of improved pregnant ewes, and the provision of essential machinery like tractors. By bridging the gap between documented damage and renewed production, the Ministry of Agriculture and its international partners aim to secure Palestinian food sovereignty and strengthen the economic resilience of rural communities facing complex local challenges.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Golden Pass LNG project, a landmark joint venture between QatarEnergy (70%) and ExxonMobil (30%), has achieved a historic milestone b...
records.description: The Golden Pass LNG project, a landmark joint venture between QatarEnergy (70%) and ExxonMobil (30%), has achieved a historic milestone by producing its first LNG from the first of its three liquefaction trains. Located in Sabine Pass, Texas, this $10 billion investment represents a core pillar of QatarEnergy’s decade-long international strategy and its 2018 commitment to invest $20 billion in the US energy sector. With a total planned capacity of 18 million tonnes per annum (mtpa), the start of operations at Golden Pass LNG is timed to address urgent global energy security needs, providing international markets with expanded access to cleaner energy while solidifying the strategic partnership between the Qatari state energy firm and the US oil major.

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: The Ministry of Municipality has established a resilient food security framework for Qatar, anchored by three strategic pillars: local pr...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality has established a resilient food security framework for Qatar, anchored by three strategic pillars: local production, strategic stockpiling, and international investment. The Ministry of Municipality has achieved 100% seasonal self-sufficiency in vegetables and approximately 99% in poultry and dairy products, significantly reducing reliance on imports. To mitigate global supply chain risks, the Ministry of Municipality, in coordination with the Ministry of Commerce, maintains reinforced stockpiles of essential grains like rice and wheat, supported by early warning systems and international activities through the Hassad Company. This comprehensive approach is further bolstered by the Ministry of Municipality’s digital transformation, which offers over 250 electronic services via the Aoun app to ensure market stability and the continuous availability of production inputs.

records.title: The Regional Agricultural Development Commission (CRDA) in Siliana has executed a large-scale crop protection and fertilization campaign...
records.description: The Regional Agricultural Development Commission (CRDA) in Siliana has executed a large-scale crop protection and fertilization campaign during the 2025–2026 agricultural season to safeguard the governorate's cereal production. According to the Regional Agricultural Development Commission, weed control operations have already covered 82,000 hectares, while nitrogen fertilization with ammonium nitrate has reached 51,000 hectares, with an additional 21,000 hectares scheduled for imminent treatment. Despite meeting only 31% of the total regional demand for ammonium nitrate (approximately 94,469 quintals), the Regional Agricultural Development Commission is actively managing a targeted fungal disease response, having already treated over 2,000 hectares following the detection of infections across more than 11,000 hectares of field crops.

records.title: The Ministry of Local Development and Environment has approved the draft budget for the upcoming fiscal year for the Waste Management Reg...
records.description: The Ministry of Local Development and Environment has approved the draft budget for the upcoming fiscal year for the Waste Management Regulatory Authority, alongside new measures to strengthen oversight of the waste sector. To curb informal operations and reduce environmental harm, the Waste Management Regulatory Authority is extending license durations and reclassifying non-hazardous waste activities—which already include approximately 2,300 issued licenses—by specific waste types such as municipal, industrial, agricultural, and marine waste. This updated framework includes a new electronic tracking system to monitor the sorting and compacting of packaging waste, enhancing transparency and regulatory compliance. Furthermore, the board established updated fee structures for environmental impact assessments and new rules for license renewals, significantly reinforcing the Waste Management Regulatory Authority's capacity to enforce technical standards and manage integrated waste flows across the country.
records.institution: The Ministry of Local Development and Environment

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq, through its Department of Animal Resources, has successfully reached the third phase of the current...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq, through its Department of Animal Resources, has successfully reached the third phase of the current fish breeding season at the Al-Suwaira fish hatchery. As part of a specialized technical program to enhance national fish production, the Ministry of Agriculture introduced the third batch of common carp to the breeding laboratory for intensive monitoring. Specialized staff are currently conducting rigorous examinations of larvae from previous batches to ensure they are free of deformities and to monitor the absorption of the yolk sac. According to approved procedures, the Ministry of Agriculture has confirmed that several larval groups have transitioned to the feeding stage, a critical step in its broader strategy to boost optimal production rates and strengthen national food security through the fisheries sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon, in partnership with the Bekaa Potato Farmers Syndicate, has launched a targeted market interventi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon, in partnership with the Bekaa Potato Farmers Syndicate, has launched a targeted market intervention to stabilize prices and protect consumer purchasing power. By securing a strategic shipment of imported potatoes from Egypt, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to bridge the supply gap until the domestic Akkar harvest begins in early April. Under this initiative, high-quality potatoes are being capped at a retail price of 400,000 Lebanese pounds per 10 kg through participating outlets. This phased measure is part of a broader response plan to prevent market exploitation, maintain a healthy balance between supply and demand, and reinforce the resilience of the agricultural sector as a pillar of national food security.

records.title: Following intensive technical meetings at the CERAWeek global energy conference in Houston, AGOCO announced a strategic initiative to enh...
records.description: Following intensive technical meetings at the CERAWeek global energy conference in Houston, AGOCO announced a strategic initiative to enhance its production capacity by integrating advanced technological innovations from the United States. To foster new competition within the Libyan market, AGOCO is engaging with leading global technical service firms to explore investment opportunities in oil field development, with a specific focus on enhanced oil recovery (EOR) techniques such as gas, water, and chemical injection to extend well productivity. On the environmental front, AGOCO is prioritizing production water treatment technology to convert oil and gas wastewater into resources suitable for irrigation, representing a major shift toward sustainable water utilization. These initiatives are designed to open broad prospects for foreign investment, support the national strategy to increase daily production rates, and reduce operating costs by localizing modern technologies through fair technical competition.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The seventh edition of the Libya International Food Fair has officially opened at the Tripoli International Fairgrounds, featuring a robu...
records.description: The seventh edition of the Libya International Food Fair has officially opened at the Tripoli International Fairgrounds, featuring a robust participation of 98 international companies from 14 countries—led by Turkey, Egypt, and Tunisia—alongside over 100 local firms. Inaugurated by a high-level delegation including the Ministry of Industry and Minerals, the Ministry of Economy and Trade, and the Ministry of Tourism and Handicrafts, the event is being hailed as a clear indicator of growing investor confidence in the stability of the Libyan market. According to the Ministry of Industry and Minerals, the exhibition's primary goal extends beyond product display to the localization of modern technology and the establishment of international partnerships aimed at raising the efficiency of domestic products to global standards.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Minerals, the Ministry of Economy and Trade, and the Ministry of Tourism and Handicrafts

records.title: The Nouakchott Region, in a strategic partnership with the National Water Company, the city of Lausanne, and the International Associatio...
records.description: The Nouakchott Region, in a strategic partnership with the National Water Company, the city of Lausanne, and the International Association of Francophone Mayors, has launched a technical workshop dedicated to modernizing leak management in the capital's water network. Titled “From Water Loss to Improved Performance,” the initiative marks a transition in the Nouakchott Region’s priorities from expanding distribution to optimizing production and ensuring service sustainability. By exchanging technical expertise with Swiss water authorities, the Nouakchott Region aims to implement practical measures to reduce water waste, particularly in outlying neighborhoods, aligning with national directives to ensure equitable and efficient water access for all families.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and wholesale trade networks in Morocco have significantly increased the importation of Dutch onions to addre...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and wholesale trade networks in Morocco have significantly increased the importation of Dutch onions to address a prolonged domestic shortage. Driven by adverse weather conditions in key production basins like Tamehdit, Fes, and Meknes, the current scarcity of yellow onion varieties has extended beyond the typical January–March window. According to trade indicators at the Casablanca wholesale market, the "more acute" shortage this year has made the Netherlands the primary supplier due to favorable pricing and high volumes. While Moroccan traders traditionally use imports as a seasonal workaround, the Ministry of Agriculture expects the reliance on Dutch imports to continue later into the 2026 season until local production levels in the Fes-Meknes region recover.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched the "Solar Energy – Sustainable Harvest" initiative to integrate...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched the "Solar Energy – Sustainable Harvest" initiative to integrate renewable energy into Oman's farming sector. In collaboration with Nafath Renewable Energy and the Development Bank, the program offers financing of up to RO 15,000 to transition farms—particularly those using greenhouses and modern irrigation—to solar power. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has structured the financing to include zero interest for full-time farmers and a 3% rate for part-time farmers, aimed at reducing operational costs and carbon emissions. Priority is given to projects supporting national food security, provided the land is officially registered, possesses an agricultural electricity meter, and offers at least 100sqm of shade-free space for panel installation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Hebron Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, through its local department in Idhna, has signed 29 new support agreements as part of...
records.description: The Hebron Governorate Directorate of Agriculture, through its local department in Idhna, has signed 29 new support agreements as part of a targeted food security project for rural families in Areas Classified as (C). Supervised by the Ministry of Agriculture and funded by the CRIC Foundation, the initiative provides essential resources for poultry farming, home gardening, and vegetable production. By focusing on these high-impact, household-level interventions, the Ministry of Agriculture and the Land Research Center aim to strengthen the economic resilience of families in the Hebron and Bethlehem governorates, ensuring a sustainable and independent food supply for vulnerable rural communities.
records.institution: The Hebron Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Municipality of Al-Bireh have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to establish a central fores...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Municipality of Al-Bireh have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to establish a central forestry nursery in Al-Bireh. This facility, spanning two dunams, is designed to produce 50,000 seedlings annually, including forest, rangeland, and ornamental trees, as well as olive saplings. The project serves as a strategic replacement for the nursery recently destroyed in Kafr Malik and aims to counter the systematic targeting of agricultural symbols like the olive tree. Beyond seedling production, the partnership focuses on "circular" agricultural practices, including the production of compost from organic waste, the expansion of urban agriculture, and the delivery of specialized veterinary and extension services to bolster national food security and environmental resilience.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully completed the first phase of its European Union-funded agricultural assistance program in th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully completed the first phase of its European Union-funded agricultural assistance program in the Salfit Governorate. By officially receiving nine new projects in the towns of Bruqin and Kafr ad-Dik, the total number of implemented and delivered projects in the governorate has reached 35.
