This latest batch includes six specialized beekeeping initiatives, two sheep projects, and one cattle project, all designed to restore the productive capacities of farmers whose livelihoods were previously documented as damaged. Under the direct supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture's technical teams, these interventions aim to economically empower local producers and ensure the long-term sustainability of agricultural work on their lands.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully received two pioneering agricultural projects dedicated to alternative feed production in th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully received two pioneering agricultural projects dedicated to alternative feed production in the Hebron Governorate. Part of the Italian-funded "Saneet" project, these initiatives target farmers in Beit Ula and Al-Dhahiriya to modernize the livestock sector. Implemented by the CIHEAM Bari Institute in partnership with the Palestinian Employment Fund, the projects provided integrated feed production units and rehabilitated sheep-rearing facilities. By equipping local farmers with advanced technology for the domestic manufacturing of feed, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to reduce high production costs, improve nutritional quality, and decrease the sector's dependence on imported fodder, thereby fostering long-term economic sustainability in rural and marginalized areas.

records.title: Saudi Arabia has achieved a monumental environmental milestone by successfully rehabilitating one million hectares of degraded land under...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has achieved a monumental environmental milestone by successfully rehabilitating one million hectares of degraded land under the Saudi Green Initiative, a feat the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) hails as a global blueprint for water-scarce regions. Spearheaded by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, this achievement utilizes science-based solutions—including cloud seeding, sandstorm early warning systems, and expanded protected areas—to strengthen biodiversity and ecosystem resilience. Aligned with Vision 2030, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has demonstrated that coordinated action between the government and private sector can turn environmental challenges into economic opportunities. As the international community prepares for COP17 in Mongolia in August 2026, this million-hectare restoration serves as a critical example of the scale and pace required to bolster global food security and drought resilience.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in partnership with the Ministry of Environment, Wate...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in partnership with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Al-Baha branch, has launched a significant afforestation campaign in Wadi Dharak National Park. This initiative is a localized extension of the Saudi Green Initiative, focusing on the ecological restoration of the Al-Baha region through the planting of native species specifically adapted to the desert climate. By fostering community participation, the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification aims to expand the region’s green footprint, improve the quality of life for residents, and secure long-term environmental sustainability in alignment with the Kingdom's broader development goals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has marked the International Day of Zero Waste (March 30) by reaffirming its...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has marked the International Day of Zero Waste (March 30) by reaffirming its extensive commitment to the UAE’s sustainability agenda. Through a comprehensive "Circular Economy" approach, ADAFSA is integrating Agriculture 4.0 technologies—including robotics, AI-driven oversight, and big-data analytics—to minimize resource depletion across the food value chain. In 2025 alone, the Authority conducted over 116,000 inspection visits and administered 6.1 million vaccinations to stabilize livestock supply chains and reduce mortality. By repurposing food loss into broiler nutrition, redistributing surplus through food banks, and launching the Ghars Educational Platform, ADAFSA is fostering a high-tech, knowledgeable agricultural community dedicated to the UAE's 2030 Sustainable Development Goals.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has organized a specialized training course focused on human resources development for employees across its h...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has organized a specialized training course focused on human resources development for employees across its headquarters and affiliated departments. Conducted by the Planning and Follow-up Department via its Statistics, Manpower, and Training Division, the program addressed fundamental management functions including time management, knowledge management, and change management. This initiative is a central component of the Ministry of Agriculture's broader strategy to modernize its administrative capabilities and enhance the professional skills and knowledge of its workforce through consistent educational seminars and modern management training.

records.title: Jordan has achieved a landmark diplomatic and environmental milestone by becoming the first Arab nation to host a regional office for the...
records.description: Jordan has achieved a landmark diplomatic and environmental milestone by becoming the first Arab nation to host a regional office for the Green Climate Fund (GCF). Based in Amman, this new headquarters will oversee climate action across Eastern Europe, Central Asia, and the Middle East, positioning the Kingdom as a central hub for climate adaptation and natural resource management. According to the Ministry of Environment, the office will specifically target regional priorities such as water scarcity and renewable energy expansion while facilitating direct access to international climate finance. Supported by the BRCCJ Project, this strategic move is expected to bolster technical support for vital sectors like agriculture, reflecting global confidence in Jordan's capacity to lead collective, sustainable solutions for the world’s most climate-vulnerable regions.

records.title: The Public Authority for Food and Nutrition in Kuwait has confirmed that national food supplies remain "sufficient" and that its speciali...
records.description: The Public Authority for Food and Nutrition in Kuwait has confirmed that national food supplies remain "sufficient" and that its specialized teams are operating around the clock to manage the flow of incoming shipments. Under the guidance of the Public Authority for Food and Nutrition, laboratories and inspection outlets are working at full capacity to examine products and ensure strict compliance with health safety standards. According to the Public Authority for Food and Nutrition, inspection tours of central markets and food factories have been intensified to protect public health and maintain a stable food environment for all citizens and residents.
records.institution: The Public Authority for Food and Nutrition

records.title: The National Development Agency (NDA) has announced that its Sirte Agricultural Project No.
records.description: The National Development Agency (NDA) has announced that its Sirte Agricultural Project No. 87 reached an 80% completion milestone as of late March 2026. Spanning 350 hectares, the initiative is dedicated to the cultivation of strategic grains—primarily wheat and barley—to bolster national food security. According to the NDA, the project serves as a practical application of the nation’s Vision 2030, focusing on utilizing local land to reduce import dependency and build a sustainable, self-sufficient economy. As the harvest season approaches, the agency highlights this development as a fundamental pillar in a broader package of agricultural projects aimed at restoring the vital role of domestic production and achieving a genuine agricultural renaissance.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has issued an urgent advisory for farmers, livestock breeders, beekeepers, and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has issued an urgent advisory for farmers, livestock breeders, beekeepers, and fishermen to take comprehensive precautions to protect themselves and their property ahead of a forecasted weather depression. Following alerts from the National Multi Hazard Early Warning Center under the Civil Aviation Authority (CAA), officials warned of a low-pressure system expected to bring scattered thunderstorms, active winds, and potential flash floods across several governorates. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources specifically urged the public to stay away from dams and drainage channels and advised against maritime activities during the storm to mitigate risks associated with heavy wadi flow and reduced visibility.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has signed twelve new resilience agreements to support farmers in the Jerusalem, Salfit, and Ramallah governo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has signed twelve new resilience agreements to support farmers in the Jerusalem, Salfit, and Ramallah governorates who have been directly impacted by regional challenges. Funded by the European Union, this phase of the agricultural assistance program provides a total of 605,000 shekels to revitalize productive capacities that, in some cases, had been compromised for several years. The Ministry of Agriculture emphasized that the funding—ranging from 18,000 to 76,000 shekels per beneficiary—targets a diverse group of small and large-scale producers, providing essential resources such as livestock, beehives, tractors, and greenhouse infrastructure. By completing rigorous documentation and verification processes, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to transform affected farmers back into active contributors to the local economy, ensuring the long-term sustainability and food security of the Palestinian agricultural sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Hebron Veterinary Directorate, has conducted a critical field mission to dairy and sheep fatteni...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Hebron Veterinary Directorate, has conducted a critical field mission to dairy and sheep fattening farms to strengthen national biosecurity and protect livestock assets. As part of a comprehensive epidemic control plan, the Veterinary Services Department successfully vaccinated 650 dairy cows and 350 fattening sheep against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD). Beyond the vaccination campaign, the Ministry of Agriculture provided direct technical guidance to farmers on implementing rigorous biosecurity standards to limit disease transmission. These ongoing efforts are central to the Ministry’s strategy to enhance farmer resilience, safeguard the local economy, and ensure the long-term health of the Palestinian livestock sector.

records.title: The General Authority for Fish Resources and Aquatic Life, in collaboration with the Idlib Agriculture Directorate, the Arab Center for t...
records.description: The General Authority for Fish Resources and Aquatic Life, in collaboration with the Idlib Agriculture Directorate, the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), and regional academic and professional syndicates, has launched a comprehensive freshwater fish breeding course to revitalize the local aquaculture sector. This integrated training program combines theoretical and practical modules covering essential skills such as broodstock selection, advanced breeding techniques, and larval care. By partnering with the Faculties of Veterinary Medicine and Agricultural Engineering, the General Authority for Fish Resources and Aquatic Life aims to equip participants with the technical expertise required to increase production efficiency and improve the overall quality of freshwater fish, ultimately fostering a more sustainable and productive aquatic industry.
records.institution: The General Authority for Fish Resources and Aquatic Life

records.title: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab, in cooperation with the FAO, has commenced a maintenance project for...
records.description: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab, in cooperation with the FAO, has commenced a maintenance project for the "C2" irrigation canal to enhance the efficiency of regional water networks. The initiative involves the rehabilitation of approximately 2.5 kilometers of the canal, including concrete work across more than 23,000 square meters, alongside centralized maintenance for irrigation in the Al-Hawrat and Al-Karim areas. Additionally, the project includes the dredging of over 10 kilometers of earthen drains to improve water flow and ensure reliable access for farmers. This work is a core component of the General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab's strategic plan to modernize agricultural infrastructure and boost the overall productivity of the region's farming sector.
records.institution: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has issued a comprehensive suite of emergency guidelines for farmers and liv...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has issued a comprehensive suite of emergency guidelines for farmers and livestock breeders to mitigate the impact of recent weather events. To protect plant wealth, ADAFSA recommends delaying harvests until crops are fully dry and applying copper and calcium-based treatments to fruit trees and tuber crops to prevent fungal infections. For livestock management, the ADAFSA protocols mandate the disinfection of barn floors with lime or agricultural sulphur, the isolation of animals exposed to rain, and a strategic 10–20% increase in high-nutrient feed supplemented with Vitamin C and amino acids to bolster immunity. Furthermore, ADAFSA urged operators of shared irrigation systems to inspect water tanks and transmission lines, emphasizing that technical support remains available through its regional agricultural extension centers and veterinary clinics to ensure the long-term sustainability of the sector.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, has confirmed that Iraq maintains a "sufficient strategic reserve" of ess...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, has confirmed that Iraq maintains a "sufficient strategic reserve" of essential medicines and vaccines to protect the national livestock population despite regional instability. Director General Dr. Muhammad Al-Mayahi revealed that the Ministry has successfully pivoted its logistics strategy, moving away from a reliance on Baghdad International Airport toward robust overland supply routes through Turkey and Jordan. By utilizing specialized refrigerated trucks to ensure the cold-chain integrity of these biological products, the Ministry is securing the needs of both the public and private veterinary sectors and enhancing the country’s long-term veterinary security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, as part of Jordan’s Economic Modernisation Vision (2026–2029), has launched a strategic initiative to establ...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, as part of Jordan’s Economic Modernisation Vision (2026–2029), has launched a strategic initiative to establish the National Artificial Insemination Centre for Sheep and Goats. Implemented in coordination with the National Centre for Agricultural Research (NCAR), which serves as the technical arm, this project aims to revolutionize the livestock sector by accelerating the dissemination of superior genetic traits. By focusing on local breeds such as Awassi sheep and Shami and Baladi goats, the centre will improve milk production, growth rates, and feed conversion efficiency while minimizing disease transmission. With an estimated executive programme cost of JD 64.5 million for 2027–2029, the Ministry of Agriculture intends to enhance national food security, reduce import dependency, and empower rural breeders to adapt to climate challenges like drought and rising temperatures through resilient, genetically improved livestock.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Lebanon Agricultural Department, has successfully concluded the "Agricultural Business Man...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Lebanon Agricultural Department, has successfully concluded the "Agricultural Business Management School" in Jezzine. This strategic capacity-building initiative, implemented in coordination with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), the Municipality of Jezzine, and the J. Grove Foundation, provided 15 local farmers with intensive training in transforming traditional farming into sustainable commercial enterprises. By focusing on financial management, risk assessment, and production programming, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to equip rural operators with the professional tools necessary to withstand Lebanon's current economic challenges. The program concluded with the distribution of in-kind assistance to trainees, ensuring they have the immediate resources to apply their new managerial skills to their own agricultural projects.

records.title: Credit Oman achieved a 3.67% growth in performance, with total exports and insured local sales reaching OMR 390.2 million compared to OMR...
records.description: Credit Oman achieved a 3.67% growth in performance, with total exports and insured local sales reaching OMR 390.2 million compared to OMR 376.4 million in the previous year. Operating entirely on its own resources, Credit Oman reported a profit of OMR 258,200 while playing a pivotal role in supporting national development and promoting non-oil exports, which accounted for OMR 210 million of its insured sales across sectors such as agriculture, fisheries, and petrochemicals. The institution saw a 15.7% increase in the number of document holders, reflecting a growing awareness of its credit insurance services as a vital tool for mitigating non-payment risks and stabilizing cash flows for companies of all sizes. By allocating investments into highly liquid instruments, Credit Oman grew its total assets beyond OMR 20 million, reinforcing its strategic approach to providing comprehensive insurance solutions that enable local businesses to contract confidently with international partners and expand into global markets.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine has officially received the completed rehabilitation works for eight agricultural wells in the t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine has officially received the completed rehabilitation works for eight agricultural wells in the town of Nuba, Hebron. Funded by the World Food Programme and implemented by the Applied Research Institute – Jerusalem (ARIJ), this initiative is a core component of the "Developing Livelihoods and Climate Change Resilience in Palestine" project. The intervention included the modernization of well infrastructure, the installation of an integrated irrigation network, the construction of a 1.5-cubic-meter water tank, and the integration of a 30-liter fertilizer injector. By improving water use efficiency and resource management, the Ministry of Agriculture and its international partners aim to bolster farmer resilience and enhance national food security in the face of escalating climate and economic challenges.

records.title: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) has dramatically accelerated its "Logistics Corridors Initiative" to bypass the Strait of Hormuz block...
records.description: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) has dramatically accelerated its "Logistics Corridors Initiative" to bypass the Strait of Hormuz blockade. By launching a new shipping link with Bahrain and adding five high-capacity maritime services in partnership with global leaders like Maersk and MSC, Saudi Arabia has added over 63,000 TEUs of operational capacity to the region. The strategic pivot focuses on rerouting Gulf-bound cargo toward Red Sea gateways—including Jeddah Islamic Port and King Abdullah Port—and utilizing overland transport to deliver essential goods to Eastern markets. This shift, coupled with new integrated vessel support services in the Arabian Gulf, is designed to stabilize food supply chains and ensure the predictable movement of commodities despite ongoing geopolitical volatility.

records.title: The state grain agency OAIC has secured approximately 690,000 tons of milling wheat in a significant international tender, far exceeding...
records.description: The state grain agency OAIC has secured approximately 690,000 tons of milling wheat in a significant international tender, far exceeding typical minimum purchase volumes to bolster national food security. The wheat was acquired at an estimated cost of $272 per ton, totaling roughly $187.7 million, with the majority of the supply expected to originate from the Black Sea region, including Ukraine, Romania, and Bulgaria. This procurement reflects a strategic shift by OAIC to diversify its import sources away from traditional European suppliers toward more competitive Black Sea exporters. By planning shipments for the early and late weeks of June, OAIC aims to maintain stable grain stocks and mitigate the risks of shortages amidst global market volatility and shifting international trade patterns.

records.title: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation / Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) has confirmed that four key dams—Al Tannour, Shaytham, Al Fidan, and...
records.description: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation / Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) has confirmed that four key dams—Al Tannour, Shaytham, Al Fidan, and Al Wuhaydi—have reached 100% capacity and are currently overflowing following a series of intense low-pressure systems. This surge in surface runoff has significantly bolstered Jordan's water security, providing a critical buffer for the upcoming summer season. The Ministry of Agriculture noted that these precipitation levels have not only recharged groundwater and desert ponds but have also revitalized rain-fed crops and natural rangelands in the Badia, offering immediate financial relief to livestock breeders through increased access to natural fodder.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation / Jordan Valley Authority (JVA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced a temporary suspension of tomato exports to address a recent supply deficit and stabilize local...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced a temporary suspension of tomato exports to address a recent supply deficit and stabilize local market prices following a seasonal spike in demand. This measure aims to bridge the gap between the current daily supply and the required national consumption while countering instances of unjustified price hikes by retailers. By monitoring daily data from the central market, the Ministry of Agriculture anticipates a production surplus in the coming days that will naturally lower consumer costs. Furthermore, the Ministry of Agriculture, in coordination with the Ministry of Industry and Trade, will publish regular guidance bulletins to ensure price transparency and has reassured the public that national agricultural stocks remain secure, eliminating the need for panic buying.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Mauritania, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has launched a national wor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Mauritania, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has launched a national workshop to finalize and enrich the National Strategy for Agricultural Mechanization. Chaired by Secretary-General Ahmed Salem Ould Larbi, the workshop serves as a collaborative platform for regional representatives and development partners to review the strategic document before its official adoption. This initiative, aligned with the directives of President Mohamed Ould Cheikh Ghazouani, identifies mechanization as the primary driver for increasing agricultural productivity and national food security. By integrating modern equipment, supporting youth-led agricultural projects, and providing specialized technical training, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to modernize production systems and ensure the long-term sustainability of the sector across Mauritania.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, led by Minister Professor Rizq Salimiya, has signed 16 critical support and resilience agreements with farme...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, led by Minister Professor Rizq Salimiya, has signed 16 critical support and resilience agreements with farmers from the Hebron and Bethlehem governorates. Hosted by the Hebron Chamber of Commerce and Industry, this initiative is part of an European Union-funded agricultural assistance program designed to revitalize the productive capacities of farmers directly affected by regional challenges. With a total investment of 862,000 shekels, the funding is divided between 14 farmers in Hebron (768,000 shekels) and 2 in Bethlehem (94,000 shekels). The Ministry of Agriculture emphasized that these beneficiaries were selected based on documented damage records and rigorous EU criteria, ensuring that the aid directly supports high-impact projects such as livestock replenishment, modern machinery acquisition, and climate-resilient infrastructure.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Saudi Arabia’s waste plastic recycling market is undergoing a high-tech evolution, projected to grow from US$411.4 million in 2025 to US$...
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s waste plastic recycling market is undergoing a high-tech evolution, projected to grow from US$411.4 million in 2025 to US$748.0 million by 2034. Driven by Vision 2030 and a robust 6.87% CAGR, the Kingdom is deploying AI-driven sorting and advanced chemical recycling to manage its 7 million tonnes of annual plastic waste. With the Saudi Investment Recycling Company (SIRC) leading a nationwide infrastructure overhaul, the goal is to divert 81% of waste from landfills by 2035, transforming the nation into a regional hub for the circular economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries in Tunisia has officially launched a transformative electronic platform to ma...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries in Tunisia has officially launched a transformative electronic platform to manage the permitting process for deep-well drilling (exceeding 50 meters) and groundwater exploitation. Unveiled during World Water Day (March 22), this digital leap reduces administrative processing times from over one year to just 21 days. Developed in collaboration with the Prime Minister’s Office and the UNDP, the platform is a central pillar of Tunisia's strategy to combat unregulated drilling, enhance transparency, and manage severe water stress through data analytics and artificial intelligence.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq is advancing its national strategy to modernize the horticultural sector and boost domestic productio...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq is advancing its national strategy to modernize the horticultural sector and boost domestic production through the activities of the Mahawil Horticulture Station. Under the "National Program for the Propagation of Fruit and Olive Varieties," the station has successfully achieved high germination rates for olive, fig, grape, pomegranate, and mulberry cuttings within climate-controlled greenhouses. Simultaneously, the Ministry of Agriculture is executing the "National Program for the Propagation of Local Vegetable Crops and Hybrids," recently completing the planting of the "Batira" okra variety. These integrated efforts are specifically designed to produce improved, high-yield seed varieties and saplings to supply the local market and enhance the long-term resilience of the Iraqi agricultural landscape.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced that Jordan has achieved a 61% self-sufficiency rate for crops, affirming the agricultural sect...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced that Jordan has achieved a 61% self-sufficiency rate for crops, affirming the agricultural sector's ability to meet domestic demand without the need for vegetable price caps. The Ministry of Agriculture, in coordination with the Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply, continues to monitor market prices and anticipates a decline in vegetable costs as local supply increases following favorable rainfall. While the country remains fully self-sufficient in vegetables, the Ministry of Agriculture notes that imports are restricted to specific types of fruit, ensuring that the national agricultural season remains a primary pillar of food security.

records.title: The public body Morocco Foodex is organizing a strategic B2B mission in Marrakech for European importers and buyers to strengthen trade p...
records.description: The public body Morocco Foodex is organizing a strategic B2B mission in Marrakech for European importers and buyers to strengthen trade partnerships and showcase national agricultural expertise. This initiative, part of a broader national export strategy, includes on-site visits to production facilities and agri-food units to demonstrate the Kingdom's modernized infrastructure, traceability systems, and strict compliance with European health requirements. According to Morocco Foodex, these direct interactions between producers and international buyers focus on quality management and sustainability commitments, aiming to secure new commercial contracts and diversify exports into high-value segments. By facilitating these field visits, Morocco Foodex highlights the competitiveness of the sector and reinforces the nation's position as a reliable global supplier of high-quality food products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in partnership with the private sector, is spearheading a transition toward i...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in partnership with the private sector, is spearheading a transition toward investment-driven farming in the Al-Uwaynat area of Sohar to reduce imports and enhance national self-sufficiency. This initiative encompasses nine integrated projects covering approximately 100 acres with a total investment of OMR 2.3 million, positioning North Al Batinah as a primary food basket for the Sultanate. By utilizing a strategic mix of open-field cultivation and modern greenhouse technologies, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources ensures year-round production of sustainable fruit crops like mango and lemon, alongside seasonal melons and protected vegetables. These model farming projects, facilitated through the "Tatweer" platform, align with the goals of Oman Vision 2040 by adopting advanced irrigation and smart farming techniques to secure water resources while creating employment and stabilizing the local food supply.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Nablus Veterinary Directorate, has completed a critical livestock protection missi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Nablus Veterinary Directorate, has completed a critical livestock protection mission involving the tagging and vaccination of sheep in the towns of Burin, Einabus, Beita, and Duma. This initiative, executed within the framework of an European Union-funded agricultural assistance project, specifically targets farmers previously affected by external agricultural damages. By implementing standardized biosecurity protocols and recording herd data in official registers, the Ministry of Agriculture is enhancing its veterinary monitoring and rapid intervention capabilities. These efforts are part of a broader package of projects aimed at empowering rural livestock breeders, reducing the spread of infectious diseases, and ensuring the long-term sustainability of the agricultural sector in the Nablus Governorate.

records.title: Egypt’s wheat production is projected to reach 9.8 million tons in the 2026/2027 season, marking a 6.5% year-on-year (YoY) increase accor...
records.description: Egypt’s wheat production is projected to reach 9.8 million tons in the 2026/2027 season, marking a 6.5% year-on-year (YoY) increase according to the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA). This growth is driven by a strategic expansion of cultivated land to 3.6 million feddans and enhanced government procurement prices designed to incentivize local farmers. As a direct result of these domestic gains, national wheat imports are expected to stabilize at 12.5 million tons, reflecting a successful pivot toward long-term food security and a reduced reliance on international grain markets.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced a strategic, one-month temporary opening of tomato imports to bridge a seasonal supply gap in I...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced a strategic, one-month temporary opening of tomato imports to bridge a seasonal supply gap in Iraq’s local markets. Undersecretary Dr. Mahdi Suhr al-Jubouri clarified that this move addresses the "transitional phase" between the conclusion of the autumn harvest and the start of the spring cycle. Despite regional volatility, the Ministry reaffirmed the overall stability of the agricultural sector, attributing consistent crop prices to the widespread adoption of integrated agricultural packages, including modern drip irrigation, protected agriculture (greenhouses), and improved seed varieties by Iraqi farmers.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully renewed the accreditation of its seed testing laboratories within the International Seed Tes...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully renewed the accreditation of its seed testing laboratories within the International Seed Testing Association (ISTA) for 2026. This renewal, officially confirmed during a specialized technical summit in Budapest, Hungary, ensures that Iraq’s laboratory systems continue to meet the highest globally recognized standards for seed quality and technical precision. By receiving the 2026 International Seed Testing Standards, the Ministry has secured the primary global reference for its operations, reinforcing the nation's ability to participate in international agricultural trade with verified, high-quality seed stocks.

records.title: Jordan has fortified its national food security in response to regional supply chain disruptions and the ongoing conflict involving Iran.
records.description: Jordan has fortified its national food security in response to regional supply chain disruptions and the ongoing conflict involving Iran. During a parliamentary briefing Minister of Industry, Trade, and Supply confirmed that the Kingdom's strategic wheat reserves are sufficient to cover domestic consumption for 5.5 months, with an additional four-month supply already contracted and in transit—bringing total projected coverage to nearly 10 months. To shield households from rising transport costs, the government has ruled out any tax or duty increases and has maintained strict export controls on essential staples since November 2025.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply

records.title: The second phase of the national livestock rebuilding program has commenced with a pre-payment control operation to verify the presence o...
records.description: The second phase of the national livestock rebuilding program has commenced with a pre-payment control operation to verify the presence of registered and ear-tagged breeding female sheep and goats across the country. According to a press release from the Ministry of Agriculture, this strategic initiative involves mobilizing local committees in all provinces, in coordination with the Ministry of the Interior and the Ministry of Economy and Finance, to audit data against the national livestock census. Following the successful distribution of an initial tranche of over 5.2 billion dirhams to nearly 1.1 million farmers, this final installment aims to complete the direct support program, ensuring the maintenance of breeding females and the stabilization of the red meat supply in pastoral areas. This verification process is essential for the sustainable consolidation of the national herd and the completion of a program that has already identified more than 32 million head of livestock to secure national food resilience.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Ministry of Social Development and the Land Research Center, has signed economic e...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Ministry of Social Development and the Land Research Center, has signed economic empowerment agreements to support 12 vulnerable families in the town of Halhul. Funded by the CRIC Foundation, this initiative is a core component of the "Contributing to Enhancing Food Security for Families in Rural Areas of the Southern West Bank" project. The program is divided into two primary interventions: the establishment of six home gardens equipped with irrigation networks, water tanks, and fertilizers to promote self-sufficiency, and the provision of six poultry units (including laying hens, cages, and one ton of feed per unit) to create sustainable income streams. By prioritizing the economic empowerment of rural households, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to strengthen local resilience and safeguard food security for the region's most at-risk groups.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Nablus Directorate of Agriculture, has officially received 11 livestock production...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Nablus Directorate of Agriculture, has officially received 11 livestock production projects valued at approximately 500,000 shekels. Funded by the European Union as part of a strategic agricultural assistance program, these initiatives are being implemented across the villages of Salem, Deir al-Hatab, al-Nasariya, Burqa, and Deir Sharaf. The handover process included a rigorous technical audit to ensure all infrastructure—including rehabilitated sheep pens, milking equipment, and agricultural machinery—met approved standards. By providing these essential production inputs, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to bolster the resilience of small-scale farmers in rural Nablus, enhancing their production efficiency and securing sustainable income sources to ensure they can remain on their land.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Hebron Governorate Directorate, has launched an emergency restoration initiative in the town of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Hebron Governorate Directorate, has launched an emergency restoration initiative in the town of Idhna to support farmers impacted by the recent destruction of agricultural lands. Following directives to prioritize the rehabilitation of uprooted groves, the Agriculture and Veterinary Department distributed 2,757 three-year-old olive saplings to 68 local farmers. This intervention, supported by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), serves as a direct response to the loss of over 4,000 trees and the destruction of 200 dunams of land. By providing mature saplings that are closer to production age, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to accelerate the recovery of the local olive sector and strengthen the resilience of rural communities adjacent to the separation wall.

records.title: The FAO, in partnership with the Directorate General for Land Management and Conservation (DGACTA) and with funding from Japan, has launc...
records.description: The FAO, in partnership with the Directorate General for Land Management and Conservation (DGACTA) and with funding from Japan, has launched a specialized technical training cycle at the Central Soil Analysis Laboratory in Tunis. Part of the global "SoilFER" program, this initiative focuses on harmonizing wet chemistry analytical protocols and introducing dry chemistry (spectroscopy) to ensure the production of reliable, high-quality soil data. To date, the project has facilitated the collection of over 3,000 soil samples, aiming to modernize national laboratory capacities and consolidate soil information systems. By adhering to international standards for traceability and validation, the FAO and DGACTA are establishing a data-driven foundation for sustainable natural resource management and the refinement of Tunisian agricultural policies.
records.institution: The Directorate General for Land Management and Conservation (DGACTA)

records.title: Tunisia’s olive oil sector has achieved a significant volume recovery during the first four months of the 2025–2026 campaign (November–Fe...
records.description: Tunisia’s olive oil sector has achieved a significant volume recovery during the first four months of the 2025–2026 campaign (November–February), with export quantities surging by 49.6% to reach 184.3 thousand tonnes. Data from ONAGRI indicates that while total revenues climbed to 2.263 billion TND, the industry remains heavily reliant on bulk exports, which account for the vast majority of volume. Despite a 4% decrease in the average price to 12.01 TND/kg compared to the previous season, the strategic importance of the European and North American markets—led by Spain (32.1%) and the USA (15.4%)—continues to underpin the sector's contribution to national agricultural revenue.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has launched a specialized breeding cycle for local catfish at t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has launched a specialized breeding cycle for local catfish at the Al-Radwaniyah Fish Reserve west of Baghdad. By introducing the first batch of high-quality broodstock into dedicated spawning ponds, the Ministry is executing a targeted conservation strategy to replenish indigenous Iraqi fish populations. Technical teams have implemented rigorous "approved technical standards" for the treatment of fertilized eggs—averaging 500 grams per batch—to maximize hatching efficiency. This initiative at the Al-Radwaniyah Fish Reserve is a cornerstone of Iraq’s broader commitment to preserving aquatic biodiversity and securing a resilient, local protein source for national food security.

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, is advancing Iraq’s "National Program for the Propagation of Local Vege...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, is advancing Iraq’s "National Program for the Propagation of Local Vegetable Crop Varieties and Hybrids" by scaling up the production of "Land of the Two Rivers" organic pellet fertilizer. Produced entirely by specialized national staff, this chemical-free, environmentally friendly alternative is designed to rehabilitate Iraqi soil by restoring essential nutrients—Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), and Potassium (K)—while significantly improving moisture retention. By offering this high-quality organic fertilizer at subsidized prices, the Ministry of Agriculture is directly reducing the operational costs for Iraqi farmers and decreasing national reliance on expensive, synthetic imported fertilizers.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources recorded a total of 24.47 million cubic metres of water impounded by dams acro...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources recorded a total of 24.47 million cubic metres of water impounded by dams across the Sultanate of Oman following significant weather conditions. The highest rainfall was observed in Barka at 133 mm, with major retention occurring in the Wadi Dayqah Dam in Muscat and several dams in Al Batinah South, including Al Taw and Al Maawil. Several reservoirs, such as the Al Sudairiyin and Al Aqida dams, reached maximum capacity as the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources monitored mid-range to heavy rainfall across governorates including Musandam, Al Dhahirah, and Al Sharqiyah North. This influx of surface water across the national dam network remains a critical component for recharging aquifers and securing long-term water resources for the agricultural and domestic sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Saudi Arabia’s celebration of World Water Day 2026 marks a significant transition from national resource management to global leadership.
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s celebration of World Water Day 2026 marks a significant transition from national resource management to global leadership. With this year’s theme, "Water and Gender: Where Water Flows, Equality Grows," the Kingdom is highlighting the intersection of water security and social equity. Under the guidance of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA), Saudi Arabia is leveraging its status as the world’s largest producer of desalinated water to export technical expertise and humanitarian aid to water-stressed regions globally.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The UAE has marked World Water Day 2026 by solidifying its role as a global leader in water diplomacy and innovation, highlighted by the...
records.description: The UAE has marked World Water Day 2026 by solidifying its role as a global leader in water diplomacy and innovation, highlighted by the upcoming 2026 United Nations Water Conference in December, which it will co-host with Senegal. Addressing a global crisis where 2.2 billion people lack clean drinking water, the UAE is deploying a multi-billion-dollar strategy that includes a $150 million pledge for scarcity solutions and the $60 million "Clean Rivers" program spanning Brazil, Indonesia, and the Philippines. Through high-impact humanitarian engineering like Operation Chivalrous Knight 3, the UAE has established critical infrastructure including a 2-million-gallon-per-day pipeline in Gaza and desalination units for Cyprus, demonstrating a unique ability to export both financial capital and advanced water technology to the world's most water-stressed regions.
records.institution: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative and Suqia UAE

records.title: Despite recent winter rainfall, Tunisia’s water situation remains "critical," with a structural deficit driven by an exploitation rate of...
records.description: Despite recent winter rainfall, Tunisia’s water situation remains "critical," with a structural deficit driven by an exploitation rate of 133% of available resources. Speaking on World Water Day, the Water and Development Association highlighted that while the national dam filling rate has reached 54%, the Sidi Salem dam—the country’s largest reservoir—remains below this average. With nearly 34,000 illegal deep wells currently in operation, the Ministry of Agriculture is under pressure to revise the 1975 Water Code and implement deterrent measures against overexploitation. Strategic solutions now being accelerated include the launch of a tender for Tunisia’s first underground dam in the Saouaf region, the installation of floating photovoltaic panels to reduce evaporation, and a target to increase the utilization of treated wastewater for agriculture from its current 10% to 700 million cubic meters by 2050.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has marked World Water Day 2026 by accelerating its transition to "Agricultu...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has marked World Water Day 2026 by accelerating its transition to "Agriculture 4.0," a technology-driven strategy to combat groundwater depletion and rising salinity. In a strategic partnership with the Abu Dhabi Department of Energy, the Authority has implemented a pilot AI-driven smart metering project in Al Wathba, while simultaneously expanding a massive recycled water network that currently serves over 1,600 farms. By integrating smart sensors, data analytics, and digital training via the Ghars Educational Platform, ADAFSA aims to eliminate water waste and move the Emirate toward a non-conventional water cycle, ensuring that irrigation is precisely calibrated to soil conditions while preserving non-renewable national reserves.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Egypt and Indonesia are projected to tie for the title of the world’s largest wheat importer in the 2025/2026 season, with the United Sta...
records.description: Egypt and Indonesia are projected to tie for the title of the world’s largest wheat importer in the 2025/2026 season, with the United States Department of Agriculture (USDA) forecasting imports of 13 million tons for each nation. Together, these two markets will command approximately 12% of the global wheat trade, a shift driven by Egypt's need to sustain its subsidized bread program for a population of 108 million and Indonesia's surging demand in the milling and feed sectors. While Egypt's local production is expected to rise to 9.2 million tons due to expanded planted areas, it remains far below the national consumption requirement of over 20 million tons, ensuring that major exporters like Russia, the EU, and Australia will remain focused on these two primary demand hubs.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation is preparing to launch the 2026 local wheat harvest in mid-April, starting in Upper Egyp...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation is preparing to launch the 2026 local wheat harvest in mid-April, starting in Upper Egypt's warmer climates before expanding to the Delta and Lower Egypt through August. Supported by national expansion projects like "Future of Egypt" and the New Delta, cultivated areas have reached over 3.7 million feddans, a significant increase that positions the government to meet its ambitious collection target of 4.5 to 5 million tons for the subsidized bread program. To bolster national food security and support farmers amidst global price shifts, the Cabinet has increased the procurement price to 2,350 Egyptian pounds per ardeb, while technical guidance from the Agricultural Research Center on certified, high-yield seeds has ensured crop resilience against recent climate fluctuations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department’s Najaf Specialized Nursery, is significantly scaling up its regional pl...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department’s Najaf Specialized Nursery, is significantly scaling up its regional plant production as part of a strategic plan to support Iraqi farmers and urban greening initiatives. The nursery has successfully produced 20,000 ornamental seedlings, including bougainvillea and jasmine, alongside 70,000 fruit cuttings featuring high-demand crops like jujube, grapes, and pomegranates. By providing these high-quality, certified seedlings at subsidized prices, the Horticulture Department aims to accelerate agricultural expansion, improve the genetic quality of local orchards, and enhance the climate resilience of the Najaf Governorate’s landscape.

records.title: The Moroccan avocado export campaign for the 2025/2026 season has concluded on a somber note, falling to 58,000 tonnes—a sharp nearly 50%...
records.description: The Moroccan avocado export campaign for the 2025/2026 season has concluded on a somber note, falling to 58,000 tonnes—a sharp nearly 50% decrease from the record-breaking 100,000+ tonnes achieved the previous year. According to the Moroccan Avocado Association (MAA), this "exceptional and tough" season was defined by a pincer movement of climatic extremes: initial heatwaves that decimated half the expected crop, followed by late-season flooding and gale-force winds in the Loukkos and Gharb regions. These supply shocks triggered internal price wars between producers and exporters, while logistical bottlenecks and port closures further hampered the ability to meet international commitments, leaving the industry hoping that this season remains a one-time climatic anomaly.

records.title: Syria is strategically expanding its tropical fruit production within the coastal governorates of Tartous and Lattakia, integrating these...
records.description: Syria is strategically expanding its tropical fruit production within the coastal governorates of Tartous and Lattakia, integrating these high-value crops into existing citrus orchards and greenhouses. According to the Ministry of Agriculture, this diversification aims to bolster farmer incomes and reduce national import dependency. While persimmon leads the sector with 1,400 hectares of cultivation due to its frost tolerance, emerging crops like avocado, mango, and dragon fruit are gaining traction for their high market returns. Despite challenges from lower-priced imports and the need for better "planting material," the government has begun including adapted varieties in state nurseries, signaling a formal commitment to transforming the coastal strip into a multi-crop tropical hub.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has officially launched the fish breeding season at the Al-Suwai...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has officially launched the fish breeding season at the Al-Suwaira fish hatchery south of Baghdad. The initial phase involves introducing the first batch of common carp broodstock into specialized hatchery ponds following extensive infrastructure preparations. Chosen for its rapid growth, environmental resilience, and popularity in the Iraqi market, the common carp is a cornerstone of the ministry's annual production plan to replenish local water bodies. This initiative aims to secure a sustainable, high-protein food source and support the livelihoods of fishing communities across the region.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched the Namaa Endowment Fund with an initial SAR 100 million ($26.6 million)...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched the Namaa Endowment Fund with an initial SAR 100 million ($26.6 million) contribution from the General Authority for Awqaf. Developed in partnership with the Capital Market Authority and SNB Capital, the fund introduces a modern institutional endowment model designed to finance environmental sustainability and circular economy initiatives through a licensed digital platform. By supporting non-profit institutions like Reef, Morooj, and Saqaya, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture aims to reduce food waste, protect biodiversity, and accelerate the Kingdom's goal of diverting 90% of waste from landfills by 2040, ultimately boosting the non-profit sector's contribution to the national GDP under Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: According to new projections from Fitch Ratings, rising Middle East tensions and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz are driving signific...
records.description: According to new projections from Fitch Ratings, rising Middle East tensions and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz are driving significant price increases in energy-intensive nitrogen fertilizers, while the phosphate sector remains comparatively resilient. The OCP Group is positioned as a primary stabilizer in the global market, as its maritime routes through the Mediterranean and Red Sea bypass current shipping disruptions, allowing the company to maintain steady exports to the United States, India, and Latin America. While ammonia and urea prices are expected to climb due to natural gas volatility, the OCP Group's management of the world's largest phosphate reserves ensures a reliable supply of essential agricultural inputs, prompting international governments to prioritize strategic partnerships with the institution to minimize supply shocks for farmers through 2026.

records.title: Morocco has launched a new financial incentive mechanism to diversify its fresh tomato exports and reduce its 75.6% dependency on the Eur...
records.description: Morocco has launched a new financial incentive mechanism to diversify its fresh tomato exports and reduce its 75.6% dependency on the European Union. According to a decree published on March 5, the government is introducing a subsidy of 750 dirhams per ton for shipments to alternative markets, specifically targeting Africa and other non-EU regions. This performance-based scheme applies only to export volumes exceeding historical averages, ensuring that the aid drives genuine market expansion rather than subsidizing existing trade. With 2024 exports reaching 767,347 tons ($1.15 billion), the Ministry of Agriculture is seeking to mitigate rising trade tensions and "unfair competition" allegations in France and Spain by securing new, high-growth corridors for Moroccan produce.

records.title: The export campaign for Moroccan Nadorcott mandarins is seeing an upward trajectory for the 2025-2026 season, solidifying its status as a...
records.description: The export campaign for Moroccan Nadorcott mandarins is seeing an upward trajectory for the 2025-2026 season, solidifying its status as a premium benchmark in the global citrus market. According to reports from Fructidor, the Nadorcott Producers Association in Morocco (APNM) is successfully differentiating the variety in high-competition regions like Europe and North America through a "high-quality positioning" strategy. To sustain this momentum, the APNM has activated a sophisticated international visibility campaign at major B2B platforms, including Fruit Logistica and Fruit Attraction, using the slogan "Nadorcott of Morocco – the pride of Morocco" to cast a positive ripple effect across the entire Moroccan citrus sector.
records.institution: The Nadorcott Producers Association in Morocco (APNM)

records.title: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in South Al Batinah has partnered with the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fish...
records.description: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in South Al Batinah has partnered with the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources to launch 23 new investment sites in the Al Muladdah area, covering over 180 acres. Offered through the "Tatweer" platform under a 25-year usufruct system, these opportunities include 16 agricultural projects focused on lemon and mango cultivation, plant nurseries, and crop sorting, alongside 7 integrated livestock ventures combining goat and sheep breeding with fodder production and aquaculture. By providing a five-year grace period and specific investment incentives, the Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning aims to optimize government land use and attract high-value investments that align with the Sultanate's economic diversification and food security targets.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Confederation of Citizen Enterprises of Tunisia (CONECT) has officially relaunched the National Professional Group for Agriculture (C...
records.description: The Confederation of Citizen Enterprises of Tunisia (CONECT) has officially relaunched the National Professional Group for Agriculture (CONECT Agri) to serve as a strategic bridge between farmers, investors, and industry stakeholders. Amidst escalating challenges such as climate change, water scarcity, and infrastructure deficits, CONECT Agri aims to modernize production chains and introduce technological innovations to ensure long-term food security and sector sustainability. By advocating for updated legal frameworks and facilitating access to financing for young farmers and smallholders, the Confederation of Citizen Enterprises of Tunisia is working to restructure strategic agricultural sectors and elevate the socio-economic standing of producers, ultimately positioning agriculture as a resilient driver of national economic growth.
records.institution: The Confederation of Citizen Enterprises of Tunisia (CONECT)

records.title: The arrival of the new season of Egyptian oranges has seen initial market prices settle at approximately 10%–15% lower than the previous...
records.description: The arrival of the new season of Egyptian oranges has seen initial market prices settle at approximately 10%–15% lower than the previous year, offering a more competitive alternative to high-priced American varieties burdened by tariffs and sorting losses. According to reports from S&P Global Commodity Insights, this trend is occurring alongside a price rebound for blueberries due to reduced arrivals and a general decline in green grape values driven by sluggish post-holiday consumer demand. While the supply of certain Chilean stone fruits has tightened as producers shift toward cherry cultivation, the broader fruit market remains impacted by high arrival losses in sectors like Peruvian avocados, which are currently trading at significantly lower values than in previous seasons.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has launched a strategic initiative to accelerate agricultural exports to the Gulf regio...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has launched a strategic initiative to accelerate agricultural exports to the Gulf region, specifically targeting the UAE, Qatar, Kuwait, and Bahrain to stabilize regional food supplies amidst ongoing conflict. Under the direction of the Central Administration of Egyptian Agricultural Quarantine, the ministry is facilitating rapid market access for high-demand crops such as peppers, lettuce, and lemons. By coordinating directly with quarantine authorities in neighboring Arab states, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation aims to bypass logistical disruptions caused by recent regional tensions, reinforcing Egypt's position as a critical food security partner and maximizing economic returns for the national agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the National Center for Epidemic and Communicable Disease Control (JCDC) have signed a strategic Memorand...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the National Center for Epidemic and Communicable Disease Control (JCDC) have signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to formalize the "One Health" approach in Jordan. This partnership, established by the Minister of Agriculture and the President of the JCDC, focuses on the critical intersection of human, animal, and environmental health. By integrating data exchange and early warning systems, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to proactively manage zoonotic diseases—those transmitted between animals and humans—to secure the Kingdom's livestock sectors and ensure the long-term safety of national food production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and the National Center for Epidemic and Communicable Disease Control (JCDC)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has unveiled a comprehensive 119 million dinar development plan for...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has unveiled a comprehensive 119 million dinar development plan for 2026 to modernize the blue economy and ensure the sustainability of marine resources. This strategy, presented by Minister Ezzedine Ben Cheikh and supported by the 2026 Finance Bill, focuses on upgrading critical infrastructure in ports like Sfax, Kelibia, and Menzel Abderrahmane, while allocating 82 million dinars specifically for fuel subsidies to support small-scale fishermen. To combat overexploitation, the ministry has implemented satellite tracking for 90% of large vessels and updated legal frameworks to include stricter penalties for illegal fishing. Furthermore, a 7.7 million dinar investment grant has been earmarked to expand marine aquaculture, introducing new technologies and species to meet growing seafood demand while protecting traditional coastal stocks.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Nefer Benban project, a 258.5 MWp hybrid solar-plus-storage facility, has reached a series of critical procurement milestones with Ha...
records.description: The Nefer Benban project, a 258.5 MWp hybrid solar-plus-storage facility, has reached a series of critical procurement milestones with Hassan Allam Constructions finalizing agreements for its core technological components. As part of Egypt's NWFE (Nexus of Water, Food and Energy) initiative, the project integrates 200 MW of solar PV with a 120 MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). By partnering with global leaders like GameChange Solar for tracking systems and Sineng Electric for central inverters, the project is positioned to become one of the first utility-scale storage-integrated plants in the Benban Solar Park, supporting the national goal of reaching 42% renewable energy in the electricity mix by 2030.

records.title: Wheat prices in Egypt have surged to record highs, with local 12.5% protein wheat jumping from 12,400 EGP to 14,300 EGP per metric tonne...
records.description: Wheat prices in Egypt have surged to record highs, with local 12.5% protein wheat jumping from 12,400 EGP to 14,300 EGP per metric tonne in the weeks following the outbreak of regional conflict. According to a report from S&P Global Commodity Insights, this sharp inflation is primarily driven by a 9.4% depreciation of the Egyptian pound, which hit a record low of 52.39 EGP per US dollar on March 13. As one of the world's largest grain buyers, Egypt faces compounding pressures from tightened Black Sea supplies, rising fuel costs, and severe logistical disruptions, all of which have heightened the country's exposure to international supply shocks and increased the cost of maintaining staple food stability.
records.institution: The General Authority for Supply Commodities (GASC)

records.title: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) has entered into a series of strategic investment agreements designed to catalyze economic growth in th...
records.description: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) has entered into a series of strategic investment agreements designed to catalyze economic growth in the Jordan Valley through the agricultural, tourism, and industrial sectors. Signed by the Secretary-General, these deals include the development of quarries and sand pits alongside the critical provision of water supplies for new agricultural investments. Aligned with the national Economic Modernisation Vision, the Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) is focusing on creating an "investor-friendly" environment that prioritizes local employment and sustainable water resource management. These initiatives aim to empower youth to launch productive businesses while enhancing the overall social and economic stability of communities within the Authority's jurisdiction.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The Ministry of Environment has entered into a strategic partnership with the Waste Recycling Cooperative Association to implement a nati...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment has entered into a strategic partnership with the Waste Recycling Cooperative Association to implement a national circular economy model aimed at diverting refuse from landfills toward productive reuse. Formally signed by the Minister of Environment and the Association Chairman, the Memorandum of Understanding prioritizes source-based waste sorting for materials such as paper, plastic, and metal to address the fact that over 90% of the country’s waste currently ends up in landfills. The Ministry of Environment will provide technical oversight and awareness support, while the Association manages the grassroots rollout—including the distribution of specialized containers to schools and businesses—to create a transparent, monitored recycling chain that fosters job creation and long-term environmental sustainability.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon has launched an expansive emergency response plan to safeguard national food security and support...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon has launched an expansive emergency response plan to safeguard national food security and support the livelihoods of farmers during the current war. By forming a rapid assessment team in collaboration with the FAO, UNDP, and the National Council for Scientific Research, the Ministry of Agriculture is prioritizing urgent interventions such as relocating livestock and beehives from conflict zones to safer regions. Furthermore, the ministry is integrating local agricultural production into the national humanitarian response by coordinating with the Disaster Risk Management Unit to include fresh Lebanese fruit in food baskets for displaced persons. These measures, alongside streamlined administrative licensing and continuous market monitoring, are designed to maintain the stability of food supply chains and ensure that rural communities remain resilient despite significant logistical and economic challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Equipment and Water and the National Agency for Water and Forests (ANEF) have signed a strategic framework agreement to c...
records.description: The Ministry of Equipment and Water and the National Agency for Water and Forests (ANEF) have signed a strategic framework agreement to combat dam siltation through an integrated watershed management approach. By combining technical expertise and data exchange, the two institutions aim to implement soil conservation programs upstream of hydraulic infrastructure to significantly reduce erosion and sediment runoff. This partnership is designed to preserve the Kingdom's total reservoir storage capacity—a critical factor for national drinking water supplies, agricultural irrigation, and hydroelectric power generation—while simultaneously integrating socioeconomic dimensions to mitigate the growing risks of flooding and water scarcity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Equipment and Water and the National Agency for Water and Forests (ANEF)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in the presence of the Jenin Governor and technical leads, has launched a critical rehabilitation phase by d...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in the presence of the Jenin Governor and technical leads, has launched a critical rehabilitation phase by distributing 3,106 mature olive trees and 36 specialized water tanks (1.5 cubic meters each) to 36 farmers in the Jenin Governorate. This initiative serves as a direct response to the systematic land leveling and uprooting of olive groves in communities like Silat al-Harithiya, Ya'bad, and Faqqu'a. By providing three-year-old trees, the Ministry of Agriculture is effectively bypassing the long non-productive juvenile stage, allowing farmers to reach the harvesting phase years earlier than with standard seedlings. Coupled with the provision of irrigation tanks to combat water scarcity, this national program aims to restore the Palestinian "food basket" and secure the long-term economic resilience of families whose livelihoods were targeted by occupation forces.

records.title: The International Dates Council, headquartered in Saudi Arabia, has officially initiated the transfer of high-quality date palm seedlings...
records.description: The International Dates Council, headquartered in Saudi Arabia, has officially initiated the transfer of high-quality date palm seedlings to the Chinese Academy of Tropical Agricultural Sciences (CATAS). This technical exchange activates a 2025 strategic agreement aimed at integrating Saudi expertise in date cultivation with China’s advanced research in tropical agriculture. Beyond the scientific exchange, the initiative serves a diplomatic function, coordinated by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, to formally invite China to join the council as an associate member. By establishing these global agricultural hubs, the International Dates Council seeks to modernize production techniques and enhance the global sustainability of the palm industry through the shared development of resilient crop varieties and smart farming technologies.

records.title: The Ministry of Commerce has launched an international call for tenders to import live sheep, which will be sold exclusively by weight to...
records.description: The Ministry of Commerce has launched an international call for tenders to import live sheep, which will be sold exclusively by weight to ensure market transparency and fair pricing. This strategic initiative, implemented through the Ellouhoum Company, aims to stabilize the red meat sector and provide a regular supply to consumers in response to recent commodity shortages. The Ministry of Commerce is coordinating directly with the Ministry of Agriculture to establish fixed pricing structures for the imported livestock, while simultaneously working to resolve the financial and operational pressures facing the state-owned distribution company. Furthermore, the ministry is developing new legal frameworks to modernize e-commerce regulations, ensuring enhanced protections for both consumers and sellers in the evolving digital marketplace.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has launched a comprehensive food safety and inspection campaign across the...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has launched a comprehensive food safety and inspection campaign across the Emirate in preparation for Eid Al Fitr 2026. This proactive strategy involves intensifying routine and unannounced inspections at retail outlets, traditional kitchens, and produce markets across Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, and Al Dhafra to ensure the highest standards of hygiene and raw material quality. By utilizing advanced smart inspection tools and deploying additional veterinary staff to approved abattoirs, ADAFSA aims to streamline the inspection process and prevent unregulated slaughtering practices. The authority emphasizes a partnership with the public, encouraging consumers to report violations via the government contact center to maintain the integrity of the food supply chain during this high-demand season.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has partnered with the Azimut Group to develop a first-of-its-kind...
records.description: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has partnered with the Azimut Group to develop a first-of-its-kind food security equity index, scheduled for launch in the second quarter of 2026. This collaboration focuses on creating a transparent, rules-based benchmark for listed companies across the Arab world that specialize in agricultural production, supply-chain infrastructure, and food processing. By providing structured exposure to these critical sectors, the Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) aims to attract institutional capital into regional agriculture, with plans already underway to launch a dedicated Exchange-Traded Fund (ETF) on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADX) later this year.
records.institution: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department in Tikrit, has launched a specialized spring planting program t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department in Tikrit, has launched a specialized spring planting program to safeguard the genetic purity of high-yielding yellow corn strains. By utilizing mechanical precision sowing and advanced weed management, the Ministry of Agriculture is ensuring the propagation of "promising" genetic makeups that are vital for Iraq’s food security. This initiative focuses on maintaining the structural integrity of strategic seed stocks, which are engineered to produce maximum yields while resisting local environmental stressors, ultimately strengthening the national economy through reduced reliance on imported seeds.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture distributed 465 mature olive saplings to 18 farmers in the Hebron Governorate as part of an urgent emergency...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture distributed 465 mature olive saplings to 18 farmers in the Hebron Governorate as part of an urgent emergency response program to support those affected by agricultural violations and land attacks. This initiative, marking the fourth phase of a specialized support program in the southern region, aims to facilitate the rehabilitation of damaged agricultural lands and bolster the economic resilience of farmers in threatened areas.
