By providing high-quality saplings through a coordinated effort involving local joint services and village councils, the Ministry of Agriculture seeks to ensure the sustainability of the olive sector, which remains a vital symbol of national steadfastness and a cornerstone of the local agricultural economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully completed its third virtual training module focused on the development and operation of a sp...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully completed its third virtual training module focused on the development and operation of a specialized palm tree irrigation scheduling application. This digital initiative, conducted in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the International Water Management Institute, represents a major shift toward precision agriculture in the region. By training technicians from both the Ministry of Agriculture and the Water Authority, the program aims to deploy a high-tech solution that calculates exact water requirements for date palms, ensuring maximum fruit productivity while significantly reducing water waste in a region defined by scarcity.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Hebron Governorate Directorate, has finalized the handover of eight strategic agricultural proje...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Hebron Governorate Directorate, has finalized the handover of eight strategic agricultural projects valued at 300,000 shekels. Funded by the European Union, these initiatives were distributed across Hebron, Tarqumiya, and Idhna to provide targeted relief to rural communities. The portfolio includes six livestock-focused projects and two infrastructure-based projects involving the establishment of water tanks, greenhouses, and reforestation efforts. By combining direct animal husbandry support with critical water management and climate-resilient infrastructure, the Ministry of Agriculture is working to modernize local farming operations, improve household income, and secure the long-term sustainability of the agricultural sector in the region.

records.title: The General Directorate of Forests (DGF) has adopted a modernized, proactive strategy to combat forest fire risks, resulting in a 90% red...
records.description: The General Directorate of Forests (DGF) has adopted a modernized, proactive strategy to combat forest fire risks, resulting in a 90% reduction in burned areas compared to the previous decade's average. This success is attributed to the full mobilization of state institutions and a participatory approach that ensures synergy between the People's National Army (ANP), the General Directorate of Civil Protection, the National Gendarmerie, and the Algerian Space Agency (ASAL). Moving forward, the General Directorate of Forests (DGF) is transitioning to an integrated digital system utilizing drones, satellite imagery from Alcomsat-1, and Geographic Information Systems (GIS) to enhance early warning and risk analysis. The strategy emphasizes standardized scientific methodologies for loss assessment, the involvement of local communities in prevention efforts, and the support of startups to strengthen the technological "technical backbone" of forest heritage preservation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon has enacted temporary emergency protocols to safeguard the national food supply chain against the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon has enacted temporary emergency protocols to safeguard the national food supply chain against the administrative paralysis caused by the country’s current exceptional circumstances. By allowing the temporary use of digitized or photocopied phytosanitary certificates in lieu of original hard copies, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to prevent bottlenecking at ports and border crossings. This pragmatic shift ensures that perishable plant products can enter the Lebanese market without delay, provided that importers submit a notarized pledge to deliver original documentation once the crisis subsides.

records.title: Mellitah Oil and Gas, in alignment with the National Oil Corporation’s (NOC) “Think About Tomorrow” initiative, has officially launched a...
records.description: Mellitah Oil and Gas, in alignment with the National Oil Corporation’s (NOC) “Think About Tomorrow” initiative, has officially launched a reforestation and tree-planting campaign at the El Feel oil field. This environmental project, coordinated with the Sustainable Development Department, is designed to mitigate the ecological footprint of oil operations and enhance the green cover in the arid regions surrounding the field. By integrating environmental protection into its core operational strategy, Mellitah Oil and Gas aims to fulfill its corporate social responsibility and contribute to the broader sustainable development goals of Libya’s energy sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, in collaboration with the Ministry of Local Administration and Rural Developme...
records.description: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology, in collaboration with the Ministry of Local Administration and Rural Development, has launched a humanitarian initiative to distribute 1,500 food baskets to impoverished families in the Al-Thawra District of Sana’a. Attended by high-ranking officials, including the Acting Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the launch follows national directives to strengthen social solidarity and alleviate the suffering caused by the ongoing blockade and economic hardship. This charitable effort is part of a broader strategy by the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology to fulfill its social responsibilities, providing essential nutrition to those in need while encouraging local businessmen and philanthropists to expand support for charitable kitchens and seasonal aid programs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

records.title: Morocco has formally joined the Global Marine Commodities 2 (GMC2) initiative, a five-year international program financed by the Global E...
records.description: Morocco has formally joined the Global Marine Commodities 2 (GMC2) initiative, a five-year international program financed by the Global Environment Facility and coordinated by the United Nations Development Programme. This strategic move follows a sharp 46% decline in sardine landings over the past two years, prompting the State Secretariat for Maritime Fisheries to implement more rigorous environmental and social standards across the seafood supply chain. By focusing on small pelagic species like sardines and anchovies, the State Secretariat for Maritime Fisheries aims to utilize technical guidance from the Sustainable Fisheries Partnership to combat illegal fishing, protect juvenile stocks, and align biological rest periods with reproduction cycles, ultimately increasing the market value of Moroccan exports through certified sustainable practices.

records.title: Morocco joins UN-backed program to strengthen management of marine fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq is advancing a major horticultural expansion through the Al-Hindiya Horticulture Station, focusing on...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq is advancing a major horticultural expansion through the Al-Hindiya Horticulture Station, focusing on the mass propagation of olive seedlings to bolster national food security. By utilizing the station's technical expertise, the ministry is nurturing several high-yield and high-oil-content varieties, such as Picual, Gerafa, and Saint Catherine, which recently achieved record oil extraction rates of 18%.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a specialized vegetable and meat fair in the city of Kiffa, designed to protect citizens' purcha...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a specialized vegetable and meat fair in the city of Kiffa, designed to protect citizens' purchasing power during the holy month of Ramadan. Led by the Secretary General, the initiative features a logistical convoy of vehicles tasked with distributing fresh produce to markets nationwide at regulated, affordable prices. Beyond immediate market stabilization, the Ministry of Agriculture utilized the event to engage directly with local producers, conducting field visits to regional farms to assess technical challenges and farming methods. By positioning Kiffa as a vital agricultural hub, the Ministry reaffirmed its commitment to providing the necessary support and infrastructure to bolster local production and achieve long-term national food sovereignty.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources convened a strategic coordination meeting at the Silal Central Market with a b...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources convened a strategic coordination meeting at the Silal Central Market with a broad coalition of merchants and investors to ensure the abundance and price stability of essential food commodities. This high-level gathering, which included representatives from the Consumer Protection Authority, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, and the Asyad Group, prioritized the maintenance of smooth supply chains to meet the increased demand during festive periods. By conducting field tours to inspect daily operational movements and listening directly to merchant feedback, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and its partners reinforced their commitment to market stability and the continuous flow of goods for all residents.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Qalqilya Governorate Directorate, has finalized the handover of 15 vital agricultural projects v...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Qalqilya Governorate Directorate, has finalized the handover of 15 vital agricultural projects valued at approximately 615,135 shekels, funded by the European Union. This batch of assistance specifically targets farmers and livestock breeders previously documented by the Ministry of Agriculture as having been affected by regional conflict and occupation practices. The diverse portfolio of projects—ranging from cattle and broiler chicken operations to specialized pigeon and rabbit breeding—is designed to restore lost livelihoods and provide a sustainable source of income. By prioritizing home-based development and livestock resilience, the initiative seeks to enhance food security and ensure that rural families can remain steadfast on their land despite ongoing economic and physical challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, via its Tulkarm Governorate Directorate, has finalized the delivery of two livestock development projects in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, via its Tulkarm Governorate Directorate, has finalized the delivery of two livestock development projects in the towns of Shufa and Kafr Jamal, valued at 120,000 shekels. Funded by the European Union, these initiatives focus on sheep breeding and lamb fattening to directly increase local meat production and revitalize the economic status of participating farmers. By providing high-quality livestock and the necessary infrastructure for fattening, the Ministry of Agriculture is working to ensure the sustainability of the regional agricultural sector and bolster the resilience of families facing ongoing geopolitical challenges and land-use restrictions.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Greater Amman Municipality (GAM) has launched the pilot phase of an organic waste separation project at the Ras Al Ain vegetable mark...
records.description: The Greater Amman Municipality (GAM) has launched the pilot phase of an organic waste separation project at the Ras Al Ain vegetable market to divert biodegradable residues from landfills and promote circular economy practices. Funded by the European Union and the German government, the initiative focuses on sorting fruit and vegetable waste at the source to be converted into high-quality organic compost for use in agriculture and landscaping. By implementing this system, the Greater Amman Municipality (GAM) aims to significantly reduce methane emissions and leachate contamination associated with traditional disposal methods. Following extensive training for market traders and workers, the Greater Amman Municipality (GAM) plans to monitor operational efficiency and vendor compliance during this phase to refine the model for a future city-wide rollout across all municipal markets.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations, has launched a joint project titled “Local financing solutions to su...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations, has launched a joint project titled “Local financing solutions to support Jordan’s agri-food system transformation” to enhance the resilience and inclusivity of the agricultural sector. Funded by the UN Joint SDG Fund, the initiative focuses on transforming the fruits and vegetables sector in Deir Alla by supporting over 1,500 smallholders and small businesses through climate-smart investments, a blended finance model, and improved market integration. A central component of the plan involves the establishment of two modern post-harvest centers by the Ministry of Agriculture and its partners, which are expected to reduce crop losses by up to 40% and facilitate access to high-value export markets. This project aligns with national food security strategies and places a specific emphasis on empowering women, youth, and vulnerable groups to ensure a sustainable and equitable transformation of the national food system.

records.title: In a significant move to stabilize its domestic food market, Mauritanian Customs has launched an intensive crackdown on the illegal re-ex...
records.description: In a significant move to stabilize its domestic food market, Mauritanian Customs has launched an intensive crackdown on the illegal re-export of Moroccan agricultural goods to Algerian markets. Following a directive aimed at protecting local purchasing power, authorities have impounded multiple vehicles transporting tons of tomatoes, onions, and potatoes that entered Mauritania through the El Guerguerate crossing but lacked the required permits for local sale. Investigations revealed that these shipments were being surreptitiously diverted toward Tindouf and other regions in southwestern Algeria, where markets rely heavily on indirect flows of Moroccan produce. The Mauritanian Customs officials have signaled that systematic inspections will now be mandatory for all food-transporting vehicles at strategic border points to curb this cross-border smuggling and prevent the outflow of essential supplies during a period of rising regional prices.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, via its Ramallah and Al-Bireh Directorate, has successfully finalized and handed over 11 agricultural develo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, via its Ramallah and Al-Bireh Directorate, has successfully finalized and handed over 11 agricultural development projects to local beneficiaries in cooperation with the European Union. Despite significant movement restrictions and checkpoint closures, the technical committee reached farmers in Beitunia, Deir Ibzi’, Bil’in, Ras Karkar, Rantis, Deir Ammar, and Beitillu. These projects, valued at 390,000 shekels, provide essential livestock, high-protein feed, and modern infrastructure to help breeders overcome economic obstacles and maintain their livelihoods.

records.title: The Ministry of Local Government and the French Development Agency, in strategic cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, facilitate...
records.description: The Ministry of Local Government and the French Development Agency, in strategic cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, facilitated the distribution of 87 sheep and 13.5 tons of fodder to livestock breeders across several towns in the Salfit Governorate. This joint initiative targets the enhancement of regional food security and the reinforcement of farmer resilience by providing essential production inputs and improving general sheep farming conditions. By delivering these resources through the coordination of local veterinary and agricultural directorate staff, the Ministry of Local Government and its partners aim to ensure the long-term sustainability of the livestock sector and support the economic steadfastness of rural communities facing challenging operational environments.

records.title: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication has initiated the planting of 813 net houses through contracts with local farmers, util...
records.description: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication has initiated the planting of 813 net houses through contracts with local farmers, utilizing seeds developed under the National Seed Production Project. This strategic move is designed to provide high-quality, virus-free potato seeds at subsidized prices, directly supporting the agricultural sector and enhancing national food sovereignty. By prioritizing locally produced "super-elite" and "elite" generations, the General Establishment for Seed Multiplication aims to reduce reliance on costly foreign imports, protect domestic crops from external pests, and stabilize market prices for this essential commodity.
records.institution: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in a strategic partnership with the Madad Foundation for Development and Peacebuilding (MDP), has officially...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in a strategic partnership with the Madad Foundation for Development and Peacebuilding (MDP), has officially launched “Ghiath,” the Syrian National Rainfall Platform. This digital transformation initiative centralizes data from a network of 166 monitoring stations to provide real-time, evidence-based insights into the country's hydrological status. By transitioning from manual reporting to a high-tech analytical hub, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to equip farmers and policy-makers with the tools needed to navigate climate volatility, optimize water usage, and safeguard national food security.

records.title: The Central Bank of Tunisia, following the publication of Law No.
records.description: The Central Bank of Tunisia, following the publication of Law No. 2026-5 in the Official Gazette (JORT), has launched a landmark debt relief program to restore the financial health of the agricultural sector. This legislation mandates both public and private banks to regularize the "Category 4 and above" unpaid debts of farmers and agricultural companies recorded before September 30, 2025. By offering two distinct pathways—long-term rescheduling or immediate settlement with massive interest waivers—the Central Bank of Tunisia aims to systematically remove negative credit ratings, allowing thousands of producers to re-enter the formal financial system and secure the credit necessary for future harvest cycles.

records.title: The “Today’s Seed… Tomorrow’s Palm” initiative has officially launched in the Al-Sukhnah District of Hodeidah, marking a grassroots expan...
records.description: The “Today’s Seed… Tomorrow’s Palm” initiative has officially launched in the Al-Sukhnah District of Hodeidah, marking a grassroots expansion of Yemen’s date production capabilities. Operating under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the project encourages residents to repurpose date seeds from daily consumption for planting. By mobilizing the Al-Sukhnah Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society and local families, the initiative seeks to leverage the district’s ideal climate to build a resilient, self-sufficient agricultural economy. Officials emphasize that this community-led effort, launched at the start of Ramadan, aims to transform simple household waste into a long-term national resource, eventually increasing the density of palm groves and reducing reliance on imported fruit.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Hydraulics has officially commissioned a major water transfer project in Algiers, connecting the Reghaïa wastewater treat...
records.description: The Ministry of Hydraulics has officially commissioned a major water transfer project in Algiers, connecting the Reghaïa wastewater treatment plant to the eastern Mitidja irrigation perimeter. With a capacity of 60,000 $m^3$/day, this initiative is a core component of the national strategy to valorize treated wastewater for agricultural use, preserving fresh water for drinking while supporting food security. During an inspection of the Water and Sanitation Company of Algiers and Tipaza (SEAAL), the Ministry of Hydraulics emphasized the importance of rigorous quality control at the SEAAL central laboratory and praised the "proactive measures" that maintained consistent supply during peak periods. Additionally, a multi-agency mobilization involving SEAAL, the Algerian Water Company (ADE), and the National Sanitation Office (ONA) is currently underway to repair a high-priority 2000 mm pipeline rupture in Boudouaou, ensuring minimal disruption to the regional water network.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has accelerated the development of the national animal wealth sector by granting 468 ope...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has accelerated the development of the national animal wealth sector by granting 468 operating licenses for livestock, poultry, feed manufacturing, and milk collection ventures during the first half of February. This administrative surge, aimed at boosting domestic production capacity and export potential, was paired with the distribution of approximately $6.35 million in financing through the National Calf Project, benefiting 425 recipients for the rearing of over 4,200 head of cattle. Furthermore, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation expanded its regulatory and digital footprint by approving 294 feed mixtures in coordination with specialized research institutes and transitioning licensing procedures to the Egypt Digital Platform to streamline services for investors and farmers alike.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has successfully secured access to the Panamanian market for Egyptian citrus exports, ma...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has successfully secured access to the Panamanian market for Egyptian citrus exports, marking a strategic expansion of Egypt’s agricultural footprint in Latin America. Following rigorous negotiations by the Central Administration of Plant Quarantine, Panama has officially approved the import of four primary Egyptian citrus products: oranges, lemons, mandarins, and grapefruits. This milestone is part of a broader government directive by the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation to diversify export destinations, reduce reliance on traditional markets, and strengthen the resilience of national trade against global economic shifts.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is accelerating the operationalization of the National Agricultural Register (RNA), a cornerstone of the Gene...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is accelerating the operationalization of the National Agricultural Register (RNA), a cornerstone of the Generation Green 2020-2030 strategy. To fast-track the system, a technical assistance mission is being launched to support the teams managing the registry and to streamline the processing of farmer registration applications. By creating a centralized, high-reliability database of all holdings in Morocco, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to move beyond simple data collection toward a strategic tool for precise mapping and modernized sector governance. This "digital backbone" is designed to improve the transparency and targeting of public aid and subsidies, ensuring that government support reaches the right farms based on accurate geographical and operational data.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has formally commended the Jordanian government’s decision to exempt Palestinian exports from fines previousl...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has formally commended the Jordanian government’s decision to exempt Palestinian exports from fines previously incurred due to emergency shipping protocols. Under the new directive, goods loaded onto open vehicles—a necessity driven by restrictive procedures imposed by occupation authorities—will no longer face financial penalties at Jordanian customs. The Ministry of Agriculture highlighted that this measure provides direct relief to Palestinian farmers and exporters, serving as a vital economic lifeline that bolsters the steadfastness of the agricultural sector. By waiving these costs, the Ministry of Agriculture asserts that the brotherly Kingdom of Jordan is actively empowering Palestinian producers to maintain their livelihoods and preserve the deep fraternal and economic ties between the two nations.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Siam Bari Institute, has commenced the distribution of agricultural grants as part...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Siam Bari Institute, has commenced the distribution of agricultural grants as part of the "Sanet" project, specifically targeting farmers within the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate. This initiative is designed to provide direct material and technical support to rural producers, enhancing their ability to maintain and develop their lands. By focusing on the North Hebron region, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to strengthen local food security and empower farming communities through strategic resource allocation and partnership-driven development.

records.title: Tunisia has achieved a record-breaking performance in the date sector for the current season, with national production surging to approxi...
records.description: Tunisia has achieved a record-breaking performance in the date sector for the current season, with national production surging to approximately 404,000 tons, a significant increase over the previous cycle. According to data from the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, this productivity boost has translated into a robust export performance, with volumes reaching nearly 99,000 tonnes valued at approximately 650.3 million dinars, representing double-digit growth in both volume and value. To sustain this momentum, the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries is coordinating multi-year interventions through the Date Quality Promotion Fund, focusing on pest control, oasis health, and the modernization of packaging and processing. Furthermore, the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has emphasized the importance of adhering to reference prices to protect producer livelihoods while promoting the valorization of palm by-products for animal feed and compost to enhance the sector's overall circular economy and global competitiveness.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism has clarified that the recent price hikes for onions and tomatoes are a temporary and limited byprodu...
records.description: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism has clarified that the recent price hikes for onions and tomatoes are a temporary and limited byproduct of the ongoing regional crisis and heightened demand during Ramadan. To counter this, the Ministry of Economy and Tourism has already injected abundant supplies of these commodities into the market and intensified nationwide field inspections to ensure price stability. With a robust strategic reserve capable of covering essential needs for up to six months, the Ministry of Economy and Tourism reassures consumers that supply chains remain fully operational through the country’s entry points. Furthermore, the Ministry of Economy and Tourism has taken strict enforcement actions—conducting over 7,100 inspection tours and identifying hundreds of violations—while emphasizing that prices for nine essential food categories remain under a strict "no-increase" policy without prior government approval.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism

records.title: The General Authority for the Development of Tihama has launched a specialized training workshop in the Bajil District of Hodeidah to qua...
records.description: The General Authority for the Development of Tihama has launched a specialized training workshop in the Bajil District of Hodeidah to qualify 28 "Livestock Champions." Operating under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the initiative is designed to bridge the gap between official agricultural authorities and local breeders. The program focuses on modernizing herd management, improving nutritional techniques, and aggressively raising awareness against the slaughter of female livestock—a practice that threatens long-term food security and the sustainability of national herds in the Tihama Plain.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) has officially approved the establishment of the Al Ahly Green Agricultural Investment Fund, mar...
records.description: The Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) has officially approved the establishment of the Al Ahly Green Agricultural Investment Fund, marking the debut of the first private equity fund specialized in agricultural investment within the Egyptian market. Licensed to engage in both private equity and venture capital (VC) activities, the fund is a cornerstone of the FRA’s strategic push to diversify investment vehicles and channel institutional capital into high-priority productive sectors. By providing a regulated platform for sustainable agricultural projects, Al Ahly Green aims to deepen private sector participation in the national economy and attract long-term domestic and foreign investment.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has announced a strategic plan to increase domestic wheat production to between 4.7 mill...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has announced a strategic plan to increase domestic wheat production to between 4.7 million and 5 million tons, a significant rise from the 3.9 million tons recorded in 2025. This initiative aims to expand the cultivated wheat area to 3.7 million acres, supported by a framework of vertical and horizontal expansion that includes the proliferation of model farms and the modernization of irrigation systems. By prioritizing the distribution of high-yield, certified seed varieties and enhancing technical extension services, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation seeks to maximize water efficiency and per-acre productivity. This move underscores the state's commitment to strengthening national food security and reducing dependency on imports through an integrated package of farmer incentives and advanced agricultural practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The government of Jordan has launched a strategic suite of initiatives under the High-Value Industries program, marking a key phase of th...
records.description: The government of Jordan has launched a strategic suite of initiatives under the High-Value Industries program, marking a key phase of the Economic Modernisation Vision (2026–2029). This ambitious roadmap is designed to transition the agricultural sector toward a high-tech, innovation-driven model that enhances Jordan's global competitiveness and food sovereignty. Executed by the Ministry of Agriculture in partnership with the National Centre for Agricultural Research, the plan focuses on optimizing scarce resources—specifically through water-saving technologies—and modernizing livestock productivity via specialized centers for artificial insemination and biological pest control.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, the National Centre for Agricultural Research

records.title: Meranti Green Steel has secured a strategic agreement with a long-term investor to accelerate its green iron project in Oman, marking a c...
records.description: Meranti Green Steel has secured a strategic agreement with a long-term investor to accelerate its green iron project in Oman, marking a critical milestone toward a Final Investment Decision (FID) targeted for mid-2026. This investment strengthens the project's financial foundation, positioning it as a bankable, low-carbon industrial hub designed to serve international markets—particularly Europe—under tightening carbon regulations like the EU’s Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). By leveraging Oman’s strategic geography, port access, and renewable energy potential, the project aligns with the Sultanate’s broader ambition to build a competitive green hydrogen economy and an export-oriented ecosystem for low-emissions materials.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a strategic surge in livestock imports to the Sultanate, facilita...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a strategic surge in livestock imports to the Sultanate, facilitating the arrival of 285,890 head of cattle, sheep, and goats to meet rising seasonal demand for red meat. This represents a significant year-on-year increase in import volumes, a trend the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has supported by approving 239 import permits and streamlining administrative and quarantine procedures. By coordinating closely with private sector importers and monitoring market data, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources ensures a steady supply of both live animals and chilled or frozen meats, maintaining food stability and price consistency across all governorates during periods of high consumption.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Elsewedy Electric for Power Transmission & Distribution has announced the successful completion and handover of the El Saad Solar Plant i...
records.description: Elsewedy Electric for Power Transmission & Distribution has announced the successful completion and handover of the El Saad Solar Plant in Saudi Arabia, a utility-scale facility with a peak capacity of 348.6 MW. Developed in partnership with Jinko Power and Al Ghazala Energy Company Limited, the project marks a significant milestone as the company's first major photovoltaic asset in the Gulf region. Elsewedy Electric for Power Transmission & Distribution demonstrated exceptional engineering efficiency by compressing the original 24-month construction timeline to just 16.5 months, delivering not only the solar array but also a 33/132 kV high-voltage substation and interconnection infrastructure. Now entering its operations and maintenance phase, the plant is fully integrated into the high-voltage grid, supporting the Kingdom’s clean energy transition under the oversight of the Saudi Power Procurement Company.
records.institution: Elsewedy Electric for Power Transmission & Distribution

records.title: The Idlib Agriculture Directorate, in a strategic partnership with Ansar and Qatar Charity, has received a significant shipment of modern...
records.description: The Idlib Agriculture Directorate, in a strategic partnership with Ansar and Qatar Charity, has received a significant shipment of modern agricultural machinery designed to modernize farming operations in the region. This equipment—which includes a tractor, multiple specialized plows, a cultivator, a pest control sprayer, and a fertilizer spreader—is part of a targeted recovery project aimed at displaced families. By focusing on the wheat and barley value chains, the Idlib Agriculture Directorate intends to lower production costs for farmers and improve the mechanical efficiency of essential seasonal tasks, directly bolstering local food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has signed a landmark memorandum of understanding with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has signed a landmark memorandum of understanding with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD) to establish a specialized research station in the Al-Ruj Plain of Idlib Governorate. With an initial investment of $3 million provided by ACSAD, the facility is designed to become a "guiding beacon" for agricultural modernization in Northwestern Syria. The station will integrate advanced plant and animal research, aiming to produce up to one million fruit tree seedlings annually—specifically olive, almond, and pomegranate—while improving the genetic productivity of local Awassi sheep breeds.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially extended a comprehensive four-year ban on the catching, possess...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has officially extended a comprehensive four-year ban on the catching, possession, and trading of sea cucumbers within the marine waters of the Republic of Yemen to safeguard depleting fish stocks and preserve marine biodiversity. Under this directive, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources prohibits all related activities, including the purchase, transport, storage, and export of the species, with oversight provided by the General Authority for Fisheries in the Red Sea to ensure legal compliance. Furthermore, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has mandated the General Authority for Marine Sciences and Aquatic Life Research to conduct specialized scientific studies to assess the environmental status of sea cucumber populations, aiming to establish long-term sustainable management policies that protect the marine environment for future generations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has officially inaugurated a new veterinary laboratory at the veterinary hospital in Dhi Qar Governorate.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has officially inaugurated a new veterinary laboratory at the veterinary hospital in Dhi Qar Governorate. This facility represents a critical expansion of the region's diagnostic infrastructure, aimed at protecting livestock from epidemic diseases and enhancing the overall health of Iraq's animal wealth. During the inauguration, the Veterinary Department reviewed the progress of ongoing preventive vaccination campaigns, which are provided free of charge to local breeders as part of a national biosecurity strategy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued a formal directive addressing the "unjustified" price hikes of essential vegetables and fruits, as...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued a formal directive addressing the "unjustified" price hikes of essential vegetables and fruits, asserting that current market rates do not reflect actual product availability or production costs. To stabilize the market, the Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture confirmed that domestic supplies remain sufficient and that import permits are being actively granted to ensure a consistent flow of goods to consumers. The Ministry is calling on all supply chain stakeholders to adhere to its periodic indicative price list, which serves as the official benchmark for balancing farmer interests with consumer protection. Furthermore, the Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture is conducting daily market monitoring in coordination with the Ministry of Economy and Trade to identify and penalize monopolistic practices or illegal speculation that artificially inflate food costs.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a transformative period for the Sultanate's aquaculture sector, w...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has overseen a transformative period for the Sultanate's aquaculture sector, which achieved a 67.7 percent growth in production to reach 9,240 tonnes with a market value exceeding OMR20.3 million. By prioritizing species such as whiteleg shrimp, European seabream, and Omani abalone, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is advancing a sustainable blue economy aligned with Oman Vision 2040 to diversify national income. This strategic expansion is supported by a robust framework that includes 80 percent project financing for entrepreneurs, the promotion of "integrated aquaculture" to optimize water use, and the construction of massive new production facilities, such as the OMR23.5 million shrimp project in North Al Batinah. To ensure global competitiveness, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources enforces strict adherence to international Best Aquaculture Practices (BAP), facilitating the export of premium Omani seafood to major markets in the European Union, China, and across the GCC.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Jenin Directorate of Agriculture, through its technical committees, has officially received a strategic water infrastructure project...
records.description: The Jenin Directorate of Agriculture, through its technical committees, has officially received a strategic water infrastructure project in the Araba Plain, funded by the European aid program. The initiative features a new 2-kilometer pipeline, constructed at a cost of approximately 60,000 shekels, designed to convey water from the Araba reservoir to a high-priority vineyard located near the Dotan settlement. Despite significant implementation challenges due to the area's sensitive location, the Jenin Directorate of Agriculture successfully completed the project to restore irrigation capabilities for a farmer whose previous water infrastructure had been demolished.

records.title: Minister of Agriculture and Irrigation Directs Formation of National Committee and Development of 2026–2030 Strategy
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation has issued a decisive ministerial directive to establish a permanent National Committee for Cotton, marking a strategic pivot to restore Sudanese cotton to its historical global prominence. This new body will serve as a unified umbrella for all stakeholders, overseeing the entire lifecycle of the crop—from seed provision and field production to advanced processing and international marketing. Central to this initiative is the launch of the National Strategy for the Development of the Cotton Value Chain (2026–2030), a five-year roadmap designed to transition cotton from a raw agricultural export into a high-value integrated industry.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture recently convened with a delegation from Kingdom Design Limited to discuss a memorandum of understanding focu...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture recently convened with a delegation from Kingdom Design Limited to discuss a memorandum of understanding focused on the strategic investment, processing, and marketing of cotton to revitalize the sector's national and international standing. During the meeting, the Ministry of Agriculture emphasized that any partnership must strictly adhere to regulations protecting the reputation of Syrian cotton, specifically mandating the use of approved local varieties, the adoption of modern irrigation to conserve water, and the transition to mechanized harvesting. The proposed framework prioritizes contract farming and the establishment of cooperatives within a structured agricultural plan that balances soil preservation and water budgets. Both the Ministry of Agriculture and the investing delegation highlighted the economic necessity of restoring this high-value crop to global markets through specialized technical and financial studies.

records.title: Silal and the National Agricultural Center have entered into a strategic partnership to establish an integrated support framework for UAE...
records.description: Silal and the National Agricultural Center have entered into a strategic partnership to establish an integrated support framework for UAE farmers, beginning with an initiative in Ras Al Khaimah’s Al Hamraniyah region. This collaboration focuses on empowering local producers through a comprehensive system that includes technical assistance, the provision of high-quality agricultural inputs, and oversight of post-harvest handling. To streamline the path from farm to market, Silal and the National Agricultural Center will establish a dedicated crop collection center designed to enhance the efficiency of agricultural supply chains and boost the competitiveness of Emirati products. By integrating production, marketing, and distribution stages, this initiative strengthens the resilience of the agricultural sector and advances the country's national food security objectives.
records.institution: Silal and the National Agricultural Center

records.title: The Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) has officially approved the establishment of Al Ahly Green Agricultural Investment Fund Company,...
records.description: The Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) has officially approved the establishment of Al Ahly Green Agricultural Investment Fund Company, marking the launch of Egypt's first private equity investment fund dedicated exclusively to the agricultural sector. This pioneering fund, which also holds a license for venture capital activities, is designed to channel institutional and private capital into high-growth agricultural projects through a regulated, supervised framework. By introducing this new financial instrument, the Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) aims to strengthen national food security and support the state’s broader strategy of increasing private sector participation in vital productive industries.

records.title: The Social Security Investment Fund (SSIF) has solidified its position as a cornerstone of the national economy, managing assets equivale...
records.description: The Social Security Investment Fund (SSIF) has solidified its position as a cornerstone of the national economy, managing assets equivalent to approximately 43 percent of the country’s gross domestic product through a diversified and prudent long-term investment strategy. By the end of its most recent fiscal year, the Social Security Investment Fund (SSIF) saw its assets grow to JD18.6 billion—a 15.2 percent annual increase—driven by record-breaking net returns and a strategic equity portfolio that accounts for 13 percent of the national stock exchange's total market capitalization. Beyond financial performance, the Social Security Investment Fund (SSIF) supports over 100,000 direct jobs and finances major national projects in sectors such as mining, renewable energy, and tourism, ensuring the long-term sustainability of the pension system while fostering a stable and attractive environment for institutional investment.

records.title: The Forestry Directorate, in collaboration with the Majd 2020 team, has launched an innovative artificial afforestation experiment across...
records.description: The Forestry Directorate, in collaboration with the Majd 2020 team, has launched an innovative artificial afforestation experiment across 11 hectares in the Latakia countryside. Utilizing clay ball technology—a method where seeds are encased in nutrient-rich clay to protect them from birds and harsh weather—the project aims to accelerate the restoration of vegetation in damaged forest zones. This specific trial focuses on several indigenous and resilient forest species, including carob, pine, laurel, and sumac, which are essential for rebuilding the local ecosystem.

records.title: The Ministry of Trade and Export Development has announced a strict new pricing ceiling for the poultry sector.
records.description: The Ministry of Trade and Export Development has announced a strict new pricing ceiling for the poultry sector. This regulatory intervention aims to combat "illegal speculation" and "unjustified price hikes" that have recently disrupted the domestic market. By fixing maximum prices at both the farm-gate and wholesale levels, the ministry intends to protect consumer purchasing power and stabilize distribution channels against monopolistic behaviors and price-fixing.
records.institution: The Ministry of Trade and Export Development

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has announced a strategic modernization of Algeria's maritime fleet, centere...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has announced a strategic modernization of Algeria's maritime fleet, centered on a new measure allowing fishing professionals to import engines less than five years old. According to Director General Miloud Triaa, this initiative aims to reactivate coastal vessels currently out of service and complements the 2026 Finance Law, which permits the import of specialized fishing vessels under 15 years old. These regulatory shifts, combined with a landmark 50% reduction in access rights negotiated with Mauritania, are designed to pivot Algeria toward deep-sea fishing in the Atlantic Ocean with a target of 20,000 tonnes of high-value resources. Simultaneously, the Ministry of Agriculture is prioritizing a 50,000-tonne production increase through aquaculture and the development of domestic bluefin tuna fattening farms in Tlemcen and El Tarf to maximize export value and stabilize local supply.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: Iraq has successfully reopened the grain silo dock at Berth No.
records.description: Iraq has successfully reopened the grain silo dock at Berth No. 10 within the Umm Qasr Port in Basra, marking the end of a ten-year hiatus. The restoration of this deep-water gateway, managed by the General Company for Grain Trade under the Ministry of Trade, was completed entirely by Iraqi engineering teams. By reconnecting the port's massive storage silos directly to seaborne wheat supply chains, the government is drastically reducing ship turnaround times and operational costs. This milestone is central to Iraq’s strategy to stabilize its national food subsidy program, which provides flour and bread to millions of citizens, while signaling to international markets that the country's logistics infrastructure is ready for high-volume grain imports.
records.institution: The General Company for Grain Trade under the Ministry of Trade

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty has signed a technical cooperation agreement with the Food and Agriculture Organization...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty has signed a technical cooperation agreement with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) to facilitate a comprehensive national agricultural census. Funded with a budget of US$231,000, the initiative focuses on establishing a robust legal and institutional framework, updating data collection methodologies, and adopting modern digital tools to ensure precise agricultural reporting. By strengthening national technical capacities and providing structural surveys, the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty intends to use the resulting data to refine agricultural policies and enhance national food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has announced that national poultry meat production has reached a re...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has announced that national poultry meat production has reached a record 1,310,000 tons. This surge in domestic output is a central pillar of the "From the Bounty of Our Land" campaign, which promotes local consumption during Ramadan to bolster food security. While domestic capacity expands under Saudi Vision 2030, the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) has simultaneously tightened biosecurity measures, imposing a total import ban on poultry products from 40 countries and partial restrictions on 16 others. These controls, driven by the global spread of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI), aim to protect the Kingdom's thriving poultry sector and ensure the safety of the national food supply.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication has launched the second phase of its National Potato Seed Production Project, planting...
records.description: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication has launched the second phase of its National Potato Seed Production Project, planting 60,000 laboratory-grown seedlings across 3,500 square meters of specialized greenhouses. This critical initiative is split between facilities in Tartous (42,000 seedlings) and Aleppo (18,000 seedlings). By utilizing controlled environments and laboratory-verified stock, the project aims to secure a domestic supply of high-quality tubers that are entirely free from viral diseases, reducing the country's reliance on imported seeds and boosting national agricultural resilience.
records.institution: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia is spearheading a major ecological and rural development project in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia is spearheading a major ecological and rural development project in the governorates of Béja, Siliana, and Bizerte. Funded with 73.54 million dinars from the African Development Bank (AfDB) and the Strategic Climate Fund (SCF), this initiative focuses on the dual goals of promoting agroforestry and restoring degraded ecosystems. By rehabilitating both private and state-owned forest and pastoral lands, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to strengthen climate resilience, reduce the national carbon footprint, and stimulate the rural economy through the creation of approximately 2,200 jobs, directly benefiting over 42,000 residents in Northern Tunisia.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has officially launched its 2026 Livestock Auction series, a strategic initiative designed to bolster national food security and support local breeders. Held on the final weekend of every month at the Al Wathba platform, these auctions provide a transparent, intermediary-free marketplace for high-quality sheep and goats. By facilitating direct sales, ADAFSA aims to increase financial returns for local producers while ensuring that consumers have access to healthy, locally-sourced livestock that meet rigorous biosecurity and Sharia standards, particularly during high-demand periods like Ramadan and the upcoming Eids.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has launched a landmark national initiative at the start of Ramadan 2026 unde...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has launched a landmark national initiative at the start of Ramadan 2026 under the slogan "Today's Pit is Tomorrow's Palm Tree." This project aims to transform the millions of date pits remaining from iftar tables into a vast production base for palm trees across Yemen. By engaging the community in a "low-cost, high-impact" model, the ministry seeks to expand the agricultural footprint of palm trees to all governorates, ultimately reducing the nation's reliance on date imports and strengthening local food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Egypt is fast-tracking the integration of 2.5 GW of new renewable energy capacity into the national grid before the onset of summer 2026.
records.description: Egypt is fast-tracking the integration of 2.5 GW of new renewable energy capacity into the national grid before the onset of summer 2026. This directive, issued by the Presidency, aims to fortify grid stability during peak seasonal demand and decrease the nation's reliance on costly conventional fuels. Against a backdrop of regional energy security concerns, this move seeks to mitigate the impact of fluctuating petroleum prices by leveraging Egypt's growing green infrastructure. By the end of 2025, the New and Renewable Energy Authority (NREA) reported that installed capacity had already reached 9.1 GW, with solar and wind now providing the majority of the country's sustainable power.
records.institution: The New and Renewable Energy Authority (NREA)

records.title: Egypt’s strategic wheat reserves are currently stable at 4.5 million tonnes, providing a critical safety net for approximately four month...
records.description: Egypt’s strategic wheat reserves are currently stable at 4.5 million tonnes, providing a critical safety net for approximately four months of domestic consumption. According to the Grain Industry Chamber at the Federation of Egyptian Industries, these stocks are strategically positioned to meet the heightened demand of the upcoming Ramadan period. The reserve is composed of 3.5 million tonnes from local production and 1 million tonnes in existing import contracts. With the 2026 domestic procurement season set to begin in mid-April, officials expect the stockpile to swell to 5 million tonnes by mid-summer, ensuring the continuity of the national bread subsidy program—a vital service that supplies 24,000 tonnes of wheat daily to 154 mills nationwide.
records.institution: The Grain Industry Chamber at the Federation of Egyptian Industries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has officially announced the resumption of fresh meat imports from a slaughterhouse in Damascus, utilizing th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has officially announced the resumption of fresh meat imports from a slaughterhouse in Damascus, utilizing the ministry’s approved electronic platform to streamline the process. This decision is a strategic move to bolster the national stock of red meat, ensuring that the local market remains well-supplied and prices remain stable. By adhering to established import regulations and leveraging digital logistics, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to meet growing consumer demand while maintaining rigorous safety and quality standards for all imported animal products.

records.title: Moroccan blueberries have solidified their status as a premium benchmark in the European small fruit market, specifically targeting the h...
records.description: Moroccan blueberries have solidified their status as a premium benchmark in the European small fruit market, specifically targeting the high-value winter and early spring windows. Recent retail observations in France show Moroccan punnets commanding prices around €17.80 per kilogram, a figure that reflects the successful strategic positioning of the Moroccan berry sector. By investing in low-chill varieties and leveraging a competitive production calendar, regions such as Loukkos, Gharb, and Souss-Massa have transformed Morocco from a seasonal supplier into a structural pillar of the European Union's blueberry supply chain, alongside giants like Spain and Peru.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its specialized technical committees, has finalized the latest phase of the EU-funded agricultural a...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its specialized technical committees, has finalized the latest phase of the EU-funded agricultural assistance program across the governorates of Qalqilya, Hebron, Ramallah, and Tubas. These field visits are part of a strategic monitoring effort to verify that implemented projects—ranging from livestock distribution to water infrastructure—meet strict technical specifications. By providing tangible assets like greenhouses, wells, and livestock, the program directly counters the economic and physical pressures faced by rural communities, particularly those in high-conflict areas where land access is frequently restricted.

records.title: Algeria’s Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Start-ups, and Micro-enterprises has officially launched its dedicated incubation and accelerati...
records.description: Algeria’s Ministry of Knowledge Economy, Start-ups, and Micro-enterprises has officially launched its dedicated incubation and acceleration program for Agritech start-ups as of early March 2026. Part of the InnovAgro component within the "Development of Digital and Green Entrepreneurship" (DGA) project, the initiative is a collaboration between the Algerian government, Germany, and the European Union, with implementation led by GIZ. The program is a direct "scale-up" phase for winners of the Agripreneurs Challenge launched in 2025. It aims to bridge the gap between academic research and commercial viability, specifically targeting solutions that utilize AI, IoT, and drone technology to solve chronic agricultural issues like water scarcity and low crop yields.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has commenced the technical preparation of the Al-Suwaira fish h...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has commenced the technical preparation of the Al-Suwaira fish hatchery laboratories for the 2026 production season. This maintenance phase is critical for optimizing hatching rates and ensuring the biological success of the upcoming breeding cycle. The scope of work includes a comprehensive overhaul of incubators and hatcheries, alongside the sterilization of production halls and the maintenance of advanced drainage and ventilation systems. By conducting rigorous technical efficiency tests, the ministry aims to create a controlled, high-performance environment that supports national aquaculture growth and enhances the local supply of freshwater fish.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has announced six new agricultural investment opportunities in the Bur...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has announced six new agricultural investment opportunities in the Buraimi Governorate, totaling 114.5 acres, accessible through the Tatweer platform. These projects are designed to integrate modern agricultural technologies with private sector expertise to boost local productivity and food sustainability. The opportunities range from high-tech tissue culture laboratories and seedling production to specialized cultivation of staples like onions and potatoes, as well as high-value crops like figs. By leveraging strategic locations in Mahdah (specifically the Al Zaroub, Al Wadiyeen, and Safwan areas), the ministry aims to diversify the Sultanate’s agricultural output and strengthen the national food security framework in line with Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

By combining the regulatory oversight of the Food Safety and Quality Center with the operational expertise of Nama Water, the agreement aims to develop innovative technical solutions and raise community awareness, ensuring that Oman’s water infrastructure aligns with the highest international safety standards and the sustainable development goals of Oman Vision 2040.

To sustain this momentum, the Directorate is implementing a comprehensive support strategy that includes technical field consultations, quality supervision, and specialized marketing exhibitions. These efforts are designed to modernize the honey value chain, enhance the global competitiveness of Omani honey, and diversify the local economy in alignment with national strategic goals for the agricultural sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has announced that Saudi Arabia’s poultry meat production has exceeded 1.31 mil...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has announced that Saudi Arabia’s poultry meat production has exceeded 1.31 million tons, a milestone that significantly bolsters national food security and self-sufficiency. This production surge is timed to meet the heightened seasonal demand during the holy month of Ramadan, providing a reliable source of high-quality protein to the local market. By employing advanced breeding technologies and rigorous nutrition standards, the ministry ensures that national products maintain superior quality and safety levels compared to imports. This growth aligns with the strategic objectives of Saudi Vision 2030, fostering sustainable agricultural development and enhancing consumer confidence in the domestic poultry sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY) has signed a strategic agreement with the Estijabah Foundation for Hum...
records.description: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY) has signed a strategic agreement with the Estijabah Foundation for Humanitarian Aid and Relief to launch the "Strengthening the Agricultural Value Chain for Smallholders" project. This initiative targets approximately 2,300 Yemeni families—benefiting more than 16,000 individuals—in the agriculturally vital governorates of Abyan, Marib, and Hadhramaut. By improving access to high-quality inputs and modernizing irrigation technologies, the project seeks to transition rural farmers from low-yield subsistence to high-value production. A key pillar of the program involves enhancing the sustainability of pastoral livelihoods, ensuring that families relying on livestock can achieve better economic returns while fostering long-term social stability and food security for vulnerable groups.
records.institution: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued an urgent alert following the detection of the first yellow rust (Puccinia striiformis) outbreaks...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued an urgent alert following the detection of the first yellow rust (Puccinia striiformis) outbreaks in durum wheat farms across northern production zones. Characterized by its rapid spread and high epidemic potential, this fungal disease poses a significant threat to cereal crops, including soft wheat and triticale. To mitigate the risk, the ministry’s technical services have advised farmers to implement rigorous, daily monitoring of their plots and to initiate immediate chemical intervention using approved fungicides at the first sign of symptoms. By contacting the ministry's central or regional support services, producers can access specialized technical guidance to prevent the disease from compromising national grain yields during the 2026 season.

records.title: The Jordanian-Palestinian Agricultural Marketing Company (JPACO), under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, has successfully...
records.description: The Jordanian-Palestinian Agricultural Marketing Company (JPACO), under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, has successfully exported 120 tons of lemons to the United Arab Emirates as part of a larger 500-ton contract with major retail chains. This milestone, achieved throughout February, highlights the growing regional demand for Palestinian citrus. To sustain this momentum, the Ministry of Agriculture is leveraging a World Bank-funded program to modernize export infrastructure, including the development of advanced packing centers and cold storage facilities in Jericho. By qualifying farmers for both PalGAP and GlobalGAP certifications, the ministry is ensuring that Palestinian produce meets the rigorous international standards required to compete in global hypermarket and supermarket sectors.
