records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has officially launched the Saudi strawberry season, marking a strategic expansion in the Kingdom's high-value crop production. Through partnerships with major retailers, the ministry is deploying innovative packaging and display techniques to enhance the market presence and perceived quality of domestic strawberries. By providing high-quality tissue culture seedlings to farmers in regions such as Qassim, Taif, and Al-Jouf, the institution is successfully reducing import dependency and leveraging diverse regional climates to extend the production window. This initiative not only secures fresh produce for local markets but also feeds into a growing agro-industrial ecosystem, supporting the manufacture of jams, juices, and frozen goods to maximize the economic value of the national agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The General Authority for Fish Resources and Aquatic Life has entered into a strategic partnership with the Arab Center for the Studies o...
records.description: The General Authority for Fish Resources and Aquatic Life has entered into a strategic partnership with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD) to significantly boost Syria’s national fish production capacity. Under the patronage of the Ministry of Agriculture, the memorandum of understanding focuses on the comprehensive rehabilitation of the Ain Zarqa hatchery in Darkoush, Idlib. Currently producing 5 million tilapia and carp fingerlings annually, the facility is targeted for modernization to reach its maximum potential. The agreement prioritizes the transfer of modern aquaculture technologies, the enhancement of technical expertise for local staff, and the utilization of ACSAD’s advanced scientific laboratories to conduct research that will eventually expand production from inland freshwater to marine environments.
records.institution: The General Authority for Fish Resources and Aquatic Life

records.title: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the U...
records.description: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has launched a major rehabilitation project for the "J1" main irrigation canal. Covering a 5.5-kilometer stretch, the initiative involves extensive concrete and metal works totaling approximately 24,000 square meters. By modernizing this critical infrastructure, the Authority aims to drastically improve water conveyance efficiency, minimize seepage losses, and ensure the long-term sustainability of the region's water resources. This project is a key component of a broader strategy to stabilize agricultural production and revitalize the infrastructure of the Al-Ghab plain, providing a more reliable water supply for local farmers.
records.institution: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab,

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Madad Foundation for Development and Peacebuilding, has officially launched the Syri...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Madad Foundation for Development and Peacebuilding, has officially launched the Syrian National Livestock Census Platform. This digital initiative marks a transition toward a data-driven agricultural policy, designed to eliminate waste and ensure the equitable distribution of resources. The nationwide census is scheduled to take place from March 4 to March 17, 2026, during which time specialized enumerators will be deployed to all regions. By centralizing livestock data through this new platform, the Ministry aims to develop more effective support programs and safeguard the agricultural sector's long-term sustainability.

records.title: The Cereals Office has announced that approximately 99% of the Siliana Governorate’s grain harvest—totaling over 1.5 million quintals of...
records.description: The Cereals Office has announced that approximately 99% of the Siliana Governorate’s grain harvest—totaling over 1.5 million quintals of durum wheat, soft wheat, and barley—has been successfully transported in good condition. The remaining 1% of the harvest, amounting to 12,000 quintals currently held in collection centers, is scheduled for relocation to ensure that storage silo owners can begin technical preparations for the upcoming agricultural season. With a regional infrastructure consisting of 28 collection centers providing a total capacity of over one million quintals, the institution is prioritizing the final clearance of these stocks to maintain efficient logistics and storage readiness for future yields.

records.title: The Serbian Ministry of Agriculture has announced the successful harmonization of veterinary certification requirements with Tunisian aut...
records.description: The Serbian Ministry of Agriculture has announced the successful harmonization of veterinary certification requirements with Tunisian authorities, officially authorizing the export of Serbian beef and lamb to the North African market. This strategic agreement confirms that the national veterinary oversight system meets international standards for food safety, animal health, and traceability, allowing Tunisia to diversify its supplier base beyond existing partners like Brazil and Argentina. The opening of this trade route comes as Tunisia faces rising domestic red meat prices and increased demand during the Ramadan season, necessitating a shift toward higher import volumes which have doubled in recent years. By establishing this partnership, the institution aims to mitigate the impact of rising local production costs and ensure a stable supply of red meat to meet the growing national consumption needs.

records.title: Al Rawdah, a subsidiary of the Emirates Rawabi Food Group, has established a benchmark for fully integrated poultry production in the UAE...
records.description: Al Rawdah, a subsidiary of the Emirates Rawabi Food Group, has established a benchmark for fully integrated poultry production in the UAE, managing every stage from breeder genetics to renewable energy generation. By operating 78 high-capacity broiler houses and an in-house hatchery producing 16 million eggs annually, the company has minimized external dependencies while optimizing bird performance in extreme climates using specialized Cobb 500 and Ross 308 breeds. A significant portion of the facility's operations—currently 30%—is powered by solar energy, with strategic plans to exceed 50% in the near future. Aligned with the UAE Food Security Strategy 2051, Al Rawdah prioritizes a "fresh-first" model, delivering 90% of its output within hours of processing, while integrating circular waste management and in-house feed production to ensure long-term sustainability and biosecurity.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation significantly expanded Egypt's livestock and poultry sectors in February by issuing 916...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation significantly expanded Egypt's livestock and poultry sectors in February by issuing 916 operating licenses for projects ranging from cattle rearing to milk collection centers. This initiative, managed by the Livestock and Poultry Development Sector, included the approval of nearly EGP 297 million in funding for the National Veal Project, specifically targeting small breeders and women under the "Haya Karima" rural development framework. To ensure quality and safety, the ministry approved over 500 feed registrations in coordination with the Regional Centre for Food and Feed and conducted intensive inspection campaigns to prevent market hoarding. Furthermore, the institution has modernized its regulatory oversight by enabling mechanized licensing through digital platforms, facilitating the export of poultry and fish feed to international markets while maintaining strict biosecurity standards across desert hinterland projects.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Horticulture, has recorded successful preliminary results in the cultivation of hy...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Horticulture, has recorded successful preliminary results in the cultivation of hybrid eggplant varieties at the Al-Burjasiya Research Station in Basra. As a key component of the National Program for the Propagation of Local Vegetable Crops and Hybrids, the project tested the "Nasr" and "Wissam" varieties in a sandy desert environment characterized by harsh climates and reliance on well water. The hybrids demonstrated significant resilience and high productivity levels despite these challenging conditions, indicating their suitability for expansion in arid regions. By developing locally adapted seeds, the institution aims to reduce dependence on imported varieties and bolster the efficiency of the domestic agricultural sector under increasingly difficult environmental circumstances.

records.title: The National Seed Bank of Jordan and the Jordan Environmental Union have highlighted the critical importance of the Kingdom’s 2,500 wild...
records.description: The National Seed Bank of Jordan and the Jordan Environmental Union have highlighted the critical importance of the Kingdom’s 2,500 wild plant species under the theme of conserving medicinal and aromatic plants. With approximately 20% of Jordan’s flora possessing documented therapeutic properties, these institutions are advocating for an integrated conservation strategy to combat threats from overexploitation, habitat loss, and climate change. The proposed framework emphasizes the protection of genetic resources through national gene banks and reserves, the implementation of sustainable harvesting guidelines, and the expansion of cultivation initiatives to support rural livelihoods. By linking plant biodiversity to the "One Health" concept, experts from these organizations argue that safeguarding botanical heritage is essential for national food security, public health, and the preservation of traditional ecological knowledge.
records.institution: The National Seed Bank of Jordan

records.title: In response to devastating floods affecting 105,000 hectares of farmland in the Gharb and Loukkos regions, the Ministry of Agriculture ha...
records.description: In response to devastating floods affecting 105,000 hectares of farmland in the Gharb and Loukkos regions, the Ministry of Agriculture has mobilized 300 million dirhams to support recovery efforts and safeguard food security. This emergency funding aims to mitigate the damage to cereal, sugar, and forage crops, which threatens a projected 80% rebound in annual production following years of drought. The Ministry of Agriculture has implemented a comprehensive plan that includes distributing seeds, fertilizers, and livestock feed, alongside the urgent rehabilitation of damaged irrigation networks, pumping stations, and rural roads. By prioritizing the restoration of agricultural infrastructure and providing direct aid to breeders and farmers, the Ministry of Agriculture seeks to stabilize the harvest outlook and ensure the sustainability of the current growing season.
records.institution: Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has concluded a significant international tender for 794,000 metric tons of wheat, exceeding i...
records.description: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has concluded a significant international tender for 794,000 metric tons of wheat, exceeding its initial procurement target to bolster national reserves. This purchase, finalized in early March 2026, is scheduled for delivery between May and July via 13 separate shipments arriving at strategic ports including Jeddah, Yanbu, Jazan, and Duba. The acquisition follows a major tender in January and aligns with the institution's strategic shift toward international imports to preserve domestic freshwater resources. By securing these substantial volumes for the national milling industry, the authority continues to ensure the stability of the grain supply chain and reinforce the Kingdom's long-term food security framework.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has distributed urea fertilizer and essential agricultural supplies to 500...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has distributed urea fertilizer and essential agricultural supplies to 500 farmers in the Aleppo Governorate as part of the Sab' Sanabel Project. This initiative aims to support a total of 750 farming families in the production of wheat and vegetables by covering the costs of energy, seeds, and tools, while simultaneously providing training on best agricultural practices. Beyond direct aid, the project creates job opportunities for approximately 500 daily-wage workers, fostering economic resilience within the local community. By empowering Syrian agricultural families and enhancing their productivity, the program serves as a critical pillar in KSrelief’s broader humanitarian strategy to achieve livelihood stability and food security in the region.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The General Corporation for the Propagation of Improved Seeds, in partnership with the Al-Hujaylah District Multi-Purpose Agricultural Co...
records.description: The General Corporation for the Propagation of Improved Seeds, in partnership with the Al-Hujaylah District Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association, has officially inaugurated the maize harvest for the 1447 AH agricultural season in Al-Hodeidah. This initiative, coordinated with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, focuses on translating the state’s strategic vision into tangible grain and fodder production to cover local needs. By utilizing modern agricultural technologies and selected seed varieties, the project aims to ensure economic feasibility for farmers while moving toward national self-sufficiency in staple crops. Initial yields in the Tihama regions have shown promising results, providing a foundation for the Agricultural Cooperative Union to expand maize cultivation across broader areas in future seasons.
records.institution: The General Corporation for the Propagation of Improved Seeds

records.title: The Union for the Mediterranean (UfM), in collaboration with CIHEAM, has launched a high-level regional initiative to address the legal a...
records.description: The Union for the Mediterranean (UfM), in collaboration with CIHEAM, has launched a high-level regional initiative to address the legal and institutional barriers facing women within Mediterranean agrifood systems. By hosting specialized webinars and policy dialogues, these institutions seek to advance women’s access to justice, land tenure, and labor protections, particularly as the region faces escalating climate stress and food insecurity. This effort builds upon a regional agenda co-designed in earlier stakeholder dialogues to strengthen women’s roles as farmers, entrepreneurs, and innovators through concrete roadmaps. The initiative marks the beginning of a comprehensive annual program that includes launching a regional agenda on gender and food security and presenting critical reports at major international climate summits to ensure women are legally and economically empowered across the Euro-Mediterranean region.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests has launched an emergency post-flood management...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests has launched an emergency post-flood management program to stabilize and restore farming operations in the Gharb and Loukkos regions. Following field assessments that identified over 100,000 hectares of damaged crops—including cereals, sugar crops, and legumes—the institution has allocated 300 million dirhams to fund recovery efforts. This comprehensive support package, coordinated through the Gharb Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVA), provides disaster-stricken farmers with seeds and fertilizers for a specialized spring planting program, alongside the repair of vital irrigation networks and pumping stations. Additionally, the initiative includes the distribution of livestock feed and mobilized veterinary services to protect animal health and maintain national milk and meat production levels in the wake of the environmental crisis.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: Algeria has initiated a significant expansion of its national food security infrastructure with the commencement of a 100,000-tonne strat...
records.description: Algeria has initiated a significant expansion of its national food security infrastructure with the commencement of a 100,000-tonne strategic grain silo in El Menia province. This project, overseen by the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries, serves as a cornerstone of a broader national strategy to modernize storage networks, minimize post-harvest losses, and stabilize domestic cereal markets. Strategically positioned in the southern production heartland, the facility is designed to optimize the collection of seasonal harvests and bolster strategic reserves, ultimately ensuring a consistent, high-quality supply of grain for downstream milling and animal feed operations across the country.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a strategic initiative to combat desertification and mitigate sand dune encroachment through a s...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a strategic initiative to combat desertification and mitigate sand dune encroachment through a series of integrated mechanical and biological projects across environmentally vulnerable regions. Under the oversight of the Forestry and Desertification Control Department, the ministry is implementing clay-based stabilization and earthen barriers alongside the planting of resilient shrubs in Dhi Qar and Salah al-Din. Furthermore, the plan includes a 100-kilometer afforestation project using triple-row windbreaks to protect major highway networks, supported by modern watershed management and drip irrigation for drought-resistant species. This effort is bolstered by a partnership with the National University in Dhi Qar, which facilitates academic collaboration in large-scale seedling distribution and pasture seeding to enhance soil cohesion and regional climate resilience.

records.title: The Ministry of Electricity confirmed that the first 250 MW unit of the Basra Sun solar park—Iraq's largest solar project to date—has suc...
records.description: The Ministry of Electricity confirmed that the first 250 MW unit of the Basra Sun solar park—Iraq's largest solar project to date—has successfully transitioned from its testing phase to active trial operations. This milestone follows the historic energization of the facility’s 132 kV transmission network by the Southern Electricity Transmission Company. The 1,000 MW (1 GW) plant is the renewable centerpiece of the Gas Growth Integrated Project (GGIP), a $27 billion multi-energy consortium led by TotalEnergies (45%), Basrah Oil Company (30%), and QatarEnergy (25%). Once the remaining three units come online by mid-March 2026, the facility will provide clean electricity to approximately 350,000 homes, significantly reducing the country's reliance on imported power and gas flaring.

records.title: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL) has accelerated the deployment and repair of solar energy systems across 25 nationwide pu...
records.description: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL) has accelerated the deployment and repair of solar energy systems across 25 nationwide public health centers to ensure a stable and sustainable electricity supply. This initiative is a core component of the "GoGreen" program and aligns with the national strategy for energy efficiency, following a directive from the Prime Ministry that mandates all public entities funded by the state to adopt renewable technologies. By transitioning healthcare infrastructure to solar power, the institution aims to enhance the operational capabilities of medical facilities, reduce carbon emissions, and alleviate pressure on the national electricity grid. The authority is now calling for broader inter-institutional cooperation to expand these renewable energy solutions across all government sectors to bolster national energy security.
records.institution: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL)

records.title: Morocco achieved a historic milestone in its agricultural sector, with exports of Brussels sprouts reaching 32,600 tonnes in a single yea...
records.description: Morocco achieved a historic milestone in its agricultural sector, with exports of Brussels sprouts reaching 32,600 tonnes in a single year, generating revenue exceeding $14 million. Data analyzed by EastFruit confirms that this performance represents a tenfold increase in volume since the start of the decade, positioning the nation among the top three global exporters alongside Mexico and the Netherlands. While European markets like the United Kingdom have seen a tenfold increase in demand for Moroccan produce, West Africa remains the primary driver of growth, with Mauritania and Senegal accounting for the vast majority of export volumes. This rapid expansion highlights the sector's ability to provide a reliable, year-round alternative to international markets, particularly during periods of production deficits in Europe caused by adverse weather conditions.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests has launched the 10th edition of the National Grand Prix for Agricultural and Rural Press to promote specialized journalism and professional information sharing within the sector. This annual competition recognizes outstanding journalistic works across print, electronic, television, and radio platforms that address strategic themes such as farm modernization, sustainable resource management, and climate challenges. By rewarding rigorous and educational coverage of national agricultural policies and agritech innovation, the institution aims to highlight the development of the rural world and support the broader goals of national food security. The current edition welcomes submissions published over the preceding year, further consolidating the role of the media in documenting the evolution and performance of the Moroccan agricultural industry.

The institution also prioritized environmental resilience through the "Green Belt" project and the cultivation of 20,000 Sidr seedlings to bolster local honey production. records.title: Scatec is significantly expanding its renewable energy portfolio in Egypt through plans to double its current investments, which include...
records.description: Scatec is significantly expanding its renewable energy portfolio in Egypt through plans to double its current investments, which include the establishment of a wind turbine factory for localized production and the development of a solar-powered water desalination plant. During high-level diplomatic discussions focused on strengthening economic ties between Egypt and Norway, the government reiterated its commitment to positioning the country as a global green hydrogen hub while attracting foreign direct investment. This expansion builds upon the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' strategic support for the private sector and complements existing large-scale initiatives, such as the Obelisk hybrid solar-plus-storage facility and the Sokhna Green Ammonia project, which together aim to establish one of the largest renewable energy and battery storage infrastructures in Africa.

records.title: The Egypt Food Export Council (FEC) announced that the nation’s food industries achieved a historic milestone, with exports reaching an a...
records.description: The Egypt Food Export Council (FEC) announced that the nation’s food industries achieved a historic milestone, with exports reaching an all-time high of nearly $7 billion in 2025. This performance represents a 12% growth over 2024 and effectively doubles the export value recorded just a decade ago. As a primary driver of foreign currency earnings, the sector’s expansion into new international markets has solidified Egypt’s position as a regional powerhouse in processed food and agricultural value-added products.

records.title: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation and the Ministry of Agriculture have convened their joint coordination committee to accele...
records.description: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation and the Ministry of Agriculture have convened their joint coordination committee to accelerate strategic projects aimed at enhancing national food security and water-use efficiency. A major milestone highlighted was the completion of the first phase of a nationwide digitization project for private irrigation canals, which has established a digital platform covering over 17,000 kilometers of waterways to facilitate real-time monitoring and equitable water distribution. The collaboration also prioritizes the modernization of on-farm practices, such as laser land leveling and raised-bed cultivation, alongside the mandatory implementation of modern irrigation systems in newly reclaimed sandy lands. To ensure the long-term governance of these initiatives, the two institutions are establishing a central joint unit to oversee the design, implementation, and impact assessment of irrigation development projects across the Nile Valley and Delta.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq, through the Agricultural Research Department, announced the successful execution of critical weed co...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq, through the Agricultural Research Department, announced the successful execution of critical weed control operations at the Al-Elm Research Station in Tikrit. Under the direct supervision of Director General Professor Zain Al-Abidin Muhammad Raouf, the station implemented a specialized program to propagate "spigot grade" (high-grade) wheat seeds. The operations focused on two primary strategic varieties—Masala and Gaza—which are central to Iraq's 2025–2026 winter agricultural plan. By eliminating narrow- and broad-leaved weeds, the initiative aims to maximize the genetic purity and production efficiency of these seeds, directly supporting the national goal of achieving wheat self-sufficiency and reducing the multi-billion dollar grain import bill.

records.title: Agriculture ministry signs Country Programme Framework agreement 2026–2030 with FAO
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has formally entered into a five-year Country Programme Framework (CPF) agreement with the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO), covering the period from 2026 to 2030. The framework is designed to bolster food security by enhancing the sustainability and resilience of the agricultural and fisheries sectors, optimizing value chain efficiencies, and improving the management of natural resources. Furthermore, the agreement emphasizes a commitment to climate action and the achievement of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), ensuring that the Sultanate’s primary production sectors remain competitive and environmentally viable through the end of the decade.

The project, spanning 2024–2025, focused on enhancing the structural integrity and monitoring capabilities of Oman's national water infrastructure. Key upgrades included the removal of millions of cubic meters of silt, the installation of 32 advanced monitoring cameras, and the replacement of 18 water discharge gates. These measures are critical for Oman’s water security, as the nation increasingly relies on groundwater recharge dams to replenish aquifers and combat seawater intrusion along its coastal plains.

This facility, which utilizes an ionization-based system to stimulate rainfall and recharge groundwater reserves, marks the 14th station in a specialized network spanning the Hajar mountains and the Dhofar highlands. With an operational reach of up to 70 kilometers, the station is designed to enhance precipitation prospects across the region’s unique geographical landscape. By expanding this weather enhancement infrastructure, the institution aims to achieve long-term water sustainability targets and mitigate the impacts of regional water scarcity through advanced meteorological technology.

records.title: The veterinary services departments have executed a comprehensive health monitoring campaign by collecting table egg samples to ensure th...
records.description: The veterinary services departments have executed a comprehensive health monitoring campaign by collecting table egg samples to ensure their safety for human consumption. Under the oversight of the Ministry of Agriculture, these samples were transported to the Al-Aroub Food Safety Laboratory for rigorous testing against established health standards and specifications. The operation was significantly enhanced by a specialized vehicle provided by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), which was utilized to streamline sample transport and improve the overall efficiency of the diagnostic process. This initiative is a core component of the ministry's ongoing commitment to strengthening its health monitoring systems, protecting public health, and maintaining consumer confidence in local animal products through advanced laboratory capabilities.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially reaffirmed the strategic status of Saudi Coffee as a vital national...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially reaffirmed the strategic status of Saudi Coffee as a vital national crop and a cornerstone of the Kingdom's cultural identity, particularly during the month of Ramadan. As part of Saudi Vision 2030, the government is aggressively scaling domestic production to transition coffee from a traditional heritage drink into a high-value global commodity. With over 1.3 million productive trees now established in the southwestern highlands, Saudi Arabia is rapidly closing the gap on its ambitious goal to reach 7,000 tons of annual production by the end of 2026.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has launched an international tender to procure 655,000 metric tons of wheat to secure t...
records.description: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has launched an international tender to procure 655,000 metric tons of wheat to secure the Kingdom’s domestic flour milling requirements and bolster national strategic reserves. This massive procurement is distributed across eleven shipments destined for major maritime hubs, including Jeddah Islamic Port, King Abdulaziz Port in Dammam, Yanbu Commercial Port, and Jazan Port. By coordinating these large-scale arrivals through a centralized digital bidding process, the institution aims to ensure a continuous and stable supply of high-quality grain during peak consumption periods, reinforcing the logistical efficiency of the national food security framework.
records.institution: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA)

records.description: European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) advanced its consideration of a EUR 40 million (USD 47.3 million) loan for a landmark solar-plus-storage project in Tunisia. Spearheaded by the state utility Société Tunisienne de l'Electricité et du Gaz (STEG), the 50-MW photovoltaic plant will be equipped with a 20-MWh Battery Energy Storage System (BESS)—the first utility-scale battery investment in the country. Located in the Tataouine Governorate (or specifically the El-Medina region of Gabes according to some project variants), the facility is designed to address the intermittency of solar power, providing a stabilized flow of clean energy to the national grid through new high-voltage transmission infrastructure.
records.institution: Tunisian Company of Electricity and Gas.

records.title: The Agency for Agricultural Development (ADA) launched a major call for projects to select twenty Productive Alliances.
records.description: The Agency for Agricultural Development (ADA) launched a major call for projects to select twenty Productive Alliances. Financed by the World Bank under the 2025–2030 Food Systems Transformation Support Program, this initiative aims to bridge the gap between small-scale producers and commercial buyers. By formalizing business plans and commercial partnerships, the program seeks to shield vulnerable farmers from market volatility while ensuring a steady, high-quality supply for market operators. Selected alliances will receive a two-year package of technical and financial government support to ensure their transition into competitive, structured value chains.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs & Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture began its specialized price monitoring program for the holy month of Ramadan.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture began its specialized price monitoring program for the holy month of Ramadan. This initiative involves publishing a weekly bulletin that tracks the average wholesale and retail prices of essential food groups—specifically meat, vegetables, fruits, and dairy. By providing a transparent "price ceiling" or benchmark, the Ministry aims to empower consumers, curb seasonal price manipulation by intermediaries, and ensure the steady flow of goods across various governorates.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty announced a strategic price-control initiative for the upcoming holy month of Ramadan.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty announced a strategic price-control initiative for the upcoming holy month of Ramadan. By establishing a mandated list of reduced prices for essential vegetables at specialized Ramadan 2026 exhibitions, the Ministry aims to protect consumer purchasing power and curb seasonal price inflation. This program serves a dual purpose: providing immediate financial relief to citizens while prioritizing the national product, ensuring that local farmers have a direct and supported route to the consumer market.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources in Dhofar announced the successful second harvest of its pilot gin...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources in Dhofar announced the successful second harvest of its pilot ginger cultivation project. Funded by the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund, the initiative has scaled from its 2024 debut to a 2026 yield of 2.5 tons—more than doubling the previous year's output. Under the leadership of Engineer Radwan bin Abdullah Al Ibrahim, the project has expanded to include 60 farmers across the Wilayats of Rakhyut and Dhalkut. By providing technical advisory, modern irrigation systems, and soil improvement techniques, the program aims to replicate the success of Dhofar’s earlier turmeric localization, shifting the region toward high-value spice production to reduce national import reliance and create sustainable income for local families.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman announced the successful commissioning of its newest artificial rainma...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman announced the successful commissioning of its newest artificial rainmaking station in the Musandam Governorate (Wilayat of Khasab). This facility marks the 14th station in Oman’s national cloud-seeding network, which now blankets the Hajar Mountains and the Dhofar highlands. Utilizing advanced ion technology, the Khasab station emits ions to catalyze cloud condensation, with an operational reach of up to 70 kilometers to the northwest and south. This expansion is a key pillar of Oman’s strategy to bolster groundwater recharge and ensure water security amidst the increasing pressures of climate change.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Tubas Agriculture Directorate, officially launched the "My Initiative" project in the Bardala co...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Tubas Agriculture Directorate, officially launched the "My Initiative" project in the Bardala community of the Northern Jordan Valley. Implemented in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and funded by the IBSA Fund (India, Brazil, and South Africa), the project addresses the critical challenge of rising traditional feed costs by promoting the production of alternative animal feed. By combining technical studies with field-based training and biosecurity extensions, the initiative aims to build the resilience of marginalized livestock farmers, ensuring the long-term sustainability of rural agribusinesses in Area C and beyond.

records.description: The Qatar Free Zones Authority (QFZ) and Qatar Foundation (QF) entered into a strategic partnership agreement to establish a collaborative framework focused on climate change action and sustainable development. This initiative aims to strengthen national preparedness and resilience through climate education, applied research, and community engagement projects, utilizing flagship sustainability platforms such as the Earthna Center for a Sustainable Future and the Sustainability Academy at Green Island. By integrating expertise in innovation and human capacity building, the partnership seeks to foster sustainable behaviors and advance the environmental pillar of the Qatar National Vision 2030 through coordinated annual work plans and measurable impact reporting.

records.title: The General Authority for the Management and Development of the Ghab in Syria officially launched its infrastructure maintenance campaign...
records.description: The General Authority for the Management and Development of the Ghab in Syria officially launched its infrastructure maintenance campaign to secure the upcoming irrigation season. The project focuses on a critical 16-kilometer stretch of the primary canal network, extending from the town of Shizar to Sheikh Hadid. By dredging accumulated silt and raising canal embankments, the Authority aims to restore the network's original hydraulic capacity. This ensures that water reaches "tail-end" farms that often suffer from shortages, thereby supporting the cultivation of strategic crops like wheat and sugar beets in one of Syria's most fertile agricultural basins.
records.institution: The General Authority for the Management and Development of the Ghab

records.title: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication (GOSM) in Syria launched its distribution phase for imported potato seeds to support th...
records.description: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication (GOSM) in Syria launched its distribution phase for imported potato seeds to support the spring 2026 planting season. To alleviate the financial burden on farmers facing high input costs and currency devaluation, the Establishment set a competitive, subsidized price of $1,100 per ton for the high-yield Agria variety. This initiative is part of a broader national strategy to ensure food sovereignty by providing elite, virus-free seeds—both imported and locally multiplied—to registered farmers across the governorates.
records.institution: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication (GOSM)

records.title: The Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Agriculture in Tunisia outlined a multi-track strategy to stabilize the livestock market ahe...
records.description: The Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Agriculture in Tunisia outlined a multi-track strategy to stabilize the livestock market ahead of Eid al-Adha. During a parliamentary hearing, officials confirmed plans to import between 15,000 and 20,000 sheep to bolster local supply and curb rising costs. To further protect consumer purchasing power, the government will introduce chilled lamb imports and enforce price regulations at retail butchers. The Ministry of Agriculture also committed to expanding the "sale by weight" program, with new dedicated sales points planned for Greater Tunis to ensure transparency and fair pricing for sacrificial animals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce and the Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) formalized two strategic industrial agreements in the Sokhna Industrial Zone with a combined invest...
records.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) formalized two strategic industrial agreements in the Sokhna Industrial Zone with a combined investment value of US$13 million (EGP 609 million). The first and larger contract, valued at US$11 million, was signed with Al-Atta Group for Food and Mining Industries to develop a 17,000-square-meter facility for packaged grain production. Scheduled to begin operations in 2027, the plant will have an annual capacity of 10,000 tonnes and uniquely integrates the company's mining interests by including units for processing minerals and precious stones. This project is complemented by a US$2 million agreement with Grass Egypt (also referred to as Gheras Egypt) to establish a 15,000-square-meter factory for fertilizers and pesticides, aimed at substituting imports with an annual output of up to 7,000 tonnes.

records.title: The Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in New Delhi issued a formal request to Indian authorities to suspend the import of fruits and vegetabl...
records.description: The Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia in New Delhi issued a formal request to Indian authorities to suspend the import of fruits and vegetables from Kerala and West Bengal. This precautionary measure follows the detection of two confirmed cases of Nipah virus (NiV) in healthcare workers in West Bengal in January 2026. While Kerala has not reported active cases in recent months, its history of near-annual outbreaks since 2018 has led to its inclusion in the suspension. The directive mandates that produce from other Indian states undergo rigorous phytosanitary inspections, specifically looking for signs of bat activity (bite marks or droppings) to prevent the zoonotic transmission of the virus through contaminated food.
records.institution: The Royal Embassy of Saudi Arabia

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries in Tunisia formalized a significant debt relief and rescheduling framework fo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries in Tunisia formalized a significant debt relief and rescheduling framework for tenants of state-owned agricultural lands. This administrative move implements Article 58 of Law No. 17-2025 (2026 Finance Law), which aims to alleviate the financial burden on farmers hit by successive droughts and irrigation water shortages. The measure specifically targets vulnerable and strategic groups, including young farmers and agricultural technicians, by providing a pathway to waive or reschedule rent payments. To qualify, tenants must navigate a cross-departmental verification process involving the Regional Agricultural Development Commissions (CRDA) and the Ministry of State Domains, ensuring that relief is accurately directed to those in officially recognized disaster zones.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.title: The Bajil Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Al-Hodeidah Governorate officially commenced its soybean procurement season.
records.description: The Bajil Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Al-Hodeidah Governorate officially commenced its soybean procurement season. This initiative, supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, marks a turning point for the Tihama region as it shifts toward localizing strategic crops to reduce the national import bill. District officials highlighted the success of intercropping soybean with corn, a technique that has significantly improved land-use efficiency and soil health. By activating cooperative warehouses for standardized drying, cleaning, and storage, the project aims to establish a reliable local value chain for plant-based protein, moving Yemen closer to food sovereignty.

records.description: The General Directorate of Fisheries and Aquaculture, under the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries, has officially integrated the creation of a National Compensation Fund for fishermen into its 2026 action plan. Announced by Director General Miloud Tria, this strategic initiative aims to provide a financial safety net for maritime professionals during periods of forced inactivity, such as extreme weather conditions or mandatory biological rest periods (designed to allow fish stocks to replenish).

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture initiated a specialized nutritional program for fish broodstock at the Al-Suwaira Fish Hatchery to optimize t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture initiated a specialized nutritional program for fish broodstock at the Al-Suwaira Fish Hatchery to optimize the current breeding season. Through its Department of Animal Resources, the Ministry of Agriculture is producing and distributing pelleted feed specifically formulated with high protein and energy levels to accelerate sexual maturation in young broodstock. These carefully studied nutritional compositions are designed to enhance egg quantity and quality during the critical pre-spawning stage. This initiative, which includes continuous technical monitoring of fertilization and hatching rates, aims to produce highly viable fingerlings to support the sustainable development of the national fisheries sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture launched a specialized weed control campaign in the wheat fields of Nineveh Governorate to safeguard the curr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture launched a specialized weed control campaign in the wheat fields of Nineveh Governorate to safeguard the current agricultural season and bolster local production. Specifically, technical staff from the Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Agricultural Research at the Tal Afar Research Station utilized herbicide treatments on the "Rahaf" wheat variety to eliminate both narrow-leaved and broad-leaved weeds. This field operation is a critical component of a broader program to propagate high-grade seeds, adhering to scientific and technical standards to ensure the production of pure, high-quality grain. By timing these interventions with ideal weather conditions, the ministry aims to maximize crop yields and maintain the purity of the national seed stock.

records.title: The Jordan Valley Authority formalized several strategic investment agreements to launch a new wave of development projects in the agricu...
records.description: The Jordan Valley Authority formalized several strategic investment agreements to launch a new wave of development projects in the agricultural and tourism sectors across the Kingdom. These agreements, aligned with the national Economic Modernisation Vision, focus specifically on leveraging the natural assets and strategic location of the Wadi Araba region in southern Jordan. By prioritizing modern agriculture and eco-tourism initiatives, the Jordan Valley Authority aims to integrate less-advantaged areas into the broader economic growth cycle, fostering social stability through the creation of direct and indirect employment opportunities. This move reinforces the government’s commitment to sustainable resource management and the creation of an enabling environment for private sector investment.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests launched a major international promotion campai...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests launched a major international promotion campaign at the 62nd Paris International Agricultural Show (SIA). Marking its thirteenth consecutive year at the event, Morocco’s pavilion—themed "Morocco, Centuries of Flavors"—serves as a primary vehicle for the Generation Green 2020–2030 strategy. By showcasing the output of over 740 small farmers and 46 cooperatives, the ministry is working to integrate traditional "terroir" products like Argan oil and Taliouine saffron into high-value European value chains, directly boosting rural incomes and empowering a workforce that is 61% female.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: The Ministry of Equipment and Water reported a dramatic recovery in the Bouregreg and Chaouia river basin, with rainfall levels surging t...
records.description: The Ministry of Equipment and Water reported a dramatic recovery in the Bouregreg and Chaouia river basin, with rainfall levels surging to 452.9 mm—an 82% excess compared to a normal hydrological year. This precipitation led to massive dam inflows of 1,080 million $m^3$ and a significant recharge of groundwater tables, with piezometric levels rising by up to 3 meters. This reversal follows a severe deficit in the previous season and provides critical relief for the Chaouia region’s strategic cereal and livestock sectors. To sustain this momentum, the Bouregreg and Chaouia Hydraulic Basin Agency is fast-tracking structural projects, including the second phase of the Sebou-Bouregreg-Oum Er-Rbia interconnection and the completion of the Casablanca desalination plant by the end of 2026.

records.title: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA), in partnership with the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Ar...
records.description: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA), in partnership with the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA), launched the preparatory phase for the fifth iteration of the Moroccan Collaborative Grants Program (MCGP) in Rabat. This strategic collaboration, which spans over two decades, aims to define the scientific roadmap for 2026–2030, focusing on developing high-impact solutions for Morocco’s arid and semi-arid regions. By providing a competitive funding mechanism for joint research, the National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) seeks to accelerate agronomic innovation and strengthen agricultural sovereignty, prioritizing climate change adaptation, sustainable resource management, and enhanced crop productivity to support the transition toward resilient and sustainable farming systems.
records.institution: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has finalized its 2026-2030 strategy
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture officially launched the National Agriculture Strategy (2026–2030) in Damascus. Developed in high-level collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the British Government (FCDO), the strategy serves as a flexible, evidence-based roadmap to transition the sector from emergency relief to long-term economic recovery. With agricultural GDP contribution having fallen from 23% in 2005 to 13% in 2022, the plan prioritizes "smart agriculture" and structural reforms to restore the livelihoods of over 114,000 farming households. Key initiatives include the restructuring of industrial crops like sugar beets and cotton in favor of high-value medicinal plants, alongside a robust Early Warning System to mitigate the severe climate-induced shocks, such as the historic 2025–2026 floods and droughts.

In partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), the ministry is rolling out the Event Mobile Application (EMA-i+) to regional veterinary services. This digital tool enables field agents to report animal disease outbreaks in real-time using geo-referenced data, which is then securely stored and analyzed on the national EMPRES-i+ platform. By modernizing the epidemiological surveillance system, Tunisia is significantly shortening the "alert-to-action" window, mitigating economic losses from livestock diseases and proactively managing zoonotic threats that could impact human health.

records.description: ne’ma (the National Food Loss and Waste Initiative) announced the expansion of its ‘Valuing Our Roots’ campaign, marking its largest nationwide rollout to date. Operating across Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Al Ain, Sharjah, and Ras Al Khaimah, the initiative aims to rescue over 300,000 tonnes of food—a 50% increase in surplus recovery compared to 2025. Centered on the ne’ma Family Iftar Boxes, the program redistributes fresh produce and non-perishables from major suppliers like Silal, Agthia, and Majid Al Futtaim to more than 10,000 low-income families.

records.title: The Eastern Sector Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana’a Governorate launched a major initiative to distribute 10,000...
records.description: The Eastern Sector Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana’a Governorate launched a major initiative to distribute 10,000 almond and fruit tree saplings from its Al-Yafi’iyah nursery. Part of a broader plan to plant 50,000 trees this year, the project targets cooperatives across several sub-districts to bolster local crop diversity and move toward national self-sufficiency in fruits like apples, peaches, and grapes. Beyond reforestation, the Eastern Sector Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society is expanding into garlic cultivation in the Khawlan districts and has provided nearly eight tons of improved cereal and legume seeds through interest-free loans.
records.institution: The Eastern Sector Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society

records.title: The National Agricultural Mutual Fund (CNMA) in Algeria has launched a pioneering insurance scheme designed to shield the agricultural se...
records.description: The National Agricultural Mutual Fund (CNMA) in Algeria has launched a pioneering insurance scheme designed to shield the agricultural sector from the escalating threats of climate change, specifically drought and rainfall deficits. Finalized in early 2026, the first phase of this mechanism prioritizes the cereal sector—a key pillar of Algeria's national food security. Under the leadership of Director General Cherif Benhabiles, the CNMA is transitioning from traditional coverage to an integrated support system that combines technical expertise, digital transparency, and rapid compensation to ensure farmers can maintain investment and production despite natural hazards.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, escalated field operations at the Umm al-Rabeein Nursery in Nineveh Gov...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, escalated field operations at the Umm al-Rabeein Nursery in Nineveh Governorate. As part of a national strategic plan to modernize Iraq’s horticultural sector, the facility is executing large-scale propagation of deciduous fruit, olives, and ornamental plants. By integrating advanced soil preparation techniques, such as the use of mechanical reclaimers, and implementing rigorous preventative fungicide protocols, the Ministry of Agriculture is ensuring the production of high-quality, disease-resistant seedlings. These efforts culminate in a direct-to-citizen distribution model, offering various plant varieties at subsidized prices to expand national green spaces and bolster local agricultural output.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment signed a strategic implementation agreement with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to launch a...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment signed a strategic implementation agreement with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to launch a comprehensive, multi-year project for the integrated management of Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs). This initiative is designed to modernize Iraq's compliance with the Stockholm Convention through nationwide surveys of hazardous pesticides and PCBs, with a specific focus on assessing contaminated sites in provinces previously affected by ISIS. By inspecting pesticide warehouses and contaminated transformer oils, upgrading specialized laboratories, and ensuring the safe disposal of toxic materials, the Ministry of Environment and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) aim to mitigate long-term health risks and build a robust institutional framework for hazardous chemical oversight.

records.title: The Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply announced that 300,000 containers of 5-litre olive oil will be supplied to the Civil and Milit...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply announced that 300,000 containers of 5-litre olive oil will be supplied to the Civil and Military Consumer Corporations to ensure market stability through the spring. To address a significant shortage in local production, the Ministry of Agriculture has authorized the importation of approximately 12,000 tonnes of Tunisian olive oil through coordinated efforts with the private sector. These measures are designed to provide citizens with affordable access to this essential commodity while a new distribution mechanism at the Civil and Military Consumer Corporations aims to streamline purchases and prevent the overcrowding recently observed at retail outlets.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply

records.title: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in South Al Batinah launched over 15 new investment opportunities through the Tatwe...
records.description: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in South Al Batinah launched over 15 new investment opportunities through the Tatweer platform to strengthen the national food security system. These initiatives involve the allocation of over 150 acres of land for diverse projects including citrus and lemon cultivation, agricultural nurseries, and fish farming, specifically designed to leverage the governorate's unique environmental advantages. Aimed at achieving the sustainable development goals of Oman Vision 2040, the program promotes decentralization by attracting quality private sector projects and empowering small and medium enterprises (SMEs) to drive local economic growth and production efficiency.

records.title: Nablus Directorate of Agriculture formalized a strategic partnership with the Naqoura Village Council to establish a public park on state...
records.description: Nablus Directorate of Agriculture formalized a strategic partnership with the Naqoura Village Council to establish a public park on state-owned forest land. This agreement, signed under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, represents a shift toward a community-based natural resource management model. By transforming protected forest areas into regulated recreational spaces, the Nablus Directorate of Agriculture aims to curb haphazard land use and illegal encroachment while simultaneously boosting local development. The project is designed to balance the preservation of critical vegetation cover with the social and cultural needs of the community, ensuring that Nablus's natural heritage remains sustainable for future generations.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has officially launched the construction of a major strategic grain silo in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has officially launched the construction of a major strategic grain silo in the Wilaya of El-Meniaa, boasting a massive capacity of one million quintals. This project is a cornerstone of the national strategy to modernize the grain storage system and consolidate food security. By increasing the region's ability to absorb surplus production during harvest, the facility will ensure high-quality storage conditions and establish a stable strategic reserve. Additionally, the ministry inaugurated an intermediate collection center designed to streamline the logistics of receiving and transporting farmers' yields to processing units, supporting the rapid expansion of modern Saharan farming techniques and irrigated agriculture in the south.

records.title: To ensure food abundance and price stability during the holy month of Ramadan 2026, the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fi...
records.description: To ensure food abundance and price stability during the holy month of Ramadan 2026, the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has deployed a massive network of 390 direct sales points across Algeria. Under the direction of Miloud Triaa, Director General of Fisheries and Aquaculture, this initiative bypasses traditional middleman costs to offer regulated prices on high-demand species. A key player in this rollout is the National Office for Livestock Feed (ONAB), which is utilizing its distribution infrastructure to market farm-raised fish, particularly red tilapia, in both coastal and deep inland provinces such as Ouargla and Adrar.

records.title: The International Organization for Migration (IOM) and the UN Environment Programme (UNEP) officially handed over a major constructed wet...
records.description: The International Organization for Migration (IOM) and the UN Environment Programme (UNEP) officially handed over a major constructed wetland project to Iraqi national authorities in the heat-stressed Thi Qar region. Supported by the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (Sida), this sustainable nature-based solution treats up to 4,000 cubic meters of wastewater daily through natural sedimentation and reed-bed filtration, benefiting 30,000 residents. By preventing untreated sewage from entering fragile marshlands, the International Organization for Migration (IOM), UN Environment Programme (UNEP), and Iraq’s Ministry of Water Resources are addressing the dual crises of pollution and climate-induced displacement, providing a low-energy, scalable model for water management that preserves both biodiversity and local livelihoods.

records.title: The Ministry of Trade officially reopened Berth No.
records.description: The Ministry of Trade officially reopened Berth No. 10 at the Umm Qasr grain silo, marking the completion of extensive rehabilitation and maintenance works. As Iraq’s primary entry point for international wheat shipments, the berth’s return to full operational readiness is a critical step in securing the national food ration program and streamlining the supply chain for strategic grain reserves. Managed by the State Company for Grain Trading, the facility now operates at its full design capacity, enabling faster vessel unloading and reduced logistics costs. This restoration, supported by the highest levels of government, reinforces the Ministry of Trade’s role in safeguarding national food security and maximizing the efficiency of Iraq's maritime grain infrastructure.

records.title: The National Defense Administration issued an international call for bids (No.
records.description: The National Defense Administration issued an international call for bids (No. 01/ADN/ZS/2026) to procure 4,000 tons of frozen red meat for Royal Armed Forces units in the Southern Zone. This large-scale procurement is divided into 3,000 tons of frozen beef—exclusively reserved for Brazilian suppliers under existing bilateral health protocols—and 1,000 tons of frozen camel meat, with a combined estimated value of $18.4 million. Managed by the National Defense Administration, the contract mandates strict adherence to halal standards and specialized logistics, including 40-foot refrigerated containers and direct delivery to Agadir. This initiative follows a year of surging trade between Rabat and Brasília, which saw Moroccan beef imports from Brazil rise by over 300% in 2025 as part of broader efforts to stabilize domestic meat supply.

records.title: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) reported a historic surge in Tunisia's aquaculture sector, with approved private inve...
records.description: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) reported a historic surge in Tunisia's aquaculture sector, with approved private investments reaching $30.7 million (88.1 million dinars)—a threefold increase from the previous year. By 2030, the government aims to boost farmed output to 50,000 tonnes, focusing on modernizing offshore cages and land-based facilities for sea bass and sea bream. To ensure long-term profitability, the Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) and industry leaders are also pushing for regulatory reforms to allow more cost-effective aquafeeds, aiming to enhance the competitiveness of Tunisian seafood in high-value European and Asian markets.

records.title: Tunisia’s aquaculture investment reaches US$30.7M in 2025
records.description: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) reported a historic surge in Tunisia's aquaculture sector, with approved private investments reaching $30.7 million (88.1 million dinars)—a threefold increase from the previous year. This capital influx represents 17% of all private agricultural investment for 2025, signaling a decisive shift toward high-intensity fish farming to preserve overexploited marine resources. By 2030, the government aims to boost farmed output to 50,000 tonnes, focusing on modernizing offshore cages and land-based facilities for sea bass and sea bream. To ensure long-term profitability, the Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) and industry leaders are also pushing for regulatory reforms to allow more cost-effective aquafeeds, aiming to enhance the competitiveness of Tunisian seafood in high-value European and Asian markets.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Egypt is strategically scaling its national biogas initiatives to bolster the green economy by transforming agricultural and animal waste...
records.description: Egypt is strategically scaling its national biogas initiatives to bolster the green economy by transforming agricultural and animal waste into renewable energy and organic fertilizer. Under the governance of the Bioenergy for Sustainable Development Foundation, the state has implemented nearly 2,000 biogas units that generate approximately 2.1 million cubic metres of gas annually—offsetting the need for 70,000 LPG cylinders—while processing tens of thousands of tonnes of waste. These projects, which include planned expansions in Upper Egypt, Wadi El-Natrun, and key slaughterhouse facilities, are designed to enhance resource efficiency, support thousands of acres of farmland with organic inputs, and foster rural entrepreneurship through the establishment of dozens of bioenergy start-ups.

records.title: Food security has been elevated to a top national security priority for Egypt, prompting the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation...
records.description: Food security has been elevated to a top national security priority for Egypt, prompting the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation to initiate a comprehensive strategy for the optimal utilization of all agricultural land and underutilized assets. The institution is focusing on reactivating stalled projects through strict implementation timelines, modernizing mechanized farming systems, and enhancing the role of applied research to develop climate-resilient, high-productivity crop varieties. To protect the domestic market and support the national economy, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation is expanding direct-to-consumer food outlets to eliminate intermediaries, enforcing a "red line" policy against agricultural land encroachment, and prioritizing the expansion of organic farming to boost the global competitiveness of exports and increase foreign currency revenues.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) and Italian trade officials held a high-level summit in Cairo to accelerate the return of Egypt...
records.description: The National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) and Italian trade officials held a high-level summit in Cairo to accelerate the return of Egyptian seafood to European tables. Following the 2024 lifting of a three-year EU export suspension, Egypt is now moving to recapture a market that once saw Italy consuming 38% of its total European fish exports. By aligning health regulations, streamlining facility approvals, and digitizing inspection processes, the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA) aims to help domestic producers tap into the EU's massive $48 billion seafood market. This strategy is a critical effort to restore Egypt's pre-2021 market share and establish its fishery products as high-value, compliant staples in Italian and broader Mediterranean markets.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture achieved a major milestone in regional trade by successfully exporting 1,000 tons of tomatoes to Kuwait throu...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture achieved a major milestone in regional trade by successfully exporting 1,000 tons of tomatoes to Kuwait through the Safwan border crossing. This shipment serves as a practical demonstration of Iraq's reaching a state of agricultural surplus, transitioning from a focus on domestic self-sufficiency to becoming an active regional exporter. By utilizing a strategic "agricultural calendar" to protect local produce and opening international marketing channels, the Ministry of Agriculture is ensuring long-term profitability for Iraqi farmers and demonstrating the robust health of the current harvest season.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The National Team for Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency Projects announced the allocation of 140 sites across various governorates f...
records.description: The National Team for Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency Projects announced the allocation of 140 sites across various governorates for the construction of investment-oriented solar power plants. Approved by the cabinet, these projects are strategically located in non-agricultural areas near power load centers, including regions surrounding Baghdad such as Al-Nahrawan, Al-Taji, and Al-Husayniyah, to ensure efficient distribution through 11 kV lines. The National Team for Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency Projects highlighted that these plants will utilize giant battery storage systems to support the national grid both day and night, producing electricity at approximately one-third of the cost of conventional thermal generation.
records.institution: The National Team for Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency Projects

records.title: The Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation finalized a significant $116 million financing package with the World Bank to bols...
records.description: The Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation finalized a significant $116 million financing package with the World Bank to bolster the Jordan Agriculture Resilience, Value Chain Development and Innovation (ARDI) program. This funding—a strategic mix of loans from the IBRD, grants from the Global Concessional Financing Facility (GCFF), and a targeted PROSPECT fund grant from the Dutch government—is dedicated to transforming Jordan's agricultural sector into a climate-smart, high-value industry. Fully implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture, the ARDI program integrates water-saving technologies, digital veterinary services, and export-focused infrastructure to ensure the Kingdom’s food systems remain resilient in the face of regional water scarcity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources officially broke ground on a massive white-legged shrimp aquaculture project i...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources officially broke ground on a massive white-legged shrimp aquaculture project in the Wilayat of Shinas, North Al Batinah. With a substantial investment of RO 23.5 million (approx. $61 million), this 15-hectare facility is engineered to produce 7,500 tonnes of shrimp annually. This project is a cornerstone of Oman Vision 2040, aimed at transforming the Sultanate into a regional aquaculture powerhouse while reducing economic reliance on oil and gas. By integrating high-tech hatcheries and automated water management, the facility will serve as a technical hub for localizing modern biosecurity standards and boosting the national food security index.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (URAP) in Nabeul has formally rejected the government's decision to maintain price caps o...
records.description: The Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (URAP) in Nabeul has formally rejected the government's decision to maintain price caps on agricultural products, particularly oranges, arguing that the measure threatens the survival of the sector. The institution contends that the maximum prices set by the Ministry of Commerce—ranging from 1,500 to 2,500 millimes per kilo depending on the variety—fall significantly below current production costs and fail to account for the devastating impact of recent floods on crop yields. According to the Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (URAP), enforcing these price ceilings without addressing the soaring costs of essential inputs risks forcing producers out of business, especially during high-demand periods like the month of Ramadan. The organization has criticized the lack of consultation with stakeholders and is calling for a balanced approach that respects market dynamics and the economic realities faced by farmers in the Nabeul region.
records.institution: The Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (URAP)

records.title: The Netherlands Embassy in Cairo and the Netherlands Food Partnership released the final Salinity Roadmap Egypt 2035, a strategic report...
records.description: The Netherlands Embassy in Cairo and the Netherlands Food Partnership released the final Salinity Roadmap Egypt 2035, a strategic report detailing the critical threat soil salinity poses to national food security. Prepared by Dutch firms Delphy and The Salt Doctors, the study reveals that salinity currently affects 30–35% of Egypt’s irrigated land (over 1.8 million hectares), causing crop yield losses of up to 40%. The report provides a structured framework for Dutch-Egyptian collaboration to modernize drainage and irrigation, with the goal of protecting the livelihoods of the one-fifth of the Egyptian workforce employed in agriculture.

records.title: The Erbil Governorate, in strategic partnership with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), has launched the first phase of a...
records.description: The Erbil Governorate, in strategic partnership with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), has launched the first phase of a wastewater recycling project valued at $288 million to modernize the city's sewage network. This initiative, which spans 75 kilometers, represents the largest environmental infrastructure project in the capital of the Kurdistan Region and focuses on treating domestic wastewater for the irrigation of parks and green spaces. By preventing wastewater from contaminating groundwater and the Greater Zab River, the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) and local authorities aim to reduce environmental pollution and expand urban green areas. A second phase, valued at $300 million, is planned to follow the initial stage, further strengthening the coordination between the Erbil Governorate and international partners to enhance public service sectors and water sanitation.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture reached a historic milestone as its Seed Testing and Certification Department laboratories secured firs...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture reached a historic milestone as its Seed Testing and Certification Department laboratories secured first place globally (Grade A) in the International Seed Testing Association (ISTA) proficiency tests for rice. Competing against 205 accredited laboratories from 78 countries during the second cycle of 2025, the Iraqi technical staff achieved top marks in critical areas of purity, germination, and seed weight. This achievement signals a major leap in Iraq’s laboratory precision and quality control systems, positioning the nation as a global leader in seed health and agricultural trade standards.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Forestry and Combating Desertification, participated in the ratification of Iraq's...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Forestry and Combating Desertification, participated in the ratification of Iraq's Seventh National Report on Biodiversity. Developed in accordance with the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) and supported by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the Global Environment Facility (GEF), this document serves as the primary scientific record of Iraq's ecological health. The report outlines a strategic roadmap for species conservation and ecosystem protection, documenting national achievements while identifying critical gaps in the management of natural resources. By aligning the efforts of the Ministries of Environment, Agriculture, and Water Resources, the report provides decision-makers with a practical tool to develop climate-resilient policies and fulfill Iraq's international environmental obligations.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture took a significant step toward industrializing Jordan's food sector by signing support agreements for two inn...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture took a significant step toward industrializing Jordan's food sector by signing support agreements for two innovative factories. Led by Minister Saeb Khraisat, these agreements focus on "High-Value Industries" within the Economic Modernization Vision (EMV).
