By utilizing advanced technologies like freeze-drying and organic waste recycling, the ministry aims to convert local agricultural output into high-value exports and nutritious animal fodder, simultaneously creating jobs in Mafraq and Al Muwaqqar while bolstering national food security.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN), in collaboration with the German Agency for International Cooperation (GIZ) an...
records.description: The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN), in collaboration with the German Agency for International Cooperation (GIZ) and the League of Arab States, launched a high-level training program in Cairo focused on integrating Nature-Based Solutions (NbS) into regional development planning. Attended by representatives from across the Arab world—including the Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture—the initiative aims to standardize the application of the IUCN Global Standard for ecosystem protection and climate resilience. Through interactive workshops and a field visit to the Wadi El-Rayan and Lake Qarun reserves in Fayoum, the program facilitated a strategic shift toward innovative development models that balance environmental preservation with economic growth.
records.institution: The International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN)

records.title: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources launched a major investment drive in the Buraimi Governorate, unveiling 20 diverse...
records.description: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources launched a major investment drive in the Buraimi Governorate, unveiling 20 diverse opportunities via the Tatwir platform. Spanning approximately 798.3 feddans, these projects are designed to localize food production and integrate advanced "Agri-Tech" into Oman's desert landscapes. By focusing on high-demand staples like onions and garlic alongside livestock fattening and veterinary services, the ministry aims to transform Buraimi into a high-efficiency agricultural hub that aligns with the Sultanate’s broader economic diversification and food security goals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), formalized a new batc...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), formalized a new batch of 13 investment support agreements under the MAP II program. With total investments reaching nearly 3.9 million shekels, the initiative targets the northern West Bank governorates of Jenin, Nablus, Tulkarm, Tubas, and Qalqilya. By providing non-refundable grants that cover 45% of project costs, the program aims to modernize plant and animal production and food processing, transforming agriculture into a resilient, market-oriented system that strengthens Palestinian identity and economic sovereignty.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Central Acceptance Committee, conducted a series of strategic field audits in northern Hebron to...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Central Acceptance Committee, conducted a series of strategic field audits in northern Hebron to monitor and officially accept projects under the EU-funded Agricultural Assistance Program. These visits—covering the municipalities of Beit Ummar, Kharas, Beit Ula, and Sa'ir—ensure that critical infrastructure, ranging from renewable energy for irrigation to livestock livestock expansion, meets the high technical standards required for sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) launched a national awareness campaign titled "Our Land's Bounty" (Khair Ardhin...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) launched a national awareness campaign titled "Our Land's Bounty" (Khair Ardhina) to coincide with the approach of Ramadan. This strategic initiative aims to pivot consumer behavior toward domestic agricultural products and their processed derivatives, directly supporting Saudi farmers and enhancing the Kingdom's self-sufficiency. By promoting high-quality local content such as dates, red meat, and olive oil, the campaign reinforces the goals of Saudi Vision 2030 to build a resilient, sustainable agricultural sector that reduces the carbon footprint associated with food imports and ensures food security during periods of peak seasonal demand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation formalized a strategic partnership with the Agricultural Research Corporation (ARC) and DAL Co...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation formalized a strategic partnership with the Agricultural Research Corporation (ARC) and DAL Company to indigenize and scale cotton seed production. This public-private research alliance focuses on producing pure foundation seeds to eliminate import reliance and ensure high resistance to pests and diseases. By integrating scientific research with industrial value chains, the Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation, the Agricultural Research Corporation (ARC), and their private sector partners aim to elevate the global competitiveness of Sudanese cotton, boost national productivity, and stabilize farmer incomes through sustainable, high-quality local supply.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Abu Dhabi-based Global South Utilities (GSU) inaugurated a 5 MWp grid-connected solar PV plant in Berbera and launched the Green Berbera...
records.description: Abu Dhabi-based Global South Utilities (GSU) inaugurated a 5 MWp grid-connected solar PV plant in Berbera and launched the Green Berbera Vision, a strategic roadmap to transition the city’s utility system from diesel dependence to renewable-powered generation. Through its 45% ownership in the Berbera Electric Company (BEC), Global South Utilities (GSU) is positioning the strategic port city as a regional hub for clean energy in the Horn of Africa, utilizing solar PV as the primary daytime source supported by battery energy storage systems (BESS). The project, which includes 11.2 km of transmission lines and generates 10,000 MWh annually, aligns with Somaliland’s National Electrification and Energy Sector Strategy to provide reliable power to 28,000 households while avoiding nearly 6,890 metric tonnes of carbon emissions. By 2027, the Berbera Electric Company (BEC) plans to double its renewable capacity, establishing a model for East African port cities to strengthen economic resilience through cost-stable, sustainable energy.

records.title: Gheras Agricultural Company is advancing an integrated agricultural model in Sharjah designed to revolutionize sustainable food security...
records.description: Gheras Agricultural Company is advancing an integrated agricultural model in Sharjah designed to revolutionize sustainable food security in arid environments. Strategically located in Al Dhaid to leverage the region's farming heritage and proximity to academic institutions, the 32-hectare project combines innovative Emirati-developed techniques with smart technologies. A centerpiece of the facility is a unique positive-air-pressure cooling system that utilizes solar energy to reduce water and power consumption by 70%, allowing for the direct use of well water without desalination. With a diverse production profile including organic blueberries, citrus, and a honey factory capable of producing 120 tonnes annually, Gheras Agricultural Company is bridging the gap between historical seed preservation and modern, research-based farming.

records.title: The Bonyan Development Foundation, in partnership with the Sharab Al-Salam Association, concluded a specialized four-week animal health t...
records.description: The Bonyan Development Foundation, in partnership with the Sharab Al-Salam Association, concluded a specialized four-week animal health training program in Taiz Governorate. This initiative, supported by the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects Financing Unit, successfully trained 27 female specialists to serve as the "first line of defense" for Yemen’s livestock resources. By equipping rural women with advanced veterinary and epidemiological skills, the program addresses the critical intersection of animal health, community resilience, and national food security.

records.title: Egypt is experiencing a sharp seasonal rise in poultry prices driven by strengthening consumer demand in the run-up to the holy month of...
records.description: Egypt is experiencing a sharp seasonal rise in poultry prices driven by strengthening consumer demand in the run-up to the holy month of Ramadan. While domestic production saw significant gains in 2025—with broiler output reaching 1.6 billion birds—retail prices for fresh white poultry have climbed to approximately US$1.80 per kilogram, a notable increase from December levels. To mitigate the impact on household budgets and address regional price disparities, the Egyptian government has announced plans to expand imports of frozen poultry, primarily from established partners like Brazil, to be sold at controlled prices of around US$2 per kilogram through state outlets.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: European Commission announced a EUR 124.3 million (USD 147m) funding package to accelerate Egypt’s transition toward a sustainable energy...
records.description: European Commission announced a EUR 124.3 million (USD 147m) funding package to accelerate Egypt’s transition toward a sustainable energy economy. Unveiled during a high-level conference in Cairo, this investment is a critical component of the Trans-Mediterranean Renewable Energy and Clean-Tech Cooperation (T-MED) initiative. By focusing on both structural grid upgrades and innovative green fuel production, the funding directly supports Egypt’s strategic goal of integrating 22 GW of clean energy into the national network by 2030, while positioning the country as a regional hub for green hydrogen and ammonia manufacturing.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture announced a strategic suspension of live sheep exports to neighboring countries to prioritize national food s...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture announced a strategic suspension of live sheep exports to neighboring countries to prioritize national food security. This decision is specifically timed ahead of the holy month of Ramadan to ensure a consistent supply of red meat, maintain price stability, and protect consumer purchasing power during a period of peak demand. To further bolster the domestic market, the Ministry of Agriculture has diversified its supply chains by opening new import channels for live sheep and calves. Additionally, it has expanded the list of accredited international slaughterhouses, ensuring that all imported meat meets rigorous health and veterinary standards while securing an adequate and safe supply for the local population.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its specialized Green Project initiative and in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organizati...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its specialized Green Project initiative and in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), signed new support agreements with 66 farmers across the Nabatieh, North Bekaa, and West Bekaa governorates. This programmatic phase focuses on fortifying Lebanon's agricultural infrastructure against climate volatility by financing the construction of advanced concrete reservoirs for water management and stone retaining walls to combat soil erosion. By specifically targeting 33 beneficiaries in Nabatieh, 25 in North Bekaa, and 8 in West Bekaa, the Ministry of Agriculture and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) aim to boost rural incomes and production quality, transitioning local communities from emergency reliance toward sustainable food stability and economic resilience.

records.title: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG (OFM) has signed a share purchase agreement to increase its stake in the Arabian Food Production Company SA...
records.description: Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG (OFM) has signed a share purchase agreement to increase its stake in the Arabian Food Production Company SAOC to 66.67%, securing majority control through its subsidiary, Atyab Investments LLC. By acquiring an additional stake from Gulf Japan Poultry Farm, the company aims to strengthen vertical integration across the food value chain, from milling to specialized bakery mixes and poultry feeds. This strategic move, supported by Oman Food Capital and the Oman Investment Authority, aligns with national food security objectives by enhancing local production resilience and streamlining operations. Through its diverse portfolio, including Oman-Australia Limited for grain sourcing and Atyab International Services for quality assurance, Oman Flour Mills Company SAOG (OFM) continues to expand its manufacturing ecosystem to ensure reliable access to essential commodities and improve market competitiveness.

records.title: Thde Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources officially inaugurated the Al Bashayer Veterinary Hospital in the Wilayat of...
records.description: Thde Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources officially inaugurated the Al Bashayer Veterinary Hospital in the Wilayat of Adam, Al Dakhiliyah Governorate. This OMR 2 million facility represents a strategic milestone in Oman’s animal health infrastructure, particularly as a model for public-private partnership (PPP). Operated by Al-Khairat Veterinary Medical Services Company, the hospital is specifically designed to support the Sultanate’s livestock sector, which comprises approximately four million heads. With a specialized focus on camels—which hold immense social and economic value—the hospital integrates advanced surgical and reproductive technologies to enhance the productivity and health of national herds.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Al-Quds Open University and the National Agricultural Research Center (NARC) convened a high-level scientific workshop in Qabatiya, Jenin...
records.description: Al-Quds Open University and the National Agricultural Research Center (NARC) convened a high-level scientific workshop in Qabatiya, Jenin, to advance the "BreadTech" project. Funded by the Erasmus+ program, the initiative focuses on the practical application of biotechnology—such as CRISPR gene editing and Gene Silencing Spray Technology (SIGS)—to enhance the resilience and productivity of strategic Palestinian crops like chickpeas and sesame. By serving as the research arm of the Ministry of Agriculture, the National Agricultural Research Center (NARC) is leveraging this academic partnership to bridge the gap between laboratory innovation and field-level implementation. The workshop concluded with a call for robust national biosafety frameworks and the adoption of environmentally friendly technologies to secure food stability in the face of evolving agricultural challenges.
records.institution: Al-Quds Open University and the National Agricultural Research Center (NARC)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, launched a specialized exchange farmin...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, launched a specialized exchange farming and training initiative to address the critical water challenges in the Beit Dajan, Tayasir, and Aqaba areas. Held at the Tubas Sports Club, the program focused on the sustainable management of non-conventional water resources, specifically reviewing wastewater sterilization mechanisms and the optimization of collection wells. By integrating modern technologies to reduce soil salinity and improve irrigation efficiency, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to strengthen the resilience of Palestinian farmers while maintaining rigorous safety and environmental standards.

records.title: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially launched the Namaa Endowment Fund, a pioneering institutional model desi...
records.description: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially launched the Namaa Endowment Fund, a pioneering institutional model designed to secure the long-term sustainability of the non-profit sector within the Kingdom’s environmental framework. In collaboration with the General Authority for Awqaf, the Capital Market Authority, and SNB Capital, the fund seeks to enhance the non-profit sector's contribution to the national GDP in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. With an initial SAR 100 million contribution from the General Authority for Awqaf, the fund will utilize modern investment tools to finance charitable initiatives and support organizations like the Reef National Foundation, the Vegetation Cover Development Foundation, and the Sekaya Charitable Foundation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) announced the second Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition (EmiratesACE)...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) announced the second Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition (EmiratesACE) in Al Ain, a strategic move to bolster sustainable food security. The event integrates the entire food value chain, focusing on empowering local farmers and livestock owners while fostering partnerships with national food companies. By prioritizing agricultural innovation among youth and women, the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) aims to transform local agriculture into a technology-driven driver of national growth. The platform will feature a specialized knowledge conference, an international pavilion for policy dialogue, and a farmers' market, all designed to advance the UAE's position as a global hub for smart agricultural technologies and resilient food systems.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, intensified its national campaign to curb overfishing and preser...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, intensified its national campaign to curb overfishing and preserve aquatic biodiversity. Operating under the framework of Law No. 48 of 1976, the Ministry has formally coordinated with the Ministry of Interior to enforce strict legal measures against violators using prohibited fishing methods. This escalation follows a strategic directive issued in late January 2026, aimed at strengthening field monitoring across all national water bodies. By tightening the enforcement of aquatic life regulations, the Ministry seeks to halt the depletion of fish stocks, maintain ecological balance, and secure the sustainability of water resources for future generations.

records.title: Morocco and Mauritania finalized a strategic roadmap in Rabat to transition their long-standing agricultural partnership into a high-leve...
records.description: Morocco and Mauritania finalized a strategic roadmap in Rabat to transition their long-standing agricultural partnership into a high-level economic and technical integration. Driven by the Moroccan-Mauritanian Parliamentary Economic Forum, the new phase focuses on facilitating the cross-border movement of goods—particularly through the El Guerguarat border post—to reduce trade deficits and establish Morocco as a gateway for Mauritanian products to reach European markets. This "South-South" cooperation model is further supported by a massive educational expansion, including the establishment of an agricultural engineering school in Kaédi and a veterinary school in Néma, both backed by the Islamic Development Bank.

records.title: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM) significantly expanded its footprint in the Sultanate's food manufacturing sector by signing a share purch...
records.description: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM) significantly expanded its footprint in the Sultanate's food manufacturing sector by signing a share purchase agreement to acquire a controlling interest in the Arabian Food Production Company. Through its subsidiary, Atyab Investments, the group will increase its stake from 33.33% to 66.67% by acquiring the shareholding previously held by Gulf Japan Poultry Farm. This acquisition is a strategic move toward vertical integration within the newly formed Oman Food Capital—the powerhouse created by the merger of Nitaj and Fisheries Development Oman. By securing a majority stake, Oman Flour Mills aims to deepen operational coordination, enhance domestic production capacity, and further stabilize the national food value chain in line with Oman's long-term security objectives.

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in the Al Buraimi Governorate announced 20 new investment opportunities for ag...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in the Al Buraimi Governorate announced 20 new investment opportunities for agricultural and livestock projects via the "Tatweer" platform. This initiative, covering a total area of 798.3 acres, is a strategic move to localise food investments and achieve long-term food sustainability within the governorate's wilayats. The projects focus on high-demand commodities such as onions, potatoes, and garlic using modern agricultural technologies, as well as the expansion of date palm cultivation and sheep and goat fattening. By offering specialized projects like fodder processing and a dedicated veterinary clinic, the Directorate aims to build a comprehensive and resilient agricultural ecosystem that supports both large-scale investors and small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs).
records.institution: The Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources

records.title: A specialized committee held a workshop in the Jericho and Jordan Valley Governorate to discuss critical amendments to the technical regu...
records.description: A specialized committee held a workshop in the Jericho and Jordan Valley Governorate to discuss critical amendments to the technical regulations concerning pesticide residues in dates. This initiative, supported by the Governorate of Jericho and the Jordan Valley and the General Directorate of Plant Protection and Agricultural Quarantine, is designed to align Palestinian date production with the highest international safety and quality standards. By bringing together agricultural marketing experts, legal units, and private sector representatives, the committee aims to strengthen the competitiveness of Palestinian dates in global markets while ensuring absolute consumer safety through a transparent and participatory regulatory process.
records.institution: The Governorate of Jericho and the Jordan Valley and the General Directorate of Plant Protection and Agricultural Quarantine

records.title: The North Hebron Agriculture Directorate and the Agricultural Relief organization launched a specialized training initiative at the Al-Ar...
records.description: The North Hebron Agriculture Directorate and the Agricultural Relief organization launched a specialized training initiative at the Al-Arroub Agricultural Station to boost the climate resilience of Palestinian viticulture. Focused on thirty farmers from Beit Ummar, the practical program integrated advanced pruning techniques with integrated pest management (IPM) strategies to safeguard vineyards against increasing environmental stressors. By aligning field-level training with the Ministry of Agriculture’s broader goals of enhancing livelihood security and production quality, the initiative ensures that the grape sector remains a robust pillar of the regional agricultural economy.

records.title: Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture launched a targeted initiative to establish the first economically viable carob plots in t...
records.description: Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture launched a targeted initiative to establish the first economically viable carob plots in the town of Kafr Abboush. By providing 100 high-quality carob saplings to the municipal council, the Ministry of Agriculture is pivoting toward "climate-smart" crops that require minimal water and tolerate increasing aridity. This collaborative project, involving local schools and agricultural associations, is designed not only to diversify the governorate's agricultural output but also to foster a spirit of environmental initiative among the youth.
records.institution: The Tulkarm Governorate Directorate of Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Energy in Damascus signed a landmark agreement with Dubai-based Marv Energy to develop a 700-MW wind farm project.
records.description: The Ministry of Energy in Damascus signed a landmark agreement with Dubai-based Marv Energy to develop a 700-MW wind farm project. This strategic initiative involves the installation of 140 wind turbines, which will be locally manufactured at the company's factory in Homs. The project, designed to be implemented in phases over a period of five to seven years, aims to significantly enhance Syria's power generation capacity and stabilize the national electricity grid. This deal follows a series of high-capacity renewable energy agreements, including a 1-GW solar plant partnership with UCC Holding, marking a decisive shift toward sustainable energy to address the country's persistent electricity shortages.

records.title: The Ministry of Commerce reporting a significant rise in export value and volume.
records.description: The Ministry of Commerce reporting a significant rise in export value and volume. In mid-February 2026, the Export Promotion Center (CEPEX) and the National Oil Office (ONH) highlighted a strategic pivot toward high-value bottled and organic oils, moving away from bulk exports to capture higher-margin markets. This growth is evidenced by a 47% increase in exported quantities during the start of the season, including a 30% rise in packaged olive oil. Beyond traditional European routes, Tunisia has seen a surge in demand from regional partners like Jordan, where domestic production has been severely impacted by drought. With a projected export growth of 4.6% for 2026, the Ministry of Commerce is integrating agri-food investments with climate-resilient farming practices to ensure the long-term sustainability and global competitiveness of the sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Extension and Training, launched a national functional training cours...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Extension and Training, launched a national functional training course in Basra focused on "Employing Digital Technologies to Improve Field Crop Management." Organized in cooperation with the Regional Center for Agrarian Reform and Rural Development in the Near East (CARDNE), the initiative aims to build the technical capacity of extension staff to address Iraq's escalating climate challenges. The curriculum integrates theoretical and practical sessions on Artificial Intelligence (AI) for crop monitoring and digital farm management, alongside field demonstrations of Smart Irrigation and precision fertilization. By strengthening international cooperation and adopting data-driven techniques, the Ministry of Agriculture seeks to increase production efficiency and ensure long-term agricultural sustainability in the face of changing climate conditions.

records.domain: Sanitary, phytosanitary and technical standards improvements
records.title: The Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate successfully completed rigorous quality and safety inspections for 72 agricultural...
records.description: The Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate successfully completed rigorous quality and safety inspections for 72 agricultural shipments of Palestinian dates destined for the Turkish market. Under the Ministry of Agriculture's approved technical control system, representative samples were analyzed in accredited laboratories to verify compliance with international health and technical standards. These procedures are a core part of the Ministry's strategy to strengthen governance in the date sector, ensuring that all packing houses and production sites adhere to high-level monitoring protocols. By regulating these export operations, the Ministry aims to consolidate the global reputation of national dates, enhance their competitiveness, and increase international consumer confidence in Palestinian agricultural products.
records.institution: The Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate

records.title: The Al-Ahsa Agricultural Development Association, with the strategic support of the National Center for Palms and Dates, signed a landmar...
records.description: The Al-Ahsa Agricultural Development Association, with the strategic support of the National Center for Palms and Dates, signed a landmark agricultural cooperation memorandum with LOTTE International to expand the global footprint of Saudi date products. This partnership focuses on strengthening innovation in value-added production, facilitating knowledge transfer, and developing high-quality processed date products tailored for international retail markets. By leveraging a global distribution network of over 13,000 stores, the initiative seeks to enhance the competitiveness of national products and increase the agricultural sector’s contribution to the Kingdom’s GDP, directly supporting the industrial and food security objectives of Saudi Vision 2030. This collaboration represents a significant step in the national strategy to modernize the date and palm sector, transforming it into a technology-driven industry capable of securing long-term strategic investment partnerships and sustainable global market access.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, with funding from the Governorate’s Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, with funding from the Governorate’s Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit. The initiative, implemented by the General Corporation for Improved Seed Multiplication, focuses on restoring cotton’s historic role as a vital cash crop to support the national economy and achieve industrial self-sufficiency. By providing high-yield improved seeds and technical guidance, the General Corporation for Improved Seed Multiplication aims to enhance productivity and quality, directly feeding the raw material needs of the Spinning and Textile Corporation. This collaborative effort between regional authorities and the Projects Financing Unit is designed to integrate the agricultural and industrial sectors, create local jobs, and improve the income levels of farming households through sustainable and profitable production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Two specialized training courses concluded in the Ibb Governorate focused on Community Agricultural Extension and Participatory Rapid App...
records.description: Two specialized training courses concluded in the Ibb Governorate focused on Community Agricultural Extension and Participatory Rapid Appraisal (PRA) methodology. Funded by the Agricultural Financing, Projects, and Initiatives Unit, the program successfully qualified 68 researchers and extension workers from eight local cooperative associations. The curriculum was designed to shift agricultural development toward a "bottom-up" approach, enabling cadres to diagnose field problems and develop solutions in direct coordination with local communities. By mastering participatory planning and field data analysis, these trainees are now equipped to align official research with the actual needs of farmers, thereby supporting the governorate's strategic goal of achieving productive self-sufficiency.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries, through the General Directorate of Forests (DGF), has launched its most amb...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries, through the General Directorate of Forests (DGF), has launched its most ambitious reforestation project to date: the "Khadra bi idni Allah" (Green by the Will of God) campaign. Building on the momentum of the 1.4 million trees planted in late 2025, this nationwide initiative aims to plant 5 million seedlings in a single day across all 58 wilayas. The campaign is a multi-sectoral effort involving the military, private companies, and civil society, emphasizing a strategic mix of 71% forest, 26% fruit, and 3% ornamental trees. A key highlight of the project is the planting of 100,000 argan trees, a move designed to protect biodiversity and tap into the high ecological and economic value of this resilient species.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: Lemon farmers in the Qalqilya Governorate officially commenced their harvest for export to the United Arab Emirates, facilitated by the J...
records.description: Lemon farmers in the Qalqilya Governorate officially commenced their harvest for export to the United Arab Emirates, facilitated by the Jordanian-Palestinian Company for Marketing Agricultural Products. This strategic export operation, conducted under the direct supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, is designed to integrate high-quality Palestinian citrus into regional value chains and secure premium prices for local growers. To ensure market competitiveness, teams from the Qalqilya Agriculture Directorate are providing on-ground oversight for sorting, grading, and packaging, ensuring all shipments meet the rigorous health and technical standards required for the UAE market. By opening these new marketing channels, the Ministry aims to revitalize the governorate’s agricultural economy, create seasonal employment, and strengthen the long-term resilience of farmers through diversified income streams.

records.title: With Ramadan approaching, the Tunisian red meat market is facing a sharp divide between state-led stabilization efforts and professional...
records.description: With Ramadan approaching, the Tunisian red meat market is facing a sharp divide between state-led stabilization efforts and professional warnings of a price crisis. The state-owned Ellouhoum Company has launched an initiative to offer locally sourced red meat at a regulated price of 42.900 dinars per kg at its El-Ouardia outlet to protect consumer purchasing power. Conversely, the National Chamber of Butchers (UTICA) has issued an urgent appeal to the presidency, warning that a 35% shortfall in chilled meat imports compared to last year could drive market prices above 70 dinars per kg during the holy month. Professionals are advocating for emergency import authorizations through private or state channels to bridge the supply gap and curb "exorbitant" price surges already being recorded in various regions.
records.institution: Ellouhoum Company, National Chamber of Butchers (UTICA)

records.title: The Loukkos Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVAL) launched an emergency relief operation in Ksar El Kébir to support live...
records.description: The Loukkos Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVAL) launched an emergency relief operation in Ksar El Kébir to support livestock farmers affected by recent severe flooding. Part of a broader plan by the Regional Directorate of Agriculture of Tangier-Tetouan-Al Hoceima, the initiative involves the distribution of 3,750 quintals of compound livestock feed to approximately 600 farmers. To ensure efficient logistics, 90.2 tons of fodder have already been delivered to five local milk collection and marketing cooperatives in the municipalities of Souaken, Oulad Ouchih, and Souk Tolba. This free distribution aims to safeguard animal health and maintain milk production levels while rural infrastructure and grazing lands recover from record-breaking seasonal rainfall.
records.institution: The Loukkos Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVAL)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The International Agricultural Exhibition (AgriteQ 2026) was launched in Doha at Katara Cultural Village, bringing together over 520 exhi...
records.description: The International Agricultural Exhibition (AgriteQ 2026) was launched in Doha at Katara Cultural Village, bringing together over 520 exhibitors from 41 countries to promote sustainable agriculture and food security. The event highlights Qatar’s commitment to its National Food Security Strategy (2024–2030), focusing on increasing self-sufficiency, expanding local production, and strengthening resilient food systems. It serves as a platform for decision-makers, investors, and farmers to exchange knowledge, showcase advanced agricultural technologies, and build partnerships. Qatar has achieved high self-sufficiency levels in key products such as dairy and poultry and continues to enhance its agricultural competitiveness. The exhibition also features workshops, innovative farming solutions, and a new Sustainable Agricultural Production Award to encourage sustainability and innovation in the sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture reached a significant milestone in its national vaccination campaign against Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), wh...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture reached a significant milestone in its national vaccination campaign against Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), which has been active since late December 2025. This initiative is a cornerstone of the national strategy to safeguard the livestock sector from epidemic threats and ensure long-term food security. By the 55th day of the campaign, the Veterinary Department successfully completed the first dose for the national cattle population, covering over 43,000 head, while the rollout for sheep and goats surpassed 118,000 total vaccinations. The transition to the second dose is currently underway to ensure high-level immunity across thousands of farms, reflecting a high degree of coordination between state veterinary teams and local livestock breeders.

records.title: Officials from the Ministry of Agriculture and the Hodeidah Governorate officially launched the cotton marketing season at the Hodeidah g...
records.description: Officials from the Ministry of Agriculture and the Hodeidah Governorate officially launched the cotton marketing season at the Hodeidah ginning factory. The first batches crop were received from agricultural cooperatives in the Tihama plain, a region historically vital for long-staple cotton production. In coordination with the General Corporation for Textile and Spinning Industry, the initiative aims to revitalize the national textile value chain by providing farmers with a reliable cash crop and prompt payment systems. By focusing on quality control and improved harvesting techniques, the Ministry seeks to reduce dependence on imported fibers and strengthen the "community economy" through self-sufficiency in industrial raw materials.

records.title: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) finalized two industrial contracts for the Sokhna Industrial Zone totaling $13 million (EGP 609 mil...
records.description: The Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) finalized two industrial contracts for the Sokhna Industrial Zone totaling $13 million (EGP 609 million) to strengthen the national food and agricultural supply chains. The first project, an $11 million facility for Al-Atta Group for Food and Mining Industries, will occupy 17,000 square meters and is designed to produce 10,000 tonnes of packaged grains annually by 2027. The second agreement, a $2 million investment with Grass Egypt, focuses on the manufacturing of fertilizers, soil conditioners, and agricultural pesticides on a 15,000-square-meter site. These initiatives, overseen by the Main Development Company (MDC), aim to localize essential industries, substitute imported agricultural inputs, and enhance the competitiveness of Egyptian products in both domestic and international markets.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture announced an immediate and indefinite ban on the import of green onions through all border crossings.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture announced an immediate and indefinite ban on the import of green onions through all border crossings. This protectionist measure was triggered by a significant surplus in local production, ensuring that the domestic market is not oversaturated by foreign imports during the peak harvest season. Aligned with the national policy of supporting local farmers and safeguarding the agricultural economy, the Ministry of Agriculture has authorized strict enforcement protocols. These include the seizure of unauthorized imported crops and the pursuit of legal action against distributors found selling non-local green onions in markets, in accordance with applicable agricultural protection laws and regulations.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, led by the Department of Forests and Combating Desertification, reaffirmed its commitment to the MURUNA Resi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, led by the Department of Forests and Combating Desertification, reaffirmed its commitment to the MURUNA Resilience Project. This international initiative is designed to fortify the agricultural sector against the dual threats of climate change and water scarcity. Funded by the Canadian government and implemented in partnership with the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) and the World Food Programme (WFP), the project focuses on the large-scale adoption of climate-smart farming techniques. Key interventions include the transition to modern irrigation systems and the introduction of specialized crop varieties engineered for drought and salinity tolerance. By integrating these "biosaline" solutions, the project seeks to revitalize degraded lands, enhance production efficiency, and secure sustainable livelihoods for farmers in affected regions.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Akkar Agricultural Department, organized a specialized educational seminar on "Sustainable Fishi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Akkar Agricultural Department, organized a specialized educational seminar on "Sustainable Fishing" as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. The session focused on equipping local fishermen with scientific principles and modern techniques to reduce overfishing and preserve marine biodiversity. This initiative aligns with Lebanon's broader National Agriculture Strategy (2026–2035), which prioritizes the protection of fish stocks and the restoration of marine ecosystems as fundamental pillars of national food security. By promoting professional best practices and strengthening community partnerships, the Ministry aims to ensure the long-term viability of the fisheries sector and maintain the ecological balance for future generations.

records.title: A high-level coordinated intervention was launched in the Sidi Kacem province, specifically the municipality of Al Haouafate, to safeguar...
records.description: A high-level coordinated intervention was launched in the Sidi Kacem province, specifically the municipality of Al Haouafate, to safeguard livestock health following severe flooding of the Sebou River. Led by the National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA) in coordination with Civil Protection and local authorities, veterinary teams were deployed to flooded zones to diagnose and treat cattle and sheep affected by stress and illness. To prevent post-flood epidemics, ONSSA initiated targeted vaccination campaigns against foot-and-mouth disease, sheep pox, and peste des petits ruminants (PPR). Simultaneously, the Gharb Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVA), with support from the Royal Armed Forces, began the free distribution of barley and fodder to support herders in the Gharb plain whose access to pastures and markets remains restricted by impassable roads.
records.institution: The National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA)

records.title: The Moroccan State Secretariat responsible for Fisheries has implemented a one-year temporary restriction on the export of fresh, frozen,...
records.description: The Moroccan State Secretariat responsible for Fisheries has implemented a one-year temporary restriction on the export of fresh, frozen, and chilled sardines to prioritize the domestic market and stabilize local food security. This measure follows a significant surge in domestic prices for this essential staple and a notable shift in the national export composition, which saw sardines drop from 70% of small pelagic exports in 2020 to just 23% in 2025. By limiting exports of this specific species while allowing the unrestricted trade of others like mackerel, the State Secretariat aims to manage local availability and ease financial pressure on households without disrupting the broader operations of the fishing and processing industries. Supported by production from key southern ports, the State Secretariat anticipates that the domestic market can fully absorb the redirected supply, thereby curbing price inflation and supporting the long-term sustainability of the sector amidst climate-related supply challenges.
records.institution: The Moroccan State Secretariat responsible for Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), launched an urgent relief and resilienc...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), launched an urgent relief and resilience initiative from the Al-Aroub Agricultural Station to support farmers in the Hebron Governorate. Backed by the governments of Austria and Finland through the second phase of the "Palestine Interconnection" program, the intervention provided 180 beneficiaries with essential assets, including olive seedlings, water tanks, and plastic sheeting. A key highlight of the mission was the immediate replanting of mature olive trees for a farmer in Sa'ir whose groves had been uprooted, reflecting a strategic shift toward "transformative resilience" that combines humanitarian aid with long-term agricultural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Livestock Department, implemented a specialized medical protocol to enhance bull fertility withi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Livestock Department, implemented a specialized medical protocol to enhance bull fertility within the Artificial Insemination Services Section. This technical initiative involves a precise regimen of hormones, vitamins, and amino acids designed to stimulate reproductive activity and improve semen quality. As a core component of the national genetic improvement program, the protocol follows strict scientific standards and documented health procedures to ensure high fertilization rates and superior livestock production. By raising the genetic efficiency of local herds, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to strengthen the country's livestock sector and achieve sustainable growth in line with national development plans.

records.title: EastFruit reported that Morocco’s lemon exports achieved a five-season high, totaling approximately 9,700 tons for the 2024–2025 cycle.
records.description: EastFruit reported that Morocco’s lemon exports achieved a five-season high, totaling approximately 9,700 tons for the 2024–2025 cycle. This recovery, valued at over $5 million, represents a nearly 80% increase in volume compared to the previous year's historic lows. The season was characterized by a strategic shift in supply continuity, with peak volumes occurring in April and May rather than February. Geographically, Mauritania remains the top destination, absorbing 45% of the output, while the United Kingdom surpassed the 1,000-ton milestone for the first time in nearly two decades. While traditional markets like France saw a decline, the doubling of shipments to secondary markets indicates a successful push by the Ministry of Agriculture to diversify Morocco's citrus export portfolio and strengthen its presence in global markets.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nat...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), will launch a comprehensive Fisheries Resources Survey Project in the Arabian Sea and the Sea of Oman. This scientific expedition is a central pillar of Oman Vision 2040, designed to transition the Sultanate toward evidence-based marine management. Utilizing a specialized research vessel, technical teams will conduct integrated field surveys to estimate fish biomass, map the distribution of target species, and analyze critical oceanographic data such as salinity, dissolved oxygen, and chlorophyll levels. By establishing an integrated national database, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources aims to protect marine biodiversity while identifying sustainable new investment horizons in the fisheries sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Jerusalem Governorate Agriculture Directorate distributed 75 specialized veterinary kits to livestock breeders across several high-pr...
records.description: The Jerusalem Governorate Agriculture Directorate distributed 75 specialized veterinary kits to livestock breeders across several high-priority communities, including Jabal Al-Mukabber, Nabi Samuel, and Beit Iksa. This initiative is a core component of the "Economic Empowerment of Jerusalemite Families" project, funded by the Moroccan Bayt Mal Al-Quds Al-Sharif Agency and implemented in strategic partnership with the Land Research Center, the Ministry of Agriculture, and the Ministry of Jerusalem Affairs. By providing essential medical supplies and veterinary care tools, the project aims to stabilize the livelihoods of Bedouin and rural communities, ensuring improved animal health and the continuity of local food production.

records.title: The Jerusalem Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in collaboration with the Land Research Center, distributed 200 mature olive trees to...
records.description: The Jerusalem Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in collaboration with the Land Research Center, distributed 200 mature olive trees to active farmers in the Beit Iksa and Beit Ijza areas. This initiative is a strategic effort to enhance the resilience of agricultural communities in areas facing land-use challenges by providing high-quality, productive saplings. By increasing the agricultural cover, the Jerusalem Agriculture Directorate and its partners aim to empower farmers to expand their cultivated land, ensure the sustainability of local food production, and strengthen the traditional attachment to the land in the Jerusalem Governorate.

records.title: The North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief), held a spec...
records.description: The North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief), held a specialized field day on grape pruning in Halhul, a central hub for Palestine’s grape industry. As part of the "Enhancing Resilience" project, thirty local farmers received hands-on training from the Tree Horticulture Department and the Al-Aroub Agricultural Station. The training focused on modern technical principles of pruning designed to improve fruit quality, maximize vine efficiency, and mitigate the spread of pests and diseases. By fostering the adoption of best agricultural practices, the Ministry of Agriculture and its partners aim to bolster the economic resilience of farmers and ensure the long-term sustainability of the high-value grape sector in the Hebron governorate.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, launched a large-scale biological control campaign to protect Iraq'...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, launched a large-scale biological control campaign to protect Iraq's 22 million palm trees from the Red Palm Weevil. Described by agricultural officials as a "hidden enemy," this invasive pest currently threatens over 10 million palms in the central Euphrates region and southern provinces like Basra and Wasit. Under the leadership of Samir Abdul-Razzaq Hassan, Director General of the Plant Protection Department, technical teams are mass-propagating natural biological parasites—such as entomopathogenic nematodes (EPNs) and specialized fungi—in state laboratories. These "natural enemies" are specifically bred to hunt weevil larvae inside the tree trunks, providing an environmentally safe alternative to chemical pesticides and supporting Iraq's broader Integrated Pest Management (IPM) goals.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Department of Agricultural Extension and Training, held a specialized workshop at the Agricultur...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Department of Agricultural Extension and Training, held a specialized workshop at the Agricultural Extension Center in Abu Ghraib to promote the transition to closed-system fish farming. In collaboration with the Rawafed Aquaculture Foundation, the event brought together ninety agricultural engineers and experts, alongside representatives from the Ministry of Water Resources and the Ministry of Environment. The Department of Agricultural Extension and Training emphasized that moving away from traditional systems is essential to prevent soil damage and the depletion of water resources. By highlighting successful local experiences, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to utilize closed-system technology to increase production efficiency and ensure the environmental sustainability of the fisheries sector in water-stressed regions.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources in Jordan finalized a strategic cooperation agreement with Masdar (Abu Dhabi Future Energy C...
records.description: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources in Jordan finalized a strategic cooperation agreement with Masdar (Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company) to develop a 25-MW wind power project in the Batn Al-Ghul area of the Ma’an Governorate. This project, which will be fully funded by the UAE government, represents a significant expansion of the longstanding energy partnership between the two nations. The facility will feature five high-capacity wind turbines and is a key component of Jordan’s updated Energy Sector Strategy (2025–2035), which aims to increase the share of renewable energy in the national electricity mix to 50% by 2033 to meet rising domestic demand and enhance energy security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Environment in Tripoli, with technical support from GIZ Libya and the Sustainable Transition, Energy and Environmental Pa...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment in Tripoli, with technical support from GIZ Libya and the Sustainable Transition, Energy and Environmental Partnership (STEP), inaugurated an 8.8 kWp solar photovoltaic (PV) system at its headquarters in Janzur. Co-funded by the European Union and the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ), this "lighthouse project" is designed to serve as a practical model for public institutions transitioning to clean energy. The activation of this rooftop system not only provides a reliable source of green electricity for ministry operations but also symbolizes a strategic commitment to reducing carbon emissions and integrating renewable energy into Libya’s public infrastructure framework.

records.title: The Moulouya River Basin Agency (ABHM) reported a dramatic recovery in water reserves following exceptional rainfall in Morocco’s Orienta...
records.description: The Moulouya River Basin Agency (ABHM) reported a dramatic recovery in water reserves following exceptional rainfall in Morocco’s Oriental region. The Mohammed V Dam, a strategic pillar for the provinces of Taourirt, Berkane, and Nador, saw its filling rate surge from a critical 15% in December to 86% by February 6. With a stored volume of 141.09 million $m^3$, this recovery has stabilized the drinking water supply for major urban centers and secured the irrigation needs for the lower Moulouya’s citrus and vegetable perimeters. To manage this rapid inflow, the Ministry of Equipment and Water has initiated controlled releases to maintain safety margins while Moroccan engineering teams accelerate the Mohammed V Dam heightening project, which is now 69% complete and aimed at quintupling capacity to nearly one billion cubic meters.

records.title: The National Institute for Agricultural Research (INRA) and the Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research (ACIAR) formali...
records.description: The National Institute for Agricultural Research (INRA) and the Australian Centre for International Agricultural Research (ACIAR) formalized a strategic partnership in Rabat to advance sustainable agriculture amid escalating climate challenges. This collaboration, established through a memorandum of understanding and a subsequent letter of intent, is a key component of the Africa-Australia Climate-Smart Agriculture Programme, a six-year, AU$76.4 million initiative targeting nations including Morocco and Egypt. Aligned with the national Generation Green 2020–2030 strategy, the partnership focuses on joint research, capacity building, and the exchange of expertise in critical areas such as water efficiency, drought management, and conservation agriculture. By networking researchers and fostering innovative, resilient food systems, the National Institute for Agricultural Research (INRA) and its Australian counterparts aim to strengthen food security and agricultural sustainability across Morocco and the broader African continent.
records.institution: The National Institute for Agricultural Research (INRA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources has issued updated ministerial decisions to regulate the import of live birds...
records.description: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources has issued updated ministerial decisions to regulate the import of live birds and their derivatives, aligning with international veterinary and biosecurity standards. Under these new measures, the Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources lifted import bans on consignments originating from Odisha in India, Buenos Aires in Argentina, and several counties in Ireland, following successful epidemiological assessments. Conversely, the Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources imposed new temporary restrictions on imports from Catalonia in Spain, specific regions in the United Kingdom, the Philippines, and Poland to prevent the introduction of transboundary animal diseases. These protocols, which follow the guidelines of the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH), exclude products that have undergone thermal processing, ensuring that Oman's food supply remains secure while maintaining strict animal health safeguards.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Oman Investment Authority (OIA)—through its subsidiary Oman Food Capital—finalized a $150 million (OMR 57.7 million) strategic partne...
records.description: The Oman Investment Authority (OIA)—through its subsidiary Oman Food Capital—finalized a $150 million (OMR 57.7 million) strategic partnership with the Brazilian food giant JBS to establish a world-class red meat and poultry production hub. This venture, which marks the largest investment in the Middle East for the world's leading protein producer, focuses on completing an integrated poultry facility in Ibri and revitalizing a beef and mutton processing plant in Thumrait. With a target capacity of 300,000 tons annually, the project aims to transition Oman from a net importer to a regional exporter of "halal" meat within three years, supporting the national food security strategy led by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. This initiative aligns with broader efforts under Oman Vision 2040, including the development of a $4.2 billion agricultural city in Saham and the expansion of strategic grain reserves through the Salalah Mills Company, which recently secured 110,000 tonnes of wheat from Russia to ensure supply stability.

records.title: The Central Acceptance Committee for the EU-funded Agricultural Assistance Program launched a series of field inspections across 18 farms...
records.description: The Central Acceptance Committee for the EU-funded Agricultural Assistance Program launched a series of field inspections across 18 farms in the Tubas Governorate. In coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, the committee monitored the implementation of development projects in Aqaba, Tayasir, Tammun, and Salhab to ensure strict adherence to approved technical specifications. During these visits, several high-impact initiatives were officially accepted, including sheep breeding projects, the installation of modern greenhouses and irrigation networks, and the provision of essential inputs like fodder, fertilizers, and pesticides. By verifying the delivery of heavy machinery, such as plows and harvesters, the Central Acceptance Committee and the Ministry of Agriculture are working to modernize local farming infrastructure and strengthen the economic resilience of agricultural communities in the northern West Bank.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation identified the water sector as one of the most critically damaged components of national infra...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation identified the water sector as one of the most critically damaged components of national infrastructure due to ongoing conflict. During a high-level meeting with UNICEF, the Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation underscored that rehabilitating potable water systems is the essential foundation for social stability and post-war reconstruction. Both parties have committed to a strategic partnership focused on ensuring immediate access to safe drinking water while developing a long-term roadmap for sustainable recovery. This collaboration aims to direct international assistance toward the most affected communities, prioritizing the maintenance of essential water facilities as a prerequisite for both humanitarian relief and future agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.title: Ministry of Agriculture in the Syrian Arab Republic, through its Media Department, issued a strategic statement reaffirming the health st...
records.description: Ministry of Agriculture in the Syrian Arab Republic, through its Media Department, issued a strategic statement reaffirming the health stability of the national poultry sector. Represented by the Directorate of Animal Health and Production, the ministry confirmed that regular preventative vaccination programs are being successfully implemented using both locally produced and imported vaccines. Despite recent rumors, official monitoring by veterinary technical staff across all governorates indicates that poultry health remains within normal limits, with no recorded epidemic outbreaks.

records.title: The Agriculture Sector in Hajja Governorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, launched a...
records.description: The Agriculture Sector in Hajja Governorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, launched a strategic initiative providing interest-free loans to establish veterinary clinics for agricultural associations. Supervised by the General Directorate of Animal Health and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, the project aims to decentralize veterinary services by placing a dedicated clinic within every cooperative association across the governorate's districts. This "foundational core" of veterinary infrastructure is designed to provide immediate medical support to livestock owners and farmers, directly enhancing the resilience of the livestock sector. By leveraging the expertise of provincial agricultural staff, the Ministry of Agriculture and its partners are working to ensure that these clinics become sustainable hubs for animal health and productive development in rural communities.
records.institution: The Agriculture Sector in Hajja Governorate

records.title: The Al-Wahda Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association recently launched the "The Best of Our Hands" festival in the Al-Wahda Dis...
records.description: The Al-Wahda Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association recently launched the "The Best of Our Hands" festival in the Al-Wahda District to showcase the economic potential of productive families. Organized in coordination with the Agricultural and Fisheries Project and Initiative Financing Unit, the Bonyan Development Foundation, and the General Authority for the Development of Small and Micro Projects, the event focuses on completing the local "value chain" by linking agricultural inputs directly to processing, packaging, and consumer markets. By fostering a "community economy," these participating institutions aim to transform society from a model of passive consumption to one of active, sovereign production, effectively reducing the national import bill. The Capital Secretariat and the Ministry of Social Affairs have emphasized that such cooperative frameworks are essential for achieving financial independence and building a resilient national economy rooted in self-reliance and the localization of high-value-added products.
records.institution: The Al-Wahda Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq implemented a strict ban on the import of 15 key fruit and vegetable crops—including apples, bananas,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq implemented a strict ban on the import of 15 key fruit and vegetable crops—including apples, bananas, tomatoes, and potatoes—to safeguard domestic production and stabilize local market prices. This measure is part of a broader agricultural calendar designed to halt imports when national supply is sufficient, particularly as the country moves toward its goal of self-sufficiency in over 48 agricultural products. The Ministry of Agriculture identified that many of these restricted items were being funneled through the Kurdistan Region and mislabeled as local produce to bypass earlier prohibitions. These restrictions coincide with recent cabinet decisions to implement Cabinet Decision No. 957, which significantly raised customs tariffs on imported goods to as high as 30% for luxury and non-essential items. While the General Authority of Customs maintains these steps are necessary to diversify non-oil revenue and address a $69 billion national debt, the measures have sparked widespread protests and strikes by traders and shop owners across Baghdad and other provinces.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Islamic Organization for Food Security (IOFS), held a specialized workshop titled...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Islamic Organization for Food Security (IOFS), held a specialized workshop titled "Strengthening the Policy and Institutional Framework for Organic Agriculture to Improve Soil Health and Combat Desertification in Iraq." The event brought together representatives from the Ministry of Environment, the Ministry of Water Resources, the Ministry of Health, and the Ministry of Industry to address Iraq’s escalating soil degradation and climate challenges. Discussions focused on establishing organic farming as a national necessity to preserve soil fertility, enhance biodiversity, and reduce dependency on chemical pesticides. The workshop is expected to culminate in the drafting of a National Policy for Organic Agriculture, providing a legislative roadmap for sustainable farming and climate adaptation while strengthening Iraq’s regional partnerships through the Islamic Organization for Food Security.

records.title: The Regional Office for Agricultural Development of the Gharb (ORMVAG) launched a large-scale emergency intervention following exceptiona...
records.description: The Regional Office for Agricultural Development of the Gharb (ORMVAG) launched a large-scale emergency intervention following exceptional rainfall that triggered severe flooding across the Gharb plain. Cumulative rainfall reached 507 mm—a 300% increase over the previous year and 54% above the 30-year average—causing the Sebou, Ouergha, Beht, and R’dom rivers to overflow. In response, ORMVAG has mobilized technical teams to secure hydro-agricultural infrastructure, evacuate livestock to safe zones, and provide emergency feed, including barley and composite fodder, to affected breeders. To prevent accidents, power was cut to several threatened pumping stations, while teams continue to dredge drainage networks and construct protective earthen dikes around vulnerable villages.
records.institution: The Regional Office for Agricultural Development of the Gharb (ORMVAG)

records.title: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in the South Al Batinah Governorate, in collaboration with the Directorate General...
records.description: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning in the South Al Batinah Governorate, in collaboration with the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has signed 11 investment agreements valued at over OMR 750,000 ($1.9 million). These projects, covering 120 acres, aim to modernize the regional food security system by enhancing agricultural production and land utilization. A key feature of this initiative is the inclusion of four small and medium enterprises (SMEs) holding Riyada cards, which underscores a strategic push to empower local entrepreneurs and integrate them into national food supply chains. These agreements align with Oman Vision 2040, focusing on economic diversification, job creation, and sustainable development to reduce reliance on food imports.
records.institution: The Directorate General of Housing and Urban Planning

records.title: The Higher Committee for Nursery Licensing within the Ministry of Agriculture conducted a comprehensive field inspection of agricultural...
records.description: The Higher Committee for Nursery Licensing within the Ministry of Agriculture conducted a comprehensive field inspection of agricultural nurseries in the Jenin Governorate. This visit was part of a strategic effort to enforce strict technical specifications and regulatory compliance in seedling production. By monitoring operational mechanisms and the health of various seedling types, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to standardize the quality of inputs available to farmers, ensuring they are free from pests and diseases. The committee provided technical guidelines to nursery operators to modernize their production levels, emphasizing that adherence to these procedural requirements is the "cornerstone" for improving the overall efficiency and sustainability of the national agricultural sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, via the Yatta Agriculture and Veterinary Directorate, partnered with Agricultural Relief and Save the Childr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, via the Yatta Agriculture and Veterinary Directorate, partnered with Agricultural Relief and Save the Children to deliver mobile, solar-powered submersible water pumps to the marginalized communities of Masafer Yatta. Funded by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) as part of the "Strengthening the Resilience of Palestinian Families" project, these pumps provide a sustainable solution for livestock breeders in Area C who face severe water and electricity shortages. Capable of reaching depths of up to 14 meters, the portable solar units allow for efficient water extraction from ancient Roman wells and reservoirs across open grazing environments. This intervention is a critical component of the Ministry of Agriculture's roadmap to improve rural livelihoods and protect the resilience of communities affected by restrictions and resource scarcity.

records.title: The Qalqilya Directorate of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), conducted a specialized...
records.description: The Qalqilya Directorate of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), conducted a specialized workshop for fruit tree farmers operating in isolated areas behind the separation wall. As part of the EVAP III (Project on Improved Extension for Value-Added Agriculture), the session focused on planning an "Awareness Creation Tour" to a modern agricultural training center in Al-Nasariya, Nablus. This initiative aims to transition farmers from high-yield to high-profit agriculture by introducing market-oriented practices and modern technologies such as hydroponics and advanced irrigation. By partnering with the Behind the Wall Cooperative Society, the Ministry of Agriculture and JICA are working to enhance the resilience of farmers in restricted zones, empowering them with the practical skills needed to improve production quality and achieve long-term economic sustainability.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has entered into a strategic cooperation agreement with a Yemeni civil-soci...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has entered into a strategic cooperation agreement with a Yemeni civil-society organization to implement the "Seed" initiative in the Socotra Governorate. This project is designed to bolster food security and rural sustainability by providing 150 vulnerable families with essential agricultural inputs and livestock, alongside the installation of domestic biogas production units. Furthermore, the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) will facilitate specialized training for 75 individuals in dairy production and 20 in veterinary care, while equipping a mobile veterinary unit to be operated by the relevant government authority. These efforts are part of a broader humanitarian framework by KSrelief to modernize the agricultural sector in Yemen, directly benefiting 1,050 individuals through integrated livestock support and renewable energy solutions.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) officially launched the Solar (Photovoltaic) Energy Self-Supply Policy, a landmark regulatory fr...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) officially launched the Solar (Photovoltaic) Energy Self-Supply Policy, a landmark regulatory framework that allows consumers to generate and store their own renewable electricity. This policy is a core enabler of the Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Efficiency Strategy 2030, which targets a 22% reduction in electricity consumption and a 32% reduction in water use. In a strategic first phase, the policy specifically targets the agricultural sector, as well as owners of ranches and rest houses, providing these high-demand users with a "Zero-Capex" pathway to energy independence through smart solar and battery storage solutions.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries and the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research in Algeria have...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries and the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research in Algeria have signed two landmark agreements to transition the nation's agricultural sector from traditional methods to a science-driven, modern industry. By mobilizing university laboratories and introducing advanced technologies like drones, the initiative seeks to solve structural deficits in soil analysis and crop monitoring. These agreements are a core component of Algeria's 2026 Agricultural Roadmap, aiming to bolster national food security by optimizing the use of fertilizers and improving the yields of strategic crops like wheat.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade, the Ministry of Agriculture, and the Future of Egypt Authority formed a "food security triangl...
records.description: The Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade, the Ministry of Agriculture, and the Future of Egypt Authority formed a "food security triangle" to stabilize the domestic poultry market ahead of Ramadan. Facing a 15% surge in prices and seasonal demand spikes, the government reached an agreement to import massive quantities of frozen whole poultry and cuts (breasts and thighs) from multiple international sources. These shipments are arriving to reinforce strategic food reserves and mitigate "speculative practices" by middle-men. To ensure affordability, the imported goods are being distributed at discounts of up to 25% through a nationwide network of fixed and mobile outlets, including the high-visibility "Ahlan Ramadan" fairs. This intervention aims to support the local industry—which provides jobs for 3.6 million workers—by easing supply-side pressures while guaranteeing "fair prices" for Egyptian households during the peak consumption season.
