records.institution: The Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade, the Ministry of Agriculture, and the Future of Egypt Authority

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has confirmed the abundance and price stability of table eggs across local markets, specifically ensuring a s...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has confirmed the abundance and price stability of table eggs across local markets, specifically ensuring a steady supply during the current period and the upcoming month of Ramadan. To maintain this balance, the Security Permits Office highlighted the role of the newly adopted Transit Management Platform, which has streamlined the transport of animal products between governorates, effectively eliminating monopolies and forged health certificates. Furthermore, the Marketing and Price Control Department is actively monitoring the flow of locally produced eggs from all regions, including the Kurdistan Region, to ensure they reach the Zuwaini Central Wholesale Market at standardized prices. This regulatory oversight by the Ministry of Agriculture is designed to achieve a sustainable balance between supply and demand, protecting both the domestic industry and consumer purchasing power during peak seasons.

records.title: As part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, the Ministry of Agriculture, through its Nabatieh branch and the Bint Jbeil Cente...
records.description: As part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, the Ministry of Agriculture, through its Nabatieh branch and the Bint Jbeil Center, concluded a comprehensive three-week training series in Aitaroun designed to foster a new generation of beekeepers. Organized in collaboration with the Aitaroun Municipality, the program equipped approximately 65 participants with scientific knowledge and practical skills for modern apiary management. By focusing on hive structure, year-round care, and the prevention of common management errors, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to create sustainable economic opportunities for rural families in border villages while simultaneously enhancing local biodiversity. This initiative, which concludes with a practical field session in the spring, underscores the ministry's strategic push to revitalize the local economy in Southern Lebanon through specialized, professional agricultural extension services.

records.title: The Dura Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the General Directorate of Exte...
records.description: The Dura Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) and the General Directorate of Extension and Rural Development, has launched a specialized extension program for the "My Initiative" project in Al-Sarra. Funded by the IBSA Fund (India, Brazil, and South Africa), the initiative targets 40 sheep farmers to improve herd management and productive performance through a strategy developed by the UNDP. A central pillar of the project is the implementation of the National Sheep Identification System, a mandatory technical and health management tool recently decreed by the Ministry of Agriculture. The program includes training on reducing young animal mortality, utilizing farm records, and genetic improvement. To ensure practical impact, technical teams from the Dura Agriculture Directorate are conducting field visits to address regional challenges, such as the availability of affordable vaccines, feed quality oversight, and enhanced biosecurity to control infectious diseases in the Palestinian countryside.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture representative in Al-Bayda, in coordination with the local authority of the Mukayras District, launched a sig...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture representative in Al-Bayda, in coordination with the local authority of the Mukayras District, launched a significant seed distribution program to bolster regional food security. The initiative facilitated the distribution of 20 tons of improved potato seeds through the Mukayras Agricultural Cooperative Multipurpose Society, directly targeting 120 farmers across the district's sub-districts. This effort, supported by the Public Company for Potato Seed Production, is part of a broader agricultural advancement strategy in the governorate that has previously included the distribution of seeds for legumes, corn, wheat, and various vegetables. By providing high-quality inputs and technical facilities, the Al-Bayda Agriculture Office aims to expand the cultivation of fertile lands, reduce dependence on imports, and move the region toward sustainable self-sufficiency.

records.title: 99 Egyptian companies specializing in fresh produce established a powerful presence at Fruit Logistica 2026 in Berlin, the world’s premie...
records.description: 99 Egyptian companies specializing in fresh produce established a powerful presence at Fruit Logistica 2026 in Berlin, the world’s premier trade fair for the fresh fruit and vegetable sector. Organized through the strategic collaboration of the Egyptian Commercial Service, the Agricultural Export Council, and the Egypt Expo & Convention Authority (EECA), the Egyptian participation highlighted the record-breaking performance of the nation's agricultural sector. This presence follows a landmark year in 2025, where Egyptian agricultural exports reached an unprecedented $11.5 billion in value and 9.5 million tons in volume, reinforcing Egypt's position as a global leader in citrus and potato exports.
records.institution: The Egyptian Commercial Service, the Agricultural Export Council, and the Egypt Expo & Convention Authority (EECA)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL) achieved a major milestone in the nation's energy transition by completing the demarcatio...
records.description: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL) achieved a major milestone in the nation's energy transition by completing the demarcation of three large-scale photovoltaic (PV) sites. This 18-month technical initiative—conducted in partnership with GIZ Libya under the Sustainable Transition, Energy and Environmental Partnership (STEP)—identified sites at Al-Sadada (52 $km^2$), Ghadames (10 $km^2$), and Brak Al-Shati (50 $km^2$). Collectively, these areas represent an estimated 4.7 GW of solar potential. By providing comprehensive technical and environmental feasibility studies, REAoL aims to create a transparent, investment-ready framework to attract global capital and reduce Libya's historical reliance on hydrocarbons. This effort is central to the National Strategy for Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency (2023–2035), which targets a 22–25% renewable share in the national energy mix by 2030.
records.institution: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL)

records.title: The Jazan Honey Exhibition 2026, a cornerstone of the 11th annual Jazan Festival, has set new records for the region’s agricultural and t...
records.description: The Jazan Honey Exhibition 2026, a cornerstone of the 11th annual Jazan Festival, has set new records for the region’s agricultural and tourism sectors. Held at the cultural center in Al-Edabi Governorate, the event serves as a vital showcase for the biodiversity of Saudi Arabia’s southwest. This year, 60 local beekeepers presented a massive 10 tonnes of high-quality honey, featuring over 15 premium varieties unique to the region's diverse topography.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Bahraini Farmers’ Market, a flagship initiative organized by the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in partnership wi...
records.description: The Bahraini Farmers’ Market, a flagship initiative organized by the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in partnership with the National Initiative for Agricultural Development (NIAD), serves as a vital platform for strengthening national food security and supporting local producers. Held at the Budaiya Botanical Garden, the market provides a direct link between producers and consumers, featuring over 100 varieties of fresh local vegetables and fruits. By eliminating middlemen, the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture and NIAD help increase farmer incomes while ensuring high-quality, affordable produce for the public. Beyond its commercial impact, the market functions as a developmental hub for sustainable agriculture and entrepreneurship, highlighting the contributions of Bahraini youth and women and aligning with the Kingdom's broader vision for a resilient and competitive agricultural ecosystem.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: OCP Group, IAEA Partner to Boost Sustainable Agriculture and Food Security
records.description: The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) and the OCP Group launched a five-year strategic partnership to accelerate scientific innovation for global food security. This collaboration directly supports the IAEA’s Atoms4Food initiative, a joint program with the FAO that harnesses nuclear science to address growing hunger and climate challenges. The partnership centers on a coordinated research project that utilizes isotopic and nuclear techniques to optimize the management of both macronutrients like phosphorus and nitrogen and essential micronutrients such as zinc and selenium. By providing accurate data to implement the "4Rs" of nutrient stewardship—the right source, at the right rate, right time, and right place—the OCP Group and the IAEA aim to provide farmers in food-insecure regions with practical tools to increase crop yields while significantly reducing the environmental impact of fertilizers.

records.title: The AlUla Honey Season returned for its second annual edition in February 2026, transforming the Al-Manshiyah Farmers’ Market into a hub...
records.description: The AlUla Honey Season returned for its second annual edition in February 2026, transforming the Al-Manshiyah Farmers’ Market into a hub for agricultural innovation and heritage. Launched by the Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU), the event is a key component of the Khayrat AlUla Seasons, an integrated initiative designed to celebrate the oasis city’s biodiversity and transform its agricultural outputs into sustainable economic value. By empowering local beekeeping families and highlighting the exceptional quality of AlUla’s honey, the RCU is positioning the governorate as a premier destination for "agro-tourism." This strategy directly supports Saudi Vision 2030 by diversifying the local economy and preserving the region's ancient agricultural heritage.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) highlighted Najran as a premier model for Saudi Arabia’s agricultural transform...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) highlighted Najran as a premier model for Saudi Arabia’s agricultural transformation. By fusing traditional expertise with high-tech innovation, the region has successfully mitigated its arid climatic challenges to become a critical pillar of the Kingdom’s domestic food supply. This transformation is underpinned by a massive expansion of greenhouse farming and precision irrigation, ensuring year-round production of high-value crops like tomatoes, citrus fruits, and the region’s renowned "Arabian coffee.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Regional Union of Agriculture and Maritime Fishing (URAP), in collaboration with Ulysse Expo Events, announced the launch of the firs...
records.description: The Regional Union of Agriculture and Maritime Fishing (URAP), in collaboration with Ulysse Expo Events, announced the launch of the first edition of the Cap Bon Agriculture, Production, and Maritime Fishing Fair. Scheduled to take place in Nabeul, the event highlights the governorate’s strategic role as a contributor of 15% to Tunisia's national agricultural output across 16 specialized sectors, including citrus, strawberries, and spices. The fair serves as a comprehensive platform featuring a scientific program on innovative irrigation and livestock farming, a dedicated direct sales market, and professional networking spaces. Furthermore, the URAP and Ulysse Expo Events have integrated a social dimension by providing free exhibition stands for women farmers and artisans to promote traditional products and local entrepreneurship.
records.institution: The Regional Union of Agriculture and Maritime Fishing (URAP)

records.title: During the Fruit Logistica exhibition in Berlin, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation inaugurated the Egyptian Export and Bus...
records.description: During the Fruit Logistica exhibition in Berlin, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation inaugurated the Egyptian Export and Business Council in Northern Germany. This initiative, launched at the Egyptian Consulate in Hamburg, is a strategic move to double agricultural exports to Germany, building on the record-breaking $11.5 billion in exports achieved in 2025. The council acts as a non-profit, coordinating umbrella for Egyptian agricultural exporters, aimed at tackling logistical barriers and technical challenges. By empowering a new generation of "young exporters" with digital tools and modern marketing techniques, the Ministry of Agriculture and the Egyptian Commercial Service seek to cement Egypt's position as a premier supplier of citrus, potatoes, and grapes to the European Union.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture officially announced the prohibition of potato imports, citing the achievement of a significant domesti...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture officially announced the prohibition of potato imports, citing the achievement of a significant domestic surplus and the transition toward full self-sufficiency. This move is part of a broader regulatory strategy that has seen the Ministry of Agriculture ban the import of over 48 agricultural products, including poultry, table eggs, and various vegetables. By closing the borders to foreign potatoes, the institution aims to protect local farmers from market saturation and price instability. Iraq has now shifted its focus toward global markets, actively exporting large quantities of surplus potatoes and dates to neighboring Gulf states and European markets, marking a historic turning point from an import-dependent economy to a regional agricultural exporter.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) signed an emergency support agreement to contain a...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) signed an emergency support agreement to contain a major outbreak of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) that has severely impacted the national livestock sector. The outbreak, caused by the highly contagious SAT1 serotype (genetically linked to strains in Türkiye and Azerbaijan), was first detected in late 2025 and is believed to have entered via illegal smuggling routes. This new partnership prioritizes a massive second-phase vaccination campaign for cattle, sheep, and goats, while also establishing a national task force to standardize disease surveillance, biosecurity measures, and veterinary response. With an estimated 60–70% of the national cattle herd affected and milk production reportedly halved in certain areas, the Ministry of Agriculture and the FAO are focused on protecting rural livelihoods and ensuring the long-term resilience of Lebanon's food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon inaugurated a transformative strategic phase by signing three Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) de...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon inaugurated a transformative strategic phase by signing three Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) designed to shift the sector from crisis management to sustainable development. Overseen by the Ministry of Agriculture, these agreements establish partnerships with the RET Germany/GATE Lebanon consortium to bolster food security in Akkar, Bioland S.A.R.L. to pioneer specialty aromatic herb and essential oil production, and the Lebanese Association for Studies and Training (LOST) to expand agricultural extension services in the Bekaa and Baalbek-Hermel regions. These initiatives are supported by over $350 million in coordinated funding—including the $200 million World Bank-funded GATE Project—and coincide with the finalization of the National Agricultural Strategy 2026–2035. By leveraging a newly expanded Farmers’ Registry of 77,000 participants, the Ministry of Agriculture is now using data-driven transparency to direct climate-smart investments, modernize infrastructure, and empower rural women and youth, ensuring that agriculture remains a cornerstone of national sovereignty and economic recovery.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) inaugurated the Al-Hashiya Festival at the Al-Qahwiyan Reserve in the Al-Qaid C...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) inaugurated the Al-Hashiya Festival at the Al-Qahwiyan Reserve in the Al-Qaid Center, Hail Region. This festival serves as a strategic platform to showcase the region's agricultural identity, featuring over 32 specialized pavilions. The event highlights Hail's core agricultural outputs, including dates, citrus fruits, and honey, alongside emerging food processing industries. By integrating the Al-Qahwiyan Reserve into the local economic landscape, MEWA aims to stimulate agricultural tourism, support small-scale producers, and promote the sustainable use of natural resources in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially launched "Saqr", an innovative AI-powered smart assistant integrated...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) officially launched "Saqr", an innovative AI-powered smart assistant integrated into the "Hafidh" digital platform. Named after the falcon (a symbol of sharp vision and precision), Saqr is designed to revolutionize field monitoring and regulatory enforcement. By providing inspectors with real-time, accurate access to the Water Law and its implementing regulations, the tool standardizes legal interpretations across the Kingdom, minimizes procedural errors, and ensures that water resource protection is both data-driven and legally robust.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Union Internationale de Banques (UIB) announced its significant participation in a syndicated loan to finance the PURO project, a 100...
records.description: The Union Internationale de Banques (UIB) announced its significant participation in a syndicated loan to finance the PURO project, a 100 MW photovoltaic power plant in Chebika, Kairouan. This initiative marks a milestone as the first large-scale Tunisian solar project to be financed exclusively by local banks, including BIAT (the lead arranger), ATB, and UBCI. With a total investment of 280 million dinars, the UIB Group contributed 40 million dinars—comprising 30 million dinars in debt and 10 million dinars in equity through its investment arm, UIB SICAR. The power plant is a core component of the Tunisian Solar Plan (PST), which targets a 35% renewable energy share by 2030. By supplying green electricity to two major cement plants, the project directly supports the decarbonization of Tunisia's industrial sector and enhances national energy sovereignty.

records.title: Dubai Municipality unveiled the "Blue and Green Spaces Roadmap 2030" at the World Governments Summit, a $1.1 billion (AED 4 billion) stra...
records.description: Dubai Municipality unveiled the "Blue and Green Spaces Roadmap 2030" at the World Governments Summit, a $1.1 billion (AED 4 billion) strategic initiative to transform the emirate into a global leader in urban sustainability. Launched in the presence of the UAE’s top leadership, the roadmap aims to integrate nature directly into the city's infrastructure corridors to enhance the quality of life for residents and visitors. Key targets include planting 1.5 million trees by 2031, developing 120 new parks covering 3 million square meters, and creating 200 integrated sports and recreational spaces. The "blue" aspect of the plan focuses on coastlines, with 15 major projects designed to revitalize waterfronts, introduce three new beach destinations annually, and expand public beach capacity by 150%. By extending beachfront cycling and jogging tracks by 285% and increasing beach amenities by 400%, Dubai Municipality is aligning with the Dubai 2040 Urban Master Plan to ensure the city remains a resilient, human-centric, and vibrant desert metropolis.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) launched the Solar (Photovoltaic) Energy Self-Supply Policy, a landmark regulatory framework des...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) launched the Solar (Photovoltaic) Energy Self-Supply Policy, a landmark regulatory framework designed to decentralize power generation and accelerate the Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Efficiency Strategy 2030. This policy empowers consumers—specifically starting with the agricultural sector and owners of ranches and rest houses—to install their own solar panels, solar water heaters, and battery storage systems to meet their daily energy needs. By shifting from a purely grid-dependent model to a flexible "self-supply" system, the DoE aims to reduce peak demand on the national grid, lower carbon emissions, and provide significant cost savings for high-consumption rural and agricultural facilities.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) established a strategic partners...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) established a strategic partnership during the World Governments Summit in Dubai to revolutionize rural development and food security. Under this new institutional framework, both organizations will align their financing mechanisms to support sovereign projects within IFAD's global portfolio, focusing on strengthening agricultural value chains and building climate resilience for small-scale farmers. The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development will coordinate its evaluation and approval processes with IFAD to maximize resource efficiency, ensuring that co-financed investments deliver high-impact results in rural economies. By integrating their roles in sustainable development finance, the ADFD and IFAD aim to empower vulnerable communities to adapt to climatic and economic changes while fostering long-term economic growth and food sovereignty.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD)

records.title: The National Agriculture Center (NAC) and the Sharjah Entrepreneurship Center (Sheraa) have launched Agriboost 2026, a six-week sprint-ba...
records.description: The National Agriculture Center (NAC) and the Sharjah Entrepreneurship Center (Sheraa) have launched Agriboost 2026, a six-week sprint-based incubation program designed to accelerate early-stage agri-tech startups in the UAE. This initiative aligns with the national "Plant the Emirates" program and the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment’s sustainability goals. Five seed-stage startups will be selected to undergo an intensive curriculum focused on solution validation, customer discovery, and go-to-market execution. Each participating startup receives support valued at AED 15,000, alongside access to Sheraa’s co-working spaces, discounted business licensing, and a global network of mentors and investors.

records.title: The Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit of the local authority in Taiz concluded a four-day training workshop designed t...
records.description: The Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit of the local authority in Taiz concluded a four-day training workshop designed to modernize the governorate's agricultural sector. The program focused on building technical and institutional capacities for 39 directors of agriculture branches and extension units across several model districts, including Khadir, Maqbanah, Mawiyah, Al-Ta'iziyah, and Al-Silu. By equipping extension personnel with modern expertise, the General Administration for Extension Programs and Activities aims to unify extension efforts and promote the adoption of low-cost, high-productivity farming methods. This strategic investment in human capital is a key pillar of the Taiz Economic and Social Development Plan (2024–2026), which seeks to achieve food self-sufficiency, reduce the national import bill, and transition the region toward a resilient, sustainable agricultural economy.

records.title: Egypt and Türkiye have solidified a new era of bilateral relations by signing several memoranda of understanding across defense, trade, h...
records.description: Egypt and Türkiye have solidified a new era of bilateral relations by signing several memoranda of understanding across defense, trade, health, and agriculture. Following high-level discussions at the Al-Ittihadiya Presidential Palace, the two nations established a High-Level Strategic Cooperation Council to provide a permanent institutional framework for coordination. Key agreements include a partnership between the Egyptian Drug Authority and its Turkish counterpart, as well as pacts on plant quarantine and veterinary services to regulate agricultural and livestock exchanges. Additionally, the Ministry of Investment of Egypt and the Ministry of Trade of Türkiye committed to boosting bilateral trade, while further MoUs were concluded between the Ministry of Social Solidarity and the respective ministries of youth and sports to enhance social protection and youth initiatives.
records.institution: The Ministry of Investment, the Ministry of Trade

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department at the Al-Qaim station in Anbar, has commenced the operation of solar-po...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department at the Al-Qaim station in Anbar, has commenced the operation of solar-powered fixed sprinkler irrigation systems. This initiative is integrated into the National Program for the Propagation and Processing of Forage Crop Seeds, aiming to modernize agricultural infrastructure through environmentally friendly renewable energy. By transitioning to solar power, the Horticulture Department seeks to reduce operational costs, rationalize energy consumption, and increase the overall efficiency of its agricultural projects. These efforts are part of a broader strategy to support the local agricultural sector and ensure the sustainable completion of national production plans through improved performance and technological integration.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Wafa Fezzan Initiative launched a critical support program to strengthen the agricultural sector in southern Libya, specifically targ...
records.description: The Wafa Fezzan Initiative launched a critical support program to strengthen the agricultural sector in southern Libya, specifically targeting the Fezzan region. Supported by the eastern-based government, the initiative focuses on empowering local youth through entrepreneurship training and financial grants to ensure sustainable production and food security. The cornerstone of this project is the installation of solar power systems on farms to provide a reliable energy source, reducing the burden of unstable electricity and high operational costs. The first phase began in the Al-Bawanees region, with plans to expand across the south to revitalize the land and promote clean, sustainable energy solutions for local farmers.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests convened a national conference in Salé to addres...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests convened a national conference in Salé to address the future of agricultural employment in Morocco, focusing on its current state and strategies for preservation. Organized in collaboration with the Ministry of Economic Inclusion, Small Businesses, Employment and Skills, the World Bank Group, COMADER, and AMAECO, the event brought together over 250 stakeholders to analyze how climatic, economic, and social shifts are impacting rural livelihoods. Discussions centered on the critical links between sustainable water management, productive investment, and farm productivity, highlighting that the stability of the sector remains highly dependent on adapting to climate risks. To ensure social cohesion and economic resilience, the Ministry of Agriculture and its partners committed to developing a more attractive employment model that prioritizes support for young rural entrepreneurs and the long-term sustainability of national agricultural sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: The Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund financed 13 key projects in 2025 with a total investment of OMR2.4 million, targeting the...
records.description: The Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund financed 13 key projects in 2025 with a total investment of OMR2.4 million, targeting the agricultural, fisheries, and water resources sectors. According to Executive Director Hanan Said Al Sulaimi, this initiative is part of a broader five-year strategy that has seen the Fund invest over OMR10.6 million across 64 developmental projects. By focusing on aquaculture, value chain improvement, and sustainable innovation, the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund serves as a strategic driver for Oman Vision 2040, specifically supporting economic diversification, environmental protection, and food security. In close integration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, these investments aim to enhance local production and modernize the national food security ecosystem.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Agricultural Relief Association and Save the Children, has finalized two strategic...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Agricultural Relief Association and Save the Children, has finalized two strategic agreements with the municipalities of Khallat al-Miyah and As-Samu to bolster the resilience of livestock farmers south of Hebron. Funded by Save the Children, the project introduces modern animal health technologies and production techniques to marginalized and war-affected families. Specifically, the agreement in Khallat al-Miyah provides for the supply of specialized sheep baths to curb disease spread, while the partnership in As-Samu establishes an animal production field school equipped with electric milkers and a modern milking platform. By integrating these technical advancements, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to improve animal product quality, raise production efficiency, and secure the livelihoods of rural farming communities.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed the tent...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed the tenth batch of investment support agreements under the MAP II program to foster a sustainable, market-oriented agri-food system. This latest round includes 17 projects distributed across the Jenin, Nablus, Qalqilya, Hebron, Tulkarm, Jerusalem, and Ramallah governorates, with a total investment volume of 5,158,761.74 shekels. Funded by the governments of Denmark, Switzerland, Spain, Italy, and the European Union, the initiative provides direct non-refundable grants covering 48% of project costs. The investments target critical value chains, including vegetable and strawberry farming, medicinal plants, beekeeping, organic fertilizer production, and dairy manufacturing.

records.title: The European School of Management and Technology (ESMT) Berlin, through its DEEP - Institute for Deep Tech Innovation, has partnered with...
records.description: The European School of Management and Technology (ESMT) Berlin, through its DEEP - Institute for Deep Tech Innovation, has partnered with the Qatar Investment Authority (QIA) and the Qatar Research, Development, and Innovation Council (QRDI) to launch DEEP Qatar, a new university-affiliated innovation hub in Doha. This initiative aims to bridge the German and Qatari ecosystems by focusing on deep technology transfer and entrepreneurship through three main pillars: the Creative Destruction Lab (CDL-Doha), the DEEP Academy, and DEEP Pioneers. Supported by over $1 billion in venture capital funding from the Qatar Investment Authority (QIA), the hub will offer specialized tracks in artificial intelligence, health, agriculture, and food technology, providing mentorship and training to scientists and researchers. By aligning with the Qatar Research, Development, and Innovation Council (QRDI) national strategy, the partnership seeks to accelerate the commercialization of scientific research and position Qatar as a global leader in high-impact technology sectors.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Indian construction conglomerate Larsen & Toubro (L&T) has contracted Nextpower Arabia, a joint venture between Nextpower and Abunayyan H...
records.description: Indian construction conglomerate Larsen & Toubro (L&T) has contracted Nextpower Arabia, a joint venture between Nextpower and Abunayyan Holding, to supply 2.25 gigawatts of advanced solar tracking systems for the Bisha Solar project in Saudi Arabia's Asir Province. Developed by a consortium led by ACWA Power and procured by the Saudi Power Procurement Company (SPPC), this initiative is the largest of Wave 6 under the National Renewable Energy Program overseen by the Ministry of Energy. The project marks the first major order for the newly operational Nextpower Arabia, which aims to enhance efficiency and reduce shipping costs by localizing manufacturing and supply chain capabilities.

records.title: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) and the National Agricultural Development Company (NADEC) have established a l...
records.description: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) and the National Agricultural Development Company (NADEC) have established a long-term strategic partnership to bridge the gap between advanced scientific research and large-scale agricultural operations. By signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU), both institutions aim to transform theoretical scientific outputs into field-ready applications that address Saudi Arabia’s unique environmental challenges, such as water scarcity and rising temperatures. This collaboration grants KAUST researchers access to NADEC's operational data and field sites, allowing for the real-world testing and scaling of innovations through the KAUST Center of Excellence for Sustainable Food Security.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Energy of Saudi Arabia and the Turkish Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources finalized a landmark agreement to invest...
records.description: The Ministry of Energy of Saudi Arabia and the Turkish Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources finalized a landmark agreement to invest $2 billion in two massive solar farms. This project, signed during Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan's official visit to Riyadh, marks the first phase of a broader 5,000 MW renewable energy framework designed to deepen economic ties and support Turkey's ambitious energy transition. The two solar plants—one located in the central province of Karaman and the other in the eastern province of Sivas—will have a combined capacity of 2,000 MW. Together, they are expected to supply clean electricity to approximately 2.1 million Turkish households.

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic initiative to modernize rainfed crop product...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic initiative to modernize rainfed crop production across the Makkah, Al-Baha, Aseer, and Jazan regions. By distributing 729 modern devices, including 200 tillage machines and 529 specialized attachments, the program aims to enhance production efficiency and reduce operational costs for local farmers. According to Saudi Reef, this technical support is paired with comprehensive training and guidance to ensure the safe and sustainable use of the equipment, ultimately minimizing waste and labor effort while adhering to rigorous quality and safety standards.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: The General Establishment for Dairy Farms has reported significant progress in 2025, focusing on health standards, production growth, and...
records.description: The General Establishment for Dairy Farms has reported significant progress in 2025, focusing on health standards, production growth, and administrative restructuring to enhance the livestock sector's role in food security. Under the direction of Dr. Louay Hamouyeh, the establishment managed a total herd of 1,464 head of cattle, yielding substantial outputs in milk, meat, and livestock. These achievements are supported by technical partnerships with the College of Veterinary Medicine and ACSAD, ensuring that animal health assessments and specialized testing (such as for tuberculosis and leukemia) are integrated into the production cycle.
records.institution: The General Establishment for Dairy Farms

records.title: A working session at the headquarters of the Governorate of Kébili focused on the progress of a geothermal farming development project de...
records.description: A working session at the headquarters of the Governorate of Kébili focused on the progress of a geothermal farming development project designed to modernize the region’s agricultural infrastructure. Spanning 5 hectares, the project introduces a laboratory and logistical hub that brings the specialized services of the Technical Centre for Protected and Geothermal Crops (CTCPG) directly to local farmers to combat pests and improve profitability. The initiative features a specialized weather monitoring station for early pandemic and climate warnings, alongside the implementation of geothermal heating technologies aimed at rationalizing energy consumption. By providing expertise on water resource exploitation and selecting plant varieties adapted to the local climate, the Technical Centre for Protected and Geothermal Crops (CTCPG) and regional authorities aim to establish a more sustainable and efficient geothermal agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Technical Centre for Protected and Geothermal Crops (CTCPG)

records.title: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) has launched the RAIA project to support 480 youth-led ventures in Tunisia’s agricult...
records.description: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) has launched the RAIA project to support 480 youth-led ventures in Tunisia’s agriculture, fishing, and processing sectors. Funded by the MPTF and implemented with the FAO and ILO, the initiative provides grants and loans via a "Social Innovation Fund" across six governorates, including Bizerte and Medenine. By targeting high-potential areas like olive oil, aquaculture, and livestock, APIA aims to formalize the economy and create decent jobs for entrepreneurs under 40.

records.title: The Environmental Education Association in Hammamet, in collaboration with regional authorities and various partners, is organizing the 1...
records.description: The Environmental Education Association in Hammamet, in collaboration with regional authorities and various partners, is organizing the 12th edition of the citrus festival under the slogan "Hammamet between sea and orchards." This event celebrates the region's diverse agricultural and environmental heritage by exhibiting numerous citrus varieties intended for both local and international markets. Beyond its agricultural focus, the festival serves as a strategic platform to enhance ecological and cultural tourism, repositioning the city as a destination that offers rich history, customs, and traditions alongside its traditional seaside appeal.
records.institution: The Environmental Education Association in Hammamet

records.title: The Codex Alimentarius Commission (Codex) has officially approved a proposal by the United Arab Emirates to develop the first internation...
records.description: The Codex Alimentarius Commission (Codex) has officially approved a proposal by the United Arab Emirates to develop the first international standard for pasteurized camel milk. Announced during the Commission’s 48th session in Rome, this milestone aims to harmonize global quality criteria, safeguard consumers against fraudulent practices—such as the adulteration of camel milk with bovine powder—and facilitate fair international trade. With the global camel milk market projected to reach $1.934 billion by 2033, and the United Arab Emirates already producing over 7,000 tonnes annually for export to the EU, China, and the US, this standard is expected to significantly boost market confidence. The National Codex Committee emphasized that this initiative not only supports local production chains but also reinforces the nation's leadership in shaping the global food safety ecosystem and sustainable development goals.

records.title: The NRTC Group has officially launched Mazraati, a "farm-to-fork" digital platform designed to integrate and modernize the UAE’s agri-foo...
records.description: The NRTC Group has officially launched Mazraati, a "farm-to-fork" digital platform designed to integrate and modernize the UAE’s agri-food supply chain. Unveiled at Gulfood Green 2026 and digitally supported by Etheral IT Solutions LLC, the platform connects growers, logistics providers, and buyers through a unified system utilizing AI-supported quality grading, real-time logistics tracking, and QR-based traceability. By digitizing every stage of the journey—from harvest and temperature-controlled transport to pack house intake—the NRTC Group aims to eliminate fragmented workflows, reduce food waste, and provide farmers with data-driven insights into market demand. This structural shift is intended to expand the local sourcing network to over 260 farmers by 2027, with plans to increase deliveries of locally grown produce, such as lettuce and tomatoes, from 20,000 tons to over 100,000 tons within three years.

records.title: The Sharjah Environment and Protected Areas Authority (EPAA) concluded the 25th edition of the Sharjah International Forum for Arabian Bi...
records.description: The Sharjah Environment and Protected Areas Authority (EPAA) concluded the 25th edition of the Sharjah International Forum for Arabian Biodiversity (SICFAB), held at Sharjah Safari to address critical environmental and conservation challenges in the Arabian Peninsula. Bringing together 180 experts, the forum focused on the rehabilitation of seabirds, diagnostic techniques for wildlife mortality, and the management of invasive species. Sessions led by international specialists highlighted that human activities, such as fishing, significantly impact avian health, while workshops on IUCN Red List assessments and EICAT methodologies provided scientific frameworks for prioritizing protected areas. Furthermore, the Sharjah Environment and Protected Areas Authority (EPAA) emphasized the severe economic and ecological threats posed by invasive species like the red palm weevil and invasive ants, calling for unified regional databases and enhanced cooperation to protect the region's natural heritage and support sustainable development goals.
records.institution: The Sharjah Environment and Protected Areas Authority (EPAA)

records.title: The King Abdullah II Fund for Development (KAFD) has officially signed support agreements with 12 selected entrepreneurial projects under...
records.description: The King Abdullah II Fund for Development (KAFD) has officially signed support agreements with 12 selected entrepreneurial projects under its "Riyadah" programme, a strategic move aligned with Jordan’s Economic Modernisation Vision. By providing both financial and technical support to startups across various governorates, the fund aims to transform innovative ideas into sustainable, job-creating ventures. The supported projects are strategically distributed across critical sectors, including environment, agriculture, and food (3 projects), technology and the Fourth Industrial Revolution (4 projects), and tourism and services (5 projects). Following a rigorous and transparent evaluation process involving expert committees and field visits, the King Abdullah II Fund for Development (KAFD) expects these initiatives to catalyze regional economic growth, enhance sectoral integration, and provide new income streams for Jordanian youth.
records.institution: The King Abdullah II Fund for Development (KAFD)

records.title: Morocco’s food import bill is projected to reach US$10.3 billion by the end of 2025, marking a 3.3% increase driven by a seven-year droug...
records.description: Morocco’s food import bill is projected to reach US$10.3 billion by the end of 2025, marking a 3.3% increase driven by a seven-year drought cycle that has severely impacted domestic production. According to the Moroccan Exchange Office, food imports now account for 11.5% of the nation's total import spending, with wheat, sugar, corn, and live animals making up nearly 42% of the food budget. A critical highlight of the report is the 25% surge in live animal imports, totaling US$762.7 million, as the government continues to combat a 38% decline in the national herd through duty exemptions and expanded import quotas. To further stabilize this sector, **Morocco and Poland** recently signed a memorandum of understanding to harmonize veterinary standards and facilitate livestock trade, aiming to bridge the country’s US$850 million trade deficit in the food sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate and its Extension Services Department, partnered with the J...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate and its Extension Services Department, partnered with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) to conduct specialized technical training for almond farmers in Al-Shuyoukh. As a key component of the EVAP 3 project, the training targeted 20 male and female farmers, focusing on modern production techniques and efficiency-driven agricultural practices. This collaborative initiative by the Ministry of Agriculture and JICA is part of a broader effort to modernize tree horticulture, improve resource management, and strengthen the resilience of the Palestinian agricultural sector by equipping local producers with sustainable and high-yield knowledge.

records.title: The Tabuk Agricultural Development Company has finalized a strategic 10-year investment contract with Ruwad Alsinaa Waltatweer Company to...
records.description: The Tabuk Agricultural Development Company has finalized a strategic 10-year investment contract with Ruwad Alsinaa Waltatweer Company to lease its grape orchards, a move designed to stabilize cash flow and reverse a decade of financial losses. Valued at SAR 23.3 million (approximately US$6.2 million), the agreement shifts all operating costs to the investor in exchange for fixed rental income. This transition is critical for the company, as its grape segment has accumulated losses exceeding SAR 57 million over the last ten years. By converting these underperforming agricultural assets into a predictable revenue stream, the Tabuk Agricultural Development Company aims to improve the book value of its orchards and enhance its overall financial performance indicators on the Tadawul stock exchange.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the Uni...
records.description: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the World Food Programme (WFP), has launched the second phase of a project to remove water hyacinth from irrigation canals in the Al-Ghab region. Following a first phase that cleared over twenty kilometers of waterways, this stage focuses on removing debris from canal edges to prevent the invasive species from re-spreading. By restoring the smooth flow of water and improving the efficiency of the irrigation network, the General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab aims to mitigate environmental and economic damage, reduce maintenance costs, and provide critical support to local farmers and agricultural production.
records.institution: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab

records.title: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication has launched a distribution program providing potato seeds to farmers at subsidized pri...
records.description: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication has launched a distribution program providing potato seeds to farmers at subsidized prices to alleviate high agricultural costs and stimulate domestic production. Director General Engineer Ammar Al-Muhammad announced that the initiative features several approved local varieties, specifically Afamia, Sidra, Athar, Qalamoun, and Lana. By offering these varieties at reduced rates, the General Establishment for Seed Multiplication aims to enhance national food security and foster a greater reliance on local agricultural outputs, supporting the long-term sustainability of the sector.
records.institution: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication
