records.title: The Interprofessional Group of Dates (GIDattes) has launched a week-long direct-to-consumer sale in Monastir, featuring farmers from the...
records.description: The Interprofessional Group of Dates (GIDattes) has launched a week-long direct-to-consumer sale in Monastir, featuring farmers from the governorates of Kebili and Tozeur. This initiative, hosted in a large-scale exhibition space, allows citizens to purchase high-quality dates at affordable prices while bypassing traditional intermediaries. By facilitating this direct connection between producers and the public, the Interprofessional Group of Dates (GIDattes) seeks to promote local consumption and ensure the smooth distribution of national agricultural produce. Following this event, the organization plans to further support the sector through a broader promotional campaign in collaboration with major retailers to maintain preferential pricing and accessibility for consumers.

records.title: The UAE has finalized a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), marking a strate...
records.description: The UAE has finalized a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), marking a strategic expansion of its trade network into Central and Eastern Africa. Signed in Abu Dhabi by President Sheikh Mohamed and President Felix Tshisekedi, the deal aims to eliminate trade barriers and reduce tariffs to stimulate investment in critical sectors like mining, agriculture, and clean energy. Given the DRC's status as a top global producer of cobalt—a vital component for the electric vehicle and energy transition industries—the partnership is a cornerstone of the UAE's strategy to secure essential minerals while boosting its non-oil foreign trade toward a target of $1.1 trillion by 2031.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture recently conducted a specialized training course in Sana’a to enhance the technical proficiency of plant prod...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture recently conducted a specialized training course in Sana’a to enhance the technical proficiency of plant production and planning personnel. The program focused on qualifying ten participants in the precise mechanism for completing forms related to agricultural crop policies, ensuring accurate data collection and analysis. By strengthening these technical skills, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to refine its policy-making processes, ultimately boosting national production efficiency and supporting the strategic goal of achieving food self-sufficiency.

records.title: Egypt is evaluating the introduction of sugar trading on its commodity exchange to enhance market governance, transparency, and price sta...
records.description: Egypt is evaluating the introduction of sugar trading on its commodity exchange to enhance market governance, transparency, and price stability through a collaborative strategy between the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, and the Mostakbal Misr Authority for Sustainable Development. This integrated approach prioritizes national food security by modernizing production lines at state-affiliated factories and expanding the cultivation of high-yield sugar beet and sugar cane. To support the domestic industry's liquidity and manage a surplus inventory of one million tonnes, the government has resumed sugar exports following the establishment of a robust ten-month strategic reserve. By aligning agricultural production with industrial processing and distribution, the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade aims to achieve long-term self-sufficiency and mitigate price volatility while balancing the pressures of upcoming shifts in raw sugar import regulations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, and the Mostakbal Misr Authority for Sustainable Development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully supported the introduction of passion fruit cultivation to Iraq, marking a significant expan...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully supported the introduction of passion fruit cultivation to Iraq, marking a significant expansion of the crop from its native South America. Through streamlined procedures and close cooperation with the Holy Shrine of Imam Hussein, specifically its Ornamental Planting and Afforestation Department, the initiative has identified the purple variety as particularly resilient to the Iraqi climate. Successful cultivation has already been recorded across the governorates of Baghdad, Babylon, and Wasit, where the fruit is being integrated into the local production of juices and food products. This achievement reflects the Ministry's broader strategy to diversify national agricultural output and introduce high-value, climate-adapted crops to the Middle East.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, is advancing its national strategy to revitalize the fruit sector by pr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, is advancing its national strategy to revitalize the fruit sector by propagating high-quality seedlings across various governorates. As part of the National Program for the Propagation of Fruit and Olive Varieties, technical teams are currently collecting and preparing cuttings for essential crops, including figs, grapes, and pomegranates. By utilizing modern cultivation techniques—such as the application of specialized fungicides, rooting agents, and the use of protective agricultural tunnels—the Ministry ensures that rootstocks are developed according to rigorous technical standards. These improved seedlings are being made available to citizens and farmers at subsidized prices, a move designed to incentivize the expansion of orchards, boost local production, and strengthen the overall agricultural economy.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Ministry of Municipality has announced the launch of the thirteenth edition of the International Agricultural Exhibition in Qatar, kn...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality has announced the launch of the thirteenth edition of the International Agricultural Exhibition in Qatar, known as AgriteQ 2026, which serves as a premier regional and international platform for agriculture, food production, and sustainability. Spanning an area of more than 40,000 square meters at the Katara Cultural Village, the exhibition brings together government sectors, private entities, and international experts to showcase an advanced agricultural system built on innovation. The event coincides with the third phase of the National Food Security Strategy 2024–2030 and supports the goals of the Qatar National Vision 2030 by employing the latest agricultural technologies to enhance self-sufficiency. In addition to technical displays, the Ministry of Municipality has curated an integrated program featuring specialized markets for honey, dates, and flowers, alongside interactive workshops and live demonstrations designed to highlight the strategic importance of national food production.

records.title: A consortium comprising Etihad Water and Electricity (EtihadWE), Taqa Water Solutions, and Saur International has secured a landmark cont...
records.description: A consortium comprising Etihad Water and Electricity (EtihadWE), Taqa Water Solutions, and Saur International has secured a landmark contract to develop Ras Al Khaimah’s largest wastewater treatment plant. Marking the emirate's first-ever Public-Private Partnership (PPP), the project will be delivered via a Build–Own–Operate–Transfer (BOOT) model in collaboration with the Ras Al Khaimah Public Services Department. The plant will feature a capacity of 60,000 cubic meters per day, serving a population of 300,000 and enabling the reuse of 100% of recycled water for irrigation and cooling. This strategic infrastructure expansion aligns with the UAE Net Zero 2050 Strategy and reinforces Ras Al Khaimah's vision for sustainable urban growth, environmental stewardship, and long-term economic resilience.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The National Agriculture Centre has launched the Sustainable Product initiative to increase the share of locally sourced agricultural and...
records.description: The National Agriculture Centre has launched the Sustainable Product initiative to increase the share of locally sourced agricultural and animal products in the UAE’s restaurant and hotel sector to 25%. This strategic shift by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment focuses on strengthening market demand and providing Emirati farmers with the economic confidence to expand investments, effectively bridging the marketing gap. By connecting national farm output with the luxury hospitality sector, the National Agriculture Centre aims to reduce reliance on food imports and foster a climate-smart agricultural ecosystem that utilizes advanced technology and innovation to ensure long-term food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its fisheries sector leadership, has initiated a new regulatory framework at the Al-Rahedah border c...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its fisheries sector leadership, has initiated a new regulatory framework at the Al-Rahedah border crossing to tighten oversight on the entry of fishery inputs and products. During a coordination meeting with the Red Sea Fisheries Authority and the Customs Authority, officials established procedures for permanent fisheries representation at the crossing to ensure all imports comply with national laws and health standards. The collaboration focuses on defining a specific list of authorized inputs and identifying products subject to customs duties to protect local production and prevent the entry of substandard materials. By synchronizing efforts between the Red Sea Fisheries Authority and the Customs Authority, the government aims to preserve marine resources and strengthen the national economy through more disciplined trade movement.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Statistics, Training, and Manpower Department, has launched a specialized training course focuse...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Statistics, Training, and Manpower Department, has launched a specialized training course focused on the "Smart Management of Legume Crops" to address the growing challenges of climate change. Led by experts from the Planning and Follow-up Department, the program provides ministry staff with a comprehensive framework for climate-smart agriculture, covering the entire production cycle from pre-planting strategic planning to post-harvest optimization. By emphasizing scientific and practical foundations, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to modernize the cultivation of pulses—essential for both soil nitrogen fixation and human nutrition—thereby reducing crop losses, enhancing production efficiency, and securing a sustainable food supply.

records.title: The Experimental Farm Project in Al-Lith Governorate is a 10-hectare applied research hub designed to spearhead the modernization of the...
records.description: The Experimental Farm Project in Al-Lith Governorate is a 10-hectare applied research hub designed to spearhead the modernization of the Kingdom’s agricultural sector. Built to address the specific challenges of water scarcity, the project utilizes smart irrigation systems and intelligent control platforms to maximize resource efficiency across both open fields and advanced greenhouses. By serving as a high-tech testing ground for localized agricultural knowledge, the farm not only strengthens regional food supply chains but also functions as a strategic investment model. This initiative aligns with national sustainable development goals by demonstrating how modern technology can transform challenging environments into productive, attractive opportunities for agricultural investment.
records.institution: The Experimental Farm Project in Al-Lith Governorate

records.title: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has officially moved into the enforcement phase of new licensing regulations...
records.description: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE) has officially moved into the enforcement phase of new licensing regulations designed to standardize and professionalize water conservation services across Saudi Arabia. Targeting the urban, agricultural, and industrial sectors, this regulatory framework establishes clear responsibilities for service providers and practitioners while introducing rigorous oversight mechanisms to protect beneficiaries. By formalizing activities such as water auditing, leak detection, and specialized renovation management, MAEE is creating a structured market for water-saving solutions. This move is a strategic step toward achieving the sustainability goals of Saudi Vision 2030, ensuring that water resource management adheres to high-quality technical standards and verified saving protocols.
records.institution: The National Water Efficiency and Conservation Center (MAEE)

records.title: The Supreme Council for Environment and Urban & Rural Development has inaugurated the "Ecosystem Restoration and Recovery" workshop in Kh...
records.description: The Supreme Council for Environment and Urban & Rural Development has inaugurated the "Ecosystem Restoration and Recovery" workshop in Khartoum, marking a critical phase in the state’s environmental initiative. Held under the slogan "Together for a Healthy Environment and Stable Communities" and in coordination with UNEP Sudan, the event focuses on building a unified national strategy for environmental recovery following recent shocks. Key discussions emphasized the protection of wetlands—aligned with the theme of International Day for Biological Diversity—and addressed critical threats such as the encroachment on forests, pastures, and public gardens. By involving stakeholders from the Ministry of Agriculture and Animal Resources and international consultants, the Supreme Council for Environment and Urban & Rural Development aims to eliminate jurisdictional overlaps and secure international funding for large-scale restoration projects.
records.institution: The Supreme Council for Environment and Urban & Rural Development

records.title: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture has issued an exceptional decision to authorize the import of 10,000 tons of Tunisian olive oil to...
records.description: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture has issued an exceptional decision to authorize the import of 10,000 tons of Tunisian olive oil to address a local production shortage for the 2025–2026 season. Facilitated by the Tunisian mission and commercial attaché in Amman, this initiative has already resulted in the contracting of approximately 3,000 tons following field visits by over 40 Jordanian importers. Tunisia, currently the world's second-largest producer, is experiencing a 47% production increase this season—reaching an estimated 500,000 tons—even as global output declines. Celebrated for its competitive pricing and award-winning quality, Tunisian olive oil’s reentry into the Jordanian market is supported by a surge in export activity expected to peak in early February 2026.
records.institution: The Embassy of Tunisia in Jordan

records.title: On the sidelines of Gulfood 2026, the UAE Food Cluster, in collaboration with DMCC, convened a high-level summit to solidify the UAE–Indi...
records.description: On the sidelines of Gulfood 2026, the UAE Food Cluster, in collaboration with DMCC, convened a high-level summit to solidify the UAE–India strategic partnership, with India serving as the event's Country Partner. Led by officials from the Indian Ministry of Food Processing Industries (MoFPI) and the Consulate General of India, the dialogue focused on integrating India's massive agricultural production with the UAE's world-class logistics and re-export infrastructure. A centerpiece of the engagement was the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between the UAE Food Cluster and DMCC, aimed at leveraging specialized commodity exchanges and harmonizing regulatory standards. This collaboration seeks to position both nations as a unified global food hub, building on a bilateral trade relationship that surpassed US$ 100 billion in 2025.
records.institution: The UAE Food Cluster and DMCC

records.title: The Agri-food Business Development Programme (AfBDP), funded by the European Union, recently held a high-level summit in Baghdad to showc...
records.description: The Agri-food Business Development Programme (AfBDP), funded by the European Union, recently held a high-level summit in Baghdad to showcase its progress in transforming Iraq’s agricultural landscape. Launched in 2021, the programme utilizes a comprehensive "Farm-to-Fork" approach to modernize value chains and stimulate private sector investment. Managed by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the initiative coordinates a massive partnership between seven international organizations—including GIZ, IOM, ILO, ITC, UNESCO, and Cowater International. This collective effort focuses on enhancing sustainable livelihoods, creating jobs, and strengthening national food security by bridging the gap between local production and market demand, ultimately aligning Iraq’s agricultural growth with the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Kesrouan Agricultural Center, hosted a specialized educational seminar at the Basilian Oasis Cen...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Kesrouan Agricultural Center, hosted a specialized educational seminar at the Basilian Oasis Center in Zouk Mikael to strengthen the regional dairy sector. Targeted at cattle breeders and municipal representatives, the session integrated veterinary science with practical field techniques to elevate animal health standards and maximize milk quality. A central focus was placed on combating the recent Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) SAT1 strain outbreak in Lebanon, with the Ministry emphasizing the urgency of its national vaccination campaign. By combining interactive lectures on cattle nutrition with the "Ten Golden Rules of Milking," the seminar provided a comprehensive roadmap for breeders to increase production efficiency while ensuring their products meet rigorous national health specifications.

records.title: In direct response to the urgent needs of the agricultural sector in the Gaza Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture, via the Higher Ag...
records.description: In direct response to the urgent needs of the agricultural sector in the Gaza Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture, via the Higher Agricultural Emergency Committee, has implemented a vital emergency intervention in the Sheikh Ajlin area. This initiative, executed by the Palestinian Agricultural Relief Association (PARC) in partnership with Oxfam, provided 150 farmers with an integrated package of critical production supplies, including irrigation networks, nylon for ground tunnels, organic fertilizers, and pesticides. By coordinating directly with the Gaza Governorate Agriculture Directorate, this program ensures the continuity of local vegetable production for both protected and open-field crops. Looking ahead, the Ministry of Agriculture has confirmed that additional comprehensive support projects are being finalized for the first quarter of 2026 to further strengthen farmer resilience and secure food supplies in surrounding agricultural zones.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Directorate, teamed up with the Agricultural Development Associ...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Directorate, teamed up with the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief/PARC) to distribute specialized pruning supplies to almond farmers in the town of Aqaba. This initiative, funded by the Dutch Representative Office, focuses on equipping farmers with manual tools tailored to the specific age and size of their almond trees. By promoting proper pruning techniques—such as the "Open Vase" method—the program aims to improve canopy ventilation and light penetration, which are essential for reducing the spread of fungal diseases like shot hole fungus and rust.

records.title: The Ibb Governorate has launched a series of community-led water harvesting initiatives to address water scarcity and boost agricultural...
records.description: The Ibb Governorate has launched a series of community-led water harvesting initiatives to address water scarcity and boost agricultural productivity in the Yarim and al-Radmah districts. These projects, inaugurated by the local administration, center on the construction of 300 water cisterns and the rehabilitation of several existing dams. Additionally, a new water barrier project was launched in al-Radmah to maximize the capture of seasonal rainfall. By leveraging community participation, the Ibb Governorate aims to create a more resilient and sustainable water infrastructure, ensuring a reliable resource for local farmers and supporting long-term food security in the region.

records.title: Iraq emerged as the leading importer of Turkish citrus, with trade reaching US$544 million.
records.description: Iraq emerged as the leading importer of Turkish citrus, with trade reaching US$544 million. This growth was spearheaded by a staggering 544% year-on-year increase in mandarin shipments, which have become a staple of the trade between the two nations. According to the Mediterranean Exporters' Associations, Turkish citrus exports totaled 1.5 million tons globally, with mandarins comprising 62% of the volume. While Russia and Ukraine remained significant markets—ranking second and third respectively—the surge in Iraqi demand underscores a shifting regional trade dynamic. Beyond the Middle East and CIS regions, European markets such as Poland and Romania also maintained steady imports, reflecting the successful diversification of the Turkish citrus supply chain.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has launched a specialized scientific workshop in Baghdad's Al-M...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has launched a specialized scientific workshop in Baghdad's Al-Madain District to accelerate the adoption of Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS). Organized in partnership with the Iraqi Fish Producers Association, the event focused on transitioning the national fisheries sector from traditional methods to intensive, high-efficiency closed systems. These modern technologies are designed to drastically reduce water consumption—a critical priority for Iraq’s environmental sustainability—while allowing for greater control over water quality and fish health. By showcasing successful domestic and international models, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to provide local producers with a roadmap for scaling production and strengthening national food security through climate-resilient aquaculture.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with Agridev and with the financial support of the Dutch Government, has launched the field e...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with Agridev and with the financial support of the Dutch Government, has launched the field evaluation phase of the National Good Agricultural Practices (N-GAP) project. This initiative, a core component of the National Agricultural Extension Program, aims to modernize Lebanon’s agricultural sector by transitioning toward sustainable, science-based production standards. The first phase involved diagnostic field visits to 120 farmers registered in the National Agricultural Registry, across various governorates, to assess their current implementation of N-GAP. By coordinating with central and regional experts from the Ministry of Agriculture and chambers of commerce, the project identifies technical gaps and organizational challenges. These findings will inform the development of specialized training programs designed to enhance food safety, improve product quality, and boost the international competitiveness of Lebanese agricultural exports.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Baalbek-Hermel Agricultural Department, organized a specialized training seminar in Al-Khader to...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Baalbek-Hermel Agricultural Department, organized a specialized training seminar in Al-Khader to advance the technical skills of local fruit growers. Led by Engineer Ahmad Shukr from the Nabi Sheet Agricultural Center, the session provided a scientific roadmap for pruning practices specifically adapted to the semi-arid climatic conditions of the Bekaa Valley. The seminar emphasized that proper pruning is not merely an aesthetic choice but a strategic tool for managing the "Source-and-Sink" relationship within the tree—balancing vegetative growth with high-quality fruit production. By integrating sustainable principles and modern techniques, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to boost orchard productivity, improve the market value of Lebanese fruit, and ensure the long-term health of the region's agricultural heritage.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: In a significant move to localize heavy industry within the national green hydrogen ecosystem, Meranti Green Steel has secured full bindi...
records.description: In a significant move to localize heavy industry within the national green hydrogen ecosystem, Meranti Green Steel has secured full binding offtake agreements for the entire output of its planned hydrogen-ready Hot Briquetted Iron facility at the Duqm Special Economic Zone. These long-term contracts with global industrial traders and steel producers—including Thyssenkrupp Materials Trading, INTERFER, and Glencore—bolster the project’s commercial bankability as it moves toward a final investment decision. The facility is designed to leverage a blend of natural gas and green hydrogen to produce low-carbon iron feedstock tailored for international markets, utilizing a strategic partnership with the Amnah consortium for its future hydrogen requirements. Supported by KfW IPEX-Bank and Jebsen & Jessen Industrial Solutions, the initiative capitalizes on competitive energy costs and a supportive regulatory environment to position the Duqm Special Economic Zone as a hub for cost-competitive, sustainable industrial production.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The National Water Company (NWC) has successfully planted over 2.1 million trees in the Madinah Region, marking a significant milestone i...
records.description: The National Water Company (NWC) has successfully planted over 2.1 million trees in the Madinah Region, marking a significant milestone in its contribution to the Saudi Green Initiative. By utilizing tertiary-treated wastewater from its treatment plants, the company is transforming a byproduct into a vital resource to expand vegetation cover and combat desertification. In 2025, the project accelerated with the planting of 472,000 additional trees, and the National Water Company (NWC) confirmed that approximately 200,000 trees have already reached maturity, allowing them to thrive independently. This effort, conducted in partnership with the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, aims to improve air quality, reduce emissions, and support local biodiversity while optimizing the Kingdom's water resources for sustainable urban and rural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Undersecretary for Irrigation, held a high-level technical session at the Irrigation Corporation...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Undersecretary for Irrigation, held a high-level technical session at the Irrigation Corporation headquarters in Wad Madani to optimize the management of the Upper Atbara, Seteit, and Khashm-El-Girba dams. Led by the Director-General of Dams, the presentation focused on integrating multidisciplinary engineering efforts to advance the state’s strategic water policies. The session underscored the century-long legacy of expertise in Sudanese dam management while producing actionable recommendations for improved operation and maintenance. By committing to these technical interventions, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to preserve vital water resources and ensure the long-term efficiency of these critical infrastructure projects for national development.

records.title: Tunisia’s state grain importer, the Office des Céréales (ODC), has successfully finalized an international tender for 200,000 metric tons...
records.description: Tunisia’s state grain importer, the Office des Céréales (ODC), has successfully finalized an international tender for 200,000 metric tons of wheat to secure national food supplies for the first half of 2026. The purchase is evenly split between 100,000 tons of soft milling wheat and 100,000 tons of durum wheat. Trading house Finagrit secured the soft wheat contract with competitive bids around US$256 per ton, while Amber led the durum segment at US$323.89 per ton. This strategic move comes as global prices for durum have seen a sharp year-on-year decline of 18.5%, allowing the Office des Céréales (ODC) to stabilize local markets for bread, pasta, and couscous. While an above-average domestic harvest of 1.7 million tonnes in 2025 has bolstered resilience, Tunisia still anticipates a total import requirement of 2 million tonnes for the current marketing year.

records.title: The high-level preparatory meeting for the United Nations Water Conference 2026 concluded in Dakar, serving as a critical milestone for t...
records.description: The high-level preparatory meeting for the United Nations Water Conference 2026 concluded in Dakar, serving as a critical milestone for the global summit to be hosted by the United Arab Emirates in Abu Dhabi later this year. In collaboration with the Republic of Senegal, the session focused on accelerating progress toward Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6), particularly through six newly endorsed interactive dialogues: Water for people, prosperity, planet Earth, cooperation, multilateral processes, and investment. A key highlight of the deliberations was the intrinsic link between water and food security, noting that agriculture accounts for 70% of global freshwater usage. Led by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the UAE delegation emphasized the need for "tangible impact" and targeted investments to reshape the international framework for water management, ensuring that the upcoming conference translates global solidarity into practical, sustainable initiatives for communities worldwide.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development, and International Cooperation has entered into a strategic partnership with Schneider Ele...
records.description: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development, and International Cooperation has entered into a strategic partnership with Schneider Electric Egypt to bolster the NWFE Program (Nexus on Water, Food, and Energy). This multi-year agreement focuses on deploying advanced technologies, such as solar energy and Internet of Things (IoT) systems, to create climate-resilient agricultural models within the Nile Valley. By integrating these solutions into the CROWN (Climate Resilient Water Resources Management) project, the initiative aims to empower smallholder farmers and increase resource efficiency. The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development, and International Cooperation views this collaboration as a vital step toward raising the agricultural sector's contribution to GDP to 17% by 2030, while fostering a green economy through private-sector innovation and international support from the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD).
records.institution: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development, and International Cooperation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has officially launched the Transit Management System, a sophisticated electronic platform designed to digiti...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has officially launched the Transit Management System, a sophisticated electronic platform designed to digitize and streamline the movement of agricultural and livestock goods across Iraq. By adopting a QR-based electronic veterinary health certificate system, the platform integrates the existing "Local Product" data with the national Ur portal. This initiative, approved by the Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces, enables National Security Service detachments at governorate checkpoints to instantly verify cargo through secure digital scans. The system tracks comprehensive data—including driver identity, vehicle details, cargo weight, and destination—to eliminate administrative bottlenecks, protect local production from illicit competition, and ensure rigorous health and safety standards for the Iraqi consumer.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief/PARC), has launched a ta...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief/PARC), has launched a targeted support initiative for 33 farmers in the town of Aqaba, within the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Governorate. This activity focuses on the distribution of high-quality potato seeds to cultivate an estimated 66 dunams of land (two dunams per farmer). By providing essential inputs to rural families, the project aims to stabilize local food production and enhance the economic resilience of communities in marginalized areas. This partnership underscores a shared commitment between the Ministry of Agriculture and Agricultural Relief to advance sustainable agricultural development and secure food supplies across the West Bank and Gaza Strip.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministerial Council of the Middle East Green Initiative (MGI) convened its second session in Jeddah to finalize the transition into i...
records.description: The Ministerial Council of the Middle East Green Initiative (MGI) convened its second session in Jeddah to finalize the transition into its implementation phase, marked by the formal establishment of its permanent Secretariat in Riyadh. Chaired by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the meeting welcomed Ghana, Sierra Leone, Sri Lanka, and Syria as new members, bringing the total tree-planting commitments to over 22 billion. This regional effort is mirrored by the Saudi Green Initiative (SGI), which has already seen 151 million trees planted and natural reserves expanded to cover 18% of the Kingdom's land. With a long-term goal to rehabilitate 40 million hectares and achieve 30% reserve coverage by 2030, the council emphasized that unified regional action is essential for land restoration and securing environmental sustainability for future generations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed a USD 10 million grant agreement with the UNHCR and the Republic of Sudan to rehabilitate...
records.description: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed a USD 10 million grant agreement with the UNHCR and the Republic of Sudan to rehabilitate and expand critical water supply systems. This strategic initiative focuses on improving the Nile water system in Khartoum by integrating solar-powered operations and enhancing technical capacity to ensure long-term sustainability. The project is designed to address acute water scarcity and provide equitable access to clean water for both displaced populations and their host communities. By strengthening local infrastructure, the Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) aims to mitigate the risk of waterborne diseases, bolster community health, and reduce the daily hardships faced by vulnerable families affected by conflict.

records.title: The Great Man-Made River Water Utilization Authority, in partnership with Andalus Agro-Technic, has initiated preparations for a landmark...
records.description: The Great Man-Made River Water Utilization Authority, in partnership with Andalus Agro-Technic, has initiated preparations for a landmark one-million olive tree cultivation project in the Wadi Tajmoud site of the Tarhuna mountain region. This project is set to be the first in North Africa to employ Valley (Valmont) Linear Pivot Irrigation technology specifically for large-scale olive farming. By utilizing advanced systems such as the Valley Rainger, the project aims to achieve a water application efficiency of up to 98% while reducing labor requirements by 50% through GPS-guided automation and integrated fertigation. This initiative positions Tarhuna as a regional center for advanced agro-technology, directly supporting national food security and sustainable water management objectives.
records.institution: The Great Man-Made River Water Utilization Authority

records.title: The National Oil Corporation (NOC) has launched a significant reforestation campaign at the Mellitah Industrial Complex, planting over 10...
records.description: The National Oil Corporation (NOC) has launched a significant reforestation campaign at the Mellitah Industrial Complex, planting over 10,000 eucalyptus saplings. This effort is a key component of the NOC’s "One Million Tree-planting Initiative," originally unveiled as part of the "Thinking About Tomorrow" strategy at COP28. To ensure the project's long-term success, a dedicated water network has been installed to maintain the new green spaces within the industrial complex. This regional campaign—targeting 40 sites across Libya—aims to mitigate carbon emissions, combat desertification, and increase climate resilience. Furthermore, it aligns with the broader "Green Libya Initiative," a strategic project supported by major international energy partners to plant 100 million trees nationwide.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has announced that the development of the Raysut fishing port in Salalah is 81...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has announced that the development of the Raysut fishing port in Salalah is 81% complete, with full operations expected by the first quarter of 2026. This OMR 3 million investment is designed to modernize the infrastructure for local fishermen, featuring a new 610-meter breakwater and a 60-meter fixed wharf. To ensure long-term viability, the project includes a 250-meter rock groyne to prevent siltation and the deepening of 100,000 cubic meters of sand within the basin. These upgrades, overseen by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, are part of a broader strategic matrix aimed at enhancing maritime productivity across Dhofar, with future ports planned for Mirbat, Sadah, Rakhyut, and Al Shuwaymiyah.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ) has signed landmark usufruct agreements with Mawarid Turbine to est...
records.description: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ) has signed landmark usufruct agreements with Mawarid Turbine to establish Oman's first wind turbine manufacturing and assembly plant in the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD). With an initial investment of RO 70 million ($182 million) for its first phase, the plant is designed to localise the renewable energy value chain and build a national industrial base for the energy transition. The facility will have an annual production capacity of 800 to 1,000 MW, focusing initially on the manufacturing of turbine blades and specialized components. Strategically located near the Port of Duqm to facilitate global exports, the project aligns with Oman Vision 2040 and SEZAD’s 2030 strategy to become a premier regional hub for green industries.
records.institution: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ)

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman, represented by the OPEX supervisory team, is showcasing a unified national front at Gulfood 2026 to attract high-v...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman, represented by the OPEX supervisory team, is showcasing a unified national front at Gulfood 2026 to attract high-value investments into its food and beverage sector. Through a collaborative pavilion featuring the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion, and Madayn, Oman is highlighting strategic opportunities in its free zones and industrial cities, including the newly announced Al Suwaiq Industrial City. A central focus of the participation is the "Second Billion" initiative, which aims to more than double the sector's economic contribution and increase self-sufficiency rates. By leveraging its strategic location and integrated logistics infrastructure, the Sultanate aims to substitute food imports with domestic manufacturing, localize advanced food technologies, and expand the global reach of the "Omani Product" brand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Tubas Agriculture Directorate, has facilitated a strategic partnership between the Applied Resea...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Tubas Agriculture Directorate, has facilitated a strategic partnership between the Applied Research Institute – Jerusalem (ARIJ) and local municipalities in Tubas, Tammoun, and Wadi Al-Far’a. Supported by the World Food Programme (WFP), the agreement focuses on the supply and installation of submersible water pumps for agricultural wells. This initiative is a core component of a broader project to enhance climate resilience and secure livelihoods in Palestine, particularly targeting the water-scarce regions of the northern Jordan Valley. By modernizing irrigation infrastructure, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to optimize water use efficiency, ensure the sustainable delivery of resources to farmers, and strengthen their capacity to maintain productivity in the face of increasing environmental challenges.

records.title: At Gulfood 2026, Al Ghurair Foods announced a major strategic pivot toward value-added ingredients, highlighted by the launch of its new...
records.description: At Gulfood 2026, Al Ghurair Foods announced a major strategic pivot toward value-added ingredients, highlighted by the launch of its new brand, PURL, and a US$20 million investment in a new meat coating systems plant. This facility, capable of processing 60,000 tons annually, will deliver halal-certified solutions for the snacks and protein sectors with significantly reduced lead times. Complementing this is a US$130 million non-GMO corn milling facility in KEZAD, which forms the backbone of a strategy to reduce import reliance by producing infant-grade maltodextrin, native starches, and specialty flours. By integrating these advanced manufacturing capabilities with its existing 1.5 million-ton flour production capacity, Al Ghurair Foods aims to strengthen local supply chains and expand its reach into high-growth markets across Southeast Asia and North Africa.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) has completed a three-year research program evaluati...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) has completed a three-year research program evaluating seasonal forage alternatives to replace perennial crops, which are being phased out by the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture to preserve groundwater. Working across key regions like Al-Jouf and Tabuk, Estidamah identified seven high-performing plant varieties that consume significantly less water than traditional perennials—which use up to 32,000 cubic meters per hectare. These seasonal winter forages achieve productivity rates of 8–15 tons per hectare while reducing water consumption by 50% and enhancing soil fertility. This transition is a critical component of Saudi Vision 2030, ensuring a sustainable local feed supply while protecting the Kingdom's non-renewable water resources.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic initiative to modernize Saudi Arabia's beeke...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic initiative to modernize Saudi Arabia's beekeeping sector by providing 1,800 equipment packages to beekeepers across the Kingdom. This project, which aligns with Saudi Vision 2030, focuses on transitioning from traditional methods to sustainable, technology-driven practices that optimize resource use and improve honey quality. By integrating modern hive management tools, the Saudi Reef program aims to reduce colony stress and minimize losses, while complementing the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s efforts to establish queen bee breeding stations. These combined actions are designed to enhance the genetic traits of local bee populations and strengthen the market competitiveness of Saudi honey through improved safety and production efficiency.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: The City of Science in Tunis (CST) will host the International Day of Women and Girls in Science, focusing on the intersection of sustain...
records.description: The City of Science in Tunis (CST) will host the International Day of Women and Girls in Science, focusing on the intersection of sustainable agriculture and female-led volunteering. Co-organized with the French Research Institute for Development (IRD) and the Research in Action Association (REAC), the event aligns with United Nations' priorities to address food security and climate change through the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The program features two primary panels: one showcasing innovative research in eco-friendly agricultural practices, and another highlighting the impact of women’s volunteerism in rural resource preservation. By fostering a dialogue between scientists and civil society, the City of Science in Tunis (CST) aims to strengthen territorial development and empower women as central figures in Tunisia's scientific and environmental future.
records.institution: The City of Science in Tunis (CST)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Dubai Municipality has launched the third edition of the Hatta Farming Festival at Hatta Leem Lake, a cornerstone of the "Dubai Farms" pr...
records.description: Dubai Municipality has launched the third edition of the Hatta Farming Festival at Hatta Leem Lake, a cornerstone of the "Dubai Farms" program aimed at elevating Hatta as a premier destination for agri-tourism and eco-tourism. Under the supervision of the Supreme Committee to Oversee the Development of Hatta, the festival brings together Emirati farmers, local agricultural companies, and, for the first time, specialized programs to empower People of Determination. To bolster sustainable local production, Dubai Municipality has committed AED 3.7 million in support packages, which include the distribution of over 24,000 bags of fertilizer and 5,100 bags of seeds. Running until 1st February 2026, the event features livestock beauty contests, workshops, and market platforms designed to strengthen Dubai’s food security while empowering the next generation of farmers through modern technology and expert advisory services.

records.title: The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) has officially endorsed a scientific twinning programme between the Abu Dhabi Agriculture...
records.description: The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) has officially endorsed a scientific twinning programme between the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) and the State Central Veterinary Laboratory (SCVL) of Mongolia. This three-year partnership (2025–2028) positions Abu Dhabi as a global reference hub, tasked with qualifying Mongolia’s laboratory as a regional reference center for camel diseases in Central Asia. The initiative focuses on a comprehensive "One Health" approach, providing Mongolia with advanced technical training in viral isolation, biobank management, and diagnostic reagent production. By aligning with international ISO standards, the programme strengthens global biosecurity and enhances the early detection of zoonotic threats, such as MERS-CoV and Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), across both Dromedary and Bactrian camel populations.
records.institution: The World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in strategic partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and with fun...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in strategic partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and with funding from the People's Republic of China, has officially launched the "One Country, One Product" (OCOP) initiative in Iraq. This global program identifies the date palm as Iraq's high-priority agricultural product, aiming to revitalize the entire value chain—from cultivation and processing to increasing competitiveness in international markets. Represented by the Mesopotamia General Company for Seeds, the ministry outlined a comprehensive roadmap to improve production efficiency and modernization. By selecting dates, the Ministry of Agriculture highlights the fruit's critical role as both an economic pillar and a deeply rooted symbol of Iraqi heritage, ensuring that this sector becomes a driver for national food security and sustainable agricultural growth.

records.title: The Agricultural Credit Corporation has significantly expanded its financial support for Jordan's agricultural sector, providing JD 46 mi...
records.description: The Agricultural Credit Corporation has significantly expanded its financial support for Jordan's agricultural sector, providing JD 46 million in loans to over 12,880 farmers and investors in 2025—a JD 7 million increase over the previous year. Under the leadership of the Agricultural Credit Corporation, the institution disbursed JD 11 million in interest-free subsidized loans and JD 9 million through Islamic financing, targeting critical priorities such as food processing, livestock development, and the adoption of modern water technologies. A key focus remains on social equity, with JD 8 million allocated to combat unemployment and specific programs designed to empower 3,650 female entrepreneurs. By increasing its capital to JD 100 million and partnering with entities like the World Bank and the Jordan Loan Guarantee Corporation, the Agricultural Credit Corporation is strengthening the resilience of rural and Bedouin communities while fostering a technologically advanced, climate-smart agricultural economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jezzine Agricultural Center and in collaboration with the Sidon Agricultural Cooperative, conduc...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jezzine Agricultural Center and in collaboration with the Sidon Agricultural Cooperative, conducted a specialized training course on "Agricultural Waste Management and Compost Production" in Sidon. Attended by over 39 farmers and regional stakeholders, the program focused on the sustainable conversion of agricultural waste into organic compost to promote a circular economy in rural Lebanon. Under the guidance of the Ministry of Agriculture, participants learned practical methods to improve soil fertility and reduce dependency on costly chemical inputs, thereby enhancing both environmental protection and the economic sustainability of local farms. The initiative concluded with the distribution of compost supported by the J.Grove Foundation, marking a tangible step toward the nationwide adoption of sustainable, low-cost agricultural practices.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Oman is advancing a comprehensive zero-carbon strategy rooted in Oman Vision 2040, achieving a global ranking of 55th on the Environmenta...
records.description: Oman is advancing a comprehensive zero-carbon strategy rooted in Oman Vision 2040, achieving a global ranking of 55th on the Environmental Performance Index. Led by the Environment Authority, the Sultanate has implemented 589 environmental projects over the last five years, including the "Blue Carbon" initiative, which aims to plant 100 million mangrove trees to sequester 14 million tonnes of carbon dioxide. Beyond reforestation, the Ministry of Economy highlights a robust legislative framework that has achieved a 99.2% response rate to pollution reports and an 82% compliance rate with environmental penalties. These efforts are complemented by the "Rozna" system for sustainable building certification and innovative waste management programs that convert green waste into fertilizer and recycle construction debris, ensuring a balanced approach to biodiversity protection and carbon neutrality

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jerusalem Agriculture Directorate and the Jerusalem Veterinary Department, has implemented a com...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jerusalem Agriculture Directorate and the Jerusalem Veterinary Department, has implemented a comprehensive livestock tagging and vaccination campaign in areas east of Jerusalem. This initiative specifically targets farmers benefiting from the European aid project, combining field assessments of sheep pens with rigorous health monitoring to ensure compliance with technical specifications. As part of the National Veterinary Prevention Program, veterinary teams are numbering and vaccinating herds to build a robust data system and curb the spread of epidemic diseases. By integrating infrastructure oversight with disease prevention, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to improve animal production efficiency and bolster the resilience of farming families in the Jerusalem Governorate, contributing to long-term sustainable agricultural development.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The Ministerial Council of the Middle East Green Initiative is convening its second session in Jeddah to transition from its foundational...
records.description: The Ministerial Council of the Middle East Green Initiative is convening its second session in Jeddah to transition from its foundational stage to a decisive implementation phase. Bringing together representatives from 31 member states across Asia and Africa, the council is focused on activating flagship projects aimed at planting 50 billion trees and rehabilitating 200 million hectares of degraded land. These efforts, supported by a General Secretariat based in Riyadh, seek to reduce global carbon dioxide emissions by 10% while significantly improving air quality and biodiversity protection. The session reinforces a collective regional commitment to climate mitigation and land restoration, backed by long-term operational support and a dedicated governance framework under the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) has achieved a major milestone in global food safety by officially joining the Joint FAO/WHO Exp...
records.description: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) has achieved a major milestone in global food safety by officially joining the Joint FAO/WHO Expert Committee on Food Additives (JECFA). The appointment of an SFDA expert to the committee’s Roster of Experts highlights the Kingdom's growing scientific influence and professional capacity in risk assessment. This committee is responsible for setting critical international health guidelines, such as Acceptable Daily Intake (ADI) and Tolerable Daily Intake (TDI), which serve as the scientific backbone for the Codex Alimentarius Commission. By participating in the JECFA, the SFDA will play a proactive role in shaping global food policies, aligning national safety frameworks with international best practices, and advancing the strategic objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 to protect public health through science-based regulation.
records.institution: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA)

records.title: At Gulfood 2026, the Mahsool national agri-food initiative signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with NRTC (Nassar Al Rifai...
records.description: At Gulfood 2026, the Mahsool national agri-food initiative signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with NRTC (Nassar Al Rifai Trading Company) to scale domestic food production and solidify the UAE's food security. Endorsed by His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the partnership combines Mahsool’s technology-driven farming platform with NRTC’s commercial distribution network and ESG Agro’s operational expertise. The collaboration currently manages 100 high-tech, climate-controlled greenhouses with a roadmap to reach 400 farms within five years. By 2026, the initiative is projected to produce 20,000 tonnes of high-quality, pesticide-free crops—including cherry tomatoes, capsicum, and eggplant—supported by a state-of-the-art packhouse capable of handling 300 tonnes per day, significantly reducing the nation's reliance on food imports.
records.institution: The Mahsool, NRTC (Nassar Al Rifai Trading Company)
