records.title: Expo Centre Sharjah is launching the third edition of the Al Dhaid Agriculture Exhibition, a premier specialized event dedicated to advan...
records.description: Expo Centre Sharjah is launching the third edition of the Al Dhaid Agriculture Exhibition, a premier specialized event dedicated to advancing sustainable farming and food security in the UAE. Organized with the support of the Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Sharjah Department of Agriculture and Livestock, the exhibition unites over 40 leading companies to showcase innovations in hydroponics, vertical farming, smart irrigation, and livestock management. By bringing together policymakers, industry experts, and farmers, the event serves as a vital hub for addressing climate challenges and water efficiency while providing access to modern machinery and pest control solutions. The program further supports the UAE National Food Security Strategy 2051 through interactive workshops focused on high-yield, climate-resilient crops and efficient supply chain management.
records.institution: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Sharjah Department of Agriculture and Livestock

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Sharjah Cooperative, in partnership with the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), has officially launched the 6th Farmers...
records.description: Sharjah Cooperative, in partnership with the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), has officially launched the 6th Farmers’ Forum at Rahmania Mall. Running under the slogan “Our roots are the foundation of our future,” the event serves as a strategic community platform to strengthen the national food security ecosystem and support local producers. The forum features 25 dedicated booths showcasing Emirati organic products, honey, and fresh produce, alongside a "Shop and Win" initiative to incentivize the purchase of national goods. By integrating interactive workshops for children and a dedicated section for productive families, the Sharjah Cooperative aims to foster a culture of sustainable agriculture and community resilience, aligning with the Year of the Family objectives and the long-term vision of Sharjah's leadership to build a self-sufficient, sustainable food system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation has reaffirmed its strategic partnership with UNESCO to advance water management and clima...
records.description: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation has reaffirmed its strategic partnership with UNESCO to advance water management and climate resilience across Africa and the Middle East. During a high-level meeting, the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation highlighted the success of joint initiatives under the AWARe program, specifically the "Green Water Dialogue" track and the regional water training provided through the African Centre for Water and Climate Adaptation (PACWA). Key accomplishments discussed included a 2025 climate risk decision-analysis program and UNESCO's long-standing sponsorship of Cairo Water Week. By leveraging the International Hydrological Programme, the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation aims to continue prioritizing scientific research and capacity building to address the urgent challenges of water scarcity and sustainable development in the region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation

records.title: Iraq emerged as the second-largest importer of Turkish fresh fruits and vegetables in 2025, recording a massive 114% increase to reach a...
records.description: Iraq emerged as the second-largest importer of Turkish fresh fruits and vegetables in 2025, recording a massive 114% increase to reach a total value of $838.7 million. According to the Mediterranean Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Exporters' Association, Iraq’s demand contributed significantly to Turkey’s overall $3.7 billion fresh produce export sector, placing it just behind Russia ($865.1 million) and ahead of Romania. Beyond fresh produce, the Istanbul Exporters' Associations noted that Iraq remains a cornerstone of Turkey's broader trade economy, ranking as the second-largest overall export destination for Istanbul-based companies with $11.45 billion in trade during the first 11 months of the year. This growth highlights Iraq's status as a critical regional market for agricultural supplies and a key driver of the Mediterranean trade corridor.
records.institution: Mediterranean Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Exporters' Association

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Forestry and Desertification Control Department, has launched a three-year development initiativ...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Forestry and Desertification Control Department, has launched a three-year development initiative under the Desert Oases Project. In collaboration with the World Food Programme (WFP) and the Anbar Agriculture Directorate, the department conducted a specialized "Sustainable Land Management" training course designed to enhance Iraq's environmental resilience and food security. Under the leadership of the Forestry and Desertification Control Department, the program focuses on rehabilitating arid lands, expanding green spaces, and empowering local farmers—with a specific emphasis on the inclusion of women in agricultural development. This strategic partnership aims to deploy modern land management techniques across desert areas to combat desertification and create sustainable livelihoods for rural communities.

records.title: The National Agricultural Research Centre (NARC) and the Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) have signed a stra...
records.description: The National Agricultural Research Centre (NARC) and the Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) have signed a strategic agreement to preserve and genetically enhance local almond varieties in Jordan. This initiative focuses on the scientific documentation and morphological analysis of indigenous almond strains to improve their productivity and resilience against climate change and genetic erosion. In a separate milestone, the FAO, in partnership with the Greater Amman Municipality (GAM), concluded a nature-based water security project that established constructed wetlands in urban parks. These "Eco-Wetlands" utilize biological filtration systems—combining specialized plants and microorganisms—to treat greywater for safe reuse. By integrating low-cost, decentralized water solutions and safeguarding agricultural genetic resources, these institutions are working to bolster Jordan's national food security and urban sustainability.

records.title: The Commission for Food Security has taken delivery of over 4,300 tons of rice in Nouakchott as a vital component of a long-standing inte...
records.description: The Commission for Food Security has taken delivery of over 4,300 tons of rice in Nouakchott as a vital component of a long-standing international food aid partnership. This significant shipment is intended to be sold at public auction, with the generated proceeds directly funding development and social projects designed to support the most vulnerable citizens. By focusing on uplifting marginalized groups and strengthening national food security, the Commission for Food Security is implementing a development-oriented approach to reduce food insecurity. This collaboration continues a decades-long history of regular aid delivery, reinforcing international partnerships and advancing efforts to eliminate food insecurity through sustainable, community-focused initiatives.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests has reaffirmed its commitment to a strategic agr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests has reaffirmed its commitment to a strategic agricultural partnership with Senegal, positioning Morocco’s agro-industrial model as a blueprint for African cooperation. During a high-level meeting in Rabat, Senegal’s Minister of Agriculture, Food Sovereignty and Livestock praised Morocco's integrated value chains and urged Moroccan private sector actors to invest in Senegal’s vast arable land and water resources. The discussions highlighted the pivotal role of Moroccan banking institutions already present in Senegal to finance large-scale industrial and agricultural projects. This partnership aims to reduce Senegal’s $1.6 billion annual food import bill by leveraging Moroccan technical know-how in horticulture and livestock, ultimately strengthening food security and sustainable development for both nations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources has officially launched eight new environmental industry activities, establishing a struct...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources has officially launched eight new environmental industry activities, establishing a structured industrial pathway to promote investment and sustainability. Supported by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the Ministry of Municipal and Rural Affairs and Housing, and the National Center for Waste Management (MWAN), this initiative allows companies to obtain specialized licenses via the Senaa’i platform. These newly regulated activities focus on the recycling and reuse of municipal, industrial, and hazardous waste, alongside the production of organic fertilizers and the conversion of waste into alternative fuels or electricity. By integrating waste classification and primary sorting into industrial value chains, the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources aims to improve resource efficiency, reduce carbon emissions, and solidify the Kingdom's position as a leader in the circular economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has signed memoranda of understanding with eigh...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has signed memoranda of understanding with eight non-profit environmental associations to accelerate national targets for ecological restoration and sustainability. This strategic partnership—including organizations such as the Hail Agriculture Development Association and the Yanbu Environmental Association—aims to decentralize environmental efforts by integrating volunteer and community-led initiatives into the national framework. The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) will collaborate with these non-profits on large-scale afforestation, the rehabilitation of degraded lands, and the development of nature-based tourism destinations. By facilitating expertise exchange and technical training, this initiative seeks to build local capacities and foster a culture of environmental stewardship across the Kingdom, directly supporting Saudi Arabia's long-term sustainability and climate resilience goals.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: Tunisia launched its most ambitious reforestation program to date, a "green belt" initiative led by the Ministry of the Environment in co...
records.description: Tunisia launched its most ambitious reforestation program to date, a "green belt" initiative led by the Ministry of the Environment in coordination with the General Directorates of Forests. This strategic corridor, extending along highways and through sensitive central and southern regions, is designed to halt desertification and protect vital agricultural land from sand encroachment and soil degradation. To ensure the project's sustainability in arid conditions, the Ministry of the Environment is prioritizing drought-resistant species and innovative irrigation methods, such as the use of treated wastewater. Beyond its ecological goals, the project carries a significant socio-economic mandate by fostering agroforestry, creating local jobs in nurseries and maintenance, and involving civil society organizations to strengthen national climate resilience and food sovereignty.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), through its subsidiary Moro Hub, has announced that construction on Phase I of its 100MW so...
records.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), through its subsidiary Moro Hub, has announced that construction on Phase I of its 100MW solar-powered Green Data Centre in Warsan is set to begin later this year. Spanning 66,000 square meters, this facility marks the company’s fourth green data center and is designed to provide AI-ready, sustainable digital infrastructure for the UAE. Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is collaborating with international engineering consultancies to ensure the center meets global standards for energy efficiency, cooling, and advanced cloud-hosting solutions. By integrating clean energy with digital innovation, the project aims to reinforce Dubai's position as a global leader in the green economy and provide a resilient foundation for the region's digital transformation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has launched a specialized feeding program for grass carp broods...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Animal Resources, has launched a specialized feeding program for grass carp broodstock at the Al-Suwaira Fish Hatchery. After isolating the fish in designated tanks, the Ministry of Agriculture is utilizing a diet primarily based on aquatic plants, supplemented with alfalfa and clover grown on-site, to stimulate reproductive development and increase fertility levels ahead of the breeding season. The program involves calculating precise feed ratios based on the live weight of the fish and continuous monitoring of feed consumption. Additionally, specialized personnel are tracking environmental indicators within the tanks to maintain optimal conditions, ensuring the success of the hatchery's technical plans for high-quality fish breeding and sustainable production.

records.title: The Ajloun Agriculture Directorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Local Administration, and the Minis...
records.description: The Ajloun Agriculture Directorate, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Local Administration, and the Ministry of Youth, has launched a major afforestation campaign as part of a national initiative to plant 10 million trees across the Kingdom. To protect this vital green cover, the Ajloun Agriculture Directorate has intensified monitoring efforts, recording 97 forestry violations in the past year and achieving judicial rulings in 90% of cases to deter illegal logging and arson. The Jordan Environment Society further highlighted that these efforts are supported by the National Executive Program to Reduce Random Waste Dumping, which aims to minimize pollution in natural sites. By addressing challenges such as frost, overgrazing, and human encroachment, these institutions are working together to preserve forests as essential assets for soil protection, air quality, and biodiversity.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a national livestock numbering and vaccination campaign from the Salfit Governorate to support t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a national livestock numbering and vaccination campaign from the Salfit Governorate to support the resilience of local farmers and enhance national food security. Funded by the Ministry of Agriculture and international partners, including the European Union, the initiative aims to document and inventory herds while implementing a preventive vaccination program to reduce disease spread and improve animal production efficiency. In its current phase, the campaign is specifically targeting 35 affected farmers in Salfit before expanding to all other governorates according to a nationwide strategic plan. This intervention is designed to alleviate the economic burdens on livestock breeders and ensure the long-term sustainability of the agricultural sector amidst challenging environmental and economic conditions.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, has conducted specialized technical training for farm...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, has conducted specialized technical training for farmers in the town of Arraba as part of the EVAP 3 project. Implemented in cooperation with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), this initiative focused on disseminating modern agricultural techniques and production guidelines to 14 participants from local farms. The EVAP project serves as a key extension program designed to improve resource management, increase production efficiency, and specifically empower rural women within the agricultural sector. These training sessions are a core component of the Ministry of Agriculture’s broader strategy to enhance the sustainability of Palestinian farming and strengthen the resilience of rural communities through knowledge transfer and innovation.

records.title: In the Qassim Region, hydroponic farming has evolved from an innovative alternative to a cornerstone of the provincial agricultural economy.
records.description: In the Qassim Region, hydroponic farming has evolved from an innovative alternative to a cornerstone of the provincial agricultural economy. As of 2026, the region has solidified its status as a national leader in Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA), hosting over 14,600 greenhouses that produce more than 115,000 tons of crops annually. This technological surge is primarily driven by the need to mitigate groundwater depletion—which has historically fallen by nearly 0.6 meters per year—by utilizing systems that consume up to 90% less water than traditional open-field irrigation.

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The fifth edition of the Saudi International Marine Exhibition (SIMEC) has launched in Riyadh, serving as a premier global platform for t...
records.description: The fifth edition of the Saudi International Marine Exhibition (SIMEC) has launched in Riyadh, serving as a premier global platform for the fisheries, aquaculture, and maritime service sectors. Featuring participants from more than 30 countries and over 120 local and international companies, the exhibition showcases cutting-edge innovations in seafood processing, shipbuilding, and algae production while facilitating strategic cooperation between global investors. With thousands of business leaders and visitors in attendance, the Saudi International Marine Exhibition (SIMEC) highlights critical investment opportunities and addresses global challenges related to food security and environmental sustainability. The event is set to host the signing of numerous cooperation agreements, reinforcing the Kingdom's role as a vital hub for international trade and the sustainable development of marine resources.

records.title: The Jordan Chamber of Commerce has announced that food prices across the Kingdom are expected to remain stable during the upcoming month...
records.description: The Jordan Chamber of Commerce has announced that food prices across the Kingdom are expected to remain stable during the upcoming month of Ramadan, supported by sufficient national stocks and advanced procurement strategies. While the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) reported an 8.2% year-on-year increase in global food prices—driven by surges in sugar, dairy, and oils—the Jordan Chamber of Commerce notes that local merchants have secured enough inventory to buffer consumers from most sharp movements. The only anticipated exception involves vegetable oils, which have risen by 10% in exporting markets and may see partial local adjustments. Experts attribute this relative stability to the effectiveness of Jordan's supply chain management and diversified import strategies, which continue to protect the local market from significant external inflationary shocks during peak consumption periods.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully reached the 33-day mark of its national vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully reached the 33-day mark of its national vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease, completing the first dose for all targeted cattle herds across Lebanon. Under the strategic direction of the Livestock Directorate, the campaign has moved into its second phase to boost immunity while simultaneously expanding coverage to include sheep and goats. This proactive initiative is designed to mitigate the risks of transboundary animal diseases, thereby protecting the livelihoods of rural farmers and ensuring the continuity of national food production. By adhering to rigorous veterinary standards and implementing a field-based monitoring plan, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to stabilize the livestock sector and reinforce a sustainable agricultural economy through preventative health measures rather than reactive crisis management.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation has initiated a critical rehabilitation project at the Jebel Aulia Dam to repair infrastructur...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation has initiated a critical rehabilitation project at the Jebel Aulia Dam to repair infrastructure damaged by sabotage and ensure the continued stability of the nation’s water sector. During a recent inspection, the Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation confirmed that preliminary technical studies are being finalized in collaboration with the University of Khartoum Advisory Authority and the Joint Nile Water Technical Authority to restore the dam's navigation channel. The maintenance plan includes repairing essential gates, servicing heavy machinery, and refurbishing operational buildings. To protect the reservoir's long-term efficiency, a specialized technical team has also been formed to combat Nile weed infestations, drawing on expertise from hydraulic research centers and plant protection units. This effort underscores the state's commitment to safeguarding vital water resources and maintaining uninterrupted flows for agricultural and domestic use.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Energy and Renewable Energies has launched the "Project of the Century," a comprehensive 15 GW renewable energy plan desi...
records.description: The Ministry of Energy and Renewable Energies has launched the "Project of the Century," a comprehensive 15 GW renewable energy plan designed to secure Algeria's energy independence and establish the nation as a major green energy exporter. During a site visit in Tipaza province, the Ministry of Energy and Renewable Energies confirmed that the first phase will bring approximately 1,100 MW online by June, forming part of a broader 3,200 MW regional expansion. The strategy emphasizes diversifying the national energy mix through solar, wind, and hydropower, while simultaneously initiating feasibility studies for green hydrogen production. By integrating these clean energy sources, the Ministry of Energy and Renewable Energies aims to support energy-dependent sectors like agriculture, provide electricity to isolated rural areas, and significantly reduce the country’s carbon footprint in alignment with global climate goals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Renewable Energies

records.title: Egypt has significantly strengthened its position in the Japanese citrus market, with orange export volumes increasing more than tenfold...
records.description: Egypt has significantly strengthened its position in the Japanese citrus market, with orange export volumes increasing more than tenfold during the 2024/25 season. According to data from EastFruit, Japan imported 2,700 tons of Egyptian oranges valued at $1.5 million, marking a hundredfold increase since trade first opened in 2020. This growth was driven by Egyptian exporters successfully meeting the rigorous Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries (MAFF) standards and leveraging competitive pricing as currency fluctuations impacted traditional suppliers like the United States and Australia. By providing consistent volumes and improved grading, Egypt has now ascended to become one of Japan's top three orange suppliers, successfully diversifying its export footprint despite logistical challenges in the Red Sea and shifts in domestic juice processing demand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries

records.title: Morocco has reached a historic breakthrough in the US frozen strawberry market, capitalizing on a significant shift in global supply chai...
records.description: Morocco has reached a historic breakthrough in the US frozen strawberry market, capitalizing on a significant shift in global supply chains to become a top-five global exporter. During the first ten months of 2025, the Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests oversaw a 22% increase in exports to the United States, totaling 7,900 tons valued at $19 million. This surge was largely driven by a sharp decline in Mexican exports, which were hampered by anti-dumping duties and adverse weather, allowing Moroccan producers in regions like Gharb, Loukkos, and Souss-Massa to fill the gap. June 2025 marked a record peak for the sector, with 2,500 tons shipped in a single month. This achievement highlights the success of Morocco's strategy to diversify its soft fruit markets beyond Europe, leveraging advanced freezing technologies and strict adherence to international food safety standards to secure nearly 18% of its total frozen strawberry exports in the American market.

records.title: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) recently hosted an international Codex Alimentarius workshop in Riyadh, bringing together global...
records.description: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) recently hosted an international Codex Alimentarius workshop in Riyadh, bringing together global leaders from the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the World Health Organization (WHO) to shape the future of global food safety. Under the theme “One Codex: Together We Learn, Together We Lead,” the event focused on the strategic roadmap for 2026–2031, with a particular emphasis on integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI) to modernize food standard operations. By facilitating inter-regional coordination and developing new mechanisms for implementing safety texts, the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) underscored Saudi Arabia's growing influence in international food governance. The workshop concluded with a commitment to enhancing the capacity of regional coordinators and using data-driven indicators to ensure robust consumer health protections worldwide.
records.institution: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA)

records.title: The agricultural union in Siliana has raised an urgent alert regarding a severe shortage of nitrogen fertilizer, revealing that only 7% o...
records.description: The agricultural union in Siliana has raised an urgent alert regarding a severe shortage of nitrogen fertilizer, revealing that only 7% of the required ammonium nitrate has been supplied to local farmers. This scarcity poses a significant threat to the cereal harvest, as timely fertilization is critical for crop development during the current sowing season. In addition to addressing input shortages, the agricultural union in Siliana called for the immediate disbursement of compensation for farmers affected by natural disasters and highlighted the financial strain on the olive sector, where producers are facing a combination of rising production costs and declining market prices for olive oil.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Tunisia is significantly advancing its renewable energy goals through the ELMED project, which involves deploying 400 MW of solar photovo...
records.description: Tunisia is significantly advancing its renewable energy goals through the ELMED project, which involves deploying 400 MW of solar photovoltaic capacity across Sidi Bouzid and Gafsa. Supported by the Delegation of the European Union in Tunisia with €35.8 million in grants and additional financing from the EBRD and EIB, this initiative is a cornerstone of the national strategy to generate 35% of electricity from renewables by 2030 and 50% by 2035. The project will modernize the Tunisian Electricity and Gas Company (STEG) network and facilitate green energy exports to Europe via a submarine interconnector. Parallel to these large-scale efforts, the National Agency for Energy Management (ANME) has launched a funding call for municipalities to implement energy efficiency and self-consumption projects, targeting optimized public lighting and urban mobility as part of a broader shift toward carbon neutrality.
records.institution: The National Agency for Energy Management (ANME)

records.title: Egypt’s fresh and processed agricultural exports achieved a record-breaking $11.5bn in 2025, accounting for nearly 24% of the nation’s to...
records.description: Egypt’s fresh and processed agricultural exports achieved a record-breaking $11.5bn in 2025, accounting for nearly 24% of the nation’s total exports and solidifying its role as a primary economic driver. According to the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, export volumes surged to 9.5 million tonnes, with Egypt maintaining its status as the world’s leading orange exporter for the sixth consecutive year. The Central Administration of Agricultural Quarantine reported significant growth in key commodities, including potatoes, sweet potatoes, and grapes, with products now reaching 167 countries. This success is attributed to the full digitization of quarantine services, the implementation of a comprehensive farm coding system for traceability, and the opening of over 25 new markets in East Asia and Latin America. By adhering to rigorous international phytosanitary standards, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation continues to enhance the global competitiveness of Egyptian produce while ensuring long-term food security and foreign currency stability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, has intensified field operations in Baghdad to combat the red palm...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, has intensified field operations in Baghdad to combat the red palm weevil as part of a national strategy to protect Iraq’s palm groves. Working in coordination with the Baghdad Agriculture Directorate, specialized technical teams are conducting early detection, accurate diagnosis, and rapid interventions to control infestations and minimize losses for this strategic crop. These efforts rely on scientific monitoring and provide farmers with essential technical guidance on prevention and the proper handling of infested trees. By prioritizing these control measures, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to preserve the country's agricultural heritage and ensure the long-term health of its palm oil and date-producing sectors.

records.title: Municipalities across Jordan, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Local Administration, and the Ministry of...
records.description: Municipalities across Jordan, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Local Administration, and the Ministry of Youth, have launched a massive nationwide afforestation campaign to mark Arbor Day. Spanning regions from Amman and Mafraq to Karak and Tafilah, the initiative has already seen the planting of thousands of forest, shade, and fruit trees, contributing to a national target of over 250,000 new trees. Significant localized efforts include the "Greener Mafraq" initiative and large-scale plantings in Salt and Greater Amman, supported by volunteers from the "Green Volunteering" program. Beyond planting, the Ministry of Local Administration has emphasized a shift toward long-term sustainability by mandating post-planting care, including water-efficient irrigation and regular monitoring, to ensure these new green spaces mitigate climate change and enhance the Kingdom's urban landscape.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, the Electricity Distribution Company (EDCO), and the Jordan En...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, the Electricity Distribution Company (EDCO), and the Jordan Enterprise Development Corporation (JEDCO) have signed a JD14.45 million memorandum of understanding to revitalize the Agricultural Development Industrial Complex in the Southern Ghor region. Under this five-year agreement, the Ministry of Agriculture will provide approximately JD4.8 million for factory infrastructure, while additional funds are allocated for roads, sewage, and high-tech security systems. The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources will lead the energy strategy for the site, with EDCO managing power distribution and JEDCO offering technical and financial support to agribusiness SMEs. The project mandates that production must begin within two years, utilizing at least 30% local added value, and is projected to create 1,300 jobs for the local community, significantly boosting the socio-economic landscape of the southern Karak governorate.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources, the Electricity Distribution Company (EDCO)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Green Project, has reached a major milestone in North Lebanon by signing support contracts with...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Green Project, has reached a major milestone in North Lebanon by signing support contracts with 47 farmers across the Akkar, Minieh-Dinnieh, Batroun, Bcharreh, Koura, and Zgharta regions. Funded by the Government of the Kingdom of Denmark and implemented in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), this initiative focuses on reclaiming uncultivated land, constructing concrete irrigation reservoirs, and building retaining walls to prevent soil erosion. These efforts are part of a strategic plan to modernize agricultural infrastructure and enhance the resilience of rural communities against climate change and economic instability. By linking development support directly to production, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to transform the sector into a sustainable economic driver for the country's most vulnerable areas.

records.title: The Environment Authority in Musandam is implementing a comprehensive suite of conservation programs to protect the region's unique marin...
records.description: The Environment Authority in Musandam is implementing a comprehensive suite of conservation programs to protect the region's unique marine and terrestrial biodiversity, including coral reefs, dolphins, and turtles. To address challenges such as overfishing and oil pollution, the Environment Authority utilizes modern monitoring technologies and field patrols while enforcing strict environmental regulations. Key initiatives currently underway include the “Tharwa” coral reef rehabilitation project, mangrove planting in Dibba, and the conservation of wildlife within the Musandam Governorate National Natural Park Reserve. These efforts by the Environment Authority are designed to balance tourism with environmental protection, ensuring long-term sustainability through scientific research, community awareness, and active habitat restoration.
records.institution: The Environment Authority in Musandam Governorate

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is spearheading the construction of two major fishing harbours in Hasik and Ha...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is spearheading the construction of two major fishing harbours in Hasik and Hadbeen at a total cost of RO5.8mn. Currently, the Hadbeen project has reached 50% completion while Hasik stands at 34%, with both sites involving the installation of breakwaters, floating pontoons, and modern lighting systems. These projects are part of a strategic infrastructure plan managed by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources to modernize marine resource utilization and support sustainable investment in the Dhofar region. By facilitating higher landing volumes and providing integrated marketing and maintenance services, these harbours are designed to enhance the fisheries sector’s contribution to the national economy and create new growth opportunities for coastal communities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jerusalem Agriculture Directorate, supervised a strategic distribution of livestock fodder to Be...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jerusalem Agriculture Directorate, supervised a strategic distribution of livestock fodder to Bedouin communities in the Khan al-Ahmar area. In partnership with the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief) and with funding from CARE International, the initiative provided 52 farmers across the communities of Abu al-Hilu, al-Madrasa, al-Tabna, Abu Falah, and al-Mahtoush with a total of 94 tons of barley and straw. This intervention is a key component of a multi-sectoral humanitarian project designed to enhance food security and support the resilience of livestock owners facing significant environmental and economic challenges. By securing essential feed supplies, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to protect the livelihoods of these vulnerable families and ensure the continuity of traditional agricultural production in the region.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, supervised the delivery of high-quality shade nets to 25 g...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, supervised the delivery of high-quality shade nets to 25 grape farmers in the town of Halhul as part of the "Grape Value Chain Development Project." This initiative, implemented by the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief) in partnership with the World Food Programme (WFP), aims to modernize agricultural infrastructure in the Hebron and Bethlehem governorates. By providing these specialized nets, the Ministry of Agriculture is helping farmers reduce climate-related crop damage and improve the overall quality of production. These interventions are designed to boost the efficiency of the grape sector, increase household income for both male and female farmers, and ensure the long-term sustainability of one of Palestine's most vital agricultural industries.

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic project to modernize the traditional fishing...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a strategic project to modernize the traditional fishing sector by equipping small-scale boats with high-efficiency marine engines and satellite distress beacons. Implemented across the Makkah, Madinah, Tabuk, Aseer, Jazan, and Eastern regions, the initiative distributed 450 engines and 1,000 emergency devices to enhance maritime safety and operational efficiency. By upgrading the infrastructure of local fish supply chains and ensuring compliance with global safety standards, Saudi Reef aims to protect the lives of fishermen and reduce material losses while boosting the sector's economic viability. This project aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 by promoting the optimal use of state resources and transforming traditional fishing into a more sustainable and attractive source of income.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: The National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI) reported a period of extreme price volatility at the Bir El Kassaâ wholesale market, cha...
records.description: The National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI) reported a period of extreme price volatility at the Bir El Kassaâ wholesale market, characterized by a dramatic surge in citrus prices alongside a decline for other fruits like apples and pears. According to data from the National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI), clementine prices jumped by 44% and lemons by 11% due to significant supply contractions caused by drought and fluctuating temperatures. Conversely, a surplus in the market led to a 23% price drop for apples and a 28% drop for pears, providing some relief to consumers but squeezing the margins of small retailers. This dual dynamic, exacerbated by rising logistical and energy costs, highlights structural vulnerabilities in the agricultural sector, leading to selective food inflation and a weakened purchasing power for households reliant on staple citrus varieties.

records.title: The Tadweer Group has partnered with the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR) to launch "Waste-to-Value," a stra...
records.description: The Tadweer Group has partnered with the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR) to launch "Waste-to-Value," a strategic initiative consisting of academic-industry workshops designed to solve critical challenges in the waste management sector. Held during the World Future Energy Summit, the inaugural workshop focused on the recovery of green waste, seeking technically and financially viable ways to transform agricultural byproducts into high-value market products. Through this collaboration, the Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MoHESR) facilitates the integration of university research with national sustainability priorities, matching academic experts with real-world operational data provided by the Tadweer Group. This partnership aims to enhance waste segregation and feedstock quality, ultimately providing tangible benefits for farmers and supporting the UAE’s transition toward a circular economy and a more resilient future.

records.title: The Zayed International Foundation for the Environment, in partnership with the Dubai Police Academy and Curtin University Dubai, success...
records.description: The Zayed International Foundation for the Environment, in partnership with the Dubai Police Academy and Curtin University Dubai, successfully hosted the 1st International Conference on Green AI to explore how advanced technology can address urgent environmental challenges. Held under the theme "Harnessing AI Applications for Environmental Sustainability," the event gathered global experts to discuss AI’s role in climate resilience, emission reduction, and the management of water and energy resources. Key focus areas included smart environmental governance, biodiversity protection, and the development of sustainable cities through innovative digital solutions like air quality monitoring and natural risk forecasting. By integrating a specialized exhibition of green technologies with high-level policy discussions, the Zayed International Foundation for the Environment aimed to align technological progress with the national vision for sustainable development and environmental security.
records.institution: The Zayed International Foundation for the Environment

records.title: The Al-Taiziyah Agricultural Cooperative Association has inaugurated a new water reservoir project in al-Zawaqir to bolster local agricul...
records.description: The Al-Taiziyah Agricultural Cooperative Association has inaugurated a new water reservoir project in al-Zawaqir to bolster local agricultural productivity through improved rainwater harvesting. Funded by the local Zakat Authority, the initiative is designed to store seasonal rainfall for irrigation, providing a sustainable water source for farmers in the district. During the launch, representatives highlighted the project as a key component of a broader economic strategy to develop the region's agricultural sector and emphasized the importance of community-led management to ensure the reservoir's long-term effectiveness. By reducing reliance on scarce groundwater, the Al-Taiziyah Agricultural Cooperative Association aims to enhance food security and support the livelihoods of rural families in the province.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has highlighted the exceptional productivity of the tomato sector in the Zubair District of Basra, where dail...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has highlighted the exceptional productivity of the tomato sector in the Zubair District of Basra, where daily output now exceeds 3,000 tons. According to the Zubair Agriculture Division, local yields have reached 16 tons per dunam, allowing the region to supply not only the Basra Governorate but also the majority of the country's markets. This surge in production is the result of focused support for strategic vegetable crops, reinforcing the district's status as a vital economic hub for Iraqi agriculture. By overseeing the marketing of these high volumes to all regions, the Ministry of Agriculture is ensuring the stability of a staple crop essential to national food security and the local economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Deir El Qamar Agricultural Center, conducted an educational seminar and practical workshop in Ba...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Deir El Qamar Agricultural Center, conducted an educational seminar and practical workshop in Barouk focused on good agricultural practices and fruit tree pruning. Targeted at nearly 100 farmers from the surrounding municipalities, the program emphasized the importance of registering in the national agricultural registry as a prerequisite for accessing technical support and ministerial programs. Technical sessions covered the role of pruning in tree rejuvenation, pest reduction, and climate change adaptation, specifically addressing challenges like rising temperatures and water scarcity. The event concluded with the distribution of 81 modern pruning kits, including chainsaws and battery-operated shears funded by the Seel Association, to small-scale farmers to promote sustainable land management and reduce production costs within the local horticulture sector.

records.title: Morocco and Poland have established a strategic framework to enhance trade in livestock and animal products following the signing of a me...
records.description: Morocco and Poland have established a strategic framework to enhance trade in livestock and animal products following the signing of a memorandum of understanding focused on animal health and food safety. Signed by the Ministry of Agriculture, the agreement facilitates technical cooperation on sanitary standards, research, and veterinary procedures to streamline the exchange of animal-derived goods. This collaboration arrives as the Ministry of Agriculture manages a 38% decline in domestic cattle and sheep numbers caused by prolonged drought, prompting a 2026 policy that exempts specific quotas of live animal imports from value-added tax. By aligning with Poland—a major global meat exporter—the Ministry of Agriculture aims to diversify its supply chains beyond traditional partners and stabilize domestic meat prices through improved institutional links and rigorous sanitary recognition.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests has launched a series of community-driven agric...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests has launched a series of community-driven agricultural projects in the Marrakech-Safi region to revitalize Morocco's livestock and agroforestry sectors. With a total investment exceeding MAD 160 million across several regional initiatives, the program includes the distribution of over 4,000 Sardi sheep and the establishment of 21 hydroponic barley production units to ensure sustainable fodder supply. A key highlight is the implementation of an agroforestry project in the commune of Bouchane, which utilizes drought-resistant saltbushes and cactus to improve soil quality and provide resilient forage in semi-arid conditions. By combining the distribution of modern equipment with intensive farmer training and the creation of new watering points, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to rebuild national herd numbers and secure long-term food production following a period of rainfall recovery.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organi...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), held a national workshop focused on ecosystem monitoring and field verification for land rehabilitation. This initiative is a central component of the National Greening Program, which aims to rehabilitate 40 million hectares of degraded land and plant 10 billion trees in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. By integrating scientific assessment with on-the-ground implementation, the program seeks to enhance environmental security and maximize economic returns through a sustainable green economy. The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification emphasized that precise field verification ensures the efficiency of these interventions, while the FAO reaffirmed its commitment to providing international recognition and technical support for the Kingdom's extensive restoration efforts.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification

records.title: The Iraqi Parliament convened a critical session with the Ministry of Water Resources and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to address the...
records.description: The Iraqi Parliament convened a critical session with the Ministry of Water Resources and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to address the nation's severe water crisis and ongoing drought. During the session, officials highlighted the lack of a binding water-sharing treaty with Turkey and reviewed a framework agreement intended to foster cooperation on cross-border water and agricultural infrastructure. To mitigate the shortage, the Ministry of Water Resources proposed priority projects including seawater desalination for southern provinces, wastewater reuse, and the modernization of irrigation systems. Members of Parliament emphasized the necessity of linking water quotas to broader economic relations, increasing budget allocations for the 2026 fiscal year, and forming a specialized expert committee to oversee a unified national strategy for water security and salinity management

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has achieved a significant milestone in improving the producti...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has achieved a significant milestone in improving the production efficiency of the strategic barley crop at the Baghdad Research Station. As part of a specialized program for propagating high-grade seeds, research teams successfully conducted the first harvest of developed barley varieties, ensuring their genetic purity and verifying they reached optimal harvesting heights. This initiative is a key component of the Ministry of Agriculture's broader strategy to promote local crop varieties and provide farmers and seed producers with high-yielding, resilient inputs. By prioritizing these research trials, the ministry aims to stabilize domestic production and reinforce national food security through science-led agricultural development

records.title: The Jordanian Cabinet has approved the extension of a significant subsidy program for agricultural exports, covering half of air freight...
records.description: The Jordanian Cabinet has approved the extension of a significant subsidy program for agricultural exports, covering half of air freight costs and a quarter of maritime shipping costs to bolster the international competitiveness of local produce. This decision follows a successful pilot that expanded Jordan's reach into non-traditional markets and offset declines in maritime trade through increased air-bound volumes. Alongside this financial support, the Jordanian Cabinet greenlit a transformative agri-food system program in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO). This initiative includes establishing large-scale handling centers in Deir Alla and Mafraq equipped with digital traceability and sorting technologies, as well as a regional "Food Coalition" project aimed at reducing food waste and utilizing artificial intelligence for market monitoring and food security resilience.

records.title: The Sebou River Basin Agency has reported a significant improvement in water reserves, with its 11 large dams reaching an overall filling...
records.description: The Sebou River Basin Agency has reported a significant improvement in water reserves, with its 11 large dams reaching an overall filling rate of 55.6% and a total volume exceeding 3.088 billion cubic meters. The Al Wahda Dam, the basin's primary hydraulic structure, accounts for nearly two-thirds of these reserves with a 59% filling rate, a substantial increase from the previous year. This recovery is vital for the irrigation of the Gharb Plain, supporting high-value agricultural sectors such as cereal, sugar, and forage crops, while also providing flood protection. Managed under the Ministry of Equipment and Water, the basin’s network of large and small dams serves as a critical pillar for regional food security and rural water stability, contributing to a national reservoir volume that now exceeds 8 billion cubic meters.

records.title: Sultan Qaboos University (SQU), in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has achieved a scientif...
records.description: Sultan Qaboos University (SQU), in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, has achieved a scientific milestone by producing spirulina algae in commercial quantities for the first time. Funded by the Agriculture and Fisheries Development Fund (AFDF), the research project focused on cultivating strains specifically adapted to Oman's climate and salt-water conditions, achieving a high protein content of up to 65%. This initiative aims to utilize non-arable coastal lands along the Arabian Sea to manufacture spirulina-enhanced animal and fish feeds, supporting the goals of Oman Vision 2040 regarding food security and a knowledge-based economy. By successfully scaling this microalgae production, the Sultan Qaboos University (SQU) is converting theoretical research into an applied industrial solution that bolsters the national aquaculture and livestock sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has issued a ministerial decision banning the import of live birds and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has issued a ministerial decision banning the import of live birds and poultry-related products from the Indian state of Kerala. This preventive measure, based on recommendations from competent veterinary authorities, addresses health concerns following recent avian influenza outbreaks in the region. The ban encompasses live birds, their products, derivatives, and waste, and will remain in effect until the health risks are resolved. However, an exception is made for poultry products that have been thermally processed or treated in compliance with the international standards of the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH).
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), conducted a specialized workshop for...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), conducted a specialized workshop for tree-growing farmers in the Qalqilya Governorate as part of the EVAP 3 project. This initiative focuses on "market-oriented" agricultural extension, employing a seven-step technical guidance package designed to improve crop quality and production efficiency for farmers in marginalized areas behind the apartheid wall. By integrating modern agricultural technologies and market-driven strategies, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to enhance the profitability and resilience of Palestinian horticulture. The workshop provided a platform for farmers to address local production challenges and adopt sound agricultural practices that ensure the long-term sustainability of the sector in high-pressure environments.

records.title: The Yemeni Authority for Standards, Metrology, and Quality Control organized a specialized workshop as part of the National Yemeni Honey...
records.description: The Yemeni Authority for Standards, Metrology, and Quality Control organized a specialized workshop as part of the National Yemeni Honey Festival to strengthen the quality and global standing of Yemeni honey. The workshop focused on the YSMO 2449/2019 standard, which outlines the chemical composition and quality criteria for premium varieties like Sidr and Acacia honey. Technical experts highlighted the adoption of advanced detection technologies, such as NMR and C4 testing, to combat commercial fraud and ensure international compliance. By integrating these standards with support for small-scale facilities, the Yemeni Authority for Standards, Metrology, and Quality Control aims to modernize national laboratories and provide technical certifications that protect this strategic product and boost its competitiveness in global markets.
records.institution: The Yemeni Authority for Standards, Metrology, and Quality Control

records.title: Egypt and South Korea have signed a joint statement to advance a proposed Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), signaling...
records.description: Egypt and South Korea have signed a joint statement to advance a proposed Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), signaling a major deepening of trade and investment ties. Signed by the Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade and the South Korean Ministry of Trade, Industry, and Energy, the agreement targets high-growth sectors including high-tech industries, agriculture, renewable energy, and manufacturing. A key component of the partnership involves leveraging Egypt's raw materials and industrial zones, such as the Northwest Gulf of Suez, to establish joint manufacturing hubs for pharmaceuticals, telecommunications, and construction materials. With an existing development cooperation portfolio exceeding $1.3 billion, this partnership—reinforced by the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)—aims to facilitate technology transfer and expand Egyptian exports to regional and global markets.
records.institution: The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation witnessed the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding betwe...
records.description: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation witnessed the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between the German Agency for International Cooperation (GIZ) and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) to bolster climate-resilient rural development. Operating under Egypt’s NWFE (Nexus on Water, Food and Energy) programme, this partnership integrates GIZ’s technical expertise with IFAD’s financial capacity to support smallholder farmers through projects such as CROWN, STAR, and the Agricultural Innovation Project (AIP). The initiative focuses on modernizing water management in the Nile Valley, improving soil fertility, and enhancing digital marketing linkages for agricultural organizations. By aligning with the German Embassy and the German Development Bank (KfW), the ministry aims to scale up sustainable farming solutions and strengthen food security as a core pillar of Egypt's national climate and economic transformation strategy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, has officially launched the Electronic Platform for Veterinary Health Cer...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, has officially launched the Electronic Platform for Veterinary Health Certificates on the national Ur Portal. This digital initiative, developed in coordination with the National Center for Digital Transformation, automates the regulation of animal transport and products across Iraqi governorates and border crossings. The platform streamlines administrative procedures for livestock breeders and companies importing veterinary medicines and vaccines, replacing legacy paper-based systems with a secure, transparent e-governance model. By integrating health assessments and vaccination records into a unified digital database, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to enhance statistical accuracy, improve disease monitoring, and provide citizens with efficient, 24/7 access to essential veterinary documentation.

records.title: Jordan has achieved a major milestone in its national food security strategy, as announced by the Ministry of Agriculture.
records.description: Jordan has achieved a major milestone in its national food security strategy, as announced by the Ministry of Agriculture. According to the 2025 Global Hunger Index (GHI), Jordan improved its global ranking to 54th place (up from 59th in 2024), reducing its index score to 10.3—a reflection of "moderate" and steadily declining hunger levels. This progress is corroborated by the 2025 State of Food Security and Nutrition in the World (SOFI) report, which indicates that undernourishment in the Kingdom dropped from 17.9% to 14.3% over the recent assessment period. The Higher Council for Food Security attributes these successes to effective price stabilization measures and a robust national food system, which has kept the cost of an adequate diet at $0.64 per day—well below the global average. With a child stunting rate of just 2.3%, Jordan stands as a regional leader in nutritional stability, even as the ministry continues to expand local agricultural production and supply chain resilience.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief) and the South Jenin Agr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Agricultural Development Association (Agricultural Relief) and the South Jenin Agriculture Department, has delivered 35 tons of improved potato seeds to 90 farmers in the towns of Qabatiya, Zababdeh, and Masliya. Funded by the Dutch government, this initiative provides high-quality, disease-resistant seeds specifically selected for the region's climatic conditions to maximize yield and production efficiency. The project is designed to bolster the livelihoods of rural families, create seasonal employment, and enhance the overall resilience of the agricultural sector in the Jenin Governorate. By distributing these strategic inputs, the Ministry of Agriculture and its partners aim to reduce the financial burden on farmers and stabilize the local economy through sustainable food production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jerusalem Governorate Agriculture Directorate, has distributed 24 irrigation networks to farmers...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jerusalem Governorate Agriculture Directorate, has distributed 24 irrigation networks to farmers across several northwest towns and communities, including Rafat, Qalandia al-Balad, and Beit Anan. Funded by the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development, this initiative is a core component of a larger water harvesting project designed to enhance the efficiency of water use and improve crop yields. The intervention aims to support the resilience of local farmers facing economic and climatic challenges by providing sustainable production inputs and modernizing agricultural systems. By targeting areas characterized by social and economic fragility, the Ministry of Agriculture and its partners seek to protect the agricultural sector and strengthen long-term food security in the region.

records.title: The National Agricultural Research Center (NARC), part of the Ministry of Agriculture, has launched a modern hydroponic system as part of...
records.description: The National Agricultural Research Center (NARC), part of the Ministry of Agriculture, has launched a modern hydroponic system as part of the Multidonor Agribusiness Programme (MAP II). Implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and funded by the European Union and the governments of Denmark, Switzerland, and Spain, this soilless farming initiative aims to reduce water consumption by up to 80% compared to traditional methods. The system utilizes automated sensors to manage irrigation and fertilization, enhancing crop quality and biosecurity while addressing challenges like water scarcity and rising production costs. By integrating climate-smart technology, the Ministry of Agriculture and the FAO seek to strengthen agricultural value chains, support applied research, and build a more resilient and sustainable food system for Palestinian farmers.

records.title: Saudi Reef Projects Increased Earnings for Small Farmers by 2030
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) projects that the average monthly income for its beneficiaries will exceed SAR 20,000 by 2030, a significant increase aimed at ensuring long-term economic stability for rural communities. This forecast, shared by program spokesperson Majed Al-Buraikan, highlights the impact of expanding support to over 200,000 farmers and producers across the Kingdom. By providing access to modern irrigation, agricultural mechanization, and technical training, Saudi Reef is transitioning small-scale traditional farming into a commercially viable sector. These efforts are a core component of Saudi Vision 2030, focusing on reducing rural-to-urban migration, enhancing local food security, and empowering rural families to become substantial contributors to the national economy.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)
