records.title: The El Gezira and Managil Agricultural Scheme, historically one of Africa’s largest irrigation projects, is facing a severe productivity...
records.description: The El Gezira and Managil Agricultural Scheme, historically one of Africa’s largest irrigation projects, is facing a severe productivity crisis with wheat acreage plummeting by 47%, from 400,000 to just 210,000 feddans. It has been reported that prohibitive input costs—with fertilizer prices jumping sixfold—and the collapse of pre-war credit arrangements with the Agricultural Bank have made traditional farming untenable for many. Compounded by wartime looting and the siltation of irrigation canals, the scheme's recovery plan now focuses on appointing new leadership, disinfecting waterways, and securing international investment from China, Türkiye, and Austria.
records.institution: The El Gezira and Managil Agricultural Scheme

records.domain: Price intervention on cash crop commodities
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued a formal decision setting the selling prices for potato seeds produced by the National Potato Seed...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued a formal decision setting the selling prices for potato seeds produced by the National Potato Seed Production Project for the current agricultural season. The pricing structure establishes specific rates for different seed generations, including "Elite" and "Base" grade tubers. This regulatory move aims to provide farmers with high-quality, locally produced alternatives to expensive imported seeds, thereby reducing overall production costs and protecting the domestic agricultural sector from external market fluctuations. By stabilizing the cost of these essential inputs, the Ministry of Agriculture seeks to encourage expanded cultivation and ensure the long-term sustainability of the national potato industry.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Masdar, in partnership with a consortium including OQ Alternative Energy, Komipo, and Al Khadra Partners, has reached financial close for...
records.description: Masdar, in partnership with a consortium including OQ Alternative Energy, Komipo, and Al Khadra Partners, has reached financial close for the Ibri III Solar Independent Power Project in Oman. Developed for Nama Power and Water Procurement (Nama), this $300 million initiative is the first in the Sultanate to combine a 500MW solar photovoltaic plant with a 100-megawatt-hour battery energy storage system (BESS). Financed by First Abu Dhabi Bank (FAB) and Natixis CIB, the project will power approximately 33,000 homes and offset 505,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide annually. This milestone directly supports the Oman Vision 2040 target of generating 30% of electricity from renewable sources by 2030, reinforcing Masdar’s role in accelerating the regional energy transition through advanced storage technologies.

records.title: The Dubai Environment and Climate Change Authority (DECCA) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Domus Group to integrate adv...
records.description: The Dubai Environment and Climate Change Authority (DECCA) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding with the Domus Group to integrate advanced drone technologies and vertical aviation solutions into Dubai’s environmental and climate action strategies. This partnership aims to leverage high-precision aerial surveys for mapping mangroves, monitoring air quality, and conducting carbon sink assessments, as well as strengthening the enforcement of environmental regulations and unauthorized fishing laws. By aligning with the UAE Net Zero 2050 pathway and the Dubai Economic Agenda (D33), DECCA intends to use these unmanned aircraft systems as key enablers for data-driven decision-making in biodiversity conservation and sustainable agriculture. This collaboration reflects a commitment to adopting cutting-edge global innovations to meet local ecological requirements and ensure long-term sustainable development.
records.institution: The Dubai Environment and Climate Change Authority (DECCA)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The ownership consortium of the Al Dhafra solar project—comprising TAQA, Masdar, EDF, and Jinko Power—has successfully raised $871 millio...
records.description: The ownership consortium of the Al Dhafra solar project—comprising TAQA, Masdar, EDF, and Jinko Power—has successfully raised $871 million (AED 3.2 billion) through long-term green bonds. This 100% green-certified issuance, which carries a 5.794 percent coupon and matures in 2053, will refinance the debt of the 2-gigawatt plant, currently one of the world's largest single-site solar facilities. Emirates Water and Electricity Company (EWEC) serves as the principal offtaker under a 35-year fixed-tariff agreement, providing the stable cash flows that earned the bonds a preliminary 'A' rating from S&P Global Ratings. By utilizing bi-facial panel technology to offset 2.4 million metric tonnes of $CO_2$ annually, the project reinforces Abu Dhabi's energy transition strategy and establishes a model for securing competitive, long-term capital for future renewable energy infrastructure.
records.institution: TAQA, Masdar, EDF, and Jinko Power

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has overseen the expansion of the poultry sector through the development of the Sidra Al-Malika Slaughterhous...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has overseen the expansion of the poultry sector through the development of the Sidra Al-Malika Slaughterhouse in the Tarmiya District of Baghdad. With a daily production capacity of 48,000 birds yielding 16 tons of white meat, the facility utilizes the latest inspection and slaughtering technologies under the supervision of specialized veterinary staff to ensure high quality and disease-free products. By adhering to strict biosecurity procedures and supplying over 98 restaurants and 400 supermarkets with various weights of chicken, the project significantly reduces reliance on imports and strengthens local food security. This initiative aligns with the Ministry of Agriculture's commitment to maintaining public health through rigorous laboratory standards while meeting the growing consumer demand for domestic poultry.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) organized a regional workshop in Amman to enhance agricultural water al...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) organized a regional workshop in Amman to enhance agricultural water allocation systems across the Near East and North Africa (NENA) region, where renewable water availability has dropped below 500 cubic metres per capita. Under the Water Scarcity Initiative (WSI), experts from Jordan, Egypt, Palestine, and Tunisia shared outcomes from pilot programs that implemented science-based guidelines endorsed by the League of Arab States. The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) highlighted the progress of technical teams in utilizing water accounting and productivity data to develop institutional roadmaps for more efficient resource management. By fostering regional cooperation and showcasing practical applications—such as water monitoring systems in the North Shouna Valley—the FAO aims to institutionalize equitable water allocation practices that strengthen food security and climate resilience across the region.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) have signed a memorandum of understanding to re...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) have signed a memorandum of understanding to rehabilitate the Shoubak forest nursery and launch large-scale reforestation projects in Wadi Musa and Shoubak. Funded by Global Affairs Canada, the initiative is designed to strengthen the climate resilience of Jordan’s key biodiversity areas by restoring degraded ecosystems with indigenous species like juniper and mastic trees. By upgrading the Shoubak nursery, the Ministry of Agriculture intends to increase its production capacity to supply high-quality saplings for restoration programs across the Kingdom's southern regions. This partnership emphasizes nature-based solutions and community participation to protect soil, control erosion, and support local wildlife in alignment with national biodiversity conservation goals.

records.title: The World Food Programme (WFP), in support of the Higher Council for Food Security, has released the first comprehensive national data on...
records.description: The World Food Programme (WFP), in support of the Higher Council for Food Security, has released the first comprehensive national data on food waste in Jordan, identifying households as the primary source of waste. The study revealed that the average annual food waste per capita in Jordan is approximately 81.3 kilograms, a figure that has prompted the Ministry of Agriculture to call for a shift from estimated planning to data-driven national policies. By analyzing sectors including hospitals, hotels, and restaurants, the report highlights that ingrained purchasing habits and weak domestic food management are critical drivers of waste. Consequently, the WFP recommends a combination of legislative interventions and community awareness campaigns to align Jordan’s food consumption patterns with national sustainability and food security goals.

records.title: The Central Bank of Libya has unveiled an updated classification system for companies eligible to open letters of credit at the official...
records.description: The Central Bank of Libya has unveiled an updated classification system for companies eligible to open letters of credit at the official exchange rate, a move designed to stabilize the national economy and ensure market transparency. Developed in coordination with the Ministry of Economy and Trade, the new framework organizes authorized importers into 12 distinct volumes based on their sector, ranging from essential foodstuffs and pharmaceuticals to industrial raw materials and agricultural supplies. By tightening control over foreign exchange allocations, the Central Bank of Libya aims to combat monopolistic practices and price speculation while safeguarding consumer rights. The Bank also highlighted the need for a formal guiding budget from the Ministry of Economy and Trade to better align these financial approvals with the actual volume of goods required by the local market.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Trade

records.title: The State of Qatar, represented by the Ministry of Municipality, participated in the 18th Global Forum for Food and Agriculture (GFFA) an...
records.description: The State of Qatar, represented by the Ministry of Municipality, participated in the 18th Global Forum for Food and Agriculture (GFFA) and the Berlin Agriculture Ministers’ Conference held under the theme “Water. Harvests. Our Future.” During the event, which coincided with the Green Week International Trade Fair, the Qatari delegation joined agriculture ministers and international organizations to address the critical nexus between water management and global food security. The discussions centered on implementing modern, sustainable methods for water conservation within the agricultural sector to ensure resilient food systems. By engaging in this global platform, the Ministry of Municipality reaffirmed its commitment to advancing innovative solutions for water efficiency and food security in alignment with international standards and sustainable development goals.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The inaugural IFAT Saudi Arabia, held under the patronage of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, serves as a strategic pl...
records.description: The inaugural IFAT Saudi Arabia, held under the patronage of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, serves as a strategic platform to accelerate investment in sustainable waste and water infrastructure in alignment with national environmental goals. The event features a high-level summit and technical conferences, such as the Blue and Orange stages, where the National Center for Waste Management (MWAN) and the Saudi Water Authority lead dialogues on policy frameworks, circular economy models, and public-private partnerships. Key focus areas include municipal waste optimization, brine mining innovations led by NEOM, and the digital transformation of water systems to enhance resilience in arid environments. By convening government regulators, global investors, and organizations like the World Bank and the International Water Association, the event facilitates the exchange of international expertise to strengthen resource recovery and secure long-term water and waste security across the Kingdom.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Kingdom of Morocco participated in the 18th World Food and Agriculture Forum (GFFA) in Berlin, where discussions centered on the them...
records.description: The Kingdom of Morocco participated in the 18th World Food and Agriculture Forum (GFFA) in Berlin, where discussions centered on the theme "Water. Crops. Our Future." Represented by the Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests, Morocco joined over 70 countries to address the critical link between water scarcity and global food security. During a high-level panel organized by the African Union and the German government, the Moroccan delegation showcased its Generation Green 2020-2030 strategy as a continental model for integrated water management. This strategy emphasizes irrigation efficiency, the modernization of hydraulic infrastructure, and the expansion of non-conventional water resources to safeguard agricultural productivity. By highlighting that irrigated land supports a significant portion of rural employment and national food stability, the Ministry of Agriculture reaffirmed its commitment to proactive water governance amidst increasing climate-driven resource tensions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in the Aseer Region, in collaboration with an agricultural practices developmen...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in the Aseer Region, in collaboration with an agricultural practices development initiative team, has launched a project to establish seven specialized agricultural fields. Managed by a seed and seedling center in Abha, the initiative includes five open demonstration fields and two dedicated to precision agriculture to modernize the cultivation of fruits, vegetables, dates, and field crops. By integrating advanced farming methods and rigorous monitoring, the project aims to enhance regional productivity and environmental sustainability while serving as a practical model for local farmers. This effort directly supports the broader strategy of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture to modernize the agricultural sector and optimize the use of natural resources in the region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Forests, in coordination with Khartoum State authorities and the National Forests Corporation, has been d...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Forests, in coordination with Khartoum State authorities and the National Forests Corporation, has been directed to launch an urgent restoration programme for the Acacia (Sunt) Forest following significant wartime damage. During a high-level site visit, officials emphasized the forest’s critical role as a natural reserve since 1930 and a vital habitat for migratory birds, stressing the need for immediate protective measures to halt further environmental degradation. The initiative aims to replant damaged areas and restore the forest's ecological value now that administrative operations have resumed. By prioritizing this natural landmark, the Ministry of Agriculture and Forests and local leadership seek to preserve one of the region's most significant green spaces and secure its future as a key component of the local environment.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Forests

records.title: In preparation for the month of Ramadan, the National Chamber of Slaughterhouses and White Meat Processors (UTICA), in coordination with...
records.description: In preparation for the month of Ramadan, the National Chamber of Slaughterhouses and White Meat Processors (UTICA), in coordination with the Ministry of Commerce, the Ministry of Agriculture, and the Interprofessional Group of Poultry and Rabbit Products, has finalized plans to ensure a stable supply of poultry and eggs. Authorities have confirmed a strategic stock of 13,700 tons of poultry meat, 6,600 tons of turkey, and 163 million eggs to meet consumer demand during the holy month. To protect purchasing power, price caps have been established at 8,500 thousandths for consumers, with fixed profit margins for chicken and turkey cuts. These institutional efforts are designed to maintain a balanced market and guarantee that current reserves fully cover national consumption needs through the end of the festive period.
records.institution: The National Chamber of Slaughterhouses and White Meat Processors (UTICA)

records.title: The Capital Secretariat, in collaboration with the Agriculture Sector and the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financi...
records.description: The Capital Secretariat, in collaboration with the Agriculture Sector and the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, inaugurated the fourth National Yemeni Honey Festival to enhance the global reputation and quality of Yemeni honey as a strategic cash crop. During the event, officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Ministry of Economy, Industry and Investment emphasized the sector's role in supporting the national economy, announcing plans to establish a central laboratory with international specifications to ensure product quality and combat fraud. To support long-term sustainability, the Government of Change and Construction has launched a program to plant millions of Sidr trees and other bee-foraging seedlings, aiming to expand vegetative cover across the highlands.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Baalbek-Hermel Agricultural Department, organized a specialized awareness seminar on Foot-and-Mo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Baalbek-Hermel Agricultural Department, organized a specialized awareness seminar on Foot-and-Mouth Disease to strengthen livestock protection and food security. During the event, the Animal Resources Division announced the launch of the second phase of a national vaccination campaign, following successful containment efforts in the initial phase. Experts provided more than 65 regional breeders and veterinarians with technical training on disease symptoms, transmission methods, and the critical importance of preventative doses and farm sterilization. The Ministry of Agriculture emphasized the necessity of registering livestock holdings in the national agricultural registry to access technical support, reaffirming its commitment to ongoing guidance and comprehensive vaccination coverage to safeguard the sector against outbreaks.

records.title: Mauritania participated in the 18th session of the Global Forum for Food and Agriculture (GFFA) in Berlin, represented by a high-level de...
records.description: Mauritania participated in the 18th session of the Global Forum for Food and Agriculture (GFFA) in Berlin, represented by a high-level delegation from the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty. Held under the theme of sustainable water management, the forum focused on introducing smart irrigation systems, modern agricultural technologies, and a blue economy approach to enhance sector resilience against climate change. The delegation engaged in bilateral meetings to strengthen international partnerships and attended the concurrent Green Week international exhibition. These efforts align with the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty's objectives to modernize agricultural planning and plant protection while adopting innovative solutions to secure long-term food stability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has issued an international tender to purchase approximately 595,000 metric tons of hard milli...
records.description: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has issued an international tender to purchase approximately 595,000 metric tons of hard milling wheat to replenish strategic reserves and meet rising domestic consumption. The procurement, which seeks wheat with a minimum 12.5% protein content from optional global origins, includes ten consignments scheduled for delivery in April and May across key ports in Jeddah, Yanbu, Dammam, and Jizan. As the entity responsible for sourcing grain and managing storage, GFSA oversees the Kingdom's shift toward an import-reliant food security model following the 2016 phase-out of large-scale domestic wheat cultivation to conserve water. This substantial tender reinforces Saudi Arabia's role as a major global importer and ensures a stable supply for the national flour milling and baking industries.

records.title: Syria has marked its return to high-level international agricultural dialogue by participating in the Global Forum for Food and Agricultu...
records.description: Syria has marked its return to high-level international agricultural dialogue by participating in the Global Forum for Food and Agriculture (GFFA) 2026 in Berlin. Led by the Ministry of Agriculture, the Syrian delegation joined ministers from dozens of countries to address the forum's theme, "Water. Harvests. Our Future." This participation, which includes senior officials from the National Center for Agricultural Policies and the Directorate of Economics and Planning, signals a renewed focus on integrating with global efforts to manage water resources and ensure food security. By attending sessions focused on climate change and sustainable production, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to re-establish its role in international forums and address the pivotal challenges facing its national agricultural sector after a multi-year absence.

records.title: The first Agricultural Investment and Renewable Energy Fair in Central-Western Tunisia is scheduled to take place in the Kasserine Govern...
records.description: The first Agricultural Investment and Renewable Energy Fair in Central-Western Tunisia is scheduled to take place in the Kasserine Governorate, bringing together agricultural professionals, renewable energy suppliers, and funding agencies. According to the event coordination team, the primary objective is to introduce young farmers to various entrepreneurship mechanisms while promoting sustainable development and regional employment. The fair will feature scientific seminars focused on agricultural investment, organic farming, processing industries, and the integration of renewable energies within the sector.

records.title: Tunisia is facing a severe crisis in its cattle sector, with livestock numbers declining by nearly 20% due to persistent drought and soar...
records.description: Tunisia is facing a severe crisis in its cattle sector, with livestock numbers declining by nearly 20% due to persistent drought and soaring feed prices. To prevent a total collapse, the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Finance have issued a joint decree allocating 10 million dinars to support vulnerable small-scale farmers. This exceptional funding is specifically targeted at facilitating the acquisition of heifers and breeding cows, improving access to veterinary care, and preserving the genetic heritage of the national herd. While the Ministry of Agriculture views these subsidies as a vital measure for rural social stability and food security, officials emphasize that the program must be part of a broader structural policy to address long-term resource management and input regulation. By prioritizing smallholders, the state aims to stabilize domestic milk and red meat supplies while reducing dependence on costly imports.

records.title: The launch of Gulfood Logistics at the Dubai Exhibition Centre (DEC) marks a strategic expansion for Gulfood 2026, addressing a global lo...
records.description: The launch of Gulfood Logistics at the Dubai Exhibition Centre (DEC) marks a strategic expansion for Gulfood 2026, addressing a global logistics market projected to reach $23 trillion by 2035. As the Middle East's largest logistics hub, the UAE accounts for 30% of regional activity, and this new platform leverages Dubai’s geostrategic position to showcase innovations in cold-chain systems, smart warehousing, and real-time cargo tracking. Industry leaders such as Maersk, DP World, and MSC Shipping are participating to demonstrate resilient "farm-to-fork" supply chain solutions that ensure food safety and sustainability across continents. By integrating thought leadership on digital transformation and regulatory compliance, the event reinforces the UAE's role in global trade connectivity, highlighting how advanced infrastructure and international cooperation are essential for maintaining supply reliability and reducing food waste in an increasingly complex global landscape.
records.institution: The Government of the United Arab Emirates

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Land Research Center, has launched the first phase of the "Sumud" project to empower...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Land Research Center, has launched the first phase of the "Sumud" project to empower Jerusalemite families and bolster food security. Funded by the Bayt Mal Al-Quds Al-Sharif Agency, the initiative began with the distribution of 1,000 fruit-bearing almond and fig seedlings to farmers affected by land violations in the Jerusalem Governorate. This project is a core component of the ministry's strategy to protect agricultural land and improve rural livelihoods through the provision of essential production inputs and reclamation support. The Ministry of Agriculture highlighted the vital role of the Kingdom of Morocco in funding these humanitarian and developmental efforts, which aim to strengthen the economic resilience of residents and ensure the long-term sustainability of the Palestinian agricultural sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Jenin Agriculture Department, conducted specialized training for the Martyrs Triangle Live...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Jenin Agriculture Department, conducted specialized training for the Martyrs Triangle Livestock Association as part of the EVAP 3 project. Implemented in cooperation with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), the program provided 20 farmers and breeders with technical guidelines and modern techniques designed to improve livestock management and production efficiency. This initiative is part of a broader agricultural extension effort to enhance resource management, support the resilience of rural communities, and empower women within the sector. By focusing on sound agricultural practices, the Ministry of Agriculture and JICA aim to advance the sustainability and growth of the Palestinian livestock industry.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced that the adoption of Saudi Good Agricultural Practices (Saudi GAP) withi...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced that the adoption of Saudi Good Agricultural Practices (Saudi GAP) within the national poultry sector has reached approximately 90%, driving broiler chicken production to 1.2 million tons in 2024. As part of its "Your Local Guarantee" awareness campaign, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is promoting the use of modern technologies and innovations to ensure the highest standards of food safety, quality, and environmental protection. These advancements have not only strengthened national supply chains and market availability but have also increased the overall investment value of the industry. By prioritizing sustainable resource use and standardized production requirements, the ministry continues to enhance the Kingdom’s food security system in alignment with the strategic goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources, in collaboration with the Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities and Technology Zones (MOD...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources, in collaboration with the Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities and Technology Zones (MODON) and the Saudi Irrigation Organization (SIO), has launched the Mining Infrastructure Enablement Initiative to bolster the Kingdom's mining competitiveness. Announced at the Future Minerals Forum 2026, a primary focus of this initiative is the Jabal Sayid mineralized belt, which holds an estimated SAR192 billion in copper, gold, and rare earth elements. To unlock this potential sustainably, a new 75-kilometer pipeline will deliver over 20,000 cubic meters of treated water daily, reducing water costs by 60% and preserving vital groundwater resources in line with the National Water Strategy. By addressing "last-mile" infrastructure challenges and providing integrated solutions for exploitation license holders, the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources aims to de-risk investments and accelerate production, transforming Saudi Arabia into a premier global destination for a stable and cost-efficient mine-to-market ecosystem.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources

records.title: BEEAH and Masdar have signed a joint development agreement at the World Future Energy Summit 2026 to identify and develop utility-scale s...
records.description: BEEAH and Masdar have signed a joint development agreement at the World Future Energy Summit 2026 to identify and develop utility-scale solar photovoltaic projects across Sharjah. This framework covers the entire project lifecycle, from feasibility studies and grid impact assessments to the construction and operation of solar plants, with the potential to integrate hybrid battery energy storage systems for enhanced grid resilience. Building on their successful collaboration through the Emirates Waste to Energy Company, the two institutions aim to support Sharjah’s energy transformation and contribute to the national goal of tripling renewable energy capacity by 2030. This partnership aligns with the broader commitment to achieve Net Zero by 2040, as BEEAH explores innovative ways to convert closed landfills into solar farms and Masdar continues to expand its global renewable energy portfolio toward a 100-gigawatt target.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Masdar has partnered with Elite Agro Holding to launch the first agricultural photovoltaic (AgriPV) project in the MENA region, located a...
records.description: Masdar has partnered with Elite Agro Holding to launch the first agricultural photovoltaic (AgriPV) project in the MENA region, located at the Al Foah Farm in Al Ain. Announced during Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, the initiative integrates solar panels with greenhouses to enable the simultaneous generation of clean energy and crop cultivation on the same land. This innovative model is designed to maximize resource efficiency by using PV panels to provide shading, which reduces heat and water stress on plants while lowering irrigation requirements. By advancing the UAE’s Net Zero 2050 and National Food Security Strategy 2051, the project serves as a scalable blueprint for sustainable farming in arid climates, providing critical data to optimize land use and energy resilience for future large-scale deployments across the emirate.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is showcasing its leadership in autonomous technologies at UMEX 2026, highli...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is showcasing its leadership in autonomous technologies at UMEX 2026, highlighting four flagship projects that integrate AI, robotics, and unmanned systems into the agricultural and food sectors. These initiatives include the use of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) for precise monitoring of farms and livestock, the Food Security Jahazeya Project for predictive supply chain analytics, and AI-driven visual monitoring systems for food establishments to ensure real-time safety compliance. Additionally, the Advanced Agriculture 4.0 System utilizes agricultural robotics and big-data sensors to enable remote crop management and optimize resource use. By deploying these cutting-edge solutions, ADAFSA aims to modernize traditional farming methods, strengthen national food security reserves, and reinforce Abu Dhabi’s position as a global hub for innovation in sustainable agriculture and digital transformation.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The National Agriculture Centre, in collaboration with the Sharjah Entrepreneurship Centre (Sheraa), has launched the Agriboost Programme...
records.description: The National Agriculture Centre, in collaboration with the Sharjah Entrepreneurship Centre (Sheraa), has launched the Agriboost Programme 2026 to empower early-stage agri-tech startups addressing the UAE’s national food security and sustainability priorities. This six-week, sprint-based incubator is designed to help five selected UAE-based startups validate their solutions and move toward market execution through hands-on guidance, industry mentorship, and access to a network of investors. Supported by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, the program provides each participant with AED 15,000 in support, along with co-working spaces and software perks, culminating in a Demo Day to showcase climate-smart agricultural innovations. By fostering a direct link between entrepreneurs and real-world agricultural needs, the National Agriculture Centre and Sheraa are building a scalable framework for sustainable technology that strengthens the resilience of the national food system.
records.institution: The National Agriculture Centre, in collaboration with the Sharjah Entrepreneurship Centre

records.title: The property technology firm Arady Misr for Planning and Development has launched a digital platform to formalize and digitize land tradi...
records.description: The property technology firm Arady Misr for Planning and Development has launched a digital platform to formalize and digitize land trading in Egypt, targeting a market traditionally characterized by informal processes. By utilizing artificial intelligence and geospatial analysis, the platform provides verified listings and data analytics for residential, commercial, industrial, and agricultural land, allowing investors to assess opportunities with greater transparency. The initiative includes a dedicated marketplace for aggregating land from private and government holders, alongside a strategic partnership with Easy Lease to provide integrated financing and microfinance solutions for developers. This collaboration aims to modernize a sector valued at hundreds of billions of Egyptian pounds, bringing data-driven decision-making and improved project execution efficiency to the national land market.
records.institution: Arady Misr for Planning and Development

records.title: The Canadian group Food Process Solutions (FPS) has established a regional logistics platform in Morocco to serve as a distribution hub f...
records.description: The Canadian group Food Process Solutions (FPS) has established a regional logistics platform in Morocco to serve as a distribution hub for equipment and technical components across the Middle East and African markets. By leveraging the Kingdom’s geostrategic positioning, the facility aims to shorten delivery times and enhance operational continuity for agri-food industrial clients. This expansion builds upon the existing FPS Middle East & Africa office at the Tanger Med port, transitioning from a commercial outpost to a centralized regional storage center. The initiative is expected to strengthen the competitiveness of the local agri-food industry by providing easier access to advanced freezing, chilling, and processing technologies, effectively supporting the upgrading of regional value chains and industrial export capabilities.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed the nint...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has signed the ninth batch of investment support agreements under the MAP II program to foster a sustainable and market-oriented agricultural system in the West Bank. These agreements, totaling over 3.1 million shekels, fund high-impact projects across five governorates—including Jenin, Nablus, and Hebron—focused on enhancing food and water security through advanced technologies like hanging strawberry farms, aquaponics, and renewable energy integration. Supported by the Multi-Donor Agribusiness Programme (MAP II) with contributions from Denmark, Switzerland, Spain, the European Union, and Italy, the initiative aims to reduce production costs and agricultural losses while improving the quality of local inputs through new organic fertilizer units and nurseries.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate and in collaboration with the Beekeepers A...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate and in collaboration with the Beekeepers Association, conducted a specialized training workshop to enhance the technical efficiency and productivity of the local beekeeping sector. Led by the General Directorate of Extension and Rural Development and the General Directorate of Plant Protection, the sessions provided over 30 participants with critical training on wintering techniques, nutrition, and disease prevention to reduce losses and improve honey quality. This initiative underscores the Ministry of Agriculture’s commitment to developing beekeeping as a vital economic pillar that supports food security and biodiversity through pollination. By providing a platform for knowledge exchange and modern technical guidance, the program strengthens the resilience of farmers and ensures the sustainable growth of national agricultural production.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has signed a $5 million cooperation agreement with the Consultative Group on Internati...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has signed a $5 million cooperation agreement with the Consultative Group on International Agricultural Research (CGIAR) to accelerate agricultural innovation and environmental sustainability in the Kingdom. This partnership focuses on implementing joint projects that include developing a technical roadmap for crop improvement, identifying digital tools for efficient irrigation, and conducting scientific studies on sustainable water management. A key component of the agreement involves strengthening the Saudi plant gene bank and providing international experts to transfer global expertise in food security and sustainable farming. By leveraging both local research infrastructure and the global network of CGIAR, the initiative aims to build institutional capacity and advance the strategic objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: A 100MW green hydrogen project located in the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) has commenced partial production and successfully initiat...
records.description: A 100MW green hydrogen project located in the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) has commenced partial production and successfully initiated exports to European and United States markets. Developed through a partnership between the Sovereign Fund of Egypt, international energy firms, and construction leaders, the facility in the Ain Sokhna industrial zone serves as a cornerstone for the government's strategy to become a regional hub for green energy. The Ministry of Electricity and Renewable Energy has supported the venture by providing critical infrastructure, while discussions are underway to expand renewable energy targets beyond the current national goals. Furthermore, the European Union has recognized the project’s success, with international financing partners committing billions of dollars toward additional large-scale solar stations to reinforce the production of green hydrogen and ammonia for global export.
records.institution: The Ministry of Electricity and Renewable Energy

records.title: Egypt has officially opened the Uzbekistan market to its fresh strawberry exports following successful negotiations between the Ministry...
records.description: Egypt has officially opened the Uzbekistan market to its fresh strawberry exports following successful negotiations between the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation and international agricultural services. The agreement, facilitated by the national plant quarantine authority, establishes specific phytosanitary protocols and technical guidelines to ensure Egyptian produce meets the required standards for Central Asian markets. This expansion is part of a broader strategy by the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation to diversify export destinations, following similar agreements with the Philippines, Mexico, and Venezuela. By the end of 2025, Egyptian strawberry export volumes reached a record 62,133 tonnes, supported by the implementation of digital procedures within the quarantine system to enhance the efficiency of overseas shipments and maintain high product quality.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The poultry sector in the Zubair and Safwan districts of Basra has experienced a significant recovery, resulting in an abundance of table...
records.description: The poultry sector in the Zubair and Safwan districts of Basra has experienced a significant recovery, resulting in an abundance of table egg production that now exceeds 2.7 million eggs daily. According to the Ministry of Agriculture, this growth is driven by government support and scientific programming aimed at ensuring sustainable food security and local market price stability. Data from the Zubair Agriculture Division and the Safwan Agriculture Division highlight a major expansion in production projects, which has allowed the region to reduce its reliance on imports and achieve a more balanced domestic supply. These efforts reflect a broader institutional commitment to advancing livestock investments and enhancing the productivity of regional agricultural divisions to meet growing consumer demand.

records.title: The Poultry and Feed Investors Association has reported a significant decline in local poultry prices, driven by a surge in production qu...
records.description: The Poultry and Feed Investors Association has reported a significant decline in local poultry prices, driven by a surge in production quantities and a lack of avian diseases. Daily slaughter rates have reached between 700,000 and 800,000 birds, creating an oversupply that has pushed market selling prices as low as 1 to 1.29 JOD per kilogram. This creates a challenging economic environment for producers, as the current production cost stands at 1.5 JOD per kilogram, resulting in estimated sectoral losses of nearly half a million dinars daily. Furthermore, the Poultry and Feed Investors Association noted that rising feed costs are inflating production expenses, which in turn hampers the ability of local farmers to export surplus poultry and maintain regional competitiveness.
records.institution: The Poultry and Feed Investors Association

records.title: Morocco's fruit and vegetable export volumes grew by approximately 15% between 2023 and 2025, reaching nearly 1.6 million tons, according...
records.description: Morocco's fruit and vegetable export volumes grew by approximately 15% between 2023 and 2025, reaching nearly 1.6 million tons, according to data from the Office des Changes and Morocco Foodex. This expansion was led by fresh tomatoes, greenhouse vegetables like peppers and zucchini, and a rising volume of avocados. While total export value reached an estimated 43 billion dirhams, revenue growth slowed in 2025 as European market prices normalized and competition from Spain, Egypt, and Turkey intensified. Despite successfully increasing shipments to key destinations in the European Union and the United Kingdom, exporters face tighter margins due to high production costs and critical water scarcity. To address these challenges, the sector is increasingly reliant on investments in desalination and irrigation efficiency to sustain its export strategy amidst recurring droughts and high water demand in basins like Souss-Massa.

records.title: Recent rainfall has significantly bolstered water security in the Taroudant province, with the Aoulouz Dam reaching nearly 100% capacity...
records.description: Recent rainfall has significantly bolstered water security in the Taroudant province, with the Aoulouz Dam reaching nearly 100% capacity for the first time since 2018. According to the Souss-Massa River Basin Agency, the reservoir's reserves now exceed 89 million cubic meters, a dramatic increase from the 28% filling rate recorded just weeks prior. This replenishment secures the drinking water supply for the city of Taroudant through systems managed by the National Office of Electricity and Drinking Water, while also guaranteeing essential irrigation for agricultural areas within the Souss plain. Beyond immediate supply, the Souss-Massa River Basin Agency highlights that the dam serves strategic functions in flood mitigation and groundwater recharge, reinforcing the region's overall hydraulic and agricultural resilience against climate variability.

records.title: The National Center for Waste Management (MWAN) will present its strategic initiatives for the circular economy and environmental transfo...
records.description: The National Center for Waste Management (MWAN) will present its strategic initiatives for the circular economy and environmental transformation at IFAT Saudi Arabia, held under the patronage of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture. The event will feature over 3,500 specialized technologies from 450 exhibitors, focusing on innovative solutions in waste management, recycling, and water resource efficiency. By showcasing advanced models for energy recovery and smart digital solutions, the National Center for Waste Management (MWAN) aims to accelerate the Kingdom's transition toward sustainability and improve quality of life. This international platform facilitates investment partnerships and the exchange of global expertise, reinforcing the region's role as a hub for environmental innovation in line with national development goals.
records.institution: The National Center for Waste Management (MWAN)

records.title: A national workshop was launched in Damascus to enhance food security and revitalize the agricultural sector through a joint initiative b...
records.description: A national workshop was launched in Damascus to enhance food security and revitalize the agricultural sector through a joint initiative between the Ministry of Agriculture, the Planning and Statistics Commission, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), and the World Food Programme (WFP). The event focused on presenting findings from a comprehensive food security survey to establish a scientific database for future planning and resource optimization. By utilizing accurate statistics, the participating institutions aim to bridge production gaps, improve agricultural efficiency, and strengthen the resilience of local communities. This collaborative effort emphasizes the importance of national coordination and data-driven strategies to support sustainable livelihoods and ensure long-term food stability across the country.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, the Planning and Statistics Commission

records.title: The European Union is strengthening its commitment to the Tunisian date industry by facilitating direct engagement between European buyer...
records.description: The European Union is strengthening its commitment to the Tunisian date industry by facilitating direct engagement between European buyers and local producers in key regions like Douz, Kebili, and Tozeur. Through the Support Programme for Competitiveness and Market Access (PACE-AMIT)—co-financed by the European Union and Germany and implemented by the German Agency for International Cooperation (GIZ)—Tunisian companies are being supported to meet rigorous quality, food safety, and traceability standards. Access to the European market is further enhanced by customs duty exemptions under the EU-Tunisia Association Agreement, allowing varieties like Deglet Nour and organic dates to maintain a strong presence in countries such as Italy, Germany, and Spain. Despite slight fluctuations in export volumes, the sector is increasingly diversifying into high-value derivative products like date syrup and powder, reinforcing Tunisia's status as a global leader in the sustainable production and export of "Tunisian gold."

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The 18th World Future Energy Summit, hosted by Masdar as part of Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, has highlighted massive cross-border inve...
records.description: The 18th World Future Energy Summit, hosted by Masdar as part of Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, has highlighted massive cross-border investment opportunities in clean energy, including a projected $11 trillion global market for green hydrogen. The European Commission emphasized its commitment to a stable trade framework with the GCC to unlock private investment in green technologies and energy-critical raw materials, while the EU Delegation to the UAE noted that mutual investments have already reached hundreds of billions of dollars. Within the summit, the Abu Dhabi Department of Energy advocated for integrated system designs combining solar, nuclear, and hydrogen to ensure grid reliability, supported by AI-enabled digital transformation.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has inaugurated the Al Sila Veterinary and Agricultural Services Centre to e...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has inaugurated the Al Sila Veterinary and Agricultural Services Centre to enhance the service ecosystem for farmers and livestock breeders in the Al Sila region. This new facility provides integrated services, including clinical examinations, laboratory diagnostics, periodic vaccinations, and specialized agricultural extension services to promote biosecurity and animal health. By expanding its geographical footprint, ADAFSA aims to reduce service delivery times and improve the readiness of field teams to respond to veterinary and agricultural emergencies. This strategic step supports the sustainability of both the crop and livestock sectors in the Emirate while ensuring the adoption of global best practices in animal healthcare.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) hosted a Farmers’ Open Day at the Al Kuwaitat Research Station to bridge the...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) hosted a Farmers’ Open Day at the Al Kuwaitat Research Station to bridge the gap between scientific research and practical field applications. In partnership with the Abu Dhabi Agricultural Club, the event featured a comprehensive field tour where farmers explored projects involving cut flower cultivation, greenhouse management, and optimized irrigation systems tailored to local climatic conditions.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The United Arab Emirates and the Republic of the Philippines have formalized a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) to cat...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates and the Republic of the Philippines have formalized a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) to catalyze a new era of economic opportunity and bilateral cooperation. Signed on the sidelines of Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, the agreement aims to reduce tariffs and trade barriers while boosting investment in vital sectors such as agriculture, financial services, and electrical equipment. This strategic partnership, supported by the Ministry of Economy and the Philippines Department of Trade and Industry, is projected to increase the UAE’s GDP by $2.4 billion by 2032 and follows a significant rise in non-oil trade, which reached hundreds of millions of dollars in recent years. By empowering SMEs and building more resilient supply chains, the CEPA reinforces the UAE's commitment to building global partnerships that foster long-term prosperity and align with national goals to significantly increase non-oil foreign trade.

records.title: Egypt’s wheat imports declined by approximately 8% to 13.2 million tons due to a combination of rising global prices, shifting domestic d...
records.description: Egypt’s wheat imports declined by approximately 8% to 13.2 million tons due to a combination of rising global prices, shifting domestic demand, and a strategic increase in local production. Data from the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade and the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation indicate that government imports specifically dropped by 15% as local procurement rose by 18% during the recent season. This shift is supported by the expansion of cultivated land to 3.5 million acres and the development of high-yield varieties through scientific research, alongside new production areas managed by Egypt’s Future Authority.
records.institution: The Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade and the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.domain: Sanitary, phytosanitary and technical standards improvements
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has announced a successful expansion of national exports following negotiations between...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has announced a successful expansion of national exports following negotiations between the Egyptian Agricultural Quarantine Authority and its counterpart in the Dominican Republic. This agreement officially opens the Dominican market to a variety of citrus fruits, including oranges, grapefruit, and tangerines, as well as fresh pomegranates. By establishing mutually agreed technical guidelines and action plans, the initiative aims to capitalize on high demand in the Caribbean to increase export surpluses and generate foreign currency. This strategic move aligns with national efforts to boost the competitiveness of agricultural products and secure a foothold in leading international tourist destinations that require a steady supply of fresh produce.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The National Investment Commission has highlighted the Sama Karbala poultry project as a vital component of the national strategy to achi...
records.description: The National Investment Commission has highlighted the Sama Karbala poultry project as a vital component of the national strategy to achieve food self-sufficiency and reduce reliance on imports. During a recent inspection, the National Investment Commission noted that the facility is one of the largest in the country, with an annual production capacity of 325,000 tonnes of poultry meat and three billion eggs. Equipped with modern ventilation systems and automated slaughterhouses capable of processing 748,000 birds daily, the project adheres to international health and quality standards. Furthermore, the National Investment Commission noted that regional partnerships are gaining momentum, exemplified by a memorandum of understanding between Cairo 3A Holding and IVI Holding Limited to invest US$160 million in expanding Iraq's poultry infrastructure and feed manufacturing capabilities over the next five years.

records.title: The agricultural sector has become a significant driver of national economic growth, contributing up to 8.6% to the GDP in recent quarters.
records.description: The agricultural sector has become a significant driver of national economic growth, contributing up to 8.6% to the GDP in recent quarters. This expansion is fueled by increased exports to regional markets, the adoption of modern technologies, and a substantial rise in irrigated land, which grew to 465,000 dunams. However, the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Water and Irrigation face challenges as rain-fed farming declines due to urbanization and climate change. To mitigate risks like declining rainfall and groundwater depletion, international institutions and the Economic Modernization Vision emphasize the need for nature-based solutions, smart irrigation, and precision agriculture. Protecting the livelihoods of farmers remains a national priority, requiring integrated water harvesting strategies and the use of reclaimed water to ensure long-term food and water security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Water and Irrigation

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Al Dhafra Solar Photovoltaic Plant stands as the world's largest single-site solar power facility, utilizing millions of panels to co...
records.description: The Al Dhafra Solar Photovoltaic Plant stands as the world's largest single-site solar power facility, utilizing millions of panels to convert sunlight into clean energy for 200,000 homes in Abu Dhabi. The project significantly reduces carbon emissions by millions of tons annually through its 2-gigawatt production capacity. Managed with advanced monitoring systems and technical precision, the facility serves as a practical model for large-scale sustainability and long-term environmental vision in the region.
records.institution: The Al Dhafra Solar Photovoltaic Plant

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has announced that preliminary results from the Pirbright International Reference Laboratory in the...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has announced that preliminary results from the Pirbright International Reference Laboratory in the United Kingdom confirmed the presence of the SAT1 serotype of foot-and-mouth disease virus, alongside Topotype III, among local livestock. The ministry clarified that the virus, which is genetically related to strains previously found in Turkey and Azerbaijan, entered the country through illegal smuggling rather than official trade channels. In response, the Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture is coordinating with international health authorities to monitor livestock health daily and strengthen preventive veterinary measures across all farms. These efforts include updating protocols for cattle, sheep, and goats to safeguard local production and prevent further spread. Farmers are urged to remain vigilant and follow official veterinary guidelines until a final report with comprehensive scientific recommendations is released to ensure the effective management of the health risk.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: In the Béni Mellal-Khénifra region, the olive harvest has seen a remarkable recovery, with production forecasted by the Tadla Regional Of...
records.description: In the Béni Mellal-Khénifra region, the olive harvest has seen a remarkable recovery, with production forecasted by the Tadla Regional Office for Agricultural Development to reach approximately 97,700 tons—a 221% increase over the previous season. This surge, driven by favorable rainfall during flowering and strategic irrigation efforts, has revitalized the local economy, generating roughly 2.5 million workdays and supporting thousands of rural households. The season highlights a transition toward modern processing techniques, where facilities emphasize rapid crushing and standardized washing to ensure high-quality oil and lower acidity. As a structuring pillar of the territory, the olive sector continues to benefit from research into climate-resilient varieties by the National Institute of Agricultural Research (INRA), reinforcing the crop's status as a vital economic safety net and a symbol of regional agricultural sustainability.
records.institution: The Tadla Regional Office for Agricultural Development

records.title: Recent rainfall in the Oriental region has significantly improved water security in the Moulouya basin, a region previously burdened by s...
records.description: Recent rainfall in the Oriental region has significantly improved water security in the Moulouya basin, a region previously burdened by severe water stress. According to the Moulouya River Basin Agency, dam reservoirs have reached a filling rate of approximately 40%, totaling 319 million cubic meters across major structures such as the Oued Za, Mohammed V, and Hassan II dams. This replenishment is expected to bolster irrigated agriculture and stabilize the drinking water supply for the local population. To further strengthen regional resilience, the Moulouya River Basin Agency is overseeing major infrastructure projects, including the construction of the Targa Ou Madi and Béni Aziman dams, alongside a massive expansion of the Mohammed V dam. These hydraulic investments, which utilize specialized domestic expertise, are projected to more than double the basin's total storage capacity, ensuring a more sustainable foundation for economic and agricultural development in the face of climate change.
