records.title: The Al-Jouf International Olive Festival, organized by the Al-Jouf Municipality, continues to showcase the region as a global capital for...
records.description: The Al-Jouf International Olive Festival, organized by the Al-Jouf Municipality, continues to showcase the region as a global capital for olive oil, featuring international participation from seven countries alongside dozens of local farmers and agricultural companies. The event highlights the immense agricultural capacity of the area, which manages over 23 million trees and produces more than 150,000 tons of olives annually. To maintain high standards, the Al-Jouf Municipality enforces strict quality control through seven laboratory tests, including acidity and rancidity checks, ensuring that only certified products receive an "approved label" for sale. By facilitating expertise exchange and exploring new export markets, the festival serves as a strategic platform to leverage regional competitive advantages and foster international partnerships in line with national economic goals.

records.title: The Saudi-Japanese Ministerial Investment Forum was held under the Invest Saudi umbrella, resulting in the signing of 12 memoranda of und...
records.description: The Saudi-Japanese Ministerial Investment Forum was held under the Invest Saudi umbrella, resulting in the signing of 12 memoranda of understanding across diverse sectors including agriculture, technology, water, finance, and manufacturing. The event brought together senior government officials and private-sector representatives to strengthen trade cooperation and facilitate access to high-value investment opportunities. These agreements support the expansion of the bilateral investment partnership in alignment with the Saudi-Japan Vision 2030, focusing on shared prospects in energy, machinery, and space. Discussions also centered on empowering the private sector and integrating new growth strategies to capitalize on major development projects within the framework of the Ministry of Investment and the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry.
records.institution: The Ministry of Investment and the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has announced a major economic milestone, with the market value of it...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has announced a major economic milestone, with the market value of its supported sectors exceeding SAR 5.6 billion. This growth is driven by a strategy to diversify the agricultural production base and enhance the income of small-scale farmers in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. Key performance areas include the fruit sector, which contributed over SAR 2.3 billion, and the coffee sector, reaching SAR 825 million, alongside significant contributions from honey, roses, and rain-fed crops. By providing financial and advisory support to beekeepers, fishermen, and rural families, the Saudi Reef program aims to strengthen national food security and self-sufficiency while creating high-quality job opportunities and safeguarding environmental resources in rural areas.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: A high-level workshop on food security and agricultural livelihoods was launched in Damascus, organized by the Ministry of Agriculture in...
records.description: A high-level workshop on food security and agricultural livelihoods was launched in Damascus, organized by the Ministry of Agriculture in collaboration with the Planning and Statistics Commission, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), and the World Food Programme (WFP). The event aims to process and analyze data from recent national surveys to address production gaps and revitalize the agricultural sector. Findings presented during the session indicate that while approximately 80% of the population faces poverty, food security indicators have improved by 7% compared to previous years, with 18% of the population now classified as food secure.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company PJSC – Masdar has signed its first Power Purchase Agreement in Angola for a 150-megawatt solar photovolta...
records.description: Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company PJSC – Masdar has signed its first Power Purchase Agreement in Angola for a 150-megawatt solar photovoltaic project, established in collaboration with the state-owned offtaker Rede Nacional de Transporte de Electricidade (RNT-EP). This initiative serves as the inaugural site under a broader 500-megawatt renewable energy program aimed at strengthening the national power grid and supporting sustainable development objectives. Supported by the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) through its financing platforms, the project is expected to create thousands of jobs and provide clean electricity to hundreds of thousands of homes. The agreement highlights the commitment of the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment and the Ministry of Energy and Water to expand utility-scale renewables in emerging markets, contributing to a global clean energy portfolio target and fostering investor confidence in the regional energy transition.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company PJSC – Masdar

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) identifies the UAE as a strategic international partner essential for bolstering food securit...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) identifies the UAE as a strategic international partner essential for bolstering food security through the implementation of the National Food Security Strategy 2051. This strategy prioritizes sustainable local production, supply chain efficiency, and the reduction of food loss and waste to ensure the long-term stability of food systems. By hosting international platforms such as Global Food Week and collaborating with the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment on regional dialogues regarding food safety, the nation facilitates knowledge exchange and the development of advanced regulatory frameworks. This partnership integrates technical roles with institutional support, emphasizing capacity building and multilateral action to confront global food crises and improve preparedness in regions most affected by environmental and economic shocks.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.title: The Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award pavilion at the Sheikh Zayed Festival hosted a session focused on transitionin...
records.description: The Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award pavilion at the Sheikh Zayed Festival hosted a session focused on transitioning traditional farming into a technology-driven economic ecosystem. Organized by the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the discussion emphasized how national initiatives stimulate innovation, institutional growth, and international knowledge exchange. Modern agricultural practices in the region now integrate artificial intelligence and smart farming systems to optimize water consumption and nutrient management, moving toward a science-based model for food security. By fostering a culture of collaboration among entrepreneurs and farmers, the Emirates Agricultural Pioneers Association and Gracia Group aim to leverage advanced infrastructure and supportive policies to enhance local production quality and long-term sustainability through data-driven decision-making.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: A joint development project in Aswan has expanded into a second phase with EGP 120m in funding to integrate smallholder farmers into Egyp...
records.description: A joint development project in Aswan has expanded into a second phase with EGP 120m in funding to integrate smallholder farmers into Egypt’s formal financial system through a collaboration between the Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), the banking sector, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, and the World Food Programme (WFP). The initiative aims to improve economic livelihoods and food security by implementing modern solar-powered irrigation, promoting financial literacy, and providing technical support for strategic crop cultivation. Following a successful initial phase that significantly increased farmer revenues and crop production while reducing operational costs, the project is now targeting new villages with a specific focus on the economic empowerment of women and rural communities facing climate challenges. Participating financial institutions are further supporting this transition by offering digital payment tools, livestock project funding, and vocational training via the Executive Agency for the Comprehensive Development Projects (EACDP) and the Nilepreneurs Initiative.

records.title: Mshariq Organic Agriculture is launching one of Egypt’s most advanced integrated agro-industrial projects in the New Valley Governorate,...
records.description: Mshariq Organic Agriculture is launching one of Egypt’s most advanced integrated agro-industrial projects in the New Valley Governorate, specifically in the Farafra oasis. The project, which spans a 1,000-feddan reclamation site, is designed to merge organic cultivation with high-value processing to maximize export potential. By adhering to EU-certified organic standards, the company is targeting the rising demand for medicinal, aromatic, and health products in European and Gulf markets. The initiative aligns with national goals for desert reclamation and food security, focusing on "yield per feddan" rather than simple land expansion.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The government has inaugurated four major industrial projects within the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE), representing a total investme...
records.description: The government has inaugurated four major industrial projects within the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE), representing a total investment exceeding $153 million across the renewable energy, engineering, textile, and food sectors. A central component of this expansion is the Elite Solar technology complex, which produces solar cells and panels with a total annual capacity of 5 gigawatts, supporting national goals to become a regional green energy hub. In the engineering and textile sectors, the newly opened Vanward factory and Xin Jin complex are set to produce hundreds of thousands of water heaters and millions of meters of fabric, respectively, with a heavy focus on international exports to Africa, Europe, and the Middle East. Additionally, the opening of the Mexicano Food Industries plant further diversifies the region's output.

records.title: Shutterstock The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has la...
records.description: Shutterstock The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), has launched a practical training program for extension agents across several governorates to promote climate-smart agricultural practices. The initiative focuses on building technical expertise in milk safety, the operation of dairy processing equipment, and sustainable livestock support through green fodder cultivation and corn silage production. Furthermore, the program emphasizes water conservation by training agents on the implementation of sprinkler and drip irrigation systems.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources in the Kurdistan Region have joined the Food and Agricult...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources in the Kurdistan Region have joined the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) to launch a regional emergency project aimed at combating foot-and-mouth disease. By adopting the One Health approach, the initiative focuses on strengthening animal health systems and improving regional coordination to prevent the cross-border spread of the virus. This collaboration is designed to enhance the preparedness of veterinary personnel and protect livestock through improved disease surveillance and emergency response strategies.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department and in cooperation with the Maysan Agriculture Directorate, has...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department and in cooperation with the Maysan Agriculture Directorate, has successfully completed a research trial for the "Al-Dur" wheat variety in saline lands. Conducted in the Al-Musharrah district, the project utilized drip irrigation and well water to test the crop's resilience against harsh environmental conditions. The trial demonstrated successful growth stages, confirming the variety's high tolerance and paving the way for wider cultivation of high-purity, high-grade seeds. This achievement supports national strategies to enhance the production of strategic crops and provide sustainable solutions for farmers working in challenging soil conditions.

records.title: Shutterstock The Ministry of Environment, alongside the National Steering Committee for Reducing Random Waste Disposal, has launched the...
records.description: Shutterstock The Ministry of Environment, alongside the National Steering Committee for Reducing Random Waste Disposal, has launched the 2026–2027 Executive Program for the National Strategy on Cleanliness and Combating Random Waste Disposal. This initiative addresses the rising financial and environmental costs of waste management by targeting the accumulation of refuse in public spaces, tourist sites, and natural areas. The program centers on four primary pillars—regulatory, technical, enforcement, and awareness—to protect natural resources, reduce soil and water pollution, and support a circular economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development, has implemented a water harvesting...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development, has implemented a water harvesting project in the Jerusalem Governorate valued at 317,000 shekels to enhance food security and farmer resilience. The initiative addresses challenges such as water scarcity and climate change through three primary interventions: drilling rainwater collection wells, distributing storage tanks to livestock breeders, and installing modern irrigation networks to increase productivity. These efforts specifically target marginalized agricultural communities to optimize surface runoff for supplemental irrigation and animal watering. By utilizing a phased implementation mechanism for financial transfers and infrastructure development, the Ministry of Agriculture and the Jerusalem Agriculture Directorate aim to ensure the sustainable use of resources and support the continued investment of farmers in their land despite environmental and external restrictions.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the YMCA, has distributed the first batch of 2,800 olive seedlings to farmers in the nor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the YMCA, has distributed the first batch of 2,800 olive seedlings to farmers in the northern Hebron Governorate, specifically within the Sa’ir and Al-Shuyukh areas. This initiative is part of a long-standing joint advocacy program designed to promote olive cultivation, protect agricultural lands, and support the resilience of local communities. By partnering with various organizations, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to expand olive production across the West Bank, ensuring that farmers have the necessary resources to maintain their land and sustain their livelihoods despite ongoing regional challenges.

records.title: The National Water Distribution Company (SONEDE) is advancing several water infrastructure projects across the governorate of Siliana to...
records.description: The National Water Distribution Company (SONEDE) is advancing several water infrastructure projects across the governorate of Siliana to strengthen resource capacity and improve accessibility. Significant progress has been made with the operation of deep wells such as "Siliana 1" and "Soudal 2," while new drilling operations are underway in the Bargou delegation at sites like "Farna 1 bis" and "Aïn Ennachm."

records.title: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture has highlighted the continued success of the Bahraini Farmers’ Market at the Budai...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture has highlighted the continued success of the Bahraini Farmers’ Market at the Budaiya Botanical Garden as a vital platform for national food security. Running every Saturday through February 14, 2026, the market is a collaborative effort between the Ministry, the National Initiative for Agricultural Development (NIAD), and private sector partners. This season features 33 local farmers, alongside specialized nurseries, apiaries, and productive families. By providing a direct-to-consumer marketing channel, the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture aims to strengthen consumer confidence in "Made in Bahrain" produce, particularly fresh seasonal vegetables, while supporting the economic livelihoods of local agricultural entrepreneurs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, successfully completed the autumn harvest of yellow corn genet...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, successfully completed the autumn harvest of yellow corn genetic varieties at the Tikrit Research Department in Salah al-Din Governorate. This achievement is part of a national strategic program focused on propagating and maintaining high-purity yellow corn hybrids, such as the locally developed Maha and Baghdad varieties, which are critical for the country’s industrial oil and animal feed sectors. Despite the rigorous "high selection intensity" required to ensure genetic purity, the harvest demonstrated strong productivity, reinforcing Iraq’s transition toward seed sovereignty and climate-resilient farming.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department at the Nineveh Horticulture Station, has launched a high-intensity propa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department at the Nineveh Horticulture Station, has launched a high-intensity propagation and service campaign as part of its 2026 agricultural plan. Specialized technical teams are currently cultivating high-productivity, climate-resistant olive cuttings within advanced greenhouses to expand the availability of approved varieties. Simultaneously, the station is providing direct olive pressing services to local citizens, reporting a surge in demand for both oil processing and affordable seedlings. By combining technical propagation with community processing services, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to modernize the olive sector, bolster local oil production, and support the economic resilience of farmers in the Nineveh Governorate.

records.title: Morocco's citrus production is projected to reach new heights in the current season, driven by favorable climatic conditions and a produc...
records.description: Morocco's citrus production is projected to reach new heights in the current season, driven by favorable climatic conditions and a productive physiological cycle for orchards. According to reports from the USDA, total citrus output is expected to stabilize at over two million metric tons, with tangerines and mandarins leading the sector at approximately 1.15 million tons. This growth is supported by robust public policies under the Ministry of Agriculture, which provide financial incentives, phytosanitary support, and investment aid for packing stations. While the export season saw a slight delay due to fruit maturation, improved sizes—particularly in high-demand international grades—are expected to drive exports to 550,000 tons for soft citrus.

records.title: The agricultural sector has seen the official launch of Fallah360, the first specialized classifieds platform dedicated to the industry,...
records.description: The agricultural sector has seen the official launch of Fallah360, the first specialized classifieds platform dedicated to the industry, published by AGRI360. Designed as a comprehensive service tool, the website allows farmers and industry professionals to post and view free listings across diverse categories including livestock, irrigation, machinery, rural real estate, and employment. The platform provides a structured alternative to informal trade channels by verifying all listings through a human validation process to ensure a reliable environment. While the service remains entirely free for farmers, the AGRI360 initiative offers dedicated digital shops for equipment and supply sellers, leveraging specialized knowledge of the regional agricultural landscape to facilitate direct connections between local stakeholders and buyers.

records.title: The Cows and Poultry event, hosted within the Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award pavilion at the Sheikh Zayed Festiva...
records.description: The Cows and Poultry event, hosted within the Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award pavilion at the Sheikh Zayed Festival, concluded as a key initiative to strengthen the national sustainable food security system. Organized through a partnership between the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the Emirates Poultry Breeders Association, and specialized private firms, the event showcased advanced cattle and poultry farming technologies, focusing on biosecurity standards, smart farm management, and resource efficiency.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the Emirates Poultry Breeders Association

records.title: Sar Albraa Company has been awarded a $223,649.21 contract by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to rehabilitate the Univers...
records.description: Sar Albraa Company has been awarded a $223,649.21 contract by the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to rehabilitate the University of Basrah's Marine Science Center fish hatchery in Al-Hartha. This strategic project involves the comprehensive restoration of the hatchery's infrastructure alongside the installation of advanced solar power systems to ensure a reliable and eco-friendly energy supply for essential operations. By transitioning to solar energy and upgrading breeding facilities, the initiative aims to boost local fish production, enhance regional food security, and reduce the environmental footprint of the university's research and production activities.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests has successfully completed a nationwide livesto...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests has successfully completed a nationwide livestock identification operation, a central component of its strategic restocking program. This milestone involved the identification of 32.3 million head of livestock, creating a precise national database to manage public policies, health monitoring, and direct aid. As part of the first phase, which mobilized 5.5 billion dirhams, the Ministry has already disbursed nearly 5.2 billion dirhams to approximately 1.1 million livestock farmers via bank transfers and postal orders. This initiative aims to restore balance to the livestock sector following recent environmental and economic challenges, bolstered by current favorable weather conditions and increased forage production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: The Salalah Mills Company SAOG and the Port of Salalah have officially signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to develop a Strategic...
records.description: The Salalah Mills Company SAOG and the Port of Salalah have officially signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to develop a Strategic Silos Project at Oman’s southern maritime gateway. This partnership is a cornerstone of the Sultanate’s dual strategy: securing national food reserves and transforming Oman into a competitive hub for global grain trading. By utilizing the Port of Salalah's deep-water connectivity and cargo-handling infrastructure, the project aims to leverage international trade volumes, which were valued at approximately $330 billion in the most recent season.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al-Jouf Municipality has launched the 19th edition of the Al-Jouf International Olive Festival in Sakaka, showcasing the region’s pos...
records.description: The Al-Jouf Municipality has launched the 19th edition of the Al-Jouf International Olive Festival in Sakaka, showcasing the region’s position as a premier global hub for olive production. This year’s event features the participation of 45 olive farms, 10 specialized agricultural companies, and seven countries, highlighting the region's massive agricultural assets, which include over 23 million olive trees. Organized to align with the developmental goals of the agricultural sector, the festival provides an integrated marketing platform to empower local producers and elevate Saudi olive products in local, regional, and international markets.

records.title: The Executive Unit for the Management of Financing for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives in Dhamar Governorate has established a succ...
records.description: The Executive Unit for the Management of Financing for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives in Dhamar Governorate has established a successful model for community-led development, focusing on water security and sustainable farming. By supporting 66 community initiatives with a total investment exceeding 1.7 billion rials, the Executive Unit has facilitated the construction and maintenance of dams, barriers, and reservoirs. Notably, the local community contributed 86 percent of the total costs, while the Executive Unit provided essential supplies such as cement, fuel, and heavy machinery. This partnership has directly benefited over 8,200 farmers across 345 hectares, prioritizing the irrigation of strategic cereal and legume crops—such as wheat, barley, and lentils—while strictly prohibiting the use of these resources for qat cultivation to ensure national food security.
records.institution: The Executive Unit for the Management of Financing for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives

records.title: GroFin Mauritius has secured a contract with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to implement a strategic initiative titled "...
records.description: GroFin Mauritius has secured a contract with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) to implement a strategic initiative titled "Date Palm Value Chain Financing and Enhanced Services for Building Resilient Businesses in the Southern Governorates of Iraq." This project focuses on strengthening the economic resilience of the date palm sector—a vital component of the Iraqi agricultural identity—by providing specialized financial services and business support to enterprises in the southern region. With a contract value of $80,200, the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) aims to modernize the value chain, improve the quality of date production, and empower local businesses to withstand environmental and economic challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, is advancing the "National Program for the Propagation of Fruit and Oli...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, is advancing the "National Program for the Propagation of Fruit and Olive Varieties" at the Karbala Citrus Nursery to revitalize Iraqi orchards. This specialized facility, covering approximately 40 acres, has grown from an initial capacity of 10,000 seedlings to housing more than 200,000 seedlings today. Technical teams are currently focused on harvesting, seed extraction, and grafting to produce improved varieties of oranges, lemons, and bitter oranges. By offering these high-quality seedlings at subsidized prices, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to support local farmers, enhance national vegetation cover, and combat the environmental challenges of desertification and climate change in the region.

records.title: The National Investment Commission (NIC) has highlighted the Sama Karbala poultry project as a vital strategic investment for Iraq’s food...
records.description: The National Investment Commission (NIC) has highlighted the Sama Karbala poultry project as a vital strategic investment for Iraq’s food security and economic independence. During a recent field inspection, the National Investment Commission (NIC) emphasized that this massive complex is a cornerstone of the state's policy to achieve self-sufficiency in animal protein and stabilize domestic markets. With an annual production capacity of approximately 325,000 tonnes of poultry meat and up to 3 billion eggs, the project utilizes modern climate-controlled halls and high-capacity automated slaughterhouses capable of processing 748,000 birds daily. By adhering to international health and technical standards, the National Investment Commission (NIC) aims to bolster consumer confidence in local goods while creating thousands of jobs and reducing the nation's reliance on imported food products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Meithalun Agriculture and Veterinary Department, conducted a field inspection in cooperation wit...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Meithalun Agriculture and Veterinary Department, conducted a field inspection in cooperation with the Customs Police. The operation resulted in the seizure of 56 liters of agricultural pesticides that failed to meet approved technical specifications and regulatory standards. The Ministry of Agriculture identified these non-compliant chemicals as significant risks to public safety, the agricultural environment, and the health of both farmers and consumers. These enforcement measures are part of a broader effort across governorates, including Jenin, to sanitize the supply chain and ensure that only permitted, high-quality fertilizers and pesticides are available in the market.

records.title: Under the supervision of the Higher Agricultural Emergency Committee, the Arab International Authority for Reconstruction in Palestine ha...
records.description: Under the supervision of the Higher Agricultural Emergency Committee, the Arab International Authority for Reconstruction in Palestine has delivered urgent agricultural supplies to farmers in the Sheikh Ajlin and Zarqa areas of Gaza. This intervention provided 20 farmers with irrigation networks, seeds, and seedlings, along with production inputs sufficient to cultivate half a dunam per beneficiary. Aligned with the priorities of the Ministry of Agriculture, the project focuses on reviving agricultural activity and strengthening the resilience of families affected by the destruction of land. By encouraging the use of small agricultural holdings to produce fresh vegetables, the Higher Agricultural Emergency Committee and its partners aim to enhance local food security and provide safe, healthy food for Palestinian families facing severe economic and living challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has inaugurated the 10th annual Citrus Festival in Al-Hariq Governorate, a strategic...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has inaugurated the 10th annual Citrus Festival in Al-Hariq Governorate, a strategic event designed to empower local farmers and strengthen national food security. Aligned with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030, the ten-day festival serves as a comprehensive platform for marketing a diverse range of local produce—including citrus fruits, dates, and honey—while developing the technical and marketing capabilities of the agricultural community. By integrating commercial exhibitions with tourism and recreational activities, the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture aims to highlight the region’s agricultural identity and environmental diversity, transforming the governorate into a premier destination for both agricultural investment and sustainable tourism.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Saudi Halal Center, operating under the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA), has launched the Halal Mark Track system, a first-of-it...
records.description: The Saudi Halal Center, operating under the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA), has launched the Halal Mark Track system, a first-of-its-kind initiative designed to integrate Halal certification with Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) standards. Developed in partnership with the Halal Product Development Company (HPDC)—a Public Investment Fund (PIF) subsidiary—and THIQAH, the system ensures that products meet both Islamic Sharia requirements and international sustainability benchmarks. By embedding ESG principles like ethical sourcing and environmental stewardship into the Halal ecosystem, the Kingdom aims to boost the global competitiveness of Saudi products and solidify its position as a leading hub for the $2 trillion global Halal economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy has published a new joint decree designed to streamline the regularization of industrial proje...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy has published a new joint decree designed to streamline the regularization of industrial projects situated on agricultural land. Signed alongside the Ministries of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, and Equipment and Housing, the decree modifies the previous framework from May 2023 to correct administrative shortcomings and relax stringent documentation requirements. This legislative update aims to balance the preservation of Tunisia's agricultural resources with the need to accelerate industrial investment and land-use efficiency. In light of these changes, the Ministry has invited developers whose previous applications were rejected to resubmit their files for review under the new, more flexible criteria.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, the Ministries of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE), serving as the Principal Partner of Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, is showcasing a comprehensiv...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE), serving as the Principal Partner of Abu Dhabi Sustainability Week, is showcasing a comprehensive portfolio of projects aligned with its Strategic Framework 2050. The Department is demonstrating how an integrated approach—utilizing artificial intelligence, smart infrastructure, and digital platforms—can enhance the efficiency and resilience of the energy and water sectors. Key innovations on display include AD.WE, an AI-powered management platform for end-to-end system optimization, and the Integrated Water Strategy, which focuses on diversifying sources and improving network efficiency to ensure long-term water security. By embedding these advanced technologies into agricultural and utility networks, the Department of Energy reinforces its role in driving the UAE's sustainability ambitions and positioning the Emirate as a global leader in energy transformation.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE)

records.title: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has entered into a strategic partnership with Ghitha, a food secto...
records.description: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has entered into a strategic partnership with Ghitha, a food sector portfolio company of Bahrain Mumtalakat Holding Company, to strengthen regional food security. The Memorandum of Understanding establishes a comprehensive framework for cooperation in food production, the development of strategic commodity reserves, and the optimization of distribution networks. By leveraging Ghitha’s growing operational capabilities and AAAID’s investment expertise, the two entities aim to scale innovative agricultural products and facilitate access to international markets. This collaboration is a key component of Bahrain’s national food security objectives and AAAID’s broader mandate to foster sustainable agricultural development across the Arab world.
records.institution: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID)

records.title: In a major step toward achieving food security and national sovereignty, the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financin...
records.description: In a major step toward achieving food security and national sovereignty, the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit in Hodeida, in collaboration with the Yemen Plains Foundation and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, has introduced a fleet of 16 modern agricultural harvesters to serve local cooperative societies. This initiative, part of a broader vertical expansion program, aims to modernize the Tihama "breadbasket" by replacing traditional, high-cost manual methods with efficient mechanical technology. By accelerating the harvest of grain and fodder crops and significantly reducing post-harvest losses, the project empowers cooperative societies to organize fieldwork effectively and lowers production costs for farmers. This transition is a key pillar of the state's vision to restore agriculture's role as a primary economic driver and transform local fertile lands into a sustainable foundation for self-sufficiency.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Diyala Agriculture Directorate, has reported an exceptionally abundant and high-quality potato h...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Diyala Agriculture Directorate, has reported an exceptionally abundant and high-quality potato harvest in the Al-Khalis District. Supported by the Al-Khalis Agriculture Division, this season’s production is characterized by a high specification and low sugar content, making it ideal for both domestic consumption and industrial processing. A significant portion of the crop is being cultivated in partnership with the Masar Al-Sahab Company, a private sector firm that has secured contracts to supply local potato chip factories. By providing technical oversight and essential facilities, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to strengthen the potato value chain, support private sector investment, and stabilize the local market with premium, locally grown produce that meets international industrial standards.

records.title: In Tripoli, the Government of National Unity (GNU) has launched a high-priority monitoring campaign to stabilize the prices of essential...
records.description: In Tripoli, the Government of National Unity (GNU) has launched a high-priority monitoring campaign to stabilize the prices of essential commodities and curb market manipulation. Prompted by directives to secure the market before the high-consumption month of Ramadan, the campaign targets supplier warehouses and food factories across various regions. This initiative is a response to the dual pressure of seasonal demand and currency depreciation, which has increased the cost of the country's food imports—an estimated 80% of the total supply. By utilizing the Municipal Guard and the Law Enforcement Department, the government aims to eliminate illicit speculation and hoarding, ensuring that importers who receive preferential letters of credit do not unfairly hike prices for the public.

records.title: According to a strategic outlook for the tomato sector, Morocco Foodex (the Autonomous Establishment for Export Control and Coordination)...
records.description: According to a strategic outlook for the tomato sector, Morocco Foodex (the Autonomous Establishment for Export Control and Coordination) highlights that Morocco is uniquely positioned to address the structural supply gaps facing the European Union through 2035. As European production faces constraints from rising energy costs and stricter environmental regulations under the Green Deal, the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) notes that Morocco’s production has reached nearly 1.7 million tons with exceptional yields of 10 kg/m². By leveraging advanced greenhouse technologies and high-performing irrigation systems, Morocco Foodex ensures that Moroccan exports meet stringent international standards for quality and traceability. This positioning allows the Kingdom to remain a critical partner for the EU, providing a consistent and high-quality supply of tomatoes—particularly during the autumn and winter months—and solidifying its role as a cornerstone of the Mediterranean agri-food trade.

records.title: The Moroccan Association for Sprinkler and Drip Irrigation (AMIAG) has issued an urgent warning regarding a severe financial crisis threa...
records.description: The Moroccan Association for Sprinkler and Drip Irrigation (AMIAG) has issued an urgent warning regarding a severe financial crisis threatening the country's irrigation value chain and its broader food security goals. According to the Moroccan Association for Sprinkler and Drip Irrigation (AMIAG), the sector is facing a potential wave of bankruptcies due to a multi-billion dirham shortfall in government subsidies, with some payment delays from the Agricultural Development Fund reaching up to 24 months. These financial pressures are compounded by a sharp rise in interest rates from Crédit Agricole du Maroc—increasing from 3.5% to 5.5%—and a significant spike in the cost of technical equipment. As 73% of irrigation projects currently rely on debt-heavy financing models, the Moroccan Association for Sprinkler and Drip Irrigation (AMIAG) emphasizes that without immediate institutional intervention to settle outstanding arrears and ease financing conditions, the nation's strategic transition toward sustainable water management and modern agriculture could be permanently compromised.
records.institution: The Moroccan Association for Sprinkler and Drip Irrigation (AMIAG)

records.title: The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the YMCA/Jerusalem and the YWCA/Palestine, has delivered technical supplies...
records.description: The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the YMCA/Jerusalem and the YWCA/Palestine, has delivered technical supplies for 20 grape cultivation demonstrations in the villages of Beit Al-Roush Al-Tahta and Deir Al-Asal Al-Fouqa. With a total investment of approximately 120,000 shekels, the project provides farmers with the infrastructure and tools necessary to establish high-yield home vineyards. This initiative, part of the broader Olive Tree Campaign, is designed to diversify rural production, enhance household food security, and foster economic resilience in areas facing significant environmental and economic pressures.

records.title: The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the YMCA/Jerusalem, has delivered essential seedlings and seeds to establis...
records.description: The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the YMCA/Jerusalem, has delivered essential seedlings and seeds to establish 10 ecological home gardens for women in the village of Beit Marsam. This initiative follows a preparatory phase where the gardens were equipped with structural supplies and technical guidance on sustainable cultivation. By focusing on marginalized rural areas, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to empower women economically, improve family nutrition, and promote environmental stewardship. These ecological gardens serve as localized production hubs that enhance the resilience of the local community while preserving natural resources through sustainable agricultural practices.

records.title: Saudi Arabia has achieved a significant agricultural milestone with the inauguration of the Kingdom's first white strawberry production a...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has achieved a significant agricultural milestone with the inauguration of the Kingdom's first white strawberry production at Hail Strawberry Park, positioned as only the third country globally to produce this rare variety after the United States and Japan. This development, which coincided with the launch of the park's seventh seasonal exhibition, underscores the strategic importance of the region as a primary agricultural hub and a vital contributor to national food security. By successfully cultivating these specialty berries, the facility demonstrates the growing role of the agricultural sector as a pillar of the national economy and a leader in innovative crop production within the region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has reported a significant milestone in Saudi Arabia’s food security, with table egg p...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has reported a significant milestone in Saudi Arabia’s food security, with table egg production reaching 8.4 billion eggs, a 6.4% increase over the previous year. This surge has enabled the Kingdom to achieve a self-sufficiency rate of 100%, effectively meeting all domestic demand with local production. The Riyadh region remains the national leader, contributing 3.2 billion eggs, followed by Makkah and the Eastern Province. A key driver of this success is the Saudi Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) initiative, which now certifies 82% of the country's egg production. By enforcing these high standards for food safety and quality, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture continues to strengthen consumer trust and provide a surplus of high-quality protein for both the national market and regional exports.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture
