records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla has officially launched the latest edition of its regional citrus celebration at the farmers’ market.
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla has officially launched the latest edition of its regional citrus celebration at the farmers’ market. This community-focused event highlights the region’s rich agricultural heritage, showcasing a diverse harvest from thousands of local farms. Visitors can explore and purchase a wide variety of premium fruits—including oranges, sweet lemons, citrons, and kumquats—while farmers benefit from a vital platform to market their produce directly to the public. By supporting these agricultural efforts, the Royal Commission for AlUla is strengthening the local economy and promoting the governorate as a key destination for high-quality sustainable produce.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication has launched a major phase of the national potato seed project in Tartous, planting 39,...
records.description: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication has launched a major phase of the national potato seed project in Tartous, planting 39,000 tissue culture seedlings within specialized greenhouses. This high-tech agricultural initiative focuses on producing "mother plant" tubers that are entirely disease-free, providing a clean genetic foundation for the country's potato sector. By propagating five locally adapted varieties—Aya, Qalamoun, Athar, Afamia, and Furat—the General Establishment for Seed Multiplication aims to break the cycle of dependency on expensive imported seeds, ensuring a sustainable, locally-sourced supply for Syrian farmers.
records.institution: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication

records.title: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA), in collaboration with the Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (URAP) and the...
records.description: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA), in collaboration with the Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (URAP) and the Regional Union of Industry, Trade, and Handicrafts (URICA), is organizing the Agricultural Investment Fair (SIAS) in Sidi Bouzid. This regional event serves as a strategic platform to highlight the governorate's leading national position in olive oil, red meat, and fruit and vegetable production. By facilitating connections between farmers, investors, and financing institutions, the Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) aims to stimulate agricultural entrepreneurship and address modern challenges like climate change and livestock restocking. The fair underscores a broader vision to transform central Tunisia into a high-tech agricultural hub through professional meetings and conferences designed to promote sustainable development and enhance the competitiveness of local products.

records.title: The UAE government has enacted a major legislative overhaul to modernize its agricultural, veterinary, and environmental sectors, alignin...
records.description: The UAE government has enacted a major legislative overhaul to modernize its agricultural, veterinary, and environmental sectors, aligning national regulations with international standards like CITES and the International Plant Protection Convention. Managed by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, these updated federal laws significantly strengthen the country's biosecurity framework by introducing stricter quarantine protocols for animal and plant shipments and granting authorities expanded powers to seize illegal wildlife specimens. The reforms also introduce robust protections for new plant varieties to encourage agricultural innovation and impose much tougher penalties for violations, including fines of up to AED 2 million and mandatory deportation for repeat foreign offenders.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The World Future Energy Summit, hosted by Masdar at the ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi, is set to become a primary staging ground for a strategic...
records.description: The World Future Energy Summit, hosted by Masdar at the ADNEC Centre Abu Dhabi, is set to become a primary staging ground for a strategic green hydrogen alliance between the UAE and the UK. As the hydrogen market transitions from "hype" to "market realism," the Summit highlights the UAE's role in helping the UK reach its ambitious target of 10GW of low-carbon hydrogen production by 2030. With the UK requiring an estimated £9 billion (AED 44.6 billion) in private investment to scale its flagship hydrogen projects, the UAE—already a leader in large-scale Carbon Capture (CCUS) and renewable infrastructure—is positioned as a vital funding and technical partner. This collaboration is bolstered by the UAE's own domestic projects, such as the Ta'ziz Industrial Hub and the Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (KEZAD), as both nations seek to leverage green hydrogen to drive industrial decarbonization and long-term economic growth.

records.title: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Mahwit Governorate has launched an emergency veterinary intervention to combat a localized outbreak of lump...
records.description: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Mahwit Governorate has launched an emergency veterinary intervention to combat a localized outbreak of lumpy skin disease. Working in coordination with the Animal Health Department at the Ministry of Agriculture and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, the governorate has begun distributing a specialized batch of medicines, vaccines, and medical supplies to affected districts. The campaign focuses on treating active cases in sheep and goats while simultaneously vaccinating healthy cattle to prevent the disease from spreading further. By integrating the efforts of local cooperative societies and district agricultural offices, the Agricultural Sector aims to safeguard livestock—a critical pillar of rural income—and enhance regional food security through this comprehensive containment and awareness strategy.
records.institution: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Mahwit Governorate

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) has implemented a large-scale digital transformation to integrate artif...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) has implemented a large-scale digital transformation to integrate artificial intelligence and geospatial technologies into global agri-food systems. Through the development of data-driven solutions such as the Hand-in-Hand geospatial platform and risk monitoring tools, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) provides policymakers and farmers with actionable insights to improve agricultural productivity and anticipate climate-related threats. Additionally, the institution’s efforts in soil management, fertility preservation, and the Digital Villages initiative facilitate inclusive access to technical advice and market services in rural areas. Supported by a digital academy that fosters global knowledge sharing, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) continues to lead the transition toward more resilient, innovative, and sustainable agricultural practices.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the YMCA/Jerusalem, has successfully distributed 2,600 olive seedlings across the sout...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the YMCA/Jerusalem, has successfully distributed 2,600 olive seedlings across the southern Hebron governorate. This initiative, part of the second phase of a long-standing olive campaign, specifically targeted the Al-Koum, Hamza, and Deir Samet areas near Dura. By providing high-quality seedlings to farmers on threatened agricultural lands, the Ministry of Agriculture and its partners aim to reinforce Palestinian land tenure, enhance long-term food security, and bolster the economic resilience of rural communities. The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate emphasized that beneficiaries were selected through rigorous field investigations to ensure that support is prioritized for the most vulnerable areas and those at the highest risk of land loss.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development and Agricultural Relief, has...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development and Agricultural Relief, has delivered high-quality technical supplies to almond, plum, and apricot farmers across the Jenin Governorate. This intervention, covering key towns such as Raba, Faqou’a, Burqin, Al-Yamoun, Sila Al-Harithiya, and Ajja, is a strategic component of a larger project designed to enhance livelihoods and sustainable economic growth. By providing specialized infrastructure—including shade netting, structural piping, and binding cables—the project aims to modernize the almond value chain, protect crops from environmental stressors, and ensure the long-term food security and resilience of Palestinian rural communities.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) recently carried out a significant food distribution operation in the Badak...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) recently carried out a significant food distribution operation in the Badakhshan Province of Afghanistan, reaching 490 families in the provincial capital. This effort provided essential nutritional support to nearly 3,000 individuals, including orphans and families who have recently returned to the country. As the primary humanitarian arm of Saudi Arabia, the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) implements these projects to alleviate suffering and address food insecurity in vulnerable communities. This specific distribution is part of a broader, ongoing commitment to provide life-saving assistance and stabilize the living conditions of those affected by displacement and economic hardship across the region.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Education have jointly launched the second phase of the "Planting a Nation" campaign in t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Education have jointly launched the second phase of the "Planting a Nation" campaign in the Damascus Countryside. This collaborative initiative aims to restore the region's green cover while integrating environmental stewardship into the national school curriculum. The current operations are focused along the Damascus International Airport road, where technical teams and students are working to rehabilitate a total area of 25 hectares. By involving the youth in the physical act of planting, the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Education seek to instill a sense of national duty and environmental responsibility, ensuring the long-term protection and care of Syria’s forestry resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Education

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD), has launched a strategic in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD), has launched a strategic initiative to secure and distribute improved legume seeds across rural Aleppo. This project focuses on providing farmers with high-quality, certified chickpea and lentil seeds to boost agricultural productivity and ensure the resilience of these essential crops. By supplying high-yield, disease-resistant varieties, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to lower production costs for local farmers while enhancing national food security through the sustainable cultivation of strategic legumes, which are vital for both domestic consumption and soil health.

records.title: The National Gene Bank of Tunisia (Banque Nationale de Gènes), in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Na...
records.description: The National Gene Bank of Tunisia (Banque Nationale de Gènes), in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Tunisian Association for Sustainable Agriculture, has launched three specialized genetic field schools in Sousse, Sfax, and Bizerte. This strategic initiative focuses on strengthening national seed sovereignty by training farmers, students, and technicians directly on agricultural plots to select, conserve, and improve local varieties. Each site addresses specific regional needs: Sousse focuses on vegetables and cereals, Sfax on drought-resistant legumes, and Bizerte on humid-zone forage crops. By integrating scientific training in selection and hybridization with agroecological practices, the National Gene Bank of Tunisia aims to build a resilient agricultural sector capable of reducing dependence on imported seeds and safeguarding the country's unique genetic heritage against climate change.
records.institution: The National Gene Bank of Tunisia

records.title: The Executive Unit for Financing Agricultural Projects and Initiatives in Sa'ada Governorate has officially approved its comprehensive pr...
records.description: The Executive Unit for Financing Agricultural Projects and Initiatives in Sa'ada Governorate has officially approved its comprehensive project plan. Chaired by the Governor, the board focused on expanding water infrastructure and technical education to bolster the region's agricultural resilience. Key highlights include the completion of the Al-Lujam Dam and ongoing progress on the Awaira Dam, alongside strategic investments in the College of Agriculture to equip modern laboratories. By prioritizing water harvesting and community-led initiatives, the Executive Unit aims to provide sustainable irrigation solutions to the most underserved directorates, ensuring long-term food security and rural development across the governorate.
records.institution: The Executive Unit for Financing Agricultural Projects and Initiatives

records.title: Drake and Scull International (DSI) has announced that its German subsidiary, Passavant Energy & Environment (PE&E), has secured a €17 mi...
records.description: Drake and Scull International (DSI) has announced that its German subsidiary, Passavant Energy & Environment (PE&E), has secured a €17 million ($19.9 million) sub-contract for the Tanta Wastewater Treatment Plant (WWTP) in Egypt. This award, announced in early January 2026, marks a critical milestone in the massive Kitchener Drain Depollution Programme, one of the most significant environmental initiatives in the Nile Delta.The project involves building a new 100,000 $m^3/day$ facility adjacent to the existing 60,000 $m^3/day$ plant. This expansion is designed to meet the region's long-term needs, with a target capacity of 150,000 $m^3/day$ by 2057.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has achieved a significant milestone in sustainable crop produ...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has achieved a significant milestone in sustainable crop production by successfully cultivating barley using no-till technology at the Al-Ghalibiya Research Station. This modern approach utilizes specialized engineering techniques to plant seeds directly into undisturbed soil, creating uniform furrows that protect the seedbed while drastically reducing tillage costs. By eliminating traditional plowing, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to preserve soil fertility, minimize moisture evaporation, and optimize the use of natural resources. This achievement represents a strategic shift toward more resilient and cost-effective farming practices, ensuring the long-term sustainability of strategic grain production in the face of environmental challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Research, has achieved a historic breakthrough by officially register...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Research, has achieved a historic breakthrough by officially registering the full genetic genomes of the Barhi and Zahdi date palm varieties at the European Centre for Genetics. This milestone, realized in collaboration with the Wahaj Al-Dana Company for Scientific Research and Development, establishes a definitive "genetic fingerprint" that proves the unique Iraqi origin of these elite varieties. By documenting thousands of genetic sequences, Iraq has secured a permanent international record that prevents the risk of genetic appropriation or unauthorized copying of its national palm heritage. This database not only reinforces Iraq’s historical position as the cradle of the date palm but also provides a scientific shield for its genetic wealth in global agricultural forums.

records.title: In 2025, the National Agency for Aquaculture Development (ANDA) spearheaded a transformative period for Morocco’s blue economy, with 184...
records.description: In 2025, the National Agency for Aquaculture Development (ANDA) spearheaded a transformative period for Morocco’s blue economy, with 184 projects reaching full operational status. These ventures represent a total investment of 1.76 billion dirhams and have established a combined annual production capacity of 75,507 tonnes while generating over 2,300 direct jobs. The sector’s expansion has been primarily driven by shellfish and seaweed cultivation, though recent reforms and a new 2026 action plan aim to address structural hurdles in fish farming by modernizing infrastructure and approving alternative protein sources for feed. Moving forward, ANDA is prioritizing the digitalization of investor services through an integrated one-stop-shop platform and the opening of new investment zones to unlock the nation’s theoretical potential of 300,000 tonnes annually.
records.institution: The National Agency for Aquaculture Development (ANDA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has intensified its safety and water security measures by installing a protective metal fence around the Bani...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has intensified its safety and water security measures by installing a protective metal fence around the Bani Na’im Dam in the Hebron Governorate. This immediate intervention follows a direct field assessment and aligns with previous safety enhancements at the Beit Al-Roush Dam, reflecting an integrated preventive strategy to secure water facilities. The project is a collaborative effort involving the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, the Bani Na’im Municipality, and the Civil Defense Authority, with local volunteers assisting in the installation. By securing these perimeters, the Ministry of Agriculture aims to safeguard the public, protect local wildlife, and preserve essential water resources, fulfilling the government's broader vision of enhancing national water security and mitigating risks in the vicinity of critical infrastructure.

records.title: The General Directorate of Fisheries and Aquaculture (DGPA) has officially implemented new incentive measures under the 2026 Finance Law...
records.description: The General Directorate of Fisheries and Aquaculture (DGPA) has officially implemented new incentive measures under the 2026 Finance Law to bolster Algeria's aquaculture sector. In accordance with Article 138, the government is now granting exemptions from customs duties and applying a reduced VAT rate for the importation of essential raw materials used in the manufacture of aquaculture feed. This list of exempt materials includes specialized products such as artemia, phytoplankton, fish oils, and high-protein flours derived from fish and crustaceans. Furthermore, to encourage domestic industry, the reduced VAT rate will also apply to locally manufactured feeds. To access these benefits, operators must obtain a certification from the Ministry of Fisheries verifying that the materials are dedicated to aquaculture use, a move designed to lower production costs and enhance the strategic development of national food production.
records.institution: The General Directorate of Fisheries and Aquaculture (DGPA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is conducting a specialized training program focused on the legal frameworks governing the management of agri...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is conducting a specialized training program focused on the legal frameworks governing the management of agricultural lands and orchards. Organized by the Statistics, Training, and Manpower Department, the course provides staff with essential knowledge on laws and decrees related to land acquisition, distribution, and leasing. Participants are trained in complex administrative procedures, including land subdivision, expropriation, compensation, and reclamation. By enhancing the legal awareness of its employees, the Ministry aims to modernize land governance, ensure the transparent application of agricultural legislation, and improve the overall efficiency of resource management across the governorates.

records.title: QatarEnergy and the Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources have signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to deep...
records.description: QatarEnergy and the Egyptian Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources have signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to deepen bilateral energy cooperation. The agreement primarily addresses Egypt's immediate and long-term energy needs, starting with the supply of up to 24 LNG cargoes to the Egyptian Natural Gas Holding Company (EGAS) scheduled for delivery this summer. Beyond this immediate relief, the MoU establishes a framework for ongoing negotiations regarding a long-term LNG supply partnership. This strategic move aims to fuel Egypt’s industrial growth and economic expansion while reinforcing Qatar's position as a reliable energy provider to the region.

records.title: The Northwest Development Office (ODNO) and the Regional Union of Agriculture and Maritime Fisheries (URAP) are collaborating to host an...
records.description: The Northwest Development Office (ODNO) and the Regional Union of Agriculture and Maritime Fisheries (URAP) are collaborating to host an initiative focused on the advancement of smart and sustainable farming practices. This effort aims to introduce the latest technological and scientific trends to the agricultural sector, specifically targeting improved food security and climate change resilience. Key areas of focus include the application of nuclear technologies to optimize fertilizer and water usage, alongside methods to enhance crop productivity and quality. By bridging the gap between innovation and traditional farming, the organizations seek to empower professionals with modern knowledge and stimulate investment in eco-friendly agricultural systems.

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award recently hosted a scientific seminar at the Sheikh Zayed Festival in Abu Dhabi...
records.description: The Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award recently hosted a scientific seminar at the Sheikh Zayed Festival in Abu Dhabi to educate livestock breeders on the critical links between nutrition, feed quality, and productivity. This initiative aligns with the UAE's national strategy to empower local farmers through scientific knowledge, focusing on optimizing the "Feed Market" launched by the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA). As the largest of its kind in the Middle East, this market serves 40,000 breeders and manages a sector valued at over AED 4.5 billion. The seminar detailed how precision nutrition—balancing proteins, fibers, and energy—not only boosts meat and milk yields but also strengthens animal immunity and fertility, directly contributing to the nation's food security and self-sufficiency goals.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Egypt’s Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation significantly expanded its support for the livestock and poultry industries last mon...
records.description: Egypt’s Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation significantly expanded its support for the livestock and poultry industries last month by issuing 1,165 operating licenses for projects ranging from feed manufacturing to milk collection. This initiative included 312 permits specifically for small-scale breeders who must comply with strict biosecurity and animal safety standards, alongside the registration of 654 feed products to ensure high scientific and regulatory quality. To streamline these processes, the sector has transitioned to digital platforms, allowing for the electronic submission of license applications through the Digital Egypt platform and official government websites. Beyond facilitation, the ministry has intensified its regulatory oversight, conducting homogeneity tests at feed factories and launching unannounced inspections to prevent market manipulation and ensure that all products available to farmers meet approved national specifications.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Julyana Free Zone Authority has launched the construction of a massive grain silo project in Benghazi, designed to be one of the larg...
records.description: The Julyana Free Zone Authority has launched the construction of a massive grain silo project in Benghazi, designed to be one of the largest globally in terms of area and storage capacity. Spanning approximately 9 hectares, the facility will feature 20 cylindrical silos equipped with temperature-control systems and two advanced grain suction machines capable of unloading 600 tons per hour directly from ships. The project, which involves a collaboration between the local firm Aber Alalem and specialized French, Belgian, and Turkish companies, includes a state-of-the-art quality control laboratory, an integrated bagging plant with 10 filling stations, and a dedicated power station. By establishing a strategic grain reserve for wheat, barley, and other essential crops, the initiative aims to protect the region from international supply fluctuations while creating new technical job opportunities and enhancing maritime logistics efficiency within a one-year completion timeframe.

records.title: Under the patronage of Minister of Agriculture, a landmark tripartite agreement was signed to market 1,500 tons of industrial processing...
records.description: Under the patronage of Minister of Agriculture, a landmark tripartite agreement was signed to market 1,500 tons of industrial processing potatoes. The agreement establishes a direct supply chain between farmers in the Tubas and Jenin governorates and the Al-Salam Refrigeration Company in Hebron, with the Jordanian-Palestinian Company for Agricultural Products Marketing serving as the primary marketing partner. Supported by Agricultural Relief, which provides essential inputs like industrial-grade potato seeds, the initiative aims to stabilize farmer incomes and reduce reliance on imported raw materials for Palestinian industry. During a visit to the Al-Salam Investment Group factory, officials emphasized that this partnership strengthens the "contract farming" model, ensuring that high-quality local produce is integrated directly into national manufacturing lines.

records.title: Egypt has achieved a significant milestone in its agricultural sector, with the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation announcing t...
records.description: Egypt has achieved a significant milestone in its agricultural sector, with the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation announcing the opening of 25 new international markets. This expansion is driven by a digital coding system that tracks approximately 6,450 farms and export stations across 695,000 feddans, ensuring that Egyptian produce meets rigorous global technical and quality standards. Currently, the nation exports over 405 agricultural commodities to 167 countries, supported by strategic land expansion and modernized packaging and shipping logistics. This shift has transformed the agricultural sector into a vital economic force and a primary source of foreign currency, strengthening Egypt's competitive position across Africa, Europe, and Asia.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has overseen significant growth in cattle breeding and fattening projects in the Anbar Governorate, particula...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has overseen significant growth in cattle breeding and fattening projects in the Anbar Governorate, particularly within the Al-Shamiya area, to stabilize local red meat prices and bolster food security. This success stems from a dual-track strategy: strictly regulated imports managed by the Veterinary Department and Veterinary Quarantine to ensure consumer safety, and the revitalization of local production by supporting stalled projects and establishing new ones. By providing essential feed and veterinary supplies, the ministry has enhanced national production capacity, transforming the region into a key contributor to the local meat market. The expansion is further supported by the integration of digital platforms to facilitate communication and resource distribution for farmers and breeders across the governorate.

records.title: As part of Lebanon's national preventative plan to safeguard livestock and food security, the Ministry of Agriculture is conducting an ex...
records.description: As part of Lebanon's national preventative plan to safeguard livestock and food security, the Ministry of Agriculture is conducting an extensive vaccination campaign against Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD). By the 14th day of the campaign (January 2, 2026), veterinary teams successfully vaccinated 34,171 head of cattle across 3,304 farms nationwide. The initiative is a direct response to the spread of a new FMD strain (SAT1) in the region, which has threatened milk production and the economic stability of rural communities. Despite logistical hurdles and winter weather, the ministry continues to deploy mobile units in coordination with the Agricultural Cooperative Union and international partners like the FAO and WOAH, aiming to build a resilient "national herd" and prevent transboundary disease outbreaks.

records.title: According to data from the portal Maadialna, under the Ministry of Equipment and Water, Moroccan dams have accumulated 1.77 billion cubic...
records.description: According to data from the portal Maadialna, under the Ministry of Equipment and Water, Moroccan dams have accumulated 1.77 billion cubic meters of water since the start of the current hydrological season. A significant 76% of these inflows occurred during a concentrated period in December, highlighting the vital impact of late-year rainfall on national reserves. While the majority of this water has been successfully retained for strategic use in agriculture and the economy, approximately 80.2 million cubic meters were released into the sea, with the Sebou and Oum Er-Rbia basins accounting for the largest shares of these discharges. Overall, the low volume of water lost to the sea relative to the massive inflows underscores the kingdom's improved capacity to mobilize and manage its water resources during periods of high precipitation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Equipment and Water

records.title: In Oujda, the Provincial Directorate of Agriculture is accelerating the adoption of direct seeding as a core component of the "Generation...
records.description: In Oujda, the Provincial Directorate of Agriculture is accelerating the adoption of direct seeding as a core component of the "Generation Green 2020-2030" strategy to combat climate change and rainfall variability. By utilizing specialized seed drills that plant crops without tilling, the initiative aims to cover 3,000 hectares this season, supported by a fleet of twelve machines distributed among youth-led agricultural cooperatives. This conservation technique, backed by the National Office for Agricultural Advisory Services and the National Institute of Agronomic Research, significantly reduces fuel and labor costs while preserving soil fertility and moisture. With a long-term goal of reaching 50,000 hectares by the end of the decade, the program combines material support with technical training on optimal sowing depths and seed rates to ensure sustainable cereal production and enhanced food security in the region.

records.title: Tunisia’s citrus industry has launched an ambitious 2025–2026 campaign for the Maltese orange, aiming to export 15,000 tons to France, do...
records.description: Tunisia’s citrus industry has launched an ambitious 2025–2026 campaign for the Maltese orange, aiming to export 15,000 tons to France, doubling the previous year's volume. While production is concentrated in the Cap Bon region, specifically in areas like Nabeul, Hammamet, and Menzel Bouzelfa, the current season faces challenges including a slight yield decrease due to irregular weather and aging orchards. To counter competition from other Mediterranean producers, the sector is focusing on an earlier export start and a "high-quality niche" strategy that emphasizes the fruit's unique flavor. Success for the season depends on overcoming logistical hurdles, such as improving the cold chain, and adopting sustainable agricultural practices to meet rising international standards.

records.title: The General Corporation for the Multiplication of Improved Seeds, in partnership with the Al-Jarahi Multipurpose Association, has officia...
records.description: The General Corporation for the Multiplication of Improved Seeds, in partnership with the Al-Jarahi Multipurpose Association, has officially launched the corn harvest for the current agricultural season in Al-Hodeidah's Al-Jarahi District. Supervised by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, this initiative is a key component of a broader strategy to enhance national food security and reduce the financial burden of imports. By coordinating with the Agricultural Cooperative Union and receiving support from the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, the project focuses on expanding local production and improving the livelihoods of farmers through sustained technical follow-up. This harvest marks a significant step toward self-sufficiency, reflecting a commitment to a comprehensive agricultural revolution that prioritizes local resources over foreign commodities.
records.institution: The General Corporation for the Multiplication of Improved Seeds

records.title: The Jordan Chamber of Industry, in collaboration with the Jordanian Society for Scientific Research, Entrepreneurship and Creativity, has...
records.description: The Jordan Chamber of Industry, in collaboration with the Jordanian Society for Scientific Research, Entrepreneurship and Creativity, has highlighted the critical role of the specialized fertilizer industry in bolstering national food security and supporting modern agricultural systems. This sector, which includes approximately 50 industrial facilities and provides over 3,000 direct jobs, generates nearly $1 billion in output with a high local value-added ratio of 69%. Unlike conventional fertilizers that dominate global production, specialized fertilizers are essential for intensive, irrigated farming as they provide targeted nutrients like nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium to improve crop quality and water efficiency. Despite challenges such as high production costs and raw material price volatility, the industry is viewed as a strategic bridge between the industrial and agricultural sectors, offering a pathway toward sustainable economic development and increased national competitiveness.
records.institution: The Jordan Chamber of Industry, the Jordanian Society for Scientific Research

records.description: Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP) has advanced its procurement pipeline for approximately 1,600 MW of new renewable energy capacity. This initiative, part of Oman's strategy to decarbonize its power sector and reach a 30% renewable energy target by 2030, follows a record-breaking 2025 that saw the commissioning of 1,000 MW at the Manah solar complex. The current portfolio focuses on three massive wind farms and a significant solar expansion in the South Al Sharqiyah Governorate.
records.institution: Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP)

records.title: Oman launches 11th Five-Year Development Plan (2026-2030)
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman has officially launched its Eleventh Five-Year Development Plan (2026–2030), marking a pivotal second stage in the "Oman Vision 2040" roadmap. Targeting a steady economic growth rate of 4% at constant prices, the plan prioritizes a transition to a low-carbon economy, fiscal sustainability, and deep economic diversification. To achieve these goals, the government has allocated approximately RO 15.6 billion in additional investments, focusing on high-potential "core" sectors: Manufacturing, Tourism, and the Digital Economy. This strategic framework is divided into two pathways—Economic and Developmental—designed to bridge the nation from recovery to rapid expansion while generating 300,000 direct job opportunities for citizens by 2030.

records.title: The Hebron Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the East Jerusalem YMCA, has successfully distributed 2,700 olive see...
records.description: The Hebron Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the East Jerusalem YMCA, has successfully distributed 2,700 olive seedlings to farmers in the Buweira Al-Khalil area. This initiative is a core part of the "Keep Hope Alive" Olive Tree Campaign, which targets vulnerable lands and marginalized families to prevent land confiscation and restore uprooted groves. By conducting rigorous field inspections to select beneficiaries, the Ministry of Agriculture ensures that high-quality saplings reach those most in need, reinforcing the "sumud" (steadfastness) of Palestinian farmers. Beyond its immediate economic benefits, the project serves as a strategic environmental and national effort to expand green spaces and protect the heritage of olive cultivation, which remains the backbone of the rural economy and a vital symbol of connection to the land.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has launched a comprehensive field inspection campaign across twelve fishing ha...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has launched a comprehensive field inspection campaign across twelve fishing harbors along the Arabian Gulf to enforce marine fishing regulations and protect natural resources. Led by the Fisheries Department, the initiative involves monitoring visits to ensure that local and commercial operators adhere to environmental standards, seasonal fishing bans, and approved gear specifications. By verifying compliance with marine systems, the ministry aims to prevent overfishing, safeguard biodiversity, and enhance the long-term sustainability of the Kingdom's fish stocks. This coordinated effort is a key component of a broader strategy to modernize the fisheries sector, improve food security, and ensure the resilience of the marine ecosystem for future generations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.description: Bahrain’s Electricity and Water Authority (EWA) has officially launched the construction of the Al Dur Solar Power Plant, a major 100-megawatt (MW) project that marks a key milestone in the kingdom’s renewable energy journey. The facility is located in the Al Dur area of the Southern Governorate, spanning two adjacent sites that total approximately 830,000 square meters. Featuring 135,000 solar panels, the plant is expected to be completed and connected to the national grid by Q3 2026.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has launched a transformative investment cluster designed to turn the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) has launched a transformative investment cluster designed to turn the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) into a premier seafood industrial hub and expand large-scale farming in Dhofar. This initiative is a core component of the "From Sea to Manufacturing" strategy under Oman Vision 2040, focusing on shifting from traditional harvesting to high-value industrial processing. In Duqm, the first phase features six specialized fish processing plants focused on canning sardines, tuna, and small pelagic species, as well as producing value-added fillets. This is complemented by a newly launched RO 7.7 million floating factory operated by Oceans Fish Company, which allows for immediate sea-to-market processing. Meanwhile, in Dhofar, 16 agricultural opportunities covering 1,813 acres target the cultivation of grains, legumes, and tropical fruits like mangoes and lemons. These projects are supported by robust incentives, including 50-year land usufruct rights and 10-year tax exemptions, aimed at attracting global capital to secure the Sultanate's food future.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has formally received a newly completed agricultural irrigation unit in the village of Saida, located in the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has formally received a newly completed agricultural irrigation unit in the village of Saida, located in the Tulkarm Governorate. This infrastructure project, a significant upgrade for the rural community, features a 1,000-cubic-meter storage tank, a high-capacity pumping unit (100 $m^3/h$), and a network of 6.5 kilometers of steel pipes providing 30 direct agricultural connections. Additionally, the project included roofing for an existing 1,500-cubic-meter balance tank to prevent evaporation and contamination.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has signed the eighth batch of investment s...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has signed the eighth batch of investment support agreements under the Multi-Donor Agricultural Business Program (MAP II). This latest round, finalized in Nablus, includes 16 agreements worth approximately 4.04 million shekels to support sustainable farming and food processing in the northern West Bank governorates of Jenin, Qalqilya, Tulkarm, and Nablus. The MAP II program is a strategic $33 million initiative designed to move Palestinian agriculture from emergency relief to a market-driven, resilient model. By providing cost-shared grants—where the program covers 45% of costs and beneficiaries contribute 55%—the initiative empowers local farmers to invest in modern technologies, improve crop quality, and create rural employment. Funded by Denmark, the European Union, Switzerland, Spain, and Italy, the program serves as a critical economic shield, reinforcing the presence of Palestinian farmers on their land while enhancing national food security.

records.description: In Taiz Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Agricultural Cooperative Union and the Bonyan Foundation, held a workshop to establish marketing units and sign contract farming agreements for maize and legume crops. The initiative focuses on building the institutional capacity of cooperative associations to lead an agricultural renaissance, specifically targeting value chains in food and medicine to reduce import dependency. By forming production groups and implementing standardized marketing mechanisms, the project aims to improve product quality, reduce costs, and increase overall productivity. These efforts are designed to enhance the livelihoods of local farmers while aligning with national priorities for economic self-sufficiency and sustainable development across the governorate’s districts.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.description: Bahrain’s Electricity and Water Authority (EWA) has commenced the construction of the Al Dur Solar Power Plant, a significant clean energy initiative featuring 135,000 solar panels designed to bolster the national energy transition. Scheduled for completion next year, the project aims to increase the share of renewable energy in the national mix to 20% by the middle of the next decade while supporting long-term goals for carbon neutrality. By connecting directly to the electricity grid, this centralized generation facility enhances energy security, encourages investment, and promotes the diversification of power sources. The project reflects a broader strategic commitment to modernizing infrastructure through advanced technology and public-private partnerships to ensure the reliability and sustainability of essential services.

records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has achieved 100% completion in marketing high-grade (core and basic) wheat seeds for the 2025–2026 season. These seeds have been fully distributed to specialized seed-producing farmers contracted with the department. This milestone is a critical part of Iraq's "High-Grade Wheat Seed Multiplication Program," which aims to secure the nation's food future by providing farmers with genetically pure, locally adapted, and climate-resilient varieties.

records.title: In a significant step towards modernizing its maritime economy, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a...
records.description: In a significant step towards modernizing its maritime economy, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a RO 7.7 million ($20 million) "Floating Factory" project in collaboration with the Ocean Fish Company. This high-tech vessel, based out of the Port of Duqm, represents a shift from traditional fishing to a vertically integrated, technology-driven "Blue Economy" model.

records.title: The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) recently signed between Salalah Mills Company SAOG and the Port of Salalah marks a critical evoluti...
records.description: The Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) recently signed between Salalah Mills Company SAOG and the Port of Salalah marks a critical evolution in Oman's "Blue Economy" and food security landscape. By developing a Strategic Silos Project at the Port of Salalah, the partnership aims to transform the region into a global hub for grain trading, leveraging the port’s strategic location on major East-West shipping lanes.

records.title: In a significant move to revitalize the Al-Gash Agricultural Project, the Kassala State Government has partnered with the Indian investme...
records.description: In a significant move to revitalize the Al-Gash Agricultural Project, the Kassala State Government has partnered with the Indian investment firm Barkaat to reintroduce large-scale cotton cultivation and establish modern industrial processing infrastructure in the region. The agreement focuses on the development of 15,000 acres of cotton, supported by a new high-capacity cotton ginnery in Aroma city. This initiative aims to restore the Al-Gash Scheme's historical status as a major agricultural hub while diversifying the local economy beyond traditional subsistence farming.

records.title: In a major effort to secure agricultural sovereignty, a national strategy has been launched to manage a record-breaking olive oil harvest...
records.description: In a major effort to secure agricultural sovereignty, a national strategy has been launched to manage a record-breaking olive oil harvest and protect small-scale producers from market monopolies. For the 2025–2026 season, production is projected to reach approximately 500,000 tonnes, a historic high attributed to favorable rainfall following years of drought. Central to the government's response is an exceptional storage program aimed at stabilizing prices. Under the supervision of the National Olive Oil Office (ONH), the state aims to hold between 100,000 and 150,000 tonnes of oil for at least three months, offering financial premiums of 330 dinars per tonne for farmers and 300 dinars per tonne for millers to participate. This prevents "bulk selling" at low prices during peak production.

records.title: The Shumoukh Al Ezz Group recently signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding with the US-based company PittMoss to advance sustainab...
records.description: The Shumoukh Al Ezz Group recently signed a strategic Memorandum of Understanding with the US-based company PittMoss to advance sustainable agriculture in the UAE and the broader GCC region. This partnership focuses on introducing innovative, peat-free growing media made from upcycled cellulose fibers (such as recycled paper and cardboard), which serves as an eco-friendly alternative to traditional soil components. Under the agreement, the two entities will explore technology transfer and the potential for establishing local manufacturing facilities in the UAE to strengthen regional supply chains. The technology is designed to improve water retention by up to two-thirds and reduce fertilizer dependency by 30%, directly supporting national food security and water conservation goals in arid climates.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development, and Fisheries announced a massive intervention to stabilize the national poultry industry...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development, and Fisheries announced a massive intervention to stabilize the national poultry industry through the National Office for Livestock Feed (ONAB). To address significant market deficits and rising demand, the National Office for Livestock Feed (ONAB) is executing a staggered importation plan for 1.15 million tons of maize scheduled through February 2026. This raw material is critical, as it constitutes 80% of poultry feed. The operation involves the reception of 250,000 tons in early January via the ports of Oran, Algiers, Skikda, and Bejaïa, followed by 500,000 tons later in the month and a final 400,000 tons in February. Furthermore, the Ministry of Agriculture has decided to establish a permanent strategic reserve stock to prevent the recurrence of seasonal supply shocks, ensuring a continuous and regular supply for livestock farmers and feed manufacturers nationwide.
records.institution: The National Office for Animal Feed (ONAB)

records.title: The Egyptian Countryside Development Company (ECDC) has launched a strategic infrastructure project to extend extra-high-voltage and high...
records.description: The Egyptian Countryside Development Company (ECDC) has launched a strategic infrastructure project to extend extra-high-voltage and high-voltage electricity to the West Minya Plain, a key region within the national 1.5 Million Feddan Project. In coordination with the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company (EETC) and the consultancy firm Egyptian Power Systems Engineering (EPS), the project aims to power approximately one million feddans of reclaimed land at a total estimated cost of EGP 25bn. This electrification initiative is designed to transition the region from basic land reclamation to modern, integrated agricultural production. By providing a stable power supply, the project will enable the use of advanced irrigation systems, support the establishment of food processing industries, and attract significant private investment to Upper Egypt.

records.title: Jordan’s Minister of Environment, and Minister of Agriculture, signed a landmark cooperation agreement to establish the Hasa Forest and a...
records.description: Jordan’s Minister of Environment, and Minister of Agriculture, signed a landmark cooperation agreement to establish the Hasa Forest and afforest a 10-kilometer stretch of the Desert Highway. This project is a key milestone in the national initiative to plant 10 million trees over 10 years, aiming to combat desertification and mitigate the impacts of climate change through innovative water reuse.

records.title: The Central Agency for Public Tenders (CAPT) has directed the Ministry of Public Works to amend a significant infrastructure tender for t...
records.description: The Central Agency for Public Tenders (CAPT) has directed the Ministry of Public Works to amend a significant infrastructure tender for the construction and maintenance of rainwater drainage systems across four major residential areas: Sabah Al-Ahmad, South Sabah Al-Ahmad, Al-Khairan, and Al-Wafra. Valued at approximately KD 222 million ($723 million), the project is designed to prevent urban flooding while strategically replenishing groundwater reserves. A key feature of the system is the filtration of sediments and oils, allowing the captured runoff to serve as a sustainable alternative water source for agricultural irrigation. By reducing reliance on costly desalinated water for non-potable uses, the initiative aims to enhance Kuwait's water security and alleviate the operational burden on the nation's wastewater treatment plants.
records.institution: The Central Agency for Public Tenders (CAPT)

records.description: The Higher Agricultural Emergency Committee, in collaboration with the General Administration of Veterinary Services and Animal Production, is spearheading a critical livestock preservation project in the Southern and Central Governorates of Gaza. This initiative, funded by the Italian government through the "Food for Gaza" program, is being implemented in partnership with the FAO and local agricultural committees to protect the remaining animal wealth and ensure food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has officially launched the Conditional Fin...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has officially launched the Conditional Financial Grants Project for Field and Forage Crops. This strategic initiative, funded by the Danish government, is designed to empower young farmers and reclaim unexploited agricultural land, particularly in areas threatened by settlement expansion.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has officially signed the seventh batch of investment support agreements under the Multi-Donor Agricultural Business Programme (MAP II). This latest round involves 10 agreements across the governorates of Ramallah, Hebron, and Salfit, with a total investment value of approximately 2.66 million shekels.

records.description: The Resilience and Agricultural Livelihoods Enhancement Project (RELAP) officially concluded its seven-year tenure (2018–2025) on Monday, marking a transformative chapter for Palestinian rural development. Supported by the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) and the OPEC Fund for International Development (OFID), the project successfully navigated the challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic and regional instability to exceed many of its core targets.

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has launched a strategic awareness campaign for the Saudi Good Agricultural Practices (Saudi G.A.P.) program. This initiative is a cornerstone of Saudi Vision 2030, designed to transition the Kingdom’s agricultural sector toward a high-standard, sustainable, and commercially competitive model. By adhering to national technical standards, the program ensures that local produce—ranging from fruits and vegetables to dates—meets rigorous safety and environmental benchmarks, ultimately enhancing both domestic food security and export potential.

records.title: The National Gene Bank announced the launch of three innovative field schools in Sousse (M'saken), Sfax (El Hzeg), and Bizerte (Frétissa).
records.description: The National Gene Bank announced the launch of three innovative field schools in Sousse (M'saken), Sfax (El Hzeg), and Bizerte (Frétissa). This initiative is a strategic partnership with the Tunisian Association for Sustainable Agriculture, supported by funding from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO). These schools are situated directly within agricultural plots to provide a hands-on learning environment where farmers, students, and technicians can study plant genetics, crop resistance, and productivity. By focusing on the multiplication of local seeds for cereals and forage crops, the program aims to safeguard the nation's genetic capital while enhancing the resilience of agricultural systems against climate change.

records.title: The Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI), in partnership with the UAE Presidential Court and the Gates Founda...
records.description: The Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI), in partnership with the UAE Presidential Court and the Gates Foundation, has launched the Institute for Agriculture and Artificial Intelligence (IAAI) to revolutionize global food security through digital innovation. As a core pillar of the Abu Dhabi AI for Agriculture Ecosystem, the institute aims to support 43 million smallholder farmers in climate-vulnerable regions like Africa and India by providing open-access, real-time digital advisory tools. By creating a high-quality, trusted agricultural data corpus, the IAAI addresses critical gaps in language and geography, developing multimodal diagnostic models for pest detection and voice-based systems tailored to local dialects and literacy levels. This initiative marks a strategic shift toward field-ready AI solutions, empowering farmers to boost productivity and resilience in a warming world while positioning Abu Dhabi as a global hub for sustainable agritech innovation.
records.institution: The Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI)

records.description: The Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park reached a total installed capacity of 3,860 MW, marking a significant milestone in Dubai’s transition to renewable energy. Managed by the Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), the park now provides approximately 21.5% of Dubai’s total power generation. This year alone, 800 MW was added as part of the project’s sixth phase, utilizing a mix of photovoltaic and concentrated solar power (CSP) technologies. Furthermore, DEWA launched the tender for the seventh phase, which will add 2,000 MW of solar power integrated with 1,400 MWh of energy storage, reinforcing the park's status as the world's largest single-site solar facility.
records.institution: The Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park

records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has achieved a historic milestone in its rainfed crop sector, reporting a growth rate exceeding 1,100% as of late 2025. This expansion highlights the program's success in revitalizing traditional farming in water-scarce regions, particularly in the southwestern provinces like Jazan, Asir, Makkah, and Al-Baha. By providing financial and technical support to over 13,300 beneficiaries, the initiative has significantly improved the standard of living for smallholder farmers while reducing reliance on non-renewable water sources. These efforts, spearheaded by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) in collaboration with the FAO, are central to achieving the food security and economic diversification goals of Saudi Vision 2030.

This follows the successful completion of the drying stage to achieve optimal moisture levels for the seeds produced during the current season. These activities are part of the National Program for the Sustainability and Propagation of High-Grade Soybean Seeds in Iraq, aimed at ensuring the genetic purity and quality of local seeds. The procedures are being closely monitored by specialized staff to support the development of high-grade seed supplies for the national agricultural sector.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is supplying veterinary hospitals nationwide with essential pesticides and medical equipment, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). This initiative focuses on distributing specialized treatments to eliminate parasites that transmit hemorrhagic fever and providing personal protective gear for veterinary staff. These efforts aim to safeguard livestock from epidemic diseases and ensure the health of animal resources across all governorates.

records.title: In a major push for economic recovery and agricultural innovation, Sudan’s Minister of Animal Resources and Fisheries, held a strategic m...
records.description: In a major push for economic recovery and agricultural innovation, Sudan’s Minister of Animal Resources and Fisheries, held a strategic meeting in Dongola to revitalize the Northern State’s livestock sector. The meeting, which included the Higher Council for Animal Resources, the Ministry of Industry and Trade, and Dongola University, focused on transforming traditional animal husbandry into a high-value export industry through applied research and strategic partnerships.
records.institution: The Ministry of Animal Resources and Fisheries

records.title: As part of the #HattaWinter initiative, Dubai Municipality has launched the 10th edition of the Hatta Honey Festival, running until 31st...
records.description: As part of the #HattaWinter initiative, Dubai Municipality has launched the 10th edition of the Hatta Honey Festival, running until 31st December 2025 at Hatta Hall. The free-to-enter event serves as a strategic platform for over 50 Emirati beekeepers to showcase diverse local honey varieties while promoting sustainable agri-tourism in the region. A significant highlight this year is the involvement of the Dubai Central Laboratory, which utilizes infrared technology to test honey quality in under a minute and has introduced a smart robot for automated sample reception. Additionally, the Municipality is pioneering a "laboratory fingerprint" and digital identity system for local honey—the first of its kind in the UAE—to guarantee origin and quality, reinforcing consumer trust and supporting the local rural economy.

records.title: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), in collaboration with the Dubai Environment and Climate Change Authority (DECCA), recently...
records.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), in collaboration with the Dubai Environment and Climate Change Authority (DECCA), recently planted 600 mangrove trees at the Jebel Ali Marine Sanctuary. This initiative, supported by over 200 volunteers, brings DEWA's total contribution to 13,950 mangroves planted since early 2023. The project aligns with the "Plant the Emirates" National Programme and the UAE's goal to plant 100 million mangroves by 2030 to enhance biodiversity and combat climate change. By restoring coastal ecosystems, the authorities aim to implement nature-based solutions that protect marine habitats and ensure long-term ecological sustainability.

records.title: The Western Sector Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana'a Governorate has launched a major distribution initiative for the current wi...
records.description: The Western Sector Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana'a Governorate has launched a major distribution initiative for the current winter season, providing 20 tons of improved wheat seeds and 5 tons of legume seeds to farmers across the sector's districts. This effort, supported by the Executive Unit for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Funding Management, aims to boost local production and reduce reliance on imported food crops. The seeds are distributed through the society’s specialized seed bank, which has achieved significant success in previous seasons by supplying a cumulative total of 70 tons of cereal seeds and 10 tons of legumes. By leveraging the fertile areas of the Western Sector—which include districts like Al-Haymah Al-Kharijiyah—the society is working toward strategic goals of food security and national self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The Western Sector Agricultural Cooperative Society

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has released its second weekly report on the National Emergency Plan to combat Foot-and-Mouth Diseas...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has released its second weekly report on the National Emergency Plan to combat Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD), announcing a transition to the treatment and recovery phase. Technical teams have successfully vaccinated 20,415 head of cattle across 1,758 farms, focusing primarily on high-risk regions like the Bekaa and Baalbek-Hermel. To limit further spread, the Ministry is conducting epidemiological investigations, sending samples to WOAH and FAO accredited laboratories for strain identification, and strictly regulating animal movement in coordination with the Ministry of Interior. Additionally, in-kind assistance—including veterinary medicines and biosecurity supplies—is being provided to affected farmers through partnerships with international organizations such as the World Food Programme (WFP) and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).

records.title: Sudan and Egypt have established a strategic partnership to rehabilitate Sudan’s drinking water sector, which has seen approximately 32%...
records.description: Sudan and Egypt have established a strategic partnership to rehabilitate Sudan’s drinking water sector, which has seen approximately 32% of its infrastructure destroyed by ongoing conflict. The collaboration, discussed by the Sudanese Drinking Water and Sanitation Unit and the Egyptian Ministry of Housing and Utilities, focuses on reconstructing damaged Nile water treatment plants in Khartoum and restoring factories for essential water-treatment chemicals like chlorine. A key component of the initiative is the creation of a specialized technical school to train Sudanese cadres, ensuring long-term sustainability and addressing the critical shortage of skilled technicians. This partnership, formalised through a memorandum of understanding, aims to mitigate a severe public health crisis where 80% of local diseases are currently linked to unsafe water sources.
records.institution: The Sudanese Drinking Water and Sanitation Unit

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) officially launched the FEMBIOTEC platform in Tabarka, Tunisia.
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) officially launched the FEMBIOTEC platform in Tabarka, Tunisia. This digital ecosystem is designed specifically to support rural women engaged in organic farming by providing a centralized, "one-stop" resource for technical, economic, and professional growth. Developed through a participatory process that involved direct feedback from women farmers, the platform addresses the "digital divide" in rural Tunisia and promotes the economic empowerment of female agripreneurs in line with the national strategy for organic development.

records.title: Acting Minister of Environment has officially launched the Sharm El-Sheikh Sustainable Development Strategy (SESSDS), a comprehensive lon...
records.description: Acting Minister of Environment has officially launched the Sharm El-Sheikh Sustainable Development Strategy (SESSDS), a comprehensive long-term roadmap to transform the Red Sea resort into a global model for green and resilient urban living. Developed in collaboration with the South Sinai Governorate and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), the strategy integrates Egypt's Vision 2030 and National Climate Change Strategy 2050 into a unified framework for the city. It focuses on five key pillars: renewable energy, integrated solid waste management, water efficiency, sustainable transportation, and biodiversity conservation. This initiative builds on the successful "Green Sharm" pilot projects—such as the ban on single-use plastics in 50 hotels and the installation of 51 MW of solar power—to ensure that Sharm El-Sheikh’s economic growth, primarily driven by tourism, is balanced with the protection of its fragile marine and desert ecosystems.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Research, has commenced the manual harvesting of diverse rice varieti...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Research, has commenced the manual harvesting of diverse rice varieties at the Al-Mishkhab Research Station to preserve the purity of the crop's genetic resources. The harvest includes traditional varieties like Anbar 33 and Jasmine, alongside newly developed, short-season varieties such as Al-Ghari and Buhouth 3, which are designed to enhance field efficiency and support national food security. This manual process ensures the high quality of seeds from both established and Gene Bank varieties, providing a strategic foundation for future agricultural plans. These efforts represent a qualitative development in the strategic crops sector, offering farmers reliable local varieties characterized by high productivity and climate resilience.

records.title: Morocco's avocado sector achieved a historic milestone during the 2024/2025 marketing season, with exports reaching 112,000 tons, more th...
records.description: Morocco's avocado sector achieved a historic milestone during the 2024/2025 marketing season, with exports reaching 112,000 tons, more than double the previous record. This surge propelled export revenues beyond the $300 million mark for the first time, establishing avocados as a major contributor to the Kingdom's fruit export earnings. While Spain, France, and the Netherlands remain the top destinations, the industry successfully diversified, quadrupling sales to secondary markets and expanding its reach to 27 countries globally. Despite persistent drought conditions, the sector's growth illustrates significant adaptability and a strengthening position in the global market.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, delivered 100 olive saplings (aged 3–4 years)...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, delivered 100 olive saplings (aged 3–4 years) to a farmer in the Al-Daraja area of Wadi Sa'ir. This initiative is part of an urgent response program to support farmers whose lands have been damaged by settler attacks. By providing these high-quality saplings—referred to as "mukabir" for their advanced age and readiness—the Ministry aims to rehabilitate damaged agricultural land and strengthen the steadfastness (Sumud) of rural communities in the face of ongoing challenges. The delivery was coordinated with the Sa'ir Municipality, reflecting a unified effort between local and national government to protect Palestinian land and identity.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Research, officially began the mechanical harvesting of high-grade ri...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Research, officially began the mechanical harvesting of high-grade rice varieties at the Al-Mishkhab Research Station in Najaf Governorate for the 2025 season. A primary focus of the campaign is the Anbar 33 variety, which is being cultivated at the nucleus and foundation grades to maintain high genetic purity. To address environmental challenges, the Ministry successfully implemented sprinkler irrigation systems for rice (paddy) cultivation, demonstrating a shift toward water-efficient techniques and the use of short-season varieties that adapt to water scarcity. This initiative ensures the sustainable production and marketing of high-grade seeds to contracted farmers, securing the future of this strategic crop in Iraq.

records.title: The Veterinary Department of the Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture recently met with the technical team from Boehringer Ingelheim to strength...
records.description: The Veterinary Department of the Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture recently met with the technical team from Boehringer Ingelheim to strengthen the national response to Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) through advanced epidemiological mapping and rapid response mechanisms for emerging viral strains. The discussions focused on synchronizing laboratory testing procedures between field units and the Central Veterinary Laboratory, ensuring that sample collection and analysis align with international reference standards. To bolster these efforts, the technical team provided specialized supplies and rapid testing kits designed to immediately identify outbreaks and protect Iraq's livestock from the economic impact of the disease. By integrating these diagnostic tools with high-quality vaccines, the Ministry aims to enhance biosecurity measures and ensure the long-term health and productivity of the national agricultural sector.
