records.title: The Public Authority for Agriculture Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR) has championed a technological transformation in Al-Wafra and Al...
records.description: The Public Authority for Agriculture Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR) has championed a technological transformation in Al-Wafra and Al-Abdali, where Kuwaiti farmers are now utilizing climate-controlled greenhouses to produce commercial quantities of fruits previously considered unsuited for desert climates, such as citrus, bananas, and mangoes. This shift contributed to a $10\%$ year-on-year increase in agricultural output during the first nine months of 2025, reaching 220,700 tons of fresh produce valued at approximately 23.9 million dinars ($78.15 million). To sustain this momentum and achieve long-term food security, the Ministry of Electricity, Water, and Renewable Energy has begun implementing electronic subsidy systems to streamline financial support for energy-intensive greenhouse operations, while farmers continue to advocate for nominal utility pricing to lower production costs.
records.institution: The Public Authority for Agriculture Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR)

records.title: The Hebron Directorate of Agriculture, through its specialized department in Idhna, has launched a vital vaccination campaign for sheep a...
records.description: The Hebron Directorate of Agriculture, through its specialized department in Idhna, has launched a vital vaccination campaign for sheep against Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD). Conducted in direct coordination with the Hebron Veterinary Department and the Idhna Municipality, the initiative follows a comprehensive preventive plan to curb the spread of epidemic diseases that threaten regional livestock. Under the technical supervision of specialized veterinarians and engineers, the campaign emphasizes community partnership, with local farmers actively participating to ensure high coverage. This proactive measure is a cornerstone of the Ministry's strategy to protect animal health, stabilize the local economy, and secure the long-term sustainability of food resources in the town and its surrounding areas.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation has officially launched a critical recovery project to restore Sudan’s strategic irrigation in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation has officially launched a critical recovery project to restore Sudan’s strategic irrigation infrastructure following extensive sabotage and plundering by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF). The project focuses on repairing 1,500 breaches in the canal network to resume water flow from the Sennar Dam to the Al-Gezira Scheme, the country’s agricultural heartland. Undersecretary Engineer Daw Al-Bayt Abdel-Rahman emphasized that securing water from the primary source at Sennar is essential for the success of the current winter-season crops and for revitalizing electricity generation. The rehabilitation plan also includes restoring major pumping stations—Mena, Al-Suki, Al-Rahad, and Al-Junaid—and centralizing control structures under the Al-Gezira Irrigation Directorate to ensure efficient resource management.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.title: The Ruler of Sharjah, inaugurated the Mleiha Dairy Factory, a 20,000-square-meter facility with a daily production capacity of 100,000 li...
records.description: The Ruler of Sharjah, inaugurated the Mleiha Dairy Factory, a 20,000-square-meter facility with a daily production capacity of 100,000 liters. During the event, the Mleiha Dairy Farm was officially recognized by Guinness World Records as the world’s largest A2A2 cattle farm, housing over 6,400 cows that produce milk with superior health benefits. The project, managed by the Sharjah Agricultural and Livestock Production Foundation (Iktifa), prioritizes organic, natural practices and human health over commercial profit. It features a circular milking parlor capable of handling 500 cows per hour and eco-friendly packaging lines, marking a major milestone in Sharjah’s comprehensive food security strategy which includes wheat, poultry, and vegetable production using original, non-chemical seeds.

records.title: The Agricultural Research Department, under the Ministry of Agriculture, successfully conducted a second applied experiment for a novel p...
records.description: The Agricultural Research Department, under the Ministry of Agriculture, successfully conducted a second applied experiment for a novel poultry semen collection technique at the Poultry Research Station. This scientific initiative, led by the Planning and Follow-up Department in collaboration with the Animal Resources Research Department, focuses on stimulating and collecting sperm from Sperm Storage Tubules (SST) in Iraqi local chickens. By evaluating and storing these genetic materials, the project aims to facilitate artificial insemination to preserve and propagate rare local breeds. This research represents a critical step in integrating high-level veterinary science with practical applications to bolster national food security and safeguard indigenous livestock biodiversity.

records.title: The Iraqi Seed Production Company, a subsidiary of the Ministry of Agriculture, is successfully supplying 100% treated seeds from its Gha...
records.description: The Iraqi Seed Production Company, a subsidiary of the Ministry of Agriculture, is successfully supplying 100% treated seeds from its Ghammas branch in Diwaniyah to local farmers and contracted producers. Operating under the supervision of the National Security Service and the National Seed Council, the facility has processed over 8,999 tons of raw grain into 8,750 tons of high-quality treated seeds, with more than 7,429 tons already distributed. The program prioritizes "registered grade" seeds for contracted producers and "certified grade" seeds for independent farmers, ensuring a streamlined supply chain designed to bolster crop productivity and national food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the FAO, has launched a landmark initiative at the port of Aqiba to replace illegal fi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the FAO, has launched a landmark initiative at the port of Aqiba to replace illegal fishing nets with legal, environmentally compliant gear. This pilot project, which serves as a model for national expansion, involves the voluntary surrender and recycling of non-compliant nets (specifically those smaller than the mandated $2 \times 2$ cm mesh size) in exchange for legal equipment that prevents the capture of juvenile fish. By establishing community management committees, the project introduces a shared governance model that empowers local fishermen to lead the sustainable management of marine resources. The initiative also highlights a vital socio-economic dimension by engaging expert women in the technical preparation of the new nets and promoting alternative methods like longlines to reduce environmental pressure on fish stocks. Following the successful recycling of 451 illegal nets in Aqiba, the campaign is expanding to the city of Tyre, directly supporting over 100 additional fishermen and advancing Lebanon's 2025–2026 strategic vision for a resilient, modernized blue economy.

records.title: The On December 23, 2025, the Ministry of Agriculture’s inspection teams in Jenin confiscated 21 packages of non-compliant pesticides, fe...
records.description: The On December 23, 2025, the Ministry of Agriculture’s inspection teams in Jenin confiscated 21 packages of non-compliant pesticides, fertilizers, and soil amendments totaling 20 liters and 9 kilograms. This operation, part of a national campaign to regulate agricultural inputs, targeted products that failed to meet approved standards, posing significant risks to both crop safety and consumer health. By securing the seized items and initiating legal proceedings against violators, the ministry continues to enforce strict regulations at sales outlets to ensure farmers have access to safe, high-quality production inputs. These ongoing efforts across various governorates are essential for maintaining the integrity of the national agricultural product and protecting the rights of Palestinian farmers.

records.title: The World Green Economy Organisation (WGEO) has launched the ‘Green Circles’ platform, a strategic initiative designed to unify global le...
records.description: The World Green Economy Organisation (WGEO) has launched the ‘Green Circles’ platform, a strategic initiative designed to unify global leaders, policymakers, and businesses in accelerating the transition toward inclusive and sustainable economic models. Through high-level dialogues—including sessions held with AmCham Dubai and Dubai Chambers—the platform bridges the gap between policy and investment, resulting in two foundational white papers: ‘Accelerating the Transition to Responsible Business’ and ‘Enabling the Sustainability Ecosystem for Responsible Business’. These documents provide actionable roadmaps for integrating sustainability into core business models, reinforcing regulatory frameworks, and stimulating green investment. By fostering cross-sector partnerships, the platform serves as a practical framework for translating global climate commitments into tangible outcomes that support the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and a low-carbon future.

records.title: Throughout 2025, the UAE advanced its low-carbon economy by launching the world's first "round-the-clock" gigascale project in Abu Dhabi,...
records.description: Throughout 2025, the UAE advanced its low-carbon economy by launching the world's first "round-the-clock" gigascale project in Abu Dhabi, combining solar power with a record-breaking battery energy storage system. The Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure and the Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi expanded domestic conservation through the "Abu Dhabi Coral Gardens" and a new geospatial platform designed to reduce groundwater use by shifting agriculture toward unconventional water resources. Industrial sustainability reached new milestones as BEEAH announced the region's first commercial waste-to-hydrogen plant, while the Emirates Nuclear Energy Company confirmed the Barakah Plant now provides 25% of the nation’s electricity, offsetting 22.4 million tonnes of carbon annually. Internationally, Masdar and Mubadala solidified the UAE's leadership in climate resilience by developing gigawatt-scale solar and green hydrogen projects across Europe, Africa, and the Middle East.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure

records.title: Egypt’s Acting Minister of Environment and the Governor of Sharqeya witnessed the signing of a JD500 million contract with Gaia Titan, th...
records.description: Egypt’s Acting Minister of Environment and the Governor of Sharqeya witnessed the signing of a JD500 million contract with Gaia Titan, the green energy subsidiary of Titan Cement, to establish three municipal solid waste treatment facilities. Located in Zagazig, Husseiniya, and Belbeis, these plants will process at least 3,000 tonnes of waste daily—exceeding one million tonnes annually—while managing two sanitary landfills for residual waste. The 15-year agreement focuses on producing 200,000 tonnes of alternative fuel annually to support green construction and reduce dependence on conventional energy. This initiative represents a strategic shift toward a circular economy, significantly lowering carbon emissions and improving waste management efficiency across the governorate.

records.title: DPD to supply Date Palm Tissue Culture to Iraq
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has signed a five-year cooperation agreement with the UK-based Date Palm Developments (D.P.D. Limited) to revitalize the national date palm sector. This government-backed program, supported by the Iraq Britain Business Council (IBBC), focuses on importing rare, high-quality tissue culture plants and adopting advanced propagation technologies. By integrating cutting-edge international expertise, the initiative aims to restore the global leadership of Iraqi dates and improve export quality for international markets. The partnership represents a strategic step toward modernizing agricultural production and ensuring the sustainable rehabilitation of the country's historic farming heritage.

records.description: The Ministerial Council for Economic Affairs has approved a recommendation to the Council of Ministers to ban the import of chicken and processed poultry products starting in mid-January. This strategic move, announced by the Ministry of Agriculture, aims to revitalize the national poultry sector and protect local producers from foreign competition. By prioritizing domestic production, the government seeks to strengthen national food security and stimulate the Iraqi economy through increased self-sufficiency.

records.title: Ministry of Agriculture and FAO Conclude Project to Strengthen the Resilience of Smallholder Farmers' Families with Canadian Funding
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in Lebanon, in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and funded by the Government of Canada, has concluded a five-year project that bolstered the resilience of over 6,000 smallholder farmers, including a majority of women (56%). The initiative successfully adapted to national crises by combining immediate cash assistance and agricultural inputs—such as compost and fodder seeds—with long-term capacity building in climate-smart practices and food processing technologies. This strategic collaboration, aligned with the 2025–2026 National Extension Plan, empowered rural communities to transform traditional farming into sustainable, high-efficiency models, ensuring national food security and regional economic stability.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has commenced the distribution of 30 tons of improved, certified wheat seeds to 600 farmers across Lebanon to...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has commenced the distribution of 30 tons of improved, certified wheat seeds to 600 farmers across Lebanon to cultivate approximately 1,500 dunams, focusing on high-yielding ACSAD varieties like the 1105 durum and 1133 soft wheat. These seeds, which offer a 98% purity rate and resistance to yellow rust and drought, are designed to produce between 7 and 8 tons per hectare, significantly bolstering national food security and reducing reliance on costly imports. By providing specialized varieties ideal for Arabic bread and semolina production, the initiative lowers production costs for farmers while ensuring the resilience of a strategic crop essential for daily sustenance during periods of economic challenge.

records.title: The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), in partnership with the Ministry of Environment, has launched a $5.8 million, five-year...
records.description: The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), in partnership with the Ministry of Environment, has launched a $5.8 million, five-year project funded by the Global Environment Facility (GEF) to revitalize the Ubari Lakes Basin. This initiative aims to combat land degradation and biodiversity loss by establishing a 100,000-hectare National Park and rehabilitating 225 hectares of critical wetlands and oases. By integrating nature-based solutions with local ecotourism and sustainable agriculture, the project will create nearly 700 new jobs and provide sustainable employment for 2,250 residents, half of whom are women. This strategic effort supports Libya’s climate commitments under the UNCCD and the 2030 Agenda, fostering an economic model that harmonizes environmental conservation with regional development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Italian CIHEAM Bari Institute, has launched an intensive training program for shee...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Italian CIHEAM Bari Institute, has launched an intensive training program for sheep farmers in South Hebron as part of the SANET (Support Agri-food coop Network in Palestine) project. This three-day initiative, managed by the General Directorate of Extension, provides breeders with advanced technological methods for feed resource management and scientific animal nutrition designed to reduce costs and increase profitability. By focusing on the sound management of local resources and high-efficiency livestock practices, the project aims to create a sustainable agricultural environment that secures the local market's needs and strengthens national food security. This partnership reflects a strategic effort to modernize the livestock sector through international technical expertise and improved value chain efficiency.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in coordination with the Customs Police, Preventive Security, and the Ministry of National Economy, destroye...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in coordination with the Customs Police, Preventive Security, and the Ministry of National Economy, destroyed 1,065 kg of substandard olive oil in Nablus to protect consumers and uphold the quality of the national product. The 71 gallons of oil were seized and disposed of after technical examinations confirmed they did not meet official Palestinian specifications, an action taken to safeguard the high reputation of local oil and support law-abiding farmers. Following the operation, the ministry referred the violators to the Public Prosecution for legal action, reaffirming its commitment to rigorous market monitoring and the enforcement of standards across the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, the Customs Police, Preventive Security, and the Ministry of National Economy

records.description: The Al-Jouf International Agricultural Forum has launched its third edition to bolster sustainable development and food security in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030. During the event, the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture inaugurated a specialized Olive Laboratory to advance research and production quality in the region. With participation from over 40 domestic and international companies, the forum highlights major investment opportunities and modern technologies in one of the Middle East’s most vital agricultural hubs.

records.title: The Western District Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana’a Governorate has launched a vaccination campaign targeting over ten thousa...
records.description: The Western District Agricultural Cooperative Society in Sana’a Governorate has launched a vaccination campaign targeting over ten thousand cattle to combat the emergence of lumpy skin disease. Implemented by the association's veterinary unit under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, the initiative provides both preventative vaccinations and specialized treatment for over 200 infected or suspected cases. By deploying mobile field teams across all districts, the campaign combines medical intervention with farmer education on maintaining safe environments and eradicating disease vectors. This strategic effort aligns with national directives to protect livestock assets, enhance local production, and move toward self-sufficiency in the national meat and dairy markets.
records.institution: The Western District Agricultural Cooperative Society

records.title: Iraq’s push for wheat self-sufficiency is under severe threat as the U.N.
records.description: Iraq’s push for wheat self-sufficiency is under severe threat as the U.N. Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) warns of a potential $50\%$ harvest decline due to record-low water levels in the Tigris and Euphrates. In response, the Ministry of Agriculture has halved river-irrigated planting and mandated a transition to modern drip and sprinkler systems to replace traditional flood irrigation. To compensate for dwindling surface reserves, which have plunged from $60$ billion to less than $4$ billion cubic metres, the Wells and Groundwater Authority is overseeing an expansion into desert farming using precarious groundwater supplies. These emergency measures, including a nationwide ban on water-intensive rice cultivation, aim to mitigate a projected $2.4$ million ton import gap while addressing the displacement of $170,000$ rural citizens facing total livelihood loss.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, under the leadership of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has officially participated in launchin...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, under the leadership of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), has officially participated in launching the Regional Observatory for Food Security during a workshop in Amman, Jordan. This new digital infrastructure includes Iraq, Egypt, Jordan, Syria, Lebanon, Palestine, and Sudan, and is designed to standardize food security data through advanced analytical software and early warning systems. By integrating local databases with international standards, the observatory provides decision-makers with high-fidelity insights to formulate proactive policies and address regional crises. This collaborative initiative strengthens the commitment among member states to harness shared data and technological innovation, ensuring a resilient and secure agricultural future for the Levant region.

records.title: The Board of Directors of the Agricultural Credit Corporation (ACC) has approved a JD70 million lending budget for the upcoming year, rep...
records.description: The Board of Directors of the Agricultural Credit Corporation (ACC) has approved a JD70 million lending budget for the upcoming year, representing a $10\%$ increase to meet rising demand for agricultural financing. The institution achieved a $98\%$ completion rate on its previous loan targets, benefiting 12,880 farmers with a focus on modern farming practices, value chains, and empowering women and youth. A new humanitarian relief account was also launched to support borrowers facing death or disability, funded by investment revenues from the Solidarity Fund and Islamic donations.

records.description: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL), in cooperation with the GIZ, has successfully concluded a high-level workshop to finalize the nation’s first comprehensive renewable energy law. This landmark legislative framework aims to fill a long-standing vacuum, establishing clear governance and transparency to attract private investment in solar and wind energy. By transitioning toward a sustainable energy system, the law seeks to reduce fossil fuel dependence, enhance the stability of electricity supplies, and create high-quality job opportunities. The draft has now been referred to the relevant authorities for final ratification, marking a qualitative shift toward a green economy and long-term national energy security.
records.institution: The Renewable Energy Authority of Libya (REAoL)

records.description: Palestine Polytechnic University has inaugurated the Center of Excellence for Specialized Veterinary Examinations, a strategic facility developed in partnership with the Veterinary Doctors Association and the Land Research Center. Supported by the Ministry of Agriculture and the We Effect Foundation, the center serves as an advanced diagnostic reference point to improve the accuracy of scientific diagnoses for transboundary and zoonotic animal diseases. By integrating academic research with market needs, the facility strengthens the "One Health" system, linking animal health directly to human safety and national food security.

records.title: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture and the Palestinian counterpart signed a strategic action plan to consolidate bilateral ties and en...
records.description: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture and the Palestinian counterpart signed a strategic action plan to consolidate bilateral ties and enhance joint technical cooperation during a high-level committee meeting in Amman. The agreement focuses on facilitating the flow of agricultural trade and goods while exchanging research expertise in modern irrigation, water harvesting, and pest control to achieve sustainable regional food security. Both parties committed to developing specialized training programs and exploring private sector partnerships in seed technology, fertilizer manufacturing, and veterinary vaccines. By establishing a unified framework for resource management and capacity building, the initiative serves as a model for Arab cooperation aimed at modernizing the agricultural sectors of both nations.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Italian CIEM Bari Institute, has launched a specialized training course for plum far...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Italian CIEM Bari Institute, has launched a specialized training course for plum farmers in the northern Hebron region as part of the "SANIT" project. This three-day initiative focuses on modernizing agricultural value chains by equipping local farmers with advanced technologies for crop management and high-efficiency production techniques. Under the supervision of the Northern Hebron Agriculture Directorate and specialized technical teams, the program aims to improve product quality and increase productivity to boost rural incomes.

records.title: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD) has launched a strategic project in Syria to enhance the value chains of lentil...
records.description: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD) has launched a strategic project in Syria to enhance the value chains of lentils and chickpeas in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and the General Union of Farmers. Supported by the Arab Gulf Programme for Development (AGFUND), the initiative provides specialized training in good agricultural practices alongside the distribution of essential production inputs like seeds and fertilizers. This project focuses on integrating modern techniques into traditional farming to increase crop yields and improve market access for smallholder farmers. By strengthening the productivity of these strategic commodities, the partnership aims to bolster national food security and promote sustainable economic growth within the regional agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD)

records.title: The Al-Khut Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association organized a specialized training workshop to enhance the capabilities of p...
records.description: The Al-Khut Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association organized a specialized training workshop to enhance the capabilities of production group facilitators in managing plant and animal value chains. Supported by the Binyan Development Foundation and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, the program focused on modernizing agricultural supervision and integrating best practices from seed selection to marketing. Participants discussed strategies for cost reduction and quality improvement to drive vertical and horizontal expansion within the governorate’s agricultural sector. This initiative aims to build local community capacity and ensure the delivery of high-quality products, fostering long-term sustainable development and food security.
records.institution: The Al-Khut Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: The World Bank approved a $4 million grant to bolster the Transforming Agri-food Systems Program, supplementing an initial $250 million t...
records.description: The World Bank approved a $4 million grant to bolster the Transforming Agri-food Systems Program, supplementing an initial $250 million to support small- and medium-scale cereal farmers. This initiative utilizes digital e-vouchers to provide 1,200 farmers with mechanization services and climate-resilient seeds across 20,000 hectares of rainfed land. By promoting conservation agriculture and direct seeding, the program aims to stabilize yields, improve soil and water management, and reduce vulnerability to climate shocks. These efforts focus on strengthening national food security and creating green jobs in rural areas through modernized, climate-smart farming practices.

records.title: The Ministry of Finance reviewed progress on the Sustainable Natural Resources and Livelihoods Project, reaffirming its commitment to loc...
records.description: The Ministry of Finance reviewed progress on the Sustainable Natural Resources and Livelihoods Project, reaffirming its commitment to local funding and budget allocations for upcoming seasons. In collaboration with the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), the initiative evaluated efforts to resume activities across several states following a three-year hiatus. The mission highlighted successful seed distribution, agricultural extension support, and income-generating programs for women, even within conflict-affected areas. These strategic efforts aim to enhance food security for pastoralists and smallholders by improving resource governance, productivity, and sustainable land and water management practices.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has issued a new resolution to regulate veterinary medical practices, mandat...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has issued a new resolution to regulate veterinary medical practices, mandating that all establishments and professionals obtain official licensing before operating. This regulatory framework aims to bolster the national biosecurity system and animal health by enforcing strict technical requirements and introducing administrative fines for non-compliant entities. By aligning with the "One Health" concept, the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) seeks to ensure food safety and build a sustainable agricultural environment through enhanced oversight. This strategic move modernizes the legislative framework, positioning the region as a center of excellence for specialized medical regulation while increasing public confidence in veterinary care.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Egypt’s food industry exports exceeded $5.8bn during the first ten months of the year, reflecting an $11\%$ growth driven by a strategy t...
records.description: Egypt’s food industry exports exceeded $5.8bn during the first ten months of the year, reflecting an $11\%$ growth driven by a strategy to localize technology and transform the nation into a regional industrial hub. The Ministry of Industry and Transport is facilitating this expansion by leveraging free trade agreements and the Qualifying Industrial Zones (QIZ) to ensure duty-free access to global markets. To enhance production capacity, the Chamber of Food Industries signed protocols with the Egyptian Organization for Standardization and Quality and the American University in Cairo for food safety certifications. [Image showing Egypt's food export growth and major trade destination categories] These efforts focus on integrating local supply chains with international markets to close import gaps and transition toward a value-added green economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Transport

records.title: Noatum Ports, the international operating arm of AD Ports Group, signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Al Dahra Agriculture – Egypt t...
records.description: Noatum Ports, the international operating arm of AD Ports Group, signed a Memorandum of Understanding with Al Dahra Agriculture – Egypt to modernize logistics infrastructure and enhance agricultural supply chains. The partnership focuses on utilizing the Safaga Terminal to provide advanced warehousing, customs clearance, and supply chain digitalization, particularly targeting the development of Egypt’s eastern and southern regions. By integrating expert port operations with agribusiness leadership, the initiative aims to strengthen national food security and boost the global competitiveness of Egyptian exports through efficient farm-to-market links. These strategic investments align with national development plans to establish the country as a technology-enabled regional hub for trade and sustainable industrial growth.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is launching a targeted cattle vaccination campaign in the Western Bekaa region to combat the $\text{SET 1}$...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is launching a targeted cattle vaccination campaign in the Western Bekaa region to combat the $\text{SET 1}$ strain of foot-and-mouth disease using fifty thousand doses provided by the Ministry of Agriculture of the sisterly Arab Republic of Egypt. This collaborative effort involves vaccinating uninfected herds followed by a booster after twenty days to protect livestock and ensure the long-term sustainability of the national agricultural sector. The campaign emphasizes that the disease poses no risk to human health, encouraging the continued consumption of dairy and meat while urging breeders to adhere to official price guidelines for milk. By strengthening the resilience of the livestock sector through technical support and field monitoring, the initiative safeguards a fundamental pillar of national food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, has bolstered its national stock of veterinary supplies with a new shipme...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, has bolstered its national stock of veterinary supplies with a new shipment of the disinfectant "Vircon." Following the arrival of the shipment, the Drug Control Department began conducting laboratory tests on samples to ensure full compliance with quality specifications before distribution. Once cleared, these supplies will be dispatched to hospitals and veterinary clinics across the country as part of a proactive strategy to prevent the spread of epidemic diseases. This initiative reflects the ministry's ongoing commitment to safeguarding livestock health and ensuring the resilience of the national agricultural sector through rigorous biosecurity measures.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment has launched a steering committee to develop a comprehensive executive program for 2026–27 aimed at curbing r...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment has launched a steering committee to develop a comprehensive executive program for 2026–27 aimed at curbing random littering and improving public health. Chaired by the Prime Minister, the initiative focuses on upgrading waste management infrastructure, increasing container availability, and deploying specialized cleaning teams across streets, public squares, and forests. To ensure effective enforcement, the program will integrate modern technological tools, including an automated electronic monitoring system and vehicle-mounted cameras to track environmental violations.

records.title: Moroccan exports to Kuwait surged by approximately 7.1 percent in early 2025, reaching values between 179 million and 217 million dirhams...
records.description: Moroccan exports to Kuwait surged by approximately 7.1 percent in early 2025, reaching values between 179 million and 217 million dirhams as trade ties strengthen across automotive, aerospace, and agricultural sectors. Under the "Green Generation 2030" strategy, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Kuwait Chamber of Commerce and Industry (KCCI) are working to diversify trade beyond European markets, specifically targeting Kuwait’s $3.5 billion food and restaurant sector. This economic realignment is supported by major infrastructure upgrades and the new Investment Charter, positioning the nation as a logistical hub for global exports. Despite the current growth, officials emphasize that there is significant room for expansion, as the current trade represents only a small fraction of the total agricultural imports in the Gulf region.

records.title: Morocco has solidified its role as a strategic supplier to Europe, with frozen berry exports to France increasing by $25\%$ to reach $1,9...
records.description: Morocco has solidified its role as a strategic supplier to Europe, with frozen berry exports to France increasing by $25\%$ to reach $1,950$ tons. Data from the Moroccan Digital Farm Network and sector reports show the nation has secured a top-five market position, surpassing previous records and displacing competitors like Cyprus. This growth is driven by a structural transformation focused on both fresh and frozen high-value fruits, with fresh raspberry exports alone exceeding $64,400$ tonnes across $26$ countries. By capitalizing on varietal diversity and off-season production, the sector continues to improve its international competitiveness and the visibility of its high-quality agricultural value chains.

records.title: The closing of the 9th Agricultural Vocational Training Trainee Forum at the Royal Institute of Specialized Technicians in Livestock Farm...
records.description: The closing of the 9th Agricultural Vocational Training Trainee Forum at the Royal Institute of Specialized Technicians in Livestock Farming (IRTSE) highlighted the strategic role of youth in the "Generation Green 2030" strategy. The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests aims to train 140,000 graduates by 2030 to modernize the sector, with 50,000 already certified across 57 national institutions. A major partnership was signed between IRTSE, the Digital Hub for Agriculture, and IAV Hassan II to create the Moroccan Digital Farm Network, focusing on AgriDigital technology experimentation. This event serves as a vital platform for innovation, entrepreneurship, and rural employment, rewarding excellence in agricultural research and technical skills among over 260 trainees.
records.institution: The Royal Institute of Specialized Technicians in Livestock Farming (IRTSE)

records.title: The signing of the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) marks a significant milestone in bilateral relations, aimed at gen...
records.description: The signing of the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) marks a significant milestone in bilateral relations, aimed at generating substantial opportunities across major economic sectors and enhancing investment flows. This strategic partnership, supported by the Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry and the Confederation of Indian Industry, focuses on reducing trade barriers and fostering growth in infrastructure, technology, and food security. Additional agreements in agriculture, higher education, and maritime heritage further solidify the multi-faceted cooperation between the two nations under their respective long-term development visions. These collaborative efforts ensure a sustainable framework for economic diversification, energy cooperation in green hydrogen, and strengthened regional security through shared maritime initiatives.
records.institution: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a comprehensive national campaign to monitor agricultural medicines, fertilizers, and pesticides...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a comprehensive national campaign to monitor agricultural medicines, fertilizers, and pesticides, beginning with an intensive inspection tour in Jenin Governorate. During the initial operation, directorate teams confiscated 196 packages of non-conforming inputs, including 95 liters of pesticides and 20 kilograms of unfit or expired fertilizers. These enforcement actions aim to tighten control over production inputs across all governorates, ensuring that sales outlets strictly comply with approved standards and regulations. By taking legal measures against violators, the institution prioritizes the safety of agricultural products and protects the rights of farmers to access high-quality, safe materials for sustainable production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture signed agreements to establish four prickly pear demonstration plots covering 20 dunams in Masafer Bani Na’im...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture signed agreements to establish four prickly pear demonstration plots covering 20 dunams in Masafer Bani Na’im as part of the "Greening My Country" campaign. Managed by the General Directorate of Forests and Rangelands and the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, the project provides seedlings to farmers to combat land degradation and desertification. This initiative enhances natural resource preservation and wildlife protection while creating sustainable income sources for farmers through fruit production in arid regions.

records.title: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD) has launched a project to enhance trade integration and develop value chains fo...
records.description: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD) has launched a project to enhance trade integration and develop value chains for lentils and chickpeas across five countries, including the Syrian Arab Republic. Supported by the Arab Gulf Programme for Development (AGFUND), the initiative provides training on good agricultural practices and distributes essential inputs like seeds, fertilizers, and fungicides to local producers.The project, implemented with the Ministry of Agriculture and the General Union of Farmers, includes the development of online marketing platforms to connect growers with traders more efficiently. This strategic effort aims to improve regional productivity and expand trade in strategic commodities to ensure long-term food security and agricultural sustainability.
records.institution: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD)

records.title: The International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA) and the Office of Livestock and Pastures (OEP) launched a pi...
records.description: The International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA) and the Office of Livestock and Pastures (OEP) launched a pioneering 36-month project in Tunis titled "Expansion of low methane emission genetics in small ruminants in Asia and Africa." Coordinated by Wageningen University and running until September 2028, the initiative targets the reduction of enteric methane emissions—a greenhouse gas significantly more potent than $CO_2$—within the livestock sector. By integrating methane-reduction traits into the genetic selection schemes of sheep and goats across Tunisia, Ethiopia, India, and Mongolia, the project aims to foster climate-smart livestock farming that balances environmental sustainability with increased farmer productivity and welfare.
records.institution: The International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA)

records.title: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has partnered with Equiti Group to accelerate digital transformati...
records.description: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) has partnered with Equiti Group to accelerate digital transformation and strengthen the regional food security system through advanced financial technology. This collaboration focuses on developing an innovative digital platform powered by Distributed Ledger Technology (DLT), blockchain, and AI-driven tools to enhance investment analysis and project management for agricultural portfolios. By exchanging critical data for feasibility studies and financial projections, the entities aim to build a resilient market infrastructure that facilitates more efficient capital mobilization and expands access for accredited investors. This strategic initiative aligns with national efforts to promote sustainable growth and inclusive development across the 21 member countries of the institution.
records.institution: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID)

records.title: Al Khair River for Development Agricultural Investment and Environmental Services Company (Nahr Elkhair) signed a contract with the Minis...
records.description: Al Khair River for Development Agricultural Investment and Environmental Services Company (Nahr Elkhair) signed a contract with the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation to cultivate $150$ feddans of local broad bean seeds. Valued at $\text{EGP }15$ million, the agreement is managed by the Central Administration for Seed Production (CASP) to boost domestic seed availability. This partnership follows a period of significant growth for the company, which saw net profits surge to $\text{EGP }78.61$ million in the first nine months of the year. The project reflects a strategic effort to enhance national agricultural output through collaboration between the private sector and government entities.
records.institution: Al Khair River for Development Agricultural Investment and Environmental Services Company (Nahr Elkhair)

records.title: Iraq’s wheat production faces a potential $30\%$ to $50\%$ decline as the country grapples with its most severe drought in decades, exace...
records.description: Iraq’s wheat production faces a potential $30\%$ to $50\%$ decline as the country grapples with its most severe drought in decades, exacerbated by record-low levels in the Tigris and Euphrates. According to the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), national water reserves have plummeted from $60$ billion cubic metres in $2020$ to less than $4$ billion, heavily impacted by upstream dams and rising temperatures. In response, the Ministry of Agriculture has halved the land allocated for river-irrigated wheat and banned water-intensive rice cultivation to preserve limited resources. To mitigate these losses, the Ministry of Agriculture is mandating a shift from traditional flood irrigation to modern drip and sprinkler systems while moving production toward desert areas utilizing groundwater.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is distributing medicines and vaccines to hospitals across all governorat...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is distributing medicines and vaccines to hospitals across all governorates to strengthen livestock protection and prevent epidemic diseases. Following laboratory testing and evaluation by the Drug Control Section, these supplies are being released to regional warehouses for distribution to local clinics according to a coordinated plan. This initiative is a central part of national efforts to maintain animal health and support food security by providing essential resources for proactive disease management and preventive care. By implementing these measures, the government aims to ensure the long-term sustainability of the livestock sector and enhance the effectiveness of veterinary services nationwide.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is conducting a comprehensive scientific response to combat foot-and-mouth disease, specifically the $\text{S...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is conducting a comprehensive scientific response to combat foot-and-mouth disease, specifically the $\text{SAT1}$ strain, through rigorous epidemiological monitoring and field sampling across affected regions. An emergency committee including the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) coordinates vaccination campaigns and biosecurity protocols to ensure containment. Technical teams utilize the Agricultural Scientific Research Authority for reference testing and damage assessment to support farmers while protecting national livestock and food security. These measures prioritize public safety, as the virus does not pose a risk to human health or the safety of meat and dairy products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Al-Dhahiriya Agriculture and Veterinary Department and the Veterinary Services Department in Dur...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Al-Dhahiriya Agriculture and Veterinary Department and the Veterinary Services Department in Dura, vaccinated $17,000$ sheep across $50$ locations to assist $250$ breeders. This effort by the South Hebron Agriculture Directorate targets resilience and productivity in marginalized areas through comprehensive vaccination and health guidance programs. Coordinated with the General Directorate of Veterinary Services, the campaign effectively mitigates the spread of diseases while ensuring the sustainability of the regional livestock sector. These strategic steps provide essential veterinary services to remote farming communities, significantly improving the health and output of local herds.

records.title: King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST) and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) organized a workshop...
records.description: King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST) and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) organized a workshop on groundwater sustainability to discuss advanced technologies for aquifer recharge and restoration. This initiative aims to enhance national water security and reduce reliance on non-renewable reserves by integrating research, development, and innovation into Saudi Vision 2030 goals. Experts explored innovative solutions in desalination, treatment, and efficient management practices for arid environments to foster a more resilient and sustainable economy. The event concluded with recommendations to strengthen collaboration between research and executive bodies, establish expertise-sharing platforms, and develop specialized national capacities in water management.
records.institution: Today, King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST)

records.title: A workshop in Bayda focused on establishing marketing units and signing contracts for cooperative agricultural associations to expand pro...
records.description: A workshop in Bayda focused on establishing marketing units and signing contracts for cooperative agricultural associations to expand production and improve marketing mechanisms across districts. The Ministry of Agriculture presented contract farming as a strategic step to increase local grain and legume yields and reduce reliance on imports through organized production groups. Supported by the initiative funding unit, these efforts prioritize rainwater harvesting and land reclamation to achieve national food security and self-sufficiency. This initiative empowers farmers to participate in quality-based marketing plans that strengthen the overall capacities and sustainable development of the regional agricultural sector.

records.title: The Elsewedy Industrial Development Company signed a land sale agreement with the Polish company Fruitful, marking the first Polish inves...
records.description: The Elsewedy Industrial Development Company signed a land sale agreement with the Polish company Fruitful, marking the first Polish investment in its frozen food industry projects located in the 10th of Ramadan City. This deal, signed at the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI), covers the construction of an advanced factory spanning $8,000$ to $8,853$ square meters for producing up to $7,200$ tons annually of frozen foods using IQF and freeze-drying technologies, with production primarily allocated for export. The project is expected to create over $5,000$ direct and indirect job opportunities across various value chains, including farms and logistics, contributing to increased production efficiency and quality in Egypt.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) announced a $€200$ million financing package for the Egyptian Electricity Tra...
records.description: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) announced a $€200$ million financing package for the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company (EETC) to accelerate Egypt’s transition to a green economy. This package, which includes a $€165$ million EBRD loan and a $€35$ million investment grant from the European Union Neighborhood Investment Platform (EU NIP), is a key component of the EBRD-led energy pillar under Egypt's Nexus of Water, Food, and Energy (NWFE) initiative. The investment will be used to upgrade a $500$ kilovolt substation in Cairo, directly linked to the decommissioning of the Shoubra El Kheima gas-fired power plant, and to establish a high-voltage overhead transmission line to evacuate over $2.1$ gigawatt of renewable energy from the Gulf of Suez region. These efforts are expected to reduce transmission losses, cut annual carbon emissions by $22,584$ tons of $\text{CO}_2$ equivalent, and help Egypt integrate its target of $22$ GW of renewable capacity by $2030$.
records.institution: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a cooperation agreement with the People's Republic of China for a donation of specialized drones desig...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a cooperation agreement with the People's Republic of China for a donation of specialized drones designed for pesticide spraying in pine forests. This initiative aims to modernize the agricultural sector by adopting innovation to protect natural resources, increase production efficiency, and mitigate climate-related environmental risks. The partnership with the Chinese Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs focuses on technology transfer, scientific research, and building sustainable food security through expert training. These efforts represent a comprehensive cooperation track designed to support rural development and the resilience of farmers through advanced aerial technology.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Bethlehem directorate, delivered metal supplies for grape trellises to $70$ farmers in Al-Khader...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Bethlehem directorate, delivered metal supplies for grape trellises to $70$ farmers in Al-Khader and Jorat Al-Shamaa, targeting $150$ dunams. This initiative, carried out by Agricultural Relief in cooperation with the Bethlehem Governorate and Al-Khader Municipality, aims to support new farmers in establishing modern production systems. As part of the "Improving the Value Chain for Grapes - Phase II" project funded by the World Food Programme (WFP), the program will eventually provide irrigation networks, shade nets, and seedlings. These efforts are designed to raise productive capacities, increase efficiency, and promote the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices to develop the regional grape sector.

records.title: The third introductory workshop for the Climate-Smart Agriculture Ambassadors Program was held in Tubas to target newly graduated and une...
records.description: The third introductory workshop for the Climate-Smart Agriculture Ambassadors Program was held in Tubas to target newly graduated and unemployed agricultural engineers as part of a project to enhance resilience and sustainability. The program is implemented by Quater International in partnership with the Ministry of National Economy and the Agricultural Engineers Syndicate, with funding from the Government of Canada. Aiming to build capacities and empowerment opportunities over five years, the workshop provided a detailed presentation on climate-smart techniques to fifteen engineers from the Tubas and Nablus governorates. These sessions are being conducted across various governorates to ensure that agricultural professionals are equipped with innovative solutions despite the challenging local conditions.

records.title: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) signed a memorandum of understanding with the International Maize and Wheat Im...
records.description: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST) signed a memorandum of understanding with the International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT) to enhance scientific cooperation on improving climate-resilient crops in Saudi Arabia. This partnership aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 by combining global expertise in maize and wheat development with advanced research in genomics, bioinformatics, and computational agriculture. The collaboration aims to accelerate the creation of high-yield, climate-adapted varieties capable of withstanding the harsh conditions of arid and high-temperature environments. This strategic move strengthens national food security by addressing challenges such as climate change, pests, and rising food demand through innovative, sustainable agricultural solutions.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication in the Syrian Arab Republic is securing essential supplies for farmers through a dual-t...
records.description: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication in the Syrian Arab Republic is securing essential supplies for farmers through a dual-track distribution system. The interest-free loan track delivers seeds to program beneficiaries to alleviate financial burdens at the start of the planting season, while the direct sales track ensures certified and improved varieties are available to all interested buyers. By providing these two parallel options, the General Establishment for Seed Multiplication aims to prevent market shortages and support national agricultural productivity. This initiative forms a core part of the state's strategy to stabilize the agricultural sector and ensure the availability of high-quality inputs for food production.
records.institution: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture affirmed its commitment to supporting local agricultural projects by facilitating the establishment and devel...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture affirmed its commitment to supporting local agricultural projects by facilitating the establishment and development of livestock initiatives, such as the Najaf Farms project for fresh Iraqi table egg production. This project, located in the Al-Rahima area, utilizes the latest global and European methods and technologies. The Ministry's support is comprehensive, including providing price subsidies, supplying feed and vaccines, and offering continuous technical follow-up and guidance from veterinary staff. This strategic effort aims to improve production, enhance poultry health, and increase national output, while also providing job opportunities.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Al-Mishkhab Research Station in Najaf Governorate, achieved a new research milestone by successf...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Al-Mishkhab Research Station in Najaf Governorate, achieved a new research milestone by successfully harvesting two new short-season rice varieties, MRRS 1 and MRRS 2. These varieties were officially registered in 2025 to accommodate later planting dates and address challenges related to water scarcity. The Director of the Najaf Research Department, Dr. Abdul Kadhim Jawad Musa, confirmed the successful cultivation and harvesting, which followed the dry seed method. The Ministry now plans to generalize and expand the cultivation of these two new varieties across most Iraqi governorates during the next season to help spread rice cultivation and contribute to national water management efforts.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is actively conducting continuous field campaigns to provide health and v...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is actively conducting continuous field campaigns to provide health and veterinary supervision of local slaughterhouses and butcher shops across governorates, including Babylon and Nineveh. These campaigns are part of the Ministry's priorities to protect public health and focus on epidemiological surveillance to ensure the safety and quality of red and white meat delivered to citizens, aligning with approved health regulations. The Ministry stresses that this work supports domestic production and contributes to reducing the spread of epidemic diseases.

records.title: Consultative days on developing horticultural crop value chains in the Trarza region were opened in Nouakchott, organized by the Ministry...
records.description: Consultative days on developing horticultural crop value chains in the Trarza region were opened in Nouakchott, organized by the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty through the National Rural Development Company (SONADER), in collaboration with the Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID). The initiative aims to explore prospects and challenges for enhancing the productivity and sustainability of the horticultural sector to contribute to national food security and job creation. Emphasizing the strength of the Mauritanian-Spanish partnership, the days seek to develop practical recommendations to bolster agricultural development, focusing on production, water conservation, and post-harvest technologies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty
