records.title: Six partnership agreements were signed in Rabat between the Agency for Agricultural Development (ADA) and NGO consortia, formally launchi...
records.description: Six partnership agreements were signed in Rabat between the Agency for Agricultural Development (ADA) and NGO consortia, formally launching the IHYAE program, supported by the European Union and the French Development Agency (AFD). This €4 million grant program, running over three years, aims to strengthen the resilience of small farms by converting 8,000 hectares to agroecological practices and improving the economic performance of 2,700 family farms in the Fes-Meknes, Oriental, and Souss-Massa regions. The initiative, which is unprecedented in its broad involvement of NGOs, emphasizes a territorial focus, supports the marketing of agroecological products, and prioritizes the inclusion and economic integration of rural youth and women, aligning centrally with the Generation Green strategy to promote a sustainable and resilient agricultural model.

records.title: The final phase of the "Saïss Plain Water Conservation – SAISS III" project has been launched through a $€150$ million financing agreemen...
records.description: The final phase of the "Saïss Plain Water Conservation – SAISS III" project has been launched through a $€150$ million financing agreement signed between Morocco and the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), with additional support from the HIPCA UK mechanism. This project aims to secure irrigation for nearly $20,000$ hectares by replacing unsustainable groundwater withdrawals from the overexploited Saïss aquifer with surface water from the M'DEZ dam, delivering $90$ to $120$ million cubic meters annually. Beyond hydraulic infrastructure, the initiative includes targeted technical support for youth, women, and smallholder farmers to promote sustainable agricultural practices, aligning with Morocco’s national vision for climate resilience and sustainable development.

records.title: The Korea-Oman Joint Seminar on Sustainable Water Resources Management was co-hosted by the Embassy of Korea in Muscat, the Ministry of C...
records.description: The Korea-Oman Joint Seminar on Sustainable Water Resources Management was co-hosted by the Embassy of Korea in Muscat, the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment of Korea, and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman, along with the Korea Water Partnership (KWP) and the Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency (KOTRA) Muscat Office. The event brought together government agencies and industry leaders from both nations to share policy insights and technical expertise on topics such as non-revenue water (NRW) reduction, desalination, wastewater treatment, and smart water network innovation. This reaffirmed the shared commitment of both countries to strengthening long-term bilateral cooperation in the water sector amidst rising climate and resource challenges.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Directorate of Agriculture of Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Governorate, received crescent-sh...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Directorate of Agriculture of Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Governorate, received crescent-shaped retaining walls and a water transmission line in the village of Aqaba. This infrastructure was implemented by the Applied Research Institute - Jerusalem (ARIJ), with funding from Save the Children, under the Child and Rural Family Support Project (NORAD). This activity aims to enhance the resilience of $42$ farmers by improving agricultural infrastructure, supporting the sustainability of production, and contributing to better water resource management for agricultural lands in the region.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a joint cooperation agreement with the World Food Programme (WFP) to enhance agricultural production,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture signed a joint cooperation agreement with the World Food Programme (WFP) to enhance agricultural production, specifically focusing on supporting farmers and increasing cultivated areas in the Suwaida Governorate. The agreement's key components include the provision of a grant consisting of wheat seeds and fertilizer to local farmers. This collaboration is part of the Ministry's ongoing efforts to boost the agricultural sector and is designed to provide direct material support to farmers in the targeted governorate.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy, in collaboration with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), launched the Smar...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy, in collaboration with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), launched the Smart Metre Project in the Al Wathba area to enhance water-use efficiency and support sustainable agriculture using artificial intelligence and digital monitoring technologies. This strategic initiative involves connecting AI-powered smart meters to the Department of Energy's digital platform, AD.WE, to ensure equitable water distribution and provide farmers with real-time data and analytics. The project, which currently covers 80 farms in Al Wathba with plans for expansion, aims to improve consumption efficiency, support data-driven decision-making, and reinforce Abu Dhabi's commitment to food and water security.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy, Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The first phase of the Economic Empowerment Project was inaugurated in Ibb Governorate, providing interest-free loans for the purchase of...
records.description: The first phase of the Economic Empowerment Project was inaugurated in Ibb Governorate, providing interest-free loans for the purchase of $37$ solar power systems for $40$ farmers in Hazm Al-Udayn District, implemented by the Central Economic Empowerment Unit in cooperation with the Hazm Al-Udayn Agricultural Cooperative Association. Funded by the Governorate's Unit for Financing Agricultural Projects and Initiatives, Bonyan Foundation, and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, this initiative aims to enhance the farmers' economic empowerment by reducing production costs, increasing productivity, and shifting reliance away from traditional energy sources. The project is seen as a crucial step towards strengthening the agricultural sector, achieving food security, and supporting the local economy's resilience through sustainable production practices.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, announced a significant achievement in preparing seeds for the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, announced a significant achievement in preparing seeds for the strategic wheat crop, reaching a preparation rate of 92%. This high rate reflects the increasing demand for locally produced seeds, which is attributed to the development programs for new varieties implemented by specialized researchers. The prepared seeds, developed by Iraqi experts, include basic-grade varieties such as Al-Qimma, Al-Jawhara, Buhuth 22, Buhuth 10, Ibaa 99, Sham 6, and Adana. These varieties have proven their efficiency in abundant production and resistance to changing climatic conditions and water scarcity, aligning with the recommendations of the National Seed Council.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, announced the availability of various local and tissue-cultured date pa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, announced the availability of various local and tissue-cultured date palm offshoots for sale at subsidized prices in its branches across several governorates, including Baghdad, Diyala, Wasit, and Basra. This initiative, part of the Ministry's plan to support farmers and encourage the cultivation of date palms, aims to boost local production and increase green spaces. Available varieties include Zahdi, Khastawi, and Khalas, with prices starting from 3,750 IQD for local offshoots and 75,000 IQD for tissue-cultured offshoots.

records.title: The government approved the draft Forestry and Rangeland Law proposed by the Ministry of Agriculture, marking a crucial step to modernize...
records.description: The government approved the draft Forestry and Rangeland Law proposed by the Ministry of Agriculture, marking a crucial step to modernize the legislative framework for managing and protecting forest resources and natural rangelands in Lebanon. The draft law updates existing legislation to address emerging environmental challenges like climate change, biodiversity protection, and land degradation, encompassing all green spaces, including forests, rangelands, and wooded areas. This law ensures enhanced protection, stipulates severe penalties for violations, and establishes a special fund for maintenance, thus strengthening oversight and preserving natural resources for future generations.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture announced a significant international achievement for Lebanon, which has been officially classified in Catego...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture announced a significant international achievement for Lebanon, which has been officially classified in Category 1 for CITES (Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora) implementation by the CITES Secretariat. This advanced classification is due to the completion of the national legislative and regulatory framework, specifically following the adoption of Decree No. 651/1 appointing the CITES Scientific Committee and Decree No. 653/1 regulating trade in wild fauna and flora, which complement Law No. 47/2017. The classification, announced at the 20th Conference of the Parties, is considered a crucial step towards strengthening the effective implementation of CITES at national and regional levels to protect biodiversity and combat the illegal trade in endangered species.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Port Forestry and Fishing Center, affiliated with the North Lebanon Agricultural Department, conducted a fi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Port Forestry and Fishing Center, affiliated with the North Lebanon Agricultural Department, conducted a field visit to Al-Saydawi Fish Farm as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. The visit served to provide practical training for newly appointed forest rangers on the correct methods for measuring fish and determining permissible species, in accordance with the provisions of Decree No. 15/1 (2004), which regulates fish sizes and fishing seasons. This initiative aims to enhance the technical skills of the rangers, strengthen oversight of fish stocks, and promote adherence to laws to ensure the sustainability of marine resources and food security in Lebanon.

records.title: Libya's eastern-based National Development Agency (NDA) met with a delegation from US company Farm Tech to discuss unifying several exist...
records.description: Libya's eastern-based National Development Agency (NDA) met with a delegation from US company Farm Tech to discuss unifying several existing pivot irrigation projects in the deep southwest of Libya (Wadi Atba Municipality). The plan involves integrating the Burjuj, Tasawa, and Maknusa agricultural projects into a single, ambitious strategic project encompassing approximately 1,000 pivot irrigation circuits (50 hectares each), scheduled to be operational during the 2027-2028 agricultural season. The collaboration will leverage Farm Tech's global expertise in integrated agricultural mechanization to ensure the project is implemented according to the highest operational standards, aiming to increase agricultural production efficiency and enhance sustainability in the desert regions.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Save the Children International signed a strategic memorandum of understanding (MoU) to strengthen joint...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Save the Children International signed a strategic memorandum of understanding (MoU) to strengthen joint cooperation in supporting food security and sustainable agricultural development, with a specific focus on protecting children’s rights and improving the livelihoods of rural families. The MoU establishes an expanded partnership framework aimed at supporting national policies, promoting food sovereignty, and empowering small farmers, while also focusing on areas like natural resource management, capacity building, and coordination in humanitarian response. Both parties affirmed their commitment to transparency and accountability, with the Ministry prioritizing the "Seeds of Change" initiative, which focuses on food security and water harvesting.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the signing of two financing agreements between the Palestinian government and the French Dev...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the signing of two financing agreements between the Palestinian government and the French Development Agency (AFD), supporting strategic projects in the sanitation and water reuse sectors for agriculture. One agreement, related to the "Wadis" project, aims to build an integrated national framework for managing treated water and linking it to its reuse for cultivating agricultural fodder crops by developing legal and institutional frameworks and enhancing coordination between relevant parties. The second agreement focuses on promoting sustainable agriculture and strengthening the resilience of farmers, particularly in the western Jenin area, by providing safe quantities of treated water for irrigation and reducing pressure on groundwater.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with and funded...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with and funded by Action Against Hunger (ACF) and the Protection Coalition, carried out a large-scale distribution of 20,550 kilograms of seeds to farmers. This operation was part of the multi-sectoral humanitarian aid project and aimed to support the resilience of farmers and enhance food security in targeted areas of the Northern Jordan Valley, including Khirbet Samra, Hammamat al-Malih, the Burj area, and Hamsa al-Fouqa. A total of 42 farmers directly benefited from this distribution, which is intended to support the upcoming agricultural season and improve the livelihoods of the beneficiary families.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al Meera Consumer Goods Company (Q.P.S.C.) inaugurated the Local Farmers Market Festival at its Ain Khaled branch, with attendance fr...
records.description: The Al Meera Consumer Goods Company (Q.P.S.C.) inaugurated the Local Farmers Market Festival at its Ain Khaled branch, with attendance from the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. Running from December 11 to 24, the festival celebrates the vital contributions of Qatari farmers to food security and local production. The initiative reflects Al Meera's national mandate and commitment to empowering local producers, aligning with the Qatar National Vision 2030 for sustainable development and economic diversification. The market brings together local farms to offer fresh vegetables, fruits, and herbs, reinforcing Al Meera's role as a strategic partner in promoting national products and creating platforms for local brands to grow.
records.institution: The Al Meera Consumer Goods Company (Q.P.S.C.)

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication is a leading agricultural institution focused on providing technical services and suppl...
records.description: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication is a leading agricultural institution focused on providing technical services and supplying high-quality seeds for various crops, including grains, legumes, potatoes, and cotton, while maintaining and renewing seed varieties. The institution's production plan for the upcoming agricultural season aims to produce 60,000 tons of wheat seeds and 6,000 tons of barley seeds, along with seeds for other crops, to meet the majority of farmers' needs. Additionally, the establishment is actively involved in the National Potato Production Project, producing disease-free seeds across various stages (Super Elite and Elite) and maintaining a gene bank, ensuring high-quality seeds at competitive prices to support the national economy and enhance self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The General Establishment for Seed Multiplication

records.title: The Masyaf Forestry Division, affiliated with the Masyaf Agriculture Department, is continuing its planned afforestation project at the A...
records.description: The Masyaf Forestry Division, affiliated with the Masyaf Agriculture Department, is continuing its planned afforestation project at the Al-Kafir Forestry Site, covering approximately 40 hectares. The work involves planting around 8,500 saplings of locally suitable tree species, including stone pine, carob, bay, sumac, oak, terebinth, and rosemary. This initiative is aimed at enhancing vegetation cover and preserving forest resources. The Division has also called upon the local community in Masyaf to actively participate and suggest future afforestation locations, thereby strengthening the principle of community partnership in forest protection and development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries officially launched a program to store quantities of olive oil from sector sta...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries officially launched a program to store quantities of olive oil from sector stakeholders to regulate the market and support producers. A storage bonus has been set, offering 300 dinars per tonne for mill owners and exporters, and 330 dinars per tonne for farmers. This measure follows recommendations from a ministerial council and tasks the National Oil Office (ONH) with setting up the program, which is planned to store between 100,000 and 150,000 tonnes for a limited three-month period to contribute to price stabilization during the olive season.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries launched a strategic national storage program for olive oil to stabilize the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries launched a strategic national storage program for olive oil to stabilize the market during the peak 2025/2026 harvest season. Managed by the National Oil Office (ONH), the initiative offers financial bonuses to private operators—including farmers, mill owners, and exporters—to encourage the temporary storage of surplus production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Community Seed Bank was inaugurated in Bajil District, Al Hodeidah Governorate, implemented by the Bajil Multi-Purpose Agricultural C...
records.description: The Community Seed Bank was inaugurated in Bajil District, Al Hodeidah Governorate, implemented by the Bajil Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the Agricultural Cooperative Union, and the Tehama Development Authority. This strategic initiative is aimed at enhancing food security, supporting farmers with improved local seeds, and preserving plant genetic resources to achieve agricultural sustainability and reduce reliance on imported seeds.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation reported that the country's total agricultural exports reached approximately 8.8 million...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation reported that the country's total agricultural exports reached approximately 8.8 million tonnes so far this year, marking an increase of nearly 750,000 tonnes compared to the same period last year. The report, submitted by the Central Administration for Agricultural Quarantine, highlighted the strength and resilience of the national economy and global confidence in Egyptian products. Citrus fruits remained the top export at over 2 million tonnes, followed by fresh potatoes (1.3 million tonnes) and sweet potatoes (328,000 tonnes). The Ministry emphasized its commitment to the highest international standards, its pivotal role in foreign-currency inflows, and its ongoing efforts to open new and non-traditional markets to ensure the sustainability of growth in the agricultural export sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The 2025 Olive Exhibition was launched in Idlib Governorate, attended by the Governor and the Deputy Minister of Agriculture.
records.description: The 2025 Olive Exhibition was launched in Idlib Governorate, attended by the Governor and the Deputy Minister of Agriculture. The exhibition was overseen by the Olive Office, represented by its director, Engineer Abeer Jawhar. The three-day event is designed to support local produce and facilitate the exchange of expertise between farmers and stakeholders in the olive sector, showcasing various products and modern technologies used in the industry.

records.title: African trade ministers met during the AfCFTA Business Forum to coordinate a unified African position ahead of the 14th WTO Ministerial C...
records.description: African trade ministers met during the AfCFTA Business Forum to coordinate a unified African position ahead of the 14th WTO Ministerial Conference. Under Morocco's chairmanship, discussions reaffirmed the continent's commitment to a rules-based, inclusive multilateral trading system, stressing the need to maintain special and differential treatment for developing countries, particularly regarding agriculture and food security. Participants emphasized that WTO reform must be guided by African needs, focusing on strengthening transparency and participation, with key themes generating convergence including agriculture, fisheries subsidies, trade in services, and electronic commerce, all crucial for the competitiveness of African agricultural sectors.

records.title: Morocco has set a new record for the fifth consecutive season in sweet pepper exports, confirming its position among the most competitive...
records.description: Morocco has set a new record for the fifth consecutive season in sweet pepper exports, confirming its position among the most competitive suppliers in the region. According to EastFruit, Moroccan sweet pepper exports reached 189,200 tons in the 2024/2025 season (a 3.7% increase), generating $240 million in revenue, with an average annual growth of 13% over the last five seasons. Sweet peppers are now shipped year-round, with the peak season running from December to April. European markets, particularly Spain, France, Germany, and the Netherlands, remain the largest destination, accounting for 82% of the exports, while shipments to the United Kingdom have increased fifteenfold in five years, signaling robust diversification.

records.title: The three-year MountainHER project (2022–2025), supported by the PRIMA Foundation and the European Union and involving INRA Morocco and I...
records.description: The three-year MountainHER project (2022–2025), supported by the PRIMA Foundation and the European Union and involving INRA Morocco and ICARDA, aimed to sustainably improve the incomes of mountain farming communities across six countries by empowering women's associations in agroecological transformation. The project encouraged partner farmers to adopt new varieties and conservation agriculture principles, leading to increased production and doubled profit margins by reducing costs and environmental impact. Furthermore, in partnership with women's cooperatives supported by Oxfam, the project promoted short supply chains to retain added value locally and provided training and equipment for grain processing, which increased processing volumes and reduced losses.

records.title: Work is advancing on a large-scale shrimp farming complex in Shinas, Oman, driven by Singapore-based Blue Aqua International and Omani in...
records.description: Work is advancing on a large-scale shrimp farming complex in Shinas, Oman, driven by Singapore-based Blue Aqua International and Omani investors, as part of Oman’s strategy for food security and economic diversification. The facility, which integrates a shrimp farm, hatchery, and broodstock center, is expected to be fully operational by February 2026 with a target annual output of 1,800 metric tonnes. The site prioritizes technology-focused farming methods, controlled operations, efficient water use, and robust biosecurity procedures to ensure stable, sustainable, and disease-free harvests for both domestic and regional supply. The project is part of a broader 22-hectare aquaculture initiative that also includes plans for a 5,000 metric tonne land-based trout farm utilizing Recirculating Aquaculture System (RAS) technology by 2027, and is expected to generate significant local employment.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Arabian Qudra (AQ), a subsidiary of Abunayyan Holding Company, announced a landmark agreement with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), the n...
records.description: Arabian Qudra (AQ), a subsidiary of Abunayyan Holding Company, announced a landmark agreement with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), the national entity regulating the water sector, to establish the first floating solar power plant in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This move underscores Qudra Arabia's commitment to advancing renewable energy sources. The SWA also signed a research cooperation agreement with Saudi Yokogawa Company to apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) technologies for early water leak detection and system efficiency, and sealed a deal with the Water Management Alliance to enhance water security and build capacity.

records.title: A strategic project named APAISE-PBF, funded by the United Nations Peacebuilding Fund, has been launched in the Gafsa and Kairouan govern...
records.description: A strategic project named APAISE-PBF, funded by the United Nations Peacebuilding Fund, has been launched in the Gafsa and Kairouan governorates to alleviate growing pressure on water resources and establish equitable governance mechanisms to strengthen social cohesion. The program, which will run for 24 months, is coordinated by the FAO in partnership with UNDP and UNICEF. It aims to enhance water availability and efficiency in agriculture by providing technical support and training to Agricultural Development Groups (GDA) and local authorities, while placing a central emphasis on the participation of rural women and young people to reduce the structural causes of water-related conflicts.

records.title: The Gafsa and Kairouan regional workshops were organized to establish a proactive territorial governance framework aimed at resolving str...
records.description: The Gafsa and Kairouan regional workshops were organized to establish a proactive territorial governance framework aimed at resolving structural water challenges and social tensions. By focusing on inclusive management, these sessions brought together public institutions and local communities to address critical issues such as the overexploitation of groundwater, unequal resource distribution, and insufficient infrastructure. The initiative, led by local and national organizers, promotes a culture of dialogue and transparency, moving away from fragmented management toward a participatory model. Proposed solutions include the revision of regulatory frameworks, the adoption of water-efficient agricultural technologies, and the implementation of resource-monitoring tools, with the ultimate goal of transforming water management into a driver of social peace and environmental resilience that can be replicated across other regions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), in collaboration with Silal, is organizing a Farmers’ and Livestock Breeder...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), in collaboration with Silal, is organizing a Farmers’ and Livestock Breeders’ Market as part of the Liwa International Festival – Moreeb Dune 2025, running from December 12, 2025, to January 3, 2026. The market aims to support local producers by providing 20 fully equipped stalls for farmers to sell fresh vegetables, fruits, and honey, and 20 pens for breeders to sell local sheep, enabling direct sales to consumers without intermediaries. This initiative forms part of ADAFSA’s broader efforts to strengthen food security by supporting local production, reducing reliance on imports, and promoting sustainable agricultural practices and modern technologies. The market allows festival visitors to directly engage with local producers and contribute to the sustainability of the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Egypt’s Nuclear Materials Authority (NMA) and the Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC) signed a cooperation protocol for the sus...
records.description: Egypt’s Nuclear Materials Authority (NMA) and the Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC) signed a cooperation protocol for the sustainable management and treatment of petroleum-sector waste, including sediments, sludge, and produced water. This initiative, witnessed by the Ministers of Electricity and Petroleum, aligns with a national strategy to optimize natural resource use and convert waste streams into economically valuable materials. The NMA will take the lead in technical studies, environmental assessments, and implementing safe treatment and disposal plans, aiming to extract valuable elements, including rare minerals, from the residues. The EGPC will be responsible for identifying waste sites, quantifying volumes, and providing technical support.
records.institution: Egypt’s Nuclear Materials Authority (NMA), and the Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a national workshop in Beirut in partnership with the World Bank Group and technical support from t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a national workshop in Beirut in partnership with the World Bank Group and technical support from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) to strengthen Lebanon's capacities in plant health. The workshop, which included representatives from the Lebanese Agricultural Research Institute (LARI) and General Directorate of Customs, focused on developing regulatory, institutional, and operational frameworks to facilitate agricultural trade and enhance the competitiveness of Lebanese exports. Key outcomes included developing a roadmap to update the legal framework, identifying capacity-building needs, and establishing the technical requirements for implementing the ePhyto system for the electronic exchange of plant certificates at border crossings.

records.title: An agreement for the construction of the Wadi al Uwaynah Dam in the wilayat of Dhank was signed at the headquarters of the Directorate Ge...
records.description: An agreement for the construction of the Wadi al Uwaynah Dam in the wilayat of Dhank was signed at the headquarters of the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Dhahirah. The project, with a total cost of RO120,000, is jointly funded by the village residents and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, serving as a model of community partnership. The dam will measure 100m in length and 14m in height. It is expected to significantly enhance water availability and the sustainability of local water resources, directly benefiting Uwaynah village's vital agricultural and livestock activities, which rely on date palms, fodder crops, and seasonal produce.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources,

records.title: The text reports that Saudi Arabia recorded a significant increase in food product self-sufficiency ratios in 2024 compared to 2023, acco...
records.description: The text reports that Saudi Arabia recorded a significant increase in food product self-sufficiency ratios in 2024 compared to 2023, according to the General Authority for Statistics (GASTAT). Key self-sufficiency ratios in 2024 were highest for shrimp at 149%, dairy products at 131%, and dates at 121%. Notable increases from 2023 to 2024 included onions (+41.2%) and tomatoes (+9.2%). The highest annual per capita consumption was for rice (52.1 kg) among plant products and milk (70.3 liters) among animal products. The data compilation is based on information from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the General Food Security Authority, and the Agricultural Development Fund.

records.title: Silal’s Innovation Oasis (iO), the state-of-the-art research and development hub in Al Ain, signed a landmark collaboration agreement wit...
records.description: Silal’s Innovation Oasis (iO), the state-of-the-art research and development hub in Al Ain, signed a landmark collaboration agreement with Square Roots, a global agritech company specializing in modular controlled-climate farming and AI-powered cultivation systems. The partnership establishes a national testbed for fast-tracking innovation in desert and indoor farming, deploying a multi-zone, cloud-connected, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered research facility at the iO site. The initiative aims to advance climate-smart agriculture by developing low-light crop genetics for lower energy consumption, identifying strategic crops suited to desert environments, and localizing advanced farmer training programs to enhance the UAE's food security and water efficiency goals.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched the "Model Directorates" program, selecting Bajil Directorate in Hod...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched the "Model Directorates" program, selecting Bajil Directorate in Hodeida governorate as a key paradigm for comprehensive agricultural and productive development in the Tihama Plain. The initiative drives a vast development transformation focused on boosting local production, achieving self-sufficiency, and building an effective marketing system through partnerships between the state and the community. This transformation involves organizing over 750 productive groups, reclaiming agricultural land, distributing improved seeds for strategic crops like soybeans and maize, launching a dairy production line at the Bajil Agricultural Cooperative Society factory, and establishing infrastructure like the "Kilo 18" Central Market to support commercial and agricultural activity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The International Governmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage, under UNESCO, announced the inclusion...
records.description: The International Governmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage, under UNESCO, announced the inclusion of Jordan's ancient "Al-Mahras" olive tree on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage. The Jordanian Ministry of Culture emphasized that registering the Al-Mahras olive tree—a resilient variety prized for its high oil content (up to 30%) and distinctive quality—is a historic achievement reflecting the depth of the country's cultural heritage and its centrality in olive cultivation history. The successful submission was the result of collaboration among various national institutions, including the Ministries of Foreign Affairs and Agriculture, the National Center for Agricultural Research, the Jordan Olive Oil Exporters Association (JOPIA), and others.
records.institution: The International Governmental Committee for the Safeguarding of the Intangible Cultural Heritage

records.title: Villages in Ajloun Governorate are increasingly adopting organic farming as a pathway to achieving food security and improving farmers' i...
records.description: Villages in Ajloun Governorate are increasingly adopting organic farming as a pathway to achieving food security and improving farmers' income, supported by government and community initiatives. The Director of Agriculture in Ajloun, confirmed that the Directorate of Agriculture is implementing programs to enhance soil/water management and train farmers on organic techniques, viewing it as a sustainable choice amid environmental challenges. The President of the Farmers’ Union in Ajloun, noted that interest in organic farming has surged due to growing awareness of healthy products and better market opportunities, leading many farmers to transition due to lower long-term costs. Furthermore, the Rajib Valley Women’s Association has offered revolving loan programs to enable families and women to establish home-based organic farming projects, thus enhancing the local rural economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Civil Defense, launched the national campaign “Greening My Country” in a central eve...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Civil Defense, launched the national campaign “Greening My Country” in a central event in Jericho, simultaneously starting afforestation at 52 locations across the country's governorates. The campaign aims to plant 500,000 forest trees during the coming year to enhance the sustainability of natural resources, protect lands, and increase green spaces. The initiative emphasizes strengthening joint action and effective cooperation among all national institutions, including the Military Training Authority, to build capacity, ensure rapid emergency response in forested areas, and instill a culture of afforestation and environmental conservation.

records.title: Ebb, a water technology company, partnered with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), the government entity regulating the Kingdom's water sec...
records.description: Ebb, a water technology company, partnered with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), the government entity regulating the Kingdom's water sector, to decarbonize desalination and target megaton-level $CO_2$ removal within the next decade. This milestone project, initially deploying at SWA's research facility in Jubail, integrates Ebb’s innovative electrochemical system with existing desalination infrastructure to transform previously wasted desalination brine into valuable products like caustic soda and hydrochloric acid. This process not only improves freshwater recovery and plant efficiency but also creates a new industry by using the caustic soda to enhance seawater alkalinity, which kickstarts a natural process that permanently removes $CO_2$ from the atmosphere, directly supporting Vision 2030 objectives.

records.title: UNESCO organized the second consultative workshop on fisheries and aquaculture, with key participation from the Faculty of Marine Science...
records.description: UNESCO organized the second consultative workshop on fisheries and aquaculture, with key participation from the Faculty of Marine Sciences at Red Sea University, the Fisheries Research Center, the Fisheries Administration, and the Marine Environment Protection Authority. The Port Sudan Technical School’s fisheries department also participated to contribute to the proposed technical education curriculum. The workshop reaffirmed UNESCO’s commitment to developing technical education in the Red Sea and Kassala states to equip the workforce with necessary skills. The initiative was praised by the Ministry of Agriculture in the Red Sea State for supporting and empowering small-scale fishermen by enhancing their skills and enabling them to own fishing boats.

records.title: A closing workshop was held in Sana'a province to review the pilot project, “Farmer-Led Natural Regeneration,” implemented in Manakhah di...
records.description: A closing workshop was held in Sana'a province to review the pilot project, “Farmer-Led Natural Regeneration,” implemented in Manakhah district. Organized by Roya Amal International in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture and local authorities, the event highlighted the project's role in promoting sustainable agriculture, restoring degraded lands, and enhancing food security and livelihoods. The project's director noted that activities had been implemented across 10 villages, focusing on rehabilitating degraded environments, boosting biodiversity, and strengthening community resilience to climate change by training farmers on natural regeneration techniques and sustainable land use

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The New Urban Communities Authority (NUCA) approved a comprehensive package of urban-planning incentives to encourage real estate develop...
records.description: The New Urban Communities Authority (NUCA) approved a comprehensive package of urban-planning incentives to encourage real estate developers to adopt green and sustainable construction practices across Egypt’s new cities. These incentives apply to new developments, projects with less than 20% construction progress, and large-scale projects, and will be available until May 30, 2026. In a major policy shift, NUCA designated five new cities, including the New Administrative Capital, as "Green Cities" effective June 30, 2026, requiring developers there to obtain one of Egypt’s accredited certifications, such as the Pyramid Certificate. NUCA will also sign a cooperation protocol with the Housing and Building National Research Center (HBRC) to streamline certification and strengthen regulatory oversight.
records.institution: The Housing and Building National Research Center (HBRC)

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has begun cultivating the local eggplant hybrids "Nasr and Wissam...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has begun cultivating the local eggplant hybrids "Nasr and Wissam" at the Al-Burjasiya Research Station in Basra Governorate. This operation is part of the Ministry's efforts to promote reliance on local hybrids and enhance their development. The experiment is being conducted on sandy desert soil using well water to test the hybrids' ability to adapt and produce in harsh environments with limited water resources, thereby supporting the dissemination of this knowledge to other desert regions and developing hybrids with high production characteristics

records.title: The Jordanian LAN team in Amman analyzed the tomato and lemon food supply chains, revealing that while absolute prices fluctuate widely,...
records.description: The Jordanian LAN team in Amman analyzed the tomato and lemon food supply chains, revealing that while absolute prices fluctuate widely, the percentage mark-ups remain high, averaging around 300% from wholesale to retail for tomatoes and 200% for lemons. A subsequent workshop with stakeholders, including the Amman Central Market and the Ministry of Agriculture, identified key challenges: cost-adding inefficiencies like high product losses due to poor varieties and inadequate packaging, inefficient sales processes, and limited price transparency leading to market imbalance and reactive overproduction. To address this, potential interventions were identified, including short-term actions like establishing quality standards and improving market data access, and longer-term steps such as strengthening extension services, investing in cooled storage, and developing electronic auction systems.

records.title: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR), with support from Oman India Fertiliser Company (OMIFCO), launc...
records.description: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR), with support from Oman India Fertiliser Company (OMIFCO), launched a new Smart Vegetable Farms project adopting advanced Plant Factory technology to introduce a qualitative shift in the agricultural sector. This initiative relies on a highly controlled, closed ecosystem, or Indoor Vertical Farming, which precisely manages all growing elements to produce pesticide-free leafy vegetables year-round. The project is designed to encourage farmers, youth, and entrepreneurs to embrace modern agricultural technologies, offering measurable benefits like reduced water consumption and increased land-use efficiency, thereby reinforcing national food security, enhancing self-sufficiency, and aligning with Oman's strategy to modernize the sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Bani Na'im Agriculture and Veterinary Department of the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Land Research C...
records.description: The Bani Na'im Agriculture and Veterinary Department of the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, in partnership with the Land Research Center, conducted a field tour to follow up on the implementation of a water harvesting activity in Masafer Bani Na'im. The activity, which utilizes crescent basin and line techniques, targets 13 farmers across 60 dunams to enhance the utilization of rainwater and improve soil productivity. This initiative is part of the Water, Land and Agricultural Roads Investment Program and reflects the Ministry of Agriculture's efforts to enhance farmer resilience, ensure the sustainability of agricultural production, and promote comprehensive agricultural development in rural areas.

records.title: Under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, specifically the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, and as p...
records.description: Under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, specifically the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, and as part of the “Investing in the Future for Children and with Their Participation” project implemented by the Applied Research Institute – Jerusalem (ARIJ) in partnership with Save the Children, local wheat and barley seeds were distributed to farmers in the towns of Tammoun and Aqaba. This field activity is part of the Seed Bank program, which aims to support 25 farmers by distributing seeds and fertilizer sufficient to cultivate approximately 10 dunams per farmer.

records.title: The Ministry of Municipality of Qatar and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Oriental Republic of Uruguay signed a Memorandum of Unde...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality of Qatar and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Oriental Republic of Uruguay signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for cooperation in the fields of agriculture and food security, reflecting a commitment to strengthening bilateral relations and sustainable development. The agreement emphasizes the exchange of expertise, knowledge, and technology in various areas, including livestock and artificial insemination, feed production, the import/export of live animals, and the use of modern and smart agricultural technologies. This collaboration, which aligns with FAO agreements, seeks to implement joint training programs and expand agricultural markets, overseen by a joint working group to ensure stable and sustainable agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipality, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Oriental Republic of Uruguay

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: Under the patronage of Hafr Al-Batin Governor, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture office in the governorate launched the...
records.description: Under the patronage of Hafr Al-Batin Governor, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture office in the governorate launched the 2025 Agricultural and Animal Products Festival. The festival, which features broad participation from government and private entities, includes specialized seminars and guidance workshops. It showcases 45 booths for farmers, beekeepers, artisans, nurseries, and organic farms, alongside entertainment activities and a dedicated children’s stage.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Recent rainfall in Tunisia, particularly at the beginning of December 2025, has offered a positive sign for the country's water security,...
records.description: Recent rainfall in Tunisia, particularly at the beginning of December 2025, has offered a positive sign for the country's water security, which faces increasing water stress. According to the Directorate General of Dams and Major Hydraulic Structures at the Ministry of Agriculture, the dams in the North accumulated 51 million cubic meters in just eight days, contributing to a total influx of 200 million $m^3$ since autumn. Major dams like Sidi El Barrak and Sidi Salem have seen their reserves significantly increase, securing the supply of drinking water and potentially guaranteeing needs for agricultural irrigation. However, authorities emphasize that the situation remains fragile, necessitating a long-term sustainable strategy focused on modernizing hydraulic infrastructure, digitizing water management (in alignment with the climate adaptation plan developed in partnership with the FAO), and expanding the reuse of treated wastewater to ensure lasting resilience against climate challenges.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries, in coordination with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nat...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries, in coordination with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and with funding from the Green Climate Fund, launched the "National Adaptation Plan (NAP) and Food Security Week." This initiative is centered on the National Adaptation Plan, a strategic framework comprising 16 sectoral studies designed to safeguard Tunisia's water, soil, and forest resources while modernizing agricultural production and fishing. The program establishes a national digital platform for monitoring climate-resilient investments and provides decision-makers with a robust database to choose policies that protect vulnerable rural communities. By fostering public-private partnerships and social protection mechanisms, the Ministry of Agriculture and the FAO aim to ensure that agricultural systems remain flexible and secure, even as the nation works to finalize its Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) to meet global climate and food security targets.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.title: AgraME (Agra Middle East), the Middle East's longest-running agriculture, animal, and aquaculture exhibition, has strategically rebranded...
records.description: AgraME (Agra Middle East), the Middle East's longest-running agriculture, animal, and aquaculture exhibition, has strategically rebranded as GROWTECH. MIDDLE EAST to unify its services with GROWTECH. ANTALYA and GROWTECH. JAKARTA, creating a global platform for agricultural advancement. This integration amplifies the event's impact by combining its 17-year legacy and deep understanding of GCC market dynamics with GROWTECH. ANTALYA's expertise in greenhouse technologies, plant breeding, and sustainable farming innovations. The unified platform, which will hold its inaugural edition in Dubai in September 2026, will now offer a complete 360-degree view of agricultural technology, enhancing collaboration across the core pillars of the food production ecosystem: Agriculture, Animal Health, and Aquaculture.

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) inaugurated the first edition of the Biosecurity Forum to unify national efforts,...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) inaugurated the first edition of the Biosecurity Forum to unify national efforts, strengthen the biosecurity ecosystem, and ensure national preparedness for future biological risks. The forum emphasized the Cabinet-adopted National Biosecurity Framework 2023–2032 (Second Edition), which transitions the national approach from crisis response to proactive prevention based on the 'One Health' principle (integrating public health, animal health, and environmental systems). Discussions highlighted the critical role of national legislation, the utilization of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and advanced technologies for early detection and risk prediction, and the importance of digital modelling to enhance future readiness against potential biological threats.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI), through its Sharjah Training and Development Centre (STDC), concluded a 60-hour inte...
records.description: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI), through its Sharjah Training and Development Centre (STDC), concluded a 60-hour integrated training program called "Agricultural Workshops" in partnership with the Dibba Al Hisn Municipality. The program targeted agricultural technical personnel to strengthen the sector and advance sustainable food security by promoting sustainable farming practices. The specialized workshops covered key areas such as propagation techniques, red palm weevil control, core crop production, and smart fertilization and irrigation systems, aiming to enhance workforce capabilities and optimize agricultural operations management in accordance with global standards.
records.institution: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has begun planting the "Research 244" barley variety at the Al-Qa...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has begun planting the "Research 244" barley variety at the Al-Qaim Horticulture Station on an area of 30 dunams. This initiative is part of the National Program for the Multiplication and Processing of Fodder Seeds for the 2025-2026 agricultural season. The goal is to produce high-quality seeds to support national efforts to expand fodder crop production. The Ministry noted that the planting witnessed good germination rates, confirming the crop's readiness for subsequent growth stages.

records.title: The Veterinary Department, a division of the Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, is continuing its health inspection campaigns in the holy cit...
records.description: The Veterinary Department, a division of the Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, is continuing its health inspection campaigns in the holy city of Karbala and Salah al-Din Governorate to ensure the safety of red and white meat. The inspections, which involve monitoring local slaughterhouses and butcher shops, aim to provide the best veterinary services, enhance epidemiological surveillance, support domestic meat production, and limit the spread of infectious diseases.

records.title: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply fixed the non-subsidized selling price of barley for most livestock breeders and importing co...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply fixed the non-subsidized selling price of barley for most livestock breeders and importing companies at JD 245 per ton, while maintaining a subsidized price of JD 175 per ton for sheep breeders, based on Ministry of Agriculture records. Additionally, the subsidized price of bran for sheep breeders was kept at JD 77 per ton, compared to JD 157 per ton for other livestock types. This decision ensures price stability for key animal feeds and applies a fixed export fee of JD 1,450 for each vehicle loaded with local live sheep.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, within its National Agricultural Extension Program, organized a two-day training course on Good National Agr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, within its National Agricultural Extension Program, organized a two-day training course on Good National Agricultural Practices for agricultural extension agents from North, Akkar, and Mount Lebanon governorates. Organized in cooperation with the Lebanese Center for Agricultural Research and Studies (CREAL) and funded by the Dutch government, the course focused on the standards and procedures set by the Lebanese Standards Institution (LIBNOR). The training included a field visit to Deccache Green Line to expose agents to the latest technologies and electronic programs adopted during the GAP certification process.

records.title: The United Kingdom (UK) represents a strategic and demanding $21 billion market for Moroccan exporters due to its heavy reliance on fruit...
records.description: The United Kingdom (UK) represents a strategic and demanding $21 billion market for Moroccan exporters due to its heavy reliance on fruit and vegetable imports (only 15-17% of fruit needs are met domestically). This high dependence creates significant, solvent demand for premium and out-of-season produce, particularly avocados and berries, where Morocco has a comparative advantage and growing reputation, as noted by the Moroccan Avocado Association (MAVA). Accessing this market requires sophisticated technical and regulatory adaptation to meet stringent requirements from British supermarket chains, including consistent quality, strict adherence to delivery deadlines, and compliance with high standards for residue levels and traceability.

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The International Forum on Green Innovation and its Role in Achieving Sustainable Development in the Arab World commenced in Muscat, orga...
records.description: The International Forum on Green Innovation and its Role in Achieving Sustainable Development in the Arab World commenced in Muscat, organized by the Omani Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation in cooperation with the Federation of Arab Scientific Research Councils. The forum, attended by over 200 experts, aims to enhance Arab integration in green innovation by exchanging expertise and supporting national policies related to the environment, energy, smart agriculture, and entrepreneurship. Oman's hosting of the event underscores its commitment, aligning with Oman Vision 2040 toward balancing economic growth and environmental protection. Discussions focused on green innovation as a fundamental enabler for transitioning towards a circular economy and achieving carbon neutrality, specifically addressing the future of green innovation, practical solutions in renewable energy and clean technologies (like solar systems and waste bio-conversion), and the use of AI in environmental solutions.
records.institution: The Federation of Arab Scientific Research Councils

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Cypriot Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Environment signed a cooperation a...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Cypriot Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Environment signed a cooperation agreement to develop joint efforts in agriculture, innovation, and adaptation to climate change. The Palestinian Minister stressed that investing in agriculture is a national necessity to bolster farmer resilience, citing extensive damage to agricultural infrastructure in Gaza and attacks in the West Bank that have degraded soil and damaged irrigation systems. The Ministry is expanding its services through 43 new field offices and developing modern research programs, including the use of treated water, the cultivation of climate-resistant crops, and the development of local seeds.

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture launched the Olive Field Schools project in Salfit Governorate on Monday.
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture launched the Olive Field Schools project in Salfit Governorate on Monday. This initiative is being implemented as part of the “My Initiative” project / Olive component, in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP). The project will establish two schools—one in Farha for male farmers and one in Iskaka for female farmers—with the participation of 30 male and female farmers. The main goal is to enhance their technical capabilities and agricultural awareness of best practices related to olive production to improve quality and ensure the sustainability of this vital sector. The project is set to begin implementation at the start of 2026.

records.title: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) signed a SAR200 million contract with Arabian Agricultural Services Company (ARASCO) to establish a 40...
records.description: The Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) signed a SAR200 million contract with Arabian Agricultural Services Company (ARASCO) to establish a 40,000 square meter logistics center for storage and distribution at King Abdulaziz Port in Dammam. This initiative, which aligns with the National Transport and Logistics Strategy, aims to bolster food security in Saudi Arabia and enhance national supply chain efficiency. The investment will specifically increase the port’s capabilities in grain unloading and storage by constructing warehouses capable of handling up to 100,000 metric tons.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Tunisian Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy confirmed significant progress toward its goal of increasing the share of renewable e...
records.description: The Tunisian Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy confirmed significant progress toward its goal of increasing the share of renewable energy in its electricity mix to 35% by 2030. Under the concession scheme, the first 500 MW tender is nearing completion, with the flagship 100 MW Kairouan power plant 95% complete and expected to be operational by the end of 2025. The second 800 MW program has awarded three 100 MW projects to international developers, while Qair International also secured a separate 198 MW power plant in El Khobna. Additionally, the permitting system for small projects (less than 10 MW) is highly active, granting 186 new agreements covering 288 MW between the end of 2024 and mid-2025, a momentum reflected by Tunisia ranking among the top six solar panel importers in Africa.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy

records.title: The UAE has launched Ai.(d), a $1 billion initiative led by the Abu Dhabi Exports Office (Adex), the export financing arm of the Abu Dhab...
records.description: The UAE has launched Ai.(d), a $1 billion initiative led by the Abu Dhabi Exports Office (Adex), the export financing arm of the Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD), to advance digital infrastructure and improve lives across Africa. The platform aims to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a transformative tool for sustainable and inclusive growth, integrating AI-driven solutions in key development sectors such as education, agriculture, and digital infrastructure to advance the UN Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The initiative plans to establish Smart Resilient Future Zones (SRFZs), which will serve as AI-enabled corridors, and is underpinned by the Multilateral Innovation Fund (MIF), a blended-finance mechanism designed to reduce risks and finance AI-powered projects in coordination with African governments.

records.title: The UAE launched a major initiative, the AI Ecosystem for Global Agriculture Development, in collaboration with the Gates Foundation, bui...
records.description: The UAE launched a major initiative, the AI Ecosystem for Global Agriculture Development, in collaboration with the Gates Foundation, building on their $200 million fund announced at Cop28, to use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help millions of smallholder farmers adapt to climate change. The high-tech strategy is built upon four landmark projects, including the establishment of the CGIAR AI Hub in Abu Dhabi, hosted by ai71; the Institute of Agriculture and Artificial Intelligence at the Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI); AgriLLM, an open-source large language model developed by ai71; and Aim for Scale, based at NYU Abu Dhabi, which is successfully delivering AI-powered weather forecasting and digital advisory services to farmers.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: the Mara’ee 2025 Agriculture and Animal Production Show will open this December, offering one of the region’s largest platforms for agric...
records.description: the Mara’ee 2025 Agriculture and Animal Production Show will open this December, offering one of the region’s largest platforms for agriculture and livestock production. The event aims to strengthen national food-security efforts and support domestic farming and animal husbandry. It will feature local and international exhibitors across agricultural displays, livestock markets, a heritage village, a farmers’ market, and even a children’s play area. Through this initiative, the government underscores its commitment to advancing the agriculture sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the specialized staff of the Al-Wahda Research Station affiliated with the Department of Agricultura...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the specialized staff of the Al-Wahda Research Station affiliated with the Department of Agricultural Research, completed the rehabilitation of its lands in Baghdad in preparation for the 2025-2026 agricultural season. This effort, which included soil modification and leveling using specialized machinery, is part of a sustainable approach by the Department of Agricultural Research to achieve high success rates for strategic crops. The rehabilitation aims to prepare the station fields for the national wheat and barley programs, in line with the National Seed Council's recommendations, to ensure the availability of high-purity crops for the agricultural sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture confirmed an outbreak of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) in several livestock farms after samples tested positiv...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture confirmed an outbreak of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) in several livestock farms after samples tested positive at the Agricultural Scientific Research Authority's Animal Health Laboratory. Following the detection of a new FMD strain in surrounding countries, the Ministry formed an emergency committee and initiated comprehensive measures to limit the spread. These actions include collecting samples for epidemiological investigation, immediate vaccination of animals in affected vicinities, restricting animal movement between regions, and sending samples to WOAH and FAO reference laboratories to identify the strain and adjust the vaccination program.

records.title: The "Entrepreneurship Forum in Fifth Generation Agriculture" began in Muscat, jointly organized by the Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fis...
records.description: The "Entrepreneurship Forum in Fifth Generation Agriculture" began in Muscat, jointly organized by the Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Arab Organisation for Agricultural Development (AOAD). The five-day forum reviews fifth-generation technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), the Internet of Things (IoT), and drones, to empower entrepreneurs and build a smarter, more sustainable agricultural sector. The event, which includes an exhibition for drones and AI technologies and training programs, reflects Oman's commitment to enhancing agricultural innovation and establishing a smart and sustainable agricultural system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources signed an agreement with Future Cities Company “Tadum” for the operation of an...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources signed an agreement with Future Cities Company “Tadum” for the operation of an integrated technological system for tracking fishing boats. This strategic project aims to enhance the sustainability of fisheries resources and regulate the fishing sector by establishing a comprehensive national system for real-time monitoring of all artisanal fishing boats. The system, which relies on a coastal LoRaWAN network and satellite connectivity, transmits data on geographical location, speed, direction, and emergency alerts, enabling authorities to analyze sailing patterns, manage fishing efforts, and combat illegal fishing. Crucially, it also enhances maritime safety for fishermen by reducing risks and facilitating search and rescue operations through immediate data provision to the operations room.
records.institution: he Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Yemeni Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources' Fisheries Undersecretary stressed the Ministry's commitment to develo...
records.description: The Yemeni Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources' Fisheries Undersecretary stressed the Ministry's commitment to developing the fisheries sector, overcoming the effects of the blockade, and improving the quality of national fish products to open broader opportunities for Yemeni exports in regional and international markets. During a visit to fish processing and export facilities in Hodeida, the Undersecretary emphasized the Ministry's support for national companies and strengthening partnerships with the private sector. The al-Jazeera Marine Resources Company Ltd. highlighted challenges, primarily the ongoing blockade, which has made securing operational supplies and managing increased shipping costs difficult.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Jordan is launching the transformative National Water Conveyance project, the largest in its history, aiming to secure the country’s wate...
records.description: Jordan is launching the transformative National Water Conveyance project, the largest in its history, aiming to secure the country’s water future amidst mounting scarcity and climate pressures. This $3.5 billion project will produce 300 million cubic meters of desalinated seawater annually in Aqaba and transport it via a 438-kilometer pipeline to Amman, powered by a 281-megawatt solar energy plant. The Ministry of Water and Irrigation established a specialized national unit to oversee the project under a Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model, with Meridiam Suez as the preferred contractor. Despite challenges like high pumping costs and environmental risks from brine discharge, Jordan plans for gradual water delivery between 2027 and 2028, positioning the nation as a regional leader in water management.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation

records.title: The Agricultural Emergency Committee held a meeting with the agricultural engineers, veterinarians, and administrators recently accepted...
records.description: The Agricultural Emergency Committee held a meeting with the agricultural engineers, veterinarians, and administrators recently accepted into the employment program, in cooperation with the Palestinian Employment Fund, in Khan Younis Governorate. The meeting reviewed the assigned tasks and the work plan to be implemented, aiming to enhance services for farmers and raise the level of response to emergency needs. The Committee emphasized the important role these new staff will play in supporting the efforts of the Ministry of Agriculture, especially in light of the exceptional circumstances facing the agricultural sector in the southern governorates.
records.institution: The Agricultural Emergency Committee, the Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: Startups across the MENA region are accelerating growth, evidenced by new funding rounds and partnerships across key sectors, demonstrati...
records.description: Startups across the MENA region are accelerating growth, evidenced by new funding rounds and partnerships across key sectors, demonstrating strong investor confidence. Saudi Arabian agritech startup Nabt secured a $3.4 million seed extension (bringing total funding to $5 million), led by SHG Group, to expand its physical and digital infrastructure for fresh produce and develop services like its Online Auction and Intel platform, aligning with the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture's efforts. Additionally, Saudi cybersecurity company COGNNA closed a $9.2 million Series A round to accelerate the global expansion of its AI-driven Agentic SOC platform, while Dubai-based AI-native lunch subscription startup Funch raised $500,000 in a pre-seed round.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Dubai Municipality launched the fifth season of the Farmers' Souq at Quranic Park, an initiative supporting the local agriculture sector...
records.description: Dubai Municipality launched the fifth season of the Farmers' Souq at Quranic Park, an initiative supporting the local agriculture sector and providing a direct marketing channel for 41 Emirati farmers. The market, which runs every Saturday and Sunday until February 8, 2026, features locally grown fresh produce and new family-friendly attractions like the Plant Lab and Petting Zoo. The initiative reflects the Municipality's commitment to strengthening the local agriculture sector, promoting sustainable farming practices, and enhancing the community's support for local products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by the Director General of the Horticulture Department, signed a cooperation agreement with the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by the Director General of the Horticulture Department, signed a cooperation agreement with the British date palm development company DPD Limited on the sidelines of the Iraqi-British Business Council (IBBC) conference in Basra. This agreement aims to supply distinguished and rare date palm offshoots, enhance the development of modern propagation systems, and improve the quality of Iraqi dates. The cooperation is viewed as an important step in the Iraqi government's efforts to utilize modern technologies and international expertise to re-establish Iraq's leading global position in the date palm sector.

records.title: The Association of Agricultural Research Institutions in the Near East and North Africa (AARINENA), in cooperation with the Food and Agri...
records.description: The Association of Agricultural Research Institutions in the Near East and North Africa (AARINENA), in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO), convened its 16th General Conference in Amman to address mounting water scarcity challenges in the region, which is the world's most water-stressed. The conference stressed that digitalisation is the most promising solution for managing water resources in agriculture, given that the sector consumes about 85% of available freshwater. Experts highlighted that digital technologies, including remote sensing, precision irrigation, digital advisory services, and Artificial Intelligence (AI), are essential for improving water-use efficiency, enhancing climate resilience, and driving a qualitative shift in water management. The FAO affirmed that this focus aligns with its “Four Betters” strategic framework for achieving sustainable agricultural development.
records.institution: The Association of Agricultural Research Institutions in the Near East and North Africa (AARINENA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture launched a major national solidarity campaign, “20 kg of Potatoes Helps,” in cooperation with the Ministry of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture launched a major national solidarity campaign, “20 kg of Potatoes Helps,” in cooperation with the Ministry of Information and potato farmers' unions, to rescue farmers facing a crisis where over 40,000 tons of potatoes are currently stuck in cold storage. The Minister stressed that this initiative is a humanitarian message and a step toward reciprocating the farmer's loyalty, who acts as the cornerstone of food security despite multiple crises. The campaign is part of a comprehensive plan by the Ministry to regulate production, improve quality, expand contract farming, and implement a precise mechanism for importing table potatoes to ensure market stability and the sector's long-term sustainability.

records.title: Atlantic Gulf Company (AGCO), a Moroccan family-owned business specializing in high-quality fresh fruit and vegetable exports, focuses st...
records.description: Atlantic Gulf Company (AGCO), a Moroccan family-owned business specializing in high-quality fresh fruit and vegetable exports, focuses strategically on the Gulf market, which is characterized by strong purchasing power and high demand for premium products. Despite facing competition, particularly from Egypt which offers larger volumes and lower prices, AGCO has carved out a high-end niche by emphasizing consistent visual and taste quality, strict food safety standards, and controlled logistics with fast air shipments. The company notes that despite initial climate challenges this season, the quality of Moroccan soft fruit remains exceptional. AGCO's strategy for the Gulf market—which highly prizes large, firm, and well-packaged strawberries—is centered on quality investment, optimizing high air transport costs, and adapting packaging to specific consumer preferences, such as their introduction of the popular 1 kg box.
