records.title: The largest animal and aquatic feed factory in Oman, a RO 36 million project located in Khazaen Economic Zone, was inaugurated by the Min...
records.description: The largest animal and aquatic feed factory in Oman, a RO 36 million project located in Khazaen Economic Zone, was inaugurated by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. Operated by Oman Bio-Products, a subsidiary of Oman Flour Mills, the facility is one of the first in the region to embody the circular economy by using advanced technology to recycle green agricultural and biological by-products, and date residues into specialized, value-added feed. The initial phase has an annual capacity of 48,000 tonnes of animal feed and 15,000 tonnes of aquatic feed, significantly enhancing self-sufficiency, reducing reliance on imports, and strengthening Oman’s food security ecosystem.
records.institution: The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Hydroponics is gaining importance in Saudi Arabia's Qassim Region as a sustainable solution to boost crop productivity while reducing wat...
records.description: Hydroponics is gaining importance in Saudi Arabia's Qassim Region as a sustainable solution to boost crop productivity while reducing water consumption by up to 90% compared to traditional agriculture. This modern method, which involves growing crops in nutrient-rich water solutions and using systems like vertical farming, addresses critical challenges like food security, water scarcity, and soil degradation. Although initial costs are higher, the method provides high yields of pesticide-free, quality crops year-round. The Saudi government continues to support farmers with financing and guidance to develop these sustainable systems, aligning with Vision 2030’s goal of fostering innovative farming.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, is continuing intensive field programs to monitor and control the d...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, is continuing intensive field programs to monitor and control the dangerous red palm weevil in the governorates of Najaf, Karbala, and Babylon. The Director General of the Department conducted training tours, which included lectures and specialized courses for technical staff and farmers on the latest diagnostic techniques, trap setting methods, and the use of appropriate pesticides (both contact and systemic). These efforts aim to enhance the readiness and capabilities of the technical teams, including practical training on cleaning infected offshoots and field treatment, to protect palm groves and limit the pest's spread.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Agricultural Research Department/Al-Suwaira Research Station in Wasit Governorate, has begun imp...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Agricultural Research Department/Al-Suwaira Research Station in Wasit Governorate, has begun implementing its 2025-2026 agricultural plan by planting the strategic Ebaa 265 barley variety. The station is planting areas designated by the government program and additional areas to produce seed kernels as part of the department's program for propagating high-grade barley seeds. The Ministry highlighted that the station is also implementing research trials as part of its scientific work to contribute to the sustainable development of the agricultural sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources inaugurated the first phase of a new feed production plant in Khazaen Economic...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources inaugurated the first phase of a new feed production plant in Khazaen Economic City, owned by the Omani Bioproducts Company (a subsidiary of Oman Flour Mills), built at a cost of OMR36 million. The facility has an initial annual capacity of 48,000 tonnes of animal feed and 15,000 tonnes of aquatic feed, significantly boosting local supply and reducing import dependence. The plant aligns with Oman's bio-economy strategy by using advanced technology to convert recycled green agricultural residues and date waste into high-nutrition feed, which enhances food security and supports the sustainability of the livestock and aquaculture sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Tunisia has solidified its position as the world's 3rd largest exporter of olive oil, achieving 4.5 billion dinars in exports during the...
records.description: Tunisia has solidified its position as the world's 3rd largest exporter of olive oil, achieving 4.5 billion dinars in exports during the first eight months of 2025, which constituted 53% of the country's agri-food exports across 66 markets. To further consolidate this success, the Export Promotion Center (CEPEX), the National Oil Office (ONH), and other institutions validated an ambitious 2026 national program comprising over 30 actions. The plan focuses on diversifying exports to new priority targets like China, the United Kingdom, Latin America, and the Gulf countries, by emphasizing participation in international trade fairs, market exploration missions, and an advertising campaign to promote the "Made in Tunisia" label for high-quality, packaged oil.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al Wathba Honey Festival, organized by the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) alongside the Sheikh Mansour bin...
records.description: The Al Wathba Honey Festival, organized by the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) alongside the Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award, commenced its activities at the Sheikh Zayed Festival in Abu Dhabi. The festival brings together 42 local producers to showcase and market honey, pollen, and propolis, aiming to support local beekeepers and encourage the adoption of global best practices. For the first time, it features the Beekeepers Association in the UAE and highlights the country's role as the host for the 50th International Apicultural Congress, Apimondia, in Dubai in 2027. The event includes eight competitions with a total prize pool of AED622,000, where a specialized committee, in cooperation with the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council and ADAFSA, ensures samples meet rigorous national quality and safety standards.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation witnessed the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on scientific and...
records.description: The Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation witnessed the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on scientific and research cooperation between the Agricultural Research Center and the Regional Academy of Natural Resources Sciences of Sichuan Province (China). Under the agreement, the two sides will collaborate on developing advanced agricultural science and technology, exchange expertise on modern farming practices to improve production efficiency, and expand cooperation in food safety and environmental protection. The partnership is crucial for strengthening Egypt’s food security by focusing on joint research, specialized training, and developing smart technologies that enhance resource efficiency and sustainability in the face of climate change and water scarcity.

records.title: Cairo 3A Holding has reportedly signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with International Venture Investment (IVI) Holding Limited in...
records.description: Cairo 3A Holding has reportedly signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with International Venture Investment (IVI) Holding Limited in Baghdad to develop an integrated poultry project in Iraq. This partnership leverages Cairo 3A's experience across the poultry value chain (broiler production, feed manufacturing, food processing) with IVI Holding's local presence and investment capabilities. The project, which involves a first phase investment of $160 million over five years, is aimed at supporting Iraq's efforts to increase its domestic poultry production, meet international standards, create new jobs, and strengthen food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has begun the manual sowing of the strategic barley crop, Ebaa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has begun the manual sowing of the strategic barley crop, Ebaa 99 (line-spiked), at the Abu Ghraib Research Station. This activity is part of the 2025-2026 winter agricultural plan and the program to propagate high-grade barley seeds. The Ministry aims to increase productivity and preserve local varieties of strategic crops through the research and scientific work of the Agricultural Research Department, despite the challenges posed by water scarcity.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Horticulture Department announced the completion of the final stages of preparing the greenhouse and land d...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Horticulture Department announced the completion of the final stages of preparing the greenhouse and land designated for receiving tissue culture date palm offshoots. This preparation is a key component of the National Program for the Rehabilitation and Development of Date Palms and the Propagation of Tissue Culture Offshoots in Iraq. By adhering to approved scientific and technical standards, the Ministry aims to provide an ideal environment for successful offshoot cultivation, increase production rates, and expand the propagation of distinguished varieties with high economic viability.

records.title: Asyad Group unveiled a series of forward-looking projects during the Oman Green Hydrogen Summit 2025, organized under the auspices of the...
records.description: Asyad Group unveiled a series of forward-looking projects during the Oman Green Hydrogen Summit 2025, organized under the auspices of the Ministry of Energy and Minerals and in partnership with Hydrom. These projects are designed to enhance Oman’s national logistics infrastructure for the green hydrogen economy. Key initiatives include developing an AI-driven digital platform for enhanced transport efficiency, advancing digital simulation solutions for routing wind-turbine components, and establishing smart warehouses equipped with IoT systems. Asyad is also upgrading Oman’s ports to handle, store, and export low-carbon fuels like green ammonia and liquid hydrogen, and developing green-fuel bunkering corridors, solidifying Oman’s position as a provider of advanced clean-fuel solutions.

records.title: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced a crucial, mandatory requirement for Omani companies exporting agr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced a crucial, mandatory requirement for Omani companies exporting agricultural, livestock, and water products, including poultry, to the Saudi Arabian market. These companies must now adhere to the mechanism for obtaining the Saudi Good Agricultural Practices (Saudi GAP) certificate. To secure the certificate, firms must pass an inspection by an accredited documentation body, which verifies the application of Saudi GAP standards on the farm of origin. This new measure, offered free of charge through the ‘NAAMA’ platform, aims to ensure that imported Omani products meet the high quality and safety benchmarks required by the Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the closing ceremony of the project “Quinoa Cultivation for Climate-Resilient Agriculture in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the closing ceremony of the project “Quinoa Cultivation for Climate-Resilient Agriculture in Palestine.” The project, a pioneering experiment to introduce quinoa to Palestinian lands, was led by Al-Quds Open University in partnership with the Environmental Quality Authority and supported by the Global Environment Facility – Small Grants Programme/UNDP. The Ministry stressed that the current climate reality, highlighted by unprecedented challenges during the 2024 agricultural season, requires the sector to move toward alternative, climate-resilient crops like quinoa. The project's success supports the development of a smart and sustainable agricultural system capable of adapting to accelerating climate challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, confirmed the signing of the sixth batch of investment support agreements within the Multi-Donor Agribusines...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, confirmed the signing of the sixth batch of investment support agreements within the Multi-Donor Agribusiness Programme (MAP II). This batch included 30 agreements across nine governorates, with total investments amounting to about 10.6 million shekels (supported at a 40% rate). The intervention is implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), with financial support from the governments of Denmark, Switzerland, Spain, and the European Union. The projects cover diverse sectors, including plant and animal production, food processing, solar energy systems, hydroponics, cooling and packaging units, fish farms, and organic fertilizer units, all aimed at boosting the local economy, increasing productivity, and enhancing farmers' resilience and sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through the technical teams of the General Directorate of Plant Protection and Agricultural Quar...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through the technical teams of the General Directorate of Plant Protection and Agricultural Quarantine and the Tulkarm Agriculture Directorate, has begun the process of inspecting imported potato seed shipments for the 2025/2026 agricultural season. Specialized teams are inspecting the shipments upon arrival at the Taybeh crossing in Tulkarm Governorate. The procedures ensure that the seeds conform to approved specifications, are free of pests and diseases, and that the official documents are scrutinized. The Ministry affirms that these measures are critical for protecting the agricultural sector and enhancing the quality of local production by ensuring the introduction of sound and safe seeds.

records.title: The Ministry of Animal Resources and Fisheries, led by the Minister, announced 40 investment projects under the strategic plan of the Gov...
records.description: The Ministry of Animal Resources and Fisheries, led by the Minister, announced 40 investment projects under the strategic plan of the Government of Hope to develop the animal resources and fisheries sector. The strategic plan includes defining a clear five-year timeline, conducting a livestock census (currently estimated at 140 million heads), and implementing projects over the next three years. These projects focus on establishing animal production cities across all states to achieve self-sufficiency and reduce prices, along with developing a veterinary vaccine factory and utilizing the Red Sea coastline for fish farming. The plan also includes establishing three business councils with Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, and Oman, and launching a smart application for investors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Animal Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab, in cooperation with the Directorate of Water Resources and the World...
records.description: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab, in cooperation with the Directorate of Water Resources and the World Food Programme (WFP), has launched a project to remove the invasive water hyacinth from two sites in the Al-Ghab Plain. This initiative aims to improve the environmental situation and reduce the significant damage caused by the plant, which clogs irrigation canals, exacerbates water loss, and threatens biodiversity. The project is crucial for ensuring effective water flow, especially with the approach of the winter planting season, and supports the Authority's ongoing efforts to preserve water resources for the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The General Authority for the Management and Development of Al-Ghab

records.title: The Tunisian Institute for Strategic Studies (ITES) study calls for overcoming training, infrastructure, and funding gaps to fully integr...
records.description: The Tunisian Institute for Strategic Studies (ITES) study calls for overcoming training, infrastructure, and funding gaps to fully integrate agricultural Artificial Intelligence (AI), aligning with the 2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Supported by FAO partnerships and regional forums, pilot projects demonstrate AI's effectiveness in the ecological transition against soil degradation. The ITES matrix prioritizes the urgency of adopting AI to transform challenges into opportunities, securing agricultural incomes, and forging an innovative agriculture vital for growth and national resilience.
records.institution: The Tunisian Institute for Strategic Studies (ITES

records.title: Al Khayyat Investments (AKI) announced a partnership via a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with CJ Group's food division, CJ Foods, to...
records.description: Al Khayyat Investments (AKI) announced a partnership via a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with CJ Group's food division, CJ Foods, to expand the availability of Korean food products across the Middle East, particularly in the UAE and Saudi Arabia. This collaboration will leverage AKI's regional distribution network and CJ Foods' expertise to meet the increasing demand for K-Food, driven by the growing popularity of Korean culture. The companies will also explore opportunities for joint product development and the possibility of local manufacturing within the UAE, supporting the country's initiatives for food security and economic diversification.

records.title: Egg prices in Egypt have fallen sharply, with some markets reporting a decline of nearly 35%, due to a surge in domestic egg production t...
records.description: Egg prices in Egypt have fallen sharply, with some markets reporting a decline of nearly 35%, due to a surge in domestic egg production that has pushed annual output to approximately 16 billion, a 25% increase over the previous cycle. This oversupply from new farms and the addition of over 1.6 million new chickens has created a supply glut that local demand cannot fully absorb, resulting in prices often sold below the cost of production. The fluctuations between soaring chicken prices and plummeting egg costs highlight the high volatility in the poultry market and the severe financial pressure on farmers facing sustained high operational costs.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The Egyptian Cabinet approved a draft presidential decree for Egypt to join the Green Middle East initiative, aimed at strengthening envi...
records.description: The Egyptian Cabinet approved a draft presidential decree for Egypt to join the Green Middle East initiative, aimed at strengthening environmental protection and climate-change mitigation across the region. The initiative focuses on land restoration, preserving vegetation cover, and applying nature-based solutions to mitigate climate impacts. Simultaneously, the Cabinet approved Egypt's joining the European Union's Horizon Europe research and innovation program as a partner country. This partnership will grant Egyptian researchers equal access to EU research resources and funding, supporting job creation, industrial competitiveness, and advancing the UN Sustainable Development Goals through international cooperation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture confirmed that it has successfully obtained an official governmental decision to ban the entry of imported ta...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture confirmed that it has successfully obtained an official governmental decision to ban the entry of imported table eggs into local markets. This decisive protective measure is a key pillar of the Ministry's comprehensive plan designed to provide full support to local poultry egg producers. By implementing this ban, the Ministry aims to protect the national product from foreign competition, address domestic market saturation, and ensure the economic viability of local poultry farms, thereby reinforcing the nation's efforts toward food security and self-sufficiency in this vital protein source

records.title: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) announced that it will begin integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into the management of agricultur...
records.description: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) announced that it will begin integrating artificial intelligence (AI) into the management of agricultural land at the beginning of 2026 to support water resource development and sustainable agriculture. The JVA plans to implement the new AI-driven system on 100,000 dunums of land in Northern Shouneh, enabling farmers to access real-time data on water needs, evaporation rates, and suitable crops. The JVA, which oversees the 390,000 dunums of agricultural land in the valley, is committed to maximizing the economic value of water by prioritizing high-yield crops like Medjool dates and strengthening water harvesting projects across the Kingdom’s 16 major dams and 630 desert ponds.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests officially launched the "IBTIKAR" project in Ra...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests officially launched the "IBTIKAR" project in Rabat, an initiative within the "Al Ard Al Khadraa – Green Land" program aimed at supporting the sustainable transformation of the agricultural and forestry sectors. Funded by the European Union to the tune of 43 million dirhams over three and a half years, the project seeks to reposition training, applied research, and innovation as essential levers for resilience in the face of climate change. It will adapt curricula, strengthen the skills of future engineers, establish competitive financing mechanisms for agroecology, and create a digital platform to disseminate best practices, aligning fully with the Generation Green and Forests strategies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: The Oman AgroFood, the 7th International Trade Exhibition for Agriculture, Food and Fisheries, was launched at the Oman Convention and Ex...
records.description: The Oman AgroFood, the 7th International Trade Exhibition for Agriculture, Food and Fisheries, was launched at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. The three-day event serves as a platform for knowledge exchange and the promotion of investment opportunities, supporting the Sultanate's vision for transformative and sustainable growth. The exhibition highlights government initiatives such as supporting SMEs in local medicinal and aromatic plants, introducing water- and fertilizer-efficient technologies like soilless cultivation and aquaponics, and implementing renewable energy solutions (solar power) in net house operations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The SOHAR Port and Freezone is exploring the potential development of naturally occurring (white) hydrogen in the Wilayat of Suhar throug...
records.description: The SOHAR Port and Freezone is exploring the potential development of naturally occurring (white) hydrogen in the Wilayat of Suhar through collaboration with Swiss specialist HYNAT SA, according to CEO. Reserves are confirmed, and the next stage is extraction testing to assess feasibility, which could provide a direct, low-carbon fuel source for SOHAR's industries. This effort is complementary to SOHAR’s commitment to green hydrogen, where it aims to be a manufacturing hub. The port's strategy includes finalizing an investment case to install 80–100 MW of grid-connected electrolysers to supply continuous hydrogen to high-demand industries and has established a partnership with a Swiss consortium to explore a green corridor between Oman and Switzerland.

records.title: Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Statistics released its 2024 Agricultural Statistics Bulletin, reporting that date production reache...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's General Authority for Statistics released its 2024 Agricultural Statistics Bulletin, reporting that date production reached approximately 1.923 million tons, a 1% increase over 2023, from over 37.6 million date palm trees. Open field vegetable production saw an 8.4% increase to 2,745,000 tons, led by potatoes and watermelons. Notably, greenhouse vegetable output reached 797 tons (a 10.6% increase), with tomatoes and cucumbers as the leading crops, reflecting the continued expansion of controlled environment cultivation. Overall, agricultural exports totaled 506,000 tons, up 13% year on year, with edible fruits and nuts accounting for 72.1% of the total volume.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development, and Fisheries has introduced a comprehensive price-regulation strategy for animal feed.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development, and Fisheries has introduced a comprehensive price-regulation strategy for animal feed. To combat illicit speculation and ensure continuous supply, the Cereal and Pulses Cooperatives (CCLS) will now market barley year-round at a competitive price of 3,900 DA per quintal, while maintaining a deeply subsidized rate of 2,500 DA per quintal specifically for breeding females to preserve the national herd. Complementing this, the National Livestock Feed Office (ONAB) is offering balanced feed based on maize and soy at regulated prices—3,150 DA for sheep and 3,300 DA for fattening cattle—while mill-sourced bran has been capped at 1,800 DA per quintal. This institutional framework, developed in coordination with the National Chamber of Agriculture (CNA) and the National Union of Algerian Farmers (UNPA), aims to strengthen national food security by making high-quality, affordable feed a permanent fixture for all livestock farmers.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: Egypt's Ministry of Agriculture announced that the country's agricultural exports have increased to 8.5 million tons so far this year, re...
records.description: Egypt's Ministry of Agriculture announced that the country's agricultural exports have increased to 8.5 million tons so far this year, representing a rise of nearly 700,000 tons compared to the previous year. Citrus fruits remained the top export with shipments approaching 2 million tons, followed by fresh potatoes (1.3 million tons) and sweet potatoes (310,000 tons). The Ministry praised the coordinated efforts across the supply chain, highlighting the crucial role of the Central Administration of Plant Quarantine and reference laboratories in ensuring the safety of exported produce and supporting continued growth in the sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture launched a new electronic platform for the Agricultural Lands Department to improve public services and...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture launched a new electronic platform for the Agricultural Lands Department to improve public services and achieve digital transformation. The platform provides citizens with an efficient electronic channel to submit and track their applications related to agricultural land management. This initiative, overseen by the Director General, aims to expedite transactions, reduce bureaucracy, and enhance transparency and governance by automating procedures and moving away from paper-based processing.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, is intensifying its field campaign to curb the spread of the red pa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, is intensifying its field campaign to curb the spread of the red palm weevil (RPW) in the Abu Ghraib district. A technical team conducted inspection tours and provided technical guidance and training to orchard owners on the pest's risks, transmission methods, and necessary preventive and treatment measures. The Ministry affirmed its commitment to continue technical and field efforts, including implementing treatment procedures in infested orchards, to protect palm orchards and limit the spread of the pest.

records.title: The Lebanese avocado season has begun on a high note, with the industry expecting a recovery after two seasons severely affected by regio...
records.description: The Lebanese avocado season has begun on a high note, with the industry expecting a recovery after two seasons severely affected by regional conflict. The sector is intentionally shifting toward the highly demanded Hass and Lamb Hass varieties, which now represent most orchards and show an estimated 15–20% increase in production compared to last year. This season's crop boasts excellent dry matter, oil content, and balanced sizing, strengthening Lebanon's position with GCC and European buyers. Furthermore, logistical operations are more manageable this season, with more stable air freight and smoother documentation flow, enabling exporters like Fadel Trading to prioritize speed, temperature management, and quality preservation to meet the solid international demand for their premium-grade fruit.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Akkar Agricultural Department and the Bireh Agricultural Center, organized a specialized seminar...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Akkar Agricultural Department and the Bireh Agricultural Center, organized a specialized seminar on the scientific and sound principles of fruit tree pruning as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. The seminar focused on modern pruning techniques and their importance in increasing productivity, improving fruit quality, and enhancing tree health and climatic adaptability. To support farmers in adopting these best practices, the American organization SEAL presented a gift of a battery-operated shears and saw during the event. The Ministry affirmed that these extension activities are a fundamental pillar for developing farmers' skills and enhancing the sustainability of the agricultural sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty informed citizens that, as part of the 2025–2026 vegetable campaign, significant quantit...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty informed citizens that, as part of the 2025–2026 vegetable campaign, significant quantities of chemically treated potato seeds have been sent to various states for distribution to farmers. The Ministry issued a strong warning that these seeds are intended for agricultural use only and are not suitable for human or animal consumption. Citizens are urged to report any instances of selling or trading these seeds outside of official channels.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: Moroccan exports of fresh sweetcorn to Germany reached a new milestone in the first nine months of 2025, with shipments exceeding 2,000 t...
records.description: Moroccan exports of fresh sweetcorn to Germany reached a new milestone in the first nine months of 2025, with shipments exceeding 2,000 tonnes worth approximately 42 million dirhams. This represents an 18% increase compared to 2024 and double the volume recorded in 2023, according to EastFruit. For the first time, Germany is now among the top three Moroccan markets for sweetcorn, surpassing the Netherlands, with Morocco's market share in Germany rising to more than 30% in the first nine months of the year.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests and the Chinese Ministry of Water Resources met...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests and the Chinese Ministry of Water Resources met on the sidelines of the 19th World Water Congress to emphasize their shared commitment to enhancing water resources for economic stability and sustainable development. The two parties agreed to consolidate the exchange of expertise and technologies in irrigation, water management, and desalination. Morocco, which is integrated into the Chinese “Belt and Road” initiative, aims to particularly benefit from Chinese expertise in drip irrigation technologies, water filtration, and inter-basin water transfer, as well as cooperation in agronomic research and agricultural modernization.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: An acoustics-based system trained with AI is emerging as a new line of defense for Gulf date palm farms against the destructive red palm...
records.description: An acoustics-based system trained with AI is emerging as a new line of defense for Gulf date palm farms against the destructive red palm weevil (RPW), which currently causes losses exceeding $400 million in Saudi Arabia alone. This technology, repurposed by researchers at Kaust (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology), uses extremely thin fiber cables wrapped around palm trees combined with an AI machine learning method to filter background noise and detect the faint sounds of feeding insect larvae, costing only about $0.50 per tree per year for monitoring. The World Economic Forum’s Centre for the Fourth Industrial Revolution in Saudi Arabia is collaborating with the Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water & Agriculture to implement technology-based solutions, while the UAE launched the International Consortium for Red Palm Weevil Control with partners like the Gates Foundation and ICARDA to scale these innovations.
records.institution: Kaust (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)

records.title: Tanmiah Food Company has entered into a cooperation agreement with Big Idea Ventures, a global investment firm, to jointly pursue project...
records.description: Tanmiah Food Company has entered into a cooperation agreement with Big Idea Ventures, a global investment firm, to jointly pursue projects supporting Saudi Arabia’s food security goals. The arrangement creates a framework for both companies to evaluate equity stakes in US red meat producers and study opportunities in upstream assets such as feedlots and related infrastructure to secure reliable red meat supplies. A second key focus is developing a local agricultural system to grow alternative feed ingredients, which aims to cut the country’s exposure to external feed markets and support cost-efficient poultry and dairy operations.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is continuing to implement the organic fertilizer preparation and mushroom cultivation project in Al-Muthanna...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is continuing to implement the organic fertilizer preparation and mushroom cultivation project in Al-Muthanna Governorate, under the supervision of its Planning and Follow-up Department and the Organic Agriculture Section of the Plant Protection Department. The project aims to convert plant and animal waste into high-quality organic fertilizers for use in mushroom cultivation and to support the Ministry's strategy for sustainable agriculture. This initiative, implemented in cooperation with the Muthanna Agriculture Directorate and international organizations, seeks to improve production, reduce water consumption, and enhance farmers' incomes.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, received Algeria’s Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries f...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, received Algeria’s Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries for talks on strengthening bilateral cooperation. The meeting focused on exchanging expertise in agriculture, marine fishing, and rural development. Experts from both sides outlined specific potential areas for joint investment, including desert soil management, precision agriculture, date cultivation, tropical fruits, and horticultural development. Both countries agreed on the need for continued coordination in research and technical programs to support sustainable food security and the development of vital sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture held a specialized workshop on water allocation in the agricultural sector in the Al-Badhan Basin, within the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture held a specialized workshop on water allocation in the agricultural sector in the Al-Badhan Basin, within the framework of the Water Scarcity Initiative (WSI) Regional Support Program. This program is funded by the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (SIDA) and implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and the Water Authority. The workshop reviewed technical, institutional, and socio-economic studies and integrated water accounting, relying on remote sensing data from the WaPOR platform. The ultimate goal is to propose short- and long-term scenarios to improve water allocation, enhance water use efficiency, and increase productivity to ensure sustainable water and food security in the targeted region.

records.title: The agricultural development commission in Zaghouan, Tunisia, recently released 5,500 ladybugs to combat the cactus mealybug.
records.description: The agricultural development commission in Zaghouan, Tunisia, recently released 5,500 ladybugs to combat the cactus mealybug. This biological control operation, which utilized ladybugs available at the citrus technical center, was carried out across 64 square kilometers in areas like Nadhour, Saouaf, and Zriba, where the prickly pear crops had been infested. The total area cultivated with prickly pears in the region amounts to 2,700 hectares. The commission is urging producers to join this biological control effort to protect the affected crops.
records.institution: The agricultural development commission in Zaghouan

records.title: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture, in partnership with the National Initiative for Agricultural Development (NIAD) a...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture, in partnership with the National Initiative for Agricultural Development (NIAD) and with support from stc Bahrain and Gulf Petrochemical Industries Company (GPIC), officially opened the 2025–2026 season of the Farmers’ Market at the Budaiya Botanical Garden. The market runs until February 14, 2026, featuring 33 Bahraini farmers offering fresh produce, alongside agricultural companies, productive families, and artisans. The initiative is praised as a national model for supporting local farmers, enhancing the competitiveness of local products, and strengthening food security and sustainable agricultural development under royal directives.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: The Al Saeed Multi Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Bani Sa'd District, Al Mahwit Governorate, Yemen, implemented various...
records.description: The Al Saeed Multi Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Bani Sa'd District, Al Mahwit Governorate, Yemen, implemented various field activities to reclaim damaged and neglected agricultural lands. The work, supported by the Central Emergency Development Interventions Unit, included surveying and reclaiming an area estimated at 10,500 square meters and removing approximately 3,500 cubic meters of flood debris. These interventions aim to facilitate farming operations, improve water flow, and enable farmers to resume agricultural activity next season, ultimately enhancing food security and achieving self-sufficiency in the district.
records.institution: The Al Saeed Multi Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture witnessed the signing of 12 agreements between the National Center for Palms and...
records.description: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture witnessed the signing of 12 agreements between the National Center for Palms and Dates and several public- and private-sector entities. These agreements are intended to support the development of palm and date processing industries by enhancing public-private partnerships. The Minister also honored the winners of the fourth edition of the International Award of the National Center for Palms and Dates, which aims to advance modern technologies, encourage innovation, and reinforce the Kingdom’s position as the world's largest exporter of dates.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Syria is actively stepping up efforts to strengthen its waste management and clean energy capabilities through high-level talks with the...
records.description: Syria is actively stepping up efforts to strengthen its waste management and clean energy capabilities through high-level talks with the UAE's BEEAH Group, a regional sustainability leader with operations across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Egypt. The Syria Investment Authority, led by Talal Al-Hilali, met with the BEEAH delegation in Damascus to discuss potential cooperation in waste-to-energy models, integrated waste management systems, and recycling technologies.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries confirmed a decline of approximately 20% in the national cattle herd, attribut...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries confirmed a decline of approximately 20% in the national cattle herd, attributing the crisis to successive drought seasons and rising global drilling prices. To address this, the Ministry has adopted several measures, including the creation of the National Drilling Office, fixing prices for imported drilling raw materials by the Ministry of Trade and Export Development, and organizing livestock protection efforts. Additionally, the National Oil Office has been tasked with maintaining a strategic stock of 100,000 to 150,000 tonnes of olive oil by offering competitive prices. Finally, the Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) secured accreditation from the Green Climate Fund to mobilize subsidies for climate change adaptation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Al Rostamani Group inaugurated three state-of-the-art agricultural facilities at the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (...
records.description: The Al Rostamani Group inaugurated three state-of-the-art agricultural facilities at the International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) headquarters in Dubai, marking the completion of a multi-year partnership fully funded by the Group. The ceremony was attended by the UAE Minister of Climate Change and Environment. The new facilities—a Training and Knowledge Transfer Building, a Plant Tissue Culture Laboratory, and an Integrated Agri-Aquaculture System—significantly enhance the UAE’s agricultural research landscape. These facilities are designed to advance sustainable agriculture, scientific research, and capacity development, supporting national capabilities in climate-smart agriculture, water-efficient production, and the nation’s vision for environmental sustainability and food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, specifically the Agricultural Business Incubators Department and the Agricultural Extension and Training Dep...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, specifically the Agricultural Business Incubators Department and the Agricultural Extension and Training Department, participated in conducting an international training course on smart and protected agriculture in arid lands. The training, which targeted young agricultural engineers from African Union countries, was implemented through cooperation between the League of Arab States and the African Union, under the direct supervision of the Iraqi Ministry of Planning and the Ministry of Agriculture. This initiative reinforces the Ministry's commitment to exchanging expertise and training young people in the latest agricultural technologies.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture organized a three-day specialized training course for trainers at the Al-Fanar Agricultural Technica...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture organized a three-day specialized training course for trainers at the Al-Fanar Agricultural Technical School as part of the “Contributing to Food Security for People Living in Lebanon” project. This initiative, funded by the European Union and supported by the World Food Programme (WFP) and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), was implemented in partnership with CARE International.

records.title: The recent Duqm Economic Forum outlined a "Green Blueprint" for transforming Al Duqm into a green manufacturing hub, leveraging its vast...
records.description: The recent Duqm Economic Forum outlined a "Green Blueprint" for transforming Al Duqm into a green manufacturing hub, leveraging its vast renewable energy potential and strategic position in the green-hydrogen value chain. Speakers from Asyad Group emphasized that large-scale green-hydrogen projects are creating a strong pipeline for sectors like green steel. be'ah highlighted that strong policy frameworks will establish the circular economy as a core business model, while the World Bank Group praised Al Duqm's ecosystem-based approach that clusters industries and resources. This transition is supported by Oman’s success in mobilizing green finance, including a $1 billion Sovereign Green Sukuk.

records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) concluded its third international virtual workshop f...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) concluded its third international virtual workshop focused on advancing Saudi Arabia’s agricultural sector through smart and innovative solutions. Held under the patronage of the Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the event attracted over 6,000 participants and featured 16 speakers from eight countries. The workshop supported the national agricultural research and innovation ecosystem by discussing global trends in smart agriculture, remote sensing, and precision farming to enhance production efficiency and resource sustainability.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Emirates Rawabi PSC, one of the UAE’s leading integrated agribusiness groups, has formed a strategic partnership with ReFarm Global Inves...
records.description: Emirates Rawabi PSC, one of the UAE’s leading integrated agribusiness groups, has formed a strategic partnership with ReFarm Global Investments LLC, a pioneer in regenerative and circular sustainability technologies. This collaboration aims to revolutionize the UAE's agricultural and food production systems by driving a new model of circular agribusiness. They will implement cost-efficient, carbon-conscious solutions to strengthen food security, enhance soil health, and drastically reduce water use, aligning with the UAE’s long-term vision for sustainable growth and urban greening, particularly in Dubai.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Hazardous Materials Management Centre and the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) signed a Memorandum...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Hazardous Materials Management Centre and the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to establish a comprehensive framework for cooperation in the handling of hazardous materials within the agricultural sector. The agreement supports the safe and responsible management of these materials to reinforce the highest standards of environmental sustainability and public safety in Abu Dhabi. This strategic partnership aims to enhance the business and investment environment by streamlining regulatory procedures, improving operational efficiency for farmers and producers, and supporting Abu Dhabi's position as a leading destination for agricultural and food innovation.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The University of Boumerdès in Algeria is actively supporting and modernizing the country's beekeeping sector through the MEDIBEES projec...
records.description: The University of Boumerdès in Algeria is actively supporting and modernizing the country's beekeeping sector through the MEDIBEES project, led by Professor Noureddine Adjlane. This project, along with complementary initiatives like PRFU and PRIMA, aims to strengthen beekeeping by disseminating up-to-date scientific knowledge and fostering collaboration between researchers and beekeepers. Activities include practical workshops on bee diseases, apiary management, and nutrition, as well as training on honey, pollen, and propolis to improve product quality and traceability. This integrated approach helps build colony resilience, combat diseases, and sustainably improve beekeeping productivity, ultimately supporting food security and biodiversity conservation.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) in Jordan, in partnership with the Spanish Agency for International Dev...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) in Jordan, in partnership with the Spanish Agency for International Development Cooperation (AECID), marked the conclusion of the project, “Enhancing food security through adaptation to climate change and water scarcity in Maan and Karak Governorates. The project’s core objective was to significantly improve the food security and livelihoods of vulnerable rural communities while contributing to vital water conservation through sustainable management.

records.description: The Moroccan citrus industry is launching its first National Citrus Fair in Sidi Kacem, under the theme "The Citrus Industry Facing the Challenge of Sustainable Water Resource Management." This ambitious event is organized by the Gharb Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVAG), in partnership with the Moroccan Interprofessional Federation of Citrus (Maroc Citrus), and under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests.
records.institution: The Gharb Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVAG)

records.title: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that local olive production in the Kingdom has surged past 351,000 tons.
records.description: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that local olive production in the Kingdom has surged past 351,000 tons. This achievement, driven by the expansion of cultivated areas and the adoption of modern farming technologies, has increased the total number of olive trees to nearly 21.5 million, with over 18 million fruit-bearing trees. This growth aligns with the National Agriculture Strategy and Vision 2030 by supporting sustainable economic and social development and enhancing food security. The Al-Jouf Region remains the most important center, leading the Kingdom with a production of 290,000 tons.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Tunisia's livestock sector is facing a severe agricultural crisis, confirmed by the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisherie...
records.description: Tunisia's livestock sector is facing a severe agricultural crisis, confirmed by the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, which reported a decline of nearly 20% in the national cattle herd by 2025. This contraction stems from multiple structural factors, including successive droughts that reduce pastureland, a continuous surge in production costs (especially for imported fodder), and low state-controlled milk prices that fail to compensate farmers. The crisis threatens the national dairy sector, increases reliance on imports of milk powder and meat, and undermines national food sovereignty. In response, the Ministry of Agriculture has announced emergency measures such as direct financial support for small farmers, livestock restocking programs, and efforts to strengthen water and forage resource management, though these require integration into an ambitious, long-term structural reform strategy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Emirates Biotech unveiled Embio, its new line of UAE-produced PolyLactic Acid (PLA) biopolymers, positioning the company as one of the Mi...
records.description: Emirates Biotech unveiled Embio, its new line of UAE-produced PolyLactic Acid (PLA) biopolymers, positioning the company as one of the Middle East’s emerging suppliers of bioplastics. The PLA biopolymers offer a lower carbon footprint than conventional plastics, are recyclable, and industrially compostable. By stocking PLA locally, Emirates Biotech will eliminate long lead times, offering faster delivery and lower minimum order quantities for regional customers. This launch and the ongoing development of the $90 million Falcon PLA plant reinforce the UAE’s commitment to sustainable manufacturing, circular economy solutions, and its Net Zero 2050 goals.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: KarmSolar, a leading clean energy company, plans to invest $110 million over three years to expand its solar infrastructure across Egypt,...
records.description: KarmSolar, a leading clean energy company, plans to invest $110 million over three years to expand its solar infrastructure across Egypt, targeting key sectors like industry, agriculture, and tourism. Flagship projects include a 100 MW solar plant under Egypt's new Private-to-Private (P2P) framework to supply industrial clients via the national grid, the expansion of the Farafra Solar Grid to serve 64,000 acres of agricultural land, and the development of the Marsa Alam Solar Grid. Simultaneously, the company has launched its first international project in Cyprus through KarmCyprus, positioning itself as a regional renewable energy utility that integrates generation, distribution, and storage.

records.title: The poultry sector in Al-Muthanna Governorate has achieved remarkable development, reaching self-sufficiency in both table eggs and chick...
records.description: The poultry sector in Al-Muthanna Governorate has achieved remarkable development, reaching self-sufficiency in both table eggs and chicken meat, which aligns with the Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture's strategic plans. This success resulted from government support, including technical and veterinary services provided by the Al-Muthanna Agriculture Directorate and the adoption of modern systems. The expansion of poultry projects has increased production capacities, enabling the governorate to meet local consumer needs and potentially export the surplus to other governorates, positively impacting food security and the national economy.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the German Cooperation Agency (GIZ) organized a workshop to discuss the third phase of the Su...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the German Cooperation Agency (GIZ) organized a workshop to discuss the third phase of the Sustainable Livelihoods Improvement Project in rural areas of the northern West Bank. The workshop included partner institutions such as the Palestinian Water Authority and the Environmental Quality Authority. The project emphasizes planning priority interventions consistent with the Ministry's strategy, aiming to support entrepreneurial work, enhance agricultural business opportunities through financial resources and credit associations, and encourage resource-conserving production. Furthermore, the project focuses on raising agricultural extension capabilities through digital transformation and producing knowledge related to climate change and integrated resource management.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its directorate in Ramallah and Al-Bireh Governorate, supervised the Land Foundation for...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its directorate in Ramallah and Al-Bireh Governorate, supervised the Land Foundation for Agricultural Development in distributing 24 olive harvesting machines (equipped with a battery and electric charger) to farmers affected by settler attacks in the villages of Abu Falah and Al-Mughayyir. This intervention is part of a project to empower and rehabilitate ten agricultural communities, aiming to enhance the farmers’ ability to continue their work and raise the efficiency of agricultural processes during the peak olive season. The Ministry affirmed the importance of this support in strengthening the resilience of farmers in targeted areas.

records.title: The National Company for Agricultural Services (AgriServ) is participating in the Global Veterinary Expo at the Riyadh International Conv...
records.description: The National Company for Agricultural Services (AgriServ) is participating in the Global Veterinary Expo at the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center. The company is showcasing services mandated by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA), including expedited permit issuance, quarantine appointment booking, and vaccination services for imported livestock. AgriServ is also presenting its agricultural services application and offering a live demonstration of its virtual clinic service, which allows remote or on-site veterinary consultations, reflecting its commitment to enhancing digital solutions and service accessibility.
records.institution: The National Company for Agricultural Services (AgriServ)

records.title: The fifth edition of VIV MEA – Middle East and Africa for Animal Production, the world’s leading exhibition for livestock development, op...
records.description: The fifth edition of VIV MEA – Middle East and Africa for Animal Production, the world’s leading exhibition for livestock development, opened at the Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre (ADNEC), Organized by VNU Europe, the event brings together over 500 exhibitors to showcase advanced solutions across the complete animal protein production spectrum, including meat, dairy, poultry, and aquaculture, alongside smart food systems and sustainable resource management. The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is participating with a dedicated pavilion to showcase its initiatives in food security, animal health, and modern farming systems, reinforcing Abu Dhabi's position as a global hub for sustainable agriculture and offering opportunities for knowledge exchange and partnership expansion.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) is set to launch the second edition of the "Al Dhaid Honey Festival", at Expo Al Dhaid.
records.description: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) is set to launch the second edition of the "Al Dhaid Honey Festival", at Expo Al Dhaid. The festival, which will feature over 70 exhibitors (including beekeepers and traders), aims to strengthen the beekeeping sector, promote local production, and align with the objectives of the National Food Security Strategy 2051. The event will host competitions for the "Best Sidr Honey" and "Best Samar Honey," with winners selected based on rigorous technical and chemical testing. The SCCI affirmed the festival's role as a vital platform for showcasing local products, fostering knowledge exchange, and supporting sustainable agricultural growth in Sharjah.
records.institution: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.title: Ghitha, Bahrain’s Food Holding Company and a portfolio company of Bahrain Mumtalakat Holding Company, has secured a strategic minority in...
records.description: Ghitha, Bahrain’s Food Holding Company and a portfolio company of Bahrain Mumtalakat Holding Company, has secured a strategic minority investment in baked goods manufacturer Amalfi Foods. This partnership marks Ghitha’s entry into the bakery industry and will enable Amalfi Foods to double its production capacity by establishing a new, highly automated facility. The expansion is expected to support the launch of over 20 new bakery products for regional distribution and create up to 100 new jobs. This collaboration aligns with Bahrain's strategy to diversify its food production capabilities and establish itself as a hub for premium food manufacturing.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Egypt signed a €53.8 million concessional financing and grant agreement with the French Development Agency (AFD) and the European Investm...
records.description: Egypt signed a €53.8 million concessional financing and grant agreement with the French Development Agency (AFD) and the European Investment Bank (EIB) to support its Sustainable Green Industries (GSI) programme. This agreement, which is part of a larger €271 million financing package, aims to promote greener industrial production, reduce emissions, and enhance competitiveness. Additionally, an €8.8 million EU-funded technical assistance agreement, managed by the EIB, was signed with the Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency. The GSI programme will help industrial facilities comply with environmental regulations, expand renewable energy and energy-efficiency projects, and enhance export readiness—particularly for European markets—by adopting cleaner technologies.

records.title: Egypt's government has imposed a temporary, three-month ban on refined sugar imports, signaling a pivotal moment aimed at protecting loca...
records.description: Egypt's government has imposed a temporary, three-month ban on refined sugar imports, signaling a pivotal moment aimed at protecting local producers from market saturation and price volatility following a surge in domestic output. This decision, announced by the Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade, is a recurring policy tool to stabilize the market during periods of surplus. Domestic production is surging due to state efforts, including expanding sugar beet cultivation by 25% to 750,000 feddans in the 2024/2025 season, with production hitting a record 2.6 million tons in 2025. This boost positions Egypt closer to self-sufficiency, predicted to be achieved by 2026, though long-term sustainability depends on managing water availability and rising input costs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Baalbek-Hermel Agricultural Department and the Nabi Chit Agricultural Center, organized an educa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Baalbek-Hermel Agricultural Department and the Nabi Chit Agricultural Center, organized an educational seminar on the proper principles of fruit tree pruning. The seminar, held in cooperation with the Union of Municipalities of Eastern Baalbek and the Baalbek and Surrounding Areas Association, aimed to enhance tree productivity and maintain quality, thereby improving local agricultural production. During the event, the American organization SEAL presented a gift of battery-operated pruning shears and a saw to enhance farmers' tools and support the application of best agricultural practices.

records.title: Morocco has strengthened its drive to modernize irrigation systems by finalizing a new financing agreement with Japan to support hydro-ag...
records.description: Morocco has strengthened its drive to modernize irrigation systems by finalizing a new financing agreement with Japan to support hydro-agricultural development in the Gharb plain. The agreement, signed with the Ministry of Budget, the Japanese Embassy, and the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA), secures a loan of 64.6 billion yen (US$346.7 million). This initiative will extend irrigation to 30,000 hectares using water from the Al Wahda Dam, prioritizing water-saving drip irrigation systems. This crucial investment aligns with the Ministry of Agriculture's plan to cultivate over 4 million hectares of cereals and pulses in the 2025/2026 campaign and achieve the national program's target of 1 million hectares of irrigated cereals by 2030, thereby enhancing the country's food security and export capacity.

records.title: The Moroccan green bean sector is a crucial, though less visible, component of the nation's agricultural exports, benefiting thousands of...
records.description: The Moroccan green bean sector is a crucial, though less visible, component of the nation's agricultural exports, benefiting thousands of small and medium-sized farms with recognized expertise in cultivation. Despite this, the last season saw a decline in export volumes to the European Union (down 16% to 27,990 tonnes in Q1 2025) and faced significant international competition that drove down prices. Moroccan operators are responding by shifting their strategy away from pure volume toward premium segments, focusing on quality certification (like GlobalGAP), specific sizes, and labeled products to mitigate price volatility and enhance commercial resilience.

records.title: The Moroccan pepper sector is launching its first dedicated forum, the RAMD, Pepper Congress 2026, which will be held on March 2026, in A...
records.description: The Moroccan pepper sector is launching its first dedicated forum, the RAMD, Pepper Congress 2026, which will be held on March 2026, in Agadir. The event is designed as a crucial platform for discussion and networking, bringing together all stakeholders involved in the strategic crop, including producers, researchers, seed companies, and institutions. The Congress will feature an exhibition area for varietal and technological innovations, conferences by national and international specialists on market trends and cultivation practices, and B2B meetings. The goal is to address the challenges influencing the competitiveness of Moroccan peppers, such as input management, post-harvest quality, and agronomic innovations, to strengthen this export-oriented sector's performance.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals reinforced Oman’s role in the global hydrogen economy by participating in the Asian Hydrogen Summit a...
records.description: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals reinforced Oman’s role in the global hydrogen economy by participating in the Asian Hydrogen Summit and Exhibition in Sydney. The Under-Secretary delivered a keynote address outlining Oman’s national strategy to advance a large-scale hydrogen industry, detailing regulatory and investment reforms, streamlined permitting, and targeted incentives to attract global investors. The Omani delegation held high-level meetings with the Australian government and the Australian Trade and Investment Commission to explore cooperation and technical exchange. Oman's participation highlights its determination to build strategic partnerships, attract investment, and develop national capabilities to emerge as a leading international hub for green hydrogen.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals

records.title: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA) confirmed the purchase of 300,000 metric tons of 12.5% protein hard wheat in its latest...
records.description: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA) confirmed the purchase of 300,000 metric tons of 12.5% protein hard wheat in its latest international tender, with arrival scheduled between February and April 2026. The tender was open to multiple origins, though European traders suggest the bulk will likely be sourced from the Black Sea region due to competitive pricing. The GFSA secured the volumes on a cost-and-freight (C&F) basis from sellers including Cargill, Solaris, and Cofco, with pricing reflecting notable market aggression due to strong global wheat supplies. This purchase is part of the GFSA's strategic plan to maintain national wheat stocks and stabilize domestic supply, following a series of substantial recent procurements.
records.institution: The Saudi General Food Security Authority (GFSA)

records.title: The Sudanese Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation launched its Digital Transformation Project to advance the agricultural sector and st...
records.description: The Sudanese Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation launched its Digital Transformation Project to advance the agricultural sector and strengthen water resource management, following extensive destruction and data loss caused by the war. The project, which aligns with government directives and is coordinated with the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Telecommunications, aims to restore capacities and improve efficiency in national reconstruction efforts. The program will support farmers and specialists through digital tools for crop monitoring, irrigation assessment, pest surveillance, production evaluation, and integrated decision-making.

records.title: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture, participated in planting olive trees in the Maaret al-Numan region as part of the ministry's plan to...
records.description: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture, participated in planting olive trees in the Maaret al-Numan region as part of the ministry's plan to distribute 200,000 olive saplings. This initiative, carried out in cooperation with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), is aimed at restoring the damaged agricultural sector and compensating for the logging carried out by the former regime.

records.title: The Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) between the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Chile has officially entered into forc...
records.description: The Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) between the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and Chile has officially entered into force, marking a transformative step to significantly enhance bilateral trade, which is projected to exceed $500 million within five years. The pivotal agreement is set to create new investment opportunities across vital sectors, including renewable energy, tourism, infrastructure, and agriculture. This collaboration, which solidifies the UAE's role as a global supply-chain hub connecting South America with markets in Africa, Europe, and Asia, is integral to the UAE's foreign trade strategy targeting $1 trillion in total trade value by 2031.

records.title: VIV MEA 2025, the Middle East and Africa’s leading trade show for animal protein production and agribusiness, returns to the Abu Dhabi Na...
records.description: VIV MEA 2025, the Middle East and Africa’s leading trade show for animal protein production and agribusiness, returns to the Abu Dhabi National Exhibition Centre (ADNEC) from November 25–27, 2025, in partnership with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA). The event serves as a crucial hub for food security, uniting over 500 global and regional exhibitors to showcase cutting-edge technologies and strategies across the complete feed-to-food chain, including poultry, dairy, and aquaculture. Highlights include the dedicated Aquatic Pavilion and the VIV Industry Leaders (VIL) Program for senior executives, with over 30 conference sessions addressing critical issues like AI-powered solutions and intelligent water management.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation announced that total financing for the National Veal Project has reached EGP 10.053 bill...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation announced that total financing for the National Veal Project has reached EGP 10.053 billion, benefiting over 45,100 small farmers, young graduates, and women. This national initiative has supported the raising and fattening of around 522,500 head of livestock and is a cornerstone for boosting domestic red-meat output, expected to reach 600,000 tonnes by the end of 2025, and fresh milk production, forecast to reach 7 million tonnes. The project provides soft loans at low, declining interest rates and ensures continuous veterinary supervision, technical support, and insurance through the Livestock Insurance Fund to guarantee its success and sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Iraq and Turkey have signed a "historic" oil-for-water agreement, touted by officials as a breakthrough to boost both countries' economie...
records.description: Iraq and Turkey have signed a "historic" oil-for-water agreement, touted by officials as a breakthrough to boost both countries' economies and ease Iraq's water crisis. The accord entails Iraqi oil revenues from sales to Turkey being funneled into Iraqi water infrastructure projects managed by Turkish firms. The agreement, signed by the Iraqi and Turkish Foreign Ministers in the presence of the Iraqi Prime Minister, was hailed as potentially the "largest infrastructure investment" in Iraq's history and a sustainable solution for water management. However, critics have charged that the quid-pro-quo is one-sided and leaves Iraq facing environmental catastrophe.

records.title: Tanmiah Food Company, a leading Saudi producer, signed three Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) during the Saudi Agri-Food Tech Alliance...
records.description: Tanmiah Food Company, a leading Saudi producer, signed three Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) during the Saudi Agri-Food Tech Alliance (SAFTA) Forum to fast-track its decarbonization and enhance energy efficiency. The MoUs include a partnership with Schneider Electric to perform a carbon inventory under the SBTi framework, collaboration with Strataphy to deploy the region’s first geothermal-cooled poultry operation at its Shaqrah Facility under a Cooling as a Service (CaaS) model, and an agreement with Kayes Arabia to convert diesel-powered equipment to Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) systems. These strategic partnerships reflect Tanmiah’s commitment to innovation, sustainability, and contributing to Saudi Vision 2030 objectives for a cleaner food production ecosystem.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture will patronize the 6th International Date Palm Conference and Exhibition, "The World o...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture will patronize the 6th International Date Palm Conference and Exhibition, "The World of Dates," organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates at King Saud University. Held in scientific partnership with King Abdullah University of Science and Technology, the conference's theme is "Investment and Innovation to Explore New Horizons for the Palm and Date Sector." The event aims to enhance sustainability and food security by exploring innovations, addressing challenges like pests and diseases, and promoting the application of circular economy principles and smart farming technologies. This highlights the sector's importance, as Saudi Arabia ranked first in global date exports in 2024, with export values reaching SAR 1.695 billion.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture will attend the Sixth International Date Palm Conference and Exhibition, "The Wo...
records.description: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture will attend the Sixth International Date Palm Conference and Exhibition, "The World of Dates," organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates at King Saud University in Riyadh. Held in scientific partnership with King Abdullah University of Science and Technology, the conference's theme is "Investment and Innovation to Explore New Horizons for the Palm and Date Sector." The event aims to enhance sustainability and food security by exploring innovations, promoting circular economy principles, addressing challenges like palm pests and diseases, and emphasizing smart farming technologies and post-harvest automation. This highlights the sector's importance, as Saudi Arabia ranked first in global date exports in 2024, with export values reaching SAR 1.695 billion from production exceeding 1.9 million tons.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Agricultural expenditure in the national budget
records.title: The Assembly of the Representatives of the People (ARP) and the National Council of Regions and Districts (CNRD) began examining the miss...
records.description: The Assembly of the Representatives of the People (ARP) and the National Council of Regions and Districts (CNRD) began examining the mission budget for the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries for the financial year 2026, which is estimated at 2,467 million dinars (MDT), an increase of 5% from 2025. The budget aims to achieve food self-sufficiency and security by preserving natural resources, diversifying production, and adapting to climate change. Investment expenditures are set to increase by 8.8%, reflecting the sector's vision of achieving "A resilient, inclusive and sustainable agriculture" aligned with the 2026-2030 development plan.
records.institution: The Assembly of the Representatives of the People (ARP)

records.title: A comprehensive veterinary campaign was launched in Al-Hali District, Al-Hodeidah Governorate, to vaccinate and treat sheep against Peste...
