records.description: A comprehensive veterinary campaign was launched in Al-Hali District, Al-Hodeidah Governorate, to vaccinate and treat sheep against Peste des Petits Ruminants (PPR). The campaign is being implemented through cooperation between the Al-Hali Cooperative Association and relevant authorities. The initiative aims to protect livestock, curb the spread of epidemic diseases, and enhance the immunity and productivity of sheep herds. This effort is emphasized as a fundamental part of national directions to prioritize the livestock sector and agriculture, thereby supporting food security and local development efforts toward self-sufficiency.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Akkar Agricultural Department and the Al-Abdeh Agricultural Center, organized specialized traini...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Akkar Agricultural Department and the Al-Abdeh Agricultural Center, organized specialized training on integrated beekeeping management in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO). This initiative, part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, aimed to support farmers in Akkar Governorate by covering topics like selecting apiary sites, proper feeding methods, and regular disease detection. The training emphasized the importance of registering in the agricultural registry to enable farmers to benefit from the Ministry's services and adopt the latest scientific methods to efficiently manage their apiaries and increase local productivity.

records.title: The Yemeni Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources reaffirmed the continued enforcement of the ban on importing foreign ra...
records.description: The Yemeni Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources reaffirmed the continued enforcement of the ban on importing foreign raisins, denying a widely circulated forged document that claimed the ban had been lifted. The Ministry stressed that the ban remains in effect to protect local producers, promote local production, and prevent the drain on foreign currency, which contributes to achieving self-sufficiency. The Ministry's Marketing Sector urged importers to comply with the official circular and emphasized that official decisions are published exclusively through verified channels.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Suez Canal Container Terminal (SCCT) in East Port Said opened a $500 million expansion, adding 2.2 million TEUs of annual capacity an...
records.description: The Suez Canal Container Terminal (SCCT) in East Port Said opened a $500 million expansion, adding 2.2 million TEUs of annual capacity and increasing total throughput to 7 million TEUs. The project, attended by the Egyptian President, reflects the commitment of SCCT and APM Terminals to strengthening Egypt's and the region's trade opportunities. The expansion included 955 meters of new quay, the deployment of electric cranes powered by battery systems, and is expected to create over 1,000 jobs. The facility's high efficiency, ranked third globally in 2024 by the World Bank and S&P Global Market Intelligence, is expected to influence routing and transit decisions for exporters in the East Mediterranean corridor.

records.title: The National Agricultural Research Center (NARC), through its Agritech Innovation and Entrepreneurship Incubator, signed six pioneering a...
records.description: The National Agricultural Research Center (NARC), through its Agritech Innovation and Entrepreneurship Incubator, signed six pioneering agreements with startup companies to boost a knowledge-based economy and strengthen the agricultural sector. The projects include a smart application for managing livestock health, recycling agricultural waste, producing organic hybrid prickly pears, and an electronic application connecting farmers directly to markets. The NARC affirmed that these agreements, which also include a project for a natural, non-chemical disinfectant, align with the Royal vision to turn entrepreneurial success stories into scalable and sustainable projects that contribute to food security and create jobs.

records.title: Mauritania, German Firm Sign Framework Agreement for Green Hydrogen Export Project
records.description: The Mauritanian government signed a framework agreement with Germany’s Möhring Energie Group to develop the major green hydrogen and green ammonia project, NAYRAH. The initial phase of the project will add up to 1 gigawatt (GW) of power capacity and is expected to produce around 140,000 tons of green hydrogen and 400,000 tons of green ammonia annually. With production slated to start in 2029, all output is intended for export to Europe. This project is the first German initiative governed by Mauritania’s new regulatory framework and strengthens the country's ambition to become a regional clean-energy hub, leveraging its strong wind and solar resources in line with its National Low-Carbon Hydrogen Roadmap.

records.title: The Agency for Agricultural Development (ADA) organized a national seminar in Marrakech focused on making "Digital technology at the hear...
records.description: The Agency for Agricultural Development (ADA) organized a national seminar in Marrakech focused on making "Digital technology at the heart of the development of local products," continuing the Generation Green 2020–2030 strategy. The ADA launched two major projects: the new "E-shop" platform dedicated to marketing local products, which includes 250 groups and over 500 cooperatives, and an integrated data management system to improve sector governance. Digital transformation is viewed as essential for strengthening the competitiveness, transparency, and traceability of local products in both national and international markets.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture sponsored a major initiative in Taza Province by distributing professional kits worth 1.5 million dirhams to...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture sponsored a major initiative in Taza Province by distributing professional kits worth 1.5 million dirhams to thirty rural micro-entrepreneurs, prioritizing youth and women. This program directly supports the objectives of the Generation Green strategy by strengthening productive capacities, improving product quality, and stimulating income-generating activities in sectors like processing and the promotion of local products. The initiative is critical for the region's dominant almond industry and reflects the government's commitment to strengthening the economic empowerment of rural populations and fostering a human-centered, innovation-oriented strategy for sustainable rural development.

records.title: Egypt’s New Egyptian Rural Development Company has launched a new administrative and service area and a model farm in the city of El-Tor,...
records.description: Egypt’s New Egyptian Rural Development Company has launched a new administrative and service area and a model farm in the city of El-Tor, South Sinai, as part of its plan to expand agricultural and service development projects in the Sinai Peninsula. The new administrative area serves as a "smart management centre" for the national project to reclaim and develop 1.5 million feddans in Sinai. This initiative aims to establish an integrated agricultural community that supports investment by providing modern infrastructure and technical support, with the land proven suitable for strategic crops, ultimately strengthening Egypt’s food security in line with the “New Republic” strategy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has begun implementing a new initiative via the National Program for th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has begun implementing a new initiative via the National Program for the Propagation of Fruit and Olive Varieties to enhance natural pollination. This involves introducing beehives to the deciduous fruit nursery in Hawija to efficiently transfer pollen, thus boosting fruit set and improving overall production quality. In a related effort, the nursery continues to sell diverse deciduous fruit seedlings (such as figs, grapes, and apples) to citizens at affordable prices, starting from 750 dinars per seedling, to support farmers and encourage the expansion of fruit tree cultivation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Agricultural Research, through its Al-Dawwar Research Station in Anbar Governorate, achieved...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Agricultural Research, through its Al-Dawwar Research Station in Anbar Governorate, achieved a significant research success by producing the Al-Nahrain yellow corn hybrid, an autumn and early-season variety. This success included the preservation of the hybrid's parent strains (strain 5 and strain 18). The project aims to enhance local hybrids known for their high productivity and make the Al-Nahrain hybrid available to farmers at affordable and subsidized prices to meet the needs of the local market.

records.title: The Ministry of Industry and Trade organized the first Agro Export Day 2025 to stress the critical importance of adding value to Moroccan...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry and Trade organized the first Agro Export Day 2025 to stress the critical importance of adding value to Moroccan agri-food products for export success. The Minister emphasized the need for Moroccan products, promoted under the theme "Made in Morocco, Desired Worldwide," to move upmarket and build a genuine brand premium to increase competitiveness and presence in international markets. Organized in partnership with the National Federation of Agri-Food (FENAGRI), the event serves as an annual platform for strategic reflection, fostering exchanges, and promoting the quality of national agri-food production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Trade

records.title: Saudi Arabia's state grains buying agency, the General Food Security Authority (GFSA), issued its sixth and final international tender fo...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's state grains buying agency, the General Food Security Authority (GFSA), issued its sixth and final international tender for 2025 to purchase around 300,000 tonnes of hard milling wheat, with delivery scheduled between February and April 2026. This purchase, divided across five vessels for Jeddah Islamic Port and Yanbu Commercial Port, is part of the GFSA's strategic plan to maintain wheat stocks and ensure the availability and price stability of food supplies. Concurrently, the Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAID) is exploring new investment opportunities in the Kingdom's agricultural and food industries to support the national strategy of strengthening food security and meeting Saudi Vision 2030 goals for self-sufficiency in key commodities.

records.title: The Central Bank of Sudan (CBOS) launched a financial inclusion initiative for the winter season with SDG 20 billion in funding.
records.description: The Central Bank of Sudan (CBOS) launched a financial inclusion initiative for the winter season with SDG 20 billion in funding. The project, which includes contracts with Azm Microfinance Company and Al-Ebdaa Microfinance Bank, aims to link small producers to the formal banking system and reach three million new beneficiaries. The initiative targets young entrepreneurs, small farmers, and production groups, directing 50% of the financing to agriculture, 30% to industry, and 10% each to trade and services, prioritizing the reduction of poverty and unemployment while supporting rural women.

records.domain: Sanitary, phytosanitary and technical standards improvements
records.title: The Algerian Ministry of Trade and Market Regulation announced a strategic achievement: the inclusion of Algeria's "Deglet Nour" date in...
records.description: The Algerian Ministry of Trade and Market Regulation announced a strategic achievement: the inclusion of Algeria's "Deglet Nour" date in the international standard for "fresh dates" adopted by the Codex Alimentarius Commission (CAC) at FAO headquarters. The Ministry, supported by an inter-ministerial team including the Ministry of Agriculture and Ministry of Higher Education, successfully defended the specific qualities of its date variety to strengthen its competitiveness and international recognition.
records.institution: The Ministry of Trade and Market Regulation

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain announced that the Bahrain Animal and Agriculture Production Show (Mara...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain announced that the Bahrain Animal and Agriculture Production Show (Mara’ee 2025) will be held under the patronage of His Majesty King Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa. The exhibition, taking place at the Bahrain International Endurance Village, aims to support food security and strengthen local production by showcasing advanced agricultural technologies and expanding livestock development initiatives. The Minister highlighted the show's role as a scientific, technical, investment, and family-oriented event that reflects Bahrain’s commitment to sustainable agricultural development, with expanded activities including the Bahrain Mangrove Exhibition, a farmers’ market, and a date exhibition.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: Indications that Saudi Arabia is preparing to lift its ban on agricultural imports from Lebanon have renewed expectations for the sector,...
records.description: Indications that Saudi Arabia is preparing to lift its ban on agricultural imports from Lebanon have renewed expectations for the sector, which historically saw $40 million to $50 million in annual exports to the Kingdom before the disruption. The expected move, which the Chamber of Commerce, Industry, and Agriculture in Zahle and the Bekaa views as a major boost, will revive the largest market for Lebanese produce, which suffered a more than 50% drop in total agricultural exports following the ban. Lifting the ban is expected to restore equilibrium to the entire supply chain, including the collapsed land transport sector, and reflects renewed confidence in Lebanon's authorities.
records.institution: The Chamber of Commerce, Industry, and Agriculture in Zahle and the Bekaa

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) signed agreements to launch tw...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) signed agreements to launch two new projects aimed at strengthening the agricultural sector. The first project, "Strengthening Corporate Governance," is a two-year initiative focused on institutional reform and capacity building within the Ministry to enhance its ability to effectively manage and implement agricultural policies. The second project addresses environmental safety by providing support for the safe disposal of confiscated pesticide stockpiles, thereby minimizing risks to human health and the environment in Lebanon. This dual initiative reflects the ongoing partnership to promote sustainable, safe, and innovative agricultural practices.

records.title: The Moroccan government has launched the National Livestock Regeneration Program with a budget of 12.8 billion dirhams for the 2025–2026...
records.description: The Moroccan government has launched the National Livestock Regeneration Program with a budget of 12.8 billion dirhams for the 2025–2026 period to support livestock farmers. The program provides direct financial support for the acquisition of livestock feed and includes an advance of 100 DH per female on the premium allocated for maintaining female sheep and goats. This comprehensive initiative also features the rescheduling and relief of farmers' debts in partnership with Crédit Agricole du Maroc, the organization of vaccination campaigns, and technical support.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The province of Taza, Morocco, has launched the Aknoul commercial platform, a 2.5 million dirham project that is part of the Integrated R...
records.description: The province of Taza, Morocco, has launched the Aknoul commercial platform, a 2.5 million dirham project that is part of the Integrated Rural Development Project in the Pre-Rif Mountain Areas of Taza (PRODER). This infrastructure aims to modernize marketing channels by consolidating supply and facilitating direct connections between producers, buyers, and processors. The platform is strategically important for the local almond industry, which covers 40,520 hectares in the province. By improving marketing conditions and product quality, the project is designed to enhance the value of local products, improve the incomes of small farmers, and align with the core objectives of the Generation Green strategy.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its Yatta Agriculture and Veterinary Directorate, supervised the delivery of 40 tons of...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its Yatta Agriculture and Veterinary Directorate, supervised the delivery of 40 tons of concentrated feed to 100 livestock farmers in Masafer Yatta. This intervention, carried out by Agricultural Relief in cooperation with Save the Children, is part of a project funded by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development aimed at strengthening the resilience of marginalized and conflict-affected families. The goal is to support livestock breeders and enhance their ability to continue production despite difficult conditions and daily attacks.

records.title: The peanut harvest in Tunisia's Nabeul Governorate has reached a 60% completion rate, with production expected to total 5,000 tons in the...
records.description: The peanut harvest in Tunisia's Nabeul Governorate has reached a 60% completion rate, with production expected to total 5,000 tons in the El Haouaria delegation alone, which accounts for 1,500 of the 2,400 total hectares dedicated to the crop. According to the El Haouaria Agricultural Union, the delegations of El Haouria, Kélibia, and Hammam-Ghezaz account for 80% of national peanut production. To ensure a reasonable profit margin for farmers facing rising production costs, the Union advocates for increasing the current selling price of peanuts from 5 to 6 dinars.

records.title: The Tunisian government has implemented an exceptional plan to regulate and facilitate the distribution of strategic agricultural product...
records.description: The Tunisian government has implemented an exceptional plan to regulate and facilitate the distribution of strategic agricultural products, including dates, olives, apples, and citrus fruits. Coordinated by several ministries, the plan aims to support smallholder farmers by reducing logistical costs, stabilizing domestic supply to ensure fair and affordable prices for consumers, and boosting exports of high-value products like Deglet Nour dates and olive oil. Concrete measures include simplifying transport procedures, strict storage regulations to limit post-harvest losses, and enhanced oversight of distribution channels to prevent speculative practices.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Tunisia has significantly raised its climate ambition in the preliminary draft of its next Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0),...
records.description: Tunisia has significantly raised its climate ambition in the preliminary draft of its next Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC 3.0), proposing a 62% reduction in carbon intensity by 2035 (and 46.2% by 2030), a major leap from its previous 45% target. This updated plan extends the implementation period to 2026–2035 and seeks to reduce net emissions to 24 MtCO2e by 2035, with the energy sector expected to account for 81% of avoided cumulative net emissions. Achieving the most ambitious scenario, however, is contingent upon securing massive international support, as the total required financing is estimated at approximately $28.22 billion by 2035.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture began issuing import licenses for olive oil to address a significant shortage in domestic production caused b...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture began issuing import licenses for olive oil to address a significant shortage in domestic production caused by water scarcity and drought conditions across the Kingdom, with the imported oil expected to arrive within a few weeks. The imports are aimed at easing the financial burden on citizens and are anticipated to cause prices to drop significantly. The Ministry of Agriculture limited imports to member countries of the International Olive Council to ensure product quality. Sticking to strict guidelines, importers must submit a judicial commitment worth 25,000 Jordanian dinars pledging not to sell the shipment outside the Jordanian market, and the imported oil cannot be blended, repackaged, or re-exported.

records.title: The Minister of Fisheries, Maritime Infrastructure, and Ports, inaugurated the workshop for the "New Aquatic Value Chains for Healthy and...
records.description: The Minister of Fisheries, Maritime Infrastructure, and Ports, inaugurated the workshop for the "New Aquatic Value Chains for Healthy and Sustainable Nutrition" project in Nouakchott. This five-year initiative, implemented through a partnership between the National Agency for the Development of Inland Fisheries and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), is funded by the European Union (EU). The project is specifically designed to develop and improve the fisheries value chain in the Foum Lekleita lagoon, recognizing the inland fisheries sector as a fundamental pillar for enhancing food security in Mauritania.
records.institution: The National Agency for the Development of Inland Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture supervised the delivery of production supplies to 71 almond farmers in Jenin Governorate.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture supervised the delivery of production supplies to 71 almond farmers in Jenin Governorate. This initiative, carried out in cooperation with Agricultural Relief and the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development, is part of the project "Improving Livelihoods, Food Security and Sustainable Economic Growth in the West Bank and Gaza Strip – Palestine." The supplies included 21.25 tons of compound fertilizers and 1,350 liters of fungicides and insecticides. The goal is to support smallholder farmers who manage model almond plots (covering over 350 dunams) by enabling them to use best practices, enhance the almond value chain, and contribute to national food security. The Ministry’s agricultural extension staff provided direct technical guidance and field follow-up to ensure optimal use of inputs.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Directorate of Agriculture of Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Governorate, in cooperation with...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Directorate of Agriculture of Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Governorate, in cooperation with the Tubas Governorate, the Chamber of Commerce, and the international organization Action Against Hunger, conducted an extensive workshop to discuss the needs of the agricultural sector and identify intervention priorities. The Governor stressed the importance of supporting the agricultural sector as the "first line of defense for the land" and called on institutions to intensify interventions that meet the real needs of farmers. The Director General of the Directorate explained that agriculture in the region is a fundamental pillar of food security and requires joint work to develop infrastructure and expand projects. Action Against Hunger distributed needs assessment forms to collect data for designing future projects.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Global investments in the energy transition hit a new record of $2.4 trillion in 2024, a 20% increase from the prior two years' average,...
records.description: Global investments in the energy transition hit a new record of $2.4 trillion in 2024, a 20% increase from the prior two years' average, with $807 billion specifically directed toward renewable energy technologies. Despite this milestone, the year-on-year growth rate for renewables significantly slowed to 7.3% in 2024 (down from 32% in 2023). A major finding from the report by the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) and the Climate Policy Initiative (CPI) is that 90% of energy transition investments remain concentrated in advanced economies and China, leaving emerging and developing countries behind. This gap highlights the urgent need for impact-driven capital like low-cost debt and grants, as nearly half of global investment is provided as market-rate debt, risking an exacerbation of debt burdens in lower-income nations.

records.title: Nama Women Advancement (NAMA) announced the launch of the three-year “Nthanda Women Mushrooms Project” in Lilongwe, Malawi, running from...
records.description: Nama Women Advancement (NAMA) announced the launch of the three-year “Nthanda Women Mushrooms Project” in Lilongwe, Malawi, running from 2025 to 2028. Implemented in partnership with Zayane Creations Trust, the initiative aims to empower 900 rural women by establishing 45 women-led agricultural enterprises focused on mushroom cultivation. The project provides comprehensive training in technical, financial, and entrepreneurial skills, directly addressing the economic and social challenges faced by rural women in Malawi. This initiative is designed to create sustainable enterprises, increase household income, and promote environmental sustainability through drought-resilient irrigation practices, aligning with NAMA's global strategy to empower women and achieve the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Kuwait Authority for Partnership Projects (KAPP) has opened bidding for a new 0.5-gigawatt (GW) solar project, covering the Al Dibdib...
records.description: The Kuwait Authority for Partnership Projects (KAPP) has opened bidding for a new 0.5-gigawatt (GW) solar project, covering the Al Dibdibah Power and Al Shagaya Renewable Energy Phase III. The project is being developed under a 30-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) to supply the Ministry of Electricity. Six pre-qualified consortia, including groups led by Masdar and ACWA Power, have been invited to submit proposals for the Independent Power Project (IPP). This initiative is part of Kuwait's effort to expand clean power generation and address severe power shortages caused by population growth and rising temperatures.
records.institution: The Kuwait Authority for Partnership Projects (KAPP)

records.title: Nama Water Services officially inaugurated the Al Shikhaikhat Renewed Water Network in the Wilayat of Barka, under the auspices of the Mi...
records.description: Nama Water Services officially inaugurated the Al Shikhaikhat Renewed Water Network in the Wilayat of Barka, under the auspices of the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. The first phase of the project, valued at over RO 2 million, includes 40 kilometers of pipelines supplying reclaimed water to 40 farms to support agricultural productivity and reduce pressure on groundwater. This initiative aligns with Oman Vision 2040 by promoting environmental sustainability and the circular economy. Nama also unveiled its new reclaimed water brand, Manhal Nama, and integrated the network with a central SCADA system and smart meters, marking a major step in the company's digital transformation journey.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture oversaw the launch of the first shipment of 22 tons of Palestinian avocado crop to the Republic of Turkey, ma...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture oversaw the launch of the first shipment of 22 tons of Palestinian avocado crop to the Republic of Turkey, marking a successful expansion of the country's agricultural exports. This achievement is a continuation of the Ministry's efforts to enhance the presence of Palestinian products in regional and international markets by developing the agricultural traceability system and streamlining technical and administrative procedures to meet the highest international standards. The Ministry's committees strictly supervised the entire export process, from verifying farmer data and granting approval to conducting final inspection and issuing the phytosanitary certificate.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, and Agricultural Relief conducted a joint technical worksh...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, and Agricultural Relief conducted a joint technical workshop for 31 farmers from the Beit Ummar area. The workshop focused on the second phase of the grape value chain project, implemented within the program to enhance resilience and improve livelihoods for farmers exposed to climate change, funded by the World Food Programme (WFP). The session provided a detailed review of best practices for grape cultivation, aimed at increasing productivity, improving fruit quality, and enhancing the technical capabilities of farmers in the value chain.

records.title: The Jazan Region is renowned for its significant livestock production, particularly cattle rearing, a longstanding tradition that provide...
records.description: The Jazan Region is renowned for its significant livestock production, particularly cattle rearing, a longstanding tradition that provides essential local food sources of milk, meat, and cheese. Current statistics from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) indicate approximately 130,161 cattle, underscoring the importance of this activity for local food security. MEWA is committed to enhancing this wealth by providing crucial support through regional branches and veterinary clinics, including preventive immunizations, disease diagnosis, and financial aid. This effort, supported by the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef), aims to boost livestock productivity and marketing, linking traditional practices with sustainable development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that Saudi Arabia is committed to reducing ozone-depleting compounds (ODCs)...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that Saudi Arabia is committed to reducing ozone-depleting compounds (ODCs) by 67.5% by the end of 2025, with the ultimate goal of complete elimination (100%) by 2030. This follows a phase-out plan that began with a 10% reduction in 2015 and reached 35% in 2020. The Minister stressed that relevant authorities must strictly adhere to the precise timelines for phasing out hydrochlorofluorocarbons (HCFCs) and comply fully with the Unified Law of the GCC regarding ozone-depleting substances. Furthermore, the regulations stipulate that prior environmental approval is required for any contracts or projects involving controlled materials listed in the Montreal Protocol.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Dubai International Food Safety Conference, organized by Dubai Municipality under the theme “Technology and Innovation in Food Safety...
records.description: The Dubai International Food Safety Conference, organized by Dubai Municipality under the theme “Technology and Innovation in Food Safety,” opened with over 3,500 participants and 225 international speakers. Organized in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO), the International Association for Food Protection (IAFP), and the National Environmental Health Association, the conference examines leveraging emerging technologies to enhance food safety systems, reduce food waste, and support sustainable global food practices. Dubai Municipality launched several programs, including the "Food Safety Storytellers – Creators" initiative and the "AI Food Intelligence Guide," reinforcing Dubai's mission to achieve a safe, resilient, and sustainable food environment in line with the National Food Security Strategy 2051.

records.title: The First Deputy Governor of Al Hodeidah inaugurated a series of campaigns for health awareness, agricultural guidance, and rural develop...
records.description: The First Deputy Governor of Al Hodeidah inaugurated a series of campaigns for health awareness, agricultural guidance, and rural development, along with an agricultural land reclamation project in the Bab Al-Naqa area of Bajil. These initiatives were organized by the Bajil Multi-Purpose Agricultural Cooperative Society to strengthen food security and rural development. The implemented activities included health awareness programs, community guidance on dairy production, and the reclamation of neglected lands to enhance income sources for productive families. The Governor praised the association’s work in integrating health awareness with local food production and emphasized the governorate leadership’s support for such productive projects.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Aknoul Almond Festival in Taza Province, Morocco, was inaugurated under the theme "The Almond Tree: An Ally Against Climate Change an...
records.description: The Aknoul Almond Festival in Taza Province, Morocco, was inaugurated under the theme "The Almond Tree: An Ally Against Climate Change and in Preserving Local Soil," underscoring the crop's crucial role in the region's resilience. The festival, organized under the patronage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests, highlights the almond sector, which covers 40,520 hectares (28% of the province's arboriculture). Concurrently with the festival, the Minister launched the construction of the Aknoul commercial platform, a key project funded at 2.5 million dirhams under the Integrated Rural Development Project in the Pre-Rif Mountain Areas of Taza (PRODER).
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Guercif Regional Olive Fair opened its fifth edition under the theme "The Olive Tree: Territorial Identity, Enhanced Value, and Susta...
records.description: The Guercif Regional Olive Fair opened its fifth edition under the theme "The Olive Tree: Territorial Identity, Enhanced Value, and Sustainable Water Management," with the inauguration led by the Minister of Agriculture. The Oriental region, which has 151,000 hectares planted with olives, confirmed its status as a stronghold of the national sector, generating over 5.65 million workdays annually. The fair serves as an essential forum for networking and strengthening the skills of the seventy-seven agricultural cooperatives and other stakeholders present. By focusing on sustainability and the need for adaptation to water stress, the event aligns with the Generation Green strategy to stimulate local development and consolidate the competitiveness of the olive oil value chain.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Sultanate of Oman announced the launch of its "National Climate Platform" during the United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP30)...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman announced the launch of its "National Climate Platform" during the United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP30), positioning it as a strategic pillar for implementing national climate priorities and attracting climate finance. Spearheaded by the Environment Authority, the platform is a comprehensive national system for coordination and investment, aiming to transform national strategies into practical programs. Focusing on high-priority sectors like clean energy, water, and agriculture, the initiative aligns with Oman Vision 2040 and the Zero Neutrality Strategy 2050 to transition towards a low-carbon, more resilient future.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the We Effect Foundation signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen cooperation in sustaina...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the We Effect Foundation signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen cooperation in sustainable agricultural development, empowering small farmers, and enhancing food security and climate resilience in Palestine. The Minister stressed that this partnership is crucial for enhancing the resilience of farmers facing continuous attacks and ensuring support is directed according to actual needs. Under the MoU, the Foundation commits to aligning its programs with national agricultural strategies, providing technical and financial support to small farmers and cooperatives, and promoting optimal use of resources. This collaboration aims to develop quality projects with a tangible impact on rural communities and supports the Ministry's national initiative, "Seeds of Change."

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture's General Administration for Plant Protection and Agricultural Quarantine has initiated a campaig...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture's General Administration for Plant Protection and Agricultural Quarantine has initiated a campaign to take samples of fruit seedlings from agricultural nurseries across the governorates. The samples are being sent to the Central Laboratory for Plant Health in Jenin to ensure they are free of diseases and pests. This rigorous inspection process is a prerequisite for nurseries to obtain licensing for the 2025–2026 agricultural season, aligning with the provisions of the Agricultural Nurseries System No. (14) of 2018, and enhances technical control over the safety and quality of seedlings traded in the markets.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture witnessed the signing of nine new investment contracts to support the production of co...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture witnessed the signing of nine new investment contracts to support the production of coffee, almonds, fruits, and poultry in the Al-Baha Region, reflecting the Kingdom's commitment to Saudi Vision 2030. These contracts include establishing five new coffee cities for planting over 819,000 Arabica coffee trees, an almond city, and two poultry production projects. The projects are designed to boost agricultural production, stimulate investment, and advance development in the region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Iraqi government has purchased two vessels of US long-grain rice, totaling 88,000 metric tons, from the agri-foods giant Archer-Danie...
records.description: The Iraqi government has purchased two vessels of US long-grain rice, totaling 88,000 metric tons, from the agri-foods giant Archer-Daniels-Midland (ADM). The shipments are scheduled for delivery in January and March 2026. This purchase was confirmed by the industry group USA Rice Federation (USA Rice), which celebrated the sales as significant news for the U.S. rice industry.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), launched a pilot pr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), launched a pilot project to cultivate a mother plant field for prickly pear at the Agricultural Scientific Research Institute's Kfardan station. The project involved planting 2,500 prickly pear pads to establish a reliable source for propagating spineless prickly pear, a crop highly resilient to climate change due to its drought tolerance and low water requirements. This strategic step aligns with the Ministry's vision to promote alternative, promising crops that contribute to food security and enhance the resilience of the agricultural sector.

records.title: A land reclamation and watercourse rehabilitation project was launched in Bani Saad District, al-Mahwit Governorate, Yemen.
records.description: A land reclamation and watercourse rehabilitation project was launched in Bani Saad District, al-Mahwit Governorate, Yemen. The project is implemented by the Executive Unit for Road Maintenance, funded by the Central Emergency Intervention Unit, in partnership with the local authority and the Multi-Purpose Agricultural Association. The initiative aims to reclaim land damaged by floods and rehabilitate irrigation channels to support the maize planting season, thereby boosting agricultural productivity and improving farmers' livelihoods. This project is highlighted as a crucial step in developing agricultural infrastructure and supporting national efforts toward food security and self-sufficiency.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department/Nineveh Horticulture Station, announced the commencement of olive...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department/Nineveh Horticulture Station, announced the commencement of olive oil pressing for the current season. The station is pressing olives from its own trees and also provides subsidized pressing services to citizens. Additionally, the station sells olive seedlings at reasonable prices to promote the cultivation of environmentally tolerant varieties. These activities are part of the Ministry's ongoing efforts to develop the olive oil sector, increase local production of high-quality oil, and contribute to achieving self-sufficiency with competitive national products.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The UN-Habitat and the Dutch embassy in Jordan signed a €10 million agreement to implement a four-year project aimed at boosting the resi...
records.description: The UN-Habitat and the Dutch embassy in Jordan signed a €10 million agreement to implement a four-year project aimed at boosting the resilience of Irbid and Mafraq to flood risks and climate change. The initiative seeks to enhance urban resilience by developing and implementing smart water management systems through green urban infrastructure. Building on prior climate adaptation studies, the project aims to turn flood risks into opportunities for sustainable development, reinforcing the long-standing partnership between the Netherlands and UN-Habitat in supporting environmentally sustainable infrastructure.

records.title: The Qassim Region maintains a vibrant, year-round agricultural output, particularly in leafy greens, which are valued for their nutrition...
records.description: The Qassim Region maintains a vibrant, year-round agricultural output, particularly in leafy greens, which are valued for their nutritional richness and strong market demand. Local farmers are expanding cultivated areas as these greens are economically rewarding, easy to cultivate, and allow for multiple annual harvests with low cost. Farmers utilize modern methods like drip irrigation and temperature control in greenhouses to ensure high-quality, consistent production. This sector is actively supported by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture through training and guidance, which has been crucial for boosting productivity and promoting sustainable agricultural returns.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Singapore-based Destiny Energy plans to invest $210 million to establish a green ammonia production facility in Egypt's Suez Canal Econom...
records.description: Singapore-based Destiny Energy plans to invest $210 million to establish a green ammonia production facility in Egypt's Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE). The facility is designed to produce over 100,000 tonnes of green ammonia annually and will rely entirely on future wind and solar power capacities within the SCZone to ensure environmental sustainability and lower production costs. The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) strongly supports the project, citing its strategic significance for reducing the carbon footprint of Egyptian exports and ensuring compliance with the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). GAFI reaffirmed government support through incentives, including tax rebates of up to 55% of investment costs and access to financing via the Egypt Nexus of Water, Food and Energy (NWFE) platform.
records.institution: The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)

records.title: The company Aydi successfully raised $7.5 million in a pre-seed funding round to launch ORTH, the world’s first AI-powered agricultural e...
records.description: The company Aydi successfully raised $7.5 million in a pre-seed funding round to launch ORTH, the world’s first AI-powered agricultural engineer, marking a groundbreaking step in smart farming. This cutting-edge AI platform is designed to provide farmers with advanced digital tools to make precise and timely decisions on irrigation, fertilization, and pest control, thereby addressing rising production costs and unpredictable climate conditions. The funding, which included investment from Daltex Corporation, COTU Ventures, Nuwa Capital, Magrabi Agriculture, and Foundation Ventures, will enable Aydi to scale ORTH globally, enhancing farming efficiency, minimizing resource waste, and supporting the target of increasing global food production by 70% by 2050.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP), Oman's sole procurer of new capacity, signed a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement...
records.description: The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP), Oman's sole procurer of new capacity, signed a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with a joint venture between Sembcorp and OQ Alternative Energy (OQAE) to develop the 125 MW Dhofar II Wind Power Project. With an investment of approximately RO 43 million, the project will generate about 396,754 MWh of electricity annually enough to power over 18,000 Omani households. This strategic initiative, scheduled for commercial operation in Q3 2027, marks a key milestone in Oman’s commitment to achieving net-zero emissions by 2050 and the goals of Oman Vision 2040 by significantly reducing 158,000 tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions and conserving approximately 76 million cubic meters of natural gas annually.
records.institution: The Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the General Directorate of Forests and Rangelands, held a specialized workshop on nature conservatio...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the General Directorate of Forests and Rangelands, held a specialized workshop on nature conservation and sustainable hunting in Palestine. The workshop was organized at the National Center for Agricultural Research in cooperation with the Wildlife Society in Palestine, and targeted government forest rangers in the Jenin and Tubas governorates. The goal was to enhance the rangers' capabilities, raise awareness about protecting natural resources and biodiversity, and enable them to regulate wild hunting in a way that achieves environmental sustainability.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Palestinian Hydrologists Group signed an agreement with farmers in Kafr Ra'i to construct...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Palestinian Hydrologists Group signed an agreement with farmers in Kafr Ra'i to construct a 1,000 cubic meter agricultural water reservoir and a 3,000-meter-long pipeline. The project, valued at approximately $180,000 (with farmers contributing 20%), will serve over 60 farmers and approximately 1,500 dunams of crops, enhancing supplemental irrigation and production. The initiative is funded by the Dutch government and supervised by the Cooperation Foundation, reflecting joint efforts between the Ministry and its partners to strengthen the agricultural sector and water security.

records.title: Beekeepers in the Najran Region harvested nearly 20,000 kilograms of natural Sidr honey last month, contributing significantly to the reg...
records.description: Beekeepers in the Najran Region harvested nearly 20,000 kilograms of natural Sidr honey last month, contributing significantly to the region's estimated annual production of 90 tons. Najran's environment is ideal for beekeeping due to its suitable weather and flowering plants. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef), has launched a rural development incubator to support entrepreneurs in beekeeping and honey production, enhancing their skills in strategic planning, business management, and marketing.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: A delegation from the Ministry of Agriculture's Directorate of Health and Animal Production visited the Zahid Dairy Farm to select calves...
records.description: A delegation from the Ministry of Agriculture's Directorate of Health and Animal Production visited the Zahid Dairy Farm to select calves with superior genetic traits. This initiative is part of the Ministry's plan to support and improve the genetic and productive status of livestock in the country. Calves were selected and sampled to ensure they meet approved health and technical standards before being supplied to the Ghazlaniyah Frozen Semen Production Center. This effort is a crucial step in enhancing reproductive performance, increasing the size and quality of the cattle herd, and supporting the national strategy for food security.

records.title: The International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) inaugurated a new Training and Knowledge Transfer Building, a Plant Tissue Cult...
records.description: The International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA) inaugurated a new Training and Knowledge Transfer Building, a Plant Tissue Culture Laboratory, and an Integrated Agri-Aquaculture System at its Dubai headquarters, fully funded by Al Rostamani Group. The inauguration, attended by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, marks a major milestone in strengthening ICBA’s role as a center for sustainable agriculture and innovation. The facilities will support farmers, researchers, and policymakers by developing water-efficient models and pioneering work in enabling crops to thrive in saline and arid environments, reinforcing the UAE’s National Food Security Strategy 2051.
records.institution: The International Center for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Egyptian Ministry of Public Enterprises Sector discussed the progress of the green ammonia plant project at El Nasr Fertilizers in At...
records.description: The Egyptian Ministry of Public Enterprises Sector discussed the progress of the green ammonia plant project at El Nasr Fertilizers in Ataqa, Suez, with a delegation from Envision Energy and Benchmark Power International. This key project, which involves forming a dedicated company through a partnership between El Nasr Fertilizers, Benchmark (as main developer), and Envision (as technical provider), marks a major milestone in Egypt’s transition toward sustainable industrial development. The plant, approved to operate as a free zone and running entirely on renewable energy, aims for an initial annual production capacity of 420,000 tonnes of green ammonia, with most output intended for export. The Minister emphasized that this project is central to Egypt’s green economy agenda, strengthening its position on the global clean energy map through strategic public-private partnerships.
records.institution: The Ministry of Public Enterprises Sector

records.title: The Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) is facilitating the export of local agricultural products, specifically 6,000 tonnes of potatoes...
records.description: The Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) is facilitating the export of local agricultural products, specifically 6,000 tonnes of potatoes to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) this year. This initiative is part of the KRG's efforts to support farmers and boost domestic production. The Kurdistan Region produces around 600,000 tonnes of potatoes annually, and the increasing international interest confirms the quality of Kurdistani agricultural goods.

records.title: Jordan and Syria have reopened their long-suspended water file, an important step towards restoring structured cooperation over shared re...
records.description: Jordan and Syria have reopened their long-suspended water file, an important step towards restoring structured cooperation over shared resources, particularly the Yarmouk Basin. The Jordanian Ministry of Water and Irrigation announced the establishment of the Jordanian-Syrian Joint Water Platform for improving data exchange, joint monitoring, and institutional coordination. The Syrian side has expressed readiness to address the issue of illegally drilled wells and reiterated its commitment to preserving Jordan's water share from the Wahda Dam.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation

records.title: Jordan has intensified efforts to bolster food security by purchasing approximately 60,000 metric tons of hard milling wheat from Cargill...
records.description: Jordan has intensified efforts to bolster food security by purchasing approximately 60,000 metric tons of hard milling wheat from Cargill and implementing olive oil import measures following sharp domestic production declines. The Ministry of Agriculture announced it will allow the import of an initial 4,000 tonnes of olive oil to stabilize prices, granting priority to entities like the Military Consumers Corporation and the Civil Service Consumers Corporation. All olive oil imports must be sourced from members of the International Olive Council (IOC) to ensure quality. This action is critical as the Department of Statistics (DoS) reported olive oil production stood at only 1,419 tonnes recently, far below the typical annual average of 25,000 tonnes.

records.title: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture signed an agreement with the UN-Habitat to implement a $253,000 project aimed at enhancing the ecos...
records.description: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture signed an agreement with the UN-Habitat to implement a $253,000 project aimed at enhancing the ecosystem through sustainable water harvesting in Al Husseiniya, Maan. The project will establish a water catchment pond to support agricultural and pastoral activities and strengthen water security in the arid region. The initiative aligns with the Ministry’s water harvesting strategy and the executive program of the Economic Modernisation Vision for 2026–2029, promoting the efficient use of natural resources and enhancing local community resilience against climate change.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP), Oman's sole offtaker for power and water projects, signed a 20-year Power Purchase A...
records.description: Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP), Oman's sole offtaker for power and water projects, signed a 20-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with a consortium led by Sembcorp Utilities and OQ Alternative Energy (OQAE) to develop the 125-megawatt (MW) Dhofar II Wind Power Project. Valued at approximately OMR 43 million ($112 million), the project will begin operations in 2027 and is expected to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by around 158,000 tonnes annually while conserving 76 million cubic meters of natural gas annually. The project is a major step in fulfilling Oman Vision 2040 and the national goal of achieving net-zero emissions by 2050, as Nama PWP aims to attract an additional $5 billion in renewables and add 9 GW of clean capacity by 2030.
records.institution: Nama Power and Water Procurement Company (Nama PWP)

records.title: The Directorate of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Al Batinah North, Oman, organized the Water Security Seminar to highligh...
records.description: The Directorate of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Al Batinah North, Oman, organized the Water Security Seminar to highlight the importance of water sustainability and explore alternatives to groundwater. The event focused on two main themes: "Sustainable Water Wealth," which discussed modern technologies like advanced irrigation and water recycling, and "Investment Opportunities in the Water Sector." The seminar emphasized the urgent need to reduce dependence on groundwater and promote the use of treated wastewater and desalinated water as viable alternatives, underscoring the shared responsibility of protecting water resources in line with Oman Vision 2040's environmental sustainability goals.
records.institution: The Directorate of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Al Batinah North

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman has kicked off the distribution of 15 tonnes of improved and l...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman has kicked off the distribution of 15 tonnes of improved and local wheat seeds to farmers across the Dhahirah Governorate. This initiative, which includes high-yielding, bird-resistant varieties like Wadi Quriyat 110, aims to promote strategic crop cultivation and enhance the Sultanate's self-sufficiency in wheat production. The MAFWR provides certified seeds, technical guidance, and on-field monitoring to ensure optimal yields. This effort is part of a broader national strategy under Oman Vision 2040 to expand wheat cultivation, improve seed quality, and enhance food resilience, especially given the sector's reliance on modern irrigation systems.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman launched a new initiative to support Omani beekeepers and enha...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman launched a new initiative to support Omani beekeepers and enhance the value of honeybee products like pollen, propolis, and royal jelly. The project seeks to strengthen commercial production by providing equipment, technical guidance, and monitoring. Applicants must be Omani citizens with a valid apiary license, own more than 150 beehives, and commit to meeting specific annual production targets. The initiative is being implemented in collaboration with the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund and aims to achieve sustainable growth in the sector, especially prioritizing jobseekers dedicated to beekeeping.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ), through its Chairman, affirmed that the transition to green hydrog...
records.description: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ), through its Chairman, affirmed that the transition to green hydrogen as a primary energy source in the Special Economic Zone at Al Duqm (SEZAD) is firmly on track, although natural gas will serve as a crucial bridge fuel initially. The Integrated Gas Company (IGC) recently allocated 18.614 million standard cubic metres per day of gas for industrial consumers in Al Duqm, underscoring its growing industrial prominence. New projects, such as the green steel project and the refinery, are required to factor in a transition to green hydrogen from the design stage, aligning SEZAD's decarbonization efforts with Oman Vision 2040 and the nation’s Net Zero 2050 goal.
records.institution: The Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones (OPAZ)

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture completed the signing of the fifth batch of multi-donor investment support agreements, known as t...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture completed the signing of the fifth batch of multi-donor investment support agreements, known as the “MAP 2 Project,” which is funded by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the European Union, and the governments of Denmark, Spain, Switzerland, and Italy. The latest event included the signing of 17 new agreements valued at approximately 7.5 million shekels. These projects cover plant and animal production, food processing, and include qualitative projects in hydroponics and solar energy to enhance production efficiency and sustainability, affirming the Ministry’s commitment to strengthening the resilience of farmers and the rural economy.

records.title: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia achieved a major international milestone when the Codex Alimentarius Commission (CAC) adopted the first inter...
records.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia achieved a major international milestone when the Codex Alimentarius Commission (CAC) adopted the first international standard for fresh dates during its 48th session at the FAO headquarters in Rome. This achievement took place while the Kingdom was co-chairing the working group, according to the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA). The development of this unified standard reflects the Kingdom's leading position as the world's largest exporter of dates and its influential role in shaping international food standards. The initiative, a close collaboration between the SFDA and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, aims to raise the quality and safety of dates, facilitate international trade, and align with Saudi Vision 2030 objectives to solidify the Kingdom as a global hub for date production and trade.
records.institution: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Moroccan cactus sector is undergoing a major renaissance following years of devastation by the cochineal insect, driven by the nation...
records.description: The Moroccan cactus sector is undergoing a major renaissance following years of devastation by the cochineal insect, driven by the national program for planting resistant cacti under the "Generation Green 2020-2030" strategy. The Ministry of Agriculture aims to restore 122,000 hectares by 2028 with a total investment of 1.4 billion dirhams. This scientific achievement is credited to the National Institute for Agricultural Research (INRA), which successfully identified and developed eight cactus varieties naturally resistant to the pest. This revival is crucial for combating desertification, strengthening agricultural incomes in semi-arid regions, and enhancing the sector's role in animal and human nutrition.
records.institution: The National Institute for Agricultural Research (INRA)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The World Bank has approved the Tunisian Program for Improving Energy Reliability, Efficiency and Governance (TEREG), a $430 million prog...
records.description: The World Bank has approved the Tunisian Program for Improving Energy Reliability, Efficiency and Governance (TEREG), a $430 million program to modernize Tunisia's energy sector. The program, which includes $30 million in concessional funding, aims to ensure a sustainable, reliable, and affordable electricity supply by strengthening the national electricity company (STEG). TEREG will accelerate the deployment of renewable energy and attract $2.8 billion in private investment to add 2.8 GW of new solar and wind capacity, supporting Tunisia’s long-term energy security and aiming to reduce electricity supply costs by 23%.

records.title: The hospitality property "Erth" successfully activated its Food Waste Composter (Waste Master System) in October, marking a significant m...
records.description: The hospitality property "Erth" successfully activated its Food Waste Composter (Waste Master System) in October, marking a significant milestone in its commitment to sustainability. Since its activation, the system has processed over 1,150 kilograms of food waste, converting it into nutrient-rich compost for landscaping. This achievement diverts substantial waste from landfills and underscores "Erth" leadership in responsible, sustainable Emirati hospitality, contributing directly to the UAE’s vision for a cleaner, more sustainable future.

records.title: The Algerian Ministry of Agriculture announced an allocation of 764.2 billion dinars (US$5.84 billion) to the agriculture sector under th...
records.description: The Algerian Ministry of Agriculture announced an allocation of 764.2 billion dinars (US$5.84 billion) to the agriculture sector under the 2026 Finance Bill, marking a 4% increase from the previous year. This significant investment signals the government’s determination to strengthen domestic production and reduce Algeria's dependence on food imports, which surged to US$10.97 billion in 2024. Despite agriculture contributing 13% to GDP, the sector faces challenges like low cereal yields and high post-harvest losses. The new funding will support programs focused on irrigation efficiency, seed system improvement, and technology adoption to achieve food self-sufficiency, aligning with the strategic goals of the Ministry.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain announced the return of the Bahraini Farmers’ Market, organized in coop...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain announced the return of the Bahraini Farmers’ Market, organized in cooperation with the National Initiative for Agricultural Development (NIAD) and STC Bahrain. The market, opening at the Budaiya Botanical Garden, will feature 32 Bahraini farmers, local brands, and artisans. This initiative is a core pillar of national food security, providing a direct marketing platform linking farmers with consumers, encouraging product diversification, and reflecting strong royal support for the agricultural sector's development and growth.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: Egypt's Ministry of Supply and Foreign Trade approved the establishment of Feerum Egypt, a new joint-stock company that will locally manu...
records.description: Egypt's Ministry of Supply and Foreign Trade approved the establishment of Feerum Egypt, a new joint-stock company that will locally manufacture grain storage silos, marking a major step toward self-sufficiency in storage infrastructure. The company, jointly owned by Samcrete Egypt and Feerum S.A. (Poland), aims to achieve 80% local component production within three years and deliver equipment supporting a total storage capacity of 1.4 million tonnes. This initiative is a cornerstone of the government's strategic plan to modernize its storage system, minimize post-harvest losses, and position Egypt as a regional grain storage hub.
records.institution: The Ministry of Supply and Foreign Trade

records.title: The Suez Canal Authority (SCA), led by Admiral Ossama Rabiee, announced the transit of the container ship CMA CGM BENJAMIN FRANKLIN, the...
records.description: The Suez Canal Authority (SCA), led by Admiral Ossama Rabiee, announced the transit of the container ship CMA CGM BENJAMIN FRANKLIN, the largest vessel to pass through the Suez Canal in the past two years. This transit, along with the rerouting of another CMA CGM vessel, reflects a gradual return of large container vessels to the Red Sea and the Suez Canal, signaling improving regional conditions and the success of the SCA's marketing policies and operational incentives.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture announced the start of registration for farmers to receive free olive saplings as part of its progra...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture announced the start of registration for farmers to receive free olive saplings as part of its program to support and develop olive cultivation, a strategic crop. Registration is open from November 12 to November 20, 2025. Farmers must be registered in the Ministry's farmers' registry, and the maximum allocation is 20 saplings per farmer. The Ministry specifies recommended varieties by region (Sourani, Qaisi, and Khodairi). This program aims to expand olive groves, improve seedling quality, and enhance food security and the rural economy in Lebanon.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its Mount Lebanon Agricultural Department and the Aley Agricultural Center, organized an ol...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its Mount Lebanon Agricultural Department and the Aley Agricultural Center, organized an olive tree training seminar in Majdalia, Aley, in cooperation with the Majdalia Municipality. The seminar targeted approximately 30 farmers and focused on practical topics, including proper pruning techniques, to improve olive productivity and oil quality. This initiative is part of the Ministry's National Agricultural Extension Program to enhance agricultural knowledge and encourage smallholders to register in the agricultural registry to access future support programs and projects.

records.title: The Palestinian Water Authority, in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, held a specialized workshop in Ramallah to discuss inve...
records.description: The Palestinian Water Authority, in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, held a specialized workshop in Ramallah to discuss investment opportunities in treated wastewater from the Hebron Regional Wastewater Treatment Plant. The project, valued at over $70 million and funded by the French Development Agency (AFD), the World Bank, and the European Union, aims to transform wastewater into a strategic, productive economic resource. The treatment plant, expected to be operational by mid-2026 with a capacity of 15,000 cubic meters per day, will strengthen the resilience of citizens, enhance water and food security in Palestine, and represents a key step toward achieving Palestinian sovereignty over its water resources.

records.title: Fourth Milling Co., one of the privatized milling entities in Saudi Arabia, signed a civil works agreement worth approximately SAR 265 mi...
records.description: Fourth Milling Co., one of the privatized milling entities in Saudi Arabia, signed a civil works agreement worth approximately SAR 265 million ($70.7 million) to begin construction of a major new flour mill and feed plant in Al-Kharj. The investment, which has received approval from the General Food Security Authority (GFSA), will fund a 750-tonne-per-day (tpd) flour mill and a new 240-tpd feed mill. This significant expansion aims to enhance the company's ability to serve domestic and regional demand for flour and animal feed, playing a key role in supporting the Kingdom’s national food security and self-sufficiency objectives under Saudi Vision 2030.

records.title: Tanmiah Food Company, a leading Saudi poultry producer, has partnered with the geothermal technology firm Strataphy to establish the MENA...
records.description: Tanmiah Food Company, a leading Saudi poultry producer, has partnered with the geothermal technology firm Strataphy to establish the MENA region's first geothermal-cooled poultry facility at its Shaqrah site. The project utilizes Strataphy's technology, which relies on stable subsurface temperatures, offering a high-efficiency, low-carbon alternative to conventional air conditioning. The system is implemented under Strataphy's Cooling as a Service (CAS) model. This initiative, which aligns with the objectives of the Saudi AgriFood Tech Alliance, aims to significantly reduce energy dependence in the agri-food sector and position Saudi Arabia as a potential leader in scalable, low-carbon agricultural technology.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) concluded the AlUla dates auction, achieving a 48% increase in sales compared to last season.
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) concluded the AlUla dates auction, achieving a 48% increase in sales compared to last season. The auction, a flagship event of the sixth AlUla Dates Season, recorded total sales exceeding 2,000 tons of premium dates and generated revenues surpassing SAR 13 million. The event featured participation from more than 1,600 farmers and attracted strong interest from traders and investors. This success reaffirms AlUla’s position as a leading agricultural hub and highlights the RCU's efforts to support farmers and boost the competitiveness of local products in global markets.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture inaugurated the fourth annual BIOFACH SAUDI ARABIA exhibition, one of the world’...
records.description: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture inaugurated the fourth annual BIOFACH SAUDI ARABIA exhibition, one of the world’s leading organic products showcases. The three-day event, held at the Riyadh International Convention & Exhibition Centre (RICEC), aims to support and enhance the organic agriculture sector, attract investors, and engage stakeholders in sustainable practices. Organized in strategic partnership with the Saudi Organic Farming Association (SOFA), the exhibition features at least 53 exhibitors from nine countries and hosts specialized workshops, all contributing to the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Tunisia launched a large-scale national soil sampling campaign, led by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)...
records.description: Tunisia launched a large-scale national soil sampling campaign, led by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries. This initiative, part of the SoilFER-VACS project funded by the Government of Japan, aims to collect approximately 3,200 samples to create an up-to-date database on soil composition and fertility. The primary goal is to develop high-resolution digital maps that will serve as strategic tools for policymakers and farmers, guiding agricultural policies, combating soil degradation (which affects nearly 50% of agricultural land), and strengthening the resilience of agricultural systems to climate challenges.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: Emirates Rawabi PSC, a leading integrated agribusiness group, entered into a strategic partnership with ReFarm Global Investments LLC, a...
records.description: Emirates Rawabi PSC, a leading integrated agribusiness group, entered into a strategic partnership with ReFarm Global Investments LLC, a pioneer in regenerative and circular sustainability technologies. This collaboration aims to revolutionize the UAE's food production and landscaping industries by creating a new model of circular agribusiness. The partnership will combine their expertise to deliver cost-efficient, carbon-conscious, and regenerative solutions that strengthen food security, enhance soil health, drastically reduce water use, and support the development of sustainable urban greening master plans.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is aggressively advancing the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, a strategic pro...
records.description: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is aggressively advancing the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, a strategic project that exemplifies the UAE's push for clean energy leadership. The solar park’s total production capacity has reached 3,860 MW, with a target to exceed 8,000 MW by 2030—a 60% increase over the original plan. This expansion supports the UAE Consensus target of tripling renewables globally and significantly contributes to the Dubai Clean Energy Strategy 2050, aiming for 100% clean energy capacity by 2050. DEWA implements these projects using the independent power producer (IPP) model and advanced technologies to build a sustainable and innovative green economy.
records.institution: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA)

records.title: The Livestock Festival has begun with strong participation from breeders across the UAE as part of the Fourth Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Ag...
records.description: The Livestock Festival has begun with strong participation from breeders across the UAE as part of the Fourth Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award, organized by the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA). The festival aims to support the livestock sector's development and enhance its contribution to national food security, offering total prizes worth AED 2.624 million. The event, which kicked off in Al Dhafra with the "Best Weights" competition, marks the start of a series of contests running until February 2026, featuring three main categories: Best Weights, Best Breeds, and Best Milk Production. The festival serves as a leading platform to promote excellence, innovation, and sustainable practices in livestock production across all emirates.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Cairo 3A, a vertically integrated agri-commodity group, announced an ambitious $150 million investment plan over three years to boost its...
records.description: Cairo 3A, a vertically integrated agri-commodity group, announced an ambitious $150 million investment plan over three years to boost its industrial production capacity and achieve annual exports of $350 million by 2028. The investment includes developing Egypt's first citric acid production plant, valued at $35 million, and expanding existing production lines for products like sorbitol and starch derivatives.
