This strategy, which aims to reduce the country's import bill and increase the export share to 40-50%, is supported by the cultivation of maize and soybeans and a target of 60,000 tonnes of annual poultry meat production.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Jordan Valley Authority organized a field visit to the King Tal...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Jordan Valley Authority organized a field visit to the King Talal Dam to showcase a pilot project featuring a water-cooled floating solar energy system. This pioneering project, which the Jordan Valley Authority uses to power its facilities, generates clean energy while boosting panel efficiency by 5–15% and reducing water evaporation by up to 90%. The initiative is part of the Authority's strategic plan to promote a green transition in the water sector, where electricity costs are high. The Ministry of Agriculture and the National Agricultural Research Center both affirmed that the project supports their commitment to expanding clean energy use in irrigation and agricultural production, exemplifying effective cooperation toward achieving food and water security.

records.title: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture announced it will permit the import of an initial 4,000 tonnes of olive oil to stabilize prices and...
records.description: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture announced it will permit the import of an initial 4,000 tonnes of olive oil to stabilize prices and ensure high-quality supply following a sharp decline in local production. Import priority will be granted to entities including the Military Consumers Corporation, the Civil Service Consumers Corporation, the Syndicate of Olive Press Owners, and the Farmers Union. Imports will be sourced only from member states of the International Olive Council (IOC) to ensure quality and will be restricted to containers not exceeding four kilogrammes for most entities to prevent market exploitation.

records.title: The Jordanian Ministry of Investment and the Ministry of Agriculture signed a main developer agreement for the Agricultural and Developme...
records.description: The Jordanian Ministry of Investment and the Ministry of Agriculture signed a main developer agreement for the Agricultural and Development Industries Complex in Ghor Al Mazraa and Al Hadeetha, following a Cabinet decision to designate the area as a development zone. The Ministry of Agriculture will begin implementing infrastructure works in stages starting in 2026. This complex, which is expected to create over 300 direct jobs and benefit around 5,000 farmers, aims to absorb surplus agricultural production, enhance value chains through modern food processing, reduce import costs, and strengthen small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), aligning with the Royal Economic Modernisation Vision (EMV).
records.institution: The Ministry of Investment and the Ministry of Agriculture

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Moroccan citrus sector in the Souss-Massa region is facing an acute climate challenge from a rare, severe autumn heatwave (potentiall...
records.description: The Moroccan citrus sector in the Souss-Massa region is facing an acute climate challenge from a rare, severe autumn heatwave (potentially reaching $36^{\circ}\text{C}$ in Taroudant) following one of the driest Octobers on record. This extreme weather, coupled with chronic drought, poses an immediate threat to the current citrus cycle, risking premature fruit drop, reduced size, and increased acidity, thereby compromising export quality. The prolonged drought has already forced the disappearance or uprooting of nearly 30% of the national citrus area (about 40,000 hectares) since 2018, and groundwater levels in the Souss region have fallen dramatically to 600 meters. Experts are urging a structural adaptation of the Moroccan agricultural model beyond dam construction, including regulating irrigated areas, integrating agroforestry, and converting to more water-efficient crops like carob or almond trees, to ensure the sector’s long-term viability.

records.title: The Moroccan National Federation of Milling (FNM) signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Cereals Canada to deepen comme...
records.description: The Moroccan National Federation of Milling (FNM) signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Cereals Canada to deepen commercial and technical cooperation, reinforcing stable trade between the two nations. Morocco relies heavily on high-grade Canadian durum wheat importing 1.1 million metric tonnes in a recent year for its couscous and pasta industries. The FNM sees the agreement as vital for securing premium wheat supply, driving innovation, and reinforcing Morocco’s regional leadership in processing. The partnership includes knowledge transfer and technical engagement to help Moroccan processors optimize milling and final product performance.
records.institution: The Moroccan National Federation of Milling (FNM)

records.title: The new tomato season in Morocco's Souss-Massa region is off to a promising start, with sustained vegetative growth and the earliest harv...
records.description: The new tomato season in Morocco's Souss-Massa region is off to a promising start, with sustained vegetative growth and the earliest harvests beginning in the Agadir area. However, the season is marked by high humidity (sometimes reaching 100% relative humidity for over ten hours), creating a high risk for fungal diseases like cladosporium leaf spot and downy mildew. Producers are urged to strengthen disease monitoring, optimize greenhouse ventilation, and judiciously use approved fungicide treatments. Despite these phytosanitary risks, the 2025/2026 campaign remains promising for vegetable growers due to consistently high demand from European markets.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oxy Oman, a subsidiary of Occidental, has launched a first-of-its-kind pilot project using carbon dioxide CO₂ for enhanced oil recovery (...
records.description: Oxy Oman, a subsidiary of Occidental, has launched a first-of-its-kind pilot project using carbon dioxide CO₂ for enhanced oil recovery (EOR) in its Block 9 concession, with potential for replication across its portfolio. The project, launched in 2023 at the Safah Field, aims to increase oil recovery from mature fields while supporting Oman's decarbonization and net-zero ambitions. If successful, this initiative will integrate carbon capture and storage (CCS) with existing operations to deliver carbon-neutral oil. Additionally, Oxy signed an MoU with OQ Gas Networks (OQGN) to explore an integrated carbon management platform and is exploring renewable energy integration with OQ Alternative Energy.

records.title: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in North Al Batinah Governorate, Oman, organized a water security s...
records.description: The Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in North Al Batinah Governorate, Oman, organized a water security symposium under the auspices of the Governor of North Al Batinah. The event featured two dialogue sessions on key water security issues. The symposium also included an exhibition showcasing equipment used for water quality testing and highlighting the Directorate's efforts in monitoring water quality and implementing water projects. The primary focus was on raising public awareness about preserving water resources and ensuring their sustainability for future generations.
records.institution: Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in North Al Batinah Governorat

records.title: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) issued Ministerial Decision No.
records.description: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) issued Ministerial Decision No. 258/2025, announcing a ban on the import of live birds and related products from several European regions due to animal health concerns. The affected regions include Gelderland (Netherlands), Žilina (Slovakia), West Flanders and Antwerp (Belgium), Nordland (Norway), and Zeeland and the southern region of Denmark. The Ministry stated that the ban will remain in force until the health reasons are resolved. Products that have been heat-treated or processed in accordance with the World Organisation for Animal Health standards are exempt.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that the Governor of Riyadh Region, the Prince inaugurated 82 development pr...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that the Governor of Riyadh Region, the Prince inaugurated 82 development projects and laid the foundation stone for 99 new development projects, totaling 181 initiatives with a massive cost exceeding SR 38.1 billion for the Riyadh region. These projects are aimed at enhancing environmental and water sustainability in line with Saudi Vision 2030. Projects implemented by the National Water Company and the Saudi Water Authority focus on expanding drinking water distribution and sanitation services.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Syrian Honey Festival kicked off in Damascus under the patronage of the Minister of Agriculture, The festival was organized by the Ar...
records.description: The Syrian Honey Festival kicked off in Damascus under the patronage of the Minister of Agriculture, The festival was organized by the Arab Beekeepers Union – Syria Branch, with support from the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD). The event aims to support the beekeeping sector, help it overcome challenges, unify the efforts of beekeepers, and promote Syrian honey as a valuable agricultural product for domestic and international markets.
records.institution: Arab Beekeepers Union – Syria Branch, The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The microfinance institution Enda Tamweel in Tunisia will grant loans totaling 40 million dinars to help farmers finance their projects.
records.description: The microfinance institution Enda Tamweel in Tunisia will grant loans totaling 40 million dinars to help farmers finance their projects. The funding is intended for farmers currently facing financial difficulties. Projects eligible for this financing include livestock farming, cereal cultivation, fishing, fish farming, olive cultivation and harvesting, and the cultivation of fruit trees, vegetables, and dates. The loans offer flexible repayment terms designed to align with the farmer's seasonal income.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA) in Siliana, Tunisia, reported that planting for the 2025-2026 season has reac...
records.description: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA) in Siliana, Tunisia, reported that planting for the 2025-2026 season has reached 30% for cereal crops and 79% for forage crops. The region's total planned cereal acreage is estimated at 155,500 hectares, with a required 65,300 quintals of selected seeds. The CRDA has already made available 59% of the required high-quality seeds to farmers, along with quantities of ordinary barley seed and essential fertilizers, such as Super 45 phosphate and diammonium phosphate (DPA).
records.institution: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Egyptian Ministry of Electricity and Germany signed a €50 million debt swap agreement to finance grid connection projects for two win...
records.description: The Egyptian Ministry of Electricity and Germany signed a €50 million debt swap agreement to finance grid connection projects for two wind farms in Ras Ghareb and Jebel Zeit. The agreement converts part of Egypt’s debt into a grant, to be disbursed in two equal tranches. This initiative supports Egypt’s strategy to diversify its electricity mix, increase the contribution of renewable energy to over 42% by 2030, reduce carbon emissions, and encourage private sector participation in clean energy projects.

records.title: The Iraqi National Investment Commission (NIC) has commenced the planting works for the Baghdad Sustainable Forests Project, which is the...
records.description: The Iraqi National Investment Commission (NIC) has commenced the planting works for the Baghdad Sustainable Forests Project, which is the largest urban afforestation initiative in the capital. The project aims to transform the former Al-Rashid Camp area from a site of waste and pollution into a vast green, sustainable space with major recreational and commercial facilities. The NIC is leading this effort to attract investors and is collaborating with relevant government bodies. The initiative involves planting native and climate-resilient tree species and reflects the government's commitment to combating pollution and enhancing the quality of life in Baghdad, with local community participation being crucial for the project’s long-term success.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Royal Scientific Society (RSS) in Jordan launched a new pilot project focused on integrated aquaponics farming at the Rouh Al Sharq C...
records.description: The Royal Scientific Society (RSS) in Jordan launched a new pilot project focused on integrated aquaponics farming at the Rouh Al Sharq Centre for Persons with Disabilities, funded by the European Union (EU) as part of the "Baraka" project. This initiative aims to promote climate-smart agriculture and sustainable lifestyles by transferring scientific knowledge and supporting the green transition. The project was highlighted as a model of effective cooperation between local and international partners in advancing innovation and strengthening the resilience of vulnerable and marginalized communities in Jordan.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture signed 27 grant agreements with farmers in the Qalqilya and Tulkarm governorates, totaling about...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture signed 27 grant agreements with farmers in the Qalqilya and Tulkarm governorates, totaling about 1.112 million shekels, with 95% funding from the European Union (EU). This initiative, part of the EU-funded agricultural assistance program, aims to improve the agricultural business environment, achieve sustainable economic development, and specifically strengthen the resilience of farmers in areas like Qalqilya that face repeated attacks. The program's activities include building and renewing agricultural infrastructure, reclaiming land, developing water sources (reservoirs and wells), and enhancing the plant and livestock sectors through the supply of equipment, solar energy units, and farm animals.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Agriculture Directorate, supervised the distribution of 1,236 cubes of salt an...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Agriculture Directorate, supervised the distribution of 1,236 cubes of salt and energy stones (molasses) to 309 sheep farmers in the governorate. This initiative was carried out by CARE International as part of the Palestinian Marketplace Field Schools (FFBS) project for sheep breeders. The support, which included 14 field schools, aims to enhance the efficiency and improve the productivity of the local herd. The Ministry affirmed that this intervention is part of its ongoing programs to support the sustainability of the livestock sector and enhance cooperation with international institutions.

records.title: The National Chamber of Butchers in Tunisia has painted an alarming picture of the red meat sector, characterized by soaring prices, scar...
records.description: The National Chamber of Butchers in Tunisia has painted an alarming picture of the red meat sector, characterized by soaring prices, scarcity of local production, and the government's perceived inaction against structural difficulties like smuggling and disorganization. The Chamber's president warned that production costs have become "unbearable," pushing prices beyond the Tunisian consumer's reach. He argued for an immediate solution: opening the Tunisian market to more affordable Brazilian meat, citing examples from other Arab nations. However, the long-term solution requires a national recovery plan to rebuild the decimated local livestock sector, urging the Ministry of Agriculture to coordinate with professional bodies, as communication between them has been severely lacking since 2018.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) officially opened the Al Wathba Food Festival as part of the Fourth Sheikh M...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) officially opened the Al Wathba Food Festival as part of the Fourth Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Agricultural Excellence Award. The festival aims to promote sustainable food security, encourage local production, and celebrate Emirati food heritage through 14 culinary competitions offering AED 362,000 in prizes. The event provides a crucial platform for productive families to showcase their talents and contribute to the local economy. It reinforces ADAFSA's commitment to empowering local farmers and advancing the UAE Food Security Strategy 2051 by blending heritage with innovation.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The largest edition of Global Food Week concluded in Abu Dhabi with historic success, securing 58 agreements valued at Dh6.6 billion and...
records.description: The largest edition of Global Food Week concluded in Abu Dhabi with historic success, securing 58 agreements valued at Dh6.6 billion and attracting over 40,108 attendees (a 16% increase). Held under the patronage of the Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the week featured major exhibitions like the Abu Dhabi International Food Exhibition and the Abu Dhabi Date Palm Exhibition, alongside new initiatives. These included the debut AgriTech Forum and the Agricultural Investment Forum, aimed at empowering food producers, fostering sustainable development, and showcasing over 30 investment opportunities. Key discussions focused on food security, resilient food systems, innovation, technology, and best global practices, while the launch of the Alternative Proteins Initiative (PALT) by the Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) highlighted innovations in plant-based and cultivated protein products.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Jawf Governorate, Yemen, launched a 20-day national veterinary campaign to vaccinate and treat livestock ac...
records.description: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Jawf Governorate, Yemen, launched a 20-day national veterinary campaign to vaccinate and treat livestock across 13 districts. The campaign aims to protect over 650,000 heads of livestock from widespread diseases like sheep plague and smallpox, thereby ensuring the sustainability of income sources for thousands of families and supporting the national economy. The initiative is being implemented by 39 field teams comprising 156 veterinarians, with support and guidance from the Ministry of Agriculture's General Directorate of Animal Health and Veterinary Quarantine and local authorities. The launch included a training workshop for participants to ensure maximum efficiency and comprehensive coverage of all targeted areas.
records.institution: The Agricultural Sector in Al-Jawf Governorate

records.title: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture signed agreements to allocate six agricultural plots in Hoorat A'ali, covering 40,...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture signed agreements to allocate six agricultural plots in Hoorat A'ali, covering 40,138 square meters, to Bahraini farmers through a public auction on the Government Land Investment Platform. This initiative, supported by the National Initiative for Agricultural Development (NIAD), is part of the Ministry's strategy to strengthen food security and develop the agricultural sector. The allocated plots come equipped with essential infrastructure, including treated and desalinated water and irrigation networks, to empower local farmers and expand sustainable local production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Egyptian Ministry of Local Development and Acting Ministry of Environment asserted Egypt's significant steps toward diversifying its...
records.description: The Egyptian Ministry of Local Development and Acting Ministry of Environment asserted Egypt's significant steps toward diversifying its energy mix, aiming for 42% clean electricity by 2030. This goal is supported by the country's leading projects in solar, wind, and green hydrogen, alongside investments in energy efficiency and green ammonia. The Ministry emphasized that achieving this transition, which is estimated to cost $250 billion by 2050, requires an equitable global partnership, including technology transfer and concessional climate finance, to address the challenges faced by developing countries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Local Development and the Ministry of Environment

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, launched an extensive campaign to combat the red palm weevil...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, launched an extensive campaign to combat the red palm weevil in Diyala and other governorates. The campaign involves mobilizing technical teams for inspection, control operations, and the use of pheromone traps and specialized pesticides. The Ministry is stressing cooperation with orchard owners to implement preventative measures, such as reducing water levels and dusting pruning wounds, to protect orchards and prevent the spread of the destructive insect.

records.title: The African Institute for Research in Sustainable Agriculture (ASARI), part of Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P) and operational...
records.description: The African Institute for Research in Sustainable Agriculture (ASARI), part of Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P) and operational in Laâyoune, is a major scientific hub developing resilient agricultural solutions for arid environments and climate change adaptation in Morocco and Africa. The Institute focuses on five research programs, including sustainable water management and biorefining, and has already developed practical innovations such as a patented biopesticide effective against the destructive cactus mealybug and a drought/salinity-resistant forage species, Blue Panicum. ASARI emphasizes knowledge transfer through demonstration platforms and aims to be a regional cooperation hub for arid-adapted agriculture, supporting farmers and strengthening regional food security.
records.institution: The African Institute for Research in Sustainable Agriculture (ASARI)

records.title: The province of Boujdour in the Moroccan Sahara is establishing itself as an emerging agricultural region through major hydro-agricultura...
records.description: The province of Boujdour in the Moroccan Sahara is establishing itself as an emerging agricultural region through major hydro-agricultural projects aligned with the New Development Model for the Southern Provinces and the Generation Green 2020-2030 strategy. These projects, exemplified by the Oudiyat Tious development, focus on sustainable agriculture in arid zones. Initiatives rely heavily on drip irrigation, the use of photovoltaic panels for energy self-sufficiency, and desalination to utilize marine resources.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that the Governor of Riyadh Region will inaugurate and lay the foundation st...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced that the Governor of Riyadh Region will inaugurate and lay the foundation stone for 181 environmental, water, and agricultural projects in the Riyadh Region, with a massive total cost exceeding SAR 38.1 billion. The projects, which include 82 initiatives costing over SAR 9.8 billion and 99 new projects worth SAR 28.3 billion, aim to enhance sustainability, improve the quality of services provided to citizens, and strengthen food and water security in line with Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Egypt has significantly increased its garlic exports to Spain, reflecting a shift in the European market due to declining Spanish product...
records.description: Egypt has significantly increased its garlic exports to Spain, reflecting a shift in the European market due to declining Spanish production. According to EastFruit analysts, Spain imported over 3,000 tons of Egyptian garlic in a recent period, a fivefold increase year-on-year that exceeded the previous decade's cumulative total by 50%. This surge is driven by lower prices for Egyptian imports compared to Spanish garlic, whose local output has fallen due to drought and rising costs.

records.title: Jordan's Minister of Agriculture, affirmed the strong relationship between Egypt and Jordan, particularly in the vital agricultural secto...
records.description: Jordan's Minister of Agriculture, affirmed the strong relationship between Egypt and Jordan, particularly in the vital agricultural sector, following the conclusion of the eighth session of the Joint Egyptian-Jordanian Agricultural Technical Committee. The committee discussed establishing Jordanian private-sector companies in Egypt to produce seeds and pesticides as a joint investment supported by the two countries' ministries of agriculture. These companies are expected to begin operations soon, enhancing agricultural production and strengthening food security and economic integration across agricultural supply chains in both nations.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has renewed and strengthened its cooperation with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has renewed and strengthened its cooperation with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD) to enhance agricultural development and food security. The collaboration, valued at over $600,000, focuses on exchanging expertise in sustainable development and transferring modern technology to Lebanese farmers. As a result, the Ministry received a significant shipment of high-quality saplings and agricultural materials, including 200,000 olive saplings, 1,500 pistachio seedlings, and 3,000 saffron corms. The partners also agreed to implement a joint project to produce high-quality olive saplings and expand pistachio cultivation in suitable Lebanese regions, which aligns with the Ministry’s 2026–2035 vision for strengthening value chains and climate resilience.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its Forestry Center in Tannourine, organized a specialized educational seminar on proper ap...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its Forestry Center in Tannourine, organized a specialized educational seminar on proper apple tree pruning as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. The seminar, attended by registered farmers and local officials, was highlighted by the Minister of Agriculture's emphasis on the importance of registering in the agricultural registry to access support and guidance. At the seminar's conclusion, specialized pruning equipment (a chainsaw and electric shears) was distributed to registered farmers. This equipment was provided by the CEL Foundation according to a transparent mechanism approved by the Ministry, with the aim of empowering farmers and encouraging them to adopt modern, sustainable practices.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The National Development Agency (NDA) announced the launch of Libya's first large agricultural project powered by clean energy, located a...
records.description: The National Development Agency (NDA) announced the launch of Libya's first large agricultural project powered by clean energy, located at the 87 Umm Al-Dhalal Agricultural Project near Sebha. The initiative involved implementing a solar system with a total production capacity of 146.2 kilowatts (kW). This system powers two underground irrigation pumps (60 HP and 50 HP) and the center-pivot irrigation tower for an estimated 50 hectares of farmland. This national initiative enhances the sustainability of agricultural operations, reduces reliance on the weak public electricity grid, and promotes the transition to clean renewable energy sources in strategic development projects.

records.title: The Moroccan Hass avocado campaign has kicked off with prices 20% lower than last season due to the European market being flooded with si...
records.description: The Moroccan Hass avocado campaign has kicked off with prices 20% lower than last season due to the European market being flooded with significant, late volumes from Latin America, particularly Peru and Chile. This intense competition follows a "disastrous" start for Moroccan green-skinned varieties, which were undercut by abundant Israeli supply. According to exporter, the low prices are expected to persist until early next year due to high global supply and low holiday demand. Moroccan exporters, represented by companies like Mavoca, are attempting to mitigate the challenge by focusing on offering better quality and larger sizes later in the season.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The National Agency for Energy Management (ANME) in Tunisia is driving a national energy strategy focused on leveraging waste recovery wi...
records.description: The National Agency for Energy Management (ANME) in Tunisia is driving a national energy strategy focused on leveraging waste recovery within the circular economy framework to tackle growing energy and environmental challenges. According to the Director General, the strategy prioritizes solar and wind power but also aims to diversify energy sources through waste exploitation, which accounts for about 20% of global electricity production. Tunisia has established a favorable legal framework, including the Energy Transition Fund to finance projects, and set the purchase price of electricity produced from biogas at 307 millimes per kilowatt-hour (double the solar energy price) to attract private investment.
records.institution: The National Agency for Energy Management (ANME)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Dubai Municipality has opened registration for the fifth season of the Farmers’ Market, set to run from December 6, 2025, to February 8,...
records.description: Dubai Municipality has opened registration for the fifth season of the Farmers’ Market, set to run from December 6, 2025, to February 8, 2026, at Quranic Park in Al Khawaneej. The initiative brings together 41 Emirati farmers and 16 local product and agricultural supply owners to showcase their fresh and organic goods directly to consumers. The market supports farm and business development, aims to boost local agricultural output, and encourages sustainable practices, aligning with Dubai Municipality’s efforts to strengthen local agriculture through logistical assistance, training, and advisory services.

records.title: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture announced it will accept applications for olive oil imports for a short period to ensure sufficient...
records.description: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture announced it will accept applications for olive oil imports for a short period to ensure sufficient supply, quality, and price stability in local markets following a decline in domestic production. The Ministry confirmed that imports will only be permitted from member countries of the International Olive Council to guarantee the quality of imported products. Companies and institutions wishing to import must submit required official documents, and a specialized team will review all applications. This strategic move aims to balance supply and demand and prevent unjustified price increases while continuing to monitor and support the local olive sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched an electronic tagging platform for sheep across all governorates of the Kingdom.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched an electronic tagging platform for sheep across all governorates of the Kingdom. The Ministry confirmed the completion of preparations across 47 tagging centers to begin operations. This initiative targets new livestock owners and those whose holdings have not been previously electronically tagged, as part of the Ministry's efforts to organize the livestock sector and improve the accuracy of related data. The Ministry urged breeders to register via its online platform and visit local Directorates of Agriculture for details on the process.

records.title: Morocco is marking its first participation in the China International Import Expo (CIIE) in Shanghai, aiming to strengthen its presence i...
records.description: Morocco is marking its first participation in the China International Import Expo (CIIE) in Shanghai, aiming to strengthen its presence in major global markets. The Moroccan pavilion is showcasing the richness and quality of national agri-food products under the "Morocco, Kingdom of Taste" banner, which is managed by Morocco Foodex. This strategic participation aligns with the country's Generation Green 2020-2030 objective: to diversify trade, make agri-food exports a driver of national development, and capitalize on the growing Asian demand for premium, traceable products.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) reports that soil degradation is a silent but relentless global crisis,...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) reports that soil degradation is a silent but relentless global crisis, now affecting nearly 1.7 billion people worldwide and reducing agricultural yields. For Morocco, this crisis is particularly urgent, as over 90% of the country is considered vulnerable to desertification. The degradation, attributed to overgrazing, salinization, and climate change, results in significant losses of fertile land and jeopardizes the nation's efforts to achieve food sovereignty. Moroccan researchers and the FAO call for integrating sustainable soil management into national agricultural and climate policies, promoting agroecological techniques like crop rotation and efficient irrigation to preserve this vital living asset.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Social Development, in collaboration with the Nuba Municipality, supervised t...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Social Development, in collaboration with the Nuba Municipality, supervised the signing of 8 agreements by the Applied Research Institute – Jerusalem (ARIJ) to rehabilitate domestic and agricultural wells in Nuba, Hebron Governorate. Supported by the World Food Programme (WFP), this initiative is part of the project to develop livelihoods and resilience to climate change. The project aims to enhance water security and improve the livelihoods of vulnerable rural families by providing sustainable water sources, thereby improving agricultural production in water-scarce areas.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture signed 48 grant agreements with farmers from the Bethlehem and Hebron governorates, totaling abou...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture signed 48 grant agreements with farmers from the Bethlehem and Hebron governorates, totaling about 2 million shekels, as part of the European Union (EU)-funded agricultural assistance program. This funding, which covers up to 95% of project costs, is intended to enhance farmer resilience and improve the agricultural production environment. The projects encompass various interventions, including protected agriculture, livestock breeding, irrigation networks, and the establishment of greenhouses. This round of agreements continues a series of grants that now total 319 agreements across seven governorates in the West Bank.

records.title: SALIC, a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and global agri-tech leader Syngenta Crop Protection AG (Syngenta), have signed...
records.description: SALIC, a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and global agri-tech leader Syngenta Crop Protection AG (Syngenta), have signed a Letter of Intent (LOI) to explore joint projects aimed at creating a resilient agri-food sector in Saudi Arabia and globally. The collaboration will focus on areas like sustainable farming, digital agriculture, soil health, and crop protection solutions. Potential projects include climate-smart farming, water conservation, and the creation of centers of excellence for capacity building and knowledge transfer. Both entities affirm that this strategic partnership is intended to enhance resource efficiency and strengthen the Kingdom’s food security.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Syrian Ministry of Energy signed final concession agreements with an international consortium led by Urbacon Holding (including Urbac...
records.description: The Syrian Ministry of Energy signed final concession agreements with an international consortium led by Urbacon Holding (including Urbacon Concessions Investment, Kalyon G.I.S. Energy, Cengiz Energy, and Power International) to build and operate eight new power generation stations with a total capacity of 5,000 megawatts (MW). This major undertaking, part of the Qatari project package in Syria, involves four natural-gas-fired combined-cycle power plants (totaling 4,000 MW) and four solar renewable energy projects (totaling 1,000 MW). The project is a pivotal stage in rehabilitating Syria's energy system, driving economic growth by providing stable electricity essential for restoring factories and launching new industrial, agricultural, and commercial ventures, while generating thousands of job opportunities.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Egypt's Acting Environment Minister, announced that the Green Climate Fund (GCF) Board has approved $50 million for climate-tech investme...
records.description: Egypt's Acting Environment Minister, announced that the Green Climate Fund (GCF) Board has approved $50 million for climate-tech investments in Egypt. This funding is part of the larger Novastar Investment Fund III, a $200 million equity venture targeting five African countries. The funds will be allocated to support climate-tech start-ups and growth-stage firms in three primary sectors: enhancing adaptation and resilience, developing low-emission technologies to reduce carbon intensity, and finding innovative solutions for natural resource management. This program is crucial for expanding mitigation and adaptation investments in Egypt and building a strong climate-tech innovation ecosystem.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Research, achieved a major success in improving irrigation wate...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Research, achieved a major success in improving irrigation water quality in the Najaf Governorate desert. As part of the fodder crop seed propagation and processing program, the Department established a well water filtration system to remove hydrocarbons that previously made farming impossible by obstructing seed germination. This pioneering research and technical intervention has yielded positive results, improving irrigation water quality, increasing agricultural productivity at the desert research station, and representing a major step towards enabling sustained agriculture in the desert region.

records.title: A pioneering agricultural initiative in Jerash is introducing hydroponic farming as a modern solution to water scarcity, aiming to streng...
records.description: A pioneering agricultural initiative in Jerash is introducing hydroponic farming as a modern solution to water scarcity, aiming to strengthen Jordan's national food security. According to the Director of the Land and Irrigation Directorate at the Ministry of Agriculture, the hydroponic system is highly efficient, saving 70 to 90 per cent of water compared with traditional farming methods while doubling or even tripling crop yields. Given Jordan's limited water resources, the government is prioritizing this method within national development plans. Investment is being encouraged through training programs and the establishment of model projects across various governorates, such as the pilot project growing white cotton in a closed, water-recycling system.

records.title: Morocco has become the overwhelming supplier of imported peppers to Spain, accounting for 91.92% of the record purchase volume during a r...
records.description: Morocco has become the overwhelming supplier of imported peppers to Spain, accounting for 91.92% of the record purchase volume during a recent season, according to Hortoinfo data. Spain purchased 103.97 million kilos from Morocco, valued at €135.79 million, confirming a highly interdependent trade relationship. This rapid growth, an increase of 161% over ten seasons, highlights the need for Moroccan exports to strengthen quality, sorting, and traceability practices to sustain competitiveness and meet stringent technical requirements in the European market.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) has announced a tender for consultancy services related to the Fisher...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) has announced a tender for consultancy services related to the Fishery Industries City in South Al Sharqiyah Governorate. This key strategic initiative is designed to develop modern infrastructure that supports the growth of fishery industries and enhances the value-added of the fisheries sector. The project aims to strengthen supply chains, attract local and foreign investment, and implement sustainable solutions to promote a sustainable blue economy. Specialized companies are invited to submit their bids through the eTendering platform.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture signed grant agreements with the European Union (EU) for the first phase of an agricultural assis...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture signed grant agreements with the European Union (EU) for the first phase of an agricultural assistance program, targeting 119 farmers across the Nablus, Jenin, and Tubas governorates. This segment of the program has a total development budget of 5 million shekels, with 95% contributed by the EU. The projects are focused on strengthening farmer resilience in the northern West Bank through interventions that include the construction of livestock barns, the supply of sheep and fodder, and the rehabilitation of agricultural lands and drilling of agricultural wells. This joint governmental effort is designed to enhance the sustainability of production and provide job opportunities despite escalating attacks from the occupation.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, represented by the General Directorate of Extension and the Nablus Agriculture Directorate, cond...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, represented by the General Directorate of Extension and the Nablus Agriculture Directorate, conducted a field training tour on pruning olive trees in accordance with climate change. The event was held in cooperation with World Vision and the Ma’an Development Center as part of the Green Palestine project, which is funded by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ). The training emphasized the crucial role of proper pruning, along with fertilization and irrigation, as a fundamental means to protect olive trees from the impacts of climate change and ensure continued productivity.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Sbikha photovoltaic solar power plant in Kairouan is preparing to enter operation, becoming Tunisia's largest power plant with an est...
records.description: The Sbikha photovoltaic solar power plant in Kairouan is preparing to enter operation, becoming Tunisia's largest power plant with an estimated annual production of 230 megawatts. The Tunisian Electricity and Gas Company (STEG) will be the exclusive buyer of the energy produced. This project, costing 260 million dinars, is a major step in Tunisia's energy transition, aiming to reduce natural gas imports by approximately $25 million annually and cut carbon dioxide emissions by 120,000 tons per year.

records.title: The Egyptian government is implementing a national silo project to significantly increase the storage capacity for wheat and grains.
records.description: The Egyptian government is implementing a national silo project to significantly increase the storage capacity for wheat and grains. This project involves constructing around 50 silos across 17 governorates, adding 1.5 million tons of new storage capacity and bringing the total reserve to over 6 million tons. Furthermore, in collaboration with the World Food Program (WFP), the state launched the Luxor Coordination Center to promote resilience and innovation in Upper Egypt. Egypt is also working with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) to host a global grain storage center in the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE).

records.title: The Egyptian Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation met with Ireland's Minister of State for Agriculture and Food in Cairo to stren...
records.description: The Egyptian Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation met with Ireland's Minister of State for Agriculture and Food in Cairo to strengthen bilateral cooperation in agriculture and food security. The ministers agreed to enhance collaboration in key areas, including benefiting from Ireland's expertise in livestock management, breed improvement, and agricultural digitization, while Ireland expressed interest in learning from Egypt's experience in modern irrigation and land reclamation. The partnership focuses on supporting small farmers, expanding trade (including opening Irish markets to Egyptian products meeting EU standards), and boosting cooperation in agricultural research, particularly concerning water resource sustainability and climate change adaptation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) announced that local solar panel production will begin soon with up to a 90% l...
records.description: The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) announced that local solar panel production will begin soon with up to a 90% local component rate, supported by new legislative reforms. GAFI is steering the country's renewable energy transition by making environmental protection a core criterion for investment incentives, including those for green hydrogen projects. The Authority is also preparing exporters for the EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) and leveraging Egypt's accession to the EU's Horizon Europe program to fund research in water management and sustainable agriculture.
records.institution: The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)

records.title: The Iraqi Cabinet has approved the 2025–2026 winter agricultural plan, dramatically shifting the focus to groundwater and mandating the u...
records.description: The Iraqi Cabinet has approved the 2025–2026 winter agricultural plan, dramatically shifting the focus to groundwater and mandating the use of modern irrigation systems for wheat cultivation. The plan allocates 3.5 million dunams (350,000 hectares) for cultivation using groundwater, in addition to one million dunams (100,000 hectares) using surface (river) water. This strategic decision comes as Iraq, a large wheat importer, continues to suffer from severe water scarcity due to climate change and reduced river flow, leading to a significant reduction in surface-water cultivation from the previous season's two million dunams.

records.title: The Iraqi government, through Prime Minister, presided over the signing ceremony of the implementation mechanism for the framework cooper...
records.description: The Iraqi government, through Prime Minister, presided over the signing ceremony of the implementation mechanism for the framework cooperation agreement between Iraq and Turkey in the field of water. The Prime Minister stated that the agreement represents a sustainable solution to Iraq's water crisis, focusing on major joint projects aimed at managing and addressing water scarcity challenges. This financing mechanism is expected to strengthen bilateral relations and expand cooperation across various fields, addressing the significant impact of the global water crisis on Iraq.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, launched an extensive campaign to combat the red palm weevil for th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Plant Protection Department, launched an extensive campaign to combat the red palm weevil for the autumn season in Diyala and other governorates. The campaign involves mobilizing technical teams for inspection, control operations, and the use of pheromone traps and specialized pesticides. The Ministry is stressing cooperation with orchard owners to implement preventative measures, such as reducing water levels and dusting pruning wounds, to protect orchards and prevent the spread of the destructive insect.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Agricultural Drone Center affiliated with the Plant Protection Department of the Najaf Agricultu...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Agricultural Drone Center affiliated with the Plant Protection Department of the Najaf Agriculture Directorate, conducted a pioneering field experiment using modern agricultural drones. The drones were used to precisely spray an insecticide in a tomato field to combat the dangerous pests Tuta absoluta and Tuta mite. This experiment successfully tested the efficiency of aerial spraying to achieve uniform pesticide distribution and significantly reduce chemical waste. This initiative is a critical step in the Ministry's commitment to smart transformation in agriculture, aiming to enhance pest control efficiency, increase productivity, and reduce operating costs for farmers.

records.title: The Moroccan zucchini export sector is lagging behind, with exports to the European Union (EU) falling by 25.4% over the last ten seasons...
records.description: The Moroccan zucchini export sector is lagging behind, with exports to the European Union (EU) falling by 25.4% over the last ten seasons, according to Hortoinfo data. Despite the decline, Morocco remains the second-largest supplier to the European market, exporting 36.3 million kilos, representing 7.3% of the total volume. The decline underscores the need for Morocco to accelerate its transition to high value-added niches, focusing on certified, traceable, and sustainable products to maintain competitiveness against market leader Spain and leverage its geographic proximity and technical expertise.

records.title: The National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA), Morocco's primary food integrity authority, has intensified its regulatory actions against n...
records.description: The National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA), Morocco's primary food integrity authority, has intensified its regulatory actions against non-compliant flour mills amid escalating political debate over the national wheat subsidy program. The ONSSA seized and destroyed 33 tons of flour deemed unfit for human consumption in a recent period and referred 60 cases to judicial authorities after analyzing 577 samples. The agency also revoked or suspended 13 health licenses from violating mills. This action coincides with major political controversy over potential fraud in the MAD 16 billion (US$1.73 billion) subsidy system, prompting the Public Prosecutor’s Office in Rabat to initiate a judicial investigation into claims that some companies were mismanaging subsidized flour.
records.institution: The National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) has enforced a new directive requiring importers of selected agricult...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) has enforced a new directive requiring importers of selected agricultural products to register their consignments with the Agricultural Quarantine Department prior to the goods' arrival. Shipments arriving without this essential pre-registration will be rejected, and the Ministry explicitly stated it will not bear responsibility for them. This move comes as Oman's imports of fruits and vegetables are growing, with the import value of vegetables alone surging by 44.9% to $110.5 million in a recent period.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) signed 44 agreements with farmers in th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) signed 44 agreements with farmers in the towns of Battir and Husan. These agreements will facilitate the construction of 44 agricultural wells as part of the Sustainable Tourism Support Project. Implemented in cooperation with the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) and the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities, the project aims to provide sustainable water sources for local farmers. This effort enhances food and water security while contributing to the development of the agricultural sector and strengthening the tourist appeal of the region.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture signed grant agreements with the European Union (EU) to fund agricultural assistance projects totaling over €...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture signed grant agreements with the European Union (EU) to fund agricultural assistance projects totaling over €787,000 for farmers in the Ramallah and Salfit governorates. The funding, which primarily targets the livestock sector through the construction of barns and the supply of animals and fodder, will benefit 75 farmers across the two governorates. This initiative is a core part of the Ministry's strategic plan to empower farmers, strengthen their resilience on their land, and enhance national food security.

records.title: The Agricultural Development Fund (ADF) will participate in the Biban Forum 2025 in Riyadh, organized by the Small and Medium Enterprises...
records.description: The Agricultural Development Fund (ADF) will participate in the Biban Forum 2025 in Riyadh, organized by the Small and Medium Enterprises General Authority (Monsha’at). The ADF will use its dedicated pavilion to showcase financing programs and products to investors and entrepreneurs in the agricultural sector. These programs cover a wide range of projects, including greenhouses, poultry farming, aquaculture, veterinary facilities, and agricultural/food product factories. The Fund's participation is designed to promote financing solutions that support sustainable agricultural transformation and help investors capitalize on promising opportunities within the Kingdom's agricultural sector.

records.title: Tunisia launched a large-scale national soil sampling campaign in Tunis, led by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Natio...
records.description: Tunisia launched a large-scale national soil sampling campaign in Tunis, led by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) as part of the SoilFER-VACS project. The initiative is being conducted in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries. The objective is to collect nearly 3,200 samples to gather up-to-date data on soil composition and fertility. This information will be used to develop high-resolution digital maps, which are strategic tools for implementing sustainable agricultural practices and reducing reliance on imported fertilizers.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Green Project, has completed a new phase of the "Enhancing Agricultural Livelihoods" project in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Green Project, has completed a new phase of the "Enhancing Agricultural Livelihoods" project in North Lebanon (Akkar and Minieh-Dinnieh). This initiative, funded by the Danish Embassy and in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), provided support contracts to fifty farmers. The contracts cover critical activities such as land reclamation, the construction of concrete reservoirs for irrigation water collection, and the building of retaining walls to protect land from erosion. This effort aligns with the Ministry's vision to empower local farming communities, improve agricultural infrastructure, and promote sustainable development in rural Lebanon.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests organized the 14th International Date Fair of M...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests organized the 14th International Date Fair of Morocco (SIDATTES) in Erfoud, which achieved 38 million dirhams in sales and attracted over 94,000 visitors. The fair's theme, "Sustainable Water Resource Management," emphasized the urgent need to address water stress in oasis ecosystems, with support from the National Agency for the Development of Oasis Zones and the Argan Tree (ANDZOA). The event served as a crucial catalyst for promoting water-efficient systems, attracting investment, and advancing the national strategy for building resilient date palm systems.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: A two-day symposium focused on "Using Available Water Resources in Al Buraimi and Al Dhahirah Governorates to Enhance the Sustainability...
records.description: A two-day symposium focused on "Using Available Water Resources in Al Buraimi and Al Dhahirah Governorates to Enhance the Sustainability of Projects" kicked off in Al Buraimi Governorate, Oman. The symposium is organized by the Oman Water Society in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Office of the Governor of Al Buraimi. The goal is to assess scopes for agricultural investment and related industries, study current water challenges, and explore ways to achieve the sustainability of projects related to farming, food security, and industry.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman issued a ministerial decision prohibiting the fishing, collect...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman issued a ministerial decision prohibiting the fishing, collection, possession, and trade of abalones during the 2025 fishing season. This ban covers all related activities, including its preparation, export, handling, transport, sale, and distribution. The prohibition aims to protect abalone stocks and ensure the sustainability of marine life in Omani waters. Quantities legally registered with relevant authorities from previous seasons are exempt, provided they do not exceed the set limits.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture launched a major European Union (EU)-funded agricultural assistance program from the Jerusalem Governorate he...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture launched a major European Union (EU)-funded agricultural assistance program from the Jerusalem Governorate headquarters. This program, part of a larger €10.4 million agreement, is intended to support and strengthen the resilience of Palestinian farmers in the Jerusalem, Jericho, and Jordan Valley governorates. The current phase allocates €4.16 million in aid, with approximately €560,000 benefiting 50 farmers in Jerusalem and Jericho.

records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has signed a collaboration agreement with the National Company for Agricultural Services (NCAS) to a...
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has signed a collaboration agreement with the National Company for Agricultural Services (NCAS) to advance specialized agriculture and veterinary services in AlUla. The partnership aims to elevate service quality and strengthen the farmer experience by establishing unified standards for laboratories, plant and animal quarantine, market operations, and streamlined licensing. This initiative, which includes joint efforts on advisory studies, training programs, and agricultural festivals, reflects the RCU’s commitment to advancing the agricultural sector as a pillar of sustainable economic development and aligns with the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is spearheading a joint initiative with the Quality and Conformity Council (...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is spearheading a joint initiative with the Quality and Conformity Council (QCC) and the Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) to develop a new regulatory framework for novel foods like cultivated meat and precision fermentation-based dairy. This framework aims to reduce product approval timelines by six to nine months and will simplify procedures by consolidating product registration, halal certification, and permits into a single contact point.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched a project in Taiz Governorate to distribute seeds for maize, beans,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched a project in Taiz Governorate to distribute seeds for maize, beans, and wheat to agricultural cooperatives and district branches. The project is funded by the local authority through the Unit for Financing Agricultural and Fishery Projects and Initiatives. The launch included the distribution of 30 tons of maize seeds, 2 tons of wheat, and 2 tons of beans from the governorate's seed bank. This strategic step aims to enhance local production, achieve self-sufficiency, and develop the local seed system with modern agricultural standards to reduce import costs and strengthen national food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Deputy Minister for Technical Affairs, inaugurated a specialized workshop in Erbil, held in coll...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Deputy Minister for Technical Affairs, inaugurated a specialized workshop in Erbil, held in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Ministry of Agriculture and Water Resources in the Kurdistan Region. The workshop's goal is to develop a national guide for operations during animal health emergencies in Iraq. By bringing together various veterinary entities, this initiative aims to enhance the country's capacity for rapid and effective crisis management, thereby protecting livestock and securing food supplies.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry considers the citrus sector a strategic priori...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry considers the citrus sector a strategic priority, aiming to increase exports to 1 million tons by 2030. This ambition comes despite the cultivated area decreasing by 30% due to drought and rising costs. The strategy focuses on diversifying markets by shifting towards Asia, with Japan opening a premium market following successful phytosanitary inspections. Simultaneously, the industry must renew aging orchards and prioritize water-resilient varieties and modern irrigation to strengthen competitiveness against high international standards.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry

records.title: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) Morocco has made its second deposit at the Svalbard Global Seed Vault in Norway, send...
records.description: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) Morocco has made its second deposit at the Svalbard Global Seed Vault in Norway, sending 863 accessions representing 42 species to safeguard the national genetic heritage. The deposited material includes local varieties of durum wheat, common wheat, and barley, food legumes (lentils, chickpeas, broad beans), and aromatic/medicinal plants. Many of these samples are unique and have no known duplicates, making their external preservation a pragmatic investment for Morocco’s long-term food security.
records.institution: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources' Animal Wealth Department in Al Dhahirah Governorate, Oman, is spearheading st...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources' Animal Wealth Department in Al Dhahirah Governorate, Oman, is spearheading strategic projects to bolster the national food security framework under Oman Vision 2040. The relevant authorities have signed seven investment contracts worth approximately OMR35 million across over five thousand acres. Key projects include the "Gulf International Poultry Farm," which produces about one million eggs daily, and new ventures like the Al Nour Al Haditha Company project for eggs and liquid egg products, all aiming to drive self-sufficiency in high-quality livestock products.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources' Animal Wealth Department

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its marketing arm, the Jordanian-Palestinian Company for Marketing Agricultural Products, achieved a...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its marketing arm, the Jordanian-Palestinian Company for Marketing Agricultural Products, achieved a qualitative accomplishment by exporting over 500 tons of the "Ettinger" avocado variety from Tulkarm and Qalqilya to regional markets, with a financial value exceeding $1 million. The Ministry views this success as the result of continuous efforts to develop avocado cultivation and focus on high economic value varieties. Despite obstructive measures, the Ministry coordinated with the Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture to ensure continued exports. The Jordanian-Palestinian company is now working to open new markets in the UAE, Qatar, and Egypt, with the Ministry expecting total avocado exports to reach approximately 2,000 tons this year, making the avocado a promising export crop similar to the Medjool date.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: QatarEnergy has awarded the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contract to Samsung C&T Corporation for a landmark carbon ca...
records.description: QatarEnergy has awarded the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contract to Samsung C&T Corporation for a landmark carbon capture and sequestration (CCS) project. The new facility is set to capture up to 4.1 million tons of $\text{CO}_2$ per annum, making it one of the world’s largest CCS projects and strongly supporting Qatar’s National Climate Change Action Plan. This initiative is a critical part of QatarEnergy's strategy to capture over 11 million tons of $\text{CO}_2$ by 2035, reinforcing its position as a reliable provider of affordable lower-carbon energy.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced four new investment opportunities in the Jazan Region to promote self-su...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced four new investment opportunities in the Jazan Region to promote self-sufficiency and food security, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. The investments include establishing an agricultural city in Abu Arish focusing on fruit cultivation and a project for hydroponic farming greenhouses in Damad Governorate. Additionally, two large opportunities were announced in the livestock sector in Farasan Governorate for breeding, fattening, and red meat production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) recently opened the Megal Project in Erbil, a $100 million private-sector investment aimed at str...
records.description: The Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) recently opened the Megal Project in Erbil, a $100 million private-sector investment aimed at strengthening food security and modernizing production. Spanning 366 acres, the project integrates several facilities, including a slaughterhouse, shopping center, animal control, and a wastewater treatment facility. The Prime Minister emphasized that the project represents a major step toward agricultural self-sufficiency and food security by integrating livestock production, fodder supply, and animal trading, which is expected to create more than 1,000 new jobs.

records.title: The Second Edition of the Water Partnerships Forum will launch in Riyadh, hosted and organized by the Saudi Water Partnerships Company.
records.description: The Second Edition of the Water Partnerships Forum will launch in Riyadh, hosted and organized by the Saudi Water Partnerships Company. The event, held under the patronage of the Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture, will serve as a strategic platform to strengthen cooperation between the public and private sectors. With over 50 local and international speakers, the forum aims to combine expertise with advanced solutions to build a sustainable water future. This initiative directly supports Saudi Vision 2030 objectives related to sustainability, resource management efficiency, and the development of water infrastructure.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The "Lomjati" program, an initiative of the "solidarity trips" association supported by the World Food Programme (WFP) and the European U...
records.description: The "Lomjati" program, an initiative of the "solidarity trips" association supported by the World Food Programme (WFP) and the European Union, concluded recently in Tunis. The project successfully mobilized female agricultural workers from 12 professional organizations to prepare 21,750 balanced meals for students in rural primary schools over a two-week period. The program aimed to strengthen the link between sustainable agriculture and responsible consumption while economically empowering rural women through specialized training in meal preparation. The organizers hope that the Ministry of Education will ensure the continuation of this program due to its proven benefits for both the workers and the students.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) became the first entity in Tunisia to receive accreditation from the Green Climate Fu...
records.description: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) became the first entity in Tunisia to receive accreditation from the Green Climate Fund (GCF) to mobilize international climate financing. This accreditation prompted an international expert to call for APIA to suggest GCF funding for a "Cactus/Carbon" project aimed at replanting 600,000 hectares of cactus, an area ravaged by the cactus mealybug. The project would leverage cactus as a significant carbon sink and include components for multiplying resistant varieties and strengthening biological control to enhance the resilience of the agricultural sector.

records.title: The General Directorate of Forests in Tunisia, in partnership with the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF), North Africa office, organized t...
records.description: The General Directorate of Forests in Tunisia, in partnership with the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF), North Africa office, organized the first regional workshop in Tabarka. The workshop aimed to involve various stakeholders in developing the National Strategy for the Sustainable Development and Management of Forests and Rangelands (2026–2050). This new national vision emphasizes sustainability, participatory governance, and the inclusion of local communities. The initiative aligns with national and international commitments regarding climate and biodiversity conservation.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) officially launched the festivals and 77 accompanying competitions of the Fo...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) officially launched the festivals and 77 accompanying competitions of the Fourth Edition of the Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Award for Agricultural Excellence. This prestigious award, held at the Sheikh Zayed Festival, celebrates excellence and innovation across the UAE's agricultural and food sectors. The events include five major specialized festivals: the Al Wathba Food Festival, the Al Wathba Agricultural Festival, the Livestock Festival, the Honey Festival, and the Flower Festival. These platforms reinforce the nation's drive toward sustainability and food security by connecting producers with consumers and fostering a culture of innovation, with dedicated competitions now including youth participants.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Algeria's government has unveiled a new plan centered on science, technology, and innovation to significantly reduce its $10 billion annu...
records.description: Algeria's government has unveiled a new plan centered on science, technology, and innovation to significantly reduce its $10 billion annual food import bill. The latest move saw the creation of the National Scientific Council for Food Security, a strategic body established during the National Conference on the Modernization of the Agricultural Sector. This council, comprising 34 researchers and professors, is tasked with supporting the government's goal of improving agricultural resilience and achieving food sovereignty through scientific research and technological integration.
records.institution: The National Scientific Council for Food Security

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Neopreneur Association launched the "Market 10452 – A Market for the Nation" initiative under the patronage of the Lebanese Ministry...
records.description: The Neopreneur Association launched the "Market 10452 – A Market for the Nation" initiative under the patronage of the Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture. This national platform aims to support local production and connect Lebanese farmers and manufacturers with consumers and markets, with a strategic vision focused on decentralization and economic sustainability. The Ministry's representative emphasized that the initiative embodies a new philosophy for agricultural work, transforming it into a competitive, decentralized, and community-based sector integrated with the national economy. The plan includes launching decentralized weekly markets in each region and creating a digital platform to connect producers directly with local and international consumers and merchants.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Mauritanian Ministry of Economic Affairs and Development signed a financial protocol with France allocating over €39.2 million to con...
records.description: The Mauritanian Ministry of Economic Affairs and Development signed a financial protocol with France allocating over €39.2 million to construct ten combined-cycle solar power plants with storage units. This strategic project aims to leverage Mauritania's vast solar potential to significantly enhance its clean energy supply and reduce the disparity between rural and urban areas. The initiative supports the country's national vision by increasing electricity coverage, improving service quality, and advancing the national energy transition toward clean sources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Developmen

records.title: Moroccan avocado exports to Germany have reached a new seasonal record, with 19,600 tonnes shipped, a volume that more than doubles the p...
records.description: Moroccan avocado exports to Germany have reached a new seasonal record, with 19,600 tonnes shipped, a volume that more than doubles the previous season. This performance, according to East-Fruit, has propelled Morocco to the position of Germany's third-largest supplier of avocados, reinforcing its role as the country's second-leading fruit export by volume. The success highlights the Moroccan agricultural sector's ability to meet demanding markets and successfully diversify its global export outlets.
