records.title: Oman has earmarked US$97 million for new food security initiatives, announced at the conclusion of the Food Security Lab, as part of the...
records.description: Oman has earmarked US$97 million for new food security initiatives, announced at the conclusion of the Food Security Lab, as part of the country's broader strategy under Oman Vision 2040. The funding supports the rollout of 27 investment projects and 31 enabling initiatives aimed at boosting domestic production and enhancing self-sufficiency. The largest share of this new funding, $81.4 million, is allocated to the fisheries sector, underscoring the nation's aquaculture potential. These efforts are complemented by local agricultural projects, such as large-scale garlic cultivation in Dhofar Governorate, and infrastructure investments like the Integrated Food Market and Khasab Port expansion.

records.title: The Tunisian Ministry of Economy and Planning announced the launch of the new five-year development plan (2026–2030), projecting an estim...
records.description: The Tunisian Ministry of Economy and Planning announced the launch of the new five-year development plan (2026–2030), projecting an estimated economic growth rate of 3.3% for the first year of implementation. The government's projections are based on a recovery across productive sectors, with the agriculture and services sectors each expected to grow by 2.9%, and the industry sector projected to rise by 4.8%. The plan also assumes a more favorable international context and is designed to support national priorities, including job creation, stimulating investment, strengthening community businesses, and promoting social inclusion.
records.institution: The Tunisian Ministry of Economy and Planning

records.title: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID), based in Dubai, has launched operations at a new fish-processing...
records.description: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID), based in Dubai, has launched operations at a new fish-processing plant in Nouadhibou, Mauritania, described as the largest in North Africa. The plant, valued at approximately US$28 million, has an annual processing capacity of 100,000 metric tons and cold storage for up to 10,000 metric tons. The facility, which is run by AAAID's subsidiary, the Arab Mauritanian Fish Company (SAMAK), is supported by the Mauritanian government as part of its strategy to process more of the national catch domestically. The project is expected to generate hundreds of jobs, strengthen Mauritania's industrial base, and increase foreign exchange earnings through exports of fish products, fish oil, and fish powder.
records.institution: The Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID)

records.title: The Egyptian Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation and the Netherlands renewed their strategic cooperation by signing a Memorandum o...
records.description: The Egyptian Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation and the Netherlands renewed their strategic cooperation by signing a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) for the Egypt-Netherlands High-Level Water Committee. The MoU aims to strengthen joint efforts in water resource management, coastal zone management, and climate change adaptation over the coming years. Furthermore, preparations are underway for a new MoU between the Ministry and Dutch financier Invest International to conduct a feasibility study on using environmentally friendly beach nourishment techniques to protect Egypt’s vulnerable Mediterranean coastline.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation

records.title: The Iraqi Agricultural Research Department has begun processing seed deliveries from contracted farmers who applied via the electronic pl...
records.description: The Iraqi Agricultural Research Department has begun processing seed deliveries from contracted farmers who applied via the electronic platform "Ur." This procedure is being carried out to fulfill the contractual requirements for delivering high-grade wheat seeds (foundation and kernel) for the upcoming 2025–2026 agricultural season. The seeds will be distributed equally among farmers based on the order of application, following a streamlined process set by the National Seed Council. This effort affirms the Ministry of Agriculture's commitment to supporting the agricultural sector by

records.title: The Moroccan government, represented by the National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) and the National Agency for the Development o...
records.description: The Moroccan government, represented by the National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) and the National Agency for the Development of Oasis Zones and Argan Trees (ANDZOA), signed a tripartite agreement with the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AODA). This partnership is an urgent response to climatic pressures and aims to strengthen the resilience and sustainability of oasis ecosystems and argan groves. The AODA is providing US$200,000 in financial support for actions that prioritize strengthening scientific capacity, preserving natural resources, and promoting the use of local genetic resources, particularly the date palm. INRA will contribute its expertise in research
records.institution: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA)

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture officially joined the unified national electronic payment platform E-SADAD.
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture officially joined the unified national electronic payment platform E-SADAD. This move is part of the government's direction towards comprehensive digital transformation and enhancing e-governance, aiming to facilitate farmers' access to agricultural and financial services quickly and securely. The Ministry, through this integration, will enable the electronic payment of fees for services like issuing import and export certificates and agricultural licenses, thereby improving the agricultural business environment and easing burdens on citizens.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture opened the new Agriculture and Veterinary Department in Idhna, Hebron Governorate, to expand the...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture opened the new Agriculture and Veterinary Department in Idhna, Hebron Governorate, to expand the scope of agricultural services. This initiative aligns with the Ministry’s vision for promoting sustainable agricultural development and enabling farmers and breeders in the western areas to access essential technical and advisory support without having to travel. The opening is part of the Ministry's plan to develop its institutional structure and expand its network of directorates to support the resilience of farmers and develop agricultural production in rural and border areas.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) delivered 55 diverse modern agricultural machines to farmers in Yemen's Had...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief) delivered 55 diverse modern agricultural machines to farmers in Yemen's Hadhramout Governorate. This initiative is part of a sustainable agriculture project aimed at enhancing agricultural resilience and boosting productivity through modern mechanization. The equipment provided included hand tillers, threshing tools, and farm-spraying and cutting machines. The project also included a training program to help farmers operate and maintain the equipment, along with providing fuel supplies, all to facilitate plowing and harvesting while significantly reducing costs and labor.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre (KSrelief)

records.title: Vegetable farming in Saudi Arabia's Taif Governorate is a key agricultural activity that significantly contributes to strengthening the K...
records.description: Vegetable farming in Saudi Arabia's Taif Governorate is a key agricultural activity that significantly contributes to strengthening the Kingdom’s food security. Due to its fertile soil and moderate, year-round climate, Taif is a leading producer of a wide variety of vegetables in the Makkah region, including tomatoes, cucumbers, eggplant, and peppers. The favorable conditions allow for multi-season cultivation and a continuous supply of high-quality produce, particularly in winter. Taif also serves as the primary distribution hub for vegetables to neighboring cities.

records.description: Yokogawa Saudi Arabia has been awarded a contract by the Royal Commission for Riyadh City to provide the command and control systems for the major Green Riyadh project. This massive afforestation initiative aims to plant 7.5 million trees and will use treated wastewater for irrigation. records.title: The Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA) will launch a US$13.5 million project with the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resource...
records.description: The Korea International Cooperation Agency (KOICA) will launch a US$13.5 million project with the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries to improve Tunisia's agricultural productivity and resilience to climate change. The initiative, running from 2026 to 2031, will establish three pilot farms focusing on cereals and olive trees to introduce climate-smart agriculture and smart irrigation technologies. This collaboration is designed to strengthen political and technical capacities, providing models that can be extended across the country.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture held a specialized training course on saffron cultivation and production in Beirut, strengthening it...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture held a specialized training course on saffron cultivation and production in Beirut, strengthening its cooperation with the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD). The course, attended by agricultural engineers and farmers, aimed to promote saffron as a high-value, promising crop capable of increasing incomes in mountainous and arid regions. ACSAD experts delivered scientific lectures covering the technical foundations of cultivation, harvesting, and marketing, followed by practical field demonstrations.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the SPHERE Building Tomorrow Association (SBT) to en...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the SPHERE Building Tomorrow Association (SBT) to enhance food security and agricultural development in Lebanon. The MoU aims to unify efforts in rural development, empower local communities, and support sustainable livelihoods by providing training, agricultural extension, and capacity building to local farmers. The agreement specifically focuses on empowering farmers in the South and Nabatieh governorates by providing unconditional financial support of $500 USD to 129 registered farmers and connecting them with community kitchens to market their products.

records.title: The Alaouite Organization for the Promotion of the Blind in Morocco (OAPAM), in partnership with the Regional Directorate of Agriculture...
records.description: The Alaouite Organization for the Promotion of the Blind in Morocco (OAPAM), in partnership with the Regional Directorate of Agriculture of Tangier-Tetouan-Al Hoceima, launched a pioneering initiative in Tetouan to train blind individuals in the agricultural sector. The work-study program, delivered by the Institute of Specialized Technicians in Agriculture (ITSA), focuses on the production of medicinal and aromatic plants. This inclusive project aims to promote the economic autonomy and professional integration of visually impaired people through sustainable, income-generating activities.
records.institution: The Alaouite Organization for the Promotion of the Blind in Morocco (OAPAM)

records.title: The Musandam Global Investment Company (MGIC), through its new branch MP World, has launched a strategic initiative by signing a 10-year...
records.description: The Musandam Global Investment Company (MGIC), through its new branch MP World, has launched a strategic initiative by signing a 10-year agreement with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources for the development and operation of the Khasab Fishery Port. This agreement is exclusively designated to advance Oman's fisheries infrastructure and support the nation's growing blue economy. MGIC, a publicly listed company on the Muscat Stock Exchange (MSX), aims for MP World to eventually manage additional commercial, industrial, and logistics ports, reinforcing Musandam’s strategic role as a maritime gateway.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture signed the fourth batch of agricultural investment grant agreements in Ramallah as part of the mu...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture signed the fourth batch of agricultural investment grant agreements in Ramallah as part of the multi-donor Agribusiness Program (MAP2). This batch included 13 new grants across seven governorates, with total investments amounting to 3 million shekels. The program, funded by the European Union, Denmark, Spain, and Switzerland, and implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), is highlighted as a successful model of cooperation for supporting productive and entrepreneurial projects.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, delivered 57 olive saplings to a farmer in the...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, delivered 57 olive saplings to a farmer in the Umm al-Batim area of Wadi Sa'ir. This action was an urgent response to settler attacks that damaged the farmer's land. The Ministry affirmed that this intervention is part of its program to intensify technical and field support for affected farmers, aiming to rehabilitate damaged agricultural lands and strengthen the resilience of farmers against escalating settlement practices

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Masdar, an Abu Dhabi energy company, was awarded two solar photovoltaic (PV) projects with a combined capacity of 2 gigawatts (GW) under...
records.description: Masdar, an Abu Dhabi energy company, was awarded two solar photovoltaic (PV) projects with a combined capacity of 2 gigawatts (GW) under Saudi Arabia's National Renewable Energy Program (NREP). These Independent Power Producer (IPP) projects, for the Najran and Ad Darb facilities, will be developed on a Build, Own, and Operate (BOO) basis under a 25-year power purchase agreement with the Saudi Power Procurement Company (SPPC). The award significantly expands Masdar's portfolio in the Kingdom, supporting Saudi Vision 2030's renewable energy targets.

records.title: Prices for proteins in Egyptian food markets are showing volatility, with the Cabinet’s Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC) re...
records.description: Prices for proteins in Egyptian food markets are showing volatility, with the Cabinet’s Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC) reporting sharp, uneven movement. White poultry prices saw a steep daily drop of about 13.4%, bringing the average retail price to roughly EGP 74.2 ($1.58) per kilogram, with white eggs falling by a similar percentage. Conversely, beef and tilapia fish prices posted a moderate increase. This volatility highlights the ongoing instability in the market, which is burdened by economic pressures and rising input costs such as feed imports and fuel expenses.
records.institution: The Cabinet’s Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Egyptian Ministry of Environment, represented by the BioEnergy for Sustainable Rural Development initiative, signed a cooperation agr...
records.description: The Egyptian Ministry of Environment, represented by the BioEnergy for Sustainable Rural Development initiative, signed a cooperation agreement with Italy’s Eni to prepare a feasibility study for establishing biogas production units from agricultural waste. This strategic move, supported by the Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources and the United Nations Development Program (UNDP), aims to expand the application of biogas technology across all governorates. The project is critical for converting waste into clean energy, reducing emissions, and boosting rural economies in line with the national clean energy transition strategy.

records.title: The Egyptian Swiss Group for Pasta, Milling & Concentrates has announced a bold US$25 million expansion plan over the next five years to...
records.description: The Egyptian Swiss Group for Pasta, Milling & Concentrates has announced a bold US$25 million expansion plan over the next five years to significantly boost its production capacity. The company aims to reach EGP 5 billion (US$105.53M) in total sales by the end of 2025, with a focus on its pasta division, which will gain three new spaghetti production lines. The investment is also directed towards expanding milling operations and enhancing export capabilities across Africa, the Middle East, and Europe. A key strategic component is the recent international accreditation of its laboratories by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the Egyptian Accreditation Council (EGAC), which ensures compliance with global quality standards.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) is collaborating with the Ministries of Water and Irrigation, Agricultu...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) is collaborating with the Ministries of Water and Irrigation, Agriculture, and Environment and the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) on a Green Climate Fund (GCF)-financed project to enhance water resilience in Jordan. The initiative involves increasing the storage capacity of the Madaba Wastewater Treatment Plant to around 50,000 cubic meters, which will allow for the irrigation of about 2,000 dunums of farmland. This effort promotes sustainable, climate-resilient agriculture and helps conserve drinking water sources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty in Mauritania launched the "Kao" project in Nouakchott, an initiative designed to streng...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty in Mauritania launched the "Kao" project in Nouakchott, an initiative designed to strengthen agriculture and support women's entrepreneurship. The project aligns with the national priorities of women's economic empowerment, food security, and climate change adaptation. The African Development Bank's representative in Mauritania affirmed the institution's commitment to supporting the government's efforts to sustainably transform the Mauritanian economy and improve living conditions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: According to Hortoinfo data, Morocco remains a secondary supplier of cucumbers to the European Union (EU), exporting 20.21 million kilogr...
records.description: According to Hortoinfo data, Morocco remains a secondary supplier of cucumbers to the European Union (EU), exporting 20.21 million kilograms during a recent marketing year, which places it seventh among suppliers. The market is overwhelmingly dominated by Spain, which exported 582.44 million kilograms. To strengthen its competitiveness and gain more market share, the article suggests that Morocco must focus on controlling logistics costs, diversifying varieties, and enhancing product quality and certification to meet European environmental requirements.

records.title: The National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA) of Morocco responded firmly to a controversy over pesticide residues in exported tomatoes, as...
records.description: The National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA) of Morocco responded firmly to a controversy over pesticide residues in exported tomatoes, asserting that its health and safety system adheres to strict international standards. The ONSSA noted that, according to the European Rapid Notification System for Food Hazards (RASFF), Moroccan products accounted for only 0.9% of total notifications over a five-year period, disputing claims that threaten the competitiveness of Moroccan tomatoes in the European market.
records.institution: The National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA)

records.title: Oman is nearing the launch of its first-ever sugar refinery at Sohar Port and Freezone, a major step toward domestic production and reduc...
records.description: Oman is nearing the launch of its first-ever sugar refinery at Sohar Port and Freezone, a major step toward domestic production and reduced reliance on imports. The advanced facility is in the final stages of commissioning by the German engineering firm BMA. Once operational, the Oman Sugar Refinery will have a daily production capacity of 3,000 tonnes of refined white sugar. The complex, which includes a massive 30,000-metric-tonne capacity DomeSilo, is designed for low energy consumption and high efficiency, marking a significant milestone in Oman's industrial diversification and aiming to strengthen its position as a regional player in the sugar industry.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture twice intervened urgently in Umm al-Khair village, Masafer Yatta, to support farmers against settler attacks...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture twice intervened urgently in Umm al-Khair village, Masafer Yatta, to support farmers against settler attacks and land confiscation threats. Following an appeal, the Ministry initially provided 300 saplings for planting on threatened land. After settlers uprooted those trees, the Ministry immediately supplied and helped replant another 100 olive seedlings. The Ministry affirmed this swift, repeated action is part of its firm policy to strengthen the resilience of citizens, protect the Palestinian agricultural character, and confront attempts to uproot the Palestinian presence in the southern Hebron Governorate.

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) is affirming its commitment to supporting and enhancing afforestation...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) is affirming its commitment to supporting and enhancing afforestation across the Kingdom by empowering small farmers with training and providing them with seedlings of environmentally compatible varieties. These efforts align with the Saudi Green Initiative and Saudi Vision 2030. Since its launch until 2024, Saudi Reef successfully planted more than 15.5 million seedlings across all regions of the Kingdom. The fruit sector accounted for the largest share with 12.6 million seedlings, while the coffee and rose sectors contributed 1.8 million and 1.1 million seedlings, respectively.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA), placed under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fis...
records.description: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA), placed under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia, obtained official accreditation from the Green Climate Fund (GCF). This international recognition is a major step for Tunisia, enabling APIA to mobilize funding for climate change mitigation and adaptation. This capability will directly contribute to strengthening the resilience of the agricultural and fisheries sector and demonstrates the GCF's confidence in the agency's ability to manage climate projects.

records.title: The Tunisian Consumer Information Organization (OTIC) has denounced the excessive rise in red meat prices, with local sheep and beef bein...
records.description: The Tunisian Consumer Information Organization (OTIC) has denounced the excessive rise in red meat prices, with local sheep and beef being sold above official price ceilings. The organization called for the establishment of a system of regulated prices for red meat and a strengthening of on-the-ground controls to protect household purchasing power. The surge in meat prices contributes to Tunisia's overall inflation rate, which stood at 5% in a recent month, though the National Institute of Statistics reported a slight decline in the rate due to slower price increases in sectors like food and leisure.

records.title: The Tunisian Ministry of Trade and Export Development is actively working to establish an electronic platform to digitize the issuance of...
records.description: The Tunisian Ministry of Trade and Export Development is actively working to establish an electronic platform to digitize the issuance of certificates of origin for exports to African countries under the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) agreement. This move, which comes after 350 certified trade operations under AfCFTA, reflects the state's strategic orientation to position the African continent as a key focus for national export strategy and economic policy. The Ministry is also planning to create think tanks with Chambers of Commerce and Industry to leverage regional proposals and strengthen complementarity and integration in Africa.
records.institution: The Ministry of Trade and Export Development

records.title: Tunisia has launched its national food security monitoring platform, foodsecurity.tn, which aims to centralize data, strengthen coordinat...
records.description: Tunisia has launched its national food security monitoring platform, foodsecurity.tn, which aims to centralize data, strengthen coordination, and guide public policies toward greater food resilience. This strategic initiative was designed as part of a program led by the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, with support from the World Food Program (WFP) and the Principality of Monaco. Its management is handled by the National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI), which is responsible for collecting and analyzing data on production indicators, strategic food stocks, and risk areas. The platform is a crucial governance tool for achieving food sovereignty and enhancing the sustainability of the agri-food sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: Ghitha Holding PJSC, a subsidiary of IHC, reported strong financial results for the nine months, with revenue climbing to AED 4.0 billion...
records.description: Ghitha Holding PJSC, a subsidiary of IHC, reported strong financial results for the nine months, with revenue climbing to AED 4.0 billion and operating profit rising by 41.1%. The growth was driven by strategic acquisitions, including the realignment of agricultural operations via NRTC Food Holding LLC, and its role in forming Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG). Ghitha is now set to merge with other IHC entities into a single AED 120 billion investment powerhouse, reinforcing its leadership in food and resource security.

records.title: Provisur Technologies and IMA Group will showcase their advanced processing and packaging solutions at Gulfood Manufacturing 2025 in Duba...
records.description: Provisur Technologies and IMA Group will showcase their advanced processing and packaging solutions at Gulfood Manufacturing 2025 in Dubai, highlighting the push for automation in food production. Provisur will feature its latest industrial food processing systems, including the Formax® forming system for shaping meat products and separation equipment designed to maximize protein recovery. Meanwhile, IMA Group will present integrated processing, filling, dosing, and packaging technologies across multiple food categories, from dairy to confectionery.

records.title: The Mayor of the capital of Yemen, launched the first phase of a project to rehabilitate and deepen four water wells for the agricultural...
records.description: The Mayor of the capital of Yemen, launched the first phase of a project to rehabilitate and deepen four water wells for the agricultural sector and operate them with solar energy. This project has a cost of 140 million Yemeni riyals. The initiative is funded by the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit in Sana'a, and aims to enhance water resources for the agricultural sector.

records.title: Egyptian sweet potatoes are rapidly gaining market share in Europe, competing with pricier supplies due to Egypt's favorable location and...
records.description: Egyptian sweet potatoes are rapidly gaining market share in Europe, competing with pricier supplies due to Egypt's favorable location and stable supply chain. The Egyptian government's investment in curing and storage allows for a stable, near year-round supply that meets growing European demand across both the fresh and industrial markets. Exporters are working to manage quality variation and build long-term partnerships to reinforce the product's strong position in the global market.

records.title: The Egyptian Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation announced that the Venezuelan market has officially opened to Egypt’s fresh pom...
records.description: The Egyptian Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation announced that the Venezuelan market has officially opened to Egypt’s fresh pomegranate exports, following successful phytosanitary negotiations. This achievement, spearheaded by the Agricultural Quarantine Authority, is a key part of the Ministry’s strategy to diversify its export portfolio and strengthen foreign currency inflows. The Ministry affirmed its commitment to working with producers to uphold international quality standards and build global market confidence in Egyptian agricultural products.
records.institution: The Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Directorate of Studies and Financial Forecasts (DEPF), under the Ministry of Economy and Finance, reported that the Moroccan economy...
records.description: The Directorate of Studies and Financial Forecasts (DEPF), under the Ministry of Economy and Finance, reported that the Moroccan economy saw a strong recovery in the first half of a recent year, led by a 4.6% improvement in the agriculture sector due to favorable rainfall. This rebound, resulting in 43 million quintals of cereal production, was supported by sustained domestic demand and strong Foreign Direct Investment. The DEPF warned, however, that growth remains vulnerable due to persistent climate challenges and water shortages, requiring faster technological adaptation under the Green Generation strategy.
records.institution: The Directorate of Studies and Financial Forecasts (DEPF)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests is organizing the 14th International Date Fair o...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests is organizing the 14th International Date Fair of Morocco (SIDATTES) in Erfoud. The fair's central theme is "Sustainable management of water resources: Basis for the development of date palms and oases," addressing the urgent challenge of water stress and climate change. The event expects to draw over 90,000 visitors and 230 exhibitors, serving as a platform to mobilize public and private stakeholders around solutions for efficient irrigation and agricultural adaptation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry is driving the technological transition in Mor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry is driving the technological transition in Moroccan agriculture, supported by projects like the World Bank Large Scale Irrigation Modernization Project. The most widely adopted technologies are localized irrigation and basic mechanization, which have shown a tangible economic impact by improving yields and conserving water. However, the overall adoption rate remains uneven, with large farms mechanizing faster than smaller farms, requiring continued efforts to integrate digital tools across all regions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has banned the import of bottled water and its products from the Islam...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has banned the import of bottled water and its products from the Islamic Republic of Iran. The suspension was enacted under Ministerial Decision No. 241/2025 and took effect immediately. The decision is based on Oman's Food Safety Law and its accompanying regulations. The Ministry stated that the ban will remain in place until the reasons for the order are resolved and an official decision is made to lift the suspension.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia has received ISO 42001 accreditation for its artificial intelligence (...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia has received ISO 42001 accreditation for its artificial intelligence (AI) management systems. This achievement is the culmination of the ministry's efforts to establish a comprehensive AI governance system that ensures the safe and effective use of AI technologies. The system focuses on risk assessment, transparency, accountability, and adherence to regulations. The accreditation highlights the Ministry's commitment to advancing digital transformation, promoting innovation, and supporting decision-making to enhance productivity and sustainability across the environment, water, and agriculture sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia launched “Saudi Pomegranate Week” across local retail markets to promo...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia launched “Saudi Pomegranate Week” across local retail markets to promote local varieties and enhance marketing efficiency. This initiative aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 goals by supporting farmers and boosting economic returns. Saudi Arabia cultivates pomegranates over approximately 2,000 hectares, with an annual production of around 37,000 tons. Cultivation is primarily concentrated in the Al-Baha, Aseer, Makkah, Madinah, and Tabuk regions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Tunisia's olive oil sector is anticipating a record harvest for the 2025/2026 season, but this is overshadowed by a sharp collapse in exp...
records.description: Tunisia's olive oil sector is anticipating a record harvest for the 2025/2026 season, but this is overshadowed by a sharp collapse in export prices. According to the National Agricultural Observatory (ONAGRI), a recent increase in export volumes resulted in a significant drop in revenue. Sources allege that this price crisis is due to opaque financial transactions and speculation involving foreign buyers, leading several Italian agricultural associations to call for judicial investigations into what they believe is a major fraud in the Mediterranean olive oil trade.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Women's Affairs Division participated in a workshop on "Bridging the Food Gap Analysis," organized by the M...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Women's Affairs Division participated in a workshop on "Bridging the Food Gap Analysis," organized by the Ministry of Planning and the World Food Programme (WFP). The workshop aimed to identify obstacles to accessing healthy and affordable food and support evidence-based policies across key sectors. The Ministry emphasized that tackling the food gap requires strong coordination between agriculture, social protection, health, and trade to ensure equitable access to nutritious food.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture's Women's Affairs Division

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon, through its Mount Lebanon Agriculture Department, organized a guidance workshop on "Fruit Tree Pr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon, through its Mount Lebanon Agriculture Department, organized a guidance workshop on "Fruit Tree Pruning" in Shehim, attended by approximately 170 farmers. The Ministry provided comprehensive training on modern scientific pruning methods and stressed the importance of registering farmers in the National Agricultural Registry. Pruning equipment, provided by the SEAL organization, was distributed to all registered participants, supporting the Ministry's commitment to developing sustainable agriculture and national food security.

records.title: The Environment Authority (EA) of Oman is adopting innovative financial policies to meet the Sultanate's 2050 carbon neutrality objective...
records.description: The Environment Authority (EA) of Oman is adopting innovative financial policies to meet the Sultanate's 2050 carbon neutrality objectives by securing funding from the Green Climate Fund (GCF). This strategic effort includes developing the National Adaptation Plan (NAP) and facilitating access to green financing through partnerships with bodies like the Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI). The initiative supports Oman Vision 2040 by financing projects crucial for coastal resilience, protecting water resources, and supporting sustainable agriculture.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman imposed a ban on the import of live birds and their products f...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman imposed a ban on the import of live birds and their products from three regions—Ardabil (Iran), Drenthe (Netherlands), and Veneto (Italy)—due to animal health concerns. This preventive measure, issued under the national Veterinary Quarantine Law, will remain in effect until the health risks are resolved. Despite rising local production, the country remains a net importer of poultry, making the ban a crucial step in protecting the safety of domestic poultry supplies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture is supporting the olive sector by ensuring the quality and safety of olive oil for local and inte...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture is supporting the olive sector by ensuring the quality and safety of olive oil for local and international markets. The Service Laboratories Directorate of the Agricultural Research Center is central to this effort, having already tested over 1,000 samples since the season's start to ensure compliance with specifications. This initiative is a core part of the Ministry's vision to enhance consumer confidence and strengthen the sector as a key driver of the national economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia announced that the date sector is a major economic contributor, wit...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia announced that the date sector is a major economic contributor, with exports reaching approximately 128 thousand tons for a value of nearly 850 million dinars (MD) in a recent campaign. This success places dates second among agricultural exports, and the sector provides income to approximately 50,000 families and over two million workdays annually. The Kebili region is highlighted as a fundamental pillar of production, accounting for 75% of the national output, including the vital "Deglet Nour" variety.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The General Corporation for the Development and Production of Grains in Yemen, under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheri...
records.description: The General Corporation for the Development and Production of Grains in Yemen, under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, launched the harvest and purchase of the bean crop in Dhamar District. This strategic initiative, implemented in partnership with the Mikhlaf Manqadha Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association, aims to achieve self-sufficiency in legumes by providing support for seed supply and guaranteed crop purchase. The locally produced crop will be designated as seeds for distribution, directly contributing to reducing the annual import bill and enhancing national food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Capital Agro Group launched a $25 million integrated logistics project in Egypt for frozen food storage, securing a 25-year usufruct...
records.description: The Capital Agro Group launched a $25 million integrated logistics project in Egypt for frozen food storage, securing a 25-year usufruct right for the land from the Sharkia National Company for Food Security. The new 30,000-square-meter complex will utilize advanced and smart technologies, including Artificial Intelligence and solar energy, to increase operational efficiency. With an operational capacity exceeding 30,000 pallets, the initiative aims to boost food storage space and contribute significantly to the country's logistical infrastructure.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) have resumed their cooperation on the "Capa...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) have resumed their cooperation on the "Capacity Building for Veterinary Services" project after a two-year hiatus. Japanese experts began field visits in Ramallah, Jericho, and Bethlehem to assess the work of agriculture and veterinary departments. The collaboration, which is the first of its kind between Palestinian veterinary services and JICA, aims to enhance the efficiency of veterinary, advisory, and laboratory services, and improve field monitoring of animal diseases.

records.title: Olive presses in Saudi Arabia's Tabuk Region have started receiving the harvest from over 1.5 million olive trees, signaling the start of...
records.description: Olive presses in Saudi Arabia's Tabuk Region have started receiving the harvest from over 1.5 million olive trees, signaling the start of an anticipated abundant olive season. The Ministry of Environment, Water and None Agriculture's Tabuk branch estimates production will reach 94,000 tons of olives, yielding more than 12,250 tons of oil. Tabuk is a prominent region for olive production due to its temperate climate and fertile soil, and it also contributes significantly to the production of various fruits, reflecting the region's agricultural strength and prosperity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and None Agriculture's Tabuk branch

records.title: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) of Saudi Arabia purchased approximately 500,000 metric tonnes of wheat from Saudi investors op...
records.description: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) of Saudi Arabia purchased approximately 500,000 metric tonnes of wheat from Saudi investors operating overseas in its second dedicated tender. This procurement is a key part of the Kingdom's strategy to enhance food security by diversifying sourcing channels and securing supply directly from Saudi-backed farming ventures abroad. The investor-sourced supply will complement traditional international tenders to meet the national consumption demand of about 4.6 million tonnes.

records.title: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA) of Kasserine is struggling to contain an accelerating cactus mealybug infesta...
records.description: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA) of Kasserine is struggling to contain an accelerating cactus mealybug infestation that has spread across the governorate and previously destroyed nearly 500 hectares in the Nabeul region. Despite the release of thousands of ladybugs as a biological control measure, the crisis is overwhelming farmers and threatening the vital local prickly pear economy. The Minister of Agriculture announced a national emergency plan that mandates the systematic uprooting of infested plants and provides financial aid to stabilize the sector.
records.institution: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) signed five strategic Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) during Global Food W...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) signed five strategic Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) during Global Food Week to expand its partnership network and reinforce Abu Dhabi's position as an agricultural innovation hub. The agreements cover crucial areas, including delivering specialized technical training with the Ministry of Defence, developing an advanced trade framework for perishable agricultural products with ADIO and Abu Dhabi Customs, and promoting joint research in arid-environment agriculture with the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA). These collaborations strengthen the sector's sustainability and competitiveness by integrating government, military, research, and private sector efforts.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC), and the Abu Dhabi Inv...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC), and the Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) launched a strategic initiative to develop a new regulatory framework for novel foods. This collaboration aims to accelerate the adoption of advanced solutions, such as alternative proteins, by establishing a streamlined, single-point registration system. The new framework will reduce the registration period by up to nine months, strengthen Abu Dhabi's position as a competitive global hub for food innovation, and support the UAE's National Food Security Strategy 2051.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The General Corporation for Grain Development and Production in Yemen, under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and...
records.description: The General Corporation for Grain Development and Production in Yemen, under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, launched a Soybean Seed Multiplication Project in the Bajil District of Al-Hodeidah. The initiative involves distributing 800 bags of seeds across 1,000 hectares to 300 farmers. This project is a practical step toward expanding the cultivation of strategic crops, strengthening food security, and advancing the national goal of self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The General Corporation for Grain Development and Production, Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Training courses on beekeeping, honey production, and marketing concluded in four districts of Yemen's Al-Bayda Governorate, training 200...
records.description: Training courses on beekeeping, honey production, and marketing concluded in four districts of Yemen's Al-Bayda Governorate, training 200 participants over six days. The program was organized by the Ministry of Agriculture's General Directorate of Animal Wealth and Technical Committee and supported by the Yemeni Red Crescent Society and the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC). This initiative is part of an economic empowerment program focused on developing local resources, improving the quality of Yemeni honey, and advancing the national goal of self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) has unveiled Oman's first electric locomotive, a project undertaken in partnership with the Ministry of Commerce,...
records.description: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) has unveiled Oman's first electric locomotive, a project undertaken in partnership with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion and the Royal Oman Police. This sustainable initiative aims to fortify the food security sector and supports Oman's commitment to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2050. The locomotive is expected to reduce OFM's operating and maintenance costs by 59% while substantially reducing carbon emissions.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MoAFWR) in Oman signed an MoU with Sea Pride LLC for an RO 8.3 million projec...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MoAFWR) in Oman signed an MoU with Sea Pride LLC for an RO 8.3 million project to establish one of the country's largest shrimp farms. This 100-hectare, state-of-the-art Semi-RAS farm will use advanced technology to cultivate 3,200 metric tonnes of export-quality shrimp annually. The project is a major step in integrating Oman's seafood supply chain and supports the local economic growth through employment and technology transfer.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MoAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries in Tunisia issued an urgent appeal for livestock farmers to strengthen preven...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries in Tunisia issued an urgent appeal for livestock farmers to strengthen preventive measures against transboundary animal diseases, such as bluetongue and Rift Valley fever. This heightened vigilance is critical due to current climatic conditions that favor insect proliferation. The Ministry emphasized the "One Health" approach and provided concrete recommendations on hygiene, sanitation, and the use of insecticides to protect the national herd and secure the country's livestock production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.title: The Nabeul Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries anticipates a significant national recovery for the 2025 citrus season in Tunisia,...
records.description: The Nabeul Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries anticipates a significant national recovery for the 2025 citrus season in Tunisia, with national production estimated to reach between 350,000 and 400,000 tons. This rebound is driven by a better water balance, although structural challenges like the lack of irrigation water and high production costs persist. Stakeholders are focused on boosting exports and diversifying value-added products, urging the Ministry of Agriculture to strengthen support, facilitate financing, and modernize infrastructure to ensure the sector's long-term sustainability and competitiveness.
records.institution: The Nabeul Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries

records.title: Algeria’s state grains agency, OAIC, purchased approximately 600,000 metric tons of milling wheat in a recent international tender for US...
records.description: Algeria’s state grains agency, OAIC, purchased approximately 600,000 metric tons of milling wheat in a recent international tender for US$258.50 per ton. The majority of the volume is suspected to be sourced from the Black Sea region, with French wheat reportedly excluded by OAIC due to ongoing diplomatic tensions. This large purchase aligns with the agency's strategy to secure strategic food supplies despite geopolitical challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Works in Bahrain has launched the Innovation in Irrigation Solution Competition to encourage creative solutions for optim...
records.description: The Ministry of Works in Bahrain has launched the Innovation in Irrigation Solution Competition to encourage creative solutions for optimizing the use of surplus treated water. This national initiative targets individuals, firms, and universities to submit practical innovations that enhance efficiency in agriculture and afforestation. The competition is designed to support the Kingdom's comprehensive development and sustainability goals by expanding irrigation networks and promoting smart water management.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Crop Protection, conducted field visits to palm groves in Diyala Governorate...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Crop Protection, conducted field visits to palm groves in Diyala Governorate to assess and combat the dangerous red palm weevil pest. The visits focused on monitoring pesticide distribution and providing technical guidance to local agricultural cadres. This initiative emphasizes the Ministry's commitment to protecting palm groves and preserving this important national agricultural resource.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture's Horticulture Department is continuing the production of infection-free tissue culture potato seedling...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture's Horticulture Department is continuing the production of infection-free tissue culture potato seedlings as part of the National Potato Development Program. This use of modern laboratory technology is aimed at providing pure propagation material to increase potato productivity and improve quality. This initiative directly supports food security and sustainable agricultural development in Iraq.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry organized the 7th Pan-African Conference on Ru...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry organized the 7th Pan-African Conference on Rural Engineering in Fez, where it reaffirmed Morocco's ambition to position water management as a strategic lever for African food sovereignty. The Minister emphasized Morocco's policy of South-South cooperation through the AAA Initiative and highlighted domestic efforts like the modernization of irrigation networks and the implementation of desalination plants. The event confirmed Morocco's role as a central player in continental agricultural cooperation, striving to transform its hydraulic innovations into models reproducible across Africa.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry

records.title: The World Citrus Organization (WCO) issued a warning regarding the proliferation of arbitrary private standards imposed by distributors,...
records.description: The World Citrus Organization (WCO) issued a warning regarding the proliferation of arbitrary private standards imposed by distributors, which are complicating the global citrus industry. These additional requirements increase costs and uncertainty for producers, including those in Morocco, and risk eroding the economic and phytosanitary sustainability of the sector. The WCO is calling for a structured dialogue between all stakeholders to preserve the resilience of production systems and avoid unnecessarily burdening the value chain.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman issued a ministerial resolution banning the import of live bir...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman issued a ministerial resolution banning the import of live birds and their products from three specific regions—Ardabil (Iran), Drenthe (Netherlands), and Veneto (Italy)—due to animal health concerns. The decision, based on the national Veterinary Quarantine Law, will remain in effect until the health risks are resolved. Products that have undergone heat treatment in accordance with the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) standards are exempt from the ban.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture inaugurated new offices for agriculture and veterinary medicine in Al-Rihiya and Al-Karmel, and a dairy sales...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture inaugurated new offices for agriculture and veterinary medicine in Al-Rihiya and Al-Karmel, and a dairy sales point in Masafer Yatta. These openings are part of the Ministry's strategic effort to localize agricultural and veterinary services and provide essential technical and advisory support to farmers and livestock breeders in rural and marginalized areas. The Ministry partnered with Save the Children and the Agricultural Relief to distribute support and strengthen the resilience and livelihoods of 66 beneficiaries on threatened lands.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Salfit Agriculture Directorate, participated in the third event of the National Olive 2025 Campa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Salfit Agriculture Directorate, participated in the third event of the National Olive 2025 Campaign in the village of Iskaka. This event, held with the Higher Council for Youth and Sports, is part of a national effort to support farmers in harvesting their olives and strengthening their resilience on threatened lands. The campaign embodies the spirit of national cooperation, supports the rural economy, and enhances the sustainability of agricultural resources in Palestine.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) launched the Golden List, a strategic initiative under its Zadna Rating Prog...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) launched the Golden List, a strategic initiative under its Zadna Rating Programme, to reward food establishments that consistently meet the highest safety standards. This list grants compliant businesses enhanced regulatory privileges, including a transition from traditional risk-based inspections to an audit-based oversight model. The initiative supports ADAFSA's strategy to modernize food control systems and reinforce Abu Dhabi's position as a regional leader in food safety and agricultural sustainability.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries is strengthening its logistical and financial support for sunflower producers.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries is strengthening its logistical and financial support for sunflower producers. Following a meeting with farmers and involved public institutions—including OAIC and ONAB—the ministry announced several support measures. These include maintaining state subsidies for sunflower cultivation to encourage expansion and giving instructions to public institutions to mobilize resources for acquiring and sorting harvests. Additionally, private contracting companies are now obligated to take charge of farmers' harvests and carry out seed sorting within 40 days.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, in cooperation with the United Nations Industrial Development Organisation (UNIDO), launched a strategic pro...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, in cooperation with the United Nations Industrial Development Organisation (UNIDO), launched a strategic project to implement the Kigali Amendment. This initiative aims to help the Jordanian industrial sector, particularly in refrigeration and air conditioning, transition towards environmentally friendly alternatives and reduce greenhouse emissions. The project aligns with the national Economic Modernisation Vision (EMV), positioning Jordan as a regional model for sustainable industrial and climate action.

records.title: Mauritania plans to collaborate with Egypt to leverage its expertise in cereal crop development to enhance agricultural productivity and...
records.description: Mauritania plans to collaborate with Egypt to leverage its expertise in cereal crop development to enhance agricultural productivity and reduce import dependency. The primary goals are to elevate the productivity of key crops like rice, wheat, and corn, and a proposal is being considered to establish a branch of the Egyptian Agricultural Research Center in Nouakchott. This cooperation will build on Mauritania's existing efforts with partners like the Arab Africa Trade Bridges (AATB) program to advance local wheat seed production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: The President of the Republic of Tunisia recently denounced an "irresponsible statement" that falsely claimed Tunisian date exports were...
records.description: The President of the Republic of Tunisia recently denounced an "irresponsible statement" that falsely claimed Tunisian date exports were excluded from the Moroccan market. This claim was based on a rumor stemming from a temporary postponement announced by the Interprofessional Date Group (GID). However, the GID officially corrected the misinformation, confirming that date exports to the Moroccan market had begun as planned.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, and the Palestinian Agricultural Relief Fund signed suppor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Agriculture Directorate, and the Palestinian Agricultural Relief Fund signed support agreements with 31 farmers in Halhul. This initiative is the second phase of the project "Enhancing Resilience and Improving Livelihoods for Farmers and Communities Vulnerable to Climate Change," which is funded by the World Food Programme (WFP). The project specifically aims to enable grape farmers in the northern Hebron region to develop their production and improve crop quality, thereby strengthening the sustainability and resilience of the agricultural sector.

records.title: Saudi Arabia's Minister of Investment announced that a decision to open the market for Uzbek agricultural produce will be finalized soon.
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Minister of Investment announced that a decision to open the market for Uzbek agricultural produce will be finalized soon. This move is a strategic opportunity for both countries, as Saudi Arabia seeks to strengthen its food supply channels by welcoming Uzbek fruits and farm products. The two governments intend to accelerate cooperation to jointly develop agriculture and implement large projects that speed up trade.

records.title: The National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program is participating in the 42nd Saudi Agriculture Exhibition 2025, held under the p...
records.description: The National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program is participating in the 42nd Saudi Agriculture Exhibition 2025, held under the patronage of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture. The program is highlighting its efforts to develop and improve local livestock breeds, including camels, sheep, and cattle, and to preserve their genetic diversity for national food security. Furthermore, the program is promoting its initiatives to localize the production of veterinary vaccines and laboratory technologies and presenting investment opportunities to advance the Kingdom’s production system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Northern Borders Chamber of Commerce and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Northern Borders Region branch have ope...
records.description: The Northern Borders Chamber of Commerce and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Northern Borders Region branch have opened registration for engineering cooperation services for the upcoming rainfed farming season. This initiative aims to enhance the quality of agricultural services for farmers, with the ministry reporting a strong demand that reached nearly 70,000 applications for seasonal rainfed land across the region's governorates.
records.institution: The Northern Borders Chamber of Commerce and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Northern Borders Region Branch

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), in partnership with the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC), h...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), in partnership with the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC), has launched a Professional Training Programme for agricultural workers and farmers in Abu Dhabi. This initiative is a key part of a development plan to transition the sector to a professional, knowledge-based model by establishing clear occupational standards and promoting best practices. The program strengthens biosecurity, enhances operational quality, and supports the Emirate's goals for food security and sustainability.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), in partnership with the Abu Dhabi Quality and Conformity Council (ADQCC)

records.title: The Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG), a national food champion in the UAE, has signed a three-year strategic agreement with the Al Dahra Group d...
records.description: The Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG), a national food champion in the UAE, has signed a three-year strategic agreement with the Al Dahra Group during Global Food Week. This partnership secures a dedicated local supply of premium raw milk from Al Dahra Group’s dairy farms in Al Ain, ensuring a consistent supply for AAFG’s dairy production, including its Marmum Dairy brand. The collaboration is seen as a major step toward advancing the UAE’s food security goals by reinforcing the drive for a resilient, self-sufficient food production ecosystem and strengthening the domestic dairy sector.

records.title: The College of Agriculture at Amran University in Yemen inaugurated its new laboratories and research facilities, which were funded by th...
records.description: The College of Agriculture at Amran University in Yemen inaugurated its new laboratories and research facilities, which were funded by the Emergency Interventions Unit at a cost of 32 million Yemeni riyals. The facilities and the university's agricultural reserves, which also received significant support, are intended to advance agricultural research and provide practical field experience for students. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources affirmed its commitment to supporting the university's infrastructure, highlighting the vital role of the agricultural sector in the national economy.
records.institution: The College of Agriculture at Amran University

records.title: The Eastern Sector Multipurpose Agricultural Development Association in Yemen launched the first phase of an improved wheat harvest, with...
records.description: The Eastern Sector Multipurpose Agricultural Development Association in Yemen launched the first phase of an improved wheat harvest, with the ten tons of seeds allocated to fund a Community Seed Bank. This strategic step is part of the association's efforts to support local agriculture and achieve food security and self-sufficiency by reducing reliance on imported wheat. Additionally, the association plans to cultivate thousands of fruit seedlings this year to encourage farmers and expand agricultural areas in the region.
records.institution: The Eastern Sector Multipurpose Agricultural Development Association

records.title: The Ministry of Industry and Transport announced the establishment of a logistics zone at Damietta Port and highlighted the use of the fa...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry and Transport announced the establishment of a logistics zone at Damietta Port and highlighted the use of the fast Ro-Ro line to Trieste, Italy, to facilitate agricultural exports. This infrastructure supports the newly opened Agro Green for Exporting Agricultural Crops facility, which represents a $300 million investment with a 30,000-tonne annual capacity for vegetables. The Minister of Agriculture noted that this expansion aligns with Egypt’s National Industrial Strategy to raise the industrial sector's contribution to GDP and significantly boost agricultural exports.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Transport

records.title: The persistent climb in the cost of poultry in Egypt is severely impacting households, driven by a mix of costly feed imports, fuel price...
records.description: The persistent climb in the cost of poultry in Egypt is severely impacting households, driven by a mix of costly feed imports, fuel price hikes, and transportation challenges. The Egyptian government is under pressure to implement policies to stabilize the market by controlling inflation, promoting domestic feed production, and reducing import costs. The rising prices, which threaten to force small and medium farmers to cease operations, are already causing many Egyptian families to cut back on chicken consumption.

records.title: The Kuwait Ministry of Public Works has signed a contract worth 149.6 million dinars (or $488.9 million) with Turkish construction compan...
records.description: The Kuwait Ministry of Public Works has signed a contract worth 149.6 million dinars (or $488.9 million) with Turkish construction company Kuzu to build a large wastewater treatment plant for the South Al-Mutlaa city project. The new plant will use a hybrid system that combines conventional and renewable energy sources. This facility is crucial for the Al-Mutlaa city development, which includes over 28,000 housing units, and is designed to produce around 400,000 cubic meters of tertiary-treated water per day for agricultural and other uses. The Turkish company will be responsible for the plant's construction, operation, and maintenance.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the Genera...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the General Fisheries Commission for the Mediterranean (GFCM), and the National Council for Scientific Research (CNRS), has launched the fourth scientific survey of fishery resources along the Lebanese coast. This crucial 12-day survey is part of a GEF-funded project to provide vital data for assessing fish stocks and mapping habitats, directly supporting the development of evidence-based policies for the sustainable and resilient management of the fishing sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized an advisory seminar on white mushroom cultivation in Zgharta al-Matawla as part of its National Agr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized an advisory seminar on white mushroom cultivation in Zgharta al-Matawla as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program. The seminar was attended by approximately 40 participants, including farmers and cooperative heads. The training provided detailed instruction on the steps involved in mushroom cultivation, with a strong emphasis on maintaining strict hygiene, temperature, and ventilation standards to ensure production success. Additionally, an official from the Ministry of Agriculture stressed the importance of registering farmers in the agricultural registry to ensure they receive essential technical and advisory support for their work.

records.title: Spain broke its pepper import record during the 2024–2025 season by purchasing 113.11 million kilograms, with Morocco emerging as the ove...
records.description: Spain broke its pepper import record during the 2024–2025 season by purchasing 113.11 million kilograms, with Morocco emerging as the overwhelming supplier. According to Hortoinfo data, Morocco supplied 103.97 million kilograms, or 91.92% of Spain's total pepper imports. This dominance reflects a strong trade interdependence, with Moroccan exports to Spain increasing by 161% over the last ten seasons. The rapid growth meets the Spanish market's need for volumes outside its local season at a competitive price, averaging €1.31/kg for Moroccan peppers. The article notes that to maintain this momentum, Morocco must focus on technical improvements, including adopting specialized varieties, optimizing irrigation and pest management, and strengthening sorting and traceability practices.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman has launched the ‘Solar Energy – Sustainable Harvest’ program...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman has launched the ‘Solar Energy – Sustainable Harvest’ program in cooperation with Nafath Renewable Energy Company and Development Bank. The initiative encourages farmers to adopt solar energy as a sustainable alternative to reduce costs and enhance productivity, prioritizing farms with modern irrigation systems that support national food security. Furthermore, full-time farm owners may qualify for interest-free financing from the Development Bank.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, signed an agreement with the Tu...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by the Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, signed an agreement with the Tubas Municipality to establish a water tank in the Khallet Einun area of the Tubas Governorate. This project aims to improve irrigation services and the sustainability of natural resources in the Northern Jordan Valley. The agreement is part of the Ministry of Agriculture's strategic plan to enhance water and agricultural security and expand irrigated land in support of farmers' resilience, in accordance with the Forest Land Management Law.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the General Administration of Veterinary Services, inaugurated the second workshop on developing an...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the General Administration of Veterinary Services, inaugurated the second workshop on developing an animal health strategy. This workshop is part of a project to enhance national capacities in the field of sanitary and phytosanitary measures (SPS), implemented in partnership with several national and international institutions. The goal is to develop a comprehensive national framework that will strengthen the veterinary control system, improve food safety, and align with international animal health standards.

records.title: Olive presses in Saudi Arabia's Al-Jouf Region have started production, marking the beginning of a busy season for olive oil and pressed...
records.description: Olive presses in Saudi Arabia's Al-Jouf Region have started production, marking the beginning of a busy season for olive oil and pressed olives destined for local and international markets. The local multipurpose cooperative association upgraded its press capacity to 60 tons per 24 hours and ensures product safety through laboratory testing in cooperation with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture. The region celebrates this annual production, which boasts over 25 million olive trees, with the Al-Jouf International Olive Festival, organized by the regional municipality.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Qassim branch

records.title: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture launched the Weqaa beneficiaries platform for individuals and businesses in plant and...
records.description: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture launched the Weqaa beneficiaries platform for individuals and businesses in plant and animal health. The platform, introduced during the 2025 Saudi Agriculture Exhibition, is an initiative by the National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plants Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center) to promote digital transformation in the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plants Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center) signed three strategic Memoranda of...
records.description: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plants Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center) signed three strategic Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) at the 42nd Saudi Agriculture Exhibition. The agreements, made with the Agricultural Development Fund, King Faisal University, and Klybeck Life Sciences, aim to boost national integration, research, and industry in support of food security and sustainability.
