records.title: The Muslim World League (MWL) signed several cooperation agreements in Port Sudan with Sudanese ministries, including the Ministry of Hum...
records.description: The Muslim World League (MWL) signed several cooperation agreements in Port Sudan with Sudanese ministries, including the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Welfare. These agreements aim to strengthen partnership and expand humanitarian and developmental work in Sudan. The collaboration focuses on expertise exchange, human resource development, social welfare, health, agriculture, and irrigation to support national capacities and social programs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Welfare

records.title: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture organized a workshop in cooperation with the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry...
records.description: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture organized a workshop in cooperation with the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA) to develop the agricultural sector and enhance food security in Syria. The workshop focused on strengthening collaboration in scientific research, crop breed improvement, water resource management, and the application of modern agricultural technologies. The Minister of Agriculture emphasized the importance of resuming ICARDA's activities in Syria, while ICARDA affirmed its commitment to continued support through research and development projects.

records.title: The first Agriculture, Animal Production and Modern Technologies Exhibition "Agri Centre Product" will be held in Kairouan, organized by...
records.description: The first Agriculture, Animal Production and Modern Technologies Exhibition "Agri Centre Product" will be held in Kairouan, organized by the Kairouan Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries. The event aims to promote technological advances and local products specific to the governorate, such as olive trees and pistachio trees. As a hub for innovation and business, the exhibition will showcase modern solutions like solar energy for farms and smart machinery to support the region’s strong growth in agricultural investment.
records.institution: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has issued an urgent call for livestock farmers to adopt precautionary measure...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has issued an urgent call for livestock farmers to adopt precautionary measures against transboundary animal diseases, which are favored by high temperatures and humidity. The ministry stressed the "One Health" approach and recommended daily cleaning, drying of stagnant water, and the use of authorized pesticides and mosquito nets to protect the national herd. This proactive effort is intended to ensure animal and human health, requiring solidarity between farmers, veterinarians, and the administration.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia is supporting the strong growth of persimmon cultivation in the Nef...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia is supporting the strong growth of persimmon cultivation in the Nefza region, with production estimated to reach 310 tons in a recent year. This increase is being promoted by the annual Ouechtata Persimmon Festival, which acts as a key economic and promotional lever for the local product. The government is working to structure the sector through technical support and investment incentives, aiming for potential national recognition or a protected geographical indication.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: Tunisia is actively ramping up efforts to expand its olive oil exports to China as part of a strategic plan to diversify markets and redu...
records.description: Tunisia is actively ramping up efforts to expand its olive oil exports to China as part of a strategic plan to diversify markets and reduce reliance on traditional European buyers. A delegation from Tunisia's Ministry of Trade and Export Development, led by the Export Promotion Center (CEPEX), recently visited China to strengthen logistics and improve market access, particularly in Hubei Province. Despite being a top global producer, Tunisia is currently only the eighth-largest supplier to China.
records.institution: The Ministry of Trade and Export Development

records.description: Tunisia's Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has announced a strategic milestone, achieving record production of selected seeds for the 2024–2025 cereal season, effectively doubling volumes from the previous year. The country plans to provide farmers with 351,000 quintals of selected seeds, with 225,000 quintals already distributed to ensure a smooth start to the season. This dramatic increase is aimed at strengthening Tunisia's seed autonomy, improving crop yields through certified varieties, and boosting the resilience of the agricultural sector. The success relies on a national logistical mobilization involving regional agricultural centers and cooperatives, supported by quality control from the Tunisian National Institute of Agricultural Research (INRAT).
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

The innovative platform offers integrated tools like smart chatbots and calculators across six key sectors, including agriculture and livestock, with plans to expand its multilingual accessibility. This initiative strengthens applied knowledge, supports the local "Plant the Emirates" Programme, and aligns with the UAE's vision to foster a sustainable, knowledge-based ecosystem for food security and innovation.

The collaboration focuses on three areas: advancing camel milk research for global commercialization, developing sustainable poultry feed using local agricultural by-products, and providing students with hands-on experience in a talent incubation program. This alliance is committed to developing solutions that support the UAE's circular economy and sustainable growth.

records.title: The Global Food Week has kicked off in Abu Dhabi, highlighting international cooperation in the food sector.
records.description: The Global Food Week has kicked off in Abu Dhabi, highlighting international cooperation in the food sector. Organized by ADNEC Group in partnership with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), the event is attracting record participation from government and private entities and global brands. The week-long summit focuses on food innovation, modern agricultural technology, supply chains, and sustainability. Key events include the Abu Dhabi International Food Exhibition (ADIFE), the Abu Dhabi Date Palm Exhibition, and the inaugural Agricultural Investment Forum and Protein Alternatives initiative, with a strategic partnership from the UN Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO).

records.description: The local authority in Yemen's Bajil District, Hodeida Governorate, held a demonstration field day for grain and fruit farmers in the Al-Khadira sub-district. The event is part of a program to form and activate developmental agricultural production groups, supervised by the Ministry of Local and Rural Administration and Development and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. The activity aims to enhance agricultural production, develop farmers' skills, and train them in applying best field practices to achieve vertical expansion in production and improve crop quality.

records.description: The MEDIBEES project, funded by the European Union under the PRIMA program, is supporting the development of resilient beekeeping in Algeria, notably through the M'hamed Bouguerra University of Boumerdès (UMBB). The project focuses on genetic mapping of local bee subspecies to enhance resistance to drought and disease. records.institution: The M'hamed Bouguerra University of Boumerdès (UMBB)

records.description: A member of Bahrain’s parliamentary delegation participated in an Inter-Parliamentary Union (IPU) workshop on food security, held in cooperation with the WHO and the FAO. The MP highlighted Bahrain's National Food Security Strategy, which is a top priority that aims to enhance local production, support small farmers, and strengthen supply chains.

records.title: Egyptian spring onion exports to Europe have seen a significant surge, with sales nearly quadrupling in a recent marketing year, driven b...
records.description: Egyptian spring onion exports to Europe have seen a significant surge, with sales nearly quadrupling in a recent marketing year, driven by stable weather and farmers' better adherence to European specifications. Exporters are leveraging improved post-harvest handling and digital traceability to manage logistical challenges and meet the growing demand, particularly from Germany, the Netherlands, and Belgium. The focus is on building long-term, reliable partnerships to further strengthen Egypt's competitive position in the global market.

records.title: The Kuwait Fund for Development won a major award for financing the "Bahr Al-Baqar" project in Egypt, a crucial $416 million development...
records.description: The Kuwait Fund for Development won a major award for financing the "Bahr Al-Baqar" project in Egypt, a crucial $416 million development that converts wastewater into usable resources. The project components include a massive water treatment plant and the reclamation of thousands of acres of agricultural land. This initiative has significant economic, social, and environmental benefits, supporting food security and addressing the severe pollution of Lake Manzala.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon, through its Mount Lebanon Agriculture Department and the Deir al-Qamar Agricultural Center, organ...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon, through its Mount Lebanon Agriculture Department and the Deir al-Qamar Agricultural Center, organized a guidance workshop in Niha, Chouf. The seminar, held in collaboration with the Niha Municipality and REMER Company, focused on "Sustainable Agriculture and the Importance of Soil Biodiversity." Approximately 60 farmers and municipal figures participated. The workshop emphasized the principles of sustainable agriculture and Good Agricultural Practices (GAP), including the use of organic fertilizers, water management, and crop rotations.

records.title: A team of researchers from Oregon State University and Florida State University has developed an AI-powered smartphone application that p...
records.description: A team of researchers from Oregon State University and Florida State University has developed an AI-powered smartphone application that predicts the maturity and internal quality of Hass avocados from images. The system achieved a near 92% accuracy in predicting firmness and over 84% in distinguishing internal quality, offering a tool for consumers and industry to reduce waste. For the growing Moroccan avocado industry, this innovation could significantly reduce losses and optimize shipping decisions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: The National Office of Agricultural Advice (ONCA) organized a training session at the 5th National Apple Show (SAPOM 2025) to improve the...
records.description: The National Office of Agricultural Advice (ONCA) organized a training session at the 5th National Apple Show (SAPOM 2025) to improve the skills of local farmers. The session focused on crucial topics for mountain agriculture, including integrated pest management, water-saving techniques, and the rational use of nutrients. The event was held under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests and aimed to strengthen the resilience and profitability of the apple sector.
records.institution: The National Office of Agricultural Advice (ONCA)

records.title: Qatar Charity (QC) has launched the construction of a solar-powered seawater desalination plant in the Obock region of Djibouti.
records.description: Qatar Charity (QC) has launched the construction of a solar-powered seawater desalination plant in the Obock region of Djibouti. This eco-friendly facility, the second of its kind in the country, will provide safe drinking water to approximately 5,000 residents and livestock, addressing water scarcity and supporting local agricultural needs. The QR2 million project is part of a series of integrated interventions by Qatar Charity to improve living standards and foster sustainable development.

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia launched the 42nd Saudi Agriculture Exhibition in Riyadh, securing over SAR3.5 billion in investments across 28 agreements and memoranda of understanding. records.description: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and Syngenta Crop Protection AG (Syngenta) have signed a letter of intent (LOI) to combine their expertise to create a resilient agri-food sector in the Kingdom and globally. records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has issued the National Water Report for 2024, which highlights a c...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has issued the National Water Report for 2024, which highlights a critical water crisis due to the country's fifth consecutive year of drought. Dam inflows have dropped significantly, prompting the government to strengthen water mobilization through new desalination plants and drilling. The report's main recommendation is the urgent establishment of good water governance and institutional reforms to stabilize demand and ensure the sustainability of water resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The olive harvest season has begun in Tunisia's Gafsa governorate, with production estimated to reach 115,000 tons of olives, a significa...
records.description: The olive harvest season has begun in Tunisia's Gafsa governorate, with production estimated to reach 115,000 tons of olives, a significant increase from the previous year. This large harvest is expected to yield 24,500 tons of olive oil. The region has a substantial olive sector, with nearly 13 million olive trees and 34 oil mills, making the increase positive for the local economy.

records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture's Horticulture Department has announced the self-sufficient production of Pelt organic fertilizer (#Mesopotamia) to support national products. records.title: The Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) has reported significant progress in modernizing the region's water infrastructure.
records.description: The Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) has reported significant progress in modernizing the region's water infrastructure. The government has completed nine dams at a cost of about IQD 266 billion (approximately $203 million), providing a combined water storage capacity of approximately 253 million cubic meters. Additionally, 23 ponds have been completed, with more under construction.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Jordan held a consultative meeting to discuss the current season's olive oil prices and production volumes.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Jordan held a consultative meeting to discuss the current season's olive oil prices and production volumes. Amid rising prices and market challenges, participants agreed on a two-part measure to ensure market stability: they will continue monitoring prices, and if they continue to rise, Jordan will open olive oil imports from approved sources to meet local demand.

The industry is also investing in new varieties that offer larger fruit with longer shelf life to maintain its competitiveness in the global market.

records.description: The Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries announced a series of projects for 2026 and beyond aimed at ensuring the sustainable and efficient management of water resources. records.title: Egypt's sweet potato exports to Spain have surged, nearly quadrupling in the 2024/25 marketing year.
records.description: Egypt's sweet potato exports to Spain have surged, nearly quadrupling in the 2024/25 marketing year. A marketing year (MY) is a designated period for reporting and analyzing a commodity, typically beginning around harvest time. For the 2024/25 MY, Egypt exported a record 18,600 metric tons (or tonnes) of sweet potatoes to Spain, valued at approximately $12.4 million. A metric ton is a unit of mass equal to 1,000 kilograms (approximately 2,204.6 pounds). This volume is a significant increase from previous years and has made Egypt the leading sweet potato supplier to Spain, with a 62.8% share of the total import market. Egypt has also doubled its shipments to France, becoming the top supplier there as well. The country's increasing prominence in the global berry industry is the result of years of investment in the sector, including improvements in logistics, product quality, and traceability. The success of Moroccan blueberries in Canada is a part of a larger trend of the country's emergence as a key player in the global agri-food market.

records.description: The Jordanian Cabinet has approved a series of decisions to boost economic activity and support agriculture. These actions align with a broader plan to improve public services and strengthen the national economy.

This growth, supported by modern techniques and smart irrigation, highlights coffee's growing contribution to the national economy and reinforces the region’s position as a key producer.

The Algerian delegation consists of 17 national companies specializing in the production and marketing of various agricultural goods that meet high international standards. This participation is part of a broader strategy to promote Algerian products and boost their presence in European and international markets, utilizing a major global event that is expected to draw over 100,000 visitors.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has initiated a school afforestation campaign in Najaf Governorate, in collaboration with the Directorate of...

This campaign reflects the ministry's belief in the importance of afforestation to mitigate climate change and promote the concept of agriculture within the governorate. It is a concerted effort to plant a variety of seedlings and trees, raising awareness about their environmental benefits.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is conducting continuous veterinary health campaigns to ensure the safety of meat in local markets.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is conducting continuous veterinary health campaigns to ensure the safety of meat in local markets. The Veterinary Department's teams are performing regular field visits to slaughterhouses to monitor operations, providing essential health services and epidemiological monitoring. Their work involves supervising the inspection and slaughtering processes of poultry to guarantee that consumers have access to safe and healthy meat.

records.title: In the 2024/25 season, Morocco has become the leading non-EU supplier of small citrus fruits to Spain, a remarkable achievement given the...
records.description: In the 2024/25 season, Morocco has become the leading non-EU supplier of small citrus fruits to Spain, a remarkable achievement given the overall 16% decline in Spanish citrus imports. According to the Spanish Ministry of Agriculture, imports of Moroccan small citrus fruits have surged by 190% compared to the previous year, now accounting for 48% of Spain's extra-EU imports in this category. This growth solidifies Morocco's position as a strategic player in the Mediterranean market, demonstrating the competitiveness of its citrus industry through investments in quality, logistics, and variety diversification, and creating direct competition for Spanish producers.

records.title: The CMGP group, a major player in Moroccan agricultural inputs, has acquired a 92.5% stake in the Compagnie de Produits Chimiques du Maro...
records.description: The CMGP group, a major player in Moroccan agricultural inputs, has acquired a 92.5% stake in the Compagnie de Produits Chimiques du Maroc (CPCM), with the intention of acquiring the full company. This acquisition, which is part of CMGP's external growth strategy, will allow the group to expand its offerings to include chemical products for agriculture, water treatment, and industrial applications. The deal, which is subject to approval by the Competition Council, is expected to boost CMGP's consolidated revenue to nearly 3 billion dirhams, creating a more comprehensive range of solutions for farmers and manufacturers.

records.title: The Moroccan avocado industry is under significant pressure during the 2025–2026 season due to a severe heatwave that destroyed nearly ha...
records.description: The Moroccan avocado industry is under significant pressure during the 2025–2026 season due to a severe heatwave that destroyed nearly half of the expected crop. According to the Moroccan Association of Avocado Producers, production is forecasted to drop by 30% to 80,000 tonnes from the previous year's record of 115,000 tonnes. This decline, most severe in the main production area of Gharb, highlights a growing divide between large, resilient farms and smaller, more vulnerable producers. In response, industry professionals expect prices to rise significantly and are calling for a necessary restructuring of the sector, which would include the creation of a "Moroccan Avocado" label, the generalization of certifications, and stronger support for cooperatives and agronomic research.

This plan aims to make family farming a key driver for sustainable development, food security, and climate resilience in Tunisia. records.description: Tunisia is expecting an exceptional 2025–2026 date harvest, with a projected increase in both quantity and quality. records.description: The 2025 Egyptian pomegranate season is seeing a growing price gap between different varieties, such as Baladi and Wonderful, as a result of increased consumer awareness. Despite a slight delay in the start of the season, a fresh produce trader, Triland, notes that volumes are normal with medium to small sizes. Even with a price increase due to better quality, Egyptian pomegranates remain cheaper than those from Spain and Turkey, which allows them to target European markets. The company secures its programs for South East Asia and Eastern and Central Europe in advance to ensure a stable supply for its customers.

records.title: Morocco's blueberry industry is cementing its position as a major global player, with production expected to exceed 80,000 tonnes.
records.description: Morocco's blueberry industry is cementing its position as a major global player, with production expected to exceed 80,000 tonnes. The country is capitalizing on varietal diversification and a continuous harvest season that extends from January to June, with officials from African Blue praising the sector's maturity. While Europe remains the primary market, new markets in Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and the United States are being explored. Despite challenges such as insufficient seasonal labor and extreme weather conditions that can reduce yields by up to 25%, producers and authorities are investing in precision irrigation and water infrastructure to strengthen the sector's resilience and competitiveness.

records.title: The Fishermen's Pier project in the Khour Al Hajar area of the Wilayat of Ras Al Hadd has been inaugurated.
records.description: The Fishermen's Pier project in the Khour Al Hajar area of the Wilayat of Ras Al Hadd has been inaugurated. The project, funded by the Oman Liquefied Natural Gas (Oman LNG) Development Foundation at a cost of OMR250,000, is a significant addition to the fishing sector. It includes 100-meter-long breakwaters, a 12-meter-wide slipway, and solar-powered lighting. The initiative, overseen by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, aims to provide a safe environment for fishermen, facilitate the movement of boats, and encourage investment and maritime tourism. It will also reduce risks and enhance the efficiency of daily operations, thereby supporting sustainable local development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman is partnering with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) to develop farms on 54,000 acres of land in th...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman is partnering with the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) to develop farms on 54,000 acres of land in the Al Najd area of the Dhofar region. According to a press release from Oman's Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, JICA will provide the investment for the project, which aims to reduce the country’s reliance on imported food and ensure a stable supply. The initiative will include building reservoirs to store water from seasonal monsoon rains and is part of Oman's broader effort to enhance food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture opened two new agricultural offices in Jenin Governorate to enhance the decentralization of its services.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture opened two new agricultural offices in Jenin Governorate to enhance the decentralization of its services. The opening, attended by officials from the Jenin Governorate and the municipalities of Al-Yamoun and Arraba, aims to empower farmers and facilitate their access to services, particularly in light of the transportation difficulties they face. This move, which is a key part of the ministry’s efforts to support farmers’ steadfastness, will help provide services more efficiently and quickly. Following the opening, the delegation visited the National Center for Agricultural Research to review its operations.

records.title: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has announced that Saudi Arabia has reduced food loss and waste by 16%, bringing the total rat...
records.description: The General Food Security Authority (GFSA) has announced that Saudi Arabia has reduced food loss and waste by 16%, bringing the total rate from 33.1% to 27.9% compared to the 2019 baseline. This achievement, which aligns with Saudi Vision 2030, was highlighted at a ceremony in Riyadh that marked the launch of the Letadom platform and the signing of eight cooperation agreements to address food loss and waste. The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture stated that these results affirm the effectiveness of national strategies and enhance the Kingdom's international competitiveness in this area.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has reaffirmed the prohibition of cryptocurrency mining on agricultural land...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has reaffirmed the prohibition of cryptocurrency mining on agricultural land, an activity that contradicts the purpose of farm use and negatively impacts sustainability and biosecurity. Following the detection of violations, ADAFSA announced strict administrative penalties, including a fine of AED 100,000 for violators, which can be doubled for repeat offenses. The authority will also suspend all services and support programs, confiscate mining equipment, and disconnect electricity to non-compliant farms, reinforcing its call for all agricultural workers and owners to adhere to the approved economic uses of farmlands.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The AI-powered platform Aydi has closed a $7.5 million seed funding round to scale its new AI agronomy assistant, Orth.
records.description: The AI-powered platform Aydi has closed a $7.5 million seed funding round to scale its new AI agronomy assistant, Orth. The platform, which provides real-time insights to growers, aims to help them improve their yields and efficiency by over 20% by combining satellite monitoring, predictive analytics, and conversational AI. The funding round was led by COTU Ventures, Daltex, and Nuwa Capital, with participation from Magrabi Agriculture and Foundation Ventures. The launch of Orth at the Fruit Attraction event in Madrid marks a significant step toward democratizing access to expert agronomy for millions of farmers worldwide, addressing the challenges of climate volatility and rising input costs.

records.title: The Al Seer Group, a leading FMCG distributor, and Food Tech Valley, a government-backed food innovation hub, have announced a strategic...
records.description: The Al Seer Group, a leading FMCG distributor, and Food Tech Valley, a government-backed food innovation hub, have announced a strategic partnership to build a state-of-the-art food logistics facility in Dubai. The partnership, signed at the Future Food Forum 2025, also aims to support the growth of locally owned food brands and attract global partners, reinforcing the UAE’s position as a leader in sustainable food systems.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has inaugurated the second phase of a contract farming project for poultry production in Dhamar Governorate, with an initial capacity of 540,000 frozen chickens. The initiative, which is part of a broader effort to replace imports with domestic production, is considered a strategic step to strengthen national production, regulate the market, and stabilize prices. The project operates on a contractual framework that balances the interests of farmers and importers, aiming to boost marketing opportunities and ensure a competitive domestic product. Local authorities and the Chamber of Commerce are involved to support breeders and investors, thereby strengthening economic resilience and sustainable agricultural development.

CEDARE also announced plans to partner with Egypt’s New and Renewable Energy Authority to position the country as a regional hub for carbon certification.
