records.title: The date season in AlUla is attracting a growing number of farmers, shoppers, and traders, solidifying its role as a key economic platform.
records.description: The date season in AlUla is attracting a growing number of farmers, shoppers, and traders, solidifying its role as a key economic platform. The region, home to over 4.1 million palm trees that produce more than 169,000 tons of dates annually, saw sales of over 1.7 million kilograms last season, generating SAR8.8 million in revenue. This success is a result of support from the Royal Commission for AlUla, which has empowered more than 2,500 farmers and certified 250 farms to ensure their dates meet high quality standards. These efforts have established AlUla dates as a premium Saudi product, boosting the local economy and enhancing AlUla's reputation as a cultural and tourist destination.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Dumat Al-Jandal agricultural processing products festival is an event that brings together farmers, family businesses, and government...
records.description: The Dumat Al-Jandal agricultural processing products festival is an event that brings together farmers, family businesses, and government entities. Its main goal is to promote the diverse agricultural products of the Al-Jouf region and explore new opportunities for the sector. The festival offers specialized workshops for producers, covering topics like agricultural laboratory services, farm biosecurity, and renewable energy. It also serves as a platform for young innovators in sustainable agriculture. The event highlights various local products, including olives, honey, and dates, and features popular local dishes from the cottage industry.

records.title: The Sudanese Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation has affirmed the government's strong commitment to the Gezira Scheme, calling it a na...
records.description: The Sudanese Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation has affirmed the government's strong commitment to the Gezira Scheme, calling it a national priority crucial for the country's recovery and food security. In a meeting with scheme workers, officials highlighted the importance of coordinating efforts, attracting investment, and supporting farmers to boost productivity. The Governor of the Scheme confirmed the completion of arrangements for the summer harvest and the preparation to cultivate 500,000 acres for the upcoming winter season, with the goal of strengthening the national economy and countering claims of famine.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.title: The Iraqi government has approved an allocation of 500 billion Iraqi dinars (approximately $340 million) to support farmers nationwide.
records.description: The Iraqi government has approved an allocation of 500 billion Iraqi dinars (approximately $340 million) to support farmers nationwide. Announced by the Ministry of Trade, this initiative aims to strengthen the agricultural sector and enhance national food security. The General Company for Grain Trade will be responsible for distributing the funds through transparent and fair mechanisms. The ministry views this as a crucial step to build farmers' confidence, encourage increased production, and promote self-sufficiency in order to ensure the stability of the domestic market.

records.title: Moroccan producer Cap Growers is introducing a new persimmon variety, Rojo Brillante, grown in the Chichaoua region, despite a challengin...
records.description: Moroccan producer Cap Growers is introducing a new persimmon variety, Rojo Brillante, grown in the Chichaoua region, despite a challenging agricultural season marked by severe drought and heatwaves that have impacted fruit volumes and sizes across Morocco. The company notes a general trend of lower volumes and smaller fruit sizes, with persimmon volumes in the region having fallen by 20% and significant losses reported in the citrus sector. To navigate these challenges, Cap Growers plans to focus on the late season to avoid intense competition from South African supply and is considering shifting its export focus towards the European market following a disappointing season in the U.S.. The company will also participate in the Fruit Attraction trade show to explore new opportunities.

records.title: Morocco has begun its soft wheat import campaign for the 2025-2026 season amidst a period of international price stability.
records.description: Morocco has begun its soft wheat import campaign for the 2025-2026 season amidst a period of international price stability. Consequently, the National Interprofessional Office for Cereals and Legumes (ONICL) has suspended the flat-rate import subsidy, as international prices remain below the 270 dirhams per quintal threshold required for state support. Importers are acting proactively to secure necessary volumes, with shipments from key suppliers like France and Russia expected in the coming months. Last season, Morocco imported over 10.2 million tonnes of soft wheat, with France being the primary supplier.
records.institution: National Interprofessional Office for Cereals and Legumes (ONICL)

records.title: Morocco has confirmed its position as a major player in the international market, with a record export of nearly 745,000 tons of tomatoes...
records.description: Morocco has confirmed its position as a major player in the international market, with a record export of nearly 745,000 tons of tomatoes valued at $1.2 billion. This represents an increase of over 8% compared to the previous season. France remains the largest customer, absorbing about half of the volume, while the United Kingdom is the second-largest market. Despite persistent challenges like drought and labor constraints, the Moroccan tomato sector has shown remarkable resilience, with new markets in Scandinavia and West Africa also showing growing demand.

records.title: The National Observatory of Agriculture (Onagri) published a report detailing a desert locust invasion that affected southern Tunisia, wh...
records.description: The National Observatory of Agriculture (Onagri) published a report detailing a desert locust invasion that affected southern Tunisia, which originated from Libya and Algeria. In response, the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries launched a national control campaign that successfully contained the spread by treating over 20,800 hectares. This effort was supported by international cooperation through the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)'s Desert Locust Control Commission in the Western Region, which includes partners like Algeria and Mauritania. While the immediate threat was mitigated, the report warns of a potential return of the locusts in the fall, highlighting the need for continued vigilance.

records.title: The Tunisian government has set a regulatory stock of 19.7 million liters of sterilized fresh milk for 2025.
records.description: The Tunisian government has set a regulatory stock of 19.7 million liters of sterilized fresh milk for 2025. This decision, published in the Official Journal of the Tunisian Republic (JORT), is a key part of the national strategy to stabilize the dairy market and ensure a continuous milk supply. The stock will be built during the peak lactation period, which occurs between March and August, and will be supported by a government-issued storage bonus for dairy plants to help them offset associated costs. The measure, which relies on a consolidated legal framework, is intended to prevent crises from overproduction and support the country's food sovereignty.
records.institution: Official Journal of the Tunisian Republic (JORT)

records.title: The Tunisian olive oil industry is facing a crisis of overproduction, with a forecast of up to 500,000 tons for the upcoming season, whic...
records.description: The Tunisian olive oil industry is facing a crisis of overproduction, with a forecast of up to 500,000 tons for the upcoming season, which has caused a 30% drop in export prices. In response, members of the Tunisian Parliament submitted a report calling for urgent measures to support the sector, including simplifying regulations for the disposal of olive pomace. Experts are exploring solutions such as increasing exports to new markets and focusing on value-added products through packaging, as only 14.7% of exports are currently bottled. The crisis highlights the urgent need for a comprehensive national strategy to improve storage, modernize mills, and strengthen the competitiveness of this vital sector that supports over 300,000 families.

records.title: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has announced that 21 international teams from 13 countries have advanced in the "Al Miyah Challen...
records.description: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has announced that 21 international teams from 13 countries have advanced in the "Al Miyah Challenge for Agriculture." This competition, which offers a prize of AED 8 million, seeks to identify innovative solutions for reducing water consumption while maintaining or increasing crop yields in water-scarce regions. The qualifying teams proposed a range of technologies, from precision irrigation to AI-driven analytics. The initiative is a partnership with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), ASPIRE, and Silal Food and Technology. Finalists will pilot their technologies in the UAE to test their viability for real-world application.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: According to the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, Egypt has achieved 60% domestic production of red meat and is nearing comp...
records.description: According to the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, Egypt has achieved 60% domestic production of red meat and is nearing complete self-sufficiency in poultry. This progress is attributed to a government food security program that prioritizes veterinary services and regular inspections to ensure the safety and quality of animal products. The ministry is also strengthening agricultural cooperation with Kuwait, with officials discussing potential joint ventures and investment opportunities in livestock, fish farming, and the meat industry to enhance food security and expand trade between the two nations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Jordanian government has earmarked JD139 million (US$196 million) for wheat subsidies to bolster food security and stabilize bread pr...
records.description: The Jordanian government has earmarked JD139 million (US$196 million) for wheat subsidies to bolster food security and stabilize bread prices. The Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply announced that it will continue providing direct cash assistance to bakeries to protect citizens from fluctuating global commodity prices. Although Jordan’s domestic wheat production is minimal, the country maintains substantial reserves, with its wheat stockpiles reported to cover over 10 months of domestic consumption. To secure its supply, the government is actively engaged in the global grain market by issuing tenders, while also supporting local farmers through a grain purchase program with subsidized prices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply

records.title: Moroccan strawberries, mainly produced in the Gharb and Loukkos regions, have become a cornerstone of export agriculture, especially to E...
records.description: Moroccan strawberries, mainly produced in the Gharb and Loukkos regions, have become a cornerstone of export agriculture, especially to European markets. While cultivation practices such as drip irrigation, biological inputs, and careful manual harvesting are generally well managed, a recent study in Frontiers in Microbiology highlights significant post-harvest microbial challenges. High levels of bacteria and yeasts were detected on freshly harvested fruit, accelerating spoilage, reducing shelf life, and risking export rejections.

records.title: Morocco's olive oil sector is anticipating a record-breaking year, with production projected to reach 200,000 tons, more than double the...
records.description: Morocco's olive oil sector is anticipating a record-breaking year, with production projected to reach 200,000 tons, more than double the amount from the previous year. The Moroccan Olive Interprofessional Federation (Interprolive) attributes this rebound to favorable weather conditions following two years of severe drought. The bumper crop is expected to create an exportable surplus of 60,000 tons, with domestic prices projected to fall significantly. The country is well-positioned to capitalize on this surplus, particularly in the United States, where new tariffs give Moroccan producers a competitive advantage over traditional European suppliers. The optimism is shared by officials, who see this as a turning point that will strengthen Morocco's position as a regional agri-export leader.

records.title: Syngenta Morocco has launched Broncos, a new zucchini variety designed for outdoor cultivation, as part of its broader strategy to enhanc...
records.description: Syngenta Morocco has launched Broncos, a new zucchini variety designed for outdoor cultivation, as part of its broader strategy to enhance agricultural resilience in Morocco. This variety is known as a "4x4" due to its exceptional vigor, high yield potential, and reliable fruit setting, even in low temperatures. It is also highly resistant to common viruses like CMV, ZYMV, and WMV, making it a reliable choice for areas with increasing climatic variability. The fruit has a dark color and straight shape, which are desirable qualities for export. Initial feedback from producers has been very positive, confirming the variety's performance and suitability for local market requirements.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced new regulations for the packaging and labeling of fruits and vegetables...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced new regulations for the packaging and labeling of fruits and vegetables sold in public markets, as part of its commitment to food safety and environmental protection in line with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030. The rules require that each packaged retail unit include a label with the product name, net weight, packaging date, country of origin, and supplier details. Furthermore, the regulations specify that packaging must be made of durable, recyclable, and food-grade materials that allow for air circulation. For cardboard, the packaging must be corrugated and covered externally to prevent contamination during storage and transport.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Maritime Fisheries has announced the launch of its program to distribute seeds and ferti...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Maritime Fisheries has announced the launch of its program to distribute seeds and fertilizers for the agricultural season in Tunisia. A total of 520,000 quintals of selected seeds, double the amount from last year, have been reserved for distribution, with 150,000 quintals already available for farmers. Additionally, the program includes the provision of 120,000 tons of DAP fertilizer and 220,000 tons of ammonium nitrate to support agricultural productivity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Maritime Fisheries

records.title: The National Agronomic Institute of Tunisia (INAT) celebrated the graduation of the first class of 26 rural eco-advisors, marking a key m...
records.description: The National Agronomic Institute of Tunisia (INAT) celebrated the graduation of the first class of 26 rural eco-advisors, marking a key milestone for the BioTED project. This initiative, a collaboration between Tunisia and Belgium, aims to boost sustainable agritourism by training professionals from the Regional Agricultural Development Commissions (CRDA) and the Regional Tourism Commissions (CRT) to support farm-based hospitality projects. The BioTED project, which is part of Tunisia's national strategy for organic agriculture, seeks to diversify farmers' incomes, promote rural employment, and enhance the resilience of agricultural communities by creating a new profession and a national support structure for agritourism.

records.title: Tunisia, a leading exporter of the Deglet Ennour date variety, experienced a concerning decline in its date export sector.
records.description: Tunisia, a leading exporter of the Deglet Ennour date variety, experienced a concerning decline in its date export sector. According to the National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI), export volumes dropped by 6% and revenue fell by 3.8% during the 2024–2025 season. This downturn is attributed to several factors: intensifying competition from other countries like Saudi Arabia and Algeria 🇦🇪, a fall in the average price of the flagship Deglet Ennour variety, and changing consumer demands for traceability and organic certification. To counter this trend, industry professionals are calling for a strategy to diversify markets, invest in quality and certification, and modernize the sector.

records.title: Egypt’s Minister of Water Resources and Irrigation met with Bahrain’s Minister of Works to discuss boosting cooperation in water management.
records.description: Egypt’s Minister of Water Resources and Irrigation met with Bahrain’s Minister of Works to discuss boosting cooperation in water management. Egypt presented its “Irrigation System 2.0” strategy focused on reuse of agricultural drainage water, desalination, and advanced technologies like AI and satellite monitoring. Both sides stressed shared challenges of water scarcity and agreed to expand collaboration in water treatment, desalination, digital solutions, and capacity-building through Egypt’s Regional Training Center for Water Resources and Irrigation.
records.institution: The Ministry of of Water Resources and Irrigation

records.title: Egypt’s state grain buyer, Mostakbal Misr (Future of Egypt for Sustainable Development), secured six shipments of vegetable oil totaling...
records.description: Egypt’s state grain buyer, Mostakbal Misr (Future of Egypt for Sustainable Development), secured six shipments of vegetable oil totaling over 74,000 tons and finalized agreements to import more than 600,000 tons of wheat, mainly from Black Sea countries and France, for delivery in September and October. The purchases aim to offset a domestic shortfall, as government procurement from local farmers reached only 3.9 million tons—below the 4–5 million ton target—due to farmers preferring private buyers despite higher official prices. With inflation, rising living costs, and currency pressures straining households, the government remains heavily reliant on imports to sustain its subsidized bread program, a key support for two-thirds of the population. Wheat imports for 2025/26 are projected at around 13 million tons, in line with last season.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the World Food Programme, implemented a successful barley fodder project in Al-Madinah...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the World Food Programme, implemented a successful barley fodder project in Al-Madinah district, Basra Governorate, to support buffalo breeders. The initiative provided equipment such as germination trays, cooling devices, sprinklers, solar cells, and caravans, easing breeders’ challenges in securing green fodder. Continuous follow-up ensured its success, with breeders reporting improved milk and dairy production in both quality and quantity.

records.title: Jordan’s Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources signed an MoU with China’s UEG Green Hydrogen Development Holding Limited to conduct a...
records.description: Jordan’s Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources signed an MoU with China’s UEG Green Hydrogen Development Holding Limited to conduct a feasibility study for a $1.155 billion green hydrogen project. The study will assess producing 200,000 tonnes of green ammonia annually for export, using desalinated seawater and renewable energy across Jordan. The initiative aligns with Jordan’s national framework to position the country as a regional hub for green hydrogen, leveraging its renewable resources and available land to attract foreign investment and advance clean energy development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources

records.title: An Omani-Indian fertiliser joint venture is planning to list on the Muscat stock exchange as part of Oman’s broader privatisation efforts.
records.description: An Omani-Indian fertiliser joint venture is planning to list on the Muscat stock exchange as part of Oman’s broader privatisation efforts. The company has requested proposals from banks for the potential listing, which remains in the early stages. State-backed OQ holds half of the venture, with the rest equally owned by two Indian cooperatives. Established in 1994, the company operates plants in Sur Industrial City producing large volumes of ammonia and urea. Oman has recently raised billions from previous listings, while IPO activity across the Middle East and North Africa has surged to its highest first-half level since 2008, with 25 companies raising a combined $4.5 billion.

records.title: The Food Security Forum and Exhibition, held under the theme “Safe Investment for Sustainable Food”, concluded after two days with over 3...
records.description: The Food Security Forum and Exhibition, held under the theme “Safe Investment for Sustainable Food”, concluded after two days with over 360 participants, 25 expert speakers, and 27 exhibiting institutions. Discussions highlighted Oman’s economic growth and investment opportunities as drivers of food security. Key recommendations focused on boosting local food manufacturing, strengthening agricultural value chains, and encouraging private investment in storage, distribution, and marketing systems.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources for Agriculture

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), held a na...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), held a national workshop in Jericho on promoting climate-smart and resilient agriculture along the date value chain. Organized under the FAO-led project Promoting Market-Led Investments and Innovations for the Development of Sustainable Agrifood Systems (MAP II), funded by Denmark, the European Union, Switzerland, and Spain, the workshop gathered government officials, farmers’ associations, research institutions, the private sector, and international partners. Discussions focused on climate challenges facing the date sector, opportunities for climate-smart solutions, and strengthening partnerships to enhance resilience, food security, and rural economic development in Palestine.

records.title: The Union of Agricultural Work Committees, in partnership with the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture through the North Hebron Agricultu...
records.description: The Union of Agricultural Work Committees, in partnership with the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture through the North Hebron Agriculture Directorate and the Rural Development Department, delivered inputs for a hydroponic vertical farming project to 27 beneficiaries across five locations in Hebron Governorate. Implemented under the Palestinian Women Farmers Support Project, the initiative seeks to promote food sovereignty, empower rural women, encourage home farming, and strengthen resilience in communities facing economic hardship and pressures from occupation and settlement activities.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: QatarEnergy signed an agreement with Samsung C&T’s Engineering & Construction Group to build the Dukhan solar power plant, a world-scale...
records.description: QatarEnergy signed an agreement with Samsung C&T’s Engineering & Construction Group to build the Dukhan solar power plant, a world-scale project west of Doha that will reach 2,000 MW capacity by mid-2029. The plant, one of the largest globally, will double Qatar’s solar production, support the country’s renewable energy targets, and contribute to Qatar National Vision 2030. Integrated with KAHRAMAA’s grid, it will reduce carbon emissions by an estimated 4.7 million tons annually and cover up to 30% of peak electricity demand, strengthening Qatar’s sustainable energy transition.

records.title: QatarEnergy signs Dukhan Solar Power Plant construction contract
records.description: QatarEnergy has signed an agreement with Samsung C&T for the construction of the Dukhan Solar Power Plant, one of the world’s largest, located 80 km west of Doha. The project will be developed in two phases, reaching 2,000 MW capacity by mid-2029, and will double Qatar’s solar power production. Once operational, it will contribute up to 30% of peak electricity demand and cut carbon emissions by 4.7 million tons annually. The first 1,000 MW phase is expected to begin supplying power to the KAHRAMAA grid by late 2028.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Saudi Arabia’s Power Procurement Company (SPPC) has launched a Request for Qualification (RFQ) for the seventh round of the National Rene...
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s Power Procurement Company (SPPC) has launched a Request for Qualification (RFQ) for the seventh round of the National Renewable Energy Programme (NREP), covering six projects with a total capacity of 5.3 GW. The round includes four solar PV projects—Tabarjal 2 (1,400 MW), Mawaq (600 MW), Tathleeth (600 MW), and South Al-Ula (500 MW)—and two wind projects, Bilghah (1,300 MW) and Shaqran (900 MW), all located in different regions of the Kingdom. To date, SPPC has tendered over 43 GW of renewable capacity and signed PPAs for more than 38 GW.

records.title: The National Center for Meteorology (NCM), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the National Cent...
records.description: The National Center for Meteorology (NCM), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the National Center for Non-Profit Sector, launched an initiative in Jeddah to support weather and climate enthusiasts, associations, and volunteer teams by granting free access to its resources, services, and training. The program aims to boost community participation, strengthen meteorological awareness, and provide opportunities for engagement in climate-related events, with registration available through the NCM website and the Anwaa platform.

records.title: Hodeidah has launched the second phase of contract farming in the poultry sector, aiming to replace imports with 5,400 tons of locally pr...
records.description: Hodeidah has launched the second phase of contract farming in the poultry sector, aiming to replace imports with 5,400 tons of locally produced frozen chicken by the end of 2025. The initiative, coordinated by the Yemeni government through the Ministries of Agriculture, Fisheries, Water Resources, Economy, Industry, and Investment, brings together cooperative associations, small-scale poultry farmers, slaughterhouses, and marketing companies. It is designed to strengthen local production, improve product quality, create jobs, and support self-sufficiency in the poultry sector.
records.institution: The Ministries of Agriculture, Fisheries, Water Resources, Economy, Industry, and Investment

records.title: The Chamber of Agriculture of Souk Ahras, in collaboration with the Algerian Association for the Promotion of Saffron, organized a practi...
records.description: The Chamber of Agriculture of Souk Ahras, in collaboration with the Algerian Association for the Promotion of Saffron, organized a practical study day dedicated to the cultivation and production of saffron, aiming to promote high-value agricultural sectors. The event gathered project leaders, university students, associations, and local participants, providing explanations on saffron cultivation adapted to the region’s favorable climate and soil. A practical model planting was carried out at the Green Corner nursery in Souk Ahras to demonstrate optimal techniques. The training emphasized scientific methods to ensure abundant saffron production as a promising economic alternative, and forms part of a broader program of agricultural training sessions to support and develop high value-added crops in the wilaya.
records.institution: The Algerian Association for the Promotion of Saffron

records.title: Egypt will host the eighth edition of Cairo Water Week (CWW) this October under the theme “Innovative Solutions for Climate Resilience an...
records.description: Egypt will host the eighth edition of Cairo Water Week (CWW) this October under the theme “Innovative Solutions for Climate Resilience and Water Sustainability.” Organized by the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation, the event will gather global experts, policymakers, and organizations to address climate-related water challenges. Key sessions include meetings of the World Water Council, the Arab League, UNESCO’s International Hydrological Programme, and the EU-Egypt Water Investment Forum, affirming Egypt’s role in advancing regional and international cooperation on water security and sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, announced the approval and registration of several veterinary medicines a...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, announced the approval and registration of several veterinary medicines and vaccines after they met the required physical and biological field tests set by the department. During a meeting of the Veterinary Medicines and Vaccines Registration Committee at the department’s headquarters, a total of 21 veterinary pharmaceutical materials and 5 feed additives were approved in line with the regulations governing veterinary medicine and vaccine registration.

records.title: Lebanon’s Ministry of Agriculture, launched a training course on climate change data analysis with 16 participants.
records.description: Lebanon’s Ministry of Agriculture, launched a training course on climate change data analysis with 16 participants. The program focuses on modern tools like RICCAR, CORDEX, and NetCDF to assess climate impacts on water and agriculture. ACSAD Director General Dr. Nasreddine Al-Obeid and Minister Dr. Nizar Hani highlighted joint projects, including mountain lakes, olive seedling distribution, and wheat self-sufficiency. The course strengthens national capacities, supporting Lebanon’s food and water security and resilience to climate change.
records.institution: The Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD)

records.title: Morocco is set to host the 6th World Conference of the World Association for Soil and Water Conservation (WASWAC) in Rabat, under the the...
records.description: Morocco is set to host the 6th World Conference of the World Association for Soil and Water Conservation (WASWAC) in Rabat, under the theme “Resilient Landscapes: Innovations and Traditions in Climate-Adaptive Soil & Water Conservation (RISE-SWC).” The event is organized by the National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) in partnership with ICARDA, APNI, OCP Nutricrops, and international organizations including FAO-GSP, UNESCO, IWMI, and IAV Hassan II. Bringing together over 500 participants from across five continents, the conference will feature plenary sessions, panels, workshops, training for young researchers, and a scientific tour, focusing on sustainable soil and water management, digital and scientific innovations, policy frameworks, and North-South partnerships.
records.institution: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA)

records.title: The olive oil sector is showing renewed optimism after several years of low productivity caused by drought, thanks to rainfall in March a...
records.description: The olive oil sector is showing renewed optimism after several years of low productivity caused by drought, thanks to rainfall in March and April that revived olive groves and raised expectations for a record harvest. The Ministry of Agriculture, through its regional and provincial departments, has been monitoring progress to offset previous losses, while the Moroccan Interprofessional Olive Federation highlighted improved yields driven by late rainfall and new trees planted under the Green Morocco Plan. Despite irrigation challenges in some areas, production is expected to surpass last year in both quantity and quality, which could ease the high domestic olive oil prices that have burdened consumers.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Agriculture Directorate, signed 14 grant agreements with farmers in Beit Qad and Deir Ghazaleh.
records.description: Agriculture Directorate, signed 14 grant agreements with farmers in Beit Qad and Deir Ghazaleh. The project provides half-dunum greenhouse units to support farmers’ livelihoods and resilience to climate change. Seven farmers from each town benefited, receiving direct support to boost production and income. The initiative aligns with the Ministry’s strategy to enhance sustainable agriculture and climate adaptation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Islamic Relief France (SIF)

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture met with a delegation from the French Development Agency to discuss key water and agriculture projects, inclu...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture met with a delegation from the French Development Agency to discuss key water and agriculture projects, including the Hebron Reuse Project to irrigate 10,000 dunams with treated water, the Gaza Reuse Project to address the Strip’s water crisis and produce renewable energy, the “Renewal” sewage project in the northern West Bank serving 90,000 people, and the WADS Programme to strengthen water and sanitation management. The Minister stressed the importance of the “Seeds of Change” initiative and water security as a strategic priority for resilience and sustainable development, while the French Agency reaffirmed its commitment to supporting Palestine through innovative water and agriculture projects.

records.title: The “Saudi Reef” program launched a media initiative called “Sustainable Reef” to showcase its role in empowering farmers and rural famil...
records.description: The “Saudi Reef” program launched a media initiative called “Sustainable Reef” to showcase its role in empowering farmers and rural families, promoting agricultural sustainability, and strengthening food security in the Kingdom. Since inception, it has supported over 87,000 rural beneficiaries through financial aid, training, and modern technologies. The program covers eight sectors—coffee, livestock, rain-fed crops, beekeeping, aromatic plants, fisheries, fruits, and value-added development—advancing smart farming and contributing to Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program “Saudi Reef”

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) signed a memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Economy and Finance of Mauritania in Nouak...
records.description: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) signed a memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Economy and Finance of Mauritania in Nouakchott, providing a $6 million grant from Saudi Arabia under the fifth phase of the Saudi Well Drilling and Rural Development Program in Africa. The initiative aims to strengthen water security in Mauritania, combat desertification, support agriculture, and reduce waterborne diseases. Since 1982, the program has drilled and equipped over 10,000 water facilities in 21 African countries, with investments exceeding $330 million, contributing to improved living standards and sustainable water and food security.

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: Joint Decree of the Minister of Industry, Mines, and Energy, the Minister of Agriculture, Water Resources and Sea Fishing, the Minister o...
records.description: Joint Decree of the Minister of Industry, Mines, and Energy, the Minister of Agriculture, Water Resources and Sea Fishing, the Minister of Finance and the Minister of Trade and Export Development, establishing the buffer stock of sterilized fresh milk and the peak lactation period for the year 2025, as well as the period during which dairies will benefit from the storage premium for the year 2025.

records.title: The ministry announced the closure of the coastal shrimp fishing season in the Red Sea from 16 September 2025 until further notice, to pr...
records.description: The ministry announced the closure of the coastal shrimp fishing season in the Red Sea from 16 September 2025 until further notice, to protect shrimp stocks. Exporters must declare stored quantities, while violators will face legal penalties. Fishermen were urged to adjust nets to 38 mm mesh, with the Fisheries Authority and Coast Guard tasked to enforce monitoring.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Despite importing 90% of its food, Bahrain has achieved an advanced global ranking of 38th on the Global Food Security Index (GFSI).
records.description: Despite importing 90% of its food, Bahrain has achieved an advanced global ranking of 38th on the Global Food Security Index (GFSI). The Bahrain Food Holding Company (Ghitha) is a key driver of this success, acting as a partner to the private sector to develop national food security initiatives. Ghitha oversees major food companies, including the Bahrain Flour Mills Company, which is planning a strategic project to increase wheat storage capacity to six months. In addition, the General Poultry Company is expanding to raise its market share from 44% to 70%, while the Delmon Poultry Company also has significant room to expand its current 18-20% market share to meet growing local demand.

records.title: The National Bank of Egypt (NBE) has signed a cooperation protocol with Europe Solar for Electromechanical Contracting and Solar Energy t...
records.description: The National Bank of Egypt (NBE) has signed a cooperation protocol with Europe Solar for Electromechanical Contracting and Solar Energy to finance projects in solar energy, irrigation system modernization, and agricultural land reclamation. This partnership aims to advance Egypt's green economy and sustainable development goals, aligning with national strategies like Water Strategy 2050 and Vision 2030. The agreement provides flexible financing mechanisms to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and farmers, helping them adopt clean energy and water-efficient technologies to reduce costs and boost productivity. The bank will also provide comprehensive banking services to support Europe Solar's clients and foster growth in these key sectors.

records.title: The Anouar Invest Group has officially launched its 480 million dirham (MDH) AYA industrial project in the Jorf Lasfar industrial zone.
records.description: The Anouar Invest Group has officially launched its 480 million dirham (MDH) AYA industrial project in the Jorf Lasfar industrial zone. The new factory will produce fresh and dry yeast as well as food improvers, with an initial annual capacity of 25,000 tonnes, which could expand to 58,000 tonnes. The project, which is financed by CDG Capital and CIH Bank, is a green initiative that will use 95% Moroccan raw materials, including molasses from sugar production, to support a circular economy. The initiative, which aligns with King Mohammed VI's vision, is expected to create over 500 jobs, enhance Morocco's industrial and food sovereignty, and establish the country as a regional leader in agro-industrial biotechnology by exporting 30% of its production.

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman has officially joined the World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies, marking its commitment t...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman has officially joined the World Trade Organization (WTO) Agreement on Fisheries Subsidies, marking its commitment to international cooperation, ocean sustainability, and the protection of marine resources. The Ministry of Commerce, Industry, and Investment Promotion, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and Oman’s mission to the WTO in Geneva, led the accession efforts to ensure alignment with national legislation, economic priorities, and UN Sustainable Development Goal 14.6. The agreement, adopted at the WTO’s Twelfth Ministerial Conference, prohibits harmful fisheries subsidies that contribute to overfishing and global fish stock depletion. Oman emphasized that this step supports food security, artisanal fishing, fair maritime trade, and environmental sustainability, while reinforcing the country’s active role in the multilateral trading system since joining the WTO in 2000.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Béja Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (URAP) is sounding an alarm over the critical decline of sunflower cultivation in th...
records.description: The Béja Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (URAP) is sounding an alarm over the critical decline of sunflower cultivation in the Béja governorate, with the cultivated area falling by over 90% to less than 500 hectares in 2025. This drastic drop is attributed to a combination of factors, including massive, unregulated imports, smuggling from Algeria, and a lack of institutional support for local producers. The disappearance of sunflowers has had significant social and economic repercussions, such as the loss of seasonal jobs and the discouragement of farmers. In response, the Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) is calling for urgent action, proposing measures like regulating imports and offering targeted subsidies to revive this strategic oilseed sector and ensure the country's food self-sufficiency.
records.institution: Béja Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (URAP)

records.title: Tunisia has officially launched its first agrivoltaic pilot project, an initiative that integrates solar panels on agricultural land to s...
records.description: Tunisia has officially launched its first agrivoltaic pilot project, an initiative that integrates solar panels on agricultural land to simultaneously produce electricity and crops. The project is being led by the National Agency for Energy Management (ANME) and is located at the Institute of Arid Regions (IRA) in Chenchou, Gabes governorate. The project is supported by German cooperation (GIZ), which funded the preliminary strategic studies.

records.title: On Arab Palm Day, ADAFSA reaffirmed its commitment to developing the palm sector and promoting sustainable agriculture in Abu Dhabi.
records.description: On Arab Palm Day, ADAFSA reaffirmed its commitment to developing the palm sector and promoting sustainable agriculture in Abu Dhabi. Through initiatives such as the Integrated Palm Pest Management and Palm & Date Best Practices Programmes, ADAFSA has treated over 6.5 million palm trees and captured major pests, while supporting farmers with training and awareness campaigns. Backed by ADAFSA, Al Foah Company also promotes Emirati dates globally via the digital platform eZad, strengthening the sector’s market reach and sustainability.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.description: The ministry launched Phase II of the Government Facilities Afforestation Project in Sana’a, targeting 100,000 seedlings (50% fruit trees, 50% ornamental/forest trees) as part of a national plan to plant nearly one million seedlings across governorates. The project also covers streets and public spaces, with community participation encouraged to build a productive and sustainable society.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture has taken proactive steps to support local producers who were negatively impacted by a market flooded w...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture has taken proactive steps to support local producers who were negatively impacted by a market flooded with imported goods. The ministry's measures include banning table egg imports, raising customs duties on poultry by 50% and poultry cuts by 25%, and reducing shipments from the Kurdistan Region by half. These policies are intended to protect local production, create jobs, and encourage producers to expand their businesses to meet domestic demand. In return for this government support, the ministry is asking producers to stabilize prices, ensuring that consumer purchasing power is protected and a fair balance is maintained.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Alternative Energy Projects (AEPCo), a Kuwaiti renewable energy developer, has partnered with elementsix, a Dubai-based carbon and ESG ad...
records.description: Alternative Energy Projects (AEPCo), a Kuwaiti renewable energy developer, has partnered with elementsix, a Dubai-based carbon and ESG advisory firm, to accelerate corporate decarbonization in the Gulf and MENA region. The partnership provides companies with an integrated solution to measure their carbon footprint, develop reduction strategies, and implement clean energy projects. This initiative is designed to help businesses achieve net-zero goals, gain a competitive advantage, and align with ESG standards for investor confidence, while also contributing to job creation and economic transformation.

records.title: The Municipality of Zliten announced the launch of a pilot laboratory for fish collection and storage at the city’s port, as part of the...
records.description: The Municipality of Zliten announced the launch of a pilot laboratory for fish collection and storage at the city’s port, as part of the European Union’s REBUILD programme. The project, coordinated by the Friuli-Venezia Giulia Region of Italy and implemented by the Italian National Institute of Oceanography and Applied Geophysics (OGS), aims to strengthen the fisheries sector, improve conservation, refrigeration, and commercialization processes, and establish a traceability system in line with EU legislation to facilitate access to local and international markets. Supported by the European Union Delegation to Libya, the Italian Embassy, and Libyan ministries including the Ministry of Local Government, Ministry of Marine Resources, and Ministry of Planning, the facility will include refrigeration, freezing, and processing rooms with a capacity to handle 500kg to 2 tons of fish daily.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Yatta Agriculture and Veterinary Directorate, has partnered with the Land and Development Founda...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Yatta Agriculture and Veterinary Directorate, has partnered with the Land and Development Foundation to distribute straw bales and nutritional supplements to 42 livestock breeders in the areas of Susya and Wadi al-Rakhim. This action is part of an emergency response project to support food security and enhance the resilience of livelihoods in the West Bank and Gaza.

records.title: A research team from King Khalid University has been granted a patent by the Saudi Authority for Intellectual Property for an innovative...
records.description: A research team from King Khalid University has been granted a patent by the Saudi Authority for Intellectual Property for an innovative method to purify industrially contaminated water using prickly pear peels. The technique, which leverages agricultural waste, has been proven to remove over 98% of contaminants and remains effective after multiple uses. This groundbreaking method is not only environmentally friendly and energy-efficient but also cost-effective and practical for both industrial and community applications, transforming agricultural waste into a high-value environmental solution.

records.title: The Saudi Irrigation Organization participated in the Fourth World Irrigation Forum (WIF4) and the 76th meeting of the International Comm...
records.description: The Saudi Irrigation Organization participated in the Fourth World Irrigation Forum (WIF4) and the 76th meeting of the International Commission on Irrigation and Drainage in Kuala Lumpur, where it highlighted Saudi Arabia's advancements in water resource management. The organization presented initiatives focusing on agricultural wastewater treatment and the reuse of treated water to address water scarcity. The discussions also featured papers on a smart tool for irrigation scheduling in dry areas and a framework for improving water efficiency, both of which are aligned with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The second Sakaka dates festival, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf, has concluded.
records.description: The second Sakaka dates festival, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf, has concluded. The five-day event featured 30 farmers and 18 families from the cottage industry, with the goal of supporting local farmers, promoting Al-Jouf dates, and exploring new marketing opportunities. The festival also included entertainment, agricultural activities for children, and a showcase of local cuisine, concluding with a ceremony that recognized winners of awards for the largest date bunches.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture and the Turkish Ministry of Agriculture have signed a memorandum of goodwill to enhance agricultural c...
records.description: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture and the Turkish Ministry of Agriculture have signed a memorandum of goodwill to enhance agricultural cooperation. The agreement focuses on joint investment, unifying quality standards and customs tariffs, implementing smart agriculture, and encouraging the private sector. While the Turkish side affirmed its readiness to cooperate on a broad range of issues, including forestry, water, and livestock, the Syrian side specifically highlighted the importance of water resource management, increasing the flow of the Euphrates River, and establishing joint research centers to combat climate change and bolster food and water security.

records.title: A training workshop for agricultural field school facilitators has begun in Ibb governorate, organized by the Office of Agriculture, Fish...
records.description: A training workshop for agricultural field school facilitators has begun in Ibb governorate, organized by the Office of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the General Department of Agricultural Extension and Training. Funded by the Executive Unit for Financing Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives, the three-day workshop aims to provide 62 participants with skills and knowledge to boost agricultural and livestock production under an agricultural expansion project. The training focuses on the principles of sustainable field schools to raise farmers' awareness through informal education and practical learning, ultimately contributing to rural development and achieving food security and self-sufficiency.
records.institution: Office of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Sahara International Agricultural Exhibition, the largest agriculture-focused event in the Middle East, is being held at the Egypt In...
records.description: The Sahara International Agricultural Exhibition, the largest agriculture-focused event in the Middle East, is being held at the Egypt International Exhibition Center. The event features over 350 exhibitors from 10 countries, including Spain, China, India, and the Netherlands. This year's exhibition includes a new section for veterinary medicine and animal feed and will host international buyer delegations from countries such as Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Iraq to boost regional trade and investment in the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by the Director General of the Agricultural Extension and Training Department, participated in a...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by the Director General of the Agricultural Extension and Training Department, participated in a training workshop in Najaf. The workshop focused on establishing and managing Farmer Field Schools to improve the production of green fodder and enhance animal nutrition. This initiative is part of the "Integrating Climate-Smart Agricultural Practices" project, funded by Norway and implemented by the FAO in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and local governments in Karbala, Basra, and Dhi Qar. The goal of the workshop was to empower agricultural extension workers to better support farmers, particularly women, in adopting sustainable agricultural practices to boost productivity.

records.title: The fourth edition of BIOFACH Saudi Arabia, an international exhibition for organic products, will be held at the Riyadh International Co...
records.description: The fourth edition of BIOFACH Saudi Arabia, an international exhibition for organic products, will be held at the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center. Sponsored by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in strategic partnership with the Saudi Society for Organic Agriculture, the event will showcase the latest innovations in organic products and promote sustainable agricultural practices. The exhibition aims to attract major investors, distributors, and suppliers, with the goal of promoting a healthy lifestyle and boosting the competitiveness of Saudi organic products in global markets. Workshops and discussion sessions led by experts will also be featured.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Baalbek-Hermel Agriculture Department, organized a training workshop in Yahfoufa on sustainable...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Baalbek-Hermel Agriculture Department, organized a training workshop in Yahfoufa on sustainable agriculture and biodiversity. The event, which was part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, was held in cooperation with the Nabi Sheet Agricultural Center and the Yahfoufa Municipality, and in partnership with Remer Company. The workshop aimed to empower farmers by providing them with knowledge on modern agricultural practices, soil and water resource preservation, and the importance of biodiversity. The workshop's success, marked by strong farmer participation, reflects the ministry's strategic goal of fostering sustainable rural development and strengthening partnerships with municipalities and the private sector across various Lebanese regions.

records.title: According to data from the Spanish Federation of Producers and Exporters (FEPEX), Morocco has consolidated its dominance in the Spanish f...
records.description: According to data from the Spanish Federation of Producers and Exporters (FEPEX), Morocco has consolidated its dominance in the Spanish fresh fruit and vegetable market. The value of Moroccan exports to Spain has seen significant growth, making Morocco the top non-EU supplier with nearly a 20% market share. This notable advancement is attributed to the diversity and quality of its products, such as tomatoes, peppers, citrus fruits, and red fruits, which have allowed it to directly compete with and surpass countries like Peru, France, and Portugal.

records.title: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) is advancing its goal of producing sustainable protein for animal feed by incorporating insect farming.
records.description: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) is advancing its goal of producing sustainable protein for animal feed by incorporating insect farming. According to a recent report, the company has completed a feasibility study for a facility that would produce insect meal from black soldier fly larvae (BSFL), a high-protein source that can serve as a viable alternative to fishmeal and soy. This initiative aligns with circular economy principles by utilizing organic waste, and it's being supported by OFM's strong financial performance. The company is leveraging its profitability to also pursue other diversification projects, including a health bar production facility and a baby food project in Uzbekistan.

records.title: The Ariana governorate in Tunisia is implementing a strategic initiative to combat the country's water crisis by strengthening the manage...
records.description: The Ariana governorate in Tunisia is implementing a strategic initiative to combat the country's water crisis by strengthening the management and reuse of treated wastewater for agriculture. The strategy, which is supported by a multi-sectoral commission including the National Sanitation Office (ONAS) and the Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA), aims to increase the available volume from 2,500 to 3,500 cubic meters per day. Despite facing challenges such as network leaks and a lack of storage infrastructure, the governorate plans to rehabilitate pipelines, install smart meters, and launch training campaigns to promote the sustainable use of this resource. This proactive approach aims to maintain crop productivity, reduce pressure on conventional water resources, and serve as a model for other regions.

records.title: Egypt has exported around 7 million tonnes of agricultural products so far, marking an 8% increase from last year.
records.description: Egypt has exported around 7 million tonnes of agricultural products so far, marking an 8% increase from last year. Citrus was the top export at 1.9 million tonnes, with other significant exports including fresh and dry beans and grapes. According to the Minister of Agriculture and the head of the Central Agricultural Quarantine Department, this growth is attributed to ongoing progress in the agricultural sector, adherence to international standards, and the opening of new markets. This export success is seen as a sign of the Egyptian economy's robustness, contributing to foreign currency inflow and creating new jobs.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation in Egypt is providing substantial support to the country's agricultural sector.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation in Egypt is providing substantial support to the country's agricultural sector. Farmers receive annually more than 2.4 million tons of subsidized fertilizers, at a cost exceeding EGP 40 billion, with assistance from the Ministry of Petroleum. As part of its strategy under “Egypt Vision 2030,” the government provides over EGP 4 billion in direct financial support through low-interest loans, with the sponsorship of the Central Bank of Egypt (CIB) and the Ministry of Finance. The ministry has activated digital systems at a 90% rate to ensure subsidies reach small-scale farmers. These efforts, combined with technical guidance and the establishment of new wastewater treatment plants, have helped overcome export barriers and expand cultivated land.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has highlighted the second annual Dates and Honey Exhibition in Wasit Governorate, which was organized by the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has highlighted the second annual Dates and Honey Exhibition in Wasit Governorate, which was organized by the Agricultural Department in Al-Suwayrah District. The event served as a platform for farmers and breeders to showcase their products, including over 50 varieties of Iraqi dates and various types of natural honey. This exhibition is part of the ministry's broader efforts to support local production, enhance its role in achieving food security, and expand the market for national products.

records.title: The Fask Dam, located in Guelmim, Morocco, is a significant hydraulic project aimed at boosting the region's agricultural sector and wate...
records.description: The Fask Dam, located in Guelmim, Morocco, is a significant hydraulic project aimed at boosting the region's agricultural sector and water security. Completed in 2024 as part of a national strategy for dam construction, this strategic infrastructure has a storage capacity of 79 million cubic meters and is intended to irrigate over 10,000 hectares of agricultural land. In addition to supporting agriculture, it contributes to replenishing the water table, supplying drinking water to the city of Guelmim, and protecting against floods. The dam, which is part of the Integrated Development Program for the Guelmim-Oued Noun region, is expected to help create a diversified agricultural ecosystem and attract new investments, countering the effects of increasing drought and climate change.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture concluded a training course on "Alternative Feed and Livestock Breeding" in the presence of officials from th...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture concluded a training course on "Alternative Feed and Livestock Breeding" in the presence of officials from the Tubas Agriculture Directorate. The course, which is part of the SANET project, was funded by the Italian Cooperation and implemented in partnership with the Bari Institute, Italy. The training aimed to enhance farmers' skills in the value chains of fodder and alternative feed to improve production quality and promote sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture concluded a training course on "Post-Harvest Techniques for Plums" in the presence of officials from the Nort...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture concluded a training course on "Post-Harvest Techniques for Plums" in the presence of officials from the North Hebron and Hebron Agriculture Directorates. The course was implemented as part of the SANET project, a program funded by the Italian Cooperation and conducted in collaboration with the Bari Institute, Italy. The training aimed to enhance farmers' skills in plum value chains, improve production quality, and promote sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Tubas Agriculture Directorate, has delivered 36 tons of animal feed (18 tons each of barley and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Tubas Agriculture Directorate, has delivered 36 tons of animal feed (18 tons each of barley and wheat straw) to 9 beneficiaries in the Ain al-Hilweh area of the Northern Jordan Valley. This initiative is part of an urgent response project to assist farmers affected by settler attacks and restrictions imposed by the Israeli occupation. The project, which is implemented by CARE International in cooperation with the ministry and funded by CARE, aims to reduce the financial burden on livestock owners who are unable to access pastures.

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) participated in the International Government Communication Forum (IGCF) to showca...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) participated in the International Government Communication Forum (IGCF) to showcase the UAE's strategic vision for food security and sustainable development. The ministry highlighted its focus on empowering youth through initiatives like the 'Plant the Emirates' National Programme and the 'Mustadeem' programme, while also emphasizing the role of advanced agricultural technologies, such as vertical farming, in overcoming climate challenges. The discussion also covered the UAE's ambitious vision for marine conservation, including a proposed 'National Partnership for the Sea' initiative, and its efforts to ensure a sustainable fishing industry through the National Framework Statement for Sustainable Fisheries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has announced the 21 qualifying teams for its "Al Miyah Challenge for Agriculture," a competition...
records.description: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has announced the 21 qualifying teams for its "Al Miyah Challenge for Agriculture," a competition focused on developing innovative solutions for water-scarce regions. Selected from hundreds of international applicants, the teams represent 13 countries and have proposed a wide range of solutions, including precision irrigation, AI-driven analytics, and wastewater reuse, all aimed at reducing water consumption in agriculture. The challenge, which offers a prize purse of AED 8 million, is a partnership with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA), ASPIRE, and Silal Food and Technology. The goal is to identify and test technologies for real-world application in the UAE that can be scaled for global use, thereby enhancing food security and sustainability.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: A workshop held in Hajja Governorate, organized by the local Agriculture Sector and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, emphasized the im...
records.description: A workshop held in Hajja Governorate, organized by the local Agriculture Sector and the Agricultural Cooperative Union, emphasized the importance of unifying efforts to promote agricultural expansion projects and value chains. The participants, including representatives from the Agricultural and Fisheries Project and Initiative Financing Unit, discussed the need to support farmers and agricultural associations with technical expertise and essential resources. The workshop concluded by stressing the importance of a joint work plan and a strengthened partnership between the Ministry of Agriculture, its local office, the Cooperative Union, and agricultural associations to achieve self-sufficiency and develop the agricultural sector in the governorate.

records.title: A major event titled “A New Era for Egyptian Agriculture: The Food Security Dialogue” was hosted by BASF Agricultural Solutions in collab...
records.description: A major event titled “A New Era for Egyptian Agriculture: The Food Security Dialogue” was hosted by BASF Agricultural Solutions in collaboration with the Horticultural Export Improvement Association (HEIA) and the Egyptian Businessmen's Association (EBA). The dialogue, held at the Grand Egyptian Museum, brought together agricultural leaders to discuss the potential of Egyptian agriculture to enhance food security and drive economic growth. The key discussion points included expanding land reclamation, adopting sustainable practices, and boosting productivity through smart farming, technology, and innovation. The participants emphasized a need for a national integrated plan, public-private partnerships, and farmer-centric strategies to solidify Egypt's position as a regional agricultural power.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced a ban on the import of whole frozen chicken, chicken parts, and processed chicken to support lo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has announced a ban on the import of whole frozen chicken, chicken parts, and processed chicken to support local poultry production. This decision, which follows a comprehensive study and a careful calculation of local production costs, aims to protect and promote domestic products. The ministry confirmed that the move was made in response to requests from local producers via the Iraqi Association for the Care of Poultry Producers, demonstrating a collaboration between the public and private sectors to achieve food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agriculture in the South and the Jezzine Agricultural Center, organized a speciali...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agriculture in the South and the Jezzine Agricultural Center, organized a specialized workshop in Jezzine to address the damage caused by the invasive pine bug. The workshop, held in cooperation with the Jezzine Union of Municipalities, educated 38 participants, including farmers and beekeepers, on the pest's life cycle and its negative impact on pine production and the local economy. It also presented control methods, including aerial spraying with a specific pesticide, while emphasizing the importance of integrated pest management to minimize environmental harm.

records.title: Morocco is experiencing a significant boom in sweet corn exports, with over 21,800 tonnes exported between July and June, generating $20...
records.description: Morocco is experiencing a significant boom in sweet corn exports, with over 21,800 tonnes exported between July and June, generating $20 million. This represents a 28% increase over the previous market year and a 61% increase over the one before that. The unprecedented figures, sourced from reports by East Fruit, the Global Trade Tracker, and Morocco’s Office des Changes, show that Morocco has notably surpassed Spain to become one of the primary sweet corn exporters to the European market. This achievement is particularly impressive given the climate challenges, such as drought, faced by the country's agricultural sector.

records.title: The National Institute of Agricultural Research (INRA) in Morocco has published the first high-resolution national maps of soil nutrients...
records.description: The National Institute of Agricultural Research (INRA) in Morocco has published the first high-resolution national maps of soil nutrients, a strategic tool that makes Morocco the first country in North Africa to implement such a system. The maps, developed through an inter-institutional collaboration using artificial intelligence to analyze thousands of soil samples, provide farmers with a technical basis for optimizing fertilizer use, thereby reducing costs and waste. This initiative is also intended to protect the environment by preventing water pollution from excess fertilizers and to advance precision agriculture on a national scale. The project aligns with the objectives of the Generation Green 2020–2030 program to modernize the country's agricultural sector.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC) has announced that its green hydrogen plant, the world's largest, is over 80% complete.
records.description: The NEOM Green Hydrogen Company (NGHC) has announced that its green hydrogen plant, the world's largest, is over 80% complete. This flagship project, seen as a blueprint for low-cost, large-scale production, is advancing rapidly across its production facility, solar farm, wind garden, and transmission grid. With key equipment now being installed, the project remains on track to complete 4GW of renewable power generation by mid-2026, with the first hydrogen product expected to be available in 2027. This initiative is a core component of Saudi Arabia's global energy transition efforts.

records.title: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA), in cooperation with the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), hosted the Hack4SaferPlates...
records.description: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA), in cooperation with the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), hosted the Hack4SaferPlates hackathon to support innovation in food safety and sustainable food systems. The event brought together innovators and professionals from across the region to develop technology-based solutions aimed at improving food safety standards, enhancing early warning systems, and reducing food waste. The hackathon also featured workshops and mentorship sessions from local and international experts from organizations like Berytech, the Mediterranean Agronomic Institute of Bari (CIHEAM Bari), the National Center for Research and Development of Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), Fermendom, FoodSight, and Goumbook.
