records.title: The wine grape harvest in Tunisia's Nabeul governorate has reached 85% completion, despite a significant decline in production to 17,000...
records.description: The wine grape harvest in Tunisia's Nabeul governorate has reached 85% completion, despite a significant decline in production to 17,000 tons, a 30% drop from the previous season. This decrease is attributed to several factors, including reduced cultivated areas due to drought, aging vines, and the cumulative effects of climate change. As Nabeul accounts for 70% of the national production, the sector faces major challenges, such as a lack of irrigation water, rising production costs, and limited export opportunities due to a lack of widespread certification. To revitalize this vital industry, the text calls for targeted replanting programs, the implementation of water-efficient irrigation systems, and stronger partnerships between producers, cooperatives, and research institutions.
records.institution: Local Union of Agriculture and Fisheries in Grombalia

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) has signed a landmark agreement with Goldman Sachs International to explore innovative financing...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Department of Energy (DoE) has signed a landmark agreement with Goldman Sachs International to explore innovative financing models for enhancing water security. This partnership aims to attract foreign direct investment and implement joint projects to modernize water infrastructure, reduce network losses, and deploy next-generation desalination technologies powered by clean energy. The collaboration, which will also leverage the AD.WE platform for digital transformation, is a key part of Abu Dhabi's strategy to attract significant foreign investment and establish itself as a regional leader in sustainable utilities, in line with the UAE Water Security Strategy 2036.

records.title: The Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy, and Remote Work Applications Office has partnered with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food S...
records.description: The Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy, and Remote Work Applications Office has partnered with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) to enhance food security using artificial intelligence. The collaboration focuses on developing innovative digital solutions, building talent, and fostering a culture of innovation through workshops, competitions, and hackathons. This partnership aligns with the UAE's goal of becoming a global leader in AI development and reinforces its commitment to using technology to achieve food security and sustainable agricultural practices. The agreement follows ADAFSA's recent achievement of the ISO 42001:2023 international certification for AI Management Systems, a global first in the agriculture and food security sector.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The second edition of the International Agriculture and Plant Production Exhibition has opened in Sétif, with 49 exhibitors from both the...
records.description: The second edition of the International Agriculture and Plant Production Exhibition has opened in Sétif, with 49 exhibitors from both the public and private sectors, including participants from Tunisia and Turkey. Organized by "Ritadj Expo" in coordination with the Regional Chamber of Agriculture, the event aims to showcase the latest technologies, encourage investment, and strengthen partnerships in the agricultural sector. The exhibition features various products and services, from machinery and irrigation systems to fertilizers and financial services. The fair's program also includes scientific symposia focused on integrating modern techniques to achieve sustainable agricultural development.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Global Water, Energy and Climate Change Congress (GWECCC) is being held in Bahrain, focusing on sustainability and security in the Ar...
records.description: The Global Water, Energy and Climate Change Congress (GWECCC) is being held in Bahrain, focusing on sustainability and security in the Arabian Gulf. Under the theme "Sustainable Water and Energy Transformation: Innovation for a Secure Future," the conference will bring together over 3,000 participants from 30 countries. The event aims to discuss the interconnected challenges of water, energy, and climate change and will feature a comprehensive program including ministerial sessions, leadership dialogues, a youth forum, and a hackathon for university students. An accompanying exhibition will showcase the latest technologies and innovations from specialized companies and startups.
records.institution: Global Water, Energy and Climate Change Congress (GWECCC)

records.title: The European watermelon market has contracted, but Morocco has achieved a strong rebound, becoming the second-largest supplier after Spai...
records.description: The European watermelon market has contracted, but Morocco has achieved a strong rebound, becoming the second-largest supplier after Spain and capturing nearly a fifth of total imports. While Spain’s exports dropped sharply due to unfavorable weather, higher costs, and increased competition, Morocco benefited from better conditions, strong demand, and efficient logistics. Despite exporting lower volumes than Spain, Morocco sold at higher prices, generating greater revenue by positioning its watermelons as higher quality, fresher, and better managed for demanding markets.

records.title: The Fisheries Investment Opportunities Forum, organized by Oman’s Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, highlights the...
records.description: The Fisheries Investment Opportunities Forum, organized by Oman’s Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, highlights the growing role of aquaculture both globally and locally. The two-day event brings together government officials, investors, financial institutions, international organizations such as FAO and WAS, and academic experts to discuss global trends, challenges, and opportunities. Sessions cover Oman’s achievements, global market prospects, farming techniques for key species, governance, and investment models, with Chile presented as a successful example. The forum also showcases advanced technologies, including AI, and highlights Oman’s rich marine biodiversity, which supports farming of more than 15 species.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), through its Al Batinah North branch, is organizing a Food Security Forum in Al Suwaiq w...
records.description: The Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI), through its Al Batinah North branch, is organizing a Food Security Forum in Al Suwaiq with the theme "Safe Investment for Sustainable Food." The event aims to boost investment and localize technology-driven projects in agriculture and fisheries, aligning with Oman Vision 2040. The two-day program will include sessions on investment opportunities and financing, with a focus on how traditional farms can evolve into innovative ventures through partnerships with government bodies, private firms, and international organizations like the FAO. An accompanying exhibition will showcase innovative solutions and foster new partnerships to shape a sustainable food future for Oman.
records.institution: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI)

records.title: The Regional Workshop of the International Plant Protection Convention (IPPC) for the Near East and North Africa region began in Salalah,...
records.description: The Regional Workshop of the International Plant Protection Convention (IPPC) for the Near East and North Africa region began in Salalah, bringing together experts from 20 countries to discuss the latest developments in plant health. The four-day programme covers outcomes of recent IPPC meetings, updates on international standards, and consultations on new measures, while also addressing emerging challenges such as climate change and e-commerce. Participants will explore regional initiatives on propagation materials for key crops like date palms, citrus, and olives, alongside advances in digital tools such as electronic certification and monitoring platforms. The workshop emphasizes strengthening institutional and technical capacities in diagnostics, early warning, and pest risk management, aiming to unify regional positions on draft standards, enhance national preparedness, and promote knowledge exchange across the region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture and the Governor of Jericho and the Jordan Valley inaugurated the Palestinian date harvest season for 2025/20...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture and the Governor of Jericho and the Jordan Valley inaugurated the Palestinian date harvest season for 2025/2026 at a farm in Al-Jiftlik, highlighting the palm sector as a key pillar of the national economy. This year’s production is expected to exceed 25,000 tons from nearly 900 farms with over 351,000 trees, generating investments of more than two billion shekels and annual exports valued at over 400 million shekels. The role of the Higher National Committee for Date Production Assessment was praised, while emphasis was placed on strengthening farmers’ resilience through water and agricultural support projects.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) signed a cooperation agreement in Damascus with a civil society organizatio...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) signed a cooperation agreement in Damascus with a civil society organization to support the wheat production chain in eastern Aleppo’s countryside. The project focuses on rehabilitating agricultural infrastructure, improving access to high-quality wheat seeds, and providing technical support in extension and mechanization. Covering 2,750 hectares and benefiting about 16,500 people from 2,750 families, the initiative aims to empower small farmers, strengthen food security, and promote self-sufficiency. This intervention is part of Saudi Arabia’s broader humanitarian and relief efforts in Syria through KSrelief.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Statistics Department, organized a training course on climate change and its negative impact on...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Statistics Department, organized a training course on climate change and its negative impact on Iraq's agricultural sector and food security. The course aimed to enhance employees' capacity to adapt to these challenges and reviewed proposed solutions, with a particular focus on increasing afforestation and expanding vegetation cover. This initiative is part of broader efforts to mitigate the repercussions of climate change.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a seminar in Marsati on "Sustainable Agriculture and the Importance of Soil Biodiversity," as part...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a seminar in Marsati on "Sustainable Agriculture and the Importance of Soil Biodiversity," as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program. The event highlighted the essential role of biodiversity in maintaining soil fertility and crop quality, contrasting the long-term benefits of organic fertilizers with the detrimental effects of traditional chemical systems. At the conclusion of the seminar, the ministry distributed organic medicines and personal protective equipment to encourage farmers to adopt sustainable practices. This initiative is part of a series of activities aimed at raising awareness about modern agriculture and providing farmers with the necessary tools and knowledge to conserve natural resources and ensure food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has approved and distributed over 21,000 date palm seedlings and 100,000 fruit...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has approved and distributed over 21,000 date palm seedlings and 100,000 fruit seedlings to eligible farmers. This initiative, in line with Oman Vision 2040, aims to establish "model fields" to achieve sustainable agricultural development, enhance production efficiency, and strengthen food security. The ministry is supporting farmers with technical guidance, workshops, and coordination with the Development Bank and the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund. The date palm seedlings are sourced from the Tissue Culture Research Center in Jamah, and the program's objective is to supply the market with high-quality local products and provide a new source of income for farmers.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: The Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development, in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, has distributed irrigation n...
records.description: The Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development, in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, has distributed irrigation networks to 17 beneficiaries in Hebron's Yatta region. The support package, part of the "Ray of Hope for Palestinian Children" project, included a complete irrigation network for a two-dunum plot, a 1,500-liter water tank, and organic fertilizer for each beneficiary. The project aims to support local farmers, promote agricultural concepts to achieve food security, and improve the standard of living in the area. This initiative reflects the joint efforts of the supporting entities and the Ministry of Agriculture to promote sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has distributed seeds and veterinary kits to 90 beneficiaries in Marib Gove...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has distributed seeds and veterinary kits to 90 beneficiaries in Marib Governorate, Yemen, as part of its sustainable agriculture and fisheries support project. This initiative is considered vital for empowering local farmers and enhancing food security. The project also includes a component to train veterinarians, which will improve animal health services in rural areas. The distribution is part of the ongoing humanitarian assistance provided by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia through KSrelief to support the livelihoods of vulnerable communities in Yemen.
records.institution: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Grain Board has announced a new program allowing farmers to barter their durum and soft wheat from the recent harvest for certified s...
records.description: The Grain Board has announced a new program allowing farmers to barter their durum and soft wheat from the recent harvest for certified seeds of the same grains. This initiative, based on a recent decree, will run until the end of the year. Farmers can deliver their quantities to collection centers and will receive a "fast delivery bonus" to be used for the purchase of the new seeds. The program allows for a flexible exchange between durum and soft wheat seeds. This announcement comes as data from the Office of Cereals shows that over 11.8 million quintals of cereals were collected in the last season, with the majority for consumption and a smaller portion for selected seeds.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi International Hunting and Equestrian Exhibition (ADIHEX) is featuring strong participation from leading institutions and co...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi International Hunting and Equestrian Exhibition (ADIHEX) is featuring strong participation from leading institutions and companies in veterinary medicine and animal health. Exhibitors are showcasing the latest innovations in veterinary care, breeding technologies, and animal nutrition. Prominent participants include the Advanced Scientific Group, which operates a specialized veterinary laboratory for camel research, and the United Arab Emirates University, which offers academic programs in veterinary medicine, food science, and integrated agriculture. Companies like Zabeel Feed, Al Hikma, and the German Standards Group are also present, offering animal feeds, nutritional supplements, and a wide range of veterinary medicines and equipment.

records.title: As summer ends, Jordan's agricultural sector is undergoing a critical transition as farmers shift from summer crops like tomatoes and pep...
records.description: As summer ends, Jordan's agricultural sector is undergoing a critical transition as farmers shift from summer crops like tomatoes and peppers to autumn plantings such as onions. This seasonal change, particularly in the productive Jordan Valley region, stimulates demand for agricultural inputs like seeds and fertilizers, providing a temporary economic boost to traders. The Ministry of Agriculture has emphasized the importance of this period for stabilizing local food supplies and reducing reliance on imports. Additionally, the shift is expected to increase exports of dates and certain vegetables to Gulf markets, generating foreign currency and strengthening the national trade balance. Despite challenges like water scarcity and a shortage of skilled labor, farmers in the region maintain a sense of cautious optimism, hoping for favorable weather to recover from summer losses and sustain their livelihoods.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a seminar on the rational use of agricultural pesticides as part of the National Agricultural Guida...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a seminar on the rational use of agricultural pesticides as part of the National Agricultural Guidance Program. Held under the Sharon Forum, the seminar emphasized the importance of adopting good agricultural practices to protect both human health and food safety. Key recommendations included requesting proper prescriptions for pesticides, adhering to label instructions to prevent chemical residues, and reporting the sale of unregistered medicines. The initiative is part of the ministry's broader effort to provide scientific and cognitive guidance to farmers, ensuring the delivery of safe agricultural products and thereby strengthening the confidence of local and foreign markets in Lebanese production.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Buraidah Dates Carnival is showcasing over 150 varieties of dates, including many rare types for which the Qassim Region is renowned.
records.description: The Buraidah Dates Carnival is showcasing over 150 varieties of dates, including many rare types for which the Qassim Region is renowned. The wide selection highlights the abundance and diversity of Saudi date products, with each variety offering a distinct flavor. By focusing on these unique dates, the carnival aims to enhance the Qassim Region’s reputation as a hub of agricultural quality, thereby boosting the area's economic and tourism activity.

records.title: Egypt's agricultural exports have reached a total of seven million tonnes, marking an increase of 650,000 tonnes from the previous year.
records.description: Egypt's agricultural exports have reached a total of seven million tonnes, marking an increase of 650,000 tonnes from the previous year. According to the Ministry of Agriculture, this growth is attributed to the agricultural sector's ability to compete on the global stage, a result of the government's efforts to open new markets and enforce strict quality standards. A ministry report highlights that citrus and potatoes were the leading exports with 1.9 million tonnes and 1.3 million tonnes respectively, followed by grapes, onions, and beans. The continued success of these exports is considered vital for strengthening the national economy and enhancing food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The date harvest season has begun in Morocco's Drâa-Tafilalet region, the country's leading producer, which accounts for nearly 90% of to...
records.description: The date harvest season has begun in Morocco's Drâa-Tafilalet region, the country's leading producer, which accounts for nearly 90% of total date production. Despite a slight decrease in national production to 103,000 tonnes in the previous agricultural season, favorable weather conditions are leading to optimistic forecasts for an exceptional harvest this season. The Erfoud date market is bustling with customers seeking various affordable varieties, and the harvest provides significant employment for the region. These efforts are part of a national strategy, with the Ministry of Agriculture's Generation Green plan aiming to plant 5 million palm trees to reach an annual production of 300,000 tonnes by 2030.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Tunisia is participating in the Second African Climate Summit (ACS2), a major event co-organized by the African Union and the Ethiopian g...
records.description: Tunisia is participating in the Second African Climate Summit (ACS2), a major event co-organized by the African Union and the Ethiopian government. The summit, held in Addis Ababa from September 8 to 10, 2025, is focused on "Accelerating Global Climate Solutions: Financing for Africa's Resilient and Green Development." It aims to unify the continent's stance on climate change and foster a common position on climate justice, sustainable financing, and technology transfer. The meeting will feature over 50 thematic panels and 180 side events on topics ranging from nature-based solutions and energy to agriculture and food systems. This summit is being held just a few months before the UN conference on climate change (COP30) in Brazil, where African leaders intend to present their unified position.

records.title: Jordan is expected to produce 36,000 tonnes of dates and currently accounts for approximately 14% of the world's Medjool date production.
records.description: Jordan is expected to produce 36,000 tonnes of dates and currently accounts for approximately 14% of the world's Medjool date production. While the industry faces significant challenges like water scarcity and a shortage of skilled labor, it received an unexpected boost from a recent heatwave. Higher temperatures accelerated the ripening process and reduced a common fruit defect, leading to improved quality, particularly for Medjool dates. This growth is part of a broader plan to expand the number of date palm trees to one million in the next few years.

records.title: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply has increased the sale price of barley to JD 245 per ton for most livestock farmers and impor...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply has increased the sale price of barley to JD 245 per ton for most livestock farmers and importers, a JD 5 increase. However, according to the Ministry of Agriculture, the subsidized price for sheep farmers remains unchanged at JD 175 per ton. Additionally, the subsidized price of bran for sheep farmers remains at JD 77 per ton, while other livestock farmers now pay JD 157 per ton. The ministry also collects a fixed fee of JD 1,450 for each vehicle exporting live local sheep.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply

records.title: The Safawi Educational Centre for Soilless Agriculture and Innovation has been inaugurated in Jawa, Northeastern Badia, to support nation...
records.description: The Safawi Educational Centre for Soilless Agriculture and Innovation has been inaugurated in Jawa, Northeastern Badia, to support national development and community resilience. The center, a project of the National Centre for Research and Development (NCRD), features facilities for hydroponic and suspended farming, scientific research, and desert plant cultivation. The inauguration emphasized the critical need for inter-organizational collaboration, turning expert proposals into practical projects for communities vulnerable to climate change. It also called for the creation of a knowledge-based database to link historical and current agricultural practices, enhanced cooperation within the water-food-energy nexus, and the empowerment of women and youth in the agricultural sector.
records.institution: Higher Council for Science and Technology (HCST), Safawi Educational Centre for Soilless Agriculture and Innovation

records.title: The Aseer Region Municipality has signed an environmental and technical partnership agreement with netzero, an environmental services com...
records.description: The Aseer Region Municipality has signed an environmental and technical partnership agreement with netzero, an environmental services company from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Sedra Program. The collaboration aims to launch "smart afforestation initiatives" across the region's 33 municipalities, including a landmark project to plant and document one million smart trees. The initiative also seeks to establish miniature forests to boost biodiversity and increase green spaces, reinforcing a commitment to a sustainable future and supporting Saudi innovations in climate technologies.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced a new Cabinet-approved protocol that will strengthen Saudi Arabia's comm...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has announced a new Cabinet-approved protocol that will strengthen Saudi Arabia's commitment to marine sustainability, in line with Saudi Vision 2030. The agreement, which includes members of the Regional Organization for the Conservation of the Environment of the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden (PERSGA) such as Egypt, Jordan, Sudan, Djibouti, Somalia, and Yemen, is a key tool under the Jeddah Convention. It provides a specialized platform for cooperation to sustainably manage marine resources, protect habitats, combat illegal fishing, and enhance data exchange. The protocol also aims to provide training and technical support to member states to help them modernize legislation and improve biosecurity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: With the arrival of fall, Saudi Arabia's Aseer Region celebrates its pomegranate harvest, a key economic driver for local farmers and fam...
records.description: With the arrival of fall, Saudi Arabia's Aseer Region celebrates its pomegranate harvest, a key economic driver for local farmers and families. Known for its distinctive varieties, including a sweet local red, a slightly sour yellow, and the Taif pomegranate, the fruit's season generates significant income and marketing opportunities. The harvest is celebrated at annual festivals organized by the local branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture. These events showcase the quality of local produce and support farmers while attracting visitors from across the Kingdom, thus solidifying the pomegranate's status as a central local product that stimulates economic and tourism activity.
records.institution: Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The General Organization for Seed Multiplication is leading the National Potato Seed Production Project to produce high-quality, virus-fr...
records.description: The General Organization for Seed Multiplication is leading the National Potato Seed Production Project to produce high-quality, virus-free potato seeds domestically. The initiative aims to reduce reliance on imports and provide local farmers with productive and reliable varieties. The process begins in a laboratory by isolating meristems from disease-free tubers, which are then rapidly multiplied using in vitro techniques to create healthy seedlings. The project also includes a gene bank that stores a wide range of potato varieties, ensuring genetic diversity and supporting future agricultural innovation.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: A World Bank team visited agricultural research sites in Nineveh to monitor the progress of the Additional Financing Project.
records.description: A World Bank team visited agricultural research sites in Nineveh to monitor the progress of the Additional Financing Project. The project, which has reached 55% completion, is being implemented at the Seed Research Division and the Rashidiya Livestock Research Station, both affiliated with the Agricultural Research Department. The World Bank praised the Ministry of Agriculture's efforts and cooperation, noting that the project represents a significant and positive step toward supporting both the plant and animal agricultural sectors in the region.

records.title: Oman is set to establish the first integrated green ship recycling facility in the Middle East, a move that aligns with its 2050 net-zero...
records.description: Oman is set to establish the first integrated green ship recycling facility in the Middle East, a move that aligns with its 2050 net-zero goals. The project, a partnership between the Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT) and Green Wheel Recycling Middle East, will be located in North Batinah. The facility is designed to responsibly dismantle and recycle over 70 ships annually and is projected to produce 2 million tonnes of low-carbon steel each year in its initial phase. This initiative will provide eco-friendly solutions for international fleets to comply with regulations like the EU Ship Recycling Regulation and the Hong Kong Convention, while also creating jobs and contributing to the country's non-oil GDP.
records.institution: The Ministry of Transport, Communications and Information Technology (MTCIT)

records.title: The National Livestock Vaccination Campaign has been launched in South Al Batinah Governorate and will be implemented for eight months by...
records.description: The National Livestock Vaccination Campaign has been launched in South Al Batinah Governorate and will be implemented for eight months by the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources. The campaign aims to vaccinate goats, sheep, and cattle against priority infectious diseases, thereby reducing infection rates and enhancing biosecurity. As a fundamental part of the national strategy to combat animal epidemics, the initiative seeks to increase the number of vaccinated animals annually and ensure the sustainability of livestock production, which contributes to food security. Officials have urged livestock breeders to cooperate with veterinary teams to protect their herds and support the agricultural sector.
records.institution: Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has distributed fifty water tanks, each with a capacity of 1,500 liters, to farmers in the village of Al-Mugh...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has distributed fifty water tanks, each with a capacity of 1,500 liters, to farmers in the village of Al-Mughayyir, north of Ramallah. This support is intended to strengthen the resilience of villagers and secure their rights to their land following recent attacks. The ministry affirmed that this action is part of its program to protect farmers from displacement, emphasizing that their continued presence on their land is crucial for their livelihood and identity. The Ramallah and Al-Bireh Agriculture Directorate confirmed that various forms of support will continue to be provided to farmers to help them preserve their land and livelihood.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jenin Agriculture Directorate, has completed a workshop for olive press owners in the Jenin Gove...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jenin Agriculture Directorate, has completed a workshop for olive press owners in the Jenin Governorate. The event focused on the nature of olive press work, licensing requirements, and challenges facing the sector, including the issue of olive oil residues. The workshop also explored ways to reduce oil loss in the pomace, thereby improving product quality and economic returns. At the conclusion of the workshop, participants agreed to begin submitting licensing procedures for their presses to the relevant agriculture departments.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Buraidah Dates Carnival is a major economic and tourism event in the Qassim Region, attracting traders, farmers, and visitors from ac...
records.description: The Buraidah Dates Carnival is a major economic and tourism event in the Qassim Region, attracting traders, farmers, and visitors from across Saudi Arabia and the Gulf. The carnival serves as an integrated platform for marketing, tourism, and entertainment, featuring a wide range of activities, including traditional performances, exhibitions, and sections for productive families and handicrafts. The event is organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates and the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture, under the supervision of the Qassim Region Principality. Its purpose is to support Saudi Vision 2030 objectives by promoting the local agricultural sector, empowering productive families, and highlighting local heritage.
records.institution: National Center for Palms and Dates, The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has launched an agricultural training program to help farmers in the governorate adopt modern, effic...
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has launched an agricultural training program to help farmers in the governorate adopt modern, efficient farming practices. The program offers specialized courses on a variety of topics aimed at enhancing crop quality and production efficiency. Key areas of focus include field irrigation techniques, optimal pesticide use, palm seedling care, drip irrigation, and fertilization management. This initiative reflects the RCU's commitment to developing the agricultural sector in the region.

records.title: Egypt is seeking to strengthen agricultural cooperation with Kuwait, particularly in the area of investment.
records.description: Egypt is seeking to strengthen agricultural cooperation with Kuwait, particularly in the area of investment. The Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation met with the country’s new ambassador to Kuwait to discuss opportunities in sectors such as land reclamation, poultry production, and fish farming. To attract investors, the ministry proposed inviting Kuwaiti experts to visit Egypt and explore the improved investment climate firsthand. The officials also discussed increasing Egyptian agricultural exports to Kuwait and sharing Egypt's technical expertise in fields like pest control and veterinary medicine. The ambassador emphasized his commitment to translating these discussions into concrete steps that would boost trade and investment between the two nations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Juhayna Food Industries has upgraded the rotating parlor at its "Enmaa" farm in Bahariya Oasis, Egypt, as part of a strategy to enhance d...
records.description: Juhayna Food Industries has upgraded the rotating parlor at its "Enmaa" farm in Bahariya Oasis, Egypt, as part of a strategy to enhance dairy production and implement sustainable practices. The new parlor, manufactured by DeLaval, features 80 milking points and can milk up to 500 cows per hour, significantly boosting the farm's efficiency. This investment in one of Egypt's largest specialized dairy farms supports Juhayna's vertical integration model, from farm to consumer, and aligns with Egypt's national food security objectives and Egypt Vision 2030 goals of fostering innovation and boosting local production.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Rising wildfires in Iraq and Jordan, fueled by climate change, are posing a significant threat to the region's expanding solar energy sec...
records.description: Rising wildfires in Iraq and Jordan, fueled by climate change, are posing a significant threat to the region's expanding solar energy sector. In Iraq, recent blazes have destroyed large forested areas in Nineveh and Duhok, raising concerns that thick smoke could reduce sunlight and impact solar power generation. This comes as Iraq aims to increase its solar capacity to 12,000 MW by 2030. Similarly, Jordan, with a solar capacity of over 2,000 MW, has seen a 70% increase in forest fires. Experts from institutions like the US National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) and the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change (IPCC) warn that wildfire smoke can diminish solar energy production by blocking sunlight. The issue highlights the interconnectedness of natural resources and infrastructure, emphasizing the need for better integration between wildfire response and energy planning to safeguard renewable energy investments.

records.title: The total value of certificates of origin issued by the Irbid Chamber of Industry in August reached $113.08 million, representing a 5.3%...
records.description: The total value of certificates of origin issued by the Irbid Chamber of Industry in August reached $113.08 million, representing a 5.3% decline compared to the previous year. The drop in value was primarily driven by a decline in major industrial sectors like therapeutic and medical supplies and engineering industries. In contrast, several sectors recorded significant growth, including food, agricultural, chemical, and construction materials. The majority of exports, which are dominated by the Al Hassan Industrial Estate, went to countries with trade agreements, with the United States remaining the top destination, followed by the European Union and the Arab League.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Kafr Nabrakh Municipality, organized an advisory seminar on integrated pest manageme...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Kafr Nabrakh Municipality, organized an advisory seminar on integrated pest management for tomato farmers. The event, part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, provided guidance on sustainable pest control practices. Following the seminar, the ministry distributed modern point-of-pipe irrigation equipment to 86 farmers to help them rationalize water consumption and increase production efficiency. These initiatives, which also include registering farmers in the National Agricultural Registry to access support programs, are part of a broader vision to develop more sustainable and competitive agriculture.

records.title: In its participation in the African Food Systems Forum (AFSF) in Dakar, Morocco reaffirmed its commitment to the sustainable transformati...
records.description: In its participation in the African Food Systems Forum (AFSF) in Dakar, Morocco reaffirmed its commitment to the sustainable transformation of African agriculture by focusing on youth. The forum's theme emphasizes the crucial role of young people in achieving food security and climate resilience. Morocco's involvement aligns with its "Green Generation 2020-2030" strategy, a national initiative that aims to support young farmers and entrepreneurs to consolidate food sovereignty. The Kingdom has also launched major continental initiatives, such as the Initiative for the Adaptation of African Agriculture (AAA) and the Royal Atlantic Initiative. On the sidelines.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al-Badayea Governorate date market is experiencing robust economic activity with the start of the Al-Badayea Date Season.
records.description: The Al-Badayea Governorate date market is experiencing robust economic activity with the start of the Al-Badayea Date Season. An average of 170 tons of dates arrive at the market daily, attracting shoppers and suppliers from across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. This influx of produce offers a wide selection of date varieties that meet consumer needs in terms of quality, quantity, and value. The market is considered a major agricultural and economic event for the region due to its significant commercial value and its role in ensuring transparent buying and selling.

records.title: The Global Water Expo, organized by dmg events, is being held in Riyadh, bringing together over 300 exhibitors from more than 25 countrie...
records.description: The Global Water Expo, organized by dmg events, is being held in Riyadh, bringing together over 300 exhibitors from more than 25 countries to showcase technologies for water, wastewater, and environmental services. The event serves as a strategic platform to connect solution providers with opportunities in Saudi Arabia, particularly following the National Water Company's announcement of 30 new water and sewerage projects valued at $533 million. The expo reflects the rapid growth of the Saudi water sector, which is projected to expand significantly, and aligns with the country's Vision 2030 water priorities. The event features a range of exhibitors, from global leaders to local companies, presenting advanced systems and smart monitoring tools to address the Kingdom's water challenges.

records.title: The General Organization for Seed Multiplication, in cooperation with the International Committee of the Red Cross, organized a training...
records.description: The General Organization for Seed Multiplication, in cooperation with the International Committee of the Red Cross, organized a training course on "Wheat Crop Management and Seed Preparation" for 16 agricultural engineers. The course was designed to enhance the scientific competence of the technical staff and improve their ability to effectively manage wheat crops and increase production. A key objective of the training was to empower the staff to provide expert agricultural consultations to farmers, thereby supporting the production of high-quality, disease-free crops.

records.title: A new trend in bank financing is emerging in Tunisia, with the agricultural sector taking precedence over a struggling industrial sector.
records.description: A new trend in bank financing is emerging in Tunisia, with the agricultural sector taking precedence over a struggling industrial sector. According to a report by the Central Bank of Tunisia (BCT), outstanding loans to agriculture and fisheries rose to 4.2 billion dinars in 2024, an increase of 7.8%, while industrial credits grew by a more modest 2.8%. The BCT has implemented specific measures to support agriculture, including revised credit scales and interest rate subsidies, reflecting a national priority to strengthen food security and promote climate resilience. This shift in financing from medium- and long-term loans to short-term loans, although a reflection of an uncertain economic context, is seen as a reorientation toward more resilient sectors.

records.title: Despite a production increase to 106 tons, the Tunisian zgougou (Aleppo pine seed) market is facing a paradox of rising prices and struct...
records.description: Despite a production increase to 106 tons, the Tunisian zgougou (Aleppo pine seed) market is facing a paradox of rising prices and structural challenges. The Ministry of Agriculture and the Forest Exploitation Agency regulate production through public auctions, but prices have climbed to 50-53 dinars per kilogram due to high collection costs, scarcity in certain areas, and market speculation. The sector's long-term viability is threatened by climate change, forest fires, administrative delays, and a shortage of collectors. The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) warns that if these issues are not addressed, prices could soar to 200 dinars per kilogram. Proposed solutions to ensure the sector's sustainability include professionalizing the workforce, digitizing permits, creating cooperatives, and implementing price controls to maintain affordability.

records.title: The Khudair Cooperative Association in Taiz Governorate has inaugurated a new Agricultural Services Center to provide support for local f...
records.description: The Khudair Cooperative Association in Taiz Governorate has inaugurated a new Agricultural Services Center to provide support for local farmers. The center will supply agricultural inputs, including seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, and equipment. The new center is part of the Agricultural Value Chain program and was funded by an interest-free loan of six million Yemeni Riyals from the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit to the cooperative. Officials emphasized that the center is a significant step toward advancing the agricultural sector, as it will enable farmers to easily access essential services and benefit from agricultural development programs.

records.title: The Ministries of Higher Education and Agriculture in Algeria have launched a national strategy for the organization and development of s...
records.description: The Ministries of Higher Education and Agriculture in Algeria have launched a national strategy for the organization and development of saffron cultivation. The initiative aims to promote research, improve production, and establish a national "Algerian label" for saffron to enhance the country's economic prestige. As part of the strategy, a cooperation agreement was signed between the National Higher School of Agronomy (ENSA), the Centre for Scientific and Technical Research on Arid Regions (CRSTRA), and the National Institute of Forestry Research (INRF), along with the National Centre for the Control and Certification of Seeds and Plants (CNCC). The agreement focuses on validating the technical process for saffron cultivation, ensuring production for export, and providing training, marking a significant step toward reviving this high-value sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Egypt is trying to attract private sector investment into its waste management sector, focusing on recycling and organic fertilizer produ...
records.description: Egypt is trying to attract private sector investment into its waste management sector, focusing on recycling and organic fertilizer production. In a recent meeting, officials from the Ministry of Local Development and Ministry of Environment discussed a private company's proposal to build a EGP 650 million ($13.5 million) recycling facility in 10th of Ramadan City. This project aims to process urban waste and produce organic fertilizer for use in the company's developments, creating a closed-loop sustainability model. The initiative supports Egypt's national strategy to boost agricultural exports through sustainable practices and reduce reliance on chemical fertilizers. This push for private-sector involvement aligns with Egypt's Vision 2030 strategy and its commitments under the Paris Agreement to improve waste management and promote a green economy.

records.title: The Veterinary Department of the Ministry of Agriculture is continuing its field campaigns to monitor local slaughterhouses to ensure the...
records.description: The Veterinary Department of the Ministry of Agriculture is continuing its field campaigns to monitor local slaughterhouses to ensure the health and safety of poultry meat. As part of this effort, a team from the Health Supervision Department conducted a visit to the Al-Kanz slaughterhouse in the Al-Radwaniyah area to verify compliance with health requirements. These ongoing tours are intended to support the national product and ensure that safe and healthy meat reaches consumers, thereby promoting public health and helping to prevent epidemic diseases.

records.title: In an effort to address water scarcity and climate change impacts, Jordan has initiated a pilot project in Wadi Seer to protect water and...
records.description: In an effort to address water scarcity and climate change impacts, Jordan has initiated a pilot project in Wadi Seer to protect water and agricultural resources. The initiative, called "Al Murunah," aims to prevent water contamination and land degradation by restoring springs and lining canals. It also promotes sustainable farming methods, such as solar-powered drip irrigation and the use of drought-resistant crops. The Wadi Seer Springs Cooperative (WSSC) has been established to manage local water distribution and support the community. The project, which aligns with Jordan's National Adaptation Plan and Water Sector Strategy, is intended to serve as a scalable model for water management and community resilience across the country. Oversight is provided by a task force including the Greater Amman Municipality, the Ministry of Agriculture, and other key ministries.

records.title: According to EastFruit, Morocco set a new record for fresh onion exports, shipping nearly 64,900 tons in the 2024/25 season.
records.description: According to EastFruit, Morocco set a new record for fresh onion exports, shipping nearly 64,900 tons in the 2024/25 season. This marks a substantial rebound and a 4.8-fold increase compared to the previous season, which was affected by a temporary export ban. While West Africa remains the primary market, particularly Mauritania and Côte d'Ivoire, the record also reflects a strategic move into the Middle East, with the United Arab Emirates emerging as a new partner. The success is partly attributed to a government subsidy program that facilitated access to seeds and inputs for producers, solidifying the sector's growth.

records.title: The Moroccan Ministry of Agriculture is planning to reintroduce customs duties and value-added tax on imported sheep and goats, having su...
records.description: The Moroccan Ministry of Agriculture is planning to reintroduce customs duties and value-added tax on imported sheep and goats, having suspended them to address a national red meat shortage. The decision follows a livestock census that found the national flock has recovered to 23.1 million sheep and 7.47 million goats, a number deemed sufficient to meet domestic demand. In a separate agricultural development, the poultry sector is experiencing rising chicken prices, which have climbed to approximately US$2.30 per kilogram. This increase, attributed to higher feed costs, heat-related losses, and a decline in chick production, has occurred despite earlier assurances of stable prices. Experts anticipate that prices may stabilize in approximately six weeks as production levels begin to recover.

records.title: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, has l...
records.description: The Omani Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in collaboration with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, has launched 12 new investment opportunities in Al Buraimi Governorate via the "Tatweer" platform. These projects, which span a total area of 287.9 acres, are designed to boost food security and encourage agricultural investment. The initiatives include diverse projects such as cultivating vegetables and other crops using modern technology, raising livestock and fish, and establishing specialized facilities like a veterinary clinic, a modern agricultural nursery, and a water bottling plant. The opportunities also cover specific ventures in the wilayats of Al Buraimi, Mahda, and Al Sunainah. This is part of a larger government effort that has seen a total of 54 investment opportunities launched in the agricultural and water sectors in the governorate this year.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: A 25-dunum plot of land in the Jericho and Jordan Valley Governorate has been allocated to the Ministry of Agriculture to strengthen the...
records.description: A 25-dunum plot of land in the Jericho and Jordan Valley Governorate has been allocated to the Ministry of Agriculture to strengthen the agricultural sector and foreign trade. The land will be used to establish crucial infrastructure such as cooling, packaging, and shipping facilities. This initiative, which was the result of a recommendation from the Council of Ministers and a presidential decree, aligns with the Ministry of Agriculture's strategy and the Food Security Initiative to promote Palestinian agriculture, particularly export crops. The Land Authority praised the move, emphasizing the national goal of utilizing land for sustainable development and strengthening the Palestinian economy.

records.title: The General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) is participating in the Saudi Drone Exhibition (SADEX 2025) in Riyadh, an event showcasing...
records.description: The General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) is participating in the Saudi Drone Exhibition (SADEX 2025) in Riyadh, an event showcasing the latest drone technologies for a variety of sectors, including transportation, agriculture, and environmental management. The exhibition brings together over 100 entities from within Saudi Arabia and abroad. GACA's involvement in the event is part of its ongoing effort to establish the Kingdom as a global logistics hub and advance its infrastructure for emerging air transport technologies, in line with the country's National Aviation Strategy.

records.title: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa) organized a forum in Buraidah to discuss th...
records.description: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa) organized a forum in Buraidah to discuss the sustainable management of palm trees. The event, which is part of Weqaa's efforts to protect national agricultural resources, focused on key issues such as integrated pest management, post-harvest control, and the latest technologies for combating the red palm weevil. The forum also saw the signing of several agreements to advance laboratory diagnostics and strengthen collaboration with the private sector. This initiative aligns with Saudi Vision 2030, which aims to enhance food security and support the national economy through the palm and date sector.
records.institution: National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa)

records.title: The National Environmental Recycling Company (Tadweer) has secured a SAR 90 million ($24 million) loan from the Saudi Industrial Developm...
records.description: The National Environmental Recycling Company (Tadweer) has secured a SAR 90 million ($24 million) loan from the Saudi Industrial Development Fund (SIDF), which is part of a larger credit facility obtained from Saudi Awwal Bank (SAB). This financing is intended to support the company's expansion of recycling projects, including technology upgrades and capacity boosts, aligning with Saudi Arabia’s sustainability agenda and Vision 2030 goals. The Saudi National Center for Waste Management aims to divert 82% of the Kingdom's waste from landfills by 2035, creating significant opportunities for companies like Tadweer, which specializes in recycling scrap metals. This financial milestone reflects a growing regional trend where lending institutions are actively supporting green industrial development and sustainable finance.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: According to a report by the energy think tank Ember, Tunisia ranked 6th among 25 African countries for solar panel imports from China, h...
records.description: According to a report by the energy think tank Ember, Tunisia ranked 6th among 25 African countries for solar panel imports from China, having imported 655 megawatts (MW) between July 2024 and June 2025. This activity is part of a "solar boom" across the continent, which saw a 60% increase in imports from China, reaching 15,032 MW. The continent's top importers were South Africa, Nigeria, and Algeria, with Morocco and Egypt ranking 4th and 5th, respectively. The report suggests that these imports could significantly reduce a country's reliance on refined oil and highlight a strategic shift toward renewable energy. A separate report from the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) indicates that Africa's overall renewable energy capacity grew by 91% over the last decade, reaching 62.10 gigawatts (GW) in 2023.

records.title: Tunisia, led by the Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA), is a key participant in the Big Tech Africa 2025 exhibition in Tunis...
records.description: Tunisia, led by the Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA), is a key participant in the Big Tech Africa 2025 exhibition in Tunis, showcasing its climate-smart agricultural innovations. The initiative, in partnership with the German Cooperation (GIZ) and the Soil Matters project, features startups with solutions like digital nutrient mapping, AI-based decision-making tools, and innovative agroecological inputs. According to the Ministry of Agriculture, these technologies aim to address challenges such as soil degradation and water scarcity, which affect more than 60% of Tunisia's cultivated land. The participation highlights the growth of Tunisia's agritech sector and aims to accelerate the adoption of these solutions while fostering international partnerships, aligning with the country's 2020-2030 Agricultural Strategic Plan.

records.title: The Egyptian Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation has announced a plan to invest EGP 144.8 billion ($...
records.description: The Egyptian Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation has announced a plan to invest EGP 144.8 billion ($3 billion) in the country's agriculture and irrigation sectors. The plan, which includes both public and private investment, aims to bolster food and water security by increasing agricultural production to an estimated EGP 3.7 trillion. Key initiatives include land reclamation in areas like Toshka and the New Delta, improving crop yields by up to 15% through modern irrigation and greenhouse technology, and expanding the country's wheat silo capacity to 5.5 million tons. The plan also targets increasing livestock production and achieving self-sufficiency in white meat and fish. To support these efforts, the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation will continue projects to improve water resource efficiency, such as the rehabilitation of canals and the completion of the New Deirout Barrage to serve 1.6 million feddans in Upper Egypt.
records.institution: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Jerusalem Governorate signed 20 agreements with farmers to implement a water harvesting p...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Jerusalem Governorate signed 20 agreements with farmers to implement a water harvesting project in seven villages and towns. Funded by the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development, part of the League of Arab States, the initiative involves building rainwater collection wells and providing modern irrigation networks and tanks. This project, which is part of the ministry's Water Security Initiative, aims to increase water availability, support agricultural expansion, and enhance household food security and income. The effort is intended to strengthen the resilience of farmers on their land in the Jerusalem Governorate, which holds significant national importance.

records.title: The Buraidah Dates Carnival in Saudi Arabia is a major event organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates and the regional branch...
records.description: The Buraidah Dates Carnival in Saudi Arabia is a major event organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates and the regional branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, under the supervision of the Qassim Principality. The carnival serves as a central hub for the Qassim Region's annual production of over 390,000 tons of dates. At the carnival's export yard, dates are processed and distributed both domestically and to more than 100 countries worldwide. Farmers in the region plan to plant over two million additional palm trees to further increase output, an initiative that supports the goals of Saudi Vision 2030 to boost non-oil revenues. .
records.institution: National Center for Palms and Dates

records.title: The Farmer Field Schools project has been launched in 14 districts of Al-Hodeidah Governorate under the General Authority for the Develop...
records.description: The Farmer Field Schools project has been launched in 14 districts of Al-Hodeidah Governorate under the General Authority for the Development of Tihama. The initiative, sponsored by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and funded by the Agricultural and Fisheries Project Finance Unit, aims to empower 2,500 farmers by establishing 100 field schools. These schools will focus on key crops such as sesame, date palms, cotton, and corn, as well as dairy production. The project, which emphasizes a hands-on approach and the empowerment of rural women, seeks to enhance farmers' skills in good agricultural practices, post-harvest processes, and marketing to improve their livelihoods.
records.institution: General Authority for the Development of Tihama

records.title: The Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has launched a nationwide campaign to monitor and combat fruit flies, which pos...
records.description: The Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has launched a nationwide campaign to monitor and combat fruit flies, which pose a major threat to crops like citrus. The campaign, which includes field visits to areas such as the Beheira Governorate, aims to support farmers by providing technical guidance, promoting affordable biological pest control methods, and ensuring crop quality to boost export competitiveness. This initiative is part of the ministry's broader efforts to preserve key agricultural products, safeguard against pests, and enhance Egypt's position as a leading agricultural producer and exporter.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: A national afforestation and direct seeding campaign, organized by the National Agency for the Great Green Wall (NAGW) and supported by t...
records.description: A national afforestation and direct seeding campaign, organized by the National Agency for the Great Green Wall (NAGW) and supported by the Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development, has successfully concluded in Mauritania. The campaign, which was part of National Tree Week, exceeded its goal by reclaiming 4,616 hectares, surpassing the original target of 4,000 hectares. This effort, which utilized both modern technologies like drones and broad community participation, is part of a national vision to address the challenges of desertification and climate change and work toward a "Green Mauritania." .
records.institution: National Agency for the Great Green Wall (NAGW)

records.title: The Sahel Tihama Cooperative Fisheries Association has launched the first phase of a Community Savings Funds project for fishermen at the...
records.description: The Sahel Tihama Cooperative Fisheries Association has launched the first phase of a Community Savings Funds project for fishermen at the Hodeidah Fishing Port. The initiative, which is funded with 25 million riyals to benefit 70 fishermen, is a collaboration with the Red Sea Fisheries Authority, the Navy, and the Coast Guard. The project aims to provide practical solutions to the economic issues faced by fishermen and to enhance their livelihood stability. The initiative, also supported by the Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries, is expected to be expanded in the future to include more beneficiaries.

records.title: After two years of decline, Egypt's palm date exports to Indonesia reached a new record of 25,500 tons in the marketing year (MY) 2024/25...
records.description: After two years of decline, Egypt's palm date exports to Indonesia reached a new record of 25,500 tons in the marketing year (MY) 2024/25, a 56% increase from the previous year. This surge in exports, valued at $23.8 million, was enabled by improved logistical conditions following disruptions in the Red Sea. Indonesia is Egypt's second-largest market for dates after Morocco, accounting for about 30% of its total exports. The record volume underscores Indonesia's significant dependence on Egyptian dates, which comprised 44% of its total date imports in MY 2024/25, with peak shipments occurring in January and February.

records.title: Despite a recent market oversupply and price drops, an Egyptian exporter argues that Egypt's overproduction of sweet potatoes is both ben...
records.description: Despite a recent market oversupply and price drops, an Egyptian exporter argues that Egypt's overproduction of sweet potatoes is both beneficial and necessary for maintaining its strong position in the global market. With an annual production of over six million tonnes spread across three cycles, Egypt has been able to displace other competitors from the European market. The abundance of volume provides pricing flexibility and a competitive edge, while also ensuring low prices for the local market, which consumes a large amount of sweet potatoes. The shift towards internationally demanded varieties like Bellevue and Beauregard at the expense of the local Baladi variety is a key part of this strategy. The exporter anticipates that low prices in the European market will rise after the summer production cycle ends.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its Directorate of Studies and Coordination, organized a training session on the sustainabi...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its Directorate of Studies and Coordination, organized a training session on the sustainability of medicinal and aromatic plants in cooperation with the Directorate of Rural Development and Natural Resources. The session, which was attended by forest rangers and agricultural workers, addressed the economic importance of these plants, the challenges to their sustainability, and the legal framework for their management. It provided comprehensive guidance on both wild harvesting and organized cultivation, in addition to post-harvest procedures. The ministry emphasized the importance of preserving these plants as a national treasure and called for continued cooperation with farmers to ensure organized and sustainable investment in this sector.

records.title: According to the U.S.
records.description: According to the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), Morocco is projected to import 7.5 million tonnes of wheat, highlighting its reliance on foreign markets for over half its domestic needs due to persistent droughts. As global wheat supplies tighten due to poor harvests in regions like Russia and Ukraine, Morocco's imports from Russia have surged, with over 1.1 million metric tons imported. This increase places Morocco among the top global importers of Russian wheat, alongside countries like Turkey, Bangladesh, and Egypt.

records.title: According to Oman's National Centre for Statistics and Information, the country’s GDP grew by 4.7% in the first quarter of 2025, reaching...
records.description: According to Oman's National Centre for Statistics and Information, the country’s GDP grew by 4.7% in the first quarter of 2025, reaching 10.53 billion Omani rials. The growth was driven by a strong performance in non-oil activities, which grew by 4.1%. The highest growth was in the agriculture and fisheries sector, which expanded by 11.1%, signaling progress in Oman's economic diversification efforts. The oil sector also contributed, primarily due to an 89% increase in natural gas value, which offset a decline in crude oil. The overall non-oil exports also saw an 8.6% increase, driven by goods like construction materials, petrochemicals, and agricultural products
records.institution: Oman's National Centre for Statistics and Information

records.title: During the Damascus International Fair, several Saudi companies, including ACWA Power, signed a series of agreements with Syrian authorit...
records.description: During the Damascus International Fair, several Saudi companies, including ACWA Power, signed a series of agreements with Syrian authorities to support the country's energy sector. ACWA Power's agreement with Syria's Ministry of Energy focuses on studying and proposing up to 1,000 megawatts of solar and 1,500 megawatts of wind power projects, in addition to evaluating and optimizing Syria's existing power grid. Other deals were signed by Saudi Electricity Company, Saudi Electricity Project Development Company, TAQA, ADES Holding, Arabian Drilling, and ARGAS, covering cooperation in electricity infrastructure, as well as oil and gas exploration, drilling, and processing.

records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM Food Company Topian, concl...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM Food Company Topian, concluded the second edition of a greenhouse management training program in Riyadh. The five-day program provided 30 participants, including graduates and agricultural practitioners, with 40 hours of theoretical and practical training. Participants learned how to operate advanced climate control systems, smart irrigation, and crop monitoring technologies to address environmental challenges related to soil, crop health, and resource conservation.
records.institution: National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The second phase of a UAE-funded solar power plant has been launched in the Bir Ahmed area of Aden, Yemen.
records.description: The second phase of a UAE-funded solar power plant has been launched in the Bir Ahmed area of Aden, Yemen. The project, which is implemented in partnership with the Yemeni Ministry of Electricity and Energy, is expected to have a total capacity of 240 megawatts upon completion, making it the first of its kind in the country. The plant is designed to provide clean, sustainable power to residents, reduce reliance on imported fuel, and significantly lower carbon emissions. The initiative is seen as a strategic step toward renewable energy development in Yemen and a model for other governorates.
records.institution: The Ministry of Electricity and Energy

records.title: Alba and the Bahrain Centre for Strategic, International and Energy Studies (Derasat) have partnered to advance Environmental, Social, an...
records.description: Alba and the Bahrain Centre for Strategic, International and Energy Studies (Derasat) have partnered to advance Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives and support Bahrain's national sustainability goals. The collaboration will focus on boosting energy efficiency and reducing carbon emissions, with a joint task force tasked with studying the ideal energy mix for Alba’s operations and creating a unified ESG framework. This agreement, which aligns with Bahrain’s 2060 net-zero commitment, reinforces the importance of strategic partnerships in driving sustainable industrial growth.
records.institution: Bahrain Centre for Strategic, International and Energy Studies (Derasat)

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Department has completed preparations for a national autumn campaign to combat hemorrhagic...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Department has completed preparations for a national autumn campaign to combat hemorrhagic fever. The free campaign, which will cover all Iraqi governorates except the Kurdistan Region, involves spraying and dipping cows, buffalo, sheep, and goats of all ages to eliminate the disease-causing tick. To ensure the campaign's success, the department is deploying veterinary teams in collaboration with various local authorities, including provincial councils and agricultural departments, and is urging farmers and breeders to cooperate.

records.title: Jordan's state grain buyer has launched an international tender to procure up to 120,000 metric tons of animal feed barley and a separate...
records.description: Jordan's state grain buyer has launched an international tender to procure up to 120,000 metric tons of animal feed barley and a separate tender for milling wheat. These tenders are part of the country’s proactive strategy to secure essential commodities, as Jordan is a net importer of grains due to its limited domestic production. The tenders are crucial for replenishing strategic reserves, which the Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply confirms are sufficient for several months. According to the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA), Jordan's wheat imports are projected to reach 1.15 million metric tons in the next marketing year, primarily from the Black Sea region, including Russia and Ukraine.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply

records.title: Following years of drought, Morocco's economic growth is projected to rebound to 3.8% in 2025 and remain strong in 2026, according to the...
records.description: Following years of drought, Morocco's economic growth is projected to rebound to 3.8% in 2025 and remain strong in 2026, according to the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD). This positive trend is primarily driven by a robust recovery in the agricultural sector, specifically in fruit and vegetable exports. According to the publication East-Fruit, key products like cucumbers, asparagus, and mandarins have set new export records, signaling a revitalized agricultural sector capable of playing a major role in the national economic recovery. The dynamic export performance, along with sustained growth in tourism and industry, is strengthening Morocco's position as a key supplier for the European Union and the Middle East.
records.institution: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman is prioritizing In-Country Value (ICV) to ensure its emerging green hydrogen sector maximizes benefits for the local economy.
records.description: Oman is prioritizing In-Country Value (ICV) to ensure its emerging green hydrogen sector maximizes benefits for the local economy. Hydrom, the state-backed entity responsible for the sector's development, mandates that all project developers demonstrate clear strategies for local supply chains, SME participation, and community engagement. The SME Development Authority (Riyada) and Hydrom are collaborating to support small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), which are being presented with opportunities across the entire value chain, from manufacturing renewable energy components to infrastructure.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a new commercial sesame-farming project in Oman's Dhofar Governor...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a new commercial sesame-farming project in Oman's Dhofar Governorate. The initiative, a partnership with SIFCO, Salalah Free Zone, and the Omani Agricultural Association in Dhofar, utilizes a contract-farming model that connects farmers directly to processing facilities. In its initial phase, the project covers 600 feddans with a projected yield of 300 tonnes. The goal is to build a value-added agri-food chain by converting sesame into products like tahini and various oils. Officials state that this project will strengthen national food security and support the industrial diversification goals of Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Agricultural Relief, with funding from the Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development, has signed agreements to construct approxim...
records.description: The Agricultural Relief, with funding from the Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development, has signed agreements to construct approximately 11 kilometers of agricultural roads in the Tulkarm Governorate. The project, which includes seven different areas, is part of a larger initiative to reclaim lands threatened with confiscation in both the Tulkarm and Hebron Governorates. The new roads aim to facilitate farmers' access to their lands, enabling them to enhance their cultivation and maintenance efforts and thus strengthen their resilience and preserve the land.

records.title: The Higher Committee for Date Production Estimation has estimated a harvest of approximately 25,300 tons of dates, an increase from the p...
records.description: The Higher Committee for Date Production Estimation has estimated a harvest of approximately 25,300 tons of dates, an increase from the previous year. This estimate is the result of a field assessment that covered 893 palm farms with over 351,000 trees. The effort is part of the Ministry of Agriculture's strategic focus on regulating the date sector. Collaboration with private sector partners has already led to a qualitative leap in exports, with 16,000 tons shipped to over 35 countries. The committee includes representatives from the Ministry of Agriculture, the Financial and Administrative Control Bureau, the Farmers Union, the Palm Growers Cooperative Society, the Jericho and Jordan Valley Governorate, and security services.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Sustainable Rural Agricultural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a solar drying tunnel project for figs, which aims to re...
records.description: The Sustainable Rural Agricultural Development Program (Saudi Reef) has launched a solar drying tunnel project for figs, which aims to reduce post-harvest losses by up to 30%. A successful trial produced 2,500 kilograms of dried figs, generating a return of over SAR100,000. The program also provided training on the new technology to 13 farmers and employees.
