This initiative is part of Saudi Reef's efforts to support the fruit sector and enhance food security by improving the quality and market value of agricultural products.
records.institution: Sustainable Rural Agricultural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) approved a total of 16.4 million dinars in agricultural and aquaculture investments i...
records.description: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) approved a total of 16.4 million dinars in agricultural and aquaculture investments in the governorates of Monastir, Sfax, and Sousse. Additionally, APIA granted two land loans worth 311,000 dinars to young developers. These loans will enable the acquisition of 13.9 hectares of agricultural land in the Kasserine governorate for new agricultural projects.

records.title: A tree-planting campaign was launched in the Azal District of Sana'a Capital as part of activities to mark the Prophet's birthday.
records.description: A tree-planting campaign was launched in the Azal District of Sana'a Capital as part of activities to mark the Prophet's birthday. The initiative, led by the Agriculture Sector of the Capital Secretariat, aims to expand green spaces, improve the city's urban landscape, and raise environmental awareness. Dozens of fruit-bearing trees provided by the sector's nursery were planted in streets and neighborhoods. The campaign reflects a commitment to agriculture and environmental preservation and relies on cooperation between officials and the community to ensure the continued care of the planted trees.

records.title: Egypt’s Ministry of Communications and Information Technology proposed the establishment of the Arab Council of Ministers for Artificial...
records.description: Egypt’s Ministry of Communications and Information Technology proposed the establishment of the Arab Council of Ministers for Artificial Intelligence and Emerging Technologies at the First Arab Forum on Artificial Intelligence, which was organized in collaboration with the Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport and the League of Arab States. The proposed council aims to unify policies and strengthen the Arab world's position in the global AI sector. The minister highlighted Egypt's own advancements, including new AI systems for remote litigation and early tumor detection, and announced that the country will host the inaugural AI Everything Middle East and Africa Summit to foster regional cooperation and maximize developmental impact.
records.institution: The Ministry of Communications and Information Technology

records.title: The Egyptian and Lebanese Ministers of Agriculture concluded the fifth session of the Egyptian-Lebanese Joint Agricultural Technical Comm...
records.description: The Egyptian and Lebanese Ministers of Agriculture concluded the fifth session of the Egyptian-Lebanese Joint Agricultural Technical Committee in Cairo. The two sides agreed to sign a memorandum of understanding to enhance cooperation in various fields, including agricultural research, the development of climate-resilient crops, and fish farming. The ministers stressed the importance of removing obstacles to agricultural trade, with Lebanon affirming its prioritization of potato imports from Egypt. Agreements were also reached to facilitate the trade of animal and fish products by exchanging veterinary health certificates. This collaboration is aimed at strengthening food security and addressing shared challenges like climate change. The sixth session is planned for Beirut in August 2026.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is working to ensure meat safety for citizens and visitors in Karbala.
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is working to ensure meat safety for citizens and visitors in Karbala. The department confirmed that veterinary slaughterhouses are adhering to the highest health standards, with specialized veterinarians overseeing the slaughtering of thousands of animals, including sheep, cows, and chickens at facilities like the Sama Karbala slaughterhouse. This is part of a comprehensive plan to enhance food security and public health by providing clean, safe, and healthy meat.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Lebanese Army's Beirut Air Base, has launched an aerial spraying campaign i...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Lebanese Army's Beirut Air Base, has launched an aerial spraying campaign in the Upper Metn region to combat the Leptoglossus insect, which has severely damaged pine production. The campaign, which was based on the recommendations of entomologists and coordinated with the Mount Lebanon Agriculture Department and the Syndicate of Pine Tree Growers in Lebanon, aims to protect this vital sector. The ministry confirmed that this is part of a comprehensive plan to safeguard fruit pine forests across Lebanon, with plans for a similar campaign in the Bkassine area.

records.title: The Libyan Prime Minister has directed the Ministry of Economy and Trade to cancel all exceptional fish export licenses, a decision based...
records.description: The Libyan Prime Minister has directed the Ministry of Economy and Trade to cancel all exceptional fish export licenses, a decision based on advice from the Ministry of Marine Resources. This policy reversal, which had been a point of contention between the two ministries, was implemented to address high fish prices in the local market and ensure national food security. The instructions were first announced during a meeting with officials from the Privatization and Investment Board and the Commercial Registry Authority.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: A regional workshop was held in Nouakchott to validate a progress report for a program on strategic branches to enhance food security, re...
records.description: A regional workshop was held in Nouakchott to validate a progress report for a program on strategic branches to enhance food security, resilience, and trade in the Sahel countries. Organized by the Mauritanian Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty in cooperation with the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development, the CELAS Committee, and the Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa, the program aims to address the region's challenges, including drought and food insecurity. It seeks to develop strategic sectors, improve value chains, and create employment opportunities. The Arab Bank for Economic Development in Africa is financing the study, which highlighted obstacles such as weak water control and limited infrastructure. The program will be coordinated through the Permanent Joint Committee for Combating the Effects of Drought in the Sahel (CILSS).
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: Morocco has emerged as the leading supplier of blueberries to the United Kingdom, marking a significant milestone in its agricultural exp...
records.description: Morocco has emerged as the leading supplier of blueberries to the United Kingdom, marking a significant milestone in its agricultural export sector. Driven by a strategic response to new opportunities after Brexit, Moroccan blueberry exports to the UK have increased tenfold in the last five seasons. Between July 2024 and June 2025, the country exported nearly 19,000 tonnes of blueberries, valued at $144 million. This success is attributed to the sector's competitiveness, efficient logistics, and high-quality products, which have allowed Morocco to surpass competitors like Spain, Chile, and Peru in this demanding market.

records.title: Morocco's fresh onion exports have reached a record high of 64,900 metric tons, a substantial increase following the lifting of a ban.
records.description: Morocco's fresh onion exports have reached a record high of 64,900 metric tons, a substantial increase following the lifting of a ban. The ban, implemented by the state agency Morocco Foodex, had previously caused a sharp decline in exports. According to EastFruit, this new record re-establishes onions as a leading Moroccan vegetable export. The primary destination for these exports remains West Africa, with shipments to Mauritania and Côte d'Ivoire seeing notable increases. Furthermore, Morocco has successfully expanded its market reach into the Middle East, with the United Arab Emirates becoming a new significant importer.

records.title: Under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, the Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate has signed agreements to cons...
records.description: Under the supervision of the Ministry of Agriculture, the Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate has signed agreements to construct mineral water tanks for farmers in the Jericho and Jordan Valley Governorate. This project is part of the Ministry's efforts to protect water resources and improve agricultural water management. The initiative also seeks to empower Palestinian women and support women's agricultural associations by helping them establish sustainable projects that contribute to the local community and improve agricultural production. This is seen as a model for integrating the efforts of local and international partners to achieve sustainable agricultural and water development.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Maaden Bauxite and Alumina Company (MBAC), a subsidiary of Maaden, has signed a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Emerge, a joint ventu...
records.description: Maaden Bauxite and Alumina Company (MBAC), a subsidiary of Maaden, has signed a Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with Emerge, a joint venture between the UAE’s Masdar and France’s EDF. The agreement is for a solar power project with a battery energy storage system to supply the Al Baitha Bauxite Mine with clean energy. The off-grid facility will generate approximately 17,300 MWh of electricity annually and help to prevent 13,800 tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions per year. This initiative aligns with Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 and its energy transition goals.

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has launched a new investment opportunity for w...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has launched a new investment opportunity for wild thyme cultivation in Saudi Arabia's Northern Borders Region. Covering an area of 1 million square meters, the initiative aims to enhance the sustainability of natural vegetation, increase local production to achieve self-sufficiency, and contribute to the local economy. This project is part of the NCVC's strategic plans to promote environmental and economic sustainability through the optimal use of natural resources and by fostering an investment environment that supports the agricultural sector and biodiversity.
records.institution: National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The Siliana governorate has collected 1,577,000 quintals of cereals this season, with 737,000 quintals of durum wheat and 697,000 quintal...
records.description: The Siliana governorate has collected 1,577,000 quintals of cereals this season, with 737,000 quintals of durum wheat and 697,000 quintals of barley making up the majority of the harvest. A portion of the collected quantities, including 435,000 quintals of durum wheat and 350,000 quintals of barley, has already been sold. The harvest is overseen by the Regional Commission for Agricultural Development.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), in partnership with Expo 2020 Dubai and Siemens Energy, has produced over 100 tonnes of...
records.description: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), in partnership with Expo 2020 Dubai and Siemens Energy, has produced over 100 tonnes of green hydrogen from its project, the first of its kind in the Middle East and North Africa. The facility uses solar energy to produce and store hydrogen, which is then used to generate clean electricity and to fuel hydrogen-powered vehicles for companies like Emirates National Oil Company (ENOC). This initiative supports a number of key strategies in the UAE and Dubai, including the UAE's Net Zero 2050 Strategy and the Dubai Green Mobility Strategy 2030, reinforcing the country's leading position in green hydrogen competitiveness as noted in a report by Alvarez & Marsal.

records.title: The Egyptian government, through the Ministry of Local Development and the Ministry of Environment, is collaborating with a private real...
records.description: The Egyptian government, through the Ministry of Local Development and the Ministry of Environment, is collaborating with a private real estate group to recycle urban waste. The real estate group has proposed a EGP 650 million plant to process household, garden, and treatment plant waste into organic fertilizer for its own properties. The government has committed to encouraging private sector investment in waste management and may allocate land for the project at the integrated waste management complex in 10th of Ramadan City. This initiative is a part of Egypt's national strategy to expand agricultural exports and transition to a more sustainable, environmentally friendly model.

records.title: Joint efforts by the Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture and the Karbala Agriculture Directorate have successfully protected the governorate's...
records.description: Joint efforts by the Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture and the Karbala Agriculture Directorate have successfully protected the governorate's palm groves from the red palm weevil. The campaign involved free pest control and a focus on optimal agricultural management practices, particularly in the Al-Hussainiya District. The success is attributed to a combination of free pest control services provided by the Crop Protection Department and effective awareness-raising activities for orchard owners, which have collectively contributed to safeguarding this important national resource.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture is prioritizing the improvement of the seed sector in Karbala by conducting proactive laboratory and fi...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture is prioritizing the improvement of the seed sector in Karbala by conducting proactive laboratory and field tests. The Seed Inspection and Certification Department in Karbala is responsible for ensuring the suitability of seeds for cultivation through a rigorous process. This includes laboratory testing of samples from the Mesopotamia General Seed Company to check for germination, purity, moisture, and health status before a recommendation for acceptance or rejection is issued. These efforts are part of the ministry's broader strategy to enhance the quality and safety of wheat and other seeds for cultivation.

records.title: This year, Iraq’s Duhok province is projected to harvest 60,000 tons of grapes, an increase from last year, solidifying its position as t...
records.description: This year, Iraq’s Duhok province is projected to harvest 60,000 tons of grapes, an increase from last year, solidifying its position as the top grape producer in Iraq. This achievement is supported by the Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG), which has invested in new processing factories, including one in Mangesh and another under development in the Semel district, to manage surplus production and improve market access for farmers. The province cultivates more than 105 grape varieties and has historically faced challenges in selling its produce, a problem now being addressed by government initiatives and investor involvement. These efforts are part of the KRG's broader agricultural reforms to boost local output and expand agricultural exports.

records.title: The Mauritanian government, through the Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development and the Ministry of Fisheries and Maritime an...
records.description: The Mauritanian government, through the Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development and the Ministry of Fisheries and Maritime and Port Infrastructure, launched a national workshop in Nouakchott to strengthen the country's climate action efforts. The workshop aims to align Mauritania's national ambitions with its international commitments on climate change. The government views climate action not only as an environmental necessity but also as a strategic opportunity to enhance national food and energy security, in line with its broader goals for sustainable development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development

records.title: After several years of decline, the Moroccan potato industry has made a strong comeback on international markets, driven by the lifting o...
records.description: After several years of decline, the Moroccan potato industry has made a strong comeback on international markets, driven by the lifting of an export embargo and sustained demand from West Africa. Exports reached 42,900 tonnes, a nearly six-fold increase over the previous season. The recovery was fueled by key markets like Mauritania and Mali, which account for almost half of the exported volume, while Spain, France, and Portugal remain key European importers. Despite this strong rebound, the sector faces ongoing structural challenges, including water stress and climate change, which will require strategic investments in sustainable practices to ensure the industry's long-term resilience.

records.title: Facing decreased profitability and significant phytosanitary issues, the Moroccan tomato company Ô Fresh is changing its strategy to aban...
records.description: Facing decreased profitability and significant phytosanitary issues, the Moroccan tomato company Ô Fresh is changing its strategy to abandon the production of plum tomatoes for the European market. Plum tomatoes have become less profitable due to fierce competition from local European producers and a high susceptibility to the ToBRFV virus. In response, Ô Fresh is shifting its focus to more resilient and profitable varieties, such as round cherry tomatoes and beefsteak tomatoes, which meet the strict standards of major retailers. This strategic repositioning reflects the adaptability of Moroccan producers in a constantly evolving market where quality, disease resistance, and regulatory compliance are essential for competitiveness.

records.title: The Moroccan government conducted a national livestock census between June and August 2025 to create an accurate database for improving t...
records.description: The Moroccan government conducted a national livestock census between June and August 2025 to create an accurate database for improving the livestock sector and ensuring food sovereignty. The census recorded a total of 32.8 million animals, revealing an overall increase in numbers but a decline of about 30% in cattle and camels compared to their usual averages, due to a combination of drought and issues stemming from the COVID-19 pandemic. Based on these findings, the government will maintain the suspension of import duties and value-added tax on cattle to help rebuild the herd, while lifting these suspensions for sheep, goats, and powdered milk. To support breeders, the government has allocated nearly 11 billion dirhams in direct financial aid for feed, debt relief, and other essential services.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its Bethlehem Governorate Agriculture Directorate, has delivered agricultural equipment...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its Bethlehem Governorate Agriculture Directorate, has delivered agricultural equipment to Farmers' Field Schools in the towns of Battir and Husan. This initiative is part of the Sustainable Tourism Support Project, which is being implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) in partnership with the Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities and the Arab Agricultural Engineers Association. The equipment was provided to 60 farmers in five specialized field schools with the aim of enhancing their agricultural knowledge, skills, and production methods to empower them and support the local economy.

records.title: Qatar is working to increase its food self-sufficiency, with the National Food Security Strategy 2030 aiming to reduce reliance on import...
records.description: Qatar is working to increase its food self-sufficiency, with the National Food Security Strategy 2030 aiming to reduce reliance on imports and secure essential goods. The strategy focuses on local production of perishable items and building strategic reserves for storable products. While current self-sufficiency levels are high in dairy and poultry (98%), the country has set new targets for 2030, including reaching 55% in vegetables and 70% in eggs. This is supported by partnerships between the public and private sectors, with private companies investing in agricultural technology and livestock projects, while key institutions like the Ministry of Municipality, Qatar Chamber, and the Ministry of Commerce and Industry provide guidance and oversight.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Agroforestry is a sustainable agricultural practice that combines trees with crops or pastures in a single area to provide environmental,...
records.description: Agroforestry is a sustainable agricultural practice that combines trees with crops or pastures in a single area to provide environmental, economic, and social benefits. The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) is spearheading efforts to promote agroforestry in the Kingdom. The NCVC's projects, including an action plan to advance agroforestry, aim to enhance environmental sustainability, foster economic and social development, and encourage investment. The organization is also strengthening partnerships with local communities to protect vegetation cover and support national targets aligned with the Saudi Green Initiative and Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's office in Yanbu, in collaboration with the Reef National Foundation, provided suppor...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's office in Yanbu, in collaboration with the Reef National Foundation, provided support to fishermen. The initiative included delivering marine engines and other tools and equipment for boats. The program also trained beneficiaries and, in a previous phase, supplied refrigeration vehicles and fishing boats in partnership with the Yanbu Cooperative Society for Fishermen. The fishing boats have generated significant sales from numerous fishing trips. This initiative is part of the larger Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM food company Topian, launc...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM food company Topian, launched a greenhouse management training program in Riyadh. The initiative, part of Estidamah's knowledge transfer program, aims to promote sustainable agricultural practices by training participants in the management of climate-controlled greenhouses. The curriculum focuses on advanced systems for smart irrigation, crop monitoring, and energy-saving solutions, while also addressing key challenges like water scarcity and soil health. This program supports the country's National Agriculture Strategy to improve production efficiency and enhance food security.
records.institution: National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: Despite a 40.1% increase in export volume, Tunisia's olive oil earnings dropped by 28.9% during the first half of the 2024/25 campaign du...
records.description: Despite a 40.1% increase in export volume, Tunisia's olive oil earnings dropped by 28.9% during the first half of the 2024/25 campaign due to a significant decline in global prices. According to the National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI), the sector's growth has been constrained by a heavy reliance on bulk exports, which account for 88.1% of total volume. While Europe, led by Italy and Spain, remains the primary market, the lack of investment in branding and packaging has prevented the country from capturing higher value. In response to these challenges, the Tunisian Technical Centre for Packaging (Packtek) is leading a promotional campaign to pivot toward more profitable, value-added exports.

records.title: The Kasserine governorate in Tunisia has estimated its prickly pear harvest at 250,000 tons, maintaining its position as the top national...
records.description: The Kasserine governorate in Tunisia has estimated its prickly pear harvest at 250,000 tons, maintaining its position as the top national producer with 50% of the country's total output. The region, which has developed a plan to combat the cochineal insect, benefits from a strategic sector that covers 100,000 hectares and generates approximately 80 million dinars in annual revenue. The industry provides about 40,000 jobs, primarily for women. A single locality, Zalfane, is the largest production area, contributing 150,000 tons to the total.

records.title: The National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI) reports that the total filling rate of Tunisian dams stands at 30.9%.
records.description: The National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI) reports that the total filling rate of Tunisian dams stands at 30.9%. This represents a 32.3% increase in water reserves compared to the previous year, with levels reaching nearly 731 million cubic meters. However, the increase is a more modest 9.5% compared to the average of the last three years. The distribution of water is uneven, with northern dams accounting for 92% of total reserves, while dams in the central and Cap-Bon regions have significantly lower filling rates.

records.title: The Tunisian Ministry of Environment is working with tomato processors in the Nabeul governorate to address pollution caused by the disch...
records.description: The Tunisian Ministry of Environment is working with tomato processors in the Nabeul governorate to address pollution caused by the discharge of industrial water into the natural environment. A working session identified that 13 tomato processing units and around 50 oil mills are contributing to the pollution, with only a small fraction of the industrial water being treated. Rather than imposing fines or closures, the ministry is seeking "innovative solutions" and plans to offer incentives and financing to help manufacturers rehabilitate their water treatment plants. The goal is to ensure that the industrial water complies with Tunisian environmental standards as the country works to meet its international commitment to reduce carbon emissions.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon has signed a memorandum of understanding with the civil society organization "This Land Is Ours" A...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon has signed a memorandum of understanding with the civil society organization "This Land Is Ours" Association to foster cooperation in developing the agricultural sector and supporting farmers, particularly small-scale producers. The agreement focuses on improving farmers' access to resources, providing guidance and training, and facilitating communication with the Ministry. In a separate meeting, the Minister also discussed with the Syndicate of Lebanese Food Industries the importance of establishing a legal framework for contract farming to ensure the rights of farmers and the stability of the national food industry.

records.title: In the rural commune of Guenfouda, Jerada province, the prickly pear harvest is beginning with optimism after an exceptional yield, despi...
records.description: In the rural commune of Guenfouda, Jerada province, the prickly pear harvest is beginning with optimism after an exceptional yield, despite a recent cochineal infestation. This success is attributed to diligent farming practices and abundant rainfall. The Jerada provincial directorate of agriculture has announced plans to plant new, pest-resistant trees to rehabilitate several hundred hectares of land, aligning with the "Green Generation" plan. The prickly pear is considered a strategic crop for rural development and a key asset in the fight against desertification due to its low water footprint and high economic value, which also provides employment opportunities.

records.title: The General Administration of Veterinary Services and Animal Health at the Ministry of Agriculture has completed a comprehensive national...
records.description: The General Administration of Veterinary Services and Animal Health at the Ministry of Agriculture has completed a comprehensive national campaign to combat rabies and vaccinate domestic animals. In response to rising rabies cases, the campaign vaccinated 4,878 animals belonging to 1,322 citizens across various governorates, including Jenin, Jericho, and Nablus. The initiative, conducted in cooperation with the Ministry of Health and local authorities, also included educational workshops to raise public awareness. This campaign is part of the ministry's broader plan to protect public health and control the spread of epidemics.

records.title: The Palestinian government, led by the Ministry of Agriculture, has launched the "Olive 2025" national campaign to support olive growers...
records.description: The Palestinian government, led by the Ministry of Agriculture, has launched the "Olive 2025" national campaign to support olive growers and strengthen their resilience against challenges, including those from the occupation and settlements. The initiative is a collaborative effort involving various national institutions, including the Ministry of Interior, the Wall and Settlement Resistance Commission, and Popular Committees, as well as civil society and international organizations. A national central committee, headed by the Ministry of Agriculture, has been formed to coordinate efforts and ensure a unified approach. The campaign, which will be managed in a decentralized manner through various governorate offices, has received support from the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), which is providing equipment and guidance to improve the olive production chain and enhance crop quality.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched an agricultural advisory application called Murshiduk to provide farmers...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched an agricultural advisory application called Murshiduk to provide farmers with fast and reliable guidance. The app offers real-time support through consultations, educational content, and seasonal advice to help farmers make informed decisions, thereby reducing costs and improving productivity. The ministry encourages all farmers to use the free application, which is available on iOS and Android, and has already provided over 6.4 million technical consultations to its 282,000 registered users.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) is working with the government of Sudan to rehabilitate the country's a...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) is working with the government of Sudan to rehabilitate the country's agricultural and animal resources, particularly in Khartoum State, which has been devastated by war. The FAO resident representative in Sudan met with a member of the Transitional Sovereignty Council (TSC) to brief him on the organization's plans to help rebuild the sectors and achieve food security. The FAO representative noted that Khartoum was a major producer of vegetables and had a large number of animal resources that were destroyed during the conflict. The organization aims to assist the Sudanese government in rebuilding these sectors to achieve food security in the country.

records.title: The ADAPT program, a long-term initiative funded by the European Union and implemented by the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation...
records.description: The ADAPT program, a long-term initiative funded by the European Union and implemented by the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS) and the World Food Programme (WFP), aims to support the sustainable development of Tunisia's agricultural and fisheries sectors. The program provides financial assistance through a €25 million fund for private investors adopting sustainable practices, offering grants to cover a portion of their loans. It also focuses on building the capacity of professional agricultural organizations, improving the school canteen supply chain with local food, and using data to inform policy. A recent call for proposals offered €3 million in grants to strengthen these organizations' operational and technical capabilities.
records.institution: Institute of Agricultural Research and Higher Education (IRESA)

records.title: The 8th annual Sharjah Investment Forum (SIF 2025) will be held in a joint agenda with the 29th World Investment Conference (WIC), markin...
records.description: The 8th annual Sharjah Investment Forum (SIF 2025) will be held in a joint agenda with the 29th World Investment Conference (WIC), marking the first time the two events have been integrated. The forum, organized by the Sharjah FDI Office (Invest in Sharjah) in partnership with the World Association of Investment Promotion Agencies (WAIPA) and the UAE Ministry of Investment, will address global shifts in investment strategies under the theme, "Transforming Our World: Investing for a Resilient and Sustainable Future." It will serve as a global platform for economic leaders, investors, and decision-makers to discuss sustainable investment, green finance, and food security as key drivers of resilience and growth.

records.title: The Survey and Land Registration Bureau (SLRB) in Bahrain has signed an agreement with the international company "Aetosky" to begin the s...
records.description: The Survey and Land Registration Bureau (SLRB) in Bahrain has signed an agreement with the international company "Aetosky" to begin the second phase of an AI-powered system that detects changes and building violations. This system, which utilizes satellite imagery, aims to enhance the efficiency and accuracy of geospatial data and improve coordination among government agencies. Building on the success of the first phase—which resulted in a more than 60% improvement in monitoring efficiency—this new phase focuses on transferring and localizing the AI technology within the Bureau and expanding its use to other government entities to support the country's Government Programme (2023–2026).

records.title: The Egyptian government held a high-level meeting to review the progress of the New Delta project, a key initiative aimed at enhancing ag...
records.description: The Egyptian government held a high-level meeting to review the progress of the New Delta project, a key initiative aimed at enhancing agricultural production, achieving food security, and creating jobs. The discussions, which involved the Prime Minister and ministers from the Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources, the Ministry of Housing, Public Utilities and Urban Communities, and the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, focused on maximizing water use efficiency. Strategies discussed included reducing network losses, expanding seawater desalination and wastewater treatment, and limiting the cultivation of water-intensive crops. The meeting also highlighted the state's commitment to strengthening public-private partnerships to ensure the project's success.
records.institution: The Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources

records.title: The pastoral nursery in Oman's A’Dhahirah Governorate, which is affiliated with the Directorate General of Agricultural Wealth and Water...
records.description: The pastoral nursery in Oman's A’Dhahirah Governorate, which is affiliated with the Directorate General of Agricultural Wealth and Water Resources, has distributed over 8,000 pastoral seedlings free of charge to more than 385 beneficiaries. This initiative aims to increase vegetation cover, improve soil quality, and support beekeepers by providing plants essential for producing high-quality local honey. The distribution of these indigenous species is part of a broader effort to engage the local community in environmental conservation and promote the green economy in Oman.
records.institution: Directorate General of Agricultural Wealth and Water Resources in A’Dhahirah Governorate

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries in Tunisia has announced new prices for selected and ordinary seeds for the u...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries in Tunisia has announced new prices for selected and ordinary seeds for the upcoming grain season. As part of a national program to ensure sufficient grain quantities, the price for a quintal of selected durum wheat has been set at 170 dinars, soft wheat at 140 dinars, and barley and triticale at 130 dinars. Ordinary barley seeds will be sold for 115 dinars per quintal, with an additional 3% fee applied to selected seeds under commercial contracts. This initiative follows a harvest of approximately 11.823 million quintals of cereals, of which about 700,000 quintals are being used as selected seeds.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.title: While export revenues for Tunisian olive oil have fallen due to a drop in average price, the Tunisian government is implementing a strate...
records.description: While export revenues for Tunisian olive oil have fallen due to a drop in average price, the Tunisian government is implementing a strategic program to strengthen the sector. The initiative, which includes agribusiness investments and training, aims to transition from bulk to bottled oil, improve product quality, and enhance the sector's resilience to climate change. Despite the overall decline in revenue, the volume of exports has increased, and organic olive oil has shown a strong performance in key markets like Italy, Spain, and the USA. The government's efforts are focused on promoting agricultural innovation and strengthening the country's position as a supplier of high-quality olive products.

records.title: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain, in cooperation with Checklist Events, Trade and Advisories, is organiz...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain, in cooperation with Checklist Events, Trade and Advisories, is organizing the first Bahrain Veterinary Medicine Forum and Exhibition. The event will serve as a platform for veterinarians, researchers, experts, and government and private institutions from Bahrain, the GCC, and worldwide to exchange knowledge and learn about the latest innovations in the field. The forum, which will include the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH), aims to address health and environmental challenges and enhance Bahrain's role as a regional hub for veterinary and scientific investment. An accompanying exhibition will feature the latest technologies and services from veterinary companies, hospitals, and clinics, fostering partnerships and investment.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: Agricultural exports from Egypt have increased to 6.8 million tons so far this year, marking a rise of over 650,000 tons compared to the...
records.description: Agricultural exports from Egypt have increased to 6.8 million tons so far this year, marking a rise of over 650,000 tons compared to the previous year. According to a report from the Central Administration for Plant Quarantine (NPPO), citrus fruits led the exports, followed by fresh potatoes, onions, beans, and grapes. The sustained growth is attributed to the sector's resilience, its increased competitiveness in global markets, and the government’s efforts to modernize the sector, open new markets, and maintain high quality standards. This performance is seen as a positive indicator of the country's economic strength, contributing to foreign currency inflows and job creation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Veterinary Department of Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture has approved and registered 76 new veterinary products, including 48 medicine...
records.description: The Veterinary Department of Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture has approved and registered 76 new veterinary products, including 48 medicines, 11 vaccines, and 17 feed additives. The approvals were granted by the Veterinary Medicines and Vaccines Registration Committee after the products passed rigorous testing. This measure is intended to enhance livestock health, provide high-quality products to the local market, and meet the needs of breeders and farms.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has signed a cooperation agreement with the SEAL Foundation (Social and Economic Action for Lebanon) to suppo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has signed a cooperation agreement with the SEAL Foundation (Social and Economic Action for Lebanon) to support Lebanese farmers. The initiative aims to improve agricultural productivity and economic returns by providing farmers with modern tools and training. The agreement includes a specialized program on fruit tree pruning and the distribution of 3,300 battery-powered electric pruners and saws to registered farmers. This partnership is seen as a key step in empowering the agricultural sector and promoting sustainable practices, which will enhance national food security in Lebanon.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized an advisory seminar in Ain Atta, a town in the Rashaya District, as part of its National Agricultur...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized an advisory seminar in Ain Atta, a town in the Rashaya District, as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program. The event, attended by over 90 farmers and agricultural experts, focused on the importance of sustainable farming practices and their role in enhancing soil biodiversity and preserving the environment. Presentations were given by officials from the Ministry and REMER COMPANY, which also provided free samples of agricultural medicines. Discussions at the seminar highlighted the benefits of farmer registration in the agricultural registry and the adoption of modern agricultural technologies.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Jenin Grape Festival 2025 was launched to promote local agricultural products and support farmers.
records.description: The Jenin Grape Festival 2025 was launched to promote local agricultural products and support farmers. Organized by the Jenin Agriculture Directorate in partnership with several organizations, the three-day event in Jenin Governorate aims to strengthen the agricultural production chain and its economic impact. The festival, which saw wide participation from farmers, cooperatives, and women's associations, also serves to highlight the ministry's goal of achieving sustainable agricultural development that enhances food and water security.

records.title: Markets in Saudi Arabia are experiencing a significant influx of local fig crops, with this season's production exceeding 28,100 tons.
records.description: Markets in Saudi Arabia are experiencing a significant influx of local fig crops, with this season's production exceeding 28,100 tons. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture noted that the figs are not only valued for fresh consumption but also for their use in various processing industries, which enhances the crop's added value. The ministry is supporting local farmers through an integrated system of technical, advisory, and financial services to help them adopt modern agricultural technologies. This initiative is aimed at improving food security and is aligned with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Najran Region of Saudi Arabia is gaining recognition for its high-quality fig production, with annual output exceeding 650 tons.
records.description: The Najran Region of Saudi Arabia is gaining recognition for its high-quality fig production, with annual output exceeding 650 tons. The region's unique climate makes it well-suited for this summer crop, which offers high economic returns and is used in various processing industries. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Najran Region supports farmers by providing agricultural guidance and improved seedlings to promote the adoption of good farming practices, which has led to a consistent expansion of the cultivated area and presents promising investment opportunities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Najran Region

records.domain: Price intervention on cash crop commodities
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has revised the prices of cereal seeds for the 2025-2026 season.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has revised the prices of cereal seeds for the 2025-2026 season. The new prices for selected seeds are set at 170 dinars per quintal for durum wheat, 140 dinars for soft wheat, and 130 dinars for both barley and triticale. Ordinary barley seeds are priced at 115 dinars per quintal. A 3% increase will be applied to selected seeds sold under commercial contracts. This initiative is part of a larger support program for the cereal sector, which follows a recent harvest of approximately 11.823 million quintals of cereals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Egyptian Swiss Group for Pasta, Milling, and Concentrates is expanding its presence in the Middle East by establishing a strategic fo...
records.description: The Egyptian Swiss Group for Pasta, Milling, and Concentrates is expanding its presence in the Middle East by establishing a strategic foothold in Jordan, capitalizing on a surge in Egyptian food exports to the country. The group's debut at the InftExpo 2025 International Food and Food Technology Exhibition allowed it to forge partnerships with local importers. Given its geographic position as a hub for the wider region, including Palestine, Syria, Iraq, and Saudi Arabia, Jordan is considered a cornerstone of the company's regional expansion strategy. The group plans to gradually scale its exports of pasta and concentrates, with the goal of building a strong foundation in a market that has shown a strong demand for Egyptian food products.
records.institution: Egyptian Swiss Group for Pasta, Milling, and Concentrates

records.title: The Sennar State Ministry of Production and Economic Resources has met with a delegation from the Giad Group for Engineering Industries t...
records.description: The Sennar State Ministry of Production and Economic Resources has met with a delegation from the Giad Group for Engineering Industries to discuss cooperation in developing the agricultural sector. The discussions focused on providing agricultural machinery, civil and mechanical irrigation methods, and investment projects to increase productivity and reduce production costs. The ministry highlighted that its agricultural potential was negatively impacted by an attack by the Rapid Support Forces in the previous season and is now seeking funding for equipment. The Giad Group presented a plan to implement modern agricultural projects aimed at creating jobs and improving livelihoods in the region.
records.institution: Sennar State Ministry of Production and Economic Resources

records.title: The governments of Brazil and Algeria have signed a health agreement to permit the export of live sheep from Brazil to the Algerian market.
records.description: The governments of Brazil and Algeria have signed a health agreement to permit the export of live sheep from Brazil to the Algerian market. Announced by the Brazilian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock, this deal is considered a significant business opportunity, particularly for the northern and northeastern regions of Brazil where sheep farming is of economic importance. The agreement reinforces the growing trade relationship between the two countries, as reported by the Arab-Brazilian news agency ANBA.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: A consortium led by the French energy company Engie has fully commissioned the 650-megawatt (MW) Red Sea Wind Energy project in Egypt, wh...
records.description: A consortium led by the French energy company Engie has fully commissioned the 650-megawatt (MW) Red Sea Wind Energy project in Egypt, which is now the largest operational wind farm in the Middle East and Africa. The project, located near the Gulf of Suez, was developed as a Build-Own-Operate (BOO) scheme and is expected to power over one million households while reducing annual carbon emissions. The venture, which supports Egypt’s energy diversification strategy and goal of reaching 42% renewable energy by 2035, includes partners such as Orascom Construction and Toyota Tsusho Corporation. It was financed by a group of international lenders, including the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the Japan Bank for International Cooperation, with a long-term power purchase agreement with the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: Egypt's Vision 2030 places special priority on the agricultural sector as a cornerstone of national food security and sustainable develop...
records.description: Egypt's Vision 2030 places special priority on the agricultural sector as a cornerstone of national food security and sustainable development. The strategy focuses on integrated water management, aiming for 100% of agricultural land to benefit from water-efficient practices by 2030. Key initiatives include expanding the production of strategic crops through high-yield seeds and implementing digital transformation via the "farmer's card" for improved land management and smart farming. The 2025/2026 Socio-Economic Development Plan further underscores the sector's importance as a primary engine for economic growth, job creation in rural areas, and strengthening the trade balance by increasing exports and reducing import dependency, all while integrating the economic, social, and environmental dimensions of sustainable development.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, is continuing its efforts to boost olive production in the country.
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, is continuing its efforts to boost olive production in the country. The initiative involves preparing olive seedlings received from the Arab Center for the Study of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD). These seedlings are being cared for at horticultural stations with the aim of establishing "mother orchards" across Iraq, which will contribute to increasing local production and achieving self-sufficiency in olives.

records.title: With the support of the Ministry of Agriculture, citrus orchards in the Al-Suwaira District, Wasit Governorate, have had a successful pro...
records.description: With the support of the Ministry of Agriculture, citrus orchards in the Al-Suwaira District, Wasit Governorate, have had a successful production season marked by high quality and abundance. The Ministry's efforts, which include providing free pesticides, conducting pest control campaigns, and offering continuous field follow-up, have contributed to the success. Farmers have also adopted modern practices like planned fertilization and advanced irrigation techniques, leading to a distinguished local lemon crop. These initiatives are aimed at increasing local production and boosting consumer confidence in the quality of domestic produce.

records.title: The Civil Aviation Regulatory Commission of Jordan has issued its first commercial drone operator license to Al-Anasir Television Product...
records.description: The Civil Aviation Regulatory Commission of Jordan has issued its first commercial drone operator license to Al-Anasir Television Production Company. This milestone is the result of the commission's efforts to establish a robust regulatory framework under Civil Aviation Law No. 41 of 2007 to ensure safety and security. The company plans to use drones for various applications across the media, tourism, construction, and agriculture sectors, supporting the growth of a promising industry that is expected to create new investment and employment opportunities in Jordan.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Minister of Agriculture has launched a series of strategic projects in Akkar Governorate to enhance agriculture and protect the envir...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture has launched a series of strategic projects in Akkar Governorate to enhance agriculture and protect the environment. These initiatives, undertaken in partnership with local and international organizations, include expanding a nursery to produce millions of seedlings and inaugurating a new compost site with the Emkan Association. To protect forests, a drone-based monitoring program was launched, and an agreement was reached with the Qobayat municipality to declare the Al-Adhr forests a protected area. The minister also met with the United Cooperative Association of Beekeepers to discuss supporting the honey sector. These projects are intended to transform Akkar into a national model for sustainable rural development.

records.title: Viticulture in the Moroccan province of Nador is experiencing significant growth, but this expansion is threatened by severe water stress...
records.description: Viticulture in the Moroccan province of Nador is experiencing significant growth, but this expansion is threatened by severe water stress and high production costs. Despite a partial supply of dam water, the lack of sufficient resources has forced some farmers to invest in costly desalination units, which has impacted grape quality. The sector, represented by the Oriental Chamber of Agriculture and the Association of Grape Producers, is also hampered by its lack of a structured organization and is urging for the urgent construction of a seawater desalination plant to ensure the long-term sustainability of the industry and protect thousands of jobs.

records.title: The Al-Omari Dragon Fruit Farm was officially inaugurated in Jenin under the patronage of the Ministry of Agriculture and the Jenin Gover...
records.description: The Al-Omari Dragon Fruit Farm was officially inaugurated in Jenin under the patronage of the Ministry of Agriculture and the Jenin Governorate. The project is seen as a significant step in introducing a new and competitive agricultural product to the local market and pioneering a concept of agricultural tourism. The Ministry of Agriculture has expressed its full support for the project, which is considered an important national initiative that will compete with imported varieties and strengthen the commitment to land preservation.

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, also known as Reef Saudi, is a gold sponsor of the Lomi Hasawi Exhibition, organi...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, also known as Reef Saudi, is a gold sponsor of the Lomi Hasawi Exhibition, organized by the Al-Ahsa Chamber. The program’s participation highlights its commitment to supporting small farmers and enhancing lemon production and marketing in the Eastern Region, an effort that has provided over SAR342,000 in support and contributed to a production increase of more than 122,400 tons.
records.institution: Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Reef Saudi)

records.title: The tissue culture laboratory of the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture's (Estidamah) has delivered 4,0...
records.description: The tissue culture laboratory of the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture's (Estidamah) has delivered 4,000 coffee seedlings and 15,000 blackberry seedlings to the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Al-Baha Region. The seedlings, grown using advanced tissue culture technology, are part of Estidamah's programs to enhance agricultural diversity and support local farmers. This initiative aligns with the national agricultural strategy to introduce economically valuable crops and contribute to food security and agricultural sustainability.
records.institution: National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture's (Estidamah)

records.title: The Syrian Ministry of Economy and Trade has implemented a temporary ban on the import of several fresh produce items for the month of Au...
records.description: The Syrian Ministry of Economy and Trade has implemented a temporary ban on the import of several fresh produce items for the month of August to protect local producers and ensure food security. The measure, which applies to all countries, is an expansion of earlier import restrictions. Officials from both the Syrian General Administration of Land and Sea Ports and the Turkish Ministry of Trade have confirmed the ban's temporary nature, with trade discussions ongoing and a Turkish delegation still expected at the Damascus International Trade Fair. The restrictions are reported to be a response to low market prices faced by local
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Trade

records.title: To address a severe domestic wheat shortfall caused by the country's worst drought in decades, Syria will issue an international tender t...
records.description: To address a severe domestic wheat shortfall caused by the country's worst drought in decades, Syria will issue an international tender to import 200,000 metric tons of wheat. The Ministry of Economy and Industry stated that the country's wheat output has been reduced by about 40% against an annual consumption need of 2.55 million tons. The government is financing these imports through sovereign funds, with no foreign subsidies. This effort is crucial for the state's bread program, especially as the United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) estimates that more than three million Syrians are facing severe hunger.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Industry

records.title: The board of Egypt’s Waste Management Regulatory Authority has approved new measures to strengthen the country's waste management system.
records.description: The board of Egypt’s Waste Management Regulatory Authority has approved new measures to strengthen the country's waste management system. The new regulations include independent licenses for companies handling construction and demolition waste, which will be digitally monitored. To combat open-air burning, the board also approved reducing license fees for rice straw collection and will integrate data with the ministries of agriculture and planning for better management. Additionally, the board recommended replicating the "Port Said Initiative," a pilot project funded by the Japan International Cooperation Agency (JICA) focused on reducing plastic waste, in other governorates.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The General Authority for the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) has signed two cooperation agreements with Japanese partners.
records.description: The General Authority for the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone) has signed two cooperation agreements with Japanese partners. The first agreement, with Japan’s Itochu Corporation and Orascom Construction, is for the design and development of facilities to supply ships with ammonia fuel at the ports of Sokhna and East Port Said. The second agreement, signed with the Tokyo Metropolitan Government, focuses on cooperation in the field of green hydrogen. These agreements, which were concluded during the Egyptian-Japanese Business Council and Egyptian-Japanese Investment Forum, underscore Egypt’s commitment to becoming a regional hub for clean energy.
records.institution: General Authority for the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZone)

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: Mango cultivation projects in the wilayats of Barka and Al Musanaah in South Al Batinah Governorate, Oman, are vital initiatives aimed at...
records.description: Mango cultivation projects in the wilayats of Barka and Al Musanaah in South Al Batinah Governorate, Oman, are vital initiatives aimed at bolstering food security and reducing import reliance. The projects, which are part of a larger food security portfolio, will involve planting over 35,000 mango seedlings across 373 acres, with an expected annual production capacity of 3,382 tons. Under the supervision of the Directorate General of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, these projects utilize modern farming methods to diversify agricultural production and are intended to provide both local market supply and potential for future export.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The date trade in the Qassim Region of Saudi Arabia is a prominent economic pillar, largely centered around the Buraidah Dates Carnival.
records.description: The date trade in the Qassim Region of Saudi Arabia is a prominent economic pillar, largely centered around the Buraidah Dates Carnival. This market serves as a central hub where traders compete to acquire premium date varieties through public auctions, ensuring transparent transactions. The region's advanced infrastructure, including sales yards and refrigerated warehouses, facilitates sales, storage, and transportation, supporting the various marketing strategies of traders.

records.title: The Qassim Region in Saudi Arabia has become a model for sustainable agriculture and urban development by launching the "Qassim Land" ini...
records.description: The Qassim Region in Saudi Arabia has become a model for sustainable agriculture and urban development by launching the "Qassim Land" initiative. This program, which promotes green cities and the circular economy to support Sustainable Development Goal 12, focuses on advancing production methods, recycling agricultural waste, and expanding exports. The initiative was presented by the Saudi Green Building Forum at a United Nations forum as a success story. A key part of the region’s strategy is the launch of the "International Date Route," an effort to boost annual date exports and solidify the Kingdom’s position as a global date trading hub in line with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.

records.title: The Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development (KFED) is supporting the participation of 10 Emirati SMEs in Grains Africa 2025, a major even...
records.description: The Khalifa Fund for Enterprise Development (KFED) is supporting the participation of 10 Emirati SMEs in Grains Africa 2025, a major event for agriculture and food security in Nairobi, Kenya. The SMEs, which specialize in agricultural technology, food security, and sustainable agriculture, are being backed as part of KFED's vision to enhance the global competitiveness of Emirati enterprises and expand the national entrepreneurial ecosystem. The initiative also aligns with the Fund’s "SME Export Enablement Programme," which aims to help small and medium-sized businesses enter international markets and contribute to the UAE's goals for industrial and agricultural innovation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, is implementing an advanced breeding program to purify and sel...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, is implementing an advanced breeding program to purify and select promising genetic combinations for the sesame crop. This initiative is part of an effort to develop industrial crops and achieve sustainable biodiversity. The program aims to reintroduce sesame into the agricultural sector, focusing on varieties that are characterized by a short growing season and high tolerance to water scarcity and climate change.

records.title: The Japanese government has approved the use of JD 280,000 from the Jordan-Japan Joint Account to fund a project managed by the Ministry...
records.description: The Japanese government has approved the use of JD 280,000 from the Jordan-Japan Joint Account to fund a project managed by the Ministry of Agriculture for the construction and maintenance of irrigation channels. This initiative aims to improve water-use efficiency, promote sustainable water management, and reduce water loss by rehabilitating spring-fed irrigation channels. The Jordan-Japan Joint Account, established in 1997 and managed by the Ministry of Finance, is used to finance agricultural and food security development projects in coordination with the Japanese government.

records.title: The International Organization for Migration (IOM) has released a report highlighting the growing challenges at the intersection of clima...
records.description: The International Organization for Migration (IOM) has released a report highlighting the growing challenges at the intersection of climate change, food insecurity, and migration in Libya. The report states that climate-induced environmental degradation, such as desertification and rising temperatures, is a major cause of food insecurity. This, in turn, influences migration dynamics, particularly among vulnerable rural populations whose livelihoods depend on natural resources. The analysis underscores how these pressures exacerbate existing social and economic vulnerabilities and provides valuable evidence to inform strategies for resilience and adaptation.

records.title: The Food Security Commission distributed over 4.5 tons of basic food items to 70 families affected by recent storms and rains in the vill...
records.description: The Food Security Commission distributed over 4.5 tons of basic food items to 70 families affected by recent storms and rains in the villages of Takadah al-Wasi'a and Lamjajta. Located in the Kamour municipality of the Gru district in Assaba province, these villages experienced home damage due to the storms. The aid package, which included rice, sugar, and cooking oil, was provided to assist the affected families.

records.title: The inaugural Firnas Summit, organized by the Ibn Firnas Drone Center in Oman, was held to promote the use of drone technologies and posi...
records.description: The inaugural Firnas Summit, organized by the Ibn Firnas Drone Center in Oman, was held to promote the use of drone technologies and position the country as a regional hub for the drone industry. The summit, which supports the goals of Oman Vision 2040, served as a platform for experts from various sectors, including representatives from the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, Nama Group, and Omantel. A key feature was the first Middle East launch of the DJI Matrice 400 (M400) drone, for which the Ibn Firnas Drone Center is the exclusive agent. The event included discussions on practical drone applications in urban planning, agriculture, and utilities, showcasing how the technology can improve service efficiency and support smart city infrastructure.

records.title: The Qalqilya Agriculture Directorate received a delegation from the Jordanian-Palestinian Agricultural Marketing Company to discuss enhan...
records.description: The Qalqilya Agriculture Directorate received a delegation from the Jordanian-Palestinian Agricultural Marketing Company to discuss enhancing agricultural trade and cooperation. The visit included a field tour of a packing house and farms in the towns of Habla, Jayyus, and Flamia, where the delegation was briefed on the quality of crops like guava, mango, and avocado. The company expressed its commitment to facilitating trade procedures and obtaining necessary import permits to open new regional and international markets. The collaboration aims to strengthen external marketing channels, enhance the competitiveness of Palestinian products, and support local farmers to achieve price stability.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: A consortium led by Masdar, a UAE renewables company, has secured financial closure for the 2-gigawatt (GW) Al Sadawi solar project in Sa...
records.description: A consortium led by Masdar, a UAE renewables company, has secured financial closure for the 2-gigawatt (GW) Al Sadawi solar project in Saudi Arabia. The $1.1 billion project, which includes partners GD Power Development Company and Korea Electric Power Corporation, has received funding from eight regional and international lenders, including Standard Chartered Bank, KEXIM, and HSBC. Located in the Eastern Province, the plant is a part of the National Renewable Energy Programme (NREP) and supports Saudi Arabia’s target of achieving 50% renewable energy by 2030.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Global South Utilities (GSU), a UAE-based company, has officially broken ground on a 50-megawatt (MW) solar plant in Sakaï, Central Afric...
records.description: Global South Utilities (GSU), a UAE-based company, has officially broken ground on a 50-megawatt (MW) solar plant in Sakaï, Central African Republic (CAR). The project, which includes a 10 MW-hour battery energy storage system (BESS), is expected to supply clean electricity to more than 300,000 households and offset over 50,000 tons of carbon emissions annually. This initiative, which also aims to create new employment opportunities, follows a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) signed between the UAE and CAR, reinforcing the UAE's commitment to clean energy investments in Africa.

records.title: Based on a report by the General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC) and the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA), Egypt...
records.description: Based on a report by the General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC) and the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA), Egypt exported approximately 210,000 tonnes of food and agricultural products last week. The shipments, which totaled 3,400 consignments, included a wide variety of goods, with vegetable exports amounting to 30,000 tonnes (led by sweet potatoes) and fruit exports reaching 26,000 tonnes (led by strawberries). Egyptian products were sent to 180 international markets, with top importers including Italy, India, the United States, and the United Kingdom. The primary export hub was Alexandria Port. To ensure compliance with global standards, the NFSA issued 1,000 health certificates, helping to strengthen confidence in Egyptian exports.
records.institution: General Organization for Export and Import Control (GOEIC)

records.title: Egypt, a leading global wheat importer, procured almost 4 million metric tons of wheat from its domestic harvest.
records.description: Egypt, a leading global wheat importer, procured almost 4 million metric tons of wheat from its domestic harvest. This represents an increase of more than half a million tons compared to last year's procurement of 3.43 million tons. The government had targeted a procurement of between 4 and 5 million tons from an estimated total harvest of around 10 million tons. The domestic harvest season ran from mid-April through mid-August. Annually, the country supplements its local production with about 5 million tons of imports to support its strategic reserves and subsidized bread program.

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: The Agricultural Research Centre and the Military Technical College in Egypt have signed a joint research protocol to enable the local pr...
records.description: The Agricultural Research Centre and the Military Technical College in Egypt have signed a joint research protocol to enable the local production of potash fertilizers. The agreement is intended to reduce Egypt's reliance on importing approximately 1 million tons of potassium annually by focusing on extracting the mineral from natural sources like feldspar rocks. This initiative supports the government's plans for sustainable agricultural development by helping to save foreign currency and improve agricultural productivity.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Meranti Green Steel (MGS) is advancing its plans for a major green iron project in the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) in Oman.
records.description: Meranti Green Steel (MGS) is advancing its plans for a major green iron project in the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) in Oman. The first phase will feature a 2.5 million tonnes per annum (mtpa) Hot Briquetted Iron (HBI) plant, with a Final Investment Decision (FID) targeted for mid-2026 and commissioning planned for mid-2029. The facility will initially use a mix of natural gas and green hydrogen, with the goal of progressively increasing the hydrogen share to 85% to reduce carbon emissions. This project is a key part of the company's strategy to supply sustainable materials to its proposed green steel mill in Rayong, Thailand, and to meet growing demand from European customers. Oman was selected as the project's location for its competitive energy resources and the robust infrastructure of SEZAD.

records.title: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) is making progress on its initiative to invest in insect farming as a sustainable source of protein for animal feed.
records.description: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) is making progress on its initiative to invest in insect farming as a sustainable source of protein for animal feed. The project, which is in the preliminary assessment stage with a feasibility study completed, involves producing insect meal from organic and poultry waste. The company is exploring the use of black soldier fly larvae (BSFL) as they contain a high crude protein content and can be reared efficiently on waste, aligning with a circular economy model. This initiative is one of several new ventures under consideration by OFM, which also include a health bar manufacturing facility and a baby food project in Uzbekistan. The company's animal feed division currently accounts for roughly half of its total revenue, and this project aims to further enhance its market position and address global trends toward sustainable protein.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Presidential Guard have signed a memorandum of understanding to develop and rehabilitate agricultural...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Presidential Guard have signed a memorandum of understanding to develop and rehabilitate agricultural lands within the Presidential Guard Training Center in Jericho and the Jordan Valley Governorate. The agreement aims to enhance agricultural development, food security, and green spaces. As part of the collaboration, the Ministry will provide "Majhool" palm seedlings, train Presidential Guard members in modern agricultural practices, and offer comprehensive advisory services. This partnership is seen as a practical step to support the resilience of the Jordan Valley and integrate national efforts.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Qatar is advancing its renewable energy strategy, a key component of the Qatar National Vision (QNV) 2030 and the Third National Developm...
records.description: Qatar is advancing its renewable energy strategy, a key component of the Qatar National Vision (QNV) 2030 and the Third National Development Strategy 2024–2030. Three major solar power plants are now operational, including the flagship Al-Kharsaah Solar Power Plant (800 MW) and two others that add 875 MW of capacity. A larger, 2,000 MW project, the Al-Dhakhira Solar Power Plant, is also planned. These large-scale projects, alongside the "BeSolar Service" initiative by Qatar General Electricity & Water Corporation (Kahramaa), which enables residents to install rooftop solar panels and feed excess electricity back to the national grid, reflect the country's commitment to reducing carbon emissions, diversifying its economy, and transitioning to clean energy.

records.title: A model hydroponic farm in Madinah has produced over 2,015,000 kilograms of various crops, including lettuce and herbs, from an area of 1...
records.description: A model hydroponic farm in Madinah has produced over 2,015,000 kilograms of various crops, including lettuce and herbs, from an area of 183,000 square meters. The farm employs modern agricultural technologies that provide significant environmental and economic benefits, such as reducing fertilizer use by up to 60% and conserving approximately 90% of water compared to traditional methods. These efforts align with the country’s National Water Strategy 2030 and the National Agricultural Strategy, with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture supporting farmers to enhance production efficiency, quality, and market competitiveness.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi climate center launches project to digitize 73 years of weather records
records.description: The Regional Climate Change Center, in collaboration with the National Center for Meteorology, has launched a major project to digitize 73 years of historical climate records from 33 stations across Saudi Arabia. This initiative aims to enhance data accuracy and accessibility for scientific research and environmental planning by converting 36,000 paper archives into digital copies. The project follows a five-track process that includes data entry, auditing, and quality checks, with the ultimate goal of supporting the digital transformation of the meteorological sector and reinforcing the country's position as a leading regional hub for climate monitoring and forecasting.
