records.title: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) are co-hosting a regional...
records.description: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) are co-hosting a regional hackathon called "Hack4safeFood" at the SFDA's headquarters in Riyadh. The event aims to foster innovation and develop technical and policy solutions for food safety challenges in the NENA region, with a focus on supply chain tracking, early warning systems, and reducing food waste. Winning participants will be offered a six-month incubation program and a chance to present their ideas at the FAO's Science and Innovation Forum in Rome. The hackathon highlights the ongoing collaboration between the two organizations to leverage data and artificial intelligence for better food practices.
records.institution: The Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD) have launched a training course on "I...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD) have launched a training course on "Improved Seed Production and Multiplication Stages" for personnel from the General Organization for Seed Multiplication. The program aims to enhance the efficiency of technical staff and contribute to sustainable production by focusing on the latest technologies for developing and multiplying high-yielding wheat varieties. This training is considered a vital step toward achieving food security by developing strategic crops.

records.title: According to the National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI), Tunisia's food trade balance recorded a surplus of 823.4 MD during the fir...
records.description: According to the National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI), Tunisia's food trade balance recorded a surplus of 823.4 MD during the first seven months of the year, a significant decrease from the 1,729.2 MD surplus recorded during the same period in the previous year. The import-export coverage rate also fell to 121.8% from 143.4%. In terms of value, food exports saw a decrease of 19.4%, while imports fell by 5.1%.

records.title: A workshop on expanding grain and legume production was held in Hodeida governorate, organized by the local authority in cooperation with...
records.description: A workshop on expanding grain and legume production was held in Hodeida governorate, organized by the local authority in cooperation with the General Corporation for Grain Development and Production. The event aimed to achieve national self-sufficiency and reduce import costs by strengthening the role of agricultural associations and promoting a contract farming project. Officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the local government affirmed the importance of the initiative, highlighting the governorate’s potential and the commitment to supporting farmers with modern inputs and stable marketing mechanisms to ensure food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Extension Center in Nineveh, conducted a field visit to combat the spread of ticks that transmit...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Extension Center in Nineveh, conducted a field visit to combat the spread of ticks that transmit hemorrhagic fever. In cooperation with the Veterinary Hospital, the Nineveh Agriculture Directorate/Agricultural Extension Department, and the Local Union of Farmers' Associations, the activity involved spraying cattle, buffaloes, and their pens with insecticides. The event also included an educational component for participating breeders on disease prevention and control mechanisms, as part of an extension program to control common diseases.

records.title: The Al-Baha Region of Saudi Arabia is a key agricultural area with a growing interest in grape cultivation, which currently spans 51 hect...
records.description: The Al-Baha Region of Saudi Arabia is a key agricultural area with a growing interest in grape cultivation, which currently spans 51 hectares with an annual production of 772 tons. To support this sector, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture is launching the Grape City Project in Baljurashi Governorate, a large platform designed to provide advanced facilities for sorting, packaging, and marketing to enhance product quality and market competitiveness. The ministry also empowers farmers through government support programs, including the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (REEF) and the Organic Agriculture Program, which provides financial and technical assistance to increase production efficiency and help farms obtain organic certification.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Unaizah International Dates Season in Saudi Arabia is a leading environmental event that operates with zero carbon emissions.
records.description: The Unaizah International Dates Season in Saudi Arabia is a leading environmental event that operates with zero carbon emissions. The season features a market platform launched by the National Center for Palms and Dates to enhance transparency and efficiency in the buying and selling of dates. As the world's largest producer and exporter of dates, the Kingdom reinforces its global position through the event, which aligns with the agricultural sustainability and economic diversification goals of Saudi Vision 2030. The season receives support from relevant government entities and broad participation from farmers, marketers, and entrepreneurs.
records.institution: National Center for Palms and Dates

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture and Irrigation in Sudan recently visited the Arbaat Dam rehabilitation project in the Red Sea State, which is...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture and Irrigation in Sudan recently visited the Arbaat Dam rehabilitation project in the Red Sea State, which is nearing completion after a collapse. The dam, a grant from the General Intelligence Service and supervised by the ministry's Dam Implementation Unit, will have an annual storage capacity of 6.5 million cubic meters. Its primary purpose is to address the freshwater crisis in Port Sudan by providing water for drinking, agriculture, and livestock, while also protecting the city from floods and increasing groundwater supplies. The ministry has also completed designs for the Arous Dam as a further step to resolve the region's water crisis.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a "Forest Fire Management" workshop to establish scientific and practical foundations for protectin...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a "Forest Fire Management" workshop to establish scientific and practical foundations for protecting forests, preventing fires, and rehabilitating affected areas using modern methods. The workshop focused on developing a practical and implementable forestry plan to address challenges such as a shortage of heavy machinery and difficult terrain. Topics covered included pre- and post-fire forest management, protected area management, firefighting, and the restoration of damaged forests, with the goal of enhancing the sector's ability to address environmental risks.

records.title: According to the Interprofessional Fruit Group (GIFruits), Tunisia’s fruit exports have increased, reaching 24 thousand tons with a value...
records.description: According to the Interprofessional Fruit Group (GIFruits), Tunisia’s fruit exports have increased, reaching 24 thousand tons with a value of 96.3 MD. Libya remains the leading customer, while the United Arab Emirates has moved into second place in terms of value. Tunisian fruit sales have also grown in new markets like India and Qatar. However, exports to traditional partner Italy have declined, while sales to France have increased. The primary products exported are watermelon and stone fruits such as apricots and peaches.

records.title: The tomato harvest in Tunisia's Nabeul governorate concluded with a production of approximately 260,000 tonnes, a 30-40% decrease from th...
records.description: The tomato harvest in Tunisia's Nabeul governorate concluded with a production of approximately 260,000 tonnes, a 30-40% decrease from the previous season. The decline was largely attributed to the spread of a late blight fungus, which severely affected crops in the Mida and Korba delegations. In addition to the disease, farmers faced challenges such as rising production costs, labor shortages, and what the Regional Union of Industrial Tomato Producers described as arbitrary deductions by some processing units. Due to these persistent difficulties, the union has called for a boycott of tomato cultivation for the upcoming season and for a national dialogue on the future of the agricultural sector.

records.title: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) and the Dibba Al Hisn Municipality are co-organizing the Al Maleh and Fishing Festiva...
records.description: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) and the Dibba Al Hisn Municipality are co-organizing the Al Maleh and Fishing Festival at Al Hisn Island. The festival's purpose is to preserve the UAE's maritime heritage by celebrating the traditional salted fish (Al Maleh) industry and other ancient sea-based crafts. It serves as a platform to stimulate economic and tourism activity in the Eastern Region by empowering entrepreneurs and productive families in marine industries. The event features educational workshops, seminars on sustainable fishing, and exhibition spaces, blending traditional practices with modern approaches to support the long-term viability of the maritime economy.
records.institution: Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.title: A meeting in Al-Hodeidah province, attended by officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the General...
records.description: A meeting in Al-Hodeidah province, attended by officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the General Authority for Fisheries, discussed strengthening cooperation with Hodeida University. The primary goal is to activate specialized research on fisheries to support sustainable practices, preserve marine resources, and improve livelihoods. The participants also discussed transforming the Faculty of Agriculture’s farm into a model training and research station to provide students with practical experience. The meeting underscored the importance of linking academic institutions with government entities to address community needs and enhance sustainable development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The General Authority for the Development of Tihama, represented by its Agricultural Extension Department, organized a training workshop...
records.description: The General Authority for the Development of Tihama, represented by its Agricultural Extension Department, organized a training workshop for Farmer Field School facilitators in Al-Hodeidah. Held under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and with support from the Agricultural and Fisheries Initiatives Financing Unit, the training targeted 16 facilitators. The workshop aimed to enhance participants’ skills in field-based education to improve the production of strategic crops like cotton, sesame, and maize. The program underscored the importance of hands-on training for adopting modern agricultural techniques and the vital role of facilitators in enhancing food security and achieving a qualitative shift in crop production.
records.institution: General Authority for the Development of Tihama

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Lebanon Agriculture Department and the Rural Development Department, organized a seminar o...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Lebanon Agriculture Department and the Rural Development Department, organized a seminar on "Good Forest Management and Fire Prevention" in Hasroun for approximately 40 farmers. As part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, the event was held in cooperation with the Federation of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, and Agriculture in Lebanon, the Bsharri Agricultural Center, and the Agricultural Cooperative in Hasroun and the Neighborhood. The seminar focused on the pivotal role of forests in preserving biodiversity and mitigating climate change, while also addressing the rising risk of fires due to drought. The meeting emphasized the importance of community involvement, sound agricultural practices, and inter-institutional cooperation to protect forest resources and ensure an effective response to fires.

records.title: Agricultural markets in the Kingdom are experiencing an abundance of local pomegranate production, with a volume exceeding 37,100 tons, w...
records.description: Agricultural markets in the Kingdom are experiencing an abundance of local pomegranate production, with a volume exceeding 37,100 tons, which is boosting food security and self-sufficiency. According to the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, cultivation is concentrated in the Aseer, Makkah, Tabuk, Qassim, and Al-Baha regions, with popular varieties including Taifi, Hijazi, Wonderful, and Eversweet. The ministry is committed to supporting farmers with technical and financial assistance and by promoting modern agricultural technologies to enhance production, in line with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: New agricultural and development projects with a total budget of 344,533,000 Yemeni riyals have been inaugurated in the southern district...
records.description: New agricultural and development projects with a total budget of 344,533,000 Yemeni riyals have been inaugurated in the southern district of the Al-Hodeidah governorate. Funded by the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, the projects include the rehabilitation of irrigation facilities and canals in Wadi Zabid, the restoration of buildings for the General Authority for Tihama Development, the construction of six dual-purpose greenhouses, and the drilling of a solar-powered well. The initiatives are part of a government plan to strengthen the agricultural sector, improve production, and achieve food security and self-sufficiency, with the aim of creating jobs, supporting farmers, and restoring the region's role as a key "food basket."
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Date Palm Harvest Closing Festival was held in the Al-Tuhaita District of the Al-Hodeidah Governorate, highlighting the economic and...
records.description: The Date Palm Harvest Closing Festival was held in the Al-Tuhaita District of the Al-Hodeidah Governorate, highlighting the economic and social importance of dates to the Tihama region. Organized under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and the local authority, in cooperation with institutions such as the Agricultural Cooperative Union, the Agricultural and Fisheries Project and Initiative Financing Unit, the General Authority for the Development of Tihama, and the Al-Balad Al-Tayyibah Multipurpose Association, the festival aims to support farmers and promote Tihami dates. The event showcased a variety of dates and related products and featured traditional cultural activities, underscoring a commitment to developing this strategic crop and improving production methods.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Cairo Poultry Company reported a 46.82% increase in its consolidated net profit for the first half of the year, reaching $34.73 milli...
records.description: The Cairo Poultry Company reported a 46.82% increase in its consolidated net profit for the first half of the year, reaching $34.73 million compared to $23.54 million in the previous year. This rise in profit was accompanied by a growth in consolidated revenues, which climbed to $165.52 million. However, the company's standalone results showed a different trend, with its net profit after tax dropping to $0.71 million from $2.02 million a year earlier.

records.title: The Jordan River Foundation (JRF) and the Agricultural Credit Corporation (ACC) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to support smal...
records.description: The Jordan River Foundation (JRF) and the Agricultural Credit Corporation (ACC) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to support small agricultural and rural startups. As part of JRF’s Community Empowerment Program, the agreement aims to foster a supportive environment for entrepreneurs, particularly youth and women in rural areas. It will provide financing, capacity-building, and skills development training to empower sustainable agricultural ventures, ultimately contributing to the national economy and helping to reduce poverty and unemployment.

records.title: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) has warned that dam storage levels have dropped to "red line" thresholds this summer due to a significa...
records.description: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) has warned that dam storage levels have dropped to "red line" thresholds this summer due to a significant lack of rainfall. An emergency plan has been put in place to manage water supplies for both domestic and agricultural use, with distribution being carefully managed. Despite these measures, some farmers are reporting losses of up to 30 percent, and the Cooperative Date Growers Association has noted that reduced water pumping is already affecting date production.

records.title: A new fish hatchery has been inaugurated in the Mahmuda area of the municipality of Béri Baffé, Nema Province, as part of the "My Ambitio...
records.description: A new fish hatchery has been inaugurated in the Mahmuda area of the municipality of Béri Baffé, Nema Province, as part of the "My Ambition for the Nation" program. The facility, which is self-sufficient in water and electricity through solar energy, was launched under the supervision of the Ministry of Fisheries, Maritime and Port Infrastructure and is overseen by the Agency for the Development of Fisheries and Inland Aquaculture. The agency stated that this initiative is a first step, with future plans to include the construction of new stations and markets, as well as the training of stakeholders in fishing and aquaculture techniques. Professional certificates were also distributed to participants in a relevant training course.
records.institution: The Ministry of Fisheries, Maritime and Port Infrastructure

records.title: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning (MHUP) in Oman has announced four new usufruct land investment opportunities totaling 16 hecta...
records.description: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning (MHUP) in Oman has announced four new usufruct land investment opportunities totaling 16 hectares in the Dhahirah governorate. The projects are dedicated to cultivating citrus, figs, and palms for date production, as well as livestock and fodder cultivation. These initiatives, developed in cooperation with the Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources, aim to strengthen the agricultural sector and attract investors to support the economic diversification goals of Oman Vision 2040. Preference will be given to proposals that utilize modern irrigation systems and sustainable practices to enhance food security and improve competitiveness in local and export markets.
records.institution: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning (MHUP)

records.title: Saudi Arabia has lifted its ban on poultry imports from Brazil's southernmost state of Rio Grande do Sul following a bird flu outbreak.
records.description: Saudi Arabia has lifted its ban on poultry imports from Brazil's southernmost state of Rio Grande do Sul following a bird flu outbreak. The decision was welcomed by Brazilian food processor BRF, whose exports had been affected by the trade restrictions. Chile, which had also imposed restrictions, has agreed to resume buying Brazilian poultry products. Meanwhile, other large importers like China have not yet resumed buying.

records.title: Saudi Arabia is addressing soil pollution through a multi-pronged approach that includes mapping, regulation, monitoring, emergency respo...
records.description: Saudi Arabia is addressing soil pollution through a multi-pronged approach that includes mapping, regulation, monitoring, emergency response drills, and strict waste controls. The efforts are aimed at mitigating threats to human health, food security, and climate resilience caused by contaminants like heavy metals, hydrocarbons, and industrial and agricultural chemicals. This is in line with warnings from environmental agencies about the global consequences of soil degradation, which can lead to biodiversity loss, degraded farmland, and polluted groundwater.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The third annual Agricultural Products Festival is taking place in Tayma Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and...
records.description: The third annual Agricultural Products Festival is taking place in Tayma Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Tabuk Region. The four-day event, held at Tayma’s Historic Wall Park, involves over 30 farmers and exhibitors, as well as various government and non-profit entities. The festival aims to support local farmers by providing a marketing platform for their products and to promote sustainable agricultural practices, in alignment with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030. The event features a variety of local crops, educational workshops on topics such as organic farming, and dedicated sections for producer families to sell their handicrafts.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Organic Meat Company Limited (TOMCL), a Karachi-based processor and exporter, has become the first Pakistani meat company to gain app...
records.description: The Organic Meat Company Limited (TOMCL), a Karachi-based processor and exporter, has become the first Pakistani meat company to gain approval to supply products directly to Carrefour outlets in the United Arab Emirates. The approval, which came after TOMCL achieved a score of 94.89% in a comprehensive audit, allows the company to supply its chilled and frozen halal meat products without intermediaries. This move, supported by MAF Hypermarkets Pakistan (Private) Limited, is considered a key stage in TOMCL's expansion into Middle Eastern markets and is expected to increase its export volumes to the UAE. The company's new status as an authorized vendor for Carrefour UAE, which is operated by Majid Al-Futtaim Hypermarket LLC, provides access to a high-value retail channel in a market where demand for halal-certified meat is strong.

records.title: Egyptian chili peppers are set to enter the market from late August to January, taking advantage of a commercial window with little compe...
records.description: Egyptian chili peppers are set to enter the market from late August to January, taking advantage of a commercial window with little competition in Europe. Cultivated on Egypt's northern coast, the peppers are being exported by Al Awwad for Import and Export, which aims to overcome previous perceptions of poor quality by ensuring full compliance with European regulations. The company has already begun to gain a foothold in markets like the Netherlands, Italy, and the UK, and is seeing growing interest from France, Spain, and Eastern European countries, as well as Canada, with the goal of establishing Egyptian chili peppers as a commercial success.
records.institution: Al Awwad for Import and Export

records.title: Morocco's National Office of Electricity and Drinking Water (ONEE) has launched an international tender for a 61.8 million Moroccan dirha...
records.description: Morocco's National Office of Electricity and Drinking Water (ONEE) has launched an international tender for a 61.8 million Moroccan dirham ($6.18 million) hybrid solar-diesel power plant in Guerguarat city, Western Sahara. The facility, which is expected to be built on a 10-hectare site over 18 months, will combine a 1.5 MWac solar PV park with a 1.5 MWh battery storage system and a diesel component. This project represents a significant step in the region's transition to renewable energy. A 22 kV distribution substation will manage the system, ensuring a continuous power supply.
records.institution: Morocco’s National Office of Electricity and Drinking Water (ONEE)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has received a new water unit in the Tamoun area of the Tubas Governorate and the northern Jordan Valley, as...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has received a new water unit in the Tamoun area of the Tubas Governorate and the northern Jordan Valley, as part of the "Investment in Land, Water, and Agricultural Roads" project. Funded by the Dutch Representative Office, implemented by the Palestinian Hydrology Group, and managed by the Welfare Association, the unit includes a 1,000 cubic meter water tank and two kilometers of water lines. The new infrastructure is designed to serve approximately 400 acres of agricultural greenhouses, which will improve irrigation services, increase water use efficiency, and ultimately enhance agricultural production and national food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is participating in the "Monitoring Land and Water Productivity Using Remote Sensing Technologies" project, a...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is participating in the "Monitoring Land and Water Productivity Using Remote Sensing Technologies" project, a partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the Delft Institute for Water Education (IHE Delft), and the International Water Management Institute (IWMI), with funding from the Dutch government. The initiative utilizes the high-resolution WaPOR platform to monitor agricultural water productivity in the pilot areas of the Jericho and Jordan Valley Governorates. The project's main activities include merging WaPOR data with the national water information system, monitoring groundwater, and developing a mobile application for irrigation. This effort represents a significant step toward enhancing the sustainable management of water and agricultural resources and improving food security in Palestine. 🇵🇸💧

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Salfit Agriculture Directorate, and in cooperation with the United Nations Development Programme...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Salfit Agriculture Directorate, and in cooperation with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), organized a specialized workshop to discuss challenges facing olive presses in the Salfit Governorate. As part of the "My Initiative" project, funded by the IBSA Fund (India, Brazil, and South Africa), the workshop brought together olive press owners and agricultural engineers. Discussions focused on the issue of olive oil residues in the pomace and explored ways to reduce oil loss, with the ultimate goal of enhancing product quality and improving economic returns. This workshop followed a similar event in the Hebron Governorate.

records.title: A new international study led by King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), and published in the journal Nature, offers...
records.description: A new international study led by King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), and published in the journal Nature, offers a blueprint to reverse land degradation by the year 2050. The study, conducted in collaboration with the AEON Collective and the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD), proposes three key actions: increasing sustainable food production from the sea, reducing food waste by 75%, and restoring 50% of degraded land. Implementing these measures would save a total land area roughly the size of Africa and protect biodiversity and food security. The research highlights that these approaches are feasible and can be achieved by transforming food systems, supporting small-scale farms, and fostering international cooperation.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
