records.description: The third edition of the Tayma Governorate’s Agricultural Products Festival has been launched, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Tabuk Region branch. The four-day event features over 30 farmers and exhibitors, alongside several governmental and non-profit organizations. The festival's primary goal is to showcase the rich variety of crops in the governorate, support the agricultural sector, empower small-scale farmers, and strengthen food security. It includes dedicated sections for children to learn about farming and other awareness activities for the public.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Tabuk Region branch

records.title: In Port Sudan, the Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation met with a delegation from the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC)...
records.description: In Port Sudan, the Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation met with a delegation from the International Committee of the Red Cross (ICRC) to discuss post-war strategies and cooperation. The ministry's official called on the ICRC to include people with disabilities in its programs and provide them with improved seeds for food production, with distribution to be handled by the ministry's Seeds Directorate. The ICRC delegation stated its purpose was to align its post-war operations with the ministry's strategies, highlighting its ongoing work in producing local seeds and distributing food in war-affected areas. Both parties expressed a desire for greater cooperation, particularly in light of the ICRC's recent loss of its facilities and operational mechanisms.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.title: The Ministry of Economy and Industry in Syria issued a decision to suspend the import of certain agricultural and food products—including...
records.description: The Ministry of Economy and Industry in Syria issued a decision to suspend the import of certain agricultural and food products—including apples, pears, grapes, citrus, bananas, potatoes, onions, garlic, cheese, tea, and coffee—to support local production and reduce reliance on imports.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Industry

records.title: The WWF-North Africa office is developing two policy briefs to propose agricultural policy reforms in Tunisia, including a revision of st...
records.description: The WWF-North Africa office is developing two policy briefs to propose agricultural policy reforms in Tunisia, including a revision of standards for chemical inputs and a reform of the agricultural subsidy system. As part of the "BIODEV 2030" project, the initiative aims to promote an agro-ecological approach that encourages organic inputs and integrates ecological and social criteria into subsidies. The WWF asserts that current practices compromise Tunisia's commitments under the Kunming-Montreal Agreement and threaten biodiversity, and these briefs will serve as a key tool for advocacy among political decision-makers and ministries to guide reforms toward a more sustainable agricultural model.

records.title: EWEC issues RFP for UAE’s largest single-site carbon-capture-ready CCGT power plant
records.description: Emirates Water and Electricity Company (EWEC) has issued a Request for Proposals (RFP) for the Al Nouf Independent Power Producer (IPP) project, which is planned to be the UAE's largest single-site carbon-capture-ready Combined Cycle Gas Turbine (CCGT) plant. The 3.3 gigawatt (GW) plant will be located at the new Al Nouf Complex in Abu Dhabi, a strategic hub for power and water production that can also accommodate desalination technologies. The project, expected to begin commercial operations in the third quarter of 2029, will provide transitional capacity to support large-scale renewable energy integration and meet peak demand. The requirements for the RFP include the use of artificial intelligence (AI) and digital twins to optimize the plant's performance and maintenance.

records.title: New agricultural projects with a total budget of 272.5 million riyals have been launched in the Al-Hodeidah governorate, funded by the Pr...
records.description: New agricultural projects with a total budget of 272.5 million riyals have been launched in the Al-Hodeidah governorate, funded by the Project and Agricultural & Fisheries Initiatives Financing Unit. The projects, located in the Al-Duha District, include the drilling of five solar-powered wells and the restoration of the Agricultural Research Center “Tihama Station”. These initiatives are part of a plan by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources to enhance the agricultural sector, improve productivity, and contribute to food security and self-sufficiency. The projects are expected to provide sustainable water resources for the General Organization for Seed Multiplication and enhance the research capabilities of the center, thereby improving farmers' livelihoods.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: In a trial that could pave the way for expanding cultivation into arid regions, Egypt has successfully grown cotton in the South Sinai de...
records.description: In a trial that could pave the way for expanding cultivation into arid regions, Egypt has successfully grown cotton in the South Sinai desert for the first time. The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Agricultural Research Centre (ARC) and the Cotton Research Institute, achieved high-quality yields in El-Tor City by using modern irrigation and tailored fertilization methods. The first harvest of several cotton varieties, including Super Giza 86, 94, and 97, was completed in just 127 days. The authorities consider this a major achievement that demonstrates the power of applied research and opens the door to using more of the country’s land for this strategic crop. The trials are set to be expanded to other governorates to boost productivity and help farmers adapt to climate change challenges.
records.institution: Agricultural Research Centre (ARC), Cotton Research Institute

records.title: Supply of Egyptian sweet potatoes has improved and is now meeting the strong demand from international markets.
records.description: Supply of Egyptian sweet potatoes has improved and is now meeting the strong demand from international markets. According to a fresh produce exporter, quantities and sizes are now readily available for export, allowing them to prepare new shipments for customers across Europe after an earlier shortage. The company reports that the season is currently stable, with prices at a reasonable level. The exporter plans to participate in the upcoming Fruit Attraction event in Madrid, where they hope to connect with clients and discuss fixed seasonal pricing.

records.title: The Egyptian mango season has seen a quiet period following its initial launch, with market shifts this week leading to a price decrease.
records.description: The Egyptian mango season has seen a quiet period following its initial launch, with market shifts this week leading to a price decrease. According to an export manager at Al Mansi, demand has increased in markets like Jordan and Italy but has slowed in Russia, the UK, and the European Union compared to last year. This has caused the average export price to drop to $1,000 EXW from $1,100, although prices remain higher than in the previous season. The market is also seeing a growing interest in local Egyptian varieties like the high-quality, competitive Naomi mango. The company highlights the importance of continuous market monitoring in the dynamic fresh fruit market to manage these shifts.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the World Food Programme (WFP), has enhanced local agricultural production in Nineveh Go...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the World Food Programme (WFP), has enhanced local agricultural production in Nineveh Governorate by equipping its Agricultural Research Department with modern laboratory facilities. The new equipment, specifically for the Soil and Water Division, will be used to conduct tests on agricultural programs, soil, and water samples. This project aims to support farmers and increase the quantity and quality of local agricultural production in the region.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the World Food Programme (WFP), has successfully implemented a project in Nineveh Govern...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the World Food Programme (WFP), has successfully implemented a project in Nineveh Governorate to provide climate change risk insurance to smallholder farmers. The first phase of the project, which took place in the Hamdaniya District, benefited 94 farmers. This insurance offers financial support for damages to wheat, barley, and olive crops caused by high temperatures or low rainfall, thereby helping to protect farmers from future losses and ensure the continuity of their agricultural work.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Baalbek-Hermel Agriculture Department and the Nabi Othman Agricultural Center, organized an orie...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Baalbek-Hermel Agriculture Department and the Nabi Othman Agricultural Center, organized an orientation seminar on artificial intelligence and climate-smart agriculture in Ras Baalbek. The event, held in cooperation with the Federation of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, and Agriculture in Lebanon and sponsored by the Ras Baalbek Municipality, saw the participation of over 20 farmers. The seminar provided an introduction to AI's uses in agriculture, discussed the concept of climate-smart agriculture, and showcased successful smart projects and digital applications for farmers. The organizers also highlighted the importance of registering in the agricultural registry to ensure farmers can benefit from support programs.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Mount Lebanon Agriculture Department and the Aley Extension Center, organized a specialized advi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Mount Lebanon Agriculture Department and the Aley Extension Center, organized a specialized advisory seminar in cooperation with the Aramoun Municipality for approximately 25 smallholder farmers. As part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, the seminar covered various technical topics related to the olive sector, including the advantages of different types of seedlings, olive varieties for oil and dual use, and the importance of good agricultural practices. The event highlighted the significance of agricultural extension in improving production and farmers' incomes and marks the beginning of a continued partnership to support sustainable agricultural development in the town.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman is now focusing on the development of white hydrogen, a naturally forming, low-emission energy source.
records.description: Oman is now focusing on the development of white hydrogen, a naturally forming, low-emission energy source. A key agreement between Sohar Port and Freezone and the Swiss company Hynat will facilitate the evaluation and development of this resource, in line with Oman Vision 2040 and the National Strategy for an Orderly Transition to Net Zero. While significant technical challenges exist in subsurface estimation and extraction, academic institutions like Sultan Qaboos University are set to play a crucial role in research and development. The goal is to leverage innovations in technology, including artificial intelligence, to overcome hurdles and position Oman as a frontrunner in this emerging sector, thereby enhancing energy security and economic resilience.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a "Livestock Development" project targeting 150 farmers in 16 towns and villages northwest of Je...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched a "Livestock Development" project targeting 150 farmers in 16 towns and villages northwest of Jerusalem. The initiative, funded by the Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development and implemented by the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development in cooperation with the Joint Services Council, aims to enhance food security and support farmers' resilience. The project involves rehabilitating 150 sheep and goat pens, providing veterinary supplies and guidance, and distributing modern feeding machines. The ministry also announced additional projects for the Jerusalem Governorate in collaboration with the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development and the Bayt Mal Al-Quds Agency, all of which align with its strategy to increase local production and reduce reliance on imports.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has received a set of upgraded facilities at the As-Samu Breed Improvement Station as part of a project funde...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has received a set of upgraded facilities at the As-Samu Breed Improvement Station as part of a project funded by the European Union. This initiative, known as the "Supporting Palestinian Resilience in Area C through the Sustainable Livestock Development Program," aims to enhance the productivity of the sheep sector and promote sustainable livestock development, particularly in the southern West Bank. The new facilities, which include a bio-laboratory and a training hall, were handed over by a technical committee and representatives from the Ministry of Public Works and Housing, Al-Aseeli General Contracting and Contracting Company, and Al-Hanbali Office for Engineering Supervision and Studies. This project is a key part of the ministry's strategic plan to develop local production, reduce imports, and strengthen food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Directorate in North Hebron, in cooperation with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), held a sp...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Directorate in North Hebron, in cooperation with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), held a specialized workshop for olive press owners and farmers to discuss challenges facing the olive sector. The workshop, which is part of the ministry's preparations for the upcoming olive harvest season, focused on issues such as olive oil loss in pomace and ways to improve mill operations. Participants discussed how to reduce this loss to improve oil quality and increase farmer returns. The workshop concluded with recommendations aimed at supporting the sustainability and development of the olive press sector.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The third Agricultural Products Festival is being held in Tayma Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agricult...
records.description: The third Agricultural Products Festival is being held in Tayma Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Tabuk Region branch. The four-day event, featuring over 30 farmers and exhibitors, aims to showcase the diverse agricultural products of the Tabuk Region, including crops, palm produce, and vegetables. The festival also includes a dedicated area to introduce children to the fundamentals of agriculture and a guidance corner that promotes modern and sustainable farming techniques.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Tabuk Region branch

records.title: South Sudan has launched the One Health Strategic Plan and the 2nd National Action Plan for Health Security (2025-2030) to enhance its pr...
records.description: South Sudan has launched the One Health Strategic Plan and the 2nd National Action Plan for Health Security (2025-2030) to enhance its preparedness for public health threats. The two plans, which integrate human, animal, and environmental health, will address issues like zoonotic diseases and antimicrobial resistance. The high-level launch event in Juba included officials from multiple ministries, including the Ministry of Health, Ministry of Agriculture and Food Security, and Ministry of Environment and Forestry. The World Bank provided funding, while the World Health Organization (WHO) offered technical support for the plans' development. South Sudan was recognized for being the sixth country in the Africa Region to complete its National Action Plan for Health Security. The focus is now on implementation, with upcoming forums for resource mapping, operational planning, and progress monitoring.
records.institution: The Ministry of Livestock and Fisheries

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The General Commission for Scientific Agricultural Research has approved two new high-yielding wheat varieties for irrigated agriculture...
records.description: The General Commission for Scientific Agricultural Research has approved two new high-yielding wheat varieties for irrigated agriculture in specific governorates. These varieties are highly tolerant of environmental and disease stresses, as part of an ongoing effort to develop crops adapted to local conditions. The Commission also previously approved the "Douma 5" and "Sham 2" varieties for rainfed agriculture to combat drought. Current research is focused on developing new strains that are even more tolerant to drought and heat, and on improving water use efficiency, all in support of food security and sustainable resource management.
records.institution: General Commission for Scientific Agricultural Research

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The WWF-North Africa office is developing two policy briefs to propose reforms for agricultural practices and subsidies in Tunisia.
records.description: The WWF-North Africa office is developing two policy briefs to propose reforms for agricultural practices and subsidies in Tunisia. The briefs, which are part of the "BIODEV 2030" project, will address the revision of standards for chemical inputs and the reform of the agricultural subsidy system. The goal is to promote the sustainable use of natural resources, encourage organic inputs, and integrate ecological criteria into subsidies. According to the WWF, current practices compromise Tunisia's commitments under the Kunming-Montreal Agreement and increase pressure on biodiversity. These documents will serve as a tool for awareness-raising and advocacy among political decision-makers and key ministries to guide reforms toward a more sustainable agricultural model.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar and the EDF Group, has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Emirates Development Bank (ED...
records.description: Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar and the EDF Group, has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Emirates Development Bank (EDB) to explore developing and financing distributed solar projects in the UAE. Under the agreement, Emerge will identify potential renewable energy projects for EDB to evaluate and offer tailored financing solutions. The partnership aims to support the UAE's energy transition and strengthen industrial growth by helping commercial and industrial businesses, including small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), to lower costs and achieve their clean energy goals.

records.title: Edita Food Industries, an Egyptian packaged snack producer, reported a strong second quarter with net profit surging 72.1% to EGP 539 mil...
records.description: Edita Food Industries, an Egyptian packaged snack producer, reported a strong second quarter with net profit surging 72.1% to EGP 539 million, while revenues reached a record EGP 5 billion. This performance was fueled by a notable recovery in sales volume, with cakes, bakery, and rusks leading the growth. The company’s net export sales climbed 47.7%, and its subsidiary, Edita Morocco, also posted significant growth. As part of its expansion strategy, the company is preparing to launch bakery operations in Baghdad, Iraq.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued an important alert for beekeepers in light of a forecast for extreme heat, advising them to take s...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued an important alert for beekeepers in light of a forecast for extreme heat, advising them to take several preventive measures to protect bee colonies. Recommended actions include effectively shading hives with canopies or insulators, providing clean and nearby water sources, and enhancing ventilation by opening hive entrances. Beekeepers are also advised to monitor food supplies, avoid opening hives unless absolutely necessary to maintain internal humidity, and clear the apiary surroundings of dry weeds and flammable materials to prevent fires. These steps are crucial for reducing potential losses and ensuring the health of bee colonies during harsh climatic conditions.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's North Lebanon Agriculture Department, through the Batroun Agricultural Center, and in cooperation with the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's North Lebanon Agriculture Department, through the Batroun Agricultural Center, and in cooperation with the Hamat Municipality, held an advisory lecture on "Quality Standards in Olive Oil." The lecture, which was part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, focused on the scientific and technical standards for producing high-quality olive oil and the importance of good agricultural practices to improve production and local product competitiveness. The meeting, which saw a strong turnout from the local community, is the first step in a new partnership between the Ministry and the municipality to support sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: Oman is revitalizing its olive sector, particularly in the Al Jabal Al Akhdhar and Western Hajar mountain ranges, as part of a national v...
records.description: Oman is revitalizing its olive sector, particularly in the Al Jabal Al Akhdhar and Western Hajar mountain ranges, as part of a national vision for food security. With government support, including the distribution of free saplings and the establishment of modern olive mills, the number of olive trees has increased to 20,000. The country's production reached over 83 tonnes of olives and 10,000 liters of olive oil in 2022, but this still falls short of the high demand. To further boost output, research from the College of Agricultural and Marine Sciences is identifying ideal cultivation areas and promoting best practices, while new efforts are being made to transform by-products like olive leaves into value-added products.
records.institution: College of Agricultural and Marine Sciences

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, with funding from the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), has completed the rehabilitation of three...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, with funding from the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), has completed the rehabilitation of three water tanks in the town of Tammun. Each tank has a capacity of 500 cubic meters. The project was implemented through the Tubas Agriculture Directorate in partnership with the Tubas Chamber of Commerce, Industry and Agriculture, and in cooperation with the Tammun Municipality. As part of the "Urgent Support for Women's Projects" program, this initiative aims to improve water infrastructure and enhance water access to agricultural lands, thereby supporting sustainable agricultural production for farmers in the Tubas Governorate and the Northern Jordan Valley.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The annual prickly pear season in the Aseer region, where the fruit is known as "Al-Barshumi," is a significant seasonal event that blend...
records.description: The annual prickly pear season in the Aseer region, where the fruit is known as "Al-Barshumi," is a significant seasonal event that blends nutritional value with tourism appeal. The season revitalizes local markets, with visitors and vacationers purchasing the fruit in its various colors, from green and yellow to red. According to a researcher from the National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa), the prickly pear is a nutrient-dense cactus fruit rich in fiber, vitamin C, and essential minerals like potassium and calcium. Its consumption is linked to several health benefits, including improved digestive health, boosted immunity, and the regulation of blood sugar and blood pressure.
records.institution: National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa)

records.title: The Madinah Regional Municipality is organizing the first-ever grape festival in the Al-Hanakiyah Governorate to promote local agricultur...
records.description: The Madinah Regional Municipality is organizing the first-ever grape festival in the Al-Hanakiyah Governorate to promote local agricultural products, support productive families, and enhance handicrafts. The five-day event, to be held at the Al-Nakheel Center, will feature an exhibition of grape varieties, traditional and artistic performances, and children's activities. The festival aims to revive Al-Nakheel’s agricultural heritage, market local products, and encourage investment in farming, in alignment with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.

records.title: Dragon fruit from the Balangir district of Odisha has been exported to Dubai, UAE for the second consecutive year, reflecting the state’s...
records.description: Dragon fruit from the Balangir district of Odisha has been exported to Dubai, UAE for the second consecutive year, reflecting the state’s growing agri-horticulture export sector. The 330 kg shipment was sold at a 20% higher price compared to the previous year, highlighting increased demand and market access for farmers. This export was facilitated under the Promotion and Stabilization of Farmer-Producer Organizations (PSFPO) project, implemented by Palladium with support from the Gates Foundation, and received marketing support from the Agricultural and Processed Food Products Export Development Authority (APEDA). The initiative is part of a broader effort by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers' Empowerment (DA&FE) to empower local farmers and integrate them into competitive global markets.

records.title: Prices for meat and seafood in Egypt have stabilized following a government meeting to ensure a steady supply of red meat.
records.description: Prices for meat and seafood in Egypt have stabilized following a government meeting to ensure a steady supply of red meat. The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation has detailed plans to expand slaughterhouses and authorized quarries, and is also using fixed and mobile outlets to sell products at reduced prices. These efforts, which include the use of temporary "one-day" markets, are in line with the President's directives to maintain sufficient stocks of essential goods. The gross production value of Egypt’s meat market is projected to grow from US$9.73 billion in 2025 to US$10.82 billion by 2029, even though imports are still forecast to be worth US$121.9 million in 2025, reflecting a continued reliance on foreign supplies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Ismailia Governorate is a major hub for mango cultivation in Egypt, serving as the country's leading producer with an annual yield of...
records.description: The Ismailia Governorate is a major hub for mango cultivation in Egypt, serving as the country's leading producer with an annual yield of up to 720,000 tons. The governorate's 120,000 acres of mango farms account for 36% of the national total and contribute 40% of Egypt's mango exports to over 50 countries. To celebrate the harvest season and promote the crop, the third annual Ismailia Mango Festival was recently held. The event aims to attract foreign investment through export agreements and boost agricultural tourism by offering activities like mango harvesting.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Electricity and Renewable Energy met with AMEA Power to discuss expanding renewable energy and battery storage projects i...
records.description: The Ministry of Electricity and Renewable Energy met with AMEA Power to discuss expanding renewable energy and battery storage projects in Egypt, with a focus on establishing the country's first stand-alone energy storage plants. These plants are designed to optimize the use of renewable energy and enhance grid stability, particularly during peak demand. The initiative aligns with the Ministry's strategy to increase the share of clean energy to 42% by 2030 and 65% by 2040. Projects discussed included the Abydos 2 solar and Amont 2 wind power projects, as well as two stand-alone energy storage stations in the Aswan and Red Sea Governorates with a combined capacity of 1,500 MWh. AMEA Power already manages a functioning 300 MWh storage station in Aswan, and the private sector is highlighted as a vital partner in these projects.
records.institution: The Ministry of Electricity and Renewable Energy

records.title: In Karbala, five major food industry projects, operated by Etihad Food Industries and valued at $2 billion, have been inaugurated.
records.description: In Karbala, five major food industry projects, operated by Etihad Food Industries and valued at $2 billion, have been inaugurated. The initiatives, which focus on meat production, dairy, and fish farming, are aimed at supporting local market needs and achieving greater food safety and self-sufficiency. The projects include a dairy factory with a daily capacity of 3,000 tonnes, a meat production facility capable of processing 1,500 cattle daily, a dairy cattle farm housing 195,000 cows, and a fish farming project producing 300 tonnes of fresh fish daily. The government praised the company as a key private sector partner for national development and emphasized the importance of a supportive investment climate in Iraq

records.title: The Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) has implemented a series of measures to strengthen food security and agricultural resilience.
records.description: The Kurdistan Regional Government (KRG) has implemented a series of measures to strengthen food security and agricultural resilience. This includes a significant increase in the budget allocated to the agricultural sector, which has facilitated the establishment of 30,000 plastic greenhouses and 319 cold storage facilities. In terms of infrastructure, the KRG has completed three modern grain silos and is constructing additional storage facilities to achieve a total wheat storage capacity of 200,000 tonnes. These efforts have also supported business growth, with the registration of over 11,000 companies and the formal export of agricultural products for the first time. The KRG remains committed to supporting local production and reducing dependency on imports.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has signed a cooperation agreement with Al Baraka Islamic Insurance Company to launch the first commercial ag...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has signed a cooperation agreement with Al Baraka Islamic Insurance Company to launch the first commercial agricultural insurance products in the Palestinian market. This initiative is part of the "Building Palestinian Agricultural Insurance Systems and Services" project, which is funded by the European Union and implemented by Oxfam and the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development. The Palestinian Capital Market Authority is also a partner in the project, which will provide a subsidy of up to 60% of the insurance policy's value. The pilot phase will cover farmers of greenhouse tomatoes, open-field grapes, and poultry in closed systems, with the goal of protecting them from risks, stimulating agricultural investment, and enhancing national food security by strengthening public and private sector partnerships.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Fourth Fruit Festival has opened in Tabarjal Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in...
records.description: The Fourth Fruit Festival has opened in Tabarjal Governorate, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region. The event brings together 30 local farmers and 20 families from the cottage industry to showcase agricultural products, handcrafted goods, and fruit processing industries. In addition to commercial pavilions, the festival offers cultural activities, including visual arts, theatrical performances, and a children's art studio. The primary objective of the festival is to support local farmers, promote their products, and establish new marketing channels.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region

records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM Food Company Topian, has l...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), in partnership with NEOM Food Company Topian, has launched the second edition of a greenhouse management training program to enhance the skills of national cadres. The program aims to equip participants with advanced expertise in modern technologies such as smart irrigation, crop monitoring systems, and energy-saving solutions. Trainees will receive hands-on experience under the guidance of experts to prepare them for managing climate-controlled greenhouses and addressing key agricultural challenges like water scarcity and soil health. This initiative is part of Estidamah's commitment to supporting agricultural innovation and aligns with the objectives of the National Agriculture Strategy to improve production efficiency and preserve natural resources.
records.institution: National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.title: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), is a key driver in the...
records.description: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), is a key driver in the food and agriculture sector, with a strategic focus on food sustainability and diversifying supply sources. Since its establishment, SALIC has pursued a long-term investment strategy, resulting in a diversified international portfolio of 13 projects across seven countries. The company's managed assets have increased to over SAR27 billion, reflecting its successful approach of balancing economic returns with a commitment to food security. Through its global investments, SALIC has access to more than 20 million tons of strategic commodities, strengthening the Kingdom's ability to respond to emergencies and achieve its development goals.
records.institution: The Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC)

records.title: The second phase of the Building the Resilience of Local Rural CommunitieThe Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), in collaboration wi...
records.description: The second phase of the Building the Resilience of Local Rural CommunitieThe Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, launched the second phase of the Building Local Resilience in Syria (BLRS) project in a workshop held in Damascus. The workshop served to review the achievements of the first phase of the project, which is a key initiative to help Syrians feed themselves and reduce reliance on emergency aid. According to the Ministry of Agriculture, this next phase is a crucial step in building the capacity of farmers to address the challenges facing the agricultural sector, particularly in light of the drought affecting the country.s in Syria (BLRS) project was launched during a workshop organized by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture in Damascus. The workshop reviewed the most important results achieved by the project in its first phase, followed by the launch of the second phase

records.title: The Tunisian Grains Board has purchased 75,000 tons of soft wheat following a tender for 100,000 tons.
records.description: The Tunisian Grains Board has purchased 75,000 tons of soft wheat following a tender for 100,000 tons. The purchase was made on a C&F basis, with the winning bids going to Dreyfus and Ray. A total of sixteen companies participated in the tender, with the purchased wheat set for delivery between September and October.

records.title: In Al-Bayda Province, a preliminary survey for a veterinary campaign targeting cattle and goats has been launched by 11 field teams from...
records.description: In Al-Bayda Province, a preliminary survey for a veterinary campaign targeting cattle and goats has been launched by 11 field teams from the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries. The ten-day survey aims to detect and treat livestock diseases by collecting samples for diagnostic tests, which will help identify the appropriate vaccines and preventive measures needed. The campaign is intended to protect this vital resource and contribute to its development, and local authorities have been urged to cooperate with the teams to ensure their success.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.title: Al Dahra Agriculture has successfully completed the first river shipment of 750 tons of urea fertilizer, in cooperation with Misr Fertili...
records.description: Al Dahra Agriculture has successfully completed the first river shipment of 750 tons of urea fertilizer, in cooperation with Misr Fertilizers Production Company (MOPCO). The fertilizer was transported from Damietta Port to Upper Egypt via a river unit operated by the National Nile Company for River Transportation. This initiative supports the Ministry of Transport's directive to activate the Nile as a safe, efficient, and cost-effective logistics corridor for multimodal transport. The project, which also involved the Damietta Port Authority, aims to support farmers, meet local market demand, ease pressure on roads, and advance environmentally friendly transport as part of a national sustainable-development plan.

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: Egypt is launching a new project in the Beni Suef Governorate to convert agricultural and animal waste into biogas.
records.description: Egypt is launching a new project in the Beni Suef Governorate to convert agricultural and animal waste into biogas. This initiative is a collaboration between the Biogas Energy Foundation for Sustainable Development, the Ministry of Environment, and the United Nations Industrial Development Organisation (UNIDO), with preparation being done in partnership with Eni. The project will involve a plant with a daily capacity of 5,000 cubic meters of biogas and will process 134 tons of animal waste. This effort is part of Egypt's wider strategy to expand biogas technology to ensure the safe disposal of organic waste and produce clean energy and organic fertilizer.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, is actively working to develop cotton cultivation by implement...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, is actively working to develop cotton cultivation by implementing a breeding and improvement program at the Abu Ghraib Research Station. This initiative includes cultivating approved and promising new varieties to enhance local production and support the industrial sector. As part of this effort, a ginning plant, used to separate cotton fibers from seeds for research purposes, has been maintained and rehabilitated, making it operational for the first time since 2003.

records.title: Dhofar Foods & Investment (DFI), a key player in Oman's food security efforts, will participate in a Food Safety Exhibition in Salalah.
records.description: Dhofar Foods & Investment (DFI), a key player in Oman's food security efforts, will participate in a Food Safety Exhibition in Salalah. The company's presence at the event, which is part of its year-long "Rooted in Oman. Nurturing the Future" campaign, aims to highlight its role in advancing the nation's journey toward self-sufficiency and sustainable development in line with Oman Vision 2040. DFI will showcase its vertically integrated model across various sectors, including dairy, beverages, and agriculture, through an interactive exhibition space. The company's participation also serves to emphasize the Dhofar Governorate's growing importance as a strategic food production hub, with the goal of enhancing local value creation, supporting job opportunities, and reducing import dependence.

records.title: Oman's agricultural sector is undergoing a transformation toward innovation and technology, in line with Oman Vision 2040, to enhance foo...
records.description: Oman's agricultural sector is undergoing a transformation toward innovation and technology, in line with Oman Vision 2040, to enhance food security and sustainability. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources is leading this effort by providing financial and technical support to innovative projects and collaborating with research centers and international organizations like the Arab Organisation for Agricultural Development (AOAD) and the Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO). The government has also enacted legislation to support agricultural startups, including tax exemptions and customs waivers on modern technologies. This focus on innovation is demonstrated by a research study from Sultan Qaboos University on the antifungal properties of the local Harmal plant and by new products from innovators, such as the organic pesticides from the company AZDARA and the smart soil analysis device from the University of Technology and Applied Sciences in Ibri. These collective efforts aim to promote sustainable practices, reduce chemical usage, and transform the food system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture held a workshop to begin developing a national animal health strategy aimed at governing and advancing the li...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture held a workshop to begin developing a national animal health strategy aimed at governing and advancing the livestock sector. The event was attended by representatives from the Ministry and the European Union. Experts from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) also participated, presenting on the methodology for creating the strategy based on national priorities and international standards. The Ministry confirmed that further expanded meetings with partners and stakeholders will be held to finalize the strategy, which is intended to enhance food security, animal health, and public health.

records.title: Farms in Saudi Arabia's Aseer Region have become a leading model for sustainable agricultural tourism, drawing visitors to its mountainou...
records.description: Farms in Saudi Arabia's Aseer Region have become a leading model for sustainable agricultural tourism, drawing visitors to its mountainous highlands. The region's farmers have transformed their agricultural holdings, known for a variety of crops, honey, and roses, into tourist destinations offering immersive experiences in nature and farming techniques. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Aseer highlights the region's prominent role, noting that it has over 159,000 agricultural holdings, is the top national honey producer, and contributes 14% of the Kingdom's fruit production. With 40 tourist farms, including the country's largest rose farm, Aseer is positioning itself as a major rural tourism destination that blends nature and heritage.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Aseer

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Arab Center for the Study of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), organized a trainin...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Arab Center for the Study of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD), organized a training course on "Feed Production Management" at ACSAD's headquarters in Damascus. The four-day course covered the nutritional values of feed, laboratory analysis, and the feed requirements of ruminants. The Ministry emphasized the importance of guiding farmers on proper feed production methods and encouraging the cultivation of fodder crops to support livestock sustainability and enhance their productivity.

records.title: The Ministry of Economy and Industry in Syria issued a decision to suspend the import of refined white sugar originating from India, with...
records.description: The Ministry of Economy and Industry in Syria issued a decision to suspend the import of refined white sugar originating from India, with the aim of protecting local production and regulating the domestic sugar market.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Industry

records.title: An activation workshop was held in Yemen's Dhamar province for directors of agriculture branches, organized by the governorate’s Agricult...
records.description: An activation workshop was held in Yemen's Dhamar province for directors of agriculture branches, organized by the governorate’s Agriculture Sector and funded by the Executive Unit for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing. The workshop focused on preparing for the second phase of the Grain and Legumes Expansion Project and intensifying oversight of pesticide and fertilizer sales, with a specific emphasis on smuggled or banned products. The event highlighted the importance of enhancing agricultural production and achieving food security by leveraging available facilitations like contract farming and loans provided through agricultural cooperatives. Discussions also covered mechanisms for monitoring and licensing vendors and strengthening the role of cooperatives in supporting the resilient community economy.
records.institution: Executive Unit for Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing

records.title: The General Authority for the Development of Small and Micro Enterprises implemented numerous projects in the first half of a given year...
records.description: The General Authority for the Development of Small and Micro Enterprises implemented numerous projects in the first half of a given year to create sustainable jobs, support local production, and empower communities. The initiatives, which are aligned with priorities set by the National Committee for Economic Empowerment, focused on six key value chains: dairy, sesame, palm, cotton, leather, and fish. Key achievements included providing interest-free loans and in-kind support for farmers and fishermen, often in partnership with the General Authority for Zakat and local associations. The Authority also established several revolving lending portfolios in various governorates, implemented training and capacity-building programs, and conducted research to design targeted interventions.
records.institution: General Authority for the Development of Small and Micro Enterprises

records.title: Egypt’s Agricultural Research Center (ARC) has engaged in discussions with a high-level delegation from China’s Northeast Institute of Ge...
records.description: Egypt’s Agricultural Research Center (ARC) has engaged in discussions with a high-level delegation from China’s Northeast Institute of Geography and Agroecology to expand cooperation. The talks focused on joint research in climate-resilient crops and sustainable agriculture, with specific attention given to hybrid rice, drought-tolerant crops, and remote sensing technologies. This collaboration is aimed at boosting Egypt’s food security and reducing reliance on imports of strategic crops. The Chinese delegation expressed interest in formalizing the partnership through a memorandum of understanding, underscoring the commitment from both sides to strengthen scientific cooperation for sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: Oman is adopting smart agriculture to address environmental challenges and ensure food security.
records.description: Oman is adopting smart agriculture to address environmental challenges and ensure food security. This strategy, also known as precision farming, uses technologies like IoT sensors, drones, and AI-powered analytics to improve efficiency and reduce waste. Pilot projects, led by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, are implementing methods such as hydroponics and aquaponics in greenhouses. The country is also focusing on developing human capital through initiatives like the Agriculture Innovation Centre to train a new generation of "agripreneurs" with the necessary digital skills. This move toward smart agriculture aligns with the national strategic plan.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Wadi Qafeefah dam is successfully supporting agriculture in the drought-hit Ibra region.
records.description: The Wadi Qafeefah dam is successfully supporting agriculture in the drought-hit Ibra region. The dam, which is 122 meters long and 24.3 meters high, has a storage capacity of up to 926,520 cubic meters of water. This water is helping to replenish groundwater, recharge traditional irrigation systems known as aflaj, and ultimately boost crop fertility. The region's agricultural output includes local produce like mangoes, dates, lemons, and bananas. The dam also contributes to the local ecosystem by providing habitats for wildlife and supporting indigenous flora.

records.title: Saudi Arabia's annual cantaloupe production exceeds 63,100 tons, with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture attributing this...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's annual cantaloupe production exceeds 63,100 tons, with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture attributing this high volume to the adoption of modern farming technologies. These advancements have not only increased production and improved the quality of various cantaloupe varieties but have also boosted farmers' incomes. This strategic focus on agricultural technology is part of the ministry's broader effort to enhance the Kingdom's food security and support the sustainability of the agricultural sector. The main cantaloupe-producing regions are identified as Riyadh, Qassim, Madinah, Hail, and Najran.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Arabia's melon production has reached over 63,100 tons this summer, a result of the use of modern farming technologies.
records.description: Saudi Arabia's melon production has reached over 63,100 tons this summer, a result of the use of modern farming technologies. According to the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, these advancements have boosted production, improved crop quality, and increased farmers' incomes, all of which contribute to the nation's food security. The ministry continues to support domestic agriculture through various programs that provide production resources, training on modern practices, and financial assistance.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.description: The Buraidah Dates Carnival, organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture under the supervision of the Principality of Qassim Region, is underway to highlight the economic and cultural importance of palm trees. The event, held in the Qassim Region, offers a fertile environment for business and numerous investment opportunities for entrepreneurs in date-related services such as buying, selling, storing, packaging, and delivery. This initiative aims to stimulate and expand the region's palm-based economy while preserving its authentic heritage.

records.title: Egyptian agricultural exports have reached a total volume of about 6.5 million tons, representing an increase of more than 600,000 tons c...
records.description: Egyptian agricultural exports have reached a total volume of about 6.5 million tons, representing an increase of more than 600,000 tons compared to the previous year. According to an official report from the Central Administration of Agricultural Quarantine, citrus fruits topped the export list with over 1.9 million tons, followed by fresh potatoes, fresh onions, and beans. The increase in exports, as highlighted by the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, reflects a significant performance in the country's agricultural sector and its efforts to enhance global competitiveness.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Upper Egypt Flour Mills (UEFM), a key player in Egypt's milling sector, reported an increase in its annual standalone net profit to US$4....
records.description: Upper Egypt Flour Mills (UEFM), a key player in Egypt's milling sector, reported an increase in its annual standalone net profit to US$4.67 million, up from US$3.91 million in the previous fiscal year. However, the company experienced a decline in its nine-month consolidated earnings, with a net profit of US$3.85 million, suggesting challenges in its subsidiary operations. Listed on the Egyptian Exchange, the company specializes in processing wheat, producing bread, and exporting grain-based products. Through its subsidiary, Wadi Al-Muluk Milling Company, it also manufactures various food products and builds grain storage silos, which support Egypt's food security infrastructure.

records.title: The President of the Nouakchott Region oversaw the launch of a tree-planting campaign in the Samia neighborhood of the Mina district as p...
records.description: The President of the Nouakchott Region oversaw the launch of a tree-planting campaign in the Samia neighborhood of the Mina district as part of the National Tree Week activities. The campaign aims to improve the urban appearance of the capital and increase green spaces, contributing to a healthy and sustainable environment. Residents were called upon to actively participate in caring for the newly planted trees.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, has carried out a field activity as part of the Green...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, has carried out a field activity as part of the Greening Palestine project. This initiative provided fencing, irrigation networks, and agricultural seedlings to 16 model plots covering an area of 56 dunums. The project aims to promote sustainable agriculture by giving farmers the necessary infrastructure and inputs to enhance land use efficiency, improve production quality, and increase economic returns. The distribution of fencing protects lands from encroachment, while the irrigation networks and seedlings contribute to reducing water loss, aligning with the ministry's broader policies to achieve food and water security in the Jenin Governorate.

records.title: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry (MoCI) in Qatar has announced a public tender for the supply of 2.4 million bags of barley to suppo...
records.description: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry (MoCI) in Qatar has announced a public tender for the supply of 2.4 million bags of barley to support the country's livestock industry. The tender, managed by the Ministry's Tenders and Auctions Committee, aims to ensure an uninterrupted supply of fodder and contribute to food security and rural development. This initiative, which aligns with Qatar National Vision 2030, is also expected to stimulate the private sector by creating opportunities for local and international suppliers. The Ministry of Municipality is also actively supporting the agricultural sector with various initiatives aimed at encouraging farming.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce and Industry (MoCI)

records.title: The quantity of cereals collected in Siliana reached 1.57 million quintals at the end of the agricultural campaign.
records.description: The quantity of cereals collected in Siliana reached 1.57 million quintals at the end of the agricultural campaign. This production is comprised of durum wheat, soft wheat, barley, and triticale. A portion of the harvest, 690,000 quintals, has already been stored, and a bonus for the rapid delivery of grain to collection centers is still being offered by the regional agricultural commission.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in a specialized workshop on measuring the maturity of e-government and mobile services.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in a specialized workshop on measuring the maturity of e-government and mobile services. The workshop was organized by the General Authority for Statistics and Geographic Information Systems in cooperation with the Economic and Social Commission for Western Asia (ESCWA). The event provided detailed guidance on completing maturity forms and the standards for ensuring accurate information. This participation is part of the government's broader efforts to follow up on directives for assessing service maturity, thereby enhancing the quality and efficiency of services provided to citizens and improving overall institutional performance.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, with the approval of the Cabinet, will soon establish a subsidy for local factories to encourage them to pur...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, with the approval of the Cabinet, will soon establish a subsidy for local factories to encourage them to purchase greater quantities of locally grown tomatoes. This measure is a response to challenges faced by tomato farmers, such as overproduction and falling prices, which lead to financial losses. By supporting local tomato processing, the ministry aims to absorb surplus production, provide farmers with a sustainable market, and stabilize their income. This decision is part of the government's broader strategy to enhance national food security by supporting production and promoting local food processing. The value of the subsidy per ton and the payment mechanism will be determined in coordination with relevant authorities to ensure transparency and fairness.

records.description: The Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation has signed a legal status agreement with the Global Green Growth Institute (GGGI), allowing the institute to open an official office in Jordan. This collaboration aims to provide technical and institutional support to the government to develop policies and projects that align with the nation's environmental and economic priorities. records.title: The Kingdom of Morocco has launched a comprehensive waste recovery plan with a budget of 1.88 billion dirhams, aimed at transforming envi...
records.description: The Kingdom of Morocco has launched a comprehensive waste recovery plan with a budget of 1.88 billion dirhams, aimed at transforming environmental challenges into economic opportunities. The plan, which is coordinated by the Ministries of Energy Transition and Interior and Morocco's 12 regional governments, focuses on overhauling the waste sector by building new infrastructure, closing unregulated landfills, and promoting professional domestic waste collection. Building on a previous strategy, the new plan targets key areas like energy recovery in cooperation with the cement industry, the management of hazardous waste, and the expansion of recycling initiatives. The initiative is also expected to create green jobs by integrating informal waste pickers into formal recycling networks, aligning Morocco's efforts with global sustainability commitments.
records.institution: The Ministry for Energy Transition and Sustainable Development

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and its German counterparts met to enhance cooperation in agricultural research and plant protect...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and its German counterparts met to enhance cooperation in agricultural research and plant protection, following up on a meeting at the World Food Conference in Berlin. Representatives from the National Center for Agricultural Research and the General Administration of Plant Protection and Quarantine on the Palestinian side, along with the German JKI Center and the GIZ Foundation, participated in the discussions. Both sides gave presentations on their research and work, and the meeting concluded with an agreement on specific areas of cooperation and plans to draft a memorandum of understanding to formalize bilateral work.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) have concluded the "Land Resilienc...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) have concluded the "Land Resilience and Natural Resources Management" (RELAP) project, which was valued at approximately $7.8 million. The project is considered a successful partnership that supported over 4,300 farmers, reclaimed and rehabilitated thousands of dunums of land, and provided significant water resources. It also included key initiatives to empower rural women, improve marketing through grants and training, and rehabilitate agricultural roads. The ministry views the project's results as a strong foundation for future agricultural development projects aimed at promoting agricultural sustainability and supporting vulnerable rural communities.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture has received the final shipment of veterinary vaccines, part of a grant from the Food and Agricul...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture has received the final shipment of veterinary vaccines, part of a grant from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), valued at approximately 4.3 million shekels. This latest batch included over a million doses of vaccines for small ruminant plague and sheep pox. The full grant will provide a wide range of vaccines for livestock, which the Ministry will use to implement preventive vaccination programs across all governorates until the end of the first quarter of next year. The initiative is a crucial part of the Ministry’s national strategy to control the spread of animal diseases, reduce economic losses for breeders, and enhance food security in Palestine.

records.title: Sawani, a camel dairy company owned by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), has launched a state-of-the-art model farm and production facili...
records.description: Sawani, a camel dairy company owned by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), has launched a state-of-the-art model farm and production facility in collaboration with German company GEA. The facility can house over 10,000 camels and produce up to 500,000 liters of milk per month, with a focus on advanced technologies and high standards of food safety. Sawani has also introduced a line of long-life camel milk products under its NOUG brand, which are being distributed across Saudi Arabia and to international markets. The company's strategy includes developing high-yield camel breeds and building a sustainable production ecosystem to enhance productivity, thereby reinforcing Saudi Arabia's position in the global camel milk sector.

records.description: The fourth Fruit Festival in Tabarjal Governorate will be held at Prince Nawaf bin Abdulaziz Park, organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Al-Jouf branch. The event aims to support farmers, showcase their products, and create new marketing opportunities, featuring 30 farmers and 20 families from the cottage industry. In addition to exhibitions and pavilions for agricultural products, the festival will include a variety of activities such as handicrafts, folk heritage exhibits, fine arts, a children's theater, food trucks, and agricultural workshops, with the participation of government, private, and non-profit entities.

The training will provide farmers with specialized courses in areas such as sustainable agricultural program design, management, marketing, integrated pest management, and veterinary practices. This program is a reflection of Saudi Arabia's ongoing efforts to improve food security and livelihoods for vulnerable populations in Yemen.

records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch office in Qatif Governorate has launched a five-day mangrove honey event to highlight sustainable agricultural and environmental initiatives. The event, now in its fifth edition, is part of the ministry's efforts to support national agricultural value chains and empower productive beekeepers. It aims to balance environmental preservation with economic growth by showcasing the unique value of the region’s mangrove honey and related processing industries. This year’s event has already revealed a production volume exceeding 20 tons of mangrove honey, underscoring the success of local beekeepers and the role of young Saudi entrepreneurs in developing this product.

records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) is implementing an integrated project to produce organic agricultural fertilizer from palm waste, ai...
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) is implementing an integrated project to produce organic agricultural fertilizer from palm waste, aiming to enhance soil fertility and improve agricultural productivity. The initiative has already recycled over 50,000 cubic meters of organic waste into high-quality fertilizer, which has been distributed to more than 1,300 farmers and used to rehabilitate over 3,000 hectares of degraded farmland. This project has also led to significant environmental and economic benefits, including a 30% reduction in chemical fertilizer use and the sequestration of carbon dioxide. As part of its community outreach, the RCU has provided training programs to more than 240 farmers and students, underscoring its commitment to long-term sustainability and food security in the region.

records.description: A memorandum of understanding has been signed between the Algerian Ministry of Energy, Mines and Renewable Energies and the Sonarem group and the Pakistani Fatima Group. The collaboration aims to promote the manufacture of phosphate fertilizers and strengthen related value chains in both countries. It also seeks to explore joint investment opportunities in industrial projects for the Algerian, Pakistani, and international markets, reinforcing efforts to promote investment in the mining sector and enhance food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy, Mines and Renewable Energies

records.description: The General Company for Silos and Storage (GSSC), a major player in Egypt’s agri-logistics sector, has reported strong unaudited financial results, with a net profit of EGP 271.594 million, marking a 31.83% increase from the previous year. The company’s shares also saw a significant rise on the Egyptian Exchange. Despite this strong performance, the company has issued a cautious outlook for the upcoming fiscal year, projecting a profit decline of 37.9% due to expected market volatility and foreign exchange fluctuations. However, with its extensive operations and strategic presence in key port cities such as Alexandria, Damietta, Suez, and Port Said, the company is well positioned to maintain its leadership in grain handling and storage.
records.institution: General Company for Silos and Storage (GSSC)

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture – through its Baalbek-Hermel Agriculture Department and the Nabi Othman Agricultural Center – organized a guidance seminar in Fakiha on the challenges of climate change. The seminar, held in cooperation with the Federation of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, and Agriculture in Lebanon and sponsored by the New Fakiha Municipality, brought together farmers and agricultural experts. Discussions focused on the impacts of climate change on the agricultural sector in the Bekaa Valley and strategies for adaptation. Key topics included the adoption of modern irrigation techniques, improved water management, and the selection of drought-resistant crops. The event concluded with recommendations to intensify guidance seminars, enhance technical support from the Ministry of Agriculture, and encourage registration in the agricultural registry to ensure farmers receive necessary support and services.

records.title: OCP Group, a state-backed phosphate company in Morocco, is ramping up its production of Triple Superphosphate (TSP) fertilizer to meet in...
records.description: OCP Group, a state-backed phosphate company in Morocco, is ramping up its production of Triple Superphosphate (TSP) fertilizer to meet increasing global demand. This expansion is part of a broader strategy, which includes the Mzinda-Meskala strategic program (SP2M), to increase total fertilizer capacity and integrate renewable energy and desalinated water. The initiative is designed to provide tailored, high-performance fertilizers for sustainable agriculture globally, leveraging Morocco's leading position in world phosphate reserves.

It will achieve this by facilitating fishing operations, increasing productivity, creating job opportunities, and mitigating the effects of storms and cyclones. The project is also expected to improve boat efficiency, ease navigation, and prevent sinking.

records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched two new dam projects in North Sharqiyah, Oman, with a combined cost of more than RO116,000. The projects, which include a surface storage dam in Al Rashbi village and a groundwater recharge dam in Quraisha village, are designed to improve groundwater levels and manage rainwater. These dams will help to regulate natural water flow, reduce flood risks, and support agricultural development by ensuring water availability and contributing to an expansion of green cover in the region. The initiatives are part of the ministry's broader efforts to manage water resources across Oman.

records.title: The 10th local Dates festival in Doha, organized by the Ministry of Municipality (MoM) and Souq Waqif, is concluding after a successful run.

According to organizers, the event has attracted more than 78,300 visitors and achieved significant sales, with a total of 150,863 kilograms of dates sold. The festival showcased produce from 114 local farms, featuring popular varieties such as Khalas, Shishi, Khunaizi, and Barhi. In addition to dates, 1,858 kilograms of other fruits were also sold.

records.title: Acwa Power has awarded a contract to a consortium of Tecnicas Reunidas and Sinopec Guangzhou Engineering to provide Front-End Engineering...
records.description: Acwa Power has awarded a contract to a consortium of Tecnicas Reunidas and Sinopec Guangzhou Engineering to provide Front-End Engineering Design (FEED) services for the Yanbu Green Hydrogen Project in Saudi Arabia. The project, which is a key part of Saudi Arabia's energy transition, will design a facility to produce 400,000 tonnes of green hydrogen annually. This hydrogen will then be converted into green ammonia for export to international markets. The project, located in Yanbu Industrial City, aims to utilize a total of 10 GW of wind and solar power and will contribute to the decarbonization of hard-to-abate sectors.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Aseer branch has launched the "Ambassadors of Agriculture" initiative to highlight t...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Aseer branch has launched the "Ambassadors of Agriculture" initiative to highlight the region's agricultural potential and support the local sector. The program engages volunteers and tourism media enthusiasts through field visits to farms, livestock breeders, and beekeepers. Coinciding with the "Aseer Summer" events, the initiative began with an introductory workshop and visits to coffee farms near Abha, where participants learned about traditional farming practices. Through this effort, the ministry aims to enhance community involvement in agricultural development and rural tourism while promoting a culture of volunteerism.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's office in Rabigh Governorate and the Energy and Water Academy have signed a memorand...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's office in Rabigh Governorate and the Energy and Water Academy have signed a memorandum of understanding to train and upskill beneficiaries of the ministry’s services in the agricultural and environmental sectors. The agreement aims to enhance the skills of national workers to better meet job market demands by collaborating on volunteer initiatives, participating in agricultural events, and providing specialized training programs. This partnership is designed to foster sustainable development and build human capacity, aligning with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Egypt's Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation met with the Dutch Ambassador to review progress on joint water initiatives and discus...
records.description: Egypt's Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation met with the Dutch Ambassador to review progress on joint water initiatives and discuss future cooperation. The discussions focused on a project to modernize irrigation technologies for small-scale farmers in Upper Egypt, which is a partnership with the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and is funded by the Dutch government. The Minister emphasized the importance of educating farmers on the benefits of these systems. Officials also addressed plans to sign a memorandum of understanding with the Dutch organization Invest International for a feasibility study on using eco-friendly techniques for coastal protection along Egypt's Mediterranean coast. Furthermore, they discussed renewing the MoU for the Egyptian-Dutch High Committee on Water and making preparations to mark the 50th anniversary of the Egyptian-Dutch Advisory Panel on Water Management during the upcoming 8th Cairo Water Week.
