The EIIG is a holding company that has interests in various sectors, including steel, cement, and media, and also holds a stake in Beltone Financial Holding.

records.title: Uganda and Egypt have agreed on a new cooperation framework to boost investment, capacity building, and the development of water resource...
records.description: Uganda and Egypt have agreed on a new cooperation framework to boost investment, capacity building, and the development of water resources, following their Second Round of Bilateral Consultations. The framework will facilitate the localization of some Egyptian industries in Uganda, with a focus on vaccines and other pharmaceutical products. The two countries also plan to implement several joint projects along the Nile basin, including dam construction, groundwater harvesting, and mechanized irrigation. The Egyptian Minister of Foreign Affairs affirmed his country's readiness to enhance cooperation with Uganda in a number of fields, including agriculture and energy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture announced that fig farmers in Babil Governorate welcomed the decision to halt fig imports for a month, coinci...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture announced that fig farmers in Babil Governorate welcomed the decision to halt fig imports for a month, coinciding with the peak of the local harvest season. This move is intended to support and encourage local production, enhance self-sufficiency, and bolster national food security. The ministry noted that Iraqi figs are known for their high quality and taste. The decision reflects the Ministry of Agriculture's broader efforts to guide farmers toward advanced technologies and biological control programs to improve the quantity and quality of agricultural production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has unveiled an initiative to encourage the use of solar energy to power modern irrigation systems.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has unveiled an initiative to encourage the use of solar energy to power modern irrigation systems. This follows the expansion of desert lands, which has enabled Iraq to achieve self-sufficiency in wheat but relies on irrigation systems that use fuel and electricity, creating an environmental and economic burden. In cooperation with the Ministry of Environment, the ministry is directing farmers toward solar energy to reduce emissions and enhance reliance on clean energy. While acknowledging that solar energy systems have high initial costs, the ministry notes they are a viable long-term economic option for farmers.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department and the Al-Mishkhab Research Center, is purifying and disinfect...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department and the Al-Mishkhab Research Center, is purifying and disinfecting high-grade wheat seeds for the upcoming 2025 agricultural season. The process, which follows the regulations of the National Seed Council, is overseen by the Seed Inspection and Certification Department to protect the seeds from fungal and insect infestations. This is a key step in ensuring improved germination rates and production quantities. Approximately 276,640 tons of seeds have been received from contracted farmers, and the initiative is part of the Ministry's broader plan to provide pure and certified seeds to farmers for a strong start to the season.

records.title: Jordan is reinforcing its food security strategy by prioritizing accurate national data, institutional coordination, and global partnersh...
records.description: Jordan is reinforcing its food security strategy by prioritizing accurate national data, institutional coordination, and global partnerships. The Food Security Council, in collaboration with the World Food Programme and the Department of Statistics, is finalizing two pivotal studies focusing on nutrition gaps and food consumption patterns. A national survey is also underway in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) to measure critical international food insecurity indicators. This data-driven approach, which includes the advanced National Food Security Information System, has earned Jordan international recognition, leading to its selection by Wageningen University and Oxford University as a model for transforming food systems. A permanent information committee has been established under the Higher Council for Food Security to regularly track and update indicators, reflecting a deep-rooted institutional awareness of the strategic importance of data in shaping national decisions.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), in partnership with Advance Consulting and the Tafileh Agriculture Directorate's Extension D...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), in partnership with Advance Consulting and the Tafileh Agriculture Directorate's Extension Department, has organized a training course for local farmers and members of agricultural cooperatives on water-use efficiency. This initiative, part of a project aimed at building resilience to climate change, seeks to raise farmers' awareness and enable them to adopt climate-smart agricultural practices. The training included interactive sessions and practical applications on modern irrigation techniques to reduce water loss, boost productivity, and ensure sustainable farming in drought-affected areas. The overall goal is to strengthen food security and promote sustainable agricultural development in regions of Jordan most vulnerable to climate change.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Kuwait is prioritizing environmental sustainability as a core pillar of its national plans, aiming to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060.
records.description: Kuwait is prioritizing environmental sustainability as a core pillar of its national plans, aiming to achieve carbon neutrality by 2060. The government has intensified efforts, guided by its Cabinet, to implement a long-term roadmap for low-carbon development. This roadmap emphasizes sustainable economic growth through a circular carbon economy, green investment, and innovative solutions. Kuwait is also working to diversify its energy mix, with an ambitious goal of generating 50% of its electrical power from renewable energy by 2025. Key projects include the Shagaya Renewable Energy Park and a policy requiring all facilities to produce a portion of their energy from renewable sources. Furthermore, the country is focusing on sustainable urban development through its 2040 Master Plan, promoting green buildings, and expanding green spaces to combat desertification.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is closely monitoring the grape export file, with Minister Hani affirming the ministry's full support for the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is closely monitoring the grape export file, with Minister Hani affirming the ministry's full support for the sector. During a meeting held at the Bekaa Agriculture Department in Zahle with a group of grape farmers, discussions focused on developing the value chain for Lebanese grapes and opening new markets such as South Africa, Canada, and Indonesia. The Ministry announced that it would closely monitor the export file and use all its capabilities to overcome any obstacles. To facilitate this, the Director General also held coordination meetings with the Agricultural Research Institute and the Ministry of Economy and Trade. This initiative is part of the "Agriculture: The Pulse of the Earth and Life" campaign, which aims to connect agricultural policies to the actual needs of farmers and achieve integration between production, marketing, and export.

records.title: The Minister of Environment and Sustainable Development in Mauritania inaugurated eight new nurseries affiliated with the National Agency...
records.description: The Minister of Environment and Sustainable Development in Mauritania inaugurated eight new nurseries affiliated with the National Agency for the Great Green Wall. As part of the National Tree Week activities, these nurseries are distributed across the provinces of Trarza, Brakna, Assaba, Hodh El Gharbi, and Dakhlet Nouadhibou. They are designed to produce four million seedlings annually to support afforestation and ecosystem rehabilitation efforts. The project aims to contribute to rural development and create new job opportunities, with the locations chosen based on technical and social criteria like water availability and local demand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development

records.title: The "Tatweer" platform of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning has launched 14 agricultural and commercial investment opportunities...
records.description: The "Tatweer" platform of the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning has launched 14 agricultural and commercial investment opportunities in North Al Sharqiyah Governorate. These opportunities, offered by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the North Al Sharqiyah Governor’s Office, are designed to attract private sector involvement. The agricultural projects focus on using modern farming techniques for crops such as figs, onions, garlic, potatoes, and dates, with the goal of ensuring sustainability and enhancing competitiveness. The commercial opportunities, which include a strategic investment project in Ibra and the establishment of industrial shops in Al Mudhaibi, are aligned with Oman Vision 2040 and aim to diversify national income, boost local economies, and create jobs for citizens.
records.institution: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning

records.title: Emerge signs 20-year solar energy deal with Misk City
records.description: Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar and EDF power solutions, has signed a long-term agreement with Misk City to deliver sustainable electricity by developing a 621-kilowatt peak rooftop solar plant. The project, located in Riyadh, will be fully developed and managed by Emerge and is expected to significantly reduce the city’s carbon footprint. This initiative supports Misk City’s ambition to achieve a high level of environmental performance through LEED certification and its vision of becoming a leading green urban community. The partnership, which was attended by representatives from the French Embassy in Riyadh, leverages the combined expertise of the Masdar and EDF Group to accelerate the transition to clean power in the region.

records.title: The Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia is a vital hub for fish farming, with its strategic location on the Arabian Gulf facilitating exports...
records.description: The Eastern Region of Saudi Arabia is a vital hub for fish farming, with its strategic location on the Arabian Gulf facilitating exports to regional and international markets. According to the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Eastern Region branch, the region has 88 licensed fish-farming projects, with 23 currently in production. In 2024, the combined production from these projects and the Arabian Gulf coasts exceeded 44,000 tons. These projects, which use a closed-system, semi-intensive farming method, have a target annual production capacity of 12,000 tons and an average investment value of SAR4 million to SAR6 million. This initiative is crucial for strengthening local markets, enhancing food security, and contributing to the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Variety Certification Committee, a body under the Ministry of Agriculture, has approved two new high-yield durum wheat varie...
records.description: The National Variety Certification Committee, a body under the Ministry of Agriculture, has approved two new high-yield durum wheat varieties. The first, a national product named "Buhuth 13," is characterized by a high protein content and good disease resistance, with an average yield of 5,892 kg/ha. The second variety, "Sham 13," is the result of a collaboration with ICARDA and has an even higher average yield of 6,479 kg/ha, in addition to being highly resistant to yellow rust. Both varieties are adaptable to irrigated agriculture and are expected to boost crop productivity.

records.title: According to the National Oil Office (ONH), Tunisia's olive oil export volume saw a significant increase in the first half of 2025, reach...
records.description: According to the National Oil Office (ONH), Tunisia's olive oil export volume saw a significant increase in the first half of 2025, reaching 195,000 tons. Despite this growth in volume, export revenues declined by 27.5% due to a drastic drop in global prices, a trend also noted by the IMF. An encouraging development, however, is the growth of packaged olive oil, which now makes up a larger share of both the total volume and revenue, suggesting a shift towards higher-value exports.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) in the UAE has released the results of its joint monitoring and inspection campai...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) in the UAE has released the results of its joint monitoring and inspection campaigns for the first half of 2025, which were conducted in collaboration with local authorities. The campaigns, which are part of MOCCAE’s Strategic Plan 2023–2026, involved 27 joint inspections of 91 facilities across various Emirates. The inspections focused on the livestock, agricultural, and fisheries sectors, as well as the environmental compliance of industrial facilities like crushers and cement factories. The initiative is a mechanism for enforcing environmental laws, identifying violations, and educating business owners about their role in achieving environmental sustainability. The ministry confirmed that legal actions, including penalties and closures, were taken against non-compliant entities, and that an emphasis was also placed on educational and awareness programs to prevent future violations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The National Food Safety Authority of Egypt reported on the country's food trade, stating that it received approximately 345,000 tonnes o...
records.description: The National Food Safety Authority of Egypt reported on the country's food trade, stating that it received approximately 345,000 tonnes of food imports from 84 countries. Ukraine, Russia, Indonesia, and the United States were among the top exporting nations. Alexandria Port served as the main entry point for these shipments. Simultaneously, Egypt exported around 165,000 tonnes of food products, including vegetables and fruits, to 170 international markets. The top importers were Sudan, Saudi Arabia, the United States, and Russia. Alexandria Port was also the busiest terminal for exports. The Authority issued 750 health certificates to support these exports and ensure compliance with food safety standards.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department and the Al-Mashkhab Research Station, has successfully cultivat...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department and the Al-Mashkhab Research Station, has successfully cultivated advanced rice varieties for the second consecutive year, overcoming water scarcity and drought. This was achieved by multiplying high-grade rice varieties and using modern irrigation techniques like fixed and pivot systems, which have proven effective in reducing water consumption while increasing productivity. The program has also contributed to developing disease-resistant varieties with a short growth period, enabling the ministry to expand rice cultivation to new governorates and support food security.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Minister of Environment and Sustainable Development launched the Green Partnership for a Sustainable Future initiative in the municip...
records.description: The Minister of Environment and Sustainable Development launched the Green Partnership for a Sustainable Future initiative in the municipality of Adwirrara in Hodh El Gharbi province. The initiative, organized in cooperation with the National Agency for the Great Green Wall as part of National Tree Week, included a visit to a plastic waste collection point and an organic fertilizer collection point to support local agricultural cooperatives. The ministry's regional delegation confirmed that it has its own nursery with a production capacity of over three thousand saplings and relies on the population for its seedling distribution.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development

records.title: A Memorandum of Understanding was signed at the Salalah Free Zone between the food industry company SEFCO and the Omani Agricultural Asso...
records.description: A Memorandum of Understanding was signed at the Salalah Free Zone between the food industry company SEFCO and the Omani Agricultural Association (Dhofar Branch) to promote sesame cultivation in the Najd area. The initiative is a collaborative effort with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones, designed to connect local agricultural output with the food processing industry and support the goals of Oman Vision 2040. SEFCO has committed to buying the entire sesame harvest from 35 farmers in the project’s first phase, which spans 600 acres. The partnership is a model of public-private cooperation aimed at reducing reliance on imports, enhancing self-sufficiency, and driving sustainable national growth.

records.title: The Green Qassim Land Initiative has successfully planted over 7.5 million trees in its fifteenth phase, with the aim of increasing veget...
records.description: The Green Qassim Land Initiative has successfully planted over 7.5 million trees in its fifteenth phase, with the aim of increasing vegetation, combating desertification, and improving the quality of life in the region. The initiative, launched in 1438 AH, is supported by the Governor of Qassim Region and the Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture and is overseen by the ministry's branch in the region. It is implemented in two annual phases and is the result of collaboration between government agencies, the private sector, environmental associations, and volunteers. This effort is a prominent part of Saudi Arabia's wider environmental strategy, including the National Environment Strategy and the Saudi Green Initiative, which are aligned with Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The International Date Council has officially become an "Observer" in the Codex Alimentarius Commission, a move that signifies growing gl...
records.description: The International Date Council has officially become an "Observer" in the Codex Alimentarius Commission, a move that signifies growing global recognition of the council's role. This new status provides institutional acknowledgment of the council's importance in setting standards for the quality and safety of date production and improving agricultural and commercial practices among its member states. According to the council's Executive Director, this is a significant milestone that reflects increasing confidence in the council as a key reference body for the dates sector.

records.title: The Gafsa governorate in Tunisia is set to achieve a historic record in pistachio production, with a harvest of 4,289 tonnes, more than d...
records.description: The Gafsa governorate in Tunisia is set to achieve a historic record in pistachio production, with a harvest of 4,289 tonnes, more than double that of the previous season. This performance, according to the Regional Directorate of Plant Production under the Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA), confirms Gafsa's position as the leading national producer. The record harvest is attributed to an expanding cultivated area and abundant rainfall. In response, agricultural authorities have launched awareness campaigns to assist farmers with phytosanitary prevention and ensure quality. A dedicated pistachio market has been established in Gafsa to better structure the sector, and authorities are encouraging farmers to form professional groups to improve marketing and ensure fair remuneration.

records.title: NRTC Food Holding LLC, a leading fruits and vegetables distribution company in the GCC, has acquired Al Hashemeya Farms, one of the large...
records.description: NRTC Food Holding LLC, a leading fruits and vegetables distribution company in the GCC, has acquired Al Hashemeya Farms, one of the largest privately managed farming estates in Egypt. The acquisition, a strategic move to secure a sustainable fresh produce supply and enhance regional food security, marks NRTC's direct entry into upstream agriculture. The 10,000-acre farm, located in Egypt’s Wadi El Natrun region, has a diverse portfolio of crops, including citrus, olives, and grapes, and is supported by modern irrigation systems. By controlling its supply chain from the source, NRTC aims to improve quality and reduce reliance on third-party suppliers.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The 10th edition of the Liwa Ajman Dates and Honey Festival, organized by the Ajman Department of Tourism Development (ADTD), has conclud...
records.description: The 10th edition of the Liwa Ajman Dates and Honey Festival, organized by the Ajman Department of Tourism Development (ADTD), has concluded at the Emirates Hospitality Centre. The event served as a regional platform for celebrating agriculture, heritage, and cultural exchange, with broad participation from countries including the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, the Sultanate of Oman, Jordan, and Egypt. The festival featured competitions for dates, honey, and fruits, alongside live performances, educational sessions, and workshops on local crafts. With 61 exhibitors, the event reaffirmed its role in preserving heritage and supporting farmers, beekeepers, and entrepreneurs, while also promoting Ajman as a growing hub for heritage tourism and cultural events.

records.title: The Agriculture Sector in the Capital Sana'a has launched a public initiative to preserve and replant ancient trees from private properti...
records.description: The Agriculture Sector in the Capital Sana'a has launched a public initiative to preserve and replant ancient trees from private properties into public spaces across the city. The program aims to expand green areas, protect vegetation, and raise public awareness about the national value of these trees. Citizens are encouraged to contact the sector for the safe relocation of trees, particularly those over 10 years old.
records.institution: Agriculture Sector in the Capital Sana'a

records.title: The General Authority for Water Resources and Infrastructure held a workshop in Sana'a to launch a groundwater recharge program called "B...
records.description: The General Authority for Water Resources and Infrastructure held a workshop in Sana'a to launch a groundwater recharge program called "Blessings from the Sky and Earth." The event, which included officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and the Water Resources Authority, focused on utilizing rainwater and floodwaters to replenish groundwater reserves and mitigate declining water levels. The program aims to optimize water resources for both drinking and agriculture, thereby enhancing water and food security. Officials emphasized the collective responsibility for water security and the importance of prioritizing drinking water and agriculture over other needs. The initiative is intended to be a national effort, involving local authorities in drafting proposals and educating the public on its importance.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation's minister inspected the Al-Salihiya agricultural project in Sharqia governorate, praisi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation's minister inspected the Al-Salihiya agricultural project in Sharqia governorate, praising it as a successful model for integrated agricultural investment that contributes to food security. Spanning 21,000 acres, the project uses eight water stations to support diverse activities, including the production of various vegetable and fruit crops, livestock and poultry breeding, and fish farming. It also includes supplementary industries like feed, compost, and cardboard factories. The project is seen as a way to increase agricultural production, create jobs, and support the local economy. The ministry affirmed its commitment to providing support and facilities to serious investors in the agricultural sector, aligning with the state's vision to achieve food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq, through its Agricultural Research Department, has developed a research plan in partnership with the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq, through its Agricultural Research Department, has developed a research plan in partnership with the Arab Alliance for Scientific Research. The project, which also involves researchers from the University of Baghdad, aims to reduce methane emissions from ruminants and mitigate heat stress using advanced nutritional and physiological technologies. This initiative is part of a regional research effort that includes Egypt and Jordan, with the goal of promoting environmental sustainability and improving animal production efficiency in the face of climate change.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's North Lebanon Agriculture Department is working to regulate the marine fishing sector and protect fisheries.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's North Lebanon Agriculture Department is working to regulate the marine fishing sector and protect fisheries. As part of its National Agricultural Extension Program, the Ministry held consultative meetings with fishermen, cooperatives, and municipalities at the Marine Science Center in Batroun and the Anfeh Municipality. Participants included the Federation of Chambers of Commerce, Industry, and Agriculture, local fishing associations, and coastal municipalities. The discussions focused on enforcing Law No. 277/2012, which regulates marine fishing by prohibiting illegal methods and fishing during protected periods. The Ministry plans to intensify surveillance campaigns in cooperation with security and regulatory authorities and will also provide technical support and training to promote sustainable fishing techniques.

records.title: The Minister of Environment and Sustainable Development launched an afforestation and direct seeding campaign along the Great Green Wall...
records.description: The Minister of Environment and Sustainable Development launched an afforestation and direct seeding campaign along the Great Green Wall route in the municipality of Adwirareh, Hodh El Gharbi province. As part of National Tree Week, the campaign aims to rehabilitate 4,000 hectares of degraded land through direct seeding and afforestation in 89 locations across five provinces, including Hodh El Gharbi, Assaba, Tagant, Brakna, and Trarza. The initiative, overseen by the National Agency for the Great Green Wall, is designed to combat environmental challenges like desertification and climate change, with local stakeholders being urged to participate actively.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Sustainable Development

records.title: A Memorandum of Understanding was signed at Salalah Free Zone between the food industry company Saifco and the Dhofar Governorate branch...
records.description: A Memorandum of Understanding was signed at Salalah Free Zone between the food industry company Saifco and the Dhofar Governorate branch of the Oman Agricultural Association to cultivate sesame in the Al Najd area. This initiative, a joint cooperation program between the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and the Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones, aims to support food security and national value chains in line with Oman Vision 2040. Under the agreement, Saifco will purchase the harvest from 35 farmers in the first phase of the project, which covers 600 acres. The partnership seeks to reduce sesame imports, boost self-sufficiency, and serves as a model for cooperation among government entities, free zones, and the private sector to support sustainable development.

records.title: Oman has adopted smart agriculture as a key part of its strategy to achieve food security and preserve natural resources, in line with Om...
records.description: Oman has adopted smart agriculture as a key part of its strategy to achieve food security and preserve natural resources, in line with Oman Vision 2040. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, through its Directorate General of Agricultural and Livestock Research, is promoting modern technologies such as soilless farming, smart irrigation, and drones. The strategy aims to enhance crop productivity and reduce costs while carefully balancing the integration of these innovations into traditional systems, such as upgrading aflaj irrigation channels. The ministry provides farmers with specialized training and, along with the Development Bank, offers financial support and soft loans to help them acquire these technologies. Despite challenges like infrastructure disparities and the need for greater technical awareness, Oman is steadily moving toward establishing smart agriculture as a cornerstone of its sustainable development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jerusalem Governorate Agriculture Directorate, has delivered a metal fence to protect seven agri...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jerusalem Governorate Agriculture Directorate, has delivered a metal fence to protect seven agricultural plots planted with almond and fig trees in the areas of Sawahreh, Beit Surik, Beit Iksa, and Al-Jib. The fence, which is part of the "Greening Palestine" project, aims to enhance the sustainability of agricultural production and protect cultivated lands from wild animals and pigs. The supported plots, which total approximately 35 dunums, belong to farmers who met the project's criteria. This initiative is a priority of the food security program approved by the Ministry of Agriculture.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Al-Hanakiya Governorate, located in the Madinah Region, is set to launch its inaugural Grape Festival at the Palm Center to bolster t...
records.description: The Al-Hanakiya Governorate, located in the Madinah Region, is set to launch its inaugural Grape Festival at the Palm Center to bolster the local agricultural sector and enhance economic and tourism activities. The festival, which will serve as a marketing platform for farmers to showcase their products, aims to reinforce the center's reputation as a source of high-quality produce and raise food awareness. The event will include exhibitions of various grape varieties, artistic performances, handicrafts, and educational entertainment for children, with the involvement of relevant government entities. The Al-Hanakiya Governorate has called on farmers, investors, and visitors to attend, highlighting the region's commitment to boosting local production and expanding agricultural marketing.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The fourth edition of the Otaiqah Dates Season has launched in Riyadh to highlight Saudi Arabia's leading position in the date industry.
records.description: The fourth edition of the Otaiqah Dates Season has launched in Riyadh to highlight Saudi Arabia's leading position in the date industry. The event, an initiative of the Riyadh Development Company, is a collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the National Center for Palms and Dates, with the support of Riyadh Municipality. The Culinary Arts Commission and the Saudi Tourism Authority are also participating. Held at the Otaiqah Central Market, the event is the longest-running seasonal date market in the Kingdom, serving as a platform for over 65 traders and farmers to showcase their products. The festival also features a children’s area with educational activities, entertainment shows, and participation from local families, creating a community-driven atmosphere.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has launched a training program for 90 farmers in Yemen's Al-Mahra governor...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) has launched a training program for 90 farmers in Yemen's Al-Mahra governorate. This initiative is part of a larger project for sustainable agriculture and empowerment in agriculture and fisheries, which aims to strengthen resilience in the country. The program includes specialized courses on sustainable farming, farm management, integrated pest management, and the optimal use of pesticides. It also provides training for veterinary workers. The program is an extension of KSrelief's broader efforts to support Yemeni agricultural communities and increase local food production through training, distribution of agricultural inputs, and water resource management.
records.institution: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: According to data from ONAGRI, Tunisia's date export revenues and quantities have fallen during the first nine months of the current camp...
records.description: According to data from ONAGRI, Tunisia's date export revenues and quantities have fallen during the first nine months of the current campaign compared to the previous one, with the "Deglet Nour" variety making up the majority of the export volume. The European Union is the largest importer, followed by Africa and Asia, with Morocco, Italy, and France being the top three individual importing countries. Organic date exports also experienced a decline in both quantity and value, with Germany as the leading destination. In response to market dynamics, the Tunisian Union of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries (UTAP) and the Tunisian Union of Industry, Trade and Handicrafts (UTICA) have agreed to set new reference prices for dates. The interprofessional group of dates under the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has also stressed the importance of quality standards for exports.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has been awarded the ISO 42001:2023 certification for Artificial Intelligenc...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has been awarded the ISO 42001:2023 certification for Artificial Intelligence Management Systems, making it the first entity globally in the agriculture and food security sector, and the first government entity in the UAE, to receive this recognition. The certification acknowledges ADAFSA's responsible integration of AI, including intelligent analytics and machine learning, into its core functions. This achievement supports the UAE’s strategic focus on sustainability, digital innovation, and leadership in AI governance, and aligns with the goals of the UAE’s Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2031. The UAE has been proactively involved in shaping international AI standards through its Emirates AI Experts Group, and this milestone reinforces ADAFSA’s status as a leading body committed to pioneering innovation in food safety and long-term sustainability.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Officials in Capital Sana'a have reviewed a fruit tree planting initiative in the al-Safiyah and al-Sabeen districts.
records.description: Officials in Capital Sana'a have reviewed a fruit tree planting initiative in the al-Safiyah and al-Sabeen districts. The project, which is part of a broader plan by the Capital Sana'a's Agriculture Sector and involves coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, focuses on planting productive fruit trees like guava, peach, and lemon instead of ornamental ones. The initiative aims to improve urban greenery, enhance food security by utilizing public spaces for production, and serve as a model for other provinces. Officials praised the community involvement and stressed the importance of field monitoring and collaboration to ensure the sustainability and long-term impact of the project.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the World Food Programme (WFP), has launched the first agricultural barometric insurance...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the World Food Programme (WFP), has launched the first agricultural barometric insurance initiative in the Middle East, with the pilot phase successfully concluding. The program is designed to protect small farmers from the effects of climate change, such as drought and high temperatures, by automatically and quickly disbursing compensation based on weather indicators. The first phase included 500 beneficiaries in Karbala and Nineveh governorates, and its success is expected to lead to an expansion of the program to cover other risks like floods. The program is overseen by the Insurance Bureau, with insurance coverage provided by Asia Gate Insurance Company, and reinsurance handled by the Iraqi Reinsurance Company.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Agricultural Research in Iraq has launched seeding operations for new varieties of short-seas...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Agricultural Research in Iraq has launched seeding operations for new varieties of short-season rice at the Rice Research Station in Al-Mashkhab. This initiative aims to address water challenges and support farmers by developing varieties with a shorter growing season, thereby saving significant amounts of water, reducing costs for farmers, and preventing the rice harvest from overlapping with the wheat harvest. The project was widely welcomed at a Field Day attended by representatives of the Directorate of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Agricultural Extension in Najaf Governorate, as well as rice farmers from Najaf and Diwaniyah.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture/Department of Agricultural Research

records.title: Saudi markets are seeing an increase in locally grown summer fruits, with domestic grapes being particularly popular.
records.description: Saudi markets are seeing an increase in locally grown summer fruits, with domestic grapes being particularly popular. The Kingdom produces over 122,300 tons of grapes annually. The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has stated that grape cultivation has grown due to government support, advanced farming techniques, and good agricultural practices. Major grape-producing regions include Tabuk, Qassim, Hail, Al-Jouf, Madinah, Asir, and Taif, with popular local varieties being Taifi, Halawani, Banati, Early Sweet, Crimson Seedless, Thompson Seedless, and Superior. The diversity of grapes supports various food processing industries, contributing to both food security and the national economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture organized the third Tabuk Honey and Agricultural Products Festival, which has attracte...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture organized the third Tabuk Honey and Agricultural Products Festival, which has attracted numerous visitors. The festival serves as a platform for marketing, agricultural education, and shopping, with a family-friendly design. It highlights the importance of Tabuk as a major agricultural hub, and the Ministry's support for farmers has contributed to the prominence of the region's products in both local and foreign markets.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla's efforts to enhance food security and develop agricultural communities, in line with Saudi Vision 2030, w...
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla's efforts to enhance food security and develop agricultural communities, in line with Saudi Vision 2030, were highlighted by the strong attendance at the Summer Fruits Season events at Al-Manshiyah Farmers' Market in AlUla. The event provided local farmers and cottage industry families with profitable sales and new marketing opportunities for their summer produce, while also raising community awareness about supporting local products. AlUla's farms annually produce over 4,900 tons of fruit from 216,000 trees.

records.title: The Supreme Council for Environment and Natural Resources held a consultative workshop to create an action plan for recovering the plant...
records.description: The Supreme Council for Environment and Natural Resources held a consultative workshop to create an action plan for recovering the plant gene bank for agricultural crops, which was affected by war. The workshop brought together government institutions and organizations, including the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the United Nations Development Program (UNDP), to secure financial support and conduct a scientific assessment. The Agricultural Research Corporation in Al-Gezira State explained the negative impacts of the war on the Agricultural Genetic Resources and Plant Conservation and Research Center in Wad Madani, but noted that 70% of the genetic resources were transferred and preserved. The corporation is seeking support for necessary equipment, and the FAO representative emphasized the organization's commitment to providing technical and financial assistance for projects that contribute to food security.
records.institution: Supreme Council for Environment and Natural Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has issued a call for grain collection centers to take necessary pr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has issued a call for grain collection centers to take necessary precautions against unstable weather conditions, following forecasts from the INM (National Institute of Meteorology). The Ministry has urged the Regional Agricultural Development Commissions and the services of the Cereal Office to provide technical support and monitor the preparations of the collection centers. Farmers are also advised to protect their greenhouses and livestock. The weather is predicted to include local rains, thunderstorms with potential hail, and strong winds, especially near the coasts and in the south.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a training workshop on the use of treated wastewater in agricultural irrigation as part of its Nati...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a training workshop on the use of treated wastewater in agricultural irrigation as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program. The workshop, held at Alwaleed Bin Talal Hall, discussed three types of wastewater suitable for reuse after treatment and emphasized its role as a sustainable solution to water scarcity. It highlighted the serious environmental and health risks of using untreated water in agriculture, which can lead to soil and crop contamination. The seminar also covered technical treatment stages, official national standards, and the importance of public safety regulations. The Ministry of Agriculture affirmed its commitment to guiding farmers, monitoring compliance, and combating the practice of irrigation with untreated wastewater to protect food safety and soil integrity.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program, organized a seminar at the Training and Development...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program, organized a seminar at the Training and Development Center in Atrin on chickpea cultivation and seed production. The event, which is part of a project funded by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), targeted approximately 30 small-holder farmers and included participation from staff of the Agricultural Center in Deir al-Qamar and the Agricultural Technical School in Baakline. Experts from the Agricultural Research Institute presented topics on good agricultural practices, selecting cold-resistant varieties, pest control, and preserving local seed varieties.

records.title: The asparagus industry in Morocco is on a path of structural growth, with a fifth consecutive record export season expected.
records.description: The asparagus industry in Morocco is on a path of structural growth, with a fifth consecutive record export season expected. According to EastFruit, Moroccan exports have seen a significant increase, supported by an extended harvest season that now stretches until the end of May. The European Union remains the primary market, although there has been a notable shift this season with Belgium becoming the main destination, surpassing Spain. Other key markets include France, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom, with a growing presence in Germany. Beyond Europe, Morocco is also expanding into the Middle East, with new shipments made to countries such as Bahrain, Qatar, and Jordan.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: A consortium of Acwa Power, Saudi Electricity Company (SEC), and Korea Electric Power Corporation (Kepco) has secured SAR12.8 billion in...
records.description: A consortium of Acwa Power, Saudi Electricity Company (SEC), and Korea Electric Power Corporation (Kepco) has secured SAR12.8 billion in senior debt financing for two 3,600MW independent power producer (IPP) projects, Rumah 1 and Nairyah 1, in Saudi Arabia. The financing was provided by a diverse group of institutions, including the Export Import Bank of Korea (Kexim), Saudi National Bank, Saudi Investment Bank, Banque Saudi Fransi, Standard Chartered Bank, several Chinese banks, and the Arab Petroleum Investments Corporation. The projects, which support Saudi Arabia's energy diversification under Vision 2030 and its net-zero emissions goals, are designed for the future integration of carbon capture technologies. The Saudi Power Procurement Company (SPPC) is the principal buyer, and the plants will be operated by Remal Energy Company and Naseem Energy Company, respectively.

records.title: The 4th Khairat Al-Jouf Festival has concluded in the city of Sakaka, having promoted over eight different agricultural and food products...
records.description: The 4th Khairat Al-Jouf Festival has concluded in the city of Sakaka, having promoted over eight different agricultural and food products, including fruits, vegetables, and processed goods. The festival, which was held at Al-Nakheel Park, was organized by the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region, with participation from several government entities, agricultural associations, and local farmers. It attracted thousands of visitors with its pavilions, educational workshops, and a children's stage. The event was deemed a success by participating farmers and families due to strong sales, and it aims to support and empower the region's agricultural sector by providing a direct marketing channel for local products.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Buraidah Dates Carnival, organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture,...
records.description: The Buraidah Dates Carnival, organized by the National Center for Palms and Dates and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, has begun under the supervision of the Qassim Principality. The event features more than 100 varieties of dates and offers a wide array of activities beyond sales, including processing industries, handicrafts, cultural performances, and a dedicated children's area. The carnival has a history of significant success, with previous sales reaching SAR3.2 billion and attracting over 800,000 visitors.
records.institution: National Center for Palms and Dates

records.title: The 35th edition of the Maghreb Honey Festival was held in Sidi Alouane, Tunisia, attracting exhibitors from Tunisia, Algeria, Morocco, a...
records.description: The 35th edition of the Maghreb Honey Festival was held in Sidi Alouane, Tunisia, attracting exhibitors from Tunisia, Algeria, Morocco, and Libya. The festival, which featured a record number of participants and honey volume, focuses on beekeeping excellence, Maghreb cooperation, and rural innovation. A technical committee, comprising representatives from the National Office for Livestock and Pastures, the UTAP, and the National Authority for Food Safety, ensures product quality by conducting rigorous analyses of honey samples. The central theme of the festival was the impact of climate change on beekeeping, with a scientific conference highlighting the effects of prolonged drought, based on data from the National Institute of Meteorology.
records.institution: National Office for Livestock and Pastures

records.title: The Cereals Office in Tunisia announced that cereal collection reached 11.747 million quintals, a quantity that exceeds the average for t...
records.description: The Cereals Office in Tunisia announced that cereal collection reached 11.747 million quintals, a quantity that exceeds the average for the last five years for the same period. The majority of the cereals collected, 94.1%, are intended for consumption, with the remainder being selected seeds. Durum wheat accounted for the largest share of the cereals for consumption. The regions of Beja, Bizerte, and Siliana were the top contributors to the national collection. The Cereals Office also confirmed that grain transportation from production to consumption areas is ongoing and has set up a monitoring unit to assist farmers and stakeholders throughout the collection campaign.

records.title: A scientific study conducted by the American University of Sharjah (AUS), in partnership with international research institutions, has hi...
records.description: A scientific study conducted by the American University of Sharjah (AUS), in partnership with international research institutions, has highlighted the potential of soil microbiomes for sustainable agriculture in the UAE. The research, published in the journal Science, explores how microbial interactions in arid soils can enhance fertility and improve crop resilience under extreme weather conditions. To further this initiative, AUS has launched the Sharjah Sustainable Agriculture Research Group and is conducting field trials on local crops using microbial inoculants to improve resistance to heat, drought, and salinity. The study redefines soil as a living system that can be harnessed for sustainable and climate-resilient farming.

records.title: The General Authority for Science, Research, Technology and Innovation in Yemen has announced the successful manufacturing and developmen...
records.description: The General Authority for Science, Research, Technology and Innovation in Yemen has announced the successful manufacturing and development of solar dryers as a sustainable solution to reduce post-harvest agricultural losses. A specialized technical team reverse-engineered a German solar dryer to produce a local version with comparable efficiency at only 30% of the import cost. The Authority has conducted research and trials on various Yemeni crops, such as grapes, coffee, and dates, and has also trained technicians from cooperative associations. The initiative, which has shown promising initial results with palm farmers in Al-Hodeidah, aims to increase crop quality, boost farmers' income, and promote local innovation.
records.institution: General Authority for Science, Research, Technology and Innovation

records.title: Bahrain's total livestock population has significantly increased over the past decade.
records.description: Bahrain's total livestock population has significantly increased over the past decade. The data indicates a substantial rise in the number of animals, with sheep remaining the most dominant livestock. Goat and cattle numbers have remained relatively stable, while horse and camel populations have also stayed consistent. The number of chicken farms has shown little change, reflecting a focus on local meat production.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its Koura district center, recently held a "Sensory Tasting of Olive Oil" seminar as part o...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its Koura district center, recently held a "Sensory Tasting of Olive Oil" seminar as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program. The event at the Ajd Ebrine Municipality Hall educated farmers and olive grove owners on olive tree importance, health benefits, and quality standards (Libnor). Participants engaged in practical tasting to differentiate oil qualities. The Ministry emphasized ongoing agricultural guidance and encouraged registration in its agricultural registry to facilitate support based on regional needs.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture – Mount Lebanon Agriculture Department, Deir al-Qamar Center, in cooperation with the Deir al-Qamar Municipal...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture – Mount Lebanon Agriculture Department, Deir al-Qamar Center, in cooperation with the Deir al-Qamar Municipality, organized a seminar on "Rationalizing the Use of Agricultural Pesticides" as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. Attended by approximately 67 farmers and local figures, the event emphasized the importance of responsible pesticide use for environmental and public health, aligning with the Ministry's commitment to integrated pest management to enhance the quality and safety of Lebanese agricultural production. The seminar provided technical guidelines on pesticide handling and disposal, highlighting the role of farmers in protecting health and combating agricultural fraud. The Ministry of Agriculture affirmed its continued monitoring of the pesticide sector and urged reporting of any suspected adulterated or smuggled products.

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman, through its sovereign wealth fund-majority-owned ME Solaris Commodities Holding (Solaris), has acquired a controll...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman, through its sovereign wealth fund-majority-owned ME Solaris Commodities Holding (Solaris), has acquired a controlling interest in Humberg Agribrasil Comércio e Exportação de Grãos SA (Agribrasil), a leading Brazilian grain exporter, and the Santa Catarina grain terminal (TESC). This strategic move strengthens Oman's global food security and expands its agricultural commodities footprint, aligning with Oman Vision 2040 by securing reliable food sources and diversifying its economy. Solaris gains entry into Brazilian corn and soybean markets and access to port logistics, while Agribrasil benefits from enhanced global reach and supply stability.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), conclude...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), concluded the second round of a specialized training workshop on climate data analysis and its impact on the agricultural sector. This workshop, part of the "Enhancing Planning and Adoption Capacities for Climate-Resilient Agriculture in Palestine" project, is funded by the Green Climate Fund (GCF) and partnered with the Environment Quality Authority and the Palestinian Meteorological Authority. Forty participants from the Ministry of Agriculture and partner agricultural institutions received training to develop early warning systems to mitigate climate risks and enhance farmers' resilience against extreme weather conditions impacting agricultural production and food security.

records.title: King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (KACARE), in collaboration with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), has successfully deve...
records.description: King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (KACARE), in collaboration with the Saudi Water Authority (SWA), has successfully developed and implemented an integrated water desalination system in Riyadh. This innovative system utilizes solar thermal energy and forward osmosis technology, a project carried out by a national team from KACARE and SWA's Water Technologies Innovation Institute and Research Advancement (WTIIRA). The initiative, part of a national effort to develop sustainable renewable energy solutions, has achieved significant environmental outcomes by creating a zero-carbon desalination system that reduces wastewater production by 20% compared to traditional methods. This project is crucial for bolstering Saudi Arabia's water security and supporting its transition to a low-carbon economy.
records.institution: King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy (KACARE)

records.title: Saudi Arabia has made significant strides in environmental conservation, water sustainability, and food security under Saudi Vision 2030,...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has made significant strides in environmental conservation, water sustainability, and food security under Saudi Vision 2030, as reported by its Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture. The National Environment Strategy has led to five specialized environmental centers and a large environmental fund, alongside new regulatory frameworks. Under the Saudi Green Initiative, substantial land rehabilitation and tree planting have occurred, with national parks increasing and protected areas expanding significantly. Enforcement efforts by the National Center for Environmental Compliance have surged, and air quality monitoring has expanded. Two pioneering centers, the Regional Center for Climate Change Studies and the Regional Center for Sand and Dust Storms, have been established.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Diriyah Gate Development Authority (DGDA) and the National Center for Waste Management (MWAN) have signed a memorandum of understandi...
records.description: The Diriyah Gate Development Authority (DGDA) and the National Center for Waste Management (MWAN) have signed a memorandum of understanding to enhance waste management and environmental sustainability within DGDA's supervisory area, aiming to transform Diriyah into a global cultural and tourist destination by 2030. This partnership, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030, involves MWAN providing qualified waste management service providers and clarifying regulations, while DGDA will pilot a sustainable neighborhood with waste source separation and recycling of construction and demolition waste. Both organizations will collaborate on improving waste management regulations and exchanging environmental data to support decision-making and achieve environmental sustainability across the Kingdom.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq is actively promoting tissue culture techniques in Basra Governorate to propagate plants that are dif...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq is actively promoting tissue culture techniques in Basra Governorate to propagate plants that are difficult to cultivate traditionally, such as bananas, strawberries, pineapples, and paulownia. The Plant Tissue Culture Laboratory in Basra Governorate has successfully implemented these methods, covering all stages from laboratory work to field acclimatization. This initiative underscores the Ministry's commitment to modern scientific agricultural practices, as evidenced by official visits and support for the technical personnel involved in the laboratory.

records.title: The Jordan Phosphate Mines Company (JPMC) and the Arab Potash Company (APC) have signed an agreement to establish an integrated industria...
records.description: The Jordan Phosphate Mines Company (JPMC) and the Arab Potash Company (APC) have signed an agreement to establish an integrated industrial complex in the Aqaba Special Economic Zone and Sheidiya. This project aims to produce phosphoric acid, pure phosphoric acid, and specialized fertilizers, marking a significant step towards Jordan's economic modernization in the mining, chemical, and fertilizer sectors. The initiative will create advanced manufacturing industries, boost exports, enhance Jordan’s regional and global standing in the specialized fertilizer market, and generate employment opportunities and training programs for Jordanian professionals.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture and AVSI International have launched a new five-year partnership agreement aimed at promoting agricu...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture and AVSI International have launched a new five-year partnership agreement aimed at promoting agricultural development, enhancing vocational training, and improving rural livelihoods across Lebanon. This agreement, signed at the Ministry of Agriculture – Central Administration building, aligns with the Ministry's vision to strengthen cooperation with international organizations and foster sustainable development partnerships. The partnership will include field training trips between Lebanon and Italy for expertise exchange and capacity building for youth and agricultural professionals, with a focus on agricultural technical schools that have received support from AVSI.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine, through its Hebron Governorate Agriculture Directorate, and with support from the United Nation...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine, through its Hebron Governorate Agriculture Directorate, and with support from the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), distributed 32 water tanks and 32 awnings to livestock breeders in "C" areas of Idhna town. This initiative is part of an urgent response project aimed at supporting the resilience of farmers in areas threatened with confiscation, falling within the Ministry's emergency programs to improve living conditions and enhance the ability of farmers and breeders to withstand challenging circumstances, particularly by providing essential water resources.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture conducted a comprehensive veterinary vaccination campaign in July, administering approximately 18...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture conducted a comprehensive veterinary vaccination campaign in July, administering approximately 186,000 doses of vaccine against diseases such as brucellosis, foot-and-mouth disease (for sheep and cattle), smallpox, plague, and rabies. This initiative, costing around 258,000 shekels, benefited nearly 3,400 livestock breeders and farmers across various governorates. The campaign is part of the Ministry's integrated strategy to enhance veterinary prevention, reduce economic losses, improve animal product quality and safety, and support farmers' resilience, ultimately strengthening preventive food security and ensuring the sustainability of local livestock production.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The State of Qatar is pursuing an ambitious strategy in renewable energy, primarily solar, to foster a green economy and reduce reliance...
records.description: The State of Qatar is pursuing an ambitious strategy in renewable energy, primarily solar, to foster a green economy and reduce reliance on biofuel, aligning with the environmental and energy objectives of the Qatar National Vision 2030. Targets include producing 20% of electricity from renewable sources by 2030 and slashing greenhouse gas emissions by 25%. Flagship projects like the 800-megawatt Al Kharsaah solar power plant, commissioned in 2022, and the recently operational Ras Laffan and Mesaieed solar power plants, with a combined capacity of 875 megawatts, have boosted Qatar's total solar output to 1,675 megawatts, covering nearly 15% of peak electricity demand. This strategic expansion by QatarEnergy, which aims to generate over 4,000 megawatts of renewable energy by 2030, demonstrates the nation's commitment to sustainability and economic diversification, with a growing reliance on national expertise for the construction, operation, and maintenance of these plants.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Saudi Arabia has made significant progress in environmental conservation, water sustainability, and food security under Saudi Vision 2030...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has made significant progress in environmental conservation, water sustainability, and food security under Saudi Vision 2030, as reported by its Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture. The National Environment Strategy has led to five specialized environmental centers and a large environmental fund, alongside new regulatory frameworks. Under the Saudi Green Initiative, substantial land rehabilitation and tree planting have occurred, with national parks increasing and protected areas expanding significantly. Enforcement efforts by the National Center for Environmental Compliance have surged, and air quality monitoring has expanded. Two pioneering centers, the Regional Center for Climate Change Studies and the Regional Center for Sand and Dust Storms, have been established. In waste management, strategic plans are in place to divert waste from landfills.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The grape orchards in Saudi Arabia's Najran Region, covering approximately 67 hectares and yielding around 3,000 tons annually, are cruci...
records.description: The grape orchards in Saudi Arabia's Najran Region, covering approximately 67 hectares and yielding around 3,000 tons annually, are crucial for both the agricultural and tourism economies. The approaching conclusion of the summer grape harvest highlights the region's agricultural development and local production. This season is popular for residents and visitors, offering shopping and recreation opportunities in areas like Al-Hadhan Village, known for its landscapes and diverse crops. Najran's fertile soil, moderate climate, and abundant water contribute to its significant agricultural output and make it a rural tourism destination.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s regional branch in Tabuk Region has organized the third annual Honey and Agricultura...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s regional branch in Tabuk Region has organized the third annual Honey and Agricultural Products Festival, a five-day event at Prince Fahd bin Sultan Park. Over 45 farmers and beekeepers are participating, alongside various government, private, and non-profit entities. The festival serves as a platform for agricultural awareness and the promotion of local honey products, aiming to strengthen collaboration, provide marketing opportunities, elevate product quality, and encourage investment in agriculture and beekeeping. It aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 goals to support productive sectors and empower small-scale producers, featuring over 45 booths, including a "Young Beekeeper" section for children.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s regional branch

records.title: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center) has launched the "BugVape" Applicati...
records.description: The National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center) has launched the "BugVape" Application Project in Saudi Arabia, an innovative technology adopted by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) for the early detection of red palm weevil infestations. This project, part of a regional management program in the NENA region, aims to strengthen efforts against the destructive pest by enabling early detection that significantly outperforms traditional visual inspections. The Weqaa Center plans to expand the application of this technology through strategic local and international partnerships, following final evaluations.
records.institution: National Center for the Prevention and Control of Plant Pests and Animal Diseases (Weqaa Center)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Liwa Ajman Dates and Honey Festival, in its 10th edition, was opened by the Crown Prince of Ajman and Chairman of Ajman Executive Cou...
records.description: The Liwa Ajman Dates and Honey Festival, in its 10th edition, was opened by the Crown Prince of Ajman and Chairman of Ajman Executive Council, reflecting the legacy of the late Sheikh Zayed bin Sultan Al Nahyan in strengthening national identity and Emirati heritage. Organized by the Ajman Department of Tourism Development (ADTD) at the Emirates Hospitality Centre, the festival showcases dates, honey, and fruits from producers across the UAE, GCC, and Arab world, including Saudi Arabia, Oman, Jordan, and Egypt. The event aims to promote Ajman's cultural legacy, enhance its identity, and boost its reputation as a cultural and tourism destination, while also supporting sustainable development and innovation in local agriculture.

records.title: Algiers has witnessed the signing of initial contracts worth over USD 500 million for the first phase of Baladna Algeria's integrated agr...
records.description: Algiers has witnessed the signing of initial contracts worth over USD 500 million for the first phase of Baladna Algeria's integrated agri-industrial project, a USD 3.5 billion investment aimed at powdered milk production. Baladna Algeria is a joint-stock company formed through a partnership between Baladna Q.P.S.C. and Algeria’s National Investment Fund. The ceremony was attended by various Algerian Ministers (Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries; Environment and Quality of Life; Industry; Water Resources; Labor; and representatives from Foreign Affairs and Vocational Training and Education), along with officials from the National Investment Promotion Agency, the National Dairy Office, national banks, and representatives from Baladna Q.P.S.C. and contracting companies.

records.title: Egypt's agricultural exports have achieved a significant milestone, surpassing 6.2 million tons by mid-July, an increase attributed to th...
records.description: Egypt's agricultural exports have achieved a significant milestone, surpassing 6.2 million tons by mid-July, an increase attributed to the country’s rising global competitiveness and national export strategy. The Ministry of Agriculture reported citrus fruits as the leading export, followed by potatoes, onions, grapes, and sweet potatoes, with diversification into other crops. The Ministry has also opened eight new markets, attributing this success to the combined efforts of farmers, producers, exporters, and national regulatory bodies. The Plant Quarantine Authority, central laboratories, and international cooperation are highlighted for ensuring compliance with global standards, with Kuwait’s Public Authority for Food and Nutrition expressing confidence in Egypt’s export protocols.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq announced the successful mangrove cultivation along the Shatt al-Arab coastline in Basra province.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq announced the successful mangrove cultivation along the Shatt al-Arab coastline in Basra province. Led by the Basra Directorate of Agriculture with full Ministry support, the initiative involved transplanting over 1,000 mangrove trees. This project is expected to deliver significant environmental benefits, including coastal erosion protection, enhanced marine biodiversity, fish conservation, expanded green spaces, environmental improvement, and a reduction in climate change impacts.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq convened a committee meeting in Diwaniyah Governorate to ensure the stability of live and slaughtered...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq convened a committee meeting in Diwaniyah Governorate to ensure the stability of live and slaughtered chicken and local table egg prices. The committee assessed current market prices against production costs, finding them stable, and issued recommendations to guarantee the availability of high-quality products at competitive prices, while emphasizing continuous market price monitoring. The meeting included representatives from the Ministry's Office of the Undersecretary, Animal Production Department, Marketing and Price Control Department (within the Planning and Follow-up Department), and the Department of Animal Wealth, alongside representatives from the Ministries of Finance, Trade, and Higher Education and Scientific Research.

records.title: The Municipal Council’s Technical Committee in Kuwait has approved Kuwait Flour Mills and Bakeries Company (KFMB) to expand its operation...
records.description: The Municipal Council’s Technical Committee in Kuwait has approved Kuwait Flour Mills and Bakeries Company (KFMB) to expand its operational scope across all bakery locations. This strategic move allows KFMB to offer a wider range of food and beverage services, including retail sales of all manufactured products, hot and cold beverages, pies, pastries, sweets, and the operation of various bakery styles. The approval also permits the use of designated areas for manufacturing and storing industrial products, though it is contingent upon clearances from the Ministry of Finance, the Public Authority for Industry, and other relevant regulatory bodies. The decision supports Kuwait's urban development goals and the company's commitment to consumer preferences.
records.institution: Kuwait Flour Mills and Bakeries Company (KFMB)

records.title: Morocco, represented by its Minister of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry, participated in the s...
records.description: Morocco, represented by its Minister of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forestry, participated in the second United Nations Food Systems Summit (UNFSS+4) in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Amid intensifying global crises, Morocco emphasized the urgent need for a just, resilient, sustainable, and inclusive transformation of food systems, based on participatory governance, environmentally friendly agriculture, accessible food, and the promotion of local knowledge and innovation. The Kingdom of Morocco highlighted its strategic vision and concrete initiatives, such as the "Generation Green 2020-2030" strategy, aligning with Sustainable Development Goals.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Minister of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests presided over the opening of the 10th edition o...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests presided over the opening of the 10th edition of the Regional Exhibition of Oriental Local Products in Saïdia. Organized under the aegis of the Ministry and supported by the Association of the Rural Family House Beni Znassen, in partnership with the Regional Directorate of Agriculture of the Oriental, the Regional Chamber of Agriculture, and the Regional Directorate of the Agricultural Council, this event promotes local products as an economic, social, and cultural lever. The exhibition, which hosts 300 exhibitors from agricultural cooperatives across Morocco on a 3,000 m² covered area, aligns with the "Green Generation" strategy's Regional Agricultural Plan and contributes to strengthening the social and solidarity economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: The prefecture of Oujda-Angad is seeing a series of development projects covering agriculture, social infrastructure, and road networks.
records.description: The prefecture of Oujda-Angad is seeing a series of development projects covering agriculture, social infrastructure, and road networks. The Provincial Directorate of Agriculture is leading an initiative to create 11 sprouted barley production units to support animal production. Separately, as part of the National Initiative for Human Development (INDH), social projects are being launched, including the expansion of the "Dar Attadamoun" center and the construction of a reception center for cancer patients. Finally, the Ministry of Equipment and Water and the General Directorate of Local Authorities are overseeing several road projects to improve traffic flow, integrate border areas, and enhance the region's overall infrastructure. The collective initiatives aim to modernize the region and strengthen its social and economic fabric.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine, through its Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, distributed fencing and supplies...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine, through its Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, distributed fencing and supplies to 8 model plots, totaling 40 dunums, as part of the "Greening Palestine" project. This project, funded by the Ministry of Finance of the Palestinian government, aims to introduce high-economic-return varieties like almonds, citrus, and grapes, grown strategically to bridge the gap between local production and consumption.
