The fencing intends to bolster farmers' resilience, protect their land, and enhance crop quality and productivity. These actions are a priority of the Food Security Initiative approved by the Ministry of Agriculture, which emphasizes implementing agricultural initiatives to support farmers' resilience and achieve agricultural self-sufficiency in Palestine.

records.title: In Saudi Arabia's Najran Region, over 500,000 palm trees cultivate more than 40,000 tons of high-quality dates annually, including Najran...
records.description: In Saudi Arabia's Najran Region, over 500,000 palm trees cultivate more than 40,000 tons of high-quality dates annually, including Najran Rothana, Shishi, Barhi, Medjool, and local specialties like Al-Bayad and Al-Mawakil, significantly contributing to the local market and regional economic activity. The area's moderate climate and fertile soil enhance date quality. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture actively supports palm tree cultivation, ensuring product quality and effective marketing, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 to increase local agricultural output, ensure food security, and promote sustainable agriculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Three specialized laboratories from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region are providing quality s...
records.description: Three specialized laboratories from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region are providing quality services to farmers at the ongoing Khairat Al-Jouf Festival in Sakaka. These include a pesticide residue laboratory with a portable testing device for immediate, on-site results; a soil and water testing laboratory offering comprehensive analysis for optimal agricultural practices; and an olive oil quality testing laboratory conducting precise acidity assessments. These services aim to ensure product quality and adherence to approved standards.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's branch in Al-Jouf Region

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the second review meeting for the United Nations Food Systems Summit +4 in Addis Ababa, Ethio...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the second review meeting for the United Nations Food Systems Summit +4 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The meeting's purpose was to assess progress in the global and regional transformation of food systems. It also aimed to enhance multilateral partnerships and mobilize investments to accelerate the implementation of the 2030 Sustainable Development Goals.

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) in the UAE has launched the MUSTADEEM program as part of the 'Year of Community',...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) in the UAE has launched the MUSTADEEM program as part of the 'Year of Community', aiming to develop youth skills in environment and sustainability. This first edition, targeting Emirati youth aged 13-16, is organized in partnership with Silal, an agricultural food and technology company, and the International Centre for Biosaline Agriculture (ICBA). The program offers specialized workshops in areas like soil and water laboratory, post-harvest laboratory, and crop health, alongside professional safety awareness. It seeks to shape future sustainability leaders in agriculture and the environment, foster innovation in food security, and enhance participants' readiness for the job market by empowering them with research, analytical, and teamwork skills.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Iraq's wheat production has significantly declined to 5.12 million tons in 2025, largely due to a severe summer drought, reduced rainfall...
records.description: Iraq's wheat production has significantly declined to 5.12 million tons in 2025, largely due to a severe summer drought, reduced rainfall, and upstream water restrictions from Turkey and Iran. This comes despite the Ministry of Agriculture declaring wheat self-sufficiency for the third consecutive year, a claim critics argue masks underlying vulnerabilities and devastating losses for farmers in regions like Mosul and Nineveh. The United Nations ranks Iraq as highly vulnerable to climate change, and the World Resources Institute places it among nations facing extreme water stress, as the country uses over 80% of its available water without formal water-sharing agreements with its neighbors.

records.title: The Abu Ghraib Research Station, operating under the Agricultural Research Department of the Ministry of Agriculture, has initiated its a...
records.description: The Abu Ghraib Research Station, operating under the Agricultural Research Department of the Ministry of Agriculture, has initiated its agricultural plan for the fall season. This plan focuses on enhancing strategic crop productivity, particularly yellow and white corn, through improved genetic compositions and the application of drip irrigation to conserve water resources, a crucial measure given current water scarcity. The Ministry of Agriculture highlights the Agricultural Research Department's past successes, such as achieving wheat self-sufficiency, as evidence of how advanced research and technology contribute to local production and sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq announced that the Sidra Model Nursery, supported by the Ministry, is a major producer of ornamental...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq announced that the Sidra Model Nursery, supported by the Ministry, is a major producer of ornamental and shade plants in Basra Governorate. Located in the Al-Siba/Al-Saihan sub-district of Al-Faw District, this nursery is one of Basra's largest, covering 17,500 square meters and managed entirely by local workers. It supplies other nurseries in the governorate with over 180 varieties of imported and locally produced indoor and shade plants, utilizing modern techniques. The Ministry of Agriculture provides the land and grants licenses and approvals for plants suitable for the Iraqi environment through its Horticulture Department. The nursery also incorporates other agricultural and animal projects, with its operations overseen by the Basra Agriculture Directorate.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Department in Iraq has initiated precautionary veterinary health measures across all governorate...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Department in Iraq has initiated precautionary veterinary health measures across all governorates to curb the spread of foot-and-mouth disease, prompted by Turkey's closure of its animal markets due to an outbreak. These measures involve heightened epidemiological surveillance, restricting animal and product movement from Turkey at all border crossings, and sterilizing vehicles. Veterinary hospitals in specific governorates are directed to increase surveillance and immediate reporting of suspected cases, while animal movement within all governorates is restricted without a veterinary health certificate, and samples are sent to the Central Department of Veterinary Laboratories and Research.

records.title: The Sultanate of Oman, represented by its Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, is participating in the second United N...
records.description: The Sultanate of Oman, represented by its Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, is participating in the second United Nations Food Systems Summit (UNFSS+4) in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. Jointly organized by the governments of Ethiopia and Italy, the summit aims to review global progress in transforming food systems to align with the 2030 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). The gathering seeks to enhance joint action, assess national and international efforts, and mobilize resources to establish comprehensive, sustainable, and resilient food systems that ensure food security and nutrition for all.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine, through its Undersecretary, inaugurated a specialized training workshop on "Climate data analys...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine, through its Undersecretary, inaugurated a specialized training workshop on "Climate data analysis and its impact on the agricultural sector." This workshop is a component of the "Enhancing Planning and Adoption Capacities for Climate-Resilient Agriculture in Palestine" project, which is fully implemented in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), supported by the Green Climate Fund (GCF), and conducted in effective partnership with the Environment Quality Authority and the Palestinian Meteorological Authority.

records.title: The Syrian Ministry of Trade and Economy issued a decision banning the import of a number of products through August 2025 (mostly vegetab...
records.description: The Syrian Ministry of Trade and Economy issued a decision banning the import of a number of products through August 2025 (mostly vegetables and food products).
records.institution: Syrian Ministry of Trade and Economy

records.title: The Ministry of Trade and Export Development in Tunisia has launched an exceptional program to address recent supply tensions and improve...
records.description: The Ministry of Trade and Export Development in Tunisia has launched an exceptional program to address recent supply tensions and improve the national supply of coffee. The program, which came into effect following a meeting of regional directors, establishes a new distribution strategy. This strategy includes weekly allocations through a digital application managed by the Tunisian Trade Office, additional volumes for participating roasting units, and direct allocations to large commercial areas to increase availability. The ministry has invited smaller roasting units to join the system, which is part of a broader effort to ensure regular supply, market stability, and meet consumer needs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Trade and Export Development

records.title: Tunisia is positioning itself as a gateway to global agricultural opportunities by increasing wheat imports and modernizing its infrastru...
records.description: Tunisia is positioning itself as a gateway to global agricultural opportunities by increasing wheat imports and modernizing its infrastructure, a structural shift driven by domestic production constraints, geopolitical realignments in suppliers (favoring Russia and Ukraine over the EU), and significant investments in storage and logistics. The country's growing reliance on imports, particularly for wheat and barley, is creating ripple effects in global markets, attracting interest from international grain traders and logistics companies. Supported by a government grain purchase program and a World Bank loan for the Emergency Food Security Response Project, Tunisia aims to mitigate water challenges and become a regional grain transshipment hub, with UkrAgroConsult highlighting its strategic importance for investors in barley, infrastructure, and diversified grain supply chains.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) hosted a delegation from Shell to discuss Shell's "Energy Security Scenarios" report, which...
records.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) hosted a delegation from Shell to discuss Shell's "Energy Security Scenarios" report, which explores AI's impact on global energy systems. DEWA showcased its pioneering clean energy projects, including the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, aiming for a significant capacity by 2030, and its new headquarters, the Al Shera'a building, designed to be the tallest and largest net-positive energy government building. DEWA also highlighted its remarkable achievements in adopting AI, aiming to become the world's first AI-native utility, and its global leadership in low electricity and water network losses and customer minutes lost.

records.title: The Zabid Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association has launched a community-led initiative in Wadi Rama’, Al-Hodeidah, to rehabi...
records.description: The Zabid Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association has launched a community-led initiative in Wadi Rama’, Al-Hodeidah, to rehabilitate 14 main and secondary irrigation canals. This effort, supported by the Provincial Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, aims to revive the agricultural infrastructure in the area, which has suffered from years of neglect. The initiative is part of a broader effort to enhance food security and expand arable land, and has been praised by local authorities for demonstrating effective cooperation between communities and officials in serving the agricultural sector and improving livelihoods.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries and six public banks in Algeria have signed agreements to finance the constr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries and six public banks in Algeria have signed agreements to finance the construction of small and medium-sized refrigerated structures for farmers. This financing mechanism, called "Tabrid," provides an interest-free investment credit of up to 150 million DA with a repayment period of up to 10 years. The initiative, which is a joint effort with the Ministry of Finance, aims to strengthen the storage capacity for agricultural products, improve market balance, and stabilize prices by allowing farmers to store surplus products. It aligns with the government's broader strategy to support farmers and encourage investment in the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development, and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Guidance and Training and in cooperation with the Basra Agriculture D...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Guidance and Training and in cooperation with the Basra Agriculture Directorate, organized a training course entitled "Date Palms and Environmental Pollution." Hosted at the Guidance and Training Center in Basra, with 30 employees participating, the course covered the environmental and health importance of date palms, their role in combating desertification, soil stabilization, and climate improvement, as well as cultivation challenges like climate change, increased water salinity, and pest proliferation. It also addressed types of environmental pollution and their impact on agriculture and humans, and methods to reduce pollution through tree planting, clean energy, and environmental legislation.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Northern Borders Region is undertaking a national excellence project for ani...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Northern Borders Region is undertaking a national excellence project for animal research and disease control, spanning over 17,000 square meters and budgeted at SAR 29,636,570. This initiative aims to enhance veterinary security and the veterinary sector by improving diagnostic services and research capabilities through specialized facilities including laboratories, animal pens, and administrative buildings. The project's overarching goal is to foster an advanced scientific environment, improve transboundary animal disease control, strengthen food security and animal health, and contribute to the objectives of Saudi Vision 2030 for sustainable agricultural and environmental development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The integration of family farming, which constitutes 80% of the agricultural sector, into the 2026/2030 development plan is crucial for l...
records.description: The integration of family farming, which constitutes 80% of the agricultural sector, into the 2026/2030 development plan is crucial for leveraging international cooperation funding, according to the general coordinator of the "United Nations Decade of Family Farming (UNDFF)" program. Professional organizations and agricultural experts are advocating for the government to include family farming in the development plan to access funding from various UN organizations, such as the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), which already provides technical support to this agricultural segment through existing programs.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The 9th Al Dhaid Date Festival, held at Expo Al Dhaid, saw record participation from leading date producers and palm farmers across the UAE.
records.description: The 9th Al Dhaid Date Festival, held at Expo Al Dhaid, saw record participation from leading date producers and palm farmers across the UAE. Organized by the Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI), the festival showcased innovative sustainable farming technologies, including modern agricultural mechanization and AI-driven processes, alongside the preservation of traditional practices. The event served as a commercial and marketing platform for technology transfer among farmers, emphasizing product excellence and innovation's role in food security and sustainable development. Notable participants like Al-Washah Dates Farm and Al-Fahd Dates Farm highlighted premium local date varieties and strategic investments in downstream industries, respectively. Young farmers also presented inspiring success stories, reflecting the UAE's efforts to empower youth in agriculture. Participating farmers praised the consistent support from the Sharjah Chamber.
records.institution: Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.title: The Bulgarian government has approved a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Bulgaria's Ministry of Agriculture and Food and Iraq's...
records.description: The Bulgarian government has approved a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between Bulgaria's Ministry of Agriculture and Food and Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture. This agreement, reported by the Bulgarian News Agency (BTA), aims to deepen bilateral cooperation in agriculture and food production. The MoU outlines joint activities such as seminars, training programs, knowledge exchange, and technology transfer, with key focus areas including innovations in crop and livestock farming, fisheries, aquaculture, and strengthening technical and administrative capacity in both countries. This partnership seeks to lay the groundwork for a more active collaboration, enhance trade in agricultural and food products, and facilitate joint projects of mutual interest.

records.title: The Department of Forests and Desertification in Iraq has discussed mechanisms for implementing a joint research project under the #Arab...
records.description: The Department of Forests and Desertification in Iraq has discussed mechanisms for implementing a joint research project under the #Arab Alliances for Scientific Research and Innovation Initiative, sponsored by the Union of Arab Scientific Research Councils. The project, which includes a research team from Iraq, Egypt, and Jordan, aims to address challenges related to the impacts of climate change on agricultural livestock production. The meeting focused on the scientific and organizational aspects of the project and cooperation mechanisms among the participating parties to achieve common goals.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its General Administration of Plant Protection and Quarantine, held a workshop as part of the Plant...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its General Administration of Plant Protection and Quarantine, held a workshop as part of the Plant Health Project, implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO). The three-day workshop focused on pest risk analysis, early warning systems, agricultural pest survey and monitoring mechanisms, and standard operating procedures for important pests. It targeted plant protection inspectors from agricultural directorates at the governorate level, plant protection laboratory staff, and directors of technical departments from the General Administration of Plant Protection and Agricultural Quarantine.

records.title: Saudi Arabia's agricultural sector is experiencing a successful summer fruit harvest, with watermelon production exceeding 610,000 tons a...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's agricultural sector is experiencing a successful summer fruit harvest, with watermelon production exceeding 610,000 tons and demonstrating high demand in local markets. The diverse and high-quality watermelon varieties, such as Charleston Gray, Klondike R7, Congo, Royal Sweet, and Crimson Round, are integral to various food processing industries like juices, ice creams, and candies. This successful harvest aligns with Saudi Arabia's vision for food security and self-sufficiency, supporting the national economy. The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture actively empowers farmers through technical guidance, financial facilitation, and the promotion of modern agricultural technologies, while also supporting supply chains and marketing programs to ensure national products reach consumers efficiently and enhance their economic impact.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Qatif Governorate office of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia commemorated the International Day for...
records.description: The Qatif Governorate office of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia commemorated the International Day for the Conservation of the Mangrove Ecosystem with a field visit to the Ras Tanura Mangrove Eco-Park. The event included participation from the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) and local beekeepers. This participation was part of a ministry initiative to promote the responsible economic use of mangrove resources and to showcase locally produced mangrove honey. The Ras Tanura Mangrove Eco-Park is significant as the Kingdom’s first nature reserve specifically dedicated to mangrove forests, classified as an organic nature reserve due to its rich biodiversity and balanced coastal ecosystem, making it a vital component of the national environmental protection system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: UN-Water has recognized the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia as a global model for best practices in accelerating progress towards Sustainable Dev...
records.description: UN-Water has recognized the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia as a global model for best practices in accelerating progress towards Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6), which focuses on water. This announcement was made during the High-Level Political Forum on Sustainable Development (HLPF) at the United Nations headquarters in New York. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture represented the Kingdom, sharing insights on enhancing water security and sustainability in a water-scarce region. Key lessons included the importance of strong political commitment, clear strategies with measurable targets, effective use of innovation and data for improved water governance, private sector engagement, and robust international partnerships.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Dubai Municipality is participating in the Dubai Dates Festival to showcase its advanced laboratory services, agricultural initiatives, a...
records.description: Dubai Municipality is participating in the Dubai Dates Festival to showcase its advanced laboratory services, agricultural initiatives, and food safety programs, while also promoting environmental sustainability. This involvement highlights the Municipality's dedication to supporting national products and fostering a sustainable food ecosystem. The Dubai Central Laboratory will conduct daily on-site testing of date samples using its Mobile Food Testing Lab, ensuring rapid analysis and adherence to international safety standards. The Municipality will also present its agricultural programs that support local farmers through education and sustainable practices, emphasizing productivity enhancement and environmental impact reduction. Furthermore, it will showcase scientific pest control efforts, particularly against the red palm weevil, offering live demonstrations, expert consultations, and information on tissue culture techniques and free home palm pest control services.

records.title: The Government of Change and Development in Yemen has launched the Value Chain Management Program, a strategic initiative aimed at signif...
records.description: The Government of Change and Development in Yemen has launched the Value Chain Management Program, a strategic initiative aimed at significantly reducing import costs and achieving self-sufficiency. This program, considered vital for economic resilience and job creation, particularly in rural and urban areas, is built on a national vision leveraging Yemen's potential, with success dependent on genuine partnerships between the government, private sector, and community. The Ministry of Administration and Local and Rural Development plays a pivotal coordinating role, mobilizing community initiatives and encouraging local authority participation.
records.institution: The Ministries of Economy, Industry and Investment

records.title: Middle Egypt Flour Mills Company (CEFM) reported a net profit of US$2.33 million for the fiscal period ending May 31, 2025, marking a 5%...
records.description: Middle Egypt Flour Mills Company (CEFM) reported a net profit of US$2.33 million for the fiscal period ending May 31, 2025, marking a 5% increase year-over-year, despite significant challenges such as currency devaluation, rising energy prices, and higher logistics costs impacting the milling sector. As a company operating across the grain value chain, CEFM plays a crucial role in Egypt's bread subsidy program, which benefits over 70 million Egyptians. The company maintains steady contracts with the General Authority for Supply Commodities (GASC), contributing to Egypt’s strategic food reserves. The broader milling sector in Egypt is undergoing reforms led by the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade, focusing on tighter quality controls and improved extraction rates to reduce waste and subsidy leaks, aligning with the government’s strategy to enhance bread subsidy program efficiency and encourage private investment in grain storage and logistics infrastructure.

records.title: Iraq has acquired agricultural drones from a private Iranian manufacturer as part of its strategy to boost domestic food production and r...
records.description: Iraq has acquired agricultural drones from a private Iranian manufacturer as part of its strategy to boost domestic food production and reduce imports. These drones, intended for tasks like monitoring, pesticide spraying, irrigation expansion, production reporting, and seed spraying in arable areas, are expected to support farming development by expanding cultivated areas and saving time and labor. This move aligns with Iraq's broader post-conflict reconstruction and development efforts across various sectors, while its trade relations with Iran continue to expand, with plans to significantly increase two-way trade.

records.title: Iraq has begun construction on its first large-scale seawater desalination plant in Basra, a crucial $4 billion project aimed at tackling...
records.description: Iraq has begun construction on its first large-scale seawater desalination plant in Basra, a crucial $4 billion project aimed at tackling severe water scarcity in the southern region. This venture is a joint development between Baghdad-based Al-Ridha Group and Chinese state-owned PowerChina. The project, long-delayed, will feature three parallel desalination lines, each with a capacity of 335,000 cubic meters per day, and includes 12 local water storage tanks, nine distribution stations, and a 240 km pipeline system across the Basra governorate. A dedicated 300-megawatt power generation station will also be built to support the plant, which is expected to create around 3,500 jobs in Basra.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: A new agricultural plastic recycling plant has been inaugurated in Deir Alla, Jordan, as a collaborative effort between the Ministry of I...
records.description: A new agricultural plastic recycling plant has been inaugurated in Deir Alla, Jordan, as a collaborative effort between the Ministry of Interior, the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), and funded by the European Union. Developed in partnership with the New Deir Alla Municipality, this initiative aims to tackle agricultural plastic waste, create economic opportunities, and foster entrepreneurship in local communities by serving as a sustainable business model. The plant will establish a reliable market for recycled agricultural plastics and is a flagship project under Jordan's green growth strategy, promoting improved solid waste systems and paving the way for future public-private partnerships.
records.source: Jordan's minister inaugurates agricultural plastic recycling plant in Deir Alla

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon, through its Directorate of Studies and Coordination and in cooperation with the Directorate of Ag...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon, through its Directorate of Studies and Coordination and in cooperation with the Directorate of Agricultural Resources, organized a guidance seminar on "Rationalizing Irrigation Water Use in Light of Climate Change" at the Alwaleed Bin Talal Hall in Beirut. Part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, the seminar aimed to strengthen the capacities of technical personnel and agricultural workers by addressing the impacts of climate change on Lebanese agriculture, specifically the decline in rainfall and water resources. The seminar assessed agricultural water needs under future climate projections and reviewed modern practices for water conservation, including adjusting water quantities, optimizing irrigation timing, enhancing irrigation system efficiency, improving soil quality, and managing fertilizers. It also explored alternative water resources such as rainwater harvesting, mountain ponds, and the reuse of treated wastewater.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Qassim Fruits Exhibition has opened in Buraidah, organized by the Qassim Principality and the Qassim Chamber.
records.description: The Qassim Fruits Exhibition has opened in Buraidah, organized by the Qassim Principality and the Qassim Chamber. The three-day event showcases the diverse seasonal produce of the Qassim Region, including watermelons, cantaloupes, strawberries, grapes, pomegranates, peaches, figs, and over 150 varieties of pumpkins, some weighing more than 500 kilograms. The exhibition also features live cooking demonstrations, product tastings, and educational booths aimed at promoting agricultural knowledge and enriching food culture.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department and specifically the Nineveh Research Department at the Rashidi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department and specifically the Nineveh Research Department at the Rashidiya Research Station, has completed the harvest of the "greengold" variety of jit as part of its fodder seed multiplication and processing program. This initiative falls under the Ministry's advanced scientific plan to multiply local fodder seeds and develop their varieties, supporting both plant and animal agricultural sectors. The jit crop is highlighted as a strategic, climate-change-resistant crop, demonstrating success with fixed sprinkler irrigation and adaptability to various environments, with moderate climates being optimal for its production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is intensifying preventive veterinary health measures in anticipation of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, is intensifying preventive veterinary health measures in anticipation of the upcoming Arbaeen pilgrimage. This action is crucial to mitigate the increase of hemorrhagic fever cases and safeguard the health of citizens and visitors. A comprehensive preventive plan is being implemented, which includes providing veterinary pesticides to eliminate the primary vector of the hemorrhagic fever virus and equipping veterinary hospitals and clinics with essential medicines and vaccines, notably the foot-and-mouth disease vaccine.

records.title: A national campaign to reduce forest fires, operating under the slogan "#Don't_Play_with_Fire," has been launched from the headquarters o...
records.description: A national campaign to reduce forest fires, operating under the slogan "#Don't_Play_with_Fire," has been launched from the headquarters of the National Council for Scientific Research in Beirut. This strategic initiative, involving the Ministry of Environment, Ministry of Agriculture, and a representative from the Ministry of Interior and Municipalities, aims to move beyond seasonal responses to a permanent battle against fires, which are increasingly threatening Lebanon's environmental and cultural identity. The campaign adopts a scientific and practical approach, including clearing dry biomass for compost, developing early warning networks based on National Council for Scientific Research forecasts, raising community awareness, enforcing laws against violators, and activating the role of municipalities and local associations. It integrates with the Ministry of Environment's Forest Fire Risk Management Project and utilizes the National Council for Scientific Research's integrated early warning system with daily risk assessment bulletins and post-fire environmental assessments.

records.title: A new agricultural products collection center is being developed in the Masroon area of Ibra, North Sharqiyah, Oman, with funding exceedi...
records.description: A new agricultural products collection center is being developed in the Masroon area of Ibra, North Sharqiyah, Oman, with funding exceeding RO300,000 from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund. This facility, spanning 42,000 square meters, will serve as a logistics hub for receiving, storing, and distributing seasonal produce, aiming to enhance local farming output, improve market access, and add value to products while ensuring quality standards for both local and export markets. The center will feature modern storage, sorting and packaging facilities, sales outlets, and display spaces for fresh produce.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has launched a project to rebuild and modernize the fish market in Al...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has launched a project to rebuild and modernize the fish market in Al Saffala, Ibra, North Sharqiyah. This initiative aims to boost seafood trade and improve market infrastructure for fish across the governorate. The existing market, one of the oldest in the governorate, currently handles approximately 1,250 tonnes of fish annually. The new, climate-controlled facility, spanning 2,081 square meters and fully funded by the Ministry at a cost of RO50,000, is slated for completion in the second quarter of 2026. It will include 12 fish display platforms, an ice-making unit, a waiting area, and other public utilities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Agricultural Aid and Insurance Sector at the Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine, through its General Administration of Agricultural...
records.description: The Agricultural Aid and Insurance Sector at the Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine, through its General Administration of Agricultural Insurance, has conducted a series of specialized awareness workshops in the Tubas and Jenin governorates. These workshops, part of the "Building Agricultural Insurance Systems and Services" project, are funded by the European Union and implemented in cooperation with Oxfam and the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development. The initiative aims to raise awareness among farmers about the importance of agricultural insurance as a protective tool against natural and economic risks. The workshops provided detailed explanations of the insurance products designed by the Ministry, covering greenhouse tomatoes, open-field grapes, and broiler poultry farms, along with comprehensive information on covered risks and policy terms, emphasizing insurance's role in strengthening farmers' resilience and achieving sustainable agricultural production.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Syria is currently facing a severe agricultural crisis due to an unprecedented drought, climate change, chronic environmental degradation...
records.description: Syria is currently facing a severe agricultural crisis due to an unprecedented drought, climate change, chronic environmental degradation, and the prolonged effects of war, threatening millions with food insecurity. This year has seen a drastic collapse in crop production, especially wheat, leading to competition for limited produce between the official government and the Autonomous Administration in North and East Syria (AANES). The crisis, driven by declining rainfall, groundwater levels, and resource mismanagement, highlights the need for urgent national action and sustainable policies. Agricultural officials emphasize the importance of adopting modern irrigation projects and climate-smart agriculture to mitigate future damage and ensure food security, as farming has become a high-risk venture for many.
records.institution: Autonomous Administration in North and East Syria (AANES)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has issued two warning statements based on climate forecasts from t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has issued two warning statements based on climate forecasts from the National Institute of Meteorology (INM). The first alert instructs grain collection companies to take all necessary precautions against anticipated scattered rains and local storms to protect collected grain and adhere to open-air storage guidelines. It also calls upon regional delegations for agricultural development and cereal offices to monitor preparations and provide technical support. The second statement, in response to an ongoing heat wave, urges all farmers, breeders, and those involved in animal production chains to implement preventive measures to mitigate heat effects on livestock (including ruminants, camelids, poultry, rabbits, and bees) and ensure animal welfare during transport and breeding.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Agricultural Guidance and Training Department, specifically its Guidance Center/Explanation Farm in Al-Hamdaniya District, Nineveh Go...
records.description: The Agricultural Guidance and Training Department, specifically its Guidance Center/Explanation Farm in Al-Hamdaniya District, Nineveh Governorate, recently organized a field day focused on "The Importance of Dipping Sheep and Goats to Combat External Parasites." This awareness event, conducted in cooperation with the Veterinary Clinic and the Agricultural Division in Al-Hamdaniya, along with the Local Union of Agricultural Associations, educated 41 livestock breeders and agricultural cadres. The program included a lecture on external parasites, their transmission, and associated diseases, emphasizing the use of dipping basins for prevention and demonstrating the dipping process. This activity is part of the Ministry's broader efforts to enhance breeder efficiency and promote preventive health care for livestock.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Jordan has lifted restrictions on poultry meat imports from Brazil, having previously imposed them due to...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Jordan has lifted restrictions on poultry meat imports from Brazil, having previously imposed them due to avian influenza concerns. This decision was made after technical teams at the Ministry closely monitored health developments and presumably received satisfactory reports, likely from entities like the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH). Jordan typically imports between 8,000 and 10,000 tons of frozen chicken from Brazil annually. The Ministry reiterated its commitment to taking necessary actions to protect public health and the agricultural sector, in line with its policy of safeguarding animal wealth, public health, and food security.

records.title: Kuwait's Public Authority for Food and Nutrition (PAFN) has implemented new trade measures for poultry meat imports due to avian influenz...
records.description: Kuwait's Public Authority for Food and Nutrition (PAFN) has implemented new trade measures for poultry meat imports due to avian influenza concerns. Following a recommendation by the Supreme Committee for Food and Water Security, the existing ban on poultry imports from Brazil has been lifted for all categories of poultry meat, as Brazil has been declared free of bird flu. Conversely, PAFN has imposed a new ban on poultry imports from several regions in the United States due to fresh outbreaks of the virus. These adjustments, reported by the Kuwaiti News Agency (KUNA), reflect Kuwait's ongoing efforts to ensure domestic food safety while maintaining reliable sources for the 70% of its poultry demand met by imports. In 2023, Kuwait imported poultry meat worth US$364 million, with Brazil being the top supplier.
records.institution: Public Authority for Food and Nutrition (PAFN)

records.title: Tetra Pak Egypt Area, in collaboration with Zulfa, a subsidiary of the Alushibe Group, has completed and delivered Libya's first 1 MW sol...
records.description: Tetra Pak Egypt Area, in collaboration with Zulfa, a subsidiary of the Alushibe Group, has completed and delivered Libya's first 1 MW solar power plant in Kufra, marking Tetra Pak's first greenfield initiative in the Libyan market. The state-of-the-art facility, spanning 140,000 square meters, is set to commence operations in early 2026, initially focusing on milk and juice products. This US$16 million investment aims to enhance Libya’s food supply chain and meet growing consumer demand by introducing advanced, fully integrated processing and packaging systems, including mixing systems, ultra-high-temperature (UHT) processing, pasteurization units, and three production and filling lines in its first phase.

records.title: Morocco's cucumber exports are achieving historic growth, positioning the country as a leading player in European markets.
records.description: Morocco's cucumber exports are achieving historic growth, positioning the country as a leading player in European markets. Data from EastFruit indicates that in the first ten months of the current marketing year, Morocco exported 27,700 tonnes of cucumbers, generating over $26.3 million, setting a new national record for the sixth consecutive year with an average annual growth rate of 32%. Shipments are now year-round, with a peak of 5,900 tonnes in January. Spain remains the primary market, accounting for 57% of exports, with Portugal showing spectacular 17-fold growth in imports over four years. The UK retains second place, while Italy and the Netherlands are emerging markets. This boom is partly driven by severe drought in Southern Europe, reinforcing Morocco's role as a reliable supplier due to its continuous production capabilities despite national water constraints.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) have signed the initial ag...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) have signed the initial agricultural investment grant agreements for the second phase of the Multi-Donor Agribusiness Programme (MAP2). This first phase includes 20 agreements for innovative agricultural projects in the West Bank, totaling $1.8 million, out of an anticipated 350 agreements with overall funding of $11 million. The program is supported by the governments of Denmark, the European Union, Switzerland, and Spain, with additional parallel funding from the Italian government. MAP2 aims to boost agricultural production, enhance value chains, support food processing, and promote sustainable water and energy management, while creating approximately 1,500 direct and over 3,000 indirect job opportunities, with a significant focus on empowering women and youth (45% participation).

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine has signed a financing agreement for the "Sumoud" agricultural project with the Bayt Mal Al-Quds...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Palestine has signed a financing agreement for the "Sumoud" agricultural project with the Bayt Mal Al-Quds Agency, aiming to support 250 farmers in Jerusalem and its suburbs. This initiative, which is part of a series of programs directed by the King of Morocco, will involve distributing agricultural seedlings, water tanks, and veterinary kits to support livestock. The project is crucial for bolstering the steadfastness of farmers facing systematic attacks and land confiscation. A steering committee, including representatives from the Ministry of Jerusalem Affairs and the Jerusalem Governorate, will oversee the project, with on-the-ground implementation carried out by the Land Research Center, serving as the Ministry of Agriculture's operational partner.

records.title: The Ministry of Investment in Saudi Arabia is launching the Syrian-Saudi Investment Forum to strengthen bilateral economic ties with Syri...
records.description: The Ministry of Investment in Saudi Arabia is launching the Syrian-Saudi Investment Forum to strengthen bilateral economic ties with Syria, aligning with Saudi Arabia’s vision for regional integration and mutual benefit. Acting on directives, the Ministry is working to activate the private sector in both countries by facilitating cross-border partnerships, including organizing this forum and related business workshops. As part of preparations, the Ministry, in cooperation with the Federation of Saudi Chambers, is coordinating a delegation visit to Damascus involving prominent Saudi companies across various sectors. The forum is expected to feature the signing of memoranda of understanding and joint venture agreements, opening new avenues for cooperation in infrastructure, manufacturing, agriculture, and technology.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Summer Fruits Season has commenced in AlUla as part of the “Khayrat AlUla” initiative by the Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU).
records.description: The Summer Fruits Season has commenced in AlUla as part of the “Khayrat AlUla” initiative by the Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU). Held at Al Manshiyah Farmers' Market, this event showcases the region's agricultural diversity, featuring fruits like mangoes, grapes, and figs from local farmers, alongside participation from productive families. This period is significant for AlUla, producing over 4,900 tons annually from approximately 216,000 fruit-bearing trees. The Summer Fruits Season is part of the larger Khayrat AlUla series, which also includes seasons for dates, citrus fruits, and honey. These efforts align with the RCU's goals to enhance food security and develop agricultural communities, contributing to Saudi Vision 2030. The initiative also aims to empower farmers, expand marketing channels, and develop sales outlets to foster the long-term sustainability of the agricultural sector.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef), in collaboration with the National Research and Development Center f...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef), in collaboration with the National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah), has launched an innovative project utilizing tissue culture technology to boost coffee seedling production. This initiative aims to increase coffee tree productivity by 30% and plant 50,000 seedlings by the end of 2025. Significant progress includes re-evaluating genetic patterns to consolidate them into 12 genetic groups, initiating seedling production from cuttings, and developing disease-resistant and drought-tolerant varieties. The project has also produced fourteen knowledge products on advanced techniques and good agricultural practices, completed a technical review of the coffee cultivation guide, and prepared a comprehensive book on coffee resources.
records.institution: Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: An innovative "Projet Dégache" has been launched in the Dégache region of the Tozeur governorate, Tunisia, to integrate fish farming into...
records.description: An innovative "Projet Dégache" has been launched in the Dégache region of the Tozeur governorate, Tunisia, to integrate fish farming into traditional oases. Funded by the Italian association Albo and implemented by the Tunisian Wildlife Association, this initiative aims to diversify agricultural activities and promote sustainable development. The project involves using existing oasis ponds for fish farming, with the nutrient-rich water then used to irrigate date palms, improving soil fertility and reducing the need for chemical fertilizers. Six local farmers received specialized aquaculture training, and each was provided with fingerlings and equipment. The project supports participants through commercialization, focusing on the local market to ensure economic viability and reduce dependence on imported fish.

records.title: The Tunisian Wildlife Association (ATVS) has launched the Naturadex Islands platform, an innovative initiative aimed at mapping and prese...
records.description: The Tunisian Wildlife Association (ATVS) has launched the Naturadex Islands platform, an innovative initiative aimed at mapping and preserving the biodiversity of Tunisia's island wetlands. This publicly accessible online tool centralizes ecological data to bolster conservation, scientific research, and public awareness. It encourages active participation from citizens, naturalists, and local associations to enrich its database. The project receives support from partners including Notre Grand Bleu, AJEM (Jlij Association for the Marine Environment), Association Kraten in Kerkennah, Association Tipaza, The Dreamer, and the Laboratory for Diversity, Management, and Conservation of Biological Systems, with funding from the Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund (CEPF) and the PIM Initiative. Naturadex Islands seeks to become a national benchmark for island biodiversity, facilitating data access and monitoring ecosystem changes to inform management measures in the face of climate change and pollution, aligning with Tunisia's commitments under the Ramsar Convention on Wetlands and the Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD).

records.title: Tunisia has significantly increased its organic agricultural exports, with the National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI) reporting sub...
records.description: Tunisia has significantly increased its organic agricultural exports, with the National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI) reporting substantial turnover from organic products, predominantly organic olive oil and dates. Organic olive oil has seen Italy, the United States, and Spain as top importers, while Germany, the Netherlands, and Belgium lead imports of organic dates, underscoring Tunisia's reputation as a reliable supplier. The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) is supporting Tunisia's efforts to further develop this strategic sector through a territorial approach, aiming to define benchmark organic farming models adapted to different bioclimatic levels. A nationwide study has provided detailed statistics on the sector, which includes nearly 7,200 stakeholders actively seeking guidance to enhance their competitiveness and comply with evolving international organic regulations.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: A new report by the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) confirms that renewable energy sources maintained their cost leadership...
records.description: A new report by the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA) confirms that renewable energy sources maintained their cost leadership in global power markets, with solar PV and onshore wind being significantly cheaper than new fossil fuel alternatives in 2024. This cost advantage, driven by technological innovation and economies of scale, resulted in substantial avoided fossil fuel costs and reinforces renewables' role in improving energy security. While continued cost reductions are anticipated, challenges such as geopolitical shifts, trade tariffs, raw material bottlenecks, and infrastructure limitations, particularly in Europe and North America, could temporarily raise costs; however, regions like Asia, Africa, and South America are expected to see pronounced declines.

records.title: Abu Dhabi delivers ‘Climate Change Adaptation Plan for Environment Sector'
records.description: The Environment Agency – Abu Dhabi (EAD) has launched the Abu Dhabi Climate Change Adaptation Plan for the Environment Sector (2025–2050), a comprehensive, science-based roadmap to protect the emirate's natural resources from climate change impacts. This pioneering plan, the first of its kind for the emirate, is part of the broader Abu Dhabi Climate Change Strategy 2023–2027 and aligns with the UAE National Climate Change Plan 2017-2050 and the UAE Framework for Global Climate Resilience established at COP28. The plan focuses on three highly vulnerable environmental systems: groundwater, soil, and biodiversity, which are critical for human health, water security, and agricultural productivity. It outlines 142 adaptation actions to be implemented by 2050, with 86 high-priority projects set for the next five years, encompassing technical, institutional, and nature-based solutions. Developed collaboratively with over 40 government, semi-government, academic, civil society entities, and youth, the plan is designed to be dynamic, with mechanisms for periodic review and integration of new scientific findings, aiming to increase food self-sufficiency, promote sustainable land and water management, and enhance biodiversity conservation.

records.title: Hassan Allam Holding and Schneider Electric have partnered to launch a sustainable agriculture project in El-Nouras village, south of Por...
records.description: Hassan Allam Holding and Schneider Electric have partnered to launch a sustainable agriculture project in El-Nouras village, south of Port Said. This initiative aims to improve rural livelihoods and promote climate-resilient farming through smart infrastructure and renewable energy technologies, aligning with Egypt's Vision 2030 and adopting the Nexus of Water-Food-Energy (NWFE) framework. The core of the project is a solar-powered, climate-controlled greenhouse designed to produce up to 20 tons of vegetables annually, utilizing Schneider Electric's EcoStruxure platform to enhance energy and water efficiency and reduce reliance on diesel for irrigation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is reviewing a field experiment conducted by the Agricultural Research Department's Rice Research Station in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is reviewing a field experiment conducted by the Agricultural Research Department's Rice Research Station in Al-Mishkhab to evaluate new rice varieties, "Jasmine" and "Ghari," under modern irrigation systems like fixed sprinklers and drip irrigation. This initiative directly addresses the intensifying impact of climate change, specifically water shortages and the reduction of the rice cultivation plan. The experiment, part of the Higher Grade Seed Multiplication Program for Rice, tracks growth stages from planting to physiological maturity and will be repeated with modern agricultural methods.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Jordan has temporarily suspended issuing licenses for importing live sheep from the Syrian Arab Republic.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Jordan has temporarily suspended issuing licenses for importing live sheep from the Syrian Arab Republic. This decision, effective from the beginning of July, aims to safeguard local producers and support Jordanian livestock breeders by balancing the local market due to abundant domestic sheep production. The Ministry is committed to monitoring market activity and implementing flexible measures to ensure price stability, food security, and a balance between supply and demand, ultimately supporting the entire agricultural and livestock production chain. This action aligns with the broader governmental focus on enhancing national production, achieving self-sufficiency, and creating economic opportunities for rural communities.

records.title: The Lebanese Poultry Syndicate has organized a conference at the American University of Beirut (AUB) to launch the "National Poultry Sect...
records.description: The Lebanese Poultry Syndicate has organized a conference at the American University of Beirut (AUB) to launch the "National Poultry Sector Strategy." This strategy aims to ensure the sustainability of Lebanon's poultry sector, which significantly contributes to food security, employs approximately 36,000 people, and produces around 110 million birds annually. The conference emphasized the need for genuine dialogue and strategic partnership between the public and private sectors, along with academic institutions like AUB, to develop a productive, long-term economic plan. The Ministry of Agriculture highlighted its comprehensive role in developing policies, providing health and veterinary supervision, offering technical support, ensuring quality and food safety, and encouraging exports.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Infinity Libya, a subsidiary of Infinity Group, and Al-Jouf Free Zone have successfully completed and delivered Libya's first 1 MW solar...
records.description: Infinity Libya, a subsidiary of Infinity Group, and Al-Jouf Free Zone have successfully completed and delivered Libya's first 1 MW solar power plant in Kufra. The project was handed over in May, ahead of schedule, and is now fully operational, marking a significant step in Libya's renewable energy transition. Developed in collaboration with Lamsa Company for General Contracting and Real Estate Investment as the main contractor, the plant, with a planned capacity of 1.14 MWp, will produce approximately 2,182 MWh of clean electricity annually, directly supplying the Al-Jouf Free Zone. This initiative is expected to save 545,000 liters of diesel and reduce carbon emissions by around 1,300 tons annually, contributing to environmental sustainability, energy diversification, local job creation, and technical capacity building within Libya's renewable energy sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Mauritania has launched the second phase of its agricultural mechanization project, aiming to enhance prod...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Mauritania has launched the second phase of its agricultural mechanization project, aiming to enhance productivity and provide advanced services to farmers. This phase involves a four-party agreement: the Ministry of Agriculture will supply 72 agricultural tractors and accessories, along with spare parts, to regional councils. The Ministry of Youth Empowerment, Employment, Sports, and Civil Service will establish integrated workshops for maintenance services to ensure the sustainable operation of these machines. Concurrently, the Ministry Delegate to the Minister of Interior, Decentralization, and Local Development, in collaboration with the regional councils, will conduct awareness campaigns to promote optimal equipment use and ensure widespread benefit for farmers. This project aligns with the directives of the President of the Republic to boost agricultural output and continues the qualitative shift initiated by the first phase, which saw agricultural tractors become common among farmers.

records.title: The Agriculture and Fisheries Development Fund is financing an initiative to support the Omani rose harvest sector in Jabal Akhdar.
records.description: The Agriculture and Fisheries Development Fund is financing an initiative to support the Omani rose harvest sector in Jabal Akhdar. This program aims to enhance the value-added potential of the region’s distinctive rose harvest, which spans over 6,300 rose trees across more than 10 acres. The enhancements will come through improved production quality, expanded marketing and manufacturing capabilities, and farmer training specifically focused on developing products derived from rose water.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Palestinian Energy and Natural Resources Authority have discussed and agreed to enhance cooperation t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Palestinian Energy and Natural Resources Authority have discussed and agreed to enhance cooperation to support the agricultural sector through renewable energy, primarily solar power. The immediate priority is to equip agricultural wells with solar energy systems to reduce production costs and ensure continuous irrigation. This project will later expand to include other plant and animal agricultural facilities, especially those related to post-harvest technologies. Both parties will draft a memorandum of understanding and form a joint committee to determine priorities and develop an implementation plan, aligning with the Palestine Renewable Energy Strategy 2025–2030 and the Ministry of Agriculture's own strategy to enhance resilience and local production.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) is supporting farmers in Gadaref State, Sudan, with improved seeds and...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) is supporting farmers in Gadaref State, Sudan, with improved seeds and specialized training. This project, funded by Norway, aims to enhance agriculture and water management and build the capacity of farmers, particularly women and youth, through practical training and the establishment of sustainable agricultural networks. The Ministry of Production in Gadaref State has welcomed this support for agricultural development.

records.title: A field day for vegetable farmers in Hamdan District, Sana'a, was organized by the Small and Micro Enterprises Development Agency (SMEDA)...
records.description: A field day for vegetable farmers in Hamdan District, Sana'a, was organized by the Small and Micro Enterprises Development Agency (SMEDA) of the Social Fund for Development (SFD) to encourage and support agricultural productivity. The event was funded by the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank in partnership with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), and supervised by the Agricultural Sector in the province. This initiative aims to enhance food security, improve livelihoods, and introduce modern agricultural techniques, including modern irrigation systems and advanced methods, to 60 small-scale vegetable farmers. The project also includes rehabilitating agricultural infrastructure such as ponds, dams, irrigation channels, and terraces through a "Cash-for-Work" component. Officials from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Water Resources and the local authority stressed their commitment to developing agricultural infrastructure and supporting farmers to achieve self-sufficiency, praising the collaborative efforts of all partners.
records.institution: Small and Micro Enterprises Development Agency (SMEDA)

records.title: The Ministry of Internal Trade and National Market Regulation in Algeria has ordered the allocation of free spaces for farmers in all reg...
records.description: The Ministry of Internal Trade and National Market Regulation in Algeria has ordered the allocation of free spaces for farmers in all regional wholesale markets managed by the "Magros" company. This measure is intended to allow farmers to sell their products directly to consumers and large wholesalers, thereby eliminating intermediaries and protecting farmers from exploitation. The policy is part of a broader effort to ensure that agricultural products, particularly fruits, reach consumers at fair prices and to maintain transparency in transactions. The ministry is also instructing control agents to monitor prices to protect citizens' purchasing power and is calling for a more equitable market framework.
records.institution: The Ministry of Internal Trade and National Market Regulation

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture held a workshop to discuss its training plan for raising awareness about climate change and its impacts on Iraq.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture held a workshop to discuss its training plan for raising awareness about climate change and its impacts on Iraq. This plan aims to enhance the institutional understanding of climate risks and support national efforts in adaptation and sustainability. The workshop also reviewed the ISO Energy and Efficiency Team's annual plan for 2025, focusing on implementation mechanisms based on quality and energy efficiency standards within the Ministry's institutions. This meeting falls within the Ministry of Agriculture's broader efforts to promote institutional quality and improve environmental performance, aligning with national goals for addressing climate challenges and achieving sustainable development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its Department of Forestry and Desertification, has completed the rehabilitation of a new 200-d...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its Department of Forestry and Desertification, has completed the rehabilitation of a new 200-dunam agricultural oasis in Haditha District, Anbar Governorate, utilizing drip irrigation. This project, a result of intensive efforts by the Ministry and support from the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), aims to expand green areas and combat desertification. The rehabilitation included connecting a power line, installing two solar energy systems, rehabilitating two wells, equipping an agricultural pump, and installing advanced drip irrigation systems across the entire oasis. Approximately 21,000 seedlings of drought- and salinity-tolerant varieties, including high-oil olive trees and windbreaks, were planted, making this oasis a significant green belt for Haditha District and an important achievement for the Ministry.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Forests and Desertification has successfully planted and produced pistachios in Anbar Governo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Forests and Desertification has successfully planted and produced pistachios in Anbar Governorate as part of the Desert Oases Project, demonstrating resilience against harsh climatic conditions. Al-Buhayat Oasis No. 45, a key agricultural oasis, features over 4,000 pistachio "mother trees" known for their tolerance to drought and salinity. These trees are being propagated into more than 100,000 seedlings within the agricultural oases' activities to combat desertification, which will then be distributed to local governments and municipalities. This initiative is a component of the national plan adopted by the Ministry of Agriculture to expand agricultural land in desert areas and diversify food sources, thereby contributing to sustainable development.

records.title: The African Development Bank (AfDB) has approved €100 million in financing for Morocco's Program for Supporting Inclusive Solidarity Agri...
records.description: The African Development Bank (AfDB) has approved €100 million in financing for Morocco's Program for Supporting Inclusive Solidarity Agriculture for Women and Youth (PAASIFEJ). This initiative aims to create lasting opportunities for women and young people in rural areas, strengthen food security, and enhance the climate resilience of small-scale farmers by stimulating entrepreneurship through tailored financing, technical and financial support systems, and new agricultural production and service infrastructure. The program aligns with Morocco’s national priorities, specifically supporting the implementation of the “Generation Green” strategy 2020-2030, the National Solidarity Agriculture Program, and the National Youth Entrepreneurship Program, fostering synergies within the broader development framework.

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests launched the commissioning of the irrigation net...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests launched the commissioning of the irrigation network associated with the Kaddoussa dam in Boudenib. This project, overseen by the ORMVA of Tafilalet and aligning with national strategies like Plan Maroc Vert and Génération Green, aims to secure and enhance the climate resilience of agricultural activities by improving surface water mobilization and rationalizing groundwater use. It benefits 16,600 inhabitants across two municipalities by harnessing an average of 30 million m3 of water annually to irrigate 5,000 hectares. Beyond infrastructure, it supports farmers by promoting good agricultural practices and financing projects for youth and agricultural cooperatives, thereby contributing to local socio-economic development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: Field committees of the Ministry of Agriculture have initiated efforts to estimate date production for the upcoming season, following dir...
records.description: Field committees of the Ministry of Agriculture have initiated efforts to estimate date production for the upcoming season, following directives from the Minister and recommendations from the Higher Committee for Production Estimation. This initiative is part of the Ministry's broader strategy to govern, oversee, and regulate the date sector, which has seen significant growth in cultivation, production, and exports, particularly for "Majhool" dates. Palestinian "Majhool" dates are now directly exported to over 35 countries, including Turkey, the European Union, the United States, Latin America, East Asia, and many Arab nations.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Palestine Technical University - Kadoorie (specifically its Al-Arroub branch) have signed an agreement to...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Palestine Technical University - Kadoorie (specifically its Al-Arroub branch) have signed an agreement to enhance institutional cooperation and develop agricultural educational and research programs. This partnership aims to create an attractive educational environment, protect lands from confiscation, and enable the university to reorganize its structure to serve students and the agricultural community. The Ministry views this as a crucial step in activating its collaboration with the academic sector through the National Center for Agricultural Research, as well as bolstering field and extension work in rural areas by opening new agricultural departments and offices to strengthen farmers' resilience and promote scientific advancements.

records.title: Saudi Arabia has achieved global leadership in water safety and drowning prevention standards, following the adoption of its National Dro...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has achieved global leadership in water safety and drowning prevention standards, following the adoption of its National Drowning Prevention Policy. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture announced a 17% decrease in drowning fatalities, attributing this progress to nationwide safety programs and their economic and social impact, which have helped avoid an estimated economic burden exceeding SR800 million. This achievement, highlighted during a workshop marking World Drowning Prevention Day, is the result of 12 integrated national initiatives. The ministry, in collaboration with the Public Health Authority (Weqaya) and other government bodies, has activated awareness campaigns through various platforms to promote safe behavior around water.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Eastern Region has completed preparations for the shrimp fishing season, whi...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Eastern Region has completed preparations for the shrimp fishing season, which will run for six months with 710 licensed vessels. Strategies for this season include issuing electronic permits to streamline licensing for fishermen, a process facilitated in coordination with the National Company for Agricultural Services (AgriServ). Furthermore, the Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program “Reef Saudi” offers financial support to Saudi fishermen for qualifying trips. The Ministry enforced a six-month fishing ban to allow stock regeneration, and the Fish Resources Research Center, in collaboration with the General Directorate of Border Guard, will conduct monitoring campaigns to ensure compliance and protect the marine environment.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Faced with market tensions and speculation, the Tunisian government has implemented urgent measures to regulate agricultural product dist...
records.description: Faced with market tensions and speculation, the Tunisian government has implemented urgent measures to regulate agricultural product distribution, following an interministerial meeting chaired by the Ministers of Agriculture and Trade. These steps aim to ensure regular market supplies, protect consumer purchasing power, and support local producers, particularly as autumn approaches when production of key crops like potatoes, tomatoes, and onions declines. The Ministry of Agriculture has established a buffer stock of 11,000 tonnes of potatoes, part of a larger 45,000-tonne market security strategy. Controls are being intensified on warehouses, roads, and distribution points through a national coordination mechanism involving the Ministry of Commerce, economic brigades, and security forces to prevent hoarding and price manipulation. Additionally, the Ministry of Commerce is supporting small farmers by mobilizing wholesale markets in major cities and planning targeted, price-regulated import programs for strategic products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia projects a grain harvest of 19.8 million quintals for the upcoming...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia projects a grain harvest of 19.8 million quintals for the upcoming season, a significant increase from the previous season. To prepare for the grain collection campaign, the ministry has renewed rental contracts for 50 collection centers for nine years and is working to open more. The Grain Office currently has a storage capacity of 4.3 million quintals, with an additional one million quintals identified, and an agreement has been reached with the National Chamber of Flour Mills for the temporary use of private silos, adding up to 2.9 million quintals during peak months. The collection network now includes 190 centers, and grain transportation relies on Grain Office trucks, numerous private trucks, and rail cars.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries in Tunisia has issued a decree to regulate the halfa harvest season, a plant...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries in Tunisia has issued a decree to regulate the halfa harvest season, a plant vital for both the economy and ecology of the country's semi-arid regions. This regulation covers the official start and end dates of the harvest, authorized areas, estimated quantities, and transportation and marketing procedures. Halfa provides income for thousands of rural families and is a significant export for paper pulp manufacturing, particularly to European and Maghreb markets. Ecologically, its deep roots stabilize soils and combat desertification. To ensure sustainability, the ministry also focuses on compliance with quotas and prohibited areas, while experts recommend establishing local cooperatives, introducing selective harvesting techniques, and developing higher value-added products. The ministry plans to publish an evaluation report to assess the impact of these measures and adjust future management policies.

records.title: The Makhlaf Munqitha Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Dhamar governorate has launched a wheat and legume seed distrib...
records.description: The Makhlaf Munqitha Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association in Dhamar governorate has launched a wheat and legume seed distribution campaign to farmers, in preparation for the autumn farming season.
