This initiative is a collaborative effort with the General Corporation for Grain Development and Production, Bonyan Development Foundation, the governorate’s Agriculture Sector, and the local authority. The campaign aims to encourage farmers to expand agricultural production, enhance food security, and move towards self-sufficiency, aligning with directives to reduce reliance on food imports. The General Corporation for Grain Development and Production reaffirmed its commitment to providing seeds and has already purchased a significant quantity of bean seeds from the association for cultivation. Additionally, the Agriculture Sector and its Executive Unit for Agricultural Project and Initiative Financing are committed to facilitating expanded cultivation, having previously provided loans to agricultural cooperatives for grain production.
records.institution: Makhlaf Munqitha Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, announced successful cultivation and harvesting of yellow corn...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, announced successful cultivation and harvesting of yellow corn in the Tikrit Research Department during the spring season. This achievement, part of Iraq's national program for sustaining certified corn hybrids, demonstrated abundant production with healthy cobs, even in dry soil and harsh conditions, despite water scarcity. Harvesting was completed mechanically after a field visit by representatives from the departments and directorates of agriculture in Salah al-Din Governorate and agricultural associations, who lauded the results.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), in collaboration with the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), in collaboration with the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the municipalities of Nablus and Tulkarm (Nablus Municipality and Tulkarm Municipality), has launched a $2 million project to rehabilitate and develop central markets in these two governorates. This initiative, part of the Multi-Donor Agribusiness Programme (MAP II) "Promoting Market-Led Investments and Innovations for Sustainable Development of Agri-Food Systems," is funded by the governments of Denmark, the European Union, Switzerland, and Spain. The project aligns with the National Plan for the Development of Central Markets, aiming to improve the agricultural marketing environment, enhance services for farmers, traders, and consumers, support local production, and strengthen agricultural supply chains.

records.title: Tabuk's farms are a significant source of high-quality pears, producing over 750 tons annually from more than 15,000 trees, with peak pro...
records.description: Tabuk's farms are a significant source of high-quality pears, producing over 750 tons annually from more than 15,000 trees, with peak production in July and August. This success is attributed to the region's temperate climate, fertile soil, and the integrated efforts of farmers and relevant authorities, notably the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture Tabuk branch, which provides guidance on modern agricultural practices. Tabuk's favorable environment attracts investors and farmers, supporting over 14,000 farms across 270,000 hectares that yield diverse crops beyond pears, including peaches, apricots, grapes, and various vegetables, solidifying its role as a vital national agricultural hub.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has signed a cooperation agreement with Green E...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has signed a cooperation agreement with Green Environment Industrial Company to remove invasive mesquite trees from designated sites and sustainably repurpose the resulting waste. This initiative aims to protect native vegetation, support national environmental preservation efforts, and evaluate the effectiveness of mesquite elimination methods, as these invasive species threaten local ecosystems, plant diversity, and vegetation quality.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD), in collaboration with the Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation and t...
records.description: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD), in collaboration with the Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation and the Ministry of Production and Economic Resources in Al-Gadarif State, organized a national training session on Good Agricultural Practices (GAP) and Societies' Management, alongside peanut seed distribution. This initiative is part of a wider project implemented in Sudan, Yemen, Mauritania, Lebanon, and Syria, aiming to enhance food security, economic integration, and intra-Arab trade for sustainable development. In Sudan, the project focuses on developing value chains for peanuts and gum arabic. The Acting Minister of the Ministry of Production and Economic Resources praised the training, which targeted 52 members of agricultural societies, emphasizing the practical application of modern agricultural technologies and the need for concerted efforts to effectively utilize Al-Gadarif State's vast agricultural area, especially given environmental challenges like El-Niño and climate change.
records.institution: Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD), Federal Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The 2025 Liwa Dates Festival, organized by the Abu Dhabi Heritage Authority, welcomed over 50,000 visitors in its first five days.
records.description: The 2025 Liwa Dates Festival, organized by the Abu Dhabi Heritage Authority, welcomed over 50,000 visitors in its first five days. This 21st edition, ongoing in Liwa City, Al Dhafra Region, is a significant platform celebrating the UAE's palm heritage and traditional agriculture. The festival provides vital support for the agricultural sector and food security, featuring 24 competitions with 308 prizes totaling AED8.735 million, along with stage competitions for visitors. The event reflects Abu Dhabi's dedication to preserving and transmitting heritage across generations, while also celebrating the date harvest and the palm tree's cultural significance. It attracts visitors and tourists from across the UAE and the Gulf Cooperation Council, offering a traditional and interactive atmosphere that supports farmers and engages families.

records.title: An awareness meeting for palm farmers in al-Nakhila area of al-Durayhimi district in Hodeida governorate focused on best practices for hi...
records.description: An awareness meeting for palm farmers in al-Nakhila area of al-Durayhimi district in Hodeida governorate focused on best practices for high-quality date collection, proper drying, and marketing through agricultural associations. Organized by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources in coordination with al-Durayhimi Farmers' Association, the meeting aimed to enhance farmers' capabilities to improve date quality and market value. The initiative is part of a national strategy to localize date production, achieve self-sufficiency, and reduce import costs, with the state directing traders and date companies to purchase local produce through associations to improve packaging and marketing.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation announced that the Board of Directors of the National Veal Project has approved new fund...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation announced that the Board of Directors of the National Veal Project has approved new funding of EGP 149.8 million for 107 small-scale farmers and young graduates, covering 2,140 heads of livestock. This brings the project's total financing to over EGP 9.715 billion, benefiting around 44,900 individuals and supporting over 520,000 heads of cattle to increase meat and dairy availability and stabilize market prices. The initiative aligns with the "Decent Life" programme for rural development. Specialized field committees from the Livestock and Poultry Development Sector and the General Authority for Veterinary Services, in coordination with agricultural and veterinary directorates, provide technical and healthcare support. The Ministry, along with the Agricultural Bank of Egypt and the National Bank of Egypt, conducts on-site inspections before funding approval, and livestock are insured through the Livestock Insurance Fund.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Department in Iraq returned a 20-ton shipment of Turkish-origin chicken liver due to its expiry...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Department in Iraq returned a 20-ton shipment of Turkish-origin chicken liver due to its expiry period and lack of necessary official import approvals. The shipment was deemed unfit for human consumption as it had exceeded half of its production period, violating public health laws and Iraqi standard specifications. This action by the Veterinary Department at the Western Region/Al-Qaim border crossing, under the supervision of security agencies and relevant institutions, falls within the Ministry of Agriculture's mandate to prevent the entry of non-compliant food and animal products to protect the health of Iraqi citizens.

records.title: The University of Balamand, in cooperation with the Lebanese Association for Sustainability and Social Responsibility, organized a confer...
records.description: The University of Balamand, in cooperation with the Lebanese Association for Sustainability and Social Responsibility, organized a conference focused on "Social Responsibility: An Introduction Towards Sustainable Cities and a Green Environment." This event, which coincided with the 30th anniversary of the founding of the Faculty of Public Health and Sciences, served as a platform to discuss vital topics ranging from waste management and eco-friendly transportation to environmental laws and climate challenges, also reviewing smart agriculture and integrating sustainability into local policies.

records.title: Sudan has signed a contract to participate in the Yokohama International Agricultural and Horticultural Exhibition, scheduled to run from...
records.description: Sudan has signed a contract to participate in the Yokohama International Agricultural and Horticultural Exhibition, scheduled to run from March to September 2027 in Japan. This exhibition, expected to host over 100 countries and numerous agricultural technology companies, offers Sudan a crucial opportunity to promote its agricultural capabilities and attract foreign investment. The contract was signed by the Sudanese Director General of the Ministry of Agriculture and the Japanese Ambassador. Furthermore, Sudan will also have a full pavilion at Expo Osaka 2025, an initiative supported by the Japanese government as part of its assistance to developing countries.

records.title: Oman accelerates the localization of green hydrogen technology.
records.description: Oman is accelerating its efforts to localize green hydrogen technology and manufacturing capacity, driven by Hydrom, the entity overseeing the country's green hydrogen sector. The nation aims to produce 1 million tonnes of low-carbon molecules annually by 2030, which will require a substantial number of solar panels and wind turbines. To achieve this, Hydrom is focusing on technology localization, including signing Memorandums of Understanding with electrolyser manufacturers like Siemens Energy and ThyssenKrupp Nucera.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has launched an electronic service for issuing...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has launched an electronic service for issuing grazing permits via its "Nabati" platform. This new service aims to simplify procedures, promote digital transformation, and support local communities while ensuring the sustainable use of natural rangelands. It offers easy, fully electronic application and rapid issuance of permits, automatically verifying environmental and regulatory requirements and integrating with geospatial and environmental data platforms. This initiative coincides with a NCVC effort, in cooperation with the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture and other entities, to allow controlled grazing in specific natural rangelands and forest areas across the Kingdom.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with global biotechnology provide...
records.description: The National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with global biotechnology provider PhageGuard and Saudi poultry producer Tanmiah Food Company. This partnership aims to promote sustainable livestock production and enhance the quality and safety of local products in Saudi Arabia. Under the MoU, PhageGuard, through its local agent Portalis Capital, will provide advanced bacteriophage technology to Tanmiah Food Company. This technology serves as a biological alternative to traditional antibiotics, specifically targeting Salmonella bacteria to reduce its spread, lower antibiotic dependence, and transition towards safer food production. The initiative is expected to boost the poultry sector's operational and production efficiency, build a knowledge- and innovation-driven livestock industry, and mitigate the risk of foodborne illness, thereby strengthening the competitiveness of Saudi animal products.
records.institution: National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program

records.title: The 2025 agricultural season in Tunisia's Béja governorate, particularly in the Ouechtata delegation, shows a promising boom in strawberr...
records.description: The 2025 agricultural season in Tunisia's Béja governorate, particularly in the Ouechtata delegation, shows a promising boom in strawberry cultivation, driven by expanded cultivated areas, improved climatic conditions, farmer mobilization, and modern techniques. The Ouechtata Agricultural Development Group (GDA) reports a significant increase in the area dedicated to strawberries, leading to an estimated production of 1,350 tons for the current season. This growth has a tangible socio-economic impact, directly employing around 240 people, primarily rural women, and generating substantial workdays. Ouechtata is gaining recognition as an agricultural center due to the quality and distinctive taste of its strawberries. However, a major challenge remains the lack of irrigation water, with calls for collective mobilization from local authorities, agricultural institutions, and technical partners to ensure sustainable water access.

records.title: Tunisia has reaffirmed its ambitious goal to increase national forest cover from its current 8.5% to 16% of its territory, as announced b...
records.description: Tunisia has reaffirmed its ambitious goal to increase national forest cover from its current 8.5% to 16% of its territory, as announced by the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries. This initiative is a core part of the country's environmental strategy to address growing climatic, ecological, and socioeconomic challenges. Despite past challenges like recurring fires, Tunisian forests have shown remarkable natural regeneration. To achieve the 16% target, the Directorate General of Forests is developing a national forest strategy for 2050, focusing on targeted reforestation, soil restoration, combating illegal logging, and integrating local communities into sustainable management. The forestry sector currently contributes 1.4% to national GDP and 14% to agricultural GDP, playing a vital role in soil erosion control, climate regulation, biodiversity, and rural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.title: The TAB Group has announced the 6th Global Vertical Farming Show (GVF 2025), scheduled to take place at the Festival Arena, Dubai Festiva...
records.description: The TAB Group has announced the 6th Global Vertical Farming Show (GVF 2025), scheduled to take place at the Festival Arena, Dubai Festival City. This event aims to be a transformative gathering for professionals in vertical farming and controlled-environment agriculture (CEA), addressing global food security challenges. It expects over 5,000 attendees, 100 exhibitors, and 50 speakers from more than 35 countries, serving as a strategic meeting point for agritech startups, CEA pioneers, investors, policymakers, and researchers. The show is supported by partners and sponsors like IEMA, Enjazonic, Wallfarm SRL, and Körber Technologies, showcasing next-gen solutions in various aspects of vertical farming. With support from government bodies such as the UAE’s Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, MOCCAE, ADAFSA, and Emirates Development Bank, GVF 2025 is set to foster public-private collaboration for food system resilience.

records.title: The first phase of a project to plant ten thousand Sidr tree seedlings has commenced in the Jabal Ras district of Hodeidah Governorate.
records.description: The first phase of a project to plant ten thousand Sidr tree seedlings has commenced in the Jabal Ras district of Hodeidah Governorate. This initiative, supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, is part of broader national efforts in Yemen to expand green areas and achieve sustainable environmental and agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Algeria's state grains agency, the Office Algérien Interprofessionnel des Céréales (OAIC), recently made one of its largest milling wheat...
records.description: Algeria's state grains agency, the Office Algérien Interprofessionnel des Céréales (OAIC), recently made one of its largest milling wheat purchases, securing approximately 1.05 to 1.08 million metric tons in a tender. This substantial acquisition, with prices largely at US$257 per ton c&f, underscores Algeria's heightened demand for wheat to maintain domestic flour supplies amidst global market shifts and geopolitical issues. The wheat is of optional origin but is likely sourced from the Black Sea region and possibly the Baltic states, with deliveries scheduled for various periods in September and October. This increased volume and price reflect Algeria's strategic stockpiling, intensified by tight global supplies and logistical risks. As Africa's second-largest wheat importer, Algeria is expected to import 7 to 8 million metric tons of wheat, a necessity driven by a projected 40% drop in its domestic cereal harvest to only 3.2 million tons, according to the Algerian Ministry of Agriculture, mainly due to drought. While France historically dominated Algeria's wheat imports, Black Sea exporters, especially Russia, have significantly increased their market share after Algeria relaxed quality specifications.

records.title: Egypt grants Masdar ‘golden license’ for wind farm project
records.description: The Egyptian cabinet has granted a 'golden license' to the UAE’s Masdar for its new 200 megawatt (MW) wind power project in the Gulf of Suez, Red Sea governorate. This license streamlines approvals, allowing Masdar to purchase/lease land and operate the project with a single consent. The wind farm, covering 37.3 sq km, is expected to save 175 million cubic meters of natural gas annually once operational. This project follows a power purchase agreement signed in August 2024 between Infinity Power (a joint venture of Egypt’s Infinity and Masdar) and the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company. Golden licenses are awarded for strategic projects contributing to sustainable development in sectors like renewable energy. Egypt, facing declining natural gas production, is accelerating its solar, wind, and green hydrogen projects, aiming for 42% renewable power generation by 2035. Masdar also received approval to invest over $900 million in 1,000MW solar power plants in Upper Egypt.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Egypt is spearheading efforts to propagate mangrove forests along its coastlines, particularly in the Red Sea region, as a crucial strate...
records.description: Egypt is spearheading efforts to propagate mangrove forests along its coastlines, particularly in the Red Sea region, as a crucial strategy against climate change and to foster a blue and green economy. Projects like the one initiated by the Environment Without Borders Foundation in Wadi Al-Gemal, sponsored by the Ministry of Environment, aim to conserve and expand mangroves, leveraging their capacity to absorb carbon dioxide and generate revenues from carbon storage, while also enhancing the social and economic well-being of local communities through activities like honey production. These initiatives align with Egypt's National Climate Change Strategy 2050, the National Biodiversity Conservation Strategy 2030, and international commitments.

records.title: Egypt's Agricultural Research Center (ARC) has partnered with the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS) through a US$40 milli...
records.description: Egypt's Agricultural Research Center (ARC) has partnered with the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation (AICS) through a US$40 million investment under the European Union-funded Knowledge and Action for Food Initiative (KAFI) to boost national wheat production and food security. The collaboration focuses on modernizing Egypt’s wheat value chain by supplying modern farming equipment, upgrading varietal selection laboratories, and establishing certified seed production units, aiming to increase improved seed availability and promote mechanization. Additionally, the program will support nationwide farmer training and introduce advanced post-harvest management systems. Despite efforts by ARC to develop high-yield wheat varieties, Egypt’s wheat production has stagnated due to challenges like water scarcity, fragmented farmland, rising production costs, and competition from other winter crops.

records.title: Presidential decree has been issued approving a €7 million grant from the European Union to Egypt under the Green Facility Program, suppo...
records.description: Presidential decree has been issued approving a €7 million grant from the European Union to Egypt under the Green Facility Program, supporting sustainable development efforts. This approval follows the joint launch of the European Fund for Sustainable Development Plus (EFSD+) by the Egyptian government and the EU Delegation in Cairo, which offers €1.8 billion in investment guarantees to catalyze development financing. EFSD+ is a key component of the EU’s external financial tools, designed to promote sustainable investments in countries like Egypt by incentivizing private sector involvement and utilizing innovative financial instruments to reduce investor risk and drive development in crucial sectors such as water, energy, agriculture, climate resilience, infrastructure, and digital transformation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Department in Iraq is continuing its efforts to limit the spread of hemorrhagic fever by reviewi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Department in Iraq is continuing its efforts to limit the spread of hemorrhagic fever by reviewing scientific research and studies. The Scientific Committee within the department held a technical meeting to discuss preventive campaign strategies, changes in spraying and dipping operations for animals and pens, and pesticide usage methods to control the fever's spread. The meeting also addressed a study on antibiotic use in veterinary colleges, stressing the importance of sensitivity tests before treatment to prevent resistance development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty and the National Federation of Agriculture in Mauritania have signed an agreement to red...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty and the National Federation of Agriculture in Mauritania have signed an agreement to reduce the price of raw and white Mauritanian rice. This agreement sets the price of a ton of raw rice at 14,000 new ouguiyas and white rice at 28,000 new ouguiyas. The Minister explained that the country's irrigated sector has seen consistent improvement, with increased cultivated areas and production due to measures like maintaining waterways, supporting inputs, and combating pests. This initiative, which involved evaluating the agricultural campaign, aims to positively impact both producers and consumers, reflecting the government's commitment to supporting farmers and achieving food sovereignty.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: Morocco significantly increased its wheat imports from Russia to over 1.1 million metric tons by June 2025, marking a 2.3-fold rise from...
records.description: Morocco significantly increased its wheat imports from Russia to over 1.1 million metric tons by June 2025, marking a 2.3-fold rise from the previous agricultural season, according to Interfax, citing data from the Russian Federal Center Agroexport. This surge positions Morocco among Russia's top wheat importers, driven by a substantial decline in local cereal production (down 67% to 5.51 million metric tons in 2023, as reported by the Moroccan Ministry of Agriculture) due to drought and irregular rainfall. To meet its annual domestic consumption of 9-10 million tons, Morocco is increasingly reliant on imports. The country's rising import volumes are supported by ongoing investments in port infrastructure and storage capacity, with the National Ports Agency (ANP) reporting upgrades in key ports like Casablanca, Jorf Lasfar, and Nador to enhance efficiency in handling grain shipments.

records.title: An agreement for a major agricultural investment project to cultivate moringa trees and produce byproducts has been signed, supporting fo...
records.description: An agreement for a major agricultural investment project to cultivate moringa trees and produce byproducts has been signed, supporting food security, environmental sustainability, and export diversification. The usufruct contract, covering 10.5 million sqm in the Hanfit area of Thumrait, was signed between the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning and the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. This project, led by Trufud, has an investment value exceeding RO5.3 million. It is a unique initiative linking agriculture, manufacturing, and supply chains, aiming to yield annual revenues of RO4 million to RO5 million through exports to North America, Europe, and Asia.
records.institution: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning

records.title: Grape cultivation in Tanuf village, Dakhliyah, is becoming a significant model for food security and agricultural innovation in Oman, wit...
records.description: Grape cultivation in Tanuf village, Dakhliyah, is becoming a significant model for food security and agricultural innovation in Oman, with increasing support from the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR). A vineyard, initially spanning 1.5 acres with 1,000 grape seedlings, yielded three tonnes of fruit this season, with further increases expected as more vines mature. The farm receives technical supervision and regular agricultural consultations from the MAFWR. The initial phase of the vineyard involved an investment exceeding RO16,000, covering farm setup, modern irrigation, trellises, and seedling nurseries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman’s OQ Alternative Energy has signed an agreement with Kuwait’s Naqaa Sustainable Energy to invest in multiple wind energy projects in...
records.description: Oman’s OQ Alternative Energy has signed an agreement with Kuwait’s Naqaa Sustainable Energy to invest in multiple wind energy projects in the wilayats of Duqm, Mahout, and Sadah. These projects are anticipated to generate up to 1,100 megawatts (MW) of power using wind turbines that will be locally manufactured by Mawarid Turbine’s upcoming factory in Duqm. This collaboration reinforces OQ’s role in the clean energy transition and supports Oman's national objectives to diversify energy sources by harnessing its natural resources, aligning with the OQ Group's broader strategy to build an integrated clean energy value chain and promote national industries by localizing expertise.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture branch in Najran reports that date palm farming is crucial to the region's economy, w...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture branch in Najran reports that date palm farming is crucial to the region's economy, with over 526,000 palms producing more than 40,000 tons of dates annually from 2,696 hectares. Najran's favorable climate and rich soil are key to the high quality and quantity of its dates, such as the popular Khalas and Majdool varieties. Farmers receive financial and logistical support from the Ministry, which helps maintain product quality and market effectiveness, aligning with the region’s strengths and Vision 2030. The early harvest dates are already stimulating the local market, with prices fluctuating based on type, supply, and demand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Tadweer Group has acquired Masdar's stake in the Sharjah Waste-to-Energy plant, making Tadweer Group and BEEAH joint venture partners...
records.description: The Tadweer Group has acquired Masdar's stake in the Sharjah Waste-to-Energy plant, making Tadweer Group and BEEAH joint venture partners in the Emirates Waste-to-Energy company. This strategic move allows Masdar to focus on increasing its clean energy capacity, while Tadweer Group expands its UAE operations and international presence in waste value unlocking. The Sharjah Waste-to-Energy plant, inaugurated in 2022, is crucial for diverting waste from landfills and generating electricity, aligning with the UAE's sustainability goals. The joint venture plans to enhance the plant's power output from 30 MW to 60 MW, double its processing capacity for hard-to-recycle waste, and reduce emissions, further solidifying the UAE's ambition to be a global leader in sustainable waste management and energy conversion.

records.title: A workshop was held in Al-Bayda province to launch work on value chains for crops, agricultural products, and livestock, targeting three...
records.description: A workshop was held in Al-Bayda province to launch work on value chains for crops, agricultural products, and livestock, targeting three model districts. Organized by the local authority in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, in coordination with the Agricultural Cooperative Union and the Bunyan Development Foundation, and funded by the Agricultural and Fisheries Financing Unit, the workshop aimed to introduce development partners to the action plan. This effort is part of an integrated vision to achieve food security and enhance local production, with discussions covering development principles, intervention mechanisms for agricultural and food products, and the roles of supporting entities. The Al-Bayda Governor emphasized the project's priority for the current year, stressing the importance of institutional work, alignment among government agencies, civil society, and donors, and activating the role of agricultural associations and cooperative unions. The project is expected to contribute to rural development, job creation, and improved resource efficiency, translating the National Vision's objectives of doubling local production and achieving self-sufficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Sana’a Governorate, particularly the Al-Hayma Al-Dakhiliya District, is experiencing a significant shift towards revitalizing its agr...
records.description: The Sana’a Governorate, particularly the Al-Hayma Al-Dakhiliya District, is experiencing a significant shift towards revitalizing its agricultural sector, with a notable trend of replacing qat cultivation with high-return cash crops like coffee and almonds. This movement is driven by increasing farmer awareness of the economic benefits and aligns with the Government of Change and Development’s plans for self-sufficiency and sustainable growth, as supported by local authorities and multi-purpose agricultural cooperative associations. A pilot initiative in Hijrat Al-Ain village has already seen farmers successfully replace qat with coffee, leading to a clear conclusion that coffee offers a more valuable return. Farmers are seeking support from relevant authorities in the form of coffee seedlings, promotion of intercropping, and reliable water sources through the construction of dams and reservoirs.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Egypt is establishing a new national climate finance platform to decarbonize its industrial sector and protect exports from the European...
records.description: Egypt is establishing a new national climate finance platform to decarbonize its industrial sector and protect exports from the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). This platform, mirroring the successful Nexus of Water, Food and Energy (NWFE) Programme, aims to mobilize concessional financing, grants, and technical assistance for low-carbon manufacturing, especially within the private sector. The Ministry of Industry and the Ministry of Planning have agreed to form a joint technical committee to oversee this initiative and coordinate with development partners. The platform will serve as a central hub connecting Egypt’s industrial strategy with international climate finance tools from entities such as the Green Climate Fund (GCF), the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), and the Climate Investment Funds (CIF).
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, the Ministry of Planning

records.title: Despite a short season and an 80% loss in cherry volumes due to adverse weather, Lebanese growers, represented by Fav Lebanon (a consorti...
records.description: Despite a short season and an 80% loss in cherry volumes due to adverse weather, Lebanese growers, represented by Fav Lebanon (a consortium of agricultural cooperatives), remain optimistic for the next season. The severe volume loss made cherries too expensive for competitive export to traditional markets like Kuwait, Qatar, and Dubai, though small quantities were shipped, and trials in Hong Kong and Singapore were successful for premium quality cherries. To adapt to climate change, growers plan to implement new agricultural practices such as covering orchards and using advanced machinery, which will increase production costs but are deemed justified by market prices. Fav Lebanon intends to increase acreage and continue efforts in pest management, varietal development, post-harvest operations, and branding under the Fruits and Vegetables Lebanon (FAV Lebanon) appellation.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program and national strategy for productive areas,...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program and national strategy for productive areas, conducted a field visit to Qarshita—the "Town of Pears"—to develop an integrated plan for pear cultivation. The visit, led by the Head of the Agriculture Department in North Lebanon and the Head of the Bakhoun Agricultural Center, involved discussions with the Qarshita Municipality and local farmers. An action plan was agreed upon, including promoting Good Agricultural Practices, organizing training courses for farmers, coordinating with the Department of Cooperatives in the North to establish an agricultural cooperative for pears, and launching an annual pear festival to promote local production.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its North Lebanon Agriculture Department, in cooperation with the Lebanese Migratory B...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its North Lebanon Agriculture Department, in cooperation with the Lebanese Migratory Bird Association (LAMB), organized a scientific symposium in Denniyeh. Part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, the symposium focused on "Environmental Awareness and Biodiversity: How Birds, Reptiles, and Mammals Contribute to Protecting Forests and Enhancing Agricultural Systems." Experts discussed the roles of birds in pest control, mammals and rodents in maintaining forest and agricultural life cycles, and reptiles and amphibians in combating agricultural pests and promoting soil health.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, organized an introductory worksho...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, organized an introductory workshop focusing on pesticide residue regulations in Palestinian dates. This initiative is part of the Ministry's efforts to develop the agricultural sector and strengthen partnerships with relevant authorities, farmers, and exporters. The workshop emphasized the importance of adhering to these regulations to ensure the quality and competitiveness of Palestinian dates in regional and international markets. Officials from the Ministry, including the Director General of Plant Protection and the Director General of Agricultural Marketing, along with the Governor of Jericho and the Jordan Valley, stressed the need for cooperation and continuous monitoring to ensure compliance with international health standards.

records.title: AlUla's public parks are undergoing several sustainable development projects focused on preserving local vegetation and enhancing aesthet...
records.description: AlUla's public parks are undergoing several sustainable development projects focused on preserving local vegetation and enhancing aesthetics in line with the area's environmental identity and heritage. These initiatives include intensive planting of local species, developing green infrastructure with modern and eco-friendly irrigation, and rehabilitating natural components for sustainability and efficiency, all while adhering to environmental standards. The projects also involve designing visitor-friendly paths and facilities that offer recreational and cultural experiences, support biodiversity, and mitigate environmental impacts, as part of an integrated plan balancing urban development and nature conservation.

records.title: Saudi Arabia will host the fifth session of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) Conference of Ministers in Charge of Water in J...
records.description: Saudi Arabia will host the fifth session of the Organization of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) Conference of Ministers in Charge of Water in Jeddah. The three-day conference will focus on addressing water-related challenges and exploring solutions for OIC member states' water needs. The Kingdom officially signed the hosting agreement with the OIC General Secretariat. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture noted that Saudi Arabia's hosting underscores its pivotal role in supporting water issues across the Islamic world and its commitment to strengthening cooperation in sustainable development, aligning with OIC initiatives and global water challenges. Preparations for the event are already underway, involving coordination, development of organizational and technical requirements, and review of international water resource developments.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The fourth annual Otaiqah Dates Season is set to launch in early August at the Agricultural Seasons Hall in Otaiqah Central Market in Riy...
records.description: The fourth annual Otaiqah Dates Season is set to launch in early August at the Agricultural Seasons Hall in Otaiqah Central Market in Riyadh, running for four months to coincide with various date harvesting periods across Saudi Arabia. This event serves as a significant tourist destination and an integrated platform for showcasing the Kingdom's date varieties, attracting visitors, shoppers, investors, merchants, and farmers from Saudi Arabia and the Gulf states. The date sector is crucial to the national economy, contributing approximately 12% to agricultural GDP, with products reaching over 113 countries. The season, managed by the Riyadh Development Company, spans 10,000 square meters, including an air-conditioned indoor hall, and offers 65 retail stalls, the large Otaiqah Haraj traditional date auction with 16 lanes, and an an online store for broader reach.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Production and Economic Resources in Gezira State has commended the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Natio...
records.description: The Ministry of Production and Economic Resources in Gezira State has commended the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) for its support to agricultural production, emphasizing the need for continued coordination regarding animal production inputs and aid. During a meeting, the FAO delegation outlined its efforts to provide production supplies to farmers for food security, stating that it would contact donors for any shortages, increase improved seed distribution, and support the horticultural sector. The Acting Minister also detailed the extensive damage to both plant and animal agricultural sectors in Gezira State due to attacks by a rebel militia, exacerbated by equipment and supply shortages.
records.institution: The Ministry of Production and Economic Resources

records.title: National Guard units in Kasserine, in coordination with economic control brigades under the regional trade directorate, seized approximat...
records.description: National Guard units in Kasserine, in coordination with economic control brigades under the regional trade directorate, seized approximately 120 tons of potatoes due to non-compliance with subsidy provisions. The seized quantity will be reintroduced into legal distribution channels, with its financial value remitted to the public treasury. Legal proceedings will be initiated against the offender as part of ongoing efforts to combat speculative practices and illicit storage.

records.title: The 2025 agricultural season in Tunisia is characterized by a significant decline in market gardening areas across several governorates,...
records.description: The 2025 agricultural season in Tunisia is characterized by a significant decline in market gardening areas across several governorates, raising concerns about the sustainability of the Tunisian agricultural model and national food security. According to the National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI), the total area dedicated to market gardening reached 115,800 hectares in 2024, a continuation of a decade-long trend of reduction, particularly for tomatoes, melons, watermelons, onions, and carrots. Despite this, national production remains relatively stable due to improved productivity from certified seeds, efficient irrigation, and partial mechanization. The Kef governorate exemplifies this regression, with its market gardening areas significantly limited due to factors like the absence of program contracts, lack of skilled labor, rising input costs, and declining irrigation water resources caused by repeated droughts.

records.title: Three major Tunisian institutions, the Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA), the National Pension and Social Security Fund (CN...
records.description: Three major Tunisian institutions, the Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA), the National Pension and Social Security Fund (CNRPS), and the Technical Agency for Land Transport (ATTT), have signed strategic framework agreements to enhance agricultural and fisheries sector attractiveness. This alliance aims to strengthen public and rural transformation through digital transformation, administrative simplification, and investor support. The agreements will facilitate electronic data exchange to reduce processing times, improve social security access for agricultural and fishing professionals, and streamline agricultural transport. The APIA will also implement digital tools to support investors, focusing on innovation and technology.

records.title: Tunisian date export revenues saw a 3.8% decrease, reaching 771.7 million dinars from October 2024 to June 2025, according to data from O...
records.description: Tunisian date export revenues saw a 3.8% decrease, reaching 771.7 million dinars from October 2024 to June 2025, according to data from ONAGRI. Exported quantities also fell by 5.7% to 121.5 thousand tonnes, with the "Deglet Nour" variety making up the majority (84.2%). The average price for dates was 6.35 dinars/kg. The European Union remained the largest destination for Tunisian dates, followed by Africa and Asia, with Morocco, Italy, and France as the top importing countries. Organic date exports experienced declines in both quantity and value, with Germany, the Netherlands, and Belgium being the main destinations for this category.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) is preparing to launch the 9th edition of the Al Dhaid Date Festival at Expo Al Dhaid...
records.description: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) is preparing to launch the 9th edition of the Al Dhaid Date Festival at Expo Al Dhaid, featuring extensive participation from UAE palm farmers, date producers, government entities, private agricultural organizations, and home-based businesses. This annual event aims to promote palm cultivation by encouraging advanced agricultural practices to enhance date quality and support the UAE's food security and sustainable agricultural growth. The festival will host various competitions with prizes, including "Ratb (Date) Beauty" contests, "Best Lemons," "Fig Contest," and a homegrown date competition for women, alongside cultural activities and workshops on modern agricultural methods.
records.institution: Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.title: In Al-Ta’aziyah District, Taiz Province, 300 fodder choppers are being distributed to 1,200 families of livestock breeders in Al-Da’isa,...
records.description: In Al-Ta’aziyah District, Taiz Province, 300 fodder choppers are being distributed to 1,200 families of livestock breeders in Al-Da’isa, Al-Shahna, and Hazran villages, with support from the Social Fund for Development. This initiative aims to enhance food security and promote sustainable rural development. The project also plans to establish milk collection and localization centers in Taiz Governorate and activate contract farming for corn and legumes in the upcoming year. The Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, and Water Resources, along with Taiz’s Acting Governor, has secured an agreement with the Hail Group of Companies to receive dairy and legumes produced in Taiz and Ibb Governorates.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, and Water Resources

records.title: Egypt hosted the second Egyptian Global Food Safety Symposium (EGFoSS), bringing together international and local experts to underscore t...
records.description: Egypt hosted the second Egyptian Global Food Safety Symposium (EGFoSS), bringing together international and local experts to underscore the nation’s commitment to food safety and regulatory excellence. The event was held under the auspices of the National Food Safety Authority (NFSA), in cooperation with the International Union of Food Science and Technology and the Global Food Regulatory Science Society. This forum served as a platform for stakeholders to emphasize a collaborative approach to food safety, aligning with Egypt’s national commitment to science-driven regulatory reform in the food and agriculture sectors. It also aligns with the NFSA's 2023–2026 strategic plan, which aims to position the authority as a leading food safety regulatory body in Africa and the Middle East, emphasizing scientific foundations in inspection, public health protection, and building confidence in Egyptian food products globally.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: Plastic Recycling Company’s project in Ain Sokhna, aimed at establishing a new polyethylene terephthalate (PET) recycling facility.
records.description: Plastic Recycling Company’s project in Ain Sokhna, aimed at establishing a new polyethylene terephthalate (PET) recycling facility. This investment, equivalent to around EGP 742 million, will fund a 10,000-square-metre facility capable of processing 20,000 tons of processed plastic waste annually and creating 500 new direct jobs. The project will export 70% of its output, with the remaining 30% serving the local market, aligning with Egypt’s industrial export strategy and efforts to enhance the value of domestically recycled products. The expansion follows the initial launch of the Nile Plastic Recycling Company in November 2024 with $20 million in capital, with its first facility expected to begin operations in the first half of 2026.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has successfully introduced the 'Black Ruby Grape' variety into the Nat...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Horticulture Department, has successfully introduced the 'Black Ruby Grape' variety into the National Program for the Propagation of Fruit and Olive Varieties. This grape variety is highly valued for its quality and resilience to harsh climatic conditions. The introduction of this variety is part of the department's strategy to test new varieties compatible with the Iraqi environment, opening promising prospects for farmers and contributing to enhanced food security. This achievement aligns with the Ministry of Agriculture's broader efforts, with direct support from the Minister, to boost local production and achieve self-sufficiency by providing subsidized seedlings and encouraging high-quality fruit cultivation across various governorates.

records.title: The Jordanian-Syrian Joint Economic and Trade Committee meetings highlighted the flourishing historical relations between the two countri...
records.description: The Jordanian-Syrian Joint Economic and Trade Committee meetings highlighted the flourishing historical relations between the two countries, with Jordan's Ministry of Industry and Trade affirming royal directives to support Syria. A Joint Coordinating Council has been established to enhance bilateral relations and address economic cooperation obstacles. Key agreements reached include forming a bilateral committee to review the Free Trade Agreement, preparing product lists, and creating a direct communication committee for private sector trade challenges. Both sides emphasized expediting the reopening of the Bab al-Hawa border crossing, agreeing on mutual recognition of conformity certificates for Jordanian products, and considering the approval of Jordanian pharmaceuticals. Training on digital transformation at the Jordanian Ministry of Industry and Trade will also be provided to the Syrian side. On agricultural matters, the Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture noted an agreement to develop an agricultural calendar meeting both countries' needs and to appoint contact points to accelerate work and avoid bureaucracy, while the Syrian Minister of Industry stressed the need for integrated interests and mutual support in rebuilding Syria.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Trade

records.title: Oman and Türkiye have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to deepen technical and investment cooperation across the energy spectru...
records.description: Oman and Türkiye have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to deepen technical and investment cooperation across the energy spectrum, encompassing oil and gas, green hydrogen, and carbon-capture technology. The agreement was signed in Muscat by Oman’s Ministry of Energy and Minerals and its Turkish counterpart, committing both sides to exchange expertise, align regulatory policies, explore joint projects, and study financing options to boost efficiency and accelerate the transition to cleaner fuels. Areas of collaboration include crude exploration, liquefied natural gas trade, renewable power, energy-storage solutions, and alternative fuels, with a dedicated focus on green hydrogen production, storage, and transport, aligning with Oman's 2050 net-zero drive. This pact supports Oman’s ambition to become a regional hub for sustainable energy and attract foreign direct investment, while Türkiye expressed interest in expanding LNG volumes and participating in upstream projects.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Oman's Environment Authority (EA), in coordination with the United Nations Industrial Development Organization, organized a three-day wor...
records.description: Oman's Environment Authority (EA), in coordination with the United Nations Industrial Development Organization, organized a three-day workshop in Muscat to advance the country's National Adaptation Plan (NAP) for climate change. This initiative aims to integrate climate risk into national planning and strengthen Oman's third Nationally Determined Contributions under the Paris Agreement. Participants, including representatives from various government agencies and international organizations, are discussing national policies, strategies, and financing mechanisms for implementing adaptation measures across key sectors like water, agriculture, health, coastal zones, and infrastructure.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture held the first meeting of the National Committee for Breed Improvement as part of its efforts to develop the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture held the first meeting of the National Committee for Breed Improvement as part of its efforts to develop the livestock sector, which is crucial for Palestinian food security and national income. The committee comprises representatives from the Ministry of Agriculture, local universities, and the Veterinary Syndicate, alongside the Director General of the Agricultural Research Center and the Director of the Breed Improvement Program. The meeting emphasized the strategic importance of sheep and goat breed improvement programs to increase production efficiency, narrow the red meat and milk production gap, and enhance disease resistance.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has signed a contract for a project focused on utilizing ground and surface wat...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) has signed a contract for a project focused on utilizing ground and surface water resources and mitigating flood risks. This initiative aims to improve water resource management and development, conserve non-renewable groundwater from depletion and pollution, and contribute to water security by fostering a safe and sustainable water sector. The project is part of MEWA's broader efforts to enhance the efficiency of non-renewable water resources through monitoring drilling and production, rationalizing usage, identifying safe water sources, and supporting their development, while maximizing the use of surface and renewable water with international best practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environm...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC), in collaboration with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, the principalities of Jazan, Al-Baha, Aseer, and Makkah regions, and other stakeholders, launched an initiative to allow continued grazing in natural rangelands and forest areas across several Saudi Arabian regions. This initiative will engage local communities, nonprofit and for-profit organizations, and volunteers in pruning dry juniper branches in Makkah, Aseer, and Al-Baha. The NCVC encourages livestock breeders in various specified areas to benefit from this effort, which is part of broader aims to preserve the environment, support rangeland development, enable sustainable use of forage plants, meet livestock nutritional needs, enhance rangeland sustainability, protect wildlife habitats, and foster biodiversity.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has issued a decree (No.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has issued a decree (No. 2025-344) setting the prices and terms for the payment, storage, and transfer of cereals for the 2025-2026 campaign. This includes basic production and purchase prices for durum wheat, soft wheat, barley, and triticale, along with exceptional prompt delivery bonuses. The decree also specifies a statistical tax, paid into the budget of the Cereals Office and allocated to the National Institute of Large-Scale Crops, and a solidarity tax, intended for the Compensation Fund for agricultural damage due to natural disasters. The gross and net margins of retrocession for cereals paid to the Cereals Office are detailed, as well as a sum allocated to the Equipment Fund of the Cereals Office, alongside monthly storage premiums.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: Tunisian olive oil exports saw a 35.9% increase in volume during the first eight months of the 2024/2025 marketing year, reaching 224.6 t...
records.description: Tunisian olive oil exports saw a 35.9% increase in volume during the first eight months of the 2024/2025 marketing year, reaching 224.6 thousand tonnes, according to the National Observatory of Agriculture (Onagri). Despite this volume increase, revenues significantly dropped by 31% to 3,030.4 million dinars due to a sharp fall in international prices. Packaged olive oil constituted only 13.6% of the total volume and 19.7% of total revenue, with extra virgin oil dominating exports at 80.8%. The European market, particularly Italy and Spain, remained the primary destination, followed by North America. Organic olive oil exports reached 45.0 thousand tons, generating 610.8 million dinars, though only 6% was packaged, with Italy being the main importer.

records.title: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism, in coordination with the UAE Embassy in Tunisia, organized the UAE-Tunisia Agriculture and Food Foru...
records.description: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism, in coordination with the UAE Embassy in Tunisia, organized the UAE-Tunisia Agriculture and Food Forum on the sidelines of the International Food Show Africa (IFSA Africa) at Tunisia's KRAM Expo Center. The forum aimed to strengthen economic partnership between the UAE and Tunisia in food, supply chains, and food value chain technologies. Attended by officials from both public and private entities, including Al Islami Foods, Iveco, and Emirates Bio Farm, and representatives of international organizations and startups, the event emphasized enhancing bilateral cooperation in food manufacturing, modern agricultural technologies, and sustainable food production practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Tourism

records.title: In Al-Dhalea Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, alongside the Acting Governor of Al-Dhalea, inaugu...
records.description: In Al-Dhalea Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, alongside the Acting Governor of Al-Dhalea, inaugurated 23 agricultural and fisheries projects worth over 598 million Yemeni riyals. Funded by the local authority through the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit and coordinated with the agricultural sector, these projects cover institutional and social development, marketing and services, and the development of livestock and crops. The initiatives align with directives from the Supreme Political Council and the Transformation and Development Government's agenda to boost agricultural growth and food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Cleanliness and Improvement Fund in Amran governorate has launched a campaign to plant 2,000 fruit trees, including guava, lemon, and...
records.description: The Cleanliness and Improvement Fund in Amran governorate has launched a campaign to plant 2,000 fruit trees, including guava, lemon, and pomegranate, along median strips of several streets in Amran city. This initiative, supported by the Amran governorate leadership, emphasizes utilizing the rainy season for urban greening with fruit-bearing and ornamental trees, aligning with directives to promote agriculture. The campaign is part of a broader effort to increase vegetation cover, preserve the environment, and foster a culture of planting productive trees, thereby supporting national agricultural development programs and enhancing food security.

records.title: Egypt's agricultural exports have recently surpassed 5.8 million tons, showcasing the nation's growing competitiveness in global markets.
records.description: Egypt's agricultural exports have recently surpassed 5.8 million tons, showcasing the nation's growing competitiveness in global markets. Citrus leads the export list with over 1.9 million tons, followed by potatoes with approximately 1.3 million tons. Other significant exports include fresh onions, beans, grapes, garlic, strawberries, tomatoes, guava, mangoes, and pomegranates. These figures underscore the resilience of the Egyptian agricultural sector and its commitment to delivering high-quality products internationally. The Ministry of Agriculture is actively working to increase productivity, improve quality, expand export markets, provide support to exporters, remove obstacles to competitiveness, and ensure best practices through continuous monitoring by agricultural engineers and researchers.

records.title: The foundation stone has been laid for Iraq's first Gene/Seed Bank in Hawari Shar Park, Sulaymaniyah, a landmark initiative to protect th...
records.description: The foundation stone has been laid for Iraq's first Gene/Seed Bank in Hawari Shar Park, Sulaymaniyah, a landmark initiative to protect the country's agricultural legacy and enhance food security. Funded by the European Union (EU) and implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), in cooperation with Iraq's Federal and Regional Governments, the facility is part of the "Restoration and Strengthening the Resilience of Agri-Food Systems in Iraq" project. The inauguration was attended by the Deputy Prime Minister of the Kurdistan Regional Government, the Minister of Agriculture and Water Resources, the Governor of Sulaymaniyah, the Mayor of Sulaymaniyah, and the FAO Representative. The gene bank will conserve over 3,500 native Iraqi plant species, including rare and wild varieties of grains and vegetables, supporting climate-resilient agriculture by preserving traits like drought tolerance.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has completed the mechanical harvest of the Green Gold fodder...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has completed the mechanical harvest of the Green Gold fodder variety at the Fodder and Pasture Division of the Animal Wealth Research Department. This achievement is part of the Fodder Crop Seed Multiplication and Manufacturing Program, which aims to develop and multiply high-nutritional fodder varieties to meet the needs of the animal wealth sector and enhance feed security. The Ministry highlighted that adopting modern agricultural technologies in harvesting reflects a commitment to higher production efficiency and resource sustainability, noting the Green Gold variety's potential to improve local fodder quality.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Investments, signed a contract addendum for the rehabilitation of the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Agricultural Investments, signed a contract addendum for the rehabilitation of the seed purification plant in Nineveh Governorate. The contract was signed in Baghdad by the Director General of the Department, representing the Ministry, and a representative from Rawaa Al-Barq General Contracting Company Limited, following the completion of legal and technical reviews. The Ministry emphasized the importance of adhering to the project's timetable, highlighting its significance in strengthening Nineveh's agricultural infrastructure and supporting local seed production.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program, organized a specialized training course on...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, as part of its National Agricultural Extension Program, organized a specialized training course on "Integrated Pest Management and Composting Techniques" at the Alwaleed Bin Talal Hall. The course aimed to educate agricultural engineers, experts, farmers, and relevant department representatives on best practices for reducing pesticide use and adopting environmentally friendly methods. This initiative seeks to ensure safe agricultural production that meets local and international food safety standards, particularly given the risks posed by excessive pesticide residues to human and animal health and the hindrance to Lebanese product exports.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is actively monitoring a herd of cattle that reportedly infiltrated the Bint Jbeil area from occupied Palesti...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is actively monitoring a herd of cattle that reportedly infiltrated the Bint Jbeil area from occupied Palestine, prioritizing health and environmental safety. A team from the Agricultural Center in Bint Jbeil, supervised by the head of the Nabatieh Agriculture Department and in coordination with relevant municipalities, conducted a field inspection. This operation, led by the district veterinarian and supported by the General Directorate of State Security, involved examining three cattle found in Aita al-Shaab. The inspection found the cows in stable health with no initial signs of contagious diseases. Veterinary guidelines were issued to the Aita al-Shaab Municipality for handling the case.

records.title: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM) has invested over OMR6 million in procuring locally grown wheat, a collaborative initiative with the Minis...
records.description: Oman Flour Mills Company (OFM) has invested over OMR6 million in procuring locally grown wheat, a collaborative initiative with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources that has benefited more than 150 Omani farmers. This investment supports OFM's strategy to promote in-country value and strengthen national food security through domestic agricultural production. As part of these efforts, OFM launched 'Flour 1', the first flour made entirely from Omani wheat, showcasing its commitment to supporting local agriculture and developing value-added food industries.

records.title: In a significant move to bolster bilateral relations and support Palestine's agricultural sector, the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture...
records.description: In a significant move to bolster bilateral relations and support Palestine's agricultural sector, the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture and the Indonesian Ministry of Agriculture signed a joint cooperation agreement in Jakarta. This agreement encompasses specialized training programs for Palestinian farmers and technical personnel, the exchange of scientific and technical expertise, and the promotion of agricultural trade and investment to facilitate the entry of Palestinian products into Indonesian markets. Both nations also agreed to form a joint agricultural technical committee, involving both public and private sectors, to oversee the implementation of the agreement. As part of Indonesia's humanitarian assistance, the Indonesian Minister announced an urgent grant of 10,000 tons of rice for the Gaza Strip.

records.title: Local date markets in several Riyadh Region governorates are experiencing significant commercial activity with the start of the early dat...
records.description: Local date markets in several Riyadh Region governorates are experiencing significant commercial activity with the start of the early date harvest season. The palm and date sector is a vital resource for the national economy, contributing to income diversification and enhancing food security, with the Kingdom's date exports reaching SAR1.695 billion last year, distributed across 133 countries. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has identified Riyadh Region as a key date-producing area, home to major central date markets and nearly 80 diverse varieties. The region's total date production exceeded 453,000 tons, positioning it as one of the highest-producing areas in the Kingdom, with over eight million palm trees, of which more than 6.8 million are productive.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: On Shark Awareness Day, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture renewed its call for responsible environmental behavior and pu...
records.description: On Shark Awareness Day, the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture renewed its call for responsible environmental behavior and public awareness regarding the protection of marine species, especially endangered sharks. This emphasis highlights the vital ecological role sharks play as apex predators in maintaining marine balance by feeding on weak and sick fish, which helps prevent disease spread and ensures overall ecosystem health. By regulating prey populations, sharks indirectly support biodiversity and critical habitats like coral reefs and seagrass meadows, contributing to the resilience of marine environments against issues like overfishing and climate change.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Principal Buyer has signed power purchase agreements, totaling SAR31 billion ($8.3 billion), with a consortium led by Acwa Power fo...
records.description: Saudi Principal Buyer has signed power purchase agreements, totaling SAR31 billion ($8.3 billion), with a consortium led by Acwa Power for seven new renewable energy projects, falling under the Saudi Ministry of Energy's National Renewable Energy Program. These projects, upon completion, will collectively have a total capacity of 15,000MW. The consortium includes Acwa Power as the main developer, along with Water and Electricity Holding Company (Badeel), owned by the Saudi sovereign fund PIF, and Aramco Power, owned by Saudi Aramco. The seven projects consist of five photovoltaic solar projects and two wind energy projects located across the Aseer, Madinah, Makkah, and Riyadh Regions, with competitive levelized costs of energy.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched the second phase of its "Sustainability Innovation Challenge" program in...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched the second phase of its "Sustainability Innovation Challenge" program in Boston, US, to enhance innovation and sustainability in the environment, water, and agriculture sectors. A ministry delegation visited Boston to start an intensive training program for the challenge winners, in collaboration with Babson College. This initiative aims to equip participants with essential skills for their innovative projects, reflecting the Kingdom's commitment to fostering sustainable solutions and promoting international collaboration.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The strawberry farms located in Aseer Region's high peaks, over 3,000 meters above sea level, have become a prominent agricultural and to...
records.description: The strawberry farms located in Aseer Region's high peaks, over 3,000 meters above sea level, have become a prominent agricultural and tourist attraction, drawing visitors from across the Kingdom to experience freshly harvested strawberries. These ventures combine natural beauty with the local community's passion for farming, leveraging the region's cool climate and scenic landscapes to cultivate thousands of strawberry seedlings. The farms represent an advanced model of environmental and agricultural tourism, offering an immersive experience in nature. The success of strawberry cultivation in the summer is due to cool temperatures and seasonal rainfall at high elevations, resulting in superior crop quality and abundance. Key locations for strawberry farming, known for their crop size and quality and popular for visitors, include Al-Aziza village, the center of Abha, and Wadi Bin Hashbal.
