records.description: The Minister of Agriculture discusses with international organizations a plan to combat drought and forest fires in Syria.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is undertaking a comprehensive transition of its services and infrastructure...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is undertaking a comprehensive transition of its services and infrastructure to cloud computing. This strategic move aligns with the Abu Dhabi government's vision, led by the Department of Government Enablement (DGE), to establish a fully AI-native government by 2027. ADAFSA aims to leverage cloud platforms to streamline operations, optimize resource utilization, drive innovation in agriculture and food safety, and enhance operational efficiency, agility, and service accessibility for stakeholders. This initiative is a crucial part of Abu Dhabi's broader digital strategy to integrate over 40 government entities into a centralized, hybrid, multi-cloud environment.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Hodeida governor has launched the 2025 date harvest season and a pilot date and agricultural/fish product drying project in al-Suweiq...
records.description: The Hodeida governor has launched the 2025 date harvest season and a pilot date and agricultural/fish product drying project in al-Suweiq area of al-Tuhaita district, which includes solar drying rooms and drying beds. This initiative is supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, the local authority, and implemented by the Agricultural and Fisheries Production Promotion Fund in cooperation with partners, aiming to enhance value chains and improve local product quality. The project is seen as a key step towards food security and developing date production in Tihama, improving post-harvest processes, and boosting market quality for dates, with the Head of Agricultural Production Development noting the eco-friendly nature of the solar dryers. The Head of Tihama Development Authority highlighted its role in supporting farmers, and the Executive Director of the Production Promotion Fund emphasized that this is the first of several sustainable initiatives to modernize post-harvest practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The local authority in Hodeida governorate launched a workshop to initiate agricultural and livestock value chains across 13 model distri...
records.description: The local authority in Hodeida governorate launched a workshop to initiate agricultural and livestock value chains across 13 model districts, as part of the 1447 AH development plan. Supervised by the Ministries of Agriculture and Local Development and supported by the Agricultural and Fisheries Financing Unit, the project aims to enhance food security and local production. The Governor of Hodeida emphasized the need for coordinated efforts among government bodies, communities, and the private sector, highlighting the region's potential for self-sufficiency through improved production, packaging, and marketing. Presentations were given by key agencies, with partners like the Zakat Authority and the Yemeni Economic Corporation committing to support the project's implementation and sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministries of Agriculture and Local Development

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, along with the Ibb Governorate leadership and the General Authority for Wate...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, along with the Ibb Governorate leadership and the General Authority for Water Resources and Facilities, have inaugurated projects for constructing water lakes to harvest rainwater and floods. These projects, part of the first phase targeting the Habish and Al-Makhader districts, aim to replenish groundwater. The Minister of Agriculture emphasized that these initiatives are in line with the directives of the Leader of the Revolution, the Supreme Political Council, and the Government of Change and Construction's program, all aimed at enhancing water security and optimizing the utilization of rainwater and floods.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Egypt's Agricultural Research Centre (ARC), an affiliate of the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, has signed a cooperation pr...
records.description: Egypt's Agricultural Research Centre (ARC), an affiliate of the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, has signed a cooperation protocol with the Haya Karima Foundation to advance sustainable agricultural development, empower rural women, and improve living standards across Egyptian villages. This partnership will implement various initiatives, including training programs for youth and women in agriculture and food industries, awareness campaigns on healthy nutrition, and support for small and medium-sized agricultural projects.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture participated in a specialized regional workshop titled "Pesticide Registration Tools," organized by the...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture participated in a specialized regional workshop titled "Pesticide Registration Tools," organized by the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) in Agadir, Morocco. This participation is part of the Ministry's efforts to modernize agricultural practices, with representatives from Iraq and most Arab countries discussing the latest systems and procedures for pesticide registration and handling to ensure safe use, environmental protection, and public health. The workshop concluded with participants receiving certificates of appreciation, emphasizing the importance of international and regional collaboration in building capacity in this vital field for the Arab agricultural sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Statistics, Training, and Manpower Department organized a training course on food security and post-harvest...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Statistics, Training, and Manpower Department organized a training course on food security and post-harvest technology in wheat processing and storage. The course, attended by Ministry employees, focused on the importance of food security, the adoption of modern technologies to reduce waste and improve storage quality through proper sorting, packaging, and storage methods in line with international standards. It also addressed local challenges and infrastructure development.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its General Administration of Plant Protection, and in cooperation with the Palestinian...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its General Administration of Plant Protection, and in cooperation with the Palestinian Red Cross, has completed a project to combat the olive fruit fly. This initiative involved training farmers and distributing 25,000 environmentally friendly traps to 669 farmers across 12 villages in seven governorates (Salfit, Ramallah, Hebron, Jenin, Tulkarm, Nablus, and Qalqilya), covering approximately 2,632 dunums. The training included theoretical lectures on the olive fruit fly and practical demonstrations on trap installation and operation, delivered by plant protection inspectors from the agriculture directorates in the targeted areas.

records.title: In a valley beneath the Asir Mountains, local environmentalist Lahiq Al-Hadi is developing an educational environmental museum in the Rij...
records.description: In a valley beneath the Asir Mountains, local environmentalist Lahiq Al-Hadi is developing an educational environmental museum in the Rijal Almaa governorate. This initiative aims to raise awareness, attract tourists, and preserve the region’s natural and cultural heritage. The museum will document rare trees, insects, birds, and traditional agricultural tools, with a dedicated section on beekeeping, honey production, and the preservation of endangered seeds. Al-Hadi has already replanted over 68 species of rare or threatened local trees and plants on his farm, actively sourcing and distributing rare seeds to growers. His efforts have shown positive results, including the return of migratory bird species due to environmental improvement. The museum will also feature a pavilion on Asir’s traditional stone architecture, offering insights into the region’s cultural legacy.

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture and the World Food Programme (WFP) have signed a joint cooperation agreement to provide cash and in-kind assi...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture and the World Food Programme (WFP) have signed a joint cooperation agreement to provide cash and in-kind assistance to 33,000 farmers affected by drought. The assistance, which will last for three months, is intended to support farmers in the governorates of Aleppo, Hama, Idlib, Homs, Hasakah, Daraa, Raqqa, and Deir ez-Zor.

records.title: In Ibb Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, along with the Ibb Governorate leadership, has inaugurat...
records.description: In Ibb Governorate, the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, along with the Ibb Governorate leadership, has inaugurated 45 completed agricultural projects and launched 57 new ones for the year 1446 AH, representing a total investment of 1.852 billion Yemeni riyals. These projects span various sectors, including institutional and informational infrastructure, community development, human resource development, land resource management, water resource development (with significant community contributions), plant resource development, agricultural extension and media, livestock development, and marketing and agricultural services. Key officials from the General Authority for Water Resources and the Grain Development Foundation were present at the ceremony, underscoring the collaborative effort towards agricultural advancement in the region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation states that the increase in agricultural exports signifies international confid...
records.description: The Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation states that the increase in agricultural exports signifies international confidence in Egyptian production. A spokesperson for the Ministry confirmed that the government prioritizes opening new global markets. This sector has seen significant growth in recent years due to strategic decisions focused on boosting productivity through expanded cultivated areas and improved farming techniques. Egypt's agricultural exports have risen substantially, with the resulting revenues positively impacting agriculture's contribution to the national economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Veterinary Department is conducting continuous health supervision at the Karkh Red Meat Slaughterhouse to ensure the provision of saf...
records.description: The Veterinary Department is conducting continuous health supervision at the Karkh Red Meat Slaughterhouse to ensure the provision of safe meat for human consumption and to supply Taawun Hypermarket with veal and sheep meat. This oversight includes comprehensive veterinary examinations of animals before and after slaughter. This initiative is part of the Ministry's broader monitoring efforts for official slaughterhouses under veterinary health supervision, aimed at protecting livestock and ensuring safe meat supply. While the specific "Ministry" isn't named in this snippet, the context from previous documents often implies the Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture or a similar relevant ministry for such veterinary services in Iraq.

records.title: Morocco is strategically increasing its wheat imports and building reserves to secure local consumption for the next three to five months...
records.description: Morocco is strategically increasing its wheat imports and building reserves to secure local consumption for the next three to five months, capitalizing on recent declines in global wheat prices. The National Federation of Mill Owners revealed that Morocco is taking advantage of softer prices, particularly for soft wheat, a staple for bread and pastry production. The current reference price for wheat delivery to mills remains below the Moroccan government's subsidy threshold, meaning no compensation is currently triggered for importers. The government provides these subsidies to ensure stability in flour and bread prices and maintain adequate supply. This move aligns with a recent report from the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO), which attributed the downward trend in international wheat prices to subdued global demand and favorable crop conditions in key exporting countries.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Oman’s Ministry of Energy and Minerals reported stable oil and gas production in 2024, alongside progress in renewable energy and gre...
records.description: The Oman’s Ministry of Energy and Minerals reported stable oil and gas production in 2024, alongside progress in renewable energy and green hydrogen initiatives. Crude oil and condensate reserves stood at 4.825 billion barrels, and natural gas reserves at 23.3 trillion cubic feet. The country operated 475 production fields, drilling 73 exploratory wells. Daily oil output averaged 992,600 barrels, with exports totaling 308.4 million barrels at an average price of $80.79.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals

records.title: Despite challenges, Moroccan avocado cultivation has seen impressive growth over the past 15 years, with production increasing from a few...
records.description: Despite challenges, Moroccan avocado cultivation has seen impressive growth over the past 15 years, with production increasing from a few tons in the early 2010s to over 100,000 tons last season. Maroc Avocado highlights that the quality now meets strict European standards, and many growers have acquired necessary certifications, thanks to a new generation of specialists and visionary producers. The industry's progress is also attributed to authorities officially setting the season's start date, which has led to improved fruit quality and reinforced the importance of respecting agricultural fundamentals for long-term results.

records.title: Qassim Region is a prominent area for fruit production in Saudi Arabia, with seasonal fruits like grapes, pomegranates, figs, Japanese pl...
records.description: Qassim Region is a prominent area for fruit production in Saudi Arabia, with seasonal fruits like grapes, pomegranates, figs, Japanese plums, watermelons, and mulberries being highly popular, especially in summer. The production of these fruits consistently increases due to the region's fertile soil, abundant freshwater, and skilled farmers. This agricultural growth is further bolstered by the government's support through soft loans, agricultural services, and expert guidance, which has encouraged investment from specialized agricultural companies.

records.title: Qassim Region, known for its fertile soil, is experiencing significant agricultural development and crop diversification.
records.description: Qassim Region, known for its fertile soil, is experiencing significant agricultural development and crop diversification. Notably, fig cultivation is emerging as a new success story, complementing traditional date palms and other crops, and directly supporting national food security objectives. The region boasts 10 specialized fig production projects, including nurseries and over 10 different fig varieties, alongside related processing industries. This expansion in fig cultivation and enhancement of agricultural infrastructure aligns with Saudi Vision 2030 goals to generate additional economic value and boost food security.

records.title: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) in Tunisia is organizing "AGRI-TRE," an open week dedicated to Tunisians Living Abroa...
records.description: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) in Tunisia is organizing "AGRI-TRE," an open week dedicated to Tunisians Living Abroad (TRE) to encourage their involvement in national agricultural development. This hybrid event aims to provide comprehensive information on investment opportunities, administrative procedures, and support systems, mobilizing TREs' skills and capital to foster innovation and resilience in Tunisian agriculture. Participants will engage with experts from various institutions, including the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, Tunisian Customs, the Ministry of Finance, and the Central Bank of Tunisia, covering topics such as project creation, regional opportunities, financing, and export.

records.title: The National Office for Animal Feed (ONAA) in Tunisia announced the acquisition of 50,000 tonnes of fodder corn through an international...
records.description: The National Office for Animal Feed (ONAA) in Tunisia announced the acquisition of 50,000 tonnes of fodder corn through an international tender. This strategic import aims to bolster animal feed stocks for poultry and ruminants, addressing the volatility of agricultural commodity prices and international market tensions. Given that Tunisia imports a significant portion of its feed grain needs, this initiative is crucial for the country's food sovereignty. The purchase is part of a broader Tunisian government strategy, supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries, to regulate the agricultural input market, stabilize prices, and support livestock farmers facing rising production costs.
records.institution: The National Office for Animal Feed (ONAA)

records.title: The Egyptian sweet potato industry is facing a challenge of maintaining value amidst surging volumes as the season begins.
records.description: The Egyptian sweet potato industry is facing a challenge of maintaining value amidst surging volumes as the season begins. Despite a significant increase in production and exports, particularly to European markets, the industry has experienced price instability in recent seasons, leading some producers to suspend harvests. However, Grand Egypt Agro, a key exporter, anticipates more price stability this season due to strategic planning, demand-driven production, diversification of target markets, and pre-harvest contracts securing minimum guaranteed prices for growers. Strong demand is expected from Europe, the Gulf, and emerging Asian markets.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department / Rice Research Division in Najaf Governorate - Al-Mashkh...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department / Rice Research Division in Najaf Governorate - Al-Mashkhab, has adopted a new "dry seed method" for rice cultivation. This modern technique involves spreading seed trays in the field, lightly covering them with soil, and then irrigating in stages, resulting in high germination rates compared to traditional methods. The department's staff has already planted thousands of trays of jasmine and ghari varieties using this technique, which facilitates rapid completion and allows for large-scale mechanical transplanting. These efforts are part of a program to multiply high-grade seeds and adapt to water scarcity by developing water-stress-tolerant varieties and implementing modern irrigation to rationalize water consumption, thereby supporting the continuous production of strategic crops.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Seed Testing and Certification Department ensures farmers receive high-quality seeds by adhering to the tec...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Seed Testing and Certification Department ensures farmers receive high-quality seeds by adhering to the technical standards of the Swiss-based International Seed Testing Association (ISTA). The department employs specialized committees for seed purification and disinfection, beginning with device calibration and moving to the actual purification phase. Samples are then taken from each shipment for comprehensive laboratory tests, including humidity, count, nematodes, cleanliness, weeds, bacterial and viral tests, and germination levels. This rigorous process, which also involves the Iraqi Seed Production Company (specifically its Ghammas site purification committee), ensures that farmers receive certified seeds, reflecting the Ministry's commitment to supporting the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture's Seed Testing and Certification Department

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture – Akkar Agriculture Department, in collaboration with the Gate Lebanon Association, has issued an ur...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture – Akkar Agriculture Department, in collaboration with the Gate Lebanon Association, has issued an urgent agricultural warning regarding the significant threat posed by the olive fruit fly (Bactrocera oleae) to this season's olive crops in Akkar and coastal areas. This alert, part of the National Agricultural Extension Program and based on field inspections, emphasizes the heightened risk due to current high temperatures and humidity. Agricultural engineers urge farmers to prepare, closely monitor their crops, and implement early preventive and curative interventions to mitigate potential damage, including fruit drop, deterioration in oil quality, and substantial crop losses. Recommended control measures include preventive spraying with kaolin and, if infestation is detected, using specific pesticides under the supervision of a specialized agricultural engineer.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Drâa-Tafilalet Chamber of Agriculture organized the fifth edition of the Regional Fair for Local Products in Midelt, in collaboration...
records.description: The Drâa-Tafilalet Chamber of Agriculture organized the fifth edition of the Regional Fair for Local Products in Midelt, in collaboration with the Wilaya of the Drâa-Tafilalet region, the province of Midelt, and in partnership with the regional directorate of Agriculture, the National Agency for the Development of Oasis Zones and Argan Trees, the Provincial Council of Midelt, and the Ministry of Culture. The fair aimed to strengthen the capacities of professional organizations by providing a platform for around one hundred cooperatives to market and promote their products. The event, which attracted thousands of visitors, generated significant sales and included training days for cooperative members on topics like social security and finance, coinciding with the International Day of Cooperatives.

records.title: As part of Oman’s efforts to boost agricultural sustainability and food security, the Agricultural Research Centre in Suhar, affiliated w...
records.description: As part of Oman’s efforts to boost agricultural sustainability and food security, the Agricultural Research Centre in Suhar, affiliated with the Directorate-General of Agricultural and Animal Research at the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, conducted two vital studies focused on mango cultivation. These initiatives aim to improve pest management and optimize nursery planting media for mango seedlings, a crucial fruit crop for Oman, which covers significant acreage and produces thousands of tonnes annually. The first study evaluated seven insecticides against thrips, finding that certain products like Plesiva Pro and Tracer effectively maintained high mortality rates.

records.title: The General Organization for the Conservation of Coral Reefs and Turtles in the Red Sea (SHAMS) is launching its “Adopt a Coral” environm...
records.description: The General Organization for the Conservation of Coral Reefs and Turtles in the Red Sea (SHAMS) is launching its “Adopt a Coral” environmental initiative this Saturday. This program aims to engage the community in coral reef restoration and raise awareness about their importance, aligning with national efforts to protect Saudi Arabia's marine environment, the goals of Saudi Vision 2030, and the Saudi Green Initiative. SHAMS, which has extensive field experience in reef restoration and monitoring, will offer opportunities for public participation through coral planting, awareness workshops on threats like climate change and pollution, and engagement in reef monitoring.
records.institution: The General Organization for the Conservation of Coral Reefs and Turtles in the Red Sea (SHAMS)

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 550 food baskets to vulnerable displaced families in Al-Qurashi...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 550 food baskets to vulnerable displaced families in Al-Qurashi locality in Sudan’s Al Jazirah State, benefiting over 6,700 individuals. This initiative is part of the 2025 Food Security Support Project in the Republic of Sudan, aligning with the Kingdom's broader humanitarian and relief efforts to alleviate suffering and enhance food security amidst the ongoing crisis in Sudan.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, represented by the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture (MEWA), showcased seven advanced digital...
records.description: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, represented by the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture (MEWA), showcased seven advanced digital initiatives at the World Summit on the Information Society (WSIS+20) High-Level Event in Geneva. These initiatives significantly enhance livestock health, water sustainability, and food security. Highlights included MEWA's AI-powered Livestock Health AI Platform, which recently received a Certificate of Excellence, and the Smart Platform for Monitoring Water Resources aimed at groundwater conservation. The presentation also featured Smart Monitoring of Slaughterhouses and Public Benefit Markets, demonstrating an integrated approach to food security and public health.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Gabès governorate in southeastern Tunisia is becoming a key hub for greenhouse agriculture, particularly cherry tomatoes, with an amb...
records.description: The Gabès governorate in southeastern Tunisia is becoming a key hub for greenhouse agriculture, particularly cherry tomatoes, with an ambitious Tunisian-Dutch partnership project named Farhet El Hicha. This project involves a 35 million dinar investment to expand its agricultural infrastructure by an additional 10 hectares of glass greenhouses in Ouedhref, bringing the total covered area to 60 hectares. This expansion is expected to create 210 new permanent jobs, bringing the total to 1,700, and significantly increase export capacity, targeting European and Gulf markets. To ensure sustainable growth and address water scarcity, the project includes the construction of a seawater desalination plant.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Masdar, an Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company, and Spanish utility Iberdrola have jointly secured approximately $4.8 billion in funding from...
records.description: Masdar, an Abu Dhabi Future Energy Company, and Spanish utility Iberdrola have jointly secured approximately $4.8 billion in funding from 24 international banks for the East Anglia Three wind farm in the UK. This 1.4 gigawatt greenfield project, located off the Suffolk coast, is expected to begin operations in late 2026. Masdar and Iberdrola each hold a 50 percent stake, with the transaction anticipated to close shortly. This achievement follows the successful installation of 50 wind turbines at their Baltic Eagle offshore wind farm in Germany. Masdar, which is 43 percent owned by Abu Dhabi National Energy Company (Taqa), continues to expand its international presence in renewable energy, having recently secured significant green bond sales and non-recourse financing for various clean energy projects globally.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Morocco is in discussions with several UAE companies to initiate wind energy projects in its southern provinces, specifically in Western...
records.description: Morocco is in discussions with several UAE companies to initiate wind energy projects in its southern provinces, specifically in Western Sahara, as part of its ambitious goal to increase renewable energy's share to 52 percent by 2030. Reports indicate that Rabat is negotiating with Masdar, AMEA Power, and Taqa for these projects, which are expected to involve investments ranging from $8 billion to $10 billion and achieve a production capacity of 5,000 megawatts. Western Sahara currently hosts four operational wind stations, and additional projects are planned for Boujdour and Tiskrad.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Plant Protection and in coordination with its Human Rights Department, organized a...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Plant Protection and in coordination with its Human Rights Department, organized a workshop aimed at improving environmental performance and enhancing institutional integration. The workshop discussed progress on the Sustainable Development Goals (2015-2030), addressed environmental rights based on international standards, reviewed successful local models, and focused on developing employee capacity to tackle environmental challenges. Participants stressed the importance of implementing the workshop's outcomes to bolster institutional performance, align with national policies, and achieve sustainable agricultural development.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Forestry and Desertification commemorated the World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Forestry and Desertification commemorated the World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought by holding a specialized symposium titled "Reclaim the Land, Unleash Opportunities." The event focused on strategies to combat desertification and mitigate drought effects, showcasing a film on afforestation and reviewing successful projects such as sand dune stabilization in Dhi Qar, Al-Shihimiya forests in Wasit, the desert oases project, and the wild plant atlas in Muthanna.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Forestry and Desertification

records.title: The Department of Statistics in Jordan reported that the cumulative agricultural producer price index (APPI) for the first five months re...
records.description: The Department of Statistics in Jordan reported that the cumulative agricultural producer price index (APPI) for the first five months reached 118.2 points, an 11.4 percent increase compared to the same period in the previous year. This rise was primarily driven by higher prices for crops such as hot peppers, green sweet peppers, and colored sweet peppers. Conversely, prices declined for potatoes, eggplants, and tomatoes. For the month of May, the APPI stood at 145.1 points, an 18.3 percent increase from the previous year's May, and climbed 20.9 percent compared to April, largely due to increased prices for white cabbage, lemons, and loose green chickpeas. However, prices for melons, green onions, and dry onions saw declines.

records.title: The Jordanian-Kuwaiti Joint Higher Committee is holding its fifth session in Kuwait, co-chaired by the Jordanian Minister of Foreign Affa...
records.description: The Jordanian-Kuwaiti Joint Higher Committee is holding its fifth session in Kuwait, co-chaired by the Jordanian Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates and his Kuwaiti counterpart. Preparatory meetings have already taken place, submitting recommendations to the higher committee. Both sides anticipate that the outcomes will enhance political, economic, trade, investment, industrial, transportation, agriculture, education, and international cooperation relations. The committee will also discuss increasing trade volume and removing barriers to goods flow, with the expectation of signing a final statement, agreements, and memoranda of understanding.

records.title: Volunteers from Housing Bank's "Imkan Al-Iskan" team participated in harvesting activities at the "Al-Dar/Bab Amman” Farm, managed by the...
records.description: Volunteers from Housing Bank's "Imkan Al-Iskan" team participated in harvesting activities at the "Al-Dar/Bab Amman” Farm, managed by the Dar Abu Abdullah Association in Jerash. This marked the conclusion of an agricultural cycle supported by Housing Bank's Hydroponic Agriculture Project, which aims to promote sustainable livelihoods for beneficiary families. The partnership between Housing Bank and Dar Abu Abdullah reflects the bank's commitment to achieving a hunger- and poverty-free Jordan, aligning with the goals of Tkiyet Um Ali, a long-standing strategic partner. Through its "Imkan Al-Iskan" initiative, Housing Bank provided direct support for the agricultural cycle, covering costs, supplying tools, and offering training, to create sustainable solutions and empower communities. This support ensures project continuity and a stable income for beneficiaries, with crop revenue funding future cycles.
records.institution: Housing Bank, Dar Abu Abdullah Association

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon is proactively engaged in monitoring the movement of wholesale and retail prices for essential foo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Lebanon is proactively engaged in monitoring the movement of wholesale and retail prices for essential food items, including meat, vegetables, fruits, and milk. This daily oversight is conducted to establish transparent average prices accessible to the public, thereby preventing market manipulation and ensuring the efficient and smooth flow of goods. As part of this commitment, the Ministry has begun issuing regular weekly bulletins that detail these average prices, with the first such bulletin covering the initial week of July. This ongoing effort underscores the Ministry's dedication to maintaining market stability and consumer protection within the agricultural sector.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Meranti Green Steel (MGS), a Singapore-based low-carbon steel producer, is advancing its plans for a major green steel project at the Spe...
records.description: Meranti Green Steel (MGS), a Singapore-based low-carbon steel producer, is advancing its plans for a major green steel project at the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) in Oman, having secured a provisional commitment for natural gas supply from the Integrated Gas Company (IGC). This foundational step for green iron production in Duqm is complemented by ongoing discussions with potential green hydrogen and financing partners, including KfW IPEX-Bank. The project underscores Duqm's growing appeal for 'hard-to-abate' sectors, supported by anticipated green hydrogen availability.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Municipality of Tunis have launched the Municipal Academy for S...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Municipality of Tunis have launched the Municipal Academy for Sustainable Development and Bioeconomy. This pioneering initiative in Tunisia aims to enhance municipalities' capacities in local food governance by integrating food security, bioeconomy, and sustainable practices. The Academy will serve as a hub for learning, experimentation, and collaboration, reflecting the partners' shared goal of transforming food systems towards healthier, more sustainable, and resilient models for urban populations.

records.title: The prickly pear industry in Tunisia, particularly in the Kasserine governorate, is facing a severe crisis in 2025 due to the uncontrolle...
records.description: The prickly pear industry in Tunisia, particularly in the Kasserine governorate, is facing a severe crisis in 2025 due to the uncontrolled spread of the cochineal parasite, leading to an estimated 40% fall in production from the previous year. This decline, reported by the National Association for Cactus Development, threatens the local economy and thousands of jobs in a region highly dependent on this crop. The Ministry of Agriculture's current chemical and biological treatments are deemed insufficient by stakeholders, who are calling for broader mobilization, including the wider distribution of ladybugs, a natural predator of the cochineal.
records.institution: The National Association for Cactus Development

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Egypt and Norway have signed a $650 million deal for the establishment of a 1-gigawatt solar power plant.
records.description: Egypt and Norway have signed a $650 million deal for the establishment of a 1-gigawatt solar power plant. The agreement was signed by Egyptalum, a subsidiary of the Metallurgical Industries Holding Company, and a new subsidiary of Scatec of Norway. Located in Nagaa Hammadi, the project will be implemented in two 500 MWh phases over 24 months and will include battery storage capacity. Scatec will handle the full financing, construction, and operation, aiming to supply a significant portion of Egyptalum's electricity needs from renewable sources. This initiative is expected to transform Egypt's aluminum industry, reduce operational costs, boost production efficiency, and lower carbon emissions, aligning with national goals for renewable energy expansion and environmental sustainability. It also signifies international investor confidence in Egypt's market and its government's support for green energy partnerships.

records.title: Egyptian grower-exporter Pico is optimistic about the current grape season, with early varieties performing well and shipments reaching E...
records.description: Egyptian grower-exporter Pico is optimistic about the current grape season, with early varieties performing well and shipments reaching European markets in good condition. The company is actively trialing and expanding new premium grape varieties, including those from Sun World and Bloom, to extend its season and meet modern market demands, especially for varieties that can withstand longer transit times to distant markets. Despite isolated reports of shipping congestion, routes to Europe have been running smoothly. Pico is confident its adherence to European standards will mitigate trade friction, though global trade shifts are being monitored. Beyond grapes, Pico is significantly expanding its portfolio with investments in blueberries, mangoes, and avocados.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Agricultural Guidance and Training held a guidance course on "Agricultural Cycle, Its Methodo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Agricultural Guidance and Training held a guidance course on "Agricultural Cycle, Its Methodology, and Its Impact on Improving Soil Properties and Fertility and Increasing Crop Productivity." The course, part of a guidance and awareness program supporting the winter plan for the wheat crop, took place at the Guidance Training Center in Babil Governorate/Al-Kifl Guidance Farm with 25 participating farmers. It covered the economic importance of crop seasons within the agricultural cycle for soil resource preservation and pest elimination, along with practical applications of modern agricultural techniques to maximize production and reduce costs.

records.title: The National University of Science and Technology has developed an innovative, environmentally friendly method to produce aluminum oxide...
records.description: The National University of Science and Technology has developed an innovative, environmentally friendly method to produce aluminum oxide nanoparticles from used aluminum foil. A research study, titled “Eco-Friendly Synthesis and Characterization of Aluminum Oxide Nanoparticles from Waste Aluminum Foil for Antibacterial, Anti-fungal and Anti-Corrosion Applications,” demonstrated these nanoparticles' effectiveness against bacteria and fungi, making them promising for various biological, environmental, and industrial applications. This approach addresses the issue of accumulating aluminum waste by transforming it into high-value functional materials, promoting sustainable practices. The research highlights potential uses in healthcare for antibacterial coatings, in environmental waste management for sustainable recycling, in industry for anti-corrosion coatings, in water purification for efficient filtration, in food packaging for extended shelf life, and in agriculture as natural antifungal agents.
records.institution: The National University of Science and Technology

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the 121st session of the Council of Members of the International Olive Council, with technica...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the 121st session of the Council of Members of the International Olive Council, with technical committee meetings held via videoconferencing and the general session held on Tuesday. This engagement highlights the Ministry's commitment to fostering international cooperation and expertise exchange in the olive sector, a strategic crop vital to the Palestinian agricultural economy. The participation also aimed to monitor technical, commercial, and administrative developments in the olive and olive oil industry and contribute to international policy formulation for the sector. The Ministry emphasized the importance of Palestine's active presence in international forums to support and develop the national agricultural sector and explore new cooperation opportunities with member states and international institutions.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Qalqilya Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in collaboration with the Jordanian-Palestinian Co...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Qalqilya Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in collaboration with the Jordanian-Palestinian Company for Marketing Agricultural Products, organized a specialized workshop. The workshop targeted tropical crop farmers in the Qalqilya governorate, aiming to enhance their awareness of improving field operations and production quality, ultimately increasing planted areas of tropical crops (avocado, mango, guava, and lemon). It also focused on achieving foreign market specifications by improving packaging and addressing production and marketing challenges. Twenty farmers participated in the workshop, held at the Qalqilya Agricultural Marketing and Irrigation Association, where discussions centered on cooperation between farmers and marketing companies to boost product export opportunities and improve the agricultural value chain.

records.title: The Palestinian National Center for Agricultural Research, in cooperation with Caritas Jerusalem, organized a guidance workshop on using...
records.description: The Palestinian National Center for Agricultural Research, in cooperation with Caritas Jerusalem, organized a guidance workshop on using plant alternatives for agricultural pest control. Held at the Center's headquarters in Jenin, the workshop aimed to promote sustainable agriculture and reduce chemical pesticide use by teaching farmers about effective, environmentally friendly organic alternatives. Engineer Umayya Hammad led theoretical and practical training, explaining plant extract mechanisms, types of plants used (e.g., garlic, ginger, pepper), and safe preparation methods. A live field experiment allowed participants to observe practical application and ask questions.
records.institution: The Palestinian National Center for Agricultural Research

records.title: A national team of 12 specialists from Saudi Arabia's environment, water, and agriculture ecosystem, including representatives from the M...
records.description: A national team of 12 specialists from Saudi Arabia's environment, water, and agriculture ecosystem, including representatives from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s water agency, the Saudi Irrigation Organization, and the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, participated in a training course in Lanzhou, China. Organized by the Gansu Academy of Agricultural Sciences in cooperation with the Chinese Ministry of Commerce, the course focused on rainwater harvesting technologies and their applications. This participation aligns with Saudi Arabia's efforts to implement international agreements and exchange expertise in water management, covering topics such as harvesting system designs, water quality management, purification technologies, supplementary irrigation, economic evaluation, sponge city concepts, water reuse, and the role of harvesting in combating desertification and promoting sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The date palms of Madinah Region have flourished for generations, providing fruit locally and internationally, with the temperate desert...
records.description: The date palms of Madinah Region have flourished for generations, providing fruit locally and internationally, with the temperate desert climate being vital for sustainable cultivation, preserving quality, and cementing Madinah's status as a top date producer. The region's unique environmental features, including stable temperatures, favorable rainfall, and low humidity, enhance crop quality and support year-round agricultural activities, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 goals to boost food security, promote sustainable practices, and improve the economic and cultural significance of Madinah dates in global markets.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) in Saudi Arabia has highlighted the continuous growth of the cooperative sector...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) in Saudi Arabia has highlighted the continuous growth of the cooperative sector, which reached 198 cooperatives by the end of Q1 2025, encompassing agriculture, livestock, fisheries, and environmental sectors. This growth underscores their crucial role in rural development and enhancing food security, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. To bolster knowledge and institutional capabilities, MEWA has developed 13 guidebooks for managing agricultural cooperatives and has enhanced their regional and international presence through participation in events like the regional conference of the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), and collaboration with the International Cooperative Alliance (ICA).
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The seasonal tomato harvest has begun in the Sidi Bouzid governorate, Tunisia, with an estimated production of 59,000 tonnes primarily fo...
records.description: The seasonal tomato harvest has begun in the Sidi Bouzid governorate, Tunisia, with an estimated production of 59,000 tonnes primarily for industrial processing, from a cultivated area of 735 hectares. This forecast comes from the Regional Delegation for Agricultural Development (CRDA). Despite this, tomato cultivation in the region has seen a significant decline over recent years due to factors such as farm fragmentation, diseases, ineffective phytosanitary treatments, and a lack of price regulation. The National Union of Tunisian Farmers (SYNAGRI) highlights structural issues, including the absence of standard contracts between producers and manufacturers and unregulated collectors, which reduces profit margins and discourages investment.
records.institution: The Regional Delegation for Agricultural Development (CRDA)

records.title: The Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries has issued a health alert regarding enterotoxemia ("boumrirra"), an...
records.description: The Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries has issued a health alert regarding enterotoxemia ("boumrirra"), an acute bacterial disease threatening ruminants, particularly after harvest due to sudden dietary changes. The disease, caused by the proliferation of Clostridium perfringens type D bacteria, can lead to sudden death with few prior symptoms, making prevention crucial. While not contagious to humans, it poses a significant threat to livestock, especially in high-density regions like Kef, Siliana, Kairouan, Béja, and Sidi Bouzid, with June to August being a critical period. Preventive measures include timely vaccination before dietary changes, gradual transitions to new feed, maintaining nutritional balance, regular deworming, and prompt veterinary consultation for any suspicious signs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The World Green Economy Summit (WGES) is positioned as a global catalyst for climate action, focusing on empowering societies vulnerable...
records.description: The World Green Economy Summit (WGES) is positioned as a global catalyst for climate action, focusing on empowering societies vulnerable to climate change with practical solutions for climate security. Organized by the Dubai Supreme Council of Energy, Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), and the World Green Economy Organization (WGEO), the summit's theme is 'Innovating for Impact: Accelerating the Future of the Green Economy'. It will explore the role of modern technologies, including AI and IoT, in optimizing renewable energy integration, enhancing predictive analytics, and improving carbon emissions monitoring, while also addressing energy storage solutions and promoting public-private collaboration for green technology deployment.
records.institution: The Dubai Supreme Council of Energy, Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation in Egypt met with the UNDP to discuss Green Climate Fund (GCF)-funded projects, highlighti...
records.description: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation in Egypt met with the UNDP to discuss Green Climate Fund (GCF)-funded projects, highlighting the success of the "Enhancing Climate Change Adaptation in the Nile Delta and North Coast" project. This initiative has involved building protective barriers and installing monitoring stations to combat sea-level rise and extreme weather, utilizing environmentally friendly materials and community participation as part of a wider effort to safeguard coastal areas and promote sustainable development. Discussions also included expanding desalination for food production, emphasizing the need for research to reduce costs for agricultural use.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation

records.title: Morocco, a leading exporter of capers, hosted the 7th National Caper Fair in Safi to promote this resilient crop and its industry, partic...
records.description: Morocco, a leading exporter of capers, hosted the 7th National Caper Fair in Safi to promote this resilient crop and its industry, particularly in the face of climate change. The event, organized by the Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests and the Provincial Association of Caper Producers of Safi, in partnership with the Province of Safi, the Chamber of Agriculture of the Marrakech-Safi region, the Provincial Council, and the Municipality of Safi, showcased local products and highlighted development initiatives, especially those led by rural women. Caper cultivation spans 31,000 hectares nationally, producing nearly 24,000 tonnes annually, with the Marrakech-Safi region leading. This drought-resilient sector generates significant employment and is experiencing sustained growth through the Generation Green strategy, which includes planting additional hectares, supporting cooperatives, and recognizing the "IGP Câpres de Safi" protected geographical indication.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: Oman's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) at constant prices grew by 2.5% in the first quarter of 2025, reaching OMR 9.43 billion.
records.description: Oman's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) at constant prices grew by 2.5% in the first quarter of 2025, reaching OMR 9.43 billion. This increase from OMR 9.20 billion in the same period of 2024 is primarily due to a 4.4% rise in non-oil activities, which contributed OMR 6.92 billion. Specifically, agricultural and fishing activities saw a 7.6% growth (OMR 273.6 million), industrial activities increased by 7% (OMR 2.03 billion), and services grew by 3.2% (OMR 4.62 billion). Conversely, oil-related activities experienced a slight decline of 0.4%, totaling OMR 2.92 billion, driven by a 2.2% decrease in crude oil production. However, natural gas activities showed strong growth, increasing by 9.5% and contributing OMR 475.3 million to the GDP.
records.institution: The National Centre for Statistics and Information

records.title: Al-Ra’i National Livestock Company, a subsidiary of the National Agricultural Development Company (Nadec), has launched a SAR 2 billion p...
records.description: Al-Ra’i National Livestock Company, a subsidiary of the National Agricultural Development Company (Nadec), has launched a SAR 2 billion project in Saudi Arabia's Hail region for intensive livestock farming and meat production, with significant financing from the Agricultural Development Fund (ADF). This initiative aims to boost local meat production, reduce reliance on imports, and support small-scale farmers, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030 by targeting an annual production capacity of one million heads of sheep by 2030. Furthermore, Al-Ra’i has signed memorandums of understanding with the University of Hail, the Sulaiman Al-Rajhi Foundation for Development Finance, and the Entag Association for Productive Families in Hail to foster student training, research, local industry development, and social responsibility, enhancing the project's broader economic and social impact.
records.institution: Al-Ra’i National Livestock Company, a subsidiary of the National Agricultural Development Company (Nadec)

records.title: AlUla is a prominent agricultural destination, particularly for mangoes, with farms covering approximately 125 hectares and containing ov...
records.description: AlUla is a prominent agricultural destination, particularly for mangoes, with farms covering approximately 125 hectares and containing over 50,000 mango trees. These trees produce around 1,125 tons of various mango varieties annually, including the popular Zebda, Sanarah, and Keitt, known for their high quality and unique flavors. The mango season in AlUla runs from July to September. The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) is dedicated to supporting farmers, promoting modern agricultural practices, and developing infrastructure to enhance environmental sustainability, food security, and diversity, while preserving the region's natural and cultural heritage. The information is provided by the Saudi Press Agency (SPA).

records.title: The King Khalid Foundation has opened registration for the fourth edition of its green grants, available to nonprofit organizations acros...
records.description: The King Khalid Foundation has opened registration for the fourth edition of its green grants, available to nonprofit organizations across the Kingdom until August 9. This initiative supports Saudi Arabia’s economic diversification, green investment promotion, and nonprofit sector empowerment, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. The grants aim to raise awareness of the green economy and foster sustainable development within the nonprofit sector by providing financial support for projects that equip lower-income individuals with vocational and professional skills. This enables them to access green opportunities that improve their living standards, supporting jobs, small projects, and entrepreneurial ventures in environmentally friendly sectors focused on preservation and mitigating negative impacts.

records.title: Tadweer Group, the waste management authority for Abu Dhabi and a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi Developmental Holding Company (ADQ), has offici...
records.description: Tadweer Group, the waste management authority for Abu Dhabi and a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi Developmental Holding Company (ADQ), has officially joined the United Nations Global Compact (UNGC). This move reinforces Tadweer Group's commitment to sustainable waste transformation through circular economy solutions, aligning with the UAE’s Net-Zero 2050 Strategic Initiative and the national Green Agenda 2030.
