records.description: Saudi Power Procurement Company (SPPC), the Kingdom’s principal electricity buyer, signed a power purchase agreement for the 700 MW Yanbu wind Independent Power Plant project in Al-Madina Al-Munawwarah with a consortium led by Japan’s Marubeni Corporation and Saudi Arabia’s Ajlan & Bros Holding. The project, valued at over 1.7 billion SAR, will generate wind energy at a levelised cost of 6.4 halalas per kilowatt-hour. This forms part of Saudi Arabia’s broader renewable energy expansion, though the agreement's duration wasn’t disclosed.

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The International Camel Organization (ICO) took part in the closing ceremony of the International Year of Camelids, organized by the Food...
records.description: The International Camel Organization (ICO) took part in the closing ceremony of the International Year of Camelids, organized by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) at its headquarters in Rome. The event celebrated a year dedicated to recognizing the vital role of camelids in food security, economic development, cultural heritage, and climate resilience across over 90 countries. As an active member of the initiative’s Steering Committee, ICO contributed to awareness efforts for the camel sector globally. The organization reaffirmed its commitment to advancing the camel sector through international cooperation, knowledge exchange, and partnerships to support camel-based economies and communities.

records.title: The King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC) unveiled its first brand refresh since 2016, reflecting its strategic e...
records.description: The King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC) unveiled its first brand refresh since 2016, reflecting its strategic evolution as a policy advisory hub driving Saudi Arabia’s energy sector transformation and informing global policy. Retaining its core logo for continuity, the update introduces new colors symbolizing sustainability, foresight, and energy innovation. This refresh reinforces KAPSARC’s core action: producing evidence-based, applied research and policy advice to support energy transition, sustainability, and regional economic development, while actively contributing to global climate and environmental platforms.
records.institution: The King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC)

records.title: An "AGRI-TRE" open week for Tunisians living abroad will be organized by the Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) to provide i...
records.description: An "AGRI-TRE" open week for Tunisians living abroad will be organized by the Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) to provide information on agricultural investment opportunities in Tunisia and the administrative procedures for establishing agricultural projects. The event, held both in person at APIA’s headquarters in Tunis and online, will include the participation of the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, Tunisian Customs, the Ministry of Finance, and the Central Bank of Tunisia. Interested participants are required to register in advance to attend.

records.title: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is launching a series of virtual awareness workshops this July to strengthen far...
records.description: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is launching a series of virtual awareness workshops this July to strengthen farmers' and breeders' skills in modern, sustainable agricultural practices. Covering topics like poultry farm efficiency, sheep pen standards in hot climates, and integrated pest management, the workshops aim to improve productivity, reduce costs, enhance food safety, and promote eco-friendly farming. ADAFSA emphasized the importance of these sessions in supporting agricultural sustainability, food security, and resource conservation for future generations.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Egyptian Food Bank (EFB), Egypt’s pioneering organization specializing in food insecurity, was selected for the United Nations Food a...
records.description: The Egyptian Food Bank (EFB), Egypt’s pioneering organization specializing in food insecurity, was selected for the United Nations Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Award, chosen among 69 organizations globally. This international recognition highlights EFB’s impactful contributions to food security, hunger eradication, and sustainable development through innovative, community-driven programs and partnerships. The organization’s comprehensive model ensures food access for vulnerable groups, supports small-scale farmers, reduces food loss and waste, and extends regional humanitarian support.

records.title: A project led by international and local partners concluded its work to transform agri-food systems in Jordan, aiming to make them more e...
records.description: A project led by international and local partners concluded its work to transform agri-food systems in Jordan, aiming to make them more efficient, inclusive, resilient, and sustainable. The initiative supported over 1,700 vulnerable Jordanian farmers and Syrian refugees through grants, training, composting units, improved market access, financial services, and job creation. It also introduced innovations like fish farming systems and food loss assessments, while promoting sustainable practices and economic opportunities in rural communities. The project contributed to strengthening livelihoods, food security, and resilience in some of the country’s most vulnerable areas.

records.title: Jordan’s national exports to the European Union have recorded notable growth, reflecting improved trade exchange and increased competitiv...
records.description: Jordan’s national exports to the European Union have recorded notable growth, reflecting improved trade exchange and increased competitiveness of Jordanian products in European markets. Exports rose significantly, supported by simplified rules of origin under the EU agreement and stricter adherence to European standards. Key exports include garments, fertilizers, pharmaceuticals, chemicals, and agricultural products, while imports from the EU primarily consist of machinery, vehicles, pharmaceuticals, and food items. The Jordanian-European Business Association highlighted both opportunities for expanding trade—particularly in green sectors, technology, and creative industries—and ongoing challenges like high shipping costs, complex regulations, and the need for technical support for small businesses.

records.title: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) in Jordan is leading the “Adaptation to Climate Change in the Jordan Valley” project, a strategic initi...
records.description: The Jordan Valley Authority (JVA) in Jordan is leading the “Adaptation to Climate Change in the Jordan Valley” project, a strategic initiative aimed at improving water security, agricultural resilience, and irrigation efficiency in response to growing water scarcity and drought risks. Funded by the European Union, the German Development Bank, the European Investment Bank, and the government, the 87.13 million euro project involves rehabilitating agricultural water networks, expanding the use of treated water, and providing advisory services to farmers. It is expected to benefit over 257,000 people, including thousands of farmers and their families across the Jordan Valley.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Saham Fruit Festival was launched in the Wilayat of Saham, North Al Batinah Governorate, organized by the Office of the Wali in coope...
records.description: The Saham Fruit Festival was launched in the Wilayat of Saham, North Al Batinah Governorate, organized by the Office of the Wali in cooperation with the Department of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources. The event aims to support local farmers by offering a direct platform to market their produce, promote sustainable farming practices, and raise community awareness about the agricultural sector’s economic and environmental importance. Held at Saham Public Park, the festival features stalls selling local fruits, workshops on modern farming techniques, and seminars on best agricultural practices, contributing to local production and community development.
records.institution: Department of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Saham

records.title: A meeting was held to advance the establishment of the Palestinian Center for Agricultural Technology Transfer, following the approval of...
records.description: A meeting was held to advance the establishment of the Palestinian Center for Agricultural Technology Transfer, following the approval of its roadmap. The discussion emphasized the commitment to finalizing the center’s legal and organizational frameworks, aiming to create a national hub for transferring agricultural technologies to and from Palestine. The center will support innovation, training, and capacity building in the agricultural sector. Both sides highlighted the importance of activating international partnerships to back this strategic project, which seeks to enhance agricultural development and technical expertise across the country.

records.title: The Veterinary Departments launched a nationwide field campaign to vaccinate companion animals and pets against rabies in several governo...
records.description: The Veterinary Departments launched a nationwide field campaign to vaccinate companion animals and pets against rabies in several governorates. The initiative, offered free of charge, aims to protect public health, limit disease transmission, and safeguard both humans and animals. Citizens are urged to cooperate with veterinary field teams and report any suspected cases of infection, as part of broader efforts to maintain a safer, healthier environment for communities.

records.title: Growing public concern over pesticide residues in food has driven SICAM, the country’s leading tomato processor, to launch its voluntary...
records.description: Growing public concern over pesticide residues in food has driven SICAM, the country’s leading tomato processor, to launch its voluntary Zero Detectable Pesticide Residue (ZRP) program. Aimed at ensuring tomatoes delivered to its factories are free of detectable pesticide traces, the program relies on strict agronomic supervision, full traceability from field to factory, and advanced laboratory testing. Now covering the majority of SICAM’s partner producers, the initiative offers an affordable alternative to organic produce while promoting sustainable farming practices. Recognized nationally and internationally, the ZRP program positions SICAM as a regional pioneer in responsible agriculture and food safety, with ambitions to extend this model across the tomato sector and other key crops.

records.title: Tunisia has signed a $38 million loan agreement with the Saudi Fund for Development to finance the Oasis Hub project in the country’s sou...
records.description: Tunisia has signed a $38 million loan agreement with the Saudi Fund for Development to finance the Oasis Hub project in the country’s south, aimed at revitalizing rural areas through integrated sustainable development. The initiative focuses on rehabilitating over 1,000 hectares of farmland, drilling wells for irrigation and drinking water, building housing units, and developing essential infrastructure such as roads, water networks, and community facilities. It seeks to address unemployment, rural exodus, and limited access to services by creating jobs, enhancing food security, and improving living conditions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Planning

records.title: Bahrain’s national standards committee has approved comprehensive updates to its product regulations, introducing a new eco-label called...
records.description: Bahrain’s national standards committee has approved comprehensive updates to its product regulations, introducing a new eco-label called the “Green Product Card” and aligning water-saving rules with Gulf Cooperation Council standards to improve efficiency in plumbing and fixtures. The revisions also update technical specifications to enhance consumer safety and conformity with international measurement, safety, and quality benchmarks, with further proposals under review to support domestic initiatives. The move demonstrates a strategic commitment to embedding sustainability into Bahrain’s industrial and trade frameworks, with the next phase focused on enforcing the updated standards and promoting public awareness of the green labeling system.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Egypt has launched a new national initiative, with support from the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) and fundin...
records.description: Egypt has launched a new national initiative, with support from the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) and funding from the Green Climate Fund (GCF), to become a regional leader in clean technology innovation. This project aims to accelerate climate action and support the country's energy transition by strengthening institutional coordination, building capacity, attracting private sector participation, and enhancing early-stage climate finance. It will also develop innovative financing tools, offer business acceleration programs, and help prepare bankable climate projects aligned with Egypt's Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs) and its 2050 National Climate Strategy.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: SCZONE Unveils Major Solar Industrial Complex in Ain Sokhna Egypt's General Authority for the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) has start...
records.description: SCZONE Unveils Major Solar Industrial Complex in Ain Sokhna Egypt's General Authority for the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE) has started construction on a $200 million integrated industrial complex in the Ain Sokhna industrial zone, which will focus on producing solar energy components. This project, developed by a Chinese company within the TEDA–Egypt framework, will span 200,000 square meters and be implemented in two phases. The first phase, costing $90 million, will establish two factories for solar cells and modules, each with a 2 GW capacity. The second phase, with an investment of $110 million, will localize the production of key raw materials like silicon ingots and wafers, alongside expanding module and cell manufacturing. SCZONE views this initiative as a crucial step towards localizing advanced industries and integrating clean energy production in Egypt, anticipating over 1,800 direct job opportunities and thousands more indirectly.
records.institution: Egypt's General Authority for the Suez Canal Economic Zone (SCZONE)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Iraq has launched a significant Green Climate Fund (GCF)-backed project, "Strengthening Climate Resilience of Vulnerable Agricultural Liv...
records.description: Iraq has launched a significant Green Climate Fund (GCF)-backed project, "Strengthening Climate Resilience of Vulnerable Agricultural Livelihoods in Southern Iraq" (SRVALI), in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO). This $39 million initiative, also supported by the Government of Canada and the Swedish International Development Cooperation Agency (SIDA), aims to directly benefit rural households in the drought-affected governorates of Karbala, Najaf, and Muthanna. The project will upgrade irrigation systems for improved water use efficiency, deploy solar-powered irrigation solutions, reclaim degraded farmlands, and promote sustainable land and water management. It also focuses on strengthening Water User Associations, empowering rural women and youth, and introducing digital tools and early warning systems to build resilience and mitigate risks.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water Resources, the Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The agricultural directorate in Karbala has successfully concluded its wheat harvest and marketing campaign, achieving a record-breaking...
records.description: The agricultural directorate in Karbala has successfully concluded its wheat harvest and marketing campaign, achieving a record-breaking yield for the province. Over 305,000 tonnes of wheat were delivered to the state grain trading company, a significant increase from the previous year's 228,000 tonnes. This achievement was supported by effective collaboration between different levels of government, which helped address various logistical issues. The cultivated area for wheat encompassed 365,000 dunams, with a substantial portion utilizing modern irrigation techniques, including expansion into desert regions. The entire harvest, even crops grown outside the official plan, received central government approval for procurement, with differentiated pricing based on irrigation methods.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq, through its Veterinary Department, has implemented a series of veterinary health control measures at...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Iraq, through its Veterinary Department, has implemented a series of veterinary health control measures at slaughterhouses in Baghdad to ensure the safety of meat for human consumption. A recent visit to one of the slaughterhouses was conducted to review operations and confirm that proper veterinary examinations are performed before and after slaughter. These inspections are part of ongoing efforts to safeguard public health and maintain the country’s animal resources through regulated, supervised slaughterhouse operations.

records.title: The Sidi Ifni seawater desalination plant in Morocco is a major project designed to secure drinking water for the town and nearby areas,...
records.description: The Sidi Ifni seawater desalination plant in Morocco is a major project designed to secure drinking water for the town and nearby areas, addressing shortages worsened by climate change and drought. Part of a national program for water supply and irrigation, the plant uses advanced reverse osmosis technology with a capacity of 100 liters per second, supplying Sidi Ifni and parts of Tiznit province. The facility includes water storage tanks, sand filters, and a quality monitoring lab. Locals have welcomed the project, noting its role in reducing water cuts, improving living conditions, and supporting regional economic growth, tourism, and investment.
records.institution: The National Office of Electricity and Drinking Water (ONEE)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Project cargo has commenced arriving at the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) for Oman's inaugural green hydrogen and ammonia venture...
records.description: Project cargo has commenced arriving at the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD) for Oman's inaugural green hydrogen and ammonia venture, marking a significant step for the Sultanate's burgeoning green energy industry. Green Hydrogen and Chemicals Company SAOC (GHC), a subsidiary of India-based ACME Group, is developing the $750 million green ammonia plant, which will have an initial capacity of 100,000 tonnes per annum (tpa) with plans for phased expansion to 1.1 million tpa. The initial shipment of oversized equipment has been successfully delivered, with further heavy cargo, including solar PV modules, trackers, and electrolyzers, expected as the plant prepares for its scheduled commissioning in the first quarter of 2027.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and with s...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and with support from the Canadian government, distributed agricultural and livestock equipment to farmers in several areas of the West Bank and Gaza Strip. This initiative, part of a broader strategy to enhance food and water security and strengthen farmers' resilience, supports rural livelihoods by reducing production costs, improving profitability, and promoting sustainable practices. The program includes field schools and training, with a focus on livestock development and practical support for vulnerable agricultural communities.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia announced the start of the Rutab (semi-ripe date) harvest season in A...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia announced the start of the Rutab (semi-ripe date) harvest season in Al-Ahsa Governorate, home to the world’s largest palm oasis and a UNESCO World Heritage Site. With over two million palm trees producing more than 120,000 tons of dates annually, markets across the Kingdom are receiving early Rutab varieties, while the full date (tamar) harvest will follow from mid-August to early October.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform in the Syrian Arab Republic inaugurated the "Agritex" exhibition for agricultural and vet...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform in the Syrian Arab Republic inaugurated the "Agritex" exhibition for agricultural and veterinary production supplies, bringing together companies, experts, and specialists in the fields of agriculture and animal health. The exhibition showcased modern technologies, equipment, and products that support agricultural production, livestock care, and food security efforts. It aimed to encourage investment in agriculture, enhance cooperation between public and private sectors, and introduce farmers and breeders to the latest innovations that improve productivity and sustainability in the sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture in Tunisia, in collaboration with the Tunisian National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRAT) and IRESA, ha...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture in Tunisia, in collaboration with the Tunisian National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRAT) and IRESA, has been leading national efforts to combat the rapid spread of the cactus mealybug, which since 2021 has devastated prickly pear plantations across several governorates. After chemical treatments proved insufficient, the ministry launched a long-term strategy centered on introducing resistant cactus varieties, complemented by a biological control program involving ladybugs, in partnership with Morocco and the FAO. These efforts aim to safeguard a vital crop supporting rural livelihoods, fodder supply, and biodiversity, though challenges remain in scaling up resistant plant production, maintaining phytosanitary vigilance, and securing adequate funding.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia, in partnership with the FAO, launched the TEC-EAU project to tackl...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia, in partnership with the FAO, launched the TEC-EAU project to tackle the country’s worsening water scarcity, with annual freshwater availability now critically low. The project tests four innovative, climate-adapted water management technologies—including monomolecular films on dam surfaces, floating solar panels, cloud seeding, and underground dams—across different pilot regions. Developed through a participatory, territorial approach involving national institutions, TEC-EAU aims to build sustainable water resilience and could serve as a model for other drought-prone countries if successful.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched a national awareness and guidance program to protect poultry farms a...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources launched a national awareness and guidance program to protect poultry farms and hatcheries from diseases and epidemics. Led by the General Directorate of Animal Health and Veterinary Quarantine and the General Directorate for Livestock Development, the initiative targets broiler producers, hatcheries, and parent farms, focusing on biosecurity, veterinary care, nutrition, and hatchery management. It aims to reduce production losses, improve food security, and advance toward self-sufficiency in poultry products, with periodic monitoring to ensure adherence to health and safety standards.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, has initiated preventative health measures against hemorrhagic fever and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Veterinary Department, has initiated preventative health measures against hemorrhagic fever and other epidemic diseases. This effort includes coordinating with local authorities to prevent unauthorized slaughter and designate alternative, pre-sprayed sites for animal processing. Transporting animals will require health certificates issued only after a specified period following anti-tick spraying. A local veterinary hospital is also collaborating with the governorate and a veterinary college on a strict preventative plan to ensure public safety during an upcoming significant period. The Ministry urges citizens and livestock breeders to cooperate with veterinary teams to protect both human and animal health.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Agricultural Extension and Training Department recently conducted two guidance seminars in the Anbar and Ma...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Agricultural Extension and Training Department recently conducted two guidance seminars in the Anbar and Maysan governorates. These sessions are part of an ongoing initiative to enhance farmers' agricultural knowledge and skills. One seminar, held in Anbar, focused on "The Role of Agricultural Associations in Educating Farmers on How to Reduce Loss and Waste in Wheat Sowing." This particular session, which also took place at a training center in Maysan, covered the causes of wheat sowing loss and waste, the role of agricultural associations in awareness campaigns, proper sowing techniques, and tools to minimize waste and boost production.

records.title: Oman's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by 4.7 percent in the first quarter, reaching 10.53 billion Omani rials, largely driven by a str...
records.description: Oman's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) grew by 4.7 percent in the first quarter, reaching 10.53 billion Omani rials, largely driven by a strong 4.1 percent increase in non-oil activities. The agriculture and fisheries sector saw the highest growth at 11.1 percent. This expansion reflects Oman's strategic focus on diversifying its economy, with non-oil exports also rising significantly. The nation is also implementing fiscal reforms, including a future personal income tax, and its residential property market has shown renewed strength.
records.institution: National Centre for Statistics and Information

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The traditional process of date peeling, known as Tabsil, has commenced in several regions of Oman for the creation of Al Faghour, a loca...
records.description: The traditional process of date peeling, known as Tabsil, has commenced in several regions of Oman for the creation of Al Faghour, a local delicacy. Al Faghour is made from unripe dates and its production is a significant cultural and heritage activity, often carried out by hand by families and communities, particularly in the Wilayat of Manah. This seasonal practice focuses exclusively on Al Mabsaly date palm trees, which are widely cultivated across Oman. After careful peeling, the unripe dates are dried and processed into Al Faghour, a product experiencing growing demand both domestically and internationally, with a substantial portion exported. Besides being enjoyed as a food, Al Faghour is also converted into a powder for use in sweets, cakes, and cookies as a natural sweetener. There are also plans to further integrate Al Faghour into food industries to maximize its economic potential.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its agricultural office in Idhna, has partnered with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the Na...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its agricultural office in Idhna, has partnered with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the Nations (FAO) to provide field school equipment to livestock breeders. This equipment, including a feed press, mixer, and filler feed grinder, is designed to enhance animal nutrition management, decrease costs, and promote sustainable practices. This initiative is part of a broader project focused on "Enhancing Resilience and Food and Nutrition Security of Vulnerable Agricultural Livelihoods in the West Bank and Gaza Strip by Linking Humanitarian Action to Development and Peacebuilding." The project's goal is to improve the capabilities of livestock breeders and boost the efficiency of animal production by supplying essential tools.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, has entered into an agreement to provide cruc...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Jericho and Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, has entered into an agreement to provide crucial agricultural equipment to the Al-Jiftlik Village Council and Al-Auja Municipality. This initiative includes essential tools like an agricultural tractor, a dump truck, and a 500cc spray tank, which are vital for supporting farmers and enabling local councils to deliver effective agricultural services. This support is particularly significant for farmers in Area C, where land is at risk of confiscation by pastoral settlements and military forces. The agreement aligns with the Ministry's strategic plan to equip small farmers, easing their financial burdens related to production in marginalized and vulnerable regions. This intervention demonstrates the Ministry's commitment to enhancing farmer resilience and fostering sustainable agricultural development, especially in the Jordan Valley, a region of considerable agricultural and national importance that faces ongoing aggression.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy and the United Nations Environment Program (UNEP) have formalized their collaboration on climate action...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Energy and the United Nations Environment Program (UNEP) have formalized their collaboration on climate action, signing a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to advance the Regional Cooperation for Emissions Reduction Initiative. This agreement, stemming from recent high-level discussions, aims to bolster MENA countries in achieving their climate goals by fostering clean energy technologies and developing supportive policy frameworks. The partnership will focus on shared objectives of enhancing resource efficiency and reducing carbon emissions through a balanced and sustainable approach. Key areas of cooperation include policy research, international partnerships, knowledge exchange, and the creation of comprehensive climate policy frameworks, all designed to support the overarching aims of the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change and the Paris Agreement, while also promoting Saudi initiatives like the Saudi Green Initiative and the Middle East Green Initiative, and the Circular Carbon Economy (CCE) framework.

records.title: Egypt has achieved a unanimous election to the General Committee of the U.N.
records.description: Egypt has achieved a unanimous election to the General Committee of the U.N. Food and Agriculture Organisation (FAO) conference, currently underway in Rome. This committee is highly selective, comprising only seven of the 194 member states, and plays a crucial role in reviewing and recommending all decisions made during the conference for final adoption. A representative from Egypt's Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation is attending, emphasizing the conference's importance in tackling global challenges like food security, climate change, and sustainable agricultural development. Egypt's participation aims to foster the exchange of expertise and best practices in areas such as smart agriculture, water resource management, and climate change adaptation, ultimately to bolster its own food security and lessen its food gap. The involvement of the Egyptian delegation highlights the nation's active engagement with U.N. agricultural organizations, particularly the FAO.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Egypt is on the cusp of a significant milestone in its agricultural sector, rapidly approaching full self-sufficiency in sugar, a commodi...
records.description: Egypt is on the cusp of a significant milestone in its agricultural sector, rapidly approaching full self-sufficiency in sugar, a commodity deemed crucial for the nation's strategic reserves. The country has already achieved an impressive 90% self-sufficiency, a testament to ongoing efforts and investments in sugar crop cultivation and processing. This upward trajectory is expected to culminate in 100% self-sufficiency next year, driven by the anticipated full operational capacity of the Canal Sugar Company's factory. Looking beyond mere self-sufficiency, the state has ambitious plans to further bolster its sugar industry by establishing a new factory in the Dabaa area.
records.institution: Canal Sugar Company, the Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Lebanon Agriculture Department and Minyeh Agricultural Center, recently collabora...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Lebanon Agriculture Department and Minyeh Agricultural Center, recently collaborated with the Minyeh Municipality to host a seminar for over 90 farmers on "Good Agricultural Practices for Avocado Crops." The session covered modern cultivation techniques, emphasizing quality improvement, sustainable standards, and the safe use of pesticides, with a focus on encouraging farmers to register with the Agricultural Center for better support. The event concluded with a practical field visit and is part of the Ministry's ongoing efforts to support farmers in adopting high-economic-value alternative crops to enhance food security and sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture – Jezzine Agricultural Center recently hosted a seminar in Jezzine for over 45 beekeepers on "Controlling Var...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture – Jezzine Agricultural Center recently hosted a seminar in Jezzine for over 45 beekeepers on "Controlling Varroa Mite in Lebanese Apiaries," as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. The seminar focused on understanding the mite's spread, its impact on bee health, and effective preventative and treatment methods, including the importance of alternating treatment types and adhering to safe dosages. This initiative is part of the Ministry's broader efforts to provide technical knowledge, enhance productivity, and support beekeepers across Lebanon in strengthening the agricultural sector and rural livelihoods.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Jezzine Agricultural Center

records.title: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed a development loan agreement exceeding $38 million with the Ministry of Economy and Plann...
records.description: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has signed a development loan agreement exceeding $38 million with the Ministry of Economy and Planning of the Republic of Tunisia to fund an Oasis Hub Project in southern Tunisia. This project aims to support sustainable rural development by reclaiming over 1,000 hectares of agricultural land, drilling wells, expanding rural villages with housing units and infrastructure, and developing educational, agricultural, cultural, social, and commercial centers. This initiative aligns with the SFD's commitment to financing infrastructure projects that improve living standards, create jobs, and contribute to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in Tunisia, continuing a long-standing development partnership.

records.title: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has granted Tunisia a loan of 112 million dinars (143.3 million Saudi riyals) to finance the creatio...
records.description: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) has granted Tunisia a loan of 112 million dinars (143.3 million Saudi riyals) to finance the creation of an oasis center in southern Tunisia. This agreement, signed in Tunis, will support the expansion of the "Borj Bourguiba" border village in the Ramada delegation (Tataouine governorate) and the establishment of new neighboring villages. Additionally, 1,000 hectares of agricultural land will be developed. This loan is repayable over 20 years, with a 5-year grace period and an interest rate of 2.5%. The project aims to diversify and develop the economy in southern Tunisia, create jobs and income, rationalize underground water use, combat unemployment, preserve desert biodiversity, and enhance climate change resilience. The SFD has a long history of financing development projects in Tunisia, with this being the latest in 32 projects totaling an estimated $1.2 billion.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has initiated a free campaign in Muthanna to combat the palm dust spider mite.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has initiated a free campaign in Muthanna to combat the palm dust spider mite. This effort, conducted by the Department of Plant Protection in collaboration with the Muthanna Agriculture Directorate, involves technical personnel carrying out surveys to identify infestation areas. The Ministry stated that the campaign aims to assist farmers, agriculturalists, and orchard owners throughout the governorate by utilizing effective, environmentally friendly pesticides from international sources.

records.title: The Agricultural Credit Corporation's Irbid branch has launched a program providing interest-free loans to livestock breeders and agricul...
records.description: The Agricultural Credit Corporation's Irbid branch has launched a program providing interest-free loans to livestock breeders and agricultural loans to farmers and rural families in Irbid Governorate. So far, 136 farmers have benefited, with over JD 2 million disbursed across various categories, including support for women's empowerment, rural financing, land reclamation, livestock development, and food processing. The corporation highlights its vital role in supporting the agricultural sector's sustainability, particularly in light of recent low rainfall, by ensuring livestock feed availability and funding projects at subsidized rates.
records.institution: The Agricultural Credit Corporation's Irbid branch

records.title: Kuwait's KOC eyes green economy with net-zero goal by 2050
records.description: Kuwait Oil Company (KOC) is conducting a comprehensive study on the green economy to facilitate its transition to clean energy and achieve net-zero carbon emissions by 2050. This effort includes exploring green hydrogen production, expanding carbon capture, and underground carbon dioxide storage. The Central Agency for Public Tenders (CAPT) recently approved KOC's request to cancel tenders for electrical power supply to industrial pumps, aligning with cost-cutting and emission reduction goals. Despite these cancellations, KOC continues to modernize operations, improve efficiency, and aggressively rehabilitate idle oil wells. The company has a history of integrating renewable energy, notably with its Sidra 500 solar project, and is actively pursuing solar and wind initiatives to balance oil production with sustainability.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) have launched a $4.5 million p...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) have launched a $4.5 million project, funded through the World Bank, to bolster Lebanon's dairy sector. This initiative aims to reduce production costs and create sustainable job opportunities for vulnerable Lebanese and Syrian displaced farmers by providing grants, technical support, and improving productivity. The project will also enhance the Ministry's services with digital tools, mobile veterinary clinics, and laboratories, ultimately strengthening the agricultural sector and rural livelihoods.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has begun deploying drones to monitor forest encroachments in Lebanon, a significant move towards digitizing...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has begun deploying drones to monitor forest encroachments in Lebanon, a significant move towards digitizing environmental protection. This new system has already led to the discovery of an illegal quarry in the Keserwan district, with aerial documentation enabling the issuance of a citation. The Ministry stated that drones will be regularly used across Lebanon, especially in sensitive and hard-to-reach forest areas, to detect random logging, unlicensed quarrying, and encroachments on public forest land. The Ministry urged citizens to report illegal activities and affirmed its commitment to protecting forest resources and prosecuting offenders in coordination with security forces and the judiciary, as part of its vision to modernize the environmental and agricultural sector using advanced technology.

records.title: Morocco has achieved a new record in its agricultural exports, with zucchini shipments to Switzerland surpassing 1,000 tonnes in the 2024...
records.description: Morocco has achieved a new record in its agricultural exports, with zucchini shipments to Switzerland surpassing 1,000 tonnes in the 2024/25 marketing year, a 25% increase from the previous year. This performance, according to EastFruit data, is part of a consistent growth trend, averaging over 40% annually in the last four marketing years. While Spain and Italy remain dominant in the Swiss market, Morocco's market share for zucchini has significantly risen from 2.3% in 2021/22 to 5.8% in 2024/25. This breakthrough is attributed to favorable weather conditions, improved logistics, advantageous trade agreements, and increasing demand for fresh vegetables in Switzerland, particularly during the peak export season from January to March. Morocco is strategically focusing on quality, supply chain efficiency, and innovation to enhance its competitive edge against European rivals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, Water and Forestry

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman's inaugural green ammonia project, developed by Green Hydrogen and Chemicals Company SAOC (GHC), a subsidiary of India-based ACME Gr...
records.description: Oman's inaugural green ammonia project, developed by Green Hydrogen and Chemicals Company SAOC (GHC), a subsidiary of India-based ACME Group, has started receiving essential cargo at the Special Economic Zone at Duqm (SEZAD). This significant project, with an initial capacity of 100,000 tonnes per annum (tpa) and future expansion plans to 1.1 million tpa, has an estimated cost of around $750 million. Key shipments for the project include oversized equipment, solar PV modules, trackers from GameChange Solar for a 450 MWp solar installation, and alkaline electrolysis systems from Sungrow Hydrogen and Shuangliang Hydrogen. The plant is slated for commissioning in the first quarter of 2027 and is pivotal for launching Oman's large-scale green energy industry.
records.institution: Green Hydrogen and Chemicals Company SAOC (GHC)

records.title: Saudi Arabia signs port deals to boost logistics
records.description: Under the patronage of the Minister of Transport and Logistic Services, the Saudi Ports Authority (Mawani) and the National Center for Privatization (NCP) have finalized 20-year Build-Operate-Transfer (BOT) contracts to privatize multipurpose cargo terminals across eight key Saudi ports. These agreements, signed with Saudi Global Ports and Red Sea Gateway Terminal Company, represent a significant private sector investment exceeding SAR 2.2 billion (US$586 million) aimed at boosting port capacity, operational efficiency, and global competitiveness. The Minister highlighted these partnerships as crucial for Saudi Arabia's emergence as a logistics hub, aligning with the National Transport and Logistics Strategy and Vision 2030. The CEO of NCP emphasized this as a comprehensive privatization effort in the maritime sector, expected to yield long-term economic benefits.

records.title: Camel milk is emerging as a valuable resource in southern Tunisia, transforming a long-underutilized product into a new "white gold" for...
records.description: Camel milk is emerging as a valuable resource in southern Tunisia, transforming a long-underutilized product into a new "white gold" for the region. Despite traditional farming methods, scientific research has highlighted the milk's significant nutritional and medicinal benefits, including high iron content, immune-boosting properties, and potential for diabetes management. A pioneering industrial pasteurization unit in Medenine is now processing the milk, aiming to expand its supply network among local farmers. This developing sector is creating jobs and empowering rural communities, offering a sustainable economic opportunity. While challenges like the lack of a specific legal framework, traditional milking practices, high costs, and limited product diversification persist, strategic efforts are underway to address these, including the planned opening of a regional collection and packaging center, all working to establish camel milk as a key driver for the region's sustainable development.

records.title: In Tunisia, the Regional Center for Agricultural Research (CRRA) in Sidi Bouzid recently hosted a national workshop, supported by IRESA (...
records.description: In Tunisia, the Regional Center for Agricultural Research (CRRA) in Sidi Bouzid recently hosted a national workshop, supported by IRESA (Institution of Agricultural Research and Higher Education). This event focused on utilizing local and alternative fodder resources to boost the sustainability of animal production systems, a critical response to the challenges climate change poses to livestock farming in the region. The workshop highlighted the potential of drought-resistant fodder plants and the recovery of agricultural residues, aiming to shift towards a circular agricultural economy. Key recommendations from the gathering included strengthening applied research on local forage, developing public-private partnerships, and integrating sustainable fodder management into agricultural training, all with the goal of building a more resilient livestock sector.
records.institution: The Regional Center for Agricultural Research (CRRA)

records.title: The 2025 agricultural season saw a significant increase in processing tomato production in Tunisia's Gafsa governorate, with a 26% rise i...
records.description: The 2025 agricultural season saw a significant increase in processing tomato production in Tunisia's Gafsa governorate, with a 26% rise in harvest volume attributed to expanded cultivation areas. The harvest, confirmed as healthy and high-quality by regional technical services, is primarily destined for industrial processing. Despite this success, the sector faces challenges like a lack of farmer organization, high input costs, and logistical issues. Efforts are underway by regional authorities and stakeholders to address these by promoting producer groups, strengthening technical capacities, and improving infrastructure to ensure a more sustainable and resilient tomato industry in southwest Tunisia.
records.institution: The Regional Center for Agricultural Research (CRDA) in Gafsa

records.title: ADQ, an Abu Dhabi-based sovereign investor, plans to acquire a 35% stake in Limagrain Vegetable Seeds (LVS), the vegetable seed division...
records.description: ADQ, an Abu Dhabi-based sovereign investor, plans to acquire a 35% stake in Limagrain Vegetable Seeds (LVS), the vegetable seed division of Limagrain. This strategic move aims to deepen ADQ's involvement in the food value chain. As part of this collaboration, LVS and Silal, an ADQ agri-food technology company, will form a joint venture to develop desert-adapted vegetable genetics. This partnership will focus on creating crop varieties resilient to extreme heat, drought, and salinity, with research conducted at Silal's Innovation Oasis in Al Ain. The initiative is expected to significantly enhance the UAE's national food security agenda by boosting local innovation in climate-resilient seeds and increasing domestic food production.

records.title: Armenia has approved an economic partnership agreement with the UAE under the EAEU framework, a move that follows negotiations initiated...
records.description: Armenia has approved an economic partnership agreement with the UAE under the EAEU framework, a move that follows negotiations initiated in 2022. This agreement aims to boost and streamline trade by reducing barriers and fostering economic cooperation. Notably, approximately 95% of Armenia's exports to the UAE will receive preferential treatment. Once effective, 217 out of 270 export goods will gain preferential access, potentially saving Armenian exporters around $500,000 by reducing average customs duties from 6% to 2.6%. Armenia is particularly focused on increasing agricultural exports such as fresh fruits, tomatoes, and honey, eyeing a potential export value of at least $10 million in the UAE market.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Algeria’s state-owned oil company, Sonatrach, has signed a memorandum of understanding with US-based Hecate Renewable Energy and steelmak...
records.description: Algeria’s state-owned oil company, Sonatrach, has signed a memorandum of understanding with US-based Hecate Renewable Energy and steelmaker Tosyali Algerie to develop a green hydrogen project aimed at decarbonizing steel production. The agreement involves an initial feasibility study phase followed by project development, supporting Algeria’s broader strategy to expand renewable energy and green hydrogen capacity while preserving natural gas for export. The project aligns with regional initiatives like the proposed SoutH2 Corridor pipeline, which could supply a significant portion of Europe’s future hydrogen needs by 2030.
records.institution: National State-Owned Oil and Gas Company

records.title: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development recently hosted the first meeting of liaison officers for the Arab Olive Office, bring...
records.description: The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development recently hosted the first meeting of liaison officers for the Arab Olive Office, bringing together representatives from Arab ministries of agriculture and regional organizations. This foundational meeting aimed to establish a coordination platform for supporting the olive sector, focusing on enhancing its role in food, economic, and environmental security. Key discussions involved organizing the office, defining its tasks, establishing a technical advisory committee for the private sector, and unifying standard specifications for olive oil. An action plan was approved to guide future work, with a particular focus on addressing the upcoming change in olive oil classification by the International Olive Council. Participants commended the efforts to establish the office and Tunisia's initiative to host a national training center, ultimately recommending an ambitious plan for the following year to support olive oil value chains, research, and innovation across Arab countries.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), in partnership with King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST), h...
records.description: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST), in partnership with King Abdulaziz City for Science and Technology (KACST), has developed an innovative new composite material that significantly enhances solar cell efficiency and lifespan through passive cooling. This breakthrough material absorbs moisture at night and releases it during the day, effectively cooling solar panels without consuming electricity, leading to an 18 percent reduction in electricity generation costs. Tested successfully across diverse climates, this technology also shows potential for applications in lighting and laser technologies, contributing to national goals in renewable energy and food security.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.title: Abu Dhabi investment firm ADQ is in discussions to acquire a 35% stake in the vegetable seeds business of French agricultural group Limag...
records.description: Abu Dhabi investment firm ADQ is in discussions to acquire a 35% stake in the vegetable seeds business of French agricultural group Limagrain. This proposed alliance would also involve a joint research and development (R&D) partnership in the UAE, focusing on developing desert-adapted seeds for harsh climates. Limagrain, a leading global seed supplier and the largest in the vegetable seed segment, views this as an opportunity to boost its research into climate-resilient varieties and aligns with its strategy of bringing in minority shareholders. ADQ has prior investments in the agricultural supply chain, including a significant stake in a major crop merchant.

records.title: The fourth edition of the Mango Festival is underway at Expo Khorfakkan, organized by the Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)...
records.description: The fourth edition of the Mango Festival is underway at Expo Khorfakkan, organized by the Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI) in collaboration with local municipal bodies. This event aims to promote the Eastern Region as an agri-tourism destination, support local farmers, and enhance the quality and sustainability of domestic agricultural products, aligning with national food security goals. The festival showcases over 150 premium local mango varieties, offers cultural activities and educational programs on advanced agricultural practices, and features various competitions, ultimately fostering partnerships within the agribusiness sector and supporting sustainable development.
records.institution: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.title: The General Secretariat of Khalifa International Award for Date Palm and Agricultural Innovation, affiliated with Erth Zayed Philanthropi...
records.description: The General Secretariat of Khalifa International Award for Date Palm and Agricultural Innovation, affiliated with Erth Zayed Philanthropies, Presidential Court, has signed an agreement with the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development of the United Mexican States to organize the fourth Mexico International Date Palm Festival. This collaboration highlights the UAE's efforts in supporting global date palm cultivation, aiming to enhance expertise exchange, develop value chains, and expand marketing opportunities for Mexican dates, thereby contributing to sustainable economic and agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development

records.title: Witthal to set up UAE’s first lithium battery recycling plant at Kezad
records.description: Witthal Gulf Industries, a part of Singapore-based Witthal Group, has secured a 50-year land lease agreement with the Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (Kezad Group) to establish the UAE's first lithium battery recycling plant in the Taweelah region. The company, a major player in the global commodities market, will invest AED 40 million ($11 million) in this project. The new plant will utilize cutting-edge technology to recycle end-of-life batteries from electric vehicles, solar farms, and other renewable energy systems, recovering valuable materials like black mass, copper, and aluminum to produce sustainable alternatives. This collaboration is set to create robust infrastructure for responsible lithium battery recycling, aligning with both entities' vision for sustainable industrial development and the UAE's net-zero goals.
records.institution: Witthal Gulf Industries, Khalifa Economic Zones Abu Dhabi (Kezad Group)

records.title: Egypt is actively seeking greater access to the Philippine market for its key agricultural exports, specifically onions, garlic, potatoes...
records.description: Egypt is actively seeking greater access to the Philippine market for its key agricultural exports, specifically onions, garlic, potatoes, and grapes, with the aim of establishing the Philippines as a distribution hub for Egyptian goods to ASEAN nations. This request was made by Egypt's Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation during the Philippines' National Day celebration, where he underscored the long-standing and multifaceted relationship between the two countries, despite current bilateral trade levels not meeting their full potential. The Minister highlighted existing foundational agreements and Egypt's strategic position as a gateway to African markets, while encouraging the Philippines to serve a similar role for Egyptian exports into ASEAN. He also called for increased private sector engagement and investment, particularly in agriculture, to enhance food security and mutual economic interests across various sectors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its Department of Forests and Desertification, has supplied the Gazal AlReem Reserve with 800 f...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its Department of Forests and Desertification, has supplied the Gazal AlReem Reserve with 800 fodder pellets, a fodder mixture. This initiative, facilitated by the National Program for Seed Multiplication and Production of Fodder Crops, is part of a collaborative effort with local governments. It aims to address a fodder shortage at the reserve, aligning with the national program's goals of boosting fodder availability and conserving biodiversity, all within the broader context of supporting food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Computer Science Department, has established an advanced digital work platform.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Computer Science Department, has established an advanced digital work platform. This platform is part of a larger project to automate the ministry's systems, encompassing functionalities such as managing incoming and outgoing communications, human resources, and powers. Utilizing modern technologies like Python, Django, and MySQL, the platform is designed to boost institutional work efficiency and improve the technical skills of participants in computer applications and electronic archiving. The training, led by the Director of the Computer Science Department and other specialists, focused on building a strong foundation in information technology to enable ministry personnel to adapt to the demands of digital transformation.

records.title: The fifth Jordanian Interlinkages Exhibition for Packaging and Printing (JOPEX), organized by the Eastern Amman Industrial Investors Asso...
records.description: The fifth Jordanian Interlinkages Exhibition for Packaging and Printing (JOPEX), organized by the Eastern Amman Industrial Investors Association (EAIIA), recently opened in Amman, featuring 24 major local companies in the packaging, printing, and plastics industries. Held concurrently with the International Exhibition for Electromechanical Machinery and Equipment, JOPEX aims to connect industrial, commercial, and service sectors while showcasing innovative solutions. To boost global visibility for Jordan's manufacturing, the association invited international investors and businesspeople to explore investment opportunities and facilitate commercial agreements. The packaging, printing, and plastics sectors in East Amman comprise around 260 facilities employing nearly 5,000 workers, with combined exports reaching approximately JD 40 million in 2024. The exhibition serves as a platform to explore production technologies and foster business partnerships.
records.institution: The Eastern Amman Industrial Investors Association (EAIIA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture recently signed a 1.65 million euro grant agreement with the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture recently signed a 1.65 million euro grant agreement with the Italian Agency for Development Cooperation. This funding will support a project designed to enhance food security and foster inclusive economic growth by promoting sustainable rural products and the efficient use of local resources. The initiative aligns with various national frameworks, including plans for sustainable agriculture, economic modernization, green growth, climate change adaptation, and national food security. The project will specifically focus on strengthening the resilience of agricultural and food supply chains through support for smallholder farmers, the introduction of improved technologies and protocols, and the enhancement of local production, food quality, and sustainable natural resource management. The Ministry expressed gratitude for the Italian government's ongoing support to its agricultural sector.

records.title: The Model Farms Programme in Al Dhahirah Governorate, launched in 2020, is a significant initiative aimed at increasing farmers' income b...
records.description: The Model Farms Programme in Al Dhahirah Governorate, launched in 2020, is a significant initiative aimed at increasing farmers' income by providing high-yielding seeds and modern irrigation systems. This project supports over 250 farms, distributing more than 15,000 date palm offshoots and various fruit seedlings, including mango, Adalia lemon, Omani lemon, guava, figs, and grapes. These efforts have led to the cultivation of date palm and fruit trees across 140 fedans, contributing to the agricultural development of the governorate. The program is an integral part of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources' broader plan to enhance food security and achieve sustainable agricultural development in Oman. The Ministry, in close cooperation with farmers, supports this program, which also extends to other governorates. The core idea is to achieve a qualitative shift in the agricultural sector by improving quality and productivity, with the distribution of seedlings governed by strict conditions to ensure the installation of modern irrigation systems for water conservation and increased production efficiency, thereby making these farms agriculturally sustainable.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Wilayat of Taqah in Dhofar Governorate recently hosted the second Agricultural Forum, a two-day event organized by the Office of the...
records.description: The Wilayat of Taqah in Dhofar Governorate recently hosted the second Agricultural Forum, a two-day event organized by the Office of the Wali of Taqah in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. This gathering brought together farmers, agricultural experts, government officials, and private sector partners to advance sustainable agriculture and support national food security. The forum aimed to strengthen local farming practices, boost productivity, and expand rural economic opportunities, with discussions highlighting Dhofar’s unique advantage of the annual monsoon season, known as Khareef, for reviving traditional farming cycles and expanding crop production. Technical sessions covered topics such as pest control, livestock genetic improvements, and enhancing the value of local agricultural products. An agricultural exhibition showcased local produce, agri-tech solutions, and services.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Pest Control and Monitoring Department within the General Administration of Plant P...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Pest Control and Monitoring Department within the General Administration of Plant Protection and Agricultural Quarantine, held a virtual meeting with plant protection inspectors. This initiative aims to establish a specialized unit for monitoring insect pests, assessing infection levels, and developing epidemiological maps to guide interventions. The unit will utilize various traps for weekly monitoring on selected model farms, ensuring close coordination with agricultural extension units to provide farmers with technical recommendations. This effort is central to the Ministry's strategy to enhance pest control capabilities and protect agricultural production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Tubas Governorate Agriculture Directorate and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Department, has...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Tubas Governorate Agriculture Directorate and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Department, has provided the Bardala Association for Livestock Development with equipment for alternative feed production. This initiative, part of a project funded by Italian Cooperation, aims to support the livestock sector in marginalized areas impacted by external pressures and rising costs, while also promoting the utilization of agricultural waste. It underscores the Ministry's commitment to strengthening farmer resilience and ensuring sustainable livestock and agricultural production in the Northern Jordan Valley.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change in Qatar organized a workshop on the updated National Biodiversity Strategy as part of the...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change in Qatar organized a workshop on the updated National Biodiversity Strategy as part of the Early Action Support Project for the Global Biodiversity Framework, in collaboration with the Global Environment Facility and the United Nations Environment Programme. The event reviewed new national objectives and initiatives aimed at conserving biodiversity, supporting food and water security, and promoting sustainable environmental resources in line with Qatar National Vision 2030. It also focused on aligning national priorities with global biodiversity targets and fostering inclusive participation from government, academia, civil society, and the private sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change

records.title: Tabuk Agricultural Development Company (TADCO) has sought approval from the Capital Market Authority (CMA) to reduce its capital by 52.94%.
records.description: Tabuk Agricultural Development Company (TADCO) has sought approval from the Capital Market Authority (CMA) to reduce its capital by 52.94%. This move, recommended by the board, aims to restructure the company's capital and extinguish accumulated losses. If approved, TADCO's capital will decrease from SAR 391.76 million to SAR 184.35 million, with a corresponding reduction in the number of shares. The capital reduction is contingent on both CMA approval and the endorsement of the company's extraordinary general assembly. This financial restructuring follows TADCO's recent agreement to establish a power transmission station for its farm in the Tabuk region.

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in collaboration with Aramco, successfully sowed appr...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification, in collaboration with Aramco, successfully sowed approximately 50 million seeds of native plant species across three sites in the Rub' al Khali Desert and two additional sites in eastern Saudi Arabia. This initiative aligns with the Saudi Green Initiative and the Middle East Green Initiative, demonstrating Saudi Arabia’s commitment to global climate goals and efforts to combat climate change. This action further expands the country's ongoing greening efforts towards a sustainable future. Since the launch of Vision 2030, Saudi Arabia has made significant strides in environmental protection, accelerating energy transition, and implementing sustainability programs, including offsetting carbon emissions, expanding afforestation, restoring land, and protecting natural areas.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification

records.title: The Director General of the Ministry of Production and Economic Resources in Gadarif State recently met with a delegation from the Arab O...
records.description: The Director General of the Ministry of Production and Economic Resources in Gadarif State recently met with a delegation from the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development (AOAD). This meeting is part of the Agricultural Transformation Systems Platform, an initiative in Gedaref State aimed at moving farmers from traditional to sustainable commercial production, including a Smallholder Farmers Livelihood Support Project. The AOAD highlighted the crucial role of existing technologies from the Ministry and research centers in boosting production efficiency, noting Gedaref's suitability for this transformation. The discussion also covered providing farmer financing through the Irada company and supporting women farmers via cooperatives.
records.institution: The Ministry of Production and Economic Resources

records.title: The Undersecretary of the Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources recently inspected irrigation divisions within the Gezira and Al-Man...
records.description: The Undersecretary of the Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources recently inspected irrigation divisions within the Gezira and Al-Managil Scheme to assess water flow following the start of the new agricultural season's pumping. The Ministry plans to increase water supply to meet agricultural needs, despite prior damage to canals. Remediation efforts, including clearing silt and weeds, are continuing, and officials reassured farmers that water will be consistently available throughout the project area.
records.institution: The Ministry of Irrigation and Water Resources

records.title: In a notable agricultural achievement in Tunisia's Béja region, over 5,000 cereal varieties have been successfully multiplied and regener...
records.description: In a notable agricultural achievement in Tunisia's Béja region, over 5,000 cereal varieties have been successfully multiplied and regenerated by the National Institute of Agronomic Research of Tunisia (INRAT) and the National Institute of Large-Scale Crops (INGC). This effort is crucial for preserving plant genetic resources and bolstering national seed sovereignty, especially as Tunisia largely depends on imported seeds and faces climate challenges. The project has produced over 80 tons of seeds, including varieties showing exceptional drought resistance and adaptability, and has reintroduced forgotten indigenous cereals. This initiative is a major step towards food security, reducing economic vulnerability, and promoting sustainable farming practices by reducing chemical inputs and optimizing water use, with plans to extend to other cereal-producing governorates.
records.institution: National Institute of Agronomic Research of Tunisia (INRAT)

records.title: Tunisia significantly relies on imported potato seeds, with the majority sourced from other European countries, making it vulnerable to m...
records.description: Tunisia significantly relies on imported potato seeds, with the majority sourced from other European countries, making it vulnerable to market fluctuations and supply chain issues. A strong call has been made to activate a national plan for local seed production, aiming to reduce this dependency and enhance food security, especially as Tunisian agroclimatic conditions are now favorable for multiple potato growing seasons. Extensive testing of various potato varieties is underway across the country to identify the most resilient and profitable options. The proposed national plan for self-sufficiency involves establishing production stations, training farmers, implementing certification, and fostering public-private partnerships, all crucial steps towards stabilizing yields, reducing costs, and positioning Tunisia as a regional leader in sustainable seed production.
records.institution: Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP)

records.title: Tunisia, a major olive oil exporter, faces a challenge with low domestic consumption despite high production.
records.description: Tunisia, a major olive oil exporter, faces a challenge with low domestic consumption despite high production. The National Oil Office (ONH) highlights this reliance on exports over local use. To counter this, the International Olive Council (IOC) has launched a funding initiative to promote local consumption of olive oil and table olives in member countries, including Tunisia. This strategic move aims to boost domestic demand, support local producers, and enhance food sovereignty, leveraging Tunisia's significant olive-growing regions and the health benefits of its olive products.

records.description: An open community gathering, co-organized by the Emirates Council for Balanced Development and Emirates Nature-WWF, recently brought together residents in Al Rams, Ras Al Khaimah, to brainstorm ideas for a sustainable future, aiming to align future initiatives with local needs and preserve the area's unique identity. This "majlis" is part of a broader sustainable development roadmap for Al Rams, which includes infrastructure enhancements and eco-tourism plans. This collaborative effort, led by the Emirates Council for Balanced Development, seeks to improve quality of life and foster economic growth in Emirati villages, leveraging nature-based projects to conserve heritage, create unique tourism experiences, and generate opportunities for local people, particularly youth, farmers, and entrepreneurs, while establishing Al Rams as a national model for sustainable rural living.
records.institution: The Emirates Council for Balanced Development and Emirates Nature-WWF

records.title: Officials in the Capital recently participated in a fruit tree planting campaign across two districts, an initiative led by the Capital S...
records.description: Officials in the Capital recently participated in a fruit tree planting campaign across two districts, an initiative led by the Capital Secretariat's Agriculture Sector and Knights of Development. Trees and coffee seedlings were planted, with emphasis placed on the economic and environmental benefits and the importance of community participation and local nurseries. Over 13,500 fruit trees have been planted in recent months as part of ongoing efforts to green the capital and foster agricultural development.

records.title: Egyptian sweet potato producers are gearing up for a promising season, anticipating consistent volume, high quality, and expanding global...
records.description: Egyptian sweet potato producers are gearing up for a promising season, anticipating consistent volume, high quality, and expanding global demand. Years of meticulous agricultural practices have resulted in exceptional crop quality for key varieties, with production and export volumes projected to increase significantly. While previous seasons faced challenges from overproduction, initial market indicators suggest more favorable pricing due to global supply shortages and rising production costs, with strong European demand expected to stabilize the market for premium quality produce. Buyers are becoming more discerning, reinforcing the value of high-quality crops, and interest is growing across established markets in Europe and the Middle East, as well as emerging markets in Asia and Eastern Europe. The nation has cemented its position as a reliable supplier in the international sweet potato market, leveraging its advantageous location and agricultural expertise to meet global off-season demand.
records.institution: The Egyptian Department of Agricultural Quarantine (Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation)

records.title: Iraq has lifted its trade ban on Brazilian chicken meat, which was put in place last month due to a bird flu case on a commercial farm.
records.description: Iraq has lifted its trade ban on Brazilian chicken meat, which was put in place last month due to a bird flu case on a commercial farm. South Korea has also eased its restrictions, now limiting imports only from the region affected by the outbreak, rather than a nationwide ban. Brazil is working to reverse remaining trade restrictions after recently declaring itself free of the bird flu virus in commercial flocks, following a 28-day period with no new outbreaks on commercial farms.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully completed the mechanical harvest of alfalfa at the Al-Suwaira Research Station in Wasit Gove...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully completed the mechanical harvest of alfalfa at the Al-Suwaira Research Station in Wasit Governorate. This achievement was carried out by the Fodder Crop Seed Multiplication and Manufacturing Program, under the purview of the Agricultural Research Department. This harvest is a regular part of the Agricultural Research Department's work plan, aimed at ensuring the supply and processing of fodder crops to support the nation's livestock sector. The Ministry affirmed that this program contributes to sustainable fodder production and seeks to boost self-sufficiency by expanding agricultural cultivation at the Agricultural Research Department's stations and fields.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture recently conducted a specialized training course titled "Basics of Managing and Monitoring Agricultural Proje...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture recently conducted a specialized training course titled "Basics of Managing and Monitoring Agricultural Projects."
