This course was designed for various technical and administrative employees across the Ministry's departments. The instruction, provided by an Assistant Director from the Agricultural Incubators Department, covered key topics including a comparison of programs and projects, as well as the professional fundamentals of project management. The importance of integrating modern management methodologies to boost project implementation efficiency and achieve sustainable agricultural development objectives was highlighted during the training. This initiative is one of several training programs organized by the Ministry to enhance its staff's capabilities and elevate overall institutional performance, thereby enabling it to address the agricultural and economic challenges facing the country.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Women's Affairs Department, highlighted its key achievements in supporting rural women during a...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Women's Affairs Department, highlighted its key achievements in supporting rural women during a workshop titled "Enhancing the Role of Women in the Private Sector and Supporting Their Economic Empowerment." This workshop was a collaborative effort with the National Department for Iraqi Women at the General Secretariat of the Council of Ministers. The event, attended by the Undersecretary of the Ministry of Planning for Administrative Affairs and representatives from women's affairs departments across various ministries, focused on strategies to empower rural women to actively engage in the local economy through small and medium-sized agricultural projects. The workshop also referenced a significant celebration held by the Ministry the previous year, which showcased the inspiring success stories of rural women in agriculture and rural development.

records.title: In the first quarter of 2025, Moroccan fruit and vegetable exports to the European Union saw a significant 14% increase in value, reachin...
records.description: In the first quarter of 2025, Moroccan fruit and vegetable exports to the European Union saw a significant 14% increase in value, reaching €1.121 billion, solidifying Morocco's standing as a crucial supplier to the European market. Tomatoes remained the leading export, valued at €369 million, with peppers and green beans also being significant contributors. A notable development was the surge in avocado exports, which jumped by 101% in volume and 79% in value, reaching €176.7 million. Despite some minor decreases in volumes for certain vegetables, the overall trend of Moroccan fruit and vegetable exports to the EU is upward, driven by the quality and competitive pricing of its products. This performance further strengthens Morocco's position as a key agricultural partner for Europe.

records.title: The Moroccan avocado industry achieved a record export volume of over 100,000 tonnes during the 2024/2025 season, attributed to favorable...
records.description: The Moroccan avocado industry achieved a record export volume of over 100,000 tonnes during the 2024/2025 season, attributed to favorable climatic conditions and optimal flowering that doubled cultivated areas in five years. Despite this significant growth, the sector faces challenges, including a 20% drop in prices due to domestic overproduction and heightened international competition. To address these issues and further structure the young industry, an interprofessional organization is slated for creation next season to enhance coordination between producers and exporters. With potential market expansion into the United States and increasing global demand, the Moroccan avocado industry is poised to solidify its position in the global market.

records.title: The Second Agricultural Forum has officially opened in the Wilayat of Taqah, Dhofar Governorate.
records.description: The Second Agricultural Forum has officially opened in the Wilayat of Taqah, Dhofar Governorate. This two-day event brings together agricultural experts, farmers, government officials, and rural entrepreneurs to discuss modernizing agriculture, supporting local communities, and strengthening food security in line with Oman Vision 2040. Organized by the Office of the Wali of Taqah in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the forum features technical presentations, case studies, and an exhibition of innovative agricultural products and technologies. Key topics include improving date palm cultivation, modern breeding practices, veterinary health standards in livestock farming, and enhancing the value of local agricultural goods. The event also promotes home-based farming and sustainable animal husbandry, with competitions and the distribution of free seedlings and farming starter kits. The forum emphasizes applied agricultural research, pest management, hydroponic farming, sustainable irrigation, and home nurseries, underscoring Dhofar's importance to Oman's food production and the country's commitment to economic diversification and climate-resilient agricultural practices.
records.institution: Office of the Wali of Taqah

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Veolia has launched its GreenUp 2027 strategic program in Oman, highlighting three significant projects in waste, water, and energy manag...
records.description: Veolia has launched its GreenUp 2027 strategic program in Oman, highlighting three significant projects in waste, water, and energy management that align with Oman's Vision 2040 and its shift towards a low-carbon, resource-efficient economy. In waste management, Veolia is transforming the Barka and Al Multaqa landfills into pioneering biogas-to-energy systems, converting landfill gas into 1.08 MW of renewable energy and maximizing landfill capacity while reducing greenhouse gas emissions. For water, in partnership with Petroleum Development Oman (PDO), Veolia operates the Rima Wetlands, a nature-based solution for oilfield wastewater treatment that processes 66,000 cubic meters daily, significantly reducing CO2 emissions and fostering wildlife habitats. In energy, the Sur Desalination Plant is a vital water infrastructure asset that integrates one of Oman's largest solar farms dedicated to water production, providing potable water to over 600,000 residents and increasingly powered by renewable sources with advanced reverse osmosis technology.

records.title: Date markets across Saudi Arabia are now receiving the early harvest of dates from Madinah, signaling the start of the annual date season.
records.description: Date markets across Saudi Arabia are now receiving the early harvest of dates from Madinah, signaling the start of the annual date season. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture stated that Madinah alone produces 58 distinct date varieties, contributing to the Kingdom's extensive total of over 404 varieties grown nationwide. Saudi Arabia boasts approximately 37.1 million date palm trees, with total date production surpassing 1.9 million tons. Regionally, Qassim led in production, followed by Riyadh, Madinah, and the Eastern Region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Center for Curriculum and Educational Research has announced a new plan for vocational training and technical education in S...
records.description: The National Center for Curriculum and Educational Research has announced a new plan for vocational training and technical education in Sudan, with a strong focus on youth who have been impacted by recent instability. This initiative aims to enhance employment opportunities by building the capacities of educators and administrators at the Port Sudan Industrial School, in collaboration with UNESCO. The program will develop qualifications frameworks, curriculum, and provide training in various technical fields like industry, agriculture, engineering, and crafts, along with offering short-term courses to meet job market demands.
records.institution: National Center for Curriculum and Educational Research

records.title: The 20th edition of Food Expo 2025 was launched in Damascus under the patronage of the Ministry of Economy and Industry, bringing togethe...
records.description: The 20th edition of Food Expo 2025 was launched in Damascus under the patronage of the Ministry of Economy and Industry, bringing together over 200 local, Arab, and international companies representing 800 brands. Held within a 25,000 square meter exhibition space, the event aims to support Syria’s food industry, foster connections between businesses and investors, and present the latest technological innovations in the sector. Positioned as a key platform for exporters, importers, decision-makers, and researchers, the exhibition showcases diverse food product categories and promotes the country’s role in the regional and global food market.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Industry

records.title: In the Capital Secretariat, Yemen, several agricultural and fisheries projects, funded by the local authority through the Agricultural Pr...
records.description: In the Capital Secretariat, Yemen, several agricultural and fisheries projects, funded by the local authority through the Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, have been inaugurated. These initiatives, totaling over 659 million Yemeni riyals, aim to boost food security and self-sufficiency by establishing fish sales points, launching a digital platform for support, and enhancing the Agricultural and Veterinary Institute through hospital upgrades and educational resource improvements for its colleges. Officials emphasize that these projects strengthen value chains, promote local product marketing, and contribute to a resilient economy, with plans for further integration and expansion of similar initiatives nationwide.
records.institution: Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation in Egypt has announced a significant increase in agricultural exports, reaching 5.2 mill...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation in Egypt has announced a significant increase in agricultural exports, reaching 5.2 million tons in the first half of the year. Citrus fruits and potatoes were the leading export commodities. The Central Administration for Agricultural Quarantine, an entity under the Ministry, was responsible for releasing these figures. The Ministry emphasizes its dedication to strengthening Egypt's position as a regional hub for agricultural exports by implementing rigorous quality and food safety standards to access new international markets and build global trust. It also provides support to exporters, addresses obstacles, and acknowledges the crucial contributions of farmers, producers, engineers, and quarantine authorities in maintaining quality throughout the entire export process.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department's Animal Wealth Research Division, has released a new hatch of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department's Animal Wealth Research Division, has released a new hatch of local quail and chicken chicks from its Poultry Research Station. This initiative is part of broader efforts to manage poultry surplus, replenish existing flocks, and generate additional revenue. Veterinary staff are overseeing the hatching and routine vaccination processes, ensuring the birds receive proper healthcare and a suitable breeding environment. These sustainable activities are continuously monitored as part of the Agricultural Research Department's commitment to advancing the poultry sector and securing all necessary operational requirements.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture (MoA) and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) have signed an agreement...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture (MoA) and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) have signed an agreement to prepare for a comprehensive agricultural census in Lebanon. This crucial initiative will establish the legal and institutional framework and enhance the Ministry's technical capacity, aligning with international standards. The project aims to update outdated agricultural data, which is essential for evidence-based planning, policymaking, and fostering more sustainable and resilient food and agricultural systems for the future.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Lebanon Agriculture Department and Bakhoun Agricultural Center, in collaboration...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Lebanon Agriculture Department and Bakhoun Agricultural Center, in collaboration with the Beit al-Faks Municipality, recently organized a seminar in Denniyeh. The event addressed challenges faced by beekeepers, such as climate fluctuations, marketing issues due to adulterated honey, disease from uncoordinated pesticide use, and weak support. Proposed solutions included enacting protective legislation, establishing quality testing laboratories, providing sustainable financial and technical aid, fostering cooperation, and diversifying products. The seminar emphasized the sector's vital role in the rural economy and the need for a comprehensive strategy combining technical support, environmental protection, and quality improvement.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture – Agricultural Center in Chehim recently held a training workshop at the "For Development First" Association...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture – Agricultural Center in Chehim recently held a training workshop at the "For Development First" Association center in Mazraat El Dahr. The workshop, attended by approximately 25 farmers, focused on the sensory tasting of olive oil and scientific methods for quality assessment. Participants gained practical skills in evaluating oil quality and discussed best practices for storage and crop improvement, all part of the Ministry's ongoing efforts to enhance agricultural production and empower rural communities across Lebanon.

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The 4th edition of the Hassan II Agronomic and Veterinary Institute (IAV) Exhibition was recently held in Rabat, focusing on "The Morocco...
records.description: The 4th edition of the Hassan II Agronomic and Veterinary Institute (IAV) Exhibition was recently held in Rabat, focusing on "The Morocco of tomorrow: towards a territorial transition and efficient management of natural resources." Organized by student associations, the event highlighted the crucial role of local dynamics in agricultural and territorial transitions, emphasizing that territories are central to challenges like climate change and food security. The "Green Generation" strategy was noted for placing human capital at the core of agricultural transformation, stressing the need to connect academic knowledge with practical realities. The Institute's ambition is to serve as a hub for ideas and solutions, strengthening ties between researchers, industry, decision-makers, and future professionals to build a more sustainable agricultural model.
records.institution: Hassan II Agronomic and Veterinary Institute (IAV)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Omani researchers from the German University of Technology in Oman (GUtech) and Oman LNG, in collaboration with EJAAD (the research and d...
records.description: Omani researchers from the German University of Technology in Oman (GUtech) and Oman LNG, in collaboration with EJAAD (the research and development platform of the Ministry of Higher Education, Research and Innovation), have completed a study on repurposing the Sultanate's natural gas pipeline network for green hydrogen transport. This is crucial for Oman's future green hydrogen economy, which aims to produce up to 8.5 million tonnes annually by 2050 for both export and domestic decarbonization. The study assessed the technical and economic feasibility of retrofitting existing pipelines, noting that this approach offers significant cost and complexity advantages over building new infrastructure, leveraging the existing, well-established network. The research included rigorous analysis of operating conditions, gas mixtures, and physical properties, developing a model to calculate the levelized cost of hydrogen transport across various natural gas-hydrogen blends. EJAAD facilitated this public-private partnership, demonstrating the value of such collaborations in supporting Oman's energy transition and economic diversification efforts.
records.institution: German University of Technology in Oman (GUtech), Oman LNG

records.title: Vineyards in Saudi Arabia's Najran Region have begun supplying local markets with high-quality grape harvests, following a five-month cul...
records.description: Vineyards in Saudi Arabia's Najran Region have begun supplying local markets with high-quality grape harvests, following a five-month cultivation period. This agricultural process, from planting to irrigation and care, is a seasonal tradition for the region's farmers, with grapes now distributed across Najran and throughout Saudi Arabia. The region's farms annually yield nearly 3,000 tons of grapes from 67 hectares, including both white and black varieties. The fertile soil, moderate climate, and ample water supply in Najran contribute to the exceptional quality of these grapes, making agriculture a significant contributor to the local economy and a vital income source for farmers. Known for their nutritional value, rich flavor, and sweetness, Najran's grapes are in high demand. Recent observations noted scenic rows of grape clusters and farmers actively harvesting and packing the fruit.

records.title: The nation has achieved a significant milestone in its organic agriculture sector, exporting a substantial volume of certified products a...
records.description: The nation has achieved a significant milestone in its organic agriculture sector, exporting a substantial volume of certified products and generating considerable revenue across numerous international markets. Organic olive oil remains the leading export, highly sought after in European and North American countries, with organic dates also contributing significantly. This success is a testament to an ambitious national strategy aimed at establishing the country as a major global force in organic farming, emphasizing high-value products, expanding certified cultivation, and developing producer expertise. Primary production areas for organic olive oil and dates are concentrated in specific regions known for their favorable conditions. Despite this encouraging performance, the sector faces ongoing challenges, including market price fluctuations, certification expenses, import regulations, and the effects of environmental shifts on yields.

records.title: The Tunisian Forum for Economic and Social Rights (FTDES) has strongly criticized the Ministry of Agriculture's explanation for a "red ti...
records.description: The Tunisian Forum for Economic and Social Rights (FTDES) has strongly criticized the Ministry of Agriculture's explanation for a "red tide" and mass fish deaths in the Gulf of Monastir, which the Ministry attributed to natural causes. The FTDES asserts that the region has suffered chronic pollution since the 1990s due to continuous discharge of domestic and industrial wastewater from several treatment plants and factories, directly implicating the National Sanitation Office (ONAS) and industrial entities. The Forum cites historical studies and reports that highlight human responsibility for decades of environmental degradation and accuses authorities of attempting to conceal disastrous public policies. The FTDES demands that a state of environmental emergency be declared, an extraordinary ministerial council be convened to address the crisis with concrete financial and operational measures, responsible parties be held accountable, and legal action be taken against those whose policies have worsened the situation, warning of escalating social tensions if genuine political will is absent.
records.institution: The Tunisian Forum for Economic and Social Rights (FTDES)

records.title: The Tunisian Wildlife Association (ATVS) has launched "Naturadex Islands," a new online biodiversity platform.
records.description: The Tunisian Wildlife Association (ATVS) has launched "Naturadex Islands," a new online biodiversity platform. This collaborative and free-to-access portal already holds over 2,500 data points on the fauna and flora of wetlands in the Béja Governorate, with plans to expand to other Tunisian islands. It aims to centralize, share, and promote knowledge about the nation's island biodiversity, providing access to ATVS's collected data and comprehensive species checklists. Citizens are encouraged to contribute their own observations to the evolving database. The project is a collaborative effort with several partner organizations focused on marine environment, sustainable development, and biological systems, and receives funding from the Critical Ecosystem Partnership Fund (CEPF) and the PIM Initiative for Small Mediterranean Islands.

records.title: Tunisia faces a potential 28% surcharge on its exports to the United States, particularly impacting olive oil, necessitating a rapid dive...
records.description: Tunisia faces a potential 28% surcharge on its exports to the United States, particularly impacting olive oil, necessitating a rapid diversification of its trade markets. The Tunisian Economic Observatory (OTE) highlights that this protectionist measure could significantly reduce export revenues for key products like olive oil and fertilizers, eroding Tunisia's price competitiveness against other exporters and potentially diminishing indirect exports of bulk oil to European countries also affected by these tariffs. While the United States is a significant importer of Tunisian products, especially olive oil, representing a large portion of its "fats, oils and waxes" exports, this new policy underscores the vulnerability of Tunisia's specialized production and its reliance on specific export markets. To mitigate the effects of this protectionism, the OTE advises reducing import needs, ensuring national sovereignty, and seeking new export opportunities, particularly in African and Asian markets.

records.title: Emirates Biotech has collaborated with the United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) in Al Ain to conduct joint research on new applications...
records.description: Emirates Biotech has collaborated with the United Arab Emirates University (UAEU) in Al Ain to conduct joint research on new applications and end-of-life solutions for Polylactic Acid (PLA). This partnership aims to enhance PLA's sustainability and performance as a bio-based, biodegradable polymer, leveraging UAEU's resources and engaging its academic community. The goal is to facilitate the commercialization of bioplastics tailored for the UAE and wider Middle East, positioning PLA as a viable alternative to fossil-based plastics and supporting a circular economy. Both organizations express enthusiasm for this collaboration, viewing it as a significant step towards advancing the biopolymers sector in the region, fostering innovation in materials science, and providing students with practical research experience. Emirates Biotech plans to market and manufacture PLA for various uses, including packaging and 3D printing, with end-of-life options like composting to reduce landfill waste.
records.institution: Emirates Biotech, United Arab Emirates University (UAEU)

records.title: The Mayor of the Capital recently reviewed a community initiative in the al-Thawra district focused on planting fruit trees in front of h...
records.description: The Mayor of the Capital recently reviewed a community initiative in the al-Thawra district focused on planting fruit trees in front of homes. This effort, praised by the Mayor, is a partnership between a local development group and the Capital's Agriculture Sector, which supplied the seedlings, with citizens responsible for their upkeep. The initiative is part of broader efforts to expand tree planting through the collaboration of local authorities, community members, development groups, and neighborhood leaders. The Mayor also inspected a campaign aimed at clearing unsightly structures and reducing congestion in the same district, reviewing the organization of street vendors and hearing updates on the field teams' progress in stabilizing the area.

records.title: Egypt's agricultural exports have shown a strong increase, reaching a significant volume in the first half of the current year, indicatin...
records.description: Egypt's agricultural exports have shown a strong increase, reaching a significant volume in the first half of the current year, indicating the sector's expanding influence in global trade. Citrus fruits led the exports, followed by substantial quantities of potatoes. Other prominent export crops included fresh onions, fresh and dried beans, and sweet potatoes. Grapes, fresh strawberries, garlic, tomatoes, guava, and pomegranates also contributed significantly, highlighting the diverse agricultural output. The government has reiterated its dedication to facilitating exports by simplifying procedures and removing obstacles, which helps Egyptian products compete more effectively internationally.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Iraq's first specialized center for housing imported animals, including cows and calves, has been inaugurated in Nineveh Governorate.
records.description: Iraq's first specialized center for housing imported animals, including cows and calves, has been inaugurated in Nineveh Governorate. This facility serves as a crucial precautionary measure by the Ministry of Agriculture, where veterinary staff examine and inspect imported livestock before their distribution to other governorates. Officials highlighted the center's strategic importance in strengthening the system for preventing and controlling diseases common to both humans and animals, thereby contributing significantly to the protection of livestock and public health through thorough monitoring.

records.title: The Agricultural Research Department has concluded the mechanical harvest of the Sham 6 wheat variety in Nineveh Governorate, specificall...
records.description: The Agricultural Research Department has concluded the mechanical harvest of the Sham 6 wheat variety in Nineveh Governorate, specifically at the Tal Afar Research Station, following its successful second season of planting. This particular variety demonstrated high productivity compared to other types previously cultivated at the station. The harvesting was carried out by specialized technical staff in the designated agricultural area within the Nineveh Research Department, after securing necessary approvals from the Seed Inspection and Certification Department. The decision to select the Sham 6 variety was based on direct instructions from the department's management and a comparative scientific study. These harvesting operations are integral to the high-grade wheat seed multiplication program, aligning with the Ministry of Agriculture's strategic goal of expanding agricultural areas to benefit the agricultural sector and public interest.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Hasbaya Agricultural Center, as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, has been actively invo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Hasbaya Agricultural Center, as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, has been actively involved in diverse initiatives to support farmers and promote sustainable agricultural practices, collaborating with various local and international partners. These activities included a sensory training session on olive oil tasting, organized with a German development agency, where farmers learned about quality preservation. To mark World Environment Day, the Center participated in an environmental event with an Indian battalion serving with a UN peacekeeping force, including a tree planting ceremony. Further efforts involved a specialized seminar on the biological control of olive pests using pheromone traps, also in cooperation with the German development agency, providing practical field training and trap distribution. The Center also engaged in an awareness session supporting beginning beekeepers, emphasizing the importance of agricultural registry registration.

records.title: AlUla Governorate, known for its unique natural landscape and agricultural abundance, is a key producer of dates in Saudi Arabia.
records.description: AlUla Governorate, known for its unique natural landscape and agricultural abundance, is a key producer of dates in Saudi Arabia. Its palm farms span approximately 16,579.40 hectares, hosting over 3.1 million palm trees. The region's annual date production is about 116,055.81 tons, significantly contributing to the national supply. The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) actively supports the agricultural sector through technical assistance and advisory programs, promoting sustainable farming practices to enhance production efficiency and strengthen food security, aligning with national development goals.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Al-Baha branch recently undertook a rapid initiative, re-plowing over 858,000 square...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture’s Al-Baha branch recently undertook a rapid initiative, re-plowing over 858,000 square meters across 393 farms in just ten days. This project, focused on revitalizing agricultural terraces in the villages of Daws and Barahrah, north of Al-Mandaq Governorate, aims to significantly enhance food security in the region. The branch's director noted that the effort exceeded its goals thanks to strong cooperation from local residents and various governmental and private organizations. This initiative also seeks to boost environmental protection by clearing dry weeds to reduce fire risks, encourage renewed farming activity, and improve soil quality for future seasons. Al-Mandaq Governorate, known for its rich natural resources and diverse crops like pomegranates, grapes, and coffee, stands to benefit greatly from these efforts.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) is actively progressing afforestation efforts i...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) is actively progressing afforestation efforts in Makkah Region, aligning with Saudi Arabia's broader environmental sustainability initiatives. Millions of trees have been planted as part of a national green initiative, with these efforts forming part of numerous planned projects covering key zones in Makkah. This campaign directly supports the national objective to plant a massive number of trees and rehabilitate extensive areas of degraded land throughout the Kingdom, underscoring Saudi Arabia’s ongoing commitment to enhancing vegetation cover, combating desertification, and promoting long-term environmental sustainability.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has announced new regulations for the sale of live livestock by weight, set to...
records.description: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has announced new regulations for the sale of live livestock by weight, set to take effect soon. These regulations aim to enhance fairness and transparency in livestock markets across the Kingdom, benefiting both producers and consumers while contributing to environmental and economic sustainability, in line with Saudi Vision 2030. The new rules will apply to livestock sold both within and outside pens. For sales within pens, vendors must use approved, regularly maintained scales and provide a safe weighing environment, meticulously recording all operations. Transparency in the weighing process is mandated, allowing buyers to request reweighing and strictly prohibiting any tampering. For sales outside pens, market investors are required to provide a sufficient number of approved scales and dedicated staff for weighing.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, "Saudi Reef," continuously highlights and supports the achievements of its benefi...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, "Saudi Reef," continuously highlights and supports the achievements of its beneficiaries, including small-scale farmers, producers, and productive families. The program aims to motivate participants and empower them with effective production and marketing techniques to enhance their farming outputs and traditional handicrafts. It provides direct assistance that helps intensify cultivation, expand planted areas, and encourages the adoption of sustainable practices, leading to recognized successes in producing premium local produce. The fruit sector is one of several key areas targeted by Saudi Reef, which implements strategic projects to improve quality of life, achieve food security, and enhance the economic status of various agricultural sectors.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The second "Agritech" forum, an international event for smart green agriculture, is set to begin in Egypt under the patronage of several...
records.description: The second "Agritech" forum, an international event for smart green agriculture, is set to begin in Egypt under the patronage of several ministers. This forum aims to foster international participation, engage youth and women, educate farmers on smart agricultural practices, and highlight innovations from new agricultural startups. It will emphasize the global shift towards environmentally conscious and climate-responsible farming, aligning with international commitments to reduce emissions. Key discussions will revolve around international cooperation, climate change's impact on Egyptian agriculture, carbon emissions reduction, food security, digital technologies, and scientific research. A significant focus for this edition will also be on seed production, infrastructure, and the national seed policy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Ministry of Irrigation, Ministry of Planning, Ministry of Environment, and Ministry of Communication

records.title: Food prices in Jordan have seen a continuous upward trend over recent months, with data from international and national sources confirmin...
records.description: Food prices in Jordan have seen a continuous upward trend over recent months, with data from international and national sources confirming higher food and consumer prices. A report from the UN Food and Agriculture Organisation warns that hot, dry weather conditions are expected to reduce grain production across Jordan and neighboring countries, which will likely increase Jordan's import requirements for the coming marketing year. Despite a heavy reliance on imports to meet domestic demand, Jordan maintains sufficient strategic reserves of key grains to prevent supply disruptions, reflecting its ability to manage stocks amidst challenges. While the nation faces economic pressures from ongoing regional conflicts impacting sectors like tourism, food price inflation remained stable compared to a year prior.

records.title: The grape harvest season has commenced in AlUla Governorate, marking a significant period for the region's summer agriculture as high-qua...
records.description: The grape harvest season has commenced in AlUla Governorate, marking a significant period for the region's summer agriculture as high-quality grapes, alongside figs and pomegranates, become highly sought after in local and domestic markets. Grapes are the most abundant and economically vital of these summer crops, collectively cultivated across approximately 348.96 hectares and yielding over 3,140.66 tons annually. Their production not only supports regional trade and creates seasonal employment but also plays a crucial role in local food security. The Royal Commission for AlUla actively supports the agricultural sector through various development initiatives, advisory programs, and the integration of modern farming technologies, aiming to enhance the quality, sustainability, and productivity of AlUla’s agricultural output, in alignment with Saudi Vision 2030.

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, known as "Saudi Reef," continues to highlight the success of its beneficiaries, i...
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program, known as "Saudi Reef," continues to highlight the success of its beneficiaries, including small-scale farmers and producers. Through its "From Our Countryside" series, the program showcased farmer Salman Al-Tuwairqi from Taif Governorate, who successfully enhanced the quality of his local grapes, even surpassing imported varieties, using traditional propagation methods. He also cultivates Taif roses and other seasonal fruits. An Assistant Secretary-General at Saudi Reef explained that direct support from the program enabled Al-Tuwairqi to intensify grape cultivation, expand his planted areas, and adopt sustainable farming practices, leading to the recognition of his premium local grapes.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program Saudi Reef

records.title: Authorities in Tunisia have issued a warning following the appearance of a "red tide" phenomenon and unusual fish mortality along a porti...
records.description: Authorities in Tunisia have issued a warning following the appearance of a "red tide" phenomenon and unusual fish mortality along a portion of its coastline. The phenomenon is attributed to a massive proliferation of microalgae, also known as a harmful algal bloom (HAB), which can produce toxins dangerous to marine life and human health. The agricultural ministry is advising against fishing, consuming, or selling dead fish or fish from unverified sources, and urges citizens to report suspicious activities. Investigations are underway to determine the exact cause, with satellite imagery showing unusual water discoloration in the affected area. Experts indicate that such occurrences are intensified by rising water temperatures, stagnant currents, and pollution from human activities, making the semi-enclosed Mediterranean particularly susceptible to these events.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.title: In Ibb governorate, a veterinary vaccination campaign has been launched, targeting over one million small ruminants and livestock across...
records.description: In Ibb governorate, a veterinary vaccination campaign has been launched, targeting over one million small ruminants and livestock across 17 districts to combat diseases like sheep pox and address internal and external parasites. The Governor of Ibb emphasized the national leadership's commitment to developing the livestock sector, crucial for food security and economic growth. He lauded the campaign's organization and urged full cooperation from citizens and breeders with the field teams, stressing the importance of reaching all animals, including those in remote areas. The head of the Agricultural Sector in the province detailed the 20-day campaign's scope, including specific vaccination targets and the various diseases it aims to address, noting its extension of prior efforts.
records.institution: General Administration of Animal Health and Veterinary Quarantine

records.title: Algeria's state grain agency, OAIC, recently purchased a substantial volume of milling wheat, estimated at 550,000 to 570,000 metric tons...
records.description: Algeria's state grain agency, OAIC, recently purchased a substantial volume of milling wheat, estimated at 550,000 to 570,000 metric tons, in an international tender. The majority of these purchases were made at competitive prices, primarily from the Black Sea region, including Romania, Bulgaria, and Ukraine. This significant acquisition, far exceeding the nominal tender volume, is partly attributed to sellers aiming to clear storage space as new harvests arrive. Historically, France has been a major wheat supplier to Algeria, but Black Sea exporters have increasingly gained market share. This shift is reportedly influenced by ongoing diplomatic tensions between France and Algeria, which have led the Algerian grain agency to implicitly exclude French wheat and trading companies from recent tenders. The wheat is scheduled for shipment in August, with earlier periods for South American or Australian origins.
records.institution: The Office Algérien Interprofessionnel des Céréales (OAIC)

records.title: Egypt is developing its first fully integrated waste management city, supported by the World Bank, as a cornerstone of its strategy to co...
records.description: Egypt is developing its first fully integrated waste management city, supported by the World Bank, as a cornerstone of its strategy to combat air pollution and achieve national environmental goals. This model facility is designed to process all types of solid waste for decades, serving key urban areas, and is being built to international standards with significant progress in construction and infrastructure. It will be managed through a public-private partnership, aligning with the country's push for increased private sector involvement in environmental services. This pioneering project, hailed as a regional first, underscores Egypt's commitment to modernizing its waste management sector, fostering a circular economy, and improving air quality.

records.title: Etihad Group has inaugurated a significant flour milling project in Iraq, completed in just eleven months, which stands as one of the lar...
records.description: Etihad Group has inaugurated a significant flour milling project in Iraq, completed in just eleven months, which stands as one of the largest and most rapidly constructed milling plants in the Middle East with a daily production capacity of 4,500 tons. This new facility is part of Etihad Food Industries' broader integrated industrial ecosystem, which includes operations like sugar refining, vegetable oil production, and animal feed manufacturing on the same campus, allowing for streamlined production and cost reduction. The state-of-the-art mill, equipped with six modern production lines and a substantial grain storage system supplied by a Swiss firm, will produce various types of flour. This project is expected to considerably reduce Iraq's reliance on flour imports, bolster food security, and create numerous employment opportunities, aligning with the country's strategic push for industrial self-sufficiency.

records.title: A model agricultural nursery is being established within the Akkar Agriculture Department in Abdeh, with support from the United Nations...
records.description: A model agricultural nursery is being established within the Akkar Agriculture Department in Abdeh, with support from the United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) and in collaboration with the Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture. Spanning 666 square meters, this nursery aims to boost the region's capacity to produce high-quality vegetable seedlings for free distribution to Akkar farmers. The project is designed to lower agricultural production costs, increase productivity, and enhance local food security, especially amidst challenging economic conditions. Additionally, a 500-meter fence will be constructed to protect the agricultural infrastructure and ensure long-term sustainability. Expected to begin seedling production next agricultural season, the nursery will serve as a vital resource for small farmers facing rising input prices.

records.title: An agreement has been signed between the Office national des pêches (ONP) of Morocco and the Société mauritanienne de commercialisation d...
records.description: An agreement has been signed between the Office national des pêches (ONP) of Morocco and the Société mauritanienne de commercialisation de poissons (SMCP) of Mauritania. This protocol of understanding aims to develop the commercialization of fishery products and strengthen bilateral cooperation in the fishing sector. The partnership will focus on exchanging expertise in managing commercialization sites, strengthening competencies through training programs, transferring know-how related to standardized container management, and providing technical assistance.

records.title: The International Association of Operative Millers - Middle East and Africa (IAOM MEA), in partnership with the National Flour Milling Fe...
records.description: The International Association of Operative Millers - Middle East and Africa (IAOM MEA), in partnership with the National Flour Milling Federation (FNM) and Essa Al Ghurair Investment (EGI), has launched a fully funded scholarship program. This initiative aims to provide aspiring milling professionals with advanced technical training through a six-month intensive course in Advanced Milling Technology, hosted at the Centre for Study and Research in the Cereal Industry (CERIC) in Casablanca, Morocco, starting in January 2026. The program is designed to enhance technical capacity within the grain milling sector across the MEA region, offering full tuition, practical materials, and industrial visits. IAOM MEA emphasizes its commitment to education and innovation, while EGI brings strategic industry insight and FNM champions technical standards and workforce development. The curriculum at CERIC will blend theoretical knowledge with hands-on modules and field experience, ensuring graduates meet international milling standards. The scholarship is open to young professionals across the Middle East and Africa interested in grain milling, cereal science, food processing, or agricultural engineering.
records.institution: Centre for Study and Research in the Cereal Industry (CERIC)

records.title: A Riyadh-based private equity firm has partnered with a Canadian asset manager to launch two substantial funds for agricultural investmen...
records.description: A Riyadh-based private equity firm has partnered with a Canadian asset manager to launch two substantial funds for agricultural investments across the GCC, with an ambitious long-term goal of investing significantly and becoming a leading global fresh food business. The new joint entity will serve as the Canadian firm's regional headquarters, focusing on investments in permanent crops and temperature-controlled supply chain infrastructure within the region and globally to enhance food security. This collaboration seeks to reconfigure food trade routes and bolster the region's resilience against disruptions, directly addressing the high dependency on food imports, which governments are striving to reduce through national economic programs. The funds will target a range of agricultural companies, technology, and new projects.

records.title: A significant program supporting the private sector and financial inclusion recently concluded, marking a key advancement for agriculture...
records.description: A significant program supporting the private sector and financial inclusion recently concluded, marking a key advancement for agriculture, fishing, and the social economy in the country. This initiative, backed by international cooperation, involved a unique blend of aid and grants, establishing credit lines for agricultural and social enterprises and boosting investment capacity. Over its duration, it successfully funded numerous projects across the nation, leading to substantial job creation and economic growth, particularly in rural areas. This program also fostered collaborations with other development initiatives aimed at promoting sustainable food systems. Building on its achievements, a new program is in preparation, focusing on agroecology and sustainable fishing, with additional credit lines becoming available for various economic sectors. Concurrently, agricultural investments have shown robust growth, with a national agency approving a large number of projects designed to generate employment and expand agricultural activities.

records.title: Tunisia's crucial olive industry, with its vast number of trees, faces a serious threat from a bacterium that has already caused extensiv...
records.description: Tunisia's crucial olive industry, with its vast number of trees, faces a serious threat from a bacterium that has already caused extensive damage to olive groves in a neighboring country. This pathogen clogs the internal systems of plants, leading to their decline and death, and is spread by insects. Authorities in Tunisia are proactively addressing this danger, participating in international workshops and developing national response plans to strengthen defenses against the bacterium's potential arrival. The severe economic and ecological devastation witnessed elsewhere underscores the critical need for prompt and coordinated action. Tunisia's climate, economic reliance on olive oil, and specific agricultural practices make it particularly susceptible. Identifying the infection is challenging due to its varied symptoms, necessitating specialized laboratory testing. Preventive measures include stringent border checks, vigilant monitoring for insect carriers, educating farmers, and having an emergency plan ready for immediate deployment if an outbreak occurs. Safeguarding the olive sector is vital for the nation's economy, food supply, and the well-being of its rural communities.
records.institution: The General Directorate of Plant Health and Control of Agricultural Inputs (DGSVCIA)

records.title: Italy and the UAE are strengthening their agricultural collaboration, particularly in GreenTech, to boost the UAE's agricultural developm...
records.description: Italy and the UAE are strengthening their agricultural collaboration, particularly in GreenTech, to boost the UAE's agricultural development. The UAE's agricultural machinery market is seeing significant growth, with Italian exports to the region more than doubling in recent years. Italian manufacturers primarily supply systems for milk processing, seeding, fertilizing, and livestock. Officials emphasize that innovative Italian technology is crucial for addressing the UAE's challenging environmental conditions, such as limited arable land and water scarcity. The upcoming Agrilevante exhibition in Bari will be a key platform to showcase specialized solutions, fostering partnerships and introducing new features like robotic technologies and a dedicated gardening sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries is set to launch a national vaccination campaign against skin diseases in li...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries is set to launch a national vaccination campaign against skin diseases in livestock, with necessary vaccines already imported. This campaign will run in parallel with the ongoing national effort to vaccinate against foot-and-mouth disease, which has seen over two million doses imported. The Ministry also highlighted the importance of the completed General Census of Agriculture in establishing a comprehensive database for sector evaluation and data improvement, with results to be published soon. Additionally, a financial envelope of over 75 billion DA has been mobilized for the green dam rehabilitation project (2023-2030), with 11 billion DA allocated for the current phase, focusing on reforestation, infrastructure development, and water resource mobilization. Efforts are also underway to review agricultural land regularization files, with a national commission established and new mechanisms in place to address pending situations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: A new flour mill, developed by Etihad Group in Iraq's Babil Governorate, has been inaugurated, boasting an annual production of one milli...
records.description: A new flour mill, developed by Etihad Group in Iraq's Babil Governorate, has been inaugurated, boasting an annual production of one million tonnes of premium-grade flour. This facility, which began construction less than a year ago, now covers approximately half of the nation's domestic flour demand, significantly reducing previous import reliance. The government reaffirmed its dedication to revitalizing national industry, supporting the private sector, and ensuring food security amidst global challenges, declaring the current period as the "Year of Iraqi Industry" with ongoing efforts to launch new manufacturing facilities.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Marjayoun Center recently hosted a guidance seminar on "Management of Agricultural Cooperatives" as part of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Marjayoun Center recently hosted a guidance seminar on "Management of Agricultural Cooperatives" as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. Held in Marjayoun, the seminar aimed to bolster the management, organizational, and marketing capabilities of agricultural cooperatives. Fourteen farmers, representing six cooperatives from various towns, participated in the event. The first session, led by the Head of the Cooperatives Department in Nabatieh Governorate, focused on the laws and regulations governing cooperatives and their vital role in sustainable rural development. The second session, presented by the head of the Marjayoun Center, emphasized the importance of collaboration and coordination among regional cooperatives for collective marketing and knowledge exchange.

records.title: A new durum wheat variety, Jawahir, developed by INRA and ICARDA, is poised to significantly impact Moroccan agriculture by offering exce...
records.description: A new durum wheat variety, Jawahir, developed by INRA and ICARDA, is poised to significantly impact Moroccan agriculture by offering exceptional drought tolerance. This promising seed has demonstrated higher yields than traditional varieties, with farmers in specific provinces achieving up to 15 quintals per hectare even under challenging conditions. The result of a decade of research, Jawahir incorporates ancestral species resilient to extreme climates. Since its field testing began, farmers have rapidly adopted it, commending its resistance to pests, deep rooting, and grain quality. The Ministry of Agriculture has fast-tracked its commercialization to 2027, collaborating with INRA, SONACOS, and private stakeholders to ensure sufficient production. Jawahir represents a substantial advance for Moroccan agriculture, showcasing how innovation can provide tangible solutions to climate change impacts.
records.institution: INRA (National Institute of Agricultural Research), Ministry of Agriculture

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Dhofar Municipality has initiated a large-scale environmental campaign in the Dhofar mountains during the current khareef season, aiming...
records.description: Dhofar Municipality has initiated a large-scale environmental campaign in the Dhofar mountains during the current khareef season, aiming to restore natural vegetation and control invasive species. This involves dispersing approximately 10 million seed balls and over 3 billion pastoral grass seeds. Building on previous years' efforts, this initiative, overseen by a steering committee, is part of a broader plan to enhance biodiversity and curb the spread of problematic plants like parthenium weed and mesquite trees, which contribute to desertification alongside overgrazing, climate change, and human activities. The project employs nature-based solutions through drought-resistant seed balls containing native plant species adapted to local conditions. In addition to seed dispersal, various methods such as manual removal, mechanical cutting, flame treatment, and targeted pesticide use are being applied to control parthenium weed and mitigate its harmful effects.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with a development center, recently conducted specialized training for farmers in Azzun Atma...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with a development center, recently conducted specialized training for farmers in Azzun Atma and Ezbet El Tabib. These lectures, part of a project supported by an Arab fund, focused on key topics like farm management, tree care, and integrated pest control, aiming to boost farmers' abilities to tackle agricultural challenges and achieve sustainable production. Forty participants actively engaged, highlighting the value of such training in improving their agricultural practices. This initiative is part of the Ministry's ongoing efforts to empower rural farmers, providing them with essential knowledge and expertise to efficiently and sustainably manage natural resources and strengthen their resilience against economic and environmental difficulties.

records.title: Saudi Aramco has launched the Regional Center for Sustainable Development of Fisheries (RCSDF) on Abu Ali Island in Jubail, a collaborati...
records.description: Saudi Aramco has launched the Regional Center for Sustainable Development of Fisheries (RCSDF) on Abu Ali Island in Jubail, a collaborative effort with the Ministry of Energy and the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture. This center aims to support local fishermen, bolster expertise, and enhance fish production to protect marine life in the Arabian Gulf. It features a fish hatchery designed to produce and release local fish species that have seen population declines, managing their entire life cycle using advanced aquaculture and water recycling technologies. This initiative complements Aramco's ongoing mangrove plantation project, as these forests provide crucial nursery habitats for the released fish, ultimately contributing to the sustainability of marine ecosystems and aligning with national aquaculture goals.

records.title: Cereals: extension of the deadline for application of the specifications for collection activity
records.description: A recent joint decision by relevant ministries in Tunisia has amended the regulations governing grain collection activities. Published in the official national journal, this new text extends the deadline for operators to comply with regulatory requirements by three years. Additionally, a revised annex now outlines detailed technical, logistical, and administrative conditions for approving grain collection centers. These updated specifications cover mandatory equipment, hygiene and safety standards, and required documentation, all designed to ensure that collection centers meet strict criteria for quality, traceability, and adherence to regulations.

records.title: The agricultural sector significantly strains the nation's water resources, consuming three-quarters of the total mobilized water.
records.description: The agricultural sector significantly strains the nation's water resources, consuming three-quarters of the total mobilized water. This persistent imbalance, exacerbated by climate change leading to decreased rainfall and increased evaporation, intensifies the existing water stress in the country. Despite some recent improvements in dam filling rates, the long-term sustainability of irrigated agriculture, especially in vulnerable regions, remains a concern. Areas specializing in water-intensive crops are particularly impacted, prompting authorities to implement reforms. These efforts include deploying smart water meters, constructing solar-powered pumping stations, utilizing desalination plants, and promoting less water-intensive crops, all part of a broader plan to adapt to climate change. The challenge lies in balancing water conservation with maintaining food production and supporting the livelihoods of those in the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) is organizing the fourth edition of the Tunisian Farmers' Market, a pilot project...
records.description: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) is organizing the fourth edition of the Tunisian Farmers' Market, a pilot project aiming to create a national network of such markets. This initiative focuses on connecting citizens directly with farmers to provide quality produce at fair prices, ultimately strengthening agricultural and fishery distribution channels. The World Farmers' Market Coalition (WorldFMC), based in Italy, offers technical support for the program, which promotes a more equitable and sustainable food system.
records.institution: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP)

records.title: To secure harvests and protect water resources, Tunisia's Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries and Ministry of the Inte...
records.description: To secure harvests and protect water resources, Tunisia's Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries and Ministry of the Interior have implemented strict measures. They've established a joint committee to ensure agricultural machinery meets safety standards, with the power to suspend harvesting if violations occur. Additionally, regional committees will monitor harvests and investigate fire causes. Both ministries are also mobilizing against the uncontrolled pumping of water from the Medjerda wadi, launching joint campaigns with security forces and the Regional Agricultural Development Commissions to combat this issue and protect public water resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG), the UAE’s largest national provider of protein and beverages, has forged a strategic partnership with Finnish...
records.description: Al Ain Farms Group (AAFG), the UAE’s largest national provider of protein and beverages, has forged a strategic partnership with Finnish food-tech innovator FoodIQ. This collaboration marks a significant milestone, as AAFG will be the first company globally, outside of Finland, to implement FoodIQ’s patented Multi-Layer Cooker (MLC) technology on an industrial scale. This innovative system enables the local production of a new generation of clean-label, natural, and high-protein foods, allowing for flexible-batch production of various high-viscosity recipes while preserving nutritional value and significantly reducing energy use, water consumption, and waste. This agreement directly supports the UAE’s Food Security Strategy, its National Strategy for Industry and Advanced Technology, and Net Zero goals, reinforcing AAFG’s role as a regional leader in functional, natural foods and contributing to the UAE’s emergence as a global hub for sustainable food-tech innovation.

records.title: The Multi-Purpose Hays Agricultural Cooperative Association has been officially launched in Al-Jarahi District, Hodeida province, followi...
records.description: The Multi-Purpose Hays Agricultural Cooperative Association has been officially launched in Al-Jarahi District, Hodeida province, following a meeting organized by the local council. During the meeting, administrative and supervisory bodies for the association were elected. Officials present described the association's establishment as a significant step for agricultural development in the district, embodying the state's commitment to empowering local communities in managing their projects and improving livelihoods. They noted that Hodeida province is experiencing growing developmental momentum, particularly in agriculture, and emphasized the importance of community involvement in leveraging agricultural potential.
records.institution: The Multi-Purpose Hays Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Social Housing and Mortgage Finance Fund (SHMFF) in Egypt is exploring the issuance of green bonds to diversify its funding, improve...
records.description: The Social Housing and Mortgage Finance Fund (SHMFF) in Egypt is exploring the issuance of green bonds to diversify its funding, improve financing terms, and bolster its "Green Architecture" initiative. This aligns with Egypt's "Housing for All Egyptians" program, which provides affordable housing for low- and middle-income citizens, having seen demand surge to over 500,000 applicants in its latest offering. The Fund, which develops 85% of its units in new urban communities, partners with a growing number of public and private banks for mortgage finance and relies on private contractors, creating millions of job opportunities. To date, 730,000 housing units are completed, with another 300,000 under construction. SHMFF is committed to environmentally sustainable development, aiming to create entire green communities, and recently launched a design competition for 30,000 new green housing units in collaboration with international partners.
records.institution: Social Housing and Mortgage Finance Fund (SHMFF)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is consistently advancing its National Ornamental Plants and Cut Flowers Propagation Program.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is consistently advancing its National Ornamental Plants and Cut Flowers Propagation Program. This initiative successfully provides various ornamental plants and rose seedlings at reduced prices, supporting local cultivation and expanding green areas throughout the country. Staff at the Nineveh Horticulture Station actively maintain plant health through tasks like monitoring soil moisture, managing weeds, organizing seedlings, and performing morning pruning. Concurrently, the Ministry's stations continue to offer subsidized fruit and olive tree seedlings, along with vegetable seeds, to the public.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Jordan has effectively maintained stable food supply chains and secured strategic reserves of essential commodities despite escalating re...
records.description: Jordan has effectively maintained stable food supply chains and secured strategic reserves of essential commodities despite escalating regional tensions, primarily due to its proactive planning, diversified import routes, and robust emergency response mechanisms. While the nation heavily relies on imports for certain staples like wheat and sugar, it boasts high self-sufficiency in poultry and dairy, and maintains significant stockpiles of vital goods, particularly grains. Experts highlight the resilience of the private sector and call for sustained governmental support for the agricultural sector, advocating for long-term strategies, expanded local markets, and strengthened regional trade ties. Efforts include diversifying import sources, reinforcing strategic reserves, and implementing a national food security strategy focused on smart irrigation, water harvesting, and agricultural investment.

records.title: The Casablanca-Settat region in Morocco is actively working to combat water stress and declining rainfall by acquiring around thirty desa...
records.description: The Casablanca-Settat region in Morocco is actively working to combat water stress and declining rainfall by acquiring around thirty desalination plants. Of these, 28 monobloc seawater desalination and demineralization stations (SMBs) are intended to supply the population with drinking water, with 17 already operational. These projects represent a significant investment of 400 million dirhams (MDH), funded by both the State and the Regional Council. Officials emphasized the positive impact of these stations on water supply and called for vigilant monitoring and public awareness to prevent water waste. This initiative is part of a comprehensive strategy that includes other major projects like the water highway and large desalination plants, such as the one planned for Casablanca, which is expected to cover about 80% of the region's drinking water needs upon completion.
records.institution: Casablanca-Settat Regional Council, Casablanca-Settat Regional Multiservice Company (SRM), Ministry of the Interior

records.title: The Souss Massa region will soon host a workshop-conference, "Digitization in the service of agriculture: practical case of BeeOne," orga...
records.description: The Souss Massa region will soon host a workshop-conference, "Digitization in the service of agriculture: practical case of BeeOne," organized by Agridata Consulting in partnership with the Association of United Farmers of Souss Massa and the regional Chamber of Agriculture. Nearly 80 farmers specializing in market gardening, soft fruits, and arboriculture are expected to attend and explore the BeeOne solution, a digital tool designed for farm modernization. The event's program features a practical demonstration, a discussion on digitalization challenges, and networking. This initiative aims to boost local producers' capabilities in facing climate, economic, and technological hurdles, emphasizing innovation and smart resource management.
records.institution: Association of United Farmers of Souss Massa (ASAUSM)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman is strategically positioning itself as a global leader in green hydrogen, leveraging its abundant solar and wind resources, progress...
records.description: Oman is strategically positioning itself as a global leader in green hydrogen, leveraging its abundant solar and wind resources, progressive government policies, and world-class port infrastructure. Driven by its Vision 2040 and National Energy Strategy to achieve 30% renewable electricity by 2030, the Sultanate established Hydrogen Oman (Hydrom) in 2022 to oversee the development of its green hydrogen economy, which aims to produce up to 8.5 million tonnes per annum by 2050. Hydrom has already secured landmark agreements worth nearly $20 billion with major global firms for projects around the ports of Duqm and Salalah, representing approximately 15 GW of planned renewable capacity. Notable projects include Hyport Duqm, a collaboration to produce 60,000 tonnes of green hydrogen annually, and ACME's Duqm facility aiming for 900,000 tonnes of green ammonia.

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: A recent regional workshop in Cairo brought together representatives from across the Middle East and North Africa, including the State of...
records.description: A recent regional workshop in Cairo brought together representatives from across the Middle East and North Africa, including the State of Palestine's Ministry of Agriculture, to discuss food and nutrition security. This event served as an important step in developing the Regional Food and Nutrition Security Report for the area, focusing on transforming agrifood systems to address current challenges. Discussions highlighted the critical role of food systems in economic growth and job creation, with participants collaborating on policy strategies to improve food and nutrition security throughout the region. Palestine's delegation presented on the state of its food security, including the impact of recent conflicts on its food systems and the agricultural initiatives being undertaken.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Hebron Agriculture Directorate, recently distributed six agricultural grants to farmers in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Hebron Agriculture Directorate, recently distributed six agricultural grants to farmers in communities south of Hebron Governorate. These grants, part of the "Resilient Land and Natural Resources Management" (RELAB) project funded by the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), aim to support farmers facing Israeli threats and bolster their presence on agricultural lands. The grants included livestock (sheep and goats), a laying chicken farm, and greenhouses. Delivered to the communities of Raboud and Abu Al-Asja, these projects are intended to boost farmer incomes and improve food security in vulnerable areas. The RELAB project's broader goal is to empower agricultural communities, enhance sustainable natural resource management, protect agricultural lands, and increase productivity to foster economic and social stability in rural Palestine.

records.title: On the World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought, the Ministry of Municipality in Qatar reiterated its strong commitment to environ...
records.description: On the World Day to Combat Desertification and Drought, the Ministry of Municipality in Qatar reiterated its strong commitment to environmental sustainability by significantly expanding the nation's green infrastructure. This strategic focus involves growing public parks and increasing vegetation cover as a crucial part of Qatar's efforts to combat desertification, mitigate drought impacts, and promote long-term sustainable development. The initiative, themed "Restore the land. Unlock the opportunities," highlights how land restoration can generate jobs, enhance food and water security, support climate action, and build economic resilience. Qatar currently boasts 127 public parks and 153 green areas, with plans to increase this to 160 soon, having already developed over three million square meters of green space. Projects prioritize native and drought-tolerant plants, along with smart water-saving technologies and the use of treated wastewater for irrigation. The Ministry's landmark "Plant Ten Million Trees Initiative" complements a broader strategy for green belts, ornamental agriculture, and aesthetic landscaping. Beyond planting, the Ministry fosters a culture of environmental responsibility through public awareness campaigns, encouraging community participation in conservation and urban farming, reinforcing Qatar's dedication to environmental stewardship for future generations.

records.title: VCM, Enowa to deliver over 30mln tonnes of carbon credits
records.description: The Voluntary Carbon Market Company (VCM), a carbon credit firm established by the Public Investment Fund (PIF) and Saudi Tadawul Group, has announced a significant long-term agreement with Enowa, NEOM's energy and water subsidiary. This deal aims to facilitate the delivery of approximately 30 million tonnes of high-integrity carbon credits by the end of this decade. The agreement marks a major step in VCM's goal to foster a robust voluntary carbon market in the region, with credits sourced primarily from global climate action projects, especially in the Global South, and transacted on VCM's platform. This collaboration helps Enowa offset current emissions while building sustainable infrastructure for NEOM's renewable energy system, and it provides crucial funding certainty for climate projects worldwide.

records.title: Discussing the necessary preparations for importing potato seeds for the 2025/2026 agricultural season during a meeting of the Assistant...
records.description: Discussing the necessary preparations for importing potato seeds for the 2025/2026 agricultural season during a meeting of the Assistant Minister of Agriculture for Plant Affairs with the Director of the General Authority for Scientific Research, the Director of the General Organization for Seed Multiplication, the Director of Agricultural Affairs, and the President of the Federation of Chambers of Agriculture. The meeting focused on the technical requirements for importing potato seeds for the upcoming agricultural season, and regulating the import process to achieve market balance and guarantee farmers' rights.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI), in collaboration with the Municipal Council of Khor Fakkan and Khor Fakkan City Muni...
records.description: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI), in collaboration with the Municipal Council of Khor Fakkan and Khor Fakkan City Municipality, is launching the fourth edition of the Mango Festival at Expo Khor Fakkan. The festival, themed "Mango: Our Fruit, Our Wealth," aims to promote the Eastern Region as an agri-tourism destination, bolster the local economy by supporting farmers and families, and enhance the quality and sustainability of domestic agricultural products. It also seeks to preserve cultural heritage and advance national food security goals. The event will showcase over 150 local mango varieties and feature competitions for the "Mango Mazayna" (beauty contest), "Best Mango Basket," "Best Agriculture-themed Video" for children, and "Best Farmer's Booth." Educational workshops with agricultural experts will also be offered, covering mango tree care and modern farming techniques. The organizing committee has set a submission deadline for video entries via WhatsApp.
records.institution: The Sharjah Chamber of Commerce and Industry (SCCI)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The UAE Ministry of Defense has partnered with National Central Cooling Company (Tabreed) and Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar (UAE...
records.description: The UAE Ministry of Defense has partnered with National Central Cooling Company (Tabreed) and Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar (UAE) and EDF Group (France), to integrate solar energy into two district cooling plants serving the ministry in Abu Dhabi. This project, established through a partnership agreement signed in March 2024 for 25 years of operation, involved installing approximately 4,000 solar panels. These panels will provide 2.4 megawatts (MW) of clean electricity to power the plants' thermal energy storage infrastructure and chilled water pumps, significantly reducing reliance on the electricity grid during peak periods and preventing over 2,600 tons of CO2 emissions annually. This initiative aligns with the UAE's broader sustainability goals and the UAE Armed Forces Climate Change Strategy, emphasizing the growing importance of renewable energy solutions across vital sectors.
records.institution: The UAE Ministry of Defense, National Central Cooling Company (Tabreed)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) has announced a $72 million investment for Egypt's first utility-scale Battery Energy Storage...
