records.description: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) has announced a $72 million investment for Egypt's first utility-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS). This project, a collaboration with AMEA Power and the Egyptian government, marks a significant step in Egypt's clean energy transition. The BESS, with a 300 megawatt-hour capacity, will be integrated into AMEA Power's newly commissioned 500MW solar photovoltaic plant, operated by its subsidiary Abydos Solar Project Company, located in Kom Ombo, Aswan. The solar plant itself became operational in November 2024. This initiative falls under Egypt’s fast-track 4GW Emergency Renewable Energy Program, designed to meet rising electricity demand with clean sources and reduce reliance on natural gas. Expected to be operational by July 2025, the BESS will generate approximately 100,000 MWh annually and is projected to reduce 20,000 tons of carbon dioxide emissions each year, contributing to Egypt's goal of cutting power sector emissions by 37%. This project aligns with national and World Bank Group frameworks focused on sustainable development and resilience.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is working to integrate 630,000 dunums of wheat, cultivated outside the official plan in governorates such as...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is working to integrate 630,000 dunums of wheat, cultivated outside the official plan in governorates such as Basra, Maysan, Nineveh, Kirkuk, and Diyala, into the current marketing season. This initiative aims to bolster farmers' confidence in the agricultural process and promote sustainable production. Addressing the legal status of these lands is being pursued through communication with higher authorities by the Minister of Agriculture. Joint committees involving the Prime Council, the Ministry of Agriculture, and its regional directorates are working to resolve these issues. Specific challenges are anticipated in governorates like Kirkuk, Nineveh, and parts of Diyala, which fall under Article 140, a constitutional provision related to disputed territories, thus requiring additional time for resolution.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has successfully cultivated yellow corn hybrids in Salah al-Di...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Research Department, has successfully cultivated yellow corn hybrids in Salah al-Din Governorate, overcoming harsh conditions like drought, soil salinity, and high temperatures. This experiment, part of the Yellow Corn Hybrid and Breeds Maintenance and Propagation Program, showcased high productivity and excellent quality due to modern technologies and specialized pest control. This achievement is a significant stride towards boosting local corn cultivation, reducing reliance on imports, and enhancing food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Minieh Agricultural Center and in collaboration with the North Lebanon Agriculture Department an...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Minieh Agricultural Center and in collaboration with the North Lebanon Agriculture Department and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), recently organized an advisory seminar in Deir Ammar. Part of the National Agricultural Extension Program and the "Scaling Up the Implementation of the One Country - One Priority Product" project, the seminar focused on "Good Agricultural Practices for Chickpea Cultivation and Seed Production in the Informal System." Its objective was to enhance farmers' awareness and capacity in sustainable agricultural methods for improving chickpea seed quality and productivity, recognizing it as a strategic crop in Lebanon. Dr. Rula Al-Amel from the Agricultural Research Institute presented on clean agriculture, seed selection, field management, and integrating small producers into agricultural value chains. The seminar saw significant engagement from farmers and local community members, who valued the initiative's contribution to their skills and knowledge.

records.title: During the first three months of 2025, Spain substantially increased its imports of fruit and vegetables from Morocco by 22%, reaching a...
records.description: During the first three months of 2025, Spain substantially increased its imports of fruit and vegetables from Morocco by 22%, reaching a total of 188,076 tonnes valued at 481 million euros. This surge highlights the expanding agricultural trade between the two nations. Moroccan tomatoes led this growth with a 34% jump in volume and 57% in value, followed closely by peppers. However, green bean imports saw a decline. While this performance affirms Morocco's strategy to expand into the European market with competitive offerings and modernized production, it has also sparked concerns among Spanish producers, particularly regarding differences in social, environmental, and phytosanitary standards. This period marks a pivotal moment in Spanish-Moroccan agri-food relations, presenting both commercial opportunities for Morocco and complex challenges for its European counterparts.

records.title: Morocco is successfully diversifying its agricultural export markets by steadily expanding its presence in the Middle Eastern raspberry s...
records.description: Morocco is successfully diversifying its agricultural export markets by steadily expanding its presence in the Middle Eastern raspberry sector. The Kingdom recently achieved a historic record for fresh raspberry exports to the region during a recent season, with the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia being key destinations. Countries like Kuwait and Jordan have significantly increased their imports from Morocco in recent years, boosting Morocco's market share across several Middle Eastern nations. This strategic expansion into the Middle East underscores Morocco's commitment to geographic diversification beyond its primary European market. The rising demand for berries in the region, driven by increasing purchasing power and urbanization, positions Morocco, a major global raspberry exporter, to further solidify its standing in these burgeoning markets, showcasing the agility and competitiveness of its agricultural sector on an international scale.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by its General Administration of Forests and Rangelands, participated in a video conference work...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by its General Administration of Forests and Rangelands, participated in a video conference workshop organized by the Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD). The workshop, involving 60 experts from Arab countries, focused on the status of desertification and drought in the Arab world. A representative from the Ministry emphasized the critical need to combat desertification and drought, highlighting it as a top priority for the agricultural sector, especially in light of aggression against agricultural land. The Ministry's projects and activities were presented, and the impact of ongoing violations, including the destruction of ecosystems and attacks on olive trees, in increasing desertification in the region were addressed. The workshop concluded with several recommendations, including prioritizing land degradation in national development plans, leveraging ACSAD's expertise, increasing public awareness, rehabilitating degraded ecosystems, implementing appropriate agricultural practices to reduce degradation, and building the capacity of national cadres through training.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Saudi Arabia is a leading participant in global efforts to combat desertification and drought, driven by its diverse geography and a comm...
records.description: Saudi Arabia is a leading participant in global efforts to combat desertification and drought, driven by its diverse geography and a commitment to environmental sustainability. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture highlights the ambitious Saudi Green Initiative, which aims for massive tree planting, carbon emission reduction, and the protection of both land and marine ecosystems, all in alignment with the national vision for a sustainable economy and improved quality of life. Significant progress has been made, including the rehabilitation of vast areas of degraded land, extensive tree planting, and the designation of substantial protected zones, alongside reintroducing endangered species. Through public environmental education and its pivotal role in hosting major international conferences, the Kingdom reaffirms its leadership in addressing land degradation and strengthening resilience to drought globally.

records.title: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) has reaffirmed its deep and long-standing commitment to supporting Saudi Arabia's transfor...
records.description: The UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) has reaffirmed its deep and long-standing commitment to supporting Saudi Arabia's transformative efforts in rehabilitating degraded lands, combating sand encroachment, and enhancing climate resilience, aligning with global calls for land restoration. As a strategic partner in this endeavor, the FAO has collaborated on initiatives ranging from irrigation projects to rangeland rehabilitation and institutional capacity building, praising the Kingdom's global leadership in combating land degradation and reducing carbon emissions through ambitious policies like the Saudi Green Initiative and the Middle East Green Initiative. This partnership has led to significant achievements in sustainable land management and climate adaptation, exemplified by the Kingdom's hosting of a major international conference on desertification, which launched a global drought resilience partnership.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Voluntary Carbon Market Company (VCM), a carbon credit firm established by a sovereign wealth fund and a major stock exchange group,...
records.description: The Voluntary Carbon Market Company (VCM), a carbon credit firm established by a sovereign wealth fund and a major stock exchange group, has sealed a long-term agreement with an energy and water subsidiary of a prominent new city project. This landmark deal aims to provide tens of millions of high-integrity carbon credits to help offset emissions as renewable energy infrastructure is developed, supporting national net-zero ambitions. The credits will mainly originate from climate action projects globally, particularly in developing regions, and be transacted on VCM's recently launched exchange platform. This platform, designed with institutional-grade infrastructure, aims to create a transparent, scalable, and liquid marketplace for carbon credits, offering features for secure transactions and price discovery, and supporting Islamic finance principles. This collaboration is a significant step in fostering a thriving voluntary carbon market and positions the nation as a key player in global climate finance.

records.title: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform participated in a regional workshop organized by the World Bank on food security a...
records.description: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform participated in a regional workshop organized by the World Bank on food security and nutrition in the Middle East and North Africa region. During the event, the Ministry reviewed key challenges facing Syria’s agricultural sector, including a sharp decrease in cultivated areas, reduced production of strategic crops, damaged infrastructure, fuel shortages, limited production inputs, and the impacts of climate change. The Ministry also presented a forward-looking vision to enhance national food security and strengthen the sector’s resilience in the coming period.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform

records.title: The Local Agency for the Support and Development of Entrepreneurship has signed an agreement with the Technological Institute specializin...
records.description: The Local Agency for the Support and Development of Entrepreneurship has signed an agreement with the Technological Institute specializing in ornamental horticulture and landscaping training to create an Entrepreneurship Development Center (CDE) within the institute. This collaboration aims to foster entrepreneurial skills among students and graduates in ornamental horticulture and landscaping, promoting their entry into the field. This initiative is part of the broader efforts of the National Entrepreneurship Support and Development Agency (NESDA) to instill an entrepreneurial spirit among vocational training graduates, in line with an existing agreement between NESDA and the General Directorate of Agricultural Production at the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries.
records.institution: The Local Agency for the Support and Development of Entrepreneurship

records.title: Egypt has been chosen as one of seven nations to benefit from a significant global program aimed at decarbonizing the industrial sector i...
records.description: Egypt has been chosen as one of seven nations to benefit from a significant global program aimed at decarbonizing the industrial sector in developing countries, reflecting international confidence in its climate action strategies. The national proposal was submitted in collaboration with several international financial institutions, highlighting the country's commitment to a green economy, institutional capabilities, and private sector engagement. This initiative seeks to foster low-emission industrial transformation, create green jobs, and enhance economic competitiveness, with participant countries developing investment plans to access concessional financing for clean technologies like green hydrogen. The program is part of a larger clean technology fund designed to mobilize substantial private capital for sustainable development, building on Egypt's intensified climate efforts and its national platform to attract climate investments through various partnerships.
records.institution: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Agricultural Extension Center in Aley, in collaboration with the Agricultural Cooperative in Ramlieh, organ...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Agricultural Extension Center in Aley, in collaboration with the Agricultural Cooperative in Ramlieh, organized a training workshop in Ramlieh, Aley District, on fruit and vegetable drying techniques. This initiative, part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, aimed to equip farmers and residents with innovative methods for preserving produce and increasing crop value. The head of the Aley Agricultural Center highlighted the importance of farmer registration and emphasized continued cooperation among extension centers, cooperatives, and municipalities to enhance farmers' skills and improve local produce marketing, especially given current economic challenges. Trainer Nabil Sarieddine provided a scientific and practical presentation on modern and safe drying methods, focusing on preserving surplus production and boosting family incomes.

records.title: A meeting was held in Laayoune, concurrently with one in Rabat via videoconference, to discuss implementing a livestock replenishment ope...
records.description: A meeting was held in Laayoune, concurrently with one in Rabat via videoconference, to discuss implementing a livestock replenishment operation in the Laayoune-Sakia El Hamra region. This initiative is part of broader national efforts to enhance the agricultural sector's sustainability. The gathering, attended by several ministers and central officials, focused on regional measures for reconstituting national livestock to ensure the sector's long-term stability. Officials affirmed the mobilization of all involved parties, including the Regional Directorate of Agriculture, the National Office of Agricultural Advice, and the National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA), to ensure the operation's success.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: Over 31 million trees have been planted in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province as part of a national afforestation project.
records.description: Over 31 million trees have been planted in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province as part of a national afforestation project. This initiative, led by a national center in partnership with numerous other entities, aims to plant 1.5 billion trees in the province by 2100 and restore over 7.9 million hectares of land. This provincial effort is a key part of a larger national green initiative that seeks to plant a total of 10 billion trees across the country and rehabilitate over 40 million hectares. Beyond planting, the center also focuses on environmental monitoring, combating illegal logging, public awareness, preventing sand encroachment in farming areas, and using native plant species to maintain ecological balance. They also collaborate with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture to organize a national afforestation season.
records.institution: National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) is spearheading ambitious plans to boost vegeta...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) is spearheading ambitious plans to boost vegetation cover in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Region, aiming for comprehensive sustainable development by 2100. To date, the NCVC has planted over 31.2 million trees in collaboration with numerous government, private, and non-profit partners. Four major projects are currently adding over 1 million more trees, contributing to a larger goal of planting 1.5 billion trees and rehabilitating over 7.9 million hectares of land. These ongoing efforts have already led to significant improvements in the region's environmental indicators and vegetation cover, demonstrating the effectiveness of the NCVC's scientific and integrated approach to afforestation. The center's projects actively support global climate change mitigation and carbon emission reduction, aligning with the Saudi Green Initiative and enhancing the quality of life for current and future generations.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: Tunisia and Mauritania are deepening their agricultural cooperation, focusing on enhancing food security and sustainable development.
records.description: Tunisia and Mauritania are deepening their agricultural cooperation, focusing on enhancing food security and sustainable development. Their partnership involves Mauritania leveraging Tunisian expertise in livestock health and veterinary infrastructure, while Tunisia shares its knowledge in irrigation and water resource management. Both nations also aim to boost trade in agricultural products like cereals, fruits, and livestock. This collaboration includes establishing working sessions to define priority areas and aligns with the regional "One Health" conference, seeking to improve agricultural productivity, secure farmer incomes, and strengthen their competitiveness in the regional market.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), the Dubai Supreme Council of Energy, and the World Green Economy Organisation (WGEO) ar...
records.description: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), the Dubai Supreme Council of Energy, and the World Green Economy Organisation (WGEO) are collaboratively hosting a major summit focused on accelerating the future of the green economy through innovation. This event will gather international experts to discuss effective approaches to combat climate change, with a strong emphasis on empowering developing regions, fostering global cooperation, and strengthening public-private partnerships. The summit's agenda is structured around seven key themes, including cutting-edge technology and innovation in climate resilience, clean and renewable energy solutions, shifts in policy and regulation, financial mechanisms for the green transition, addressing climate equity, strategies for climate adaptation and resilience, and the vital role of youth in climate action through entrepreneurship and activism.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), Dubai Supreme Council of Energy and the World Green Economy Organisation (WGEO)

records.title: The United Arab Emirates has made significant strides in combating desertification through proactive measures and innovative initiatives,...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates has made significant strides in combating desertification through proactive measures and innovative initiatives, despite challenging climatic conditions. Guided by its National Strategy to Combat Desertification 2022–2030, the UAE aims to preserve ecosystems, improve arid lands, adapt to climate change impacts, raise awareness, integrate modern technologies and scientific research, and strengthen partnerships. Recent achievements include the rehabilitation of thousands of hectares of degraded land, a smart soil monitoring system using AI, numerous scientific studies on rain enhancement, and projects in saline and desert agriculture. Various initiatives, such as sustainable grazing, a land degradation neutrality program, gene banks for native plants, and early warning systems for sand and dust storms, have been launched. The UAE's comprehensive approach also involves reclaiming desert land, establishing artificial forests and green belts, reducing unsustainable practices, promoting treated water use, and engaging the public through awareness campaigns. As a signatory to international environmental conventions, the UAE's Ministry of Climate Change and Environment has developed and updated national desertification strategies, successfully transforming vast desert areas into green landscapes and establishing numerous nature reserves.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Funding for Egypt's broader Green Sustainable Industry program includes a substantial loan from EIB Global.
records.description: Funding for Egypt's broader Green Sustainable Industry program includes a substantial loan from EIB Global. From this, a portion is allocated to co-finance projects aimed at reducing carbon emissions, enhancing recycling efforts, and cutting pollution, which are crucial steps in the country's shift towards a greener economy. A smaller part of the funding will also support the digitalization of the Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency to boost its environmental monitoring and enforcement capabilities. Officials noted that this initiative strengthens public-private cooperation, promotes sustainable industrial practices, and helps advance circular economy models.
records.institution: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development, and International Cooperation

records.title: The Vegetation Cover Development Foundation (Morooj), a Saudi entity, showcased its leading projects under the Saudi Green Initiative at...
records.description: The Vegetation Cover Development Foundation (Morooj), a Saudi entity, showcased its leading projects under the Saudi Green Initiative at GreenTech Amsterdam, a global exhibition for environmental innovations. Morooj highlighted its significant efforts, including planting millions of mangrove trees, afforesting mosque courtyards, engaging communities in environmental sanitation, and rehabilitating nature reserves across the Kingdom. The foundation's participation aimed to demonstrate its technical expertise and innovative environmental solutions, emphasizing alignment with international best practices and fostering strategic partnerships. This initiative directly supports Morooj's goals of enhancing international collaboration, sharing expertise, and promoting effective environmental practices, reinforcing Saudi Arabia's commitment to combating climate change and advancing environmental sustainability in line with Saudi Vision 2030.

records.title: A specialized workshop was recently held between the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Administrative Development, aimed at enh...
records.description: A specialized workshop was recently held between the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Administrative Development, aimed at enhancing institutional performance and integrating administrative structures with strategic objectives. Chaired by the respective Ministers and attended by key administrative personnel, the workshop focused on the Ministry of Agriculture's new organizational structure. Proposals for updating this structure were reviewed, seeking to align with current requirements, boost work efficiency, improve services to the agricultural sector, and activate the Ministry's developmental role within the state's administrative reform plan. The ultimate goal of the workshop was to forge a shared vision for a more flexible and effective organizational framework that supports efficient decision-making.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Administrative Development

records.title: Egypt's agriculture sector has demonstrated significant export growth and remains a key component of the nation's economic reform agenda.
records.description: Egypt's agriculture sector has demonstrated significant export growth and remains a key component of the nation's economic reform agenda. A recent visit to a major agricultural company in Beheira showcased various advanced facilities, including cold storage, irrigation stations, and packaging lines. This company cultivates extensive land, annually exporting a substantial volume of diverse crops, such as citrus, grapes, strawberries, dates, and lettuce, to numerous countries globally. It also serves as a significant employer, providing both full-time and seasonal jobs, including opportunities for individuals with disabilities. Furthermore, the company's pest control lab now produces local biological alternatives, significantly reducing reliance on imports, and utilizes technology for early pest detection and soil monitoring.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Through its Desert Oasis Project in Anbar, Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its Forestry and Desertification Department, has...
records.description: Through its Desert Oasis Project in Anbar, Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its Forestry and Desertification Department, has completed the rehabilitation of Jabha Oasis, with support from the World Food Programme. The recent efforts included planting 100 dunums of olive and pistachio trees sourced from the project's nurseries, significantly expanding the cultivated area. The rehabilitation also involved installing solar energy systems, fully restoring the well, setting up agricultural pumps, and equipping the entire area with modern drip irrigation. This initiative stands as a key achievement for the Ministry in advancing modern agriculture, utilizing advanced irrigation techniques, and integrating clean energy to foster sustainable agricultural development in desert regions.

records.title: The Saudi AgriFood Tech Alliance (SAFTA) recently expanded its network by signing agreements with prominent Dutch companies and research...
records.description: The Saudi AgriFood Tech Alliance (SAFTA) recently expanded its network by signing agreements with prominent Dutch companies and research institutions during a major exhibition in Amsterdam. This initiative aims to strengthen international cooperation and broaden opportunities in agricultural innovation, fostering bilateral ties and strategic partnerships for knowledge exchange between Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands, directly aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. A separate agreement also brought Dutch water entities into the Saudi Water Innovation Alliance, further advancing collaboration in food security and sustainable agricultural technologies. Ultimately, SAFTA serves as a national platform dedicated to accelerating the adoption of advanced technological solutions and enabling the Kingdom's agricultural sector to implement global best practices in smart farming, environmental sustainability, and high-quality food production.

records.title: A livestock official in a particular region has raised serious concerns about the rapid and uncontrolled spread of contagious lumpy skin...
records.description: A livestock official in a particular region has raised serious concerns about the rapid and uncontrolled spread of contagious lumpy skin disease in cattle, leading to multiple daily deaths. Breeders are reportedly distressed by what they perceive as an insufficient response from relevant authorities, particularly regarding the absence of widespread vaccination efforts and a shortage of veterinarians. The situation is exacerbated by fears of improper disposal of infected carcasses and the potential sale of contaminated meat, posing a public health risk. Calls have been made for an investigation into carcass disposal practices and for addressing illegal sales of diseased cattle at undervalued prices, highlighting a perceived lack of regulatory oversight. Farmers' diminishing trust in the administration is reportedly leading to underreporting of new cases.
records.institution: The Nabeul Regional Union of Agriculture and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has announced the indefinite closure of the squid fishing season in the Red Se...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has announced the indefinite closure of the squid fishing season in the Red Sea, effective immediately. A decision from the ministry prohibits all squid fishing during this period. The General Authority for Fisheries in the Red Sea has been directed to inventory all stored squid quantities in preparation labs, refrigerators, and fishery facilities within a week. The Ministry warns that any violations will result in penalties as outlined by the Law Regulating Fishing, Exploitation and Protection of Aquatic Life.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Sugar beet is undergoing a significant revival in Tunisia, particularly in the central and southern regions, as a strategic effort to div...
records.description: Sugar beet is undergoing a significant revival in Tunisia, particularly in the central and southern regions, as a strategic effort to diversify crops, enhance food security, and reduce reliance on sugar imports while developing marginal lands. Initial trials have demonstrated the crop's technical and economic viability with promising yields and high sugar extraction rates, even on challenging soils, supported by adapted varieties and optimized irrigation. This resurgence offers substantial agro-industrial value, yielding high-purity sucrose and valuable by-products for feed and bioenergy, alongside agronomic benefits like soil improvement and disease resistance within crop rotations. Despite facing challenges such as water management and organizational coordination, ongoing initiatives including cultivation contracts, farmer training, and digital monitoring tools are being implemented to support its sustainable growth.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully completed the mechanical harvesting of the wheat crop at the Al-Dour Research Station in Sal...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has successfully completed the mechanical harvesting of the wheat crop at the Al-Dour Research Station in Salah al-Din Governorate. This harvest, part of the current agricultural plan, was executed with precise timing to align with the northern region's climatic conditions, bolstering national efforts to enhance food security. Through such initiatives, the Ministry aims to support the provision of improved local seeds and encourage research-driven agriculture, thereby contributing to increased production and agricultural sustainability across the country.

records.title: As part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, the Ministry of Agriculture, specifically the Mount Lebanon Agriculture Departmen...
records.description: As part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, the Ministry of Agriculture, specifically the Mount Lebanon Agriculture Department/Jbeil Agricultural Center, collaborated with the Municipality of Ehmej to host an advisory seminar titled "Main Bee Diseases and Pests: Diagnosis and Treatment." The seminar, held in Ehmej and presented by expert Ali Yassin, aimed to enhance beekeepers' scientific awareness regarding diseases and pests impacting beehives, focusing on proper diagnosis, prevention, and treatment methods, as well as the environmental and climatic challenges facing the sector. The head of the Agricultural Center emphasized the importance of beekeepers registering in the official farmers' registry. Attended by the mayor of Ehmej, the Agricultural Committee, and numerous beekeepers from the Jbeil District, the event fostered constructive interaction and discussions on practical challenges. The Mayor of Ehmej thanked the Ministry and expressed the Municipality's continued commitment to cooperation.

records.title: As part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, the Ministry of Agriculture's Agricultural Center in Chehim, in collaboration wit...
records.description: As part of the National Agricultural Extension Program, the Ministry of Agriculture's Agricultural Center in Chehim, in collaboration with the Burj al-Jeish Agricultural Cooperative, held a specialized awareness workshop on "Sensory Evaluation of Olive Oil." The workshop, attended by 25 participants including municipal council members, cooperative members, and farmers, aimed to enhance scientific and practical knowledge regarding olive oil quality. Engineer Milia Al-Shabir led the two-hour theoretical and practical training, covering olive oil's nutritional benefits, factors affecting quality, production principles, common defects, and sensory evaluation standards, including direct tasting of various samples. Participants successfully classified oil samples, improving their professional and consumer awareness for selecting high-quality oil.

records.title: A field visit has been conducted to inspect a new batch of 88 agricultural tractors, acquired as part of a Regional Support Project for t...
records.description: A field visit has been conducted to inspect a new batch of 88 agricultural tractors, acquired as part of a Regional Support Project for the Pastoral System in the Sahel Region. These machines, which include equipment for sowing, tillage, and weed harvesting, supplement 102 previously purchased tractors, significantly enhancing the agricultural sector's capabilities. The Minister of Agriculture explained that this visit marks the second phase of an agricultural mechanization program, implemented under presidential directives, following a successful first phase last year. The Minister expressed optimism for the upcoming agricultural campaign, hoping it will expand cultivated areas and boost productivity, emphasizing the ministry's direct oversight of this initiative. The country possesses vast agricultural lands, particularly for rain-fed farming, with significant untapped potential. The World Bank and its technical and financial partners were thanked for their support, noting their broad involvement in projects benefiting the nation's agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, The Ministry of Animal Development

records.title: AgriEdge, a Moroccan AgriTech company from Mohammed VI Polytechnic University and supported by the OCP-InnovX ecosystem, is expanding its...
records.description: AgriEdge, a Moroccan AgriTech company from Mohammed VI Polytechnic University and supported by the OCP-InnovX ecosystem, is expanding its international presence. Following a successful launch in Canada, the digital precision agriculture startup recently opened a new subsidiary in Montpellier, France, named AgriculturiX. Montpellier was chosen as a strategic AgriTech hub from which AgriEdge plans to adapt and deploy its digital solutions, including AquaEdge for real-time irrigation, FertiEdge for optimized fertilization, and PhytoEdge for phytosanitary monitoring. These technologies aim to enhance resource efficiency, reduce costs, and improve the performance of export crops. Beyond Canada and France, AgriEdge is also establishing a subsidiary in Senegal, reinforcing its footprint in sub-Saharan Africa and continuing its global expansion with the mission to "Transforming data into nutrients."
records.institution: Mohammed VI Polytechnic University and the OCP-InnovX ecosystem

records.title: Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands have forged a significant partnership, formalizing over SR428 million in investments through numerous ag...
records.description: Saudi Arabia and the Netherlands have forged a significant partnership, formalizing over SR428 million in investments through numerous agreements and Memoranda of Understanding. These collaborations aim to develop and localize cutting-edge technologies across the environmental, water, and agricultural sectors. Key initiatives include localizing livestock disease control research, advancing agricultural technology and innovation, and implementing greenhouse farming solutions. Specific projects focus on biotechnology transfer, boosting potato production—including a new French fries factory—and investing in various localized agricultural innovations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah), a Saudi institution, has partnered with the Dutch c...
records.description: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah), a Saudi institution, has partnered with the Dutch company Hudson River Biotechnology (HRB) through a memorandum of understanding, aiming to significantly enhance international cooperation in sustainable agricultural research and technology. This collaboration focuses on transferring and localizing advanced genomics technologies and improving plant tissue culture techniques. It also includes implementing specialized training programs to develop national talent in biotechnology and genetic modification, alongside launching applied projects. These efforts are designed to boost the performance and productivity of Saudi Arabia's strategic crops, increasing their resilience to environmental and biological stresses, ultimately leading to greater agricultural production efficiency and long-term sustainability for the Kingdom.
records.institution: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah)

records.title: ADNOC Distribution has released its 2024 Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Report, showcasing significant advancements in susta...
records.description: ADNOC Distribution has released its 2024 Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Report, showcasing significant advancements in sustainability and national value creation. The report, prepared in line with GRI Standards and verified by KPMG, aligns with the UAE Net Zero by 2050 agenda and ADNOC Group's Net Zero by 2045 ambition. The company is actively pursuing a decarbonization roadmap, aiming to reduce carbon intensity in its operations by 25% by 2030 through energy-saving initiatives, building retrofits, and integrating renewable energy. Key achievements highlighted include expanding its electric vehicle (EV) charging network to 220 points, advancing over 20 AI-driven projects for sustainability and efficiency, achieving an Emiratisation rate of over 62%, and investing AED 3.9 million in Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).

records.title: Significant progress in combating water scarcity has been made by Khalifa University and Green Waste Solutions Trading DMCC through the d...
records.description: Significant progress in combating water scarcity has been made by Khalifa University and Green Waste Solutions Trading DMCC through the development of innovative technologies. Khalifa University has created a solar-powered thermal distillation device that efficiently produces freshwater from seawater without generating brine, achieving a notable daily output and attracting interest from major national companies. Concurrently, Green Waste Solutions Trading DMCC has developed a mobile, solar-powered integrated system that transforms organic waste and wastewater into potable water, renewable energy, and bio-fertilizers. This system has been successfully deployed in various countries, providing substantial quantities of clean water to remote communities. Both organizations were recently recognized for their contributions at a prestigious water award ceremony, with Khalifa University winning in the "Innovative Research and Development – National Institutions" category and Green Waste Solutions in the "Innovative Projects – Large Projects" category.

records.title: A representative from Bahrain's Animal Health Directorate, part of the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture, recently joine...
records.description: A representative from Bahrain's Animal Health Directorate, part of the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture, recently joined a global gathering of the World Organisation for Animal Health in France. This important session brought together delegates from many countries and international groups to tackle key animal health issues. They focused on updating international standards for animal health and trade, reviewing current disease situations like foot-and-mouth and avian influenza, and boosting cooperation under the One Health approach. A special forum on vaccines and immunization also took place, aiming to create a plan for improving global immunization efforts. The meeting wrapped up with several recommendations, including adopting new technical standards, launching joint efforts to enhance reporting on epidemics, developing strategies for new and zoonotic diseases, and supporting national programs for immunisation and veterinary labs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Egypt's Ministry of Environment launched the national "Qallelha (Reduce)" campaign to combat single-use plastic bags, as part of the coun...
records.description: Egypt's Ministry of Environment launched the national "Qallelha (Reduce)" campaign to combat single-use plastic bags, as part of the country's environmental initiatives focused on overcoming plastic pollution. The campaign builds on existing efforts, including a national strategy aimed at reducing plastic use while ensuring a just green transition for producers and consumers. The initiative was organized in collaboration with the Environmental Compliance and Sustainable Development Office of the Federation of Egyptian Industries, reflecting a broader global trend towards plastic reduction, with discussions ongoing with the industrial sector and anticipation of a binding international agreement on pollution. International partners expressed support, with one nation aiming for Egypt to become a regional hub for environmental sustainability in Africa, and an international organization supporting numerous projects for environmental advancement.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its Technical Department of the "Green Project," conducted a field visit to Barqa Lake in Deir...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its Technical Department of the "Green Project," conducted a field visit to Barqa Lake in Deir al-Ahmar, Baalbek District. This visit is part of ongoing efforts to bolster water security and sustainable agricultural development in North Bekaa. Barqa Lake, one of 24 mountain lakes constructed under the "Hasad" (Harvest) project, funded by IFAD and OFID, boasts a storage capacity of approximately 64,000 cubic meters, making it a strategic resource for agricultural irrigation. Additionally, a main irrigation network with a filtration system was implemented as part of the AgriCAL project to enhance water use efficiency and climate resilience in agricultural communities. This visit is among a series undertaken by the Ministry to monitor project effectiveness and sustainability, aligning with its vision to strengthen rural communities and agricultural infrastructure for climate change adaptation.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Despite ongoing drought conditions, Morocco's melon exports have shown remarkable growth, with a notable increase in volumes during a rec...
records.description: Despite ongoing drought conditions, Morocco's melon exports have shown remarkable growth, with a notable increase in volumes during a recent year, even surpassing historical averages. This surge was partly aided by challenges faced by competitors in other regions. European countries, particularly France, remain the primary destinations for Moroccan melons and watermelons. Conversely, watermelon exports experienced a significant decline in a recent period, attributed largely to severe drought and cultivation restrictions in certain areas. This reduced supply has led to a sharp rise in domestic watermelon prices, raising concerns about affordability for local consumers.

records.title: Khor Al Sawadi in Oman is recognized for its vital mangrove forests, which create a rich habitat for marine life and serve as a crucial s...
records.description: Khor Al Sawadi in Oman is recognized for its vital mangrove forests, which create a rich habitat for marine life and serve as a crucial stopover for migratory birds. Faced with global threats like climate change, the Environment Authority is diligently working to protect and rehabilitate these ecosystems. This includes a national program focused on mangrove restoration across Oman, with significant efforts in Khor Al Sawadi resulting in the substantial natural expansion and growth of the trees. A major rehabilitation campaign, conducted over several years, involved extensive planting of saplings, greatly contributing to the preservation of this critical coastal environment.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The grape harvesting season has commenced in the Wilayat of Yanqul, A’Dhahirah Governorate, with locally grown grapes highly valued for t...
records.description: The grape harvesting season has commenced in the Wilayat of Yanqul, A’Dhahirah Governorate, with locally grown grapes highly valued for their quality and taste in local markets, and the season is expected to continue until early August. Grapevines in the wilayat span approximately 13 acres, featuring about 2,600 grape trees, including both local and imported varieties, which significantly contribute to meeting the governorate's summer grape demand. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources actively supports grape farmers by providing technical supervision, advisory services on planting, trellis design, modern irrigation, pest control, and supplying seedlings, as well as scheduling preventive spraying and fertilization. These services also foster knowledge sharing among farmers, aiming to create sustainable income sources and optimize resource utilization, particularly through rationalized water consumption via modern irrigation techniques.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The decision to set the wheat purchase price for the 2025 season at $320 per ton, along with an additional $130 incentive per ton, was ma...
records.description: The decision to set the wheat purchase price for the 2025 season at $320 per ton, along with an additional $130 incentive per ton, was made by the Syrian government through its relevant agricultural authorities. Typically, such decisions are managed by the Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform in coordination with the General Organization for Cereal Processing and Trade (Hoboob), which oversees grain procurement, pricing policies, and support for local farmers. This move reflects the government’s ongoing efforts to support national food security and provide financial incentives for wheat producers amid current agricultural and climatic challenges.

records.title: Egypt's National Veal Project has secured over EGP 9.5 billion in total funding, supporting more than 44,800 beneficiaries and enabling t...
records.description: Egypt's National Veal Project has secured over EGP 9.5 billion in total funding, supporting more than 44,800 beneficiaries and enabling the rearing and fattening of over 518,000 head of livestock to significantly boost meat and dairy production. Recent new funding allocations will further expand the project, primarily benefiting small-scale breeders and young graduates. This initiative aims to enhance food security and stabilize prices for red meat and dairy, forming part of a broader national initiative to uplift rural communities. Officials emphasized the project's role in ensuring affordable meat while supporting local producers through ongoing field follow-ups, veterinary care, and pre-financing inspections. Interested individuals are encouraged to apply through agricultural offices or designated banks.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: On June 10, 2025, Domty reported Q1 2025 net profits of EGP 10.592 million, a 93.09 percent drop from EGP 153.302 million in Q1 2024, wit...
records.description: On June 10, 2025, Domty reported Q1 2025 net profits of EGP 10.592 million, a 93.09 percent drop from EGP 153.302 million in Q1 2024, with earnings per share falling to EGP 0.03 and net sales slightly declining to EGP 2.251 billion. The company cited restructuring efforts ahead of a planned demerger into two listed entities, including reducing receivable days, doubling marketing expenses, and aiming for a gradual recovery by Q3. Despite the weak quarter, Domty closed FY 2024 with US\$10.023 million in net profits and US\$184.5 million in sales, up 10.29 percent and 22.9 percent year-on-year respectively.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Investments Department, is set to participate in the Iraq Investment Forum, schedul...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Agricultural Investments Department, is set to participate in the Iraq Investment Forum, scheduled to be held in Baghdad. This forum, organized by the Iraqi Economic Council in collaboration with the National Investment Commission and directly overseen by the Prime Minister's Office, will feature broad Arab and international participation. The Ministry has finalized its preparations to showcase over 150 agricultural investment opportunities across nine Iraqi governorates. This participation aims to foster the development of the agricultural sector and accelerate economic and developmental progress within the country.

records.title: Jordan’s Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply has approved the import of select Syrian goods under a new licensing system, easing previ...
records.description: Jordan’s Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply has approved the import of select Syrian goods under a new licensing system, easing previous restrictions. Permitted items include electric fans, hair dryers, blenders, meat processors, agricultural sorting equipment, sterilisation devices, date molasses, and preserved vegetables. The move is part of Jordan’s efforts to manage trade with Syria while maintaining oversight and addressing domestic market needs.
records.institution: Jordanian Ministry of Industry, Trade and Supply

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Abadiyah Municipality, organized an awareness seminar in Abadiyah on the proper us...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Abadiyah Municipality, organized an awareness seminar in Abadiyah on the proper use of agricultural pesticides. The event, attended by approximately 45 male and female farmers from several nearby towns, aimed to enhance agricultural awareness and promote safe pesticide practices. Key speakers, including the head of the Agriculture Department in Mount Lebanon, provided technical guidelines for safe and effective pesticide use, while also highlighting the Ministry's policies for regulating pesticide application. A guiding intervention introduced the concept of biological pest control, showcasing the successful use of a specific bacterium as a natural enemy against a common pest. The symposium concluded with a discussion session, emphasizing farmer involvement in future extension plans. The event, marked by significant participant interaction, is part of the Ministry's broader agricultural extension efforts to foster sustainable development and food security across Lebanon.

records.title: Oman has lifted its ban on poultry imports from select regions in Europe following updated veterinary assessments, according to Ministeri...
records.description: Oman has lifted its ban on poultry imports from select regions in Europe following updated veterinary assessments, according to Ministerial Decision No. 126/2025 issued by Agriculture Minister Saud bin Hamoud al Habsi. The ban removal applies to Northern Ireland, Zealand Island (Denmark), Veneto (Italy), Lubuskie (Poland), and Flanders (Belgium), and aligns with international biosecurity standards. The decision takes effect upon publication in the Official Gazette.
records.institution: Oman Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: OQ Alternative Energy, the clean energy arm of a major Omani group, is set to begin operating key projects next year, aiming to contribut...
records.description: OQ Alternative Energy, the clean energy arm of a major Omani group, is set to begin operating key projects next year, aiming to contribute significantly to Oman's renewable energy capacity with a target of upwards of 7 GW by the end of the decade. This initiative is centered on two pillars: developing renewable energy and green hydrogen projects, and fostering holistic development across the entire value chain to attract foreign investment and advanced technology. A joint venture between OQ Alternative Energy and an international energy group will develop three initial projects, supplying renewable electricity to a prominent oil and gas producer under long-term agreements. Construction is underway with contributions from a Chinese contracting giant for engineering, procurement, and construction, as well as leading Chinese manufacturers for wind turbines and solar panels.

records.title: Dubai Municipality recently hosted its third Food Safety Forum, aligned with World Food Safety Day's theme "Food Safety: Prepare for the...
records.description: Dubai Municipality recently hosted its third Food Safety Forum, aligned with World Food Safety Day's theme "Food Safety: Prepare for the Unexpected." The event convened representatives from the UAE Ministry of Climate Change and Environment, the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), and various public, private, and academic entities. Discussions centered on the scientific underpinnings of food safety policy and risk management, aiming to enhance food supply chain resilience and empower consumer choices. Officials from Dubai Municipality underscored their commitment to a knowledge-driven, sustainable food ecosystem built on innovation and partnerships. The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment highlighted the UAE's dedication to food safety as a national priority, citing a robust legislative framework, digital transformation initiatives like the 'ZAD' portal and Biosecurity Early Notification System, and collaboration with FAO on a new strategic index for food control systems.

records.title: A meeting recently convened in Hajjah governorate, chaired by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, focused on the...
records.description: A meeting recently convened in Hajjah governorate, chaired by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, focused on the implementation of programs for expanding grain and legume production through contract farming. Attendees, including ministry undersecretaries, reviewed collective efforts to boost these strategic crops, aiming to enhance food security, build resilience, decrease import costs, and achieve national self-sufficiency, aligning with directives from the leadership and the government's agenda. The Minister underscored the necessity of robust inter-agency coordination for effective execution and the importance of collecting farmer data to facilitate agricultural guidance through field schools. An Undersecretary from the Ministry of Local Administration and Rural Development emphasized these programs as a top priority and a key metric for assessing the performance of district directors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and the Hodeida Governor recently inaugurated a project to sow and plant 250,...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and the Hodeida Governor recently inaugurated a project to sow and plant 250,000 Sidr tree seedlings at a district nursery. This initiative, a collaborative effort with local beekeepers and agricultural cooperative societies, aims to expand afforestation and increase agricultural land. During their visit, the officials were briefed on the nursery's operations, including seedling production and distribution plans, recognizing its role in community afforestation and boosting rural incomes. The Minister underscored the project's significance for plant production, beekeeping, and achieving self-sufficiency in fruit and environmental trees, highlighting Sidr's multifaceted value. He also emphasized the ministry's focus on establishing community nurseries to enhance farmer incomes, create employment, and foster agricultural partnerships within communities, envisioning this nursery as a model for other regions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Bahrain recently participated in a major international ocean conference in France, where government representatives discussed the nation'...
records.description: Bahrain recently participated in a major international ocean conference in France, where government representatives discussed the nation's ongoing commitment to environmental security and sustainability, guided by its national leadership. The conference, co-chaired by two republics, focused on accelerating efforts to conserve and sustainably use oceans, addressing challenges like pollution and overfishing, and aiming to adopt a declaration and action plan for ocean preservation. The delegation affirmed Bahrain's support for global initiatives to protect marine resources and advance sustainable development in cooperation with international organizations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and Nigerian Foreign Minister Yusuf Tuggar discussed strengthening economic ties, with a focus o...
records.description: Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty and Nigerian Foreign Minister Yusuf Tuggar discussed strengthening economic ties, with a focus on agriculture, trade, and investment, and emphasized expanding Egyptian business presence in Africa. They also addressed African security challenges, particularly in the Sahel, affirming cooperation within the African Union and Egypt’s support for counterterrorism and capacity-building efforts. The call included a briefing on the Gaza situation, with Abdelatty condemning Israeli actions and highlighting Egypt’s role in ceasefire mediation and humanitarian aid delivery.
records.institution: Egyptian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Emigration and Expatriates

records.title: As part of preparations for an upcoming Investment Forum in Baghdad, Iraq's National Investment Commission (NIC) recently reviewed a wide...
records.description: As part of preparations for an upcoming Investment Forum in Baghdad, Iraq's National Investment Commission (NIC) recently reviewed a wide array of investment opportunities submitted by the Ministries of Industry and Minerals, and of Agriculture. The review encompassed 97 strategic industrial opportunities, estimated at 4 trillion Iraqi dinars, focusing on rehabilitating public sector companies through private partnerships, establishing industrial cities, and developing petrochemical and fertilizer projects, alongside heavy and medium industries. In the agricultural sector, promising opportunities included crop and livestock production, modern irrigation, mechanization, and the development of food processing complexes to enhance food security. The NIC underscored the need to align the national investment map with state priorities in productive and food security sectors, calling for streamlined investor procedures in collaboration with relevant ministries to ensure project readiness for the forum.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture, through its Seed Inspection and Certification Department, maintained oversight of seed receipts in Kirkuk...
records.description: Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture, through its Seed Inspection and Certification Department, maintained oversight of seed receipts in Kirkuk Governorate, even during a holiday period. A delegation visited the seed receipt center at the Mesopotamia General Seed Company's central Kirkuk site, where samples were taken and confirmed to meet approved technical specifications. Specialized staff also inspected other sites, ensuring all receipts complied with quality controls. This ongoing supervision is crucial for guaranteeing seed quality and enhancing the nation's food security.

records.title: Iraqi authorities in al-Sulaymaniyah and Diyala intensified food safety measures during Eid al-Adha amid a severe heatwave reaching 49°C...
records.description: Iraqi authorities in al-Sulaymaniyah and Diyala intensified food safety measures during Eid al-Adha amid a severe heatwave reaching 49°C and rising concerns over Crimean-Congo Hemorrhagic Fever. In al-Sulaymaniyah, 735 animals were processed at the provincial slaughterhouse, with veterinary teams discarding nearly half a ton of unfit meat. Diyala's Health Directorate closed 10 restaurants over serious hygiene violations, including unclean kitchens and improper food handling.
records.institution: Iraqi Authorities in al-Sulaymaniyah and Diyala

records.title: On June 9, 2025, Iraq announced it had achieved wheat self-sufficiency for the 2024–2025 season, harvesting a record 6.3 million tonnes,...
records.description: On June 9, 2025, Iraq announced it had achieved wheat self-sufficiency for the 2024–2025 season, harvesting a record 6.3 million tonnes, a 21 percent increase from the previous year, with a surplus of 1.3 to 1.5 million tonnes and reserves exceeding 5.5 million tonnes. The government spent nearly US\$6 billion on procurement, paying farmers more than double global market rates, leading to an estimated US\$500 million fiscal loss. Despite storage challenges in provinces like Wasit, most of the harvest was collected, retail flour prices remained stable, 220,000 tonnes were exported to Syria, and investments are ongoing in irrigation and drought-resistant seeds.

records.title: Saudi Arabia will enforce new regulations on June 27 mandating livestock sales by weight rather than size to curb price manipulation and...
records.description: Saudi Arabia will enforce new regulations on June 27 mandating livestock sales by weight rather than size to curb price manipulation and ensure fair value for buyers and sellers. The move targets inflated pricing, particularly during Eid Al-Adha, when livestock demand spikes. In 2024, over 4 million animals were imported, with prices reportedly rising by more than SAR2,000 during the holiday. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture aims to eliminate unregulated roadside trading and improve market transparency across the supply chain.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.description: The Syrian Grain Establishment has begun receiving wheat from farmers for the 2024/2025 year, as part of its efforts to ensure local market stability and meet basic wheat needs.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) has issued a warning regarding the persistent spread of desert locusts...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) has issued a warning regarding the persistent spread of desert locusts in North Africa, particularly in a neighboring country, with potential migration towards the Sahel region. This expansion is projected to continue over the next two months, as swarms gradually move southward, and summer breeding is expected to commence in various southern African territories. The organization has noted continued swarm formation across North Africa, with some infestations preparing to coalesce into larger groups. While spring breeding has concluded in some eastern African and Arabian countries, concerns remain about limited breeding in a far eastern border region. The FAO emphasizes the urgent need for heightened surveillance and control measures throughout North Africa to prevent these locust populations from escalating into a significant threat to regional food security. In response, local authorities in the affected nation have already initiated a substantial desert locust control campaign, treating vast areas by both ground and air, with ongoing survey, surveillance, and intervention operations in several administrative regions to contain the spread and safeguard agricultural and ecologically sensitive zones. Sources
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: Tunisia's Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries and the Tunisian Solidarity Bank (BTS) have jointly launched a 10 millio...
records.description: Tunisia's Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries and the Tunisian Solidarity Bank (BTS) have jointly launched a 10 million dinar financing program to support the 2024-2025 coarse fodder harvest season. This initiative provides flexible, advantageous seasonal loans to small producers, breeders, cooperatives, and other agricultural professional structures. The program offers two types of loans: up to 10,000 dinars for small farmers and breeders, and up to 50,000 dinars for civil societies, cooperatives, and groups. These loans require no self-financing or material collateral, feature a fixed interest rate, and have a maximum repayment term of 12 months. Applications are submitted to BTS agencies, reviewed weekly by regional technical committees, and approved within ten business days. Initially deployed in nine priority governorates, the program targets all registered and active livestock farmers nationwide, with support from the Regional Agricultural Development Commissions (CRDA).
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries
