records.title: Emirates NBD, a leading banking group, has partnered with Siemens, a global technology leader, to establish an innovative finance and res...
records.description: Emirates NBD, a leading banking group, has partnered with Siemens, a global technology leader, to establish an innovative finance and resourcing agreement. This collaboration aims to accelerate the funding of green infrastructure projects across the UAE, aligning fully with the nation's Net Zero by 2050 Strategic Initiative. Emirates NBD played a crucial role in designing a unique credit framework and developing an innovative suite of financing tools that will support these projects throughout their lifecycle, including decarbonization efforts. This partnership highlights Emirates NBD's commitment to the UAE's sustainability ambitions and its goal to expand relationships with multinational companies that share its environmental, social, and governance (ESG) vision. Siemens emphasizes that the technologies for enhancing energy efficiency are readily available, and this agreement seeks to speed up their implementation to achieve critical climate goals.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The total production capacity of a major solar park has significantly increased, reaching over 3,800 megawatts using both photovoltaic pa...
records.description: The total production capacity of a major solar park has significantly increased, reaching over 3,800 megawatts using both photovoltaic panels and concentrated solar power technologies. This expansion has boosted the share of clean energy in total production to over 21%, aligning with strategic goals to achieve 100% clean energy by the middle of the century and substantial carbon emission reductions. The park is a key project in the emirate's clean energy strategy, with plans to further expand its capacity to over 7,200 megawatts by the end of the decade. Its development has progressed through multiple phases, each incorporating advanced solar technologies, and future phases are set to include large-scale battery energy storage systems, aiming to create one of the world's largest solar-plus-storage projects.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), Dubai Supreme Council of Energy

records.title: In Bahrain, the "Capital, a Healthy Governorate" initiative saw a tree-planting event at Bu Ashira Park, organized by the Capital Governo...
records.description: In Bahrain, the "Capital, a Healthy Governorate" initiative saw a tree-planting event at Bu Ashira Park, organized by the Capital Governorate in collaboration with the World Health Organization (WHO) to celebrate World Environment Day. This event underscored the nation's commitment to sustainability through various green actions, such as coastal clean-up drives, expanding urban green spaces, and launching environmental awareness campaigns. The celebration included many community organizations, showcasing the multicultural harmony present in the environmental efforts.

records.title: Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture is conducting an ongoing free aerial spraying campaign to combat the palm dubas insect in Najaf Governorat...
records.description: Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture is conducting an ongoing free aerial spraying campaign to combat the palm dubas insect in Najaf Governorate, following similar operations in Wasit and Babil. This initiative, implemented by the Department of Plant Protection in collaboration with the Ministry of Defense's Army Aviation Command and local agricultural directorates, utilizes environmentally safe agricultural pesticides. The spraying operations are carefully scheduled to target affected areas, aiming to limit the insect's spread and eliminate it, with parallel ground spraying campaigns also in effect across the governorate.

records.title: Oman is actively embracing technology and innovation to expand and diversify its agricultural sector, aiming to enhance food security in...
records.description: Oman is actively embracing technology and innovation to expand and diversify its agricultural sector, aiming to enhance food security in a sustainable manner. Through various state-owned companies, the nation is deploying precision agriculture technologies, including artificial intelligence, to boost crop yields and food production while significantly reducing water and other input consumption. This aligns with Oman's long-term agricultural strategy, which prioritizes diversifying crops, increasing livestock, and promoting aquaculture to boost self-sufficiency and reduce reliance on imports. Modern practices such as GPS-guided tools, IoT sensors, drones, hydroponics, greenhouse farming, and data analytics are being adopted to improve efficiency, strengthen food safety, and enhance competitiveness in export markets. A leading example of this tech-driven approach is the Million Date Palm Trees Project, which utilizes satellite imagery and AI to optimize cultivation and detect issues like pest infestation.

records.title: Oman marked World Oceans Day by renewing its commitment to marine environment protection through policies, conservation projects, and pub...
records.description: Oman marked World Oceans Day by renewing its commitment to marine environment protection through policies, conservation projects, and public awareness. With a 3,165 km coastline rich in biodiversity, Oman continues efforts led by the Environment Authority, including research on pollution and overfishing, marine reserves, and projects like artificial coral reef rehabilitation. Initiatives also focus on youth engagement and participation in global environmental agreements such as the Convention on Biological Diversity.

records.title: A UAE-based entrepreneur has developed a new line of energy drinks made entirely from date pits, aiming to offer a natural, caffeine-free...
records.description: A UAE-based entrepreneur has developed a new line of energy drinks made entirely from date pits, aiming to offer a natural, caffeine-free alternative to traditional beverages. The product is designed to capitalize on the nutritional value of date seeds, which are rich in antioxidants and minerals, and supports the country's push for sustainable, locally sourced innovations in the food and beverage sector.

records.title: Saudi Arabia is actively tackling its significant water scarcity challenge by focusing on ensuring water availability, accessibility, and...
records.description: Saudi Arabia is actively tackling its significant water scarcity challenge by focusing on ensuring water availability, accessibility, and affordability. The Kingdom has become a global leader in water desalination, investing heavily in advanced technologies and large-scale infrastructure. Its current desalinated water supply is substantial, with plans to significantly increase capacity in the coming years and expand its transmission network. Beyond desalination, Saudi Arabia is prioritizing wastewater treatment and reuse, adopting energy-efficient technologies and integrating renewable energy sources into its water facilities. Public-private partnerships are playing a crucial role in driving these transformations, accelerating investments and infrastructure development by opening the sector to international competition.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Iraq's National Investment Commission (NIC) recently convened a high-level meeting to explore investment opportunities in green hydrogen...
records.description: Iraq's National Investment Commission (NIC) recently convened a high-level meeting to explore investment opportunities in green hydrogen and blue ammonia production, critical steps in the nation's strategy to diversify its energy sources and transition towards clean alternatives. The meeting, chaired by the NIC Chairman, highlighted these initiatives as central to the government's vision for transforming the national economy and energy sector. Emphasizing the importance of attracting foreign investment and technical expertise, the discussion underscored that public-private collaboration is vital for unlocking Iraq's renewable energy potential. The economic benefits of hydrogen production, including job creation and a sustainable energy supply, were also stressed as significant contributors to Iraq's energy security and economic growth. The meeting further addressed Iraq's future plans in renewable energy and biofuels, acknowledging the existing challenges due to heavy reliance on oil and the urgent need for alternative sources.

records.title: To bolster fish stocks, Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture, via its Department of Animal Wealth, released approximately a quarter million com...
records.description: To bolster fish stocks, Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture, via its Department of Animal Wealth, released approximately a quarter million common carp fingerlings into the Al-Kut Dam in Wasit Governorate. Sourced from the Al-Suwaira Fish Hatchery, this initiative aims to expand the targeted water bodies with sustainable aquatic life, thereby significantly enhancing future fish populations.

records.title: On June 5, 2025, Egypt’s state grain agency, Mostakbal Misr, signed major wheat deals with France and Romania to diversify imports and re...
records.description: On June 5, 2025, Egypt’s state grain agency, Mostakbal Misr, signed major wheat deals with France and Romania to diversify imports and reduce dependence on the Black Sea region, which previously supplied over 70 percent of Egypt’s wheat. The shift follows disruptions caused by the Russia-Ukraine war, sanctions, and export restrictions. Egypt has expanded sourcing to Europe, South America, and Australia, aiming to stabilize prices and strengthen reserves. The agency confirmed large wheat and vegetable oil shipments in May and emphasized deferred purchases as part of its risk management strategy.

records.title: As part of the National Agricultural Extension Program and the "Scaling Up the Implementation of the One Country One Priority Product" pr...
records.description: As part of the National Agricultural Extension Program and the "Scaling Up the Implementation of the One Country One Priority Product" project, the Ministry of Agriculture's Akkar Agriculture Department, through its Harar Agricultural Center, collaborated with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) in Lebanon to host a guidance seminar. The seminar focused on "Good Agricultural Practices for Chickpea Cultivation and Seed Production in the Informal System," aiming to enhance farmers' technical capacities for this economically important crop in Akkar. The FAO team delivered a comprehensive presentation covering all stages of chickpea cultivation, from variety selection and soil preparation to pest management and harvesting, alongside guidelines for informal seed production to ensure quality and sustainability. Over 50 farmers actively participated, contributing their questions and field experiences. These seminars are a joint effort by the Ministry of Agriculture and FAO to foster sustainable agricultural development and equip small farmers with essential knowledge and expertise to boost local production and crop quality.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman Environmental Services Holding Company (be’ah) and OQ Trading have signed a cooperation agreement to jointly develop a national proj...
records.description: Oman Environmental Services Holding Company (be’ah) and OQ Trading have signed a cooperation agreement to jointly develop a national project for producing biogas (biomethane) and bio-carbon dioxide from organic waste at landfills and future biofacilities. This strategic partnership aims to transform environmental challenges into economic opportunities by utilizing an estimated 20 million cubic meters of biogas, comprising about 40% biomethane and 60% bio-CO₂, for various sustainable industrial applications. The collaboration will involve technical and economic feasibility studies, infrastructure assessments, and the identification of commercial marketing opportunities, with the expectation of creating local investment opportunities aligned with Oman Vision 2040. Both companies emphasize this integrated model of national cooperation, leveraging be’ah’s waste management expertise and OQ Trading’s global energy capabilities to bolster Oman’s position as a regional clean energy hub.
records.institution: Oman Environmental Services Holding Company (be’ah), OQ Trading

records.title: The EU announced €175 million in new funding to support Syria’s social and economic recovery following the lifting of economic sanctions,...
records.description: The EU announced €175 million in new funding to support Syria’s social and economic recovery following the lifting of economic sanctions, focusing on public sector support, community-driven projects, livelihoods, education, health, and transitional justice. The funding will also enhance access to finance for vulnerable populations and promote integration with Mediterranean initiatives like Erasmus+. Commissioner Dubravka Šuica is currently in Syria, reaffirming the EU’s commitment to a peaceful, inclusive, Syrian-led transition. This comes as part of a broader €2.5 billion pledge made at the 9th international conference to support Syria’s recovery and refugee return.

records.title: The "Resilient, Sustainable and Inclusive Agriculture for Investment in Tunisia" (ARDII-Tounes) project, costing an estimated $224 millio...
records.description: The "Resilient, Sustainable and Inclusive Agriculture for Investment in Tunisia" (ARDII-Tounes) project, costing an estimated $224 million, has been launched to combat climate change risks in the country's agricultural sector. This 15-year initiative, stemming from support provided by the Platform for Agricultural Risk Management (PARM), aims to bolster the resilience and sustainability of Tunisian agriculture, particularly for vulnerable groups like rainfed cereal farmers, smallholder olive growers, rural women, and youth. The project builds on PARM's prior work in Tunisia, including local capacity building and risk assessment in key agricultural value chains. PARM, a global partnership on agricultural risk management established after G20 discussions, is hosted by the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD) and co-financed by the European Union, the French Development Agency, the Italian government, and IFAD, all of whom, along with other technical and financial partners, gathered for the project's inception workshop to mobilize necessary resources.

records.title: Mleiha National Park in Sharjah's central region has completed an ecological assessment, revealing over 100 distinct species within its d...
records.description: Mleiha National Park in Sharjah's central region has completed an ecological assessment, revealing over 100 distinct species within its desert ecosystem, solidifying its status as one of the Arabian Peninsula's most ecologically diverse areas. Operated by the Sharjah Investment and Development Authority (Shurooq) and spanning 34.2 square kilometers, the park is a model for integrated conservation, eco-tourism, and sustainability, serving as a living desert museum that preserves rare fossils, ancient artifacts, and rich biodiversity. The park's diverse flora, including resilient native plant species, plays a crucial role in soil stability and providing microhabitats. Its fauna includes 11 mammal species, over 10 reptile species, and more than 20 bird species, including both resident and migratory birds. Additionally, the park boasts over 39 species of insects and arachnids, which are vital for pollination, soil health, and pest control. Visitors can engage with this rich biodiversity through guided nature trails, fossil discovery walks, and wildlife observation tours, aligning with the park's mission of environmental education and supporting the UAE’s sustainability goals.
records.institution: Mleiha National Park, Sharjah Investment and Development Authority (Shurooq)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Eugene Veterinary Diagnostics Laboratory, recently hosted a specialized scientific...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Eugene Veterinary Diagnostics Laboratory, recently hosted a specialized scientific symposium focusing on foot-and-mouth disease and hemorrhagic disease. The event, attended by technical and administrative staff, including the Technical Undersecretary and various researchers and specialists, aimed to address the causes, modern diagnostic methods, and prevention and control strategies for these diseases. This symposium was particularly pertinent given the recent recording of hemorrhagic fever cases in Iraq, and it forms part of the Ministry's broader efforts to raise awareness of disease risks, enhance health and preventive responses, and strengthen scientific cooperation with academic institutions to bolster environmental health security and curb the spread of epidemics.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Eugene Veterinary Diagnostics Laboratory

records.title: To bolster supply and stabilize prices for an upcoming holiday season, the Ministry of Agriculture has opened imports of live sacrificial...
records.description: To bolster supply and stabilize prices for an upcoming holiday season, the Ministry of Agriculture has opened imports of live sacrificial animals from Syria. This includes the availability of live Syrian kids in local markets, while live sheep imports from Syria are presently restricted to military institutions. This decision aims to diversify sources, ease pressure on domestic production, and ensure citizens can access sacrifices at reasonable prices. The local livestock market currently shows a significant surplus of both local and imported sheep, far exceeding anticipated demand. While most sacrificial animals are local, imports also come from various other countries. Indicative prices for both imported and local sacrifices are available, though they are subject to market conditions and typically see a decline after the initial holiday period, encouraging consumers to compare prices at numerous sale points.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Labor, and the Palestinian Employment Fund have launched new emergency employment programs f...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, the Ministry of Labor, and the Palestinian Employment Fund have launched new emergency employment programs for agricultural engineers and unemployed workers in the southern governorates. This initiative is part of ongoing government efforts to enhance community resilience and economically empower affected populations, specifically as an emergency response to support the agricultural sector and food production amidst current exceptional circumstances. The program aims to provide a stable income for marginalized agricultural families and reduce food insecurity by increasing local vegetable production. This intervention is crucial for sustainable agricultural development, aligning with national employment and social protection policies for vulnerable groups, with operational payments planned to continue for sustained impact. Project partners emphasized that this collaboration reflects inter-institutional integration to support citizens, strengthen their capacity to face economic challenges, and foster agricultural self-sufficiency as a cornerstone of food security and national development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Ramallah and Al-Bireh Governorate directorate, partnered with an international organization to d...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Ramallah and Al-Bireh Governorate directorate, partnered with an international organization to distribute fodder barley to sheep farmers in Bedouin communities within specific West Bank areas. This initiative is a component of a larger project focused on protecting Palestinian communities from forced displacement. The distribution aims to enhance the resilience, food security, and economic well-being of these vulnerable communities by providing crucial agricultural support and fostering sustainable livelihoods. Both the Ministry and the partner organization emphasized that this effort aligns with ongoing interventions to aid farmers in areas facing land confiscation and other threats, highlighting the importance of collaborative development projects that enable citizens to remain on their lands and address economic, environmental, and humanitarian challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change in Qatar has inaugurated a National Biodiversity Database via an interactive online platfo...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change in Qatar has inaugurated a National Biodiversity Database via an interactive online platform, designed to document and categorize the nation's terrestrial and marine life. This tool will generate precise maps of natural habitats and species distribution, serving as a robust scientific resource for policymakers, researchers, and relevant bodies in crafting national reports and environmental strategies grounded in accurate data. The database represents a significant stride in the country's environmental governance and commitment to sustainable development, aligning with its national vision and development strategies focused on green transformation and enhanced environmental security. The launch involved formal agreements with several governmental and academic entities to ensure effective utilization of the environmental data, signifying an advanced approach to environmental knowledge management and a commitment to global biodiversity agreements.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change

records.title: On June 4, 2025, Tunisia’s industrial tomato harvest was projected to fall by 15 percent to 850,000 tons due to widespread downy mildew o...
records.description: On June 4, 2025, Tunisia’s industrial tomato harvest was projected to fall by 15 percent to 850,000 tons due to widespread downy mildew outbreaks worsened by heavy rainfall and waterlogged soil. In Nabeul, the main producing region, losses ranged from 20 to 70 percent, causing yields to drop by 33 percent and output to potentially fall to 240,000 tons. Tomatoes, Tunisia’s fifth most valuable agricultural export, earned US\$83.4 million in 2024, and the current decline is expected to impact processors and exporters. Similar outbreaks are affecting tomato crops in Nigeria and Kenya, straining regional supply chains.

records.title: Tunisia's crucial industrial tomato sector is facing a severe crisis due to a widespread outbreak of tomato blight, a fungal disease exac...
records.description: Tunisia's crucial industrial tomato sector is facing a severe crisis due to a widespread outbreak of tomato blight, a fungal disease exacerbated by humid conditions. This has led to a projected significant decline in yields across key producing regions, jeopardizing the sustainability of the nation's tomato cultivation, which is paramount to its economy. The crisis is compounded by factors such as ineffective treatments, escalating costs of agricultural inputs, and shrinking cultivated areas. Combating the blight requires an integrated approach that combines improved cultural practices, targeted treatments, enhanced farmer training, and strong institutional support, alongside long-term agricultural research and technological innovation to ensure the sector's resilience and safeguard the country's food security.

records.title: Tunisia’s Prime Minister Sara Zaafrani Zenzri chaired a Cabinet meeting to review preparations for the 2025–2026 agricultural season, foc...
records.description: Tunisia’s Prime Minister Sara Zaafrani Zenzri chaired a Cabinet meeting to review preparations for the 2025–2026 agricultural season, focusing on accelerating fertiliser stockpiling, maintaining current prices, and streamlining financing and energy supply for storage centres. The government will implement the “Engrais” digital platform to monitor fertiliser distribution and organise mandatory training for hazardous material truck drivers. Coordination with the Tunisian Chemical Group is underway to ensure sufficient supply of ammonium nitrate, ammonium phosphate, and triple superphosphate. The Prime Minister called for enhanced coordination, safety compliance, and outreach to farmers to support season success.

records.title: On June 4, 2025, Abu Dhabi authorities urged residents to avoid unlicensed Eid Al-Adha slaughtering and use official abattoirs, citing he...
records.description: On June 4, 2025, Abu Dhabi authorities urged residents to avoid unlicensed Eid Al-Adha slaughtering and use official abattoirs, citing heightened risks of zoonotic disease and poor meat quality. ADAFSA emphasized that licensed facilities ensure hygienic conditions, veterinary inspections, proper Islamic procedures, and safe waste disposal. The public education campaign aims to direct citizens and residents to approved slaughterhouses ahead of the holiday, where only qualified butchers are allowed to operate under strict health and safety standards.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources in Yemen has strongly condemned an environmental incident on Socotra Island,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources in Yemen has strongly condemned an environmental incident on Socotra Island, where over 80 dolphins were found beached, many deceased. The Ministry described this as the second such occurrence recently, posing a significant threat to the island's marine ecosystem. They suggest the incidents are not natural and point to suspicious human activity and potential marine pollution, possibly linked to illegal operations by foreign vessels, specifically accusing certain foreign forces of destructive activities under the guise of developmental projects with colonial motives. The Ministry hypothesizes that chemical or acoustic marine pollution from large vessels could be a major factor, disrupting the dolphins' navigational senses. Other scientific possibilities, such as viral or bacterial diseases or environmental changes like ocean currents and temperatures, are also being explored.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.description: The Yemeni Sugar Refining Company, in collaboration with the local branch of the Environmental Protection Authority in Al-Hodeidah, marked World Environment Day with the launch of a Carbon Neutrality and Biodiversity Program. The Environmental Protection Authority praised the company's significant environmental progress and commitment to sustainable development, highlighting it as a leading model for integrating industrial production with environmental responsibility. The company's officials emphasized their strategic goal of achieving carbon neutrality through adopting high environmental standards, occupational health and safety practices, and implementing projects in renewable energy, afforestation, and waste recycling. The company is noted for being the first local facility to adopt a global energy management system to reduce consumption and convert industrial and food waste into organic fertilizer.

records.title: Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the World Food Programme, has successfully rehabilitated and developed ten agricult...
records.description: Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the World Food Programme, has successfully rehabilitated and developed ten agricultural meteorological stations across several governorates including Nineveh, Najaf, Dhi Qar, Muthanna, Wasit, and Maysan. This cooperation is part of a free grant aimed at enhancing the work of these stations, which are vital for supporting the agricultural sector. The Ministry also confirmed ongoing efforts to support agricultural projects through its partnership with the World Food Programme, following an extended agreement between the two entities.

records.title: Salah al-Din Governorate is celebrated for its diverse agricultural output, particularly its thriving deciduous and grape orchards, a tes...
records.description: Salah al-Din Governorate is celebrated for its diverse agricultural output, particularly its thriving deciduous and grape orchards, a testament to its fertile soil. The Ministry of Agriculture highlighted the rich variety of orchards in the Al-Ishaqi Subdistrict of Samarra District, which produce apricots, peaches, apples, grapes, along with palm groves and citrus fruits. This subdistrict is notably recognized for its extensive cultivation of various grape types, including the historically renowned Al-Baldawi black grape, spanning over 10,000 dunums.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Department, through its Baghdad Monitoring and Inspection Committee (Rusafa Sector), has launche...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Veterinary Department, through its Baghdad Monitoring and Inspection Committee (Rusafa Sector), has launched a joint campaign with various other governmental bodies including the Public Health Department, the Health Supervision Department at the Ministry of Health, the National Security Service, municipalities, and police forces. This initiative targets unregulated slaughtering sites and sheep pens in the Fadhiliya area, coinciding with the approaching Eid al-Adha. The campaign involves inspecting meat shops for health and technical compliance and taking action against violators. Additionally, the joint committee is conducting awareness campaigns for butchers and the public regarding preventive measures for hemorrhagic fever, promoting slaughtering at official facilities, and encouraging the purchase of veterinarian-inspected, sealed meat to ensure public health and safety.

records.title: Musandam Global Investment Company, in partnership with its Turkish business partners, has signed an agreement to establish the Musandam...
records.description: Musandam Global Investment Company, in partnership with its Turkish business partners, has signed an agreement to establish the Musandam Drydock and Marine Industries Company. This strategic project in Musandam Governorate represents an initial investment exceeding OMR5 million and aims to provide vital marine services, including the construction and maintenance of fish farming cages, various types of fishing vessels, marine tugs, and transport vessels. The new company will cater to the needs of the Omani market and neighboring regional markets, fostering industrial integration within the marine and fisheries sector. The project aligns with national goals of enhancing food security and promoting sustainable industrial growth. The agreement was signed in the presence of the Omani Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources and the Governor of Musandam.

records.description: Oman's be’ah and OQ Trading launched a project to produce biogas and bio-CO₂ from organic waste, targeting 20 million cubic meters of biogas, split into 40% biomethane and 60% bio-CO₂ for industrial use. The plan includes feasibility studies, infrastructure assessments, and commercial marketing to support local waste-to-energy production and investment.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Ramallah and Al-Bireh Governorate directorate, and in partnership with the "We Are the World" Fo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Ramallah and Al-Bireh Governorate directorate, and in partnership with the "We Are the World" Foundation, distributed 50 tons of barley to sheep farmers in the Bedouin communities of Al-Khalayel, Al-Mughayyir. This initiative is part of broader efforts by the Ministry and its partners to support vulnerable agricultural groups in areas facing threats from pastoral settlement, ongoing violations, and the risk of forced displacement. The distribution aims to improve the environmental and living conditions of livestock breeders, support their continued farming as a primary income source, and strengthen their resilience on their land.

records.title: Madinah Region's date markets are now receiving the first harvests of the season, featuring early varieties like luna musaed, rabia, and...
records.description: Madinah Region's date markets are now receiving the first harvests of the season, featuring early varieties like luna musaed, rabia, and ajwa from western farms. Initial market activity shows high demand and elevated prices due to limited early supply, though a bountiful production season is anticipated, promising to stabilize availability in the coming weeks. The region's date season is among the earliest in the Kingdom, beginning in early June and peaking in July and August, with later varieties ripening by late August. The season generally spans about three months, from early June to September, marking a highly active agricultural period where authorities continuously monitor quality and supply chain safety, reinforcing Madinah's role as a key date production and trading hub.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: NEOM Green Hydrogen Company, a joint venture involving a Saudi utility major, a US group, and the developer of a Saudi mega-city, has ann...
records.description: NEOM Green Hydrogen Company, a joint venture involving a Saudi utility major, a US group, and the developer of a Saudi mega-city, has announced significant progress on its large-scale green hydrogen plant at Oxagon. The project is now 80% complete across all its sites, including the green hydrogen facility, wind garden, solar farm, and transmission grid. When fully operational by the end of 2026, this will be the world's largest green hydrogen plant, capable of producing up to 600 tonnes of carbon-free fuel daily. Key equipment, such as wind turbines, hydrogen storage vessels, electrolysers, and pipe racks, is currently being installed. The 4 GW of solar and wind power generation are slated for completion by mid-2026, with the first ammonia product expected in 2027. This pioneering project aligns directly with the Kingdom's Vision 2030, supporting economic diversification and global leadership in clean energy.

records.title: The King Abdulaziz Royal Reserve Development Authority has started issuing permits for beekeeping within the reserve, a move designed to...
records.description: The King Abdulaziz Royal Reserve Development Authority has started issuing permits for beekeeping within the reserve, a move designed to regulate this activity, promote environmental balance, and protect the local vegetation and wildlife. Beekeepers can apply for permits via the authority's official website, and applicants must provide a national ID or residency permit along with a beekeeper license from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture. Only local beekeeping is allowed, strictly adhering to veterinary health standards. New regulations prohibit the use of pesticides and chemicals, tree felling, or harming local plants. Beekeepers must operate only in designated areas, display permit information, maintain cleanliness, and follow specified routes.
records.institution: King Abdulaziz Royal Reserve Development Authority

records.title: SICO signed a Letter of Intent with the Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) to act as financial advisor on...
records.description: SICO signed a Letter of Intent with the Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID) to act as financial advisor on agricultural and food security projects across the Arab and GCC region, particularly in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia. The agreement covers sourcing and structuring direct equity and debt investments, conducting due diligence, valuations, and transaction execution, as well as raising capital for AAAID’s portfolio companies. It also includes business development support and identifying joint venture opportunities.

records.title: Egypt has initiated a national campaign to combat single-use plastic pollution, supported by an international development organization an...
records.description: Egypt has initiated a national campaign to combat single-use plastic pollution, supported by an international development organization and a foreign government. This effort aims to reduce the environmental impact of plastics and foster sustainable alternatives nationwide. The campaign, which represents a shift from outright bans to gradual reduction, is part of a broader strategy to integrate circular economy principles within the country's plastics value chain, leading to economic and environmental benefits. It also seeks to stimulate green industrial growth, create employment opportunities in recycling and sustainable manufacturing, and lessen reliance on imported materials. The initiative underscores the nation's commitment to climate action and its ambition to become a regional leader in environmental innovation.

records.title: Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture recently sponsored the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding with Bulgaria in Sofia, aiming to strength...
records.description: Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture recently sponsored the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding with Bulgaria in Sofia, aiming to strengthen their strategic partnership and develop the agricultural sector in Iraq. This agreement aligns with the Ministry's policy to activate international cooperation, which is expected to open new investment horizons in this vital sector. The memorandum also seeks to enhance the livestock and veterinary sectors, facilitate the exchange of scientific and technological expertise, and foster significant economic partnerships between the two countries.

records.title: Iraqi authorities have initiated an investigation into a significant mass die-off of fish in the southern marshlands near Najaf, marking...
records.description: Iraqi authorities have initiated an investigation into a significant mass die-off of fish in the southern marshlands near Najaf, marking the latest in a series of similar incidents. Potential causes being explored include oxygen depletion in the water, possibly due to low water flow, increased evaporation, and rising temperatures linked to climate change. Additionally, officials and activists suggest the use of chemicals or poisons by fishermen to facilitate catches could be a factor. Images show numerous dead silver fish amidst buffaloes in the Ibn Najm marshlands. A technical inspection team is collecting water samples to determine the exact cause, considering water scarcity, electrical fishing, and the use of poisons. Iraq has faced successive droughts for years, with authorities also blaming dam construction by neighboring countries for reduced river flows. Environmental activists emphasize the need for lab tests to confirm the cause, pointing to agricultural pesticides as another potential culprit, and warning of the public health and food chain dangers posed by such practices.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Animal Resources Department, has released approximately 250,000 carp fingerlings of various type...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Animal Resources Department, has released approximately 250,000 carp fingerlings of various types into the Tigris River in the Rashidiya area, north of Baghdad. This initiative is a component of the Ministry's annual strategy to bolster national fish resources, increase fish production, diversify local income streams, and strengthen the country's food security. The release of these two-knot sized carp fingerlings is being carried out across various regions of the country. Furthermore, the Ministry continues its efforts to breed and propagate native Iraqi fish species (buz, bunni, kattan, and shabat) within the Radwaniyah Fish Reserve, while also supplying other water bodies with fish fingerlings cultivated at the Suwaira Fish Hatchery.

records.title: A collaborative project, "Transformation to more efficient, inclusive, resilient, and sustainable agrifood systems," spearheaded by the F...
records.description: A collaborative project, "Transformation to more efficient, inclusive, resilient, and sustainable agrifood systems," spearheaded by the Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) and funded by the Norwegian government in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture, is making progress in Jordan. This initiative aims to bolster food security, create decent work opportunities, and enhance the overall efficiency and financial returns for vulnerable farmers, including both Jordanian host communities and Syrian refugees. Project activities include providing grants, technical training in agribusiness management, distributing essential tools, facilitating market access and microfinance, and generating direct employment.

records.title: Oman's Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced that it imported over 393,000 heads of livestock, including more...
records.description: Oman's Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources announced that it imported over 393,000 heads of livestock, including more than 25,000 cattle and over 368,000 sheep and goats, from the beginning of April to June this year. The Ministry is actively coordinating with livestock import companies to meet local market demand for live animals and red meat, streamlining import procedures by approving 155 permits during the same period. Additionally, a dedicated veterinary team at the quarantine facility is continuously inspecting all imported shipments and applying necessary health measures to prevent the entry of infectious or epidemic diseases into the Sultanate.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), conducted a worksho...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), conducted a workshop on "Awareness Campaign on Sustainable Agricultural Production and Responsible Consumption." This event, part of FAO's "Promoting Market-Oriented Investments and Innovations for the Development of a Sustainable Agricultural Food System (MAP 2)" project, aimed to finalize the awareness campaign's themes, tools, and implementation methods, ensuring their relevance to the Palestinian context and the needs of both farmers and consumers. Participants included project managers, technical committee heads, agriculture investment directors, experts from the Ministry, and representatives from civil society, agricultural unions, research centers, and women's institutions. Discussions focused on crucial topics such as water resource preservation, safe fertilization, pest control, agricultural waste management, smart agriculture, food security, promoting local products, economic empowerment for youth and women, and encouraging traditional food practices.

records.title: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture recently announced a significant commercial success with a trial harvest of thr...
records.description: The Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture recently announced a significant commercial success with a trial harvest of three newly developed local wheat varieties, achieving an impressive yield of 8,000 kilograms per hectare. This accomplishment, the culmination of roughly three seasons of scientific experimentation across over 45 hectares in the Al-Jouf Region, highlights the Ministry's dedication to growing local wheat strains suited to the Saudi climate. Undertaken in collaboration with Al-Jouf Agricultural Development Company and the Reef National Foundation, using advanced farming techniques, this project is a core part of the Ministry's Seed Center plan.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: A prominent regional asset manager, broker, and investment bank, SICO BSC (c), has signed a Letter of Intent with the Arab Authority for...
records.description: A prominent regional asset manager, broker, and investment bank, SICO BSC (c), has signed a Letter of Intent with the Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID). SICO will serve as AAAID's financial advisor, focusing on identifying and securing direct investment opportunities in the agricultural and food security sectors, particularly in Bahrain and Saudi Arabia within the broader Arab and GCC region. This collaboration aims to facilitate investments through various financing methods and business development, leveraging SICO's expertise in investment sourcing, acquisition advisory, capital-raising, and joint ventures to drive sustainable growth and a secure future in agriculture. The partnership will also involve acquisition advisory services, capital-raising support for AAAID's invested companies, and the exploration of joint venture opportunities, all while emphasizing the promotion of sustainable agricultural practices and enhancing food security resilience across the region.
records.institution: SICO BSC (c), Arab Authority for Agricultural Investment and Development (AAAID)

records.title: As an important religious observance approaches, the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is intensifying its efforts...
records.description: As an important religious observance approaches, the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is intensifying its efforts to educate the public on the critical importance of using licensed abattoirs for livestock slaughter. This campaign aims to prevent uncontrolled slaughter and dealings with unregulated butchers, thereby enhancing biosecurity and public health standards to mitigate the spread of zoonotic diseases (diseases transmissible between animals and humans). ADAFSA emphasizes that licensed abattoirs offer controlled, hygienic environments that minimize contamination risks, with pre- and post-slaughter veterinary inspections to ensure meat safety and detect diseases. Qualified butchers and proper waste management protocols further contribute to public health. The authority also verifies adherence to Islamic slaughtering guidelines to maintain meat quality. Each year, ADAFSA increases its public awareness initiatives before the holiday, encouraging residents to utilize modern abattoirs for safe and hygienic meat processing.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has launched new water resource services via its "Tabsit" e-services portal,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has launched new water resource services via its "Tabsit" e-services portal, aiming to modernize operations, simplify procedures, and enhance service quality and accessibility. The newly available services cover well-drilling, groundwater exploration, water usage rights registration, and various permits for water purification, bottling, sales, and transport. This initiative reflects the ministry's dedication to regulating water-related activities, ensuring adherence to technical and health standards, and improving oversight for consumer protection and water resource management. The ministry, through the General Authority for Water Resources, has urged all professionals in these areas to register on the portal to regularize their status and obtain necessary licenses, with technical support available for assistance. The move underscores the ministry's commitment to digital transformation and continuous improvement of its operational environment.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Animal Wealth has initiated the activation of the Quality Control Branch for Feed in Anbar Go...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Department of Animal Wealth has initiated the activation of the Quality Control Branch for Feed in Anbar Governorate. This branch will be responsible for inspecting feed materials, particularly shipments arriving from the western region's border crossings. This move, which involved providing main supplies following a visit from a specialized committee, is part of the Ministry's broader strategy to enhance oversight of feed material quality and streamline operational processes.

records.title: To enhance water management, Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture recently held a specialized workshop on advanced pump technologies, collabora...
records.description: To enhance water management, Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture recently held a specialized workshop on advanced pump technologies, collaborating with the Turkish company Standard Pumpa. The event introduced modern pumping systems and their agricultural applications through a technical presentation by company representatives. The workshop's primary goals were to highlight the impact of advanced technologies on water management, address water scarcity challenges, and improve water consumption efficiency in agriculture, with officials emphasizing the importance of educating farmers on these methods.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its Marjeyoun Center, recently organized a training seminar titled "Beginning Beekeeper" as par...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, specifically its Marjeyoun Center, recently organized a training seminar titled "Beginning Beekeeper" as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. Held in Marjeyoun, the seminar provided 18 trainees, including 14 women, with essential beekeeping knowledge. Topics covered included apiary site selection, bee disease prevention and control, proper bee nutrition, and the importance of periodic hive inspections. The high participation of women and the lively interaction among attendees highlighted a growing interest in developing agricultural skills within rural communities. This seminar is part of the Ministry's broader initiative to disseminate modern agricultural knowledge, encourage sustainable local production, and create new opportunities for youth and women in the agricultural sector across Lebanon.

records.title: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture recently announced the remarkable commercial success of a trial harvest fo...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture recently announced the remarkable commercial success of a trial harvest for three new local wheat varieties, yielding an impressive 8,000 kilograms per hectare. This achievement, building on several seasons of scientific experimentation across over 45 hectares in the Al-Jouf Region, underscores the Ministry's commitment to cultivating wheat varieties adapted to the Saudi environment. This initiative, a collaborative effort with the Al-Jouf Agricultural Development Company and the Reef National Foundation utilizing advanced techniques, is a key component of the Ministry's Seed Center plan. It aims to strengthen domestic wheat strains, boost local production efficiency, and contribute significantly to the nation's food security and agricultural sustainability goals, aligning directly with Saudi Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD) has launched a specialized training course on "Feed Warehouse Managem...
records.description: The Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD) has launched a specialized training course on "Feed Warehouse Management," attended by 18 trainees from the General Feed Corporation and overseen by the Minister of Agriculture. The course aims to enhance the efficiency of workers in managing feed storage, movement, shipping, inventory, and warehouse organization. The Minister of Agriculture underscored the importance of this training for human resource development and for ensuring optimal storage and distribution of feed, especially given current drought conditions and increased demand. He also commended ACSAD's logistical and scientific support. The Director General of ACSAD noted that this course is part of broader training initiatives designed to develop national cadres, improve technical capabilities, and transfer specialized expertise to contribute to agricultural resource development and sustainable production increases.
records.institution: Arab Center for the Studies of Arid Zones and Dry Lands (ACSAD)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform in Syria held a meeting with government agencies and agricultural officials to develop an...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform in Syria held a meeting with government agencies and agricultural officials to develop an emergency strategic plan for managing drought and reducing water waste. The discussions focused on preparing a comprehensive study with urgent and sustainable measures, including enacting legislation to regulate water use, activating early warning systems, adopting drought-resistant crop varieties, and promoting modern agricultural technologies. The plan also emphasizes recycling water, raising farmer awareness about efficient water use, controlling groundwater depletion, and enhancing agricultural guidance programs to ensure the long-term sustainability of the country’s water resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) and the Emirates Growth Fund (EGF) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to f...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) and the Emirates Growth Fund (EGF) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding to foster the growth of UAE-based companies focused on food, agriculture, and environmental resilience. This partnership, announced at a recent exhibition, aims to support small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in areas crucial for national self-sufficiency and sustainability, including food and water security, agricultural innovation, local production, environmental technologies, and climate-aligned business models. Both entities share a vision of empowering the private sector to drive lasting positive impact, aligning with the UAE's long-term climate and food security goals. The collaboration will facilitate knowledge exchange, promote eligible companies, and showcase success stories. EGF, established with a significant capital, invests in growth-stage companies in strategically important sectors for the nation, providing both funding and long-term strategic partnership to help businesses scale and contribute to national resilience.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) recently launched the first National Agricultural Guidance Forum to drive sustain...
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) recently launched the first National Agricultural Guidance Forum to drive sustainable agricultural transformation and knowledge sharing, empowering farmers with climate-smart innovations. Held alongside a major agricultural conference and exhibition, the forum featured discussions on farmer empowerment, the role of women in agricultural guidance, practical advice, and the contribution of international organizations. Officials emphasized the forum's alignment with national food security and sustainable development goals, highlighting agricultural guidance as crucial for optimizing resource use and improving production quality. Collaboration between federal and local entities, including the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority, was underscored as vital for sector progress.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: In Taiz Governorate, a project was launched to distribute 155 cows and concentrated feed to productive families in the Maqbanah District.
records.description: In Taiz Governorate, a project was launched to distribute 155 cows and concentrated feed to productive families in the Maqbanah District. This initiative, costing 80 million riyals, is part of an economic empowerment project utilizing white loans. It is a collaborative effort involving the local authority, the Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit, a development foundation, the governorate's agriculture sector, the local authority in the district, and the Agricultural Cooperative Union.

records.title: The United Nations reports that the humanitarian situation in Gaza is catastrophic, the worst in 19 months, despite limited aid deliveries.
records.description: The United Nations reports that the humanitarian situation in Gaza is catastrophic, the worst in 19 months, despite limited aid deliveries. Although Israel lifted a blockade and a new U.S.- and Israel-backed "Gaza Humanitarian Foundation" (GHF) was launched, the UN and other aid groups largely refuse to collaborate with GHF due to neutrality concerns. The UN has struggled to transport aid, citing insecurity and Israeli restrictions, and has reported looting. The UN criticizes Israel for limiting permitted aid to mostly flour and denying access, while Israel maintains it facilitates all deliveries. A U.S. ceasefire proposal currently under review includes provisions for humanitarian aid delivery.

records.title: Tunisia's Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has introduced a new program offering advantageous credits and simplifie...
records.description: Tunisia's Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has introduced a new program offering advantageous credits and simplified measures to fodder farmers and livestock breeders. These loans, provided by the Tunisian Solidarity Bank (BTS) and the National Agricultural Bank, aim to finance the collection and storage of roughage, such as hay bales, to ensure sufficient feed for livestock in the coming periods and stabilize the market. The initiative provides seasonal loans with flexible terms, some without guarantees and others with extended repayment periods, benefiting various agricultural entities including individual farmers, cooperatives, citizen companies, and agricultural development groups.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: BASF Agriculture Solutions Egypt has officially launched its Nunhems vegetable seeds brand in Egypt, marking a significant expansion to p...
records.description: BASF Agriculture Solutions Egypt has officially launched its Nunhems vegetable seeds brand in Egypt, marking a significant expansion to provide Egyptian farmers with high-performance, innovation-led seed varieties. These seeds, developed through over a century of breeding expertise and global R&D, aim to boost yield, enhance quality, and support sustainable agricultural practices. This initiative is set to create local jobs and contribute to Egypt's goal of increasing agricultural exports by 20% in 2025, aligning with the country's focus on modernizing agriculture and promoting food security by bringing advanced seed technology closer to farmers through a localized distribution network.

records.title: Iraq continues to heavily rely on U.S.
records.description: Iraq continues to heavily rely on U.S. rice imports, with sales to the U.S. reaching 220,000 tonnes for 2025. Rice constitutes a significant portion of the regular food allotments provided by the Iraqi government to its citizens, and Iraq imports nearly 90% of its rice needs. Despite occasional financial delays, the U.S. rice industry values Iraq as a consistent partner. However, the article criticizes Iraq's persistent dependence on food imports, attributing it to decades of corruption, resource mismanagement, and inefficient budget allocation by successive Iraqi administrations that have favored short-term solutions over investment in domestic agricultural production.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the UN (FAO) has signed a $33 million agreement to design and supervise treated wastewater stora...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization of the UN (FAO) has signed a $33 million agreement to design and supervise treated wastewater storage ponds in southern Jordan. This initiative is part of the "Building Resilience to Climate Change in Jordan through Improving Water Use Efficiency in the Agriculture Sector" (BRCCJ) project. Funded by the Green Climate Fund (GCF) and implemented by FAO in collaboration with Jordanian ministries and UNDP, the project aims to expand and regulate the use of treated wastewater from three treatment plants for irrigation, thereby enhancing climate resilience and water security in the agricultural sector. This effort supports Jordan's national water strategies and green growth plans, providing additional water to farmers during peak demand periods.
records.institution: Ministries of Water and Irrigation, Agriculture, Environment

records.title: The Ministries of Finance, State Lands and Land Affairs, and Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia have announced a new m...
records.description: The Ministries of Finance, State Lands and Land Affairs, and Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia have announced a new measure allowing the staggering of debt owed by operators of state property. Operators can submit a written request to the relevant Receiver of Finance, in coordination with the regional services of the Department of State Lands and Land Affairs, to arrange flexible repayment terms, provided the monthly payment meets a minimum threshold. This initiative, designed to facilitate payment and offer flexibility rather than debt regularization, aims to bolster the economic role of state land, support public projects, and safeguard the sustainability of economic enterprises and employment.

records.title: BASF Agriculture Solutions Egypt has officially launched its specialized vegetable seeds brand, BASF | Nunhems, in Egypt.
records.description: BASF Agriculture Solutions Egypt has officially launched its specialized vegetable seeds brand, BASF | Nunhems, in Egypt. This expansion aims to support Egyptian farmers with high-performance vegetable seed varieties that boost yield, enhance quality, and promote sustainability, leveraging over 100 years of breeding expertise. The new business model is expected to create local jobs and contribute to Egypt's goal of increasing agricultural exports by 20% in 2025. This initiative aligns with Egypt’s Sustainable Agricultural Development Strategy, which focuses on modernizing agriculture and promoting food security, by bringing innovative, tailored solutions closer to farmers through a robust local distribution network.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Morocco is a key beneficiary of the €363 million Mirova Sustainable Land Fund 2 (MSLF2), an impact investment initiative focused on susta...
records.description: Morocco is a key beneficiary of the €363 million Mirova Sustainable Land Fund 2 (MSLF2), an impact investment initiative focused on sustainable agricultural and forestry management across seven countries. Launched by Mirova with Green Climate Fund support, MSLF2 addresses urgent agro-environmental challenges like soil erosion, water scarcity, and climate disruption. Morocco's selection reflects its commitment to sustainability, evidenced by its National Sustainable Development Strategy and Green Generation 2020-2030 agricultural roadmap. The funding will specifically target agroforestry projects, organic agriculture, and regenerative soil management, aiming for resilient agricultural practices, greenhouse gas reduction, and sustainable job creation. This positions Morocco as a leader in results-based climate financing in Africa.

records.title: The Tunisian Agriculture Minister, Ezzedine Ben Cheikh, announced that Tunisia expects its grain harvest to reach 1.8 million metric tons...
records.description: The Tunisian Agriculture Minister, Ezzedine Ben Cheikh, announced that Tunisia expects its grain harvest to reach 1.8 million metric tons this season. This represents a more than 64 percent increase from last year and marks the country's strongest season in five years, primarily due to improved rainfall after consecutive droughts. The anticipated boost in domestic production is expected to help Tunisia reduce its grain imports, offering some relief amidst its deep financial crisis and the impact of high global wheat prices.

records.title: BASF Agriculture Solutions Egypt has officially launched its BASF | Nunhems vegetable seeds brand in Egypt, aiming to provide high-perfor...
records.description: BASF Agriculture Solutions Egypt has officially launched its BASF | Nunhems vegetable seeds brand in Egypt, aiming to provide high-performance varieties that enhance yield, quality, and sustainability for Egyptian farmers. This initiative, part of BASF's regional expansion, is expected to generate local jobs and support Egypt's goal of increasing agricultural exports by 20% in 2025. The company emphasizes its alignment with Egypt’s Sustainable Agricultural Development Strategy, focusing on modernizing agriculture and strengthening food security through innovative and locally tailored solutions delivered via a new distribution model.

records.title: Facing its most severe water crisis in 80 years, Iraq has launched a regional initiative, "Our Water...
records.description: Facing its most severe water crisis in 80 years, Iraq has launched a regional initiative, "Our Water... Our Future," at the Fifth Baghdad International Water Conference. Led by Prime Minister Mohammed Shia' al-Sudani, this plan aims to foster cooperation among riparian states and leverage innovation to manage water resources, combat climate change impacts, and address upstream restrictions from Turkey and Iran. Iraq's strategic water reserves are at historic lows, impacting the agricultural sector significantly, leading to reduced cultivated areas. Domestically, Iraq is implementing a national Master Plan for water and wastewater, along with new desalination units and smart water management projects. However, experts express skepticism about the government's international efforts and highlight the need for more robust action to prevent future water conflicts and internal instability.

records.title: The Bulgarian government has approved a draft Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture.
records.description: The Bulgarian government has approved a draft Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Iraq's Ministry of Agriculture. This agreement aims to foster cooperation in the agriculture and food sector, including veterinary products, animal disease control, fisheries, and combating desertification. The collaboration will involve joint events, seminars, training courses, exchange of information and expertise, and the introduction of new technologies in crop, livestock, fisheries, and aquaculture, as well as technical and administrative capacity building.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Moroccan fertilizer giant OCP Group has secured a €365 million agreement with Italy’s export credit agency SACE, marking the first transa...
records.description: Moroccan fertilizer giant OCP Group has secured a €365 million agreement with Italy’s export credit agency SACE, marking the first transaction under OCP’s Green Finance Framework and the first SACE Push Strategy guarantee in Morocco. This funding will significantly support OCP’s US$13 billion Green Investment Program through 2027, aiming for 100% non-conventional water use and 100% clean energy by 2027, including substantial desalination capacity. This partnership not only reinforces OCP’s leadership in sustainable plant nutrition but also strengthens industrial cooperation between Morocco and Italy, aligning with Italy’s Mattei Plan to boost ties with African countries.

records.title: The wilaya of Boumerdes has been granted a fishing permit for 54 tonnes of bluefin tuna for the 2025 fishing season.
records.description: The wilaya of Boumerdes has been granted a fishing permit for 54 tonnes of bluefin tuna for the 2025 fishing season. This allocation is part of Algeria's national quota of 2047 tonnes for the current year. Boumerdes is participating in this campaign for the fourth consecutive year, contributing one of 39 vessels nationally, a 35-meter-long vessel built locally. The national tuna fishing campaign began recently and will continue until early July. The wilaya also boasts nine private workshops specializing in naval construction and maintenance, including one dedicated to tuna fishing vessels, which have already produced three tuna boats with three more currently under construction.
records.institution: The local fisheries and aquaculture directorate

records.title: Tunisia's Ministry of Agriculture is significantly strengthening its efforts to protect forests and agricultural crops from fires.
records.description: Tunisia's Ministry of Agriculture is significantly strengthening its efforts to protect forests and agricultural crops from fires. This initiative includes establishing forward seasonal centers in vulnerable areas and implementing an enhanced operational plan for the General Directorate of Forests. The Ministry has focused on maintaining and developing essential infrastructure in forest regions, such as improving trails, rehabilitating watchtowers, creating water points, and strategically distributing equipment. Proactive measures also involve organizing awareness-raising days with civil society to instill a culture of prevention and shared responsibility among citizens, alongside conducting field visits. Progress has been made in developing the National Forest Protection Centre in Rades for better coordination, and a new Vigilance Center for Information and Early Detection is being set up to improve intervention efficiency.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: Algeria officially launched its 2025 bluefin tuna fishing campaign from the port of Algiers, with the national fleet strengthened by the...
records.description: Algeria officially launched its 2025 bluefin tuna fishing campaign from the port of Algiers, with the national fleet strengthened by the addition of two new, locally made tuna boats. These vessels, the largest of their kind nationally at 42 meters long with over 75% local integration, bring the total participating fleet to 39 ships. One vessel, named "Zmalet El Emir Abdelkader," built by "CMR NAVAL," boasts a 420-ton capacity and a 25-person crew, while the second, "Chahid Abane Ramdane," from "ADAM Construction Bateaux," has a 430-ton capacity. These new additions will contribute to Algeria's bluefin tuna quota, which exceeds 2000 tons for this campaign.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: Edita Food Industries reported a 9.1% year-on-year revenue increase in Q1 2025, reaching EGP 4.3 billion, with net profit rising to EGP 3...
records.description: Edita Food Industries reported a 9.1% year-on-year revenue increase in Q1 2025, reaching EGP 4.3 billion, with net profit rising to EGP 381 million. Gross margins improved to 31.6% following the March 2024 devaluation. The cake segment led with 53.7% of total revenue, while biscuits saw a 224.8% revenue surge. Export sales rose 19.5%, and Edita Morocco’s revenue jumped 57.9%. The company also expanded distribution networks, boosted e-commerce sales by 68%, and continued regional growth across emerging markets.

records.title: The 97th Conference of Liaison Officers of the Regional Offices for the Arab Boycott of Israel, held at the League of Arab States headqua...
records.description: The 97th Conference of Liaison Officers of the Regional Offices for the Arab Boycott of Israel, held at the League of Arab States headquarters, announced a ban on 20 companies for violating Arab boycott rules, citing investments in illegal settlements and support for the Israeli economy and military. The conference also recommended issuing notifications to other companies suspected of similar breaches and called on all companies to withdraw investments and cease cooperation with the Israeli settler-colonial regime. Participants emphasized strengthening boycott bodies and enhancing coordination between the Arab League and the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation (OIC) to align and enforce boycott mechanisms.

records.title: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has completed its fifth review of Egypt's $8 billion financial support program, noting the country'...
records.description: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) has completed its fifth review of Egypt's $8 billion financial support program, noting the country's significant progress towards macroeconomic stability. The IMF has upgraded Egypt's growth forecast for the current fiscal year to 3.8% and acknowledged efforts to modernize tax and customs procedures and enhance oversight of public infrastructure projects. However, the IMF emphasized the ongoing need for domestic revenue mobilization, particularly through widening the tax base and streamlining tax exemptions.

records.title: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture announced significant growth in the country's agricultural sector, with its added value reaching JD...
records.description: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture announced significant growth in the country's agricultural sector, with its added value reaching JD1.691 billion (US$2.38 billion) and exports increasing by 441% to JD1.5 billion (US$2.12 billion), now reaching 112 countries. This expansion is attributed to a 91% rise in vegetable production and a 141% increase in fruit yields, alongside a 38% growth in agricultural employment. The ministry is actively supporting high-value crops and modern farming technologies, including solar energy systems, through the Agricultural Credit Corporation. To further boost agro-industrial development, initiatives include promoting the Agricultural Industries Complex in the southern Jordan Valley (with new factories for tomato paste and frozen vegetables), encouraging private sector investment in industrial estates by covering hangar rental costs, and providing soft loans via the Agricultural Production, Marketing and Manufacturing Accelerator Project. Additionally, small-scale agricultural enterprises are supported through alliance projects.

records.title: SEDCO Holding and Bugshan Investment have completed the sale of Arabian Farms, a leading GCC poultry and egg producer, to the newly forme...
records.description: SEDCO Holding and Bugshan Investment have completed the sale of Arabian Farms, a leading GCC poultry and egg producer, to the newly formed Al Ain Farms Group in the UAE. This strategic consolidation brings together five UAE protein producers, aiming to significantly increase market share in the dairy and poultry sectors. For SEDCO Holding and Bugshan Investment, the sale represents a rebalancing of portfolios and an alignment with national visions such as Saudi Vision 2030. This transaction is seen as supporting the UAE’s National Food Security Strategy 2051, fostering an integrated and self-reliant regional food ecosystem.

records.title: To alleviate the burden of living by providing more subsidized bread, the Syrian Ministry of Economy and Industry has signed a cooperatio...
records.description: To alleviate the burden of living by providing more subsidized bread, the Syrian Ministry of Economy and Industry has signed a cooperation agreement with the World Food Programme (WFP). This partnership will supply 64 bakeries with flour, initially focusing on the governorates of Daraa, Latakia, Tartous, Aleppo, Hama, and Homs, with plans for expansion to other governorates in subsequent phases. This initiative aims to improve living conditions and strengthen collaborations with international organizations. Approximately two million citizens are expected to benefit from the provision of 40,000 tons of flour by the end of next year.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is participating in the Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition 2025,...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is participating in the Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition 2025, an event organized by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment under the national "Plant the Emirates" program. This conference serves as a platform to exchange knowledge, showcase innovations, and explore technologies in sustainable agriculture, aiming to foster public-private partnerships, accelerate agricultural investment, support local producers, and empower youth to enhance national food security and environmental sustainability. ADAFSA will highlight its initiatives in supporting farmers and promoting modern, sustainable agricultural practices, including advanced vertical farming systems and irrigation techniques, and will feature local farm products.
records.institution: Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.title: The ADNEC Centre Al Ain is preparing to host the Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition 2025, an event held under the patronage o...
records.description: The ADNEC Centre Al Ain is preparing to host the Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition 2025, an event held under the patronage of His Highness Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan. This national platform aims to advance the UAE’s agricultural sector, promote sustainable practices, and strengthen the country’s long-term food security strategy, aligning with its national vision. The conference will gather decision-makers, experts, investors, and industry leaders to accelerate agricultural development and enhance sustainable farming methods, while ADNEC Group reinforces its role in supporting economic diversification, food resilience, and knowledge exchange in sustainable agriculture.

records.title: Jordan's agricultural sector has achieved significant growth since independence, with a 9% increase in added value to JD1.691 billion.
records.description: Jordan's agricultural sector has achieved significant growth since independence, with a 9% increase in added value to JD1.691 billion. Vegetable production rose by 91%, fruit trees by 141%, and livestock by 54%, increasing the total number of animals to 3.8 million. Agricultural exports have grown by 441% to JD1.5 billion, reaching 112 countries. Employment in the sector increased by 38% to 261,000 workers. The Agricultural Credit Corporation's capital grew by 213% to JD100 million, providing JD55 million in annual loans to 11,000 farmers, guiding them towards high-value crops and modern technologies.
