records.title: Launch of the Implementation Plan for the "Enhancing Food and Nutrition Security in Lebanon" Project, Funded by Canada and Implemented by the FAO in Cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture
records.description: A steering committee meeting marked the launch of the "Enhancing Food and Nutrition Security in Lebanon" project, a five-year initiative funded by the Government of Canada and implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) in close cooperation with the Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture. The project aims to strengthen agricultural value chains in Lebanon, focusing on sectors like apples, vegetables, and carob, by enhancing the skills of farmers and promoting climate-smart, nutrition-sensitive, and gender-sensitive agricultural practices. It also seeks to support SMEs, develop skills, transfer technology, improve the enabling environment, and strengthen cooperation within the agricultural sector to build resilience against climate and economic challenges. The project's work plan and implementation for the initial years were approved, emphasizing the need for ongoing coordination among all stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and achieve the desired improvements in food and nutrition security for rural communities in Lebanon.

records.title: Morocco has reinforced its standing as a major global tomato exporter, achieving record-high exports to Norway with 5,000 tonnes shipped...
records.description: Morocco has reinforced its standing as a major global tomato exporter, achieving record-high exports to Norway with 5,000 tonnes shipped between July 2024 and March 2025, marking a substantial increase compared to previous periods. This performance highlights the Kingdom's growing strategic importance in Scandinavian markets, particularly during winter. Morocco has consistently been among the top three global tomato exporters since 2021, driven by the quality of its production, competitive pricing, and effective export strategies. While France, the United Kingdom, and the Netherlands remain key markets, Norway's significance is increasing, with Morocco's market share growing considerably. This growth trajectory positions Morocco to potentially become Norway's second-largest supplier, after Spain. Beyond tomatoes, Morocco is also diversifying its exports to Norway with products like frozen mandarins, blueberries, and raspberries, demonstrating its adaptability to international market demands and its reliability as a high-quality agricultural supplier. This expansion illustrates the success of Morocco's export-focused agricultural strategy and its ongoing efforts to penetrate new markets.

records.title: The Moroccan government is renewing an export bonus for citrus fruits to support its exporters facing international competition and logis...
records.description: The Moroccan government is renewing an export bonus for citrus fruits to support its exporters facing international competition and logistical challenges, particularly from Egypt. This measure is implemented as Moroccan citrus exports are experiencing significant growth, with a projected 31% increase to 597,000 tonnes for the 2024/2025 campaign, alongside a substantial rise in domestic production to 2.1 million tonnes due to favorable conditions and advanced irrigation. Mandarins constitute the majority of exports at 83%, followed by oranges and lemons. This governmental initiative aims to enhance the competitiveness of Moroccan citrus in international markets, notably Europe and West Africa, where new trade routes are being established.
records.institution: The Moroccan Government, The Moroccan Interprofessional Federation of Citrus Fruits Maroc Citrus

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Directorate in Tulkarm Governorate, in partnership with the Palestinian Center for Economic and...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Directorate in Tulkarm Governorate, in partnership with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development, provided 15,000 high-quality cartons to farmers participating in the "Building Community Resilience and Improving Livelihoods and Food Security through Good Agricultural Practices (PAL GAP)" project in the towns of Baqa al-Sharqiya and Kafr Jamal. This initiative aims to enhance the quality of Palestinian products and empower farmers by adopting sustainable agricultural practices, implemented with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development, under the Ministry's supervision, with funding from the French Agency for Relief and Islamic Aid, and in cooperation with the Palestinian Standards Institution and An-Najah National University. The beneficiary farmers were selected for their commitment to sound agricultural standards and having obtained the "PAL GAP" certificate. The Ministry of Agriculture emphasized that this project supports its strategy to aid farmers and increase productivity while maintaining environmental and food safety standards, boosting the competitiveness of Palestinian products. The active role of partners in achieving the project's objectives, which contribute to strengthening the resilience of Palestinian farmers and ensuring the sustainability of the agricultural sector, was also commended.

records.title: Peru's Minister of Foreign Affairs reaffirmed the country's interest in boosting agricultural and food exports to Saudi Arabia, highlight...
records.description: Peru's Minister of Foreign Affairs reaffirmed the country's interest in boosting agricultural and food exports to Saudi Arabia, highlighting investment incentives available in Peru during a meeting with a representative from the Federation of Saudi Chambers, attended by other officials and business representatives from both nations. The Peruvian minister pointed out the variety of Peruvian agricultural products and the current trade volume, inviting Saudi investors to an upcoming agricultural exhibition in September. The Saudi representative outlined Saudi Arabia's economic progress and its efforts to strengthen economic partnerships, including with Peru, emphasizing the Kingdom's investment advantages. Both sides stressed the importance of enhancing bilateral cooperation through agreements, a joint business council, increased trade missions, economic forums, and exploring investment opportunities in sectors like tourism, trade, and agriculture.

records.title: The Djillali Liabes University of Sidi Bel Abbes recently hosted an Italian delegation, leading to an agreement in principle for the esta...
records.description: The Djillali Liabes University of Sidi Bel Abbes recently hosted an Italian delegation, leading to an agreement in principle for the establishment of an Algerian-Italian training center focused on agriculture. The Italian delegation included representatives from the Italian Agency for Cooperation and Development and the Italian Ministries of Foreign Affairs, Agriculture, and the Environment. They were accompanied by representatives from the Algerian Ministries of Agriculture and Higher Education and Scientific Research. The visit, aimed at strengthening Algerian-Italian bilateral cooperation in higher education and scientific research, focused on the University's Institute of Agricultural Sciences. Discussions between the institute's director, university officials, teachers, and the Italian delegation explored ways to expand scientific and educational cooperation, culminating in the agreement in principle to create the agricultural training and research center within the Institute of Agricultural Sciences in Sidi Bel Abbès.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: DP World Sokhna achieved its highest quarterly volume in nearly two decades, handling a record 285,000 TEUs in the first quarter of 2025,...
records.description: DP World Sokhna achieved its highest quarterly volume in nearly two decades, handling a record 285,000 TEUs in the first quarter of 2025, a 26% increase over planned figures. This growth underscores the port's increasing strategic importance for regional trade and Egypt's economic development, significantly boosted by refrigerated container exports as Egypt strengthens its position as a leading citrus exporter. Since 2008, DP World has invested over $1.3 billion in modernizing the port, enhancing its capacity for large vessels and improving global trade route connectivity through digital infrastructure. This enhanced capability in handling refrigerated cargo supports Egypt's perishable goods trade with advanced cold chain facilities. As DP World continues to expand its presence in Egypt, Sokhna Port remains a key integrated supply chain hub for local businesses engaging in international trade.

records.title: The Iraqi Higher Committee for Construction and Investment convened, emphasizing the need to streamline administrative processes to enhan...
records.description: The Iraqi Higher Committee for Construction and Investment convened, emphasizing the need to streamline administrative processes to enhance the investment climate and instructing ministries to prioritize projects that maximize state revenues, in accordance with the government's reform strategy. The committee approved several residential developments and endorsed the establishment of a significant olive farm in Wasit Governorate by an Iraqi-Spanish investment venture.
records.institution: Higher Committee for Construction and Investment

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture held a committee meeting to maintain stable prices for live and slaughtered chicken and local table eggs, rev...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture held a committee meeting to maintain stable prices for live and slaughtered chicken and local table eggs, reviewing market prices against production costs to ensure stability and monitor the market. The committee developed recommendations to ensure the availability of high-quality, competitively priced products that are affordable for consumers. The Ministry highlighted its role in supporting and monitoring strategic local projects to strengthen the national economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the Investment and Entrepreneurship Exhibition for Modern Technology Projects at the College...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture participated in the Investment and Entrepreneurship Exhibition for Modern Technology Projects at the College of Engineering at Al-Mustansiriya University, represented by its Agricultural Business Incubators Department and the Agricultural Investments Department. The exhibition showcased proposed technology projects in various fields and included active participation from business incubators of several ministries and government institutions. The event fostered interaction among participants, facilitating the exchange of ideas and future visions on supporting entrepreneurial projects and empowering youth in modern technology sectors. Participants were also honored for their contributions to the success of this scientific event.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, via its Horticulture Department's Qaim Horticulture Station, gifted 7,000 olive seedlings to the Anbar Educa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, via its Horticulture Department's Qaim Horticulture Station, gifted 7,000 olive seedlings to the Anbar Education Directorate as part of ongoing governmental collaboration. These seedlings were produced under the National Program for the Propagation of Various Fruit and Olive Varieties, supporting the department's continuous efforts to enhance agricultural production and expand green spaces. Moreover, the Horticulture Department's stations continue to sell diverse fruit and olive seedlings to the public at reduced prices to promote increased vegetation cover in Iraq.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the FAO and the Lebanese Agricultural Research Institute, organized a training course...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the FAO and the Lebanese Agricultural Research Institute, organized a training course on good agricultural practices for chickpea cultivation as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. This "Training of Trainers" course aimed to enhance the knowledge of the Ministry's engineers and technicians from various regional departments regarding optimal chickpea cultivation methods. Experts from the Lebanese Agricultural Research Institute, in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), implemented the course, which falls under the efforts of the Ministry and its partners to develop the agricultural extension system and build the capacity of technical personnel. The course also addressed developing the seed multiplication sector, crucial for food security in Lebanon, by focusing on improving informal cereal seed production to provide quality seeds and better access to inputs for small farmers in mountainous areas.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Directorate in Tulkarm Governorate and in cooperation with relevant departments, conducted a fie...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Directorate in Tulkarm Governorate and in cooperation with relevant departments, conducted a field visit to agricultural lands planted with new seed varieties to monitor developments and promote modern practices for increased productivity and improved quality. The visit focused on new vegetable varieties in greenhouses and open fields to evaluate their performance under local conditions. This initiative is part of the Ministry's plan to officially register these varieties after ensuring their quality and suitability for the local environment, including disease resistance and productivity. The importance of cooperation between farmers and technical bodies was highlighted to ensure the success of these trials and the adoption of modern agricultural technologies, aligning with the Ministry's strategy to improve the agricultural sector, increase crop diversity, and enhance food security through best scientific and technical practices.

records.title: Gulf Warehousing Company (GWC) has partnered with Yellow Door Energy to launch a significant private solar energy project across its logi...
records.description: Gulf Warehousing Company (GWC) has partnered with Yellow Door Energy to launch a significant private solar energy project across its logistics hubs in Qatar: Logistics Village Qatar, Bu Sulba Warehousing Park, and Al Wukair Logistics Park. This initiative aims to enhance GWC's sustainability efforts, reducing its carbon footprint and contributing to a greener future, aligning with Qatar National Vision 2030's renewable energy goals. As a UN Global Compact member, GWC is committed to reducing emissions and waste. Yellow Door Energy will develop these solar power plants to lower GWC's energy costs and support Qatar’s Net Zero by 2050 target. GWC has been recognized for its environmental stewardship, including awards for its green initiatives. This solar project follows other sustainability efforts by GWC, such as a food waste recycling program.

records.title: The Ambassador of Kuwait to Sudan announced a new two million dollar grant from the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development and the Uni...
records.description: The Ambassador of Kuwait to Sudan announced a new two million dollar grant from the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development and the United Nations Development Programme to enhance drinking water access for displaced people, refugees, and host communities in Sudan. This aid reflects Kuwait's solidarity with Sudan, demonstrated by significant relief efforts since the conflict began, including numerous air and sea shipments and substantial financial contributions from Kuwaiti organizations. The Ambassador expressed appreciation for the cooperation of Sudanese institutions and hoped the assistance would help those affected and support Sudan's recovery. He emphasized the long-standing and crucial role of the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development in Sudan's development across various sectors through loans and grants, also managing additional grants from the Kuwaiti government. The drinking water grant agreement was signed during the 2025 Spring Meetings of the World Bank Group and the International Monetary Fund.

records.title: Summer camp students in Al Mahwit City engaged in agricultural and traffic awareness activities, including field visits and educational l...
records.description: Summer camp students in Al Mahwit City engaged in agricultural and traffic awareness activities, including field visits and educational lectures, to enhance their understanding of the significance of agriculture and responsible traffic behavior. These activities aimed to cultivate national values and a sense of connection to the land, forming part of a summer program that emphasizes agriculture to achieve self-sufficiency.

records.title: The Municipal Council approved amendments to building regulations for agricultural and livestock areas, defining these areas as state pro...
records.description: The Municipal Council approved amendments to building regulations for agricultural and livestock areas, defining these areas as state property for production by the Public Authority for Agriculture Affairs and Fish Resources (PAAAFR), the Public Authority for Sports (PAS), and the Public Authority for Manpower (PAM). These areas will be used for diverse agricultural and livestock activities, including cultivation, raising animals, beekeeping, and the breeding/training of racehorses and camels by relevant clubs, specifically including plots in Abdali and Wafra. The amendments allow a building ratio of up to 10 percent of the plot area, with a 10,000 square meter maximum, in agricultural zones within Wafra, Abdali, and Sulaibiya. Furthermore, the council approved allocating a reservoir and pathway, adding a transformer, canceling previous reservoirs in South Sabahiya, and allocating overhead lines for the main transformer station in Wafra.

records.title: Acting in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and...
records.description: Acting in cooperation with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has conducted field trials to assess the effectiveness of drones in combating desert locusts. This initiative is part of the Ministry's efforts to advance modern aerial spraying techniques for controlling locusts and other agricultural pests. The trials aim to evaluate aerial spraying methods, including the use of drones, for potential standardization in member states of Desert Locust Control Commissions. The event involved the participation of FAO experts and representatives from local and international companies specializing in the development of drone-based aerial spraying technologies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the European Union, received the first phase of the Samou Station project for breed impr...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the European Union, received the first phase of the Samou Station project for breed improvement, funded by the EU to support sustainable livestock development. This initial handover included key infrastructure like the bio-laboratory and training hall, following a review by a technical committee. The project aims to advance the Ministry's strategy to develop the livestock sector and increase sheep productivity in the southern West Bank, with EU support as part of broader aid for Palestinian economic and social stability. The European Union's support in agriculture and infrastructure underscores its commitment to empowering Palestinians in marginalized areas.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Tulkarm Agriculture Directorate, organized a field tour of various agricultural sites to support...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Tulkarm Agriculture Directorate, organized a field tour of various agricultural sites to support the sector and improve productivity. The tour, led by the Guidance and Technical Departments, provided farmers with technical advice on best practices to enhance production quality, efficiency, and disease/pest prevention. The ministry highlighted this visit as part of its ongoing strategy to directly support farmers, increase productivity, and ensure better economic returns from agricultural projects, thus improving food security. The ministry also praised the cooperation between farmers and technical staff and affirmed its commitment to continuing advisory initiatives for sustainable agriculture and modern technology adoption.

records.title: Jazan Region is a significant agricultural hub in the Kingdom due to its fertile land and consistent water supply, enabling sustainable f...
records.description: Jazan Region is a significant agricultural hub in the Kingdom due to its fertile land and consistent water supply, enabling sustainable farming that enhances food security and the local economy. The region's high productivity in tropical fruit cultivation, yielding approximately 53,211 tons annually, offers further development opportunities, boosted by Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture initiatives modernizing farming and introducing new varieties. This has solidified Jazan's leading role in tropical fruit production, supported by state aid to farmers. With increasing agricultural awareness, over 19,110 farmers cultivate various fruits, including mangoes, figs, guavas, papayas, bananas, and custard apples. Jazan annually celebrates its tropical fruit harvest with a festival that promotes its agricultural products nationally and internationally, reinforcing its status as a key agricultural producer contributing to national food security and economic strength, aligning with the Kingdom's agricultural vision.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The seventh release of predatory ladybugs was carried out as part of ongoing biological control efforts against the mealybug and to conse...
records.description: The seventh release of predatory ladybugs was carried out as part of ongoing biological control efforts against the mealybug and to conserve local cactus varieties, a joint initiative by the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries. 1 This release aims to establish a protective zone around the Bouargoub area as part of an emergency project to manage the cactus mealybug in Tunisia. The FAO noted that the ladybugs have been bred at the Citrus Technical Center (CTA) through a partnership for their propagation and release. An initial batch from Morocco was previously provided by the Directorate of Plant Protection to the General Directorate of Plant Health and Control of Agricultural Inputs (DGSVCIA) for research and subsequent releases in the Kasserine production zone. The UN organization reported that infested cacti were uprooted and buried to halt the spread of the mealybug to the Bouargoub and Zelfane production areas, leading to the elimination of numerous outbreaks in both regions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Zaghouan Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA) has allocated two million dinars to advance organic product developm...
records.description: The Zaghouan Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA) has allocated two million dinars to advance organic product development in beekeeping, sheep farming, cereal crops, olive trees, fruit trees, and poultry, with funding from the African Development Bank (ADB). These funds will support farmer training by the Technical Center for Organic Agriculture and the acquisition of necessary equipment for each sector, following an agreement with the CRDA of Zaghouan. Seven areas within the governorate of Zaghouan have been selected for the project based on their specific characteristics, and organic groups are being formed to supervise and support the participating farmers. This initiative covers an estimated total land area of over 6,500 hectares within the Zaghouan governorate.
records.institution: The Zaghouan Regional Commission for Agricultural Development (CRDA)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has reaffirmed its ban on frozen chicken imports to protect local production...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has reaffirmed its ban on frozen chicken imports to protect local production and support poultry farmers, aligning with national self-sufficiency goals and import cost reduction strategies. This ban aims to safeguard local production, stabilize the market, and offer healthy alternatives for consumers, with the ministry commending efforts to purchase and stock local chicken as direct support for small farmers and market stability. Highlighting the poultry sector's importance to the national economy and food security, the ministry noted the private sector's positive response to local produce and affirmed its commitment to facilitating local production and investment in the poultry sector to meet domestic demand and enhance national product quality.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Sonelgaz has proactively ensured electricity and gas connections for the Algerian-Italian cereal, legume, and pasta production project in...
records.description: Sonelgaz has proactively ensured electricity and gas connections for the Algerian-Italian cereal, legume, and pasta production project in Timimoun. Following a meeting between Sonelgaz and BF El Djazaïr, a partnership between an Italian group and the Algerian State, facilitated by the National Investment Fund, and with representatives from the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries, progress on technical studies for these connections was reviewed. Sonelgaz affirmed its commitment to supporting agricultural and rural investment and providing necessary facilities to ensure the project's timely commencement. BF El Djazair acknowledged Sonelgaz's efficiency in project support. An agreement was reached to form a joint working team to develop a preliminary roadmap with technical solutions and financial estimates, which will underpin the contractual framework in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries. This team immediately began work on the roadmap's implementation. The Algerian-Italian project in Timimoun, an integrated production initiative spanning 36,000 hectares with a USD 420 million investment, aims to boost national cereal and legume production, diversify non-hydrocarbon exports, and create over 6,700 jobs.

records.title: Iraq's Minister of Trade inaugurated the construction of a new, modern grain silo with a 60,000-tonne storage capacity in Kirkuk province.
records.description: Iraq's Minister of Trade inaugurated the construction of a new, modern grain silo with a 60,000-tonne storage capacity in Kirkuk province. This project is a component of the Ministry's infrastructure development strategy aimed at supporting the agricultural sector and increasing the nation's grain storage capabilities. Speaking at the ceremony, the Minister emphasized that this initiative supports the Government's service-oriented goals and the Ministry's efforts to manage growing grain production from across Iraq. The Minister described the project as a significant advancement towards adopting global best practices in grain storage, providing a secure and efficient environment for farmers to market their harvests. The Minister confirmed that this silo is one of five being developed by the General Company for Grain Trade, an entity under the Ministry of Trade, in cooperation with international firms from Switzerland and Egypt. It was noted that this is the first purpose-built silo constructed in Iraq in several decades, reflecting the government's commitment to reconstruction and agricultural infrastructure development, with plans to implement similar strategic projects nationwide. The Director General of the General Company for Grain Trade stated that the project is part of a comprehensive plan to support farmers by streamlining grain marketing and storage, thereby enhancing national food security.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is continuing its nationwide free campaign, initiated in April, to combat and vaccinate against hemorrhagic f...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is continuing its nationwide free campaign, initiated in April, to combat and vaccinate against hemorrhagic fever across all governorates, excluding the Kurdistan Region. Implemented by the Veterinary Department, the campaign involves dipping and spraying animals and their enclosures. This initiative is part of the Ministry's broader plans to safeguard the country's livestock sector from epidemic diseases. The Director General of the Department highlighted the participation of 248 veterinary teams in the campaign, targeting animals of all ages to eliminate ticks, the primary vector of the hemorrhagic fever virus. The Ministry also ensured that veterinary hospitals are equipped with necessary supplies, including dipping basins, sprinklers, and transportation for veterinary teams, to ensure the campaign's effectiveness in vaccinating animals against the disease.

records.title: The Chairman of JEBA highlighted Jordan's economic cooperation with the EU as vital for national growth and sustainable development, offe...
records.description: The Chairman of JEBA highlighted Jordan's economic cooperation with the EU as vital for national growth and sustainable development, offering export opportunities in value-added industries. Jordan has strong potential to increase exports to EU markets, particularly in industry and agriculture. The Jordan-EU Comprehensive Strategic Partnership Agreement marks a new phase with substantial EU financial aid, including grants and investments, demonstrating the EU's commitment to Jordan. Jordanian-EU trade agreements largely provide duty-free access, especially for agricultural exports. The signing of this agreement was a significant event, followed by the EU's announcement of a multi-billion-euro aid package for Jordan.

records.title: At a recent prestigious grand prix for agricultural invention and research, three projects by researchers from the National Institute of...
records.description: At a recent prestigious grand prix for agricultural invention and research, three projects by researchers from the National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA) were among the top five winners. One project developed a Drought Warning and Cereal Yield Forecasting System, a crucial tool for farmers and policymakers facing climate change, providing valuable foresight for agricultural planning. Another winning project from INRA researchers focused on creating new argan tree varieties, a significant step in preserving and promoting Morocco's natural heritage. The third recognized project involved the registration of the first high yellow index wheat varieties in the official catalog, opening new possibilities for the national agri-food industry, especially in pasta and couscous production. These awards underscore the excellence and importance of research at INRA, confirming its role as a driving force in Moroccan agricultural innovation, addressing key challenges in food security, climate adaptation, and the sustainable development of vital sectors.
records.institution: The National Institute of Agronomic Research (INRA)

records.title: The Municipal Council of Al Buraimi Governorate discussed developmental and service topics, emphasizing investing in natural resources fo...
records.description: The Municipal Council of Al Buraimi Governorate discussed developmental and service topics, emphasizing investing in natural resources for ecotourism and updates on key infrastructure projects. The meeting, chaired by the Governor, included presentations on environmental investment for sustainable tourism. The council reviewed the past year's achievements of the Directorate General of Agriculture and Water Resources in Al Buraimi. Updates were given on the rainwater drainage project consultancy study in Al Buraimi, with the council stressing improved drainage to protect property from rainfall. The Chairman also highlighted a planned Recreational Centre to enhance quality of life and attract tourism, noting that these projects will create SME opportunities and local jobs, boosting the economy and serving the community.
records.institution: Municipal Council of Al Buraimi Governorate

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture opened two new branch offices in Qalqilya Governorate to decentralize services and improve farmer access due...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture opened two new branch offices in Qalqilya Governorate to decentralize services and improve farmer access due to movement restrictions, an initiative supported by the Qalqilya Governor and the Undersecretary of the Ministry of Agriculture, with collaboration from the Ministry of Local Government. This is part of a broader plan to establish numerous branch offices in the northern governorates. The delegation also inspected a well rehabilitation project using solar energy and visited a lemon packing house involved in exports. Additionally, they toured a beekeeping project funded by the FAO to support queen bee production. The Director General of the Qalqilya Agriculture Department expressed gratitude for the ongoing support towards sustainable agricultural development and farmer empowerment in the governorate.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Bethlehem Governorate directorate, conducted a field visit to follow up on the "Developing Livel...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Bethlehem Governorate directorate, conducted a field visit to follow up on the "Developing Livelihoods and Climate Change Adaptation in Palestine" project, in cooperation with the Applied Research Institute (ARIJ), the World Food Programme, and the Ministry of Social Development. The team assessed beneficiary conditions in the Tuqu' area, monitoring greenhouses and hydroponic units and providing agricultural guidance to support the project's aim of enhancing farmers' ability to cope with climate change. This project is part of the Ministry's efforts to support farmers in adopting sustainable agricultural methods that address climate challenges and improve productivity, recognizing the collaboration with partners to achieve these goals.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has partnered strategically with British consultancy...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) has partnered strategically with British consultancy Kew REACH to implement the initial phase of a previously announced agreement. This collaboration aims to accelerate the National Greening Program through impactful partnerships that facilitate knowledge transfer and reinforce the Kingdom’s environmental sustainability agenda, initially announced at COP 16. Kew REACH will assist the NCVC in establishing baseline data, conducting assessments, and framing planning for the National Greening Program and the Saudi Green Initiative, providing expertise in ecosystem restoration, seed conservation, sustainable land management, and offering advisory services and training. The partnership also includes a knowledge exchange program at the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, in London. The NCVC Chief Executive highlighted that the collaboration will leverage Kew’s botanical expertise for land restoration and environmental sustainability, aligning with national green initiatives. Kew REACH, a joint-venture consultancy, delivers scientific and advisory services for ecosystem restoration based on rigorous data.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Under the patronage of the Governor of Makkah Region, the Governor of Al-Qunfudhah will inaugurate the 14th Mango Festival in Al-Qunfudha...
records.description: Under the patronage of the Governor of Makkah Region, the Governor of Al-Qunfudhah will inaugurate the 14th Mango Festival in Al-Qunfudhah Governorate this Wednesday. The three-day festival will highlight Al-Qunfudhah's considerable agricultural potential, featuring numerous farms with over half a million mango trees and a substantial annual production. The event will also support local farmers by providing a platform to promote their products and enhance the governorate's position as an important agricultural and tourist center. The festival will include diverse activities such as guidance programs for farmers, theater performances, children's activities, and contests that appeal to a wide range of visitors.

records.title: The European Investment Bank (EIB) has granted Tunisia a 30 million euro loan to enhance the drinking water supply in Greater Tunis and t...
records.description: The European Investment Bank (EIB) has granted Tunisia a 30 million euro loan to enhance the drinking water supply in Greater Tunis and the Financial Port of Tunis, aiming to strengthen the country's water and sanitation sector. This funding includes 22 million euros for the National Water Exploitation and Distribution Company (SONEDE) and 8 million euros for the Republic of Tunisia, with the latter specifically for the financial port project. These loans feature long repayment periods and grace periods, with interest rates at Tunisia's discretion. This financial support underscores the collaboration between Tunisia and the EIB in bolstering food security and reflects their long-standing partnership since 1979, which has amounted to over 7 billion euros in financing. Construction is underway for a new drinking water treatment complex in Béjaoua, co-financed by the EIB and the French Development Agency (AFD), to further secure the water supply for Greater Tunis and the financial port. The EIB is also partnering with the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF) to promote nature-based solutions for water and climate change challenges for the National Sanitation Office (ONAS), with a study focused on smaller cities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture issued an alert about a worrying spread of bark beetles in olive groves in the Medenine region, foll...
records.description: The Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture issued an alert about a worrying spread of bark beetles in olive groves in the Medenine region, following observations by the Regional Agricultural Development Commission (CRDA) of large amounts of unremoved pruning wood. This beetle poses a significant threat to the region's olive trees and olive oil production, a key economic sector, as these residues become breeding grounds. The Ministry has urged immediate action from farmers, including disposing of prunings and applying treatments, while the CRDA of Médenine is raising awareness and organizing training. However, controlling the insect is difficult due to the climate and limited resources, though the Ministry is exploring additional funding and international partnerships. Preserving these olive groves is crucial for the local economy and Tunisia's agricultural heritage, requiring sustainable practices and cooperation to mitigate damage and ensure the future of olive oil production.

records.title: AgriNext returns to Dubai as a key global agritech event, fostering innovation and sustainability by connecting leaders, innovators, and...
records.description: AgriNext returns to Dubai as a key global agritech event, fostering innovation and sustainability by connecting leaders, innovators, and policymakers. The previous Dubai event highlighted tech integration in farming for sustainable growth. Dubai's strategic hub status aligns with AgriNext's focus on food security. AgriNext 2025 will feature awards, tech exhibitions, expert sessions on AI and sustainable practices, and networking. Leaders in sustainable and tech-driven agriculture will participate. AgriNext bridges traditional farming with modern tech, empowering stakeholders and offering opportunities for investors and startups.

records.title: UNS Farms is revolutionizing UAE food production through innovation and sustainability as a leading Dubai urban vertical farm producing p...
records.description: UNS Farms is revolutionizing UAE food production through innovation and sustainability as a leading Dubai urban vertical farm producing pesticide-free vegetables daily with significantly less water and higher yields than traditional methods. Beyond its operations, UNS Farms consults on modernizing food systems, offering design and development services to make sustainable farming more accessible. Addressing global population growth and climate challenges, UNS Farms provides year-round local produce, reducing import dependence and aligning with Dubai’s Food Security Strategy.

records.title: The Agriculture Ministers of Egypt and Madagascar met in Cairo to discuss enhancing bilateral cooperation across various agricultural sec...
records.description: The Agriculture Ministers of Egypt and Madagascar met in Cairo to discuss enhancing bilateral cooperation across various agricultural sectors. The Egyptian Minister emphasized Egypt's agricultural progress in achieving food security and offered the Ministry's expertise and resources to Madagascar for sustainable agricultural development. Potential areas for collaboration included seed production, date palm cultivation in southern regions, and rice farming under South-South cooperation. Egypt's advancements in desert agriculture and irrigation techniques, supported by infrastructure development leading to significant land reclamation, were also highlighted. The importance of collaboration in applied research, agricultural exports, training, and capacity building, including training opportunities at the Egyptian International Centre for Agriculture and cooperation in agricultural education, was underscored. The Malagasy Minister expressed appreciation and a strong interest in collaborating with Egypt, particularly in the proposed areas, given Madagascar's challenges with droughts and low agricultural productivity. The meeting concluded with the signing of a memorandum of understanding to formalize cooperation and accelerate joint initiatives for sustainable agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Director General of the Department of Animal Wealth inspected the Suwaira Fish Hatchery to monitor the fish breeding season activitie...
records.description: The Director General of the Department of Animal Wealth inspected the Suwaira Fish Hatchery to monitor the fish breeding season activities, which included the introduction of the ninth batch of common carp broodstock into the hatchery. The Director General highlighted that common carp is an economically important species with growing demand in both local and international markets due to its adaptability and efficient feed conversion. This visit is part of the department's efforts to improve fisheries and ensure quality production, thereby supporting the agricultural sector and meeting market demands.

records.title: The World Food Programme (WFP) in Iraq assisted over 15,000 people with e-vouchers and cash transfers across multiple governorates, requi...
records.description: The World Food Programme (WFP) in Iraq assisted over 15,000 people with e-vouchers and cash transfers across multiple governorates, requiring significant funding for the coming months. WFP's initiatives focused on economic empowerment, livelihoods, and climate adaptation, including the rehabilitation of irrigation canals benefiting returnees and local workers, and an awareness campaign on water management. Collaborating with the Agricultural Research Station in Anbar, WFP trained farmers in plant disease management. To combat desertification, WFP supported an afforestation campaign with the Directorate of Forestry and Combating Desertification, benefiting the local community. Additionally, in partnership with the Department of Agriculture in Diyala Governorate, WFP conducted a hydroponic training course for farmers to enhance their production methods and water resource management.
records.institution: Al-Amal Rehabilitation Centre, Agricultural Research Station (ARS)

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture affirmed that untreated organic fertilizer will be banned from entering the Jordan Valley.
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture affirmed that untreated organic fertilizer will be banned from entering the Jordan Valley. During an inspection of a processed organic fertilizer plant and agricultural and tourist sites in the area, the Minister stated that the ministry is working with several other ministries and the Public Security Directorate on a comprehensive campaign to control houseflies in the Jordan Valley to protect public health and the agricultural and tourism sectors. Efforts include preventing untreated organic fertilizer from reaching agricultural lands, requiring it to be sent to specialized plants for proper processing, including biological control methods. The ministry is also educating farmers about the benefits of treated organic fertilizer through field schools and conducting extensive spraying campaigns in fly breeding areas, with ongoing monitoring of fly populations and the effectiveness of these efforts. Continuous monitoring of the transportation of untreated organic fertilizer is also taking place.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) announced the official launch of the first pilot experiment to create a continuous...
records.description: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) announced the official launch of the first pilot experiment to create a continuous network of farmers' markets. This initiative is part of the technical cooperation between UTAP and the World Farmers' Market Coalition (WorldFMC), aiming to organize Tunisian farmers' markets in a new format based on modern standards and ensure mobility between different regions. The announcement was made during a meeting in Tunis between the UTAP President and a WorldFMC delegation. This meeting is part of the partnership and technical cooperation programs between UTAP and WorldFMC, aimed at creating a permanent and continuous network of farmers' markets across Tunisia, fostering a sustainable and direct relationship between farmers and consumers. The organization of these markets will follow specifications adopted by all WorldFMC member countries.
records.institution: Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP)

records.title: The "Together for Lebanon's Olives" project, a collaborative effort between the Arab Group for the Protection of Nature, the Arab Network...
records.description: The "Together for Lebanon's Olives" project, a collaborative effort between the Arab Group for the Protection of Nature, the Arab Network for Food Sovereignty, and various civil society organizations, has been launched to restore olive farms damaged by recent aggression. The project was inaugurated at an official ceremony hosted by the Order of Engineers in Beirut, under the patronage of the Lebanese Minister of Agriculture, with attendance from representatives of environmental and agricultural bodies, security officials, academics, and syndicate heads. The Minister of Agriculture emphasized unity and cooperation in supporting southern farmers and the broader agricultural sector, highlighting the government's commitment to rehabilitation, modern technologies, and an upcoming national campaign, "Agriculture: The Pulse of the Earth," to underscore agriculture's economic importance. The President of the Arab Group for the Protection of Nature stressed the project as a symbol of Arab solidarity and the revival of hope through restoring agricultural lands. The head of the Engineers Syndicate highlighted significant losses and the olive tree's symbolic value to Lebanon. The Dean of the Faculty of Agriculture at the Lebanese University emphasized the olive tree's cultural and ecological importance and the need for new agricultural policies. A representative farmer expressed gratitude and resilience.
records.institution: Arab Group for the Protection of Nature

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Nablus Agriculture Directorate, delivered three specialized training courses under the "Land Res...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Nablus Agriculture Directorate, delivered three specialized training courses under the "Land Resilience and Natural Resources Management - RELAB" project, involving 79 farmers from diverse agricultural communities within the Nablus Governorate. These sessions were held in various local council and municipality halls across the central Jordan Valley, southern Nablus villages, and southeastern Nablus villages. The training concluded with a final workshop at the Agriculture Directorate headquarters, where 20 participating farmers from the different communities exchanged their experiences. The workshop was opened by the Directorate's Director General, with the supervising engineer present. These training courses are part of the Ministry of Agriculture's broader initiatives to improve farmers' capabilities and advance natural resource management techniques in agricultural regions.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is celebrating World Veterinary Day, highlighting the theme of teamwork in a...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is celebrating World Veterinary Day, highlighting the theme of teamwork in animal health, which involves collaboration across various disciplines to deliver high-quality veterinary services. ADAFSA's observance reflects its support for its veterinary staff and its continuous annual Animal Disease Awareness and Vaccination Campaign, which aims to vaccinate a large number of livestock against major diseases through field teams working closely with livestock breeders. Alongside this, ADAFSA has launched intensive awareness campaigns to promote biosecurity and disease prevention among livestock owners, emphasizing key practices such as isolation of animals, reporting illnesses, maintaining hygiene, and sourcing from reliable suppliers, while also providing guidance on preventing zoonotic diseases. ADAFSA underscores that its biosecurity protocols, vaccination efforts, and awareness initiatives are vital for controlling animal diseases. A representative from ADAFSA emphasized that their approach relies on strong cooperation between veterinary teams, livestock breeders, and the wider community to ensure animal health, food safety, and public wellbeing.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: Discussions were held in Sana'a concerning the imminent launch of a Specialized Court and Prosecution Office dedicated to Agricultural Ca...
records.description: Discussions were held in Sana'a concerning the imminent launch of a Specialized Court and Prosecution Office dedicated to Agricultural Cases. The meeting, involving the Minister of Justice and Human Rights and the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, focused on finalizing the necessary logistical and personnel arrangements, including the training of specialized staff to ensure the court's effective operation. This initiative aims to strengthen legal protections for the agricultural sector and address offenses that impact food and water security. The court is anticipated to handle cases involving environmental violations, illegal well drilling, water encroachment, banned pesticides, and seed smuggling, reflecting the government's dedication to protecting natural resources and supporting sustainable agriculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Justice and Human Rights

records.title: The Undersecretary of Agriculture and Animal Wealth Affairs at the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture highlighted the cri...
records.description: The Undersecretary of Agriculture and Animal Wealth Affairs at the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture highlighted the critical role of veterinary medicine in protecting public health as the first line of defense against zoonotic diseases. Marking World Veterinary Day, observed annually on the last Saturday of April, the Undersecretary emphasized the importance of disease surveillance, vaccination programs, and ensuring the safety of animal products to strengthen national health security. The Undersecretary commended the contributions of veterinary professionals both domestically and internationally to animal health, food safety, and the prevention of diseases shared between humans and animals. The Ministry's continuous efforts to enhance the national veterinary system by developing local skills, providing a supportive work environment, and maintaining high international standards to promote biosecurity, food security, and environmental balance were underscored.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Minister of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation asserted that the national investment plan aims at supportin...
records.description: The Minister of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation asserted that the national investment plan aims at supporting the implementation of the national strategy of climate change via directing the public investments towards projects that aim at easing the impact of climate change. This came during the Minister’s participation in a discussion session under the rubric “investment in the future: mobilizing finance for jobs and skills within the framework of climate transition”. The session, which comes in light of the Minister’s participation in the Spring Meetings of the World Bank Group (WBG) and the International Monetary Fund (IMF) held in Washington, discussed the role of climate action in leading technological progress, limiting risks and boosting economic efficiency. The Minister shed light on the comprehensive national strategy to change climate 2050 which represents roadmap to handle the biggest climate challenges in Egypt. The strategy includes a number of projects prioritized by the main sectors of energy, food and water which are necessary for building the ability of adapting to climate change.
records.institution: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development and International Cooperation

records.title: Under the auspices of the Minister of Agriculture and with representation from the Danish Embassy, 34 farmers formalized support agreemen...
records.description: Under the auspices of the Minister of Agriculture and with representation from the Danish Embassy, 34 farmers formalized support agreements with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO). These matching grants are part of a collaborative development project aimed at enhancing livelihoods in rural areas. The signing event was attended by delegates from the Danish Embassy, FAO, and various agricultural entities. The Minister of Agriculture underscored the Ministry's dedication to strengthening alliances with international organizations to offer direct support to small-scale farmers, noting a key agricultural project as the Ministry's primary vehicle for sustainable agricultural advancement. Appreciation was expressed for the FAO and the Danish Embassy's support of the agricultural sector and the significance of contract farming. The Ministry is also developing reform initiatives, with registration in the "Agricultural Registry" becoming essential for future assistance. Farmers voiced their challenges, particularly in the apple cultivation sector, emphasizing the need for improved marketing and protection of national production.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in collaboration with partner municipalities and loca...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, in collaboration with partner municipalities and local councils, signed 27 small agricultural grant agreements as part of the "Relab" project to bolster rural development in the Jenin Governorate. These grants, valued at approximately $135,000 in total, will support agricultural development projects across several towns, focusing on establishing greenhouses, sheep-raising initiatives, and modern cultivation systems for crops like strawberries and kiwi. The Director General of the Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate highlighted that these efforts align with the Ministry's strategy to enhance food security, strengthen agricultural value chains, and empower rural youth through income-generating and environmentally sustainable projects. These grants aim to advance plant and animal production by introducing modern agricultural techniques and supporting key sectors like beekeeping and sheep-raising, contributing to the broader Palestinian agricultural landscape.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Aseer branch is continuing its Environment Week 2025 activities with a community ini...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture's Aseer branch is continuing its Environment Week 2025 activities with a community initiative that involved 35 volunteers planting approximately 250 seedlings of various flowers and aromatic trees. This initiative aimed to empower community members in environmental preservation, especially regarding water and food consumption, and to encourage collaborative efforts and knowledge sharing for the region's sustainable growth and prosperity, ultimately ensuring societal well-being and a better future. Through numerous programs and activities, the ministry's Aseer branch is working to raise environmental awareness across all societal groups and sectors, share knowledge about key environmental issues in the Kingdom, encourage environmental commitment, and foster a sense of responsibility to address harmful environmental behaviors and promote positive ones.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Government of Tunisia, in partnership with the African Development Bank Group, has initiated a substantial $24 million project to res...
records.description: The Government of Tunisia, in partnership with the African Development Bank Group, has initiated a substantial $24 million project to restore degraded forest landscapes and enhance climate resilience in rural ecosystems. The Agroforestry and Degraded Forest Landscape Restoration Project (PARFD), with a total budget of nearly $24 million, is financed through a $17 million contribution from the African Development Bank via the Climate Investment Funds’ Strategic Climate Fund, complemented by over $6 million from the Tunisian Government and $660,000 from project beneficiaries. This initiative aligns with Tunisia’s national development priorities, including the 2030 Sustainable Development Strategy and the country’s commitment to a 45% reduction in carbon intensity by 2030. The project is expected to generate approximately 4,500 green jobs across several governorates. Representatives from both the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries and the African Development Bank emphasized the project's significance in addressing climate change and promoting sustainable rural development through an integrated approach that targets ecological restoration and creates sustainable economic and social opportunities for rural communities.

records.title: A meeting in Sana'a, led by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, addressed methods for enhancing the performance...
records.description: A meeting in Sana'a, led by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, addressed methods for enhancing the performance of the General Authority for Water Resources and Facilities. The Minister emphasized the urgent need for a specialized working group to establish guidelines for water resource development and management to improve efficiency and achieve sustainability goals. The completion of the Authority's automation project as part of the Ministry's digital transformation, including network connectivity and modern electronic systems, was also highlighted. The Minister urged the Authority to support community initiatives for rainwater harvesting and develop digital solutions for groundwater recharge and depletion reduction. Activating the Water Resources Unit for agricultural associations and appointing coordinators to improve performance were also emphasized. The Chairman of the General Authority for Water Resources and Facilities reviewed efforts to develop scientific foundations for water resource development and update public policies, noting a planned memorandum of understanding with the Geological Survey and Mineral Resources Authority and the Oil Exploration and Production Authority for integrated efforts in protecting groundwater and developing water basins.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: Two contracts were signed with the Saudi company "Goody" for the export of Algerian agricultural and food products, according to the Mini...
records.description: Two contracts were signed with the Saudi company "Goody" for the export of Algerian agricultural and food products, according to the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Export Promotion. These agreements, signed at the ministry's headquarters under the supervision of the Minister, aim to increase the presence of Algerian products in Gulf markets. The first contract involves the Algerian company "Houkoul El Janoub," a Souakri group subsidiary, for the annual export of cherry tomatoes valued at $3 million. The second contract is with the "LaBelle" group for the annual export of its food products valued at $2 million.
records.institution: The Ministry of Foreign Trade and Export Promotion

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is continuing to receive and equip modern pivot irrigation systems in Najaf Governorate through the General C...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is continuing to receive and equip modern pivot irrigation systems in Najaf Governorate through the General Company for Agricultural Equipment / Najaf Branch. The Ministry has received 100 pivot systems, including fifty 120-dunum and fifty 80-dunum Rafidain pivot systems under separate contracts. Additionally, a group of farmers in the governorate has been equipped with 80-dunum pivot systems. This initiative is part of the Ministry's efforts to facilitate and support farmers and agriculturalists to advance the agricultural sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Agricultural Center in Marjeyoun conducted a series of specialized seminars to promote sustainable agricult...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Agricultural Center in Marjeyoun conducted a series of specialized seminars to promote sustainable agricultural practices as part of the National Agricultural Guidance Program. These seminars, held across the Marjeyoun District for various agricultural professionals, focused on modern techniques for olive tree pruning and olive fly control using traps, a foundational course on bee biology and beekeeping methods for beginners, and ecological agriculture in home gardens, including irrigation, water management, and organic fertilizers with practical field activities. The head of the Agricultural Center highlighted the significance of these initiatives in increasing agricultural awareness and encouraging the adoption of modern, safe, and resource-efficient methods. The seminars saw strong participation, with numerous sessions held across the different themes, and attendees expressed their appreciation for the valuable scientific and practical information, requesting the continuation of such activities to support agricultural productivity and stability in southern Lebanon.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The sole operator of Oman’s national gas transportation network anticipates developing 300–400 km of hydrogen pipelines by 2030 to suppor...
records.description: The sole operator of Oman’s national gas transportation network anticipates developing 300–400 km of hydrogen pipelines by 2030 to support the country’s green hydrogen industry, with funding approval expected. As the National Infrastructure Provider, the company will use a phased approach, starting with regional pipelines expandable to a national network, forming part of a common use infrastructure for various utilities intended for the consortiums developing green hydrogen projects in specific governorates. The operator will leverage its experience from the extensive national gas network and is collaborating with the entity overseeing Oman’s green hydrogen strategy on the technical aspects of the proposed hydrogen pipeline system. Last year, a MoU was signed with a green hydrogen project consortium in Salalah, and a strategy study on hydrogen infrastructure development was conducted. In parallel, the operator is planning a carbon dioxide (CO₂) transportation network to link emission sources with storage and utilization, including CCS and feedstock use in various industries.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: In Doha, Qatar, local vegetable markets and Mahaseel achieved significant success in 2024, selling over 37,000 tonnes of domestically gro...
records.description: In Doha, Qatar, local vegetable markets and Mahaseel achieved significant success in 2024, selling over 37,000 tonnes of domestically grown vegetables, a testament to the Ministry of Municipality's effective marketing strategies aimed at increasing farmers' output. The vegetable markets, involving 150 local farms, sold over 13,000 tonnes in the recent agricultural season, a substantial rise since their inception. Mahaseel for Marketing and Agriculture Services Company also played a key role, receiving 24,000 tonnes of vegetables from 199 local farms, supporting them through various contracting programs under the Ministry's guidance. The Ministry's Agricultural Affairs Department offers multiple marketing avenues for local produce, including vegetable markets and partnerships with major commercial outlets and Mahaseel. Furthermore, the 'Dates Supply Programme' saw a considerable amount of dates supplied, indicating the Ministry's ongoing support for local date production to enhance food security and agricultural development.

records.title: Qatar's Minister of Environment and Climate Change emphasized that biodiversity and wildlife conservation are key priorities within the n...
records.description: Qatar's Minister of Environment and Climate Change emphasized that biodiversity and wildlife conservation are key priorities within the nation's environmental policy, integral to its sustainable development goals under the National Vision 2030. Speaking at the opening of the International Council for Game and Wildlife Conservation's General Assembly in Doha, the Minister underscored Qatar's dedication to global efforts in protecting wildlife and preserving ecosystems, noting the urgent need for increased international cooperation to address biodiversity loss and ensure the planet's future. The Minister highlighted the Ministry's initiatives to enhance wildlife protection, expand nature reserves, and enact strong legislation for endangered species as part of the National Environment and Climate Change Strategy. Hosting the Assembly in Doha provides a valuable platform for sharing knowledge and best practices in environmental conservation, with global recognition of biodiversity's central role in climate action. Qatar is also actively collaborating with international partners on wildlife conservation projects, urging participants to develop practical recommendations for advancing these efforts and integrating environmental and developmental policies, reaffirming its commitment to environmental protection and the importance of investing in biodiversity for the future.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment and Climate Change

records.title: The Director General of the General Establishment for Grains conveyed sincere appreciation to Iraq for its generous donation of 220,000 t...
records.description: The Director General of the General Establishment for Grains conveyed sincere appreciation to Iraq for its generous donation of 220,000 tons of wheat to the Syrian people, emphasizing the deep fraternal and historical ties between the two nations. Trucks carrying the wheat have started entering Syrian territory via the Qaim Crossing, with the first shipment arriving in Deir ez-Zor Governorate for distribution nationwide. The distribution process is based on a careful assessment of each governorate's needs, conducted by specialized teams at the General Establishment for Grains in coordination with relevant authorities, to ensure equitable allocation and a positive impact on food security across the country. This wheat donation is seen as a symbol of renewed and strengthened fraternal relations with the Iraqi people, with hopes for increased cooperation in various sectors in the future.
records.institution: The Ministry of Internal Trade and Consumer Protection

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The city of Zarzis, in the governorate of Medenine, will host the 1st Fair of Agriculture, Maritime Fishing, Livestock, Organic Products,...
records.description: The city of Zarzis, in the governorate of Medenine, will host the 1st Fair of Agriculture, Maritime Fishing, Livestock, Organic Products, and Renewable Energy in the fifth district under the theme of agricultural investment for sustainable development. Around 79 exhibitors from various regions will present agricultural equipment, organic products, and innovative solutions to encourage direct exchanges between producers and consumers. The event will feature scientific presentations, showcase young entrepreneurs' projects, and include regional days, aiming to promote the agricultural sector, enhance its development and infrastructure, preserve the region's natural resources, and provide a platform for exchanging agricultural goods, services, and financing options. Preparatory meetings were organized across the fifth district's governorates to ensure the fair's success and broad stakeholder participation.

records.title: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) reminded fishermen and those in the fishing sector that fishing and marketing vari...
records.description: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) reminded fishermen and those in the fishing sector that fishing and marketing various protected marine species are prohibited. These species include cartilaginous fish like rays and sharks, sea turtles, cetaceans, and seabirds. This awareness initiative aims to preserve and ensure the sustainability of fisheries resources. In a press release, UTAP mentioned that scientific guides from the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, the World Wide Fund for Nature (WWF), and the Regional Activity Centre for Specially Protected Areas (SPA/RAC) are available online for fishermen. With TAP.
records.institution: Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: A recently released Sustainability Report from DP World highlights a significant achievement, with the company sourcing 65% of its electr...
records.description: A recently released Sustainability Report from DP World highlights a significant achievement, with the company sourcing 65% of its electricity from renewables, marking considerable progress in its sustainability journey. The report outlines a substantial investment of $1.17 billion in green and low-carbon infrastructure projects, alongside innovative efforts in sustainable finance, environmental management, and inclusive growth. The company's inaugural Green Sukuk Impact and Allocation Report detailed the allocation of $1.17 billion from a prior bond towards green initiatives such as low-carbon infrastructure and renewable energy systems. DP World also issued a $100 million Blue Bond, a first for a corporate in its region, to fund sustainable projects in marine transportation, port infrastructure, and environmental conservation, establishing a new benchmark for sustainable finance in emerging markets.

records.title: Mansourah Poultry (MPCO) reported a 42.39% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profits attributable, reaching EGP 152.717 million i...
records.description: Mansourah Poultry (MPCO) reported a 42.39% year-on-year increase in consolidated net profits attributable, reaching EGP 152.717 million in 2024, compared to EGP 107.229 million in 2023. Earnings per share (EPS) rose to EGP 0.244 in the past year from EGP 0.220 at the end of December 2023. The company's revenues for 2024 were valued at EGP 755.483 million, an annual increase from EGP 497.532 million. On a standalone basis, net profits also increased to EGP 152.951 million from EGP 107.229 million.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman will host the fourth Green Hydrogen Summit (GHSO) under the Ministry of Energy and Minerals, in strategic partnership with Hydrogen...
records.description: Oman will host the fourth Green Hydrogen Summit (GHSO) under the Ministry of Energy and Minerals, in strategic partnership with Hydrogen Oman (Hydrom) and hosted by Birba Energy Services. The summit aims to attract thousands of international delegates, including officials, investors, and experts, and is considered a milestone in Oman's journey towards a green hydrogen economy and carbon neutrality goals, leveraging its strategic advantages. The Ministry views the conference as crucial for establishing a green hydrogen culture and measuring market readiness. The summit will facilitate investment, innovation, and partnerships to support Oman's hydrogen masterplan for energy security, economic diversification, emission reduction, and local capacity development, building on awarded projects in Duqm and Dhofar. Hydrom Oman highlighted the summit's significance as a key event for global stakeholders to exchange knowledge and promote innovation across the green hydrogen value chain, emphasizing Oman's commitment to annually host the summit to engage with international partners and showcase opportunities in its green hydrogen sector, featuring technology exhibitions, policy discussions, and business forums to collectively shape the future of green hydrogen.

records.title: Qatar's Cabinet convened its regular meeting, commending the Amir's visit to Russia for enhanced economic ties and partnership, and ackno...
records.description: Qatar's Cabinet convened its regular meeting, commending the Amir's visit to Russia for enhanced economic ties and partnership, and acknowledging his discussions with Lebanon's President, underscoring strong bilateral relations and regional stability. Subsequently, the Cabinet reviewed its agenda, noting the Shura Council's approval of a meteorological services law and endorsing decrees for the Ras Abu Fontas power and water project by the Qatar General Electricity and Water Corporation, in line with national development goals. A draft decision by the Minister of Commerce and Industry on a national technical regulation to improve trade and food quality was also approved. Furthermore, cooperation agreements in agriculture with Algeria, maritime affairs with Cyprus, and sports and youth with Hungary were endorsed. The meeting concluded with a review of the annual report on the Anti-Concealment Committee's activities, resulting in appropriate resolutions.
records.institution: The Cabinet, the Ministry of Commerce and Industry

records.title: A new Tunisian decree organizes the Agricultural Damage Compensation Fund for losses from natural disasters like floods, droughts, and st...
records.description: A new Tunisian decree organizes the Agricultural Damage Compensation Fund for losses from natural disasters like floods, droughts, and storms. The fund covers damages to crops, livestock, and maritime fishing activities. National and regional commissions are formed to recognize disasters, assess affected areas, and manage compensation procedures. Indemnities are determined based on actual production costs and cannot exceed 60% of those costs or 90% of the fund’s available resources. Farmers and fishers must subscribe to the fund at 2.5% of their production expenses to be eligible for compensation. Detailed procedures for subscription, claim submission, and damage assessment are outlined to ensure fair and organized indemnification.

records.title: Tunisia is participating in the 17th edition of the International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM) in Meknes.
records.description: Tunisia is participating in the 17th edition of the International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM) in Meknes. Organized by the Export Promotion Center (CEPEX) in collaboration with the Tunisian Embassy in Rabat, this participation aims to promote Tunisia's agricultural and agri-food products, such as dates, olive oil, tuna, and harissa, to Moroccan and international buyers. The Tunisian stand has attracted significant interest from professionals. The SIAM, with over 1.1 million visitors, participation from 70 countries, and numerous exhibitors and conferences, is a key platform for international agricultural and commercial exchange. Tunisian agri-food exports to Morocco reached 235.56 million Tunisian dinars in 2024, highlighting the Moroccan market's strategic importance for Tunisian products.

records.title: The Minister of Supply and Internal Trade announced a strong start to the local wheat procurement season, reflecting the government's com...
