records.description: The Minister of Supply and Internal Trade announced a strong start to the local wheat procurement season, reflecting the government's commitment to supporting Egyptian farmers and bolstering national food security through a competitive procurement price exceeding global market rates. The government has mobilized various entities, including the Future of Egypt for Sustainable Development Authority, the Holding Company for Silos and Storage, affiliated milling companies, and the Agricultural Bank of Egypt, to ensure efficient operations across over 420 delivery points nationwide, with financial dues promised within 48 hours. A central and local operations rooms have been established to monitor progress and address issues, urging farmers to participate to benefit from favorable pricing and support services, ultimately aiming to enhance the strategic stockpile and ensure a fair wheat marketing system for local producers, contributing to long-term national food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture confirms the ongoing free campaigns in all governorates to control hemorrhagic fever as part of the National...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture confirms the ongoing free campaigns in all governorates to control hemorrhagic fever as part of the National Spring Campaign. The Director General of the Veterinary Department stated that field visits were conducted to veterinary facilities to oversee the implementation of animal spraying and dipping, as well as pen spraying, aimed at eliminating ticks, the primary carrier of hemorrhagic fever. These visits also involved monitoring progress and educating breeders on the importance of collaborating with veterinary teams and following vaccination procedures to prevent epidemics and ensure livestock safety throughout the country.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture – Nabatieh Agriculture Department – ​​Bint Jbeil Agricultural Center held a guidance seminar on post-war envi...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture – Nabatieh Agriculture Department – ​​Bint Jbeil Agricultural Center held a guidance seminar on post-war environmental damage and the safe use of pesticides as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. The seminar addressed the negative impacts of war on the agricultural environment, such as pollution and vegetation deterioration, and emphasized the importance of properly handling agricultural pesticides for user safety and ecosystem preservation. Attended by students, farmers, activists, and others, the seminar saw active engagement and highlighted the need for more awareness and technical support, especially in conflict-affected areas. This seminar is part of the Ministry's ongoing efforts to promote sustainable and safe agricultural practices and enhance environmental awareness across Lebanon, aligning with its vision for comprehensive and sustainable agricultural development.

records.title: During the International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM) 2025, the Moroccan Interprofessional Olive Association and the French associ...
records.description: During the International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM) 2025, the Moroccan Interprofessional Olive Association and the French association Olives Avenir signed a strategic partnership agreement. The ceremony was attended by the Moroccan Minister of Agriculture and the French Minister Delegate for Europe, underscoring the political commitment of both nations to sustainable and cooperative agriculture. The agreement aims to enhance collaboration in olive cultivation, facilitate discussions on water management and climate issues, share data and best practices, and establish a foundation for joint international projects.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Morocco, during its International Agricultural Show, signed two agreements focused on the sustainable management of agricultural water an...
records.description: Morocco, during its International Agricultural Show, signed two agreements focused on the sustainable management of agricultural water and improved climate resilience. The first agreement establishes a participatory management contract for the Fez-Meknes water table, aiming for environmental and economic sustainability through integrated water resource management involving all stakeholders. The second agreement creates a framework for cooperation between the agriculture and water ministries on data exchange, climate services for agriculture, and capacity building. These initiatives, discussed at a high-level conference on water management for resilient agriculture, highlight efforts to strengthen resource management, promote innovation, and develop common approaches to address water challenges in the face of intensifying climate change.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: The Ministry has reaffirmed its commitment to supporting Oman’s agricultural sector and ensuring the stability of its food supply system,...
records.description: The Ministry has reaffirmed its commitment to supporting Oman’s agricultural sector and ensuring the stability of its food supply system, acknowledging the current oversupply of locally grown onions and the concerns of farmers seeking fair market opportunities and sustainable returns. The Ministry assured that it is coordinating with relevant partners to develop practical and long-term solutions to address the marketing gap, emphasizing its understanding of Omani farmers' dedication to product quality and national food security. Measures under consideration include better organization of production cycles, more effective marketing mechanisms, and support strategies to stabilize the local market during supply fluctuations. The Ministry also encouraged farmers and agricultural investors to register with the Omani Farmers Association for guidance and support programs that align with national agricultural policies and frameworks.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre (OCEC) in Muscat, in collaboration with TotalEnergies Renewables Distributed Generation Middle...
records.description: The Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre (OCEC) in Muscat, in collaboration with TotalEnergies Renewables Distributed Generation Middle East & Africa and with the support of OMRAN Group, has commissioned its solar rooftop project, now fully operational. The installation includes 8,300 solar PV modules across 16,600 square metres, designed to reduce the venue’s carbon footprint by approximately 3,300 tonnes of CO2 annually and generate around 25% of OCEC’s total energy needs. The PV modules also offer benefits like lowering indoor temperatures and protecting the roof. This initiative aligns with Oman’s national Net Zero 2050 ambitions and complements OCEC’s other sustainability efforts. The CEO of OCEC emphasized the project as a major step towards becoming a more sustainable venue, meeting the demand for green destinations through strong partnerships. The Managing Director of TotalEnergies Renewables highlighted their contribution to a sustainable future in Oman. The system is already providing green power to events hosted at the Centre.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Directorate, launched a training program for 25 farmers as part of the "Land Resili...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Directorate, launched a training program for 25 farmers as part of the "Land Resilience and Natural Resources Management" project, in cooperation with the Rural Platform and Beit Ummar Municipality. The program aims to improve farmers' skills in sustainable land and natural resource management to boost productivity and environmental conservation. Representatives from the Rural Platform and the Municipality, along with engineers and technicians from the Agriculture Directorate, attended the opening, highlighting the importance of such programs in supporting farmers and rural livelihoods. This training reflects the Ministry of Agriculture's commitment to strengthening the agricultural sector and empowering farmers with sustainable practices to achieve food security and rural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, via the Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Department, delivered 43 tons of livestock feed to 8 beneficiarie...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, via the Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Department, delivered 43 tons of livestock feed to 8 beneficiaries in the Ihmir area of the Northern Jordan Valley. This project is part of the government's urgent response to support those affected by settler attacks. Implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture under the Minister's direction, it aims to support the livestock sector in marginalized areas targeted by settlers and the Israeli occupation in the northern Jordan Valley. This initiative falls under a larger project to enhance the resilience of Palestinians in the West Bank and East Jerusalem, implemented by European Union institutions in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture and funded by the Protection Coalition. The activity seeks to alleviate the costs of livestock fodder due to farmers' restricted access to pastures because of occupation-related limitations, and to improve the health and productivity of sheep.

records.title: The technical committee for the Water Harvesting Project, associated with the Jerusalem Agriculture Directorate, conducted a field visit...
records.description: The technical committee for the Water Harvesting Project, associated with the Jerusalem Agriculture Directorate, conducted a field visit to assess the lands of farmers who applied to participate in the irrigation network distribution project. This project, funded by the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development and implemented by the Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture under the Water Harvesting Project, aims to enhance irrigation efficiency and support farmers in the region. The committee toured nominated land plots in the village of Al-Jadirah to prepare for beneficiary selection based on technical criteria. The committee will continue reviewing applications in other villages northwest of Jerusalem, with the goal of selecting 24 farmers for the project. This initiative is part of the Ministry of Agriculture's broader efforts to improve irrigation infrastructure and increase agricultural productivity, particularly in water-scarce areas.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Ministry of Municipality in Qatar, in collaboration with the Agricultural Affairs Department, has launched 17 new agricultural servic...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipality in Qatar, in collaboration with the Agricultural Affairs Department, has launched 17 new agricultural services on its ‘Oun’ app as part of its digital transformation project. This initiative aims to enhance service efficiency and simplify procedures for permits related to importing fertilizers, soil enhancers, honeybees, trees, wood, produce, fodder, seeds, pesticides, and flowers, as well as requests for various certificates and approvals. This expansion of digital services, now totaling hundreds on the Ministry’s platform, seeks to provide smart and automated services to the public and streamline processes through technological upgrades and data sharing with other government bodies.

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 588 food baskets in Yemen’s Aden Governorate, benefiting 4,116...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) distributed 588 food baskets in Yemen’s Aden Governorate, benefiting 4,116 people. This distribution is part of the 2025 Food Aid Distribution Project in the Republic of Yemen. This assistance is part of the relief and humanitarian efforts provided by the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia through KSrelief to ease the difficulties faced by the Yemeni people due to the continuing humanitarian crisis.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: Cleantech company Sparklo has partnered with UAE bottled water company Mai Dubai to encourage recycling by installing 30 AI-powered Rever...
records.description: Cleantech company Sparklo has partnered with UAE bottled water company Mai Dubai to encourage recycling by installing 30 AI-powered Reverse Vending Machines (Sparklomats) in high-traffic areas across the UAE. Users will earn points for recycling containers, redeemable for rewards like discounts on Mai Dubai deliveries. This initiative aims to make recycling more rewarding and create a closed-loop system for Mai Dubai products. Both companies' CEOs highlighted their commitment to sustainability and empowering consumers to participate in a circular economy for a more sustainable future in the UAE.

records.title: Hodeida officials from the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit conducted a field visit to assess the progr...
records.description: Hodeida officials from the Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit conducted a field visit to assess the progress and impact of several funded agricultural and fisheries projects. Inspections included the rehabilitation of the central slaughterhouse in Hodeida city, ongoing work at a shrimp factory aimed at increasing the value of marine resources and supporting employment, and infrastructure development at the fishing port to improve traditional fishing activities and fish preservation. The Unit Director emphasized the importance of continuous field monitoring to ensure quality implementation and achieve the desired development impact in crucial sectors like agriculture, fisheries, and livestock, noting that these visits help improve performance and facilitate support decisions for the Project Financing Unit's development goals within the governorate.
records.institution: Agricultural and Fisheries Projects and Initiatives Financing Unit

records.title: The Amran Water Basin Committee reviewed applications for drilling new wells and deepening existing ones in Amran and Jabal Ayal Yazid di...
records.description: The Amran Water Basin Committee reviewed applications for drilling new wells and deepening existing ones in Amran and Jabal Ayal Yazid districts. The meeting, attended by committee members including directors from the Water Resources and Facilities Authority, Rural Water Projects, the Agriculture Sector, and the Local Water and Sanitation Corporation, examined the technical and legal aspects of the submitted applications for well-drilling permits, covering objections, legal compliance, and key technical observations. Attendees, including the directors of Amran and Khamr districts, approved one application and rejected the rest due to non-compliance with legal and technical requirements. The Governor emphasized the importance of protecting the basin's water sources and implementing measures to preserve groundwater, preventing depletion caused by unregulated drilling, stressing the need to continue prohibiting random drilling in the basin area, coordinating with relevant authorities to safeguard the basin, prioritizing drinking water and agricultural needs, and restricting new well permits.

records.title: A study in Discover Food highlights chia, amaranth, and quinoa's potential as sustainable oilseed crops to reduce Egypt's reliance on imp...
records.description: A study in Discover Food highlights chia, amaranth, and quinoa's potential as sustainable oilseed crops to reduce Egypt's reliance on imported edible oils and boost food security. Research by Egyptian scientists examined these crops' adaptability across different regions. Trials showed one governorate was particularly favorable for yield. Chia from one region had the highest oil content, while chia and quinoa from another had high essential fatty acids. Different regions showed high carbohydrate and nitrogen content in chia and quinoa, and significant carbohydrates in amaranth. The study suggests integrating these crops into agricultural policy for their performance and benefits, potentially increasing local oil production and food self-sufficiency, while noting the need for further research and collaboration.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Suez Canal Authority (SCA) has launched a ship waste collection service, aiming to become the world’s first “green canal” by 2030.
records.description: The Suez Canal Authority (SCA) has launched a ship waste collection service, aiming to become the world’s first “green canal” by 2030. This initiative, announced at the SCA’s annual event, involves a partnership with V Group to initially collect solid waste, with future plans for liquid waste and a waste-to-fuel facility. Designed to meet international environmental standards, the service is part of the SCA’s broader green strategy, which includes renewable energy and improved vessel management. As a key global trade artery, the Suez Canal’s environmental efforts could set a precedent for greener international shipping.

records.title: To expand the country's green areas and fight desertification, the Ministry of Agriculture supplied the Prime Minister's Office with 5,00...
records.description: To expand the country's green areas and fight desertification, the Ministry of Agriculture supplied the Prime Minister's Office with 5,000 varied forest seedlings. This action, overseen by the Minister and the Director General of the Department of Forests and Desertification, is part of the Ministry's strategy to increase vegetation, combat desertification, and address climate change. Prepared by specialized technical staff in the Forestry Department, the selected seedlings are highly adaptable to the country's conditions and climate changes, aiming to improve the environment and increase vegetation cover. Information about the Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture can be found on their official platforms.

records.title: Jordan’s Alhusaini Group to invest US$85M in Kazakhstan’s poultry sector
records.description: Jordan-based Alhusaini Group intends to construct a large poultry breeding farm in Kazakhstan with an estimated investment of US$85 million. This project was confirmed after a meeting between Kazakhstan’s Minister of Agriculture and Alhusaini Group representatives. The planned facility will focus on producing up to 100 million hatching eggs annually to boost national production capacity. Construction is slated to begin in 2025 and will be phased, with full completion expected by 2029. Government officials anticipate the farm will decrease reliance on imported poultry products and enhance food availability within the country. Approximately 70% of the produced eggs will supply the domestic market, with the remaining 30% intended for international distribution.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the National Agricultural Extension Program, is issuing an urgent warning to apple growers about the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the National Agricultural Extension Program, is issuing an urgent warning to apple growers about the potential spread of apple leaf and fruit spot disease (apple scab) due to recent heavy rains creating ideal fungal growth conditions. Growers are advised to immediately commence preventive and curative spraying with appropriate fungicides for the current fruit development stage as soon as weather permits, emphasizing the importance of rotating pesticides to avoid resistance and adhering to pre-harvest intervals indicated on product labels to protect the crop's quality and yield.

records.title: His Excellency the Minister oversees the launch of the African Integrated Climate Risk Management Program from Kiffa.
records.description: Mauritania, IFAD, and the Green Climate Fund launched the African Integrated Climate Risk Management 6 years Program ($12M+) in Kiffa to boost climate resilience for small Sahel farmers. The program will improve climate info, support agroforestry, livestock, insurance, and build capacity. It also aims for climate-resilient value chains with renewable energy. Mauritania's government and representatives from ARRM, WFP, and IFAD stressed the program's importance for vulnerable populations and sustainable development. Benefits include land rehabilitation and agricultural insurance access.

records.title: Morocco, a significant importer of wheat, anticipates a substantial recovery in its domestic grain production for the upcoming harvest, p...
records.description: Morocco, a significant importer of wheat, anticipates a substantial recovery in its domestic grain production for the upcoming harvest, projecting an increase of 41% to reach an estimated 4.4 million metric tons. This optimistic forecast is largely attributed to more favorable weather conditions, particularly the beneficial rainfall experienced during the crucial months of March and April, which have positively impacted farming across various regions of the country following a challenging start to the agricultural season. The anticipated yield encompasses a breakdown of 2.4 million tons of soft wheat, a notable 1.06 million tons of durum wheat, and a considerable 0.95 million tons of barley, according to a statement released by the Ministry of Agriculture.

records.title: The International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM) in Meknes will focus on water issues amid climate change.
records.description: The International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM) in Meknes will focus on water issues amid climate change. SIAM has grown into a key global agricultural meeting, boosting Moroccan agriculture and regional investment. It promotes sustainable practices, tech innovation, and global cooperation. With the theme "Agriculture and the rural world: water at the heart of sustainable development," SIAM emphasizes innovative agriculture and Morocco's role in resilient agriculture and food sovereignty. The event will highlight water-saving technologies and host expert-led discussions on water governance for sustainable agriculture. Featuring many exhibitors from numerous countries and expecting high visitor numbers, SIAM facilitates partnerships for resilient and inclusive agricultural development. A guest of honor country will be featured, emphasizing strong bilateral ties in agriculture. Structured around twelve thematic centers, SIAM supports national agricultural policy and its achievements in land and water management, production, and export growth.

records.title: The Jerusalem Agriculture Directorate implemented a field intervention to support sheep farmers in Bedouin communities by distributing pl...
records.description: The Jerusalem Agriculture Directorate implemented a field intervention to support sheep farmers in Bedouin communities by distributing plastic tarpaulins. This initiative, part of a broader program by the Ministry of Agriculture in cooperation with FAO, aims to enhance the resilience of agricultural systems in vulnerable areas by providing essential production inputs. The tarpaulins will improve farm infrastructure, particularly during winter, protecting livestock and increasing production efficiency. The Agriculture Directorate emphasized this as part of ongoing efforts to strengthen rural and Bedouin communities through technical and material support and sustainable livestock development, representing a collaboration between government and international partners to create a more efficient and sustainable agricultural system.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture held a three-day specialized training on fodder and alternative fodder production under the "Support to the A...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture held a three-day specialized training on fodder and alternative fodder production under the "Support to the Agri-Food Cooperation Network in Palestine" project, funded by Italian Cooperation and implemented with the CIHEAM-Bari Institute. This initiative aims to boost Palestinian farmers' skills, improve local agricultural quality, and support sustainable agriculture for national food security. The course in Tubas Governorate targeted 20 fodder farmers, with officials emphasizing the Ministry's support for such projects in achieving sustainable agricultural development. Ministry technical staff led the training on modern fodder production methods and sheep farm management. The Ministry stated these courses are part of a strategic plan to equip farmers with modern technical knowledge, enhancing production efficiency, crop quality, and food security in Palestine.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Directorate in the Jerusalem Governorate and in cooperation with the Jerusalem Governorate and t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Directorate in the Jerusalem Governorate and in cooperation with the Jerusalem Governorate and the Biddu Municipality, distributed 800 olive seedlings to farmers impacted by Israeli attacks as part of an urgent response program. This initiative aims to support those whose olive groves were damaged or destroyed, thereby compensating for losses and reinforcing their resilience against land policies, as olives symbolize steadfastness and connection to the land. The Ministry commended the joint efforts of official and local institutions in this support for Palestinian farmers facing increasing attacks on the agricultural sector.

records.title: A pioneering sustainable hydroponics project implemented by Al-Bir Charity Association in Al-Laith Governorate has achieved self-sufficie...
records.description: A pioneering sustainable hydroponics project implemented by Al-Bir Charity Association in Al-Laith Governorate has achieved self-sufficiency in rural areas. Located on a large area, it utilizes modern agricultural technology systems. The project has a notable ecological impact by producing high-quality organic products, conserving water, and enhancing national food security through pesticide-free manufacturing. It also generates a significant investment return and creates jobs for young people in the governorate. The project serves as an inspiring model for innovation in agricultural investments and social entrepreneurship for non-profits and charitable organizations.

records.title: BRF, a Brazilian food company, will invest up to US$160 million in a new meat processing plant in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, through a joint v...
records.description: BRF, a Brazilian food company, will invest up to US$160 million in a new meat processing plant in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, through a joint venture with Saudi Arabia’s Halal Products Development Company (HPDC), owned by the Saudi Public Investment Fund (PIF). The plant is expected to start operations by mid-2026, producing around 40,000 tonnes of halal beef and poultry annually, mainly for the Saudi market with potential regional expansion. Designed for future growth, the facility could double its capacity and will create over 500 jobs. This will be BRF’s third plant in Saudi Arabia and seventh in the Middle East, initially using Brazilian raw materials. The investment will occur over two years. This initiative supports BRF’s international growth and Saudi Arabia’s aim to build a local halal manufacturing base, reduce import dependence, and meet rising demand for locally produced, high-quality processed meat, strengthening its position in the global halal market.

records.title: KROHNE Middle East participated in Saudi Food Manufacturing 2025, highlighting the vital role of precision measurement in transforming th...
records.description: KROHNE Middle East participated in Saudi Food Manufacturing 2025, highlighting the vital role of precision measurement in transforming the food and beverage sector and supporting Saudi Vision 2030. A futurist predicted Saudi Arabia will become a central food hub along the Silk Road due to its significant investment and growth in the sector. KROHNE's General Manager emphasized that their technology provides crucial data for safer, more sustainable, and efficient food systems, showcasing applications like energy reduction in sugar production and fewer batch failures in fermentation. KROHNE's Global Food Industry Expert noted that successful digital transformation requires both technology and user trust in data. The summit emphasized aligning people, process, and purpose for regional food security. KROHNE is supporting this transformation with measurement solutions for food producers across the GCC and the Silk Road.

records.title: Saudi Arabia and South Korea have jointly initiated a smart agriculture complex project in Riyadh.
records.description: Saudi Arabia and South Korea have jointly initiated a smart agriculture complex project in Riyadh. The initiative aims to enhance agricultural production, improve resource efficiency, and strengthen cooperation in smart farming. Representatives from both nations stated that the project represents a new turning point in modern agriculture, a result of integrated and collaborative efforts to foster innovation in the agricultural sector, contributing to food security and sustainable development in the Middle East. The joint project reflects technological advancements in agriculture, combining AI, IoT, and vertical farming to address contemporary agricultural challenges, increase productivity, and improve crop quality. Located at the National Agricultural and Animal Resources Research Center, the 4,000 square meter project includes a vertical farm for leafy greens, strawberries, and mushrooms using advanced container farming, and a greenhouse equipped with modern agricultural technologies to reduce water and fertilizer use while increasing production. The project utilizes AI systems to regulate water, collect and analyze data for crop recommendations in vertical farming, and features a mobile farming system that significantly increases production compared to traditional greenhouses.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture:

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Saudi Investment Recycling Company (SIRC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), participated in Environment Week 2025, o...
records.description: The Saudi Investment Recycling Company (SIRC), a subsidiary of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), participated in Environment Week 2025, organized under the patronage of the Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture. The event saw broad engagement from private, government, and non-profit sectors. SIRC's participation underscored its ongoing commitment to advancing a green economy and the transition to a circular economy, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 objectives. SIRC and its subsidiaries emphasized their dedication to the Saudi Green Initiative's goals, including diverting waste from landfills and achieving net-zero emissions through advanced recycling technologies for a sustainable environmental future. The SIRC group manages a comprehensive network of leading companies in recycling and treating various types of waste and producing soil improvers, making it a key supporter of the Kingdom's sustainable development goals.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Known as the Tunisian cherry capital, Makthar in the Siliana governorate produces a significant portion of the country's cherries.
records.description: Known as the Tunisian cherry capital, Makthar in the Siliana governorate produces a significant portion of the country's cherries. Cherry cultivation covers a large area, with a substantial production increase expected due to favorable conditions and improved farming. Makthar's climate and high altitude are ideal for slow ripening, resulting in high-quality cherries suitable for domestic and export markets. Key cultivation areas benefit from ample sunshine and water, leading to notable yields. However, producers face challenges like seasonal labor shortages and a lack of organized distribution, limiting market access. Farmers are seeking more support for infrastructure and sector organization. With increasing production and quality, Makthar has the potential to become a major international cherry player, contingent on efforts to structure the sector and develop exports. Historically significant, Makthar now represents agricultural resilience and innovation, with future success depending on overcoming challenges and promoting its key fruit.

records.title: The Environment Minister announced in Tunis that 11,500 hectares of agricultural land, mainly olive groves, will be irrigated with treate...
records.description: The Environment Minister announced in Tunis that 11,500 hectares of agricultural land, mainly olive groves, will be irrigated with treated water by the end of 2025. This initiative, in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, will affect the governorates of Ben Arous, Zaghouan, Sousse, and Sfax. The Minister clarified that only 26% of the country's 160 wastewater treatment plants are currently operational and emphasized efforts to monitor desertification and drought, noting that despite overcoming a seven-year drought, the country remains threatened by climate change. The importance of rationalizing water consumption, especially in agriculture, was highlighted, along with the move towards using treated water for irrigation and employing remote sensing techniques to understand regional agricultural specificities and support development. The Minister also praised the role of the Sahara and Sahel Observatory (OSS) in combating desertification, protecting biodiversity, and promoting agricultural products in Africa.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Tunisian date export season saw a decrease in both export volume and revenue.
records.description: The Tunisian date export season saw a decrease in both export volume and revenue. Compared to the previous season, the volume of dates exported dropped by 6.6%, leading to a 5% decrease in revenue. The Deglet Ennour variety, the main export, experienced a price decrease due to increased international competition and fluctuating demand. The EU remains the top export destination, followed by Africa and Asia, with Morocco being the leading importing country. The organic date sector also faced a slowdown in both volume and revenue. Industry professionals are suggesting a re-evaluation of export strategies, including improved logistics and quality certifications, to enhance competitiveness. As a major global date producer, Tunisia needs to focus on promoting its organic products and optimizing distribution for better profitability.

records.title: Tunisia is increasing its presence in the African market through the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) by issuing certificates...
records.description: Tunisia is increasing its presence in the African market through the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) by issuing certificates of origin for agricultural and agri-food exports. This facilitates trade with advantageous tariffs, aiming to improve the competitiveness of Tunisian agricultural sectors and diversify markets. Key export opportunities include fresh produce, oils, cereals, and processed foods, particularly olive oil, dates, citrus, and legumes. The Export Promotion Center (CEPEX) estimates significant untapped export potential to North, West, and East Africa, though logistical and regulatory challenges exist. Tunisia is focusing on promising sectors like olive oil and dates. Addressing challenges like logistics and transport costs is crucial, with the government and organizations working to establish trade corridors. The upcoming elimination of customs duties under AfCFTA is expected to boost exports. Tunisia is investing in modernizing infrastructure and training exporters to capitalize on the growing African market and ensure the sustainability of its agricultural sectors.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) inaugurated a 6.3-megawatt solar power plant in the Comoros, funded at AED25.7 million (US$7 mi...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD) inaugurated a 6.3-megawatt solar power plant in the Comoros, funded at AED25.7 million (US$7 million). The project aims to improve the Comoros' energy infrastructure, support economic growth, and promote environmental sustainability, aligning with global development goals. The solar plant will provide a reliable, renewable energy source for Moroni and surrounding areas, reducing reliance on fossil fuels and carbon emissions, thus enhancing the quality of life. Leaders from both the Comoros and the UAE attended the inauguration, praising the partnership and its impact on clean energy transition and economic stability. The project, integrating with the national grid, highlights ADFD’s long-term support for the Comoros’ development in critical sectors.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Fund for Development (ADFD)

records.title: The Council of Ministers in Algeria has approved a unified national price of forty thousand Algerian dinars (40,000 DA) for imported Eid...
records.description: The Council of Ministers in Algeria has approved a unified national price of forty thousand Algerian dinars (40,000 DA) for imported Eid sheep, following a proposal from the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries. During a meeting chaired by the President of the Republic, it was noted that new statistical data from the Ministry of Agriculture represents "a first step to put the sector on the right track and promote the various sectors and the expansion of irrigated areas." The President also instructed the Minister of Agriculture to "carefully monitor Saharan agriculture in terms of actual production levels on the ground.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Minister of Municipalities and Agriculture Affairs inspected the progress of the development project for two parks in the Sitra housi...
records.description: The Minister of Municipalities and Agriculture Affairs inspected the progress of the development project for two parks in the Sitra housing project, where the completion rate has reached 40%. The inspection was attended by the Chairman of the Capital Municipal Council, the Capital Municipality Director-General, and the Assistant Undersecretary for Housing Services Affairs. The Minister emphasized the commitment to advancing service projects that support the country’s development and highlighted the Ministry’s efforts to enhance parks and public facilities, expand green spaces, and improve park infrastructure to meet community needs. The first park in Sitra’s housing city, spanning 2,104 square metres, will feature two padel courts, over 50 trees, and 680 square metres of ground cover. The second regional park, covering 2,176 square metres, will include a multi-activity playground, approximately 50 trees, 680 square metres of ground cover, 26 parking spaces, and four seating areas. The Minister underscored the importance of collaboration with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning to ensure integrated services within housing projects, optimize spaces, bring municipal services closer to residents, and enhance the urban landscape and environmental quality of these areas.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities and Agriculture Affairs

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Seed Inspection and Certification Department has launched the final field inspection campaign for the current agricultural season.
records.description: The Seed Inspection and Certification Department has launched the final field inspection campaign for the current agricultural season. Under the patronage of the Minister of Agriculture, Chairman of the National Seed Council, and with the direct guidance of the Director General of the Seed Inspection and Certification Department, specialized technical committees composed of experienced staff have been formed, in accordance with Law 50 of 2012, to conduct field inspections ensuring the application of approved technical standards for high-grade seed production fields. The Director General stated that this final phase complements the department's efforts to implement the initial field inspection, which included recording accurate data on the inspected fields. The final inspection begins when the plants reach physiological maturity and continues through harvest, a key step in ensuring the quality of the seeds produced, contributing to supporting the agricultural process and achieving national food security.
records.institution: The Seed Inspection and Certification Department

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued a call for citizens to support Lebanese potatoes as the harvest season commences.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has issued a call for citizens to support Lebanese potatoes as the harvest season commences. The Ministry specifically highlighted potatoes grown in the Akkar Plain, noting their high quality and distinctive taste. In a statement, the Ministry pointed out the significant efforts of Akkar farmers in cultivating potatoes using sustainable agricultural practices that protect the environment and ensure a healthy and safe product for Lebanese markets, emphasizing that Akkar potatoes are a vital part of local agricultural production. The Ministry stressed that citizens' support for Lebanese potatoes directly stimulates the economic cycle in agricultural areas and strengthens farmers' resilience and continued production despite challenging economic conditions.

records.title: The 7th Oman International Food Safety and Quality Conference, held at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Center, gathered 500 specialist...
records.description: The 7th Oman International Food Safety and Quality Conference, held at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Center, gathered 500 specialists from 32 countries presenting 26 papers. Under the patronage of a Secretary-General from the Council of Ministers, the event featured opening remarks from the Director General of the Food Safety and Quality Center at the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, who emphasized the ministry's collaboration with government and private sectors to build a sustainable food safety system and the conference's role as a strategic platform for regional food safety solutions. The President of IUFoST and CEO of the Global Food Legislation Organisation highlighted the conference as a global forum to address agricultural and livestock challenges and explore technological solutions. Key themes include modernizing food safety, quality control, food fraud verification, analytical methods, risk assessment, and green food supply chains. Organized by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources with government and private sector collaboration, the three-day event was attended by the Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources and other officials.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah) branch in Jazan Region is a key agricultural center...
records.description: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah) branch in Jazan Region is a key agricultural center in the Kingdom, providing significant services through agricultural research. It aims to advance regional agricultural development scientifically, especially in tropical fruits and field crops, leading to improved crop composition and farmer income. Utilizing the region's climate and water resources, Estidamah has successfully cultivated tropical and subtropical fruits, aligning with national agricultural goals. The Jazan branch manages a large agricultural field with over 65 crop varieties and studies others. It also focuses on plant disease control to produce healthy seedlings and develop biological resistance.
records.institution: The National Center for Sustainable Agriculture Research and Development (Estidamah)

records.title: The National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program participated in the fourth edition of the Middle East Poultry Expo at the Riyadh...
records.description: The National Livestock and Fisheries Development Program participated in the fourth edition of the Middle East Poultry Expo at the Riyadh International Convention and Exhibition Center. The participation aimed to showcase key initiatives, achievements, and projects designed to advance Saudi Arabia's poultry sector. It also sought to promote local product marketing in global markets and highlight promising investment opportunities and incentives for investors in the poultry industry. Saudi Arabia's poultry sector is a major and rapidly growing sector in the region, driven by increasing government support led by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, which provides loans and facilities to poultry projects. There is also a coordinated effort to boost investment in this sector, in collaboration with the private sector, to achieve the food security goals of the Kingdom's Vision 2030.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: RedStart Tunisia launched "Women Go Green" to support 60 female eco-entrepreneurs nationwide for green economy projects.
records.description: RedStart Tunisia launched "Women Go Green" to support 60 female eco-entrepreneurs nationwide for green economy projects. The program offers training, mentoring, and funding in sustainable agriculture, eco-tourism, waste management, renewable energy, and green tech in select governorates. It aims to foster sustainable women-led businesses for Tunisia's ecological transition, potentially creating numerous jobs, with support from the Ministry of Environment and international organizations. Promising projects will receive grants and loans. Experts will assist with business models and market access. Applications are online via RedStart Tunisia's website, followed by interviews and evaluations. The initiative seeks to build a sustainable entrepreneurial ecosystem with women central to Tunisia's economic and environmental transformation.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Bids were opened for the supply, installation, and operation of a solar energy system at the Information Systems Center of the Ministry o...
records.description: Bids were opened for the supply, installation, and operation of a solar energy system at the Information Systems Center of the Ministry of Agriculture. The Tender Committee of the Agricultural and Fisheries Production Promotion Fund oversaw the bid opening, with representatives from bidding companies in attendance. The committee decided to refer the submitted bids to the technical evaluation committee for review and assessment based on the tender documents' conditions and standards. The committee emphasized adherence to the specified conditions and technical specifications and agreed to forward the results to the awarding committee to proceed with the procurement process in accordance with the law. This project is part of the fund's efforts to support sustainability and clean energy initiatives in the agricultural sector, aiming to promote the transition to renewable energy and enhance institutional performance efficiency.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has launched the second phase of producing and marketing 2,500 tons of locall...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has launched the second phase of producing and marketing 2,500 tons of locally frozen broiler chicken as an alternative to imported frozen chicken. During the launch, a representative from the Agricultural Marketing and Trade sector stated that this initiative aligns with the ministry’s strategy to reduce import costs, encourage local production, and support small poultry farmers in returning to production. This will be achieved by regulating sales based on weight and fostering competition to supply chicken with high standards and reasonable prices that satisfy both producers and consumers. A representative from the Poultry Unit emphasized the importance of contract farming in producing and marketing frozen broiler chicken to replace imports. He explained that the initiative operates under an organized mechanism involving multi-purpose cooperative associations comprising poultry breeders, producers, importers, production companies, and slaughterhouses. He highlighted that the initiative will be implemented in phases to eventually replace imported chicken with local products.
records.institution: The The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources

records.title: he Council of Ministers approved a unified national price of forty thousand Algerian dinars (40,000 DA) for imported Eid sheep during its...
records.description: he Council of Ministers approved a unified national price of forty thousand Algerian dinars (40,000 DA) for imported Eid sheep during its meeting chaired by the President of the Republic. This decision followed a proposal from the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries. The President stated that new statistical data from the Ministry of Agriculture is a first step to improve the sector and promote various areas, including the extension of irrigated land. The President also instructed the Minister of Agriculture to closely monitor Saharan agriculture regarding actual production levels.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation and the New Valley Governor met with a high-ranking official from Saudi Arabia to discus...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation and the New Valley Governor met with a high-ranking official from Saudi Arabia to discuss opportunities for investment and agro-industrial development in the New Valley governorate, according to a Cabinet statement. The meeting explored investment ideas in land reclamation, modern irrigation systems, and the cultivation of field crops suitable for agro-industrial processing and export. Discussions also focused on enhancing the region’s agricultural potential by growing strategic crops with high economic returns. The Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation highlighted the possibility of collaboration with the Future of Egypt Authority for Sustainable Development. The New Valley Governor noted that the meeting reviewed proposals to optimise the value of locally grown crops through food processing and export, supported by the governorate’s comparative advantages and commitment to modern water-saving irrigation technologies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: AAA Holding Group has completed the acquisition of an additional 45% stake in the Phosphate Fertiliser Project in Basra, now holding full...
records.description: AAA Holding Group has completed the acquisition of an additional 45% stake in the Phosphate Fertiliser Project in Basra, now holding full ownership after purchasing shares from existing stakeholders. This strategic transaction underscores AAA Holding Group's long-term commitment to advancing sustainable fertiliser production in the region and aligns with its vision of driving agricultural innovation and food security through smart investment and operational excellence. The company expressed appreciation to its partners, Jood Al-Watan for Agricultural Production and Aljanoob Islamic Bank for Investment and Finance, for their support, collaboration, and trust throughout the process, and looks forward to the next phase of development and value creation for stakeholders and communities.

records.title: OCP Green Water (OGW) secured 6 billion dirhams financing from CDG Group to expand desalination for OCP Group's sustainability and indust...
records.description: OCP Green Water (OGW) secured 6 billion dirhams financing from CDG Group to expand desalination for OCP Group's sustainability and industrial efficiency goals. OGW aims for 630 million m³ annual capacity by a target year, also supplying urban and agricultural areas, enhancing OCP Group's water autonomy. This aligns with CDG Group's commitment to national water security and responsible management. The CEO of OGW sees this funding as key for their sustainable water strategy with CDG Group, while CDG Capital's Managing Director highlights its fit with their strategy to support strategic national projects for water security and resource management.

records.title: The Agricultural and Marine Sciences Group at the College of Agricultural and Marine Sciences at Sultan Qaboos University (SQU) hosted th...
records.description: The Agricultural and Marine Sciences Group at the College of Agricultural and Marine Sciences at Sultan Qaboos University (SQU) hosted the 13th Agricultural Science Festival in the university's Grand Hall. The festival, themed "Reach: From Roots to Horizons," emphasized sustainability, innovation, and community engagement, serving as a key platform for students to raise awareness about the agricultural and marine sectors' importance in achieving national goals. Activities included scientific exhibitions, workshops, and interactive stations presenting agricultural and environmental information engagingly. The festival focused on food security, agricultural sustainability, modern technologies, and biodiversity, addressing environmental and economic challenges with innovative solutions aligned with national sustainable development. Over 120 students and researchers showcased their work and competed in a research competition promoting student talent in areas like food security and smart agriculture. Open to the public, the festival aimed to simplify scientific concepts and present agriculture as a vital science for a sustainable future. An entrepreneur in agricultural tourism highlighted the festival's value for showcasing ideas and fostering collaborations, noting its educational importance for students to engage with agriculture, environment, and sustainability.

records.title: Strawberry cultivation is thriving in Najran, demonstrating the region's capacity to utilize local resources and advanced technologies fo...
records.description: Strawberry cultivation is thriving in Najran, demonstrating the region's capacity to utilize local resources and advanced technologies for sustainable agriculture, reinforcing its position as a key agricultural region in Saudi Arabia. The Executive Director of the Cooperative Agricultural Association West of Najran stated that Najran is a highly promising region for diversifying agricultural activities, with strawberry cultivation achieving significant success due to the region's favorable climate and fertile soil, ideal for producing high-quality strawberries. Through the adoption of greenhouses and suspended farming techniques, local farmers have successfully met local market demands and contributed to food security, with daily production reaching nearly 500 packages in the last season. The Executive Director also highlighted that Najran-grown strawberries are known for their large size and distinctive flavor, making them a preferred choice for consumers regionally and beyond.
records.institution: The Cooperative Agricultural Association West of Najran

records.title: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture launched the "Green Leader Initiative" in Riyadh.
records.description: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture launched the "Green Leader Initiative" in Riyadh. The launching ceremony was attended by the Minister of State for Foreign Affairs, Cabinet Member, and UN Climate Envoy. The initiative, under the slogan "Their path is green," is organized by the Environment Fund as part of the "Environment Week" activities. Through this initiative, the Environment Fund seeks to strengthen community partnerships with various sectors to protect the environment and direct efforts toward achieving the goals of the Kingdom's Vision 2030 in the field of environmental sustainability. The initiative aims to spread the culture of environmental sustainability among students of all ages through interactive and innovative educational programs that span schools across the Kingdom. These programs focus on enhancing environmental awareness, encouraging action to address environmental challenges, promoting innovation for climate change, and stimulating a green transformation in society. The launch of this initiative comes within the framework of "Environment Week," an annual national environmental event aimed at spreading environmental awareness in the community, achieving environmental sustainability, preserving natural resources, and reducing all forms of pollution.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture stressed that the National Environmental Performance Index (EPI) is a strategic tool t...
records.description: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture stressed that the National Environmental Performance Index (EPI) is a strategic tool to monitor environmental conditions and inform decisions that ensure long-term sustainability in Saudi Arabia. His statement followed the launch of the EPI, designed to measure and track progress across various environmental areas. The launch coincided with the commencement of Environment Week. He emphasized that the index reflects the environment sector's commitment to providing practical tools for measuring progress, assessing environmental challenges, and enhancing environmental policies, aligning with the Kingdom's Vision 2030. The ministry stated that this national tool, a collaboration with the UN Environment Programme and national environmental bodies, assesses the Kingdom's environmental status and influencing factors, providing an early warning system for both positive and negative developments.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: A ship carrying 6,600 tons of wheat arrived at the port of Latakia for the first time since the fall of the former Syrian regime last Dec...
records.description: A ship carrying 6,600 tons of wheat arrived at the port of Latakia for the first time since the fall of the former Syrian regime last December. No further details were provided regarding the ship's country of registration or the destination it came from, but information from the specialized ship tracking website Marine Traffic indicates that the Russian-flagged vessel departed the port of Rostov-on-Don earlier this month.
records.institution: The Ministry of Internal Trade and Consumer Protection

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation inaugurated the 92nd edition of the Spring Flowers Exhibition at the Agricultural Museum...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation inaugurated the 92nd edition of the Spring Flowers Exhibition at the Agricultural Museum in Dokki, Giza governorate. The inauguration was attended by the Minister of Sports and Youth, the Minister of Environment, the Giza Governor, the Cairo Governor, the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) Assistant Director-General and Regional Representative for the Near East and North Africa, and 1 a number of Arab and foreign ambassadors. Up to 200 exhibitors are participating in the expo to showcase their captivating plant species, according to the Spokesman for the Ministry of Agriculture. The agriculture minister inspected the pavilions of the museum and hailed the outstanding display of horticultural excellence and ornamental flowers, cut flowers, shade plants, and rare cacti. Co-organized by the FAO, the expo will include a number of workshops and symposiums addressing the importance of expanding the use of ornamental plants and flowers, in light of their role in improving environmental quality and contributing to combating climate change.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture - Baalbek-Hermel Agriculture Department has closed the case of agricultural irrigation water pollution in the...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture - Baalbek-Hermel Agriculture Department has closed the case of agricultural irrigation water pollution in the Basatin area of Baalbek, announcing that the issue has been fully resolved in collaboration with the Baalbek Municipality and the Ministry of Health. Following reports of pollution, specialized technical teams investigated the area and local slaughterhouses. Their findings indicated that the Baalbek Municipality slaughterhouse was not responsible; rather, an external source was identified, and immediate, comprehensive measures were taken to eliminate the cause. Both the Ministry and the Baalbek Municipality stressed the critical need for strict adherence to technical and health standards in managing and operating slaughterhouses to prevent future pollution and safeguard water resources. Furthermore, a series of on-site actions were carried out to monitor the area's irrigation water and confirm its safety, successfully restoring a clean and secure agricultural environment.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Muscat Governorate met with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources to review a flood risk mapping consultancy project.
records.description: Muscat Governorate met with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources to review a flood risk mapping consultancy project. The project aims to map flood risks, develop management and emergency plans, and create a flood risk evaluation guide. The process involves analyzing rainfall data, designing flood maps, and developing risk management plans to protect vulnerable regions. Strategies include protective measures, evacuation points, and recommendations for relevant authorities, compiled in a guidebook. Initiated earlier, the project is underway in Muscat, Dhofar, and Musandam Governorates.
records.institution: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The farms of Tabuk Region saw the blooming of over 90,000 citrus trees spread across more than 8,000 dunums, encompassing a variety of or...
records.description: The farms of Tabuk Region saw the blooming of over 90,000 citrus trees spread across more than 8,000 dunums, encompassing a variety of oranges, lemons, tangerines, kumquats, and other renowned regional citrus fruits. Tabuk Region stands out as one of the Kingdom's leading agricultural areas, thanks to its advanced infrastructure and comprehensive government support. It is home to over 14,500 farms covering more than 270,000 hectares, promoting crop diversity and the development of innovative agricultural practices. These efforts play an essential role in achieving both environmental and economic sustainability while meeting the needs of the local market. A representative of the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture branch in Tabuk highlighted the region's substantial agricultural assets that have contributed to the sector's growth and development, noting that citrus cultivation has emerged as one of the leading agricultural initiatives in Tabuk. The representative emphasized that the ministry supports farmers through agricultural financing programs, providing modern equipment and training on best agricultural practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Established as a division of Speedex Group, UNS Farms is a leading urban vertical farm in Dubai, producing significant amounts of pestici...
records.description: Established as a division of Speedex Group, UNS Farms is a leading urban vertical farm in Dubai, producing significant amounts of pesticide-free vegetables daily using an advanced multi-level system for year-round supply. The farm utilizes hydroponics, drastically reducing water use and increasing yield while eliminating pesticides and lowering emissions, establishing it as a leader in sustainable food production. Beyond its own operations, UNS Farms consults on modernizing food systems, making sustainable farming more accessible. Addressing global challenges, it offers a diverse range of high-quality, locally grown produce, reducing the UAE’s import dependence and aligning with Dubai’s Food Security Strategy. The Executive Director emphasizes their goal to revolutionize food production by making sustainable, local produce the norm through technology and agricultural expertise, shaping the future of farming in the UAE and beyond.

records.title: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar province organized a workshop focused on correcting, updating, and entering agricultural expansion data...
records.description: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar province organized a workshop focused on correcting, updating, and entering agricultural expansion data according to modern models. The workshop was attended by directors of agriculture branches, agricultural associations, and development workers in the directorates. At the opening of the workshop, a representative of the governorate emphasized its importance in correcting farmers' data and the volume of expansion in plant production. The head of the governorate's agriculture sector pointed out that the workshop aims to review farmer manuals and forms, update and correct their data according to the updated forms, and provide participants with skills and expertise on how to enter farmers' data into the electronic system prepared for this purpose. He emphasized the role of agriculture branches, associations, development workers, and coordinators from a development foundation in providing participants with the skills and expertise needed to successfully expand the cultivation of staple crops, improve natural resource management, and promote the adoption of sustainable agricultural practices.
records.institution: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar Province

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is intensifying its efforts to propagate Iraqi fish species (bazza, kattan, shabat, and bani) in the Radwaniy...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is intensifying its efforts to propagate Iraqi fish species (bazza, kattan, shabat, and bani) in the Radwaniya Fish Reserve. Represented by the Animal Resources Department, the Ministry continues its direct supervision of the reserve, located west of Baghdad, as part of a strategic program to propagate these fish and preserve local biodiversity in Iraqi waters. The Director General of the Animal Resources Department highlighted the reserve's importance as a "gene bank" for these historically significant Mesopotamian fish. The Radwaniya Fish Reserve is noted as the only facility in Iraq dedicated to these species, housing them in 10 lakes fed by a main canal from the Tigris River with a water flow of 1 cubic liter per second. #Iraqi_Ministry_of_Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture/Veterinary Department has confirmed the implementation of preventive veterinary health measures to protect li...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture/Veterinary Department has confirmed the implementation of preventive veterinary health measures to protect livestock from #hemorrhagic_fever. The Director General of the Veterinary Department stated that veterinary hospitals in all governorates have been directed to implement recommendations and measures to limit and control the spread of the #disease. These include hospitals contacting governors' offices to activate oversight and inspection committees, headed by the governor and relevant authorities (health, environment, municipalities, security agencies, and the Veterinary Department), to eliminate random slaughter and prevent animal breeding inside homes. The need to #prevent the movement of animals from infected areas without a veterinary health certificate confirming they are free of ticks, issued by a hospital or veterinary clinic, was also stressed, alongside intensifying #awareness and community education campaigns and distributing awareness materials to breeders and citizens. The #Ministry of Agriculture indicated it has raised preparedness and investigation levels in #veterinary clinics, increased the presence of veterinary teams around the clock, and is coordinating with local governments and relevant departments to follow up on the containment plan and overcome obstacles in the ongoing #national preventive campaign to spray and dip animals and spray pens, which #launched previously and is still ongoing.

records.title: A specialized training program on artificial intelligence in agriculture was held in Akkar Governorate for Ministry of Agriculture employ...
records.description: A specialized training program on artificial intelligence in agriculture was held in Akkar Governorate for Ministry of Agriculture employees. Organized through a partnership between the Ministry of Agriculture and the Lebanese Order of Malta, the program focused on integrating modern technology and AI into agricultural work for regional development. The training covered AI applications, robotics, smart agriculture, work ethics, sustainable agriculture trends, and practical AI tools for precision agriculture, led by various experts. The head of the Agriculture Department in Akkar emphasized the importance of such training for agricultural development and resilience. This initiative is part of ongoing efforts to support digital transformation in Lebanese agriculture and empower technical personnel.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has warned of a high risk of foot-and-mouth disease spreading to livestock due to new cases and emer...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has warned of a high risk of foot-and-mouth disease spreading to livestock due to new cases and emerging viral diseases in the region, as highlighted by the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE). While no cases are confirmed in Lebanon, the Minister of Agriculture stressed the need for strict prevention, as the disease is highly contagious among livestock like sheep, cows, goats, and pigs, causing significant economic losses but not affecting humans. New strains detected in neighboring countries increase the risk, especially with border overlaps and animal movement. The ministry has implemented preventive measures, including importing disease-free livestock with vaccination upon arrival and continuing the national vaccination program, urging farmers to vaccinate their herds. Emergency import permits for all vaccine strains have been granted to address shortages, mainly caused by illegal border crossings of livestock.

records.title: Gafsa held a key meeting, led by a representative from the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, to address challenges...
records.description: Gafsa held a key meeting, led by a representative from the Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, to address challenges in its vital agricultural sector due to decreasing water resources. Decisions were made to improve water management by speeding up well construction and enhancing irrigation. Gafsa has over 120 agricultural wells, some needing upgrades. A plan to support drinking water access for water-deficient rural areas and farms was announced. Financial audits of local water associations will occur to restructure and ensure their financial stability for better water distribution. Stricter measures will combat illegal water connections. The meeting also focused on restarting stalled agricultural projects, prioritizing farm modernization, arid-climate crops, and agricultural cooperatives. A monitoring system with better local-national coordination and quarterly reports will track progress. Gafsa aims to boost agricultural investment, improve resource management, and achieve sustainable sector growth through these efforts.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries
