records.title: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is actively supporting the UAE’s sustainable waste management strategy through various i...
records.description: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) is actively supporting the UAE’s sustainable waste management strategy through various initiatives aligned with the Dubai Integrated Waste Management Strategy 2021–2041 and the UAE Circular Economy Policy 2021–2031. DEWA's efforts, guided by its Circular Economy Strategy's five core principles, include implementing advanced waste management systems, investing in waste-to-energy projects like the Dubai Waste Management Centre (DWMC) in Warsan (the world's largest and most efficient), and collaborating with Dubai Municipality on biogas electricity generation from landfill sites. Furthermore, DEWA promotes recycling among its employees through smart collection machines and has digitized all its services, achieving 100% paperless operations. The authority is also developing the Middle East’s first data centre powered by waste-to-energy technology.
records.institution: The Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA)

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: Uterra Middle East Agro Industries has inaugurated its new organic soil fertiliser production facility in Ras Al Khaimah, marking the reg...
records.description: Uterra Middle East Agro Industries has inaugurated its new organic soil fertiliser production facility in Ras Al Khaimah, marking the region's first dedicated facility for sustainable agricultural products with a US$20 million investment. The opening event, attended by Uterra's founder and RAKEZ Group CEO, showcased the facility's advanced organic production processes, including vertical farming, and its focus on chemical-free, non-GMO fertilisers and innovative cultivation methods. The 33,000 m2 facility aims to produce high-efficiency micro-biological organic fertilisers and enhance the year-round production of fresh produce. Uterra's technology focuses on restoring degraded soil and increasing crop yields while improving the nutritional content and resilience of plants. RAKEZ Group CEO emphasized the facility's role in advancing the UAE’s agricultural ecosystem and sustainability agenda, positioning Ras Al Khaimah as a hub for sustainable innovation. A collaboration between Uterra, RAKEZ, and the Government of Ras Al Khaimah supports the company's growth and success in the region.

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: Uterra Middle East Agro Industries has opened its state-of-the-art organic soil fertiliser production facility in Ras Al Khaimah, the reg...
records.description: Uterra Middle East Agro Industries has opened its state-of-the-art organic soil fertiliser production facility in Ras Al Khaimah, the region's first dedicated to sustainable agricultural products, following a US$20 million investment. The facility uses advanced organic production and indoor/outdoor farming technologies, including vertical farming, to produce chemical-free and GMO-free fertilisers and develop unique cultivation methods. This aims to maximize yield and sustainability, restoring degraded soil and promoting eco-friendly agriculture. The facility is expected to significantly contribute to the UAE’s agricultural ecosystem and sustainability goals, strengthening Ras Al Khaimah’s position as a hub for sustainable innovation.

records.title: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources Ministry has launched various agricultural and veterinary production services through its...
records.description: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources Ministry has launched various agricultural and veterinary production services through its new e-services portal, "Tabasit" (tabsit.ye). This initiative aims to modernize work processes, simplify procedures, and enhance the quality and accessibility of services, including those related to seed production, seedlings, fodder, fertilizers, pesticides, and veterinary medicines. The ministry stated that this step is intended to regulate agricultural production activities, ensure compliance with technical and health standards, improve consumer protection, and increase control over provided products and services. All individuals and entities working in or entering these fields are urged to visit the "Tabasit" portal to register, regularize their status, and obtain the necessary licenses by following the platform's instructions for each service.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The first edition of the "Tizi-Agri-Expo" Livestock and Dairy Products Fair will be held in Tizi Ouzou, Algeria, aiming to promote dairy...
records.description: The first edition of the "Tizi-Agri-Expo" Livestock and Dairy Products Fair will be held in Tizi Ouzou, Algeria, aiming to promote dairy products and livestock sector innovations. Organized under the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries, the event will gather exhibitors from 30 wilayas, featuring a direct sales area, a professional B2B hub, and a livestock feed zone. Partner banks and entrepreneurship agencies will present financing options, and a scientific council will host thematic conferences on agricultural economics, livestock feed, and animal health. Tizi Ouzou was chosen due to its significant livestock and dairy production. The fair aims to connect researchers, producers, investors, and students, and emphasizes preserving local know-how while promoting research and development in the dairy sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: An official from the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation participated in the opening of a preparatory meeting for the World Water...
records.description: An official from the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation participated in the opening of a preparatory meeting for the World Water Forum in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, emphasizing support for the forum and collaborative efforts towards sustainable water security. The official highlighted the water challenges in the Middle East, including low rainfall and climate change impacts, particularly on Egypt's reliance on the Nile River. Egypt's vision on the forum's themes was presented, addressing water security, the funding gap in water and sanitation, water diplomacy, the interconnection between water, food, energy, and ecosystems, and the importance of innovation and technology. The official called for international cooperation, community awareness, modern irrigation technologies, and reforms in international financing mechanisms. The need for countries to adhere to international law regarding shared water resources and to reform river basin organizations was stressed. The World Water Forum, organized by the World Water Council, will be held in Saudi Arabia.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation

records.title: During the Egyptian-Saudi Investment Forum, Egypt and Saudi Arabia formalized four investment agreements spanning key sectors, including...
records.description: During the Egyptian-Saudi Investment Forum, Egypt and Saudi Arabia formalized four investment agreements spanning key sectors, including investment promotion, food industries, solar energy, metal industries, and real estate development; these agreements aim to attract foreign capital, establish manufacturing facilities, collaborate on solar energy solutions, and expand real estate operations, while the forum also facilitated business-to-business meetings to explore further partnership opportunities between Egyptian and Saudi business leaders.
records.institution: The General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Institutional Performance Evaluation and Quality, conducted a workshop on the smar...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Department of Institutional Performance Evaluation and Quality, conducted a workshop on the smart digital agricultural extension program. The workshop, sponsored by the Minister and supervised by the Undersecretary for Administrative Affairs, aimed to develop Iraq's agricultural extension system using an interactive digital platform. A lecture by the Director of the Agricultural Extension and Training Department, Kirkuk Branch, highlighted the platform's role in facilitating communication between extension workers and farmers, enhancing knowledge exchange, and promoting sustainable resource use. The smart extension concept, recognized as the top government program idea in the 2024 Dubai Government Excellence Award, seeks to transform agricultural extension into an interactive smart system.

records.title: The Dana Biosphere Reserve, working with the Bseira Directorate of Agriculture, has completed the first phase of a reforestation project...
records.description: The Dana Biosphere Reserve, working with the Bseira Directorate of Agriculture, has completed the first phase of a reforestation project using "Cocoon" technology, planting 3,000 native trees to combat dieback and drought. This initiative uses biodegradable molds made from dried plant matter to support sapling growth by retaining water and providing compost, targeting semi-arid areas like Dana. The project replaces diseased trees with species like oak, pistachio, and juniper, aiming to improve the reserve's ecosystem, biodiversity, and vegetation cover, while also enhancing soil health. The Dana Reserve, rich in biodiversity and home to unique plant species, is using this method to preserve its natural heritage.

records.title: The Ministry of Industry and Trade's decision to increase feed prices for certain livestock has raised concerns among agricultural expert...
records.description: The Ministry of Industry and Trade's decision to increase feed prices for certain livestock has raised concerns among agricultural experts and sector representatives, who predict higher production costs for cattle and poultry farmers. Despite sheep being exempt, the decision is expected to put pressure on livestock breeders and potentially increase consumer prices. Industry stakeholders also highlight the inopportune timing of the price hike, given the ongoing challenges faced by farmers due to a prolonged dry season. Agricultural experts emphasize the cumulative impact of drought and market instability, which could particularly affect small and mid-sized farmers. The president of the Cooperative Dairy Farmers’ Association expressed concern that higher feed prices, especially for barley and bran, will further strain dairy farmers already struggling with high production costs and low milk prices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry and Trade

records.title: A ceremony was held to hand over advanced agricultural equipment to Libya, part of the Enhancing Farming Employment in Fezzan (EFEF Plus)...
records.description: A ceremony was held to hand over advanced agricultural equipment to Libya, part of the Enhancing Farming Employment in Fezzan (EFEF Plus) program, funded by the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and implemented by the Mediterranean Institute for Agricultural Studies (CIHEAM) Bari. The equipment, including modern tractors and harvesters, will be managed by municipalities to promote agricultural entrepreneurship and support the local economy. The Italian Ambassador praised Libya's efforts and reiterated Italy's commitment to food security and economic recovery. The Libyan Minister of Local Government highlighted the successful cooperation between local and international teams, acknowledging the Italian Agency for Cooperation and Development's role in the project. The program also focused on capacity building for local personnel, aiming to create a sustainable model of international partnership.

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: OCP Nutricrops, a subsidiary of the OCP Group, presented its SP2M strategic program, involving the creation of two new mining and industr...
records.description: OCP Nutricrops, a subsidiary of the OCP Group, presented its SP2M strategic program, involving the creation of two new mining and industrial platforms in Mzinda and Meskala, to increase fertilizer production by 9 million tonnes by 2028. This investment aims to strengthen OCP's leadership in the phosphate fertilizer market and address global agricultural challenges with sustainable solutions. The program, based on Industry 5.0 principles, focuses on digital transformation, sustainability, industrial ecosystem development, and talent management, contributing to OCP's carbon neutrality goals. The Mzinda complex, with a capacity of 3 million tonnes, will supply phosphoric acid to Safi for granulation, enabling the production of 4.5 million tonnes of fertilizers by 2026. The project aims to meet the growing global demand for sustainable fertilizers, particularly TSP and TSP+, and will drive development in mining, chemical, industrial, logistics, and renewable energy sectors.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Moroccan International Agricultural Show (SIAM) will host CIRAD, where they will present their research and solutions for agroecologi...
records.description: The Moroccan International Agricultural Show (SIAM) will host CIRAD, where they will present their research and solutions for agroecological and food transitions. CIRAD will participate in thematic conferences covering camel farming as a development lever in southern Morocco, agroecology and water resilience through the MAHDIA project, the agroecological transition in collective irrigation systems with Costea, and local water governance with the eGroundwater project in Sefrou. These presentations will highlight sustainable water management, pastoral systems, digital innovation, and territorial food approaches. CIRAD aims to connect research with practical solutions, emphasizing innovation, stakeholder dialogue, and local dynamics to address agricultural challenges and promote sustainability.

records.title: The Zagora region in Morocco has begun its 2025 watermelon harvest, a crucial period for the country's fresh fruit exports to Europe.
records.description: The Zagora region in Morocco has begun its 2025 watermelon harvest, a crucial period for the country's fresh fruit exports to Europe. Zagora watermelons, known for their early maturity and flavor, are a key economic product for the region, despite debates over water usage. Producers are balancing yield with sustainability through efficient irrigation, amidst climate concerns and drilling restrictions. Morocco aims to strengthen its position as a leading watermelon supplier in the European market, particularly at the Saint-Charles International market in Perpignan. While the campaign's start is promising, challenges remain in maintaining quality, volume, and traceability for markets like France, Germany, and the Netherlands. The success of the season will depend on navigating climate conditions and market dynamics.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: A specialized wind turbine manufacturing factory is being established in Oman's Special Economic Zone at Duqm (Sezad) by Mawarid Turbine...
records.description: A specialized wind turbine manufacturing factory is being established in Oman's Special Economic Zone at Duqm (Sezad) by Mawarid Turbine Company, aiming to bolster the country's renewable energy sector. The facility, with a $200 million first-phase investment, will have a 1,000 MW annual production capacity, producing 6.25 MW and 9.6 MW turbines, and is expected to commence commercial operations in 2026, creating 1,080 jobs. The project, supported by the Ministry of Energy and Minerals, will supply turbines for Omani wind farms and localize renewable energy technology. Mawarid Turbine signed agreements with Shanghai Electric Wind Power Group for technology licensing and turbine supply, and with CID (Gulf) for factory design. A memorandum of understanding was also signed with OQ Group for plant establishment. Additionally, the Ministry of Labour, APSR, and Mawarid Turbine will collaborate to train 350 Omani job seekers for roles in the renewable energy sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water (MAFWR) is expanding a grape farming initiative in North Sharqiyah, Oman, to boost agric...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water (MAFWR) is expanding a grape farming initiative in North Sharqiyah, Oman, to boost agricultural self-sufficiency and food security. The Model Grape Farms Project in Ibra aims to increase grape cultivation, improve yields, and create new market opportunities, while also encouraging youth participation in agriculture. Launched following the 2023 Grape Festival, the project seeks to cultivate 72 acres of grapes, targeting an annual production of 250 tonnes and an economic return exceeding RO250,000. Farmers will receive support, including trellising systems, irrigation, fencing, and high-quality seedlings. The initiative also focuses on private sector involvement and contract farming through agricultural associations to generate rural employment.
records.institution: Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, via its Yatta Directorate, collaborated with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) to distribute 300 l...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, via its Yatta Directorate, collaborated with the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) to distribute 300 livestock tarpaulins to farmers in the Masafer Yatta region and surrounding areas. This emergency distribution project provides essential supplies to protect livestock and maintain agricultural production. The tarpaulins safeguard livestock pens from harsh weather, enhance farmers' resilience, and promote sustainable agriculture and livestock practices. This initiative aims to help farmers manage difficulties, preserve their livelihoods, and ensure continued livestock production in Palestine.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture conducted a three-day specialized training course on plum production in Jenin Governorate.
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture conducted a three-day specialized training course on plum production in Jenin Governorate. This initiative, part of the "Support to the Palestinian Agri-Food Cooperation Network" project, was funded by the Italian Cooperation and implemented in collaboration with the CIHEAM-Bari Institute. The training aimed to enhance Palestinian farmers' capabilities, improve local agricultural production quality, and promote sustainable agriculture by focusing on economically viable plum varieties. The course, organized by the Jenin Agriculture Directorate, targeted 30 farmers specializing in plum cultivation. The training covered modern technologies and scientific methods for plum cultivation and agricultural management, aligning with the Ministry's strategic plan to provide farmers with updated knowledge and expertise to improve agricultural efficiency and food security.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture held a three-day training course on plum production in Jenin Governorate, targeting 30 plum farme...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture held a three-day training course on plum production in Jenin Governorate, targeting 30 plum farmers within the almond sector. This course, part of the "Support to the Palestinian Agri-Food Cooperation Network" project funded by the Italian Cooperation and implemented with CIHEAM-Bari Institute, aimed to enhance farmer capabilities and improve local agricultural production quality. The training, organized by the Jenin Agriculture Directorate, covered modern technologies and scientific methods for plum cultivation and agricultural management. The Ministry emphasized that these courses are part of a strategic plan to provide farmers with modern technical knowledge, improve crop quality, and enhance food security in Palestine.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, distributed advanced irrig...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Agriculture Directorate, distributed advanced irrigation networks for thyme cultivation across 9 dunams. This initiative, part of the project "Supporting marginalized and affected communities to transition to more resilient and sustainable economic growth in the occupied Palestinian territories," aims to support farmers in marginalized areas and promote sustainable agricultural growth. The project, implemented in partnership with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development and Oxfam International, focuses on improving livelihoods and enhancing farmers' resilience. Ministry officials highlighted the importance of supporting aromatic crop cultivation, increasing farmers' incomes, and promoting efficient water resource use. The initiative underscores the importance of partnerships between government agencies, civil society organizations, and donors to foster agricultural investments and economic sustainability in marginalized areas.

records.title: An official from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture launched the official logo of the World Water Forum 2027 in Riyadh, m...
records.description: An official from the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture launched the official logo of the World Water Forum 2027 in Riyadh, marking the start of preparatory events for the forum, which will be held in the Middle East for the first time. The event gathered experts to address global water issues and plan for the 2027 forum. The official emphasized Saudi Arabia's commitment to international cooperation in tackling water challenges and achieving Sustainable Development Goal 6 (SDG 6). They highlighted Saudi Arabia's national water strategy, Integrated Water Resources Management, and long-term supply and demand plans, all aligned with Saudi Vision 2030. They also mentioned the establishment of the Global Water Organization and an International Water Research Center. A representative from the World Water Council discussed the framework for the 11th forum and the need to prioritize water globally. A Deputy Minister for Water stressed the urgency of action and the importance of coherence, integration, and unified efforts to achieve SDG 6, emphasizing financing, innovation, diplomacy, and environmental considerations. The World Water Forum 2027 will serve as a platform for international water management discussions.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Al-Baha Region in Saudi Arabia is presented as a model for sustainable agricultural development, featuring 19 agricultural cities tha...
records.description: The Al-Baha Region in Saudi Arabia is presented as a model for sustainable agricultural development, featuring 19 agricultural cities that bolster food security, support the local economy, and align with Saudi Vision 2030. The region benefits from significant rainfall, allowing for water storage in numerous dams. These agricultural cities cultivate a variety of crops, including pomegranates, grapes, almonds, coffee, mangoes, olives, bananas, and citrus fruits, alongside beekeeping initiatives. These projects create job opportunities, enhance the region's tourism appeal, and contribute to its economic identity. Al-Baha aims to become a key food provider for the Kingdom while promoting sustainable practices and reducing reliance on food imports.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) and the World Food Programme (WFP) have initiated a Model Farm Project in t...
records.description: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) and the World Food Programme (WFP) have initiated a Model Farm Project in the Socotra Archipelago Governorate, Yemen. The project involves constructing a protective fence, a water tank, rehabilitating farmland, and installing drip irrigation and solar-powered water systems. Approximately 5.5 acres of land will be cultivated, benefiting local families. The Yemeni Minister of Agriculture, Irrigation and Fisheries expressed gratitude to Saudi Arabia and KSrelief for their support. This project is part of Saudi Arabia's broader efforts to enhance Yemen's agricultural and fisheries sectors, improve food security, and foster sustainable development.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.title: The National Water Company (NWC) has completed a SAR400 million project to supply desalinated water to Dhruma, Al Muzahimiyah, Al-Quwaiya...
records.description: The National Water Company (NWC) has completed a SAR400 million project to supply desalinated water to Dhruma, Al Muzahimiyah, Al-Quwaiyah, and the Al Qiddiya project in the Riyadh region. The project, supported by the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, involved laying 172 km of transmission lines and constructing six operational reservoirs with a 100,000 cubic meter daily capacity. This initiative aims to improve water services for over 270,000 beneficiaries, strengthen infrastructure, enhance operational efficiency, and ensure water security in line with the Kingdom's urban development goals. NWC is focused on rapidly implementing infrastructure projects to provide sustainable, high-quality water services and achieve Vision 2030 objectives.

records.title: A delegation from the Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform participated in the Arab Forum for Sustainable Development in Beirut, a...
records.description: A delegation from the Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform participated in the Arab Forum for Sustainable Development in Beirut, a collaborative event by the League of Arab States (ESCWA) and the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). The ministry's representatives engaged in discussions centered on empowering youth and fostering innovation, technology, and cooperation as crucial elements for global economic development.

records.title: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) and the Foundation for Action Against Exclusion (FACE Tunisia) have partnered to supp...
records.description: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) and the Foundation for Action Against Exclusion (FACE Tunisia) have partnered to support young rural entrepreneurs and encourage agricultural investment in Tunisia. The partnership aims to simplify administrative procedures, secure quality certifications, and improve market access, promoting innovative and eco-friendly agricultural practices. Targeted regions include northwest and central Tunisia, where young farmers face financial and market challenges. A three-year program will allocate an initial 10 million Tunisian dinars to support innovative projects, with additional funding from private and international partners. The program includes a call for applications to select young entrepreneurs in agriculture, agri-food, and fisheries, focusing on innovative, sustainable, and community-impactful projects. Selected candidates will receive personalized support, training, and facilitated access to financing and markets. This collaboration aims to develop resilient and responsible agricultural sectors, addressing economic and environmental challenges.

records.title: Tunisia anticipates a significant grain harvest in 2025, projected to reach 1.45 million tons, a substantial increase from the 500,000 to...
records.description: Tunisia anticipates a significant grain harvest in 2025, projected to reach 1.45 million tons, a substantial increase from the 500,000 tons produced in 2024. This improvement is due to favorable rainfall following years of drought. The 2024/2025 agricultural campaign covers 1.173 million hectares, with durum wheat, barley, and soft wheat/triticale being the primary crops. Key production areas include Béja, Jendouba, Siliana, Le Kef, Bizerte, Kairouan, and Zaghouan. The Tunisian government has implemented measures to manage the harvest, including modernizing storage infrastructure and ensuring efficient collection and transportation through the Cereals Office and the SNCFT. This harvest is expected to reduce grain imports, particularly barley and durum wheat, and enhance food self-sufficiency. The Minister of Agriculture highlighted the season's importance and the need for sustainable water resource management.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources, and Fisheries

records.title: Tunisia has solidified its position as the world's leading exporter of organic olive oil, achieving a record production of 360,000 tons i...
records.description: Tunisia has solidified its position as the world's leading exporter of organic olive oil, achieving a record production of 360,000 tons in the 2024/2025 season, with 40,000 tons dedicated to the organic market. Tunisian organic olive oil is exported to over 60 countries, including key markets in Europe and North America, with Italy, Spain, the United States, and Canada being major buyers. The country's dedication to organic production is evident in the nearly 130,000 hectares dedicated to organic olive cultivation, primarily in the northern and central regions. Tunisian producers, supported by government and private initiatives, utilize environmentally friendly practices to ensure organic certification. Tunisia's excellence was further recognized at the Afro-Asian International Extra Virgin Olive Oil Competition in Abu Dhabi, where it won 60 gold and 4 silver medals, surpassing competitors like Greece and Spain. Tunisia's commitment to organic farming and high-quality production reinforces its global leadership in the olive oil sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Mines, and Energy

records.title: Chile advances toward a trade agreement with UAE
records.description: Chile is progressing with a trade agreement with the UAE, focused on increasing bilateral trade by reducing or eliminating tariffs on Chilean products. The proposed Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA) aims to remove tariffs on a large percentage of Chilean exports, including key products like fruit, copper, wine, and food, with immediate benefits for various agricultural sectors. Within a few years, almost all Chilean exports are expected to be tariff-free in the UAE. The agreement, currently under legislative review, seeks to enhance the competitiveness of Chilean goods, attract investments, and broaden export markets, potentially establishing Chile as a strategic partner in the Middle East.

records.title: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has launched the Al Miyah Challenge, starting with a competition focused on developing water-effic...
records.description: The Mohamed bin Zayed Water Initiative has launched the Al Miyah Challenge, starting with a competition focused on developing water-efficient agricultural technologies. This AED8 million challenge aims to find solutions that reduce water consumption while maintaining crop yields, with successful technologies to be tested in the UAE by December 2026. The initiative, in collaboration with ADAFSA, ASPIRE, and Silal, seeks to identify and support practical water solutions for the UAE and other water-scarce regions. The challenge emphasizes the importance of scalability and deployment, with a significant prize awarded to the winning team. Participating teams will pilot their solutions in the UAE and undergo evaluation to demonstrate real-world impact.
records.institution: Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: A meeting in Taiz, Yemen, brought together agriculture branch directors and agricultural association heads to discuss strategies for expa...
records.description: A meeting in Taiz, Yemen, brought together agriculture branch directors and agricultural association heads to discuss strategies for expanding grain production. The meeting, attended by 44 participants, focused on activating collaborative efforts to boost the agricultural sector and reduce reliance on imports. Participants discussed data collection on agricultural areas, irrigation sources, farmers interested in contract farming, livestock, crop types, and production volumes. The goal is to expand contract farming and involve agricultural associations in achieving self-sufficiency.

records.title: Saudi investments in Egypt have reached approximately $34 billion, with over 800 Saudi companies active in the country.
records.description: Saudi investments in Egypt have reached approximately $34 billion, with over 800 Saudi companies active in the country. Conversely, Egyptian companies in Saudi Arabia number over 6,830, with investments nearing $5 billion. Saudi Arabia is Egypt’s third-largest trading partner, and Egypt ranks seventh in trade with Saudi Arabia, with total trade reaching nearly $13 billion in 2023. Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation Alaa Farouk highlighted the strong bilateral ties, noting the Egyptian-Saudi Higher Coordination Council and an investment protection agreement as key drivers of increased cooperation. The Egyptian government has been actively improving the investment climate through legislative reforms and streamlined procedures, with Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly engaging with Saudi investors to address project challenges. In the agricultural sector, over 13 major Saudi companies are already operating in Egypt, and Saudi Arabia is a significant importer of Egyptian agricultural products. Egypt offers further investment opportunities in land reclamation, strategic crop cultivation, seed production, vaccine and veterinary manufacturing, livestock, aquaculture, and food processing.
records.institution: The Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Desert Research Centre and QNB Alahli have launched the Nama Initiative, a development effort to support agriculture and empower rura...
records.description: The Desert Research Centre and QNB Alahli have launched the Nama Initiative, a development effort to support agriculture and empower rural communities in the Sinai Peninsula. Initially focusing on South Sinai’s Sahel El-Qa’a, the initiative will finance 40 agricultural projects to enhance productivity, increase income, and promote social stability, particularly by empowering women and supporting micro and small enterprises. The initiative, seen as a strategic step towards sustainable development, aims to improve food security and create jobs in desert areas. Projects will include training in sustainable farming practices to optimize land and water resources. The Desert Research Centre will provide technical guidance and seek further funding to expand the program across Sinai, serving as a model for desert agriculture development.
records.institution: Desert Research Centre and QNB Alahli

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a training course for its employees on biofertilizers and their role in enhancing agricultural proc...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a training course for its employees on biofertilizers and their role in enhancing agricultural processes. The course featured a lecture emphasizing the importance of biofertilizers for agricultural sustainability, highlighting their benefits in improving soil fertility, reducing labor, and increasing production compared to harmful chemical fertilizers. The Ministry aims to improve its staff's technical efficiency and environmental awareness, enabling them to educate farmers and contribute to the agricultural sector's advancement.

records.title: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, signed 11 u...
records.description: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, signed 11 usufruct contracts to implement agricultural and livestock projects in Oman, with investments exceeding OMR1.8 million. These projects, covering 800 acres across various governorates, aim to enhance food security and self-sufficiency by enabling investors to establish quality projects that improve local production and utilize modern technologies. The projects will be located in North Al Batinah, South Al Batinah, North A’Sharqiyah, A’Dakhiliyah, and Musandam governorates.
records.institution: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Agricultural Development Fund (ADF) is participating in the Middle East Poultry Expo in Riyadh to showcase its financing programs and...
records.description: The Agricultural Development Fund (ADF) is participating in the Middle East Poultry Expo in Riyadh to showcase its financing programs and products aimed at supporting poultry projects and their supply chains. The ADF is inviting investors, entrepreneurs, and cooperatives to learn about its services, including financing for projects using modern technologies. The fund will also emphasize its broader role in supporting various agricultural sectors, with technicians available to answer questions from farmers, investors, and other interested parties.

records.title: A workshop on the agricultural expansion program was conducted in Ibb Governorate, targeting directors of Agriculture Office branches, as...
records.description: A workshop on the agricultural expansion program was conducted in Ibb Governorate, targeting directors of Agriculture Office branches, association coordinators, and the management of the Executive Unit for Financing Agricultural and Fisheries Projects. The workshop aimed to equip 35 participants with the necessary skills and experience to expand the cultivation of essential crops.
records.institution: Agriculture Office Branches (within the Ibb Governorate)

records.title: The Customs Authority in Taiz province donated 666 kilos of fresh fruits to the 3rd Brigade.
records.description: The Customs Authority in Taiz province donated 666 kilos of fresh fruits to the 3rd Brigade. The Director General of the Taiz Customs and Control Office, Mohammed Al-Mahfadi, handed over the gift, emphasizing it as a community initiative to strengthen national unity and support the armed forces. The brigade command expressed appreciation for the donation, highlighting the unity among the Yemeni people.

records.title: On Farmer's Day, the Minister announced that the Agricultural Bank of Egypt (ABE) will increase its annual financing for farmers and crop...
records.description: On Farmer's Day, the Minister announced that the Agricultural Bank of Egypt (ABE) will increase its annual financing for farmers and crops to EGP 7 billion, with state support of EGP 500 million. The ABE will also postpone debt installments for 330,000 farmers, totaling EGP 9 billion. The bank offers diverse financing for agriculture, livestock, and related industries, including land reclamation and solar energy. It supports rural development via the "Decent Life" initiative, empowering micro-enterprises and expanding its rural branch network. The national veal project has received EGP 8 billion, benefiting 43,000 people and 500,000 livestock. The ABE has also completed the "Falah Card" system, now a Meeza card, nationwide, simplifying subsidy access and financial inclusion.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The ancient oak forests in Jordan's Zarqa Governorate, a natural heritage with thousands of oak and juniper trees, are facing severe thre...
records.description: The ancient oak forests in Jordan's Zarqa Governorate, a natural heritage with thousands of oak and juniper trees, are facing severe threats. Climate change, leading to decreased rainfall and increased temperatures, has disrupted the forests' ecosystem, weakening the trees' resistance to pests and diseases. The spread of juniper trees and fungal diseases further exacerbate the problem, contributing to "oak decline." Urban and agricultural expansion has reduced forested areas, while overgrazing and illegal logging continue despite legal penalties. The forests, concentrated in the Bireen District, attract numerous visitors. The Directorate of Agriculture is implementing a comprehensive plan to address these challenges, including patrols to prevent overgrazing, enforcement of fines, and public awareness campaigns to promote preservation and eco-tourism. They believe that with combined preventive, legislative, and community measures, this natural heritage can be preserved.
records.institution: The Directorate of Agriculture for the Zarqa Governorate

records.title: A specialized advisory seminar on bee diseases and prevention methods was held in Baalbek, Lebanon, as part of the National Agricultural...
records.description: A specialized advisory seminar on bee diseases and prevention methods was held in Baalbek, Lebanon, as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. The Baalbek Agricultural Center organized the event, which was attended by the head of the Beekeepers Syndicate in Baalbek-Hermel and local beekeepers. The seminar focused on pests and diseases affecting beehives, such as Varroa mite and foulbrood, and discussed prevention and treatment methods. The seminar emphasized the importance of maintaining ideal living conditions for bees and adopting sustainable practices to support the beekeeping sector.

records.title: The Green Project participated in the HORECA 2025 exhibition with a pavilion showcasing its initiatives for agricultural support and rura...
records.description: The Green Project participated in the HORECA 2025 exhibition with a pavilion showcasing its initiatives for agricultural support and rural development, under the patronage of the Minister of Agriculture. The pavilion featured awareness publications, technical brochures on sustainable agriculture topics, and agricultural seedlings. The Green Project, a branch of the Ministry of Agriculture since 1963, focuses on improving agricultural infrastructure and land rehabilitation. The team emphasized the project's goal to strengthen partnerships and promote integrated agricultural development. The event facilitated communication with agricultural sector stakeholders to exchange experiences and discuss future programs.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a seminar on forest fire prevention in Majdal al-Maoush, Lebanon, as part of the National Agricultu...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture organized a seminar on forest fire prevention in Majdal al-Maoush, Lebanon, as part of the National Agricultural Extension Program. The seminar, held at the Agricultural Center in Deir al-Qamar, drew over 100 participants, including local leaders, civil defense personnel, farmers, and environmentalists. The event emphasized the importance of community awareness in combating forest fires, which are exacerbated by climate change and human activities. Speakers highlighted the roles of municipalities, civil defense, and rapid response teams in fire control. The seminar included a lecture on fire causes, behavior, and prevention strategies, such as brush clearing and buffer line creation. Seedlings were distributed to participants to support afforestation and community involvement in forest preservation.

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests of Morocco opened the 12th Almond Festival in Ta...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests of Morocco opened the 12th Almond Festival in Tafraoute, which aims to promote almond cultivation and support the local economy. On the sidelines of the festival, agricultural and rural development projects were launched in the Tiznit Province as part of the Generation Green 2020-2030 strategy, including the planting of cochineal-resistant cacti. The Almond Festival, held from April 10 to 13, 2025, features over 110 exhibitors and is expected to attract 80,000 visitors, highlighting the Souss-Massa region's significant almond production, with 23,431 hectares dedicated to almond cultivation and an annual production of 27,600 tonnes.
records.institution: The Minister of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: As part of an emergency plan to support vegetable farmers in the West Bank, the Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and...
records.description: As part of an emergency plan to support vegetable farmers in the West Bank, the Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), distributed 3,400 plastic roof rolls as humanitarian aid. This initiative, part of the "Providing Emergency Support to Vulnerable Female and Male Herders and Farmers in the West Bank and Gaza Strip" project, aims to protect crops, ensure sustainable agricultural production, and revitalize the agricultural sector. 2,175 farmers benefited from this distribution, which provides crucial protection against harsh weather, improving productivity and crop quality. This support aims to enhance farmers' resilience and reduce their long-term dependence on emergency aid. The Ministry and FAO highlighted the project's contribution to food security and the preservation of farmers' livelihoods, especially in crisis-affected areas. The project underscores the importance of continued technical and logistical support for sustainable Palestinian agriculture.

records.title: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture will open the fourth Middle East Poultry Expo in Riyadh, which features 340 local and...
records.description: The Minister of Environment, Water and Agriculture will open the fourth Middle East Poultry Expo in Riyadh, which features 340 local and international companies showcasing poultry, feed, animal health, and nutrition innovations. The exhibition, includes participation from public and private sectors, scientific associations, and non-profit organizations. It will feature specialized pavilions for poultry production, feed manufacturing, veterinary services, and animal nutrition, displaying over 800 products and technologies. The ministry highlighted the growth of the Kingdom's poultry sector, driven by government support and private sector investment, in line with Saudi Vision 2030 to enhance food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla launched the first AlUla Honey event at AlManshiyah Farmers Market to highlight local honey quality and su...
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla launched the first AlUla Honey event at AlManshiyah Farmers Market to highlight local honey quality and support regional beekeepers. The event featured honey products from local producers, demonstrating the commission's dedication to strengthening agriculture and creating market opportunities. Attendees sampled AlUla's unique honey varieties and participated in demonstrations and activities. The initiative supports local beekeepers, who manage over 3,000 beehives and produce 12 tons of honey annually, including varieties like Moringa, Acacia, Sidr, Citrus, Mountain, and Valley.

records.title: Minister of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries observed desert locust control operations in the Tataouine governorate, focusing o...
records.description: Minister of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries observed desert locust control operations in the Tataouine governorate, focusing on ground treatment methods and available resources. He emphasized the proactive measures taken to mitigate treatment risks on pastures, which have covered approximately 1,050 hectares in four delegations. The Minister highlighted the FAO's training workshops on locust control equipment and noted that ground and aerial teams are actively combating the locusts, with Tataouine accounting for a significant portion of the sprayed areas. He assured that the situation is under control despite the locusts' spread to additional delegations, emphasizing the collaborative efforts of national control teams.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The province of Tiaret, Algeria, exported industrial and agricultural products worth over 1.8 million euros in 2024 to seven African and...
records.description: The province of Tiaret, Algeria, exported industrial and agricultural products worth over 1.8 million euros in 2024 to seven African and European countries. Exported products included household appliances, construction materials, and various agricultural goods. African destinations included Mauritania, Mali, Ghana, and Tunisia, receiving food, cleaning products, soft drinks, and building materials. European exports consisted of peanuts to France, onions to Italy, and peach pits to Turkey. The value of exports has significantly increased over the past decade, attributed to support from the regional commission for exporters, which provided information on state incentives and encouraged participation in international fairs.

records.title: Egypt's Minister of Environment met with Jordan's Tajanus Group to discuss a digital platform designed to improve waste collection and ma...
records.description: Egypt's Minister of Environment met with Jordan's Tajanus Group to discuss a digital platform designed to improve waste collection and management. The platform, which includes a mobile app for service requests and a centralized dashboard for government monitoring, aims to optimize logistics, support a circular economy by using big data for recycling, and enhance decision-making. Egypt already has a national digital waste management system, and is considering integrating the Jordanian platform to address its daily generation of 60,000 tonnes of waste. The Minister emphasized the government's commitment to developing an integrated waste management infrastructure and directed officials to assess the platform's feasibility with the New Urban Communities Authority, highlighting its potential to attract private-sector investments and improve waste management in high-density areas.

records.title: Brazil's exports to Libya saw a significant 22.3% increase in January 2025, reaching US$60.2 million, driven by strong demand for food pr...
records.description: Brazil's exports to Libya saw a significant 22.3% increase in January 2025, reaching US$60.2 million, driven by strong demand for food products. Beef exports more than doubled, reaching US$16.4 million, while sugar exports surged to US$14.1 million after no exports in the same period last year. Poultry exports, including chicken meat and offal, also rose significantly. Coffee exports also showed growth. These increases suggest a growing Libyan market for Brazilian food products. In contrast, Libya's exports to Brazil remain minimal, totaling only US$49,900, consisting entirely of aluminum waste.

records.title: Spain has increased its fruit and vegetable imports, with Morocco being the leading supplier.
records.description: Spain has increased its fruit and vegetable imports, with Morocco being the leading supplier. Spanish fruit and vegetable imports reached €444 million, a 14% increase from the previous year. Morocco accounted for €150 million of these imports, representing half of Spain's non-EU purchases and 30% of total imports, showing a 12% increase. This highlights Morocco's strong position as a strategic trading partner. While France remains a significant European supplier, Portugal saw the most substantial growth in exports to Spain. This trend demonstrates Morocco's competitiveness and the growing agricultural complementarity between Spain and Morocco.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Directorate, distributed agricultural equipment and supplies to 112 farmers in seve...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Directorate, distributed agricultural equipment and supplies to 112 farmers in several areas. This distribution was part of the "Supporting Vulnerable Families with Resources and Income-Generating Activities in the West Bank" project, in partnership with the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development and Oxfam, and funded by OCHA. The supplies included essential tools like ladders, spray pumps, pruning shears, hand saws, axes, rakes, and shovels. This support aims to protect damaged agricultural lands, enhance food security, and sustain agricultural production in northern Hebron.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Qatar is making significant strides in circular economy and sustainable waste management through initiatives like the Domestic Solid Wast...
records.description: Qatar is making significant strides in circular economy and sustainable waste management through initiatives like the Domestic Solid Waste Management Center (DSWMC) in Mesaieed, which processes substantial amounts of household waste and generates electricity and fertilizer. The country's 2024-2030 strategy, led by the Ministry of Municipality, focuses on implementing the National Integrated Solid Waste Program, which includes constructing new landfills, rehabilitating old sites, promoting waste segregation, and increasing recycling rates. To boost private sector involvement, the Ministry has established the Al Afjah Recycling Industries site, facilitating the recycling of various materials. Qatar is also implementing a phased waste segregation program and conducting public awareness campaigns to foster a culture of sustainability. Through these efforts, Qatar aims to reduce landfill dependency, recover resources, and advance its environmental stewardship.

records.title: An agricultural experiment to cultivate sandalwood and aloeswood is being conducted in Najran, with approximately 200 seedlings planted o...
records.description: An agricultural experiment to cultivate sandalwood and aloeswood is being conducted in Najran, with approximately 200 seedlings planted on three farms, as part of a national development project. A representative from the Najran Chamber's Agricultural Committee stated that Najran's inclusion in sandalwood cultivation aligns with national vision goals, aiming to boost the local economy and diversify income. He highlighted Najran's suitable agricultural conditions, including its climate, soil, and water resources. A local farmer emphasized the value of sandalwood and aloeswood for their fragrance and natural oils, particularly in the perfume and cosmetics industries, despite requiring special care. The cultivation effort aims to create new investment opportunities, strengthen the national economy, support sustainable development, and preserve environmental heritage.

records.title: APIA, in collaboration with DGREE, BTS, and GIZ, has launched a final expanded call for expressions of interest for its Project for the V...
records.description: APIA, in collaboration with DGREE, BTS, and GIZ, has launched a final expanded call for expressions of interest for its Project for the Valorization of Irrigated Areas through the Development of Value Chains (PVPI-DCV), financed by the African Development Bank (ADB). This call is for those wishing to invest in the agricultural sector and create sustainable jobs in Sidi Bouzid, Kairouan, and Kasserine. The PVPI-DCV project offers advantageous financing, including a repayable interest-free grant with a grace period and extended repayment terms. Participants will also receive comprehensive personalized technical and strategic support, along with targeted training to enhance entrepreneurial skills, and access to marketing and partnership networks for project development.

records.title: The Undersecretary of Al-Bayda province and the Engineering Supervision Officer of the Central Intervention Unit inaugurated the distribu...
records.description: The Undersecretary of Al-Bayda province and the Engineering Supervision Officer of the Central Intervention Unit inaugurated the distribution of 3,500 bags of cement to support road and agricultural initiative projects in the province. The initiative aims to motivate community involvement in implementing service and development projects. The Undersecretary praised community efforts and emphasized the need for project supervision. The Supervision Officer highlighted the unit's commitment to accelerating project implementation and supporting new initiatives to improve infrastructure.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: A commission from the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries visited the commune of Sedrata in Souk Ahras to assess the...
records.description: A commission from the Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries visited the commune of Sedrata in Souk Ahras to assess the agricultural situation, focusing on the impact of current climate challenges on crops. The commission, comprising representatives from various agricultural institutes and the local phytosanitary inspection, examined production stages, irrigation, disease prevention, and farmer needs for fertilizers and pesticides. They aim to compile a detailed report with practical proposals to mitigate climate change effects and enhance farmer support, contributing to the State's policy of improving local agriculture and ensuring food security. Sedrata's fertile plain is crucial for cereal and vegetable production, making it a strategic area for regional and national food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: Egypt's Minister of Environment met with Sweden's Ambassador to Cairo to explore enhanced bilateral cooperation on green transition and c...
records.description: Egypt's Minister of Environment met with Sweden's Ambassador to Cairo to explore enhanced bilateral cooperation on green transition and climate change mitigation. The Minister highlighted Egypt's commitment to a green transition, embedded in its national development agenda, and its active role in global environmental governance, including hosting past COPs and the upcoming Barcelona Convention Conference. She emphasized the need for affordable green technology access for developing nations, technology transfer, private-sector involvement, and investment. Potential cooperation areas discussed included green investments in various waste management sectors, carbon capture, and industrial by-product reuse. The Swedish Ambassador praised Egypt's climate leadership and expressed interest in introducing Swedish green technologies and private-sector expertise, citing Sweden's advancements in waste recycling, electric vehicles, and climate finance, as well as innovative environmental monitoring using AI and 5G.

records.title: The Egyptian Minister of Environment met with a French business delegation to discuss expanding green investments in Egypt.
records.description: The Egyptian Minister of Environment met with a French business delegation to discuss expanding green investments in Egypt. The Minister highlighted Egypt's commitment to environmental sustainability, emphasizing its integration of environmental goals into economic development, its leadership in global environmental agreements, and its focus on climate adaptation. She outlined Egypt's national strategies for climate change, circular economy, and blue economy, and discussed investment opportunities in various sectors including sustainable tourism, waste management, sustainable aviation fuel, green industry, construction waste recycling, eco-friendly design, electric vehicles, and green finance. Specifically, she also referenced the National Bioeconomy Strategy, highlighting Egypt's focus on this emerging sector. The French delegation expressed strong interest in investing in Egypt's green transition and agreed to further explore specific investment opportunities through virtual meetings. The delegation comprised companies specializing in various green technologies and services.

records.title: Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister chaired a meeting of the Ministerial Council for Economy, which included key decisions on trad...
records.description: Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister chaired a meeting of the Ministerial Council for Economy, which included key decisions on trade and agriculture. The council added table eggs to the "agricultural calendar," halting their import due to sufficient local supply, and permitted the import of several vegetables after their local growing season ended. Conversely, onion imports were suspended due to domestic production, and dates and date paste were added to the electronic export license system. These measures aim to support local farmers, improve trade efficiency, and align with seasonal production cycles.

records.title: The Horticulture Department is actively implementing its production plans across its stations, aiming to increase output and sustain proj...
records.description: The Horticulture Department is actively implementing its production plans across its stations, aiming to increase output and sustain projects through the National Program for the Propagation of Fruit and Olive Varieties. Ongoing field work includes essential agricultural practices like plowing, weeding, greenhouse and irrigation system maintenance, pest control, and fertilization, alongside daily tasks such as grafting and seedling preparation. Station managements report promising signs of a high-yield season due to the diligent efforts of their agricultural staff. Additionally, the department's stations continue to supply diverse seedlings to government entities, farmers, and the public at subsidized rates.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Modern Irrigation and Mechanization Technologies Project, has completed a database of mode...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture, through its Modern Irrigation and Mechanization Technologies Project, has completed a database of modern irrigation systems used by farmers in Kirkuk and Diyala Governorates. This was done in coordination with local governorate teams, involving site surveys of wheat farms from the 2023-2024 and 2024-2025 winter agricultural plans. A report is being prepared detailing the winter agricultural plan's implementation and the wheat crop yields for the 2022-2023 and 2023-2024 seasons. This database completion, excluding the Kurdistan Region, aims to accurately map agricultural areas using these irrigation systems for the winter agricultural plan.

records.title: The Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan launched a Country Partnership Strategy (CPS) to su...
records.description: The Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development and the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan launched a Country Partnership Strategy (CPS) to support Jordan's economic resilience and inclusive growth, marked by the signing of a KWD21 million loan agreement. The CPS includes a potential financing package of KWD211 million to support Jordan, focusing on improving social services like water infrastructure, renewable energy production, and TVET education, as well as unlocking private sector potential through investments in high-value industries, SMEs, and startups. The initial loan will finance a gasification unit to enhance Jordan's energy security. The CPS aims to contribute to several Sustainable Development Goals. The Arab Fund has been a long-term supporter of Jordan, providing significant financing across various key sectors since its establishment.
records.institution: The Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture organized a guidance seminar on compost production at the Abdeh Agricultural Center as part of its N...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture organized a guidance seminar on compost production at the Abdeh Agricultural Center as part of its National Agricultural Guidance Program. The seminar focused on converting plant waste into organic fertilizer, highlighting the importance of compost for soil fertility and its role as a sustainable alternative to chemical fertilizers. The seminar covered compost production methods, materials, decomposition conditions, and benefits. Farmers learned about the economic and environmental advantages of local compost production. The Ministry aims to promote sustainable agriculture through these seminars, supporting farmers with knowledge and tools to adapt to environmental and economic challenges.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Malta Lebanon Organization, delivered a specialized training program focused on arti...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with the Malta Lebanon Organization, delivered a specialized training program focused on artificial intelligence and sustainable agriculture for its regional employees. This initiative aimed to enhance staff knowledge and skills in modern agricultural technologies to promote environmental sustainability and improve operational practices within the agricultural sector. The program was part of a broader national agricultural extension effort and a signed agreement between the two entities. The collaboration signifies a successful partnership between the public sector and an international organization, contributing to the improvement of technical and administrative capabilities, the enhancement of food security, and the achievement of sustainable development within the country.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Hebron Directorate - Dura, distributed plastic tarpaulins to livestock breeders in collabo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Hebron Directorate - Dura, distributed plastic tarpaulins to livestock breeders in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and with funding from the Canadian government. This initiative is part of the "Supporting Economic Growth through the Development of Agricultural Value Chains in the West Bank" project, which aims to improve the living conditions of rural families and enhance the sustainability of the agricultural sector. The project provides shelters to ensure suitable weather conditions for sheep and their offspring, thereby boosting productivity and income. Engineers from the Ruminant Department and the Surra and Dhahiriya Units participated in the distribution, emphasizing the project's importance in improving beneficiaries' lives and achieving sustainable development. The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with international organizations, will continue to support Palestinian farmers to improve their economic situation and resilience.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Jenin Agriculture Department, distributed tarpaulins to 80 livestock farmers in nine villa...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Jenin Agriculture Department, distributed tarpaulins to 80 livestock farmers in nine villages. This distribution, part of the "Providing emergency support for agricultural inputs to protect livestock" project, aims to support and protect livestock breeders, enhance food security, and achieve sustainable agricultural production. The project is implemented by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and is funded by the Canadian government. The distribution was attended by agricultural guidance team engineers, farmers, and representatives from local councils.

records.title: Syria has exported approximately 270,000 tonnes of fruits and vegetables to Gulf states in the last two months, with Saudi Arabia being t...
records.description: Syria has exported approximately 270,000 tonnes of fruits and vegetables to Gulf states in the last two months, with Saudi Arabia being the primary importer. The produce is transported from coastal provinces to the wholesale market and then exported through Jordan. Cargo traffic through the Nassib border crossing with Jordan has significantly increased, indicating a recovery in trade relations. Jordan has also resumed fruit and vegetable exports to Syria after a 13-year halt.

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform attended the opening of the "Syria International Exhibition for Agricultural Mechanizatio...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform attended the opening of the "Syria International Exhibition for Agricultural Mechanization, Livestock, and Agricultural Production Supplies" at the Damascus Fairgrounds, which included 111 companies specializing in agricultural production supplies.

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform of Syria, met with the French Special Envoy to Syria, to discuss strengthening agricultur...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform of Syria, met with the French Special Envoy to Syria, to discuss strengthening agricultural cooperation. The meeting focused on identifying challenges in the plant and animal agricultural sectors and exploring opportunities for technical support, improved agricultural techniques, expertise exchange, and workforce training to advance the Syrian agricultural sector.

records.title: The renewable energy company Masdar from the United Arab Emirates has completed its acquisition of Greece's Terna Energy, having previous...
records.description: The renewable energy company Masdar from the United Arab Emirates has completed its acquisition of Greece's Terna Energy, having previously secured a majority stake in November of the preceding year. This full acquisition, achieved through a mandatory tender offer for the remaining shares at the same price of 20 euros per share, signifies a further step in Masdar's international expansion strategy, particularly within European markets. The CEO of Masdar emphasized the acquisition as a demonstration of the company's dedication to the energy transition in both Greece and Europe. With ambitions for growth in Asia and the United States, Masdar aims to increase its renewable energy capacity significantly by 2030. Headquartered in Abu Dhabi and controlled by TAQA, ADNOC, and Mubadala Investment Company, Masdar's recent activities include consideration of an initial public offering.

records.title: Under the patronage of a high-ranking official and in line with a national program, an Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition wil...
records.description: Under the patronage of a high-ranking official and in line with a national program, an Emirates Agriculture Conference and Exhibition will be held at a specific venue from May 28 to 31, 2025. Organized by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE), the event aims to support local farmers and advance the nation's agricultural, food, and developmental goals by promoting sustainable agricultural practices through modern technologies. The conference and exhibition will serve as a platform for dialogue, knowledge exchange, and collaboration, showcasing local produce, fostering partnerships between various stakeholders, and featuring international expertise. It will also host the launch of a National Agricultural Extension Forum and include specialized sessions and workshops on topics such as sustainability, food security, and innovative agricultural technologies, with a focus on engaging the community and youth to build a resilient and sustainable agricultural sector and achieve national food security objectives.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment

records.title: Bahrain reaffirmed its commitment to cutting methane emissions as part of its climate strategy, aiming for net-zero emissions and a 30% m...
records.description: Bahrain reaffirmed its commitment to cutting methane emissions as part of its climate strategy, aiming for net-zero emissions and a 30% methane reduction. The national plan includes energy efficiency, renewable energy, better waste management, and a circular carbon economy. Emphasis was placed on international cooperation and balanced policies that address climate goals while supporting sectors like agriculture through innovation and waste reuse.

records.domain: Fisheries and aquaculture measures and regulations
records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture is increasing its efforts to boost fish stocks in its hatcheries located in Basra and Maysan Governorates.
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture is increasing its efforts to boost fish stocks in its hatcheries located in Basra and Maysan Governorates. The Department of Animal Wealth has introduced the first batch of common carp to breeding ponds in the Al-Sharsh, Al-Maymouna, and Al-Mashrah hatcheries. This action is part of a larger plan to strengthen local fish production and enhance the food supply of Iraqi citizens with a key source of protein.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture signed a cooperation letter with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) to rehabilitate...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture signed a cooperation letter with the United Nations Office for Project Services (UNOPS) to rehabilitate irrigation projects in the governorates of Muthanna, Diwaniyah, Maysan, and Dhi Qar. This initiative falls under the Smallholder Agriculture Project (SARP) and includes nine projects encompassing design, study, implementation, and supervision. The Minister of Agriculture commended UNOPS's support, while the UNOPS delegation expressed their commitment to the successful outcomes of this cooperation.

records.title: The Ministry of Electricity, Water, and Renewable Energy has established a committee to raise public awareness about the rational consump...
records.description: The Ministry of Electricity, Water, and Renewable Energy has established a committee to raise public awareness about the rational consumption of electricity and water, focusing on sustainability, particularly during the summer. The committee, composed of specialists from various ministries and institutions, will develop comprehensive awareness programs delivered through media platforms to emphasize the importance of rational consumption for preserving public funds and the environment. The committee will engage with civil society and economic sectors, especially during peak summer hours, and educate the community on energy-efficient systems and water conservation technologies across different sectors, organizing workshops and lectures. Collaboration with the private sector and research institutions will be pursued for joint projects involving renewable energy and water-saving technologies, aiming to encourage responsible consumption and the sustainable management of national resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Electricity, Water, and Renewable Energy

records.title: Despite a significant 44% decrease in import volume to 1,995,567 tonnes by the end of March in the 2024/2025 season, Morocco remains a to...
records.description: Despite a significant 44% decrease in import volume to 1,995,567 tonnes by the end of March in the 2024/2025 season, Morocco remains a top importer of soft wheat from the European Union, ranking second behind Nigeria but ahead of Algeria. This underscores Morocco's strategic importance in the European grain market within North Africa. The decline in wheat imports is largely due to climate-induced production challenges, with severe drought slashing domestic output, coupled with a calculated government procurement strategy supported by subsidies to stabilize the domestic market amid global price fluctuations. Morocco's barley imports from the EU also saw a sharp decline to 582,323 tonnes, placing it second behind Saudi Arabia. Overall, the EU experienced significant soft wheat and barley exports and imports during this period, with Ukraine being its leading external wheat supplier.

records.title: Dried onion prices in Moroccan markets have reached record highs, nearing 12 dirhams per kilo, impacting households.
records.description: Dried onion prices in Moroccan markets have reached record highs, nearing 12 dirhams per kilo, impacting households. However, onion farmers in the El Hajeb region, a major production area, are facing very low selling prices, between 50 cents and 2 dirhams per kilo, blaming speculation and middlemen for this disparity. Farmers explain that the price surge is due to a seasonal shortage, as current supplies come from stored stocks, with transportation and storage costs also contributing to the increase. Red onion cultivation in El Hajeb relies on demanding traditional techniques and has been affected by recent rainfall deficits and a lack of logistical support. Farmers are calling for solutions such as opening up to exports, implementing sustainable agricultural policies including activating the Agropolis of Meknes project, and strict supervision to protect them from speculation. They also emphasize the need for investment in modern storage and transportation infrastructure to reduce losses and stabilize consumer prices.

records.title: Oman's state water utility, Nama Water Services (NWS), is implementing initiatives to significantly reduce its high potable water losses...
records.description: Oman's state water utility, Nama Water Services (NWS), is implementing initiatives to significantly reduce its high potable water losses (around 40% of production). Plans include replacing old networks, deploying leak detection technologies, and rolling out smart meters. This effort aims to cut Non-Revenue Water (NRW), which costs the utility millions annually. The Authority for Public Services Regulation (APSR) has a long-term goal to reduce losses to 10%. NWS has achieved some reduction and is investing in infrastructure replacement and advanced leak detection technologies, including satellite imaging, drones, and AI, along with smart meters for commercial users. The high cost of desalinated water drives these reduction efforts, which are acknowledged as a sustained challenge. Oman Water Week is held under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), provide...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), provided specialized agricultural equipment to 45 livestock farmers in the southern Hebron Governorate.
