records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture organized a two-day training workshop on "Effective Presentation Skills for Agricultural Extension Workers," attended by 65 employees. The workshop, led by a volunteer training expert, aimed to enhance communication and interaction skills for successful agricultural extension. The Minister of Agriculture emphasized the importance of developing human resources, enhancing direct communication with farmers, and collaborating with the media to promote national agricultural products. He announced that Télé Liban will broadcast agricultural guidance segments twice weekly. The Minister also highlighted the need to raise awareness about local products, such as Lebanese olive oil, and promote local consumption.

records.title: Locust swarms have spread to the Al-Wahat region in central southern Libya and northern areas like Sirte, according to the National Commi...
records.description: Locust swarms have spread to the Al-Wahat region in central southern Libya and northern areas like Sirte, according to the National Committee for Combating Desert Locusts. Despite ongoing control efforts in the south, locusts are re-invading previously treated areas, complicating control operations. Logistical challenges and the need to track and eliminate locust eggs are hindering efforts. Locust nests with large quantities of eggs have been found in southern agricultural projects, indicating a potential second wave of locusts. Residents in the central northern areas of Al-Qadwariyah, Al-Qadahiyah, and Wadi Jarf in Sirte have reported locust swarms and are requesting urgent pesticide assistance from authorities.
records.institution: The National Committee for Combating Desert Locusts

records.title: Locust swarms have begun invading several areas in Morocco, raising concerns about agricultural and food security.
records.description: Locust swarms have begun invading several areas in Morocco, raising concerns about agricultural and food security. Social media has shown images and videos of locusts in cities like Tafraout and Ighrem, near Tiznit, and other regions. These insects can destroy crops by rapidly consuming large areas of farmland. The National Center for Locust Control in Morocco has mobilized teams to monitor the situation, especially near the Algerian border in areas like Tata and the southeastern provinces.
records.institution: The National Center for Locust Control in Morocco

records.title: The In-Country Value Added (ICV) system is presented as a crucial strategy for sustainable development in agriculture, fisheries, and aqu...
records.description: The In-Country Value Added (ICV) system is presented as a crucial strategy for sustainable development in agriculture, fisheries, and aquaculture, aiming to maximize the economic benefits retained within a country. ICV focuses on boosting local production, establishing domestic supply chains, strengthening the workforce, and sustainably managing natural resources. In agriculture, ICV initiatives include increasing local productivity, improving supply chain efficiency, promoting job creation through training, and encouraging research and development. In fisheries, ICV emphasizes supporting local fishermen, developing value-added processing enterprises, conserving marine resources, creating jobs in aquaculture and related activities, and expanding market access. In the water sector, ICV aims to localize water projects, promote research and innovation in water management, develop a skilled local workforce, and encourage water efficiency.

records.title: Ghitha Holding PJSC reported strong financial results, with increased revenue and gross profit.
records.description: Ghitha Holding PJSC reported strong financial results, with increased revenue and gross profit. The Group's total assets also grew significantly. The company plans to use AI and technology to streamline operations and improve decision-making. The Group's focus on operational consolidation aims to enhance agility and drive innovation. Ghitha Holding, a subsidiary of International Holding Company (IHC), has a diversified portfolio, including Al Ain Farms, Marmum Dairy Farm, and other subsidiaries, specializing in various food sectors. IHC, its parent company, is a major holding company in the Middle East.

records.title: The province of Mila anticipates a garlic harvest of 1.55 million quintals.
records.description: The province of Mila anticipates a garlic harvest of 1.55 million quintals. This substantial yield, coming from 3,010 hectares, reflects both favorable weather and skilled local farming practices. The harvest, expected between mid-April and June, promises excellent quality. To stabilize prices and ensure market availability, 24,400 quintals from the previous harvest have been stored for gradual release. This effort highlights Mila's growing role in national agricultural production and its commitment to meeting domestic demand.

records.title: Egypt has implemented measures to regulate its cotton season, banning imported varieties and providing financial support to farmers, but...
records.description: Egypt has implemented measures to regulate its cotton season, banning imported varieties and providing financial support to farmers, but faces challenges from a recent market crisis that caused price drops, potentially affecting future cultivation; while the government's strategy has increased cultivation, delays in payments and global price volatility are concerns, prompting calls for new procurement prices and prompt farmer compensation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, The Ministry of Finance

records.title: The Iraqi Agriculture Ministry has announced plans to implement vertical farming to reduce chemical fertilizer use and maximize land effi...
records.description: The Iraqi Agriculture Ministry has announced plans to implement vertical farming to reduce chemical fertilizer use and maximize land efficiency. Vertical farming involves growing crops in stacked layers using hydroponics or aeroponics, eliminating the need for soil. This method allows for increased crop production per square meter and year-round cultivation in controlled environments, independent of weather conditions. The ministry also notes that integrating fish farming can provide natural fertilizer from fish waste.

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the FAO and the Green Project, and with support from Denmark, is implementing t...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the FAO and the Green Project, and with support from Denmark, is implementing the Agricultural Livelihoods and Employment Enhancement Project. This project aims to promote sustainable agricultural development, increase production, and enhance food security by reclaiming agricultural land, storing water, and planting seedlings. The Ministry emphasizes its commitment to supporting farmers and achieving a qualitative improvement in the agricultural sector, highlighting the importance of collaboration with international and local partners. The project aims to create job opportunities and enhance natural resource sustainability, reflecting the Ministry's vision for a thriving agricultural environment and increased rural economic opportunities.

records.title: Morocco has significantly increased its avocado exports for the 2023/24 season, reaching a record 56.7 thousand tons, valued at $179 mill...
records.description: Morocco has significantly increased its avocado exports for the 2023/24 season, reaching a record 56.7 thousand tons, valued at $179 million. This represents a 25% increase from the previous season, with further growth expected. The main export destinations are Spain, France, and the Netherlands, but Morocco is also expanding into other European markets like the UK and Italy. Additionally, Morocco is diversifying its export markets, with significant increases in exports to Switzerland, Belgium, and Portugal, and resuming shipments to Canada and Turkey. Markets in Poland, Ukraine, Greece, Malaysia, and Oman are also growing. Moroccan avocados reached 25 countries in the first six months of the season, compared to 19 for the entire previous season. This growth and diversification highlight Morocco's strategic role in the global avocado market.

records.title: Oman has imported over 428,000 live animals to meet red meat demand, with veterinary measures in place to prevent disease spread.
records.description: Oman has imported over 428,000 live animals to meet red meat demand, with veterinary measures in place to prevent disease spread. The imported livestock includes cattle, sheep, and goats, coordinated through specialized companies. In 2023, Oman saw a 45% increase in livestock exports but a slight decrease in poultry production. Oman's livestock production index, which includes various agricultural outputs, has shown growth, with current production figures indicating significant annual outputs of red meat, poultry, eggs, and milk. Agricultural land constitutes a small percentage of Oman's total land area. Additionally, A'Saffa Foods SAOG is expanding its broiler chicken production capacity to meet growing demand and support Oman's economic development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.description: Saudi Arabia is actively pursuing a sustainable future through its Circular Carbon Economy framework and national initiatives, while also engaging in regional diplomacy by facilitating talks to resolve the conflict in Sudan. The Kingdom's economy sees a boost during Ramadan with increased sales of traditional goods, and humanitarian aid is being distributed to those in need in Pakistan and Yemen. A healthcare innovation conference is set to take place in Riyadh, aiming to advance medical technologies and practices.

records.description: The Syrian Grain Corporation is issuing an urgent, dual internal and external tender to import 100,000 tons of soft wheat and 20% bread wheat, seeking rapid procurement from both domestic and international suppliers.

records.title: The Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has treated 600 hectares of land to combat desert locust invasions in...
records.description: The Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has treated 600 hectares of land to combat desert locust invasions in affected governorates. Surveillance and survey operations are ongoing in other high-risk areas. The ministry has mobilized additional resources, including vehicles, sprayers, insecticides, and protective equipment. Tunisia is also receiving support from international experts through the Regional Commission for the Fight against Desert Locusts, with a specialized mission assessing the situation and strengthening regional cooperation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: Algeria is mobilizing significant resources to combat desert locust invasions, deploying preventive and proactive measures to protect foo...
records.description: Algeria is mobilizing significant resources to combat desert locust invasions, deploying preventive and proactive measures to protect food security. A regional coordination meeting was held to develop a preventive plan, particularly for southern provinces. The Ministry has allocated substantial resources to the National Institute for Plant Protection (INPV) for annual treatments and has set up teams to address locust swarms migrating from neighboring countries. Large quantities of pesticides have been stockpiled, and efforts are being intensified with various stakeholders. The INPV Director General detailed the procedures taken since locust swarms were reported, including land and aerial treatments with assistance from the Ministry of National Defense. The current locust movements are confined to six southeastern provinces, and preventive measures are in place to curb further spread.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: Egypt's Agricultural Research Centre (ARC) and the Saudi Green Company for Agricultural Development have signed an agreement to produce a...
records.description: Egypt's Agricultural Research Centre (ARC) and the Saudi Green Company for Agricultural Development have signed an agreement to produce agricultural fertilizer and soil conditioners in the Nubaria region. The deal emphasizes Egypt's goal to attract foreign investment, especially from Saudi Arabia, to enhance food security and agricultural innovation. The collaboration will expand into seed production, fertilizers, agricultural inputs, and solar energy solutions. Future cooperation will also include clean energy, medicinal plants, and research. The Saudi company plans to start fertilizer production and marketing by June.

records.title: Egyptian potato exports are experiencing a continued upward trend, with notable growth in shipments to Russia and other markets.
records.description: Egyptian potato exports are experiencing a continued upward trend, with notable growth in shipments to Russia and other markets. In 2024, national exports reached 1.1 million tonnes, and a further 10-15% increase is expected in 2025. This growth is attributed to a stable potato ecosystem in Egypt, featuring three annual seasons and increased acreage. Traditional markets maintain strong demand, and new markets like Tajikistan and the Balkans have opened. Russia has also resumed imports, with Egyptian shipments accounting for a significant portion of their potato supply. Despite high demand and rising production costs, potato prices have fallen significantly due to increased supply and expanded cultivation areas. Egyptian potatoes are being shipped to various regions, including Europe, the Balkans, Russia, the Gulf, and Africa.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture is distributing veterinary pesticides across all governorates to initiate the spring spraying and dipping cam...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture is distributing veterinary pesticides across all governorates to initiate the spring spraying and dipping campaign. 10,000 gallons of Delta Methrin pesticide are being sent to veterinary hospitals for this purpose. The campaign, aimed at eliminating ticks, a vector for hemorrhagic fever, will commence shortly after the Eid Al-Fitr holiday.

records.title: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture, along with the Cooperative Corporation, Advance Consulting, and the Jordan Valley Citrus Agricultu...
records.description: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture, along with the Cooperative Corporation, Advance Consulting, and the Jordan Valley Citrus Agricultural Cooperative Association, signed a four-party agreement to support the Jordan Valley citrus sector. This agreement will fund advanced machinery for grading, sorting, and waxing citrus fruits. The initiative aims to strengthen public-private partnerships, improve local product competitiveness, and support farmers. The Ministry highlighted its commitment to the sector, having previously established a cooling and packaging center. The agreement also emphasizes the importance of modern production tools and aligns with the National Sustainable Agriculture Plan. The waxing line is expected to improve product quality, ensure fair pricing, and facilitate efficient marketing for farmers. The project is seen as a significant step towards completing the packaging, grading, and waxing center, ultimately enhancing farmers' income and stabilizing the citrus market.

records.title: The 7th edition of the "Fish at a Reasonable Price" initiative distributed over 4,000 tonnes of frozen fish across more than 40 Moroccan...
records.description: The 7th edition of the "Fish at a Reasonable Price" initiative distributed over 4,000 tonnes of frozen fish across more than 40 Moroccan cities and villages. Organized by Moroccan deep-sea fishing companies in collaboration with the Secretariat of State for Maritime Fisheries and local authorities, the initiative aimed to restore consumer confidence and ensure affordable access to seafood. Organizers highlighted the challenge of maintaining supply and reasonable prices during Ramadan, which coincides with the biological rest period for surface fish. They are exploring alternative solutions to address this. Participants also discussed the importance of sustainable fisheries management and adapting to climate variations. The event brought together consumer protection associations, researchers, and public and private sector representatives.
records.institution: Secretariat of State for Maritime Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman has announced two investment opportunities, totaling 200 acres...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) in Oman has announced two investment opportunities, totaling 200 acres in Buraimi, to boost the country's food security. These sites, located in Al Sunaynah, are designated for cattle and goat/sheep farming, meat production, and fodder cultivation, aiming to support farmers, increase national income, and create jobs. Additionally, MAFWR held its first meeting for the electronic census (Ta'dad) of agriculture, fisheries, and water resources, focusing on improving data collection for better planning and accurate information. The census will utilize modern technologies and a streamlined questionnaire for farmers, livestock breeders, fishermen, and private sector stakeholders. The Minister emphasized the importance of updated statistics for informed policy-making and to assess the contribution of these sectors to Oman's food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has imported over 428,000 live animals to satisfy consumer demand for red meat.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has imported over 428,000 live animals to satisfy consumer demand for red meat. This shipment included approximately 29,000 cattle and 399,000 sheep and goats. The imports were coordinated with specialized companies, and the Veterinary Quarantine Centre is ensuring the animals are free of contagious diseases. Veterinary staff are diligently implementing health measures to prevent the spread of animal diseases into Oman.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, distributed 1,500 mature olive trees to 80 farmers in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate, distributed 1,500 mature olive trees to 80 farmers in the Jenin Governorate. These farmers had their olive groves damaged by Israeli and settler attacks, including uprooting, cutting, and burning, over the past year. This initiative, part of the Greening Palestine Project, is funded by the Ministry of Finance and aims to support Palestinian farmers and strengthen their resilience. The Director General of the Jenin Governorate Agriculture Directorate highlighted the Ministry's commitment to assisting farmers and preserving agricultural lands in the face of ongoing challenges.

records.title: Larsen & Toubro (L&T), through its L&T Energy Hydrocarbon (LTEH) unit, has secured a major contract from QatarEnergy LNG for the North Fi...
records.description: Larsen & Toubro (L&T), through its L&T Energy Hydrocarbon (LTEH) unit, has secured a major contract from QatarEnergy LNG for the North Field Production Sustainability Offshore Compression Project (NFPS COMP 4), valued at over Rs150 billion ($1.7 billion). This is the largest single order in L&T's history. The project involves the engineering, procurement, fabrication, installation, and commissioning of two offshore compression complexes, including platforms, power generation, living quarters, and other related structures, located 80 km off the coast of Qatar. L&T's Chairman and Managing Director expressed gratitude to QatarEnergy LNG for their trust and highlighted the project's significance in strengthening L&T's global energy portfolio and supporting Qatar's energy security goals.

records.title: Saudi Arabia celebrated its annual Saudi Green Initiative (SGI) Day, highlighting the country's commitment to environmental sustainabilit...
records.description: Saudi Arabia celebrated its annual Saudi Green Initiative (SGI) Day, highlighting the country's commitment to environmental sustainability and the crucial role of community involvement. Under the patronage of HRH, the SGI aims to protect the planet through clean energy initiatives and environmental protection. Experts emphasized the impact of local action, showcasing community-led projects that drive environmental change. Initiatives like the National Cheetah Conservation Program and the National Center for Vegetation cover's mangrove planting project demonstrate the success of engaging local communities as conservation allies. The Royal Reserves' leadership, including its female ranger training program, also highlights the kingdom's whole-of-society approach to sustainability. Experts noted that by leveraging local knowledge and enthusiasm, communities are proving that a greener Saudi Arabia starts at the grassroots level.

records.title: A cooperation agreement has been signed between the Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture, the Tunisian Solidarity Bank, and the German Agency...
records.description: A cooperation agreement has been signed between the Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture, the Tunisian Solidarity Bank, and the German Agency for Technical Cooperation (GIZ) to boost investment in Tunisian agriculture and support young entrepreneurs with innovative projects. This initiative, part of the Irrigated Areas Development Project financed by the African Development Bank, focuses on developing agricultural value chains in Kairouan, Kasserine, and Sidi Bouzid. The agreement aims to provide financing mechanisms for young project leaders and create sustainable economic opportunities. The Minister of Agriculture emphasized the importance of this collaboration in promoting national agricultural production and job creation. The signing ceremony included officials from various institutions, highlighting the cooperative effort to modernize Tunisian agriculture and encourage innovation in priority regions.

records.title: A contract was signed between the Agricultural Research Centre and the Saudi Green Company for Agricultural Development to produce agricu...
records.description: A contract was signed between the Agricultural Research Centre and the Saudi Green Company for Agricultural Development to produce agricultural fertilizers and soil enhancers in the Nubaria area, aiming to foster cooperation and attract Saudi investments into Egypt's agricultural sector; the agreement involves collaboration on seed and fertilizer production, agricultural supplies, and training, while the Saudi company will begin fertilizer production and marketing, and the partnership explores cooperation in clean energy, medicinal plants, and utilizing the Centre's research capabilities, emphasizing Egypt's support for foreign investment to enhance food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, The Agricultural Research Centre

records.title: Egypt is accelerating its AI ecosystem by fostering collaboration between startups, investors, enterprises, and policymakers, with a focu...
records.description: Egypt is accelerating its AI ecosystem by fostering collaboration between startups, investors, enterprises, and policymakers, with a focus on talent development, AI-driven industries, and investment. During "Shaping Egypt’s AI Horizon," organized by ITIDA and 500 Global, discussions centered on Egypt’s AI roadmap, funding, and sector adoption. The Minister of Communications and Information Technology highlighted Egypt’s National AI Strategy (2025-2030), emphasizing computing infrastructure, data governance, AI-powered systems, talent development, regulatory frameworks, and ecosystem growth. ITIDA is scaling AI talent through specialized training programs, aiming to bridge the gap between AI innovation and real-world applications. The government is integrating AI solutions into sectors like healthcare, finance, and agriculture. 500 Global, which has invested in numerous Egyptian startups, sees significant potential in Egypt’s AI ecosystem. The event included sessions on AI-powered innovations and investment trends, showcasing AI's impact across various sectors.

records.title: Government officials met to discuss activating the Egyptian Commodity Exchange to enhance food security and ensure affordable essential g...
records.description: Government officials met to discuss activating the Egyptian Commodity Exchange to enhance food security and ensure affordable essential goods, focusing on fair pricing, producer and consumer protection, and improved commodity trading; the exchange will streamline import/export of agricultural and food products, support farmers and traders, unify trade policies, and learn from international best practices; discussions also covered infrastructure utilization and strategic food reserves, emphasizing government coordination to meet national needs and boost Egypt's regional trade role, while integrating local production with market demands.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, via the Agricultural Research Department, announced the production of salt-tolerant bread wheat genetic cons...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, via the Agricultural Research Department, announced the production of salt-tolerant bread wheat genetic constructs using tissue culture technology. The first generation of crosses between high-yielding, salt-tolerant varieties was cultivated at the Rice Research Station in Al-Mishkhab (Najaf) as part of the Higher Rank Seed Multiplication Program. This project aims to produce callus cells for haploid plant production, supporting the development of improved wheat varieties for Iraq's agricultural sector.

records.title: Germany recalled a batch of Moroccan peppers, shipped through Spanish operators, due to excessive Abamectin pesticide residues.
records.description: Germany recalled a batch of Moroccan peppers, shipped through Spanish operators, due to excessive Abamectin pesticide residues. Tests revealed levels significantly above the maximum residue limit, prompting a serious alert from the Rapid Alert System for Food and Feed (RASFF). Abamectin, used to control insects and mites, is toxic and can cause severe neurological symptoms, including fatal respiratory arrest at high doses. The incident emphasizes the importance of food monitoring and raises concerns about the effectiveness of regulations and control protocols in producing countries.

records.title: Macfrut, the international fruit and vegetable exhibition, will be held at the Rimini Expo Centre.
records.description: Macfrut, the international fruit and vegetable exhibition, will be held at the Rimini Expo Centre. Organizers are conducting a global campaign, with presentations held in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Tunisia, Argentina, Peru, Serbia, and Bosnia and Herzegovina, to promote the event and foster business opportunities. With a high percentage of exhibitors already booked, Macfrut is expected to have a record number of participants, providing a platform for pre-planned business meetings.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: The High Commissioner for Planning in Morocco stated that including rural women in the economy could generate a 25.3 billion dirham (MMDH...
records.description: The High Commissioner for Planning in Morocco stated that including rural women in the economy could generate a 25.3 billion dirham (MMDH) economic gain, representing 2.2% of the GDP. This was discussed at a conference focusing on women's empowerment and labor market integration, highlighting the challenges rural women face, including unpaid work and limited access to resources. The New Development Model (NMD) and the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development emphasize gender equality as a growth driver. While Morocco has made progress in women's education and health, labor market participation remains low. The European Union and UN Women representatives noted ongoing efforts, such as legal framework harmonization and family code reform, to address these inequalities.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The MENAT Regenerative Agriculture Venture Program, organized by Goumbook, has announced its 20 semi-finalists, which include four projec...
records.description: The MENAT Regenerative Agriculture Venture Program, organized by Goumbook, has announced its 20 semi-finalists, which include four projects from Morocco. These projects, chosen from 510 applications across 65 countries, aim to address the Middle East, North Africa, and Turkey's agricultural and environmental challenges through innovative, science-based solutions. The program focuses on regenerative agriculture to combat desertification and soil degradation, supporting initiatives in organic fertilizers, climate-resilient crops, agrivoltaics, biotechnology, and artificial intelligence.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with Catholic Relief Services, distributed 21 tons of fodder to 28 sheep farmers in the Jal...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with Catholic Relief Services, distributed 21 tons of fodder to 28 sheep farmers in the Jala area of Beit Ummar. This distribution is part of the "Emergency Response to Support Palestinian Farmers" project, which aims to bolster farmers' resilience against economic and environmental challenges. By providing fodder, the project supports livestock sustainability amid difficult agricultural conditions. Organizers highlighted the importance of this assistance in alleviating farmers' burdens and pledged to continue supporting the most affected groups.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Catholic Relief Services

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Jordanian Palestinian Agricultural Marketing Company, has successfully...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Jordanian Palestinian Agricultural Marketing Company, has successfully exported lemon shipments to Dubai and Qatar, opening new marketing opportunities for Palestinian produce. This initiative aims to alleviate marketing pressures on farmers, particularly in the Qalqilya and Tulkarm regions, during high-production seasons. Through partnerships with entities like Barakat Group in Dubai and World Fruit Center in Qatar, trial shipments have proven successful, with Palestinian lemons receiving positive consumer feedback. As a result, the Jordanian-Palestinian company plans to expand export operations for the current season. This achievement supports Palestinian farmers' resilience, creates job opportunities, and opens doors for exporting other crops, strengthening the position of Palestinian products in Arab markets.

records.title: The UAE Food Bank and the National Initiative to Reduce Food Loss and Waste, "Ne’ma," have announced a strategic partnership to enhance f...
records.description: The UAE Food Bank and the National Initiative to Reduce Food Loss and Waste, "Ne’ma," have announced a strategic partnership to enhance food support and environmental sustainability, particularly during Ramadan 2025. Key initiatives include providing one million meals from surplus food and deploying "Ne'ma Community Fridges" across Dubai. The "One Million Meals" initiative, in collaboration with over 75 hotels and the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism, will collect and distribute untouched surplus food, while inedible food will be converted into oil and compost. This effort has shown significant reductions in food waste and increased compost production. The "Ne'ma Community Fridges" will provide accessible food to individuals in need, with the UAE Food Bank and Ne'ma ensuring food safety.

records.title: An economic empowerment project to support people with disabilities was launched in Zabid district, Al-Hodeida province, implemented by t...
records.description: An economic empowerment project to support people with disabilities was launched in Zabid district, Al-Hodeida province, implemented by the Central Economic Empowerment Unit in cooperation with Al-Jarahi and Al-Tahita associations. Under the auspices of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, and funded by the Fund for the Care and Rehabilitation of the Disabled, the project provides white loans and distributes 240 cattle heads to 120 beneficiaries in Tahita and Jarahi districts. The initiative aims to promote economic empowerment for people with disabilities, with a focus on agricultural and rural sector participation. The project is part of broader efforts to support needy groups, achieve economic and social development, and improve the lives of marginalized communities. The project represents a practical model for economically empowering people with disabilities and enhancing their productive role in agriculture, contributing to self-sufficiency and improved living standards.

records.title: Algeria has shifted its wheat sourcing away from France, impacting a long-standing trade relationship.
records.description: Algeria has shifted its wheat sourcing away from France, impacting a long-standing trade relationship. Historically, Algeria was a significant market for French wheat, with exports reaching 5 million tons in 2019. However, since 2024, French wheat exports to Algeria have drastically declined, with forecasts indicating near-complete cessation by 2025. Algeria has turned to suppliers like Russia, Ukraine, Romania, and Bulgaria to ensure food security and navigate geopolitical tensions with France. This shift ends a decades-long partnership and creates challenges for French grain producers who are losing a major African market.

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: Algeria plans to significantly increase its national grain storage capacity from 4 to 9 million tonnes within two years, as announced by...
records.description: Algeria plans to significantly increase its national grain storage capacity from 4 to 9 million tonnes within two years, as announced by the Minister of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries. This initiative aims to achieve self-sufficiency and food security, reducing and eventually eliminating the need for wheat and barley imports. To accomplish this, the government will construct 30 large-capacity silos, 16 medium-capacity silos, and 352 local grain storage centers nationwide. The minister also oversaw the commencement of construction for a regional grain storage silo in Boumerdès. Additionally, the government will import one million sheep for the upcoming Eid El Adha to support citizens' purchasing power. The minister also highlighted the growth of the national fishing fleet, commissioning a deep-sea tuna boat built by an Algerian company. Furthermore, the ministry is developing the aquaculture sector to ensure fish availability on the national market.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries, National Office for Food Safety (ONSSA)

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: The Algerian group Souakri is expanding its presence in the agricultural and agro-industrial sectors, announcing two major agrochemical i...
records.description: The Algerian group Souakri is expanding its presence in the agricultural and agro-industrial sectors, announcing two major agrochemical investment projects totaling $1.05 billion. These projects, revealed at the International Food Exhibition (IFE) 2025, include a $1 billion methanol production plant in partnership with Azerbaijan Methanol Company LLC (AzMeCo) and a $50 million NPK compound fertilizer plant with Swiss company Casale Technology. These initiatives aim to boost Algeria's agrochemical production capacity and support the country's strategic agricultural sector. Souakri's expansion follows its $750 million industrial tomato project in Adrar province, demonstrating its growing commitment to agribusiness.

records.title: Egypt is upgrading 150 public slaughterhouses nationwide in three phases, with 41 facilities currently being renovated, before transferri...
records.description: Egypt is upgrading 150 public slaughterhouses nationwide in three phases, with 41 facilities currently being renovated, before transferring them to private operators. The government aims to improve efficiency and profitability, encouraging private firms with expertise to manage these facilities. Concerns have been raised about the potential impact on meat prices, with some predicting an increase due to private sector involvement. Meanwhile, Morocco is addressing a meat supply crisis caused by a 38% decline in livestock since 2016 due to prolonged drought. The government has implemented measures to increase meat availability, including tax exemptions, import incentives, and diversification of import sources, such as Brazil, Uruguay, and Argentina.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: An assessment was conducted in the Al-Dawaya and Al-Gharraf sub-districts of Thi-Qar [Dhi Qar] governorate, Iraq, to evaluate the impact...
records.description: An assessment was conducted in the Al-Dawaya and Al-Gharraf sub-districts of Thi-Qar [Dhi Qar] governorate, Iraq, to evaluate the impact of a climate-induced water scarcity crisis. The region's arid climate, intensified by climate change, poor irrigation, and salinity issues, has severely affected farmers and livestock owners, leading to displacement and reduced agricultural productivity. The assessment involved various stakeholders, including government bodies, international organizations, NGOs, and local communities, and was coordinated by IMPACT in partnership with ACTED and funded by ECHO. Utilizing a mixed-methods approach, including phone surveys, interviews, focus groups, and remote sensing, the study aimed to address information gaps related to economic, social, and environmental vulnerabilities. Despite limitations in remote data collection, the triangulation of data sources provided a comprehensive understanding of the challenges and informed priority interventions.

records.title: The Agricultural Research Department has achieved a significant scientific breakthrough by registering the bacterial strain (Bacillus vel...
records.description: The Agricultural Research Department has achieved a significant scientific breakthrough by registering the bacterial strain (Bacillus velezensis strain BR72 – PP346397.1) in the global database NCBI (National Center for Biotechnology Information). This strain, identified by researcher Ban Sabaa Hassoun, stimulates plant growth and enhances tolerance to harsh environmental conditions, particularly drought, through the production of bioactive compounds. It also exhibits antimicrobial properties, making it valuable for biological plant disease control. This registration marks a key advancement in agricultural biotechnology, offering potential for sustainable agricultural production and improved food security.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Agricultural Research Department has successfully preserved high-grade wheat seeds in Salah al-Din through purification, disinfection...
records.description: The Agricultural Research Department has successfully preserved high-grade wheat seeds in Salah al-Din through purification, disinfection, and bagging operations. This effort aims to maintain the region's self-sufficiency in wheat, which has been achieved over the past two years due to preventive measures. The department provides ongoing technical support to various fields and contracted farmers, ensuring the preservation of this national resource crucial for food security. The department's efforts were commended by a ministerial committee following a review of the warehouses and seed examination.

records.title: Recent heavy rainfall in Essaouira has revitalized the region's agriculture, which had been suffering from prolonged drought.
records.description: Recent heavy rainfall in Essaouira has revitalized the region's agriculture, which had been suffering from prolonged drought. Farmers and herders are experiencing renewed hope as pastures regenerate and key crops like argan, olive, and market garden produce show signs of recovery. Market garden fields are regaining their color, and farmers anticipate a more abundant and higher-quality harvest. The rainfall has reduced the need for irrigation, leading to cost savings and reduced pressure on water resources. Olive and argan orchards are also showing promising signs of flowering, indicating a good season. The provincial director of agriculture highlighted the positive impact on pastures, benefiting livestock farmers by reducing their reliance on expensive feed and improving herd health. The rains have also contributed to groundwater recharge and dam replenishment, which is crucial for sustainable agriculture in the region. The return of optimism in Essaouira's rural areas marks a significant turnaround after months of uncertainty.

records.title: The Moroccan government is extending its soft wheat import refund system to ensure a stable supply for national demand.
records.description: The Moroccan government is extending its soft wheat import refund system to ensure a stable supply for national demand. This decision, announced by the National Interprofessional Office for Cereals and Legumes (ONICL), addresses the gap between national consumption and local production, which has been hampered by harsh climatic conditions. The refund system offers a bonus to importers to encourage international purchases, compensating for the drop in domestic production. This extension responds to forecasts of below-average cereal production in North Africa, with Morocco particularly affected by low rainfall.
records.institution: The National Interprofessional Office for Cereals and Legumes (ONICL)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture signed partnership agreements with four local councils in the Jenin Governorate to utilize approximately 83 d...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture signed partnership agreements with four local councils in the Jenin Governorate to utilize approximately 83 dunams of government forest lands, aiming to enhance citizen access, reclaim the lands, and protect them from encroachment, while creating green spaces and public parks; the agreements highlight the importance of partnerships between the Ministry and local authorities, facilitating service delivery in rural areas amid occupation-imposed challenges and transforming deserted areas into vibrant lifelines that generate revenue and jobs; the Director General of the Jenin Agriculture Directorate noted that these lands will increase green areas and serve 27 population centers, benefiting farmers and local authorities; the signing ceremony, held at the Ministry’s headquarters in Ramallah, was attended by ministry officials and municipal leaders.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Directorate, distributed agricultural equipment and supplies to 112 affected farmers.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Directorate, distributed agricultural equipment and supplies to 112 affected farmers. This assistance, part of a project to support vulnerable families in the West Bank, included metal fence rolls, iron angles, and plastic water tanks. The distribution aimed to protect agricultural lands and improve their sustainability, thereby enhancing food security and restoring agricultural productivity.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: EMSTEEL Group and Yellow Door Energy have partnered to develop a 31.5 MWp solar PV rooftop project in the UAE, the largest of its kind in...
records.description: EMSTEEL Group and Yellow Door Energy have partnered to develop a 31.5 MWp solar PV rooftop project in the UAE, the largest of its kind in the region. This project will power EMSTEEL's facilities with renewable energy, supporting their decarbonization strategy and aligning with the UAE's Net Zero by 2050 commitment. Yellow Door Energy will finance, build, own, operate, and maintain the solar installations across 40 EMSTEEL roofs in ICAD 1, Abu Dhabi, generating approximately 50 million kWh of clean electricity annually and offsetting 16,000 metric tonnes of CO₂ emissions. Construction is scheduled to begin in 2025, with commissioning in 2026. This partnership will enable EMSTEEL to reduce energy costs and its carbon footprint, while Yellow Door Energy will manage the project's development without requiring upfront investment from EMSTEEL.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Masdar has agreed to acquire a 49.99 percent stake in four Spanish solar plants from Endesa, totaling 446 MW in capacity, for Dhs702m (EU...
records.description: Masdar has agreed to acquire a 49.99 percent stake in four Spanish solar plants from Endesa, totaling 446 MW in capacity, for Dhs702m (EUR184m). This deal, subject to regulatory approvals, expands Masdar's presence in the Iberian Peninsula and Europe. Building on a previous 2 GW solar asset partnership with Endesa, this acquisition strengthens their collaboration and supports Spain's National Energy and Climate Plan (NECP) targets. Masdar's CEO emphasized the company's commitment to Europe's decarbonization and global energy transformation, while Endesa's CEO highlighted the partnership's role in accelerating the energy transition. With this acquisition, Masdar's operational capacity in the Iberian Peninsula reaches 3.2GW, reinforcing its contribution to the EU's 2050 net-zero targets. Masdar also has an MOU with Enel Group to explore further renewable energy opportunities in Europe.

records.title: The National Initiative for Agriculture Development (NIAD), in partnership with Ghosn Al Bahrain, Sanwan Nursery, and Abu Subaie Nursery,...
records.description: The National Initiative for Agriculture Development (NIAD), in partnership with Ghosn Al Bahrain, Sanwan Nursery, and Abu Subaie Nursery, has completed the planting of 200 acacia trees at Al Fateh Mosque in Bahrain. This initiative demonstrates community collaboration in promoting sustainable development and increasing green spaces. The Undersecretary for Agriculture and Animal Wealth highlighted the Ministry's support for such initiatives, which align with Bahrain's national afforestation plan to double the number of trees and enhance environmental sustainability.

records.title: Air Liquide Egypt and United Energy Group (UEG) have signed an MoU to collaborate on low-carbon ammonia production in Egypt, using renewa...
records.description: Air Liquide Egypt and United Energy Group (UEG) have signed an MoU to collaborate on low-carbon ammonia production in Egypt, using renewable hydrogen. UEG, focusing on renewable projects, aims to leverage Egypt's resources and ecosystem. Air Liquide will provide nitrogen and solutions for renewable energy intermittency, utilizing its experience in low-carbon technologies. The partnership supports Egypt's renewable energy goals, aiming to establish green ammonia production facilities.
records.institution: Air Liquide Egypt and United Energy Group (UEG)

records.title: Egypt exported 86,000 tons of fruits, with citrus fruits leading at 65,000 tons, followed by strawberries and various other fruits.
records.description: Egypt exported 86,000 tons of fruits, with citrus fruits leading at 65,000 tons, followed by strawberries and various other fruits. The Agricultural Quarantine Authority reported that 34 fruit varieties were exported. The Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation stated that Egypt, with approximately 517,000 acres of citrus plantations, exports over 2.3 million tons, ranking first globally. Egyptian agricultural exports are in high demand worldwide due to their quality. Citrus fruits are popular in Egypt for their affordability, long shelf life, and nutritional value, providing vitamin C and essential minerals.
records.institution: Agricultural Quarantine Authority, the Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, oversaw the signing of two cooperation protocols between the Arab Organisation for Agricult...
records.description: Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, oversaw the signing of two cooperation protocols between the Arab Organisation for Agricultural Development and two Egyptian research centers: the Agricultural Research Centre and the Desert Research Centre. The first protocol, with the Agricultural Research Centre, focuses on developing technical cooperation projects to enhance rural and agricultural sector transformation, including creating guidance materials and expert systems. The project aims to support initiatives like "Decent Life" and improve agricultural entrepreneurship. The second protocol, with the Desert Research Centre, involves implementing a development project in South Sinai, focusing on water harvesting in the Saint Catherine area and training young graduates on unconventional water sources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture's Modern Irrigation and Mechanization Technologies Project has finalized a database of modern irrigation syst...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture's Modern Irrigation and Mechanization Technologies Project has finalized a database of modern irrigation systems used in Baghdad and Nineveh Governorates. This project involved site surveys of wheat farms implemented as part of the winter agricultural plan for the past two seasons. A report is being prepared detailing the winter agricultural plan and wheat crop yields. The database, which is being compiled for all governorates (excluding the Kurdistan Region), aims to identify agricultural areas utilizing modern irrigation systems within the winter agricultural plan.

records.title: In the Béni Mellal-Khénifra region, 114,377 quintals of subsidized nitrogen fertilizers have been distributed to 7,716 farmers, represent...
records.description: In the Béni Mellal-Khénifra region, 114,377 quintals of subsidized nitrogen fertilizers have been distributed to 7,716 farmers, representing 73% of the region's allocation. This distribution, part of the Rainfall Deficit Impact Reduction Program (PRIDP), aims to mitigate the impact of international factors on agricultural activity and maintain affordable fertilizer prices. The Tadla Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVAT) distributed 59,901 quintals to 2,486 farmers, achieving 85% distribution in its area. Twelve relay centers were established across the region's five provinces to facilitate distribution. The total allocation for the 2024-2025 agricultural campaign is 156,435 quintals, with 70,263 quintals for the ORMVA Tadla area, comprising various types of fertilizers. Subsidized prices range from 150 to 330 DH per quintal, offering subsidies between 35% and 53%.
records.institution: Tadla Regional Office for Agricultural Development (ORMVAT)

records.title: The European Commission has dismissed accusations of "tax fraud" against Moroccan tomato exports to Europe, confirming that these imports...
records.description: The European Commission has dismissed accusations of "tax fraud" against Moroccan tomato exports to Europe, confirming that these imports comply with the 2012 association agreement between Morocco and the EU. European Commissioner for Agriculture, stated that no tax fraud has been detected, addressing concerns raised by Spanish MEP Carmen Crespo. While Moroccan exports have exceeded the initial tariff quota since 2019, these "out-of-quota" imports are legal and subject to customs duties, which have totaled €81,088,776 between 2019 and 2024. The Commission refuted claims of financial losses due to these exports, emphasizing that all applicable customs duties are paid, thus reinforcing Morocco's compliance with EU trade agreements and calming tensions with some Spanish producers.

records.title: The Moroccan government has issued a ban on the slaughter of female sheep and goats to stabilize livestock populations, which have been d...
records.description: The Moroccan government has issued a ban on the slaughter of female sheep and goats to stabilize livestock populations, which have been diminished by prolonged drought. This measure aims to support local livestock farming, which has been significantly affected by high animal feed prices and dwindling pastures. The decline in livestock numbers has prompted the government to also suspend the traditional Eid al-Adha sacrifice. To address the resulting red meat demand, Morocco is increasing its reliance on imports, including from Australia, and has authorized the import of a large number of sheep and goats. These actions are similar to restrictions imposed during past drought conditions and highlight the government's focus on conservation policies.

records.title: Nama Water Services has partnered with Al Tayer Engineering Services Company to build a water purification plant at Wadi Dayqah Dam in Om...
records.description: Nama Water Services has partnered with Al Tayer Engineering Services Company to build a water purification plant at Wadi Dayqah Dam in Oman, a project valued at over OMR55 million. This 20-year public-private partnership (PPP) will utilize a Build, Own, Operate (BOO) model, constructing a plant with a 65,000 cubic meter daily capacity. Of this, 35,000 cubic meters will supply potable water through Nama Water Services' network, and 30,000 cubic meters will support agricultural irrigation in the Wilayat of Quriyat, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources. The project aims to enhance water and food security, diversify water sources, and reduce desalination costs. It includes constructing the plant, a seven-kilometer water transmission line, a pumping station, and a 20,000-cubic-meter collection tank. The plant is expected to be completed within 22 months and will employ advanced purification technologies, benefiting from the dam's lower salt content compared to seawater, thereby reducing energy consumption.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Green Hydrogen Oman Summit (GHSO) will be held at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre, supported by the Ministry of Energy and...
records.description: The Green Hydrogen Oman Summit (GHSO) will be held at the Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre, supported by the Ministry of Energy and Minerals and Hydrom, and organized by Birba, to reinforce Oman’s leadership in the green hydrogen sector. The summit will gather industry leaders, policymakers, and global investors to explore green hydrogen's potential in shaping the energy future. It will feature a conference and exhibition showcasing Oman's green hydrogen projects, investments, and policies. The summit will foster collaboration and investment, focusing on local content development, green financing, industrialization, job creation, and research. Oman has secured substantial green hydrogen production commitments through Hydrom's land block auctions, with a future auction round planned to further expand its role in the global hydrogen market.
records.institution: The Ministry of Energy and Minerals and Hydrom

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) announced the first 25 beneficiaries of...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) announced the first 25 beneficiaries of agricultural investment grants under the MAP2 program. This initiative, funded by the European Union, Denmark, Switzerland, and Spain with a $31.57 million budget, aims to support agricultural investment and market development, with a focus on empowering women and youth. It was emphasized that agriculture is a strategic role in national resilience, especially given current economic challenges and job losses. The MAP2 program received 1,640 applications, with 1,091 meeting initial criteria, and will support approximately 300 projects in areas like high-value crop production and food processing, creating thousands of job opportunities.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by its Qalqilya Governorate directorate, has signed an agreement with the Kafr Thulth Municipali...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, represented by its Qalqilya Governorate directorate, has signed an agreement with the Kafr Thulth Municipality and the Al-Funduq Village Council to open branch offices in these locations. The agreement, signed by the Director General of the Agriculture Directorate and representatives from the Local Government Directorate, aims to enhance agricultural and livestock development in the governorate. The Governor of Qalqilya praised the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Local Government for their efforts to support citizens' resilience, emphasizing the importance of these partnerships for the agriculturally dependent governorate.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Directorate, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the Unite...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its North Hebron Directorate, in partnership with the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO), distributed water tankers to seven marginalized agricultural communities. This initiative is part of the "Emergency Support Project for Time-Sensitive Agricultural Inputs to Protect Livestock and Sustain and Revitalize Agricultural Production in the Gaza Strip and the West Bank." The distribution aims to strengthen the resilience of farmers facing water scarcity, support livestock, and ensure sustainable agricultural production. The directorate highlighted its ongoing cooperation with international and local partners to provide necessary support and improve agricultural conditions in these areas.

records.title: The National Agricultural Development Company (Nadec) has secured 1.1 billion Saudi riyals ($293.2 million) in funding from the Agricultu...
records.description: The National Agricultural Development Company (Nadec) has secured 1.1 billion Saudi riyals ($293.2 million) in funding from the Agricultural Development Fund (ADF) for its subsidiary, Al-Ra’i National Livestock Company. This 15-year funding, with a three-year grace period, will be used to establish an intensive livestock farming project for sheep and goats, aiming to increase local red meat production. Nadec has provided land and corporate guarantees as collateral. The project supports Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 by enhancing national food security.

records.title: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) has published research in the "Life" journal, showca...
records.description: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah) has published research in the "Life" journal, showcasing the micropropagation technique's effectiveness in producing bioactive compounds from Bidah pomegranate. The study, "Bidah Pomegranate Landrace: Chemical Composition, Antioxidant, Antibacterial, and Anticancer Activity," demonstrates the pomegranate's potential in medical and pharmaceutical applications due to its antioxidant, antibacterial, and anticancer properties. This research aligns with the center's focus on agricultural innovation and biotechnology, contributing to food security and sustainable agriculture.
records.institution: The National Research and Development Center for Sustainable Agriculture (Estidamah)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Scatec ASA has signed a 25-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with the Tunisian Electricity and Gas Company (STEG) for a 120 MW solar po...
records.description: Scatec ASA has signed a 25-year Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) with the Tunisian Electricity and Gas Company (STEG) for a 120 MW solar power plant (Sidi Bouzid II) in Tunisia. Awarded through a government tender, the project aims to support Tunisia's renewable energy goals and enhance energy security. Scatec has also partnered with Aeolus SAS (Toyota Tsusho Group) through a Joint Development Agreement (JDA), building on their existing collaboration in Tunisia. The project, with an estimated €87 million capital expenditure, will see Scatec as the EPC provider for approximately 85% of the capex. Tunisia, targeting 30% renewable energy by 2030, is heavily reliant on gas imports, making this solar plant crucial for diversifying its energy mix. Scatec intends to participate in future renewable energy auctions in Tunisia.

records.title: Tunisia's agricultural sector experienced growth in 2024, driven by private investments totaling 444.6 million Tunisian dinars (approxima...
records.description: Tunisia's agricultural sector experienced growth in 2024, driven by private investments totaling 444.6 million Tunisian dinars (approximately 136 million euros). The Tunisian Agency for the Promotion of Agricultural Investments (APIA) supported 3,001 projects, creating 3,000 permanent jobs across various categories, including creation, extension, and renewal. Regions like Kairouan and Kasserine saw significant job creation. Approved projects received 129.4 million dinars in grants, representing 29.1% of the total investment, which encouraged investment in sectors like aquaculture and agri-food processing. This investment trend reflects Tunisia's efforts to modernize and diversify its agricultural sector through financial incentives and increased investor interest.
records.institution: Tunisian Agency for the Promotion of Agricultural Investments (APIA)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Tunisian authorities are initiating the National Green Hydrogen Development Strategy, focused on establishing a commercial green ammonia...
records.description: Tunisian authorities are initiating the National Green Hydrogen Development Strategy, focused on establishing a commercial green ammonia production unit for the fertilizer sector. The strategy aims to position Tunisia as a significant green hydrogen exporter to the EU by 2050, with plans to export 6.3 Mt annually and supply 2 Mt to the local market. A green ammonia manufacturing plant is planned for the Gabès region, designated as a "H2 Valley" for green hydrogen production and demand. The project involves creating a photovoltaic park, a seawater desalination unit, an electrolyser, and an ammonia synthesis unit at the Tunisian Chemical Group (GCT) plant in Gabès. The implementation of this strategy is supported by international financial institutions and organizations. However, environmental activists and local residents have expressed concerns about the potential environmental impacts and the project's perceived focus on benefiting European markets.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Masdar has invested nearly AED30 billion in equity and secured over AED16.5 billion in project financing across nine countries, reinforci...
records.description: Masdar has invested nearly AED30 billion in equity and secured over AED16.5 billion in project financing across nine countries, reinforcing its global leadership in clean energy. Established in 2006, Masdar aims to reach a 100GW renewable energy portfolio by 2030, contributing to the UAE's sustainability goals. The company has expanded its presence through acquisitions in Greece, Spain, and the US, and initiated seven major projects globally, including solar and battery storage projects in the UK, Azerbaijan, and the UAE. Masdar has also achieved financial closure on six projects in Saudi Arabia and Azerbaijan, signed a Power Purchase Agreement for the 2GW Sadawi project in Saudi Arabia, and inaugurated the 500MW Zarafshan Wind Farm in Uzbekistan.

records.title: The Minister of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture of Bahrain, and the US Ambassador to Bahrain, participated in a tree-planting init...
records.description: The Minister of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture of Bahrain, and the US Ambassador to Bahrain, participated in a tree-planting initiative organized by the US Embassy in Manama. The initiative highlights the strong bilateral relations between Bahrain and the US and supports Bahrain's National Afforestation Plan, which aims to double the number of trees by 2035 and achieve carbon neutrality by 2060. Both officials emphasized the importance of environmental efforts and continued cooperation between the two nations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture
