records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture has signed agreements to open agricultural offices in the municipalities of Samou and Karmel, Heb...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture has signed agreements to open agricultural offices in the municipalities of Samou and Karmel, Hebron. These offices aim to decentralize and enhance agricultural services for farmers in rural areas. The initiative, driven by Minister Rizq Salimiya, seeks to make agricultural support more accessible, particularly given current access challenges. The new offices will provide advisory and technical services to improve agricultural production.

records.title: On World Water Day, the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) of Saudi Arabia is recognized for its extensive global...
records.description: On World Water Day, the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) of Saudi Arabia is recognized for its extensive global water projects. They've implemented 105 projects across 16 countries, totaling over $301 million, to address water challenges and enhance water security. Yemen has received the most support, with 46 projects valued at over $238 million, focusing on drinking water and sanitation. KSrelief has also undertaken projects in Syria, Sudan, Mali, Ghana, and other nations, including Iraq, Somalia, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Myanmar, and Niger, drilling wells and establishing water purification systems.
records.institution: The King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Tanmiah Food Company, a major Middle Eastern food provider, has partnered with Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar and EDF Group, to i...
records.description: Tanmiah Food Company, a major Middle Eastern food provider, has partnered with Emerge, a joint venture between Masdar and EDF Group, to install a 3 megawatt-peak (MWp) solar power plant at Tanmiah’s facility in Haradh, Saudi Arabia. Emerge will manage the project, providing a full turnkey solution for 25 years. This solar plant will supply 35% of the facility's electricity, reducing CO₂ emissions significantly. The partnership aligns with Tanmiah's sustainability goals and Saudi Arabia's clean energy objectives. Emerge, established in 2021, focuses on developing renewable energy solutions for commercial and industrial clients. Tanmiah aims to be a leading sustainable protein company by 2030, and this project supports that vision. The project also underlines Emerge's goal to help the agricultural sector adopt clean energy.

records.title: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform hosted a scientific workshop and symposium focusing on the role of scientific rese...
records.description: The Syrian Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform hosted a scientific workshop and symposium focusing on the role of scientific research and technical projects in enhancing Syria's food security, with a specific focus on mechanizing the palm sector. The event, attended by the Minister, the Turkish Ambassador, and Turkish private sector companies, explored methods to improve fertilizer, seed, and pesticide production, water provision, and soil quality. The workshop also showcased modern technologies for palm tree pollination and fumigation to boost productivity and reduce costs, and included a field training trip to a palm field in the Damascus countryside.

records.title: The Tunisian Minister of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, advocates for a practical program to increase the use of prickly pea...
records.description: The Tunisian Minister of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, advocates for a practical program to increase the use of prickly pear and smooth cladodes in animal feed. He highlighted the successful experiments at the Saouaf farm, part of the Livestock and Pastures Office, which demonstrate the effectiveness of these resources. The minister emphasized the need to promote these practices among livestock breeders, aligning with the national strategy for sustainable animal feed development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: Empower, a Dubai-based district cooling services provider, has reiterated its dedication to environmental protection by using treated wat...
records.description: Empower, a Dubai-based district cooling services provider, has reiterated its dedication to environmental protection by using treated water in its operations, aligning with World Water Day. The company has increased its Reverse Osmosis (RO) treatment capacity to 21,359 m³ per day, enabling greater water recycling. In 2024, 8.3% of Empower's water usage came from recycled sources, primarily treated sewage effluent (TSE), reducing the strain on freshwater reserves. Empower has achieved significant water savings through advanced environmental practices, in accordance with Dubai Executive Council Resolution No. (27) of 2008. The company advocates for public efforts to conserve natural resources and promotes efficient water use to protect the environment and combat climate change.
records.institution: Emirates Central Cooling Systems Corporation PJSC (Empower)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Director-General of the National Centre of Meteorology and President of the World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) emphasized the im...
records.description: The Director-General of the National Centre of Meteorology and President of the World Meteorological Organisation (WMO) emphasized the importance of this year's World Meteorological Day theme, "Closing the Early Warning Gap Together," highlighting the global commitment to strengthening early warning capabilities against increasing extreme weather events. He noted the UN's "Early Warnings for All" initiative, aiming to protect everyone on Earth within five years, and while progress has been made, gaps remain, requiring enhanced global cooperation, especially to support vulnerable countries. He stressed the economic benefits of investing in early warning systems, stating a US$1 investment yields US$9 in economic benefits, and reaffirmed WMO's commitment to achieving the "Early Warnings for All" vision, placing a shared responsibility on the global community for a secure and resilient future.
records.institution: The National Centre of Meteorology and President of the World Meteorological Organisation (WMO)

records.title: The Egyptian Future Authority for Sustainable Development has reclaimed 200,000 acres of a planned 650,000-acre agricultural project in t...
records.description: The Egyptian Future Authority for Sustainable Development has reclaimed 200,000 acres of a planned 650,000-acre agricultural project in the New Valley Governorate, aiming to enhance food security, as officials praised the project's progress during a recent tour. This initiative is part of a broader government effort to reclaim and cultivate approximately 4 million acres of desert land, which includes the establishment of "Digital Tree," a joint-stock company focused on digitalizing the agricultural sector, and studies conducted by the Ministry of Agriculture and research centers to identify suitable areas.
records.institution: The Egyptian Future Authority for Sustainable Development

records.title: The Egyptian Minister of Agriculture and the Executive Director of Mostakbal Misr visited the East Owainat agricultural reclamation proje...
records.description: The Egyptian Minister of Agriculture and the Executive Director of Mostakbal Misr visited the East Owainat agricultural reclamation project, showcasing the partnership's efforts to enhance food security. The project has reclaimed 200,000 feddans, with plans to reach 650,000. The officials praised the project's progress and its contribution to national development. Additionally, the government authorized a partnership between the Ministry of Agriculture, the General Authority for Reconstruction and Agricultural Projects, and Mostakbal Misr to establish Digital Tree, a company focused on digitalizing the agricultural sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The EU Delegation to Egypt and the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation (MWRI) celebrated World Water Day, focusing on glacier pres...
records.description: The EU Delegation to Egypt and the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation (MWRI) celebrated World Water Day, focusing on glacier preservation and its impact on water resources, particularly in Egypt. The event highlighted the EU-Egypt Water Partnership and the Team Europe Initiative for Integrated Water and Food Security, emphasizing collaborative efforts to enhance water resilience and sustainable food production. Both Ambassador Angelina Eichhorst and Minister Hani Sewilam stressed the importance of joint initiatives and knowledge exchange. The event included presentations, agreements, and youth sessions, promoting sustainable water practices and climate resilience.
records.institution: The EU Delegation to Egypt and the Ministry of Water Resources and Irrigation (MWRI)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Dalhoun Municipality, organized a field day in Dalhoun to train farmers on olive t...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Dalhoun Municipality, organized a field day in Dalhoun to train farmers on olive tree pruning techniques and best agricultural practices. The event included practical demonstrations and the distribution of guidebooks to enhance farmers' skills and improve olive production. The initiative aimed to provide farmers with modern techniques for sustainable production and better economic returns.

records.title: A training workshop in Lakat, Trarza Province, Mauritania, has educated 42 agricultural supervisors and technicians on using neem tree pr...
records.description: A training workshop in Lakat, Trarza Province, Mauritania, has educated 42 agricultural supervisors and technicians on using neem tree products, biological materials, and alternative practices as natural pesticides for horticultural crop protection. This initiative, supported by the Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty, aims to promote sustainable agriculture and reduce reliance on chemical pesticides. Participants gained knowledge on applying natural pesticides to enhance agricultural production and improve crop quality. The workshop was overseen by officials from the Plant Protection department and the Regional Project Coordinator for Supporting the Pastoral System in the Sahel Countries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: Saudi Arabia has introduced stringent fines for water misuse, with penalties reaching SR200,000.
records.description: Saudi Arabia has introduced stringent fines for water misuse, with penalties reaching SR200,000. The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture has outlined these penalties in its executive regulations, covering violations across urban, agricultural, industrial, service, and general sectors. Urban violations include using inefficient plumbing fixtures, wasting water from tanks, and failing to operate grey water stations. Agricultural and industrial violations involve non-compliance with water licensing and allocated water footprints. General violations include obstructing inspectors and failing to provide required information. Service providers face fines for non-compliance with review processes, reporting, and operating without a license. The National Center for Water Efficiency and Conservation is central to these regulations.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Arabia, recognized as a global leader in water sector innovation, utilizes artificial intelligence in desalination and develops pal...
records.description: Saudi Arabia, recognized as a global leader in water sector innovation, utilizes artificial intelligence in desalination and develops palm tree-based technologies for erosion control and water infrastructure. The Kingdom's integrated institutional structure, led by the Saudi Water Authority under the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, ensures sustainable water management. The authority oversees the production and distribution of approximately 15 million cubic meters of water daily through an extensive network, demonstrating its commitment to sustainability and climate change adaptation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Arabia's poultry sector has achieved complete self-sufficiency in table egg production, exceeding 8 billion eggs in 2024.
records.description: Saudi Arabia's poultry sector has achieved complete self-sufficiency in table egg production, exceeding 8 billion eggs in 2024. The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture reports that this output meets domestic demand and generates a surplus, strengthening national food security. The ministry has implemented strategies to boost production, support investment, and localize the poultry industry, including incentives for new projects and job creation. They are also focused on enhancing food quality, safety, and availability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is prioritizing water conservation to ensure sustainable agriculture in the...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) is prioritizing water conservation to ensure sustainable agriculture in the region. Facing challenges like water scarcity and salinity, ADAFSA is implementing innovative solutions and initiatives. To mark World Water Day 2025, they highlighted their efforts to promote efficient irrigation practices among farmers, including modern technologies and awareness programs. Key projects include distributing recycled water to farms, promoting hydroponics and smart irrigation, and developing an "Electronic Irrigation Calculator" for crop water requirements. ADAFSA also provides irrigation water through collective stations and encourages the use of non-traditional water sources.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: The Algerian Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has launched a new financing initiative to support agricultural far...
records.description: The Algerian Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries has launched a new financing initiative to support agricultural farmers and investors. In collaboration with the Association of Banks and Financial Institutions (ABEF) and several public banks, the program aims to simplify access to credit and modernize the agricultural sector. The state will cover loan interest, and financing ceilings are set at 100 million dinars for individuals and 200 million dinars for cooperatives. The program supports various projects, including farm creation, infrastructure modernization, product transformation, and export. This initiative strengthens the agricultural sector, promotes food security, and fosters economic diversification.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.title: The Algerian Ministry of Foreign Trade and Export Promotion is taking legal action against 53 banana importers for failing to meet their...
records.description: The Algerian Ministry of Foreign Trade and Export Promotion is taking legal action against 53 banana importers for failing to meet their import commitments. This decision follows market fluctuations and a review by a multi-sectoral commission. The importers' actions disrupted the national market and affected consumer purchasing power. As a result, they face legal measures, including a permanent ban on future import activities.
records.institution: The Ministry of Foreign Trade and Export Promotion

records.title: Diyala Governorate, Iraq, produced over 70,000 tons of citrus fruits during the winter season, despite water scarcity.
records.description: Diyala Governorate, Iraq, produced over 70,000 tons of citrus fruits during the winter season, despite water scarcity. The Diyala Farmers' Associations Union reported an increase in local crop production, with markets and shops well-supplied. While the region has suffered from drought, citrus orchards have thrived. Farmers are requesting further support from the Ministry of Agriculture.

records.title: Heavy rainfall in Morocco, following a prolonged drought, has significantly disrupted strawberry production, particularly in the Larache...
records.description: Heavy rainfall in Morocco, following a prolonged drought, has significantly disrupted strawberry production, particularly in the Larache region. The excess water caused ripe strawberries to rot, leading to a two-week halt in exports and the redirection of the harvest to freezing. This disruption occurred during peak European demand. While strawberry producers faced losses, other soft fruits like blueberries and raspberries were less affected. Despite the temporary setbacks, the rainfall is considered beneficial for Moroccan agriculture overall, which has suffered from drought.

records.title: Moroccan avocado exports have reached a record 56,700 tons in the 2023/24 season, a 25% increase from the previous year.
records.description: Moroccan avocado exports have reached a record 56,700 tons in the 2023/24 season, a 25% increase from the previous year. Spain, France, and the Netherlands remain the top export destinations, but Morocco is actively diversifying its markets. Exports to Switzerland, Belgium, and Portugal have significantly increased, and shipments have resumed to Canada and Turkey. New markets include Poland, Ukraine, Greece, Malaysia, and Oman. A trade mission to Singapore and Malaysia is planned to further expand export opportunities.

records.title: Masdar, an Abu Dhabi-based renewable energy company, is considering acquiring a stake in TotalEnergies' Portuguese renewable energy asset...
records.description: Masdar, an Abu Dhabi-based renewable energy company, is considering acquiring a stake in TotalEnergies' Portuguese renewable energy assets, according to sources. This potential deal would likely be conducted through Saeta Yield, which Masdar acquired from Brookfield last year. Masdar is pursuing this as part of its strategy to expand its European presence and reach its global target of 100 gigawatts of renewable energy capacity by 2030. TotalEnergies has approximately 600 megawatts of installed renewable capacity in Portugal, primarily wind power, along with some solar and hydroelectric assets.

records.title: Algeria is facing a potential desert locust invasion across fourteen wilayas, posing an ecological and economic threat.
records.description: Algeria is facing a potential desert locust invasion across fourteen wilayas, posing an ecological and economic threat. The National Institute for Plant Protection (INPV) warns that strong winds could carry locust swarms from the Sahara to fertile agricultural regions, including Biskra, Ouargla, El Oued, and Tébessa, endangering crops and food security. Authorities have established a surveillance unit and are urging farmers to report sightings and take preventive measures. Algeria is also collaborating with Sahel countries and the FAO. The threat is amplified by climate variations, and farmers are using natural and mechanical defenses, but concerns remain amidst drought and water shortages.
records.institution: The National Institute for Plant Protection (INPV)

records.title: Algeria is planning to import one million sheep to meet the high demand for Eid al-Adha.
records.description: Algeria is planning to import one million sheep to meet the high demand for Eid al-Adha. The decision, made during a Council of Ministers meeting, aims to stabilize the market and ensure affordable prices for citizens. The Minister of Agriculture will oversee the international tender, with public institutions managing the imports. Distribution will involve public cooperatives and company social services. This move comes as Algeria's sheep farming sector faces challenges like drought and rising feed prices, leading to high meat and sheep prices. Previous import efforts have not fully addressed the issue. The government hopes this measure will alleviate shortages and protect consumer purchasing power during the festival.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development, and Fisheries

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Egyptian government, through the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company (EETC), has partnered with Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy...
records.description: The Egyptian government, through the Egyptian Electricity Transmission Company (EETC), has partnered with Siemens Gamesa Renewable Energy to build a 500 MW wind power plant in the Gulf of Suez. This project aligns with Egypt's ambitious renewable energy targets of 42% by 2030 and 65% by 2040. Siemens Gamesa will handle construction, financing, and operation. The initiative aims to reduce reliance on fossil fuels and promote sustainable energy, reinforcing public-private partnerships in Egypt's renewable energy sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched the "Official Agricultural Extension Program" to promote sustainable agricultural practices.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has launched the "Official Agricultural Extension Program" to promote sustainable agricultural practices. The launch was attended by the Ministers of Information and Agriculture, along with other ministry officials and experts.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the European Union and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the European Union and the International Fund for Agricultural Development (IFAD), launched the Rural Financial Inclusion Project. This project aims to enhance economic and environmental resilience in rural Palestine, improve livelihoods, and expand access to financial services, with a focus on rural micro-enterprises, women, and youth. The European Union is providing $12 million of the project's $27 million budget, which also includes contributions from the Palestinian government and other international agencies. Targeting rural areas in the West Bank and Gaza Strip, the project will benefit an estimated 120,000 indirect and 24,000 direct beneficiaries, creating 13,000 jobs over six years. The Ministry of Finance will manage the project, while the Ministry of Agriculture will chair the steering committee.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Aramco has launched Saudi Arabia's first direct air capture (DAC) test unit, developed with Siemens Energy, which can remove 12 tons of C...
records.description: Aramco has launched Saudi Arabia's first direct air capture (DAC) test unit, developed with Siemens Energy, which can remove 12 tons of CO2 annually. The facility will test CO2 capture materials and aim to reduce DAC technology costs. Aramco and Siemens Energy plan to scale up the technology for potential large-scale DAC facilities. Aramco is also developing a Carbon Capture and Storage (CCS) hub in Jubail with Linde and SLB, aiming to capture and store up to nine million metric tons of CO2 annually by 2027. This aligns with Aramco's goal to achieve net-zero Scope 1 and Scope 2 emissions by 2050.

records.title: SONEDE, Tunisia's national water distribution company, is implementing a program to drill 57 wells across the country to address peak dri...
records.description: SONEDE, Tunisia's national water distribution company, is implementing a program to drill 57 wells across the country to address peak drinking water consumption. So far, 18 wells are operational, and 24 are nearly completed. Six of these wells will be in the Siliana governorate, which has experienced water supply disruptions due to depleted local wells from consecutive dry seasons. Additional wells are planned for the Gafsa governorate, and hydraulic projects are expected in the El Kef governorate. SONEDE has also established a 24-hour central operations room to monitor citizen complaints and has automatically rescheduled debts for customers with low quarterly consumption.

records.title: The Tunisian Cereals Office will invest 6 million dinars to digitalize its grain collection operations, connecting approximately 200 coll...
records.description: The Tunisian Cereals Office will invest 6 million dinars to digitalize its grain collection operations, connecting approximately 200 collection centers. This initiative is part of a broader modernization program for the cereal sector, which includes rehabilitating collection centers and extending compliance deadlines for these centers. The program also involves acquiring new wagons, rehabilitating railway silos, and establishing a drying unit with cold storage. The Cereals Office is conducting a cereal consumption study and, in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Commerce, will digitalize the entire cereal sector. Additionally, a general agricultural census is underway to inform development decisions. Efforts are also focused on updating the agricultural map, strengthening research for climate-resilient cereal varieties, and encouraging large-scale farming.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Hotpack Global has installed a 2.2 MW rooftop solar power system at its Dubai manufacturing facility, one of the largest in the National...
records.description: Hotpack Global has installed a 2.2 MW rooftop solar power system at its Dubai manufacturing facility, one of the largest in the National Industries Park. This initiative will generate 3.52 million kWh of clean energy annually, reducing CO₂ emissions by 2,992 metric tons, equivalent to planting over 142,000 trees. The company aims to reduce its environmental footprint, align with the UAE’s Net Zero by 2050 goals, and become a carbon-neutral packaging company.

records.title: Dhamar province launched the "Facilitated Ploughing Initiative" to boost wheat, corn, and legume cultivation.
records.description: Dhamar province launched the "Facilitated Ploughing Initiative" to boost wheat, corn, and legume cultivation. Agricultural cooperatives, in collaboration with the Agricultural Cooperative Union and Bunyan Development Foundation, are leading the effort to help farmers prepare hard lands for the agricultural season. The initiative aims to enhance food security and self-sufficiency by reclaiming land. It will provide 1,176 hours of plowing at low prices, using cooperative-owned machines, across targeted districts.

records.title: Algeria is actively working to expand its irrigated agricultural land to 3 million hectares, prioritizing efficient water management and...
records.description: Algeria is actively working to expand its irrigated agricultural land to 3 million hectares, prioritizing efficient water management and the integration of treated wastewater for irrigation. This initiative aims to bolster food security by focusing on strategic crops, ensuring year-round availability of essential produce like potatoes, and supporting farmers through debt settlement. The government is also investing in strategic infrastructure, such as new cereal storage silos, to enhance national storage capacity and ensure a stable food supply, demonstrating a commitment to agricultural development and food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries,

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: Iraq's Council of Ministers has authorized the Ministry of Agriculture to contract with Date Palm Developments Ltd (DPD) for 20,000 tissu...
records.description: Iraq's Council of Ministers has authorized the Ministry of Agriculture to contract with Date Palm Developments Ltd (DPD) for 20,000 tissue-cultured palm seedlings. This is part of the National Program for Date Palm Rehabilitation and Seedling Propagation in Iraq for 2024. The contract was exempted from standard government contracting and budget execution regulations.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture reports achieving self-sufficiency in seven crops and exporting 13.
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture reports achieving self-sufficiency in seven crops and exporting 13. Despite water shortages, Iraq is expanding agricultural plans by cultivating desert lands, using well water, and developing drought-resistant crops. The government has invested in modern irrigation systems and water conservation campaigns, leading to surpluses in crops like wheat. Iraq is exporting various crops, including dates, tomatoes, potatoes, and watermelon, and aims to significantly increase palm tree cultivation.

records.title: Abundant rainfall in Tetouan province, Morocco, during March is expected to significantly benefit the agricultural season, mitigating the...
records.description: Abundant rainfall in Tetouan province, Morocco, during March is expected to significantly benefit the agricultural season, mitigating the effects of prolonged drought. Rainfall has exceeded 420mm, a 14% increase from the previous season, with dams reaching near full capacity. This will support the cultivation of cereals, legumes, vegetables, fodder crops, and fruit trees. Farmers are optimistic, as the rainfall will replenish water tables, improve vegetation cover, and alleviate irrigation restrictions. The positive impact is felt across various rural communes, with farmers actively tending their crops and anticipating a successful harvest.
records.institution: Provincial Directorate of Agriculture of Tetouan

records.title: Morocco is becoming a leader in regenerative agriculture in Africa, focusing on soil restoration and sustainability.
records.description: Morocco is becoming a leader in regenerative agriculture in Africa, focusing on soil restoration and sustainability. The Green Morocco Plan has significantly boosted agricultural exports and created jobs. The OCP Group, through initiatives like Al Moutmir, supports farmers and shares expertise, leading to improved yields across Africa. Morocco's approach combines innovation, sustainability, and international collaboration to address food security and climate challenges.

records.title: Morocco's central bank, Bank Al-Maghrib (BAM), forecasts a slight increase in the country's grain harvest to 35 million quintals, though...
records.description: Morocco's central bank, Bank Al-Maghrib (BAM), forecasts a slight increase in the country's grain harvest to 35 million quintals, though this remains below government expectations and previous predictions. This improvement is attributed to recent rainfall, which has also increased dam reservoir levels. Despite this, the reservoir filling rate is still significantly lower than in previous years. Experts warn that the recent rainfall is not sufficient to resolve Morocco's long-term water crisis, noting that drought is a structural issue.

records.title: The IMF has approved the disbursement of $496 million to Morocco, the third tranche under the Resilience and Sustainability Facility, bri...
records.description: The IMF has approved the disbursement of $496 million to Morocco, the third tranche under the Resilience and Sustainability Facility, bringing the total to $1.24 billion. Despite drought, Morocco's economy has shown resilience, with a modest slowdown in 2024. Economic growth is expected to accelerate due to investments and reforms, particularly related to infrastructure projects for the 2030 World Cup. The IMF praised Morocco's strong economic policies and climate efforts, including measures to protect water resources and promote renewable energy. Unemployment remains a challenge.

records.title: The Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund in Oman aims to enhance food security by preserving resources, building capacity, and pro...
records.description: The Agricultural and Fisheries Development Fund in Oman aims to enhance food security by preserving resources, building capacity, and promoting innovation. It operates through specialized and joint programs. Specialized programs focus on aquaculture development, using non-traditional water sources in agriculture, and date palm development. Joint programs, in collaboration with private sector and communities, emphasize innovation, empowering rural and coastal women, and developing local feed industries. These programs address challenges like climate change, water scarcity, and import dependence, strengthening local producers and fostering sustainable agricultural practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture has opened an agricultural office in Bidya, Salfit Governorate, through a cooperation agreement w...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture has opened an agricultural office in Bidya, Salfit Governorate, through a cooperation agreement with the local municipality. This initiative aims to decentralize agricultural services, providing farmers with easier access to advisory and technical support. Engineers from the Salfit Agriculture Directorate will offer ongoing assistance both at the office and in the field. The project, driven by Minister Rizq Salimiya, seeks to enhance agricultural production, efficiency, and sustainability.

records.title: The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate has partnered with the Al-Majd Village Council to open an agricultural office.
records.description: The South Hebron Agriculture Directorate has partnered with the Al-Majd Village Council to open an agricultural office. This initiative, driven by Minister Rizk Eslimia, aims to improve agricultural services and support rural development by providing farmers with easier access to guidance and technical support. The Al-Majd Village Council will furnish the office, while the Ministry of Agriculture will provide staff and logistical support.

records.title: Saudia Cargo plays a crucial role in exporting Saudi Arabian dates, a symbol of Ramadan, to global markets.
records.description: Saudia Cargo plays a crucial role in exporting Saudi Arabian dates, a symbol of Ramadan, to global markets. With Saudi Arabia being a major date producer, Saudia Cargo's extensive network delivers these dates to over 45 international destinations, experiencing a 64% growth in date exports in 2024. The company utilizes advanced cold chain technology and its global network to ensure quality and rapid transit. Saudia Cargo supports national sustainability initiatives, aligning with the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture and the National Center for Palms and Dates. Committed to smart logistics and sustainable solutions, Saudia Cargo contributes to the growth of the Saudi agricultural sector and its global presence.
records.institution: Saudia Cargo, Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY) is implementing sustainable development projects in Yemen, focusing on...
records.description: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY) is implementing sustainable development projects in Yemen, focusing on infrastructure and essential services. Notably, they are enhancing the water sector through 58 projects, including two renewable energy-powered water security projects in Aden and Hadhramaut. These projects aim to diversify water sources, improve distribution efficiency, and reduce operational costs by using solar energy. In Aden, 10 wells are being upgraded, benefiting 800,000 people. In Hadhramaut, the project targets nine districts, benefiting 1.7 million people. SDRPY supports various sectors across Yemen with 264 projects.
records.institution: The Saudi Development and Reconstruction Program for Yemen (SDRPY)

records.title: Tunisia's Cereals Office plans to increase cereal storage capacity by building new silos and rehabilitating existing ones.
records.description: Tunisia's Cereals Office plans to increase cereal storage capacity by building new silos and rehabilitating existing ones. By 2027, they aim to add nearly 120,000 tons of storage capacity, focusing on key locations like Radés, Sousse, and Sfax. They will also rehabilitate existing silos to improve overall storage. The goal is to enhance food security by ensuring sufficient capacity for grain collection and maintaining safety stock levels. The office is also implementing training on open-air storage techniques and providing financial support to collectors. The national storage infrastructure will be expanded, and additional storage capacities have been identified for the current season. The focus is to improve the efficiency of grain transfer and collection.

records.title: Tunisian dates, particularly Deglet Nour, are highly regarded for their quality and nutritional value.
records.description: Tunisian dates, particularly Deglet Nour, are highly regarded for their quality and nutritional value. Despite their global reputation, Tunisian date export revenues decreased by 1% to 581.8 million dinars by the end of February 2025. Export quantities also saw a slight decrease. Deglet Nour dates dominate exports, with the EU, Africa, and Asia being major destinations. Morocco is the leading importer. Organic date exports also experienced declines in volume and revenue. Germany is the primary destination for organic dates. According to the FAO, Tunisia is the second-largest date exporter by volume and third-largest by revenue globally. The date industry is significant, with major production in Asia and Africa, and Arab countries contributing substantially to global output.

records.title: Egypt: IRSC, Arabian Cement sign landmark clean energy power purchase agreement
records.description: IRSC has signed a 30-year Power Purchase Agreement with Arabian Cement Company to supply renewable energy, supporting cleaner industrial operations in Egypt. IRSC will develop, finance, and operate the second phase of ACC’s solar power plant, reducing costs and carbon emissions. The 17.6 MWp solar plant will generate 32.5 GWh annually, advancing Egypt’s transition to sustainable energy.

records.title: The Egyptian Chamber of Food Industries reported a 21% increase in food sector exports, exceeding $10 billion in 2024.
records.description: The Egyptian Chamber of Food Industries reported a 21% increase in food sector exports, exceeding $10 billion in 2024. The Chamber is focused on institutional growth, digital transformation, and improving governance. Strategic objectives for 2024 include addressing factory challenges, providing market data, and enhancing sector competitiveness. The Chamber also prioritizes food safety compliance, delivering training programs and collaborating with the National Food Safety Authority. Additionally, it contributes to standardization efforts and represents Egypt's food sector in international missions.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture has opened agricultural offices in Sinjil and Silwad, Ramallah, through cooperation agreements wi...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture has opened agricultural offices in Sinjil and Silwad, Ramallah, through cooperation agreements with the local municipal councils. These offices aim to decentralize agricultural services, providing advisory and technical support to farmers. Engineers will offer ongoing assistance both at the offices and in the field. The initiative, driven by Minister Rizq Salimiya, seeks to enhance agricultural production and efficiency, with support from the Ramallah and Al-Bireh Agriculture Directorate.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture has opened an agricultural office in Al-Ubeidiya, Bethlehem, through an agreement with the local...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture has opened an agricultural office in Al-Ubeidiya, Bethlehem, through an agreement with the local municipality. The office will provide integrated services to farmers and livestock breeders in several surrounding areas, covering a significant amount of agricultural land and livestock. It will be staffed by agricultural engineers and a veterinarian, offering technical, advisory, and veterinary health services. This initiative aims to enhance agricultural services, improve production, and support sustainable development, contributing to food security and the local economy.

records.title: Almarai's plan to acquire Hammoudeh Food Industries for 263 million riyals ($70 million) has been canceled.
records.description: Almarai's plan to acquire Hammoudeh Food Industries for 263 million riyals ($70 million) has been canceled. The deal fell through because the seller could not fulfill the necessary conditions. Almarai, through its subsidiary Teeba Investment, had intended to acquire the Jordanian dairy and cheese business. Despite the failed acquisition, Almarai remains interested in future expansion opportunities.

records.title: KAUST researchers are collaborating with local farmers and the Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture to address water sca...
records.description: KAUST researchers are collaborating with local farmers and the Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture to address water scarcity in agriculture. They are developing innovative strategies, including controlled environment agriculture (CEA) integrated with tailored desalination and wastewater treatment, to provide "clean enough" water for hydroponic farming. The project aims to reduce costs and energy use by selectively removing unwanted ions from brackish water and reclaiming municipal wastewater. They are evaluating technologies like nanofiltration and forward osmosis, with the goal of developing prototypes. This initiative supports Saudi Arabia's goals for sustainable agriculture, wastewater reuse, and food security.
records.institution: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Kyoto Network and G6T Group are partnering to develop waste-to-value plants that transform waste into high-value products, supporting was...
records.description: Kyoto Network and G6T Group are partnering to develop waste-to-value plants that transform waste into high-value products, supporting waste management, food security, and the UAE's role in the global Voluntary Carbon Market. Their first UAE project will produce Engineered Biochar, enhancing desert soil fertility and acting as a long-term carbon sink. The initiative aims to drive economic growth, create green jobs, and position the Middle East as a leader in waste-to-value and carbon dioxide removal technologies.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The Governor of Al-Bayda inspected the Central Agricultural Nursery, containing over 90,000 seedlings.
records.description: The Governor of Al-Bayda inspected the Central Agricultural Nursery, containing over 90,000 seedlings. He highlighted the project's importance for agriculture, advocating for the use of local resources to grow various crops. He also stressed the need for community education on agriculture and the formation of agricultural associations to achieve self-sufficiency, following leadership directives.

records.title: Algeria is addressing drought through a large-scale development plan focused on desalination plants, aiming to strengthen its water secur...
records.description: Algeria is addressing drought through a large-scale development plan focused on desalination plants, aiming to strengthen its water security. The plan, initiated two years ago, reflects an anticipatory vision in response to climate change predictions. Algeria is building desalination infrastructure along its coastline, complementing its traditional water resources. The country ranks first in Africa and second in the Arab world in desalination capacity, significantly increasing its drinking water coverage. Algeria has inaugurated four desalination plants and plans to open more, using national resources and skills. A second phase, involving six solar-powered desalination plants, is also underway, with the agricultural sector as a primary beneficiary.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Since 2020, over 77,000 farms in Algeria have been connected to the electricity grid, according to the Minister of State for Energy, Mine...
records.description: Since 2020, over 77,000 farms in Algeria have been connected to the electricity grid, according to the Minister of State for Energy, Mines and Renewable Energy. The government is committed to continuing this program to enhance food security and address technical and administrative obstacles. Additionally, significant progress has been made in connecting homes to natural gas in M'Sila and Ouled Djellal, with ongoing projects despite budget constraints.
records.institution: The Ministry of State for Energy, Mines and Renewable Energy, National People's Assembly (APN)

records.title: The United States Department of Agriculture and the Algerian Ministry of Agriculture have signed an agreement to allow the importation of...
records.description: The United States Department of Agriculture and the Algerian Ministry of Agriculture have signed an agreement to allow the importation of American dairy cows into Algeria. This agreement builds on previous collaborations in livestock management and dairy production. The introduction of American dairy cows, known for their advanced genetics and high milk yields, is expected to enhance Algeria's dairy industry, increase milk production, create jobs, and improve food security.

records.title: A water awareness program was conducted in Karak Governorate, Jordan, during Ramadan, focusing on water conservation and efficient usage.
records.description: A water awareness program was conducted in Karak Governorate, Jordan, during Ramadan, focusing on water conservation and efficient usage. The Ministry of Water and Irrigation's Water Authority, through its Media and Communication Directorate, organized lectures in schools, universities, cultural forums, and associations. These sessions addressed Jordan's water challenges and promoted water-saving methods in various settings, including homes, agriculture, and public spaces. Participants learned about water-saving devices, leak prevention, and the importance of responsible water consumption. The program emphasized the collective responsibility of water conservation and received positive feedback, with pledges of cooperation for future awareness initiatives.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation

records.title: The Jordanian Ministry of Water and Irrigation, the Water Authority, and the National Center for Agricultural Research have signed an MoU...
records.description: The Jordanian Ministry of Water and Irrigation, the Water Authority, and the National Center for Agricultural Research have signed an MoU to establish a research station in Deir Alla – Tal al-Mantah. The station, funded by a 200,000 Jordanian Dinar grant, aims to improve water resource sustainability and agricultural water use, particularly reclaimed water. The MoU emphasizes scientific research as crucial for climate change adaptation and sustainable water management. The station will analyze reclaimed water quality, attract research funding, and align with strategies to enhance wastewater treatment and water reuse. This initiative supports Jordan's economic modernization vision and National Water Plan, focusing on strategic partnerships and efficient resource use.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation, the Water Authority, and the National Center for Agricultural Research

records.title: Moroccan orange exports to Germany, specifically Lane Late oranges for juice, have been temporarily suspended.
records.description: Moroccan orange exports to Germany, specifically Lane Late oranges for juice, have been temporarily suspended. This is due to increased domestic demand during Ramadan, when orange juice is popular. Production is currently focused on meeting local needs. The suspension is expected to be temporary, and exports to Germany and other markets will resume once domestic demand is satisfied. The price of Lane Late oranges in Morocco is considered fair, though consumers are accustomed to lower prices. The early start of the Moroccan citrus export season and this temporary interruption highlight the sector's ability to adapt to local and international demands.

records.title: The Nablus Agriculture Directorate, following the Ministry of Agriculture's strategy, conducted an extension activity to enhance field sc...
records.description: The Nablus Agriculture Directorate, following the Ministry of Agriculture's strategy, conducted an extension activity to enhance field school management. This activity, supported by the FAO, covered tree horticulture, field crops, and olives in the central Jordan Valley, Naqoura, and Beit Furik. The initiative aimed to educate farmers on agricultural operations, their timing, and their importance, ultimately increasing production and reducing damage from climate and diseases.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture signed agreements with the municipal councils of Bani Naim, Beit Ummar, and Nuba to establish thr...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture signed agreements with the municipal councils of Bani Naim, Beit Ummar, and Nuba to establish three agricultural offices. These offices aim to decentralize and enhance agricultural services for farmers, providing advisory and technical support, especially given current access difficulties. The offices will be staffed by engineers offering 24/7 assistance.

records.title: Qatar General Electricity and Water Corporation (Kahramaa) has increased its strategic water storage to 5.2 days.
records.description: Qatar General Electricity and Water Corporation (Kahramaa) has increased its strategic water storage to 5.2 days. This is due to the Water Strategic Mega Reservoirs Project, which boosted storage capacity significantly. Potable desalinated water production is substantial and is expected to increase further. Kahramaa is also enhancing groundwater resources by rehabilitating and developing water-harvesting wells and implementing artificial groundwater recharge projects. The corporation is strategically managing the water sector in line with Qatar's Vision 2030, and the Mega Reservoirs Project holds Guinness World Records for the largest drinking water storage tank and network.
records.institution: Qatar General Electricity and Water Corporation (Kahramaa)

records.title: Saudi Arabia's fig production surpassed 28,159 tons in 2023, achieving a 107% self-sufficiency rate.
records.description: Saudi Arabia's fig production surpassed 28,159 tons in 2023, achieving a 107% self-sufficiency rate. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture highlighted figs as a key agricultural product, with local production meeting market demands. The ministry is supporting farmers by promoting advanced agricultural technologies to enhance productivity and sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Sudan's grain production for the 2024-2025 summer season reached 6.6 million tons, the highest in five years, exceeding national food needs.
records.description: Sudan's grain production for the 2024-2025 summer season reached 6.6 million tons, the highest in five years, exceeding national food needs. This represents a 62% increase from the previous year. The production includes maize, millet, and wheat. Despite this positive output, the ongoing conflict has severely disrupted Sudan’s agricultural sector, particularly in key farming regions. Challenges include looting, security threats, fuel shortages, and rising costs. While the harvest offers hope for food security, humanitarian concerns and disrupted trade routes remain significant. Separately, the African Development Bank (AfDB) approved a $46.2 million grant to South Sudan to support its agricultural sector, aiming to increase cereal and fish production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry

records.title: Potato and tomato growers are being warned of the increased risk of late blight due to favorable climatic conditions.
records.description: Potato and tomato growers are being warned of the increased risk of late blight due to favorable climatic conditions. The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Maritime Fisheries is urging growers to take immediate action, including using approved systemic fungicides, following dosage instructions, and practicing proper land management. Preventive and curative measures are recommended to minimize the spread of the disease and prevent the development of resistant strains. The ministry emphasizes the importance of regular treatments, proper spraying techniques, and environmental protection.

records.title: The national capacity for collecting and storing cereals (durum wheat, soft wheat, and barley) in Tunisia for the 2024-2025 season is est...
records.description: The national capacity for collecting and storing cereals (durum wheat, soft wheat, and barley) in Tunisia for the 2024-2025 season is estimated at 1,578 thousand tonnes. This capacity is divided between 780 thousand tonnes in production areas and 798 thousand tonnes in storage facilities (508 thousand tonnes at the Cereals Office and 290 thousand tonnes at flour mills). Additional collection and storage capacities have been identified. The national average annual consumption of these cereals is approximately 3,600,000 tonnes.

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: The Tunisian Cereals Office has established a two-month security stock of durum and soft wheat, as well as barley, to ensure food security.
records.description: The Tunisian Cereals Office has established a two-month security stock of durum and soft wheat, as well as barley, to ensure food security. The monthly consumption of durum and soft wheat is 2 million quintals, while barley consumption varies. The national annual cereal consumption is approximately 36 million quintals. The Cereals Office aims to maintain and potentially increase the security stock to prevent supply and price disruptions. The constitution of this stock depends on storage capacity at ports, highlighting the need for new storage facilities and silo rehabilitation. The cereal sector is considered strategic for economic development and social stability.

records.title: Tunisian olive oil exports have increased significantly in volume for the 2024/2025 season, but revenue has declined sharply.
records.description: Tunisian olive oil exports have increased significantly in volume for the 2024/2025 season, but revenue has declined sharply. Exports reached 132.2 thousand tonnes, a 40.8% increase, but revenue fell by 26.8% due to a 54.9% drop in average prices. This paradox is attributed to the heavy reliance on bulk exports (89.8%), which command lower prices, while packaged oil, despite representing only 10.2% of exports, generates a larger share of revenue. Extra virgin olive oil dominates exports, with the EU being the primary market.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Sharjah Electricity and Water Authority (Sewa) has launched its largest 220 kV substation in Umm Fannin, near the airport area.
records.description: The Sharjah Electricity and Water Authority (Sewa) has launched its largest 220 kV substation in Umm Fannin, near the airport area. Costing over AED500 million ($136 million), this project, in collaboration with Siemens Energy and General Projects Company, aims to enhance Sharjah's energy infrastructure. The substation features high-capacity transformers, providing over 1,200 MW to meet growing energy demands and support the city's economic and urban development. Sewa emphasizes its commitment to developing reliable and sustainable energy networks.
records.institution: The Sharjah Electricity and Water Authority (Sewa)

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fish Resources and Water Resources in Sana'a, Yemen, condemned the American aggression's targeting of a cott...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fish Resources and Water Resources in Sana'a, Yemen, condemned the American aggression's targeting of a cotton shop in the Zabid district of Al-Hodeidah Governorate. The ministry stated that the American, British, and Zionist enemies are targeting civilian and service installations, including the cotton shop, to increase human suffering.

records.title: A study examined seasonal nutrient concentration changes in fig tree leaves to optimize fertilization and diagnosis.
records.description: A study examined seasonal nutrient concentration changes in fig tree leaves to optimize fertilization and diagnosis. Nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium levels decreased as leaves aged, while calcium and magnesium increased. These variations highlight the importance of considering leaf age for accurate nutrient analysis and fertilization timing.
records.institution: Institut National de la Recherche Agronomique (INRA)

records.title: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) has launched strategic projects to enhance food security and expand globally.
records.description: Oman Flour Mills (OFM) has launched strategic projects to enhance food security and expand globally. Key initiatives include establishing Oman-Australia Limited to secure wheat from farmers and launching Atyab International Services (AIS) in Uzbekistan to monitor import quality. OFM is investing in strategic grain reserves, diversifying procurement, and improving product quality. The company is also expanding its investment portfolio by acquiring a feed mill, integrating frozen bakery operations, and exploring new markets like baby food and millet cultivation. Regionally, OFM is exploring bakery expansion in Saudi Arabia and developing industrial clusters. Recent acquisitions, like Sohar Beach Bakery and Oman Bio Products, are enhancing operational efficiency.

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: Oman held a symposium, "The Right to Food," on Arab Human Rights Day, focusing on food security and human rights.
records.description: Oman held a symposium, "The Right to Food," on Arab Human Rights Day, focusing on food security and human rights. The event, organized by the Oman Human Rights Commission and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, highlighted Oman's efforts in promoting food security, its support for the Palestinian people, and its commitment to international human rights agreements. Speakers emphasized the importance of food availability, diversity, and accessibility, condemning the food crisis in Gaza. Oman Vision 2040's role in strengthening food security was discussed, along with national and regional legislation.
records.institution: The Oman Human Rights Commission and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs

records.domain: Agricultural expenditure in the national budget
records.title: The Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment (Entaj) will list on the main market of the Saudi Tadawul with a share pri...
records.description: The Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment (Entaj) will list on the main market of the Saudi Tadawul with a share price of SAR50 ($13.30). Entaj, a poultry company, has issued 9 million ordinary shares in an initial public offering (IPO) for 30 percent of its share capital. The IPO raised SAR450 million, giving Entaj an implied valuation of SAR1.5 billion. Entaj plans to distribute the funds as dividends to shareholders. Recent IPOs in Saudi Arabia have attracted major attention. The company's listing aligns with Saudi Arabia's goal of achieving 90 percent food self-sufficiency by 2030.
records.institution: The Arabian Company for Agricultural and Industrial Investment (Entaj)

records.title: The Bayt Al-Faqih Directorate in Yemen launched the marketing of 5,000 locally raised chickens to reduce reliance on imported poultry.
records.description: The Bayt Al-Faqih Directorate in Yemen launched the marketing of 5,000 locally raised chickens to reduce reliance on imported poultry. The initiative, led by the Bait Al-Faqih Cooperative Society and poultry breeders, aligns with the Ministry of Agriculture's strategy for food security and self-sufficiency. Local officials emphasized the initiative's significance in achieving self-sufficiency in white meat and called for its expansion. The initiative supports small poultry breeders through contract farming and aims to increase production to 5,000 tons. The cooperative society pledged its readiness to meet market demand, highlighting the initiative's role in boosting the national economy and food security.
records.institution: Bait Al-Faqih Cooperative Society, Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The local authority in Khab Wa Sha'af district, Jawf province, Yemen, inaugurated the wheat harvest season in al-Jeblah village.
records.description: The local authority in Khab Wa Sha'af district, Jawf province, Yemen, inaugurated the wheat harvest season in al-Jeblah village. The district director praised the farmers' efforts, highlighting the importance of wheat cultivation for food security. He pledged continued support for fair market prices and urged farmers to use high-quality seeds. He also emphasized the Houthi leadership's directives to advance agriculture and achieve self-sufficiency, reducing dependence on imports amid ongoing conflict.
records.institution: The local authority in Khab Wa Sha'af district, Jawf

records.title: Iraq leads globally in palm tree count with over 22 million trees and aims to increase this to 30 million.
records.description: Iraq leads globally in palm tree count with over 22 million trees and aims to increase this to 30 million. It ranks fourth in global date production, exporting over 700,000 tons in 2024. The Ministry of Agriculture attributes this growth to its support of the agricultural sector and efforts to diversify the economy.

records.title: The Ajloun Forest Reserve in Jordan is recognized as a model for environmental investment and sustainable tourism.
records.description: The Ajloun Forest Reserve in Jordan is recognized as a model for environmental investment and sustainable tourism. It has achieved environmental excellence, earning a place on the IUCN's Green List and being named a top 100 sustainable tourism site. The reserve, covering 12,000 dunams with 6,500 fenced for protection, boasts rich biodiversity, including 575 plant and 108 animal species. Reserve management balances conservation with community needs, allowing controlled grazing to aid seed germination and combating threats like firewood overexploitation. Ecotourism and planned development projects, including renewable energy and economic workshops, aim to further support environmental protection and local community development.

records.title: The Greater Amman Municipality's central wholesale market received 3,864 tons of produce today, comprising 2,963 tons of vegetables, 606...
records.description: The Greater Amman Municipality's central wholesale market received 3,864 tons of produce today, comprising 2,963 tons of vegetables, 606 tons of fruits, and 276 tons of leafy greens. Prices per kilogram are as follows: black eggplant (15-25 piasters), dry onions (15-20 piasters), potatoes (20-35 piasters), tomatoes (7-20 piasters), carrots (25-45 piasters), cucumbers (20-50 piasters), cauliflower (10-20 piasters), lemons (20-40 piasters), and local bananas (50-75 piasters).

records.title: Morocco's dam reservoirs have seen a significant increase, reaching 33.82% capacity on March 15th, holding 5.7 billion cubic meters of wa...
records.description: Morocco's dam reservoirs have seen a significant increase, reaching 33.82% capacity on March 15th, holding 5.7 billion cubic meters of water. This is a notable rise from last year's 26.58% and a daily increase of 1.51%. Water levels vary across regions, with the Loukkos, Tensift, and Bouregreg-Chaouia basins showing strong levels, while the Souss-Massa region remains critically low at 8.42%. Recent gains between March 12th and 14th added 317.13 million cubic meters to the reservoirs.
records.institution: The Ministry of Equipment and Water

records.title: Saudi Arabia's grape production surpassed 122,000 tons, reflecting strong growth in the local agricultural sector and meeting significant...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's grape production surpassed 122,000 tons, reflecting strong growth in the local agricultural sector and meeting significant market demands. This production has contributed to a 66% self-sufficiency rate. The Kingdom's grape industry comprises over 7.1 million grape trees, with more than 6.1 million bearing fruit. The diversity and quality of local grape varieties have made them highly competitive in domestic markets. This variety also supports processing industries, enabling the production of natural juices, jams, raisins, and other food products. The ministry supports farmers by providing access to modern technologies and encourages consumers to choose local grapes, emphasizing quality, nutrition, and reduced food waste.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Arabia's watermelon production exceeded 613,632 tons in 2023, achieving a 98% self-sufficiency rate, according to the Ministry of E...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's watermelon production exceeded 613,632 tons in 2023, achieving a 98% self-sufficiency rate, according to the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA). This highlights the strong ability of Saudi agriculture to meet domestic demand. MEWA encourages consumers to choose local watermelons during Ramadan for their quality and nutritional value, which supports hydration and aligns with Saudi Vision 2030's goals for economic strength and sustainability.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA)

records.title: The Brazilian government has eliminated customs duties on extra virgin olive oil imports, moving from a previous 9% tax.
records.description: The Brazilian government has eliminated customs duties on extra virgin olive oil imports, moving from a previous 9% tax. This presents a significant opportunity for Tunisian olive oil exporters to increase their presence in Brazil, a market that imported approximately 250,000 tons of olive oil worth $695 million in 2024. The Tunisian Embassy in Brazil is offering support to Tunisian exporters, including assistance with laboratory registration with the Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture, a requirement for market access.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has initiated locust control operations in the Dhehiba region of Tataouine, fo...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries has initiated locust control operations in the Dhehiba region of Tataouine, following the arrival of Saharan locust species from Libya. Regional agricultural services began treatment, supported by teams from Sidi Bouzid and Gabès, and the Ministry has confirmed the continuation of eradication efforts. The Ministry, in cooperation with the Saharan locust control authority, is conducting a training cycle on insecticide spraying techniques, including practical sessions on newly acquired spraying machines. This training is being attended by technicians from the General Directorate of Plant Health and Control of Agricultural Inputs and representatives from the affected regions.
records.institution: Share The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Algerian state-owned company OAIC has purchased 450,000 tons of soft wheat in a tender at $268.50 C&F per ton.
records.description: The Algerian state-owned company OAIC has purchased 450,000 tons of soft wheat in a tender at $268.50 C&F per ton. The wheat is scheduled for delivery in two periods in May, with adjustments for South American or Australian sources. Traders indicate the grain will primarily come from Black Sea countries like Ukraine, Romania, and Bulgaria, though some traders estimate the total purchase volume to be 650,000 tonnes.

records.title: Jordan has exported 46,000 sheep to Gulf markets, facilitated by the Directorate of Agriculture in Mafraq.
records.description: Jordan has exported 46,000 sheep to Gulf markets, facilitated by the Directorate of Agriculture in Mafraq. This export resumption is expected to positively impact the livestock sector and national economy without affecting local sheep prices.
records.institution: The Directorate of Agriculture in Mafraq

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Morocco is launching a public consultation on climate services in agriculture, led by Maroc Météo and the Ministry of Agriculture, to ada...
records.description: Morocco is launching a public consultation on climate services in agriculture, led by Maroc Météo and the Ministry of Agriculture, to adapt to climate challenges. A preparatory meeting gathered stakeholders to develop climate tools for farmers. The initiative, using a participatory approach, aims to co-develop operational services, integrating new technologies and expertise. Key actions include thematic panels, stakeholder mobilization, and a roadmap for accessible climate services. Partners like Comader, COSUMAR Group, and Crédit Agricole du Maroc are supporting the effort. The consultation, planned for SIAM 2025, seeks to strengthen agricultural resilience against environmental challenges.
records.institution: General Directorate of Meteorology (Maroc Météo), The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: The Moroccan Economic Center (CMC) has released its "Maroc Conjoncture" No.
records.description: The Moroccan Economic Center (CMC) has released its "Maroc Conjoncture" No. 376 publication, focusing on "Moroccan Agriculture: Challenges and Development Measures." The publication covers themes like sustainable agriculture, the informal economy, structural reforms, the blue economy, and demographic transitions. It highlights the challenges facing Moroccan agriculture due to climate change and drought, emphasizing the need for a new sustainable production model. The publication also addresses the importance of attracting foreign investment through structural reforms and explores the potential of the blue economy for economic development and social inclusion.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Tunisia's energy independence rate has fallen, indicating increased dependence on imports and a rise in the energy deficit.
records.description: Tunisia's energy independence rate has fallen, indicating increased dependence on imports and a rise in the energy deficit. Primary energy resources have decreased due to declining domestic oil and gas production, with renewable energy contributing marginally. The energy deficit has increased. Energy demand has remained broadly stable, but natural gas demand has decreased, leading to increased electricity imports, while petroleum product demand has risen. These trends highlight Tunisia's ongoing energy security challenges and the need for a stronger transition to renewable energy.
records.institution: National Observatory of Energy and Mines

records.title: Tunisia's trade deficit increased to 3.5 billion dinars in the first two months of 2025, with 1.8 billion dinars attributed to the energy...
records.description: Tunisia's trade deficit increased to 3.5 billion dinars in the first two months of 2025, with 1.8 billion dinars attributed to the energy balance deficit. This is a significant rise from 1.7 billion dinars in the same period last year. Exports declined by 4.4% to 10 billion dinars, while imports increased by 10.2% to 13.6 billion dinars. The export-import coverage ratio dropped to 74.3%. Declines in exports were noted in energy, agriculture, and textiles, while phosphate exports increased. Imports rose across most categories, with energy imports remaining relatively stable.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) has partnered with Ignite Energy Access, a pan-African renewable energy solutions provider, to est...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) has partnered with Ignite Energy Access, a pan-African renewable energy solutions provider, to establish its global headquarters in Abu Dhabi. ADIO will support Ignite's expansion across Africa and into the UAE, deploying solar solutions and digital connectivity to remote areas. Ignite will create over 200 jobs in Abu Dhabi and collaborate with local universities for knowledge transfer. The partnership aligns with Abu Dhabi's energy transition goals and aims to position the emirate as a global hub for clean energy innovation.

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: The acting Governor of Taiz was briefed on the FAO's Community Seed Bank, established at $60,000 to enhance food security in Yemen.
records.description: The acting Governor of Taiz was briefed on the FAO's Community Seed Bank, established at $60,000 to enhance food security in Yemen. He learned about the bank's role in preserving seeds and strengthening agriculture, praising its establishment. Officials highlighted its importance in promoting agricultural development and preserving local seeds, particularly corn, for which Taiz has an agricultural advantage. The bank will also contribute to improving pure seed stock in coordination with development partners.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources launched the 2024-2025 winter wheat harvest season in Al-Jawf Province, Yemen.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources launched the 2024-2025 winter wheat harvest season in Al-Jawf Province, Yemen. The cultivated area increased by over 40% to 12,000 hectares, with expectations of significantly higher productivity. The Minister of Agriculture praised the efforts of various organizations and authorities contributing to the successful season. The Governor of Al-Jawf emphasized the importance of a safe environment for agriculture. The agricultural services sector highlighted the role of infrastructure, and the Grain Corporation announced a strategic plan for further expansion, including cost reductions and seed price adjustments, while also requesting the repair of a key transportation line.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade and the Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation jointly led the in augural meeting of t...
records.description: The Minister of Investment and Foreign Trade and the Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation jointly led the in augural meeting of the Potato Export Regulation Committee. They discussed regulations for potato production, inspection, and export, aiming to meet international standards and expand Egypt's agricultural exports. The committee reviewed the current export season, strategized to enhance Egypt's global potato export position, and focused on maintaining high product quality. A future vision for investment and trade with global partners, particularly the EU, was emphasized, along with the implementation of a full potato traceability system.
records.institution: The Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade, The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development, and International Cooperation in Egypt launched the second progress report on the "NWFE"...
records.description: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development, and International Cooperation in Egypt launched the second progress report on the "NWFE" Program, focusing on water, food, energy, and sustainable transport. This report, under the theme "Two Years of Implementation," highlights Egypt's efforts in climate action, particularly following its COP27 presidency. The "NWFE" Program, launched in 2022, aims to implement the National Climate Change Strategy 2050 and attract climate finance. The report details the program's progress in mobilizing international support and private investments, showcasing it as a replicable model for developing countries. The program includes nine projects with an estimated investment of $14.7 billion.
records.institution: The Ministry of Planning, Economic Development

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman met with the Federal Minister of Commerce of Pakistan to discuss agric...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of Oman met with the Federal Minister of Commerce of Pakistan to discuss agricultural cooperation and joint investment opportunities.They emphasized strengthening bilateral ties, with Oman highlighting Pakistan's export potential and Pakistan expressing interest in enhancing cooperation for sustainable development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Palestine participated in the Arab Conference for the Development of Scientific Research and Agricultural Extension in Damascus, organize...
records.description: Palestine participated in the Arab Conference for the Development of Scientific Research and Agricultural Extension in Damascus, organized by ACSAD. A research paper was presented reviewing the relationship between scientific research and agricultural extension and the most prominent achievements in this field. The importance of enhancing integration between them to support sustainable agricultural development was emphasized. The sessions witnessed discussions on the most prominent challenges facing Arab agriculture, such as climate change, water scarcity, and enhancing food security. The need for Arab cooperation in transferring and exchanging knowledge and modern agricultural technologies was highlighted, noting the importance of partnerships between Arab agricultural research centers to address environmental crises and achieve sustainable development.

records.title: Saudi Arabia, through the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, has successfully localized chia cultivation, particularly in th...
records.description: Saudi Arabia, through the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, has successfully localized chia cultivation, particularly in the Makkah region. This initiative diversifies crops, enhances food security, and promotes environmental sustainability.
