The Ministry of Agriculture is advocating for a higher institute for oasis studies to address climate change and supports the date sector through a quality promotion fund. Fishermen are receiving assistance to combat the invasive blue crab, and artisanal fishing is supported through investment premiums and reduced fuel prices. The modernization project for the Sidi Thabet irrigated area is progressing, with the upper zone completed and work on the lower zone now resolved.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: Eviso SpA has launched SmartMele Fruits Trading in Dubai to expand its global fruit trade operations.
records.description: Eviso SpA has launched SmartMele Fruits Trading in Dubai to expand its global fruit trade operations. This new entity will leverage Dubai's strategic trade hub status to optimize supply chains and distribution networks. The initiative aims to enhance fruit imports and exports through technology and data-driven improvements, providing Eviso SpA with competitive advantages in sourcing, logistics, and market intelligence.

records.title: Algeria's diversification strategy, implemented by the Algerian Interprofessional Cereals Office (OAIC), has significantly reduced French...
records.description: Algeria's diversification strategy, implemented by the Algerian Interprofessional Cereals Office (OAIC), has significantly reduced French wheat imports. Algeria has turned to wheat from other sources, particularly the Black Sea region. Consequently, the French share of the Algerian wheat market has declined sharply, causing concern among French exporters. FranceAgriMer has also reduced its export estimates for French soft wheat to third countries due to reduced competitiveness compared to Black Sea origins.

records.title: The Egyptian government has launched a Ro-Ro shipping line between Damietta Port and Italy’s Trieste Port to boost exports to Europe.
records.description: The Egyptian government has launched a Ro-Ro shipping line between Damietta Port and Italy’s Trieste Port to boost exports to Europe. This "green corridor" aims to reduce shipping costs and transit times for perishable goods, creating over 2,000 jobs. The government is offering financial and operational incentives, including reduced port fees and a dedicated 35,000-square-meter area. Digital integration between the ports, streamlined customs procedures, and enhanced security measures, including RFID technology and electronic seals, are implemented. Customs cooperation is further strengthened through an EU grant and a twinning program.

records.title: Morocco has successfully established itself in the Asian market, exporting 610 tonnes of fresh blueberries to Singapore and Malaysia in t...
records.description: Morocco has successfully established itself in the Asian market, exporting 610 tonnes of fresh blueberries to Singapore and Malaysia in the 2023/24 model year, matching the previous season's success. Exports to Malaysia increased by 50%, while those to Singapore saw a slight 13% decrease, though demand remains positive. Morocco is now a significant blueberry supplier to both countries, ranking third in Malaysia and fourth in Singapore, competing with countries like China, Spain, and Peru. Despite increased competition, particularly from China, Moroccan exports are considered successful.

records.title: The European pepper market is shifting, with Spain remaining the leading supplier to the EU, despite a volume decline.
records.description: The European pepper market is shifting, with Spain remaining the leading supplier to the EU, despite a volume decline. Morocco is rapidly gaining market share, showing a 65.6% increase in pepper exports over five years, driven by competitive pricing, improved quality, and better logistics. While Spain's export volumes have decreased, its revenue has increased due to higher prices. Morocco, though offering lower average prices, is experiencing significant revenue growth and is expected to see prices rise as its pepper quality gains recognition.

records.title: The Moroccan mandarin season, particularly for Nadorcott, is concluding with producers facing production challenges and intense market co...
records.description: The Moroccan mandarin season, particularly for Nadorcott, is concluding with producers facing production challenges and intense market competition. Weather conditions, notably drought, have impacted yields, though there's been some improvement compared to the previous year. Increased cultivation areas offer potential for stronger national supply. However, strong Egyptian competition has disrupted European export markets with lower prices. Producers are finding success in diversifying to markets like Russia and North America.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has signed two significant contracts.
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources in Oman has signed two significant contracts. A contract worth OMR28 million was awarded to Khimji Ramdas Contracting and Archimedes Marine Engineering for the construction of a multi-purpose fishing port in Masirah, which will support fisheries, tourism, commerce, and security sectors. Additionally, a usufruct contract with National Phoenix Company was signed for a OMR23.5 million white-legged shrimp project in Shinas, aiming for an annual production of 7,500 tonnes, contributing to food security and economic diversification as part of Oman Vision 2040.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in partnership with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, has announced...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, in partnership with the Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning, has announced six new agricultural investment opportunities in Al Buraimi Governorate, Oman. These opportunities, posted on the "Tatweer Platform," aim to attract investors and support SMEs in utilizing modern agricultural technologies. The initiatives include a major project for green vegetable cultivation in Al Zaroub and five SME-focused plots for growing various crops in Safwan. The government's efforts seek to enhance food security and agricultural productivity.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning

records.title: Taif Governorate in Saudi Arabia is historically significant for its advanced ancient water systems, including springs, dams, and wells,...
records.description: Taif Governorate in Saudi Arabia is historically significant for its advanced ancient water systems, including springs, dams, and wells, reflecting its strategic water management. Over 120 years, Taif has developed a unique irrigation and water supply system, contributing to water security. Today, with over 97% water network coverage, it serves as a key water source and strategic reservoir. Taif is home to ancient dams dating back to the Umayyad era, and historian Issa Al-Qasir highlighted the presence of around 70 dams, some with historical inscriptions, demonstrating Taif's rich water management heritage.

records.title: The Prime Minister reviewed progress in the state's cotton trading system, emphasizing support for farmers and the prompt payment of thei...
records.description: The Prime Minister reviewed progress in the state's cotton trading system, emphasizing support for farmers and the prompt payment of their dues, especially for the cotton crop. During a meeting with key ministers and officials, he discussed the implementation of the system, which aims to enhance cotton quality and add value across all manufacturing stages.

records.title: The Department of Statistics, in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, released the 2024/2025 annual survey of olive oil mills,...
records.description: The Department of Statistics, in collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture, released the 2024/2025 annual survey of olive oil mills, revealing a substantial increase in production in Jordan. Olive usage for milling rose by 33.1% to 184,903 tons, and olive oil production increased by 43.2% to 35,828 tons. The oil yield also improved to 19.4%, with the total value of production estimated at 223.9 million Jordanian dinars. Irbid Governorate led in olive usage and oil production, while Aqaba had the lowest figures.
records.institution: The Department of Statistics, The Ministry of Agriculture

records.title: Saudi Arabia's date production is a cornerstone of its food security, with 2024 yields surpassing 1.9 million tons, ensuring domestic abu...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's date production is a cornerstone of its food security, with 2024 yields surpassing 1.9 million tons, ensuring domestic abundance. The Kingdom has achieved 119% self-sufficiency in dates, solidifying its position as a leading global producer and exporter. Exports reached approximately 351,000 tons, while imports were minimal at 952 tons, showcasing the superior quality of Saudi dates. This surplus production allows Saudi Arabia to meet domestic demand and export to numerous countries worldwide.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia is promoting the purchase of local products to achieve environmental...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia is promoting the purchase of local products to achieve environmental and economic sustainability and enhance food security, aligning with Saudi Vision 2030. Their campaign emphasizes the high quality and safety of local products, which are subject to strict oversight. Buying local reduces the carbon footprint, supports local farmers, and promotes the consumption of seasonal and regional products, reducing food waste.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Forum, hosted by the Department of Energy (DoE), served as a platform for key decision-making institutions...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Forum, hosted by the Department of Energy (DoE), served as a platform for key decision-making institutions, including ADNOC, TAQA, Masdar, EWEC, FANR, DMT, DoF, EAD, ADAFSA, ENEC, and Tabreed, to collaborate on achieving the Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Strategy 2050. These entities, encompassing government agencies and private companies, are responsible for shaping policies, driving innovation, and ensuring sustainable energy and water management within the Emirate.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Green Rooftops project, implemented by Climate Action Network Jordan (CAN) under the "Samim" project, has concluded.
records.description: The Green Rooftops project, implemented by Climate Action Network Jordan (CAN) under the "Samim" project, has concluded. Funded by the French Development Agency (AFD), the project transformed building rooftops in Amman's Jabal Nasr area into green spaces to improve urban living conditions. CAN conducted a study, selected buildings, and provided training to local communities, especially women, on urban agriculture, business management, and climate change awareness. Participants learned to utilize rooftops for urban farming, optimize water usage, and explore agricultural business opportunities. CAN continues to work on projects related to desertification, environmental preservation, and climate change awareness.

records.title: KSrelief has signed a cooperation agreement with BCHR to support sustainable agriculture and empower the agricultural and fishery sectors...
records.description: KSrelief has signed a cooperation agreement with BCHR to support sustainable agriculture and empower the agricultural and fishery sectors in several Yemeni governorates. The initiative aims to benefit 3,000 individuals directly and 21,000 indirectly by providing agricultural inputs, fishing equipment, veterinary kits, and greenhouses. It also includes training programs and improvements in irrigation systems. This effort aligns with Saudi Arabia’s commitment to strengthening the agricultural sector and supporting small farmers and fishermen in Yemen.

records.title: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) and the FAO are conducting a 2.5-month training program for 25 supervisors to promote...
records.description: The Agricultural Investment Promotion Agency (APIA) and the FAO are conducting a 2.5-month training program for 25 supervisors to promote responsible agricultural investment for young people in Tunisia. The training aims to enhance understanding of responsible investment principles, integrate the IRA approach into supporting young agri-entrepreneurs, and build a professional network. It focuses on strengthening business coaches' skills in responsible support methodologies, enabling them to assist young entrepreneurs in aligning their businesses with the Committee on World Food Security (CSA-IRA) principles.

records.title: The Khadir Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association has begun its wheat harvest in Taiz province.
records.description: The Khadir Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association has begun its wheat harvest in Taiz province. The association aims to improve farming practices and boost production to achieve food security and increase farmers' income. They emphasized the importance of planning and monitoring to achieve self-sufficiency, and praised the association's role in local development.
records.institution: The Khadir Multipurpose Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: Algeria is grappling with rising wheat prices, impacting farmers and consumers.
records.description: Algeria is grappling with rising wheat prices, impacting farmers and consumers. Global market fluctuations and local economic factors are contributing to the increase, raising concerns about food security. The Algerian government has pledged to address the issue, aiming to protect farmers and ease the burden on consumers.

records.title: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain has finalized preparations to ensure ample supplies of live animals and...
records.description: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture in Bahrain has finalized preparations to ensure ample supplies of live animals and meat for Ramadan. Over 38,000 live cattle, sheep, and camels have already been imported, with an additional 12,000 expected, along with large quantities of fresh and frozen meat. 250 import permits have been approved. Veterinary quarantine centers have intensified inspections, conducting over 4,500 tests, and all meat shipments require health and Halal certificates.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture

records.title: The Arab Potash Company (APC) and the French Ambassador discussed cooperation, focusing on APC's global role in the fertilizer market.
records.description: The Arab Potash Company (APC) and the French Ambassador discussed cooperation, focusing on APC's global role in the fertilizer market. APC, the sole Arab potash producer and sixth globally, exports to over 30 countries. The French market is important for APC, with exports increasing significantly. Discussions emphasized sustainability, innovation, and strengthening economic ties between Jordan and France, particularly in addressing climate change and improving agricultural productivity.

records.title: The Julyana Free Zone is expecting to receive a significant number of commercial and oil vessels.
records.description: The Julyana Free Zone is expecting to receive a significant number of commercial and oil vessels. The port has recently experienced increased traffic, handling various tankers carrying fuels and commercial ships loaded with diverse goods, including containers, construction equipment, bulk materials, and foodstuffs. The port maintains continuous operation to facilitate the flow of goods to meet market demands. Collaborative efforts between the Free Zone Administration, Customs Administration, and Food Control Centre are focused on streamlining procedures.

records.title: The Guir-Ziz-Rheris Water Basin Council met to discuss water management, highlighting recent rainfall's positive impact while emphasizing...
records.description: The Guir-Ziz-Rheris Water Basin Council met to discuss water management, highlighting recent rainfall's positive impact while emphasizing the region's chronic drought. They reviewed dam filling rates, irrigation distribution, and future dam construction plans, addressing a projected water deficit by 2050. The council adopted internal regulations, focusing on sustainable water resource management and flood control.

records.title: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Agriculture Directorate and in partnership with CARE International, distribute...
records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through the Jenin Agriculture Directorate and in partnership with CARE International, distributed milk substitute to sheep farmers in Jenin. This initiative, part of a field school project, aims to improve newborn sheep nutrition, reduce pressure on nursing mothers, and enhance milk production efficiency. The distribution of 327 bags of milk substitute benefits 113 farmers across 14 field schools. The Ministry is committed to developing farmers' technical skills and promoting sustainable agricultural practices through training, support, and partnerships.

records.title: The Steering Committee of the COSTEA3 project, held at the French Development Agency (AFD), launched a new phase (2025-2027) focused on s...
records.description: The Steering Committee of the COSTEA3 project, held at the French Development Agency (AFD), launched a new phase (2025-2027) focused on sustainable irrigated agriculture and climate change adaptation. Palestine, along with other countries, is a key partner, emphasizing the importance of international cooperation in developing irrigation strategies. The project aims to generate knowledge on ecological agriculture, improve irrigation management, and enhance national capacities through training on treated water use in agriculture. This phase seeks innovative solutions for efficient water use, contributing to food security and climate change mitigation.

records.title: Saudi Arabia has developed an integrated and sustainable water security model despite its arid conditions, with leadership support and ma...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has developed an integrated and sustainable water security model despite its arid conditions, with leadership support and major investments in desalination and water networks. This was highlighted during a global dialogue session in Indonesia reviewing outcomes from the World Water Forum. The Kingdom's advanced water system, often called underground rivers, is central to its development strategies under Vision 2030. Emphasizing the need for international cooperation, Saudi Arabia advocates for sharing expertise and adopting best practices to address global water challenges and ensure sustainable management.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture has issued recommendations for safe food consumption.
records.description: The Tunisian Ministry of Agriculture has issued recommendations for safe food consumption. Citizens are advised to purchase animal products from veterinary-controlled establishments and fish from legal distribution channels, avoiding sun-exposed items. For canned tuna, certified companies and hygienic packaging are recommended. Red meat should bear a veterinary health seal, and white meat should come from approved slaughterhouses with proper temperature control. Milk and dairy products should be from approved establishments, with checked expiration dates.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) has initiated a "Farmer's Market" in Tunis, aiming to connect consumers directly w...
records.description: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP) has initiated a "Farmer's Market" in Tunis, aiming to connect consumers directly with local agricultural producers. Featuring a rotating selection of farmers, the market offers a variety of products at competitive prices. UTAP intends to expand this concept across the country, with support from an Italian project, to facilitate year-round direct sales. The Consumer Defense Organization (ODC) endorses this approach, emphasizing its potential to improve access to quality products and reduce reliance on intermediaries.
records.institution: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP)

records.title: Tunisia is developing a national strategy to combat food waste, aiming to launch it by September.
records.description: Tunisia is developing a national strategy to combat food waste, aiming to launch it by September. The initiative, led by the National Institute of Consumption (INC) with ministerial collaboration, will focus on raising awareness, engaging stakeholders, integrating educational programs, and establishing regulations. Food waste represents a significant portion of household spending, with bread, cereals, and vegetables being the primary items wasted. Food waste dramatically increases during Ramadan, indicating a deeply ingrained behavior requiring urgent attention and changes in consumption habits.

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Forum, organized by the Department of Energy (DoE), fostered collaboration between government and private...
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Forum, organized by the Department of Energy (DoE), fostered collaboration between government and private sectors to advance the Abu Dhabi Energy and Water Strategy 2050. Discussions centered on transitioning to clean energy, improving water desalination, and addressing future demand. Key themes included innovation, digital transformation, and sustainable policy development. Participants emphasized partnerships and a commitment to carbon neutrality by 2050 for a sustainable future.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The World Bank has approved a US$18.5 million project to help Iraq minimize environmental and health risks from Persistent Organic Pollut...
records.description: The World Bank has approved a US$18.5 million project to help Iraq minimize environmental and health risks from Persistent Organic Pollutants (POPs) and other chemical pollution. The project, co-financed by grants from the Global Environment Facility (GEF) and the Iraq Reform, Recovery and Reconstruction Fund (I3RF), aims to destroy or contain 4,000 tons of hazardous chemicals, develop management policies, and establish a monitoring system. It will also reduce health risks for approximately seven million people and improve livelihoods. The project supports Iraq's efforts to meet its obligations under international conventions and strengthens the Ministry of Environment's capacity.

records.title: The agricultural producer price index in Jordan increased by 13.9% in January compared to the previous year, reaching 88.1 points.
records.description: The agricultural producer price index in Jordan increased by 13.9% in January compared to the previous year, reaching 88.1 points. This rise was primarily driven by higher prices for green sweet peppers, hot peppers, and mandarins. Conversely, prices for grapefruit, cucumbers, and green beans decreased. Compared to December 2024, the index fell by 18.6%. When comparing January 2025 to January of the previous year, tomato and fennel prices decreased, while cucumber, banana, and white cabbage prices increased.

records.title: Mauritania has received agricultural equipment donated by Japan to support agricultural development.
records.description: Mauritania has received agricultural equipment donated by Japan to support agricultural development. The donation includes tractors, excavators, plows, seeders, harvesters, dump trucks, and spare parts, with a total value of approximately 150 million new ouguiyas. The support aligns with the country’s efforts to modernize agriculture, enhance food sovereignty, and improve resilience to climate challenges. Officials emphasized the importance of agricultural mechanization in boosting productivity and expressed gratitude for Japan’s continued cooperation.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry, in collaboration with the FAO, launched a project to support food security and healthy diets in...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry, in collaboration with the FAO, launched a project to support food security and healthy diets in the Red Sea State, Sudan. The workshop's goal is to improve food security through the Food Systems Transformation Initiative. The project aims to address food insecurity and malnutrition, aligning with Sudan's Sustainable Development Goals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry

records.title: The construction progress of a 100 MW photovoltaic solar power plant in Metbasta, Kairouan governorate, was discussed in a meeting betwee...
records.description: The construction progress of a 100 MW photovoltaic solar power plant in Metbasta, Kairouan governorate, was discussed in a meeting between the Minister of Industry, Mines and Energy and representatives from "AMEA Power." The Minister expressed satisfaction with the project's advancement, emphasizing its contribution to energy independence and diversification. "AMEA Power" presented the project's components, indicating it is slated for production. The new plant is expected to reduce electricity production costs from natural gas. This project represents the first stage of concession regime projects in the initial phase of Tunisia's renewable energy production program.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy

records.title: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has launched its annual Ramadan inspection and awareness campaign.
records.description: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA) has launched its annual Ramadan inspection and awareness campaign. Inspection teams will conduct visits to food establishments, focusing on food safety violations and promoting best practices. Food handlers will be educated on proper storage and hygiene. Public awareness initiatives will highlight food waste reduction and smart shopping. ADAFSA will also organize community events, including Iftar meal distribution and an event honoring volunteers. The public is encouraged to report food safety violations via a toll-free number.
records.institution: The Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority (ADAFSA)

records.title: A workshop in Sana'a concluded, focusing on the outputs of the first phase of the Agricultural Natural Resources Map.
records.description: A workshop in Sana'a concluded, focusing on the outputs of the first phase of the Agricultural Natural Resources Map. Organized by the Ministry of Agriculture and Sana'a University's Water and Environment Center, it emphasized the importance of scientific studies for agricultural development. Participants, including researchers and academics, evaluated soil, water, land use, and crop conditions. The workshop aimed to create a unified national database for investment and development, and participants were awarded certificates of appreciation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Sana'a University's Water and Environment Center

records.title: Egypt and the UAE signed agreements to enhance trade, investment, and economic cooperation.
records.description: Egypt and the UAE signed agreements to enhance trade, investment, and economic cooperation. Talks began on a comprehensive partnership, with Egypt highlighting investment-friendly reforms. The meeting coincided with the Investopia Summit, fostering global business discussions. Both sides agreed on collaboration in industry, energy, agriculture, infrastructure, and , food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Investment and Foreign Trade

records.title: Cool temperatures in northern Morocco have significantly delayed the ripening of soft fruits, specifically blueberries, pushing the peak...
records.description: Cool temperatures in northern Morocco have significantly delayed the ripening of soft fruits, specifically blueberries, pushing the peak harvest period back. Despite this delay, fruit quality is not expected to suffer, as producers have increasingly focused on premium varieties and adhere to stringent European food safety standards. Climate change is seen to primarily cause harvest delays. Moroccan blueberries are exhibiting positive quality indicators, including increased size, improved sweetness, and extended shelf life, giving them a competitive advantage over Latin American imports due to shorter transit times to European markets. While increased competition from Spain and Portugal is anticipated, Moroccan exporters are confident in the market's ability to absorb their quality produce.
records.institution: ONSSA (Office National de Sécurité Sanitaire des Produits Alimentaires)

records.title: Nama Water Services Company in Oman has signed four agreements for strategic water sector projects, including water distribution and wast...
records.description: Nama Water Services Company in Oman has signed four agreements for strategic water sector projects, including water distribution and wastewater network construction. The company is currently implementing 27 projects worth over OMR700 million to enhance water and wastewater systems across the country, contributing to increased water network coverage and job creation through its Omanization initiative.

records.title: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning (MHUP) held a forum to discuss the Saham Agricultural City project, a joint effort with the Mi...
records.description: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning (MHUP) held a forum to discuss the Saham Agricultural City project, a joint effort with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR). The project, aimed at strengthening food security and economic diversification in Oman, will span 94sqkm and support over 25,000 people annually. The forum reviewed progress, discussed the draft master plan, and gathered stakeholder input. This project is part of a larger strategy to develop sustainable agricultural cities, with two additional cities planned in Dhahirah and the Najd region of Dhofar, representing a combined investment of RO3bn.
records.institution: Ministry of Housing and Urban Planning (MHUP)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The Ministry of Environment launched the National Climate Policy Plan in Tunis, part of Tunisia's Nationally Determined Contributions (ND...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment launched the National Climate Policy Plan in Tunis, part of Tunisia's Nationally Determined Contributions (NDC) to combat climate change. The plan aims to strengthen climate resilience and support economic development across sectors like agriculture, industry, and waste management. A year-long implementation process will develop an NDC dossier and operational plan, focusing on water, renewable energy, and waste management, with financing plans. All relevant ministries will contribute to translating the policy into projects. The private sector, represented by UTICA, emphasized its role and the need for climate indicators in financial planning. Workshops discussed greenhouse gas reduction, energy transition, and climate integration into economic planning.

records.title: Pure Harvest Smart Farms and PlanTFarm have launched a redeveloped, high-tech agricultural facility in Al Ain.
records.description: Pure Harvest Smart Farms and PlanTFarm have launched a redeveloped, high-tech agricultural facility in Al Ain. The facility focuses on producing both branded consumer produce and resource-efficient animal fodder, utilizing AI-powered technology. A key innovation is a commercial-scale pilot for animal fodder production, which significantly reduces water consumption compared to traditional methods, addressing the region's dependence on imported feed. The farm also cultivates premium Korean strawberries and leafy greens, and facilitates plant propagation research and development. Pure Harvest's CEO emphasized the integration of vertical farms within a high-tech greenhouse, highlighting the economic and sustainable advantages. PlanTFarm's technology enables the cultivation of a wide variety of crops with maximized productivity.

records.description: Iraq is planning to construct its first 500 MW wind power plant as part of efforts to improve its electricity network and address supply shortages. The National Investment Commission (NIC) has completed the feasibility study for the project. This initiative follows Iraq's awarding of 7.5 GW worth of solar power projects to various companies.

records.title: A study reveals that the agricultural sector is a significant contributor to the national economy, adding a substantial amount in value.
records.description: A study reveals that the agricultural sector is a significant contributor to the national economy, adding a substantial amount in value. The sector's impact extends to numerous related industries, making up a significant portion of the overall economy. The agricultural sector ranks highly in terms of added value among all economic sectors. The study also highlights the sector's economic influence through its connections to other industries. Government officials emphasize the study's importance for strategic planning and focus on sectors with strong economic impacts.

records.title: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) in Jordan, working with the Ministry of Agriculture and the National Ag...
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organisation of the United Nations (FAO) in Jordan, working with the Ministry of Agriculture and the National Agricultural Research Centre (NARC), has announced two new agricultural projects. One project focuses on conserving and improving local almond varieties, aiming to protect agricultural heritage and create resilient crops. The second project aims to boost food security and rural livelihoods by promoting sustainable farming and improving farmers' access to markets. Officials highlighted the projects' importance for empowering farmers and fostering sustainable agricultural development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and the National Agricultural Research Centre (NARC)

records.description: The Chairman of Libya's Renewable Energy Authority (REAoL) met with representatives of a French business organization to discuss strengthening cooperation in renewable energy and energy efficiency. They reviewed a national renewable energy strategy and discussed arrangements for an upcoming Libyan-French forum focused on renewable energy.

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: CropLife Morocco, CropLife Africa & Middle East, and the AgroTech Association have launched a pilot project in the Souss-Massa region of...
records.description: CropLife Morocco, CropLife Africa & Middle East, and the AgroTech Association have launched a pilot project in the Souss-Massa region of Morocco to sustainably manage empty pesticide packaging (EVP). The project, part of Morocco's Sustainable Pesticide Management Framework, aims to establish a responsible system for collecting, treating, and disposing of EVP. In its first year, the project collected and safely disposed of 57 tonnes of EVP, trained farmers on proper handling, and gathered data for a potential national management framework. The initiative, funded by CropLife, promotes environmentally friendly agriculture and responsible pesticide use.
records.institution: CropLife Morocco, CropLife Africa & Middle East and the AgroTech Association

records.title: For the first time, the Paris International Agricultural Show (SIA) honored a foreign country, Morocco, highlighting the strong trade rel...
records.description: For the first time, the Paris International Agricultural Show (SIA) honored a foreign country, Morocco, highlighting the strong trade relationship between France and Morocco in the agricultural sector. Trade between the two countries is dynamic, with France now having a trade surplus. Morocco is a major supplier of agri-food products to France, particularly fruits and vegetables, dominating the tomato market. This has led to tensions with French farmers due to perceived unfair competition. France exports cereals, particularly soft wheat, and dairy products to Morocco.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests

records.title: Morocco and France have signed a partnership agreement to strengthen collaboration in digital agriculture (AgriDigital).
records.description: Morocco and France have signed a partnership agreement to strengthen collaboration in digital agriculture (AgriDigital). The agreement, between the Digital Pole of the Moroccan Ministry of Agriculture and the Federation of Agritech France (Ferme Digitale), aims to promote innovation and knowledge transfer. A roundtable discussion, preceding the signing, focused on strategic collaboration to develop AgriDigital and promote resilient agriculture. Proposed actions include technology sharing, AgriTech training, improved access to financing for startups, and promoting North-South and South-South cooperation. The event brought together various stakeholders from both countries.

records.title: The Brazilian Agricultural Research Corporation (Embrapa) has signed an agreement with OCP Group, including OCP Nutricrops, OCP Fertilize...
records.description: The Brazilian Agricultural Research Corporation (Embrapa) has signed an agreement with OCP Group, including OCP Nutricrops, OCP Fertilizers, and the Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P), to strengthen research and development in sustainable agriculture. The agreement aims to facilitate knowledge exchange and develop innovative solutions between Brazil and Morocco. Officials highlighted the importance of the partnership in addressing food insecurity and climate change.
records.institution: OCP Group, Mohammed VI Polytechnic University (UM6P)

records.title: Nama Water Services Company has signed four agreements for strategic water sector projects in Oman.
records.description: Nama Water Services Company has signed four agreements for strategic water sector projects in Oman. These projects include designing and implementing water distribution networks in several wilayats, constructing water networks, and building wastewater networks in Muscat. The company is currently implementing 27 projects worth over OMR700 million to enhance water and wastewater systems across Oman. These projects are contributing to increased water network coverage, a growing number of beneficiaries, and significant in-country value. Additionally, the company's Omanization initiative has created numerous jobs in the water sector.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) inaugurated the RO45.6mn Wadi al Jifnain flood protection dam in Seeb,...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) inaugurated the RO45.6mn Wadi al Jifnain flood protection dam in Seeb, Oman. This dam, completed in three years, aims to protect residential and commercial areas from flood damage. It features advanced technology, has a storage capacity of 11.5mn m3, and meets stringent safety standards. Environmental impact studies were conducted, ensuring minimal effect on local biodiversity. The project, including construction and consultancy, was completed on schedule.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture met with officials from the Maithalun Municipal Council to discuss agricultural issues in the region.
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture met with officials from the Maithalun Municipal Council to discuss agricultural issues in the region. The Minister emphasized the importance of supporting farmers and announced the opening of an agricultural department in Maithalun to provide technical and advisory support. The Municipal Council expressed their appreciation and agreed to enhance cooperation with the Ministry to implement sustainable agricultural projects. The meeting aimed to support the agricultural sector and strengthen partnerships for comprehensive agricultural development.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the FAO, held a three-day training workshop for veterinarians on controlling foot-and-...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the FAO, held a three-day training workshop for veterinarians on controlling foot-and-mouth disease. The workshop aimed to enhance veterinarians' capabilities in implementing the national control strategy, addressing disease spread, and mitigating its impact on livestock. Topics covered included rapid response, vaccination programs, epidemiological investigation, and safe disposal of infected animals. Officials emphasized the importance of technical competency, coordination, and adherence to preventive measures. Participants made recommendations focusing on improving immunization, emergency response, breeder awareness, and international cooperation.

records.title: Olam Group Ltd.
records.description: Olam Group Ltd. has finalized a US$1.78 billion deal to sell a controlling 80% stake in its agri-business unit, Olam Agri Holdings, to Saudi Arabia's Salic. This deal, valuing Olam Agri at US$4 billion, aligns with Saudi Arabia's strategy to secure its food supply chain. Olam Group will now focus on its core businesses in cocoa and coffee trading, and explore strategic options for its remaining businesses, including ofi. The transaction solidifies Salic's control over Olam Agri and is a key milestone in Olam Group's restructuring efforts.

records.title: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) and the UN Development Programme (UNDP) have signed an MoU to implement a grant for Somalia under th...
records.description: The Saudi Fund for Development (SFD) and the UN Development Programme (UNDP) have signed an MoU to implement a grant for Somalia under the Saudi Program for Drilling Wells and Rural Development in Africa. This program aims to improve access to clean water in rural Somalia through well drilling and solar-powered water networks, contributing to potable water access, desertification control, food security, and reduced waterborne diseases. The SFD has previously supported the drilling of over 10,000 wells in 21 African countries, benefiting over 5 million people.

records.title: Tunisian Minister of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries,called on an international rural development organization to implement ef...
records.description: Tunisian Minister of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries,called on an international rural development organization to implement effective agricultural projects in member countries. The minister emphasized the need for cooperation and knowledge exchange to promote sustainable development and social equity. The organization was urged to provide technical support and contribute to rural development, especially in addressing climate change. The importance of preserving natural resources and promoting sustainable agricultural practices was highlighted.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The UAE and Kenya have signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (Cepa) to boost trade, particularly in agricultural products.
records.description: The UAE and Kenya have signed a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (Cepa) to boost trade, particularly in agricultural products. This agreement is expected to increase Kenyan exports of organic produce to the UAE. Trade between the two countries has doubled in the last decade, with Kenya exporting meat, fruits, vegetables, and flowers, and importing petroleum, machinery, and chemicals. Kenya aims to become a middle-income economy by 2030, focusing on expanding food exports.

records.title: A training program on characterizing undergraduate academic programs at the College of Agriculture and Food Sciences has begun at Ibb Uni...
records.description: A training program on characterizing undergraduate academic programs at the College of Agriculture and Food Sciences has begun at Ibb University, in cooperation with the Development and Quality Assurance Center. The program, attended by 20 specialists, aims to develop an academic map to transform college programs into productive ones with a focus on applied aspects. Officials emphasized the importance of the training in aligning programs with accreditation standards and meeting the country's needs in agriculture, animal husbandry, and food industries.

records.description: An agriculture sector official in Mawiyah District, Taiz Governorate, assessed the success of a local wheat and bean cultivation experiment. Officials emphasized the importance of replicating this success throughout the district to achieve self-sufficiency in staple crops. The need for cooperation to advance the agricultural sector was also highlighted.

records.title: Egypt and Zambia signed multiple memoranda of understanding (MoUs) to enhance bilateral cooperation in various sectors.
records.description: Egypt and Zambia signed multiple memoranda of understanding (MoUs) to enhance bilateral cooperation in various sectors. The agreements cover political consultations, agriculture, agricultural quarantine and plant health, aquaculture and fisheries development, and infrastructure. These MoUs aim to strengthen collaboration between the relevant ministries and organizations in both countries.

records.title: SEKEM has partnered with government and energy sector entities to launch a project promoting organic agriculture in Matrouh.
records.description: SEKEM has partnered with government and energy sector entities to launch a project promoting organic agriculture in Matrouh. The initiative will support farmers in transitioning to organic practices, integrating them into carbon certification, and providing sustainable income. The project includes training, resource provision, market access facilitation, and carbon credit system participation. SEKEM, a social enterprise, aims to expand sustainable agriculture practices, building on its experience in supporting local communities and environmental sustainability.

records.title: Smart greenhouses, facing the challenge of meeting global food demands while minimizing environmental impact, are benefiting from the Art...
records.description: Smart greenhouses, facing the challenge of meeting global food demands while minimizing environmental impact, are benefiting from the Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm. This algorithm optimizes environmental parameters like temperature, humidity, light, and CO₂ to enhance plant growth while reducing energy consumption. Coupled with a fuzzy controller, the ABC algorithm ensures precise regulation of greenhouse devices, resulting in significant energy savings compared to other optimization methods like genetic, firefly, and ant colony algorithms. Tests have demonstrated the ABC algorithm's superior performance, achieving lower energy consumption and higher plant comfort indices. This technology holds promise for a more sustainable and energy-efficient agricultural model, combining innovation with environmental responsibility.

records.title: The dams within a specific Hydraulic Basin Agency have a filling rate of 36.47%, with a total reservoir volume exceeding 2 billion cubic...
records.description: The dams within a specific Hydraulic Basin Agency have a filling rate of 36.47%, with a total reservoir volume exceeding 2 billion cubic meters. Three dams have filling rates above 70%, while the major Al Wahda dam has a filling rate of nearly 38.50%. Other dams within the basin exhibit filling rates between 23.57% and 57.32%. The basin, which includes numerous dams and lakes, plays a crucial role in irrigation and flood control, and significantly contributes to the national economy. The basin experiences varying rainfall levels across its different regions.

records.title: A hydroponics laboratory has opened in Nabeul, Tunisia, to promote soilless cultivation of vegetables, tomatoes, and strawberries using r...
records.description: A hydroponics laboratory has opened in Nabeul, Tunisia, to promote soilless cultivation of vegetables, tomatoes, and strawberries using recycled water and nutrients. This method offers significant water savings compared to traditional agriculture, reduces fertilizer use, and eliminates chemical pesticides. Hydroponics, already successful in countries like Spain, the Netherlands, Morocco, and Egypt, is seen as a solution to water scarcity and climate change. Nabeul, an agricultural region, could become a hub for hydroponic experimentation in Tunisia, and the technique also offers potential for urban farming. This initiative aims to transform Tunisian agriculture towards a more sustainable and resilient model.

records.title: Tunisian date export revenues have increased, reflecting growth in both quantity and average price.
records.description: Tunisian date export revenues have increased, reflecting growth in both quantity and average price. Key export destinations include Morocco, Turkey, and France. Organic date exports also contributed significantly, with Germany, the Netherlands, and France being major importers. The overall trend indicates a rising demand and improved recognition of Tunisian dates in the international market.

records.title: A scientific workshop has started to discuss the results of an agricultural natural resources mapping project.
records.description: A scientific workshop has started to discuss the results of an agricultural natural resources mapping project. The workshop, organized by government and university entities, aims to assess soil, water, land use, crops, vegetation, and climate. Officials emphasized the importance of applying research to reduce imports, develop value chains, and enhance food security. Plans were outlined to introduce new crop varieties and develop value chains for imported food items. The workshop highlighted the need to utilize agricultural resources and promote collaboration between academics and government.
records.institution: The Irrigation and Agricultural Land Reclamation Sector, the Water and Environment Center

records.title: The local authority and an agricultural cooperative have launched the winter wheat harvest season, overseen by a government ministry.
records.description: The local authority and an agricultural cooperative have launched the winter wheat harvest season, overseen by a government ministry. The launch, coordinated with agricultural organizations, took place in multiple fields. Officials stressed the importance of expanding wheat cultivation to achieve self-sufficiency and reduce imports. They pledged ongoing support to farmers, including technical assistance and training, and highlighted the success of improved seeds and modern irrigation techniques. The ministry reaffirmed its commitment to supporting wheat farmers and ensuring sustainable production.
records.institution: The local authority in Al-Hodeida, the Dahi Agricultural Cooperative Association

records.title: Morocco was the guest of honor at the Paris International Agricultural Show (SIA), highlighting the strong relationship between Morocco a...
records.description: Morocco was the guest of honor at the Paris International Agricultural Show (SIA), highlighting the strong relationship between Morocco and France. The pavilion aimed to promote Moroccan agriculture, support local producers, and develop export markets, aligning with Morocco's "Generation Green" strategy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water

records.description: Oman is preparing for increased market activity during Ramadan by ensuring a steady supply of essential food items, particularly fruits and vegetables. Health and safety measures are being prioritized through hygiene monitoring and product testing, with collaboration from government agencies. The Directorate General of Consumer Protection Authority is actively monitoring prices, controlling expired goods, and preventing misleading promotions. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources has assured a stable supply of live meat and fish.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, Central Fruits and Vegetables Market (Silal)

records.title: The Zubair Enterprises Development Centre (Zubair EDC), in partnership with FAO-Oman, launched a pilot agricultural tourism project in Ba...
records.description: The Zubair Enterprises Development Centre (Zubair EDC), in partnership with FAO-Oman, launched a pilot agricultural tourism project in Balad Sayt village, Oman, aimed at stimulating rural economic growth, creating jobs, and empowering local communities. This initiative, under the patronage of the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources, focuses on promoting sustainable local agricultural products, developing value-added goods, and providing access to new markets through agricultural tourism. The project, aligned with Oman's Vision 2040 and FAO's mission, includes branding the village, honoring participating farmers, and fostering collaboration between public, private, and civil society sectors to create a resilient and thriving local economy.

records.title: The Ministry of Commerce and Export Development predicts a continued decline in inflation and consumer product prices.
records.description: The Ministry of Commerce and Export Development predicts a continued decline in inflation and consumer product prices. Maximum prices have been set for imported meats, and competitive pricing is encouraged for local meats. The ministry also emphasizes establishing direct sales outlets and implementing commercial offers to further reduce prices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Commerce and Export Development

records.title: A 10-day training course on voluntary work, development, and community initiatives concluded in Al-Adin district, Ibb province.
records.description: A 10-day training course on voluntary work, development, and community initiatives concluded in Al-Adin district, Ibb province. Organized by the local authority and Bunyan Development Foundation, with support from the Province's Agricultural and Fisheries Financing Unit, the course aimed to equip 38 "development knights" with the skills to promote local development. The training focused on preparing plans for community initiatives in awareness, services, and agriculture. Officials emphasized the importance of participatory work and collaboration between authorities and the community to achieve development goals and self-sufficiency.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The Bahrain Farmers’ Market has been extended for two additional weeks.
records.description: The Bahrain Farmers’ Market has been extended for two additional weeks. This extension aims to support Bahrain's agricultural sector and enhance food security, aligning with national directives and sustainable development goals. The market's success is attributed to the support of key figures and collaboration between relevant organizations. The extension will provide farmers with more opportunities to market their produce and allow the public to benefit from the market’s offerings.
records.institution: The Ministry of Municipalities and Agriculture Affairs

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The agricultural sector in Jordan is facing significant challenges due to climate change, including unpredictable weather, extreme temper...
records.description: The agricultural sector in Jordan is facing significant challenges due to climate change, including unpredictable weather, extreme temperatures, and water scarcity. Farmers are experiencing shifting planting seasons, rainfall shortages, and increased soil salinity, impacting crop yields. Experts warn that the climate crisis is a global security threat, with industrial nations failing to meet Paris Agreement commitments. Jordan is particularly vulnerable due to limited resources. The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with other ministries, has launched a national plan to combat climate change, focusing on sustainable water management, expanding green cover through artificial forests and treated wastewater, and building soil and major dams.

records.title: The Libyan Export Promotion Centre (LEPC) has announced that Bella Food Industries Company, part of Al-Sahel Holding Group, is expanding...
records.description: The Libyan Export Promotion Centre (LEPC) has announced that Bella Food Industries Company, part of Al-Sahel Holding Group, is expanding its presence in African markets by shipping cake products to Guinea and Congo. This expansion is seen as a sign of the success of Libyan industry in competing regionally and internationally. The LEPC highlights that this move demonstrates Libyan companies' commitment to entering African markets with high-quality products.

records.title: Morocco is set to import 100,000 sheep from Australia to address domestic red meat demand, which has been strained by declining livestock...
records.description: Morocco is set to import 100,000 sheep from Australia to address domestic red meat demand, which has been strained by declining livestock numbers due to prolonged drought. This move is part of Morocco's strategy to diversify its meat supply sources, which has included imports from Brazil, Uruguay, Argentina, and other countries. The government has implemented measures such as tax exemptions and import subsidies to boost supply. Additionally, Paraguay aims to increase its beef exports to Morocco. This reliance on imports comes as Morocco faces ongoing drought conditions that have impacted its agricultural sector.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Oman is rapidly advancing its renewable energy and green hydrogen sectors, exceeding initial targets through aggressive project developme...
records.description: Oman is rapidly advancing its renewable energy and green hydrogen sectors, exceeding initial targets through aggressive project development, driven by Hydrom and supported by its advantageous desert landscape and strong solar and wind resources, aiming for substantial renewable energy and green hydrogen production capacity to position itself as a key player in the global energy transition, attracting significant investment while acknowledging the need for continued policy and infrastructure support.

records.title: The Secretary of State to the Minister of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has called for an action plan to ensure e...
records.description: The Secretary of State to the Minister of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries in Tunisia has called for an action plan to ensure efficient cereal transportation and storage for the 2025/2026 grain collection campaign. The meeting addressed legal, organizational, and financial aspects, including pricing, payment terms, and storage optimization. Participants emphasized the need to mobilize resources and facilitate financing procedures. The Cereals Office will also provide training for its agents on calibration, sampling, and stock conservation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: A training course is being held for agricultural extension workers focusing on livestock and bee products.
records.description: A training course is being held for agricultural extension workers focusing on livestock and bee products. The course aims to improve their skills in agricultural extension and value chain development. Participants will learn about breed improvement, animal nutrition, feed processing, dairy and honey value chains, and disease surveillance. The goal is to promote agricultural development and encourage farmers to expand livestock and bee breeding.
records.institution: The Executive Unit for Agricultural Projects

records.title: Algeria plans to cultivate 60,000 hectares of sunflowers nationwide during the 2024-2025 agricultural season, a significant increase from...
records.description: Algeria plans to cultivate 60,000 hectares of sunflowers nationwide during the 2024-2025 agricultural season, a significant increase from the previous season's 2,000 hectares. The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries is providing support to farmers across 54 wilayas to ensure the program's success. This initiative aims to reduce import costs and enhance national food security. Experiments in various regions have shown promising yields, and 150 hectares in M'sila are dedicated to this sunflower cultivation trial.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Egypt is advancing its renewable energy goals with a new 2 GW wind power project, a $2.3 billion investment by ACWA Power.
records.description: Egypt is advancing its renewable energy goals with a new 2 GW wind power project, a $2.3 billion investment by ACWA Power. This will be Egypt's largest wind farm, surpassing ACWA Power's existing 1.1 GW Suez Wind Farm, and will be the largest single-asset Independent Power Producer (IPP) in the country. The project is a key part of Egypt's strategy to reach 42% renewable energy generation by 2030 and is expected to reduce carbon dioxide emissions by over 3.5 million tons annually. This project solidifies ACWA Power's significant investment in Egypt's renewable energy sector, totaling $8.8 billion across various solar and wind projects.

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: The International Company for Fertilizers and Chemicals (El Dawlia), a leading Egyptian joint stock company specializing in blended ferti...
records.description: The International Company for Fertilizers and Chemicals (El Dawlia), a leading Egyptian joint stock company specializing in blended fertilizers and agricultural inputs, experienced significant financial growth in 2024, reporting a 44.91% increase in net profit to EGP 228.73 million and a substantial rise in net sales to EGP 2.691 billion, alongside an increase in earnings per share to EGP 3.03, reflecting its strong performance in both domestic and international markets.
records.institution: International Company for Fertilizers and Chemicals (El Dawlia)

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture is intensifying efforts to combat Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) through increased preventive measures.
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture is intensifying efforts to combat Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) through increased preventive measures. The Veterinary Directorate is leading the campaign, which involves enhanced monitoring, investigation, and reporting of suspected cases, particularly in affected areas. Livestock movement is restricted in outbreak zones. Veterinary hospitals are being supplied with necessary medications and disinfectants, and farmers are receiving these supplies. An awareness campaign, including workshops and seminars, is underway to educate farmers on disease management and prevention.

records.title: Moroccan watermelon production is decreasing due to production restrictions and prolonged drought, severely impacting key growing regions...
records.description: Moroccan watermelon production is decreasing due to production restrictions and prolonged drought, severely impacting key growing regions like the southeast. Cultivated areas have been significantly reduced, with some regions experiencing complete bans on production. Water scarcity is expected to limit volumes in other areas as well. To compensate, Moroccan growers, including Jawhara Fruits, are increasingly turning to watermelon cultivation in Mauritania for earlier market availability.

records.title: Tunisia commits to the production of 550,000 quintals of selected seeds
records.description: Tunisia is launching a ten-year project to produce 550,000 quintals of selected seeds, utilizing the SeedSyst production system to enhance food security and climate resilience. The initiative, announced during an INRAT workshop, aims to reduce reliance on seed imports, a significant challenge for the national agricultural sector. The project will involve public-private cooperation to develop innovation platforms focused on improving cereal productivity and seed quality, thereby bolstering national food security and promoting sustainable agriculture.
records.institution: The National Institute of Agronomic Research of Tunis (INRAT)

records.domain: Seed technology and quality assurance systems
records.title: Tunisia is launching a ten-year project to produce 550,000 quintals of selected seeds using the SeedSyst system, aiming to boost food sec...
records.description: Tunisia is launching a ten-year project to produce 550,000 quintals of selected seeds using the SeedSyst system, aiming to boost food security and climate resilience. The initiative, discussed at a workshop hosted by the National Institute of Agronomic Research of Tunis (INRAT), seeks to reduce reliance on seed imports and address challenges like climate variability and supply chain disruptions. The project will foster public-private cooperation to develop innovation platforms, improve cereal productivity, and promote sustainable agriculture.
records.institution: The National Institute of Agronomic Research of Tunis (INRAT)

records.title: An initiative, "Economically nationalists, socially united," was launched to ensure sufficient and affordable consumer products during Ra...
records.description: An initiative, "Economically nationalists, socially united," was launched to ensure sufficient and affordable consumer products during Ramadan. The Council for Renewal of the Algerian Economy (CREA), in collaboration with the Ministries of Internal Trade and Agriculture, is leading the effort. Participating companies, including CREA members, are offering reduced prices on approximately 880 products. The initiative aims to promote solidarity and economic citizenship, ensuring market stability and protecting purchasing power. The government is also establishing local markets and developing legal texts to regulate the national market and prevent shortages. Ministers emphasized the commitment to coordinated efforts to ensure a steady supply of goods. An exhibition showcasing the reduced-price products was held.
records.institution: The Algerian Council for Economic Renewal (CREA)

records.title: Egypt has increased its grain purchases from Russia, with a notable rise compared to the previous year, according to Russia's agricultura...
records.description: Egypt has increased its grain purchases from Russia, with a notable rise compared to the previous year, according to Russia's agricultural watchdog. Egypt has bought a significant amount of grain from Russia, adding to the previous year's purchases. While the watchdog did not specify the amount of wheat, other reports indicate a substantial increase in Egyptian wheat imports from Russia. This surge in purchases occurs as Russia anticipates a decrease in its overall grain exports due to weather-related harvest issues.

records.title: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture has signed a JD5-million agreement to build a citrus and vegetable processing center.
records.description: The Jordanian Ministry of Agriculture has signed a JD5-million agreement to build a citrus and vegetable processing center. The center will include grading, packing, waxing, sorting, and cold storage facilities (12,000 tonnes). This project aims to stabilize supply and demand, address seasonal production gaps, enhance food security, and create jobs. It aligns with the Royal modernisation vision and the National Plan for Sustainable Agriculture (2022-2025), focusing on agricultural sector development, innovation, and export expansion. The agreement also emphasizes the need for specialized harvesting skills and investment in advanced water technologies.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures

records.description: Kuwait’s Minister of Electricity, Water, and Renewable Energy, emphasized the need for innovation, cooperation, and strategic planning to advance the energy sector, aiming for a 30-50% renewable energy mix and carbon neutrality. Kuwait will host the Sustainable Energy Week, fostering regional collaboration, investment in renewable projects, and energy efficiency initiatives to support sustainable development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Electricity, Water, and Renewable Energy
