records.description: The Palestinian Ministry of Agriculture, through its South Jenin Directorate, held a field day for almond farmers to demonstrate almond cultivation on arbors. This initiative, part of the Greening Palestine project, aims to increase productivity, improve product quality, and protect trees from damage. The demonstration highlighted the method's potential to significantly boost yields and profitability, especially in areas with fragmented land ownership.

records.title: Training courses on agricultural marketing were conducted in several regions.
records.description: Training courses on agricultural marketing were conducted in several regions. The courses aimed to improve the marketing skills of farmers, enabling them to better sell their agricultural products and enhance their economic resilience. The training was organized in coordination with local agricultural authorities and will be followed by further training for other beneficiaries.

records.title: Tanmiah Food Company signed an MoU with Brazil’s Vibra Agroindustrial to enhance Halal food production, optimize supply chains, and expan...
records.description: Tanmiah Food Company signed an MoU with Brazil’s Vibra Agroindustrial to enhance Halal food production, optimize supply chains, and expand global market reach. The partnership includes strategic investment in further processing, the creation of a global Halal brand, and innovations in sustainable food security within Saudi Arabia.

records.title: A partnership agreement has been signed to support the development of Tunisia's rapeseed industry.
records.description: A partnership agreement has been signed to support the development of Tunisia's rapeseed industry. This initiative aims to enhance Tunisia's food sovereignty and promote resilient agriculture. The project will focus on structuring the rapeseed sector through information systems, stakeholder dialogue, development planning, and financing priority actions. Technical management will be provided, while a national institute will ensure alignment with national strategies. A steering committee will oversee the project's implementation, aiming to integrate small and medium-sized agricultural holdings into a more efficient and sustainable agricultural system.
records.institution: The National Institute of Large-Scale Crops (INGC)

records.title: A Tunisian government official has urged the creation of a plan to improve cereal transportation and storage ahead of the 2025/2026 grain...
records.description: A Tunisian government official has urged the creation of a plan to improve cereal transportation and storage ahead of the 2025/2026 grain collection campaign. The meeting addressed logistical, financial, and legal matters, including pricing and storage capacity. Training will be provided to Cereals Office employees. The goal is to ensure a successful campaign.
records.institution: The National Institute of Agronomic Research of Tunisia

records.title: A field day focused on maize farming took place, showcasing locally developed maize varieties.
records.description: A field day focused on maize farming took place, showcasing locally developed maize varieties. The event emphasized maize's role in food security and farmer income. Local maize hybrids were presented, highlighting the importance of research and practical application. Officials called for collaboration between the public and private sectors to improve agricultural development and achieve food self-sufficiency. Support for private sector investment in agriculture was reiterated.
records.institution: Jannat Seeds Company for Seed Production

records.title: A training workshop was held for agricultural and development coordinators, focusing on conducting a survey of farmers and livestock bree...
records.description: A training workshop was held for agricultural and development coordinators, focusing on conducting a survey of farmers and livestock breeders. The workshop aimed to educate delegates on survey procedures and related agricultural and developmental tasks. It also covered topics such as identifying and training agricultural personnel, organizing markets, and promoting community awareness. The event was part of a local development program.
records.institution: Beit Al-Faqih Agricultural Cooperative Multipurpose Association

records.title: An Algerian executive decree has declassified approximately 21.79 hectares of agricultural land in several municipalities of Algiers for...
records.description: An Algerian executive decree has declassified approximately 21.79 hectares of agricultural land in several municipalities of Algiers for the construction of subsidized public housing (LPA) and access roads. The decree, signed by the Prime Minister, concerns plots in Ain Taya, Bordj El Kiffan, Birtouta, Ouled Fayet, Birkhadem, Ain Bénian and Staouéli, as well as access roads to a 6,000-unit housing development in Mehelma.

records.title: The production of subsidized cow's milk in Algeria has significantly reduced the country's milk powder import bill.
records.description: The production of subsidized cow's milk in Algeria has significantly reduced the country's milk powder import bill. Since the initiative began, a substantial quantity of subsidized cow's milk has been produced nationally. A dairy production group has stated they are prepared to meet the expected increased demand for milk.

records.title: During the Kazakh President's visit to Jordan, several MoUs were signed to strengthen bilateral cooperation.
records.description: During the Kazakh President's visit to Jordan, several MoUs were signed to strengthen bilateral cooperation. These agreements cover cultural exchange (2025-2027), environmental protection, cooperation between free zones authorities, mutual recognition of veterinary certificates for animal product imports, and media cooperation. Additionally, a memo was signed between the Jordan Uranium Mining Company and Kazatomprom for cooperation in uranium exploration and mining.

records.title: Algerian date exporters are facing significant challenges this season due to the closure of the Moroccan market.
records.description: Algerian date exporters are facing significant challenges this season due to the closure of the Moroccan market. The political crisis between the two countries has led to restrictions on commercial transactions, including the refusal of Algerian banks to accept contracts for date exports to Morocco. Despite strong demand in the Moroccan market during Ramadan, Algerian exporters are unable to access it. Alternative export routes, such as through Tunisia, are also blocked.

records.title: The Moroccan National Office of Food Safety (ONSSA) has strongly denied social media allegations that some Moroccan strawberries are cont...
records.description: The Moroccan National Office of Food Safety (ONSSA) has strongly denied social media allegations that some Moroccan strawberries are contaminated with hepatitis. ONSSA states that all strawberries undergo strict health controls, both for domestic consumption and export. In 2024, nearly 160,000 tonnes of berries were exported to various international markets after rigorous inspection. ONSSA also points to a 2023 EU audit that confirmed the high quality of Moroccan red fruit exports. They assure consumers that no contamination has been found and that Moroccan strawberries are safe to eat.
records.institution: The Moroccan National Office of Food Safety (ONSSA)

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform inaugurated a workshop to begin developing the ministry's strategic plan.
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform inaugurated a workshop to begin developing the ministry's strategic plan. The workshop is being conducted in partnership with the FAO and includes participants from Syria, other Arab nations, and humanitarian organizations.

records.title: The National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI), based on International Cereals Council (ICC) data, forecasts relatively stable but high...
records.description: The National Observatory of Agriculture (ONAGRI), based on International Cereals Council (ICC) data, forecasts relatively stable but high global cereal prices in 2025 compared to oilseeds, which may see price declines. While global cereal production reached a record high in 2023/2024, global stocks have decreased due to lower maize production in key regions. Global cereal trade also saw a slight decline. However, ONAGRI cautions that these forecasts remain uncertain due to potential weather events and trade policy changes, particularly in the US.

records.title: Tunisia's fishery product exports generated a surplus of 387 million dinars in 2024, a slight increase from 2023.
records.description: Tunisia's fishery product exports generated a surplus of 387 million dinars in 2024, a slight increase from 2023. While export value remained relatively stable, the quantity exported decreased slightly, though average prices increased. Fish, canned/semi-preserved foods, and crustaceans were the main export categories, with Italy, Spain, and Libya as primary importers. Blue crab, sea bream, and tuna exports saw fluctuations in quantity and value, while sea bass exports increased. Imports of fishery products decreased slightly in both value and quantity, with the majority intended for industrial processing.

records.title: Fresh food retail sales in the UAE, particularly in vegetables (over 1 million tons), meat (over 536,000 tons), and fruit (514,000 tons),...
records.description: Fresh food retail sales in the UAE, particularly in vegetables (over 1 million tons), meat (over 536,000 tons), and fruit (514,000 tons), have surpassed packaged food sales in 2024, according to Dubai Chambers. Dubai's diverse culinary scene and extensive retail outlets contribute to this trend. The UAE's food retail market is projected to reach $1.5 billion, with e-commerce experiencing rapid growth. Online food ordering services, while initially growing rapidly, have stabilized. Dubai's restaurant scene boasts over 9,400 establishments, with Asian cuisine leading in numbers.

records.title: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has launched its "Innovation Forum," coinciding with UAE Innovation Month.
records.description: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) has launched its "Innovation Forum," coinciding with UAE Innovation Month. The forum brings together officials, experts, and representatives from various sectors to showcase the latest innovations and AI-powered projects in environment and sustainability. MOCCAE emphasizes the importance of innovation in achieving Net Zero and tackling climate challenges. The forum includes an "Innovators Exhibition" featuring projects from universities and schools, as well as workshops and panel discussions on environmental innovation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: Experts at the Sana’a International Coffee Exhibition in Yemen emphasized the need for a specialized system to improve coffee productivit...
records.description: Experts at the Sana’a International Coffee Exhibition in Yemen emphasized the need for a specialized system to improve coffee productivity, quality, and market competitiveness. The Coffee Business Clinic, a key part of the exhibition, provides guidance to farmers, traders, exporters, and researchers on various aspects of coffee production, from cultivation and pest control to marketing and business development. Experts highlighted the clinic's role in establishing a comprehensive database on coffee farming practices across Yemen.

records.title: A 12-hectare test garden in Illizi, Algeria, has successfully demonstrated the viability of irrigating with purified wastewater.
records.description: A 12-hectare test garden in Illizi, Algeria, has successfully demonstrated the viability of irrigating with purified wastewater. Since its creation in 2019, the "Tinemri" garden has seen an 80% success rate in planting and growing over 5,000 fruit and forest plants, including olive trees and eucalyptus, using a drip irrigation system fed directly from the local wastewater treatment plant. The garden has since expanded its irrigation system with reservoirs and a rehabilitated network, further enhancing its capacity. This environmentally friendly project aims to preserve biodiversity, create a healthy microclimate, and provide recreational spaces for the local population, while also generating employment opportunities.

records.title: The Algerian state agency OAIC purchased 360-400 thousand tons of milling wheat through an international tender at a price of $262-263 pe...
records.description: The Algerian state agency OAIC purchased 360-400 thousand tons of milling wheat through an international tender at a price of $262-263 per ton CIF. Suppliers are expected to be from Romania, Bulgaria, and Ukraine. While Algeria initially planned to purchase a larger volume, the actual volume of the contracts was lower, creating some uncertainty regarding the final procurement figures.

records.title: A World Bank official praised Egypt's investment climate, particularly in the energy sector, citing positive economic developments, gover...
records.description: A World Bank official praised Egypt's investment climate, particularly in the energy sector, citing positive economic developments, government reforms, and IMF support. The Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency (MIGA) plans to guarantee projects worth around $650 million in Egypt, especially in renewable energy. MIGA also provides political risk insurance and investment guarantees in developing countries, including those affected by conflict.

records.title: Egyptian-Serbian relations are strong and growing, according to the Egyptian Minister of Agriculture.
records.description: Egyptian-Serbian relations are strong and growing, according to the Egyptian Minister of Agriculture. Bilateral ties date back to 1908, and both countries played key roles in establishing the Non-Aligned Movement. Recent high-level visits, including presidential visits in both directions, have resulted in numerous agreements and memoranda of understanding, including a Free Trade Agreement, covering areas like trade, agriculture, investment, higher education, and culture. Trade between the two nations has increased significantly, reaching approximately $300 million in 2024, with Egyptian exports exceeding Serbian imports. An Egyptian company has also begun manufacturing agricultural tractors in Serbia in partnership with Serbian investors.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: An investigative committee has been formed to examine reported cases of foot-and-mouth disease in buffalo and cattle.
records.description: An investigative committee has been formed to examine reported cases of foot-and-mouth disease in buffalo and cattle. The committee, comprised of experts, is conducting field visits, collecting samples, and consulting with local and international organizations. The relevant ministry has been instructed to assess damages and track the disease's spread. The public is assured that the disease affects only livestock and poses no risk to human health through consumption of animal products.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture confirmed that recent laboratory tests show imported cattle are free of epidemic diseases.
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture confirmed that recent laboratory tests show imported cattle are free of epidemic diseases. While some foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) cases were detected in specific areas, authorities have the situation under control, and the disease is limited to buffalo and does not affect humans. The ministry emphasized that imported shipments, including a recent one from Djibouti, were thoroughly inspected and cleared of disease. They continue to monitor the situation closely to protect public health and the livestock sector.

records.title: The Cabinet has approved several measures to strengthen the agricultural sector and boost national exports.
records.description: The Cabinet has approved several measures to strengthen the agricultural sector and boost national exports. These include an agreement to establish a regional Food Security and Nutrition Observatory, funded by the FAO, to improve data collection and analysis for better food security. The Cabinet also approved justifications for a new Plant Varieties Registration System and an amended system for tax declarations, both aimed at streamlining processes and supporting export competitiveness, particularly in the maritime shipping sector.

records.title: A Moroccan delegation is in Perth, Australia, finalizing a significant agreement to import 100,000 live sheep before May.
records.description: A Moroccan delegation is in Perth, Australia, finalizing a significant agreement to import 100,000 live sheep before May. This agreement follows two years of negotiations and aims to address a 38% decline in Morocco's livestock population since 2016, which has impacted red meat production. Australian lamb, known for its quality and nutritional value, is seen as a strategic solution to alleviate the shortage. Beyond immediate needs, this agreement could establish a long-term trade partnership between Morocco and Australia.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development, and Water and Forests

records.title: The Moroccan Association of Agricultural Engineering Students (AMEIA), in partnership with the Moroccan Confederation of Agriculture and...
records.description: The Moroccan Association of Agricultural Engineering Students (AMEIA), in partnership with the Moroccan Confederation of Agriculture and Rural Development (COMADER), is hosting a conference at the Hassan II Agronomic and Veterinary Institute in Rabat. The conference, themed "Moroccan agriculture: Towards an optimization of multi-sectoral production in the face of water scarcity and soil degradation," will bring together experts and stakeholders to discuss solutions to these pressing challenges. The program includes expert panels featuring representatives from the public and private sectors, as well as researchers.
records.institution: he Moroccan Association of Agricultural Engineering Students (AMEIA), The Moroccan Confederation of Agriculture and Rural Development (COMADER)

records.title: The second AgriTech Expo in Sefrou highlighted the Fez-Meknes region's growing role in agricultural transformation through technology and...
records.description: The second AgriTech Expo in Sefrou highlighted the Fez-Meknes region's growing role in agricultural transformation through technology and sustainable practices. Regional and agricultural leaders emphasized the need for modern, efficient agriculture, particularly in water and energy management, to achieve food sovereignty. Despite being a leading agricultural hub with significant water resources, the region faces challenges in water management and product valorization. Speakers stressed the importance of innovation, attracting youth to the sector, and promoting digital agriculture.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Agricultural Relief and with funding from the World Food Programme (WFP), has provid...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the Agricultural Relief and with funding from the World Food Programme (WFP), has provided agricultural inputs to 28 grape farmers in Beit Ummar. This support, part of a climate change resilience project, includes irrigation equipment, shade nets, spray motors, fertilizers, and water tanks. The initiative aims to boost agricultural production, improve grape quality, and mitigate the effects of climate change on local farmers.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Directorate, and the Applied Research Institute - Jerusalem (AR...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, through its Tubas and Northern Jordan Valley Directorate, and the Applied Research Institute - Jerusalem (ARIJ) have signed agreements with 22 farmers in the West Bank. Funded by the Mennonite Foundation (MCC), the "Supporting the Resilience of Farmers in Area C" project will rehabilitate greenhouses and agricultural ponds to improve production, increase water security, and support farmers in the face of challenges. This initiative aligns with the Ministry's strategy to cooperate with partners in the agricultural sector and strengthen farmers' resilience.

records.title: The Aseer region has become Saudi Arabia's top honey producer in 2024, leading in production volume, number of beekeepers (5,000), and ag...
records.description: The Aseer region has become Saudi Arabia's top honey producer in 2024, leading in production volume, number of beekeepers (5,000), and agricultural holdings (159). Aseer accounts for 20% of the Kingdom's total honey production. The region's agricultural sector has also seen significant growth, with SAR191 million in livestock support, over 4.5 million livestock benefiting from financial aid, 26,000 registered agricultural records, 53,000 hectares under cultivation, and 29 cooperative societies.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture (Aseer branch)

records.title: Watermelon farmers in the Jazan region of Saudi Arabia have begun harvesting, anticipating a large yield to meet Ramadan demand.
records.description: Watermelon farmers in the Jazan region of Saudi Arabia have begun harvesting, anticipating a large yield to meet Ramadan demand. With 14,000 hectares cultivated, they expect to produce over 15,000 tons. The watermelons are being distributed across the Kingdom. The 90-day cultivation process is relatively resilient, and each vine can produce several fruits. The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, through the Saudi Reef program, is working to improve watermelon production and expand cultivation. The ministry also organizes watermelon festivals to support farmers and promote local production, contributing to Vision 2030 goals.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: Gulfood, the world's largest annual food and beverage trade show, is currently underway in Dubai.
records.description: Gulfood, the world's largest annual food and beverage trade show, is currently underway in Dubai. The event is expected to generate USD 20 billion in trade deals and bring together thousands of exhibitors and attendees from across the globe. Key highlights include the Food500 Summit, the Gulfood Innovation Awards, and a visit by the UAE Vice President and Prime Minister, who emphasized Dubai's commitment to becoming a global hub for innovation and collaboration within the F&B sector.

records.title: Local officials in an unnamed region reviewed a successful wheat cultivation experiment in the Dabwan area.
records.description: Local officials in an unnamed region reviewed a successful wheat cultivation experiment in the Dabwan area. They emphasized the importance of replicating this success in other areas to contribute to self-sufficiency and food stability. The officials highlighted the soil's fertility and suitability for various crops, urging farmers to focus on planting essential grains and legumes.

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of the Sultanate of Oman praised Algeria's efforts in ensuring food security d...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources of the Sultanate of Oman praised Algeria's efforts in ensuring food security during his visit to Blida. He expressed interest in strengthening bilateral cooperation in the agricultural sector, particularly in areas like tree seedling production. The visit to Vitroplant Algeria, a company specializing in plant production, highlighted the potential for collaboration in areas like potato seed production and the exchange of expertise in modern agricultural technologies. This visit is part of the implementation of agreements made during the official visit of the President of the Republic to the Sultanate of Oman.

records.title: The Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture met with the Secretary-General of the International Centre for Advanced Mediterranean Agricultural S...
records.description: The Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture met with the Secretary-General of the International Centre for Advanced Mediterranean Agricultural Studies (CIHEAM) to discuss enhancing scientific and research cooperation. Key areas of discussion included joint research projects, scholarships for Egyptian researchers, degree equivalency, and a potential joint master's program. This collaboration aims to leverage CIHEAM's expertise in areas like sustainable development, agricultural economics, and environmental resource management to enhance Egypt's agricultural sector and contribute to sustainable development and food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, CIHEAM

This initiative, aimed at expanding Egypt's export capabilities, involves reduced shipping costs, streamlined customs procedures, improved infrastructure, and enhanced digital integration. By facilitating trade and creating new job opportunities, the Ro-Ro line is expected to play a crucial role in boosting Egypt's economy and strengthening its position as a logistics hub.

records.title: Jordan's date industry is experiencing significant growth, with substantial investments exceeding half a billion dollars.
records.description: Jordan's date industry is experiencing significant growth, with substantial investments exceeding half a billion dollars. The area under date palm cultivation is expanding rapidly, and production, particularly of high-quality Medjoul dates, is increasing. With 65% of its date production exported to around 24 countries, Jordan is a major player in the global date market. While challenges like water availability and skilled labor have been addressed, the industry continues to grow at a steady pace, with annual growth rates estimated at 10-15%.

records.title: Moroccan onion exports to the United Arab Emirates surged significantly in 2024, reaching over 5,500 tons and generating $1.1 million in...
records.description: Moroccan onion exports to the United Arab Emirates surged significantly in 2024, reaching over 5,500 tons and generating $1.1 million in revenue. The UAE, previously heavily reliant on Indian onion imports, sought alternative suppliers, allowing Morocco to capitalize on this opportunity and establish itself as a key player in the Emirati onion market.

records.title: Morocco is facing a significant decline in its livestock population, impacting domestic meat production.
records.description: Morocco is facing a significant decline in its livestock population, impacting domestic meat production. To address this, the government has removed taxes on imported beef and increased imports from countries like Australia and Paraguay. Additionally, measures to support domestic livestock production, such as distributing subsidized fodder and improving veterinary services, are being implemented. While Morocco is a net importer of meat, it also exports poultry meat to several African countries. These measures aim to stabilize meat prices and ensure adequate supply in the face of declining domestic production.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests.

records.description: The Béni Mellal-Khénifra region in Morocco is facing a severe water crisis due to prolonged drought, significantly impacting sugar beet cultivation. To address this, Cosumar, a key player in the sugar industry, advocates for the establishment of a desalination plant as a strategic solution for regional development. Cosumar has implemented various measures to mitigate the impact of drought, including partnering with farmers, revaluing the purchase price of sugar beets, and adopting water-saving measures. The company is committed to ensuring the sustainability of the sugar industry by combining innovation, farmer support, and responsible water resource management.

The "Oued Ermal" dam has reached 21 million cubic meters of its 23 million cubic meter capacity, while the "Bir Mcherga" dam has recorded 10.2 million cubic meters of its 41.6 million cubic meter capacity. Mountain dams have reached 6.7 million cubic meters of their 27.5 million cubic meter capacity, and mountain lakes have around 2 million cubic meters of their 4 million cubic meter capacity. These increased water reserves will significantly contribute to the recharge of the water table and improve water quality.

records.description: Scientists from the University of Gabès, Tunisia, conducted research on green hydrogen production using a photovoltaic system and an electrolyzer. Their findings, published in the International Journal of Thermofluids, highlight the significant impact of both photovoltaic panel orientation and water quality on hydrogen production efficiency. Variable panel orientation and the use of distilled water (though with higher energy costs) were found to significantly increase hydrogen production rates compared to fixed panels and demineralized water. These findings provide crucial insights for optimizing green hydrogen production systems and contribute to the development of more sustainable and efficient energy solutions.

records.title: The Tunisian livestock sector is facing significant challenges, including a decline in national beef production and a decapitalization of...
records.description: The Tunisian livestock sector is facing significant challenges, including a decline in national beef production and a decapitalization of the cattle herd. These issues are attributed to factors such as rising production costs, low profitability for farmers, and increasing risks due to climate change and global market fluctuations. The absence of a risk-sharing policy between the state and farmers is exacerbating these challenges, leading to a decline in production and an increase in meat prices. The director of animal production at the Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries has called for urgent action to address these issues and ensure the sustainability of the livestock sector.
records.institution: The Tunisian Union of Agriculture and Fisheries (UTAP)

records.title: Egyptian dates are experiencing a surge in demand, particularly in Morocco, ahead of Ramadan.
records.description: Egyptian dates are experiencing a surge in demand, particularly in Morocco, ahead of Ramadan. Despite moderate production volumes in Egypt, the quality of Egyptian dates, especially those from the wadi, is highly competitive compared to traditional suppliers like Tunisia and Algeria. Factors contributing to this success include unfavorable climatic conditions in Tunisia, the diplomatic rupture between Algeria and Morocco, and the competitive pricing of Egyptian dates. This analysis suggests that Egyptian dates are well-positioned to further strengthen their presence in the Moroccan market in the coming years.

records.title: The 2024/2025 agricultural campaign in Morocco is facing a severe water deficit due to insufficient rainfall.
records.description: The 2024/2025 agricultural campaign in Morocco is facing a severe water deficit due to insufficient rainfall. This has significantly impacted cereal crops, arboriculture, and livestock farming. While some hope remains for timely rainfall to mitigate losses, the situation is critical, with farmers facing challenges such as limited access to water resources and rising costs for livestock feed. A prolonged drought could have significant economic and social repercussions for the agricultural sector and the country as a whole.

records.description: The Yemeni government launched the Supplementary Local Development Program to stimulate the local economy, mobilize national capabilities, and enhance production. The program focuses on activating partnerships between the government and society, supporting contract farming, and stimulating cooperative societies. Key participants in the launch included members of the Supreme Political Council, the Deputy Prime Minister, and ministers from various sectors. The program aims to reduce reliance on imports and improve the national economy.

records.title: DP World has announced that 65% of the first phase of its Sokhna Logistics Park in Egypt is now complete.
records.description: DP World has announced that 65% of the first phase of its Sokhna Logistics Park in Egypt is now complete. Located 10km from Sokhna Port, the 300,000 sqm facility is designed to provide cost-effective, integrated supply chain solutions, leveraging DP World's global network. The park will enhance Egypt's logistics infrastructure and position the country as a key regional trade hub, attracting both local and international businesses. The park will offer a range of services, including warehousing, freight forwarding, customs clearing, and value-added services, supporting a wide range of industries.

records.title: Egyptian imports of Russian wheat surged by 70%, making Egypt Russia's largest buyer.
records.description: Egyptian imports of Russian wheat surged by 70%, making Egypt Russia's largest buyer. This significant increase comes as Russia prepares to implement annual export restrictions, which will limit wheat exports to 10.6 million tonnes. Other major importers of Russian wheat include Bangladesh, Algeria, and Kenya. This news highlights the growing importance of Russia as a major supplier of wheat to global markets and the impact of export restrictions on international grain trade.

records.title: Go Green for Agricultural Investment, a company specializing in jojoba oil production, plans to invest up to EGP 500 million in 2025 to b...
records.description: Go Green for Agricultural Investment, a company specializing in jojoba oil production, plans to invest up to EGP 500 million in 2025 to boost land reclamation and expansion plans, including expanding its olive cultivation to 5,000 acres. The company, which began trading its shares on the Egyptian Exchange, has exported jojoba oil to Cargill and plans to double its annual production to meet increasing demand. Go Green will secure financing from various sources, including capital raises and investor contributions.

records.title: The National Veal Project has approved funding for 428 small-scale farmers and young graduates to purchase 4,280 head of cattle under the...
records.description: The National Veal Project has approved funding for 428 small-scale farmers and young graduates to purchase 4,280 head of cattle under the “Decent Life” initiative. This brings the total funding for the project to over EGP 9.3 billion, benefiting thousands of farmers and supporting the breeding and fattening of over 514,000 cattle. The project aims to stabilize red meat prices, benefit producers and consumers, and improve rural livelihoods. Farmers can apply for support through agricultural administration offices, banks, or by contacting the Livestock and Poultry Development Sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: The Mauritanian Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the FAO, launched a workshop to promote agricultural mechanization.
records.description: The Mauritanian Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the FAO, launched a workshop to promote agricultural mechanization. The workshop aims to equip farmers with the knowledge and skills necessary to utilize modern equipment effectively, thereby increasing productivity and reducing reliance on manual labor. This aligns with the government's efforts to modernize agriculture and achieve food security.

records.title: A conference in Rabat, Morocco, explored the role of inter-professional organizations in the development of the agricultural sector.
records.description: A conference in Rabat, Morocco, explored the role of inter-professional organizations in the development of the agricultural sector. These organizations are crucial for coordinating and optimizing sector organization. The conference aimed to identify success factors and address challenges to strengthen the effectiveness of inter-professional organizations. The discussions emphasized the importance of government support and collaboration among stakeholders to enable these organizations to effectively manage both abundance and scarcity crises, particularly in the face of climate change.
records.institution: The Moroccan Association of Agroeconomics (AMAECO), The Moroccan Confederation of Agriculture and Rural Development (COMADER

records.title: Morocco is seeking to expand its citrus fruit exports to Japan, following the successful initiation of exports to this market earlier thi...
records.description: Morocco is seeking to expand its citrus fruit exports to Japan, following the successful initiation of exports to this market earlier this year. A business mission to Japan is planned to promote Moroccan citrus fruits to Japanese professionals and consumers. This initiative aims to strengthen Morocco's presence in the Asian market, which is experiencing significant growth. While facing competition from established suppliers, Morocco is diversifying its export markets beyond traditional destinations in Europe and North America.

records.title: Within the framework of a project to enhance resilience and improve livelihoods for farmers, implemented by Agricultural Relief in cooper...
records.description: Within the framework of a project to enhance resilience and improve livelihoods for farmers, implemented by Agricultural Relief in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, 41 farmers from Al-Khader and Jouret Al-Sham’a received agricultural supplies to establish 45 dunums of grape arbors using the T-training method. These supplies included camel eye fence, grape shade net, and petrol spray tanks. Funded by the World Food Programme (WFP), this project reflects the commitment of the Ministry of Agriculture and partner institutions to support farmers and achieve food security in areas most affected by the effects of climate change.

records.title: The 10th edition of Al-Ahsa Factory Dates Festival, organized by Al-Ahsa Municipality, witnessed a significant turnout of visitors.
records.description: The 10th edition of Al-Ahsa Factory Dates Festival, organized by Al-Ahsa Municipality, witnessed a significant turnout of visitors. The festival aimed to showcase Al-Ahsa dates and promote their processed products, support farmers and date factories, and elevate dates' cultural significance. Visitors enjoyed various activities, including date sales, an interactive kitchen, a heritage zone, and cultural performances. The festival successfully combined cultural, economic, and social aspects, promoting Al-Ahsa's rich date heritage while supporting local businesses and attracting visitors.

records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Animal Health Platform.
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture has launched an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Animal Health Platform. This innovative system utilizes AI to analyze veterinary data, track infections, and predict animal disease cases, enabling real-time monitoring and improving veterinary care. The platform aligns with the ministry's efforts to leverage modern technologies to achieve sustainability in the agriculture and livestock sector.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: A partnership agreement was signed in Tunisia to establish a system for verifying and validating greenhouse gas emissions.
records.description: A partnership agreement was signed in Tunisia to establish a system for verifying and validating greenhouse gas emissions. The agreement, between the National Agency for Energy Management (ANME), the National Institute of Standardization and Industrial Property (INNORPI), and the National Accreditation Council in Tunisia (TUNAC), aims to reduce the carbon footprint of industrial companies and enhance their competitiveness. This system will facilitate access to international markets by ensuring compliance with global environmental standards and strengthening Tunisia's low-carbon economy transition. A joint working team will develop an action plan and regulatory framework, and awareness campaigns will be conducted. The system is expected to attract green investments and support sustainable projects.

records.title: The Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Sfax, in collaboration with its Libyan counterpart, is organizing a trade mission focused on oliv...
records.description: The Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Sfax, in collaboration with its Libyan counterpart, is organizing a trade mission focused on olive oil in Misrata, Libya. This initiative aims to connect Tunisian olive oil companies with Libyan traders and import-export bodies, facilitating business meetings and networking opportunities. This trade mission aligns with Tunisia's efforts to expand its olive oil exports, following a significant increase in export revenues.
records.institution: The Chamber of Commerce and Industry of Sfax

records.title: The First Deputy Prime Minister inspected the work progress at the Haran agricultural nurseries in Dhamar and reviewed preparations for t...
records.description: The First Deputy Prime Minister inspected the work progress at the Haran agricultural nurseries in Dhamar and reviewed preparations for the upcoming afforestation campaign. He urged for increased efforts to expand the cultivation of fruit trees and trees with tangible benefits. The governor reviewed the provincial leadership's plan to make the afforestation campaign a success and promote the culture of agriculture among the community. The nurseries have a production capacity of 300,000 seedlings, and the director of the agriculture sector discussed efforts to expand the cultivation of fruit trees, coffee, cereals, and legumes. This initiative demonstrates the government's commitment to promoting agriculture and environmental sustainability in Yemen.

records.title: The Algerian government has taken several measures to ensure a regular supply of consumer goods during Ramadan.
records.description: The Algerian government has taken several measures to ensure a regular supply of consumer goods during Ramadan. These measures include increasing domestic production of essential goods, implementing an exceptional meat import program, and simplifying import procedures. The government is also organizing local markets, authorizing discounts and promotional sales, and strengthening market control to ensure a stable and balanced supply of products during the holy month.
records.institution: The Minister of Domestic Trade and National Market Regulation

records.title: The Bahrain International Garden Show is a premier agricultural event showcasing the latest innovations in horticulture and agricultural...
records.description: The Bahrain International Garden Show is a premier agricultural event showcasing the latest innovations in horticulture and agricultural technology. Held in Bahrain, the show brings together investors, farmers, and researchers from around the world. Key highlights include a dedicated pavilion for Bahraini farmers, international participation, a platform for entrepreneurs, and interactive pavilions raising agricultural awareness and promoting environmental sustainability. The exhibition aims to contribute to the development of the agricultural sector in Bahrain, foster international cooperation, and promote environmental sustainability.

records.title: Annual urban inflation in Egypt slowed slightly, but monthly inflation increased significantly.
records.description: Annual urban inflation in Egypt slowed slightly, but monthly inflation increased significantly. Key price increases were observed in food categories such as grains, bread, meat, and fruits, while transportation and medical costs also rose. The central bank extended its inflation target timeline and kept interest rates unchanged, acknowledging the need for a gradual approach to inflation control. Despite the slight moderation in annual inflation, the central bank emphasized that inflation risks persist due to global geopolitical tensions. The central bank expects inflation to decline significantly in the coming quarters and reaffirmed its commitment to using all available tools to curb inflation and ensure it reaches target levels
records.institution: Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS)

records.title: Juhayna Food Industries participated in Fruit Logistica, a leading global exhibition for fresh agricultural products, showcasing its citr...
records.description: Juhayna Food Industries participated in Fruit Logistica, a leading global exhibition for fresh agricultural products, showcasing its citrus produce from Enmaa, its sustainable agricultural arm. Enmaa, located in the New Valley Governorate, utilizes eco-friendly farming techniques and has achieved several international certifications, including GLOBAL G.A.P., GRASP, and SPRING. This participation highlights Juhayna's commitment to innovation, sustainability, and enhancing Egypt's agricultural exports.

records.title: The Suez Canal Authority (SCA) is exploring a strategic partnership with China’s FAMSUN to enhance food security and diversify economic a...
records.description: The Suez Canal Authority (SCA) is exploring a strategic partnership with China’s FAMSUN to enhance food security and diversify economic activities. SCA Chairperson Osama Rabie emphasized Egypt’s commitment to international cooperation and leveraging the canal’s strategic position for large-scale development projects. The discussions focused on advanced grain storage solutions and agricultural engineering, aligning with Egypt’s broader food security initiatives. FAMSUN, known for its expertise in agro-industrial manufacturing, expressed keen interest in Egypt’s growing role as a trade hub.

records.title: As part of the Phén'Olive participatory research network, a delegation of Moroccan olive growers traveled to Montpellier, France, to deep...
records.description: As part of the Phén'Olive participatory research network, a delegation of Moroccan olive growers traveled to Montpellier, France, to deepen their knowledge of olive tree flowering and exchange with French counterparts. This project, born from the ClimOliveMed initiative, aims to better understand the effects of climate change on olive tree flowering. The visit included discussions on cultural practices for climate adaptation, olive oil promotion strategies, and a visit to the Centre de Ressources Biologiques de l'Olivier, showcasing the genetic diversity of French olive growing. This exchange fostered collaboration between Moroccan and French olive growers and researchers, demonstrating a commitment to innovate and adapt to the challenges of climate change in Mediterranean olive growing.

records.title: The Qatar National Food Security Strategy 2030 aims to ensure food security by maintaining a strategic reserve of essential food items fo...
records.description: The Qatar National Food Security Strategy 2030 aims to ensure food security by maintaining a strategic reserve of essential food items for two to eight months. This strategy focuses on three pillars: domestic production, strategic storage, and international trade. Key initiatives include enhancing domestic production of key commodities and supporting farmers, while the strategic reserve aims to cover essential commodities such as wheat, rice, sugar, and edible oils, providing a buffer against supply chain shocks.

records.title: Saudi Arabia and Argentina have signed a memorandum of understanding to enhance cooperation in the agricultural sector.
records.description: Saudi Arabia and Argentina have signed a memorandum of understanding to enhance cooperation in the agricultural sector. The agreement, signed in Riyadh by the Saudi Minister of Environment, Water, and Agriculture, and Argentine Minister of Foreign Affairs, International Trade, and Worship, focuses on collaboration in agricultural products, technological innovation, rural development, and marketing. It aims to promote sustainable development, improve living standards, and explore investment opportunities, strengthening economic and developmental ties between the two countries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.description: The Agricultural and Rural Development Project around the Hill Lakes (DARAL 2) was launched, focusing on the integrated and sustainable management of natural resources in the Governorates of Kasserine, Jendouba, and Siliana. Funded by the German Bank for Development and Reconstruction (KFW) and the European Union, the project aims to contribute to climate change adaptation and improve the living conditions of local communities by supporting sustainable resource management, promoting integrated territorial development, and enhancing the resilience of farmers.

records.title: The first day of Ramadan is expected to be March 1st.
records.description: The first day of Ramadan is expected to be March 1st. The Ministry of Trade is taking measures to ensure the availability of essential goods and stable prices during the holy month, including increased market surveillance and coordination with regional authorities. The Director of the National Observatory of Supply and Prices has denied any anticipated increase in meat prices and assured the availability of sufficient supplies of essential commodities. The National Authority for Food Safety will strictly enforce food safety regulations, particularly regarding the sale of perishable products.
records.institution: The Ministry of Trade and Export Development

records.title: Ne'ma, the National Food Loss and Waste Initiative, is collaborating with Taste of Dubai to expand efforts in food waste reduction at the...
records.description: Ne'ma, the National Food Loss and Waste Initiative, is collaborating with Taste of Dubai to expand efforts in food waste reduction at the culinary festival. Building on the success of their previous collaboration, ne'ma aims to divert food waste from landfills, reduce greenhouse gas emissions, and create compost. The partnership will involve educating visitors on practical ways to minimize food waste in their daily lives and implementing effective waste management practices at the event, including waste segregation and composting.

records.title: In Hajjah province, Yemen, a national emergency campaign to treat livestock against foot-and-mouth disease is underway.
records.description: In Hajjah province, Yemen, a national emergency campaign to treat livestock against foot-and-mouth disease is underway. Funded by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the campaign aims to protect livestock from death in response to appeals by farmers. The campaign involves specialized veterinary teams and includes awareness programs on livestock care and disease prevention. Officials of the agricultural sector in the directorates appreciated the ministry's efforts in confronting the disease and preserving livestock as a vital component of the national economy.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Hassan Allam Holding has launched Jinet Agriculture Corporation, a new subsidiary dedicated to enhancing agricultural productivity and su...
records.description: Hassan Allam Holding has launched Jinet Agriculture Corporation, a new subsidiary dedicated to enhancing agricultural productivity and sustainability. As part of this initiative, Jinet Agriculture has acquired 14,100 feddans of agricultural land in West Minya. This investment aims to increase agricultural output, generate employment, and strengthen the national economy, aligning with Egypt's Vision 2030 and global Sustainable Development Goals. By implementing modern cultivation techniques and investing in post-harvest processing infrastructure, the company aims to transform agricultural output into globally competitive food products.

records.title: The Libyan Export Promotion Centre (LEPC) reported that the first shipment of dates was exported to Spain by the Sakia El Dhahabi Company.
records.description: The Libyan Export Promotion Centre (LEPC) reported that the first shipment of dates was exported to Spain by the Sakia El Dhahabi Company. This successful export reflects the growing competitiveness of Libyan products in regional and international markets. It also signifies the efforts of Libyan companies in breaking into European markets with high-quality products.

records.title: A meeting in Rabat focused on ensuring the supply of national markets with agricultural products in Morocco.
records.description: A meeting in Rabat focused on ensuring the supply of national markets with agricultural products in Morocco. Despite the challenges of successive years of drought, including lack of water and high temperatures, efforts are being made to ensure adequate and regular supply. The meeting brought together the Minister of Agriculture, professionals, Chambers of Agriculture, and COMADER to examine solutions and address these challenges collectively, aiming to ensure the stability and livelihoods of the rural population.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests, COMADER

records.title: Morocco is facing a shortage of domestic dates due to drought, leading to increased imports from countries such as Tunisia, Egypt, and Sa...
records.description: Morocco is facing a shortage of domestic dates due to drought, leading to increased imports from countries such as Tunisia, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia to meet local demand, particularly during the upcoming Ramadan. Despite the challenges, the Moroccan government has taken steps to boost the date palm sector, including signing agreements to enhance agricultural practices and support farmers in the Drâa-Tafilalet region.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development

records.title: Al-Baha region, known for its diverse agricultural crops, is poised for further growth with the signing of a contract to establish an agr...
records.description: Al-Baha region, known for its diverse agricultural crops, is poised for further growth with the signing of a contract to establish an agricultural city dedicated to the cultivation of almonds and other fruits. This initiative aims to expand almond production, create jobs, and boost the local economy. Almonds are a valuable and durable commodity, and Al-Baha holds a distinct advantage in almond production within the Kingdom.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: Farmers in the Najran region are preparing to harvest their wheat crop in March.
records.description: Farmers in the Najran region are preparing to harvest their wheat crop in March. Wheat cultivation is an important tradition in the region, with the renowned Al-Bur Al-Najrani wheat being a key ingredient in many traditional dishes. This year's harvest coincides with Ramadan, increasing demand for local wheat varieties. The government is supporting farmers through workshops, field visits, and sustainable agricultural development programs. Al-Samraa wheat, recognized by Slow Food for its nutritional value, plays a significant role in the region's food security and cultural heritage.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The agriculture sector in Dhamar province, Yemen, began forming field schools in several districts to enhance agricultural practices and...
records.description: The agriculture sector in Dhamar province, Yemen, began forming field schools in several districts to enhance agricultural practices and improve crop yields. These schools aim to provide farmers with essential knowledge and skills, from land preparation to harvesting. This initiative is part of an emergency agriculture program and is funded by the executive unit of the Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Management in Dhamar.
records.institution: The Agriculture Sector in Dhamar Province

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a national emergency campaign to treat livestock affected by foot...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources has launched a national emergency campaign to treat livestock affected by foot-and-mouth disease. The week-long campaign will deploy specialized veterinary teams to treat livestock in five governorates: Al-Mahwit, Al-Hodeidah, Hajjah, Dhamar, and Al-Bayda
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Morocco is embracing CRISPR gene-editing to improve agriculture and food security.
records.description: Morocco is embracing CRISPR gene-editing to improve agriculture and food security. Researchers at UM6P are exploring how CRISPR can make crops more resilient to climate change, following successful applications in East and West Africa. This technology could help address food insecurity and "hidden hunger" while boosting Morocco's agricultural exports. Public education is key to overcoming skepticism about CRISPR, and further investment in research and regulations will be crucial for its successful integration. Beyond CRISPR, other biotech innovations are already strengthening African agriculture.

records.title: Morocco is leading a drive for sustainable fishing in Africa.
records.description: Morocco is leading a drive for sustainable fishing in Africa. A new agreement between COMAIP and COMHAFAT, signed in February 2025, will harmonize fishing regulations across the continent, focusing on better practices, knowledge sharing, and tailored solutions. This initiative follows Morocco's 2023 support for fish stock assessments in several West African nations. Combating illegal fishing, which costs Africa billions annually, is crucial for protecting livelihoods and a key protein source. Morocco, a major fish producer, saw a 9% rise in landings in 2023, with strong growth in pelagic fish and exports.
records.institution: The Moroccan Confederation of Industrial Pelagic Fishing Shipowners (COMAIP), The Ministerial Conference on Fisheries Cooperation between African States Bordering the Atlantic Ocean (COMHAFAT)

records.title: The Nadorcott mandarin, a 100% Moroccan variety, has become a global success story, showcased at the 32nd edition of the "Fruit Logistica...
records.description: The Nadorcott mandarin, a 100% Moroccan variety, has become a global success story, showcased at the 32nd edition of the "Fruit Logistica" trade fair in Berlin. Known for its exceptional taste and ease of peeling, this Moroccan citrus variety, developed through domestic research, is now cultivated in several countries under license. It represents 50% of Morocco's total citrus exports and generates over 70% of the sector's export revenues, showcasing the potential for Moroccan agricultural products to compete on the global market.
records.institution: Association of Nadorcott Producers in Morocco (APNM)

records.title: A project to reuse treated water for irrigation has been implemented in Nablus, Palestine.
records.description: A project to reuse treated water for irrigation has been implemented in Nablus, Palestine. Funded by the Ministry of Agriculture and the German Development Bank, and in cooperation with the Nablus Municipality, the project aims to provide an alternative water source, reducing pressure on freshwater and improving agricultural resilience. Treated water from the Nablus West Station will irrigate over 2,000 dunums of agricultural land in several areas, producing 14,000 cubic meters of treated water daily. The project includes a treatment plant, a distribution network, and the provision of seedlings and fencing. The Wadi Al Shaer Water Users Association, established in partnership with the Ministry of Agriculture and the Water Authority, will manage water distribution.

records.title: In Jazan, the Indian almond is a significant seasonal agricultural product.
records.description: In Jazan, the Indian almond is a significant seasonal agricultural product. The region's warm climate provides ideal conditions for its growth. The almond season begins in February, with peak production occurring between June and July. Ripe almonds are prized for their soft texture and distinct almond flavor. The cultivation of Indian almonds offers significant economic opportunities for Jazan, including the development of packaging and marketing operations, the establishment of oil extraction factories, and the expansion of organic agriculture.

records.title: A 20-day food processing training course for 182 school activities specialists in Sana'a has concluded.
records.description: A 20-day food processing training course for 182 school activities specialists in Sana'a has concluded. Organized by the General Administration of Marketing and Agricultural Trade in coordination with the Ministry of Education, the course focused on processing local products into items like pickles, juices, and pastries. Officials emphasized the importance of using local crops to reduce imports and achieve self-sufficiency, highlighting the role of the economic empowerment program. The training covered both theoretical and practical aspects of healthy manufacturing, including drying tomatoes and garlic, and making sauces, jams, and juices. The goal is to promote food processing, improve food security, and enhance income for families.
records.institution: General Administration of Marketing and Agricultural Trade, Ministry of Education

records.title: A campaign to treat livestock for foot-and-mouth disease has been launched in Dhamar province.
records.description: A campaign to treat livestock for foot-and-mouth disease has been launched in Dhamar province. Funded by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources, the campaign is a response to farmers' requests to protect their livestock. Officials emphasized the importance of the campaign and the need for educating farmers on healthy livestock practices and disease prevention. Local livestock breeders expressed their gratitude for the Ministry's efforts.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: A meeting in Al-Bayda Governorate discussed preparations for an awareness and treatment campaign targeting foot-and-mouth disease in live...
records.description: A meeting in Al-Bayda Governorate discussed preparations for an awareness and treatment campaign targeting foot-and-mouth disease in livestock. Officials from various ministries reviewed the emergency intervention program and implementation plan, which will target seven directorates. Seven field teams will be deployed to educate livestock breeders and administer treatment, aiming to limit the disease's spread and reduce farmers' losses. Local authorities were urged to cooperate with the field teams to ensure the campaign's success.
records.institution: The Ministry of Administration and Local Development

records.title: A program to establish field schools for wheat farmers has been launched in Yifa'a village, Dhamar.
records.description: A program to establish field schools for wheat farmers has been launched in Yifa'a village, Dhamar. Funded by the Executive Unit of the Agricultural Projects and Initiatives Financing Department, the program includes awareness sessions and field training. A field school, comprised of 20 farmers, has been formed. The program aims to enhance agricultural activity and experience sharing, familiarizing farmers with modern techniques throughout the agricultural process. Farmers are encouraged to join cooperatives, reclaim land, and increase production to achieve self-sufficiency.
records.institution: Agriculture Sector Branch in Dhamar City Directorate

records.title: Alexandria Flour Mills (AFMC), a major Egyptian grain processor, reported a 10.7% drop in net profits after tax for the first half of fis...
records.description: Alexandria Flour Mills (AFMC), a major Egyptian grain processor, reported a 10.7% drop in net profits after tax for the first half of fiscal year 2024/2025, falling to EGP 27.620 million (US$549,182) despite a 16.7% revenue increase to EGP 176.547 million (US$3.5M). This revenue growth reflects strong demand and effective market strategies. AFMC's diverse product portfolio, ranging from bakery items to pasta and other foodstuffs, contributes to its stability. This downturn follows a strong 2023/2024 where profits rose 34.3%. The profit decline in H1 2024/2025 likely stems from rising grain import costs due to currency devaluation, inflation, and volatile global wheat prices, impacting AFMC's margins despite higher sales.

records.title: Libya and Morocco have signed a cooperation protocol in the field of fisheries and aquaculture.
records.description: Libya and Morocco have signed a cooperation protocol in the field of fisheries and aquaculture. The protocol aims to deepen cooperation through knowledge exchange, training, and research, enhancing the ability to achieve sustainable development in the maritime sector. Key areas of cooperation include the exchange of experiences, advanced technical training, and research and field studies. The Libyan Minister of Marine Resources emphasized the importance of this cooperation in enhancing Libya's capabilities in developing its maritime sector and achieving environmental sustainability.

records.title: Morocco is facing significant challenges due to drought, impacting the agriculture sector.
records.description: Morocco is facing significant challenges due to drought, impacting the agriculture sector. Rainfall this season is significantly lower than average, leading to decreased crop production. The government has implemented measures to support farmers, including providing seeds, fertilizers, and subsidized fodder for livestock. However, concerns remain about the export of water-intensive crops like avocados amidst the ongoing drought, highlighting the need for effective water management strategies and a shift towards more sustainable agricultural practices.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Maritime Fisheries, Rural Development and Water and Forests (MAPMDREF)

records.description: The 17th edition of the International Agricultural Show in Morocco (SIAM) will be held in Meknes under the theme "Agriculture and the Rural World: Water at the Heart of Sustainable Development." The event will address challenges related to climate change and water resource management, emphasizing sustainable and efficient agricultural practices. France will be the guest of honor, reflecting strong agricultural cooperation between the two countries. The exhibition will feature twelve thematic centers covering various agricultural sectors and is expected to attract over a million visitors, 1,500 exhibitors, and participants from 70 countries.

records.title: he Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the We Are the World Foundation, has provided 32.5 tons of barley fodder to six livestock...
records.description: he Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with the We Are the World Foundation, has provided 32.5 tons of barley fodder to six livestock farmers in the Umm al-Hamam site, Deir Ballut. This initiative aims to support farmers in these threatened areas by reducing the financial burden of livestock production, particularly given limited rainfall and restricted access to pastures due to occupation-related constraints. The fodder will also contribute to improved sheep health and productivity.

records.description: Al-Baha region plays a key role in Saudi Arabia's agriculture, producing diverse crops like Shadwi coffee, pomegranates, and almonds. records.title: The Sudanese government emphasized the importance of supporting agricultural investment in the country.
records.description: The Sudanese government emphasized the importance of supporting agricultural investment in the country.
