The project, spanning over 15,000 acres, cultivates wheat, clover, vegetables, and legumes, utilizing irrigation from the Nile and relying on electricity and solar energy for operation.

records.title: The UAE's Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) and the FAO have initiated a Food Control System Assessment.
records.description: The UAE's Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE) and the FAO have initiated a Food Control System Assessment. A five-day workshop in Dubai, with over 50 representatives from UAE Competent Authorities, marked the start of this evaluation. FAO experts led the workshop, training participants on the FAO/WHO Food Control System Assessment Tool. This tool assesses about 160 criteria, covering food safety policy, laws, inspections, risk management, and traceability, ultimately aiming to align the UAE's system with international standards and boost food safety and trade.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: An experiment analyzing and fermenting organic fertilizer from animal and plant waste has been launched at a model farm in Al-Jundiya Al-...
records.description: An experiment analyzing and fermenting organic fertilizer from animal and plant waste has been launched at a model farm in Al-Jundiya Al-Awliya, Al-Taiziya district, Taiz province. The experiment aims to demonstrate the feasibility and impact of this process on agricultural production. Officials and farmers attended the launch. A local agricultural extension director highlighted the benefits of fermented organic fertilizer over conventional methods, including complete decomposition, full plant utilization, absence of harmful side effects, and activation of beneficial soil organisms. The fermented fertilizer also helps loosen and aerate the soil and counteract the harmful effects of excessive chemical fertilizer use.

records.title: A regional conference in Algeria highlighted the importance of good governance and transparency in the agricultural sector to prevent cor...
records.description: A regional conference in Algeria highlighted the importance of good governance and transparency in the agricultural sector to prevent corruption. Participants emphasized the need for a strong will to implement procedural and practical measures to achieve transparency and combat corruption. The conference stressed the importance of collaboration between government ministries, the judiciary, and academic institutions. The agricultural sector was recognized as crucial for sustainable development and food security in Algeria.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.domain: Establishment or modification of food stock
records.title: Algeria is significantly expanding its grain storage capacity to enhance food security.
records.description: Algeria is significantly expanding its grain storage capacity to enhance food security. A new 100,000-ton silo, costing US$6.3 million, has been commissioned in Biskra. This is part of a larger government program launched in 2024 to increase national storage capacity to 9 million tons, up from the current 4 million. The initiative includes building 30 silos and 350 local centers. This expansion aims to better manage harvests, absorb surpluses, and secure supplies amidst fluctuating global markets, as Algeria imports 75% of its cereal needs. USDA forecasts predict record corn imports for animal feed in 2024/2025.

records.title: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply in Jordan has adjusted the selling prices of barley and bran for livestock breeders.
records.description: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply in Jordan has adjusted the selling prices of barley and bran for livestock breeders. The price of barley has increased for most livestock breeders, while remaining subsidized for sheep breeders. Similarly, the price of bran has increased for most livestock breeders, with a subsidized price maintained for sheep breeders. Additionally, an export fee has been implemented for live local sheep. These adjustments aim to balance the needs of livestock breeders while ensuring the sustainable management of agricultural resources.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Trade, and Supply

records.title: A study day on the wine industry was organized in Selouane, Morocco, to provide farmers with information on modern techniques for saving...
records.description: A study day on the wine industry was organized in Selouane, Morocco, to provide farmers with information on modern techniques for saving irrigation water and improving production. Key topics discussed included fertilization in viticulture, water rationalization, and state incentives for water-saving technologies. The meeting emphasized the importance of precision agriculture and efficient water management in the face of water scarcity, highlighting the need for continued training and support for farmers to adopt these techniques and improve their productivity.
records.institution: Association of Grape Producers in the provinces of Nador and Driouch.

records.title: Morocco has increased its wheat imports to ensure food security despite a significant drop in domestic production due to drought.
records.description: Morocco has increased its wheat imports to ensure food security despite a significant drop in domestic production due to drought. Wheat imports reached close to 63 million quintals in 2024, with a reduced import bill due to lower international wheat prices. Morocco imports wheat from various sources, including France, Romania, Germany, Russia, Poland, and the United States. The government intervenes to support domestic prices, and Morocco is increasingly looking to Russia for wheat supplies. By maintaining a three-month wheat stock and diversifying its import sources, Morocco aims to ensure food security and mitigate the impact of drought on domestic production.
records.institution: The National Federation of Mills, The Ministry of Agriculture and Fisheries

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with Oxfam and the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development, has launched a ser...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in partnership with Oxfam and the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development, has launched a series of awareness workshops for grape farmers in Hebron Governorate on agricultural insurance. The workshops aim to educate farmers about agricultural insurance, its components, and the risks facing grape cultivation. They will also cover the project itself, the Ministry's role in the insurance system, the link between insurance and financing, and the role of agricultural associations. The workshops, part of a pilot project testing agricultural insurance products, will continue throughout February 2025 in Hebron and Bethlehem Governorates. The project is funded by the European Union and implemented by Oxfam and the Palestinian Center for Economic and Social Development.

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: The 12th Qatar International Agricultural Exhibition (AgriteQ) 2025 highlighted the need for public-private collaboration, scientific res...
records.description: The 12th Qatar International Agricultural Exhibition (AgriteQ) 2025 highlighted the need for public-private collaboration, scientific research, and modern agricultural technologies to ensure sustainable food security. A forum on camel production and breeding emphasized camels' role in food security amid climate challenges. AgriteQ served as a platform for global knowledge exchange, reinforcing Qatar’s commitment to sustainable agriculture and food security.

records.title: The Al-Baha region in Saudi Arabia is a significant producer of pomegranates, with an annual output exceeding 6,600 tons.
records.description: The Al-Baha region in Saudi Arabia is a significant producer of pomegranates, with an annual output exceeding 6,600 tons. The region is home to approximately 700,000 pomegranate trees and is developing a new pomegranate city to further increase production. This initiative aligns with the National Agriculture Strategy and Vision 2030 objectives. Pomegranates are highly valued for their nutritional content and diverse uses, including juices, molasses, and oils. The region hosts an annual Pomegranate Festival to promote local production and connect growers with markets.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The global microgreens market is experiencing rapid growth, driven by consumer interest in nutrition, premium foods, and innovative farmi...
records.description: The global microgreens market is experiencing rapid growth, driven by consumer interest in nutrition, premium foods, and innovative farming methods. A UAE-based vertical farm is at the forefront of this trend, offering a wide variety of sustainably grown microgreens. These nutrient-dense greens are lauded for their potential health benefits. The company emphasizes freshness, growing locally and delivering rapidly to ensure a high-quality, flavorful product.

records.title: The Algerian Minister of Agriculture, Rural Development, and Fisheries , chaired a meeting with potato producers and seed multipliers to...
records.description: The Algerian Minister of Agriculture, Rural Development, and Fisheries , chaired a meeting with potato producers and seed multipliers to discuss the sector's restructuring. The meeting included representatives from key agricultural organizations, producers, and officials. Discussions covered the late-season potato harvest, seasonal cultivation, regulatory programs, and revising support for seed multipliers. It was agreed to regularize support payments by mid-2025 and organize workshops to address industry concerns. The initiative aims to boost national production and ensure the sector's stability and development.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Rural Development and Fisheries

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Egypt’s Finance Minister, highlighted the government's commitment to economic sustainability by integrating climate considerations into f...
records.description: Egypt’s Finance Minister, highlighted the government's commitment to economic sustainability by integrating climate considerations into financial policies, promoting green financing, and supporting businesses through tax and customs reforms. Industry leaders praised these efforts, emphasizing the need for sustainable agriculture, renewable energy investments, and decarbonizing supply chains. Collaboration between the private sector and the government was underscored as essential for fostering economic growth and resilience.

records.title: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture announced the free distribution of olive seedlings to government departments as part of efforts to enha...
records.description: The Iraqi Ministry of Agriculture announced the free distribution of olive seedlings to government departments as part of efforts to enhance olive cultivation. Iraq ranks among the top 30 globally and ninth in the Arab world in olive production. The ministry is implementing a national program to develop high-oil, food, and dual-purpose olive varieties while providing training for farmers. The initiative aims to increase the cultivation of high-yield varieties suited to the Iraqi environment, supporting both oil production and table olives.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture has published the average wholesale and retail prices for meat, vegetables, fruits, and milk to monitor price...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture has published the average wholesale and retail prices for meat, vegetables, fruits, and milk to monitor price movements and ensure fair pricing. This initiative helps prevent market manipulation and ensures a smooth flow of goods in the markets. The average prices will be issued weekly to provide transparency and support market stability.

records.title: Morocco, despite increasing domestic almond production, remains a significant importer of almonds, primarily from the United States.
records.description: Morocco, despite increasing domestic almond production, remains a significant importer of almonds, primarily from the United States. While domestic production is increasing, growing demand for almonds within Morocco necessitates continued imports to meet consumer needs. The United States dominates the Moroccan import market, accounting for nearly 99% of imports. Almond imports rank second among fruit and vegetable imports in Morocco, reflecting the growing popularity of almonds among Moroccan consumers.

records.title: In Oman, turmeric farming in Dhofar has experienced significant growth, with production reaching 136 tonnes over the past three years.
records.description: In Oman, turmeric farming in Dhofar has experienced significant growth, with production reaching 136 tonnes over the past three years. The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) has supported local farmers with modern irrigation tools, high-quality seeds, and market stability by purchasing their crops. A project aimed at expanding turmeric cultivation to new areas has seen increasing participation, with the second phase expected to yield 25 tonnes of fresh turmeric.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.domain: Unspecified measures for the management and conservation of natural resources
records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Bethlehem Governorate Agriculture Directorate and the Arab Agricultural Engineers...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in collaboration with the Bethlehem Governorate Agriculture Directorate and the Arab Agricultural Engineers Association, held field days to prune fruit trees in the towns of Battir and Husan. This initiative, part of the Sustainable Tourism Support Project, involved 83 farmers pruning almond, grape, fig, and pomegranate trees, along with 76 other farmers focusing on olive tree pruning. The project, supported by the FAO and UNESCO, is aimed at promoting sustainable agriculture and tourism in World Heritage sites, contributing to farmers' resilience and agricultural productivity.

records.title: Researchers at King Khalid University have developed an innovative method to process Hasawi rice waste into valuable industrial materials...
records.description: Researchers at King Khalid University have developed an innovative method to process Hasawi rice waste into valuable industrial materials like mesoporous silica, activated carbon, and graphene oxide. This eco-friendly approach reduces pollution from burning rice husk and straw while supporting industries such as glass, ceramics, biofuels, and water desalination. The invention, currently in the U.S. patent registration process, promotes sustainability and reduces reliance on imported materials.

records.title: Saudi’s Balady plans $303mln expansion to boost kingdom’s poultry sector
records.description: Saudi Arabia’s Balady has announced a $303 million five-year expansion plan to enhance poultry production, funded through surplus cash, government loans, and Sharia-compliant financing. The plan includes building a new factory, slaughterhouse, and hatcheries to support the kingdom’s food security goals. Almunajem Foods holds a 40% stake in Balady.

records.title: In collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform, the FAO has launched a training course in water quality monitoring...
records.description: In collaboration with the Ministry of Agriculture and Agrarian Reform, the FAO has launched a training course in water quality monitoring to strengthen the ability of local communities in Eastern Ghouta to adapt to climate change and water scarcity challenges.

records.title: The General Authority for Forest Management and Development has launched an afforestation campaign across 103 hectares of forest sites in...
records.description: The General Authority for Forest Management and Development has launched an afforestation campaign across 103 hectares of forest sites in the region. The campaign aims to rehabilitate forests damaged by fires and illegal logging in previous years and expand the green cover in these areas.
records.institution: The General Authority for Forest Management and Development

records.title: The Minister of State Domains and Land Affairs visited the Zaghouan region to address state property management and support regional deve...
records.description: The Minister of State Domains and Land Affairs visited the Zaghouan region to address state property management and support regional development. The visit included the distribution of land documents and the allocation of state land to public projects. The minister highlighted the importance of land regularization for development and social programs, and stressed the need to protect state-owned agricultural land. Efforts will be made to identify and reallocate vacant properties, and to combat land violations. The minister also visited an industrial zone intended to stimulate investment and create jobs. The visit concluded with a review of the regional directorate of state property, with calls for improved efficiency and revenue collection.
records.institution: The Ministry of State Domains and Land Affairs

records.title: Tunisia's fishery trade balance recorded a surplus of 387 million dinars (MDT) in 2024, a 1.4% increase from 2023, according to Onagri.
records.description: Tunisia's fishery trade balance recorded a surplus of 387 million dinars (MDT) in 2024, a 1.4% increase from 2023, according to Onagri. Exports reached 846 MDT, with Italy, Spain, and Libya as top markets, while imports declined by 1.1% to 459 MDT. Despite a slight drop in export volumes, prices rose, reflecting a strong demand for fish, crustaceans, and canned seafood, with most imports used for processing and consumption.

records.title: The 30th edition of Gulfood will be held at the Dubai World Trade Centre under the theme "The Next Frontier in Food".
records.description: The 30th edition of Gulfood will be held at the Dubai World Trade Centre under the theme "The Next Frontier in Food". It will feature over 5,500 exhibitors from 129 countries, showcasing more than 1 million products. The event will include networking opportunities, Discovery Tours, and insights from global leaders in food trade, sustainability, and culinary innovation.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The UAE has launched a 'Green Intellectual Property' road map to accelerate the development and adoption of green technologies.
records.description: The UAE has launched a 'Green Intellectual Property' road map to accelerate the development and adoption of green technologies. This initiative aims to prioritize and expedite the patent application process for inventions in the sustainability and environmental sectors, with a goal of reducing processing time to just three months. By streamlining the patent application process and creating a more competitive environment for green innovators, the UAE seeks to attract leading researchers and businesses to the country, further solidifying its position as a global hub for sustainable innovation.
records.institution: The Ministry of Economy and Chairman

records.title: UAE aims to triple the country’s food production by 2030
records.description: CBRE Middle East's latest report highlights the UAE's strong commitment to food security through investments in Ag-Tech, strategic trade agreements, and the 2051 Food Security Strategy, aiming to triple food production by 2030. The country is emerging as a key regional food processing and re-export hub, attracting global investors and addressing gaps in infrastructure, such as cold storage. Increased participation from institutional investors and policy shifts are driving growth, positioning the UAE as a leader in innovative food production and supply chain solutions.

records.title: The Food Technology Research Institute organized a practical program for university students on "Modern Technologies for Dates Packaging...
records.description: The Food Technology Research Institute organized a practical program for university students on "Modern Technologies for Dates Packaging and Manufacturing." The program aimed to train students for the labor market and encourage them to establish small and micro projects in the field of food manufacturing. The program highlighted the importance of the date crop in Egypt, which ranks first in the world in date production, and emphasized the potential of the date industry to contribute to economic and societal development and create job opportunities.

records.title: The International Agricultural Show in France has chosen Morocco as its country of honor for the first time.
records.description: The International Agricultural Show in France has chosen Morocco as its country of honor for the first time. This reflects the strong and longstanding cooperation between the two countries in agriculture. The Moroccan pavilion will showcase the diversity and quality of Moroccan agricultural products. The event will provide an opportunity for both countries to learn from each other's experiences in agriculture, particularly in terms of adaptation to climate change.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Food Sovereignty

records.title: The potato harvest in the Doukkala region of Morocco has concluded, but many producers are facing significant challenges.
records.description: The potato harvest in the Doukkala region of Morocco has concluded, but many producers are facing significant challenges. Despite decent yields and quality, high production costs, including the impact of drought and rising input prices, coupled with low selling prices, are leading to significant losses for farmers. The situation is exacerbated by difficulties in marketing the produce, with producers struggling to find fair prices for their harvest.

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: Jazan region in Saudi Arabia is renowned for its flourishing honey industry, driven by its diverse flora and favorable climate.
records.description: Jazan region in Saudi Arabia is renowned for its flourishing honey industry, driven by its diverse flora and favorable climate. Beekeeping is a vital part of the local economy, with over 4,000 beekeepers contributing to the production of more than 192,364 tons of honey annually. The government supports the industry through initiatives such as providing advanced beehives and training programs. The ministry aims to significantly increase honey production and achieve higher self-sufficiency in both honey and beehives by 2030. Jazan honey is highly valued for its superior quality and unique taste, driving both local and international demand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture

records.title: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) is committed to supporting small-scale fishermen in Saudi Arabia.
records.description: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef) is committed to supporting small-scale fishermen in Saudi Arabia. The program provides financing and training programs to enhance their capabilities, boost productivity, and improve income levels. Saudi Reef supports fishermen in various coastal regions, including Makkah, Madinah, the Eastern Region, Aseer, Jazan, and Tabuk. The program has supported some 2,000 fishermen and financed more than 5,000 fishing trips, exceeding SAR1 million in financial support. These efforts aim to enhance the sustainability of the fisheries sector and contribute to Saudi Vision 2030's goals for food security.
records.institution: The Sustainable Agricultural Rural Development Program (Saudi Reef)

records.title: A joint decree has been issued by the Tunisian Ministers of Agriculture and Finance, setting new remuneration rates for veterinarians per...
records.description: A joint decree has been issued by the Tunisian Ministers of Agriculture and Finance, setting new remuneration rates for veterinarians performing health mandates, specifically vaccinations. This follows a period of protest by veterinarians who argued that the previous rate of 0.45 dinars per vaccination did not cover their expenses, particularly in rural areas. They had requested an increase to 0.8 dinars. The decree comes after a controversy involving the dean of veterinarians, who was detained and later released after public outcry, for expressing the veterinarians' grievances.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, The Ministry of Finance

records.title: Citrus exports have significantly increased this season.
records.description: Citrus exports have significantly increased this season. Exports have jumped by 41.4% in volume and 33.5% in value compared to the same period in the previous season. Maltese oranges are a standout performer. The increase in exports is driven by a 5.2% increase in overall citrus production, particularly of clementines, Miski oranges, and Navel oranges. This positive trend indicates a promising season for the Tunisian citrus sector, confirming its dynamism and competitiveness in international markets.

records.title: The filling rate of dams in Tunisia reached 32%, with recent rainfall slightly improving the situation.
records.description: The filling rate of dams in Tunisia reached 32%, with recent rainfall slightly improving the situation. To address water shortages, the government is accelerating desalination plant construction, strengthening water transfers, developing new boreholes, and combating illegal water withdrawals. Despite these efforts, water resource management remains a challenge due to irregular rainfall and increasing water demand.
records.institution: SONEDE, The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries

records.title: The Tunisian Permaculture Association has launched a petition urging the Tunisian government to commit to an agro-ecological and food-sec...
records.description: The Tunisian Permaculture Association has launched a petition urging the Tunisian government to commit to an agro-ecological and food-secure future. The petition highlights the negative impacts of climate change and industrialized agriculture on the country's environment and food system. It calls for a transition to agro-ecological farming practices, supporting farmers' rights, and promoting food sovereignty.

records.title: Egypt aims to leverage its strategic location and expanding infrastructure to become a major global grain logistics hub, focusing on stor...
records.description: Egypt aims to leverage its strategic location and expanding infrastructure to become a major global grain logistics hub, focusing on storing and re-exporting Ukrainian grain to African markets. This was a key focus of a meeting between Egypt's Minister of Planning and Economic Development and Ukraine's Minister of Agrarian Policy and Food.
records.institution: The Ministry of Planning and Economic Development

records.title: Egypt is cultivating 2,000 acres of short-staple cotton in East Owainat to boost domestic production and reduce reliance on imports for t...
records.description: Egypt is cultivating 2,000 acres of short-staple cotton in East Owainat to boost domestic production and reduce reliance on imports for the textile industry. This project, now in its fifth year, involves collaboration between government entities and utilizes modern agricultural practices, including mechanical harvesting. The government aims to increase self-sufficiency in cotton, improve the quality of Egyptian cotton, and enhance the competitiveness of the textile industry through initiatives such as the cotton trading system and the modernization of ginning mills.
records.institution: The Ministry of Public Business Sector

records.title: Egypt is poised to increase its citrus exports due to climate-related production declines in competing countries like Spain and South Afr...
records.description: Egypt is poised to increase its citrus exports due to climate-related production declines in competing countries like Spain and South Africa. This has created a strong demand for Egyptian citrus in Europe, Russia, the Middle East, and emerging markets. Egypt's focus on high-quality production and strategic market expansion is expected to further solidify its position as a leading exporter of citrus fruits globally.

records.title: The Minister of Water and Irrigation in Jordan emphasized the importance of water harvesting as a crucial strategy for addressing the imp...
records.description: The Minister of Water and Irrigation in Jordan emphasized the importance of water harvesting as a crucial strategy for addressing the impacts of climate change and declining water sources. This includes implementing techniques like constructing small dams, rainwater harvesting systems, and groundwater reservoirs. The minister stressed the need for collaboration between institutions, government support, and private sector involvement to effectively manage water resources and highlighted the crucial role of dams in ensuring the sustainability of water resources in the face of climate change.
records.institution: The Ministry of Water and Irrigation

records.title: The Kuwait Dairy Company (KDCow) has unveiled a refreshed brand identity, including a new logo and packaging, under its new management.
records.description: The Kuwait Dairy Company (KDCow) has unveiled a refreshed brand identity, including a new logo and packaging, under its new management. The rebranding emphasizes the company's commitment to quality, purity, and support for local farms. KDCow partners with 37 local farms, sourcing 75% of its fresh milk locally, and aims to invest in advanced technologies and expand its product portfolio to meet evolving consumer preferences. This rebranding reflects KDCow's dedication to providing high-quality dairy products while supporting local agriculture and enhancing food security in Kuwait.

records.title: COPAG-Jaouda, a major player in the Moroccan agri-food sector, has launched Nabatlé, the first 100% Moroccan plant-based milk.
records.description: COPAG-Jaouda, a major player in the Moroccan agri-food sector, has launched Nabatlé, the first 100% Moroccan plant-based milk. Available in almond, oat, and coconut varieties, Nabatlé is positioned as a nutritious and accessible alternative to dairy milk, catering to those seeking healthier and more natural options. COPAG-Jaouda is deploying a comprehensive communication campaign to raise awareness about the benefits of plant-based milks and promote Nabatlé as a "Made in Morocco" product that meets international standards.

records.title: The Moroccan pavilion at Fruit Logistica 2025 will showcase the diversity and quality of Moroccan fresh produce, including citrus fruits,...
records.description: The Moroccan pavilion at Fruit Logistica 2025 will showcase the diversity and quality of Moroccan fresh produce, including citrus fruits, tomatoes, avocados, and early vegetables. With 33 exhibitors, the pavilion aims to strengthen Moroccan exports and promote the "Made in Morocco" label in the international market. Morocco Foodex will ensure maximum visibility for the pavilion through a modern and attractive booth and strategic advertising. The exhibition will provide opportunities for Moroccan exporters to network with international partners and stay informed about the latest industry trends.

records.title: The stock market plays a crucial role in financing the Moroccan agri-food sector, providing companies with the necessary resources for gr...
records.description: The stock market plays a crucial role in financing the Moroccan agri-food sector, providing companies with the necessary resources for growth and innovation. This was emphasized at a conference held in Rabat, where speakers highlighted the importance of stock market financing for sectors like agriculture and fisheries. The conference aimed to explore how the stock market can support the development of the Moroccan agri-food industry and enhance its competitiveness on the international stage.

records.title: The National Center for Vegetation Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) launched mangrove cultivation campaigns across the Ki...
records.description: The National Center for Vegetation Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC) launched mangrove cultivation campaigns across the Kingdom, coinciding with World Wetlands Day. These campaigns, involving voluntary planting activities, will take place in various regions, including Jazan, the Eastern Region, Madinah, Makkah, and Aseer. In Makkah region, NCVC aims to plant 1,000 mangrove seedlings on Jeddah's beaches to support biodiversity.
records.institution: The National Center for Vegetation Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC)

records.title: The Saudi flour milling sector is poised for significant growth, with anticipated policy changes allowing private mills to independently...
records.description: The Saudi flour milling sector is poised for significant growth, with anticipated policy changes allowing private mills to independently manage wheat imports and exports. This shift, along with the country's strategic location, modern infrastructure, and competitive operating costs, positions Saudi Arabia to become a major exporter of flour, particularly to East Africa and the GCC countries.

records.title: The Directorate of Agriculture in Idlib has initiated the distribution of fertilizer to local farmers as part of an in-kind loan project...
records.description: The Directorate of Agriculture in Idlib has initiated the distribution of fertilizer to local farmers as part of an in-kind loan project aimed at supporting wheat cultivation in the region. This initiative is designed to help farmers improve their crop yields and enhance agricultural productivity. It is part of ongoing efforts to address food security and boost local wheat production in Syria.

records.title: The UAE is witnessing a surge in agrotourism, with farms cultivating diverse produce like strawberries, blueberries, honey, and even mush...
records.description: The UAE is witnessing a surge in agrotourism, with farms cultivating diverse produce like strawberries, blueberries, honey, and even mushrooms. These farms are not only boosting agricultural production but also attracting visitors, contributing to the country's growing tourism sector. Innovative farming practices, such as hydroponics and automated irrigation systems, are enabling farmers to overcome the challenges of the desert environment. Agritourism aligns with the UAE's focus on sustainable and experiential travel, offering visitors unique experiences and contributing to the country's economic growth.

records.description: Egypt's agricultural exports reached a record high, with a 17% increase this year. The government is implementing strategies to further boost the sector, including addressing fragmented land holdings through contract farming, investing in land reclamation, promoting modern farming techniques, and supporting small farmers. These efforts aim to enhance productivity, maximize economic returns, and strengthen Egypt's position in the global agricultural trade.

These agreements demonstrate OMIFCO's commitment to social responsibility and aim to contribute to the sustainable development of the agricultural sector in Oman.

records.title: The Agricultural Development Fund of Saudi Arabia expects to approve SAR 7.4 billion ($2 billion) in loans this year, a 9% increase from...
records.description: The Agricultural Development Fund of Saudi Arabia expects to approve SAR 7.4 billion ($2 billion) in loans this year, a 9% increase from 2024. This funding will support key agricultural projects under the National Agriculture and Food Security Strategies, including increased financing for local production and modern technologies, support for supply chain and marketing projects, and funding for mergers and acquisitions within the agricultural sector. The Fund also provides loans to innovative start-ups and foreign investors operating in the Kingdom. These initiatives aim to boost local production, enhance food security, and increase the competitiveness of the domestic agricultural sector.
records.institution: Agricultural Development Fund of Saudi Arabia

records.title: The Minister of Industry, Mines and Energy announced that olive oil production in Tunisia is expected to reach a record high of nearly 36...
records.description: The Minister of Industry, Mines and Energy announced that olive oil production in Tunisia is expected to reach a record high of nearly 360,000 tons in the 2024/2025 season. During the 2023/2024 season, olive oil exports reached nearly 195,000 tons, valued at 5 billion dinars, with Tunisia positioned as the world's leading exporter of organic olive oil. Efforts are underway to diversify export destinations and increase exports of packaged olive oil. The CEO of the Export Promotion Center highlighted the success of packaged olive oil exports, with Tunisia ranking 4th globally. The reception aimed to enhance the international visibility and recognition of Tunisian olive oil.
records.institution: The Ministry of Industry, Mines and Energy

records.title: The Tunisian Solidarity Bank (BTS) will grant seasonal credits to farmers in the governorate of Zaghouan to finance the olive harvest.
records.description: The Tunisian Solidarity Bank (BTS) will grant seasonal credits to farmers in the governorate of Zaghouan to finance the olive harvest. records.description: The Al Wathba Honey Festival in Abu Dhabi is showcasing Emirati honey and beekeeping practices, with the participation of 100 beekeepers and 60 specialized companies. The festival aims to support local honey producers, enhance their expertise, and promote the unique qualities of Emirati honey. Rigorous quality control measures are in place to ensure the highest standards for Emirati honey. The festival reflects Abu Dhabi's commitment to sustainable agriculture and national food security.

records.description: The Moroccan date market is experiencing a shift towards Egyptian varieties, driven by factors such as production challenges in Tunisia and Algeria, and diplomatic tensions. While Morocco aims to increase domestic production, Egyptian dates are expected to maintain a strong presence in the Moroccan market due to their consistent quality and strategic trade practices.

records.title: Algeria has significantly increased wheat imports from Russia, solidifying its position as a key market for Russian grain exports.
records.description: Algeria has significantly increased wheat imports from Russia, solidifying its position as a key market for Russian grain exports. In 2024, Algeria imported a substantial volume of Russian wheat, placing it among the top wheat importers globally, behind major markets like Egypt and Turkey. This surge in imports aligns with Russia's overall increase in grain exports, which reached a record high in 2024 and are projected to further grow in the coming years, with wheat remaining the primary export. This growing reliance on Russian wheat strengthens the commercial partnership between the two countries.

records.description: IRSC and Sumitomo Electric Wiring Systems Egypt have partnered to install solar power plants on the rooftops of Sumitomo's industrial facilities. The first phase of the project will install 3.2 MW of solar capacity across facilities in three regions, generating an estimated 4.9 GWh annually and reducing CO2 emissions by approximately 52,700 tons per year. Construction is expected to be completed by Q2 2025. Both companies expressed enthusiasm for the project, highlighting its benefits for cost reduction, environmental sustainability, and alignment with Egypt's Vision 2030. IRSC plans to expand its solar energy solutions portfolio in Egypt.

These positive trends confirm Morocco's position as a major player in the European fruit and vegetable market.

records.title: Egypt's 2024/25 citrus season is projected to be a record year, with production estimated at 3.7 million tonnes.
records.description: Egypt's 2024/25 citrus season is projected to be a record year, with production estimated at 3.7 million tonnes. Exports are forecast to exceed 1.8 million tonnes, driven by demand from key markets. Lessons learned from overproduction in the previous season are being applied to ensure a more balanced and profitable year. Despite competition from Turkey and Morocco, and reduced export subsidies, Egyptian citrus exporters are optimistic, viewing the subsidy reduction as a positive change that will benefit those focused on quality and sustainability. Companies like Wadi El Nour are emphasizing sustainable practices like water management, soil health, and the use of organic inputs.

records.title: Moroccan citrus season started with challenges due to poor fruit quality and strong competition from California and Chilean citrus.
records.description: Moroccan citrus season started with challenges due to poor fruit quality and strong competition from California and Chilean citrus. This led to low prices in November and December. Hopes are now focused on the Nadorcott variety, expected to arrive soon. The Moroccan crop is considered "normal," with slightly smaller fruit but good quality, and should be available until late March or early April. The arrival of Nadorcotts and a potential gap in California citrus supply could improve market conditions, provided Moroccan volumes remain manageable.

records.title: Syngenta has launched five new zucchini varieties in Morocco, resistant to both the New Delhi virus (ToLCNDV) and the Moroccan Type Water...
records.description: Syngenta has launched five new zucchini varieties in Morocco, resistant to both the New Delhi virus (ToLCNDV) and the Moroccan Type Watermelon Mosaic Virus (MWMV). This announcement was made at a "Zucchini Day" event in Agadir. These new varieties offer increased resistance, adaptability, optimized yield, and a complete resistance package against other viruses like CMV, ZYMV, and WMV, as well as powdery mildew. The five varieties include Broncos (suited for open fields), Palladion (targeting MWMV), Alpha ND (targeting ToLCNDV), Delfos ND (ToLCNDV resistance with improved agronomic performance), and SCVE 22-2031 (combining resistance to potyviruses and ToLCNDV in open fields). This launch aims to provide concrete solutions to growing viral threats and promote sustainable and competitive zucchini production.

records.title: Oman and India held their 11th Joint Committee meeting to strengthen trade and investment ties.
records.description: Oman and India held their 11th Joint Committee meeting to strengthen trade and investment ties. Discussions focused on areas of mutual interest, including renewable energy (especially green hydrogen), technology, building on their strategic partnership and a recent high-level visit. Oman highlighted its Vision 2040 and its focus on sustainable growth. The committee explored ways to increase investment collaboration, noting existing investments from both sides. Key sectors discussed included energy (with an emphasis on green hydrogen and ammonia), agriculture and food security. Agreements were made to establish a joint investment fund for sustainable infrastructure, especially in renewable energy transport, and to discuss expanding banking cooperation, resolving tariff issues, and facilitating trade in agricultural products.

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with Agricultural Relief, has distributed a second batch of potato seeds (15 tons of the Spun...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture, in cooperation with Agricultural Relief, has distributed a second batch of potato seeds (15 tons of the Spunta variety) to 33 farmers in Jenin Governorate. Each farmer received enough seeds for 2 dunums of land. Funded by the Dutch representation, the project aims to improve livelihoods, food security, and economic growth by providing affordable potatoes and supporting farmer resilience. A total of 166 farmers in Jenin Governorate are benefiting from this project.

records.title: The Governor of Qassim Region praised the success of the Green Qassim Land Initiative, which has planted five million trees as part of th...
records.description: The Governor of Qassim Region praised the success of the Green Qassim Land Initiative, which has planted five million trees as part of the Saudi Green Initiative. He commended the efforts of government and private sector organizations, especially the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture (MEWA) and the National Center for Vegetation Cover Development and Combating Desertification (NCVC). The Governor highlighted the innovative use of confiscated materials in reforestation projects and the region's commitment to environmental protection. MEWA and NCVC officials detailed their collaborative efforts and future plans, including planting five million trees by 2030 and continuing land reclamation and seed scattering.

records.title: A livestock farm in Sharjah has imported 370 goats from Cyprus to improve the genetic quality of local breeds and contribute to food secu...
records.description: A livestock farm in Sharjah has imported 370 goats from Cyprus to improve the genetic quality of local breeds and contribute to food security. The imported goats are known for high fertility, twin production, and meat production, making them valuable for breeding programs. Experts believe the breed will adapt well to the UAE climate and are disease resistant. A specialized team will oversee the goats and implement artificial insemination experiments. The project also involves scientific research, specialist training, and the production of organic meat and dairy. The farm, the largest of its kind in the region, is committed to advancing agricultural practices and ensuring the sustainability and quality of local breeds.

records.description: A meeting of the Water Basin Committee in Dhamar province, chaired by the governor, discussed preserving water resources. The committee reviewed the Water Resources Authority's achievements, such as monitoring water levels and rainfall, reducing illegal wells, resolving water conflicts, and implementing water harvesting projects. They emphasized continued collaboration between authorities and security services to enforce conservation measures and ensure sustainable water use.

This ambitious target is supported by the expansion of agricultural land in the New Delta and the entry of new companies into the sector. Despite rising fertilizer costs, the government continues to provide subsidized fertilizers to small farmers, while domestic fertilizer factories contribute to meeting local demand.

The World Bank commended Egypt’s strides in air quality, waste management, and renewable energy investments, while Egyptian officials reaffirmed commitments to sustainability and climate resilience. Egypt also introduced its first transparency report, surpassing emissions reduction targets in the transport sector.

records.title: A boycott of Algerian dates has been gaining traction in Morocco due to ongoing diplomatic tensions between the two countries.
records.description: A boycott of Algerian dates has been gaining traction in Morocco due to ongoing diplomatic tensions between the two countries. This has shifted Moroccan date imports towards Egyptian and Tunisian dates, with Tunisia emerging as a major supplier. Tunisian date exports to Morocco increased significantly in 2024, reaching 19.7% of total Tunisian date exports, surpassing traditional markets like Italy and Turkey. Moroccan demand has boosted Tunisian export revenues. Morocco, a major date importer, is diversifying its sources, with the UAE, Egypt, Tunisia, and Algeria being key suppliers. As diplomatic tensions persist, Moroccan consumers and importers are favoring products aligned with their preferences and regional dynamics.

records.title: Recent media reports in France and Spain have criticized Morocco's relations with their governments and made unsubstantiated claims about...
records.description: Recent media reports in France and Spain have criticized Morocco's relations with their governments and made unsubstantiated claims about high cadmium levels in Moroccan fertilizers. These claims appear to be politically motivated, aiming to undermine Morocco's growing international support. However, Morocco consistently meets and exceeds EU regulations on cadmium levels in its phosphate fertilizers. Moreover, Morocco is actively engaged in supporting African agricultural development through initiatives like the Farmer Service Centers project in Rwanda. These efforts demonstrate Morocco's commitment to sustainable agricultural practices and its role as a responsible global supplier of fertilizers.

This versatile flour, enriched with essential nutrients, is suitable for various baking applications. Following its recognition as Oman's Most Powerful Manufacturing Brand, OFM is expanding its operations, including increasing silo capacity, developing food security projects, and supporting local wheat farmers. The company is also pursuing an ambitious growth strategy, exploring acquisitions in the animal feed and sweets and confectionery sectors, aligning with its vision to diversify its operations and contribute to the development of the Omani food industry.

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture in Syria stated that the agricultural sector's contribution to the country's GDP has declined to 12%, with la...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture in Syria stated that the agricultural sector's contribution to the country's GDP has declined to 12%, with labor contribution down to 15%, compared to 30-35% pre-revolution. This decline is attributed to weak investments, destruction of infrastructure, and a decrease in irrigated areas due to the destruction of irrigation projects. Syria's wheat stock is sufficient for five years, with annual needs estimated at three million tons. The minister outlined a plan to increase wheat production through modern irrigation, improved seed units, and adhering to fertilization equations. He also announced plans to export certain crops and establish partnerships with international organizations. The ministry is developing a plan to collect accurate data, acknowledging the inaccuracy of previous figures. The minister stated that Syria has six million hectares of arable land, with plans to invest in one to one and a half million hectares to support the sector.

records.title: The Tunisian Ministries of Agriculture and Trade are collaborating to ensure a stable food supply during the upcoming Ramadan, when consu...
records.description: The Tunisian Ministries of Agriculture and Trade are collaborating to ensure a stable food supply during the upcoming Ramadan, when consumption is expected to increase significantly. To address potential shortages of certain products, the government is implementing measures such as importing 10,000 tons of potatoes, utilizing late-season production and greenhouse crops for tomatoes, and increasing broiler chicken production. The Ministry of Trade is also building a buffer stock of eggs to meet anticipated demand.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Water Resources and Fisheries, and the Ministry of Trade and Export Development

records.title: The Tunisian Ministry of State Property and Land Affairs is continuing its support for renewable energy projects by providing land to the...
records.description: The Tunisian Ministry of State Property and Land Affairs is continuing its support for renewable energy projects by providing land to the Tunisian Electricity and Gas Company (STEG). The Ministry has already allocated approximately 900 hectares to STEG for its renewable energy production programs and about 2,600 hectares for concession-based renewable energy projects. Land reserves have also been allocated to the Ministry of Industry, Mines, and Energy for similar purposes. Land provision will be based on requests from STEG and other renewable energy companies. This action supports the state's renewable energy policy, aiming to find alternative solutions and improve electricity distribution services.

This aligns with the Dubai Quality of Life Strategy 2033, focusing on urban environment enhancement. Key initiatives included planting a diverse range of trees, including indigenous and ornamental species, and implementing 165 beautification projects across the city. records.title: UAE plant nurseries importing seeds or saplings need authorization from the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE).
records.description: UAE plant nurseries importing seeds or saplings need authorization from the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE). This involves obtaining an import permit before shipping, which requires specific documentation depending on the type of import (seeds/tubers, plants, etc.). All shipments are inspected upon arrival. Key documents include certificates of origin, phytosanitary certificates, and company authorizations. Specific packaging and labeling requirements apply to seeds. Certain plants from countries with specific diseases or pests are prohibited. The application process is online, involves fees, and permits are valid for six months. A valid agricultural activity license is also required.
records.institution: The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment (MOCCAE)

records.title: Edita Food Industries S.A.E.

The convoy includes trucks carrying medical supplies and equipment, medicines, ambulances, large quantities of food (dry and canned), water, juices, clothing, blankets, hygiene products, baby and elderly care items. Several government ministers, business leaders, artists, and NGO representatives were present at the launch. Simultaneously, the Tahya Misr Fund is holding a "Week of Goodness" in Asmarat, aiming to reach 20,000 vulnerable families. This initiative includes distributing clothing, shoes, personal care products, toys, household items, food, and meat; providing dowries for 100 brides; supplying mobility aids for people with disabilities; offering Braille tools; running a comprehensive medical convoy; hosting a youth employment forum; and holding a handicraft exhibition. All services provided during the Giving Week are free.

records.title: Azura Group and MM Packaging have won a WorldStar Award for their jointly developed, innovative, top-loading packaging made with a cellul...
records.description: Azura Group and MM Packaging have won a WorldStar Award for their jointly developed, innovative, top-loading packaging made with a cellulose film. This packaging is 100% plastic-free and complies with French AGEC regulations, which restrict plastic use in packaging. This award recognizes their commitment to sustainable packaging and demonstrates that innovation and environmental responsibility can be combined. The companies hope their solution will inspire others to adopt more ecological packaging choices.

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture visited the provinces of Tetouan and Chefchaouen to monitor and launch agricultural and rural development pro...
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture visited the provinces of Tetouan and Chefchaouen to monitor and launch agricultural and rural development projects under the Generation Green strategy. Plans for a future livestock market were also presented. The Minister also inaugurated the new headquarters of the Provincial Directorate of Agriculture of Tetouan. In Chefchaouen, the visit focused on the solidarity agriculture program. The Minister launched the planting of 500 hectares of carob trees (part of a larger 1,500-hectare, three-year program), distributed beekeeping equipment to local cooperatives (300,000 dirhams), and presented a 2025 rural track development program (60 km of tracks, benefiting 25,800 people, with a 63 million dirham budget).

records.title: A partnership agreement has been signed to boost beekeeping and honey production.
records.description: A partnership agreement has been signed to boost beekeeping and honey production. With international funding and local partnerships, the project will focus on training, financial aid, branding local honey, and improving infrastructure to strengthen the sector and its position in global markets. The agreement includes data collection, establishing centers, and providing equipment. Officials highlighted the sector's importance for food security and employment.

records.title: An urgent government project is providing aid to beneficiaries in a specific area who have been affected by attacks.
records.description: An urgent government project is providing aid to beneficiaries in a specific area who have been affected by attacks. Implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture, the project aims to support the livestock sector in marginalized and targeted areas affected by outside groups. Funded by a coalition and implemented by international institutions in cooperation with the ministry, the project aims to bolster the resilience of the local population. The aid, specifically livestock feed, helps reduce production costs for farmers facing limited resources and restricted access to grazing lands due to the ongoing situation, while also improving the health and productivity of their livestock.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) hosted "Renewables Talk" and "Women in Diplomacy" events to celebrate the International Day...
records.description: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA) hosted "Renewables Talk" and "Women in Diplomacy" events to celebrate the International Day of Clean Energy. Held at DEWA’s Sustainability and Innovation Centre, the events were organized by the Ministry of Climate Change and Environment and the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA). The events, launched by the UAE through its Permanent Mission to IRENA, aim to facilitate knowledge exchange and enhance communication within the renewable energy sector to drive a sustainable energy transition and achieve net-zero goals. "Renewables Talk" connects IRENA, its representatives, and the diplomatic community, while "Women in Diplomacy" highlights the role of women in the sector and fosters partnerships.
records.institution: Dubai Electricity and Water Authority (DEWA), The Ministry of Climate Change and Environment and the International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA)

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The 7th International Rain Enhancement Forum (IREF) is set to begin on January 28th.
records.description: The 7th International Rain Enhancement Forum (IREF) is set to begin on January 28th. Held under the patronage of Sheikh Mansour bin Zayed Al Nahyan and attended by Sheikh Theyab bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the forum highlights the UAE's dedication to addressing global water challenges through innovation. Organized by the National Centre of Meteorology (NCM) and the UAE Research Program for Rain Enhancement Science (UAEREP), the three-day event also marks UAEREP's 10th anniversary, honoring key contributors and launching the sixth award cycle. Global experts, policymakers, and researchers will discuss water security, weather modification, and advanced technologies, focusing on collaboration, innovation, capacity building, AI, and applied research.

records.title: A preparatory committee met in Sana'a to plan celebrations for the National Day of Yemeni Coffee.
records.description: A preparatory committee met in Sana'a to plan celebrations for the National Day of Yemeni Coffee. They approved programs including the Sana'a International Coffee Exhibition to promote Yemeni coffee globally. The Minister of Agriculture emphasized supporting coffee farmers with quality seedlings and modern technologies, highlighting coffee's importance as an economic resource and part of Yemen's heritage. The meeting stressed collaboration among stakeholders to ensure the success of these promotional initiatives.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.title: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has announced a guide price of $0.70 per kilo of fresh milk to support livestock breeders, ensure th...
records.description: The Lebanese Ministry of Agriculture has announced a guide price of $0.70 per kilo of fresh milk to support livestock breeders, ensure their continued operation, and enhance national food security. This decision follows meetings with dairy cattle breeders and dairy factory owners, where a mechanism was agreed upon to protect the interests of all stakeholders. The Ministry urges adherence to this guide price for the benefit of the sector and consumers. It also affirms its commitment to combating smuggling and fraud in dairy and cheese production to ensure adherence to Lebanese standards and product quality and safety, in cooperation with other relevant ministries and agencies.

records.title: The Minister of Agriculture has issued a decision setting conditions for importing potatoes for direct consumption and processing.
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture has issued a decision setting conditions for importing potatoes for direct consumption and processing. Key requirements include refrigerated transport for direct consumption potatoes, and specific packaging and shipping rules for processing potatoes from certain varieties. Importers must be licensed factories, and shipments will be tested for brown rot and ring rot diseases. The decision cancels conflicting previous resolutions and takes effect immediately.

records.title: Over three months into the Moroccan avocado season, nearly half of the crop remains unharvested due to initially low prices.
records.description: Over three months into the Moroccan avocado season, nearly half of the crop remains unharvested due to initially low prices. Many producers opted to wait, leveraging the avocado's ability to stay on the trees. This strategy appears to be working, as prices are now improving. The initial price drop was attributed to strong competition from Latin American avocados in the European market, combined with increased Moroccan volumes due to maturing trees. The remaining unharvested avocados are mostly large Hass variety, which is expected to command better prices. The local market is also important, absorbing a significant amount, especially with Ramadan and summer approaching.

records.title: Agricultural investments approved in the Kebili governorate reached 1.9 million dinars, benefiting 162 individuals.
records.description: Agricultural investments approved in the Kebili governorate reached 1.9 million dinars, benefiting 162 individuals. Over 500,000 dinars were allocated as grants, covering more than half of the approved projects. Additionally, 263,000 dinars were paid out to 111 beneficiaries. These projects span various agricultural activities, including drip irrigation, agricultural mechanization, agricultural rehabilitation, and livestock breeding. On average, each beneficiary received approximately 11,728 dinars in approved investments. The grant funding represented about 26% of the total approved investments. For those who received payments, the average payment was about 2,369 dinars.
records.institution: The Regional Commission for Agricultural Development ( CRDA )

records.domain: Promotion of farmer markets or community markets
records.title: The establishment of the Société des Marchés de Production du Centre (SOMAPROC) in Sidi Bouzid aims to enhance agricultural product distr...
records.description: The establishment of the Société des Marchés de Production du Centre (SOMAPROC) in Sidi Bouzid aims to enhance agricultural product distribution channels, strengthen national food security, and boost fresh produce exports. Classified as a strategic megaproject, it involves an investment of 116 million dinars and will serve as a pilot initiative for central governorates and a new export platform. The project includes a market for agricultural products, a livestock market, a red meat complex with an integrated slaughterhouse, and a logistics base. Located in Om Laadham, 11 km from Sidi Bouzid's center, it benefits from a strategic position near key transportation routes and industrial zones.
records.institution: the Société des Marchés de Production du Centre (SOMAPROC)

records.title: During a parliamentary session, Algeria’s Minister of Agriculture, provided updates on animal disease control, land regularization, and a...
records.description: During a parliamentary session, Algeria’s Minister of Agriculture, provided updates on animal disease control, land regularization, and agricultural development. Over 120,000 animals have been vaccinated, with an international tender launched to acquire more vaccines. A system for agricultural land regularization is set to be implemented before the end of 2025. The 2025 agricultural plan includes cultivating 60,000 hectares of sunflowers and expanding oilseed crops to 300,000 hectares by 2028. Efforts are also underway to enhance irrigation in Guelma, increase grain storage in Tiaret to 421,000 tons, and modernize agricultural production units. Additionally, over 1.1 million skins were recovered in 2024 as part of livestock sector improvements.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development, the National People's Assembly (APN)

records.title: Iraq is providing a significant amount of wheat to Lebanon to support its food security.
records.description: Iraq is providing a significant amount of wheat to Lebanon to support its food security. This contribution follows previous aid deliveries. The wheat will be transported overland, contingent on the situation in Syria. This action is part of broader Iraqi assistance to Lebanon. Iraq has also achieved record wheat purchases domestically, highlighting its focus on local production and reducing dependence on imports. This success is attributed to its agricultural and trade policies.
records.institution: The Iraqi General Grain Trading Company, The Ministry of Trade

records.title: Lebanon's Minister of Agriculture participated in a workshop to adopt the national plan for drought management, in cooperation with the A...
records.description: Lebanon's Minister of Agriculture participated in a workshop to adopt the national plan for drought management, in cooperation with the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development. This is Lebanon's first such plan, making it one of the last Arab countries to develop one. The workshop was attended by the Director General of the Arab Organization for Agricultural Development and numerous researchers and representatives from relevant ministries and institutions. The Minister emphasized the plan's importance given global desertification, drought, and warming, especially in light of Lebanon's recent challenges and the impact of regional climate change, including low rainfall and high temperatures.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, The Arab Organization for Agricultural Development

records.title: Moroccan orange exports to the US rebounded strongly in 2024, reaching record volumes after a decline in 2023.
records.description: Moroccan orange exports to the US rebounded strongly in 2024, reaching record volumes after a decline in 2023. Exports tripled compared to the previous year, exceeding the previous record set in 2022 by almost 10%, with revenues also reaching record levels. Since 2013, Moroccan orange exports to the US have become a consistent part of their trade relationship. In 2024, the US became the top importer of Moroccan oranges, representing over 40% of total exports, placing Morocco fourth among orange exporters to the US market.

records.domain: Fisheries and aquaculture measures and regulations
records.title: Oman and Yemen discussed enhancing cooperation in agriculture, fisheries, and water resources.
records.description: Oman and Yemen discussed enhancing cooperation in agriculture, fisheries, and water resources. Oman's Minister of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources met with Yemen's Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates to explore investment and partnership opportunities in food security projects. They also discussed fisheries and livestock issues and emphasized the importance of exchanging expertise and best practices to improve food security.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: Oman has successfully grown blueberry bushes for the first time in a mountainous region.
records.description: Oman has successfully grown blueberry bushes for the first time in a mountainous region. This initiative by the Ministry of Agriculture aims to diversify agriculture and promote sustainable farming by cultivating economically valuable crops suited to colder climates. The project involves growing specific blueberry varieties that require a certain number of cold hours to thrive. Sustainable practices like modern irrigation and organic fertilizer are used. The Ministry is also providing support and guidance to investors and farmers in this new agricultural endeavor.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Directorate of Agriculture in Tulkarm Governorate, in cooperation with the General Administration of Prevention and Agricultural Quar...
records.description: The Directorate of Agriculture in Tulkarm Governorate, in cooperation with the General Administration of Prevention and Agricultural Quarantine and the National Center for Agricultural Research, conducted a field tour of local avocado fields. The purpose of the tour was to collect samples from avocado trees to survey for Fusarium disease, which is spread by the Ambrosia beetle and threatens avocado crops. Specialists and researchers collected and examined samples to find practical solutions to combat the pest. This effort is part of a broader plan by the Ministry of Agriculture and the Directorate to monitor and protect agricultural crops from diseases, working in cooperation with relevant agricultural and research institutions.
records.institution: The General Administration of Prevention and Agricultural Quarantine and the National Center for Agricultural Research

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: Date production in Madinah increased by 31% in 2024, exceeding 343,000 tons, according to the Madinah branch of the Ministry of Environme...
records.description: Date production in Madinah increased by 31% in 2024, exceeding 343,000 tons, according to the Madinah branch of the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture. This growth has contributed to greater self-sufficiency and strengthened Saudi Arabia's food security strategies. Madinah hosted several date-related events in 2024, showcasing various date varieties from eight million date palms and highlighting local agricultural production and date-related industries.
records.institution: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: The UAE remains the top importer of Pakistani mangoes, importing $159.74 million worth over the past five years, according to Pakistan's...
records.description: The UAE remains the top importer of Pakistani mangoes, importing $159.74 million worth over the past five years, according to Pakistan's Ministry of Commerce. Total Pakistani mango exports over this period reached $632.003 million. Other significant markets include the UK, Kazakhstan, Oman, Afghanistan, and Saudi Arabia. The report highlights the unique flavor and quality of Pakistani mangoes and their contribution to Pakistan's economy. Demand in the UAE is driven by its diverse population, and projections indicate increasing mango production in the UAE itself.

records.title: Egyptian snack food producer Edita has partnered with Baghdad-based Tuama Jebur Abbas (TJA) to enter the Iraqi market.
records.description: Egyptian snack food producer Edita has partnered with Baghdad-based Tuama Jebur Abbas (TJA) to enter the Iraqi market. Edita acquired a 49% stake in TJA for $8 million and will establish its first local production facility in Iraq, shifting from an export model to local manufacturing. Over the next three years, Edita plans to invest $27 million to expand operations, double production capacity, and introduce its brands to Iraqi consumers. The partnership will form Edita Iraq, managed by Edita through a UAE-based holding company. The deal includes TJA's existing factory with cake and biscuit production lines, which will be upgraded. Edita's CEO described the venture as key to the company's growth strategy, citing Iraq's growing economy and untapped snack food market.

records.title: A new "ambitious" program will be launched soon to strengthen and reorient solidarity agriculture projects, focusing on the livestock sec...
records.description: A new "ambitious" program will be launched soon to strengthen and reorient solidarity agriculture projects, focusing on the livestock sector. This three-year program will benefit 84% of producers across the country, prioritizing livestock breeding areas in its first phase. The program aims to improve small farmers' access to affordable, quality feed, improve pastures through shrub planting, and increase livestock productivity. It also seeks to boost red meat production through improved breeding techniques in partnership with organizations like the National Association of Sheep and Goat Breeders (ANOC), improve small breeder incomes, create youth employment, and empower rural women.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Development, Water and Forests

records.title: Tensions have risen between Morocco and Spain over tomato exports, with Spanish farmers alleging that Morocco has exceeded duty-free impo...
records.description: Tensions have risen between Morocco and Spain over tomato exports, with Spanish farmers alleging that Morocco has exceeded duty-free import limits set by the EU-Morocco trade agreement (285,000 tonnes). Spanish farmers' organizations plan legal action against Moroccan importers for alleged tax fraud, claiming €71.7 million in unpaid import duties over the past five years. This dispute comes amid increasing protests in EU countries against Moroccan imports. Morocco's tomato exports to the EU in the fiscal year ending September 2024 totaled 528,773 tonnes, a slight decrease from the previous year, with France being the top importer. Spanish, French, Portuguese, and Italian producers complain that these imports are undercutting local prices.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: The Minister of Agriculture announced the launch of a program to support the transition to solar-powered irrigation over 51,000 hectares.
records.description: The Minister of Agriculture announced the launch of a program to support the transition to solar-powered irrigation over 51,000 hectares. The Agricultural Development Fund will provide financial assistance of up to 30% of equipment purchase and installation costs, with a maximum of 30,000 dirhams per project. In line with royal directives, all seawater desalination plants, such as the Dakhla plant (powered by wind energy and enabling irrigation of 5,000 hectares), will use renewable energy. Future projects aim for 20% of total agricultural energy usage to come from renewables, promoting climate-resilient agriculture.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries, Rural Development, Water and Forests

records.title: Blueberry trees have been successfully grown in Jabal Al Akhdar, Oman, by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources.
records.description: Blueberry trees have been successfully grown in Jabal Al Akhdar, Oman, by the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources. This initiative aims to invest in economically valuable crops suited to cold mountainous regions. The trees are grown on 1,000 sq. meters, with each plant producing 3-5 kg of fruit. The project includes 500 Southern Highbush blueberry plants of four different species from Georgia, chosen for their requirement of 200-400 chill hours (temperatures below 7°C), which Jabal Al Akhdar's climate provides. The harvest season is from May to the end of June.
records.institution: The Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources

records.title: The Ministry of Agriculture delivered 157 tons of livestock feed to 25 beneficiaries in the northern Jordan Valley areas of Ein al-Maytah...
records.description: The Ministry of Agriculture delivered 157 tons of livestock feed to 25 beneficiaries in the northern Jordan Valley areas of Ein al-Maytah and Makhul. This is part of an urgent response project by the government to provide relief to those affected by settler attacks. Implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture, under the directives of the Minister, the project aims to support the livestock sector in marginalized and targeted areas in the northern Jordan Valley affected by settler herds and Israeli occupation. The project, funded by the Protection Coalition and implemented by EU institutions in cooperation with the Ministry of Agriculture, aims to enhance the steadfastness of Palestinians in the West Bank and East Jerusalem.

records.title: Almarai, a Middle East food producer, plans to increase its poultry output by 35% this year as part of its multi-billion-dollar expansion.
records.description: Almarai, a Middle East food producer, plans to increase its poultry output by 35% this year as part of its multi-billion-dollar expansion. The company reported increased fourth-quarter and annual profits. They plan to increase poultry capacity from 250 million to 300 million birds and boost output from 200 million to 270 million per year, targeting 450 million processed birds by 2027. Almarai holds a 35% market share in Saudi Arabia's poultry sector, with 66% of its revenue coming from the Kingdom. The company launched a $4.8 billion five-year investment strategy last year to improve growth and financial performance.

records.title: Tunisian olive oil exports for the first two months of the 2024-2025 campaign reached 42,000 tons, valued at 683.9 million dinars, repres...
records.description: Tunisian olive oil exports for the first two months of the 2024-2025 campaign reached 42,000 tons, valued at 683.9 million dinars, representing a 7.4% increase in volume but a 30.6% decrease in value compared to the same period in 2023-2024. This resulted in a 35.4% drop in the average price (16.27 dinars/kg compared to 25.19 dinars/kg). In December 2024, Italy was the main destination (32.4%), followed by Spain (27.3%) and the US (13.3%). The CEO of the National Oil Office (ONH) projects a 50% increase in olive oil exports compared to the previous season's 195,368 tons (including 28,600 tons of packaged oil).
