records.title: SABIC, in collaboration with Napco National and FONTE, has introduced the first circular packaging project in Saudi Arabia, a significant...
records.description: SABIC, in collaboration with Napco National and FONTE, has introduced the first circular packaging project in Saudi Arabia, a significant step towards a circular plastic economy. FONTE's bread bags, manufactured by Napco National, utilize SABIC's certified circular polyethylene (PE), derived from pyrolysis oil generated from recycled post-consumer plastics. This innovative approach marks a milestone in Saudi Arabia's sustainable packaging journey, aligning with SABIC's TRUCIRCLE program to promote circularity in plastic usage and address environmental concerns.

records.title: Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan's recent visit to Iraq marks a significant milestone in bilateral relations, emphasizing strengthened co...
records.description: Turkish President Tayyip Erdogan's recent visit to Iraq marks a significant milestone in bilateral relations, emphasizing strengthened cooperation, particularly in addressing Iraq's water needs. The visit resulted in agreements covering various sectors and initiatives, including a 10-year deal on the management of water resources. This agreement aims to consider Iraq's requirements for access to scarce water resources, particularly from the Tigris and Euphrates Rivers that originate in Turkey.

records.title: The Housing and Utilities Projects Authority of Sirte branch is spearheading the largest water supply initiative spanning from Ras Lanuf...
records.description: The Housing and Utilities Projects Authority of Sirte branch is spearheading the largest water supply initiative spanning from Ras Lanuf in the east to Abu Qarin in the west, covering a distance of 348 kilometers. This project aims to address the longstanding water scarcity issue in the municipalities situated between these two regions. To achieve this goal, the authority is installing water tanks with storage capacities ranging from 1,500 to 5,000 cubic meters.
records.institution: Libyan Housing and Utilities Projects Authority of Sirte

records.title: Oman Flour Mills (OFM), a subsidiary of Oman Food Investment Holding Company (Nitaj), is embarking on an ambitious expansion strategy acr...
records.description: Oman Flour Mills (OFM), a subsidiary of Oman Food Investment Holding Company (Nitaj), is embarking on an ambitious expansion strategy across the Gulf region, eyeing acquisitions in various food-related sectors. With a diverse portfolio spanning grain imports, milling, bakery operations, and more, OFM aims to capitalize on growth opportunities within the food industry. Plans include venturing into the animal feed sector and confectionery business, with Atyab Investments spearheading acquisition processes. Additionally, Atyab Food Industries (AFI) is nearing the acquisition of a prominent bakery in Oman.

records.title: The Palestinian government has received its initial convoy of agricultural aid from Jordan, signifying a strengthening of bilateral ties...
records.description: The Palestinian government has received its initial convoy of agricultural aid from Jordan, signifying a strengthening of bilateral ties between the two nations. Hussein Hamayel, the Governor of Jericho and the Jordan Valley, praised the enduring Palestinian-Jordanian relationship and expressed gratitude for Jordan's support under the leadership of King Abdullah II. The meeting, attended by Jordan's Ambassador to Palestine Issam Bdour, Palestinian Agriculture Minister Rezq Salimia, and representatives from the agriculture sector and threatened areas in Jericho and the Jordan Valley, emphasized the significance of bolstering the partnership between Palestine and Jordan across various domains. Minister Salimia highlighted the Palestinian government's dedication to agricultural sector development and collaboration with brotherly nations like Jordan. The aid, amounting to 15,000 tons of grain, targets areas facing land confiscation threats, aiming to bolster the resilience of Palestinian farmers amidst challenges such as settler aggression and land seizures for settlements.

records.title: Qatar Charity has launched an automated bread production line in northern Syria as part of its ongoing efforts to enhance food security i...
records.description: Qatar Charity has launched an automated bread production line in northern Syria as part of its ongoing efforts to enhance food security in the region. This initiative, situated in the Afrin district, is a component of Qatar Charity's broader project, 'Support the Wheat Value Chain,' which has been ongoing for five years. The newly established bread production line has the capacity to produce 15,000 loaves of bread daily, catering to the needs of over 50,000 people, including those residing in displacement camps. The ultimate objective of Qatar Charity is to foster self-sufficiency among the crisis-affected population in northern Syria. Aref Mohammed Ali, Director of Services and member of the Local Council in Maabatli, expressed gratitude for Qatar Charity's contribution, emphasizing the importance of the automated bread production line in alleviating financial burdens and enhancing food security in the region.

records.title: Qatar Museums' Cultural Heritage Protection department has introduced the Al Zubarah Trashboom Project, an environmental initiative aimed...
records.description: Qatar Museums' Cultural Heritage Protection department has introduced the Al Zubarah Trashboom Project, an environmental initiative aimed at combatting ocean pollution and safeguarding Qatar's Unesco World Heritage Site. This project, launched on International Earth Day, utilizes Trash Booms strategically deployed along rivers, sea streams, and beaches to deflect, contain, and collect various pollutants, including marine waste and plastics. Supported by the Ras Laffan Industrial City Community Outreach Programme, the project repurposes collected waste material for fittings within the site and uses Trash Boom anchors as artificial reefs, enriching marine biodiversity in Al Zubarah Bay. This multifaceted approach aligns with Qatar's commitment to long-term sustainability and the preservation of its cultural treasures, enhancing the site's ecological footprint while addressing environmental concerns.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: ACWA Power, a prominent Saudi energy company renowned for its focus on renewable energy, has entered into a new agreement aimed at expedi...
records.description: ACWA Power, a prominent Saudi energy company renowned for its focus on renewable energy, has entered into a new agreement aimed at expediting the development of renewable energy projects in Azerbaijan. The agreement, finalized with SOCAR, the State Oil Company of the Azerbaijan Republic, builds upon an initial cooperation understanding signed in February 2023. This new deal primarily centers on the joint assessment of the "Low-Carbon/Green Fertilizer" project, wherein both entities will collaborate to evaluate the production of green hydrogen to support the decarbonization of SOCAR downstream assets. Marco Arcelli, CEO of ACWA Power, expressed pride in the collaboration with SOCAR, emphasizing the shared commitment to sustainability and the potential for driving innovation in renewable energy development in Azerbaijan. The agreement's main focus is to enhance SOCAR's carbamide fertilizer facility, aiming for the production of more value-added low-carbon products. As part of the project, feasibility studies will be conducted to assess the potential production and sale of green fertilizers, aligning with Azerbaijan's vision for a clean environment. ACWA Power will play a crucial role in advancing the renewable energy and green hydrogen production aspects of the project, leveraging its expertise in these areas. Anar Mammadov, vice president of SOCAR, highlighted Azerbaijan's commitment to building a sustainable future and underscored the significance of the partnership with ACWA Power in driving renewable energy development in the region. This collaboration marks a significant step in Azerbaijan's transition toward a low-carbon economy and demonstrates the commitment of both organizations to sustainable development practices.

records.domain: Renewable energy and energy efficiency measures
records.title: Abu Dhabi's clean energy company Masdar is considering entering the Chinese market to bolster its renewable energy capacity, aiming to re...
records.description: Abu Dhabi's clean energy company Masdar is considering entering the Chinese market to bolster its renewable energy capacity, aiming to reach 100 gigawatts by 2030. Evaluating potential partnerships and market strategies, Masdar recognizes China's significance in the renewable energy landscape, with the country installing 298 gigawatts of renewable energy capacity in 2023, according to the International Renewable Energy Agency.

records.title: The UAE and Colombia have completed the first phase of their Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), marking a significant m...
records.description: The UAE and Colombia have completed the first phase of their Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), marking a significant milestone in strengthening their trade and investment ties. The Ministry of Economy highlighted that both countries are actively working together to finalize the agreement's draft, with negotiations expected to conclude within three months. H.E. Dr. Thani bin Ahmed Al Zeyoudi, Minister of State for Foreign Trade, emphasized the strategic importance of the CEPA, noting Colombia's position as a key economy in South America and a potential gateway for UAE businesses. This agreement, the first of its kind between the GCC and Latin America, aims to expedite economic benefits for both nations and contribute to sustainable global growth. Under the CEPA, customs tariffs on various goods will be reduced or eliminated, market access will be enhanced, and cooperation in sectors such as hospitality, tourism, and agriculture will be expanded.

records.title: The UAE is investing in space technologies to enhance its capability to forecast heavy rains and floods, aiming to improve early warning...
records.description: The UAE is investing in space technologies to enhance its capability to forecast heavy rains and floods, aiming to improve early warning systems and support search and rescue missions during storms. By 2026, the country plans to deploy advanced space imaging and radar capabilities for continuous monitoring of Earth's surface. The SAR program, known as 'Sirb', will involve the development of a swarm of SAR satellites, making the UAE the first Arab country to do so. This initiative follows the urgency highlighted by the devastating floods in Fujairah in 2022, prompting the need for real-time monitoring and early warnings.

records.title: Iran and Qatar are poised to bolster their bilateral energy cooperation through the signing of new agreements, with a focus on integratin...
records.description: Iran and Qatar are poised to bolster their bilateral energy cooperation through the signing of new agreements, with a focus on integrating their electricity grids and expanding collaboration in areas such as wastewater and solar energy systems. Mojtaba Akbari, an official with Iran's Ministry of Energy, highlighted the efforts undertaken under the leadership of Leader Ebrahim Raisi to advance these initiatives. Iranian energy officials are set to visit Doha later in April to finalize these agreements, with skilled Iranian firms expected to play a role in the development of solar farms in Qatar. The Qatari Electricity and Water Company has already engaged in discussions with Iranian knowledge-based firms, signaling a promising avenue for collaboration between the two nations.

records.title: Egyptian fresh produce exporter Egypt Fresh Energy is gearing up for the upcoming watermelon season with significant investments in produ...
records.description: Egyptian fresh produce exporter Egypt Fresh Energy is gearing up for the upcoming watermelon season with significant investments in production expansion. Reham Kamal, the export and marketing manager, reveals that they have tripled their greenhouse acreage to 101 greenhouses, anticipating a production of 4000 tons of watermelons this year. Despite challenges such as high temperatures and potential water scarcity, Kamal outlines their proactive strategies to optimize yield and fruit quality. Advanced greenhouse technology, water-saving irrigation techniques like drip irrigation, and the cultivation of drought-resistant varieties are among their approaches. The main export markets for their watermelons are in Europe, with a focus on major supermarket chains in Germany and England. Additionally, they plan to expand their reach to Russia this year, emphasizing the importance of cultivating watermelon varieties in high demand to stay competitive.

records.title: FAO, in collaboration with Mauritania's Institut Supérieur du Numérique, has introduced REEFI, a mobile app designed to combat child labo...
records.description: FAO, in collaboration with Mauritania's Institut Supérieur du Numérique, has introduced REEFI, a mobile app designed to combat child labor in agriculture. Launched in January 2024, REEFI is an educational game that educates children about their rights and bodily needs while safeguarding them from risks in farm settings. Tailored to Mauritania's context, where child labor affects 37.6% of children aged 5 to 17, particularly in rural areas, REEFI aims to prevent children from missing school or engaging in hazardous work.
records.institution: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

records.title: Tabuk Agricultural Development Co.
records.description: Tabuk Agricultural Development Co. (TADCO) has entered into a non-binding memorandum of understanding (MoU) with NEOM Food Company (Topian) to collaborate on the development, construction, and operation of a hydroponic greenhouse for fruit and vegetable production in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia. As per the agreement, TADCO will allocate 100 hectares of agricultural land for the construction of a mid-tech hydroponic vegetable facility equipped with necessary water and electricity infrastructure in a suitable location in Tabuk. The company will also facilitate the sale of produce to Topian for distribution to supermarket, retail, and wholesale buyers in Saudi Arabia. Additionally, TADCO will provide warehousing, cold storage, labor, and other necessary equipment for the project, as well as oversee the construction process. On the other hand, Topian will be responsible for designing and installing the greenhouse, as well as offering technical expertise for its operation and maintenance.
records.institution: Tabuk Agricultural Development Co. (TADCO) & NEOM Food Company (Topian)

records.title: The United Arab Emirates and Costa Rica have solidified their trade and investment relations by signing a Comprehensive Economic Partners...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates and Costa Rica have solidified their trade and investment relations by signing a Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA), according to UAE President Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. This agreement, announced on social media, is expected to enhance bilateral trade ties between the Middle Eastern and Central American nations. CEPAs signed by the UAE are comprehensive free trade agreements encompassing investment and services clauses. Reports from the UAE's state news agency indicate that bilateral non-oil trade between the two countries reached $65 million in 2023, marking a 7% increase from the previous year.

records.title: In response to the recent rainfall and subsequent flooding in Bahrain, HRH Crown Prince Salman has taken decisive action to address the s...
records.description: In response to the recent rainfall and subsequent flooding in Bahrain, HRH Crown Prince Salman has taken decisive action to address the situation. He has directed the Ministry of Municipalities Affairs and Agriculture and the Ministry of Works to evaluate the damages caused by the floods and provide compensation to those affected. Additionally, he has instructed for the identification of areas most impacted by the rainfall and the implementation of sustainable infrastructure and drainage solutions to mitigate future risks. The Crown Prince expressed appreciation for the efforts of the ministries and other relevant authorities in their response to the flooding, emphasizing the importance of their continued collaboration in addressing this issue effectively.

records.title: Despite a significant drop in the price of flour, Egypt's attempts to lower bread prices have encountered obstacles as free-market bakeri...
records.description: Despite a significant drop in the price of flour, Egypt's attempts to lower bread prices have encountered obstacles as free-market bakeries have not adjusted their prices for customers. Despite government efforts to ensure a decrease in flour prices and implementing a three-month price control mechanism, independent bakers have not reduced the prices of loaves, sparking potential tension between authorities and bakers. While the government increased flour supplies and received financial injections to reduce flour prices by 15 to 25 percent, the prices of non-subsidized loaves, known as "tourists' bread," remain unchanged. Unlike subsidized bread, which is subject to fixed prices and government oversight, tourists' bread prices can vary, posing challenges in ensuring affordability for all segments of society. Factors such as rising rent rates and gas prices also contribute to the complexities of bread pricing, prompting some bakers to increase loaf weights instead of reducing prices in response to economic uncertainties.

records.title: Egypt has initiated the procurement of local wheat, aiming to gather 3.5 million tons of this essential crop during the 2024 wheat supply...
records.description: Egypt has initiated the procurement of local wheat, aiming to gather 3.5 million tons of this essential crop during the 2024 wheat supply season. Ali Al Moselhy, Egypt's Minister for Supply and Internal Trade, announced purchasing prices ranging from EGP 1,900 to EGP 2,000 based on purity level, ensuring payment within 48 hours. Silos and warehouses across governorates are prepared to accommodate the substantial wheat quantities supplied by farmers. Despite being Africa's top wheat producer, Egypt imports the majority of its wheat due to high domestic demand, importing 12 million of the 18 million tons consumed annually. While wheat procurement isn't obligatory this year, strict measures on wheat usage and transportation remain enforced, including bans on unauthorized transportation and use in fodder or fish farms. Private bakeries are prohibited from using local wheat without a permit, continuing reliance on imports. The government aims to boost local wheat production by 53% by 2025/2026 to reduce dependency on foreign markets, dedicating additional land to wheat cultivation and increasing procurement prices to incentivize farmers.
records.institution: Egyptian Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade
