records.title: Egypt’s Suez Canal Economic Zone has sealed a substantial $15.6 billion deal with major Chinese firms to drive green fuel production vent...
records.description: Egypt’s Suez Canal Economic Zone has sealed a substantial $15.6 billion deal with major Chinese firms to drive green fuel production ventures, projecting the creation of 9,000 job opportunities across 11 projects. This move reflects Egypt’s ongoing collaborations with global entities in generating green hydrogen and derivatives within the Suez Canal Zone. Recent fiscal years witnessed significant trade activity for Egypt, totaling $111.40 billion, notably involving the UAE, the US, China, and Saudi Arabia as primary trade partners. The country aims to boost its US dollar liquidity to $191 billion by 2026, a portion of which is expected from Suez Canal contributions, showcasing an upward economic trajectory with increased foreign investments and heightened Suez Canal activities.

records.title: The Minister of Fisheries and Marine Economy, Mokhtar El Houssein Lam, engaged in discussions with a delegation of investors from Premier...
records.description: The Minister of Fisheries and Marine Economy, Mokhtar El Houssein Lam, engaged in discussions with a delegation of investors from Premier Fishing and Brands Limited in South Africa, led by Mr. Soren Ramdin, on November 7, 2023, in Nouakchott. The South African investors expressed a keen interest in exploring investment opportunities within Mauritania. Their aim is to establish a factory in the fishing industries sector, focusing on enhancing the national marine wealth. The proposed investment intends to generate employment opportunities and elevate the value of Mauritania's marine resources through industrial development.
records.institution: Mauritanian Ministry of Fisheries and Maritime Economy

records.title: Qatar's Ministry of Municipality has spearheaded the development of a highly efficient irrigation system, curbing water use by up to 45%...
records.description: Qatar's Ministry of Municipality has spearheaded the development of a highly efficient irrigation system, curbing water use by up to 45% for date palm cultivation. This innovative system, part of the "Project to Develop Sustainable Production Systems for Date Palms," also introduced a third-generation Polycarbonate Drying House (PDH) to enhance date quality and reduce waste during the drying process. These advancements, overseen by the International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA), aim to optimize date production and address challenges faced by the date sector in the GCC. The ongoing regional workshop facilitated by ICARDA is aiding in sharing these advanced techniques and fostering knowledge exchange among experts from Qatar and other GCC nations to bolster date palm cultivation.

records.title: The Kurdistan Regional Government's Prime Minister, Masrour Barzani, inaugurated Iraq's largest cardboard and packaging factory, Fabyab,...
records.description: The Kurdistan Regional Government's Prime Minister, Masrour Barzani, inaugurated Iraq's largest cardboard and packaging factory, Fabyab, in Erbil. Emphasizing the pivotal role in advancing the agricultural sector, Barzani highlighted the facility's significance in offering crucial packaging and branding solutions to elevate Kurdish products' visibility globally. The factory, capable of producing one million meters of cardboard daily, aims to fulfill domestic needs and expand to export markets. Additionally, it has directly employed over 250 young individuals and indirectly generated thousands of jobs, bolstering employment opportunities in the region.

records.title: Indonesia has dispatched its initial consignment of aid for Gaza, marking the start of a humanitarian effort overseen by President Joko W...
records.description: Indonesia has dispatched its initial consignment of aid for Gaza, marking the start of a humanitarian effort overseen by President Joko Widodo and top officials. This shipment includes medical gear, food, blankets, and crucial water purifiers for Gaza's hospitals, responding to the dire needs amidst a Gaza blockade and devastating conflict. The president reiterated Indonesia's unwavering support for Palestinians amid the ongoing crisis, expressing a commitment to stand by them. Palestinian representatives thanked Indonesia for its consistent solidarity, emphasizing the nation's crucial role in supporting Palestine. The Indonesian people, proud of their country's commitment, express hope for a peaceful resolution and an independent future for Palestine.

records.title: Egypt’s government has heightened the local wheat procurement price from EGP 1,500 to EGP 1,600 per 150 kg in an effort to entice farmers...
records.description: Egypt’s government has heightened the local wheat procurement price from EGP 1,500 to EGP 1,600 per 150 kg in an effort to entice farmers to sell to the state. This move aims to bolster domestic production and lessen the need for wheat imports, a strategy previously implemented in April 2023 as well. Egypt, with one of the world’s highest wheat consumption rates, imports a significant portion of its 18 million-ton annual consumption due to its inability to meet local demands despite being Africa’s leading producer. President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi’s emphasis on expanding strategic crop cultivation, particularly wheat, prompted these measures. The government allocated 45 billion EGP for local wheat purchases, surpassing last year’s allocation by over 19 billion EGP. The recent purchase of 3.8 million tons aligns with their plan to acquire four million tons during this harvest season, signaling positive progress toward bolstering local wheat supplies.

records.title: The use of glyphosate in Moroccan agriculture has stirred significant debate, with regulatory bodies and experts closely monitoring its a...
records.description: The use of glyphosate in Moroccan agriculture has stirred significant debate, with regulatory bodies and experts closely monitoring its application. Despite being part of the country's agricultural practices for over two decades, the herbicide's usage has faced scrutiny, echoing the global discussions surrounding its potential health and environmental impacts. While the European Commission renewed its approval for glyphosate after a review indicated no major concerns hindering its reauthorization, environmental advocacy groups remain wary, citing potential adverse effects on crop nutritional value, consumer health, and the environment. In Morocco, glyphosate constitutes a minor fraction of registered pesticides and undergoes stringent regulatory oversight. The country maintains strict evaluation processes, involving multiple departments, to ensure compliance with international safety standards. Application protocols involve specific procedures to minimize unintended harm, with inspectors conducting regular checks and farmers receiving awareness campaigns on proper pesticide use. Despite these measures, comprehensive monitoring remains a challenge due to the vast number of farmers and the existence of an informal pesticide market. Moreover, Morocco has been proactive in its approach, banning certain glyphosate products associated with increased toxicity and actively participating in global chemical conventions to assess hazardous pesticides' inclusion.
records.institution: Moroccan National Office of Food Safety (ONSSA)

records.title: First Mills in Saudi Arabia reported a 4.5% revenue increase in the first nine months of 2023, driven by flourishing flour sales.
records.description: First Mills in Saudi Arabia reported a 4.5% revenue increase in the first nine months of 2023, driven by flourishing flour sales. However, their net profit took a 17.5% hit, largely due to financing costs tied to merging with Al Raha Al Safi. Excluding interest expenses, profits matched last year's figures. CEO Abdullah Ababtain highlighted stable revenues, double-digit margins, and upcoming ventures, like the PESA mill launch and other expansions, indicating a positive long-term outlook. With revenue reaching SAR 718 million driven by flour segment growth and a 97.2% third-quarter capacity utilization, First Mills aims to optimize costs, expand geographically, and delve into new downstream segments for sustained growth. They're actively progressing on projects like a PESA mill, pre-mix plant, durum mill, and Jeddah mill expansion, all expected to fuel future success.

records.title: Saudi Coffee Company Celebrates the Launch of its First Model Farm in Jazan
records.description: The Saudi Coffee Company has inaugurated its first Model Farm in Jazan, spanning a million square meters, aiming to set high standards for coffee farming in Saudi Arabia. With a target of growing five million coffee trees by 2030, the farm will implement global best practices to elevate the quality of Coffea Arabica and optimize water usage in the region. This initiative aligns with their ambitious goal of increasing annual coffee production from 300 to 2,500 tons by 2023, with an investment of SAR 1.2 billion over ten years. The farm serves as a platform for knowledge exchange, talent development, and the promotion of sustainable farming practices, offering opportunities for local farmers to access expertise and refine their techniques. Ultimately, the aim is to establish Saudi Arabia as a significant player in the global coffee market.

records.title: The Egyptian Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, Elsayed Elkosayer, has announced the release of 121,000 tonnes of animal feed...
records.description: The Egyptian Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, Elsayed Elkosayer, has announced the release of 121,000 tonnes of animal feed supplies from the country's port, valued at US$60 million. These supplies include 88,000 tonnes of maize, 33,000 tonnes of soybeans, and fodder additives. This release, which occurred between October 16, 2022, and October 26, 2023, aims to ensure the availability of essential ingredients for poultry and livestock feed production. It also aligns with President Abdel-Fattah Al-Sisi's initiative to expand the cultivation of oilseed crops, reducing import costs for animal feed supplies and bolstering the national economy. The government is actively promoting local production of these crops to enhance food security and reduce dependency on imports.
records.institution: Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: In a remote village in Iraqi Kurdistan, residents are turning to solar power to address electricity shortages.
records.description: In a remote village in Iraqi Kurdistan, residents are turning to solar power to address electricity shortages. Despite Iraq's significant oil wealth, it has struggled to provide sufficient electricity due to decades of conflict, sanctions, corruption, and crumbling infrastructure. In this Kurdish region, solar power has made significant progress after the local parliament introduced incentives to compensate households for excess electricity generation. While the region plans to build three commercial solar power plants, the country still relies heavily on fossil fuels, with over 98% of its electricity generated from non-renewable sources. Authorities aim to harness green energy to meet a third of the country's needs by 2030, but progress has been slow. Initiatives like the allocation of $750 million in low-interest loans for adopting solar power have faced challenges, including a "lack of solar culture." Despite these obstacles, the growing interest in solar power is seen as an opportunity to resolve Iraq's chronic electricity shortages.

records.title: The UAE and Jordan have penned a $2 billion MoU to bolster investment cooperation, focusing on infrastructure and development projects to...
records.description: The UAE and Jordan have penned a $2 billion MoU to bolster investment cooperation, focusing on infrastructure and development projects to strengthen their strategic partnership. The agreement, signed by respective ministries, aims to foster mutual economic prosperity through collaboration in sectors like renewable energy, industry, transportation, pharmaceuticals, and food manufacturing. Non-oil trade between the two nations has soared by 138 percent in a decade, reaching $4.47 billion by 2022, solidifying the UAE as a significant trading partner for Jordan. With a robust history of cooperation, both countries are committed to expanding economic ties, leveraging innovation, and digital transformation to elevate their economies through knowledge-based sectors. The Joint Economic Committee serves as a key driver in enhancing trade and investment flows, promoting economic growth and cooperation between the UAE and Jordan.
records.institution: Jordanian Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation

records.title: Qatar to Cut Water Use in Farming by 40% by 2030
records.description: Qatar is aiming for a 40% reduction in water consumption per tonne of crop produced by 2030 to enhance water security and promote sustainable agriculture. Dr. Delphine Acloque from the Ministry of Municipality highlighted the importance of water-efficient farming methods and emphasized the use of treated wastewater for animal fodder, aiming to achieve 100% utilization by 2030. Challenges persist, including infrastructure, financial considerations, and deciding optimal uses for treated wastewater. The region's unique climate and limited freshwater resources drive the need for innovative solutions, collaborations, and tailored technologies. Agricultural legislation is also advocated to support local producers and enhance market sustainability.

records.title: Microsoft has deepened its partnerships with Saudi Arabia's stc Group and Abu Dhabi's Agthia Group to accelerate digital transformation a...
records.description: Microsoft has deepened its partnerships with Saudi Arabia's stc Group and Abu Dhabi's Agthia Group to accelerate digital transformation across industries. stc Group, backed by the Public Investment Fund, and Microsoft have joined forces to deploy advanced tech solutions fostering digitalization in various Saudi industries. The collaboration aims to bring cutting-edge technologies, innovate business models, and support economic diversification. Agthia Group's deal with Microsoft focuses on utilizing artificial intelligence and Dynamics Retail solutions to enhance digital stores, drive innovation, expand market reach, and provide personalized experiences for customers. These alliances underscore Microsoft's commitment to advancing digital transformation and innovation in the region.

records.title: Saudi Arabia's industrial sector surged in September as the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources issued 174 industrial licenses, re...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's industrial sector surged in September as the Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources issued 174 industrial licenses, reflecting a significant increase from the previous month. This year, 969 permits have been granted, totaling investments of SR5.3 billion. Small enterprises led in funding, and the licenses were predominantly for national factories across various industries like manufacturing, food products, and rubber/plastic. Despite a slight drop in new factories starting production, Saudi Arabia aims to bolster its industrial and mining sectors, emphasizing their pivotal role in economic diversification away from oil dependency. Plans to increase mineral exploration investments signify the Kingdom's commitment to expanding its non-oil sectors for sustained growth.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Industry and Mineral Resources

records.domain: Legal and regulatory measures for consumer protection
records.title: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia introduced draft rules offering rewards up to SR50,000 for whistleblo...
records.description: The Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia introduced draft rules offering rewards up to SR50,000 for whistleblowers reporting violations of the Agricultural Law. The report channels are approved by the ministry, requiring specific details including the whistleblower's information, violation location, type, and supporting documents. A committee will assess the reports, verifying their accuracy and eligibility for rewards, considering factors like violation severity and effort by the informant. Confidentiality is ensured, with strict measures against false reporting, and the ministry has discretion in disclosing information and handling reports.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture

records.title: Americana, the Middle East's major restaurant operator boasting franchises like KFC, Pizza Hut, and Hardee's, revealed robust financials...
records.description: Americana, the Middle East's major restaurant operator boasting franchises like KFC, Pizza Hut, and Hardee's, revealed robust financials for the initial nine months of 2023. With a 7.1% surge in revenue, totaling $1.89 billion, and a noteworthy 15.8% rise in net profit, reaching $226.7 million compared to the previous year, Americana displayed substantial growth. The company, listed on both the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange and Saudi Tadawul, plans to expand its restaurant count by 250-260 in 2023, especially focusing on Saudi Arabia. Their solid financial standing allows for short-term capital needs coverage and sustains their dividend policy, buttressed by an adjusted free cash flow of $195 million and a cash conversion ratio of 66.3%. Despite geopolitical concerns affecting short-term performance, Americana remains optimistic about future business prospects, aiming to enhance profit margins through operational efficiency enhancements and normalized commodity prices. Despite setbacks like Lebanon's hyperinflation accounting and Egypt's currency devaluation affecting profits, the overall upward trajectory was propelled by growth strategies and operational streamlining.

records.title: The UAE's Ministry of Investment, led by Minister Mohamed Hassan Alsuwaidi, conducted a delegation visit to Egypt, signaling a commitment...
records.description: The UAE's Ministry of Investment, led by Minister Mohamed Hassan Alsuwaidi, conducted a delegation visit to Egypt, signaling a commitment to boost bilateral relations, enhance economic growth, and explore various investment opportunities. The UAE plans to increase its investments in Egypt, covering sectors such as clean energy, mobility, food and agriculture, pharmaceuticals, infrastructure projects, real estate development, and technology, among others. The visit included meetings with Egyptian officials and industry leaders to expand the UAE's investment presence in Egypt, furthering economic development efforts. Egypt has seen significant foreign investment from the UAE, with over 1,250 UAE companies operating in the country, and bilateral trade reaching $4.6 billion in the first 11 months of 2022, showing a 6.5 percent increase compared to 2021.

records.title: Egypt has introduced an initiative to exempt defaulting farmers from paying interest and fines related to delayed installments owed to th...
records.description: Egypt has introduced an initiative to exempt defaulting farmers from paying interest and fines related to delayed installments owed to the General Authority for Rehabilitation and Agricultural Development (GARPAD). This move, aimed at alleviating the financial burdens on farmers, was announced by Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation Al-Sayed El-Quseir. The initiative is set to benefit over 80,000 farmers, with a total amount of approximately EGP 500 million allocated for this purpose. The decision aligns with the directives of President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi to support and ease the financial challenges faced by farmers.
records.institution: Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Egypt has reduced natural gas supplies to fertilizer companies operating in the country by about 30% starting from October 27th.
records.description: Egypt has reduced natural gas supplies to fertilizer companies operating in the country by about 30% starting from October 27th. This decision was made due to the reduction in Israeli gas exports to Egypt as a result of the ongoing Israel-Hamas conflict. The affected firms were informed of this decision through official letters. Additionally, on October 29th, the Egyptian government announced plans to extend the duration of power outages across the country until weather forecasts return to normal.

records.title: Egypt's food industry has experienced an outstanding surge in exports, reaching a record high of $3.9 billion in the first nine months of...
records.description: Egypt's food industry has experienced an outstanding surge in exports, reaching a record high of $3.9 billion in the first nine months of 2023, marking a significant 14% growth compared to the same period in 2022. Arab nations notably contributed to this surge, accounting for 55% of the total value and exhibiting an impressive 21% growth. The European Union and non-Arab African countries also showcased increased imports from Egypt, contributing 17% and 8% respectively. Sudan emerged as the primary importer with a value of $393 million and a staggering growth rate of 164%. Yet, some countries, such as the United States, showed a decline in imports from Egypt, experiencing a 9% decrease in food product imports. This substantial growth aligns with the Food Export Council's strategies under Hani Berzi's leadership, focusing on diverse marketing initiatives and planning upcoming trade missions to multiple countries to further strengthen Egypt's food export capabilities.

records.title: Iran and Iraq have emphasized the importance of using their respective national currencies, the 'rials' for Iran and the 'dinar' for Iraq...
records.description: Iran and Iraq have emphasized the importance of using their respective national currencies, the 'rials' for Iran and the 'dinar' for Iraq, to enhance their bilateral trade relations. This decision was made during a meeting between Iran's Minister of Industry, Mine, and Trade, Abbas Aliabadi, and Iraqi Prime Minister Mohammed Shia' Al Sudani in Baghdad. The two sides discussed strengthening their bilateral relations, increasing mutual trade exchanges, and exploring opportunities for using national currencies in trade and financial transactions. During the meeting, they also expressed their readiness to expand cooperation in sectors like petrochemical industries and fertilizers, acknowledging the economic challenges in the region and the world.

records.title: Mauritania is set to regain its trade benefits under the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) starting January 2024 following notabl...
records.description: Mauritania is set to regain its trade benefits under the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) starting January 2024 following notable advancements in workers’ rights, as announced by the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative. AGOA, a U.S. trade initiative, focuses on fostering trade and investment relationships between the United States and sub-Saharan African nations. It aims to bolster these countries' economies through principles of good governance and free market competition. The program provides eligible countries with duty-free access to a wide array of over 1,800 U.S. goods and services. Mauritania, with an economy primarily rooted in subsistence agriculture, fisheries, and livestock industries, stands to benefit from this program's reinstated trade privileges.

records.title: Projects Launched to Boost Jubail Ports Capacity, Performance
records.description: In a bid to strengthen Saudi Arabia's transport and logistics sector, the Eastern Province recently unveiled strategic initiatives at Jubail Commercial and Industrial Ports. Led by Prince Saud bin Nayef Al-Saud, these efforts aim to significantly increase throughput capacity and upgrade infrastructure standards. The projects include a railway connecting networks, reducing congestion, lowering emissions, and enhancing shipping operations. These ventures align with Vision 2030's transport strategy, positioning Saudi Arabia as a global logistics hub. Additionally, plans involve a petrochemical hub and environmental initiatives, including planting thousands of trees. King Fahad Industrial Port, the world's largest industrial dockyard, handles diverse petrochemical products, while Jubail Commercial Port manages millions of containers annually, showcasing the region's logistical strength.

records.title: Saudi Arabia has launched a series of strategic development projects at Jubail Commercial and Industrial Ports to enhance capacity and up...
records.description: Saudi Arabia has launched a series of strategic development projects at Jubail Commercial and Industrial Ports to enhance capacity and upgrade infrastructure. Among the projects is a railway connecting the northern and eastern railway networks and integrating the internal railway network with Jubail Industrial City and its commercial ports. These initiatives aim to reduce congestion, lower the ports' carbon footprint, expand shipping operations, and increase port capacity. These developments will further establish Jubail as a modern petrochemical hub, supporting Vision 2030's goal of enhancing the national transport and logistics sector. Jubail Commercial Port has a significant role in handling various petrochemical products and other cargo, reinforcing Saudi Arabia's position as a global logistics center.

records.title: Saudi Arabia's National Aquaculture Group (NAQUA) is set to significantly expand its seafood production by over 400 percent in the next s...
records.description: Saudi Arabia's National Aquaculture Group (NAQUA) is set to significantly expand its seafood production by over 400 percent in the next seven years as part of Saudi Arabia's ambitious Vision 2030 plan to achieve self-sufficiency in seafood supply. Despite having access to rich fishing grounds, the country imported around 215,000 metric tons of seafood in 2020, and its domestic seafood market faces a supply deficit. NAQUA aims to increase its production from 60,000 metric tons to 250,000 metric tons, constituting 42 percent of the country's production goals. This expansion is facilitated by a partnership with the Saudi Agricultural and Livestock Investment Company (SALIC), a subsidiary of Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund, the Public Investment Fund (PIF). This initiative is crucial in helping Saudi Arabia meet its seafood production targets under Vision 2030.

records.title: The Saudi Public Investment Fund (PIF) is reportedly in advanced negotiations to purchase an undisclosed private Egyptian waste recycling...
records.description: The Saudi Public Investment Fund (PIF) is reportedly in advanced negotiations to purchase an undisclosed private Egyptian waste recycling company, aiming to finalize the deal by the end of this year or early next year, although exchange rate fluctuations between the Egyptian pound and the dollar are presenting valuation challenges. This move represents a separate effort from the PIF's previous attempts to acquire three other private Egyptian companies in real estate development, education, and health sectors, which were halted after an unsuccessful bid to purchase the United Bank from the Egyptian government. Since August 2022, the PIF has been expanding its presence in the Egyptian market, acquiring minority stakes in four listed companies, including EFG Hermes for Financial Investments and Digital Services, Abu Qir Fertilizers and Chemical Industries, Egyptian Company for Fertilizer Production (MOPCO), and Alexandria Container Trading.

records.title: Saudi Arabia and Turkiye witnessed a significant surge in bilateral non-oil trade, hitting $13.5 billion in the first half of 2023, marki...
records.description: Saudi Arabia and Turkiye witnessed a significant surge in bilateral non-oil trade, hitting $13.5 billion in the first half of 2023, marking an 87 percent increase from the previous year. Turkiye has become the UAE's fastest-growing trading partner, ranking sixth among its top international commerce allies, with more than 3 percent of the country’s total non-oil trade. The UAE's Minister of State for Foreign Trade led a delegation to Istanbul for the UAE-Turkiye Joint Economic and Trade Commission, aiming to further boost trade and investment. These discussions covered various sectors, including agro-food, healthcare, and infrastructure, with a vision to elevate non-oil trade to $40 billion in five years. The commission also facilitated MoUs between entities from both nations, highlighting the commitment to strengthen economic ties. Meanwhile, Turkiye witnessed growth in tourism income but faced challenges in manufacturing, with contraction observed for the fourth consecutive month.
records.institution: UAE’s Ministry of State for Foreign Trade

records.title: The UAE's investment in renewable energy projects across the Pacific Islands stands as a remarkable testament to international cooperatio...
records.description: The UAE's investment in renewable energy projects across the Pacific Islands stands as a remarkable testament to international cooperation for sustainability and climate action. With financial support from the Abu Dhabi Development Fund (ADFD), the UAE-Pacific Partnership Fund has contributed $50 million to fund 11 renewable energy initiatives, generating 6.4 megawatts of clean energy. These projects have not only significantly addressed the energy needs of the islands' populations but also yielded substantial benefits, including $3.7 million in diesel fuel savings and an annual reduction of 8,447 tons of carbon dioxide emissions. In their commitment to enhancing environmental resilience and global sustainability, these initiatives reflect the UAE's dedication to clean energy investment and supporting communities affected by climate change in the Pacific Islands.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has successfully launched a landmark 103.5-MW wind project across four locations, including Sir Bani Yas I...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has successfully launched a landmark 103.5-MW wind project across four locations, including Sir Bani Yas Island, Delma Island, Al Sila, and Al Halah, Fujairah. This accomplishment comes despite initial concerns regarding the region's low wind speeds. Abu Dhabi Energy Co., known as Masdar, played a key role in this achievement, and the project's economic viability was facilitated by advancements in climate technology and the discovery of a unique weather phenomenon generating high winds at night. Wind power's nighttime strength complements the UAE's existing solar power generation, enhancing the country's renewable energy mix. Masdar will continue collaborating with technology leaders and turbine manufacturers to further develop utility-scale low-wind-speed projects. This milestone reflects significant progress for the UAE's clean energy initiatives, which have historically relied heavily on fossil fuels for power generation. The UAE is striving to meet specific energy distribution targets as part of its National Energy Strategy, with a focus on renewables like wind and solar power.

records.title: NewCold Advanced Cold Storage Logistics, a company specializing in revolutionizing food storage and delivery, celebrated the grand openin...
records.description: NewCold Advanced Cold Storage Logistics, a company specializing in revolutionizing food storage and delivery, celebrated the grand opening of its $300 million facility in Lebanon. NewCold's highly automated 14-story warehouse uses innovative technology and software to handle over 100,000 pallets of food, contributing to a more efficient and sustainable food supply chain. With strategic technology adoption, NewCold has been instrumental in helping companies like ConAgra save costs and navigate the national supply chain. The facility's technology necessitates training for employees, providing opportunities for advancement and problem-solving-minded individuals. The company currently employs around 175 people in Lebanon. They have plans for expansion, aiming to double their warehouse size and reinforce Lebanon's role in food manufacturing and supply.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: Egyptian Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, El Sayed El Quseir, met with his Tunisian counterpart, Abdel Moneim Pilati, to enh...
records.description: Egyptian Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, El Sayed El Quseir, met with his Tunisian counterpart, Abdel Moneim Pilati, to enhance cooperation in trade exchange, seed production, applied research, and addressing climate change and water scarcity impacts. They also discussed salt-tolerant seed production and promoting the trade of citrus fruits, mangoes, dates, and olive oil, aiming to bolster the agricultural partnership between Egypt and Tunisia.
records.institution: Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Acme Intralog, a prominent warehousing solutions provider in the Middle East, is set to unveil advanced AI, automation, and robotic wareh...
records.description: Acme Intralog, a prominent warehousing solutions provider in the Middle East, is set to unveil advanced AI, automation, and robotic warehousing solutions customized for the food and beverage industry at Gulfood Manufacturing 2023. CEO Navin Narayan highlighted the increasing role of technology in the Middle East's food sector, emphasizing investments in food production and capacities. Acme Intralog's automation solutions, driven by AI and robotics, are expected to optimize storage space utilization and streamline supply chains. Notable successes include automated sorting solutions for supermarket chains and high-density storage systems for regional dairy manufacturers, enhancing efficiency and reducing human intervention. Visitors to Gulfood Manufacturing 2023 can experience Acme Intralog's innovative warehousing solutions and explore the future of the industry.

records.domain: Climate change mitigation and adaptation measures
records.title: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has taken the lead in climate tech funding in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) and Turkiye region,...
records.description: The United Arab Emirates (UAE) has taken the lead in climate tech funding in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) and Turkiye region, securing $401 million, which accounts for 62% of the total venture funding across 45 deals between 2018 and 2022, according to a report by MAGNITT. Turkiye and Saudi Arabia followed with $124 million and $68 million, respectively, in climate tech funding. The region has experienced substantial growth in venture capital (VC) activity, accumulating $651 million in funding across 225 deals over the past five years, with climate tech now constituting 5% of total VC funding, marking an 11-fold increase since 2018. The horticulture sector received the most venture funding at $288 million, with renewable energy at $118 million, and renewable energy led in terms of the number of deals, totaling 39 between 2018 and 2022.

records.title: UAE universities and higher education institutions are actively engaged in educating students about climate change challenges and encoura...
records.description: UAE universities and higher education institutions are actively engaged in educating students about climate change challenges and encouraging them to develop innovative environmental initiatives. The Universities Climate Network (UNC), consisting of 32 UAE-based institutions, has been established to engage youth and academia in the lead-up to COP28. The network is chaired by New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUD) and encompasses various universities such as Abu Dhabi Polytechnic, Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi, and Zayed University. NYUD will host the 2023 Student Energy Summit (SES), bringing together 650 young people from over 100 countries to explore energy topics and sustainability. In addition, Sorbonne University Abu Dhabi has launched initiatives like "Go Green 2023" and "Youth COP," aimed at raising awareness, developing students' skills, and promoting collaborative environmental research. Zayed University offers specialized academic programs in sustainability and environment, while the Anwar Gargash Diplomatic Academy, in partnership with Mubadala and ADNOC, has introduced the Centre for Climate Diplomacy, fostering climate research and supporting climate action through various objectives, including collaboration on research agendas, providing briefings, and forming partnerships. These initiatives are part of the UAE's commitment to environmental sustainability, especially as it hosts COP28.

records.domain: Local production of fertilisers and other agricultural inputs
records.title: Minister of Agriculture and Irrigation, Engineer Abdul-Malik Al-Thawr, officially launched the winter season potato crop harvest in the "...
records.description: Minister of Agriculture and Irrigation, Engineer Abdul-Malik Al-Thawr, officially launched the winter season potato crop harvest in the "Al-Mahalla" area of Dhamar. He highlighted Dhamar's significance as the second-leading governorate in agricultural production and the foremost in potato production. Al-Thawr emphasized Yemen's and Dhamar's natural advantages for producing potato seeds, particularly their elevated altitude above sea level.
records.institution: Yemeni Ministry of Agriculture and Irrigation

records.title: In accordance with the directives of President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, the Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, Mr.
records.description: In accordance with the directives of President Abdel Fattah El-Sisi, the Minister of Agriculture and Land Reclamation, Mr. El-Sayed El-Quseir, announced a plan to cultivate and reclaim over 500,000 acres of land in the Sinai region as part of the comprehensive development scheme for Sinai. He highlighted a plan to utilize the water from the Bahr El-Baqar drainage station and the El-Mahsama station, which is considered one of the best projects worldwide. The Ministry will also establish a unit for processing agricultural residues in Sinai, converting them into organic fertilizers. This plan involves the provision of agricultural machinery and tractors to improve the land for local farmers in Sinai. It will also involve collaboration with the Ministry of Irrigation to dig new wells, establish a well repair unit, and set up an olive oil press. Additionally, the program will focus on marketing agricultural crops. Minister El-Quseir emphasized the new Republic's focus on the well-being of the Egyptian people. The research program for integrating the people of Sinai into sustainable agricultural development aims to expand the community's access to the services provided by the Ministry of Agriculture, particularly in North Sinai, with a focus on the central Sinai region. Through this program, numerous initiatives are being undertaken, including providing a 750-egg incubator for use during the incubation period and offering other resources such as a water desalination station, planting aromatic and medicinal plants, distributing olive tree seedlings to families, supplying animal feed, and offering solar panels for lighting households in various communities across Sinai.
records.institution: Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture and Land Reclamation

records.title: Experts anticipate a remarkable 30 percent increase in local olive oil production compared to the previous year's harvest, a significant...
records.description: Experts anticipate a remarkable 30 percent increase in local olive oil production compared to the previous year's harvest, a significant development for Jordan's thriving olive industry, which boasts over 10 million olive trees and 150 olive mills. Olive Oil Producer and Mill Owner Syndicate Spokesperson Mahmoud Al Omari predicts that olive oil production is set to reach 30,000 tonnes, surpassing the approximately 23,000 tonnes produced in the previous year. Jordan converts about 80 percent of its olive production into oil and pickles the remaining 20 percent. The annual per capita consumption of olive oil in Jordan is around 2 kilograms, which is relatively low considering the country's olive oil production. Omari expects the price of a 16kg tin of olive oil to be approximately JD90, noting that global olive oil prices are currently increasing. The olive harvest season plays a crucial role in Jordan's economy and society, involving around 200,000 people, with additional job opportunities in related support sectors.

records.title: The Vice Chairman of the Riyadh Chamber of Commerce, Naif Abdullah Al Rajhi, praised Bangladesh's recent advancements in commerce and tra...
records.description: The Vice Chairman of the Riyadh Chamber of Commerce, Naif Abdullah Al Rajhi, praised Bangladesh's recent advancements in commerce and trade, emphasizing the potential for further economic development and asset diversification through bilateral business and investments between Bangladesh and Saudi Arabia. He expressed optimism that Bangladeshi investors would become substantial contributors to Saudi Arabian investments. This statement was made during a business meeting and B2B matchmaking session between the Dhaka Chamber of Commerce and Industry (DCCI) and the Riyadh Chamber of Commerce. To strengthen future business collaboration, the Riyadh Chamber of Commerce and DCCI signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) aimed at enhancing their robust bilateral trade relationship. They discussed various attractive investment opportunities in sectors like IT, agriculture, infrastructure, construction, energy, garments, ceramics, tourism, and hospitality, noting the vast potential for expanding business relationships. While the current bilateral trade stands at $2 billion, both sides believe there's significant untapped potential for growth.

records.title: Saudi Arabia and Oman are actively exploring ways to enhance their trade ties through collaboration in free zones and economic cities.
records.description: Saudi Arabia and Oman are actively exploring ways to enhance their trade ties through collaboration in free zones and economic cities. During a meeting between Nabil Khoja, Secretary-General of the Saudi Economic Cities and Special Zones Authority, and Ali Al-Sunaidy, Chairman of the Public Authority for Special Economic Zones and Free Zones in Oman, discussions revolved around investment opportunities in designated sectors, incentives and facilities for the integrated economic zone project in Dhahirah, and how these initiatives can contribute to increased trade volume between the two nations. The committee responsible for overseeing the development of the Dhahirah economic zone was also emphasized, as well as the importance of establishing an electronic platform connecting Omani and Saudi companies to leverage sector-specific advantages and promote investments in various areas, including renewable energy, petrochemicals, fisheries, medicines, and oil and gas spare parts.
records.institution: Saudi Economic Cities and Special Zones Authority

records.title: The Oman Vision 2040 Implementation Follow-Up Unit and the Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) are launching...
records.description: The Oman Vision 2040 Implementation Follow-Up Unit and the Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries, and Water Resources (MAFWR) are launching a two-week "food security lab" to bolster the food security sector in Oman. This initiative, conducted in collaboration with the National Programme for Investment and Export Development 'Nazdaher' and the National Employment Programme, aims to identify investment opportunities, address challenges, and propose effective solutions for food security. Dr. Masoud bin Suleiman al Azri, Director General of Planning, emphasized the focus on modern technology-based investments, job creation, economic diversification, and attracting local and foreign investments to enhance competitiveness, implement a food security strategy, and localize high-tech projects in line with Oman Vision 2040. The Food Security Laboratory operates on four key pillars: Investment, Local Content and Enablers, Food Security Strategy, and Modern Technology.
records.institution: Omani Ministry of Agricultural, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR)

records.domain: Unspecified policy for knowledge generation and dissemination
records.title: Oman and Saudi Arabia have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) in the field of the environment to promote sustainable development.
records.description: Oman and Saudi Arabia have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) in the field of the environment to promote sustainable development. The MoU was signed by Dr. Abdullah Ali Al Amri, Chairman of the Environment Authority in Oman, and Dr. Osama Ibrahim Faqeeha, Deputy Minister for Environment at the Ministry of Environment, Water, and Agriculture in Saudi Arabia. This agreement is intended to strengthen cooperation between the two countries in environmental matters and facilitate the exchange of environmental expertise, contributing to their shared goals of sustainable development.
records.institution: Omani Chairman of the Environment Authority

records.title: Farmers in the Daraa governorate of southern Syria are resorting to recording their deferred debts in U.S.
records.description: Farmers in the Daraa governorate of southern Syria are resorting to recording their deferred debts in U.S. dollars to mitigate losses caused by the continuous depreciation of the Syrian pound. In the past week, the exchange rate reached 13,700 Syrian pounds to the dollar. To protect themselves, farmers are now fixing the prices in dollars when selling crops before they are harvested. This shift is an attempt to safeguard their income, as sales operations lack legal mechanisms to protect farmers from fraudulent practices. In Daraa, it is customary to engage in "land guarantee" agreements, where merchants agree to purchase crops before harvest, paying in Syrian pounds over a few months. However, farmers are increasingly opting for the use of dollars to set prices, reflecting the unstable currency situation. This growing trend is causing concerns about the potential consequences for the agricultural sector in the region.

records.title: Tunisia, World Bank Seek Strategy to Preserve Sustainability of Food Security
records.description: Officials from Tunisia's Ministries of Finance, Agriculture, and Trade, along with a delegation from the World Bank, have engaged in discussions to formulate an action plan aimed at preserving food security sustainability and implementing strategies to combat drought. The meeting, attended by prominent government officials, emphasized cooperation with the World Bank, particularly concerning the influence of climate change on agricultural sectors, including grain production. The initiative reflects a commitment to address the challenges of food security and environmental sustainability in the face of changing climate conditions.
records.institution: Tunisian Ministries of Finance, Agriculture, and Trade

records.title: Baladna, Suez Canal Authority Sign US$1.5B Deal to Boost Dairy Production and Food Security
records.description: Qatar-based dairy production company, Baladna Q.P.S.C., has entered into a partnership with the Egyptian state-owned entity, Suez Canal, with the aim of enhancing food security and agricultural self-sufficiency in Egypt. The agreement, signed by Major General Wissam Al-Diasti, Advisor to the Chairman of the Authority, and Malcolm Jordan, CEO of Baladna, outlines a comprehensive plan with a total investment volume of up to $1.5 billion. Key initiatives within the deal include establishing a significant cattle farm with an initial capacity of 20,000 dairy cows, producing 300 million liters of fresh milk annually to boost Egypt's dairy production and food security. Additionally, the project involves cultivating a vast 113,000-hectare area in the New Valley Governorate "El Wadi El Gedid" to meet the project's feed and agricultural product requirements for both local consumption and export. The agreement received praise from Prime Minister Dr. Mostafa Madbouly for its potential to enhance food security, generate employment for Egyptian youth, and reduce external imports, thus saving foreign currency. Dr. Madbouly directed relevant ministries to expedite the necessary procedures for implementing the memorandum, aligning with Egypt's broader efforts to promote food industry localization, agricultural development, land reclamation, knowledge transfer, and technology adoption. Baladna's Managing Director and Board Member, Ramez Al-Khayyat, expressed excitement about the partnership and their readiness to invest in the project, emphasizing its contribution to agricultural sector growth and global food security. Lieutenant General Osama Rabie, Chairman of the Suez Canal Authority, highlighted the authority's role in diversifying income sources to enhance food security and achieve self-sufficiency, underscoring the significance of the partnership with Baladna. Malcolm Jordan, CEO of Baladna, expressed eagerness to work with the Suez Canal Authority, stressing the landmark agreement's potential to ensure food security and self-sufficiency in Egypt while strengthening economic ties between the two nations. The partnership is expected to have a substantial impact on the agricultural sector and global food security, with both parties committed to achieving the project's goals.

records.title: ENVI Lodges is set to open the first-of-its-kind ecolodge, ENVI Al Jabel Al Akhdar, in Oman through a partnership with Oman’s Ministry of...
records.description: ENVI Lodges is set to open the first-of-its-kind ecolodge, ENVI Al Jabel Al Akhdar, in Oman through a partnership with Oman’s Ministry of Defense Pension Fund. The sustainable mountain lodge, located in Al Jabel Al Akhdar, aligns with Oman’s National Tourism Strategy 2040. Expected to open in 2025, the lodge will feature 40 luxury expedition tents designed by Tenthouse Structure, equipped with insulation and heating systems for the winter season. The facility will offer a farm-to-table restaurant, private pools, a wellness center, library, and family-friendly amenities. Additionally, an adjacent events space will host community activities, including markets and food trucks. ENVI Lodges emphasizes environmental conservation and plans to minimize site impact. Efforts to regenerate the damaged environment will involve rewilding and promoting community involvement. Oman's tourism sector is experiencing significant growth, with visitor arrivals reaching 2.9 million in 2022, and the ministry anticipates 3.5 million visitors by 2024.

records.title: South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol and Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani have agreed to upgrade bilateral ties by establishi...
records.description: South Korean President Yoon Suk Yeol and Qatar's Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani have agreed to upgrade bilateral ties by establishing a comprehensive strategic partnership. This agreement will enhance communication channels in diplomacy, security, and the defense industry, while expanding cooperation in various fields, including infrastructure, agriculture, shipping, culture, and health. The memorandum of understanding also signifies a focus on defense industry cooperation, acknowledging Qatar's status as a significant defense importer. A total of 12 memorandums of understanding, valued at over $4.6 billion, were signed during the visit, covering various sectors, including LNG carriers, smart farms, solar energy, autonomous vehicles, cultural content, healthcare, and finance. The leaders also discussed the situation in the Middle East and global issues, strengthening their cooperation on regional and international matters. Qatar will work with the international community to address North Korea's nuclear and missile development. The Emir has accepted an invitation for an official visit to South Korea next year, and diplomatic channels will work out the details.

records.title: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has enlisted Berlin-based architectural firm Kéré Architecture to design the Oasis Agriculture Campus.
records.description: The Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU) has enlisted Berlin-based architectural firm Kéré Architecture to design the Oasis Agriculture Campus. This campus aims to revitalize traditional agriculture through local and sustainable techniques, providing education and support for the local economy and community. The project aligns with the Mohammed Bin Salman Initiative for Cultural Oasis farmers, a part of the journey through time masterplan for the city's regeneration. The community-focused campus will drive the regeneration of the Cultural Oasis, preserving heritage buildings while introducing new structures with traditional earthen architecture. The design by Kéré Architecture is expected to be unveiled in the first quarter of 2024, with the Oasis Agriculture Campus set to open in 2027. The Cultural Oasis District's revival is a significant endeavor for RCU as it regenerates AlUla, providing a venue for community events such as agricultural festivals and farmers' markets.

records.title: Emirati agribusiness, Al Dahra, is in discussions to acquire additional agricultural land in Egypt, potentially reducing Cairo's reliance...
records.description: Emirati agribusiness, Al Dahra, is in discussions to acquire additional agricultural land in Egypt, potentially reducing Cairo's reliance on staple crop imports but raising concerns about water usage. The talks involve Al Dahra's local subsidiary, Al Dahra Egypt, and the Egyptian Army's National Service Projects Organization (NSPO). While the deal's proximity remains unclear, it could involve substantial investments, primarily for desert reclamation and the cultivation of essential crops like wheat and corn. The arrangement might entail a gradual acquisition of 500,000 feddans (210,000 hectares) in Toshka, New Valley Governorate. Egypt, a significant importer of basic commodities, seeks to decrease its import costs due to foreign currency shortages, with wheat imports supporting heavily subsidized bread, a politically sensitive benefit. Egypt has reclaimed some desert land to feed its growing population but still cultivates only about 4% of its total land area. Al Dahra aims to expand its activities in Egypt and is open to sustainable agreements or partnerships. However, wheat cultivation in the desert raises concerns about water use, prompting some experts to advocate importing wheat from more suitable regions.

records.title: Korea's Agriculture Minister, Chung Hwang-keun, and Qatar's Minister of Municipality, Abdulla bin Abdulaziz bin Turki Al Subaie, have agr...
records.description: Korea's Agriculture Minister, Chung Hwang-keun, and Qatar's Minister of Municipality, Abdulla bin Abdulaziz bin Turki Al Subaie, have agreed to introduce cutting-edge smart farms to address the challenge of growing fresh produce in Qatar's desert climate. During their meeting in Doha, the ministers discussed collaborative research and development initiatives to implement smart farms in Qatar. These smart farms are seen as a promising solution for the country's quest to domestically produce vegetables, fruit, and livestock feed in a challenging environment. Minister Chung proposed that Korean companies specializing in smart farms and related industries participate in Qatar's efforts to introduce these facilities. Both ministers explored the possibility of joint investment in localized smart farm projects. Qatar is particularly interested in enhancing its food security by producing essential fresh produce locally. The discussions also involved the exchange of experts and researchers in the field of smart farming.

records.title: The 40th session of the Saudi Agricultural Exhibition, held in Riyadh, witnessed the signing of 16 agreements with investments exceeding...
records.description: The 40th session of the Saudi Agricultural Exhibition, held in Riyadh, witnessed the signing of 16 agreements with investments exceeding SAR 3 billion, along with three memorandums of understanding for exchanging technical and economic consultations. These agreements represent a significant step in enhancing agricultural development and stimulating investments in the sector, providing an opportunity to achieve self-sufficiency and strengthen food security, in alignment with the goals of Saudi Vision 2030. The exhibition serves as a vital platform for agricultural experts and decision-makers from both Saudi Arabia and other countries, accredited by the Global Association of the Exhibition Industry (UFI) and considered the largest event of its kind in the region, organized by Riyadh Exhibitions Company Ltd.

records.title: During the Fujairah International Conference on Bee Research, the Fujairah Research Centre (FRC) and Fujairah Environment Authority (FEA)...
records.description: During the Fujairah International Conference on Bee Research, the Fujairah Research Centre (FRC) and Fujairah Environment Authority (FEA) announced the signing of three Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with esteemed partners: The University of Science and Technology of Fujairah, Beekeepers Cooperative Association-Albaha, and UAE Beekeepers Foundation. This strategic collaboration focuses on innovation, research, and development, with a primary emphasis on joint projects in education and training programs related to beekeeping. The signatories are dedicated to preserving native bees, protecting the environment, water resources, and minerals, in alignment with the authority's strategic goals. The MoUs outline intentions for impactful research and development, beekeeping training, and capacity building, encompassing sustainable beekeeping, native bee conservation, ethical honey production, and practices supporting pollinator populations. Additionally, the collaboration extends to fields such as Environment Conservation, IT, Data Science & Computing, Artificial Intelligence, Renewable Energies, Underwater Robotics & Automation System, Computer Vision, and Video Processing. The parties will work on strategies for effective beehive health management, providing support and services on an equal basis.
records.institution: Fujairah Research Centre & Fujairah Environment Authority

records.title: Elite Agro Projects (EAP), a UAE-based agricultural engineering, procurement, and construction company, is in the process of establishing...
records.description: Elite Agro Projects (EAP), a UAE-based agricultural engineering, procurement, and construction company, is in the process of establishing a wheat farm in Ethiopia and a tea factory in Uganda. These projects aim to meet the growing demand for wheat and improve the livelihood of local farmers through agro-processing in Uganda. The wheat farm project in Ethiopia involves exporting part of the harvest to the UAE and selling the rest in Ethiopia, while the tea factory project in Uganda aims to increase the farm gate price for local farmers' products. Although the specific project values are not disclosed yet, the wheat farm project in Ethiopia is roughly estimated at $200 million. EAP is known for designing and executing open field and controlled environment agriculture (CEA) projects with varying levels of technology, providing agro-processing facilities and cold chain infrastructure. The company has successfully completed projects worth AED 800 million ($218 million) since its inception.

records.title: During President Yoon Seok-yeol’s state visit to Saudi Arabia, 46 MOUs and contracts were signed, boosting economic cooperation across se...
records.description: During President Yoon Seok-yeol’s state visit to Saudi Arabia, 46 MOUs and contracts were signed, boosting economic cooperation across sectors such as clean energy, electric vehicles, and smart farms. Notable deals include a US$15.5 billion project with KEPCO, POSCO Holdings, and Lotte Chemical to produce blue ammonia. Hyundai Motor Group partnered with Saudi’s Public Investment Fund for a joint venture factory producing 50,000 vehicles annually. In the financial sector, Korea Trade Insurance Corporation (K-SURE) and Saudi Aramco signed a US$3 billion cooperative memorandum. Preliminary figures indicate potential contracts worth over US$21 million, covering various industries, with support from KOTRA to facilitate actual exports and investments.
records.institution: Saudi Ministry of Trade, Industry, and Energy

records.title: Drone Well Services (DWS) has reached an exciting milestone with its expansion into the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, and the Kingdom of S...
records.description: Drone Well Services (DWS) has reached an exciting milestone with its expansion into the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, marking a significant advancement in drone technology across the Middle East. DWS, a global leader in drone services, offers a range of cutting-edge solutions, including Window Cleaning drones, Firefighting drones, Industrial Inspection Drones, and Cranes Inspection drones designed for ports and logistics. DWS is committed to revolutionizing industries with its state-of-the-art drone technology, prioritizing efficiency, safety, and environmental preservation. Notably, DWS has entered a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Emar Investments, a strategic partnership aimed at advancing Drone Technology for the European market, expanding the applications of drone technology into aviation and delivery drones. Sheikh Mohammed Adil, CEO of DWS, emphasizes the company's dedication to pushing the boundaries of drone capabilities, delivering innovative, sustainable, and safe solutions. DWS envisions a future where drone technology plays a pivotal role in various industries, offering efficient and eco-friendly solutions to address challenges.

records.title: Singapore and the UAE have solidified their commitment to climate change initiatives and climate-vulnerable nations ahead of the COP28 cl...
records.description: Singapore and the UAE have solidified their commitment to climate change initiatives and climate-vulnerable nations ahead of the COP28 climate conference. Eight agreements were signed during a meeting between Singapore's Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong and the UAE's President Sheikh Mohamed Bin Zayed Al Nahyan. Six of these pacts focused on climate change and digital technology, aiming to reduce emissions, adapt to climate change, and offer financial support to climate-vulnerable nations. Both nations pledged to reach net-zero emissions by 2050. Additionally, they emphasized the importance of climate finance to support developing countries and discussed cooperation in green economy, low-carbon energy, and food security. Singapore's "30 by 30" initiative and the UAE's food and agriculture strategy aim to reduce reliance on food imports. The UAE's COP28 presidency also strives to address climate issues related to food security and emissions.

records.title: During a Senate Agriculture and Irrigation Committee meeting chaired by Engineer Abdelsalam El-Gebli, discussions centered on a study pre...
records.description: During a Senate Agriculture and Irrigation Committee meeting chaired by Engineer Abdelsalam El-Gebli, discussions centered on a study presented by Deputy Mohamed El-Sabaai, addressing the challenges and incentives for enhancing the investment climate of Egyptian cotton farming, a historically significant crop in Egypt. The meeting aimed to gather insights from various stakeholders, emphasizing the importance of understanding the challenges faced by this strategic crop to improve its production, utilization, and overall contribution to the country's economy. The committee recognized the significance of implementing a contract farming system with a guaranteed price, ensuring stability in the cotton sector and protecting the interests of both farmers and cotton companies in the face of fluctuating global prices.

records.title: Solutions+, a subsidiary of Mubadala, recently collaborated with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority and the Mohamed Bin...
records.description: Solutions+, a subsidiary of Mubadala, recently collaborated with the Abu Dhabi Agriculture and Food Safety Authority and the Mohamed Bin Zayed City Municipal Presence Center to host a sustainability initiative at the Zayed Agricultural Center for Development and Rehabilitation. This effort focused on enhancing sustainability and environmental preservation by planting a variety of fruit trees, including mango, lemon, guava, pomegranate, and fig. Notably, this initiative aimed to reduce carbon pollution and combat greenhouse gas emissions while also emphasizing the preservation and planting of indigenous trees to support local biodiversity. It aligns with global efforts to address climate change, particularly in the context of COP28, and invites local communities to participate in sustainable land management practices, contributing to a more environmentally conscious and sustainable future. Solutions+ offers integrated facilities management, digital services, finance, and other services to clients across various sectors in the UAE, emphasizing innovation and quality results in their work.

records.title: Minya Governorate Launches the “You Are Able...Women Produce and Manufacture” initiative
records.description: The Minya Governorate has launched the "You Are Capable... Women Produce and Manufacture" initiative to empower women economically through training, support, and easy access to loans for small projects aimed at boosting family resources, reducing unemployment, and promoting local production, in alignment with Governor Osama Al-Qadi's commitment to advancing the role of Egyptian women in society. The initiative includes three phases, including awareness-raising, vocational training, and loan acquisition, with the involvement of various government agencies and civil society organizations.

records.title: During the "ASEAN Summit—Gulf Cooperation Council" in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Cambodian Prime Minister Dr.
records.description: During the "ASEAN Summit—Gulf Cooperation Council" in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Cambodian Prime Minister Dr. Hun Manet met with Sultan Abdulrahman Al-Marshad, CEO of the Saudi Fund for Development, on October 20. During the meeting, the CEO expressed congratulations to Hun Manet for his leadership and conveyed the fund's intention to provide financing to Cambodia, emphasizing the fund's role in promoting sustainable growth in developing countries, particularly in fields such as education, sports, health, and transportation. In response, Hun Manet welcomed the meeting and thanked the fund for its commitment to communication and financing. He also highlighted potential areas of cooperation between Cambodia and Saudi Arabia, with a particular focus on agriculture, investment, tourism, and renewable energy. Both leaders expressed support for a project to provide financing to the Cambodian Government for agricultural development and infrastructure construction, and Hun Manet extended an invitation to the CEO of the Saudi Fund for Development to visit Cambodia to discuss this matter further with relevant ministries and institutions.

records.title: Singapore and Saudi Arabia have announced their decision to upgrade their bilateral relations to a "strategic partnership." This signific...
records.description: Singapore and Saudi Arabia have announced their decision to upgrade their bilateral relations to a "strategic partnership." This significant development was reached following a meeting between Prime Minister Lee Hsien Loong and Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed Bin Salman on October 18. The move reflects the commitment of both nations to deepen their cooperation across various fields. They also discussed their support for Saudi Arabia's bid to host the 2034 World Cup and welcomed the progress made by the Saudi-Singapore Joint Committee. The areas of cooperation encompass economic, trade, and investment fields, energy, climate change, defense and security, fintech, environment, water, agriculture, food security, digital economy, innovation, connectivity, tourism, culture, youth, education, and health. Both countries also expressed their dedication to supporting international peace, security, and efforts to combat extremism and promote moderation, tolerance, and interfaith harmony. Prime Minister Lee invited the Crown Prince to visit Singapore, and the latter extended his best wishes to the Prime Minister and the people of Singapore.

records.title: UAE Consolidates its Global Position in Clean and Renewable Energy
records.description: The UAE is actively focused on clean and renewable energy as a fundamental pillar of its sustainability and long-term strategic priorities. Initiatives include plans to diversify energy sources and shift towards clean and renewable energy, especially nuclear power through the Barakah nuclear power plant. The UAE Energy Strategy 2050 has been updated to increase energy efficiency and triple the share of renewable energy by 2030. Moreover, there is a commitment to achieve financial savings and channel investments into sustainable energy to meet energy demand and sustain economic growth. The UAE seeks to lead in leveraging climate change mitigation solutions and reducing emissions to address climate change effectively. The UAE is also hosting COP28, an international conference focused on climate change and sustainable development, where global solutions will be crafted. Celebrating World Energy Day in the UAE is particularly significant as the country prepares for COP28, showcasing its commitment to sustainable and clean energy development. This aligns with the UAE's broader goals of hosting the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change and its strategies for clean energy production. Initiatives, such as the Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum Solar Park, are set to play a crucial role in achieving these clean energy targets, with the aim of providing 100% of Dubai's energy capacity from clean energy sources by 2050. These efforts also extend to desalination and electric vehicles, reflecting the UAE's commitment to transitioning towards clean energy sources, preserving natural resources, reducing carbon emissions, and ensuring a sustainable future for generations to come.

records.title: Egyptian Ministry of Agriculture Affirmed the Continuation of the National Campaign to Combat Rodents
records.description: The Deputy Minister of Agriculture in the Eastern Province, Engineer Hussein Ahmed Talaat, has affirmed the continuation of the national campaign to combat rodents in the province's centers and cities in preparation for winter crop cultivation. This effort aligns with the Ministry of Agriculture's policy to fight rodents and reduce their damage to agricultural crops, mitigating both health and economic risks. Rodents pose a threat to agricultural crops, fruit and vegetable gardens, grain stores, canals, livestock farms, public facilities, and factories due to their rapid reproduction capabilities. The campaign is currently being executed in agricultural associations across the province's various centers and cities. The agricultural associations have been equipped with the necessary materials for the campaign, which include placing them in the affected areas, canal bridges, water drains, palm groves, fields, and graveyards, away from residential areas to ensure the safety of citizens. Engineer Hussein Talaat stressed the importance of safeguarding the environment and human health, as well as supporting farmers through joint efforts to provide the necessary pesticides to enhance land fertility and intensify guidance campaigns for increased productivity, working in collaboration with relevant entities.
records.institution: The Deputy Minister of Agriculture in the Eastern Province

records.title: The Moroccan Sugar Company (Cosumar), a major player in Morocco's sugar industry, is preparing for the 2023/2024 sugar campaign with ambi...
records.description: The Moroccan Sugar Company (Cosumar), a major player in Morocco's sugar industry, is preparing for the 2023/2024 sugar campaign with ambitious goals to improve its performance. Cosumar intends to allocate 57,000 hectares for sugar plant cultivation in the upcoming campaign, marking a 23,000-hectare increase compared to the previous season. This allocation comprises 54,000 hectares for sugar beet and 3,000 hectares for sugar cane cultivation, distributed across various regions in Morocco. The expansion plan requires an investment of over $48 million, primarily for acquiring inputs and seeds, with the aim of producing 487,000 tonnes of white sugar in 2024, covering around 40% of the country's estimated sugar demand of 1.2 million tonnes per year, as per the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). Cosumar emphasized the critical need for continued access to irrigation water for achieving these goals. The company, established in 1929, operates eight industrial units in Morocco and has expanded its operations to include a refinery in Yanbu, Saudi Arabia, in a joint venture with Saudi partners. The Yanbu refinery serves the Saudi market and the MENA region. Approximately 20 to 25% of Cosumar's turnover comes from exports, and the company imports half of its raw sugar from Brazil while producing the remainder locally. With its ambitious expansion plans and a focus on export business, Cosumar aims to become a competitive regional agro-industrial player.

records.title: For the 2023-2024 agricultural season, the olive harvest in the governorate of Mahdia, Tunisia, is estimated to reach 120,000 tonnes, equ...
records.description: For the 2023-2024 agricultural season, the olive harvest in the governorate of Mahdia, Tunisia, is estimated to reach 120,000 tonnes, equivalent to 24,000 tonnes of oil. The local Authority for Agricultural Development has announced that the harvest season will take place from November 1, 2023, to February 29, 2024. Governor of Mahdia Abdelfattah Chakchouk has urged the timely opening of oil mills at the start of the season to ensure a successful harvest and to combat uncontrolled olive picking. He also called for a review of the reference price for olive oil, exploring subsidies for farmers, improving agricultural infrastructure, and enhancing safe transportation for women farmers to guarantee a smooth and high-quality olive oil production. The governorate of Mahdia boasts 160,000 hectares of olive groves, constituting 65% of the region's agricultural area, with 5.7 million olive trees, half of which are organic. In recent years, annual olive production has consistently reached 100,000 tonnes, supported by 230 oil mills in the region. This sector contributes 2 million working days during the olive harvest season.
records.institution: Tunisian Local Authority for Agricultural Development
